src: Die Kabinet het goedgekeur dat Suid-Afrika op 5 en 6 September 2013 die mede-gasheer van die “Leier van Verandering in die Stad”-konferensie is, saam met die Verenigde Nasies se Meslike Nedersettingsprogram.
tgt: Cabinet approved for South Africa to co-host the “Leading Change in the City” Conference with the United Nations Human Settlements programme (UN-HABITAT) on 5 and 6 September 2013.

src: Die fokus van die konferensie is vroue se deelname aan stedelike lewe in Afrika.
tgt: The emphasis of the conference is on women’s participation in urban life in Africa.

src: Die konferensie sal ’n platform bied vir Afrika om die uitdagings van verstedeliking voldoende aan te pak en die verstedeliking vir menslike ontwikkeling benut.
tgt: The conference will provide a platform for Africa to adequately address the challenges of urbanisation and harness urbanisation for human development.

src: Die Kabinet het die Konsep-Witskrif oor Families en die plan om dit in werking te stel goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Draft White Paper on Families and the Implementation Plan.

src: Die witskrif sal die Regering en ander belanghebbers in staat stel om die familie as wegspringplek vir die skep van gesonde gemeenskappe te gebruik.
tgt: Draft White Paper on Families will enable Government and other stakeholders to use family as the springboard for the realisation of societal well-being.

src: Die witskrif stel drie sleutel-strategiese prioriteite voor, naamlik die bevordering van gesonde gesinslewe, die versterking van familiebande en die behoud van families.
tgt: The White Paper proposes three key strategic priorities, Promotion of healthy family life, Family strengthening and Family preservation.

src: Die Kabinet het die finalisering en publisering van die tweede Nasionale Waterhulpbronstrategie goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the finalisation and gazetting of the second National Water Resource Strategy.

src: Hierdie strategie bou voort op die 2004 Nasionale Waterhulpbronstrategie.
tgt: This strategy builds on the 2004 National Water Resource Strategy.

src: Nasionale Waterhulpbronstrategie 2 bied ’n uiteensetting oor die rol van water in die ekonomie en identifiseer die spesifieke uitdagings, ontwikkelingsgeleenthede en optrede wat nodig is om ’n ooreengekome raamwerk vir die prioriteitsgebiede van die land saam te stel.
tgt: The National Water Resource Strategy 2 provides an analysis on the role of water in the economy and identifies the specific challenges, development opportunities and actions which inform an agreed framework for the priority areas of the country.

src: Die strategie poog ook om volhoubare, billike en veilige watervoorsiening te verseker vir ’n beter lewe en omgewing vir almal en om te verseker dat water doeltreffend bestuur word vir billike en volhoubare groei en ontwikkeling.
tgt: The Strategy 2 also seeks to ensure sustainable, equitable and secure water for a better life and environment for all and that water is efficiently and effectively managed for equitable and sustainable growth and development.

src: Die Kabinet het die verslag oor die Uitkomste van die 16de Vergadering van die Konferensie van Partye tot die Konvensie op Internasionale Handel in Bedreigde Spesies van Wilde Diere en Plante (CITES CoP 16) wat van 3 tot 14 Maart 2013 in Bangkok, Thailand gehou is, goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the report on the Outcomes of the 16th meeting of the Conference of Parties to the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES CoP 16), held in Bangkok, Thailand from 3 – 14 March 2013.

src: Die Kabinet het ook goedgekeur dat Suid-Afrika ’n handelsooreenkoms vir oorweging voorberei en by CITES CoP 17 wat in 2016 in Suid-Afrika plaasvind, indien.
tgt: Cabinet further approved that South Africa prepares and submits a trade proposal for consideration at CITES CoP 17 in 2016 in South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet het die uitnodiging van die Afrika-Ontwikkelingsbank van Suid-Afrika aanvaar om ’n lid van die Infrastruktuur-konsortium vir Afrika (IKA) te word, wat bekendgestel is tydens die G8 Gleneagles-beraad in 2005.
tgt: Cabinet accepted the invitation from the African Development Bank for South Africa to become a member of the Infrastructure Consortium for Africa (ICA) which was launched at the G8 Gleneagles Summit in 2005.

src: Suid-Afrika se grootskaalse belegging in infrastruktuur oor die medium termyn sal bevorder word deur sy lidmaatskap aan die IKA, veral ten opsigte van die ontwikkeling van data en kennisprodukte en die koördinering van ontwikkelingsbeleide tussen die G20 en Afrika-lande.
tgt: South Africa’s large investment in infrastructure over the medium term will be enhanced through its membership to the ICA especially in the generation of data and knowledge products and the coordination of development policies between the G20 and African countries.

src: Die Kabinet het goedgekeur dat die Suid-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap se Protokol vir Handel in Dienste aan die Parlement voorgelê word vir goedkeuring, ingevolge artikel 231 van die Grondwet.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Southern African Development Community (SADC) Protocol on Trade in Services to Parliament for ratification, in accordance with section 231 of the Constitution.

src: Die doelwitte van die protokol is om handel in dienste binne streke te liberaliseer op grond van billikheid, balans en wedersydse voordeel.
tgt: The objectives of the Protocol are to liberalise intra-regional trade in services on the basis of equity, balance and mutual benefit.

src: Die protokol stel ook ’n raamwerk uiteen vir die verslapping van handel in dienste tussen SAOG-lidstate en dien as ’n basis vir onderhandeling.
tgt: This Protocol also sets out a framework for the liberalisation of trade in services between SADC member states and serves as a basis for negotiations.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die bekendstelling van die Baccalaureus-graad in Meslike Ontwikkeling van die Departement van Hoër Onderwys in samewerking met die Nelson Mandela Meropolitaanse Universiteit.
tgt: Cabinet noted the launch of the Bachelor of Human Settlements Development Degree (BHSD) in partnership between the Department of Higher Education and Training and the Nelson Mandela Metro University.

src: Die graad is daarop gemik om doeltreffende menslike-nedersettings-bestuurders en-praktisyns op te lei wat die toepaslike kennis en vaardighede sal hê wat nodig is om volhoubare menslike nedersettings in Suid-Afrika te skep, te verbeter en te bespoedig.
tgt: The Bachelor Degree (BHSD) is aimed at developing effective Human Settlements managers and practitioners who will possess the relevant knowledge and skills necessary to create, upgrade and speed up sustainable human settlements development in South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle regeringsdepartemente, munisipaliteite en semi-staatsinstellings wat in Gauteng bedryf word om alle staatsvoertuie vir e-skyfies te registreer.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all government departments, municipalities and parastatals operating in Gauteng to register all state vehicles for e-tags.

src: Die Kabinet het die voorgestelde stappe om ‘n Agentskap vir Grensbestuur te vestig goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the implementation steps proposed for the establishment of a Border Management Agency (BMA).

src: Die agentskap sal migrasie, doeane en grenslynbeheer bestuur en die dienste van alle departemente by inklaringshawens doeltreffend koördineer.
tgt: The BMA would manage migration, customs and land border line control services and efficiently coordinate the service of all departments in ports of entry.

src: Die Departement van Binnelandse Sake sal die proses om die agentskap te vestig lei.
tgt: The Department of Home Affairs will be the lead Department in establishing the BMCabinet approved the following Bills for submission to Parliament.

src: Doeanebeheer-wetsontwerp, die Doeanebelasting-wetsontwerp, 2013 en die Doeane-en-Aksyns-wysigingswet, 2013 – Hierdie wetsontwerpe bied ’n grondslag vir die vergemakliking van internasionale handel en beskerming van die ekonomie en samelewing en skep sodoende ’n balans tussen doeanebeheer en makliker handel.
tgt: Customs Control Bill (CCB), the Customs Duty Bill, 2013 (CDB) and the Customs and Excise Amendment Act, 2013 (CEAA) - The Bills provides a foundation for the facilitation of international trade and protection of the economy and society, thereby creating a balance between customs control and trade facilitation Water Research Amendment Bill - The Amendment aims to bring it in line with major changes in institutions, policy, water science and legal environment and also to increase the Water Research Commission’s contribution to the water research needs of South Africa and to ensure that the country is strategically placed to respond to the needs and challenges of an arid country like South Africa.

src: Waternavorsing-wysigingswet – Hierdie wysiging is daarop gemik om die wet in lyn te bring met grootskaalse veranderinge met betrekking tot instansies, beleid, waterwetenskap en die regsomgewing en ook om die Waternavorsingskommissie se bydra tot Suid-Afrika se waternavorsingsbehoeftes te verbeter, asook om te verseker dat die land strategies reg geposisioneer is om die behoeftes en probleme van ’n droë land soos Suid-Afrika die hoof te bied.
tgt: National Environmental Management Laws Amendment Bill, 2013 - The bill proposes amendments to certain provisions under the National Environmental Management Act, 1998 (Act No.

src: Nasionale Omgewingsbestuur-wysigingswet, 2013 – Die konsepwet stel wysigings aan sekere bepalings voor kragtens die Nasionale Omgewingsbestuurswet, 1998 (Wet 107 of 1998) en verseker verder dat die land se natuurlike hulpbronne beskerm word vir huidige en toekomstige generasies, soos beoog deur die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan.
tgt: 107 of 1998) and further ensure that the country’s natural resources are protected for current and future generation as contemplated by the National Development Plan (NDP).

src: Konsep-wysigingswet op Nasionale Omgewingsbestuur: Luggehalte, 2013 - Die konsepwet stel wysigings voor aan sekere bepalings kragtens die Nasionale Omgewingsbestuurswet: Luggehalte, 2004, wat luggehalte in die land reguleer deur redelike maatreëls daar te stel vir die voorkoming van besoedeling en ekologiese agteruitgang terwyl dit geregverdigde ekonomiese en maatskaplike ontwikkeling bevorder.
tgt: Draft National Environmental Management: Air Quality Amendment Bill, 2013 - This Bill amends certain provisions under the National Environmental Management: Air Quality Act, 2004 which regulates air quality in the country to protect the environment by providing reasonable measures for the prevention of pollution and ecological degradation while promoting justifiable economic and social development.

src: Nasionale Omgewingsbestuur-wysigingswet: Afvalbestuur, 2013 – Die konsepwet wysig die Nasionale Omgewingsbestuurswet: Afvalbestuur, 2008 (Wet 59 van 2008), wat afvalbestuur reguleer ten einde gesondheid en die omgewing te beskerm.
tgt: National Environmental Management: Waste Amendment Bill, 2013 - The Bill amends the National Environmental Management: Waste Act, 2008 (Act No.

src: Nasionale Omgewingsbestuur-wysigingswet: Beskermde Gebiede, 2013 - Die konsepwet wysig die Nasionale Omgewingsbestuurswet: Beskermde Gebiede, 2003 (Wet 57 van 2003).
tgt: National Environmental Management: Protected Areas Amendment Bill, 2013 - The Bill amends the National Environmental Management: Protected Areas Act, 2003 (Act No.57 of 2003).

src: Wysigings sluit die bestuur van seelewe- beskermde gebiede in die bestuurstelsel van ander beskermde gebiede in en gee uitvoering aan die Presidensiële Proklamasies wat die funksies van visserye en omgewingsbestuur van mekaar skei.
tgt: Amendments incorporate the management of Marine Protected Areas in the system of management of other Protected Areas as well as giving effect to the Presidential Proclamations separating the functions between fisheries and environmental management.

src: Wysigingswet op die Suid-Afrikaanse Posbank Bpk.
tgt: South African Postbank Limited Amendment Bill - The main objective of the South African Postbank Limited Act, 2010 (Act No.

src: – Die hoofdoelwit van die Wet op die Suid-Afrikaanse Posbank Bpk., 2010 (Wet 9 van 2010) is om ’n finansiële instelling te vestig vir massa-mobilisering ten opsigte van spaar en belegging en om ’n bank van eerste keuse te skep vir die laer inkomstegroep.
tgt: 9 of 2010) is to establish a financial institution for mass mobilisation of savings and investment and to create a bank of first choice for the lower income group.

src: Die Kabinet het die Wysigingswet op Werkloosheidsversekering 2012 vir openbare kommentaar bekendgemaak, asook vir oorweging deur NEDLAC maatskaplike vennote.
tgt: Cabinet approved the unemployment Insurance Amendment Bill 2012 for public comments and for consultation with NEDLAC Social Partners.

src: Hierdie konsepwet wysig die Wet op Werkloosheidsversekering, Wet 63 van 2001.
tgt: This Bill amends the Unemployment Insurance Act, No.

src: Die wysiging is daarop gemik om aandag te gee aan die kwessie van werkers wat tans nie deur die Wet gedek word nie en die betaling van voordele aan die bydraer te verbeter, die tydperk van betaling aan die bydraer van agt tot 12 maande te verleng en voorsiening te maak vir die benoeming van begunstigdes in die geval van doodsvoordele.
tgt: This amendment addresses the issue of workers who are presently excluded in the Act and improve payment of benefits to contributors, extend the period of payment of benefits to the contributor from eight to twelve months and provides for the nomination of beneficiaries in case of death benefits.

src: Die Kabinet het die voorlegging van die Verkiesingswysigingswet, 2013 aan die Parlement goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Electoral Amendment Bill, 2013 to Parliament.

src: Die wysigingswet is daarop gemik om voorsiening te maak vir spesiale stemme ten opsigte van verkiesings in die Nasionale Vergadering, asook om voorsiening te maak vir die registrasie van kiesers wat gewoonlik buite die Republiek woon om hul spesiale stemme uit te bring.
tgt: The Amendment Bill seeks to provide for special votes in elections for the National Assembly, as well as to provide for the registration of voters who are ordinarily resident outside the Republic to enable them to cast a special vote.

src: Die Kabinet beaam die aanstelling van mnr Romeo Adams in die posisie van Adjunk-Direkteur-Generaal: Korporatiewe Dienste in die Departement van Justisie en Staatkundige Ontwikkeling.
tgt: Appointments Cabinet concurs with the appointment Mr. Romeo Adams to the position of Deputy Director-General: Corporate Services in the Department of Justice and Constitutional Development.

src: Irene Rofhiwa Singo in die posisie van Hoof Finansiële Beampte in die Departement van Minerale Hulpbronne.
tgt: Cabinet concurs with the appointment Ms Irene Rofhiwa Singo to the position of Chief Financial Officer in the Department of Mineral Resources.

src: Kalayvani Pillay in die posisie van Adjunk-Direkteur-Generaal: Wetsontwikkeling in die Departement van Justisie en Staatkundige Ontwikkeling.
tgt: Cabinet concurs with the appointment Ms Kalayvani Pillay to the position of Deputy Director-General: Legislative Development in the Department of Justice and Constitutional Development.

src: Die Kabinet beaam die aanstelling van dr. Bismark Tyobeka in die posisie van Hoof Uitvoerende Beampte van die Nasionale Kernkrag-reguleerder van Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Cabinet concurs with the appointment Dr Bismark Tyobeka to the position of Chief Executive Officer of the National Nuclear Regulator of South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet beaam die heraanstelling van mnr Tsietsi Mokhele as Hoof Uitvoerende Beampte van die Suid-Afrikaanse See-veiligheidsowerheid (SAMSA) vir ’n tydperk van vyf jaar met ingang van 1 April 2013.
tgt: Cabinet concurs with the re-appointment of Mr Tsietsi Mokhele as Chief Executive Officer of the South African Maritime Safety Authority (SAMSA) for a period of five years with effect from 1 April 2013.

src: Die Kabinet beaam die heraanstelling van die volgende nie-uitvoerende lede tot die raad van die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Akkrediteringstelsel (SANAS), wie se huidige ampstermyn op 30 November 2013 sal verval, om vir ’n tweede termyn vanaf 1 Desember 2013 tot 30 November 2018 te dien.• Vernon Roderick Seymour• Phakamisa Zonke.
tgt: Cabinet concurs the re-appointment of the following Non-Executive members to the board of the South African National Accreditation System (SANAS), whose current term of office will expire on 30 November 2013, to serve a second term from 1 December 2013 to 30 November 2018.Vernon Roderick SeymourPhakamisa Zonke.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die heraanstelling van 13 lede van die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Ruimte-sake (SACSA) met ingang van 24 Junie 2013 tot 24 Junie 2015.
tgt: Cabinet noted the re-appointment of thirteen members to the South African Council for Space Affairs (SACSA) with effect from 24 June 2013 to 24 June 2015.

src: Die Kabinet neem ook kennis van die heraanstelling van verteenwoordigers van die Departement van Verdediging, die Wetenskaplike en Nywerheidsnavorsingsraad (WNNR) en die Departement van Internasionale Betrekkinge en Samewerking met ingang van 24 Junie 2013 tot 24 Junie 2015.a.
tgt: Cabinet also noted the appointment of representatives from the Department of Defence, Council of Scientific and Industrial Research and the Department of International Relations and Cooperation with effect from 24 June 2013 to 24 June 2015.Dr Peter MartinezMs Nomfuneko MajajaMr Kim Victor GorringeDr Sandile Bethuel MalingaMs Pontsho MarupingMs Andiswa MlisaDr Valanathan MunsamiMr Tenza ThembaMr Ron OlivierMr Linden PetzerMr Hendrik RheederAdv Phetole Patrick SekhuleDr Jo-Ansie Karina van WykNomination from the Department of DefenceNomination from the Council for Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)Nomination from the Department of International Relations and Cooperation.

src: Die Kabinet se posisie oor prominente kwessies in die huidige omgewing.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on prominent issues in the current environment.

src: Die Kabinet wens die mense en politieke partye van Zimbabwe geluk met die land se suksesvolle geharmoniseerde parlementêre en plaaslike verkiesing.
tgt: Cabinet congratulated the people of Zimbabwe and political parties on holding successful harmonised parliamentary and local elections.

src: Die Kabinet prys die pogings van President Jacob Zuma as die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap (SAOG) se Fasiliteerder van die Zimbabwe-dialoog wat seker gemaak het dat al die politieke partye hulle tot 'n vreedsame verkiesing verbind het.
tgt: Cabinet commended the efforts of President Jacob Zuma as the Southern African Development Community (SADC) Facilitator on the Zimbabwe Dialogue in ensuring that all political parties were committed to peaceful elections.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel die bomaanval op 'n gebou waarin die personeel van die Turkse Ambassade in Mogadisjoe, Somalië, gehuisves is en spreek hul medelye uit met die Regerings en mense van Somalië en Turkye.
tgt: Cabinet condemned the bomb attack on a building housing the Turkish Embassy staff in Mogadishu, Somalia, and expressed condolences to the Governments and people of Somalia and Turkey.

src: Op die vooraand van ons 20 Jaar van Vryheid vier die Kabinet saam met die nasie Vrouemaand onder die tema “'n Eeufeesviering van Samewerking vir die Volhoubare Bemagtiging van Vroue en Geslagsgelykheid”.Die eeufeesviering gedenk die stryd wat vroue gestry het sedert die uitnemende en beroemde aktivis, Charlotte Maxeke, 'n groep vroue in Bloemfontein in 'n optog teen paswette in 1913 gelei het.
tgt: On the eve of our 20 Years of Freedom, Cabinet joins the nation in celebrating Women’s Month under the theme “A Centenary of Working Together towards Sustainable Women Empowerment and Gender Equality”.

src: Die bydrae van vroue tot die stryd teen die paswette asook ander fasette van die vryheidstryd is 'n belangrike deel van die inspirasie agter die Slimkaart ID wat onlangs bekendgestel is.
tgt: The centenary honours the struggles waged by women since the distinguished activist, Charlotte Maxeke, led a group of women on a march in Bloemfontein against pass laws in 1913.

src: Terwyl die nasie hulde bring a an vroue, doen die Kabinet ook 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om standpunt in te neem teen enige mishandeling van vroue en kinders en om die regte van vroue soos dit in ons Grondwet verskans is, te respekteer.
tgt: The contribution made by women in fighting pass laws and in other facets of the liberation struggle is an important part of the inspiration behind the recently launched Smart ID WEBTOKEN the nation celebrates women, Cabinet also calls on all South Africans to take a stand against any abuse of women and children and to respect the rights of women as enshrined in our Constitution.

src: Die Kabinet benadruk die waardering wat President Jacob Zuma vroeër uitgespreek het teenoor die nasie en die internasionale gemeenskap vir hul bydrae om Nelson Mandela Internasionale Dag die grootste Madiba-verjaarsdag tot dusver te maak.
tgt: Cabinet reiterated President Jacob Zuma’s earlier thank you to the nation and the international community for making Nelson Mandela International Day the biggest Madiba birthday celebration to date.

src: Op 18 Julie het duisende mense regoor Suid-Afrika en die wêreld tyd ingeruim om hul moue op te rol en minder bevoorregte mense te help.
tgt: On July 18, thousands of people around South Africa and the world took time to roll up their sleeves and help less fortunate people.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om die eerste Nelson Mandela Sport-en-Kultuurdag by die FNB Stadium, in Johannesburg op 17 Augustus te ondersteun.
tgt: Cabinet called on South Africans to support the inaugural Nelson Mandela Sport and Culture Day at FNB Stadium, Johannesburg, on 17 August.

src: Die Springbokke speel op dié dag teen Argentinië, Bafana Bafana sê Burkina Faso die stryd aan en 'n Suid-Afrikaanse Mestersokkerspan speel teen Italië, wat die aand deur 'n sterbelaaide musiekkonsert gevolg word.
tgt: The Springboks will play Argentina, Bafana Bafana will take on Burkina Faso and a South African Masters football side will play Italy, followed by a star-studded music concert in the evening.

src: Alle opbrengste sal aan die Nelson Mandela kinderhospitaalprojek gaan.
tgt: All proceeds will go to the Nelson Mandela children’s hospital project.

src: Die Kabinet benadruk die beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om hul te verbind tot die slagspreuk: “Neem Aksie Inspireer Verandering (en) Maak Elke Dag 'n Mandela-dag”.
tgt: Cabinet reiterated the call to South Africans to “Take Action Inspire Change (and) Make Every Day a Mandela Day”.Cabinet continues to call on all South Africans to continue keeping former President Nelson Mandela in their thoughts and prayers as he responds to medical treatment.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om voormalige President Nelson Mandela steeds in hul gedagtes en gebede te hou terwyl hy op mediese behandeling reageer.
tgt: Cabinet is saddened by the passing of former Chief Justice Pius Langa who was laid to rest on 3 August 2013 during a Special Official Funeral.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy medelye oor aan sy familie, vriende en kollegas.
tgt: Cabinet offers condolences to his family, friends and colleagues.

src: Voormalige Hoofregter Pius Langa sal onthou word vir sy bydrae tot die Vryheidstryd, sy verdediging van ons grondwetlike demokrasie en, meer onlangs, sy werk in die Kommissie vir Persvryheid.7 Die Kabinet erken die positiewe ontwikkelings in die onderwyssektor, in die besonder die versterking van die Kurrikulum-en-Assesseringsbeleidsverklaring (KABV) en die voortgesette ondersteuning van onderwysers om dit in werking te stel.
tgt: Former Chief Justice Pius Langa will be remembered for his contribution to the liberation Struggle, his defence of our constitutional democracy and, more recently, his work in the Press Freedom Commission.6 Cabinet recognises the positive developments in the education sector, in particular the strengthening of the Curriculum Assessment Policy Statements (CAPS) and the continued support from teachers in its implementation.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die instelling van die Taakspan wat aangewys is om die implementering van die Suid-Afrikaanse Gebaretaal (SASL)-kurrikulum in 2014 van Graad R tot 12 te bestuur, in lyn met die President se beroep om Gebaretaal as ‘n amptelike taal te verklaar.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the establishment of the Task Team assigned to manage the implementation of the South African Sign Language (SASL) curriculum in 2014 from Grades R to 12, in line with the President’s call to have the sign language declared as official.

src: Die nuwe kurrikulum sal groter toegang tot onderwysgeleenthede vir almal bied.
tgt: The new curriculum will provide greater access to education opportunities for all.7 Cabinet calls on the 2013 matriculants to register now at tertiary institutions for 2014 in line with the Department of Higher Education and Training’s Apply Now!

src: Khetha-veldtog.
tgt: Khetha campaign.

src: Leerders word aangemoedig om hul loopbaankeuses deeglik te oorweeg en hul finansiële vereistes te bepaal.
tgt: Learners are encouraged to carefully consider their career choices and assess their financial requirements.

src: Leerders word herinner aan die Regering se Nasionale Finansiële Hulpskema vir Studente (NSFAS), wat finansiële bystand bied aan akademies verdienstelike en finansieel behoeftige studente.
tgt: Learners are reminded about government’s National Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS) which provides financial aid to academically deserving and financially needy students.8 Cabinet congratulates the launch of the 24-hour television news channel by the South African Broadcasting Corporation which responds to the ever-increasing demand for up-to-date news broadcasts on events of national and international importance and gives a voice and platform to all South Africans.9 Cabinet congratulates swimmers Cameron van der Burgh, Chad le Clos and Giulio Zorzi who made the country proud by winning medals at the 15th International Swimming Federation (FINA) World Championships in Barcelona.10 Cabinet extended its well wishes to the Muslims of South Africa as they celebrate Eid.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Suid-Afrikaanse Uitsaaikorporasie (SABC) geluk met die bekendstelling van die 24-uur-televisienuuskanaal in reaksie op die immer-toenemende vraag na bygewerkte nuusuitsendings oor gebeure van nasionale en internasionale belang en hierdeur 'n stem en platform aan alle Suid-Afrikaners bied.
tgt: Cabinet also wishes the South African Jewish Community a happy month of Elul.2 Key Cabinet discussions and decisions.1 Cabinet approved the commencement of the consultation process for the National Water Policy Positions by the Department of Water Affairs.

src: Dit lê die grondslag vir die inkorporering van burger-gebaseerde monitering in die Regering se WEBTOKEN hierdie raamwerk beskryf burger-gebaseerde montering 'n benadering tot die monitering van regeringsprestasie wat op die ervarings van gewone burgers fokus om openbare aanspreeklikheid te versterk en verbeterings aan dienslewering te dryf.
tgt: They were further apprised on the outstanding matters that still require WEBTOKEN of 31 July 2013 the credit balance was R.3bn compared to an overdraft of R1, 7b when it went under administration in December 2011.Having appreciated the corrective measures put in place in the five departments that are under administration, Cabinet approved that the Ministerial Committee can commence the six month transitional process of handing over the administration of Limpopo to the Premier and his new Executive.

src: Die Kabinet het die Beginsels van Delegering van Openbare Administrasie en Finansiële Bestuur goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet agreed that further investigations should continue on matters that seek to establish irregularities and where people are found to have flouted procurement procedures the due disciplinary process will take effect.

src: Die Beginsels bied 'n riglyn vir hoe die bevoegdhede van 'n Uitvoerende Gesag aan 'n rekeningkundige beampte en verder af na laer strukture gedelegeer word, soos voorgeskryf in die Staatsdienswet (PSA) en die Wet op Openbare Finansiële Bestuur (PFMA).Die Beginsels vergemaklik die proses van die delegering van bevoegdhede, wat meer doeltreffende en effektiewe dienslewering in die hand sal werk.
tgt: A fuller briefing by the Ministerial Committee will take place at an appropriate time.3 Bills.1 Cabinet approved the introduction of the Legal Metrology Bill to Parliament.

src: Kabinet se posisie oor prominente kwessies in die huidige omgewing Die Kabinet verwelkom die openbare bekendstelling van die sesde uitgawe van die Ontwikkelingsaanwysers deur die Minister in die Presidensie vir Prestasiemonitering en -evaluering.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the public launch of the sixth edition of the Development Indicators by the Minister in the Presidency for Performance Monitoring and Evaluation.

src: In die aanloop tot die feesvierings ter herdenking van 20 Jaar van Vryheid, kan Suid-Afrikaners tereg trots wees dat die lewe sedert 1994 ten goede verander het.
tgt: As the nation prepares to celebrate 20 Years of Freedom, South Africans should be proud that life has changed for the better since 1994.The indicators show improvement in key areas and simultaneously point to the hard work still required to deal with some of our more persistent challenges.

src: Die aanwysers toon verbeterings in sleutelareas en wys terselfdertyd op die harde werk wat nog nodig is om sommige van die meer hardnekkige uitdagings die hoof te bied.
tgt: Furthermore, the indicators encourage debate on the challenges our country faces and act as markers along our journey of socio-economic progress.

src: Die Kabinet wens die 41% (115) van die munisipaliteite wat finansiële ongekwalifiseerde verslae op die 2011/12-oudits ontvang het, geluk.
tgt: Cabinet commended the 41% (115) of municipalities that received unqualified financial statements on the 2011/2012 financial audits.

src: Die verbetering wat aangeteken is deur die 21 munisipaliteite wat in die vorige jaar ongunstige ouditmenings of weerhoudings van ouditmenings gekry het, word ook erken.
tgt: It further acknowledged the improvement made by the 21 municipalities that previously received the adverse or disclaimed opinions in the previous year.

src: Die Kabinet waardeer die werk wat deur die Ouditeur-Generaal gedoen word om munisipaliteite te help om algaande beter te voldoen aan die vereistes vir goeie korporatiewe bestuur.
tgt: Cabinet appreciates the work done by the Auditor General in assisting the municipalities to improve on the governance compliance requirements.

src: Die verbintenis wat deur die munisipaliteite gemaak is om deurlopend te verbeter in die areas wat deur die Ouditeur-Generaal uitgelig is, word ook erken.
tgt: It also acknowledged the commitment made by the municipality leadership to continue to work on further improving the areas highlighted by the Auditor General.3 Cabinet thanked all South Africans for their support of the Nelson Mandela Sport and Cultural Day hosted in aid of the Nelson Mandela Children's Hospital project.

src: Die Kabinet bedank alle Suid-Afrikaners vir hul ondersteuning van die Nelson Mandela Sport-en-Kultuurdag wat aangebied is ten bate van die Nelson Mandela Kinderhospitaalprojek.
tgt: South Africans are encouraged to continue working in communities and partnering with government to improve the lives of citizens and bring to life the ideals to which Madiba dedicated his life.4 Cabinet noted the upcoming visit of President Jacob Zuma to the Russian Republic.

src: Hy sal op 5 en 6 September 2013 die Groep van 20 (G20) Beraad in St Petersburg bywoon met die oog op die bevordering van Suid-Afrika se politieke en ekonomiese belange.
tgt: He will be attending the Group of 20 (G20) Summit in St Petersburg on 5 and 6 September 2013 as part of promoting South Africa’s political and economic interests.

src: Suid-Afrika gaan voort om die G20 se ontwikkelingsagenda te ondersteun ter versterking van internasionale ekonomiese stabiliteit en langtermyn volhoubare groei en werkskepping.
tgt: South Africa continues to support the G20’s development agenda that advances global economic stability and long-term sustainable growth and job creation.5 Cabinet commended the first meeting of the Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa (BRICS) Business Council, which saw business leaders from these countries converge in South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet skryf die eerste vergadering van die Sakeraad van Brasilië, Indië, Sjina en Suid-Afrika (BRICS), waartydens sakeleiers van hierdie lande in Suid-Afrika byeengekom het, hoog aan.
tgt: The meeting was also attended by prominent business leaders from 19 other African countries.6 Cabinet welcomed the assurance given at the 12th annual African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) Forum to renew AGOA before it expires in 2015.

src: AGOA het reeds vele voordele meegebring vir sowel die Verenigde State van Amerika (VSA) as die Afrika-kontinent en ondersteun 'n groeiende en relatief gebalanseerde bilaterale handelsverhouding tussen Suid-Afrika en die VSSuid-Afrika glo dat AGOA 'n toepaslike raamwerk bied om sterker, wedersyds voordelige handels-en-beleggingsbande te bou en samewerking tussen die VSA en die breër Afrika-kontinent te bou.
tgt: AGOA has benefited both the United States and the African continent and has underpinned a growing and relatively balanced bilateral trade relationship between South Africa and the United States (US).SA believes AGOA offers an appropriate framework to build stronger, mutually beneficial bilateral trade and investment relations and strengthen cooperation between the US and the broader African continent.7 As part of the nationwide celebration of Women’s Month, Deputy President Kgalema Motlanthe will on Friday, 23 August 2013 visit Gombani Village in Mutale Municipality, Limpopo, to hand over houses to the community.

src: As deel van die landswye viering van Vrouemaand sal Adjunk-President Kgalema Motlanthe op Vrydag, 23 Augustus 2013 'n besoek bring aan Gombani Village in Mutale Munisipaliteit, Limpopo, om huise aan die gemeenskap te oorhandig.
tgt: The women of Gombani actively participated in building these houses.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van die Staatsdienshandves en prys staatsdiensvakbonde en die Staat as werkgewer vir die verbintenisse wat deur hierdie Handves gemaak is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the Public Service Charter and commends public service unions and the State as the employer on the commitments made through this Charter.

src: Die handves is gerig op die invoer van diensstandaarde in die Staatsdiens, met staatsdiensvakbonde wat hulle tot die ondersteuning van hierdie diensstandaarde verbind.
tgt: The Charter introduces service standards within the public service with public service unions pledging their commitment to support the service standards.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis dat heelwat sektore tans by loononderhandelings betrokke is, of onlangs daarby betrokke was.
tgt: Cabinet notes that many sectors are currently or have been engaged in wage negotiations.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die skikkings wat in sommige sektore bereik is en neem kennis van voortgesette onderhandelings in ander.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes settlements that have been reached in some sectors and takes note of continuing negotiations in others.

src: Die Kabinet erken dat werkers in 'n demokrasie die reg het om te staak.
tgt: Cabinet recognises that in a democracy, workers have the right to strike.

src: Die Kabinet benadruk dat sodanige reg op 'n nie-geweldadige manier en in volle nakoming van die wet uitgeoefen moet word.
tgt: Cabinet emphasises that such right must be exercised in a non-violent manner and in full compliance with the law.

src: Die verantwoordelikheid berus by vakbondleiers, werkgewers en die Staat se sekuriteitsdienste om te verseker dat die wet gehandhaaf word, dat uitdagende optrede vermy word en dat nywerheidsoptrede op 'n vreedsame wyse plaasvind.
tgt: There is a responsibility on trade union leaders, employers and the state’s security services to ensure that the law is upheld, that provocative actions are avoided and that industrial action is conducted in a peaceful manner.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle partye om hul bes te doen om onderhandelinge so gou moontlik by te lê en uitgerekte geskille te voorkom.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all parties to use their efforts to settle negotiations as soon as possible and to avoid protracted disputes.

src: Spoedige skikkings sal help om die koste vir die ekonomie te beperk en bydra tot die bereiking van die land se werkskepping- en groeidoelwitte.
tgt: Such expeditious settlements will help to reduce the costs to the economy and promote the achievement of the county’s jobs and growth goals.

src: Die Kabinet erken die tweede Jaarlikse Mynbou Lekgotla wat verlede week gehou is.
tgt: Cabinet acknowledged the second Annual Mining Lekgotla that was held last week.

src: Die lekgotla het weereens 'n geleentheid gebied aan die sleutelrolspelers in die mynbedryf om saam blywende oplossings te vind vir die uitdagings waaronder hierdie sektor gebuk gaan.
tgt: The Lekgotla presented another opportunity for the key role players in the mining industry to continue engaging in finding lasting solutions to the challenges that afflict this sector.

src: Onder die leierskap van adjunk-president Kgalema Motlanthe, ondersteun die Regering steeds die raamwerkooreenkoms en die implementering daarvan vir 'n volhoubare en standvastige mynbousektor.
tgt: Under the leadership of the Deputy President Kgalema Motlanthe government also continues to support the framework agreement and its implementation for a sustainable and stable mining sector.

src: In die opbou tot die 20 Jaar van Vryheid op 27 April 2014, doen die Kabinet 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om ons geskiedenis te gedenk en ons uiteenlopende kulture gedurende Erfenismaand te vier.
tgt: In the build-up to the 20 Years of Freedom on the 27 April 2014, Cabinet calls on all South Africans to commemorate our history and celebrate our diverse cultures during Heritage Month.

src: Vanjaar se feesvierings sal plaasvind onder die tema: "Reclaiming, Restoring and Celebrating Our Living Heritage".Die Erfenisdagvierings sal plaasvind by Sisa Dukashe Stadium in Mdantsane, Buffalo City Mero Munisipaliteit, Oos-Kaap op 24 September WEBTOKEN deel van die 20 Jaar van Vryheid Veldtog sal die nasionale kommunikasievennootskap gepaardgaan met die bekendstelling van "Vryheidsvrydag" op 20 September 2013, wat aan Suid-Afrikaners 'n platform sal bied om ons swaarverworwe vryheid te waardeer, en sodoende te verseker dat toekomstige geslagte ook by ons ontwikkelende demokrasie kan baat vind.
tgt: This year’s celebrations will be marked under the theme: “Reclaiming, Restoring and Celebrating Our Living Heritage”.The Heritage Day celebrations will take place at Sisa Dukashe Stadium in Mdantsane, Buffalo City Metro Municipality, Eastern Cape province on 24 September WEBTOKEN part of the 20 Years of Freedom campaign, the national communication partnership will see the launch of ‘Freedom Friday’ on 20 September 2013, which will provide a platform for South Africans to cherish our hard-fought freedom to ensure that future generations are able to benefit from our developmental democracy.

src: Ter bevordering van ons binnelandse toerisme moedig die Kabinet Suid-Afrikaners aan om gedurende September erfenisterreine te besoek om ons aan ons vryheidsreis te herinner.
tgt: During September, in support of our domestic tourism efforts, Cabinet encourages South Africans to visit heritage sites to remind us of our journey to freedom.

src: Suid-Afrikaners kan ook ons natuurlike erfenis ondersteun deur ons nasionale parke gratis te besoek tussen 9 en 13 September 2013 as deel van die agtste jaarlikse Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Parke (SANParks) Week.
tgt: Also, to support our natural heritage by visiting national parks free of charge from 9 to 13 September 2013 as part of the 8th annual South African National Parks (SANParks) Week.

src: Die Kabinet moedig alle ouers en voogde aan om hul kinders te ondersteun in hul voorbereiding vir die komende Jaarlikse Nasionale Assesserings (ANA) in geletterdheid en gesyferdheid, wat tussen 10 en 13 September 2013 plaasvind.
tgt: Cabinet encourages all parents and guardians to support their children in the preparation for the upcoming Annual National Assessments (ANA) in literacy and numeracy that takes place between 10 and 13 September 2013.Parents and guardians must ensure that they engage with the 2013 ANA results as this serves as an important diagnostic tool of learners’ strengths and WEBTOKEN preparation for the upcoming ANA parents, guardians and learners are urged to use the tools provided by the Department of Basic Education.

src: Die Kabinet dra 'n boodskap van ondersteuning oor aan die soldate van die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Weermag wat vir die tydperk 13 Junie 2013 tot 31 Maart 2014 in die oostelike Demokratiese Republiek van die Kongo ontplooi is.
tgt: Cabinet extends a message of support to the South Africa National Defence Force soldiers deployed in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo for the period 13 June 2013 to 31 March 2014.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om hierdie soldate te ondersteun, wat bydra tot die verwesenliking van Suid-Afrika se verbintenis tot vrede, stabiliteit en die verstewiging van demokrasie in die Afrika-kontinent.
tgt: South Africans are called upon to support and give recognition to these soldiers who are instrumental is realising South Africa’s commitment to peace, stability and the strengthening of democracy in the African continent.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense oor met die Presidensiële aanstellings van mnrMxolisi Sandile Oliver Nxasana as die Nasionale Direkteur van Openbare Vervolging en Vasantrai Soni (SC) as die Hoof van die Spesiale Ondersoekeenheid.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the presidential appointments of Mr Mxolisi Sandile Oliver Nxasana as the National Director of Public Prosecutions and Vasantrai Soni (SC) as the Head of Special Investigative Unit .

src: Die Kabinet wens die Joodse gemeenskap van Suid-Afrika 'n vreugdevolle Rosh Hashanah (5 – 6 September 2013) toe.
tgt: Cabinet wishes the Jewish community of South Africa a very happy Rosh Hashanah (5 to 6 September 2013).

src: Rosh Hashanah hou groot betekenis vir die Joodse gemeenskap in, en lui 'n proses in van selfondersoek en besinning wat die hoogtepunt bereik op Yom Kippur, die Dag van Versoening.
tgt: Rosh Hashanah has profound significance for the Jewish Community in that it marks the beginning of a process of self-examination and reflection culminating in Yom Kippur, the Day of Atonement.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel met Minister Mthetwa en sy familie met die afsterwe van sy moeder, mev Nurse Gumbi op 3 September 2013.
tgt: Cabinet expresses its condolences to Minister Mthethwa and his family on the passing away of his mother Ms Nurse Gumbi on 3 September 2013.

src: Sleutelbesprekings en -besluite van die Kabinet.
tgt: Key Cabinet discussions and decisions.

src: Die Kabinet neem 'n verslag in ontvangs van die uitslae van die Instrument vir Bestuursprestasiebeoordeling (MPAT) van Nasionale en Provinsiale departemente vir die 2012/13 finansiële jaar.
tgt: Cabinet received a report on the results of the Management Performance Assessments Tool (MPAT) of national and provincial departments for the 2012/13 financial year.

src: Die verslag is nog 'n hulpmiddel vir die verbetering van die gehalte van dienste wat deur die departemente gelewer word.
tgt: The report is another tool that seeks to improve the quality of services provided by the departments.

src: Dit beoordeel die vier breë bestuursterreine, naamlik voorsieningskettingbestuur menslikehulpbronbestuur strategiese beplanning en verbetering van dienslewering.
tgt: It assesses the four broad management areas namely supply chain management human resource management strategic planning and service delivery improvement.

src: Die assessering word op drie vlakke gedoen: self-assessering, dan 'n gemodereerde proses deur die interne oudit en laastens 'n gemodereerde proses deur 'n span onafhanklike moderators.
tgt: The assessment is done on three levels, self-assessment then a moderated process by the internal audit and finally moderated by a team of independent moderators.

src: Die verslag sal volgende week in meer besonderhede deur die Departement van Prestasiemonitering en -Evaluering uiteengesit word tydens 'n geskeduleerde bekendstelling van die MPAT in Kaapstad.
tgt: The report will be further unpacked by the Department of Performance Monitoring and Evaluation during a scheduled launch of the MPAT next week in Cape Town.

src: Die Kabinet neem die verslae oor die implementering van Leweringsooreenkomste vir die Uitkomste vir die eerste kwartaal van 2013/14 in ontvangs en keur dit goed.
tgt: Cabinet received and approved the first quarter reports for 2013/14 on the implementation of Delivery Agreements for the Outcomes.

src: Hierdie verslae sal in meer besonderhede uiteengesit word tydens 'n reeks media-inligtingsessies vir elk van die 12 Uitkomste.
tgt: These reports will be unpacked during a planned series of media briefings for each of the 12 Outcomes.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die verslag van die "Projek vir die Verwydering van nadelige Kredietinligting" en keur die aanbevelings goed van die Gekose Komitee op Handel en Internasionale Verhoudings.
tgt: Cabinet noted the report from the ‘Removal of Adverse Credit Information Project’ and approved the recommendations of the Select Committee on Trade and International Relations.

src: Die aanbevelings is gerig op die kwessie van toegang tot krediet aan daardie Suid-Afrikaners wat krediet kan bekostig.
tgt: This seeks to address the issue of access to credit to those South Africans that can afford credit.

src: Dit is die verbruikers wat dalk hul skuld ten volle afbetaal het en in 'n posisie is om nuwe krediet te bekostig, maar wie se toegang tans belemmer word deur negatiewe kredietinligting op hul rekords.
tgt: These are consumers who may have paid their debts in full and are in a position to afford credit but whose access is currently impeded by negative credit information on their record.

src: Die hoofdoel is om te verseker dat die Nasionale Kredietwet, 2005 (Wet 34 van 2005) funksioneer soos bedoel, sodat verbruikers wat krediet kan bekostig, toegang daartoe kan verkry.
tgt: This is primarily about ensuring that the National Credit Act (Act 34 of 2005) works as intended in terms of ensuring that consumers who can afford credit can be able to access it.

src: Ontoeganklike of duur krediet belemmer groei.
tgt: Inaccessible or expensive credit hinders growth.

src: Toegang tot 'n volhoubare kredietmark is noodsaaklik vir die bereiking van alle ontwikkelingsdoelwitte.
tgt: Access to sustainable credit market is essential to all developmental goals.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die Witskrif oor Verhoorafwagting en die indiening daarvan by die Parlement.
tgt: Cabinet approved the White Paper on Remand Detention and its introduction to Parliament.

src: Die konsep Witskrif se doel is om die bestuur van die verhoorafwagting- aanhoudingstelsel in Suid-Afrikaanse gevangenisse te verbeter.
tgt: The draft White Paper seeks to improve the management of awaiting trial detention system in South African prisons.

src: Die Witskrif gee 'n uiteensetting van die beginsels wat as dryfveer sal dien vir die aanhoudingsbestuur van verhoorafwagting.
tgt: The paper outlines the principles that will drive the detention management of remand detention.

src: Die verslag sal deur die Parlementêre proses vrygestel word.
tgt: The report will be released through the Parliamentary process.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring dat die Konvensie oor Trosbomme aan die Parlement gestuur word vir bekragtiging.
tgt: Cabinet approved that the Convention of Cluster Munitions be sent to Parliament for ratification.

src: Die Kabinet ondersteun die vernietiging van trosbom-voorraad ter nakoming van hierdie WEBTOKEN November 2006, kon 'n Verenigde Nasies (VN) Konferensie nie ooreenstemming bereik oor hoe die nadelige humanitêre impak van hierdie wapens hanteer behoort te word nie.
tgt: Cabinet supports the destruction of cluster munitions stocks in compliance with this WEBTOKEN November 2006 a United Nations (UN) conference could not reach agreement on how the adverse humanitarian impact of these weapons should be addressed.

src: Dit het daartoe gelei dat 'n groep van 46 lande, insluitende Suid-Afrika, 'n proses, die sogenaamde Oslo-proses, buite die VN geïnisieer het om trosbomme te verbied.
tgt: This led to a group of 46 countries, including South Africa, embarking on a process outside the UN, the so-called Oslo Process, to ban cluster munitions.

src: Suid-Afrika, saam met 93 ander state, het die Konvensie in Desember 2008 onderteken.
tgt: South Africa together with 93 other States signed the Convention in December 2008.

src: Op 1 Augustus 2010 het die Konvensie in werking getree.
tgt: On 1 August 2010 the Convention entered into force.

src: Die Konvensie verbied die gebruik, produksie, opgaar en vervoer van bepaalde kategorieë trosbomme.
tgt: The Convention bans the use, production, stockpiling and transfer of certain category of cluster munitions.

src: Die bekragtiging van die Konvensie is in ooreenstemming met Suid-Afrika se verbintenis om menseregte en humanitêre reg in oorlogvoering te eerbiedig.
tgt: The ratification of the Convention is in line with South Africa’s commitments to upholding human rights and humanitarian law when engaging in war fare.

src: Die Kabinet keur die voorlegging van die verslag oor die Oudit van Geregistreerde Staatsgrond en 'n lessenaar-ontleding van Privaat Grondbesit in Suid-Afrika deur die hoof-landmeter-generaal aan die Parlement goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the report on the Audit of Registered State Land and a desktop analysis of Private Land Ownership in South Africa, by the Chief Surveyor-General to WEBTOKEN information is critical to the success of all land developments in the country.

src: Die doel van die oudit van geregistreerde staatsgrond is om te bepaal hoeveel grond deur die Staat besit word, waarvoor dit gebruik word en wie die bewoners/gebruikers is.
tgt: The purpose of the audit of registered state land is to determine how much land is owned by the state, what it is used for and who the occupants/users are.

src: Dit sal gebruik word om die integriteit van die grondgebruiker te versterk, wat sal dien as die grondslag vir verbeterde grondbeplanning en -administrasie, met inbegrip van ander funksies rakende eiendomsportefeuljebestuur en verbeterde dienslewering.
tgt: This will be used to enhance the integrity of the land register, which would serve as the basis for enhanced land planning and administration, including other functions relating to property portfolio management and improved delivery of services.

src: Die Kabinet keur die Suid-Afrikaanse Muntmaatskappy se ontwerpe vir die 2013 R2 (1/4 oz) 24 kar.
tgt: Cabinet approved the South African Mint Company’s designs for the 2013 R2 (1/4 oz) commemorative 24 ct gold coin series and the 2013 R1 (1/10 oz) commemorative 24 ct gold coin series.

src: gouemunt-gedenkreeks en die 2013 R1 (1/10 oz) 24 kar.
tgt: The design of the 2013 R2 gold coin will feature the San language and the design of the 2013 R1 gold coin will be the 3rd pollinator – the Fruit Bat.

src: Die muntontwerpe tesame met hul proklamasies sal in die Staatskoerant gedruk word.
tgt: The coin designs together with their Proclamations will be printed in the Government Gazette.

src: Daarna sal dit vervaardig en deur die normale kanale verkoop word.
tgt: Thereafter they will be manufactured and sold through the normal channels.

src: Die Kabinet keur die voorlegging goed van die drie verslae rakende die vordering wat gemaak is met die waarborg van kinders se regte en welsyn aan die Verenigde Nasies se komitee oor die Regte van die Kind en die Afrika-Unie se Deskundige Komitee.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission to the United Nation Committee on the Rights of the Child and African Union Expert Committee the 3 reports relating to the progress made in securing the rights and wellbeing of children.

src: Die verslae bied 'n deursigtige en kritieke geleentheid vir Suid-Afrika om die vordering wat dit op hierdie terreine gemaak het, te beoordeel:a) Landverslag oor die Opsionele Protokol oor die Verkoop van Kinders, Kinderprostitusie en Kinderpornografie.
tgt: The reports provide a transparent and critical opportunity for South Africa to assess the progress it has made in these areas:a) Country Report on the Optional Protocol on the Sale of Children, Child Prostitution and Child Pornographyb) the combined second, third and fourth report on the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Childc) the African Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child: First Country report to the African Union Expert Committee on the Rights and Welfare of the Child.

src: b) Die gekombineerde tweede, derde en vierde verslag oor die Verenigde Nasies se Konvensie oor die Regte van die Kind.
tgt: Cabinet thanks the range of committed civil society organisations and international partners who partnered with government in realising the commitments made to children in our Constitution.

src: Die Kabinet het die voorlegging geodgekeur van die Wysigingswetsontwerp op die Herstel van Grondregte aan die Parlement goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Restitution of Land Rights Amendment Bill to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp wysig die Wet op die Herstel van Grondregte om die datum vir die indiening van eise vir herstel tot 31 Desember 2018 te verleng die kriminalisering van die indiening van 'n bedrieglike eis die vereenvoudiging van die prosedure vir die aanstelling van regters van die Hof vir Grondeise en die wysiging van sekere bepalings wat gerig is op die bevordering van die effektiewe implementering van die Wet.
tgt: The Bill amends the Restitution Act to extend the date for the lodging of claims for restitution to 31 December 2018 the criminalisation of the lodgement of a fraudulent claim the simplification of the procedure for the appointment of Judges to the Land Claims Court and the amendment of certain provisions aimed at promoting the effective implementation of the Act.

src: Die heropening van die indiening van eise word gelei deur die visie van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan asook die Omvattende Landelike Ontwikkelingsprogram en ander groeistrategieë wat gemik is op die bevordering van nasionale versoening en sosiale samehorigheid.
tgt: The re-opening of lodgment of claims is guided by the vision of the National Development Plan as well as the Comprehensive Rural Development Programme and other growth strategies intended to promote national reconciliation and social cohesion.

src: Die Kabinet het die indiening goedgekeur van die Wysigingswet op Wette op Wetenskap en Tegnologie, 2013 by die Parlement.
tgt: Cabinet approved the introduction of the Science and Technology Laws, Amendment Bill, 2013 to Parliament.

src: Die wysigingswetsontwerp handel oor wysigings aan 'n reeks wette wat die bedrywighede van entiteite (wetenskapsrade) wat ingevolge die genoemde wette ingestel is, reguleer.
tgt: The Amendment Bill deals with amendments to a battery of Acts which govern the operations of entities (science councils) that were established in terms of the said Acts.

src: Die doel van die wetsontwerp is om die proses vir die nominasie en aanstelling van lede asook die vul van vakatures op die direksies of rade van sulke entiteite te vereenvoudig.
tgt: The Bill seeks to streamline the process for the nomination and appointment of members as well as the filling of vacancies to the Boards or Councils of such entities.

src: Die wetsontwerp versterk die doeltreffendheid en konsekwentheid in die operasionele en bestuursake van openbare entiteite wat aan die Minister van Wetenskap en Tegnologie verslag doen.
tgt: The Bill enhances efficiency and consistency in the operations and governance of public entities reporting to the Minister of Science and WEBTOKEN strengthening Parliament’s oversight role, the Bill seeks to release Parliament from certain executive responsibilities relating to the appointment of members and filling of vacancies to such Boards or Councils.

src: Dit is in ooreenstemming met die grondwetlike beginsel van die skeiding van magte.
tgt: This accords with the constitutional principle of separation of powers.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring vir die publikasie van die Wetsontwerp op Tradisionele Aangeleenthede in die Staatskoerant vir openbare kommentaar.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the publication of the Traditional Affairs Bill in the Government Gazette for public comments.

src: Die wetsontwerp maak statutêre voorsiening vir die erkenning van die Khoi-San en lê hom ook toe op die beperkings van bestaande wetgewing ten aansien van tradisionele leierskap en korporatiewe beheer.
tgt: The Bill makes statutory provisions for the recognition of the Khoi-San and also addresses limitations of existing legislation relating to traditional leadership and governance.

src: Sedert 1994 het die Regering in die besonder gefokus op die uitdagings met betrekking tot die Khoi-San, en spesifiek die erkenning van Khoi-San-gemeenskappe en -leiers.
tgt: Since 1994 government has paid particular attention to the challenges relating to the Khoi-San and specifically, the recognition of Khoi-San communities and leaders.

src: Die wetsontwerp sal bydra tot die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan se sleutelmikpunt vir die uitbreiding van sosiale samehorigheid en eenheid, en terselfdertyd die ongelykhede van die verlede help uitskakel.
tgt: The Bill will contribute to the National Development Plan’s key target relating to the broadening of social cohesion and unity while addressing the inequities of the past.

src: Die Kabinet het die Nasionale Kredietwet Beleidsoorsigraamwerk en die Nasionale Kredietwysigingswet goedgekeur vir indiening by die Parlement.
tgt: Cabinet approved the National Credit Act Policy Review Framework and the National Credit Amendment Bill for introduction to Parliament.

src: Die Nasionale Kredietwet, 2005 (Wet 34 van 2005) het op 1 Junie 2007 ten volle in werking getree, en daardeur 'n nuwe era van kredietregulasies in die Suid-Afrikaanse regstelsel ingelui.
tgt: The National Credit Act, 2005 (Act 34 of 2005) came into full effect on 1 June 2007 introducing a new era of credit regulations into the South African legal system.

src: Die wetsontwerp beoog om die kapasiteit van die Nasionale Kredietreguleerder (NCR) te versterk om bepaalde uitdagings, veral betreffende hofprosesse, aan te pak en om die afdwinging en implementering van die bepalings van die Nasionale Kredietwet, 2005 te versterk.
tgt: The Bill aims to strengthen the capacity of the National Credit Regulator (NCR) to address certain challenges especially around court processes and to strengthen enforcement and implementation of the provisions of the National Credit Act 34 of 2005.The Department of Trade and Industry (the dti) also concluded that the policy framework on Consumer Credit, on which the National Credit Act 34 of 2005 is founded, is sound and relevant.

src: Dit volg op 'n omvattende ondersoek deur die dti in 2012.
tgt: This follows a comprehensive review, in 2012 by the dti.

src: Die Kabinet keur die voorlegging van die Wysigingswet op die Bepaling van Besoldiging van Lede van Konstitusionele Instellings, 2013 goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Determination of Remuneration of Members of Constitutional Institutions Matters Amendment Bill, 2013.The Bill aims to create uniformity in respect of the determination of remuneration, allowances and other terms and conditions of employment of members from the Chapter 9 Institutions, thereby enhancing efficiency and consistency in the operations and governance of these key institutions.

src: Aanstellings.
tgt: Appointments.

src: Die Kabinet het die aanstelling goedgekeur van mnrMokutule Joseph Kgobokoe in die pos van adjunk-direkteur-generaal: Voedselsekuriteit en Landbouhervorming in die Departement van Landbou, Bosbou en Visserye.
tgt: Cabinet approved the appointment of Mr Mokutule Joseph Kgobokoe to the post of Deputy Director-General: Food Security and Agrarian Reform at the Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries.

src: Die Kabinet het die aanstelling goedgekeur van me Zandile Yvonne Mathe in die pos van adjunk-direkteur-generaal: Nasionale Waterhulpbroninfrastruktuur in die Departement van Waterwese.
tgt: Cabinet approved with the appointment of Ms Zandile Yvonne Mathe to the post of Deputy Director-General: National Water Resource Infrastructure at the Department of Water Affairs.

src: Die Kabinet het die aanstelling goedgekeur van die volgende persone as raadslede van die Ontwikkelingsagentskap vir Koöperatiewe Banke:a) Sethe Patricia Makhesha (Voorsitter)b) Peter Koch (heraanstelling as adjunk-voorsitter)c) Venete Jarlene Kleind) Lufuno Nevondwee) Thabo Vaughan Shenxanef) Samuel Senalor Akrongg) David Ginsburgh) Renganayagee Kisten.
tgt: Cabinet approved the appointment of the following people as board members to the Cooperative Banks Development Agency:a) Sethe Patricia Makhesha (Chairperson)b) Peter Koch (re appointment to Deputy Chairperson)c) Venete Jarlene Kleind) Lufuno Nevondwee) Thabo Vaughan Shenxanef) Samuel Senalor Akrongg) David Ginsburgh) Renganayagee Kisten.

src: Die Kabinet het die aanstelling goedgekeur van die volgende lede tot die Landbounavorsingsraad ingevolge artikel 9(1) van die Landbounavorsingswet, 1990 (Wet 86 van 1990) vir 'n tydperk van hoogstens drie jaar.
tgt: Cabinet approved the appointment of the following members to the Agricultural Research Council in terms of section 9(1) of the Agricultural Research Act, 1990 Act No.

src: a) MnrJonathan Winston Alexander Godden (heraanstelling)b) Prof Michael Jeffrey Kahn (heraanstelling)c) Prof Sibusiso Vil-Nkomo (heraanstelling)d) Dr Joyce Chitja (heraanstelling)e) Me Wilna Jansen Van Rijssen (heraanstelling)f) Me Dudu Msomi (heraanstelling)g) MnrMzolisi Dyasi (heraanstelling)h) Prof Frans JC Swanepoel (heraanstelling)i) MnrGerard John Martinj) Me Dora Ndabak) MnrIsmail Cassim Motalal) Me Muhle Joyce Mashitengm) Me Rowen Graham Nicholisn) MnrClive Douglas Knealeo) Prof Louw C Hoffmanp) MnrAllen Henry Bishop.
tgt: a) Mr Jonathan Winston Alexander Godden (reappointment)b) Prof Michael Jeffrey Kahn (reappointment)c) Prof Sibusiso Vil-Nkomo (reappointment)d) Dr Joyce Chitja (reappointment)e) Ms Wilna Jansen Van Rijssen (reappointment)f) Ms Dudu Msomi (reappointment)g) Mr Mzolisi Dyasi (reappointment)h) Prof Frans J.

src: Die Kabinet het die aanstelling bekragtig van die volgende persone tot die Raad van die Reguleringsowerheid vir die Privaat Sekuriteitsbedryf, vir 'n tydperk van hoogstens drie jaar:a) MnrDaniel Claude Mojalefa Rathebe (adjunk-voorsitter)b) Brigadier Cynthia Lindiwe Philison (raadslid)c) MnrBenjamin Somangamane Ntuli (raadslid)d) Me Nontokoza Mthembu (raadslid).
tgt: C Swanepoel (reappointment)i) Mr Gerard John Martinj) Ms Dora Ndabak) Mr. Ismail Cassim Motalal) Ms Muhle Joyce Mashitengm) Ms. Rowen Graham Nicholisn) Mr. Clive Douglas Knealeo) Prof Louw Hoffmanp) Mr. Allen Henry Bishop.

src: Die Kabinet het die verlenging goedgekeur van die dienskontrak van dr Vuyelwa Nhlapo as die Hoof Uitvoerende Beampte van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsagentskap, vir 'n termyn van twee jaar, met ingang 1 September 2013 tot 31 Augustus 2015.
tgt: Cabinet concurred with the appointment of the following persons to the Council Of The Private Security Industry Regulatory Authority, for a period not exceeding three years:a) Mr Daniel Claude Mojalefa Rathebe (Vice-Chairperson)b) Brigadier Cynthia Lindiwe Philison (councillor)c) Mr Benjamin Somangamane Ntuli (councillor)d) Ms. Nontokoza Mthembu (councillor).

src: Die Kabinet het die aanstelling goedgekeur van mnrMokadi Max Mathye as die Hoof Uitvoerende Beampte vir die Voedsel en Drank se Sektorale Onderwys-en- Opleidingsowerheid.
tgt: Cabinet approved the extension of the employment contract of Dr Vuyelwa Nhlapo as the Chief Executive Officer of ` the National Development Agency, for a 2 year term with effect 1 September 2013 to 31 August 2015.

src: Die Kabinet het die heraanstelling goedgekeur van daardie lede wat hul beskikbaarheid bevestig het om steeds vanaf September 2013 tot Augustus 2018 op die Raad vir Meslike-hulpbronontwikkeling van Suid-Afrika (HRDC) te dien.
tgt: Cabinet approved the appointment of Mr Mokadi Max Mathye as the Chief Executive Officer for the Food and Beverage Sector Education and Training Authority.

src: 23 Sep Die Kabinet se standpunt oor prominente kwessies in die huidige omgewing.1 Onder President Jacob Zuma se leierskap loods die Regering die land se multimiljoenrand openbare infrastruktuurprogram wat daarop gemik is om werksgeleenthede te ontsluit en dienste aan alle Suid-Afrikaners te verskaf.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on prominent issues in the current environment.1 Under President Jacob Zuma’s leadership, government is rolling out the country’s multitrillion-rand public infrastructure programme aimed at unlocking job opportunities and bringing services to all South Africans.

src: Deur hierdie program is die Regering getrou aan sy verbintenis om meer werksgeleenthede te skep.
tgt: Through these programmes government is delivering on its commitment to create more jobs.

src: Sedert die aanvaarding van die Nuwe Groeipad het werksgeleenthede met 750 000 toegeneem.
tgt: Since the adoption of the New Growth Path employment has increased by 750 000, with just under half of these jobs, having been generated in the public service, especially amongst the ranks of health workers, teachers and the police.

src: Hierdie program prioritiseer die ontwikkeling van kleinsakeondernemings wat as 'n belangrike komponent vir die ontsluiting van ekonomiese geleenthede beskou word.
tgt: These programmes prioritise small business development which is an important component for unlocking economic opportunities.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy dank teenoor alle sektore wat met die Regering saamspan om sy massiewe infrastruktuurontwikkelingsinsiatief uit te voer en vra vir verdere samewerking om werkskepping te bespoedig en om die land se ekonomie en samelewing te WEBTOKEN deel van die inwerkingstelling van die openbare infrastruktuur open President Zuma op 20 September die Grootvlei-kragstasie en inspekteer die spoorlynkonstruksieperseel in Mpumalanga.
tgt: Cabinet expresses its gratitude to those sectors who are partnering with government to implement this massive infrastructure development drive and calls for further collaboration in fast-tracking efforts to create employment and transform the economy and our WEBTOKEN part of the public infrastructure roll-out President Jacob Zuma will on 20 September 2013 open the Grootvlei Power Station and inspect the railway line construction site in Mpumalanga.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die oprigting van die nuwe Sol Plaatje Universiteit in Kimberley in die Noord-Kaap.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the construction of the new Sol Plaatjie University in Kimberley, Northern Cape which is expected to start before the end of September 2013.

src: Die universiteit is 'n mylpaal in die groei en ontwikkeling van Suid-Afrika se tersiêre onderwyssektor.
tgt: This is a major milestone in the growth and development of South Africa’s tertiary education sector.

src: Die sooispitplegtigheid lui die aanvang van die bouwerk aan die kampus in.
tgt: The sod turning event marked the official commencement on construction of the campus.

src: Die ontwikkeling van die nuwe universiteit is geïdentifiseer en geprioritiseer binne die strategies-geïntegreerde projekte (SIP 14) deur die Presidensiële Infrastruktuurkoördineringskommissie (PICC).2 President Jacob Zuma en die Kabinet, bring op 29 September 2013 hulde aan Suid-Afrika se senior burgers by die Sefako M Makgatho Presidensiële Gastehuis in Pretoria.
tgt: The development of the new university has been identified and prioritised within the Strategic Integrated Projects (SIP 14) by the Presidential Infrastructure Coordinating Committee (PICC).2 President Jacob Zuma together with his Cabinet will be honouring senior citizens of South Africa at Sefako Makgatho Presidential Guest House in Pretoria on 29 September 2013.

src: Die geleentheid huldig die bydrae wat senior burgers tot die ontwikkeling van die gemeenskappe en die land gelewer het.
tgt: This forms part of celebrating the contribution by our senior citizens to the development of our communities and country.

src: Dit lui die begin van die Week vir Ouer Persone in wat op 6 Oktober ten einde loop en as Grootouerdag bekend staan.3 President Jacob Zuma spreek die Algemene Debat van die 68ste Sessie van die Verenigde Nasies se Algemene Vergadering (UNGA68) op 24 September 2013 in New York toe.
tgt: This will mark the start of the Older Persons Week, ending on 6 October, which is Grandparents Day.3 President Jacob Zuma will address the General Debate of the 68th Session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA68) in New York on 24 September 2013.This year’s theme is: “The Post-2015 Development Agenda: Setting the Stage!” and focusses on the Millennium Development Goals (MDGs) target date of 2015, as well the Development Agenda going forward.

src: Die UNGA68 bied aan Suid-Afrika 'n platform om ons strategiese benadering vir die bereiking van die MDGs en Post-2015 Development Agenda te bevorder.
tgt: UNGA68 provides South Africa with a platform to advance our strategic approach towards achieving the MDGs and the Post-2015 Development Agenda.

src: Ons deelname word ook gerig deur Suid-Afrika se nasionale belang en prioriteite, en ons verbintenis tot die streek en die kontinent.4 Die Kabinet veroordeel ten sterkste die sabotering van die elektrisiteitsvoorsiening deur onwettige stakings wat gelei het tot kragonderbrekings in Johannesburg.
tgt: Our participation will also be informed by South Africa’s national interest and priorities, as well as our regional and continental commitments.4 Cabinet condemns in the strongest terms the sabotage to the electricity grid by illegal strikers that resulted in power outages in parts of Johannesburg.

src: Sulke dade op 'n tydstip dat die land daaraan werk om sy elektrisiteitsvoorsiening te stabiliseer kan nie geïgnoreer word nie en moet met die volle mag van die reg beveg word.5 Die vrystelling van Suid-Afrika se jaarlikse 2012/13 Nasionale Misdaadstatistiek herbevestig ons oortuiging dat samewerking ons sal help om ons doelwit van misdaadvrye samelewing te bereik, wat beleggings lok en wat op sy beurt vrede en stabiliteit in ons gemeenskappe sal verseker.
tgt: Such acts at the time when the country is moving towards stabilising its electricity supply cannot be ignored and must be dealt with to the full extent of the law.5 The release of South Africa’s annual 2012/13 National Crime Statistics reaffirms our conviction that working together we will reach our goal of a society that is free from crime, that attracts investment that ensure peace and stability in our communities.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle rolspelers om op konstruktiewe wyse met die bevindinge om te gaan.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all stakeholders to constructively engage with the findings.

src: Die Regering stel hierdie statistiek een maal per jaar vry hoofsaaklik om die jongste inligting oor die stryd teen misdaad in die land aan die publiek bekend te stel, en ook om die huidige strategieë in misdaadbestryding te hersien.
tgt: Government releases these statistics once a year primarily to provide the public with updated information on the fight against crime in the country, as well as to review of some of the current strategies in tackling crime.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens (SAPD) gebruik ook op daaglikse basis misdaadstatistiek as bestuurshulpmiddel vir operasionele planne.
tgt: Crime statistics are also used daily as a management tool to guide operational plans for the South African Police Service (SAPS).Cabinet commends the tireless efforts of the South African Police Service and all organised and community bodies which have partnered with government in the fight against crime.

src: Die Kabinet loof die onvermoeide pogings deur die SAPD en alle georganiseerde gemeenskapsliggame wat in vennootskap met die Regering optree in die stryd teen misdaad.
tgt: Cabinet calls upon all South Africans to join the fight against crime.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om betrokke te raak by die stryd teen misdaad.
tgt: Working together we will ensure a South Africa were South African feel safe and secure.6 Cabinet expressed its grave concern at the recent spate of gruesome road traffic accidents.

src: Sulke ongelukke laat gesinne sonder heenkome en het 'n ernstige negatiewe uitwerking op die ekonomie.
tgt: Such accidents have left some families destitute and they also have a serious negative impact on the economy.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle motoriste om te verseker dat hulle voertuie padwaardig is en dat hulle verantwoordelik agter die stuurwiel sal optree.
tgt: Cabinet calls upon all motorists to ensure that their vehicles are roadworthy and they take responsibility when get behind the wheel.

src: In die lig hiervan doen die Kabinet 'n beroep op verkeersowerhede om voort te gaan met hul benadering van onverdraagsaamheid teenoor onpadwaardige voertuie en dronkbestuur.
tgt: To that extent Cabinet calls upon road traffic authorities to continue to main a zero tolerance towards unroadworthy vehicles and drank driving.

src: Die Kabinet versoek ook voetgangers om die verkeersreëls na te kom.7 Die Kabinet vra alle Suid-Afrikaners om Erfenisdag op 24 September 2013 te vier deur verskille plekke dwarsoor die land waar ons ryk en diverse erfenis uitgebeeld word, te besoek.
tgt: Cabinet also calls upon pedestrians to respect the traffic laws.7 Cabinet calls on all South Africans to celebrate Heritage Day, 24 September 2013 by visiting various sites of our rich and diverse heritage across the country in celebrating our 20 Years of Freedom.

src: Daar word 'n beroep gedoen op alle Suid-Afrikaners, skole, besighede en gemeenskappe om die vlag hoog te laat wapper as simbool van ons viering van 20 jaar van vryheid en om die Freedom Friday-veldtog wat op 20 September geloods is, te ondersteun.8 Die Kabinet wens Lucas Sithole geluk met sy oorwinning in die rolstoel vierwiel enkeltitel by die Amerikaanse Ope Tennistoernooi in New York.
tgt: All South Africans, schools, businesses and communities are called upon to fly our flag high as a symbol of our celebration of 20 Years of Freedom and to support the ‘Freedom Friday’ campaign being launched on 20 September 20.8 Cabinet congratulates Lucas Sithole for winning the wheelchair quad singles title at the US Open Tennis Tournament in New York.

src: Sithole het ná die oorwinning met een plek tot tweede plek opgeskuif.
tgt: Sithole's world ranking rose one spot to second following the victory, which was the first major International Tennis Federation title for an African and South African.

src: Dit was die eerste groot titel van die Internasionale Tennisfederasie wat 'n Afrikaan en 'n Suid-Afrikaner inpalm.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to support our disabled athletes who continue to make our country proud by delivering a world-class performance and inspiring all of us to reach greater heights.9 Cabinet welcomes the National Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (BBBEE) Summit which will take place from 3 to 5 October 2013 under the theme: “A Decade of Economic Empowerment”.The policy instrument of Black Economic Empowerment is essentially a growth strategy aimed at broadening the economic base of the country by targeting inequality which remains the weakest point of the South African economy.

src: Korporatiewe rolspelers, vakbondverteenwoordigers, politieke partye en burgerlike organisasies sal deur middel van die gewysigde BBBEE Wet en die verfynde BBBEE-gedragskodes en goeie praktyk deelneem aan die kartering van Suid-Afrika se derde herhaling van swart ekonomiese bemagtiging.10 Die Kabinet loof die Departement van Sosiale Ontwikkeling vir hul nuwe strategie om dienslewering te verbeter, genaamd Projek Mikondzo wat uitgebrei sal word tot sosiale dienste aan die armes en kwesbares in al die uithoeke van Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Key Cabinet discussions and decisions.1 Cabinet approved the National Policy on Food and Nutrition Security, the Household Food and Nutrition Security Strategy and the Fetsa Tlala Food Production intervention.

src: Die plekke en program vir die week sal mettertyd aangekondig word.2 Sleutelbesprekings en besluite deur die Kabinet.1 Die Kabinet keur die Nasionale Beleid vir Voedsel- en Voedingsveiligheid, die Huishouding Voedsel en Voedingstrategie en die Fetsa Tlala-voedselproduksie-ingryping goed.
tgt: A launch will be conducted to unpack the Policy and Programmes.2 Cabinet approved the Framework for South Africa’s engagement with the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) for the period 2013/14-2016/17.South Africa seeks to utilise this relationship to achieve three key objectives i) higher, inclusive economic growth, a prerequisite for addressing unemployment, poverty and inequality ii) a skilled and capable workforce, to support the delivery of the national development targets and iii) Advancing the African agenda, where South Africa will seek to exert greater influence of the global agenda from which African economies can derive benefit.

src: Die Nasionale Beleid beoog om te reageer op die talle uitdagings wat verband hou met voedselonsekerheid in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: OECD countries remain key trade and investment partners for South Africa.

src: Dit word ondersteun deur spesifieke ingrypingstrategieë om die uitdaging van voedseltekorte in huishoudings te takel, en ook om voedselproduksie te vergroot ten einde honger teen die einde van 2030 te stop.
tgt: It is estimated that OECD countries contributed more than 65% to global GDP in 2011.The approach provides a framework for government departments to manage their respective engagements with the OECThis enhanced coordination in government would enable optimal benefits to be derived from the partnership.

src: Die Wetsontwerp stel 'n aansporing voor wat hoofsaaklik daarop gemik is om werkgewers aan te moedig om jong en minder ervare werksoekers in diens te neem.
tgt: The incentive will create conditions conducive to job creation and improve employment prospects for such marginalised workers.

src: Die aansporing is een van vele wat ressorteer onder die sambreel van die Regering se strategie vir jeugindiensneming en sal bestaande regeringsprogramme komplementeer.
