src: Die Kabinet het die sesde jaarlikse Iteratiewe Industriële Beleidsaksieplan (IPAP) 2014/15 tot 2016/17 vir implementering goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the 6th Annual Iterative Industrial Policy Action Plan (IPAP) 2014/15 - 2016/17 for implementation.

src: Die oorheersende doelwit van IPAP is om agteruitgang in die nywerheid te voorkom en groei en diversifikasie van Suid-Afrika se vervaardigingsektor ondersteun.
tgt: The overriding goal of the IPAP is to prevent industrial decline and support the growth and diversification of South Africa’s manufacturing sector.

src: Die Minister van Handel en Nywerheid sal die media toespreek wanneer IPAP volgende maand bekend gestel word.
tgt: The Minister of Trade and Industry will address the media when IPAP is launched next month.

src: Die Kabinet het die benadering tot die verstryking van permitte uitgereik kragtens die projek van Spesiale Bedeling vir Zimbabwiërs (DZP) goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the approach on the expiry of permits issued under the Special Dispensation for Zimbabweans project (DZP).

src: Die Minister van Binnelandse Sake sal mettertyd meer duidelikheid oor die proses en die datum van die inwerkingtreding gee.
tgt: The Minister of Home Affairs will in due course provide more clarity on the process to be followed and the date of commencement.

src: Die Kabinet het dit goedgekeur dat Artikel 100 (1)
tgt: Cabinet approved that Section 100 (1)

src: ingrypings in Limpopo gehandhaaf word om voorsiening te maak vir ’n oorsig in Junie 2014 na die instelling van die nuwe administrasie.
tgt: interventions in Limpopo be maintained, in order to allow for a review in June 2014 after the new administration is in place.

src: Dit sal kontinuïteit van ingrypings verseker om uitdagings aan te pak waaraan nog nie aandag geskenk is nie.
tgt: This will ensure continuity of interventions to address outstanding challenges.

src: Dit sal verseker dat die verbetering in die finansiële posisie van provinsies en dienslewering in maatskaplike dienste en ander sektore in stand gehou word.
tgt: This will ensure that improvements in the provinces financial position and service delivery in social services and other sectors are maintained.

src: Die Kabinet het die Oorsig van die Suid-Afrikaanse Weermag 2014 goedgekeur en gelas dat dit in die Parlement ter tafel gelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the South African Defence Review 2014, and directed that it be tabled in Parliament.

src: Die oorsig gee ’n beleid oor verdediging vir die langtermyn asook strategiese trajek vir verdediging wat die land oor die volgende vier Meiumtermyn- Strategiese Raamwerk periodes moet nastreef.
tgt: The Review provides a long term defense policy and Defense strategic trajectory to be pursued by the country over the next four Medium Term Strategic Framework periods.

src: Die dokument sal openbaar gemaak word aangesien die publiek die afgelope jaar landwyd in openbare gesprekke daaraan deelgeneem het.6 Die Kabinet het ingestem dat die Verslag van die Ministeriële Komitee oor Artikulasie-beleid in die Staatskoerant vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer word.
tgt: The document will be shared with the public, as they participated in the public consultations that were held across the country in the past year.6 Cabinet approved that the Report of the Ministerial Committee on Articulation Policy be published in the Government Gazette for public comment.

src: Die verslag ontleed die naskoolse onderwys-en-opleidingstelsel in ’n sosio-ekonomiese konteks.
tgt: The report analyses the post-school education and training system in its socio-economic context.

src: Dit bied aanbevelings aan die Minister van Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding oor hoe om onnodige struikelblokke, wat studente se vordering belemmer, te verwyder.
tgt: It provides recommendations to the Minister of Higher Education and Training on how to remove unnecessary obstacles and bottlenecks that prevent or inhibit students’ progression.

src: Die artikulasiebeleid verwys na die sistematiese koördinering van opvoedkundige instellings, programme en kwalifikasies, sodat studente hul gekose leerbane doeltreffend kan nastreef.7 Die Kabinet het gelas dat die Verslag van die Ministeriële Taakspan oor Grondslagprogramme vir Wiskunde en Wetenskap in die Staatskoerant vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer word.
tgt: The articulation policy refers to the systematic coordination of educational institutions, programmes and qualifications so that students are able to pursue their chosen learning pathways in an efficient manner.

src: Die Ministeriële Taakspan is opdrag gegee om ’n program vir wiskunde en wetenskap in die grondslagfase te ontwikkel wat geskoei is op tegniese beroeps- en kollege-opleiding.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Report from the Ministerial Task Team on Mathematics and Science Foundation Programmes, be published in the Government Gazette for public comment.

src: Dit sal help om die aantal studente aan universiteite wat wiskunde en wetenskap studeer, te verhoog en kapasiteit verbeter soos in die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan uitgelig.
tgt: The Ministerial Task Team was mandated to develop a Technical Vocational Education and Training College-based Mathematics and Science Foundation Programme.

src: Die program is gerig op studente wat tegniese beroepsonderwys en opleiding wil betree, die wat reeds in die tegniese beroepsgerigte onderwys en opleiding is en die wat hulself wil verbeter en aan universiteite wil studeer, asook graad 12 leerders wat by universiteite wil inskryf, maar nie aan die vereistes van wiskunde en wetenskap voldoen nie.8 Die Kabinet het gelas dat die bevindinge van die 2012/13-verslag oor openbare befondsing vir wetenskaps- en tegnologieaktiwiteite gepubliseer word.
tgt: This will help to increase the number of university Science and Mathematics entrants and enhance the innovative capacity as highlighted in the National Development Plan.

src: Nasionale departemente het ’n geraamde R29,4 miljard in wetenskaps- en tegnologie- aktiwiteite in 2012/13 gepubliseer, wat 3% van nasionale Regering se totale begroting verteenwoordig.
tgt: The programme targets those who aspire to enter the Technical Vocational Education and Training sub-sector, those already in technical vocational education and training colleges aspiring to progress and enroll in universities, as well as Grade 12 learners who wish to enroll in universities but do not meet the Mathematics and Physical Science requirements.

src: Dit is ’n verbetering van die vier-jaar-gemiddeld van 2,9% tussen 2008/09 en 2011/12.Dit is ook duidelik dat die Regering die meeste van die wetenskapsnavorsing in Suid-Afrika befonds, en dat die grootste deel van die implementering buite nasionale departemente geleë is, naamlik in die wetenskapsrade en instellings vir hoër onderwys.9 Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die evaluering van die Departement van Prestasie Monitering en Evaluering oor Die impak van die Bekendstelling van Graad R op Leeruitkomste.
tgt: This is an improvement from the four year average of 2.9% between 2008/09 to 2011/12.It is also evident that government funds most of the scientific research that takes place in South Africa, and that the bulk of the implementation is located outside national departments, i. e. in science councils and higher education institutions.

src: Vroeë belegging in die groei en ontwikkeling van kinders kan ongelykheid verminder en produktiwiteit te verhoog, veral onder benadeelde kinders.
tgt: Cabinet was apprised on the evaluation by the Department of Performance Monitoring and Evaluation of ‘The Impact of the Introduction of Grade R on Learning Outcomes’.Early investment in the growth and development of young children is likely to reduce inequality and raise productivity, especially in disadvantaged young children.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die besondere prestasie in die reuse uitbreiding van Graad R, wat optimaal moet presteer om ’n wesentlike invloed op daaropvolgende skoolprestasie uit te oefen.10 Die Kabinet is meegedeel oor die bevindinge van die Leidende Diensleweringsmoniteringsprogram vir 2013.Die Kabinet loof en is bemoedig deur die verbetering van verantwoordelike nasionale departemente, wat betref strategiese bestuur en toesig oor prestasie op fasiliteitvlak.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the significant achievement in the massive expansion of Grade R which needs to maximise its potential in order to have a more substantial impact on subsequent educational performance.

src: Bevindinge vir die 186 fasiliteite in al die provinsies in 2013 (vir die eerste keer gemonitor) het getoon dat die burgery en moniteerders dat die gemiddelde prestasie wat betref waardige behandeling, ligging en toeganklikheid en die openings- en sluitingstye positief ervaar.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the findings from the Frontline Service Delivery Monitoring Programme for 2013.Cabinet commends and is encouraged by the improvement from responsible national departments, of their strategic management and oversight of facility-level performance.

src: Prestasie-areas wat ingryping vereis, is klagtebestuur, sigbaarheid en tekens, bestuur van lang toue, wagtye en veiligheid.
tgt: Findings for the 186 facilities (monitored for the first time) across all provinces during 2013 revealed that the average ratings for dignified treatment, location and accessibility and opening and closing times were positively rated by citizens and monitors.

src: Bevindinge van die 77 fasiliteite, wat hermonitor is om verbeterings te evalueer, het ook verbeterde graderings getoon.
tgt: Findings from the 77 facilities which were re-monitored to assess improvements also signaled improved average ratings, signaling positive signs towards managing facility-level performance as a strategic priority.

src: Dit dui op verbeterings in die bestuur van prestasie op fasiliteitsvlak as 'n strategiese prioriteit.11 Kabinet het die aanbieding van die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap (SAOG) se Buitengewone vergadering van Ministers verantwoordelik vir Inligtings-en-kommunikasietegnologie, Kommunikasie en Posdienste in Johannesburg vanaf 23 tot 25 Maart 2014 goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the hosting of the Southern African Development Community (SADC) Extraordinary Meeting of Ministers responsible for ICT, Communications and Postal Services from 23 to 25 March 2014, in Johannesburg.

src: AanstellingsDie Kabinet het die volgende aanstellings goedgekeur:.
tgt: AppointmentsCabinet approved the following appointments:.

src: Me Elaine Alexander in die pos van adjunk-direkteur-generaal: Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling, Handel en Bemarking by die Departement van Landbou, Bosbou en Visserye.
tgt: Ms Elaine Alexander to the post of Deputy Director-General: Economic Development, Trade and Marketing at the Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries.

src: Me Nkidi Dina Mohoboko in die pos van adjunk-direkteur-generaal: Leerakademie by die Departement van Binnelandse Sake.
tgt: Ms Nkidi Dinah Mohoboko to the post of Deputy Director-General: Learning Academy at the Department of Home Affairs.

src: Mnr Sam Themba Mtshisa in die pos van adjunk-direkteur-generaal: Korporatiewe Dienste by die Departement van Openbare Werke.
tgt: Mr Sam Themba Mtshisa to the post of Deputy Director-General: Corporate Services at the Department of Public Works.

src: Me Malijeng Theresa Ngqaleni in die pos van adjunk-direkteur-generaal: Interregeringsverhoudings by die Nasionale Tesourie.
tgt: Ms Malijeng Theresa Ngqaleni to the post of Deputy Director-General: Intergovernmental Relations at the National Treasury.

src: Mnr Michael Sass in die pos van rekenmeester-generaal van die Nasionale Tesourie.
tgt: Mr. Michael Sass to the post Accountant-General at the National Treasury.

src: Mnr Mlungisi Justice Mathonsi as hoofbedryfsbeampte van die Suid-Afrikaanse Poskantoor.
tgt: Mr Mlungisi Justice Mathonsi as Chief Operating Officer of the South African Post Office.

src: Nie-uitvoerende lede van die Oorgrenspadvervoeragentskap:a) Me Pam Edith Pokane (Voorsitter)b) Mnr Reuben Abel Dlaminic) Mnr Gordon Noahd) Mnr Moses Cyril Tiel Scotte) Mnr Wayne Smithf) Me Maleho Margaret Nkomo (heraanstelling as ondervoorsitter)g) Me Nala Mhlongo (heraanstelling).
tgt: Non-Executive Members to the Cross-Border Road Transport Agency:a) Ms Pam Edith Pokane (Chairperson)b) Mr. Reuben Abel Dlaminic) Mr Gordon Noahd) Mr Moses Cyril Tiel Scotte) Mr Wayne Smithf) Ms Maleho Margaret Nkomo (re-appointment as Deputy Chairperson) andg) Ms Nala Mhlongo (re-appointment).

src: Kabinet se posisie oor huidige kwessies.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on current issues.

src: Die Kabinet waardeer die sewende Staatsrede deur President Jacob Zuma op Dinsdag, 17 Junie 2014.
tgt: Cabinet appreciated the seventh State of the Nation Address (SoNA) which was delivered by President Jacob Zuma on Tuesday, 17 June 2014.

src: Die programme wat die President uitgelig het en deur die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan gelei sal word, sal in die komende weke deur die onderskeie ministeriële groeperings vrygestel word.
tgt: The programmes which were highlighted by President and are guided by the National Development Plan will be unpacked in the coming weeks by the various Ministerial clusters.

src: In die gees van "Saam beweeg ons Suid-Afrika vorentoe," doen die Kabinet 'n beroep op alle sektore van die samelewing om in samewerking met die Regering die nuwe program van aksie te implementeer, wat voortbou op die prestasies van die afgelope 20 jaar van vryheid.
tgt: In the spirit of Together We Move South Africa Forward, Cabinet calls on all sectors of society to partner with Government in implementing the new Programme of Action, which builds on the achievements made over the past 20 Years of Freedom.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die einde van die vyf maande lange staking in die Platinumgordel.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the end of the five-month strike in the Platinum Belt.

src: Die uitgerekte staking het ernstige negatiewe uitwerking op werkers, werkgewers en die land se ekonomie as geheel gehad.
tgt: The prolonged strike had dire negative effects on workers, employers and our economy as a whole.

src: Hoewel die reg om te staak in die Grondwet en arbeidswette beskerm word, doen die Kabinet 'n beroep op werkgewers en die arbeidsbeweging om onderhandelinge vinnig op te los en sulke lang stakings te vermy.
tgt: While the right to strike is protected in our Constitution and labour laws, Cabinet appeals to both employers and the labour movement to resolve negotiations speedily and to avoid such prolonged strikes.

src: Die sukses van ons ontwikkelingsprogramme hang af van 'n stabiele en vooruitstrewende ekonomie.
tgt: The success of our development programmes depends on a stable and thriving economy.

src: As Suid-Afrikaners het ons almal het 'n verantwoordelikheid om die land se ekonomie te laat groei.3 Die Kabinet neem kennis van die afgradering van Suid-Afrika deur die graderingsagentskappe, Standard & Poor's en Fitch die afgelope week.
tgt: As South Africans, we all have a responsibility to grow the country’s economy.3 Cabinet noted the downgrading of South Africa by the rating agencies, Standard and Poor’s, and Fitch in the past week.

src: Die Kabinet benadruk die feit dat die Regering gereed is om die groei-uitdagings wat Suid-Afrika in die gesig staar, die hoof te bied.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates that government is alive to the growth challenges South Africa faces.

src: Die Regering het 'n prioriteit gemaak van die versnelde implementering van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan, met hervormings wat daarop gemik is om Suid-Afrika se groeipotensiaal te ontsluit.
tgt: Government has prioritized the accelerated implementation of the National Development Plan, with reforms that are aimed at unlocking South Africa’s growth potential.

src: Die Regering is verbind tot die verbetering van die regulerende omgewing, die vermindering van vaardigheidstekorte en versnelling van sy infrastruktuur-beleggingsprogram om die struikelblokke wat groei belemmer, uit die weg te ruim.4 Die Kabinet verwelkom die bevindinge van die Algemene Huishoudelike Opname 2013 wat Statistieke Suid-Afrika onlangs vrygestel het.
tgt: Government is committed to improving the regulatory environment, reducing skills shortages and accelerating its infrastructure investment programme as part of removing obstacles that are constraining growth.4 Cabinet welcomes the findings of the 2013 General Household Survey which was recently released by Statistics South Africa.

src: Hierdie bevindinge bevestig die goeie vordering wat die Regering se gesonde beleid en programme gemaak het om die lewens van Suid-Afrikaners te verbeter.
tgt: These findings confirm the good story that government’s solid policies and programmes are changing the lives of South Africans for the better.

src: Die opname bevestig dat toegang tot dienste soos water, vullisverwydering, behuising en gratis onderwys bestendige groei getoon het.
tgt: The survey confirms that access to services such as water, refuse collection, housing and free education have recorded steady growth over time.

src: Die persentasie Suid-Afrikaners met lopende water het tot 89,9% gestyg en die aantal huishoudings met elektrisiteit het in 2013 op 85% gestaan.
tgt: South Africans with piped water increased to 89,9 per cent while the number of households connected to electricity stood at 85 per cent in 2013.Government’s social grant programme continues to provide a safety net for families and communities who would otherwise be devastated by the scourge of poverty and unemployment.

src: Die persentasie mense wat toegang tot maatskaplike toelae ontvang, het vanaf 13,7% in 2003 tot 45,5% in 2013 gestyg.
tgt: The number of people accessing social grants increased from 13,7 per cent in 2003 to 45,5 per cent in 2013.

src: Die persentasie huishoudings waar mense honger ly, het van 29,3% in 2002 tot 13,4% in 2013 gedaal.
tgt: The percentage of households where people go hungry dropped from 29,3 per cent in 2002 to 13,4 per cent in 2013.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die hoëvlak- Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging gelei deur President Jacob Zuma wat die 23ste Afrika-Unie-spitsberaad onder die tema: "Landbou en Voedselsekerheid in Afrika" bygewoon het.
tgt: Cabinet noted the high-level South African delegation led by President Jacob Zuma that is attending the 23rd African Union Summit under the theme: “Agriculture and Food Security in Africa”.

src: Die beraad het van 20 tot 27 Junie 2014 in Malabo in die Republiek van Ekwatoriaal-Guinee WEBTOKEN deel van die vasteland, sal Suid-Afrika 'n bydrae maak tot die bespreking van die ontwikkelingsagenda vir Afrika en sal die spitsberaad bystaan om die ontwikkelingsprogramme vir die land te verbeter.
tgt: The Summit takes place from 20 to 27 June 2014 in Malabo in the Republic of Equatorial WEBTOKEN part of the continent, South Africa will be making a contribution to discussions of the development agenda for Africa and will leverage the Summit to enhance the development programmes for the country.6 Cabinet commends the Department of Arts and Culture and the National Youth Development Agency for leading Youth Month activities under the theme “Youth Moving South Africa Forward”.As we continue to celebrate the Youth Month, Cabinet reiterates government’s programme of working with young people to change their lives and transform the country.

src: Die Kabinet loof die Departement van Kuns en Kultuur en die Nasionale Jeugontwikkelingsagentskap vir hulle leiding in van Jeugmaand-aktiwiteite onder die tema "Jeug Beweeg Suid-Afrika Vorentoe".Terwyl ons Jeugmaand vier, bevestig die Kabinet die Regering se program om saam met jongmense te werk om hul lewens te verander en die land te transformeer.
tgt: In the last five years alone, R2,7 billion was set aside for youth entrepreneurship finance support, student bursaries have doubled and early childhood programmes have enriched the foundation stage of children.

src: Die Regering bly verbind tot sodanige ingrypings en nooi jongmense om ons te help om Suid-Afrika te lei.
tgt: Such interventions will remain a focus for government, as we invite young people to become our partners in moving South African forward.

src: Sleutelkabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die vordering van die ontwikkeling van die Nasionale Klimaatsveranderingsreaksieleid (NCCRP): Ontleding van die tempering van kweekhuisgasse.
tgt: Cabinet was apprised on progress we made in developing the National Climate Change Response Policy (NCCRP): Green House Gas (GHG) Mitigation Analysis.

src: Die verslag ontleed Suid-Afrika se vertoning om die invloed van klimaatverandering doeltreffend te bestuur en maak aanbevelings aangaande die land se bydrae tot die wêreldwye poging om konsentrasies van kweekhuisgasse in die atmosfeer te verminder.
tgt: The report analyses South Africa’s performance in effective management of the climate change impacts, and makes recommendations for South Africa’s contribution to the global effort to reduce Greenhouse Gas (GHG) concentrations in the atmosphere.

src: Die Kabinet het 'n konsep-verslag oor die Nasionale Kweekhuisgasinventaris vir Suid-Afrika vir die tydperk 2000 tot 2010 ontvang.
tgt: Cabinet further received a draft report on the National Greenhouse Gas Inventory for South Africa, for the period 2000 – 2010.

src: Dit is in lyn met die Verenigde Nasionale Raamwerkkonvensie oor Klimaatsverandering, wat Suid-Afrika in 1997 onderteken het.
tgt: This is in line with the United National Framework convention on Climate Change which South Africa ratified in 1997.

src: Ingevolge die konvensie moet lande hul vorderingsverslae elke twee jaar indien.
tgt: According to this Convention countries are meant submit their progress reports every two years.

src: Die huidige konsepverslag is vir publieke kommentaar vrygestel.
tgt: The current draft report has been released for public comments.

src: Dit sal later vanjaar gereed wees vir voorlegging.
tgt: It will be finalised to be ready for submission later in the year.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die goedkeuring van 'n nuwe buffersone vir die Mapungubwe-wêrelderfenisgebied deur die Wêrelderfeniskomitee van Unesco, wat van 15 tot 25 Junie 2014 sy 38ste Sessie in Doha, Katar, gehou het.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the approval of a new buffer zone for the Mapungubwe World Heritage Site by the World Heritage Committee of UNESCO which held its 38th Session in Doha, Qatar, from 15 to 25 June 2014.

src: Die nuwe buffersone is die gevolg van 'n lang konsultasieproses wat grondeienaars, gemeenskapsverteenwoordigers, nie-regeringsorganisasies, mynmaatskappye en verskeie regeringbelanghebbendes betrek het.
tgt: The new buffer zone is the result of a long consultation process involving land owners, community representatives, non-governmental organisations, mining companies and various government stakeholders.

src: Die goedkeuring van die nuwe buffersone is 'n welkome ontwikkeling vir Suid-Afrika se pogings om die bestuur en beskerming van sy wêrelderfenisterreine te verbeter en steeds vir verantwoordelike en volhoubare ontwikkeling voorsiening te maak.
tgt: The approval of this new buffer zone is a welcome development for South Africa’s efforts to improve the management and protection of its world heritage sites while allowing for responsible and sustainable development.

src: Komende gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Suid-Afrika sal as mede-gasheer 'n vennootskapsforumvergadering met die Vennootskap vir Moeder-, Pasgebore en Kindergesondheid by die Sandton Konferensiesentrum in Gauteng, van 30 Junie tot 1 Julie 2014 aanbied.
tgt: South Africa will be co-hosting a Partnership Forum Meeting with the Partnership for Maternal, Newborn and Child Health at Sandton Convention Centre, Gauteng, from 30 June to 1 July 2014.

src: Die vennootskap is 'n wêreldwye organisasie waar die Wêreldgesondheidsorganisasie as gasheer WEBTOKEN as mede-gasheer op te tree bied die forum 'n geleentheid om te fokus op die belangrikheid van die bevordering van moeder-, baba- en kindergesondheid in Suid-Afrika en om alle sektore van die samelewing betrokke te kry om ’n bydrae tot hierdie program te maak.
tgt: Co-hosting the Forum provides a platform to focus on the importance of strengthening maternal, infant and child health in South Africa and to mobilise all sectors of society to contribute to this effort.

src: Die vrystelling van die Wêreld-aftelling van hoe die wêreld besig is om sy Millennium-Ontwikkelingsdoelwitte 4 en 5 te bereik, sal deelnemers van gesondheids- en nie-gesondheidsektore help om vordering te ontleed en lesse daaruit te leer.
tgt: The release of the Global Countdown on how the world is doing in meeting the Millennium Development Goals 4 and 5 will also enable the participants from health and non-health sectors to take stock of progress and learn WEBTOKEN will also promote greater accountability and responsibility towards women, newborns, children and adolescents, enabling them to realise their right to the highest attainable standard of health in the years to 2015 and beyond.2 South Africa will be hosting the International Mathematics Olympiad (IMO).

src: Die IWO is 'n jaarlikse probleemoplossingswedstryd vir hoërskoolleerders en word elke jaar in ’n ander land gehou.
tgt: IMO is an annual problem-solving contest for high school students, held in a different country every year.

src: Dit is 'n geleentheid om ons land se vermoë om wêreldgeleenthede aan te bied en die land se voorste wiskundiges ten toon te stel.
tgt: This is an opportunity to showcase our country’s ability to host world-class events and profile South Africa’s top-class mathematicians.

src: ’n Totaal van 109 lande het reeds vir hierdie IWO geregistreer.
tgt: A total of 109 countries have already registered for this IMAppointmentsCabinet approved the following appointments:.

src: Die Kabinet se posisie oor huidige kwessies.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on current issues.

src: Die Kabinet herinner alle Suid-Afrikaners daaraan om gedurende hierdie Mandela-maand ons geliefde voormalige President Nelson Mandela te vereer en te onthou deur aktief deel te neem aan die "Skoon Suid-Afrika"-veldtog.
tgt: Cabinet reminds all South Africans to honour and remember our beloved former President Nelson Mandela during this Mandela Month by actively participating in the “Clean South Africa” Campaign.

src: Tydens Nelson Mandela-dag op 18 Julie en meer algemeen gedurende die hele maand, moet Suid-Afrikaners gehoor gee an President Jacob Zuma se beroep in sy Staatsrede om minstens 67 minute daaraan te wy om Suid-Afrika skoon te maak.
tgt: During Nelson Mandela Day on 18 July and more broadly during this month South Africans should dedicate at least 67 minutes to clean South Africa as per the call by President Jacob Zuma during the State of the Nation Address.

src: Oud-president Nelson Mandela het ons geleer dat enige individu 'n positiewe impak op die gemeenskap kan hê.
tgt: Former President Nelson Mandela taught us that any individual can have a positive impact on their community.

src: Ons het almal 'n verantwoordelikheid om sy lewe te eer deur die skoonmaak, die verbetering en verfraaiing van ons gemeenskappe.
tgt: We all have a responsibility to honour his life by cleaning, improving and beautifying our communities.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die Passasierspooragentskap van Suid-Afrika (Prasa) se massiewe spoorvernuwingsprogram.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa (PRASA) massive rail revitalisation programme.

src: As deel van hierdie program het die Minister van Vervoer die finale ontwerp van Prasa se splinternuwe, moderne en veilige pendelaartrein onthul, wat spog met die nuutste tegnologie wat die spoorwegbedryf wêreldwyd bied.
tgt: As part of this programme, the Minister of Transport unveiled the final design of PRASA’s brand-new, modern and safe commuter train which boasts the latest technology the rail industry has to offer throughout the world.

src: Dit is nog 'n besondere mylpaal in die Regering se verbintenis om infrastruktuur te ontwikkel wat die ekonomie stimuleer en plaaslike aankope ondersteun.
tgt: This is another special milestone in government’s commitment to build infrastructure that will stimulate the economy and support local procurement.

src: Die eerste Prasa-trein sal na verwagting in 2015 volstoom begin werk.
tgt: The first PRASA train is expected to hit the track in 2015.The modernisation of the train system will overhaul metro rail services - ‘a major catalyst for the transformation of public transport in South Africa.

src: Prasa sal oor die volgende 10 jaar R51 miljard spandeer om 600 top-klas treine vir die mense van Suid-Afrika aan te koop.
tgt: PRASA will spend R51 billion over the next 10 years to procure 600 top class trains for the people of South Africa.

src: Altesaam 580 van hierdie treine sal in Suid-Afrika vervaardig word by 'n nuwe fabriek wat in Dunnotar buite Nigel in Ekurhuleni gevestig sal word teen 'n koste van R1 miljard.
tgt: A total of 580 of these trains will be manufactured in South Africa at a new factory to be established in Dunnotar outside Nigel in Ekurhuleni at a cost of R1 billion.

src: Die 600 000 m2 fabriek is ontwerp om die vervaardigingsaanleg, 'n opleidingsfasiliteit en 'n volwaardige industriële park te huisves.
tgt: The 600 000 m2 manufacturing facility is designed to house the manufacturing plant, a training facility and fully fledged industrial park.

src: Die projek sal 8 088 regstreekse werkgeleenthede skep, wat deel uitmaak van meer as 33 000 direkte en indirekte werkgeleenthede oor die 10-jaar tydperk, en sal 'n plaaslike inhoudvlak van meer as 65% bereik.
tgt: The project will create 8 088 direct jobs, part of over 33 000 direct and indirect jobs over the 10-year period, achieving a local content level of over 65%.

src: Prasa sal altesaam 19 527 individue (ingenieurs, vakmanne, tegnici, treindrywers en, onder andere, tegnoloë) gedurende die leeftyd van die projek oplei.
tgt: PRASA will train a total of 19 527 individuals (engineers, artisans, technicians, train drivers and, among others, technologists) during the life of the project.

src: Die Spoorwegvloot-vernuwingsprogram is veel meer as die verkryging van treine dit gaan oor die drie pilare wat die bedryf tot sy eertydse glorie sal herstel, ons spoorwegingenieursektor sal laat herleef en sal bydra tot ekonomiese ontwikkeling en lokalisering.
tgt: The Rolling Stock Fleet Renewal Programme is much more than the procurement of trains, it is about three pillars which will bring this industry to its former glory, revive our rail engineering sector and contribute to economic development and localisation.3 Cabinet welcomes the launch today by President Jacob Zuma of the First Automotive Works (FAW) South Africa assembly plant and operations in the COEGA Industrial Development Zone (IDZ) in the Nelson Mandela Bay Metro in Port Elizabeth, in the Eastern Cape.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling deur President Jacob Zuma vandag van die motorvervaardiger First Automotive Works (FAW) Suid-Afrika se monteringsaanleg en bedryf in die COEGA Industriële Ontwikkelingsone (IDS) in die Nelson Mandela-baai Mero, Port Elizabeth, in die Oos-Kaap.
tgt: The R600 million truck assembly plant, located in Zone 2 of the COEGA IDZ is funded jointly by China FAW Group Corporation and the China-Africa Development Fund.

src: Dit is een van die grootste beleggings wat deur 'n Chinese maatskappy gemaak is.
tgt: It is one of the largest investments made by a Chinese company.

src: Hierdie aanleg sal 'n beduidende bydrae lewer tot die nasionale doelwitte vir sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling soos vervat in die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan, die Nuwe Groeipad en die Industriële Beleid Aksieplanne.
tgt: This plant will contribute significantly to national goals for socio-economic development as enshrined in the National Development Plan, New Growth Path and the Industrial Policy Action Plans.

src: Voordele vir Nelson Mandela-baai en die groter Oos-Kaapstreek sluit in direkte buitelandse beleggings wat op sy beurt volhoubare werkgeleenthede sal skep en geleenthede sal bied vir vaardigheidsontwikkeling en opleiding.
tgt: Benefits to The Nelson Mandela Bay and the greater Eastern Cape region include generation of foreign direct investment that will in turn create sustainable jobs and provide opportunities for skills development and training.4 Cabinet again condemns the theft of cables from rail, electrical and municipal public infrastructures.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel weer eens die diefstal van kabels van spoor-, elektriese en munisipale openbare infrastruktuur.
tgt: Such thefts hamper the smooth running of the economy of the country and in some instances jeopardise the lives of people.

src: Die wetstoepassingsagentskappe sal seker maak dat mense wat vir hierdie misdade in hegtenis geneem word met die volle mag van die reg sal kennis maak.
tgt: The law enforcement agencies will ensure those arrested face the full might of the law.

src: Die Kabinet het ook sy verbintenis bevestig tot die vervolging van skrootmetaalmaatskappye wat uit hierdie misdaad voordeel trek.
tgt: Cabinet further re-iterates its commitment to clamp down on scrap metal companies that feed off and fuel this crime.

src: Gemeenskappe word aangemoedig om saam met die Regering te werk deur gevalle by die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens aan te meld.
tgt: Communities are urged to work together with government by reporting to the South African Police Service.5 Cabinet encourages taxpayers to submit their individual tax returns for the 2014 tax season, which opened on 1 July 2014.

src: Die Kabinet moedig belastingbetalers aan om hul individuele belastingopgawes vir die 2014-belastingseisoen, wat op 1 Julie 2014 begin het, in te dien.
tgt: Taxes enable government to fund the country’s development plans.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom President Jacob Zuma se ondertekening van die Wysigingswet op die Herstel van Grondregte, wat dui op die heropening van die indiening van grondeise deur mense wat die vorige sperdatum gemis het en eisers nog vyf jaar bied om grondeise in te dien.
tgt: Every taxpayer who submits an accurate return on time plays their part in moving South Africa forward.6 Cabinet welcomes President Jacob Zuma’s signing of the Restitution of Land Rights Amendment Act, which signals the reopening of the lodgment of land claims for those who missed the previous deadline and provides claimants with another five years to lodge land claims.

src: Terwyl ongeveer 80 000 grondrestitusie-eise teen die 1998-sperdatum ingedien is, is daar na raming tot vyf keer soveel geldige gevalle wat aanhangig gemaak kan word deur slagoffers van gedwonge verskuiwings gedurende die apartheidsera.
tgt: Whilst approximately 80 000 land restitution claims were lodged by the 1998 deadline, it is estimated that there are up to five times as many valid cases that can be brought by victims of apartheid-era forced removals.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om die boodskap van hierdie wetgewing uit te dra om te verseker dat mense wat van hulle grond ontneem is en die 1998-sperdatum gemis het, na vore sal kom om hul grondeise vanaf 1 Julie 2014 tot 30 Junie 2019 in te dien.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to spread the message of this legislation to ensure that victims of land dispossession, who initially missed the 1998 deadline, come forward to lodge their land claims from 1 July 2014 until 30 June 20.7 Cabinet congratulates the Square Kilometre Array (SKA) SA-funded researchers who discovered a triple supermassive black hole system.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Suid-Afrikaans gefinansierde navorsers van die Square Kilometre Array (SKA) geluk met hulle ontdekking van 'n drieledige supermassiewe swartgatstelsel.
tgt: This is positive confirmation of the dynamic and significant radio astronomy which has developed rapidly in South Africa.

src: Dit is positiewe bevestiging van die vinnige ontwikkeling van dinamiese en betekenisvolle radio-astronomie in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: The discovery further demonstrates that South Africa has the scientific and technical expertise to be a world leader in radio astronomy.

src: Die ontdekking toon verder dat Suid-Afrika die wetenskaplike en tegniese kundigheid het om 'n wêreldleier in radio-astronomie te wees.
tgt: This internationally recognised research is a reminder of the unique opportunities presented to South Africa as a result of our successful bid, to build our skills set by stimulating interest in science and engineering among our youth.

src: Hierdie internasionaal erkende navorsing herinner ons dat daar danksy ons suksesvolle bod unieke geleenthede vir Suid-Afrika beskikbaar is om vaardighede te ontwikkel deurdat belangstelling in wetenskap en ingenieurswese onder ons jeug gestimuleer is.
tgt: It also provides the country with a basis to start producing scientists who will contribute to achieving Vision 2030 of the National Development Plan (NDP).This discovery is the beginning of many more that will be made possible with the Square Kilometre Array.

src: Dit voorsien die land ook van 'n basis om wetenskaplikes op te lei wat sal bydra tot die bereiking van Visie 2030 van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan.
tgt: Our successful bid has also opened many opportunities in the country, in particular thousands of jobs in construction, operations and maintenance in the Northern Cape where the core of the SKA is being built.8 Cabinet calls on young people to apply now for tertiary institutions in line with the Department of Higher Education and Training’s Apply Now!

src: Deur hierdie veldtog word leerders toegerus met die nodige inligting om ingeligte loopbaankeuses te maak en betyds aansoek te doen vir toelating.
tgt: Through this campaign learners are equipped with the necessary information to make informed career choices and apply on time.

src: Dit sal ook help om die druk wat aan die begin die akademiese jaar op studente geplaas word te verlig.
tgt: It will also contribute to averting the pressure that students face at the beginning of the academic year.

src: Leerders word ook daaraan herinner om gebruik te maak van die Nasionale Studente Finansiële Hulpskema, wat finansiële hulp bied aan akademies verdienstelike studente wat finansieel behoeftig is.
tgt: Learners are also reminded to make use of the National Student Financial Aid Scheme, which provides financial aid to academically deserving but financially needy students.9 Cabinet welcomes the outcomes of the recently held 23rd Ordinary Session of the African Union Assembly (AU Summit) under the theme: "2014 Year of Agriculture and Food Security in Africa" where President Jacob Zuma led a high level delegation.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die uitkomste van die 23ste Gewone Sessie van die Afrika-unie-beraad onder die tema: "2014 Jaar van Landbou en Voedselsekuriteit in Afrika" waar President Jacob Zuma 'n hoëvlak-afvaardiging gelei het.
tgt: Of note are the Summits decisions on key issues pertaining to development, peace and security, climate change and the mobilisation of resources as well as the finalisation of the Agenda 2063 Continental Framework, as part of the vision of Africa in the next 50 years and the Common African Position on the Post-2015 Development Agenda.10 Cabinet sends condolences to the family and friends of African National Congress Women's League Deputy President and former ANC Chief Whip in the National Council of Provinces, Ms Nosipho Dorothy Ntwanambi.

src: Van belang is die beraad se besluite oor belangrike kwessies wat verband hou met ontwikkeling, vrede en veiligheid, klimaatsverandering en die mobilisering van hulpbronne, sowel as die finalisering van die Agenda 2063 Kontinentale Raamwerk, as deel van die visie van Afrika in die volgende 50 jaar en die algemene Afrika-posisie oor die post-2015 Ontwikkelingsagenda.
tgt: She has left a deep void in the ongoing struggle for a just and equitable society where all its citizens enjoy equal freedoms, rights and opportunities.2 Key Cabinet decisions.

src: Die konferensie het verder ooreengekom dat die Globale Meanisme saam met die UNCCD-sekretariaat sal verskuif van die Internasionale Fonds vir Landbou-ontwikkeling in Rome, na Bonn.
tgt: Cabinet approved that South Africa ratify the Ban Amendment under the Basel Convention on the Control of Transboundary Movement of Hazardous Wastes and their Disposal.

src: Die Kabinet het goedgekeur dat Suid-Afrika die Verbodwysiging onder die Basel-konvensie oor die Beheer van die Oorgrensbeweging van Gevaarlike Afvalstowwe en Verwydering bekragtig.
tgt: The Basel Convention is an international treaty that regulates the Trans boundary movement of hazardous wastes.

src: Die Basel-konvensie is 'n internasionale verdrag wat die oorgrensbeweging van gevaarlike afval reguleer, terwyl die Basel-konvensie se verbodwysiging aangeneem is om ontwikkelende lande te beskerm teen die ontvangs van ingevoerde gevaarlike afval uit ontwikkelde lande.
tgt: While the Basel Convention Ban Amendment was adopted to protect developing countries from receiving imports of hazardous waste from developed countries.

src: Bekragtiging van die verbod sal verseker dat menslike gesondheid en die omgewing vir toekomstige geslagte beskerm word, en dat sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling volhoubaar bevorder word.
tgt: Ratification of the Ban would ensure that human health and the environment are protected for future generations, and that socio-economic development is promoted sustainably.

src: Dit sal 'n belangrike bydrae lewer tot die vermindering van Afrika se probleme met die storting van gevaarlike afval.
tgt: This would make a significant contribution to reducing Africa’s problems with dumped hazardous wastes.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: President Jacob Zuma sal 'n Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging na die sesde Brasilië, Rusland, Indië, China, Suid-Afrika (BRICS) -beraad lei, wat deur die Federale Republiek van Brasilië op 15 en 16 Julie 2014 onder die tema: "BRICS: Inklusiewe Groei, Volhoubare Oplossings" aangebied word.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma, will lead a South African delegation to the 6th Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa (BRICS) Summit, to be hosted by the Federative Republic of Brazil on 15-16 July 2014 under the theme: “BRICS: Inclusive Growth, Sustainable Solutions".During South Africa’s tenure as Chair of BRICS, substantive progress was achieved in anchoring the new BRICS mechanisms that were launched at the Fifth BRICS Summit, i. e. the BRICS Business Council as well as the BRICS Think Tanks Council, and reports will be submitted to the BRICS Leaders on the work undertaken by these structures.

src: Tydens Suid-Afrika se termyn as voorsitter van BRICS, is beduidende vooruitgang gemaak om die nuwe BRICS-meganismes wat by die vyfde BRICS-beraad van stapel gestuur is, te anker dit wil sê die BRICS Business Council, sowel as die raad van die BRICS Think Tanks en verslae sal aan die BRICS-leiers voorgelê word oor die werk wat deur hierdie strukture onderneem is.
tgt: The South African Government has fully implemented the eThekwini Action Plan, adopted at the last BRICS Summit hosted in Durban, South Africa, and will present a hand-over report on sectoral cooperation during its tenure as BRICS Chair, highlighting progress made by South Africa during its tenure as Chair of BRICS in relation to the decisions contained in the eThekwini Declaration and Action Plan.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse Regering het die eThekwini-aksieplan, wat op die laaste BRICS-beraad in Durban, Suid-Afrika ten volle geïmplementeer is, aangeneem en sal 'n oorhandigingsverslag voorlê oor sektorale samewerking tydens sy ampstermyn as BRICS-voorsitter die verslag beklemtoon vordering wat Suid-Afrika tydens sy termyn as voorsitter van BRICS gemaak het ten opsigte van die besluite vervat in die eThekwini-verklaring en -aksieplan.
tgt: On Sunday 13 July 2014 the Department of Transport will be providing feedback to the Ekangala and Dr JS Moroko communities on the Moloto Road and Rail Development Initiative.

src: Op Sondag 13 Julie 2014, sal die Departement van Vervoer terugvoer gee aan die gemeenskappe van Nkangala en Dr JS Moroka oor die Moloto-pad en die spoorontwikkelingsinisiatief.
tgt: The Moloto Rail Development Corridor will be an integrated public transport system which will have rail as a backbone and other modes of transport – buses and taxis in particular – providing feeder services.

src: Die Moloto-spoorontwikkelingskorridor sal 'n geïntegreerde openbare vervoerstelsel wees met spoorvervoer as die ruggraat en ander metodes van vervoer – busse en taxi's in die besonder – wat toevoerdienste verskaf.
tgt: The leadership of Mpumalanga, Gauteng and Limpopo as well as district and municipal mayors will join the Minister during the visit.

src: Prasa, 'n openbare entiteit onder die Departement van Vervoer, sal die projek in die toekoms lei.
tgt: PRASA, a public entity under the Department of Transport, will lead this project from now going forward.

src: Volgende week sal departemente hul begrotingsredes aan die Parlement voorlê.
tgt: Next week departments will be presenting their Budget Votes in Parliament.

src: Ministers sal hulle bestedingsplanne deur die parlementêre proses bespreek en verder met die onderskeie gemeenskappe oor hul planne vergader.
tgt: Ministers will be sharing their expenditure plans through the Parliamentary process and further engaging with the respective communities on their plans.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy beste wense oor aan ons atlete wat aan die Statebondspele, deeleneem wat vanaf 23 Julie tot 3 Augustus 2014, in Glasgow, Skotland, plaasvind en doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om hulle te ondersteun.
tgt: Cabinet conveys its best wishes to our athletes who will be participating at the Commonwealth Games, taking place from 23 July to 3 August 2014 in Glasgow, Scotland, and calls on all South Africans to support them.

src: Die Kabinet se standpunt oor huidige kwessies.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling deur President Jacob Zuma van Operation Phakisa, wat lewering versnel deur gedetailleerde implementeringsplanne, probleemoplossing en praktiese stappe om groei te bevorder.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on current issues.1 Cabinet welcomes the launch by President Jacob Zuma of Operation Phakisa, which fast-tracks delivery through detailed implementation plans, problem-solving and practical actions to drive growth.

src: Die Departement van Omgewingsake sal die eerste departement wees wat samewerking tussen die nywerheid- en arbeidsektor, die burgerlike samelewing en akademici sal lei om die ekonomiese potensiaal van ons oseane te WEBTOKEN 2010 het die oseaan-ekonomie – of die blou ekonomie, soos dit ook genoem word – meer as R54 miljard tot Suid-Afrika se bruto binnelandse produk (BBP) bygedra, en dit is verantwoordelik vir ongeveer 316 000 werkgeleenthede.
tgt: The Department of Environmental Affairs will be the first department to lead collaboration with the industry, labour, civil society and academia to work together to unlock the economic potential of our WEBTOKEN 2010, the ocean economy – or blue economy, as it is also known - contributed about R54 billion to South Africa’s Gross Domestic Product (GDP), and accounted for approximately 316 000 jobs.

src: Bewyse toon dat Suid-Afrika se oseane teen 2033 tot so veel as R177 miljard tot die BBP kan bydra.
tgt: Evidence shows that South Africa’s oceans could contribute up to R177 billion to GDP by 2033.

src: Die oseane het ook die potensiaal om tussen 800 000 en een miljoen regstreekse werkgeleenthede te skep.
tgt: The ocean also has a potential to create between 800 000 and one million direct jobs.

src: Hierdie groei-hefbome weerspieël minstens 4% jaarlikse groei in beide die BBP-bydrae en werkskepping.
tgt: These growth levers reflect at least 4 percent annual growth in both Gross Domestic Product contribution and job creation.

src: Mariene akwakultuur, mariene vervoer, aflandige olie- en gas-eksplorasie, en mariene beskerming is geïdentifiseer as fokusareas van die blou ekonomie.
tgt: Marine aquaculture, marine transport, offshore oil and gas exploration and marine protection have all been identified as focus areas of the blue economy.

src: 'n Leweringslaboratorium is onder elke gebied gevestig om te help om kritieke uitdagings op te los.2 Die Kabinet bedank alle Suid-Afrikaners asook die res van die wêreld vir hul deelname aan vanjaar se Nelson Mandela-dag.
tgt: A delivery lab has been established under each area to help resolve critical challenges.2 Cabinet thanks all South Africans and the world for participating in this year’s Nelson Mandela International Day.

src: Suid-Afrikaners uit alle uithoeke van ons land het gehoor gegee aan die oproep om 'n verskil te maak deur van hul tyd en energie op dié dag af te staan.
tgt: South Africans from every part of our country answered the call to dedicate their time and energy towards making a difference.

src: Die skoonmaakveldtog verfraai ons omgewing en verseker die bewaring van ons natuurlike omgewing.
tgt: The clean-up operation beautifies our surroundings and ensures the preservation of our environment.

src: As deel van hierdie veldtog het die Departement van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake ongeveer 150 munisipale tegniese amptenare na verskeie munisipaliteite gestuur om deel te neem aan die skoonmaakveldtog, asook om munisipaliteite regdeur die jaar by te staan.
tgt: As part of this campaign, the Department of Cooperative Government and Traditional Affairs (Cogta) dispatched about 150 Municipal Technical officials across municipalities to take part in this clean-up campaign, but also to support municipalities throughout the year.

src: Veldtogte soos die "War on Leaks" sal voortgesit en verskerp word deur werklose jeug en ander lede van gemeenskappe aan te moedig om die Regering te help om waterlekkasies te herstel.
tgt: Campaigns such as the “War on Leaks” will continue and be intensified where unemployed youth and other community members will be encouraged to join government in fixing water leaks.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op gemeenskappe om riviere en strome skoon en helder te hou aangesien dit tot gesonde, veilige en behoorlike lewensomstandighede bydra.
tgt: Cabinet calls on communities to keep rivers and streams clean and clear, as this contributes to healthy, safe and decent living conditions.

src: Besoedelde riviere en waterstrome is 'n bedreiging vir die welstand van gemeenskappe wat stroomaf daarvan woon.3 Die Kabinet verwelkom die ooreenkoms om die Nuwe Ontwikkelingsbank (NOB) by die sesde BRICS-beraad in Brasilië bekend te stel en om die bank se streekkantoor in Johannesburg te vestig.
tgt: Polluted rivers and streams threaten the livelihoods of downstream communities.3 Cabinet welcomes the agreement to launch the New Development Bank (NDB) at the Sixth BRICS Summit in Brazil and to establish the bank's regional office in Johannesburg.

src: Die NOB sal samewerking tussen BRICS-lidlande versterk en sal die werk van ander multilaterale en plaaslike finansiële instellings aanvul.
tgt: The NDB will strengthen the cooperation among BRICS member countries and will supplement the efforts of other multilateral and regional financial institutions, thus contributing to the collective commitments of BRICS member countries for achieving the goal of strong, sustainable and balanced growth.

src: Die streekkantoor sal 'n belangrike rol speel in die finansiering van infrastruktuur en volhoubare ontwikkeling in Afrika speel.
tgt: The regional office will play an important role in funding infrastructure and sustainable development projects in Africa.

src: 'n Projekvoorbereidingsfasiliteit wat die verwesenliking van verskeie potensiële infrastruktuur-projekte op die vasteland moontlik sal maak, is in die bedryfstelselmodel van die NOB ingebou.
tgt: Built into the operating model of the NDB is a project preparation facility which will enable the realisation of a number of potential infrastructure projects on the continent.

src: Dit is tot dusver nog nie geïmplementeer nie weens 'n gebrek aan finansiering vir die voorbereiding van die projek, 'n belangrike stap om projekidees gereed te maak vir finansiering en implementering.4 Die Kabinet het sy ernstige kommer uitgespreek oor die toename in geweld tussen Israel en die Palestynse gebiede.
tgt: These have hitherto not been implemented because of the lack of funding for project preparation, a key step in making project ideas ready for funding and implementation.4 Cabinet expressed great concern over the escalation in violence between Israel and the Palestinian territories.

src: Die Kabinet bevestig President Zuma se beroep op Israel se regering om sy grond- en lugoffensief, wat lewensverlies en 'n verwoestende humanitêre krisis veroorsaak, te staak.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates President Zuma’s call on the Israeli government to stop its ground and air offensive, which continues to cause loss of life and a devastating humanitarian crisis.

src: Verder word 'n beroep ook op Hamas gedoen om die afvuur van vuurpyle op Israeliese burgers te staak.
tgt: Furthermore, it calls for an end to the firing of rockets on Israeli citizens by Hamas.

src: Die Kabinet is gekant teen versluierde pogings deur Israel se regering om sy aanslag op die Gaza-strook te gebruik om die Palestynse Regering van Nasionale Eenheid te ondermyn.
tgt: Cabinet is opposed to the veiled attempts by the Israeli Government to use its onslaught on Gaza to undermine the Unity Government in Palestine.

src: Daar sal nooit 'n militêre oplossing vir die Israeli-Palestynse konflik wees nie.
tgt: There will never be a military solution to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

src: Die enigste oplossing lê in ernstige en opregte onderhandelings waarby alle partye betrokke is.
tgt: The only solution lies in serious and genuine negotiations involving all parties.

src: Suid-Afrika sluit aan by die VN se sekretaris-generaal, mnrBan Ki-moon se beroep vir 'n onmiddellike skietstilstand deur al die betrokkenes, en die hervatting van humanitêre hulp aan die mense van Gaza.
tgt: South Africa joins the UN Secretary General, Mr Ban Ki-moon, in calling for an immediate ceasefire by all sides, and a resumption of the flow of humanitarian aid to the suffering people of Gaza.

src: Die Kabinet beskou die humanitêre situasie as 'n bron van ernstige kommer.
tgt: The humanitarian situation is of great concern to Cabinet.

src: Die Regering doen 'n beroep op die Egiptiese owerhede om hul deure oop te maak vir beseerdes en ander mense wat deur die situasie in Gaza geraak word.5 Namens die mense van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika, betuig die Kabinet sy innige meegevoel met die families en vriende van al die slagoffers van die Air Malaysia-vliegtuig wat op 17 Julie 2014 in die Oekraïne neergestort het.6 Die Kabinet betuig ook sy meegevoel met die familie en vriende van die Nobelprys-bekroonde skrywer Nadine Gordimer wat onlangs oorlede is.
tgt: Government appeals to the Egyptian authorities to open their doors to the injured and affected people of Gaza.5 On behalf of the people of the Republic of South Africa, Cabinet conveys its condolences to the families and friends of all the victims of the Malaysia Airlines plane that crashed in Ukraine on 17 July 20.6 Cabinet conveys its condolences to the family and friends of the Nobel Prize-winning author Nadine Gordimer who passed away recently.

src: Suid-Afrika sal me Gordimer altyd onthou as 'n dapper aktivis wat haar pen en haar heldhaftige stem gebruik het om haar teenkanting teen die ongeregtighede van die apartheid-regime uit te WEBTOKEN Gordimer was 'n stigterslid van die Congress of South African Writers en as 'n lid van die African National Congress het sy in 1989 getuig ter versagting van vonnis vir 11 leiers van die United Democratic Front en aktiviste van die Vaal Burgerlike Vereniging.
tgt: South Africa will always remember Ms Gordimer as a brave activist who used her pen and courageous voice to speak out against the injustices of the apartheid regime.

src: Haar fiksie, wat 'n belangrike rol in die stryd teen apartheid gespeel het, het die effek wat geïnstitusionaliseerde rassisme op die lewens van gewone Suid-Afrikaners gehad, op rekord geplaas.
tgt: Ms Gordimer was a founding member of the Congress of South African Writers (COSAW) and as a member of the African National Congress in 1989, she testified in mitigation of sentence for 11 United Democratic Front leaders and Vaal Civil Association activists.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel met die ouers van die vierjarige Taegrin Morris wat in 'n kaping in Reiger Park, suid van Johannesburg, gesterf het.
tgt: Her fiction, which played an important role in the struggle against apartheid, documented the effect that institutionalised racism had on the lives of ordinary South Africans.7 Cabinet sends it condolences to the parents of the 4 year old Taegrin Morris who was killed in a high jacking incidence in Reiger Park South of Johannesburg.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel sulke brutale optrede, veral teenoor kinders en bedank voorts die polisie en lede van die publiek wat bygedra het tot die veilige terugkeer van Mongezi Phike wat onlangs ontvoer is nadat sy pa gekaap is.8 Die Kabinet herinner Suid-Afrikaners daaraan dat die Kanselary van Ordes die publiek, nie-regeringsorganisasies, siviele en geloofsgebaseerde organisasies nooi om individue, wat as waardige ontvangers van Nasionale Ordes geag word, te nomineer.
tgt: Cabinet further thanked the police and the members of the public that assisted in the safe return of Mongezi Phike who was recently kidnaped after they hijack his father.8 Cabinet reminds South Africans that the Chancery of Orders is inviting nominations from members of the public, non-governmental organisations, civic- and faith-based organisations for individuals deemed worthy recipients of National Orders.

src: Nasionale Ordes is die hoogste vorm van erkenning wat 'n land aan verdienstelike burgers toeken.
tgt: National Orders are the highest form of recognition that a country bestows on deserving citizens.

src: Die President, as die beskermheer van die Nasionale Ordes, oorhandig dié toekennings.
tgt: The President as the Grand Patron of the National Orders awards these orders.

src: Lede van die publiek word versoek om uitstaande individue in hul gemeenskappe te nomineer met behulp van 'n vorm wat op die webwerf WEBTOKEN beskikbaar is.
tgt: Members of the public are requested to submit names of an outstanding individual in their community using a form available from WEBTOKEThis must be accompanied by a separate motivation covering the following areas:an introductory paragraph with summary of the nominee’s achievementsa list of exceptional milestones reached by the nominee in his/her career and/or international arena anda description of the exceptional, outstanding, dedicated service or act of bravery rendered by the nominee.

src: Dit moet vergesel word van 'n afsonderlike motivering, wat die volgende dek:'n inleidendingsparagraaf met 'n opsomming van die genomineerde se prestasies'n lys van uitsonderlike mylpale wat deur die genomineerde gedurende sy/haar loopbaan behaal is, en/of'n beskrywing van voortreflike, uitstaande, toegewyde diens of ’n heldhaftige daad deur die genomineerde.
tgt: The nominations will close on 31 July Key Cabinet decisions Cabinet was briefed on the implementation of Section 100 (1)

src: rakende die ingryping in Limpopo en het die oorgang van die ingryping van artikel 100 (1)
tgt: intervention in Limpopo province and approved the transition of the intervention from section 100 (1)

src: na artikel 100 (1)
tgt: to section 100 (1)

src: goedgekeur met duidelike voorwaardes waaraan die Provinsiale Uitvoerende Gesag moet voldoen as 'n voorvereiste vir die bepaling van volledige WEBTOKEN ooreenstemming met die Grondwet is die Nasionale Raad van Provinsies hieroor geraadpleeg.
tgt: with clear conditions given to the Provincial Executive to fulfil as a pre-requisite, for determining full withdrawal.

src: 'n Afsonderlike inligtingsessie wat sal uitspel wat bereik is en die pad vorentoe sal bespreek, sal vroeg volgende week gehou word.2 Die Kabinet het die 2014 – 2019 Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk (MTSR) goedgekeur wat as die eerste vyf jaar lange bousteen vir die 2030 visie van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP) sal dien.
tgt: Cabinet approved the 2014-2019 Medium-Term Strategic Framework (MTSF) which will serve as the first 5-year building block towards the 2030 vision in the National Development Plan (NDP).

src: Die MTSR bevat gedetailleerde implementeringsplanne van vyf jaar vir die NOP, met teikens, aanwysers, rolle en verantwoordelikhede, asook tydskale vir die implementering van die belangrikste aksies – om stelselmatige en bewys-gebaseerde monitering van die implementering van die NOP moontlik te maak.
tgt: The MTSF contains detailed five year implementation plans for the NDP, with targets, indicators, roles and responsibilities and timeframes for the implementation of key actions - to enable systematic and evidence-based monitoring of the implementation of the NDP.

src: Die MTSR bou voort op die Regering se ervarings en die lesse wat geleer is tydens die 2009 – 2014 administrasie, toe uitkomsgebaseerde beplanning, monitering en evaluering vir die eerste keer bekend gestel is.
tgt: The MTSF builds on government’s experience and learning during the 2009- 2014 administration, when outcomes-based planning, monitoring and evaluation were introduced for the first time.

src: Gedurende daardie tydperk is leweringsooreenkomste ontwikkel, gemonitor en geëvalueer vir die Regering se 12 voorkeur-uitkomste, wat insluit basiese onderwys van gehalte, 'n lang lewe vir alle Suid-Afrikaners, veiligheid en sekuriteit, inklusiewe groei en ordentlike werk en landelike ontwikkeling en grondhervorming.
tgt: During that period delivery agreements were developed, monitored and evaluated for the 12 priority outcomes of government which included quality basic education, a long life for all South Africans, safety and security, inclusive growth and decent employment and rural development and land reform.

src: Gedurende die 2014 – 2019 administrasie is die aantal uitkomste tot 14 verhoog, met die toevoeging van twee nuwe uitkomste – maatskaplike beskerming en maatskaplike samehorigheid en nasiebou.
tgt: During the 2014-2019 administration the number of outcomes has been increased to 14, with the addition of two new outcomes - social protection and social cohesion and nation building.

src: Gesamentlik dek hierdie 14 uitkomste al die hoofstukke van die NODie Ministerie van Beplanning, Monitering en Evaluering sal binnekort 'n mediakonferensie oor die MTSR hou.3 Die Kabinet het goedgekeur dat Suid-Afrika gasheer sal wees vir die Global Smart Partnership Dialogue in Oktober 2014 onder die tema: "Optimalisering van wetenskap, tegnologie en innovasie vir sosio-ekonomiese transformasie deur slim vennootskap-beginsels.
tgt: All in all, these 14 outcomes cover all the chapters of the NDThe Ministry of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation will hold a media briefing on the MTSF shortly.3 Cabinet approved that South Africa hosts the Global Smart Partnership Dialogue in October 2014 under the theme: “Leveraging Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) for Socio-economic.

src: "Die dialoog bied 'n platform vir staatshoofde, sakeleiers, wetenskaplikes, akademici en studenteleiers om idees uit te ruil en ervarings te deel wat verband hou met wetenskap, tegnologie en innovasie.
tgt: Transformation through Smart Partnership Principles”.The dialogue provides a platform for Heads of States, business leaders, scientists, academics and student leaders to exchange ideas and experiences related to science, technology and innovation.

src: Die dialoog is ook gemik op die bevordering van sosio-ekonomiese transformasie, ontwikkeling en groei in Afrika.
tgt: Furthermore the dialogue seeks to boosting socio-economic transformation, development and growth in Africa.

src: Aanbieding van die dialoog sal verder ook die geleentheid bied om die doelwitte en doelstellings van die NOP oor die verbetering van wetenskap en tegnologie vir sosio-ekonomiese transformasie in Suid-Afrika te bespreek, en om die land se innoverende voorsprong in die streek, die vasteland en wêreldwyd te verbeter.3 Toekomstige gebeure.1 President Jacob Zuma sal Vrouemaand op 31 Julie 2014 van stapel stuur onder die tema: "60ste herdenking van die Vroue-handves as deel van die 20 Jaar van Vryheid, Vooruitgang vir die Vroue-agenda!"
tgt: The hosting will also address the aims and objectives of the National Development Plan on improving science and technology for socio-economic transformation in South Africa and on improving our innovative edge in the region, the continent and globally.

src: Die Pan-Afrikaanse Parlement sal hierby aansluit deur ook hulde te bring aan die Pan-Afrikaanse Vroue-organisasie en sy rol in die bevryding van Suid-Afrikaanse vroue.
tgt: Upcoming events President Jacob Zuma will launch Women’s Month at the Union Buildings on 31 July 2014 under the theme: “60th anniversary of the Women’s charter as part of the 20 years of Freedom, Moving Women’s Agenda Forward!” The launch will be joined by the Pan African Parliament which will also pay tribute to the Pan African Women’s Organisation and its role in liberating South African women.

src: Verskeie aktiwiteite word vir Augustus beplan ter viering van die vooruitgang wat Suid-Afrika gemaak het om Suid-Afrikaanse vroue se lewens positief te verander.
tgt: A number of activities are planned for the month of August to celebrate the gains made by South Africa in changing the lives of South African women.

src: Die hoofbyeenkoms op 9 Augustus sal in Durban gehou word.
tgt: The main event on 9 August will take place in Durban.

src: Die Departement van Kuns en Kultuur as die toonaangewende departement vir Vrouemaand, sal ook die "20 Beste Oomblikke vir Vroue" in Augustus bekendstel.
tgt: The Department of Arts and Culture, as the lead department of Women’s Month, will l also launch the 20 Best Moments for Women during August.

src: Hierdie kerngebeurtenisse vier die prestasies van uitsonderlike plaaslike vroue asook die vooruitgang wat deur alle Suid-Afrikaanse vroue gemaak is.
tgt: These key events mark achievements by exceptional local women and the gains made by all South African women.

src: Die besonderhede van dié gebeure sal mettertyd aangekondig word.2 President Jacob Zuma beplan om 'n afvaardiging te lei wat van 5 tot 6 Augustus 2014 aan die VSA-Afrika-leiersberaad sal deelneem onder die tema: "Belê in die volgende geslag."
tgt: The details of these events will be announced in due course.2 President Jacob Zuma is scheduled to lead a delegation to participate in the United States-Africa Leaders’ Summit, under the theme: “Investing in the Next Generation”, from 5 to 6 August 2014.

src: Die beraad sal na verwagting sakelui van die Verenigde State van Amerika (VSA) en Afrika byeenbring om beleggings- en sake-geleenthede in Afrika te bespreek.
tgt: The summit is expected to bring US and African business executives together to discuss investment and business opportunities in Africa.

src: Kantlynvergaderings vir uitvoerende hoofde uit die VSA en Afrika, en 'n ministeriële vergadering van die Wet op Groei en Geleenthede in Afrika (AGOA) sal ook gehou word.
tgt: There will also be side meetings for American and African Chief Executive Officers (CEOs) and an African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) Ministerial Meeting.

src: Hierdie vergaderings is gemik op die bevordering van die verhouding tussen die VSA en Afrika veral op die gebied van handel en belegging.
tgt: These meetings are aimed at strengthening relations between United States and Africa particularly on trade and investment.

src: Die beoogde uitkomste is: die bevordering van streeksintegrasie op die vasteland steun vir verskeie ekonomiese ontwikkelingsprogramme van die Afrika-unie, vrede en veiligheid, insluitend die uitbreiding van AGOA klimaatsverandering en omgewingsbeskermingskwessies en bystand om die doelwitte van die Afrika 2063-visie te verwesenlik.3 Die Departement van Wetenskap en Tegnologie sal Nasionale Wetenskapweek (NWW) op 2 Augustus 2014 bekend stel onder die tema: "Vandag se wetenskap, môre se wêreld."
tgt: The envisaged outcomes are: the encouragement of regional integration on the continent support for various African Union economic development programmes, peace and security, including the extension of AGOA climate change and environment protection issues and assistance to meet the Africa 2063 vision goals.3 The Department of Science and Technology will launch the National Science Week (NSW) on 2 August 2014 under the theme: “Today’s science, tomorrow’s world”.

src: Die NWW 2014 sal landwyd tot 9 Augustus 2014 duur.
tgt: The NSW 2014 will continue until 9 August 2014 across the country.

src: Dit sal uitstallings, wetenskapvertonings, werksessies en lesings behels.
tgt: These will entail exhibitions, science shows, workshops and lectures.

src: Besonderhede van die aktiwiteite sal mettertyd aangekondig word.
tgt: Details of the activities will be announced in due course.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op ouers, onderwysers, leerders en Suid-Afrikaners in die algemeen om deel te wees van die NWW 2014.4 Aanstellings.1 Die Kabinet het kennis geneem dat die dienstermyn van die volgende lede van die Nasionale Loteryraad verleng is, terwyl die proses om die derde lisensiehouer aan te stel afgehandel word.
tgt: Cabinet calls on parents, teachers, learners and South Africans in general to be part of the National Science Week Appointments Cabinet noted the extension of the term of office for the following members to the National Lotteries Board, while the process to appoint the third licensee is being concluded.

src: a) ProfNtshengedzeni Alfred Nevhuṱanḓa (Voorsitter)b) MeMathukana Mokokac) ProfGovin Reddyd) MeZodwa Paulina Ntuli (Departement van Handel en Nywerheid verteenwoordiger)e) MeNdileka Eumera Portia Loyilane.2 Die Kabinet het die aanstelling van die volgende nie-uitvoerende direkteure in die Raad van die Suid-Afrikaanse Martieme Veiligheidsowerheid (Samsa) goedgekeur.
tgt: a) ProfNtshengedzeni Alfred Nevhutanda (Chairperson),b) Ms Mathukana Mokoka,c) ProfGovin Reddy,d) Ms Zodwa Paulina Ntuli (the dti representative), ande) Ms Ndileka Eumera Portia Loyilane.2 Cabinet approved the appointment of the following Non-Executive Directors to the Board of the South African Maritime Safety Authority (SAMSA).

src: a) Vise-admiraal Johannes Mudimu (Voorsitter)b) Dr Michael Harry Hendricksc) AdvMotsehoa Brenda Madumise (Vise-voorsitter)d) MnrFrederick Enrew Jacobse) MeNomsa Margaret Celef) MnrBrett Naidoo.3 Die Kabinet het die aanstelling van die volgende nie-uitvoerende direkteure in die Raad van die Passasierspooragentskap van Suid-Afrika (Prasa) goedgekeur:a) MeZodwa Penelope Manaseb) Dr Popo Molefe (Voorsitter)c) MeCarol (Roskruge) Celed) MnrWilliam Solomon Steenkampe) MeNonduduzo Samukeliswe Kheswaf) MeMashila Jemina Matlalag) MnrSfiso Buthelezi (heraanstelling)h) MnrXolile George (heraanstelling as Salga-genomineerde)i) MnrLenon McMillan (Nasionale Tesourie-verteenwoordiger)j) MnrClement Manyungwana (Departement van Vervoer-verteenwoordiger).4 Die Kabinet het saamgestem met die aanstelling van die nuwe lede in die Raad vir die Beboude Omgewing.
tgt: a) Vice Admiral Johannes Mudimu (Chairperson),b) Dr Michael Harry Hendricks,c) Adv Motsehoa Brenda Madumise (Deputy Chairperson),d) Mr Frederick Andrew Jacobs,e) Ms Nomsa Margaret Cele, andf) Mr Brett Naidoo.3 Cabinet approved the appointment of the following Non-Executive Directors to the Board of the Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa (PRASA).

src: Vrouemaand/Nasionale Vrouedagvieringe.
tgt: Women’s Month/ National Women’s Day celebrations.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die planne vir die Nasionale Vrouedagvieringe en alle aktiwiteite wat gedurende Augustus beplan word.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes plans for the national Women's Day celebrations and all activities planned throughout the month of August.

src: President Jacob Zuma sal die nasionale byeenkoms lei wat op 9 Augustus 2014 by die Koning Zwelithini-stadion in Umlazi, KwaZulu-Natal, gehou sal word.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will lead the national event to be held at King Zwelithini Stadium, in Umlazi, KwaZulu-Natal, on 9 August 2014 under the theme: “Celebrating the 60th Anniversary of the Women’s Charter and 20 Years of Freedom: together moving non-racial and non-sexist South Africa forward”.As part of the celebrations of women’s month, government will host several events to profile women in different sectors and showcase the achievements we have made as a country.

src: Die tema van die geleentheid is: "Die viering van die 60ste herdenking van die Vrouehandves en 20 Jaar van Vryheid: saam beweeg ons 'n nierassige en nieseksistiese Suid-Afrika vorentoe.
tgt: Some of the events planned include the Women Awards in Construction, 14 August, Women in Science Awards, 15 August, Female Farmer of the Year Awards, 22 August and Women in Water Awards, 29 WEBTOKEN part of the celebrations, the Minister of Human Settlements together with the provincial MEC’s in the special meeting (MINMEC) held on 4 July 2014, approved a programme to deliver 1 956 houses in each of the nine provinces.

src: Die geleenthede sluit die Vroue-toekennings in Konstruksie (14 Augustus), Vroue in Wetenskap-toekennings (15 Augustus), Vroueboer van die Jaar-toekennings (22 Augustus) en Vroue in Water-toekennings (29 Augustus).As deel van die vieringe het die Minister van Meslike Nedersettings saam met die provinsiale LUR'e tydens die spesiale vergadering (Minmec) op 4 Julie 2014 'n program goedgekeur om 1 956 huise in elk van die nege provinsies te lewer.
tgt: The programme pays tribute to women who marched to the Union Buildings protesting against the pass laws in 1956.The first launch of this programme took place at Ratanda Township, Lesedi Local Municipality in Gauteng on the 4 August 2014.

src: Die program bring hulde aan die vroue wat in 1956 na die Uniegebou opgemarseer het uit protes teen die paswette.
tgt: A total of 17 604 houses will be built by women and the beneficiaries will be women, the elderly and child headed households as stipulated by Human Settlements Minister Lindiwe Sisulu during her recent budget speech.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om die programme en aktiwiteite vir Vrouemaand te ondersteun om te verseker dat die prestasies van vroue gevier word.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to support and participate in the Women’s Month programmes and activities throughout the month to ensure that women achievements are celebrated.

src: Die program vir Nasionale Vrouemaand is aangeheg.
tgt: The National Women’s Month Programme is attached.

src: Implementering van sleutelprogramme Die Kabinet verwelkom en waardeer die vordering wat gemaak is met die implementering van die belangrikste regeringsprogramme wat ons verbintenis om Suid-Afrika vorentoe te beweeg, weerspieël.
tgt: Key programme implementationCabinet welcomes and appreciates the progress on implementation of key government programmes which reflect our commitment to moving South Africa forward.

src: Die opening van die Transnet-treinwaopknappingsaanleg van R30 miljoen op De Aar in die Noord-Kaap sal die plaaslike ekonomie stimuleer en die lewens-omstandighede van die gemeenskap verbeter.
tgt: The opening of the R30-million Transnet Wagons Refurbishing Facility at De Aar, in the Northern Cape will boost the local economy and improve the living conditions of communities.

src: Mer as 100 regstreekse werk-geleenthede is reeds geskep en 'n verdere 300 poste word verwag.
tgt: More than 100 direct jobs have already been created and a further 300 jobs are expected.

src: Die treinwa-opknappingsaanleg vorm deel van Transnet se infrastruktuurplan van R300 miljard om die land se spoorweë, pyplyn- en hawenetwerk te verbeter, wat 588 000 nuwe werk-geleenthede sal skep.
tgt: The Wagons Refurbishing Facility is part of Transnet’s R300 billion infrastructure plan to revamp and modernise the country’s rail, pipeline and ports network which will create 588 000 new jobs.

src: Jong mense in die gebied sal ook baat by die ontwikkeling van 'n veeldoelige area vir die jeug.
tgt: Young people in the area will also benefit from the development of a Youth Multi-Purpose Precinct.

src: Die projek vorm deel van 'n aantal regerings-infrastruktuurprojekte wat deur die Presidensiële Infrastruktuur-koördineringskomitee gekoördineer word.
tgt: This project forms part of a number of government infrastructure projects coordinated through the Presidential Infrastructure Coordinating Committee.

src: As deel van die Regering se veldtog om die Suid-Afrikaanse vervaardigingsbedryf uit te brei, om sodoende die land se nywerheidsvermoë te verhoog en broodnodige werkgeleenthede te skep, is 'n fabriek van R80 miljoen in Epping, Kaapstad, onlangs oopgemaak.
tgt: As part of government’s drive to expand the capabilities of the South African manufacturing industry, to increase the country’s industrial base and create the much needed jobs, an R80 million facility was launched in Epping Cape Town.

src: Die fabriek vir 120 MW fotovoltaïse modules is amptelik op 6 Augustus 2014 deur Jinko Solar, 'n Chinese multinasionale maatskappy geopen.
tgt: This 120 MW solar PV module production facility was officially launched on 6 August 2014 by Jinko Solar, a Chinese multinational company.

src: Dit vorm deel van die bekendstelling van die Suid-Afrikaanse Program vir Onafhanklikheid Kragprodusente van Hernubare Energie (REIPPP).
tgt: This is part of the roll-out of the South African Renewable Energy Independent Power Producers Programme (REIPPP).

src: Die aanleg sal na verwaging 1 300 sonpanele per dag produseer en 'n verwagte omset van R600 miljoen per jaar genereer.
tgt: The facility is expected to produce 1 300 solar panels per day, with an expected R600 million turnover per year.

src: Sedert die ontstaan van die program het Jinko Solar sonpanele van meer as 300 MW vervaardig, wat 'n markaandeel van sowat 30% verteenwoordig.
tgt: Since the inception of this programme, Jinko Solar has deployed over 300MW of solar PV panels, reaching approximately 30% market share.

src: Die aanleg, die nuutste en modernste van sy soort op die vasteland, sal na verwagting 120 MW teen die einde van die jaar produseer.
tgt: The plant, which is the newest and most modern of its type on the continent, is expected to produce 120 Megawatts by the end of the year.

src: As deel van die Regering se veldtog om die Suid-Afrikaanse vervaardigingsbedryf uit te brei, om sodoende die land se nywerheidsvermoë te verhoog en broodnodige werkgeleenthede in Epping te skep.
tgt: This is part of government’s drive to expand the capabilities of the South African manufacturing industry, to increase the country’s industrial base and create the much needed jobs in Epping.

src: Die groen ekonomie is as 'n belangrike fokusarea in die Industriële Beleidsaksieplan aangewys en bied verskeie geleenthede vir werkskepping en plaaslike ekonomiese groei.
tgt: The Green Economy has been identified as a key focus area in the Industrial Policy Action Plan and provides significant opportunities for job creation, localisation and economic growth.
