tgt: The policy addresses spatial challenges and re-organisation of operations which impact on the quality of public transport.

src: Dit maak ook voorsiening vir 'n geïntegreerde beplanningstelsel en eenvormige bestuurstandaarde.
tgt: It also provides for an integrated planning system and uniform standards of management.

src: Die implementering van hierdie beleid sal 'n veilige vervoeromgewing vir leerders bied deur samewerking met wetstoepassingsowerhede.
tgt: Implementation of this policy will provide a safe and secure transport environment for learners through cooperation and collaboration with law enforcement authorities.2 Cabinet approved the Directive on Compulsory Development, Mandatory Training Days and Minimum Entry Requirements to the levels of Senior Management Service as determined in terms of Section 3(2) of the Public Service Act, 1994.This promotes skills development so as to respond to the National Development Plan objective of building a capable and developmental state for the benefit of improved service delivery.

src: Die voorskrif is 'n strategie in langtermyn-vaardigheidsontwikkeling wat die gehalte van menslike hulpbronne verbeter, wat noodsaaklik is vir die regering om sy mandaat uit te voer.
tgt: The directive is a long-term skills development strategy that will enhance the quality of human resources which is critical to government’s capacity to deliver on its mandate.

src: Daar sal van alle staatsdepartemente verwag word om 'n konsekwente benadering te volg om relevante en verpligte vaardigheidsontwikkeling binne die senior bestuursdiens te bevorder.
tgt: All departments in the Public Service will be required to adopt a consistent approach to promote relevant and mandatory skills development within the Senior Management Service.3 Cabinet approved for the Department of Performance Monitoring and Evaluation to present the draft Discussion Document on Performance Monitoring and Evaluation Principles and Approach to Parliament’s Portfolio Committee on Public Service Administration and Planning Monitoring and Evaluation.

src: Die Kabinet stem in tot die Departement van Prestasiemonitering en -evaluering om die Konsepbesprekingsdokument oor Prestasiemonitering en -evalueringsbeginsels en -benadering aan die Portefeuljekomitee van die Parlement oor die Staatsdiens en Administrasie en Beplanningsmonitering en -evaluering voor te lê.Die dokument doen 'n stel basiese beginsels en 'n benadering tot prestasie monitering en evaluering (M&E) aan die hand, wat bedoel is om deurlopende verbetering in die regering se prestasie en verhoogde aanspreeklikheid tot gevolg te hê.
tgt: The document proposes a set of basic principles and an approach to Performance Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) that is intended to result in continuous improvement in government performance and increased accountability.

src: Die belangrikste doelwit is om konsensus oor die doelwitte van M&E en hoe dit geïmplementeer moet word te bou.
tgt: Its key objective is to build consensus on the objectives of M&E, and how it should be implemented.

src: Dit dra by tot die implementering van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP) se doel om 'n bekwame en ontwikkelingstaat te bou asook die bevordering van 'n aktiewe burgery en sterk leierskap.
tgt: This contributes to the implementation of the National Development Plan (NDP) in relation to building a capable and developmental state as well as promoting an active citizenry and strong leadership.

src: Die Kabinet keur Suid-Afrika se onderhandelingsposisie vir die beskerming van migrerende wilde diere (CMS COP11) goed, wat in Quinto, Ecuador, van 4 tot 9 November 2014 gehou sal word.
tgt: M&E competencies are part of the core managerial competencies that are required for a capable and developmental state.4 Cabinet approved South Africa’s negotiating positions for Conservation of Migratory Species of Wild Animals (CMS COP11) which will be held in Quinto, Ecuador, from 4 to 9 November 2014.South Africa’s active participation in addressing challenges of climate change and the conservation of nature and associated species is based on the principle of sustainable development and environmental sustainability, and is in line with the requirements of Section 24 of the Bill of Rights.5 Cabinet approved the negotiating mandate that will serve as the basis for South Africa’s engagement at the 20th session of the Conference of Parties to the UNFCCC (COP 20), and the 10th Conference of Parties serving as the meeting of Parties to the Kyoto Protocol (CMP 10), from 1 to 12 December 2014, in Lima Peru.

src: Suid-Afrika se aktiewe deelname om die uitdagings van klimaatsverandering en bewaring van die natuur en verwante spesies die hoof te bied, is gegrond op die beginsel van volhoubare ontwikkeling en volhoubaarheid van die omgewing, en is gerig op die vereistes van artikel 24 van die Handves van Meseregte.
tgt: South Africa’s position is in line with the country’s national interest, and the implications for South Africa’s further engagement in the international climate change negotiations as outlined in the National Development Plan.6 Cabinet approved a submission of the Cape Town Agreement of 2012 on the implementation of the provisions of the Torremolinos Protocol of 1993 relating to the International Convention for the Safety of Fishing Vessels, 1977 for ratification by Parliament.

src: Die Kabinet keur die onderhandelingsmandaat, die grondslag vir Suid-Afrika se betrokkenheid by die 20ste sitting van die Konferensie van Partye tot die UNFCCC (COP 20), en die 10de konferensie van die partye goed.
tgt: The Torremolinos Convention and its Protocol of 1993 lay down safety standards, such as life-saving appliances, radio communication, fire protection, machinery and electrical installations, as well as specific requirements for seagoing fishing vessels of 24 metres and longer.

src: Die Kabinet keur ’n voorlegging van die Kaapstad-ooreenkoms van 2012 goed, wat handel oor die implementering van die bepalings van die Torremolinos-protokol van 1993 met betrekking tot die Internasionale Konvensie vir die Veiligheid van Vissersbote, 1977, vir bekragtiging deur die Parlement.
tgt: South Africa’s fishing vessels will be subject to the provisions of the protocol when in the waters of a State party to the 1993 Torremolinos protocol.

src: Die Torremolinos-konvensie en die protokol van 1993 lê veiligheidstandaarde neer, soos lewensreddingstoestelle, radiokommunikasie, brandbeskerming, masjinerie en elektriese installasies, asook spesifieke vereistes vir seevaartuie vissersbote van 24 m en langer.
tgt: This is in line with Operation Phakisa’s objectives of developing an institutional framework for the management of South Africa’s ocean space, improving the protection of South Africa’s oceans, particularly around critically endangered ecosystems, and addressing the skills gap, amongst others.7 Cabinet approved for South Africa to accede to the International Convention on Standards of Training, Certification and Watch-keeping for Fishing Vessel Personnel, 1995 (STCW-F).This is the first attempt to establish international mandatory training standards for the crews of seagoing fishing vessels of 24 metres or more in length.

src: Dit bindende internasionale veiligheidsregime sal bydra tot die verbetering van veiligheidstandaarde ten einde die aantal sterftes ter see te verminder, wat wêreldwyd jaarliks op 24 000 beraam word.
tgt: This will improve the safety of life and property at sea, as well as to prevent pollution of the marine environment by the fishing WEBTOKEN the past, extended periods of sea service were seen as the way to acquire experience and appropriate skills.

src: Dit is in ooreenstemming met Operasie Phakisa se doelwit om 'n institusionele raamwerk vir die bestuur van Suid-Afrika se oseaanruimte, die verbetering van die beskerming van Suid-Afrika se oseane, veral wat betref krities bedreigde ekostelsels, te ontwikkel en aspekte soos die vaardigheidsgaping aan te pak.
tgt: This will make it possible for fishers to progress over time from small vessels to large fishing vessels and eventually internationally trading vessels.8 Cabinet approved for the following 2015 commemorative coin designs by the South African Mint Company, to be promulgated in a Government Gazette.

src: Kabinet keur Suid-Afrika se toetrede tot die Internasionale Konvensie oor Standaarde vir Opleiding, Sertifisering en die Waghou van Vissersbootbemanning, 1995 (STCW-F) goed.
tgt: The Protea Coin Series: “The Life of a Legend: NR Mandela” The Natura Coin Series: “Nocturnal Hunters – The Black Backed Jackal” R1 Gold Coin Series: “South African Reptiles – The Nile crocodile” R2 Gold Coin Series: “UNESCO Project: Man and Biosphere” Crown and Tickey Silver Coin Series: “Trains of South Africa” and The Sterling Silver Coin Series: “Marine Protected Areas of South Africa”1.9 Cabinet was briefed on the Rationalisation of Magisterial Districts and Areas of Jurisdiction of the Divisions and Local Seats of the High Court of South Africa.

src: Die vestiging van Agrément Suid-Afrika, soos uiteengesit in die Agrément Suid-Afrika-wetsontwerp, 2014, sal help om 'n dinamiese en innoverende boubedryf op die been te bring, wat werk sal skep en uitvoering sal gee aan die regering se infrastruktuurplanne.
tgt: Media Freedom Day is a celebration of freedom of expression and freedom of the media which is guaranteed in our constitution.2 President Zuma, accompanied by Cabinet members, the Premier of KwaZulu-Natal and Provincial MECs conducted a successful Presidential Imbizo in Msunduzi and uMgungundlovu Municipalities on 30 September WEBTOKEN part of ongoing and direct communication with South African communities, President Jacob Zuma will conduct a Presidential Siyahlola in Giyani, Limpopo, on 31 October 20.3 Cabinet welcomes the progress report on the implementation of the Framework Agreement for a Sustainable Mining Industry presented at the recent Mining Sector National Consultative forum.

src: Die toegevoegde waarde sal wissel van navorsingsinnovering, verhoogde produksie-aktiwiteite, werkskepping en armoedeverligting.
tgt: The forum reflects all stakeholders’ collective commitment to the future of mining in South Africa, and to the creation and maintenance of an equitable balance between socio-economic imperatives and investment objectives.

src: Die Kabinet keur die bekendstelling van die Wysigingswetsontwerp op die Ouditprofessie goed.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes stakeholders’ recommitment to the Framework Agreement for a Sustainable Mining Industry and to finding lasting solutions to challenges facing the industry.4 Cabinet welcomes President Jacob Zuma’s announcement on the progress made through Operation Phakisa to unlock the economic potential of South Africa’s oceans in a sustainable manner.

src: Die Wysigingswetsontwerp stel wysigings aan die Wet op die Ouditprofessie, 2005, voor om kandidaatouditeure te reguleer en verwysings na die Maatskappyewet, 1973 by te werk, om die Wet op die Ouditprofessie in lyn met die Wet op Maatskappye 2008 (Wet No.
tgt: The delivery plan by President Jacob Zuma moves us closer to realising the benefits of the ocean economy, which can contribute R177 billion to our gross domestic product and create just over 1 million jobs.

src: Implementering van die belangrikste regeringsprogramme.1 Die Kabinet het saam met Suid-Afrikaners Meiavryheidsdag op 19 Oktober 2014 gevier toe president Jacob Zuma veteraanjoernaliste en -redakteurs uitgenooi het om saam met hom 20 jaar van persvryheid in Suid-Afrika te vier.
tgt: Cabinet is confident that South Africa’s energy mix which – includes coal, solar, wind, hydro, gas and nuclear energy – will ensure a reliable source of power to meet the country’s growth needs, allow for a balance between energy sources and help us reach our carbon-reduction targets.2 Cabinet welcomes and congratulates all parties for successfully reconvening the Lesotho Parliament last week in line with the Maseru Facilitation Declaration facilitated by Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa.3 Cabinet reiterates that South Africa has put in place the necessary measures to prevent Ebola from spreading to the country.

src: Die forum weerspieël alle belanghebbendes se verbintenis tot die toekoms van mynbou in Suid-Afrika en die skepping en instandhouding van 'n billike balans tussen sosio-ekonomiese knelpunte en beleggingsdoelwitte.
tgt: Cabinet supports the efforts by the World Health Organisation in establishing Ebola treatment centres and strengthening capacity for laboratory testing, contact tracing, social mobilisation, safe burials and non-Ebola health care in West Africa.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom belanghebbendes se herverbintenis aan die Raamwerk-ooreenkoms vir Volhoubare Mynbou en belanghebbers se pogings om blywende oplossings vir uitdagings in die bedryf te vind.4 Die Kabinet verwelkom president Jacob Zuma se aankondiging oor die vordering wat gemaak is deur Operasie Phakisa om die ekonomiese potensiaal van Suid-Afrika se oseane op 'n volhoubare wyse te ontsluit.
tgt: Cabinet also appeals to individuals and business worldwide to contribute to the Ebola Response Fund which was established to assist all affected West African countries in their fight against this devastating disease.4 Cabinet welcomes the arrest of six individuals linked to the cable theft which resulted in water outages in parts of Gauteng.

src: Oor 'n tydperk van ses weke gaan afgevaardigdes die sektor verken en leweringsplanne ontwikkel wat by voltooiing aan die publiek bekend gemaak sal word.5 Die Kabinet het die Meiumtermynbegrotingbeleidsverklaring (MTBBV) ontvang, wat 'n opsomming van die uitgawes skets waarbinne die nasionale en provinsiale begrotings voorberei word.
tgt: Government is seized with this issue and will not hesitate act more effectively to combat this scourge.5 Trade and Investment South Africa (TISA), a division of the Department of Trade and Industry (the dti), last week received an award at the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development’s World Investment Forum in Geneva for the promotion of sustainable investment.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die maatreëls in die MTBBV om besteding in die staatsdiens te bekamp.
tgt: This was for the work undertaken by TISA in supporting the establishment of Unilever’s Indonesia plant in Ethekwini, which was opened by the Minister of Trade and Industry during South Africa’s hosting of the COP .6 Cabinet received an update on the collapse of the building in Nigeria.

src: Die Kabinet keur die 16 Dae van Aktivisme-veldtog goed onder die tema "Sluit my in: Saam laat ons 'n nie-gewelddadige Suid-Afrika vooruitgaan".Vanjaar (2014) is die 16de herdenking van hierdie veldtog wat daarop gemik is om bewustheid te skep vir die beskerming van vroue en kinders.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions Cabinet approved the 16 Days of Activism Campaign under the theme “Count Me In: Together Moving a Non-Violent South Africa forward”.This year (2014) marks the 16th anniversary of this campaign which aims to continue generating awareness on the protection of women and children with more focus on mobilising men and partnering with them to also assist in the fight against this scourge of violence on women and children.

src: Die veldtog sal op 25 November afskop en tot 10 Desember 2014 duur.
tgt: The campaign will be launched on 25th of November until the 10th December 2014.

src: Benewens die 16 Dae van Aktivisme is daar ook 'n jaar lange program wat meet tot watter mate mense se lewens verbeter het danksy die implementering van wette en programme wat op die uitwissing van geweld teen vroue en kinders gemik is.
tgt: Beyond the 16 Days of Activism, there is a year-long programme which will monitor and evaluate the extent to which lives have improved through the implementation of laws and programmes aimed at eradicating violence against women and children.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die vorderingsverslag oor die ontwikkeling van 'n Model vir Burgerlike Monitering.’n Loodsprojek fokus op die bou van die Regering se kapasiteit om as deel van sy moniteringsmeganisme menings van landsburgers aan te hoor.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the progress report on developing a model for Citizen-based Monitoring.

src: Die projek sal bestaande programme gebruik soos die Gemeenskapswerke-program en die Gemeenskapsontwikkelingswerkers-program om die burgerlike monitering oor die tydperk van die Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk te verbeter.
tgt: A pilot project focuses on building the capacity of government to elicit the views of citizens as part of its monitoring mechanism.

src: Die projek fokus op die volgende belangrike sektordepartemente: die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens, die Departement van Gesondheid en Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling en die Suid-Afrikaanse Agentskap vir Maatskaplike Sekerheid.
tgt: The pilot will use existing programmes such as the Community Works Programme and the Community Development Workers programme to upscale the citizen-based monitoring over the Medium Term Strategic Framework period.

src: Dit sal met verloop van die tydperk van die Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk na ander sektore uitgebrei word.
tgt: This will be extended to other sectors over the course of the Medium Term Strategic Framework period.

src: Die Kabinet het die ontplooiing van 140 lede van die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens (SAPD) aan die Koninkryk van Lesotho vir die aanvanklike tydperk van 90 dae goedgekeur met dien verstande dat dit verleng mag word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the deployment of 140 members of the South African Police Service (SAPS) to the Kingdom of Lesotho for the initial period of ninety days with an extension should it be required.

src: Onmiddellike ingryping van die SAOG in die Koninkryk van Lesotho was in Augustus 2014 nodig ná toenemende spanning en daaropvolgende agteruitgang van die politieke en veiligheidsituasie.
tgt: Immediate SADC intervention was required in the Kingdom of Lesotho following the escalating tensions and the subsequent deterioration of political and security situation in August 2014.

src: Die SAOG-ingryping is veral daarop gemik om langtermyn politieke en sekuriteitstabiliteit te verseker.
tgt: The SADC intervention is aimed in particular at the attainment of long term political and security stability.

src: Die SAOG-troika oor Politiek, Verdediging en Sekuriteit waarvan Suid-Afrika die voorsitter is, het die Suid-Afrikaanse Regering versoek om die implementering van die padkaart vir die Koninkryk van Lesotho te ondersteun.
tgt: The SADC Troika on Politics, Defence and Security of which South Africa is the Chair requested the South African government to support the implementation of the Roadmap of the kingdom of Lesotho.

src: Die ontplooiing van 140 SAPD-lede het op 2 September 2014 begin en sal na verwagting tot 30 November 2014 duur, indien geen verlenging vereis word nie.
tgt: The deployment of 140 SAPS members commenced on 2 September 2014 and is expected to end on 30 November 2014, should no extension be required.

src: Suid-Afrika het die polisie in Lesotho ontplooi kragtens die Wet op die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens, 1995 (Wet No.
tgt: South Africa deployed the Police in Lesotho in terms of the South African Police Service Act 1995 (Act No.

src: 68 van 1995) wat bepaal dat die Nasionale Kommissaris van die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens polisielede buite landsgrense met die toestemming van die Minister kan ontplooi.
tgt: 68 of 1995) provides that the National Commissioner of the South African Police Service may deploy police members outside the borders of the Republic, with the permission of the Minister.

src: Aangesien die lede onder SAOG-mandaat ontplooi word, sal daar geen Meorandum van Verstandhouding tussen Suid-Afrika en die Regering van Lesotho wees nie.
tgt: Since the members will be deployed under the SADC mandate there will be no Memorandum of Understanding between South Africa and the Government of Lesotho.

src: Die Kabinet keur die onderhandelingsmandaat goed vir die Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging om van 17 tot 21 November 2014 die Gesamentlike 10de Konferensie van Partye (KVP) van die Weense Konvensie en die 26ste Vrgadering van Partye (VVP) van die Montreal-protokol oor Stowwe wat die Osoonlaag Vernietig (COP10-MOP26) in Parys, Frankryk, by te woon.
tgt: Cabinet approved the negotiating mandate for the South African delegation attending the Joint 10th Conference of the Parties (COP) to the Vienna Convention and the 26th Meeting of the Parties (MOP) to the Montreal Protocol on Substance that Deplete the Ozone Layer (COP10-MOP26), 17-21 November 2014 in Paris, France.

src: Die Weense Konvensie en die Montreal-protokol is deur die Verenigde Nasies se Omgewingsprogram gestig om die osoonlaag te beskerm.
tgt: The Vienna Convention and the Montreal Protocol were established by the United Nations Environment Programme with the objective of protecting the Ozone layer.

src: Die beskerming van die omgewing vir huidige en toekomstige geslagte is ’n prioriteit en sluit die beskerming van die osoonlaag in.
tgt: The protection of the environment for present and future generations is a priority and also the protection of the ozone layer.

src: Die hoofdoel is om ons te beywer vir gesonde, volhoubare bestuur van chemikalieë wat gunstig is vir die omgewing.
tgt: The primary aim is to work towards environmentally sound management of chemicals in a sustainable manner.

src: Die Kabinet keur die vestiging van die Raad vir die Handves vir Breëbasis- Swart Ekonomiese Bemagtiging in die Vervoersektor goed om teikens te monitor en te evalueer.
tgt: Cabinet approved the establishment of the Transport Sector Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Charter Council to monitor and evaluate implementation of the Black Economic Empowerment targets.

src: Implementering van die belangrikste Regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of Key Government Programmes.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom president Jacob Zuma se Siyahlola-diensleweringsmoniteringsbesoek aan die Mopani-distrik, in Giyani, Limpopo.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed President Jacob Zuma’s Siyahlola Service Delivery Monitoring Visit to the Mopani District, Giyani in Limpopo Province.

src: Danksy diensleweringsprogramme word water aan 55 nedersettings in die distrik gelewer en die Giyani Watersuiweringswerke is opgeknap om ’n bykomende 6,7 Mℓ per dag te lewer.
tgt: Service delivery programmes resulted in water being provided to 55 villages in this district and the refurbishment of the Giyani Water Treatment Works, which increased capacity to an additional Megalitres per day.

src: Die program sal ook sanitasie verbeter en sodoende 'n positiewe uitwerking op die gesondheid en welsyn van die inwoners hê.
tgt: This provision of water will improve sanitation and consequently have a positive impact on the health and wellbeing of residents.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die inisiatief gelei deur Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa wat die verteenwoordigers van die Nasionale Raad oor Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling en Arbeid op 4 November 2014 byeengebring het om werkbare oplossings vir konflik in die werkplek te vind tydens die Indaba oor Arbeidsverhoudinge.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the initiative led by Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa that brought together the constituency of National Economic Development and Labour Council on 4 November 2014 to find amicable solutions to workplace conflict at the Labour Relations Indaba.

src: Afgevaardigdes by die indaba het die volgende verklaar: Verteenwoordigers erken die uitdagings van werkloosheid, armoede en ongelykheid wat die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie en die samelewing in die gesig staar.
tgt: The delegates attending the Indaba declared as follows, “that constituencies recognise the challenges of unemployment, poverty and inequality facing the South African economy and society.

src: Ondanks uitdagings wat maatskaplike dialoog mag striem, erken die Nedlac-verteenwoordigers Nedlac as die sleutelstruktuur waaronder maatskaplike dialoog gevoer word, en is daarom die bewaarder van prosesse wat op die Indaba oor Arbeidsverhoudinge mag volg.
tgt: Notwithstanding any challenges which may constrain current social dialogue, the Nedlac constituencies recognise Nedlac as the key structure under which social dialogue is conducted, and therefore the custodian of any processes that may follow the Labour Relations Indaba (Indaba).The indaba social partners that it will be a launch of a process of engagement, through task teams, that will identify ways of addressing the key challenges considered during the Indaba.

src: Die indaba se maatskaplike vennote sal die bekendstelling van 'n proses van betrokkenheid, deur middel van taakspanne, wees, wat maniere sal identifiseer om die belangrikste uitdagings wat tydens die indaba oorweeg sal word, die hoof te bied.
tgt: A detailed roadmap of the process will be developed within two months of the Indaba, and the deliberations will begin during January 2015.Cabinet is confident that such engagements between government, business, labour and civil society will contribute to higher economic growth.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die Wêreldbank se verslag (South African Economic Update se sesde verslag wat klem lê op fiskale beleid en herverdeling) wat daarop dui dat Suid-Afrika die afgelope 20 jaar heelwat vermag het.
tgt: The South Africa Economic Update, released on Tuesday, 04 November 2014, found that SA’s fiscal policies are cutting the rates of poverty and inequality, and that tax and social benefits are effectively redistributing income from rich to poor.

src: Die South Africa Economic Update, wat Dinsdag, 4 November 2014 uitgereik is, het bevind dat Suid-Afrika se fiskale beleid besig is om armoede en ongelykheid te verminder, en dat belasting en maatskaplike voordele inkomste van ryk na arm herverdeel.
tgt: The report showed that fiscal policy is very progressive in South Africa as it benefits the poor.

src: Die verslag dui aan dat die fiskale beleid in Suid-Afrika progressief tot voordeel van die armes is.
tgt: The report also indicates that these fiscal policies have lifted million people out of poverty in 2010/11.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die uitdagings met elektrisiteit wat veroorsaak is deur tegniese en infrastruktuurprobleme in sommige van die land se kragstasies.
tgt: Cabinet has noted the current challenges with electricity that are caused by technical and infrastructure problems in some of our power stations.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om elektrisiteit te bespaar aangesien die land se kragnetwerk onder geweldige druk is.
tgt: Cabinet therefore calls on all South Africans to assist in saving electricity as the country's power grid is under severe strain.

src: Die Kabinet wil Suid-Afrikaners verseker dat alles gedoen word om dié probleme uit te stryk.
tgt: Cabinet would like to reassure South Africans that everything is being done to address these problems.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die Kwartaallikse Arbeidsopname wat toon dat die amptelike werkloosheidsyfer in die derde kwartaal van vanjaar 25,4% beloop het.
tgt: Cabinet noted the Quarterly Labour Force Survey which showed official unemployment during the third quarter of this year at per cent up from per cent in the same period a year ago highlighting the need for optimal economic performance so that we are able to address the triple challenge of unemployment, poverty and inequality.

src: Die Kabinet stel Suid-Afrikaners gerus dat die bekamping van werkloosheid die Regering se eerste prioriteit bly.
tgt: Cabinet reassures South Africans that addressing unemployment remains government’s top priority.

src: Hoewel openbare indiensnemingsprogramme vrugte afwerp, doen die Kabinet 'n beroep op alle maatskaplike vennote om met die Regering saam te werk om kort- en langtermynoplossings vir werkloosheid te vind.
tgt: While Public Employment Programmes continue to yield results, Cabinet calls on all the social partners to work with government to intensify efforts to create jobs and finding short and long term solutions to the challenge of unemployment.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die Fitch-graderingsagentskap se verbetering van die Nywerheidsontwikkelingskorporasie se gradering.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the recent rating upgrade of the Industrial Development Cooperation (IDC) by the Fitch Ratings Agency.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel met die Regering en die mense van die Republiek van Zambië ná die afsterwe van President Michael Chilufya Sata.
tgt: Cabinet conveys its condolences to the government and people of the Republic of Zambia following the passing of President Michael Chilufya Sata.

src: Die Kabinet betreur die dood van vier van die land se sportsterre en betuig sy meegevoel aan die familie en vriende van die professionele bokser Phindile Mwelase, Olimpiese gouemedaljewenner Mbulaeni Mulaudzi, voormalige Springbok-rugbyspeler Tinus Linee en Bafana Bafana-kaptein Senzo Meiwa.
tgt: Cabinet is saddened by the death of four of the country’s sporting stars and conveys its condolences to the families and friends of professional boxer Phindile Mwelase, Olympic gold medallist Mbulaeni Mulaudzi, former Springbok player Tinus Linee and Bafana Bafana captain Senzo Meyiwa.

src: Openbare steun vir die gedenkdienste en die opregte betuiging van meegevoel het ons ter nagedagtenis aan ons sporthelde in ons hartseer verenig.
tgt: Public support for the memorial services and the heartfelt outpouring of emotion united us in our grief as we remember our sporting heroes.

src: Die Kabinet is vol lof vir die spoedige inhegtenisneming verlede week van een van die verdagtes vir die moord op Bafana Bafana-kaptein Senzo Meiwa en doen ’n beroep op gemeenskappe om met die polisie saam te werk om al die verdagtes aan die kaak te stel.
tgt: Cabinet also applauded the speedy arrest of one suspect by the South African Police Service last week in the murder of Bafana Bafana captain Senzo Meyiwa and also urge communities to continue working with the Police to bring all suspects to book.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die nege lewenslange vonnisse wat aan Ntokozo Hadebe opgelê is vir die gruwelike misdade teen die drie jong meisies in Diepsloot, Johannesburg, asook die 315-jaar tronkstraf wat aan Mhlonishwa Elias Mathebula opgelê is vir sy skrikbewind in KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the nine life sentences meted out to Ntokozo Hadebe for his heinous crimes against three young girls in Diepsloot, Johannesburg, as well as the 315-year prison sentence given to Mhlonishwa Elias Mathebula for his reign of terror in Kwazulu Natal.

src: Van 2008 tot 2013 het Mathebula 18 vroue aan die Suidkus, hoofsaaklik Umzinto, Hibberdene, Dududu en Msinsi, agtervolg en verkrag.
tgt: From 2008 - 2013, Mathebula accosted females on the South Coast, mainly Umzinto, Hibberdene, Dududu and Msinsi by stalking and raping 18 victims, aged from 14 to 40.These sentences send a strong message to criminals that acts of criminality will not be tolerated.

src: Die Kabinet verseker Suid-Afrikaners dat die Regering alles in sy vermoë doen om landsburgers veilig te hou en doen 'n beroep op gemeenskappe om die polisie by te staan om misdaad in hul gebied aan te meld.
tgt: Cabinet assures South Africans that government is doing everything possible to keep everyone safe and calls on communities to assist the police by reporting criminal activities in their area.

src: Die Kabinet bevestig dat die gesondheids- en hawe-owerhede steeds op 'n hoë gereedheidsgrondslag is om Ebola te identifiseer en te bekamp.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates that the health and port authorities remain on high alert to identify and contain Ebola.

src: Tot op hede is 525 gesondheids- en laboratoriumwerkers by 13 hospitale (insluitende die 11 aangewese fasiliteite) en ongeveer 270 beamptes by nege hoërisikogrensposte ontplooi en opgelei om enige gebeurlikheid te hanteer.
tgt: To date approximately 525 health and laboratory workers at 13 hospitals (including the 11 designated facilities) and approximately 270 officials at nine high risk ports of entry were trained to deal with any eventualities.

src: Die Kabinet wens Sy Edele President Ian Khama Seretse Khama, leier van die Botswana Demokratiese Party, geluk met sy herverkiesing as President van die Republiek van Botswana, ná die suksesvolle verkiesings op 24 Oktober 2014.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates H. President Lt. General Ian Khama Seretse Khama, leader of the Botswana Democratic Party, on his re-election as President of the Republic of Botswana, following the successful elections on 24 October 2014.

src: Die Kabinet wens Haar Edele me Dilma Rousseff van die Arbeidersparty geluk met haar suksesvolle herverkiesing as President van die Federale Republiek van Brasilië ná die suksesvolle verkiesings op 26 Oktober 2014.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates H. Ms Dilma Rousseff, of the Workers Party on her successful re-election as President of the Federative Republic of Brazil following the successful elections in 26 October 2014.

src: Die Kabinet wens Lesetja Kganyago sterkte toe in sy nuwe hoedanigheid as President van die Suid-Afrikaanse Reserwebank vanaf 9 November 2014.
tgt: Cabinet wishes the new Governor of the South African Reserve Bank, Lesetja Kganyago well as he assumes his position on 9 November 2014.

src: Die Kabinet bedank ook die uittredende President me Gill Marcus vir haar goeie bestuur van die land se monetêre beleid onder moeilike ekonomiese omstandighede.
tgt: Cabinet also expresses its gratitude to the outgoing Governor Gill Marcus for steering monetary policy well in difficult economic times.

src: Die Kabinet wens Chad le Clos geluk as een van die twee algehele wenners van FINA (Fédération Internationale de Natation) se Wêreldbeker Swemreeks wat in Singapoer ten einde geloop het.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates Chad Le Clos as one of the two overall winners of the FINA (Fédération Internationale de Natation) Swimming World Cup Series which ended in Singapore.

src: Komende gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: President Jacob Zuma sal die G20-beraad van 15 tot 16 November 2014 in Brisbane, Australië, bywoon.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will attend the G20 Summit in Brisbane, Australia, from 15 to 16 November 2014.

src: As die enigste Afrika-land in die G20, stel Suid-Afrika se lidmaatskap hom in staat om belangrike internasionale beleid te beïnvloed wat die land se ekonomie die streek en die vasteland kan raak.
tgt: As the only African country represented in the G20, South Africa’s membership provides an opportunity to influence key international policies that could have an impact on our economy, the region and the continent.

src: Die SAOG-fasiliteerder en Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa sal Lesotho vanaf 5 tot 6 November besoek om vrede en veiligheid in die Koninkryk te probeer bewerkstellig.
tgt: The SADC facilitator and Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa will pay a visit to Lesotho from 5 – 6 November as part of efforts to consolidate peace and security in the Kingdom.

src: Dit volg op die onlangse ondertekening van die Maseru-fasiliteringsverklaring en die Maseru-sekerheidsakkoord, wat 'n basis neerlê vir die terugkeer van Lesotho na politieke normaliteit en die stabilisering van die veiligheidsituasie in die land.
tgt: This follows the recent signing of the Maseru facilitation declaration and the Maseru security accord which lays a basis for the return of Lesotho to political normalcy and the stabilisation of the security situation in the country.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die Departement van Landelike Ontwikkeling en Grondhervorming se bekendstelling op 8 November 2014 van die Mashunka- en Ngubo-brug, die Tugela Ferry-besproeiingskema en Umsinga-veilingsgeriewe in Msinga, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the Mashunka and Ngubo Bridge, the Tugela Ferry Irrigation Scheme and uMsinga auction facilities in Msinga, KwaZulu-Natal, on 8 November 2014 by the Department of Rural Development and Land Reform.

src: Die Tugela Ferry-besproeiingskema sal 1 716 kleinboere help en die uMsinga-veeveilingsterrein sal werkgeleenthede skep.
tgt: The Tugela Ferry Irrigation Scheme will assist 1 716 small-holder farmers and the uMsinga livestock sales yard will create employment opportunities.

src: Implementering van die belangrikste Regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of Key Government Programmes.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van Operasie Phakisa 2: Die Program vir die Verbetering van Ideale Klinieke, Realisering en Instandhouding.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the launch of Operation Phakisa 2: Scaling up Ideal Clinic Realisation and Maintenance Programme.

src: Dit volg op Operation Phakisa 1 wat gefokus het op die ontsluiting van die ekonomiese potensiaal van Suid-Afrika se oseane.
tgt: This follows Operation Phakisa 1 which focused on unlocking the economic potential of South Africa's oceans.

src: Operasie Phakisa 2 poog om die gehalte van sorg in 3 500 primêre gesondheidsorggeriewe te verbeter, bestaande uit staatsklinieke en gemeenskapsgesondheidsentrums.
tgt: Operation Phakisa 2 seeks to improve the quality of care provided in 3 500 Primary Health Care facilities, consisting of government clinics and Community Health Centres.

src: Die verwagte uitkomste behels die transformasie van bestaande klinieke en gemeenskapsgesondheidsentrums in sentrums van uitnemendheid, vir gebruik deur alle Suid-Afrikaners, danksy verbeterde gehalte van dienste.
tgt: The expected outcomes entails transformation of the existing clinics and Community Health Centres into centres of excellence, which will be used by all South Africans, due to the enhanced quality of services they will provide.

src: Die Kabinet wens die wenners van die Batho Pele-uitnemendheidstoekennings, wat op 14 November 2014 uitgedeel is, geluk.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the winners of the Batho Pele Excellence Awards, which was held on 14 November 2014.

src: Hierdie toekennings vestig professionaliteit en erken uitnemendheid in die Staatsdiens.
tgt: These awards entrench professionalism and recognise excellence in the public service.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis dat die Minister van Sport en Ontspanning, mnr Fikile Mbalula die 2014 Suid-Afrikaanse Sport-toekennings op 30 November 2014 by die Sandton Konferensiesentrum sal aanbied.
tgt: Cabinet noted that Minister of Sport and Recreation, Minister Fikile Mbalula will host the 2014 South African Sport Awards at the Sandton Convention Centre on 30 November 2014.

src: Die Kabinet moedig sportgeesdriftiges aan om deel van die Suid-Afrikaanse Sporttoekennings wees deur vir die Sportster van die Jaar te stem.
tgt: Cabinet encourages sport loving South Africans to be part the South African Sports Awards by voting for the Sports Star of the Year.

src: Inligting is beskikbaar op WEBTOKEDie Kabinet wens ons nasionale sportspanne Bafana Bafana, die Springbokke en die Proteas geluk met hul prestasies die afgelope naweek en dat hulle die land trots gemaak het.
tgt: Information is available on WEBTOKECabinet congratulates our national sporting teams Bafana Bafana, the Springboks and the Proteas for flying the flag high with their strong performances over the weekend and making South Africa proud.

src: Die benoeming van mnr AB de Villiers as die Internasionale Krieketraad se Eendagspeler van die Jaar nadat hy 7 000 eendaglopies behaal het, is prysenswaardig.
tgt: The naming of Mr AB de Villiers as the International Cricket Council's One Day International (ODI) Cricketer of the Year for scoring 7 000 ODI runs, is commendable.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van die A Re Yeng-snelbusdiens in Tshwane, wat op Maandag, 17 November 2014 begin het.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the A Re Yeng Bus Rapid Transport (BRT) service in Tshwane, which started operating from Monday, 17 November 2014.

src: Die A Re Yeng, soos ander snelbusdienste oor die land, maak deel uit van ’n strategiese openbarevervoernetwerk wat die lewens van pendelaars sal verbeter deur hulle vinnige, veilige, bekostigbare en gerieflike stedelike mobiliteit te gee.
tgt: The A Re Yeng, like other BRT services around the country, forms part of a strategic public transport network that will improve the lives of commuters by providing them with fast, safe, affordable and comfortable urban mobility.

src: Die bou van hierdie dienste is deel van die Regering se infrastruktuurprogram, wat wêreldklas-infrastruktuur in Suid-Afrika gaan ontwikkel en werkgeleenthede gaan skep.
tgt: The construction of these services forms part of government’s infrastructure roll-out programme, which intends to develop a world class infrastructure in South Africa, while creating jobs.

src: Sleutelkabinetsbesluite.1 Die Kabinet het die implementering van 'n omvattende program goedgekeur om nakoming van bestaande beleid oor plaaslike verkryging te verseker.
tgt: Cabinet approved implementation of a comprehensive program to ensure compliance with existing localisation procurement leverage policies and regulations.

src: Dit sluit in beleidshersiening om die Wet op die Raamwerk vir Voorkeurverkrygingsbeleid te verbeter, die uitbreiding van die program vir mededingende verskafferontwikkeling aan alle strategiese maatskappye in staatsbesit, asook die bevordering van departementele regulasies (veral die mynbou-handves) om plaaslike verkryging te verseker.
tgt: This includes a policy alignment process to review and strengthen the Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, extending the Competitive Supplier Development Program to all strategic State-Owned Companies as well as strengthening departmental regulations (particularly the mining charter) to enable local procurement.

src: Dit is 'n kragtige hulpmiddel vir industrialisering wat mededingendheid van die nywerheidsektor sal verbeter.
tgt: This is a powerful instrument for industrialisation which will enhance the competitiveness of national industry, enable the development of new national industrial and technological capabilities, increase exports and achieve deeper black economic empowerment.

src: Dit sal op sy beurt die ontwikkeling van nuwe nasionale industriële en tegnologiese vermoëns verbeter, uitvoere verhoog en groter swart ekonomiese bemagtiging bewerkstellig.2 Die Kabinet is in kennis gestel van die Beraad vir Presidensiële Plaaslike Regering, en het die Program vir die Terugkeer na Basiese Beginsels vir Plaaslike Regering goedgekeur, wat geskoei is op die bou van 'n responsiewe, deernisvolle en verantwoordelike plaaslikeregeringsektor.
tgt: Cabinet was appraised on the Presidential Local Government Summit, and approved the Back to Basics Programme for Local Government, which is based on building a responsive, caring and accountable local government sector.

src: Die Program vir die Terugkeer na Basiese Beginsels sal fokus op beplanning en werksaamhede van alle munisipaliteite vir doeltreffende lewering van basiese munisipale dienste en gereelde kommunikasie met inwoners.
tgt: The Back to Basics Programme will focus planning and operations of all municipalities on the effective delivery of basic municipal services and regular communication with residents.

src: Die doel is om van bedoeling tot aksie oor te gaan.
tgt: The aim is to move from intent to action.

src: Verbeterings in die prestasie van munisipaliteite sal die lewensomstandighede van alle Suid-Afrikaners wat afhanklik is van goed funksionerende munisipaliteite verbeter sodat hulle waardige lewens kan lei.
tgt: Improvements in the performance of municipalities will improve the living conditions of all South Africans that depend on well-functioning municipalities to lead dignified lives.

src: Sedert 1994 is plaaslike regering 'n primêre bron vir dienslewering.
tgt: Since 1994, local government has been a primary site for the delivery of service.

src: Hoewel daar ongekende vooruitgang in die lewering van water, elektrisiteit, sanitasie en vullisverwydering op plaaslike vlak was, moet ons mense ons na mense luister waar dienslewering misluk.
tgt: While there has been unprecedented progress in delivering water, electricity, sanitation and refuse removal at local levels, in areas where service delivery is failing we need to put people and their concerns first.

src: Dit vereis dat ons wegbeweeg van die ou diensleweringsbeleid wat van bo na onder strek, na 'n kultuur van Batho Pele en dien van gemeenskappe.
tgt: This requires that we move away from the outdated top down service delivery to a culture of Batho Pele and serving communities.

src: ’n Stelsel van verslagdoening oor en verantwoording is noodsaaklik vir so ’n stelsel.3 Die Kabinet het die indiening van Suid-Afrika se Tweejaarlikse Vorderingsverslag oor die Vermindering van Uitlaatgasse, insluitend die Finale 2000-2010 Nasionale Kweekhuisgasinventaris, aan die Verenigde Nasies se Raamwerkkonvensie oor Klimaatsverandering (UNFCCC) goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of South Africa’s Biennial Update Report on Emission Reductions, inclusive of the Final 2000-2010 National Green House (GHG) Inventory, to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).

src: Dit bied ’n oorsig en ontleding van Suid-Afrika se KHG-vrystellingsprofiel en kernbestuurders van verandering in emissies.
tgt: It provides an overview and analysis of South Africa’s GHG emissions profile and key drivers of change in emissions.

src: Dit beklemtoon ook die omvattende maatreëls om klimaatsverandering die hoof te bied as deel van die oorgang na 'n laekoolstofekonomie.
tgt: It also highlights the comprehensive suite of climate change measures as part of the transition to a low-carbon economy.

src: Dit sluit in die definiëring van gewenste uitkomste vir die vermindering van uitlaatgasse, bevordering van innovering en belegging in hernubare energie, aanmoediging van energiedoeltreffendheid, die skepping van 'n nasionale stelsel vir kweekhuisgasdata-insameling en ander instrumente soos koolstofbelasting.
tgt: These include defining desired emission reduction outcomes promoting innovation and investment in renewable energy encouraging energy efficiency creating a national system for greenhouse gas data collection and other instruments such as Carbon Tax.

src: Dit vorm ook deel van Suid-Afrika se internasionale verslagdoeningsverpligting onder die Verenigde Nasies se Raamwerkkonvensie oor Klimaatsverandering (UNFCCC).4 Die Kabinet het die vestiging van 'n interdepartementele taakspan onder die Groepering vir Internasionale Samewerking, Handel en Veiligheid goedgekeur om toesig te hou oor die implementering van die Wêreldhandelsorganisasie (WHO) se Ooreenkoms vir die bevordering van Handel.
tgt: This also forms part of South Africa’s international reporting obligation under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).

src: Suid-Afrika het onderneem om met ander Afrika-lande saam te werk om te verseker dat die implementering van die handelsooreenkoms nie vereis dat Afrika-lande verpligtinge aanvaar wat hulle nie kan nakom nie en hulle dan aan regsaanspreeklikheid blootstel nie.
tgt: South Africa’s position is to work with other African countries to ensure that the adoption and implementation of the Trade Facilitation Agreement does not require African countries to accept obligations they do not have the capacity to meet and that expose them to legal challenges.

src: Suid-Afrika is verbind tot die multilaterale onderhandelinge onder die Doha-ronde, maar is daartoe verbind om ’n uitkoms te soek wat ons genoeg ruimte laat om beleid deur te voer wat nywerheidsontwikkeling en indiensneming bevorder – die hart van die doelwitte uiteengesit in die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan.
tgt: While South Africa remains committed to the multilateral negotiations under the Doha Round, our position is to seek an outcome that preserves our space to pursue policies that support industrial development and employment that lie at the heart of the objectives set out in the National Development Plan.

src: Suid-Afrika het die belangrikheid van volle multilaterale en inklusiewe benaderings ten opsigte van WHO-sake bekragtig as die beste manier om gebalanseerde, regverdige uitkomste vir alle lede te beding.5 Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die Drieparty-vryehandelsooreenkoms (DVHO) van die Gemeenskaplike Mark van Oos- en Suider-Afrika, die Oos-Afrikaanse Gemeenskap en die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap en het Suid-Afrika se beleid oor DVHO bevestig.
tgt: South Africa has affirmed the importance of fully multilateral and inclusive approaches to the conduct of WTO business as best suited to balanced, equitable outcomes that meet the interests of all Members.

src: Die driepartyinisiatief is ’n kern-Afrikageleide projek wat daarop gemik is om die ekonomie van skaal te bevorder, om mededingendheid, diversifikasie, die bevordering van die plaaslike waardekettings, intraplaaslike handel en belegging, en oorgrensinfrastruktuur moontlik te maak.
tgt: Cabinet was updated on the Common Market of Eastern and Southern Africa – East African Community – Southern African Development Community (COMESA-EAC-SADC) Tripartite Free Trade Agreement (TFTA) and also approved South Africa’s position on the TFTThe Tripartite initiative is a key African led project aimed at promoting economies of scale, enabling competitiveness, diversification, fostering regional value-chains, intra-regional trade and investment, and cross-border infrastructure.

src: Suid-Afrika onderhandel namens die Suider-Afrikaanse Doeane-unie (SADU) wat as een entiteit onderhandel.
tgt: South Africa negotiates as part of the Southern African Customs Union (SACU) that negotiates as one entity.

src: Die Driepartylande het ’n gekombineerde bruto binnelandse produk van VSA$1,2 biljoen en ’n gesamentlike bevolking van ongeveer 626 miljoen, wat net meer as die helfte van die totale bevolking en ekonomie van Afrika is.
tgt: The Tripartite countries have a combined gross domestic product of US$1.2 trillion and a combined population of approximately 626 million people, representing just over half the total African population and economy.

src: Streeksintegrasie om groter markte te skep vir versnelde en volhoubare groei in Afrika is 'n beslissende stap om die koloniale erfenis van klein, gefragmenteerde markte in Afrika te oorkom.6 Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die voorstelle van die G20-Brisbane-spitsberaad vir ’n meer intensiewe, indringende en doeltreffende benadering tot die regulering van die finansiële sektor.
tgt: Regional integration to create larger markets for accelerated and sustainable growth in Africa is a decisive step to overcome the colonial heritage of small fragmented African markets.

src: Dit dra by tot voortgesette finansiële stabiliteit en veerkragtigheid van die internasionale en plaaslike finansiële stelsels.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the G20 Brisbane Summit proposals for a more intensive, intrusive and effective approach to regulating the financial sector.

src: Na aanleiding van die 2008 wêreldwye finansiële krisis, het G20-leiers hulle verbind tot fundamentele hervorming van die internasionale finansiële stelsel.
tgt: This contributes to continued financial stability and resilience of the global and domestic financial system.

src: Hul doelwitte was om die onderliggende redes wat tot die krisis gelei het, te soek en veiliger, meer doeltreffende bronne van finansiering te skep om die behoeftes van die ekonomie te dien.
tgt: Their objectives were to connect the fault lines that led to the global crisis and to build safer, more resilient sources of finance to better serve the needs of the real economy.

src: Oor die afgelope vyf jaar het die G20 op die hantering van die skuld gefokus wat die krisis veroorsaak het, deur internasionale standaarde te verbeter meer doeltreffende finansiële instellings en meer kragte markte te skep.
tgt: Over the past five years, the G20 focused on dealing with the fault lines that caused the crisis, by strengthening international standards to build more resilient financial institutions and more robust markets.

src: Die Brisbane-beraad het die eerste fase van finansiële hervorming afgesluit.
tgt: The Brisbane Summit concluded the first phase of financial reform, and going forward the Financial Stability Board will adjust its focus to mitigating new and constantly evolving risks and vulnerabilities.

src: Die Raad vir Finansiële Stabiliteit sal voortaan sy fokus aanpas om nuwe en voortdurend veranderende risiko's en kwesbaarhede te temper.
tgt: South Africa will continue to participate in the Financial Stability Board and associated regulatory forums which work to promote a system based on mutual trust and cooperation which is essential to maintain an open global financial system that can achieve the G20’s objective of strong, sustainable and balanced growth.

src: Suid-Afrika sal steeds deelneem aan die Raad vir Finansiële Stabiliteit en gepaardgaande regulatoriese forums, wat 'n stelsel geskoei op wedersydse vertroue en samewerking sal bevorder.
tgt: Cabinet noted and ratified the resolutions of the President’s Coordination Council (PCC) meeting held on 18 March 2014, for purposes of implementation.

src: Kernbesluite sluit in: aanpassing en implementering van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP) om vordering deur die plaaslikeregeringsektor met die implementering van die NOP te weerspieël.
tgt: Key resolutions include: alignment and implementation of the National Development (NDP) to reflect progress made by the local government sector in implementing the NDNational government departments, the National Planning Commission and provinces to ensure that municipal plans are aligned to the NDP and other national plans

src: Nasionale staatsdepartemente, die Nasionale Beplanningskommissie en die provinsies om seker te maak dat munisipale planne in lyn is met die NOP en ander nasionale planne
tgt: addressing capacity needs of the three spheres of government to support municipalities to deliver on their mandates

src: die oorweging van kapasiteitbehoeftes van die drie vlakke van regering om munisipaliteite te help om hul mandaat uit te voer
tgt: urgency in attaining transformative local government and addressing impediments associated with achieving equitable and effective municipal governance, addressing challenges relating to apartheid spatial patterns in towns and cities.

src: dringendheid in die bereiking van transformerende plaaslike regering en die oorweging van hindernisse wat verband hou met die bereiking van billike en doeltreffende munisipale bestuur, die oorkoming van uitdagings van ruimtelike patrone van dorpe en stede wat uit die apartheid-era dateer.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on preparations for the 2016 Municipal Elections and approved the establishment of an Inter-Ministerial Task Team and a Technical Task Team on Municipal Elections.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die voorbereidings vir die 2016 munisipale verkiesings en het 'n interministeriële en tegniese taakspan vir munisipale verkiesings goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet also approved submission of the amendment to the Local Government: Municipal Structures Act, 1998 (Act No.

src: Dit sal die President (voorheen die Minister): Munisipale Strukture, 1998 (Wet 117 van 1998) in staat stel om ’n datum vir munisipale verkiesings aan te kondig.
tgt: 117 of 1998) to Parliament, so as to provide for the President (previously the Minister) to set a date for election of all municipal councils.

src: Die 2016 munisipale verkiesings sal die vierde verkiesings van ons demokrasie wees.
tgt: The 2016 municipal elections will be the fourth elections since our democracy and the advanced preparations ensure that these elections are just as successful as the previous ones.

src: Wetsontwerpe.1 Die Kabinet het die indiening van die Strafregwysigingswet (Seksuele Misdrywe en Verwante Aangeleenthede), 2014 aan die Parlement goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Criminal Law (Sexual Offences and Related mattes) Amendment Bill, 2014 to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp behandel twee afsonderlike uitsprake van die Konstitusionele Hof met die wysiging van die toepaslike dele van die Strafregwysigingswet (Seksuele Misdrywe en Verwante Aangeleenthede), 2007, om die huidige grondwetlike ongeldigheid reg te stel.
tgt: The Bill addresses two separate Constitutional Court judgments, by amending the applicable sections of the Criminal Law (Sexual Offences and Related matters) Amendment Act, 2007, to remedy the current position of constitutional invalidity.

src: Die hoofdoel van Artikels 15 en 16 van die wet, naamlik om kwesbare kinders teen seksuele uitbuiting deur volwassenes te beskerm, bly onaangeraak.
tgt: The primary objective of sections 15 and 16 of the Act, namely to protect vulnerable children against sexual exploitation by adults, remains unaffected by the proposed amendments.

src: Die voorgestelde wysiging van Artikels 50 en 51 van die wet het ten doel om uitvoering te gee aan die beginsel dat die beste belang van kinders vooropgestel word in alle aangeleenthede wat hulle raak.2 Die Kabinet het die bekendstelling van die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Regsake, 2014, in die Parlement goedgekeur.
tgt: The proposed amendment to sections 50 and 51 of the Act aims to give effect to the principle that the best interests of children are of paramount importance in all matters that concern them.

src: Die wetsontwerp wysig talle wette, geadministreer deur die Departement van Justisie en Grondwetlike Ontwikkeling, om aandag te gee aan praktiese en tegniese uitdagings, met die doel om doeltreffendheid en aanspreeklikheid te verbeter.3 Die Kabinet keur die bekendstelling van die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Banke, 2014, in die Parlement goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the introduction of the Judicial Matters Amendment Bill, 2014 to Parliament.

src: Die Kabinet spreek sy meegevoel aan die familie van wyle Dennis Furhri uit, wat oorlede is tydens repatriasie van die oorskot van Suid-Afrikaners toe 'n kerk in Nigerië op 12 September 2014 ineengestort het.
tgt: Cabinet was heartened by the arrival of the mortal remains of those South Africans killed in the building collapse in Lagos, Nigeria on 12 September 2014.Cabinet commends the tireless efforts of those involved in the repatriation process and appreciates the cooperation received from officials in Nigeria in expediting the process given its complexities.

src: Die Kabinet beaam die Nasionale Tesourie se reaksie op Moody’s se besluit om Suid-Afrika se kredietgradering te hersien na "Baa2 / P-2" van "Baa1' / P-2", van stabiel na negatief.
tgt: Cabinet send its condolences to the family of the late Dennis Furhri who passed on whilst deployed as part of repatriation of mortal remains of South Africans who perished when a church collapsed in Nigeria on 12 September 2014.

src: President Zuma sal die Palestynse president Mahmoud Abbas van 26 tot 27 November 2014 in Tshwane ontvang.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will attend the Botswana–South Africa Bi-National Commission (BNC) in Gaborone, Botswana on 20 November 2014.

src: Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa gaan die tweede Turkye-beraad in Malabo, Ekwatoriaal-Guinee op 21 November 2014 bywoon.
tgt: President Zuma will receive Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas in Tshwane from 26 to 27 November 2014.

src: Die doel van die beraad is om die vordering deur die “Gesamentlike Implementeringsplan van die Afrika-Turkye-vennootskap 2010-2014” te bepaal.
tgt: This visit will build on the strong, brotherly relations between South Africa and Palestine, which was founded in the liberation struggle.

src: Die vennootskap dra by tot Afrika se ontwikkeling binne die doelwitte van die Afrika-unie se Agenda 2063.Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa sal op 1 Desember 2014, as voorsitter van die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Vigsraad (SANVR), Wêreldvigsdag in Virginia, Lejweleputswa, in die Vrystaat inlui onder die tema: "Sero stigma en diskriminasie".
tgt: The bi-lateral will focus on relations between South African and Palestine, the Middle East Peace Process and how South Africa can continue to the Palestinian struggle for freedom and self-determination.

src: Suid-Afrika het groot vordering gemaak ter bereiking van die doelwitte van die Nasionale Strategiese Plan vir MIV en vigs, TB en SOI 2012 – 2016.
tgt: Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa will attend the second Turkey Summit which will be Malabo, Equatorial Guinea on 21 November, 2014.

src: Die Departement van Omgewingsake gaan aan die 20ste sitting van die Konferensie van die Partye (KVP 20) en die 10de sessie van die Konferensie van Partye deelneem, wat dien as die vergadering van partye tot die Kyoto-protokol (CPM10), wat van 1 tot 12 Desember 2014 in Lima, Peru, gehou sal word.
tgt: This Partnership contributes to Africa’s development within the objectives set by African Union’s Agenda 2063.Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa, as chair of South African National AIDS Council (SANAC), will mark World AIDS Day on 1 December 2014 in Virginia, Lejweleputswa, in the Free State under the theme: “Zero Stigma and Discrimination”.

src: Die Lima Konferensie oor Klimaatverandering is noodsaaklik vir die suksesvolle afhandeling van die onderhandeling vir die 2015-ooreenkoms.
tgt: South Africa has made great progress in working towards reaching the goals of the National Strategic Plan for HIV and AIDS, TB and STIs 2012 – 2016.

src: Die Departement van Kuns en Kultuur en die Departement van Sport en Ontspanning sal op 22 November 2014 die tweede Nelson Mandela-sport-en-kultuurdag by die Uniegebou, Tshwane, aanbied, onder die tema: “Verenig: Een mens, een nasie, een viering”.Die Kabinet moedig alle Suid-Afrikaners aan om deel te neem aan die gemeenskaplike sport- en kultuuraktiwiteite aangesien dit sal help om Suid-Afrikaners te verenig.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all communities to support, care and accept those living with HIV and AIDAll South Africans are urged to practise safe sex get tested for HIV at least once a year so as to make informed decisions on preventative measures, treatment, care and support and for men and boys to take up medical male circumcision services.

src: Die Kabinet wil vanuit die staanspoor enige wanopvattings regstel dat President Zuma glo geweier het om vrae in die Parlement te beantwoord.
tgt: From the outset, Cabinet would like to clarify the misperception that President Jacob Zuma has refused to answer questions in Parliament.

src: Die Kabinet neem ook kennis van die pogings deur Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa om met politieke partye in die Nasionale Vergadering in gesprek te tree ná die onlangse ontwrigting in die Parlement.
tgt: Cabinet also noted efforts by Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa to interact with political parties in the National Assembly following chaotic scenes recently.

src: Die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika bepaal dat die President aanspreeklik is teenoor die Parlement.
tgt: The Constitution of the Republic of South Africa stipulates that the President is accountable to Parliament.

src: Die President het deurlopend sy aanspreeklikheid teenoor die Parlement nagekom.
tgt: The President has continuously fulfilled his role of accounting to Parliament.

src: Hy het skriftelike en mondelinge vrae wat lede in die Nasionale Vergadering en die Nasionale Raad van Provinsies (NRP) aan hom gerig het, beantwoord.
tgt: He has been answering written and oral questions posed to him by the members in both the National Assembly and the National Council of Provinces.

src: Die President het op 21 Augustus 2014 mondelinge vrae in die Nasionale Vergadering beantwoord.
tgt: The President went to orally answer questions in the National Assembly on 21 August 2014.

src: Agbare lede het hom ongelukkig in die rede geval terwyl hy die derde van ses vrae wat aan hom gestel is, beantwoord het.
tgt: Unfortunately Honourable Members disrupted him whilst answering the third of six questions posed to him.

src: Dit is trouens die agbare lede wat die President onbeleefd in die rede geval het en gekeer het dat hy vrae beantwoord het.
tgt: It is the Honourable Members who, through their own disrespectful behaviour, disrupted the President as he was answering questions.

src: Diegene wat die President verhinder het om vrae in die Nasionale Vergadering te beantwoord, het geen rede om die feite te verdraai en skielik te beweer dat dit die President is wat nie die agbare lede se vrae wil beantwoord nie.
tgt: Those Honourable Members who prevented the President from orally answering questions in the National Assembly have no moral grounds to twist the facts and suddenly claim that it is the President who does not want to orally reply to their questions.

src: Die Nasionale Vergadering het sedertdien die agbare lede wat die President in die rede geval het, berispe.
tgt: The National Assembly has since censured those Honourable Members who disrupted the President.

src: Die Kabinet is voorts nie bewus van enige ordelys in die Nasionale Vergadering waar die President ’n spreekbeurt gehad het om vrae te beantwoord ná die ontwrigting in die Parlement nie.
tgt: Further, Cabinet is not aware of any Order Paper in the National Assembly which had scheduled the President to answer oral questions after the disruption of his oral replies.

src: ’n Mes kan dus nie sê dat die President geweier het om vrae in die Nasionale Vergadering te beantwoord nie.
tgt: Therefore it cannot be true that the President has refused to answer questions in the National Assembly.

src: Die Kabinet is bekommerd oor die ontwrigting wat die onlangse kragonderbrekings op die lewens van Suid-Afrikaners het en die invloed daarvan op huishoudings en sakeondernemings oor die land heen.
tgt: Cabinet remains concerned over the disruptive effect of the recent power outages on the daily lives of South Africans and their impact on households and businesses across the country.

src: Die Kabinet het ’n vyfpuntplan aanvaar om die uitdagings van kragvoorsiening in die land die hoof te bied.
tgt: Cabinet has adopted a five-point plan to address the electricity challenges facing the country.

src: Die gebrek aan genoegsame kapasiteit om aan die land se energiebehoeftes te voorsien, bly ’n uitdaging en alle pogings word aangewend om die uitdaging te oorkom.
tgt: The lack of sufficient capacity to meet the country’s energy needs remains a challenge and all attempts are being made to ensure that we overcome the tight energy WEBTOKEN meet the country’s future energy requirements government is implementing an energy mix which comprises coal, solar, wind, hydro, gas and nuclear energy.

src: Om aan die land se toekomstige energiebehoeftes te voldoen, gaan die regering ’n energiebeleid implementeer wat uit 'n kombinasie van steenkool, sonkrag, wind en kernkrag sal WEBTOKEN verwagting sal biomassa, windkrag, sonkrag en hidrokrag sowat 11,4 GW hernubare energie aan die kragnetwerk lewer.
tgt: In future biomass, wind power, solar power and hydro-power will contribute Gigawatts of renewable energy to the grid.

src: In 1994, het slegs 5 miljoen mense elektrisiteit gehad.
tgt: Since 1994, five million more households were connected to the grid.

src: In 2004 het die getal huishoudings na 12 miljoen opgeskiet.
tgt: In 2004 this increased to 12 million households.

src: Dit het gebeur sonder dat nuwe kragstasies gebou is.
tgt: This happened without additional power stations being built.

src: Die styging in huishoudings met elektrisiteit moes deur die bestaande netwerk bedien word.
tgt: This increase of households was set off the existing WEBTOKEN Eskom will sign Memorandum of Understanding with the Strategic Fuel Fund and Transnet Ports Authority so that the country can be assured of a regular supply of diesel.

src: Die fokus sal val op die verbetering van strategiese instandhouding en operasionele doeltreffendheid om te verseker dat die vlak van doeltreffendheid van 72 na 80% sal verbeter.
tgt: The focus will be to improve the strategic maintenance and operational efficiency to ensure that the level of efficiency is increased from the current 72% to the target of 80%.

src: Eskom gaan ’n omvattende finansiële plan voorlê om kontantvloei ná 2015 te bestuur.
tgt: Eskom will present a detailed finance plan to manage its cash flow beyond 2015.

src: Die plan sal in Desember vanjaar aan die IMC voorgelê word.
tgt: This plan will be presented to the IMC by December 2014.

src: Die regering gaan die befondsing finansier.
tgt: Simultaneously government will finance the funding model.

src: Ander opsies vir kragopwekking in die suiker-, papier- en pulpbedrywe gaan ondersoek word om verkwiste energie van sowat 1 000 MW te ontgin.
tgt: Cogeneration (the generation of electricity and useful heat jointly, especially the use of the steam left over from electricity generation for heating) options will be pursued with the sugar paper and pulp industries to harness waste energy to the extent of 1000 megawatts.

src: Daar is verskeie geleenthede om gas in te voer.
tgt: There are significant opportunities for the importation of gas.

src: ’n Program vir privaat kragverskaffers sal teen die einde van Januarie 2015 bekend gestel word, wat op ’n opwekkingsvermoë van 2 500 MW sal neerkom.
tgt: A coal independent power producer programme will be launched by the end of January 2015 with a generation capacity of 2 500 megawatts.

src: Ons doen dus ’n beroep op die publiek om die vraag na elektrisiteit te verminder deur elektrisiteit af te skakel wanneer dit nie gebruik word nie.
tgt: We are therefore appealing to the public to help our country to reduce the demand of energy, which means switching off electricity when not in use.

src: Teen 15 Desember 2014 verwag ons ’n mate van verligting wanneer die meeste vervaardigers en nywerhede vir die jaar sluit.
tgt: We will have some relief from 15 December 2014 when manufacturing and industrial processes close for the year.

src: ’n Span kundiges gaan saamgestel word vir die onmiddellike implementering van die vyfpuntplan.
tgt: A technical team war room for the implementation of the five-point plan has been constituted with immediate effect.

src: Die plan behels:(I) die ingrypings wat Eskom binne die volgende 30 dae gaan doen(II) die ontwikkeling van medeopwekkingsgeleenthede deur die uitbreiding van bestaande kontrakte met die privaat sektor(III) versnelling van die program vir die vervanging van diesel met gas in dieselkragsentrales(IV) bekendstelling van ’n program vir privaat kragopwekkers, en(V) bestuur van vraag deur spesifieke ingrypings binne huishoudings, openbare en sakegeboue asook munisipaliteite, deur die installering van energiedoeltreffende energie.
tgt: The plan covers:the interventions that Eskom will undertake in the period over the next 30 daysharnessing the cogeneration opportunity through the extension of existing contracts with the private sectoraccelerating the programme for substitution of diesel with gas to fire up the diesel power plantslaunching a coal independent power producer programme andmanaging demand through specific interventions within residential dwellings, public and commercial buildings and municipalities through retrofitting energy efficient technologies.

src: Die Kabinet is bekommerd oor die prestasie van sommige staatsbeheerde maatskappye, veral die Suid-Afrikaanse Lugdiens, die Suid-Afrikaanse Poskantoor en Eskom.
tgt: Cabinet is concerned about the performance of some of the State-owned companies (SoCs), in particular the South African Airways (SAA), South African Post Office (SAPO) and Eskom.

src: Hierdie staatsbeheerde maatskappye speel ’n noodsaaklike rol in die ontwikkeling van die ekonomie.
tgt: These SOCs play a critical developmental role within the South African economy.

src: Die president het adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa benoem om toesig te hou oor die omkeer van drie staatsbeheerde maatskappye: die Suid-Afrikaanse Lugdiens, Eskom en die Suid-Afrikaanse Poskantoor.
tgt: The President has assigned Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa to oversee the turnaround of the SAA, SAPO and Eskom.

src: In oorleg met relevante ministerieë, gaan die SAL van die Departement van Openbare Werke na die Nasionale Tesourie oorgedra word.
tgt: Working with the relevant ministries, the SAA will be transferred from the Department of Public Enterprises to National Treasury.

src: Implementering van die belangrikste regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of key government programmes.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die positiewe uitkomste van die president se staatsbesoek aan die Volksrepubliek van China van 4 tot 5 Desember 2014.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the positive outcomes of the President’s State Visit to the People’s Republic of China from 4 to 5 December 2014, which is a true reflection of the deepening bilateral, trade and investment relations between South Africa and China.

src: Dit is ’n weerspieëling van diepgaande bilaterale, handels- en beleggingsbetrekkinge tussen Suid-Afrika en China.
tgt: South African businesses are urged to take advantage of the new economic opportunities that our relationship with China offers.

src: Suid-Afrikaanse sakeondernemings word aangemoedig om die nuwe ekonomiese geleenthede voortspruitend uit die verhouding met China te benut.
tgt: Last week’s adoption of the China-South Africa 5-10 Year Framework on Cooperation entrenches implementation of the agreements entered into since the conclusion of the Beijing Declaration in 2010 and expands on the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership.

src: Die aanvaarding van die Samewerkingsraamwerk tussen China en Suid-Afrika vir vyf tot 10 jaar verlede week is ’n versterking van die vennootskapsbande tussen die twee lande sedert die Beijing-Verklaring in 2010 tot ’n einde gekom het, en bou voort op die Omvattende Strategiese Vennootskap.
tgt: Cabinet lauds the Department of Basic Education, provincial education departments, principals, teachers and learners for their perseverance as we conclude another busy academic year.

src: Die Minister van Basiese Onderwys, Angie Motshekga, gaan op 5 Januarie 2015 die slaagsyfer van die 2014 Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat-eksamen aankondig en kandidate sal op 6 Januarie hul uitslae kry.
tgt: The Minister of Basic Education Angie Motshekga will announce the outcome of the 2014 National Senior Certificate (NSC) examinations on 5 January 2015 and the results will be released to candidates on 6 January 2015.Cabinet encourages learners who qualify for higher education studies to explore all available opportunities.

src: Die Kabinet moedig leerders aan wat vir verdere studie kwalifiseer om alle moontlike geleenthede te benut.
tgt: Those learners who have not yet been accepted at an institution of higher learning at the time of the release of the NSC results should make use of the Central Applications Clearing House (CACH) service in January and February 2015.The CACH service develops a register of potential candidates that meet institutions' minimum admission requirements to all Post-School Education and Training (PSET) institutions in South Africa.

src: Die diens bied ook loopbaanvoorligting en help voornemende aansoekers met moontlike alternatiewe.
tgt: The service also offers career advice and assists prospective applicants with possible alternatives.

src: Mese kan deur die inbelsentrum met die diens in verbinding tree by 0800 356 635 of deur ’n SMS met die naam en identiteitsnommer van die aansoeker aan 4920.0 te stuur.
tgt: The service can be accessed through the call centre on: 0800 356 635 or through an SMS with your name and identity number to Cabinet welcomes the release of the 2014 Annual National Assessments (ANA) last week which shows an upward trend in performance of all grades except Grade 9.The ANA remain a powerful tool to assess the health of our education system and where immediate interventions are required as identified for the Grade 9 learners in mathematics.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die vrystelling van die 2014 jaarlikse nasionale assessering verlede week, wat op ’n verbetering in prestasie dui, behalwe in graad 9.Die jaarlikse nasionale assessering bly ’n nuttige middel om die stand van die onderwysstelsel te bepaal en te sien waar ingrypings nodig is, soos wat nou vir graad 9-leerders in wiskunde gedoen is.
tgt: Cabinet thanks all South Africans, civil society and the media for their participation in this year’s 16 Days of Activism campaign under the theme: ‘Count me in: Together moving a non-violent South Africa forward’.The call to all South Africans to ‘Count me in’ seeks to ensure the longevity of established partnerships by translating our activism during this period into everyday actions throughout the year so that we can eliminate the scourge of violence against women and children.

src: Die Kabinet bedank alle Suid-Afrikaners, die burgerlike samelewing en die media vir hul deelname aan vanjaar se 16 dae van aktivisme onder die tema: Tel my in: Saam beweeg ons 'n nie-gewelddadige Suid-Afrika vorentoe.
tgt: South Africa will mark National Reconciliation Day on 16 December 2014 under the theme: ‘Social Cohesion, Reconciliation and National Unity in the 20 Years of Democracy’ at the Ncome Museum in the uMzinyathi District Municipality, KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Die oproep aan alle Suid-Afrikaners om deel te wees, is ’n poging om die duur van gevestigde vennootskappe te bepaal deur aktivisme heeljaar op praktiese maniere te toon, sodat ons die verskrikking van geweld teen vroue en kinders kan oorkom.
tgt: Cabinet conveys its gratitude to all South Africans and the international community that commemorated the anniversary of the passing of the country’s first democratically elected President Nelson Mandela on 5 December 2014.We must stay true to Madiba’s legacy by continuing his unwavering dedication to democracy, selflessness, reconciliation, service to humanity and striving for a better life for all.

src: Van 2005/06 tot 2012/13 het maatskappye sowat R44,1 miljard aan navorsing en ontwikkeling bestee.
tgt: 2013/14 saw 44.2% small and medium enterprises (SMEs) with an annual turnover of less than R40 million participating in the R&D tax incentive.

src: Die Nasionale Tesourie beraam dat net meer as R3,2 miljard in belastingaftrekkings vir navorsing en ontwikkeling geëis is.
tgt: Cabinet was updated on progress made with the MeerKAT project, the collateral benefits that have accrued to the local communities and South Africa, and the international negotiations underway relating to the hosting of the Square Kilometre Array (SKA) project.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die vordering van die MerKAT-projek, die voordele wat dit vir die plaaslike gemeenskap en Suid-Afrika inhou, en die internasionale onderhandelinge met betrekking tot die aanbieding van die SKA-projek.
tgt: The construction of the MeerKAT telescope – the pathfinder to the eventual SKA – is progressing well, with significant opportunities for the local South African industry.

src: Bouwerk aan die MerKAT-teleskoop – ’n baanbreker vir die uiteindelike SKA – vorder goed, en het reeds beduidende geleenthede vir die plaaslike Suid-Afrikaanse bedryf meegebring.
tgt: South Africa is driving a number of cutting-edge technology developments, especially in the area of high performance computing.

src: ’n Aantal voorpunt-tegnologie-ontwikkelings word deur Suid-Afrika aangevoer, veral op die gebied van hoëprestasierekenaarwese.
tgt: Local communities in the Northern Cape have also benefitted through the many social investment partnerships.

src: Op internasionale front word die gasheerooreenkoms, befondsingsmodel vir die SKA en die verkrygingsbeleid tans bespreek en gefinaliseer.
