src: Implementering van die belangrikste Regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of Key Government Programmes.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom president Jacob Zuma se staatsrede waarin Suid-Afrikaners die geleentheid gegun word om na die Regering se program van aksie te luister.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes President Jacob Zuma’s State of the Nation Address, which afforded South Africans an opportunity to hear government Programme of Action.

src: Die Regering doen 'n beroep op alle belanghebbendes oor die hele land om saam te werk aan die nege-puntplan om groei en werk te skep.
tgt: Government calls on all stakeholders across the country to Work Together on the nine-point plan in order to ignite growth and create jobs.

src: Om te verseker dat Suid-Afrikaners die regering se program van aksie beter verstaan, is kommunikasie-inisiatiewe ná afloop van die staatsrede in die lewe geroep om besonderhede oor die aankondiging deur die president uiteen te sit.
tgt: To ensure that South Africans better understand government’s Programme of Action, post-State of Nation Address communication initiatives have been put in place to provide details on the announcements made by the President.

src: Dit sluit in die inligtingsessies oor ministeriële groeperings wat van 15 tot 24 Februarie 2015 gehou is.
tgt: These include the Ministerial Cluster Media briefings held from 15 to 24 February WEBTOKEN addition, the 2015/16 Budget Speech scheduled for the 25 February 2015 will highlight the allocation of resources to the various government programmes as emphasised by the President.

src: Daarbenewens sal die 2015/16-begrotingsrede op 25 Februarie 2015 die toekenning van hulpbronne aan verskillende Regeringsprogramme uitlig soos deur die president aangekondig.
tgt: Cabinet condemns the unruly and un-parliamentary conduct of some Members of Parliament during the opening of WEBTOKEN is disappointing that these elected public representatives chose to dishonor the sacrifices and struggle made to realise our hard-earned democracy.2 Cabinet was briefed on the progress made with the oceans economy Operation Phakisa.

src: Die beplanningsfase het in Durban in Julie en Augustus 2014 plaasgevind en het tot die totstandkoming van duidelik uiteengesette drieledige planne gelei om die oseane-ekonomie te laat groei.
tgt: The ‘Lab’ or planning phase took place in Durban during July and August 2014 and resulted in the production of detailed ‘three feet plans’ to grow the ocean economy.

src: Die operasie het nou 'n implementeringsfase bereik, wat die monitering en projekbestuur van die projek behels.
tgt: The Operation has now entered an implementation phase, which involves the monitoring and project managing the implementation.

src: Leweringseenhede is in die lewe geroep, en moniterings- en eskalasiemeganismes is in plek gestel.’n Inligtingsessie is ook oor 'n tweede Operasie Phakisa gehou.
tgt: Delivery units have been established and monitoring and escalation mechanisms and processes are in place.

src: Dit word gelei deur die Departement van Gesondheid en is gerig op die oprigting en instandhouding van ideale klinieke.
tgt: Briefing was also provided on a second Operation Phakisa led by the Department of Health, focusing on Ideal Clinic Realisation and Maintenance which is underway and was launched by the President on 18 November 20.3 Cabinet approved the National Adolescent Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights Framework Strategy.

src: Dit is op 18 November 2014 deur die president aangekondig.3 Die Kabinet keur die Nasionale Raamwerkstrategie oor Adolessente- en Reproduktiewe Gesondheid en Regte goed.
tgt: The Strategy focuses on the advancement and promotion of health outcomes of which the sexual and reproductive health of young people is central.

src: Die strategie fokus op die bevordering van gesondheidsuitkomste waarvan seksuele en reproduktiewe gesondheid van jongmense sentraal staan.
tgt: The strategy will further ensure an improved coordination, synergy and alignment with the programme of government, civil society and development partners that already work in the area of adolescent sexual and reproductive health.

src: Die strategie sal verder beter koördinering, sinergie en belyning met die program van die Regering, die burgerlike samelewing en ontwikkelingsvennote, wat reeds met die seksuele en reproduktiewe gesondheid van tieners werk, verseker.
tgt: The Inter-Ministerial committee for the Population Policy will oversee the implementation, monitoring and evaluation of this Strategy.4 Cabinet approved the publication of the draft Early Childhood Development Policy in the Government Gazette.

src: Die interministeriële komitee oor bevolkingsbeleid sal toesig hou oor die implementering, monitering en evaluering van hierdie strategie.4 Die Kabinet keur die publikasie van die konsepbeleid oor vroeë kinderontwikkeling in die Staatskoerant goed.
tgt: This forms part of the South African Integrated Programme of Action for Early Childhood Development – Moving ahead 2013-2016, approved by Cabinet on 18 September 2013.

src: Dit maak deel uit van die Suid-Afrikaanse Geïntegreerde Program van Aksie vir Vroeë Kinderontwikkeling vir 2013 tot 2016, wat die Kabinet op 18 September 2013 goedgekeur het.
tgt: The Policy provides a framework for government’s accountability to provide a comprehensive package of quality Early Childhood Development services that would be universally available in sufficient quantities and proximity so that all children enjoy an equal opportunity to access them.

src: Die beleid bied 'n raamwerk vir die Regering se aanspreeklikheid om 'n omvattende pakket van gehaltedienste van vroeë kinderontwikkeling te bied, wat oral beskikbaar sal wees in genoegsame hoeveelhede en naby genoeg sal wees sodat alle kinders gelyke geleenthede kan kry om van die dienste gebruik te maak.
tgt: The policy also introduces a number of new services to fill gaps identified in the range of services currently available especially within the first 1 000 days of a child’s life.

src: Die Kabinet het ook die vestiging van 'n interministeriële komitee (IMC) aangekondig wat 'n samehangende en gekoördineerde benadering sal verseker.
tgt: Cabinet also approved the establishment of an Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC), which will ensure a coherent and coordinated approach.

src: Dit sal onder voorsitterskap van die minister van maatskaplike ontwikkeling geskied.5 Die Kabinet keur die vrystelling van die konsepverslag goed oor die Verenigde Nasies se eerste periodieke verslag van die land oor die Regte van Persone met Gestremdhede, vir openbare kommentaar vir 'n tydperk van 20 dae.
tgt: It will be chaired by the Minister of Social Development.5 Cabinet approved the release of the Draft First Periodic Country report on the United Nations (UN) Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities, for public comment for a period of 20 days.

src: Die verslag dek die tydperk April 2012 tot Maart 20.6 Die Kabinet keur dit goed dat Suid-Afrika deelneem aan die Internasionale Kaartjaar in 2015 en 2016 deur geleenthede op nasionale vlak te reël om kaartbewustheid en -geletterdheid in Suid-Afrika te verhoog.
tgt: The report covers the period April 2012- March 20.6 Cabinet approved that South Africa participates in the International Map Year in 2015 and 2016 by organising events at a national level with a view to increase the level of map awareness and literacy in South Africa.

src: Kaarte help om probleme en moontlikhede te verstaan, soos die voorsiening van behuising, die bewaring van natuurlike hulpbronne, risikobestuur en die fasilitering van tydige en omvattende vervoerinfrastruktuur.
tgt: Maps help to understand problems and possibilities, such as the provision of housing, sustaining natural resources, managing risk and facilitating timely and comprehensive transportation infrastructure.

src: Begrip van geo-ruimtelike inligting help met die beplanning en besluitneming van ontwikkeling in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Understanding geospatial information informs planning and decision making for the development of South Africa.

src: Sleutelkabinetsbesluite.1 Die Kabinet keur die Voorskrif oor die implementering van bevoegdheidsassesserings vir lede van die Senior Bestuursdiens (SBD), uitgereik ingevolge Hoofstuk 4, deel II
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.1 Cabinet approved the Directive on the implementation of competency based assessments for member of the Senior Management (SMS), issued in terms of Chapter 4 part II

src: en Hoofstuk 4, deel VI van die Staatsdiensregulasies, 2001, goed.
tgt: and Chapter 4, part VI of the Public Service Regulations, 2001.The amended Directive promotes the independent identification of SMS Member’s developmental gaps, introduces the use of technical exercises and provides guidance on how departments can utilize the competency assessment results in conjunction with all other processes of recruitment and selection.2 Cabinet approved the hosting of the National Imbizo Focus Week from 7 to 12 April 2015 under the theme “Together we move South Africa forward”.The Week will be characterized by door-to-door household profiling walkabout or project visits stakeholder dialogues community engagements as well as commercial and community media engagements.

src: Die gewysigde voorskrif bevorder die onafhanklike identifisering van SBD-lede se ontwikkelingsgapings, voer die gebruik van tegniese oefeninge in en gee leiding oor hoe departemente die bevoegdheidsassesseringresultate kan gebruik in oorleg met alle ander prosesse van werwing en keuring.2 Die Kabinet keur die aanbieding van die Nasionale Imbizo-Fokusweek vanaf 7 tot 12 April 2015 goed onder die tema "Saam beweeg ons Suid-Afrika vorentoe".Tydens die week sal profiele van huishoudings opgestel word deur deur-tot-deur-besoeke.
tgt: These provide principals with a platform to interact directly with South Africans, hear community issues first-hand and monitor progress of government programmes.

src: Daar sal ook rondleidings of projekbesoeke wees asook gesprekke met belanghebbers en die gemeenskap, asook samewerking met die sakesektor en gemeenskapsmedia.
tgt: Bills.1 Cabinet approved the publication of the draft Protection, Promotion, Development and Management of Indigenous Knowledge Systems Bill in the Government Gazette as well as a public consultation process.

src: Die week bied skoolhoofde ’n kans om direk met Suid-Afrikaners kontak te maak, na die kwessies van gemeenskappe te luister en prakties die vordering van regeringsprogramme te monitor.3 Wetsontwerpe.1 Die Kabinet keur die publikasie van die Konsepwet op die Beskerming, Bevordering, Ontwikkeling en Bestuur van Inheemse Kennisstelsels in die Staatskoerant asook 'n openbare konsultasieproses goed.
tgt: The primary objective of this Bill is to facilitate the protection of Indigenous Knowledge and the restoration and recognition of Indigenous knowledge relating to and owned by indigenous and local communities in South Africa.

src: Dit fasiliteer die regstelling van regte en voordele waarvan inheemse en plaaslike gemeenskappe ontneem is.2 Die Kabinet keur die Wysigingswetsontwerp op die Beheer van Vuurwapens, 2015 vir publikasie in die Staatskoerant vir openbare kommentaar goed.
tgt: It facilitates redress of rights and benefits that indigenous and local communities were deprived off.2 Cabinet approved the publication of the Firearm Control Amendment Bill, 2015 in the Government Gazette for public comments.

src: Die wetsontwerp wysig die Wet op die Beheer van Vuurwapens, 2000, en kom in reaksie op die visie van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan om die statutêre en regulatoriese raamwerk wat vuurwapens beheer, te verbeter.
tgt: The Bill amends the Firearm Control Act, 2000 and responds to the Vision of the National Development Plan by seeking to improve the statutory and regulatory framework that will govern firearms.

src: Beheer van vuurwapens is 'n belangrike aspek van die Regering se benadering tot die bekamping van misdaad.4 Kabinet se standpunt oor aktuele kwessies.1 Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op gemeenskappe en georganiseerde strukture om met die Regering saam te werk, onder die leierskap van die Ministerie van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake, om die uitdagings rakende Malamulele in Limpopo die hoof te bied.
tgt: Control of firearms is an important aspect of government’s approach to fighting crime.

src: Kabinet veroordeel die ontwrigting van onderrig deur sommige groepe as 'n manier om hul griewe te opper.
tgt: Cabinet’s Position on Current Issues.1 Cabinet urges communities and organized structures to work with government, under the leadership of the Ministry of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, to ensure the challenges around Malamulele in Limpopo are resolved.

src: Dit beroof kinders van hul reg op onderwys en die reg om vir hul graad 12 aanvullende eksamen te registreer.
tgt: Cabinet condemns the disruption of schooling by some groups as a way of raising grievances.

src: Die vestiging van 'n munisipaliteit in Malamulele moet ingevolge die wet geskied soos deur die Afbakeningsraad bepaal.2 Die Kabinet veroordeel die aanvalle op buitelandse burgers as ’n misdaad en benadruk dat wetstoepassingsagentskappe nie sal huiwer om op te tree teen diegene wat sodanige geweld aanblaas nie.
tgt: The establishment of a municipality in Malamulele should be within the confines of the law as prescribe by the Demarcation Board.2 Cabinet condemns attacks on foreign nationals as criminal activity and reiterates that law enforcement agencies will not hesitate to act decisively against anyone found to incite such violence.

src: Geen mate van ekonomiese swaarkry en ontevredenheid kan sodanige misdadige gedrag regverdig nie.
tgt: No amount of economic hardship and discontent can justify criminal activity associated with these attacks.

src: Suid-Afrika is 'n ondertekenaar van die Genève-potokol op vlugtelinge en is daartoe verbind om alle vreemdelinge in die land te beskerm.
tgt: South Africa is a signatory to the Geneva Protocol on Refugees and is committed to protect all foreign nationals in the country.

src: As ondertekenaar van die protokol, en as 'n land wat menseregte koester, sal ons die basiese regte van elke mens binne ons grense beskerm, insluitend buitelandse burgers.3 Die Kabinet keur die tertafellegging goed van die verdrag oor die BRICS-kontingent-reserwereëling en ooreenkoms oor die nuwe ontwikkelingsbank.
tgt: As a signatory to this Protocol, and as a country that cherishes human rights, we will protect the basic rights of every human being within our borders, including foreign nationals.3 Cabinet approved the tabling in Parliament for ratification, the Treaty Establishing the BRICS Contingent Reserve Arrangement and Agreement on the New Development Bank.

src: Die Kontingentreserwe-reëling kom in reaksie op korttermyndruk op die betalingsbalans.
tgt: The Contingent Reserve Arrangement is being established to respond to short-term balance of payment pressures.

src: Dit sal ook as voorsorgmaatreël dien om te help om BRICS-lande te help om probleme met likiditeit op kort termyn die hoof te bied, onderlinge ondersteuning te bied en die internasionale finansiële veiligheidsnet te verbeter.4 Die Kabinet neem kennis van die oordraging van die voorsitterskap van die Suid-Afrikaanse komponent van die BRICS-sakeraad van mnrPatrice Motsepe na mnr Brian Molefe.
tgt: Further, it will serve as a precautionary measure to help the BRICS countries forestall short-term liquidity pressures, provide mutual support and further strengthen the global financial safety net.4 Cabinet notes the handover of the Chairperson of the South African component of the BRICS Business Council from Mr Patrice Motsepe to Mr. Brian Molefe.

src: MnrMostepe was die eerste voorsitter van die Suid-Afrikaanse komponent en die BRICS-sakeraad.
tgt: Mr. Mostepe was the inaugural chair of both the South African component and the BRICS Business Council as a whole.

src: Tydens sy ampstermyn het mnrMotsepe daarin geslaag om hierdie belangrike liggaam as 'n integrale deel van die BRICS-samestelling te vestig en het met onderskeiding as voorsitter gedien.
tgt: During his tenure, Mr. Motsepe succeeded in establishing this important body as an integral component of the BRICS architecture and served as chair with distinction.

src: Die Kabinet bedank mnr Motsepe vir sy diens en wens mnr Molefe alle sterkte terwyl hy hierdie belangrike taak oorneem.5 Die Kabinet loof die Nasionale Krieketspan vir hul prestasie tydens die Krieketwêreldbeker en wens hulle sterkte toe met hulle toernooi in Australië en Nieu-Seeland.6 Die Kabinet wens die fluitspeler Wouter Kellerman geluk met die Grammy-toekenning vir die beste New Age-album wat hy onlangs ontvang het.
tgt: Cabinet thanks Mr. Motsepe for his service and wishes Mr. Molefe well as he takes over this important task.5 Cabinet commends the National Cricket team for their performance at the Cricket World Cup and wishes them well as the entire country rallies behind them for the tournament underway in Australia and New Zealand.6 Cabinet congratulates the flute player Wouter Kellerman who won the Grammy Award for best new age album.

src: Vir sy album Winds of Samsara het mnrKellerman met die Indiese komponis Ricky Kej saamgewerk, wat vir hulle die Grammy besorg het.7 Die Kabinet spreek sy dank uit aan alle kragverbruikers dat hulle gereageer het op die beroep om minder krag te gebruik.
tgt: Mr Kellerman recorded Winds of Samsara with Indian composer Ricky Kej, which earned them the award for their collaboration.7 Cabinet expresses its gratitude to all energy consumers for responding to the call to decrease the usage of electricity.

src: Die proses om die uitdagings van kragvoorsiening die hoof te bied, geniet tans die hoogste prioriteit.
tgt: The process to address the energy challenges is receiving the highest priority attention.

src: Die strategiekomitee, oftewel war room, wat adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa in Desember 2014 gestig het, gaan die implementering van die vyfpuntplan versnel om die kragvoorsieningsituasie om te keer.8 Die Kabinet sluit hom by president Zuma aan en spreek sy meegevoel uit aan die familie en vriende van die Afrikaanse literêre reus professor André P Brink.
tgt: The War Room established by Cabinet in December 2014 led by the Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa is moving to fast-track the implementation of a five-point plan to turn the current situation around.8 Cabinet joins the President Zuma in conveying its condolences to the family and friends of the Afrikaans literary giant Profssor André Brink.

src: Hy sal onthou word as een van die belangrikste Afrikaanse skrywers wat sy literêre talent gebruik het om hom teen apartheid uit te spreek.5 Komende gebeure.1 Die Kabinet benadruk die beroep deur president Jacob Zuma op alle partye in Lesotho om só op te tree dat hulle 'n klimaat skep wat bevorderlik vir verkiesings wat vreedsaam, deursigtig, geloofwaardig, vry en regverdig is, en die wil van die mense weerspieël.
tgt: He will be remembered as one of the key Afrikaans authors who used his literary talent to speak out against the apartheid regime.

src: Die Kabinet spreek ook sy vertroue uit in die voortgesette fasilitering van die SAOG-waarnemingsending na Lesotho onder leiding van adjunkpresident Ramaphosa.
tgt: Upcoming events.1 Cabinet reiterates the call by President Jacob Zuma for all parties in Lesotho to act in a manner that creates a climate conducive for the holding of elections that are peaceful, transparent, credible, and free and fair, thus reflecting the will of the people.

src: As deel van die SAOG-troika-staatshoofde gaan Suid-Afrika die leiding neem en deel wees van die SAOG-verkiesingswaarnemingsending na die Koninkryk van Lesotho vir die verkiesing op 28 Februarie 20.2 Die opperbevelvoerder van die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Weermag, President Jacob Zuma, sal op 21 Februarie 2015, in Potchefstroom, Noordwes, die belangrikste diensdoende beampte by die gewapendemagtedag-vieringe wees met die tema: "'n Profssionele en Bekwame Weermag vir die Mese van Suid-Afrika".
tgt: Cabinet also expresses its confidence in the ongoing facilitation work of the SADC Observer Mission to Lesotho under the leadership of Deputy President Ramaphosa.

src: Gewapendemagtedag word jaarliks gevier ter ere van die manne en vroue in uniform wat die nasie hier en in die buiteland onbaatsugtig dien.3 Die Kabinet moedig alle werkgewers aan wat voldoen aan die Wet op Diensbillikheid om in te skryf vir die Diensbillikheidstoekennings 2015 voor die sluitingsdatum van 13 Maart 2015.
tgt: As part of the decisions of the SADC Troika Heads of State and Government, South Africa will play its part by leading and forming part of the SADC Election Observer Mission to the Kingdom of Lesotho, for the scheduled election on 28 February 20.2 The Commander in Chief of the South African National Defence Force, President Jacob Zuma will be the main officiating functionary at the Armed Forces Day Celebration under the theme “A professional and capable defence force for the people of South Africa” on 21 February 2015, in Potchefstroom, North West.

src: Die geleentheid word aangebied deur die Kommissie vir Gelyke Indiensneming en verleen erkenning aan werkgewers wat strategieë in werking gestel het wat billike indiensneming en diversiteit verseker en alle onbillike, diskriminerende praktyke uitroei.4 Die minister van toerisme, Derek Hanekom, sal die openingsrede by Metings Africa lewer, wat by Sandton Konferensiesentrum vanaf 23 tot 25 Februarie 2015 sal plaasvind met die tema: "Saam bevorder ons Afrika".
tgt: Armed Forces Day is celebrated annually in honour of the men and women in uniform who selflessly serve the nation at home and abroad.3 Cabinet encourages all employers who have complied with the Employment Equity (EE) Act to enter the Employment Equity Awards 2015 before the closing date of 13 March 2015.This event hosted by the Commission for Employment Equity, recognises employers who have implemented strategies that ensure employment equity and diversity, while eliminating all unfair discriminatory practices.4 Tourism Minister Derek Hanekom will deliver the opening address at Meetings Africa taking place at Sandton Convention Centre from 23 to 25 February 2015 under the theme: “Advancing Africa Together”.

src: Dit is die hoofhandelskou van die Suid-Afrika se Nasionale Konferensieburo en bring uitstallers en voornemende internasionale kliënte bymekaar.5 Die Kabinet keur Suid-Afrika se aanbieding van die Wêreld Ekonomiese Forum (WEF) goed.
tgt: This is the South Africa National Convention Bureau’s premier business trade show, which brings together African exhibitors and prospective international clients.5 Cabinet approved the hosting by South Africa of the World Economic Forum (WEF) - Africa, at the Cape Town International Convention Centre (CTCC) from 3 to 5 June 2015.

src: Implementering van die belangrikste regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of key government programmes.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die 2015 Nasionale Begroting wat die implementering van die nege-puntplan wat deur die President in sy staatsrede bekendgemaak is, sal dryf.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the 2015 National Budget that will drive the implementation of the nine-point plan presented by the President during his State of the Nation Address.

src: Hierdie begroting voorsien sekerheid, stabiliteit en omsigtige fiskale bestuur, wat nodig is om die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie deur hierdie moeilike ekonomiese omstandighede te lei.
tgt: This budget provides certainty, stability and prudent fiscal management necessary to take the South African economy through these tough economic conditions.

src: Die Kabinet benadruk dat die belastingmaatreëls wat in die 2015 Nasionale Begroting bekendgestel is, nodig is om die fiskus in die jaar wat voorlê te ondersteun.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates that the tax measures introduced in the 2015 National Budget are necessary to support the fiscus in the year ahead.

src: Suid-Afrikaners word aangemoedig om met die Regering saam te werk om die huidige ekonomiese toestande teë te werk om verdere ekonomiese groei te stimuleer.2 Die Kabinet loof die uitstekende werk deur Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa met die fasilitering van die vrye en regverdige verkiesing in Lesotho in sy rol as fasiliteerder vir die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap (SAOG).
tgt: Cabinet commends the sterling work done by the Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa in facilitating the free and fair elections in Lesotho in his role as the Southern African Development Community (SADC) Facilitator.

src: Die Kabinet prys ook die SAOG se Verkiesingsadviesraad, Lesotho se Verkiesingskommissie, die veiligheidsmagte en die mense van Lesotho vir die hou van 'n vreedsame, vrye en regverdige verkiesing.
tgt: Cabinet also commends the SADC Electoral Advisory Council (EAC), the Lesotho Electoral Commission (LEC), the security forces and the people of Lesotho for holding a peaceful, free and fair election.

src: Suid-Afrika sal met Lesotho se nuutverkose regering saamwerk om die ekonomieë van die twee lande, die Suider-Afrikaanse streek en die vasteland as 'n geheel te ontwikkel.3 Die Kabinet erken en verwelkom Suid-Afrika se deelname aan Wêreld Wildlewedag op 3 Maart 2015.
tgt: South Africa will work with the newly elected government of Lesotho to develop the economy of the two countries, the southern African region and the continent as a whole.

src: Onder die rentmeesterskap van Minister Molewa, vestig Suid-Afrika steeds programme wat die land se omgewing beskerm en die stryd teen stropery voortsit.
tgt: Cabinet acknowledged and welcomed the participation of South Africa in marking the World Wildlife Day on 3 March 2015.

src: Die belangrikste hiervan is die plasing van die Groen Skerpioene by die OR Tambo Internasionale Lughawe.
tgt: Under the stewardship of Minister Molewa South Africa continues to put in place programmes that protect the country’s environment and war against poaching.

src: Dit is om te verseker dat die bedreigde of beskermde spesie-regulasies nagekom word, asook die CITES-regulasies, bio-prospekteringregulasies, regulasies oor toegang tot en deel van voordele, en die uitheemse en indringerspesie-regulasies.
tgt: This is to ensure compliance with the Threatened or Protected Species Regulations, CITES Regulations, Bio-prospecting, Access and Benefit-Sharing Regulations and the Alien and Invasive Species Regulations.

src: Suid-Afrika het ook 'n belangrike rol gespeel in die onderhandelinge met Interpol, veral op die Advesraad van die Omgewingsnakoming- en toepassingskomitee, en in die drie Interpol-misdaadwerkgroepe, naamlik die Wildlewe-misdaadwerkgroep, Visserye-misdaadwerkgroep en die Besoedeling-misdaadwerkgroep.
tgt: South Africa has also played a key role in engaging with Interpol, particularly on the Advisory Board of the Environmental Compliance and Enforcement Committee, and in the three Interpol crime-working groups namely Wildlife Crime Working Group, Fisheries Crime Working Group and the Pollution Crime Working Group.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis dat Durban op 2 Maart 2015 ‘n bod in Londen ingedien het om gasheer vir die 2022 Statebondspele te wees.
tgt: Cabinet noted that Durban has bid to host the 2022 Commonwealth Games, which was formally lodged in London on 2 March 2015.

src: Om gasheer vir dié spele te wees kan potensieel ongeveer 11 650 werkgeleenthede skep en die land se ekonomie ‘n hupstoot van 'n geraamde R20 miljard gee.
tgt: Hosting of these games can potentially create approximately 11 650 jobs and boost the country’s economy by an estimated R20 billion.

src: Nog ’n nalatenskap van die spele sal 'n geïntegreerde openbare vervoerstelsel vir Durban wees, waarvan die planne reeds goedgekeur is.
tgt: Another legacy of the Games will be an integrated public transport system for Durban for which the plans have already been approved.

src: Belangrike Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet het die Digitale Uitsaai-migrasie Wysigingsbeleid goedgekeur, insluitend die beheerstelsel in die dekodeerder wat duidelik gedefinieer sal word wanneer die beleid gepubliseer word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Broadcasting Digital Migration Amendment Policy with the inclusion of the control system in the Set Top Box (STB), which will be clearly defined when the policy is published.

src: Die Regering sal gratis dekodeerders voorsien aan meer as 5 miljoen arm mense wat huishoudelike televisiestelle het.
tgt: Government will provide free STBs to more than 5 million poor television household owners.

src: Huishoudings in die grensgebiede van die land sal voorkeur geniet.
tgt: The priority will be given to those households in the border region areas of the country.

src: Die Minister van Kommunikasie sal binnekort die datums vir die aanskakeling van die digitale sein en die afskakeling van die analoogsein aankondig.2 Die Kabinet keur die vyf-jaar Strategiese Raamwerk vir Landbou, Bosbou en Visserye en die Landboubeleid-aksieplan goed.
tgt: The Minister of Communications will announce the digital signal switch on and analogue signal switch off date shortly.2 Cabinet approved the five year Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries Strategic Framework and Agricultural Policy Action Plan.

src: Die raamwerk sit die belangrikste uitdagings wat die drie sektore in die gesig staar uiteen, en stel tussenkomste in die vier areas voor, naamlik gelykheid en transformasie billike groei en mededingendheid omgewingsvolhoubaarheid en bestuur.
tgt: The Framework sets out the key challenges faced by the three sectors and propose interventions in the four areas namely equity and transformation equitable growth and competitiveness, environmental sustainability and governance.

src: Die strategie en die aksieplan sal op 'n jaarlikse basis bygewerk word.
tgt: The strategy and the action plan will be updated on an annual basis.

src: Grondherverdeling is een van die Regering se programme wat gelykheid bevorder het, maar wat tot dusver nie veel bereik het ten opsigte van transformasie nie.
tgt: Land distribution is one of government programmes that has promoted equity, but so far without accomplishing a great deal by way of transformation.

src: Terwyl die Heropbou en Ontwikkelingsprogram verklaar het dat grondherverdeling hoofsaaklik daarop gemik was om die struktuur van die Suid-Afrikaanse landbou te verander, is dit ook daarop gemik om die sektore te ondersteun om die ekonomie te laat groei en werk te skep.
tgt: Whereas the reconstruction and development programme declared that the main purpose of land distribution was to alter the structure of South African agriculture, it also seeks to support the sectors so as to grow the economy and create jobs.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Internasionale Hospitaalfederasie se 40ste Wêreld Hospitaalkongres teen die einde van 2016 in Durban gehou word.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the International Hospital Federation 40th World Hospital Congress to be held in Durban towards the end of 2016.

src: Die Internasionale Hospitaalfederasie is 'n wêreldwye onafhanklike, nie-winsgewende, nie-regeringsorganisasie vir hospitale en gesondheidsorgorganisasies.
tgt: The International Hospital Federation is a global independent, non-profit, non-governmental organisation for hospitals and healthcare organisations.

src: Die jaarlikse kongres bied 'n geleentheid vir gesondheidspraktisyns om beste-praktykmetodes/-benaderings vir die verbetering van gesondheidsorguitkomste te deel.
tgt: The annual congress affords the health practitioners an opportunity to, share best practice methodologies / approaches to improve healthcare outcomes.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op ouers om aktief betrokke te raak by die 2015 verkiesings van skoolbeheerliggame wat van 6 tot 28 Maart 2015 in alle openbare skole sal plaasvind.
tgt: Cabinet calls on parents to actively get involved in the 2015 School Governing Body (SGB) elections that will take place in all public schools from 6 to 28 March 2015.

src: Skoolbeheerliggame dra by tot die ontwikkeling van 'n sterk gevoel van gemeenskapseienaarskap van ons skole.
tgt: The SGBs contribute in the development of a strong sense of community ownership to our schools.

src: Die algemene prestasie van skole, insluitend akademiese prestasie, is geneig om te verbeter wanneer ouers aktief betrokke is en belangstelling toon in die sake van die skool.
tgt: The general performance of schools, including academic achievement, tends to improve when parents are actively involved and take an interest in the affairs of the school.

src: Mer as 250 000 lede word elke drie jaar verkies om in ons openbare skole te dien en word verenig deur 'n gemeenskaplike doel, naamlik om onderwys 'n ware maatskaplike kwessie te maak.
tgt: Over 250 000 governors are elected every three years to serve in our public schools united by a common purpose, to make education a real societal issue.

src: Wetsontwerpe.
tgt: Bills.

src: Die Kabinet keur die indiening van twee wetsontwerpe by die Parlement goed albei wysig die Kinderwet, 2005 (Wet 38 van 2005), soos gewysig deur Wet 41 van 2007.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of two Bills, both amending the Children’s Act, 2005 (Act No.

src: Die wysigings is ‘n reaksie op die hofuitsprake wat sekere dele van die Wet as ongrondwetlik verklaar het.
tgt: The amendments respond to court judgments, which declared certain sections of the Act unconstitutional.

src: Die Wysigingswetsontwerp op die Kinderwet, 2015 (artikel 75 Wetsontwerp) – Die wysigings het betrekking op die definisie van "seksuele misdryf" en bring dit in lyn met die Wysigingswet op Strafreg- (seksuele misdrywe en verwante aangeleenthede), Wet 32 van 2007.
tgt: Children’s Amendment Bill, 2015 (section 75 Bill) – The amendments addresses the definition of “sexual offence” and aligns it to the Criminal Law (sexual offences and related matters) Amendment Act No 32 of 2007.

src: Die wysigings hou ook daarmee verband dat kinderoortreders toegelaat moet word om vertoë te rig voordat hul name in die Nasionale Beskermingsregister aangeteken word.
tgt: The amendments also deal with allowing the child offenders to make representations before their names are included in the National Protection Register.

src: Die voorgestelde wysigings verduidelik ook die voorwaardes vir die plasing van 'n kind in pleegsorg en maak voorsiening vir bykomende kategorieë van kinders wat aangeneem kan word.
tgt: The proposed amendments also clarify the requirement for placing a child in foster care and provides for additional categories of children who may be adopted.

src: Die Tweede Wysingswetsontwerp op die Kinderwet, 2015 (artikel 76 Wetsontwerp) - het ten doel om te verseker dat alle kinders dienste en voordele geniet wat gemik is op die fasilitering van toegang tot maatskaplike sorg en veiligheid en die skep van 'n doeltreffende stelsel van sosiale sekerheid.
tgt: Children’s Second Amendment Bill, 2015 (section 76 Bill) - aims to ensure that all children enjoy services and benefits aimed at facilitating access to social care and safety and to create an effective social welfare system.

src: Dit het ook ten doel om 'n veilige en beskermende omgewing te bied vir die plasing van kinders waar vasgestel is dat hulle ’n behoefte aan sorg en beskerming het.
tgt: It also seeks to provide a safe and protective environment for the placement of children who are found to be in need of care and protection.

src: Die Kabinet se standpunt oor huidige kwessies.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on current issues.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel ten sterkste die uitlek van dokumente wat die veiligheid van die land in die gedrang kan bring.
tgt: Cabinet condemns in strongest terms the leaking of documents that may put the security of the country in jeopardy.

src: Terwyl dit internasionale praktyk vir lande is om inligting te deel oor, onder meer, algemene kwessies met betrekking tot ekonomiese geleenthede en veiligheid, is die beweerde lekkasie van dokumente wat besonderhede oor bedrywighede van die Staatsveiligheidsagentskap bevat, onwettig.
tgt: While it is an international practice for countries to share intelligence on, among others, cross-cutting issues pertaining to economic opportunities and security matters, the purported leak of documents detailing operations of the State Security Agency is illegal.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die Staatsveiligheidsagentskap se volledige ondersoek na die saak en stel Suid-Afrikaners gerus dat die Staatsveiligheidsagentskap sal voortgaan om te fokus op sy mandaat om die integriteit van die land, sy burgers en infrastruktuur te beskerm.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the State Security Agency’s full investigation into the matter and reassures South Africans that the State Security Agency will continue to focus on its mandate to protect and secure the integrity of the country, its citizens and infrastructure.

src: Die Kabinet bevestig die boodskap deur die Minister van Staatsveiligheid, Minister David Mahlobo, dat sodanige optrede die operasionele doeltreffendheid van die werk om die land en sy grense te beveilig, ondermyn.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates the message by the Minister of State Security, Minister David Mahlobo, that such conduct undermines operational effectiveness of the work to secure the country and its borders.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die aankondiging deur Eskom dat Eenheid 6 van die Meupi-kragstasie hierdie week sy eerste krag opgewek het, wat dit die eerste van sy ses eenhede maak wat gesinchroniseer is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the announcement by Eskom that Unit 6 of Medupi Power Station produced its first power this week, making it the first of its six units to be synchronised.

src: Sinchronisasie is die proses waardeur die kragopwekker elektries aan die nasionale kragnetwerk gekoppel word.
tgt: Synchronisation is the process whereby the generator is electrically connected to the national power grid.

src: Terwyl ons voortgaan met werk om die kragtoevoer in die nasionale netwerk te verhoog, doen die Kabinet 'n beroep op die publiek om steeds energiebesparingsmaatreëls toe te pas.
tgt: Whilst we continue to work towards increasing the power supply in the national grid, Cabinet calls on the public to continue adhering to the energy saving measures.

src: Gemeenskappe word aangemoedig om elektrisiteit spaarsamig te gebruik, terwyl ons voortgaan om ander alternatiewe energiebronne bekend te stel.
tgt: Communities are encouraged to use electricity sparingly, while we continue to introduce other alternative sources of energy.3 Cabinet commends the bravery, commitment, dedication and hard work of the men and women who are working tirelessly to save lives and prevent damage to property, livestock and our prestigious natural environment that were engulfed by the veld fires in Cape Town.

src: Die Kabinet bedank die gemeenskappe wat in die gees van ubuntu met die Regering saamwerk om massa-sorgsentrums tot stand te bring om mense wat hul huise moes verlaat te akkommodeer.
tgt: Cabinet expresses its gratitude to the communities that in the spirit of Ubuntu, partnered with government in setting up mass care centres to accommodate those who have been displaced.

src: Die gees van vrywilligheid deur mense wat die slagoffers van brande ondersteun, is groot en bemoedigend.
tgt: The spirit of volunteerism displayed by people who are assisting the victims of fires is enormous and encouraging.4 Cabinet remains concerned about the attacks of foreign nationals and warns that the law enforcement agencies will continue to have a strong presence in affected areas, and that perpetrators will face the full might of the law.

src: Die Kabinet bly bekommerd oor die aanvalle op buitelandse burgers en waarsku dat die wetstoepassingsagentskappe sal voortgaan om 'n sterk teenwoordigheid in gebiede wat daardeur geraak word, te behou, en dat oortreders met die volle mag van die wet te doen sal kry.
tgt: Violence against foreign nationals is being addressed decisively through various existing government structures.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale onder-17 sokkerspan, die Amajimbos, geluk omdat hulle die land trots gemaak deur vir die eindstryd van die 2015-Afrika onder-17-Kampioenskap in Niamey, Niger te kwalifiseer.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the South African National Under-17 football team, the Amajimbos, for making the country proud by qualifying for the final of the 2015 African Under-17 Championship in Niamey, Niger.

src: Hul prysenswaardige prestasie by die Afrika-jeugkampioenskappe kwalifiseer hulle vir die FIFA Onder-17 Wêreldbekertoernooi in Chili later vanjaar.
tgt: Their gallant performance at the African Youth Championship qualifies them for the FIFA U17 World Cup in Chile later this year.

src: Die Kabinet betreur die afsterwe van een van Suid-Afrika se musikale legendes Zayn Adam.
tgt: Cabinet mourned the passing of one of South Africa’s musical legends Zayn Adams, a renowned lead vocalist for the seminal 70s outfit Pacific Express, whose career spanned more than 50 years.

src: Hy was 'n bekende sanger vir die invloedryke musiekgroep Pacific Express uit die sewentigerjare en sy loopbaan het oor meer as 50 jaar gestrek.
tgt: He was synonymous with Cape Town’s musical history.

src: Die Kabinet is bly dat, getrou aan die eienskappe van 'n regering wat omgee, die finale fase afgehandel is om die oorskot van Suid-Afrikaners terug te bring wat gesterf het toe ‘n gastehuis van die Synagogue Church of All Nation in Lagos, ineengestort het.
tgt: Cabinet is pleased that, true to the characteristics of a caring government, the final phase to repatriate all the mortal remains of South Africans who were killed during the collapse of the guest house owned by the Synagogue Church of All Nation (SCOAN) in Lagos has been concluded.

src: Ons dink aan die families wat hul geliefdes verloor het, asook aan die mense wat in die tragiese ongeluk beseer is.
tgt: Our thoughts are with the families who lost their loved ones and those who were injured in the tragedy.

src: Komende gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: President Jacob Zuma sal die opening van die Nasionale Huis van Tradisionele Leiers in die Parlement in Kaapstad op 5 Maart 2015 (vandag) toespreek.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will address the opening of the National House of Traditional Leaders in Parliament, Cape Town on 5 March 2015 (today).

src: Die verhouding tussen die Regering en tradisionele leiers is van deurslaggewende belang om te verseker dat ons lewenslustige, billike en volhoubare landelike gemeenskappe ontwikkel.
tgt: The relationship between government and traditional leaders is critical to ensure we build vibrant, equitable and sustainable rural communities.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die terugkeer van die oorskot van die bekende strydikone JB Marks en Moses Kotane na Suid-Afrika uit Rusland, waar hulle 42 jaar gelede begrawe is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the return of the mortal remains of renowned struggle icons JB Marks and Moses Kotane to South Africa from Russia where they were buried 42 years ago.

src: Hierdie onbaatsugtige leiers, wat beskou word as die vaders van die vryheidstryd en wat staatmakers soos Nelson Mandela, Oliver Tambo en Walter Sisulu geïnspireer het, sal met spesiale amptelike begrafnisse vereer word.
tgt: These selfless leaders, who are regarded as the fathers of the liberation struggle and had inspired stalwarts such as Nelson Mandela, Oliver Tambo and Walter Sisulu, will receive special official funerals.

src: President Jacob Zuma het opdrag gegee dat die nasionale vlag vanaf 9 Maart tot die aand van 22 Maart 2015 halfstok hang.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma has instructed that the National Flag fly at half-mast from 9 March until the evening of 22 March 2015.

src: Moses Kotane sal op 14 Maart 2015 in Pella, Noordwes herbegrawe word en JB Marks sal op 22 Maart 2015 in Ventersdorp, Noordwes herbegrawe word.
tgt: Moses Kotane will be reburied in Pella, North West on 14 March 2015 and JB Marks in Ventersdorp, North West on 22 March 2015.

src: Hulle terugkeer is deel van die Regering se verbintenis om die oorskot van al ons gevalle makkers wat op vreemde bodem gesterf het terug te bring.
tgt: Their return is part of government’s commitment to return the remains of all of our fallen heroes who died on foreign soil.

src: Verlede jaar is die bekende anti-apartheidsjoernalis, Nat Nakasa, suksesvol van New York af gerepatrieer om by die helde-akker in Chesterville, Durban herbegrawe te word.
tgt: Last year renowned anti-apartheid journalist Nat Nakasa was successfully repatriated from New York to be reburied at the Heroes Acre in Chesterville, Durban.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van die reuse omvattende TB-sifting en -toetsveldtog deur Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa op 24 Maart 2015 – Wêreld TB-dag – in die Dr Kenneth Kaunda-distrik in Noordwes, onder die tema " Beëindiging van Suid-Afrika se TB-epidemie: Bespoediging van ons reaksie in die sleutelbevolkings".
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the massive comprehensive TB screening and testing campaign to be launched by the Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa on 24 March 2015 which is World TB Day, at Dr Kenneth Kaunda District of the North West province – under the theme “Ending South Africa’s TB epidemic: Accelerating our response in Key Populations”.

src: Hierdie lewenslange veldtog sal alle Suid-Afrikaners, veral dié in mynbougemeenskappe, in korrektiewe fasiliteite en by vroeë kinderontwikkelingsentrums mobiliseer om vir TB gesif en getoets te word.
tgt: This life-long campaign will mobilise all South Africans, in particular those living in mining communities, inmates at correctional facilities and early childhood development centres, to be screened and tested for WEBTOKEN the past five years great strides have been made to strengthen government’s strategies for TB control with increased screening and testing especially through the HIV Counselling and Testing campaign.

src: In die afgelope vyf jaar is groot vordering gemaak om die Regering se strategieë vir TB-beheer te versterk met 'n verhoogde sifting- en toetsingkoers, veral deur die Veldtog vir MIV-berading- en Toetsing.
tgt: Screening and testing has been further boosted by the introduction of the rapid diagnostic tests for TB and drug resistant TCabinet commends the dedication and commitment of our teachers, without whom we would not have been able to achieve many of our national goals.

src: Sifting en toetsing is verder versterk deur die bekendstelling van die vinnige diagnostiese toetse vir TB en middelweerstandige TDie Kabinet prys die toewyding van ons onderwysers, sonder wie ons baie van ons nasionale doelwitte nie sou kon bereik nie.
tgt: The nominations for the National Teaching Awards recognise the outstanding contribution teachers make towards the development of our country.

src: Die nominasies vir die Nasionale Onderwystoekennings gee erkenning aan die uitstekende bydrae wat onderwysers tot die ontwikkeling van ons land maak die toekenningseremonie vind op 7 Maart 2015 by Gallagher Estate in Midrand plaas.
tgt: The awards takes place on 7 March 2015 at Gallagher Estate, Midrand.

src: Die Departement van Basiese Onderwys is die gasheer vir hierdie jaarlikse geleentheid waar hulde gebring word aan toegewyde, hardwerkende en professionele onderwysers.
tgt: The Department of Basic Education hosts this annual event to pay tribute to dedicated, committed, hard-working and professional teachers.

src: Die Minister van Water en Sanitasie, Nomvula Mokonyane sal Nasionale Waterweek op 16 Maart 2015 by die droogtegeteisterde KwaDukuza in KwaZulu-Natal bekendstel onder die tema: "Water het geen plaasvervanger".
tgt: Water and Sanitation Minister Nomvula Mokonyane will launch National Water Week at drought-stricken KwaDukuza in KwaZulu-Natal on 16 March 2015 under the theme: “Water Has No Substitute”.

src: Nasionale Waterweek sal op 22 Maart 2015 afgesluit word met Wêreld Waterdag.
tgt: This national week will conclude with World Water Day on 22 March 2015.This campaign will educate South Africans on the value of water and the need for sustainable management of this scarce resource.

src: Die veldtog sal Suid-Afrikaners opvoed oor die waarde van water en die behoefte vir die volhoubare bestuur van hierdie skaars hulpbron.
tgt: Cabinet reminds all South Africans that we live in a water-scarce country and urges all to conserve it by fixing leaks and making waterwise lifestyle changes.

src: Sondag 8 Maart is Internasionale Vrouedag, ‘n dag waarop daar jaarliks regoor die wêreld besin word oor vordering wat gemaak is, ‘n beroep gedoen word vir verandering en dade van moed en vasberadenheid deur gewone vroue wat buitengewone rolle in die geskiedenis van hul gemeenskappe en lande gespeel het, gevier word.
tgt: Sunday, 8 March, marks the International Women’s Day (IWD) which is a day used annually across the world to reflect on progress made, call for change and celebrate acts of courage and determination by ordinary women who played an extraordinary role in the history of their communities and countries.

src: Die Departement van Vroue sal die nasionale viering van Internasionale Vrouedag by die Langa Hoërskool in Kaapstad lei onder die tema “Vroueregte is Meseregte: Saam laat ons ‘n nie-gewelddadige Suid-Afrika vooruitgaan”.
tgt: The Department of Women will lead the national celebration of IWD at Langa High School in Cape Town under the theme "Women’s Rights are Human Rights: Together Moving a Non-Violent South Africa Forward".This theme is aligned to the United Nations’ theme of: "Equality for Women is progress for all!"

src: Hierdie tema is in lyn met die Verenigde Nasies se tema van: “Gelykheid vir Vroue is Vordering vir Almal!” Dit is ook in lyn met die Afrika-Unie se verklaring van die jaar 2015 as "Die Jaar van Vrouebemagtiging en Ontwikkeling vir Afrika se Agenda 2063".
tgt: and the African Union’s declaration of the year 2015 as “The Year of Women Empowerment and Development towards Africa’s Agenda 2063”.

src: Die dag sal gebruik word om die nasionale en provinsiale dialoogprogram wat hierdie maand begin en tot einde Junie duur, van stapel te stuur.
tgt: The day will be used to launch the national and provincial dialogue’s programme which will commence from this month until June, leading to a report on the status of women to be launched by the President on August Cabinet calls on the South African media to submit their entries for the 2015 SADC Media Awards competition.

src: Die sluitingsdatum is 31 Maart 2015 en meer inligting is beskikbaar op die Departement van Kommunikasie se webwerf WEBTOKEDie toekennings verbind formele strukture van SAOG-regerings, die burgerlike samelewing, die akademie, arbeid en die media.
tgt: The closing date is 31 March 2015 and more information is available on Department of Communications website www.

src: MnrVusimuzi Philemon Madonsela - verlenging van die kontrak as Direkteur-generaal vir die Departement van Samewerkende Regering.
tgt: Mr Mayihlome Tshwete as the Deputy Director-General: Communication Services in the Department of Home Affairs.

src: Nie-uitvoerende direkteure vir die Raad van die ZA Domeinnaamgesag (ZADNA)7.1 MeN Dhevcharran (Voorsitter)7.2 Dr NYH Mzizana.3 MnrAM Brooks.4 MnrNM Mebi.5 AdvMJ Ralefatane.6 MnrMNR Khumalo.8 Dr YKN Mohutsioa-Mathabathe.9 MeMO Morata.10 MnrJ Tshipa.
tgt: Ms CM Mogotsi as the Deputy Director-General in the Department of Arts and Culture.

src: Afsterwe van Minister Ohm Collins Chabane.
tgt: The passing of Minister Ohm Collins Chabane.

src: Die Kabinet betreur die ontydige afsterwe van Minister Chabane en sy lyfwagte, Sersante Lesiba Samuel Sekele en Mareme Lawrence Lentsoane, wat op Sondag 15 Maart 2015 in ’n tragiese motorongeluk gesterf het.
tgt: Cabinet is saddened by the untimely passing of Minister Chabane and his protectors, Sergeants Lesiba Samuel Sekele and Mareme Lawrence Lentsoane, who died in a tragic car crash on Sunday, 15 March 2015.

src: Die Regering en die mense van Suid-Afrika sal die bydrae van hierdie dienaar van die mense, wat hom tot sy dood aan die bou van ’n beter Suid-Afrika verbind het, ten seerste WEBTOKEN 'n lid van die uitvoerende komitee, kry die afgestorwe Minister van die Staatsdiens en Administrasie, 'n kategorie 1 amptelike begrafnis.
tgt: Government and the people of South Africa will solely miss the contribution from this servant of the people who remained committed to building a better South Africa until WEBTOKEN a member of the Executive, the late Public Service and Administration Minister will be afforded an Official Funeral Category The funeral service will take place on Saturday, 21 March 2015 at Xikundu village in Malamulele, Limpopo.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy innige meegevoel aan die familie en vriende van die Minister en sy twee lyfwagte oor.
tgt: Cabinet conveys its sincerest condolences to the families and friends of the late Minister and his two protectors.

src: Implementering van belangrike regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of key government programmes.

src: President Jacob Zuma sal die 50ste herdenking van Suid-Afrika se kernkrag-navorsingsreaktor SAFARI-1, wat deur die Nasionale Energiereguleerder van Suid-Afrika (NERSA) by Pelindaba naby Pretoria bedryf word, lei.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will lead the 50th anniversary celebrations of South Africa’s nuclear research reactor SAFARI-1 operated by the National Energy Regulator of South Africa (NERSA) at Pelindaba near Pretoria.

src: Sedert sy ingebruikneming op 18 Maart 1965, het die reaktor, wat 'n belangrike vervaardiger van mediese en industriële isotope vir beide plaaslike en internasionale verbruik is, talle toekennings en internasionale akkreditasies ontvang.
tgt: Since its commissioning on 18 March 1965, the reactor, which is a major producer of medical and industrial isotopes for both domestic and international consumption, received many accolades and international accreditation.

src: Dié reaktor het ook 'n deurslaggewende rol gespeel in kernnavorsing,-ontwikkeling en -opvoeding, en het Suid-Afrika op die voorpunt van wetenskaplike vooruitgang geplaas.
tgt: This reactor has also played a critical role in nuclear research, development and education and has placed South Africa in the forefront of scientific advances.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om voor die sluitingsdatum van 10 April 2015 geskikte individue te nomineer om in die Nasionale Beplanningskommissie te dien.
tgt: Cabinet calls on South Africans to nominate suitable individuals to serve on the National Planning Commission before the closing date of 10 April 2015.

src: Die nuwe kommissie sal daarop fokus om die Regering van raad te bedien oor die beste manier om die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan te implementeer.
tgt: The focus of the new commission will be on advising government on how best to implement the National Development Plan.

src: Daarbenewens sal dit ook help met die ontwikkeling van gedetailleerde planne in sekere sektore wat toegewyde aandag verg, om ekonomiese groei, radikale ekonomiese transformasie en volhoubare ontwikkeling te dryf.
tgt: In addition it will also assist in developing detailed plans in selected sectors that require focussed attention to drive economic growth, radical economic transformation and sustainable development.

src: Mer inligting oor die nominasieproses is beskikbaar by: www.
tgt: More information on the nomination process is available on: www.

tgt: za.

src: Belangrike kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet keur die voorlegging van die wysigings tot die Roomse Statuut insake die Internasionale Strafregetlike Hof aan die Parlement vir bekragtiging goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission to Parliament the Amendments to the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court for ratification.

src: Die wysigings sluit die definisie van misdade van aggressie en bykomende dade in, wat die oorlogsmisdade in die Roomse Statuut behels, soos goedgekeur deur die Byeenkoms van Staatspartye (in Kampala, Uganda op 11 Junie 2010).Suid-Afrika se bekragtiging van hierdie wysigings tot die Roomse Statuut, is ’n aanduiding van die Regering se verbintenis om ernstige misdade teen die mensdom en misdade van aggressie, hetsy of dit binne of buite ons landsgrense gepleeg word, te beveg.
tgt: The amendments include the definition of crimes of aggression and additional acts constituting the war crimes in the Rome Statute adopted by the Assembly of State Parties (in Kampala, Uganda on 11 June 2010).Ratification of these amendments to the Rome Statute by South Africa demonstrates government’s commitment to fight serious crimes against humanity and crime of aggression when committed in or outside our country.

src: Die Kabinet se standpunt oor huidige kwessies.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on current issues.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die reaksie op die jongste voorgestelde afbakenings en erken dat kragtige debat 'n integrale deel van ons demokrasie is.
tgt: Cabinet notes the responses to the latest round of proposed demarcations and acknowledges that robust debate is an integral part of our democracy.

src: Aangesien daar 'n paar munisipaliteite is wat sukkel om dienste te lewer en onvolhoubaar bly weens onvoldoende inkomste en gebrekkige bestuur, word munisipale grense voortdurend hersien.
tgt: Since there are some municipalities that are struggling to deliver services and remain unsustainable due to insufficient revenue and inadequate governance, municipal boundaries are constantly reviewed.

src: Die voorgestelde veranderings word eers onder die loep geneem deur die Munisipale Afbakeningsraad (MAR), wat verantwoordelik is vir die bepaling van munisipale grense ooreenkomstig die Wet op Plaaslike Regering: Munisipale Afbakening, 1998 (Wet 27 van 1998) en die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van WEBTOKEN 'n onafhanklike liggaam, is die MAR se prosesse deursigtig en raadplegend.
tgt: The proposed changes are first scrutinised by the Municipal Demarcation Board (MDB), which is charged with determining municipal boundaries in accordance with the Local Government: Municipal Demarcation Act, 1998 (Act 27 of 1998) and the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.

src: Die Kabinet moedig gemeenskappe aan om aktief aan hierdie prosesse deel te neem.
tgt: Cabinet, encourages communities to actively participate in these processes.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel die gebruik van geweldadige protesoptogte as 'n middel om afbakeningsgeskille op te los.
tgt: Cabinet condemns the usage of violent protest marches as a means of resolving demarcation disputes.

src: Die werk van die MAR is 'n integrale deel van die Regering se benadering om “terug te keer na basiese waardes” om die lewering van beter dienste aan gemeenskappe te verseker.
tgt: The work of the MDB is an integral part of government’s Back to Basics approach to ensure better delivery of services to communities.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Basotho-volk geluk met die gladde oorskakeling na ’n nuwe regering en moedig hulle aan om steeds saam te werk om blywende vrede en ekonomiese ontwikkeling te verseker.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the Basotho people for a smooth transfer of power and has urged them to work together for lasting peace and economic development.

src: Die Kabinet het ook die nuwe Eerste Minister van die Koninkryk van Lesotho, die Agbare Pakalitha Mosisili gelukgewens met sy verkiesing en suksesvolle inhuldiging op Dinsdag 17 Maart 2015, wat deur Sy Eksellensie President Jacob Zuma en Adjunk-president Cyril Ramaphosa bygewoon is.
tgt: Cabinet also congratulated the new Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Lesotho, Right Honourable Pakalitha Mosisili on his election and successful inauguration that took place on Tuesday, 17 March 2015, which was attended by His Excellency President Jacob Zuma and Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa.

src: Die Kabinet het die Adjunk-president gelukgewens met die rol wat hy gespeel het in die suksesvolle verloop van die verkiesing in die Koninkryk van Lesotho.
tgt: Cabinet congratulated the Deputy President on the role he played leading to the successful elections in the Kingdom of Lesotho.

src: Die Kabinet het verder ook sy waardering uitgespreek vir die rol van die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap in die fasilitering van 'n padkaart vir vrede en die verkiesing van die nuwe regering.
tgt: It further appreciated the role played by the Southern African Development Community in facilitating a roadmap for peace and elections of the new government.

src: Die Kabinet het Suid-Afrika se verbintenis tot voortgesette samewerking met die Koninkryk van Lesotho beklemtoon, om die bestaande verhoudings verder te verbeter deur te fokus op die bevordering van ekonomiese en sosiale samewerking, wat tot die verbetering van mense se lewens sal lei.
tgt: Cabinet reiterated South Africa’s commitment to continue working with the Kingdom of Lesotho to further enhance the existing relations by focusing on strengthening economic and social cooperation that will lead to the improvement of people’s lives.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Adjunk-president Ramaphosa sal die Republiek van Namibië se 25ste onafhanklikheidsvierings, insluitend die inhuldiging van President Hage Geingob in Windhoek, op 21 Maart 2015 bywoon.
tgt: Deputy President Ramaphosa will attend the Republic of Namibia’s 25th Independence Anniversary, including the Inauguration of President Hage Geingob in Windhoek on 21 March 2015.

src: Die Kabinet wens Namibië geluk met die viering van die land se silwerjubileum en President Geingob as die land se derde Staatshoof.
tgt: Cabinet commends Namibia on its Silver Jubilee celebrations and President Geingob on becoming the country’s third Head of State.

src: President Zuma sal Zimbabwe se President Robert Mugabe van 8 tot 9 April 2015 in Pretoria ontvang.
tgt: President Zuma will host Zimbabwe’s President Robert Mugabe from 8 to 9 April 2015 in Pretoria.

src: Die besoek sal lei tot die Suid-Afrika-Zimbabwe Sakeforum wat vir 9 April 2015 geskeduleer is en daarop gemik is om bilaterale handel en belegging ’n hupstoot te gee.
tgt: The visit will culminate into the South Africa-Zimbabwe Business Forum scheduled for 9 April 2015, which aims to increase bilateral trade and investment.

src: President Zuma sal op 19 Maart 2015, 95 lokomotiewe wat as deel van Transnet se R300-miljard kapitaalbeleggingsprogram gebou is om die land se vrag-infrastruktuur te vernuwe, bekendstel.
tgt: President Zuma will on 19 March 2015 launch 95 locomotives in Pretoria that have been built as part of Transnet’s R300 billion capital investment programme to revitalise the country’s freight infrastructure.

src: Vir die duur van die beleggingsprogram sal 'n aantal nuwe werkgeleenthede geskep word, terwyl die plaaslike sakeondernemings voordeel sal trek uit die lokalisering, die ontwikkeling van vaardighede en die oordrag van tegnologie.
tgt: Over the duration of the investment programme a number of new jobs will be created and local businesses stand to benefit from localisation, skills development and technology transfer.

src: Die nuwe treine sal help om die agterstand ten opsigte van die land se spoorstelsel uit te wis, en sal help om die produktiwiteit en doeltreffendheid van ons spoornetwerk te verbeter.
tgt: The new trains will address the country’s rail system backlog and will help improve the productivity and efficiency of our rail network.

src: Die bekendstelling is ook 'n aanduiding van Transnet Engineering se transformasie tot 'n volwaardige oorspronklike vervaardiger van toerusting aangesien 85 van die treine op sy aanleg by Koedoespoort naby Pretoria vervaardig is.
tgt: The launch also signals the transformation of Transnet Engineering into a fully-fledged original equipment manufacturer as 85 of the trains were produced at its facility at Koedoespoort, near Pretoria.

src: President Zuma sal die Swart Nyweraars-indaba, wat van 25 tot 26 Maart 2015 by die Gallagher Konvensiesentrum in Midrand open, as deel van die Regering se verbintenis om swart nyweraars in die land te ontwikkel.
tgt: President Zuma will open the Black Industrialists Indaba taking place from 25 to 26 March 2015 at Gallagher Convention Centre, Midrand, as part of government’s commitment to develop black industrialists in the country.

src: Die indaba sal samesprrekings tussen die openbare en private sektor aanmoedig om swart nyweraars te bevorder, en om die ekonomie radikaal te verander en te herstruktureer om inklusiewe groei te bewerkstellig.
tgt: The Indaba will foster dialogue between the public and private sector to advance black industrialists, and to radically transform and restructure the economy to achieve inclusive growth.

src: President Zuma sal die Lede van die Nasionale Vergadering van die Suid-Afrikaanse Vereniging vir Plaaslike Regering, wat van 24 tot 26 Maart 2015 by die Gallagher Konvensiesentrum in Midrand plaasvind, toespreek.
tgt: President Zuma will address the National Members Assembly (NMA) of the South African Local Government Association, which will take place at Gallagher Convention Centre, Midrand from 24 to 26 March 2015.

src: Die Lede van die Nasionale Vergadering sal besin oor die stand van plaaslike regering na 15 jaar en strategieë bespreek om doeltreffend te handel met dienslewering, kapasiteitbou, korrupsie en kwessies rondom die afbakening van munisipaliteite.
tgt: The NMA will reflect on the state of local government after 15 years and discuss strategies to deal effectively with service delivery, capacity building, corruption and issues around the demarcation of municipalities.

src: Die vergadering word gehou onder die tema: 15 Jaar van demokratiese plaaslike regering – konsolideer en verdiep lewendige, ontwikkelings- en mensgesentreerde plaaslike demokrasie.
tgt: The Assembly will be held under the theme: “15 Years of Democratic Local Government – Consolidating and Deepening Vibrant, Developmental and People Centered Local Democracy”.

src: Suid-Afrikaners sal nasionale Meseregtedag op 21 Maart 2015 in Uitenhage in die Oos-Kaap vier onder die tema: Vier die Vryheidsmanifes, geniet gelyke menseregte vir almal.
tgt: South Africans will celebrate the national Human Rights Day event on 21 March 2015 in Uitenhage, Eastern Cape under the theme: “Celebrating the Freedom Charter, Enjoying Equal Human Rights for All”.

src: Hierdie geleentheid sal 'n platform vir alle Suid-Afrikaners bied om die opofferings wat met die stryd om demokrasie gepaard gegaan het, asook ons verbintenis tot die bevordering van menseregte soos in die Grondwet verskans, te herdenk.
tgt: These events will provide a platform for all South Africans to commemorate the sacrifices that accompanied the struggle for democracy and our commitment to advance human rights as enshrined in the Constitution.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om hierdie belangrike dag te vier deur verbeterde sosiale samehorigheid en nasiebou te bevorder.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to celebrate this important day by fostering greater social cohesion and nation-building.

src: As deel van Meseregtemaand, sal gemeenskapsgesprekke in al die provinsies plaasvind om interaksie tussen gemeenskappe van verskillende agtergronde te bevorder.
tgt: As part of Human Rights Month, community dialogues will take place across all provinces to promote interaction among communities of different backgrounds.

src: Dit sal lei tot die Spitsberaad vir Verslagdoening oor en Monitering van Nasionale Maatskaplike Samehorigheid, wat op 30 Maart 2015 in Port Elizabeth gehou word.
tgt: This will culminate in the National Social Cohesion Report-back and Monitoring Summit to be held on 30 March 2015 in Port Elizabeth.

src: Die Departement van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling sal gasheer wees vir die Nasionale Maatskaplike Werk-indaba wat van 24 tot 26 Maart 2015 by die Internasionale Konferensiesentrum in Durban gehou word onder die tema: Vernuwe maatskaplike werk-praktyk in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: The Department of Social Development will host the National Social Work Indaba from 24 to 26 March 2015 at the International Convention Centre in Durban under the theme: “Revitalising social work practice in South Africa”.The Indaba will develop proposals and interventions to address matters that impact on the social work practice and align the development mandate of the profession to support government’s radical socio-economic transformation.

src: Die Indaba sal voorstelle maak en tussenkomste skep om sake te bespreek wat 'n impak op die praktyk van maatskaplike werk het en om die ontwikkelingsmandaat van die beroep in lyn te bring om die Regering se radikale sosio-ekonomiese transformasie te ondersteun.
tgt: To accomplish this, the department has rolled out a scholarship programme to fund students studying social work at universities.

src: Om dit te bereik het die Departement 'n beursprogram geskep om studente wat maatskaplike werk by universiteite studeer te befonds.
tgt: The Department of Social Development will also hold the 2nd Anti-Fraud and Corruption Conference from 30 to 31 March 2015 at St George’s Hotel, Centurion under the theme: “Ensuring human rights for all through a fraud free social grants system”.

src: Die konferensie sal die huidige maatreëls om korrupsie binne die maatskaplike toelaestelsel uit te roei, evalueer.
tgt: The conference will evaluate the current measures to root out corruption within the social grant system.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die aanbieding van die eerste Vier Nasies Basketbal-uitdaging wat by die Wembley-stadion in Johannesburg van 19 tot 22 Maart 2015 plaasvind.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the hosting of the inaugural basketball Four Nations Challenge taking place at Wembley Stadium, Johannesburg from 19 to 22 March 2015.

src: Dit bring die senior manspanne van Suid-Afrika, Nigerië, Mosambiek en Kenia byeen in wat na verwagting 'n jaarlikse instelling sal word.
tgt: This brings the senior men’s teams of South Africa, Nigeria, Mozambique and Kenya together in what is envisaged to become an annual event.

src: Die Kabinet wens ons krieketspan geluk, wat tot die halfeindrondte van die Wêreldbeker deurgedring het met ’n nege-paaltjieoorwinning in hul wedstryd teen Sri Lanka.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates our cricket team, which has advanced to the semis with a nine-wicket win over Sri Lanka in their World Cup match.

src: Ons wens die span en die afrigter sterkte toe met die res van die toernooi.
tgt: We wish the team and the coach well as they proceed with the rest of the tournament.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die nodige klarings.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Onlangse vlaag van aanvalle op buitelandse burgers.1 Die Kabinet veroordeel die onlangse geweld teen buitelanders ten sterkste.
tgt: Recent spate of attack on foreign nationals.

src: Die Kabinet wil in dié stadium graag sy innige meegevoel oordra aan die families van mense wat weens die geweld gesterf het en wens dié wat beseer is 'n spoedige herstel toe.
tgt: Cabinet condemns in the strongest terms the recent acts of violence against foreign nationals.

src: Geen mate van frustrasie of woede kan hierdie aanvalle en plundery van winkels regverdig nie.
tgt: No amount of frustration or anger can justify these attacks and looting of shops.

src: Terwyl kennis geneem word van die kwessies wat deur gemeenskappe geopper word, kan geweld teenoor ander mense nooit hierdie kwessies oplos nie.
tgt: Whilst noting the issues raised by communities, violence towards another fellow human being can never solve these issues.

src: Inteendeel, dit is ‘n swak weerspieëling op ons as 'n volk, en teenstrydig met die ideale en grondslag van ons demokrasie.
tgt: Rather, it reflects badly on us as a people, going against the very ideals and foundations of our democracy.

src: Suid-Afrika het kolonialisme en apartheid beveg saam met mede-Afrikane om te verseker dat alle mense op ons vasteland gerespekteer word en met waardigheid behandel word.2 Die uitwerking van hierdie aanvalle het verreikende gevolge op ons ekonomiese en sosiale verhoudings met die vastelenand en die res van die wêreld.
tgt: South Africa fought against colonialism and Apartheid alongside fellow Africans so that all humanity in our continent should be respected and treated with dignity.

src: Suid-Afrikaanse maatskappye wat suksesvolle ondernemings op die vasteland bedryf en wat help om ‘n bydrae tot ons inkomste en die handhawing van ons ekonomie te maak, kan dieselfde lot ly.
tgt: The impact of these attacks has far reaching implications on our economic, social and relations with the continent and the world.

src: Onlangs moes Suid-Afrikaanse kunstenaars wat vertonings buite ons landsgrense wou lewer, soos BigNuz in Zimbabwe, en Kelly Khumalo en Casper in Londen, hul konserte kanselleer as gevolg van hierdie aanvalle.
tgt: Recently, South African artists who were to showcase their craft outside our borders of our country, such as BigNuz in Zimbabwe, Kelly Khumalo and Casper in London, have had their concerts cancelled as a result of these attacks.

src: Baie van ons gemeenskappe wat staatgemaak het op winkels in besit van buitelandse burgers vir hul brood en botter, is nou gestrand.
tgt: Many of our communities who relied on shops owned by foreign nationals for their bread and butter are now WEBTOKEN, South Africa enjoys a free country, which was attained through the contribution of a number of the African Countries.

src: Vandag geniet ons vryheid in Suid-Afrika danksy die bydrae van verskeie Afrikalande.
tgt: Our own late icon, President Oliver Tambo was accommodated for close to 30 years in Zambia and many other South Africans that lived in exile.

src: Ons eie ikone, soos wyle Oliver Tambo, is byna 30 jaar lank in Zambië gehuisves en talle ander Suid-Afrikaners het ook elders in Afrika in ballingskap geleef.
tgt: Fellow African countries, did not only host our people, they also contributed resources and some paid the ultimate price and lost their own citizens in the course of South Africa attaining democracy.

src: Mee-Aftrikalande het nie net ons mense gehuisves nie, maar het ook hulpbronne bygedra, en sommige het die hoogste prys betaal deur van hul eie burgers te verloor in die stryd wat tot demokrasie in Suid-Afrika gelei het.
tgt: South Africa will never be derailed from pursuing the Pan African vision as encapsulated in AU Agenda 2063, which was since pursued by our forefathers Kwame Nkruma, Azikiwe, Mualimu Julius Nyerere and Nelson Mandela.

src: President Jacob Zuma het die ministers van die Groepering vir Justisie, Misdaadvoorkoming en Sekuriteit opdrag gegee om saam met die ministers wat gemoeid is met kleinsake-ontwikkeling, handel en nywerheid, asook maatskaplike ontwikkeling, al die betrokke partye byeen te bring om 'n oplossing te vind.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma has tasked the Justice Crime Prevention and Security Cluster Ministers together with Ministers of Small Business Development, Trade and Industry and Social Development to engage all the relevant parties to seek a solution.

src: Die ministers is ook gevra om die onderliggende sosio-ekonomiese toestande wat die kernoorsaak van dié aanvalle blyk te wees, te ondersoek, sodat hierdie kwessie beslissend en volledig die hoof gebied kan word.
tgt: The ministers have also been tasked to deal with the underlying socio-economic conditions which seems to be at the heart of these attacks, so that this matter can be dealt with decisively and comprehensively.

src: Die President het voorts ook die maatreëls wat deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Weermag onderneem is om ons grense te beheer, aangekondig.
tgt: The President has further announced the measures undertaken by the South African National Defence Force to bring control to our borders.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle gemeenskappe, organisasies en individue om saam te staan in protes teen hierdie aanvalle.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all communities, organisations and individuals to join hands against these attacks.

src: Suid-Afrika is nie 'n gewelddadige land nie en 'n paar individue kan dus nie toegelaat word om die hele land in sy greep te hou nie.
tgt: South Africa is not a violent country and therefore a few individuals cannot be allowed to hold the whole country at ransom.

src: Geweld was nog nooit 'n oplossing vir die probleme in enige samelewing nie en sal dit ook nooit in Suid-Afrika wees nie.
tgt: Violence has never been a solution for problems in any society and will never be in South Africa.

src: Nie in ons naam nie!2.
tgt: Not in our name!2.

src: Standbeelde.1 Die Kabinet het kennis geneem van die besluit van die Universiteit van Kaapstad se bestuur om die Rhodes-standbeeld van die kampus te verwyder.
tgt: Cabinet noted the decision by the management of the university to remove the Rhodes statue from the campus of the University of Cape Town.

src: Suid-Afrika het oor die afgelope twee dekades beduidende vordering gemaak om te verseker dat ons historiese simbole die demografie van ons land en ons demokratiese bestel weerspieël.
tgt: South Africa over the last two decades has made huge strides in ensuring that our historical symbols reflect the demographics of our country and our democratic order.

src: Die Kabinet erken egter dat die proses om historiese simbole en name in ons land wat aanstoot gee te verwyder, nie vinnig genoeg gevorder het nie.
tgt: Cabinet however, acknowledged that the journey of removing the historically offensive symbols and names within our country has not moved fast enough.

src: Die Kabinet het kennis geneem van en moedig die huidige breë debat oor transformasie in ons samelewing aan met die wete dat transformasie nie vinnig genoeg plaasgevind het nie.
tgt: Cabinet noted and encourages the current broad debate that have commenced on transformation within our society, noting that transformation has not been fast enough we understand the frustrations of the students.

src: Ons verstaan dus die studente se frustrasies, maar moedig hulle aan om die prosedures, soos in die land se wette omskryf, te volg.
tgt: We therefore encourage them to follow the processes as defined in our laws.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om betrokke te raak by voortgesette prosesse oor erfenis en nasiebou wat deur die Departement van Kuns en Kultuur gelei word.
tgt: Cabinet calls on South Africans to get involved in the ongoing processes led by the Department of Arts and Culture on heritage and nation building.

src: Suid-Afrikaners word daaraan herinner dat die Wet op Nasionale Erfenishulpbronne van 1999 die raadplegende prosesse uiteensit wat gevolg moet word wanneer standbeelde verwyder en/of hervestig word.
tgt: South Africans are reminded that the National Heritage Resources Act of 1999 outlines the consultative processes that should be followed in the case of a removal and or relocation of a statue.

src: Zimbabwe-staatsbesoek.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die suksesvolle Zimbabwe-staatsbesoek wat deur President Robert Gabriel Mugabe gelei is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the successful Zimbabwean State visit led by President Robert Gabriel Mugabe.

src: Suid-Afrika en Zimbabwe het 'n lang geskiedenis van plaaslike affiliasie en kulturele bande.
tgt: South Africa and Zimbabwe, have and long history of regional affiliation and cultural ties.

src: Die mense van Zimbabwe het 'n beduidende historiese rol gespeel met hul steun vir die vryheidstryd in Suid-Afrika.
