tgt: This has significantly contributed to reducing new HIV infections and mortality from AIDS, and ensured child survival and prolonged life.

src: Ywerig beplanning is 'n belangrike deel van die sukses van hierdie vlagskip-program, wat verseker dat elke openbare gesondheidfasiliteit voldoende hoevelede ARV’s in voorraad het.
tgt: Diligent planning is a major part of the success of this flagship programme, which ensures adequate availability of ARVs at every public health facility.

src: Suid-Afrika, deur die Departement van Wetenskap en Tegnologie (DWT), belê reeds jare lank in MIV-navorsing.
tgt: South Africa, through the Department of Science and Technology (DST), has been investing in HIV research for many years.

src: Die DWT se belegging in MIV-navorsing het in 1999 begin, toe die departement saam met die Departement van Gesondheid, die Suid-Afrikaanse vigs-entstofinisiatief gevestiog het.
tgt: The DST's investment in HIV research began in 1999 when together with the Department of Health, we established the South African AIDS Vaccine WEBTOKEN 2009, the DST’s support for HIV research was expanded to include other interventions such as diagnostics, ARVs, microbicides, in addition to vaccines.

src: Teen 2009, is die DWT se ondersteuning van MIV-navorsing uitgebrei om ander tussenkomste soos diagnose, ARVs, en microbisides, bykomend tot entstowwe, in te sluit.
tgt: We created the South African HIV Research and Innovation Platform (SHARP) to fund pioneering HIV and AIDS research and facilitate the development of innovative solutions to the epidemic.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse MIV-navorsing en -innovasieplatform (SHARP) is geskep om baanbrekerswerk ten opsigte van MIV- en vigs-navorsing te befonds en om die ontwikkeling van innoverende oplossings vir die epidemie te fasiliteer.
tgt: We are currently supporting a number of HIV-related projects at various stages of development through a programme called the Strategic Health Innovation Partnership, which incorporates SHARP under the auspices of the South African Medical Research Council.

src: Ons ondersteun tans verskeie MIV-verwante projekte in verskillende stadiums van ontwikkeling deur 'n program genaamd die Strategiese Gesondheidsinnovasie-vennootskap, wat SHARP inkorporeer onder die vaandel van die Suid-Afrikaanse Meiese Navorsingsraad.
tgt: The role of this programme is to facilitate the interaction of South African HIV and AIDS researchers, and to create a National Network of Collaborating Research Centres in HIV and AIDS.

src: Die rol van die program is om die interaksie van Suid-Afrikaanse MIV- en vigs-navorsers te fasiliteer, en om 'n nasionale netwerk van samewerkende navorsingsentrums in MIV en vigs te skep.
tgt: Currently, a number of multi-institutional, multidisciplinary, product development projects covering diagnostics, vaccines and microbicides are being pursued to advance the objectives of SHARSouth Africa attaches particular importance to the fight against AIDS, with prevention at the heart of the country’s National Strategic Plan for HIV, STIs and TB (2012-2016).4 Environment Month ProgrammeIn June South Africa will celebrate key environment days.

src: Op 5 Junie lei die Departement van Omgewingsake die viering van Wêreldomgewingsdag in Kimberley in die Noord-Kaap.
tgt: Led by the Department of Environmental Affairs, on 5th June, we will celebrate the World Environment Day in Kimberley, Northern Cape.

src: Wêreld-oseanedag word op 8 Junie in Bloemfontein in die Vrystaat aangebied in samewerking met verskeie vennote in die implementering van die Operasie Phakisa Oseane-ekonomie wanneer inligting oor die geleenthede in die oseane-ekonomie en verwante gebiede aan die plaaslike gemeenskappe oorgedra sal word.
tgt: The World Oceans Day on the 8th June will be hosted in Bloemfontein, Free State with various partners in the implementation of the Operation Phakisa Oceans Economy sharing information with local communities about opportunities in the ocean economy and related areas.

src: Op 17Junie vier Suid-Afrika Wêrelddag vir die Bestryding van Verwoestyning in Nqutu, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: On the 17th June South Africa will celebrate the World Day to Combat Desertification in Nqutu village, KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Al hierdie belangrike omgewingsdae is daarop gemik om bewustheid oor die omgewing te verhoog, terwyl dit ook jong mense in al die gasheerprovinsies aan geleenthede in die sektor bekendstel.5 Bekendstelling van die Driesydige Vryhandelsgebied in Sharm-el-ShaikDie COMESA-EAC-SAOG Driesydige Vryhandelsgebied sal op 10 Junie 2015 in Sharm-el-Shaik, Egipte van stapel gestuur word.
tgt: All these key environment days are aimed at heightening public awareness about the environment while also exposing young people in all the host provinces to opportunities in the sector.

src: Die vryhandelsgebied sal 'n mark van 26 lande skep, met 'n gesamentlike bevolking van meer as 625 000 000 en 'n BBP van meer as $1 triljoen.
tgt: p>4.5 Launch of the Tripartite FTA in Sharm-el-ShaikThe COMESA-EAC-SADC Tripartite Free Trade Area (TFTA) will be launched on 10 June 2015 in Sharm-el-Shaik, Egypt.

src: Die bekendstelling dui op die finalisering van die onderhandelinge oor die vryhandelsooreenkoms wat reëls en 'n raamwerk skep waarbinne tariefvoorkeure en ander verpligtinge geïmplementeer sal word.
tgt: The launch signifies the conclusion of the negotiations on the Free Trade Agreement which sets rules and a framework within which tariff preferences and other commitments will be implemented.

src: Onderhandelinge oor tariewe en reëls van oorsprong sal voortgaan as deel van die ingeboude agenda.
tgt: Negotiations on tariffs and rules of origin will continue as part of the built-in agenda.

src: Die bekendstelling van die vryhandelsooreenkoms is 'n belangrike mylpaal vir Afrika wat gevestig is in die Afrika-unie (AU) se Lagos Plan van Aksie en die Abuja-verdrag wat daarop gemik is om die Afrika Ekonomiese Gemeenskap te vestig.
tgt: The launch of the TFTA is a significant milestone for the African Continent and is rooted in the African Union (AU) Lagos Plan of Action and the Abuja Treaty which aim to establish the African Economic Community.

src: Ons glo dat dit 'n kragtige boodskap uitstuur dat Afrika verbind is tot sy ekonomiese integrasie-agenda en tot die skep van 'n omgewing wat bevordelik is vir handel en belegging.
tgt: We believe that this sends a powerful message that Africa is committed to its economic integration agenda and in creating a conducive environment for trade and investment.

src: Die onderhandelinge wat lei na die Drieledige Vryhandelsgebied is in Junie 2011 van stapel gestuur in 'n spitsberaad wat deur President Jacob Zuma in Sandton, Suid-Afrika aangebied is.6 Bekendstelling van die onderhandelinge vir 'n Kontinentale Vryhandelsooreenkoms by die AU-spitsberaad in Junie.
tgt: The negotiations towards the Tripartite Free Trade Area (TFTA) were launched in June 2011 in a Summit hosted by President Jacob Zuma in Sandton, South Africa.

src: Die bekendstelling van die onderhandelinge vir die Kontinentale Vryhandelsooreenkoms by die AU-spitsberaad vind op 15 Junie 2015 in Johannesburg, Suid-Afrika plaas.
tgt: Launch of the negotiations for Continental FTA at the AU Summit in JuneThe launch of the Continental Free Trade Agreement (CFTA) negotiations by the AU Summit takes place on 15 June 2015 in Johannesburg, South Africa.

src: Die Vryhandelsooreenkoms sal 'n mark skep van meer as 1,3 miljard mense met 'n gesamentlike BBP van meer as $2 miljard.
tgt: The CFTA will, create a market of over billion people with a combined GDP of over $2 trillion.

src: Dit sal voortbou op die Driesydige Vryhandelsgebied en vordering wat in die plaaslike ekonomiese gemeenskappe gemaak is.
tgt: It will build on the Tripartite Free Trade Area and progress achieved in the regional economic communities.

src: Dit sal ook aan handelaars en beleggers toegang verleen tot 'n groeiende mark en bied 'n basis vir beter intra-Afrika handel.
tgt: It will also give traders and investors access to a growing market and provides a basis for enhanced intra-Africa trade.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die toepaslike klaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Implementering van belangrike regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of key government programmes.

src: Die Kabinet is hoëprofiel-geleenthede op die uitkomsteverslae vir die vierde kwartaal (Januarie tot Maart 2015) en is tevrede met die vordering wat met die implementering daarvan gemaak is.
tgt: Cabinet was appraised on the outcomes reports for the fourth quarter (January-March 2015).

src: Lede van die Uitvoerende Komitee sal gesprekvoeringsaktiwiteite met die media en belanghebbendes onderneem om vordering wat met die implementering van die vierde kwartaal se uitkomste gemaak is te bespreek.
tgt: Members of the Executive will undertake media and stakeholder-engagement activities to unpack the progress made in the implementation of the fourth quarter outcomes.

src: Besonderhede sal bekendgemaak word sodra hierdie program gefinaliseerl is.
tgt: Details will be communicated as soon as this schedule is finalised.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die keuse van 13 vervaardigers van hernubare energie in die vierde fase van die Regering se Program vir die Verkryging van ’n Onafhanklike Kragvervaardiger van Hernubare Energie.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the selection of 13 renewable energy producers during the fourth window of government’s Renewable Energy Independent Power Producer Procurement Programme.

src: Hierdie vervaardigers van hernubare energie (sonkrag- en windkragenergie) sal 'n bykomende 1 084 megawatt voorsien ter ondersteuning van die nasionale netwerk en die land dus help om vordering te maak met langtermyn-volhoubare energievoorsiening.
tgt: These renewable energy producers (solar and wind power energy) will supply an additional 1 084 megawatts in support of the national grid and thus help the country to move closer towards a long-term sustainable energy supply.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die 2013/14-ouditresultate vir plaaslike regerings en waardeer die prestasie van munisipaliteite wat 'n bestendige verbetering toon in byna alle aspekte van die munisipale ouditresultate.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the 2013-2014 Local Government Audit Outcomes and applauds the performance of municipalities that showed a consistent improvement in almost all aspects of municipal-audit outcomes.

src: 'n Oorweldigende 96 persent van geouditeerdes (munisipaliteite en munisipale entiteite) het hul finansiële state betyds ingedien, wat 'n groot verbetering is van die 93 persent in 2012/13 en 78 persent in 2007/08.In die verslag word erken dat 'n doelbewuste poging aangewend is om onreëlmatige uitgawes die hoof te bied.
tgt: An overwhelming 96% of auditees (municipalities and municipal entities) submitted their financial statements on time, which is a major improvement from 93% in 2012/13 and 78% in 2007/08.The report recognises that a concerted effort was made to address irregular expenditure.

src: Dit is opvallend dat daar ’n beduidende toename in die aantal munisipaliteite en munisipale entiteite met ongekwalifiseerde oudits is in 2012/13 was daar 30 ongekwalifiseerde oudits, in 2013/14 was daar 58, en in 2007/08 was daar net sewe, wat dui op 'n bestendige neiging tot goeie regeringsbestuur en grondige finansiële bestuur.
tgt: Notable is the significant increase in the number of municipalities and municipal entities with unqualified audits from 30 in 2012/13 to 58 in 2013/14, with only seven in 2007/08 pointing to a steady trend towards good governance and sound financial management.

src: Geouditeerdes met finansieel ongekwalifiseerde oudits maak nou 76 persent van die totale plaaslike regering se bestedingsbegroting van R315 miljard uit.
tgt: Auditees with financially unqualified opinions now account for 76% of the total local government expenditure budget of R315 billion.

src: Dit beteken dat byna agt uit elke 10 rand wat deur plaaslike regerings bestee word deur entiteite met finansieel ongekwalifiseerde state bestee word.
tgt: This means that almost eight out of every 10 rand spent by local government is spent by entities with financially unqualified statements.

src: Van die 335 munisipaliteite en entiteite wat geouditeer is, het 102 verbeter, 194 het konstant gebly, en 27 het agteruitgegaan, terwyl twee nuut is en 10 nog uitstaande is.
tgt: Of the 335 municipalities and entities audited, 102 improved, 194 remained constant, 27 regressed while two were new and 10 were still outstanding.

src: Dit versterk meer doeltreffende en verantwoordbare basiese dienslewering ooreenkomstig die benadering van “keer terug na die basiese beginsels".Die Kabinet verwelkom dat daar as deel van die strategie om terug te keer na die basiese beginsels, spesiale aandag gegee sal word aan die 50 munisipaliteite wat ongunstige oudit-opinies ontvang, veral die 25 wat die afgelope vyf jaar ongunstige opinies ontvang het.
tgt: This reinforces more efficient and accountable basic service delivery in line with the ‘Back to Basics’ approach.

src: Die Kabinet het ook sy kommer uitgespreek oor die munisipaliteite wat steeds ongekwalifiseerde mense in diens neem en sodoende goeie bestuurspraktyke ondermyn.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes that as part of the Back to Basics Strategy, special attention will be given to the 50 municipalities that received disclaimed audit opinions, particularly the 25 that received disclaimed opinions for the past five years.

src: Die Minister van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake sal in samewerking met die munisipaliteite die proses waarvolgens oplossings vir hierdie probleme gesoek word, bespoedig.
tgt: Cabinet also expresses its concern over those municipalities that continue to employ unqualified people and thereby undermine good governance practices.

src: Belangrike kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet keur die Strategiese Regrukplan van die Suid-Afrikaanse Poskantoor (SAPO) goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Strategic Turnaround Plan of the South African Post Office (SAPO).

src: Hierdie plan het gehelp om vas te stel wat die grondliggende oorsake van die probleme is en het ook strategiese ingrypings om die entiteit reg te ruk geïdentifiseer.
tgt: This plan has assisted in diagnosing the root causes of problems and also identified key strategic interventions to turn the entity around.

src: 'n Nuwe besigheidsmodel word ontwikkel om die oor-afhanklikheid van posbedrywighede te verminder en na 'n meer gebalanseerde verdeling van inkomste oor te skakel.
tgt: A new business model is being developed to reduce over reliance on mail business and move towards a balanced revenue mix.

src: Die Kabinet vertrou dat hierdie strategie sal help om SAPO vooruit te laat gaan.
tgt: Cabinet is confident the strategy will move the SAPO forward.

src: Die Minister van Telekommunikasie en Posdienste, in samewerking met SAPO se bestuur, sal 'n spesiale mediakonferensie hou om die plan te bespreek.
tgt: The Minister of Telecommunications and Postal Services, together with the management of the SAPO, will hold a special media briefing to unpack the plan.

src: Die Kabinet keur die terugvoer goed oor Suid-Afrika se eerste verslag oor die implementering van die Afrika-handves vir die Regte en Welsyn van Kinders (2000-2013), wat in die Parlement ter tafel gelê sal word.
tgt: Cabinet approved that the feedback received on South Africa’s initial report on the implementation of the African Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child (2000-2013), be tabled in Parliament.

src: Die verslag is van Afrika se Komitee van Deskundiges oor die Regte en Welsyn van Kinders ontvang.
tgt: This report was received from the African Committee of Experts on the Rights and Welfare of the Child.

src: Die Kabinet onderskryf die bestuursmeganismes wat 'n geïntegreerde, samehangende en deelnemende benadering tot die implementering van die Afrika-handves oor die Regte en Welsyn van Kinders in ooreenstemming met die grondwetlike regte van kinders sal verseker.
tgt: Cabinet endorsed the governance mechanisms to ensure an integrated, coherent and participatory approach to the implementation of the African Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child in compliance to the constitutional rights of children.

src: Voorlegging van Suid-Afrika se verslag is in ooreenstemming met die wette en verpligtinge rakende internasionale verdrae.
tgt: Submission of South Africa’s report is in line with international treaty laws and obligations.

src: Hierdie verslag dien ook as 'n barometer wat Suid-Afrika se vordering met die handhawing van kinders se regte en welstand aandui.
tgt: This report also serves as a barometer on how the nation is progressing on upholding children’s rights and well-being.

src: Die Kabinet prys die suksesvolle aanbieding van die Wêreld Ekonomiese Forum (WEF) Afrika in Kaapstad verlede week, wat bevestig dat die land 'n wêreldklas internasionale bestemming vir hoëprofiel-geleenthede is.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on current issues Cabinet commends the successful hosting of the World Economic Forum (WEF) Africa in Cape Town last week, which reaffirms that the country is a world-class international destination for high profile events.

src: WEF-Afrika dien as 'n platform vir die Regering om Suid-Afrika as 'n beleggings- en sakebestemming ten toon te stel, wat van deurslaggewende belang is om aan die doel van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP) te voldoen.
tgt: WEF Africa provided a platform for government to showcase South Africa as an investment and business destination, which is critical to meeting the objective of the National Development Plan (NDP).Cabinet also welcomes the significant role played by the media sector in ensuring that information from this critical event was carried across various platforms to allow issues to resonate with South Africans.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom ook die belangrike rol van die mediasektor wat verseker dat inligting oor hierdie belangrike gebeurtenis oor verskeie platforms versprei word sodat Suid-Afrikaners daarmee kan identifiseer.
tgt: South Africa’s credit rating at BBB by Fitch Ratings reaffirms that the country remains open to foreign investment and further demonstrates government’s commitment to prudent fiscal management.

src: Suid-Afrika se kredietgradering op BBB deur Fitch Ratings bevestig dat die land oop bly vir buitelandse beleggings en dui ook op die Regering se verbintenis tot omsigtige fiskale bestuur.
tgt: Meanwhile, the issues raised by Fitch are receiving government’s attention at the highest level.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van die publikasie Meia Landscape 2014 – Celebrating 20 Years of South Africa’s Meia, wat verskeie aspekte van die inspirerende afgelope 21 jaar waarin die media 'n deurslaggewende rol gespeel het, vasvang.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the Media Landscape 2014 – Celebrating 20 Years of South Africa’s Media, which captures various aspects of the inspiring past 21 years in which media have played a critical role.

src: Elke hoofstuk neem die medialandskap sedert 1994 in oënskou en besin oor hoe ver ons gevorder het, met inagneming van toekomstige uitdagings.
tgt: Each chapter considers the media landscape from 1994 and reflects on how far we have come, while considering future challenges.

src: Die meerderheid belanghebbendes stem saam dat hierdie sektor heelwat bereik het.
tgt: Most of the stakeholders agree that much has been achieved in this discipline.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep om mense in die media, akademici, die burgerlike samelewing en die Regering om Meia Landscape 2014, te lees dit ontlok ingeligte debatvoering en besprekings oor die rol van die media in 'n demokratiese Suid-Afrika oor die afgelope 20 jaar.
tgt: Cabinet urges those in the media, academia, civil society and government to read Media Landscape 2014, which provokes informed debate and discussion on the 20 years of the media in a democratic South Africa.

src: Die publikasie bied 'n objektiewe en eerlike oorsig oor die land se mediasektor.
tgt: The publication offers an objective and honest account of the country’s media sector.

src: In die opstelproses het dit goeie samewerking tussen die Regering en die mediabedryf deur leiers en organisasies in die burgerlike samelewing teweeggebring.
tgt: In the drafting process it fostered strong collaboration between government and the media industry, through leaders and civil society organisations.

src: Die Kabinet bevestig sy vertroue in die Nasionale Vervolgingsgesag (NVG) om sy pligte as 'n mandaat van ons Grondwet doeltreffend uit te voer, ondanks die onlangse verandering in leierskap.
tgt: Cabinet affirms its confidence in the National Prosecuting Authority (NPA) to effectively execute its duties as mandated by our Constitution despite the recent change in its leadership.

src: Die NVG voer sy werk standvastig uit, en het die betrokke strukture en stelsels in plek om steeds 'n misdaadvrye samelewing te bevorder.
tgt: The NPA remains steadfast in its work, and has the relevant structures and systems in place to continue to promote a crime-free society.

src: In 2014 het die organisasie sy skuldigbevindingskoers in al die howe verbeter, met 93,6 persent (273 641 gevalle) in distrikshowe, 76 persent (27 246 gevalle) in plaaslike howe en 88 persent (911 gevalle) in al die hoë howe.
tgt: In 2014 the organisation improved its conviction rate at all court levels with per cent (273 641 cases) at district courts, 76 per cent (27 246 cases) at regional courts and 88 per cent (911 cases) at all high courts.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van die eerste Suid-Afrikaanse Stigma-opname by die 7de Suid-Afrikaanse Vigskonferensie wat tans in Durban gehou word.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the release of the first South African Stigma Survey focusing on attitudes around HIV and AIDS and TB at the 7th South African AIDS Conference, which is currently underway in Durban.

src: Die Stigma-opname, wat op gesindhede rondom MIV en vigs en TB fokus, is die omvattendste in die wêreld en bied praktiese en innoverende opredes en programme om stigma en diskriminasie teen mense wat met MIV en TB leef teen te werk.
tgt: The Stigma Survey, which is the largest in the world, provides practical and innovative actions and programmes to counter stigma and discrimination against people living with HIV and TCabinet welcomed the success of Child Protection Week (CPW) and reiterates that our children are a bedrock of our country’s future and urges communities to protect them against neglect and abuse.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die sukses van Kinderbeskermingsweek en benadruk dat ons kinders 'n hoeksteen van ons land se toekoms is ’n dringende beroep word dus op gemeenskappe gedoen om kinders teen verwaarlosing en mishandeling te beskerm.
tgt: Furthermore, Cabinet conveys its gratitude to all government agencies, civil society and social partners who are working tirelessly even beyond CPW to sensitise communities on protecting our children.

src: Die Kabinet bedank ook alle regeringsagentskappe, die burgerlike samelewing en maatskaplike vennote wat selfs buite Kinderbeskermingsweek onvermoeid werk om gemeenskappe se bewustheid van kinderbeskerming te verhoog.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the strong turnaround at Telkom in which government is a major shareholder, owning a 40% stake.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die beduidende ommekeer by Telkom waarin die Regering 'n belangrike 40%-aandeel het.
tgt: The company’s turnaround has led to strong growth in revenue and a dividend for the first time since 2011 of 245 cents.

src: Die Kabinet is geëvalueer ten opsigte van die implementering van die wysigings tot die immigrasiewetgewing en die immigrasieregulasies van 2014, insluitend die vereistes om met kinders deur Suid-Afrikaanse grensposte te reis, wat op 1 Junie 2015 in werking getree het.
tgt: Cabinet was appraised with the implementation of the recent immigration legislation amendments and the immigration regulations of 2014, including the requirements for travelling with children through South Africa’s ports of entry, which came into operation on 1 June 2015.Cabinet has however noted the views expressed by various sectors.

src: Die Kabinet het egter kennis geneem van die menings wat deur verskeie sektore uitgespreek is.
tgt: In order to hear these views, Cabinet has resolved to set up a team of Ministers from both the economic and security clusters.

src: Om hierdie menings aan te hoor, het die Kabinet besluit om 'n span van ministers van die ekonomiese en sekuriteitsgroeperings byeen te roep.
tgt: The team is expected to discuss and engage with the concerns with the aim of finding ways to address the unintended consequences brought about by the implementation of this regulations.

src: Die span sal deur Minister Malusi Gigaba byeengeroep word,.Hierbenewens sal die Inter-Ministeriële Komitee oor Migrasie ook voortgaan met sy werk en alle aspekte rakende immigrante in die land in heroënskou neem.
tgt: In addition, the Inter-Ministerial Committee on Migration will also continue with its work to relook at all the aspects relating to migrants that are in the country.

src: Dit sal help om sinergie te bewerkstellig tussen migrasie en wetgewing.
tgt: This work will assist to provide synergy between migration and our laws.

src: Toekomsige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: President Jacob Zuma sal die Jeugdagvieringe, wat op 16 Junie 2015 by die Tshwane Events Centre in Gauteng gehou word onder die tema: “Jeug laat Suid-Afrika vorentoe beweeg", bywoon.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will attend Youth Day celebrations on 16 June 2015 at the Tshwane Events Centre, Gauteng under the theme: “Youth moving South Africa forward”.

src: Die President sal ook op 23 Junie 2015 ’n Siyahlola-besoek na die Suid-kampus van die Tshwane Universiteit vir Tegnologie in Soshanguve, Gauteng onderneem.
tgt: The President will also conduct a Siyahlola visit to the Tshwane University of Technology South Campus at Soshanguve, Gauteng on 23 June 2015.

src: Hierdie moniteringsbesoek sal op inisiatiewe en tussenkomste fokus wat ons jeug se lewens verbeter en om hulle te bemagtig om meer betekenisvol by die land se ekonomie betrokke te raak.
tgt: This monitoring visit will focus on initiatives and interventions implemented to improve the lives of our youth and empower them to better participate in the economy of our country.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op jong mense om voordeel te trek uit geleenthede wat deur regeringsprogramme soos die Gemeenskapswerkeprogram gebied word, wat wys hoe vennootskappe 'n verskil aan gemeenskapsinfrastruktuur en -dienste maak, en ook tydelike werkgeleenthede tot volhoubare werkgeleenthede laat groei danksy die oordrag en ontwikkeling van vaardighede.
tgt: Cabinet calls on young people to take advantage of opportunities offered by government programmes such as the Community Works Programme, which demonstrates how partnerships make a difference to community infrastructure and services, and also grows work opportunities into sustainable jobs due to the transfer and development of skills.

src: Deur die Nasionale Jeugontwikkelingsagentskap het meer jong mense ook toegang tot die hoofstroomekonomie deur programme wat bystand aan jong entrepreneurs bied.
tgt: Through the National Youth Development Agency, more young people are also being brought into the mainstream economy through their programmes that provide support to young entrepreneurs.

src: Suid-Afrika sal op 23 Junie 2015 by die res van Afrika aansluit om Afrika-staatsdiensdag te vier onder die tema: "Die rol van openbare dienste in vrouebemagtiging, innovering en toeganklik dienslewering".
tgt: South Africa will join the continental-wide celebrations on 23 June 2015 to mark Africa Public Service Day under the theme: “The Role of Public Services in Women Empowerment, Innovation and Accessible Service Delivery”.

src: Die NOP het ook die verbetering van die Staat se vermoë geïdentifiseer as van deurslaggewende belang om Visie 2030 te bererik.
tgt: The NDP also identified enhancing the capability of the State as being critical to achieving Vision 2030.

src: Sedert 1994 is heelwat vordering gemaak met die verteenwoordiging van vroue in senior bestuursposte in die Staatsdiens, wat in Maart 2014 op 39,8 persent gestaan het .
tgt: Since 1994 the country has also made great strides with the representation of women in senior management positions in the Public Service, which was at per cent in March 2014.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om op 20 Junie 2015 by die Regering aan te sluit vir Wêreld Vlugtelingedag, om die land se internasionale verbintenis te herbevestig om alle vlugtelinge met waardigheid te behandel.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to join government on World Refugee Day, 20 June 2015, in reaffirming the country’s international commitment to treat all refugees with dignity.

src: As 'n ondertekenaar van die 1951 Geneefse Konvensie oor Vlugtelinge en as 'n land wat menseregte koester, het ons 'n verpligting om die basiese regte van vlugtelinge binne ons grense te beskerm.
tgt: As a signatory to the 1951 Geneva Refugee Convention and as a country that cherishes human rights, we have an obligation to protect the basic rights of refugees within our borders.

src: In baie gevalle is dit kwesbare mans, vroue en kinders wat gedwing is om uit hul tuislande te vlug en dit aangepak het met moed, krag en vasberadenheid.
tgt: In many instances these are vulnerable men, women and children who have been forced to flee their homelands and have done so with great courage, strength and determination.

src: Die Departement van Binnelandse Sake, saam met ander staatsdepartemente en agentskappe, sal Operasie Pyramid op 19 Junie 2015 by Skukuza in Mpumalanga van stapel stuur onder die tema: "Werk saam vir veilige grense".
tgt: The Department of Home Affairs, together with other government departments and agencies, will launch Operation Pyramid on 19 June 2015 at Skukuza, Mpumalanga under the theme: “Working together for safe and secure borders”.

src: Operasie Pyramid sal die Regering en sy agentskappe se grensprojekte, -programme en -tussenkomste beter koördineer en belyn.
tgt: Operation Pyramid will better coordinate and align government’s and its agencies’ border projects, programmes and interventions.

src: Hierdie oorgangsinisiatief sal in werking wees tot die geskeduleerde vestiging van die Grensbestuuragentskap in 2017.
tgt: This transitional initiative will be operational until the scheduled establishment of the Border Management Agency in 2017.

src: Die veilige, doeltreffende en doelmatige bestuur van die oorgrensbeweging van mense en goedere sal onderneem word in ooreenstemming met die land se NODie 60ste herdenking van die Vryheidsmanifes, wat op 26 Junie 2015 herdenk word, sal gebruik word om die vordering wat met die verwesenliking van sy ideale gemaak is te demonstreer en om belyning tussen die Regering se beleid en hierdie geskiedkundige dokument aan te dui.
tgt: The secure, effective and efficient management of the cross-border movement of people and goods will be done in a manner that is consistent with the country’s national development priorities.

src: Die Vryheidsmanifes is 'n fondament waarop ons wêreld-bekroonde Grondwet gegrond is vandag gee dit uitvoering aan die land wat ons deur ons beleid en programme bou.
tgt: The 60th anniversary of the Freedom Charter, which will be marked on 26 June 2015, will be used to demonstrate progress made towards realising its ideals, and to show alignment between government policies and this historic document.

src: Implementering van belangrike regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of Key Government Programmes.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die besluite wat by die 25ste Spitsberaad van die Afrika-unie (AU) geneem is, wat Afrika op 'n nuwe pad van ontwikkeling en groei plaas, en die vasteland in staat sal stel om sy regmatige plek in wêreldsake in te neem.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the resolutions adopted at the 25th African Union (AU) Summit which places Africa on a new path of development and growth that will enable the continent to take its rightful place in global affairs.

src: Onder die besluite wat geneem is, is die vestiging van 'n verenigde en funksionerende enkele militêre mag teen die einde van die jaar.
tgt: Resolutions included a united and functioning single military by the end of the year.

src: Leiers het onderneem om die inwerkingstelling van die Afrika-bystandsmag (ABM) te versnel.
tgt: Leaders pledged to accelerate the operationalisation of the African Standby Force (ASF).Cabinet applauded the initiative by the AU towards greater regional integration and trade through the launch of negotiations for the establishment of a continental free trade area that will forge stronger ties between African economies.

src: Die Kabinet prys die inisiatief van die AU om groter streekintegrasie en handel te bevorder, deur onderhandelings vir die vestiging van 'n kontinentale vryhandelgebied wat sterker bande tussen Afrika se ekonomieë sal bewerkstellig.2 Die Kabinet verwelkom die byeenkoms van AU-ministers verantwoordelik vir Gender- en Vrouesake, wat op 12 Junie 2015 vergader het, na afloop van die tweede AU-hoëvlakpaneel oor Geslagsgelykheid en Vrouebemagtiging van 10 tot 12 Junie 2015 aangrensend tot die 25ste gewone sessie van die AU-vergadering, onder die tema: "Laat dit gebeur deur die finansiële insluiting van vroue in die agribesigheidsektor".Die uitkoms van die twee vergaderings was 'n verklaring en 'n oproep tot aksie om finansiële insluiting van vroue in agribesighede.
tgt: Cabinet also welcomed the meeting of the African Union Ministers Responsible for Gender and Women’s Affairs held their meeting on the 12th of June 2015, following the 2nd AU High Level Panel on Gender Equality and Women’s Empowerment (HLP) which was held from the 10th – 12th of June 2015 at the margins of the 25th Ordinary Session of the AU Assembly, under the Theme: “Make it Happen Through the Financial Inclusion of Women in the Agribusiness Sector”.The outcome of the 2 meetings was a Declaration and a Call for Action on Financial Inclusion in Agribusiness.

src: Die oproep tot aksie doen ’n beroep op lidstate om onder meer die volgende te doen:Implementeer vroue se reg tot toegang, beheer, eienaarskap en voordeel met betrekking tot finansiële hulpbronne, insluitend toegang tot prosesse van openbare verkryging in onderwys, inligting en vaardigheidsontwikkeling, asook innoverende tegnologieë en praktyke, om kapasiteit te bou en vroue se ekonomiese bemagtiging in agribesigheid te ontwikkel.
tgt: The Call for Action calls Member States to among othersImplement women’s right to access, control, ownership and benefit from financial resources, including access to public procurement processes in Education, information and skills development, innovative technologies and practices, to capacitate and develop women’s economic empowerment in agribusinessIntensify initiatives to create a conducive environment for women to conduct agribusiness and the agricultural value chain through prevention and responding to conflict on the Continent, addressing, adapting and mitigating climate change impacts, and addressing the impact of epidemics and natural disasters.

src: Versterk inisiatiewe om 'n bevorderlike omgewing vir vroue te skep sodat hulle agri-ondernemings kan bedryf en deel kan word van die landbou-waardeketting, deurdat konflik op die vasteland voorkom word en daarop gereageer word die uitwerking van klimaatsverandering hanteer word, aangepas en verminder word en die impak van epidemiese en natuurlike rampe verminder word.
tgt: Facilitate the development of agribusiness and agricultural value chains through mechanisation, technological innovation and skills development for women1.3 In a few months, matric learners will be seating for their final year examinations.

src: Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van agribesigheid en landbou-waardekettings deur meganisasie, tegnologiese innovering en vaardigheidsontwikkeling vir vroue.
tgt: Cabinet calls on the Class of 2015 to apply early for admission to institutions of higher learning as part of the Apply Now/ Khetha Career Guidance Campaign that is undertaken annually by the Department of Higher Education and Training.

src: Ons doen ’n beroep op leerders om ook Wiskunde en Wetenskap as studierigtings wat ons ekonomie na hoër hoogtes kan neem, te oorweeg.
tgt: We urge learners to also consider Mathematics and Science as fields that will take our economic growth to higher levels.

src: Kreatiwiteit en innovering is die belangrikste ekonomiese aandrywers in 'n land.
tgt: Creativity and Innovation are key economic drivers in a country.

src: Jeugdiges moet benewens universiteite ook geleenthede by kolleges vir tegniese onderwys en beroepsopleiding wat regoor die land beskikbaar is, verken insluitend die nuutgestigte Sol T Plaatje Universiteit in die Noord-Kaap en die Universiteit van Mpumalanga.
tgt: Young people must also explore opportunities that are available at Technical and Vocational Education Training colleges situated across the country in addition to universities, which include the newly established Sol T Plaatje University in the Northern Cape and the University of Mpumalanga.

src: Die Kabinet bekragtig die besluit om die Maluti-A-Phofung Nywerheidsonwikkelingsone (MAP-NOS) by Tshiame (Industriqwa-1A), aan Harrismith in die Vrystaat toe te wys.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.1 Cabinet ratified the decision to designate the Maluti-A-Phofung Industrial Development Zone (MAP IDZ) at Tshiame (Industriqwa-1A), Harrismith, Free State Province.

src: Die verlening van die bedryfspermit vir hierdie sone aan die Vrystaat Ontwikkelingkorporasie is ook goedgekeur.
tgt: It also approved the granting of Operator Permit for this zone to the Free State Development CorporatioThe MAP IDZ designation will establish a logistics-orientated platform (Logistics Hub) 10 kilometers outside of Harrismith (the old Industriqwa site), primarily to service the automotive, light manufacturing, agro-processing and distribution/ logistics sectors.2 Cabinet approved that South Africa joins the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat Suid-Afrika by die Asiatiese Infrastruktuur-beleggingsbank aansluit.
tgt: The Bank focuses on Asian and Oceanic Region in supporting the infrastructure investments.

src: Suid-Afrika se deelname sal sy groeiende sakeverhoudings met die streek versterk en sal sodoende ook sy solidariteit met die ontwikkelingsaspirasies van die streek demonstreer.3 Die Kabinet het die toewysing van die ministers van Justisie en Korrektiewe Dienste en van Polisie goedgekeur as verantwoordelik vir die nakoming van die Staat se verpligting ten opsigte van artikel 9(2) van die Wet op die Voorkoming en Bestryding van Marteling, 2013.Albei Ministers sal verantwoordelik wees vir die ontwikkeling van programme wat daarop gemik is om die martel van mense te voorkom en te bestry, wat mense se fundamentele reg tot vryheid en sekerheid, ingevolge artikel 12 van die Grondwet, verseker.
tgt: South Africa’s participation will strengthen its growing business relationships with the region and will also demonstrate solidarity with the region’s development aspirations.3 Cabinet approved the designation of the Ministers of Justice and Correctional Services and Police as responsible for the fulfillment of the State’s responsibilities in terms of section 9(2) of the Prevention and Combating of Torture of Persons Act, 2013.Both Ministers will be responsible for the development of programmes aimed at preventing and combating of torture which promotes the fundamental right to freedom and security of the person as provided for in section 12 of the Constitution.4 Cabinet approved submission of the Additional Protocol to the Trade, Development and Cooperation Agreement between the European Community and its Members States to Parliament for ratification.

src: Die Kabinet keur die voorlegging aan die Parlement goed van die Aanvullend Protokol tot die Handels-, Ontwikkelings- en Samewerkingsooreenkoms tussen die Europese Gemeenskap en sy Staatspartye.
tgt: The Additional Protocol takes into account the accession of the Republic of Croatia to the European Union (EU) which join later into the Protocol.

src: Die aanvullende protokol neem die toetrede van die Republiek van Kroasië na die Europese Unie (EU), wat later by die protokol sal aansluit, in ag.
tgt: The enlargement of the EU will improve SA’s market access into the EU, which will lead to creation of job opportunities, fostering economic growth, and improve consumer choices.

src: Die uitbreiding van die EU sal Suid-Afrika se toegang tot EU-markte verbeter, wat tot werkskeppingsgeleenthede, sterker ekonomiese groei en ’n wyer verskeidenheid van verbruikerskeuses sal lei.
tgt: This is in line with the National Development Plan vision of creating employment, growing the economy and promotion of exports.5 Cabinet approved that the relevant international standards and other scientific measures be implemented with a view to ensuring adequate risk management is applied when importing cattle and bovine products.

src: Dit strook met die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan se visie vir werkskepping, ekonomiese groei en die bevordering van uitvoere.5 Die Kabinet keur goed dat die toepaslike internasionale standaarde en ander wetenskaplike maatreëls geïmplementeer word met die doel om te verseker dat voldoende risikobestuur toegepas word wanneer beeste en beesprodukte ingevoer word.
tgt: This alignment of South Africa’s import requirements with international scientific guidelines, will strengthen the county’s position in international trade.

src: Dit sal deur middel van strategiese aankope wyer toegang tot voldoende, veilige en voedsame kos vir mense en diere bied, en sal werkskepping verbeter deur die invoer van beesvleisprodukte vir verdere verwerking in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: This will broaden access to sufficient, safe and nutritious food for people and animals through strategic sourcing and will increase job creation through importation of beef products intended for further processing in South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet keur die bekendstelling van die Kriminele Aangeleenthede Wysigingswetsontwerp, 2015 in die Parlement goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the introduction of the Criminal Matters Amendment Bill, 2015 into Parliament.

src: Die wysigings maak voorsiening vir veranderinge aan die wette met betrekking tot infrastruktuur-verwante oortredings soos kabeldiefstal van telefoonlyne.
tgt: The amendments provide for changes to the laws pertaining to infrastructure-related offences such cable theft, telephone lines.

src: Strenger bepalings word voorsien vir die toestaan van borgtog en vonnisoplegging van oortreders, asook vir die skep van 'n nuwe misdryf, wat skade kriminaliseer wat deur kriminele aktiwiteite aan noodsaaklike infrastruktuur aangerig word deur peuter of inmeng met die funksionering van basiese dienste.
tgt: Stricter provisions are provided for the granting of bail, sentencing of offenders and creating a new offence to criminalise damage to essential infrastructure caused by tampering or interfering with the functioning of basic services through criminal activity.

src: Wanneer die wetsontwerp goedgekeur is, sal dit verseker dat meganismes in plek gestel word om die infrastruktuur waarin broodnodige openbare belegging geplaas is, te beveilig en te verseker dat die land sy ekonomiese groei- en werkskeppingsteikens bereik.2 Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp vir die Bevordering en Beskerming van Beleggings, 2015 aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: The bill once passed will ensures that mechanisms are put in place to safeguard infrastructure, in which much needed public investment is placed, to ensure that the country meets its economic growth targets and increases employment.

src: Die wetsontwerp herbevestig dat Suid-Afrika oop bly vir buitelandse beleggings, voldoende sekuriteit en beskerming aan alle beleggers bied, en die soewereine reg van die Suid-Afrikaanse Regering bewaar om openbare beleidsdoelwitte wat ontwikkeling en transformasie bevorder, na te streef.
tgt: Cabinet approved the introduction of the revised Promotion and Protection of Investment Bill, 2015 into Parliament.

src: Dit is ter ondersteuning van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP) se doelwit om beleggings- en uitvoergroei te bevorder om volhoubare groei en ontwikkeling in Suid-Afrika te stimuleer.3 Die Kabinet keur die publikasie van die Wysigingswet op Outeursreg, 2015 in die Staatskoerant vir wyer konsultasie goed.
tgt: The Bill reaffirms that South Africa remains open to foreign investment, provides adequate security and protection to all investors, and preserves the sovereign right of the South African Government to pursue developmental and transformational public policy objectives.

src: Die Wysigingswet verander die Wet op Outeursreg, No 98 van 1978 en die Wet op die Beskerming van Uitvoerende Kunstenaars, No 11 van 1967.
tgt: This is in support of the National Development Plan’s (NDP) objective of promoting investment and export growth to stimulate sustainable growth and development in South Africa.

src: Hierdie wette is verouderd, aangesien hulle nie ontwikkelings op multilaterale vlak in ag neem nie, en nie bepalings het wat digitale kwessies hanteer nie.
tgt: The Bill amends the Copyright Act, No 98 of 1978 and the Performers Protection Act, No 11 of 1967, which are outdated as they do not consider developments at multi-lateral level nor do they have provisions that deal with digital issues.

src: Die wetsontwerp hanteer die lisensiëring van kopieregmateriaal met betrekking tot opdragwerk om kommersiële uitbuiting te voorkom.
tgt: The Bill addresses the licensing of copyright work/ material in relation to commissioned work to prevent commercial exploitation.

src: Dit sal die Regering help om die lot van musikante en kunstenaars te verbeter deur te verseker dat tantieme betyds deur die opnamemaatskappye en uitsaaiers aan hulle betaal word, aangesien baie van hulle as armlastiges sterf.4 Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp op die Staatsdienskommissie, 2015 aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: This will help government to address the plight of musicians and performers by ensuring that royalties are paid on time by recording companies and broadcasters as most of them are dying as paupers.

src: Dit wysig die Wet op die Staatsdienskommissie, 46 van 1997.Die wysigingswetsontwerp handel oor die hernuwing van 'n kommissaris se termyn en maak ook voorsiening vir die voorsitter om een van die kommissarisse aan te wys om as die voorsitter op te tree tydens die afwesigheid van beide die voorsitter en die ondervoorsitter.
tgt: Cabinet approved the introduction of the Public Service Commission Amendment Bill, 2015 to Parliament.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die Kubaanse Vyf, wat in 1998 in die VSA in hegtenis geneem is en skuldig bevind is aan misdade wat wissel van spioenasie tot moord.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on current issues Cabinet welcomes the Cuban Five who were arrested in the US in 1998 and convicted of crimes ranging from espionage to murder.

src: Die vyf is na die VSA gestuur as deel van 'n netwerk genaamd La Red Avispa om die aktiwiteite van die militante Kubaanse ballingskapgroepe te ondersoek wat saamgesweer het om Fidel Castro se regime omver te werp.2 Die Kabinet bedank die Regering van Malawi, verteenwoordig deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Hoë Kommissaris me Cassandra Mbuyane-Mokone, vir die repatriasie van die twee Suid-Afrikaanse kinders (14) en (20), wat in Julie 2014 uit die sorg van hul ouma in Mpumalanga verwyder is en na Malawi geneem is deur 'n vrou wat haar as 'n voormalige onderwyser voorgedoen het.
tgt: The five were sent to the USA as part of a network called La Red Avispa to investigate the activities of militant Cuban exile groups plotting to overthrow Fidel Castro’s regime.

src: Die Minister van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling, Bathabile Dlamini, ontvang die kinders vandag.
tgt: Cabinet thanks the government of Malawi represented by the SA Higher Commissioner Ms Cassandra Mbuyane-Mokone for facilitating the repatriation of the two South African children (14) and a (20) who were removed from the care of their grandmother in Mpumalanga to Malawi in July 2014 by a woman who posed as a former teacher.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om deel te neem aan die viering van Nelson Mandela-maand in Julie onder die tema: "Maak elke dag ’n Mandela-dag: Ons gee 67 minute van ons tyd om mense in nood te help".
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to participate in the upcoming celebration of Nelson Mandela Month in July under the theme: “Make everyday a Mandela Day: Contributing 67 minutes of our time to help those in need.” Each South African holds the potential to expand on the legacy of our late former President Nelson Mandela by making a difference in the lives of WEBTOKEN the spirit of Madiba’s legacy let us also work together as we mark Social Cohesion Month in July to develop a cohesive society by promoting the ideals of non-racialism, non-sexism, justice and equality for all as envisioned and espoused in our Constitution.

src: Elke Suid-Afrikaner het die potensiaal om voort te bou op die nalatenskap van Oudpresident Nelson Mandela deur 'n verskil in die lewens van ander te maak.
tgt: As part of celebrating and honoring outstanding contributions to science, engineering, technology and innovation, the Minister of Science and Technology Minister Naledi Pandor will host a gala dinner to announce the winners of the 2014/15 National Science and Technology Forum – BHP Billiton Awards on 9 July 2015 at Emperors Palace, Kempton Park under the theme: “Light”.These awards were launched in 1988.

src: Laat ons in die gees van Madiba se nalatenskap ook Sosiale Samehorigheidsmaand in Julie vier en saamwerk om 'n samehangende gemeenskap te ontwikkel deur die ideale van nie-rassigheid, nie-seksisme, geregtigheid en gelykheid vir almal te bevorder ooreenkomstig die visie van ons Grondwet.2 As deel van die viering van en waardering vir die uitstaande bydraes wat gemaak is ten opsigte van die wetenskap, ingenieurswese, tegnologie en innovasie, sal die Minister van Wetenskap en Tegnologie, Naledi Pandor, 'n gala-dinee op 9 Julie 2015 by Emperors Palace in Kemptonpark hou om die wenners van die 2014/15 Nasionale Forum vir Wetenskap en Tegnologie se BHP Billiton-toekennings aan te kondig onder die tema "Lig".Hierdie toekennings is in 1988 van stapel gestuur.
tgt: In celebration of this year’s UNESCO theme of “The International Year of Light and Light-based Technologies”, a Special Award will be presented to Photonics-related research.

src: Ter viering van vanjaar se UNESCO-tema "Die Internasionale Jaar van lig en-liggebaseerde tegnologieë", sal 'n spesiale toekenning aan Fotonika-verwante navorsing oorhandig word.
tgt: In the spirit of Africa Public Service Week taking place this week (from 22 to 26 June 2015), Cabinet would like to thank all public servants for their commitment, dedication and hard work in delivering service to our people.

src: Ons doen ’n beroep op alle staatsamptenare om hulself opnuut daartoe te verbind om aan die behoeftes van alle Suid-Afrikaners te voldoen.
tgt: We call on all public servants to recommit themselves to meet the needs of all South Africans.

src: Suid-Afrika se standpunt oor die Internasionale Strafhof-kwessieDie Kabinet het weens verskeie redes besluit om Suid-Afrika se deelname aan die Roomse Statuut van die Internasionale Strafhof (ICC) te hersien.
tgt: South Africa’s position on the ICC matterCabinet, decided that it would review South Africa’s participation in the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court, for a number of reasons.

src: Suid-Afrika was nog altyd 'n stoere ondersteuner van die stigting van die Internasionale Strafhof en een van die eerste ondertekenaars van die Roomse Statuut van die Internasionale Strafhof.
tgt: South Africa was always a staunch supporter of the establishment of the International Criminal Court and one of the first signatories of the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court.

src: Die Regering bly verbind tot 'n stelsel van internasionale reg "om te verseker dat die mees ernstige en kommerwekkende misdade vir die internasionale gemeenskap as 'n geheel nie ongestraf moet bly nie, en dat die doeltreffende vervolging van sulke misdade verseker moet word deur die neem van maatreëls op nasionale vlak en deur die verbetering van internasionale samewerking.
tgt: It remains committed to a system of international justice “to ensure that the most serious crimes of concern to the international community as a whole must not go unpunished and that their effective prosecution must be ensured by taking measures at the national level and by enhancing international cooperation.”South Africa will continue to promote and encourage regional and international initiatives to deal with such crimes.

src: Suid-Afrika is 'n lid van die Byeenkoms van Staatspartye wat deur artikel 112(1) van die Roomse Statuut van die Internasionale Strafhof gestig is.
tgt: South Africa is a member of the Assembly of States Parties established by Article 112(1) of the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court.

src: Suid-Afrika is ook 'n lid van die Verenigde Nasies (VN), die Afrika-unie (AU) en ander internasionale liggame.
tgt: South Africa is also a member of the United Nations, the African Union and other international bodies.

src: Die land neem sy internasionale verantwoordelikhede en verpligtinge baie ernstig op.
tgt: It takes its international responsibilities and obligations very seriously.

src: Suid-Afrika speel 'n belangrike rol op die vasteland van Afrika en in verskillende organisasies op die vasteland.
tgt: South Africa plays a significant role on the African continent and in various continental bodies.

src: Dit huisves ook die Pan-Afrikaanse Parlement.
tgt: It also hosts the Pan African Parliament.

src: Suid-Afrika se voormalige Minister van Binnelandse Sake is die voorsitter van die AU-Kommissie.
tgt: South Africa’s former Minister of Home Affairs is the chairperson of the African Union Commission.

src: Suid-Afrika is betrokke by vredesmissies in baie Afrika-lande soos die Demokratiese Republiek van die Kongo.
tgt: South Africa is involved in peace keeping missions in many African countries such as the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

src: Suid-Afrika is ook aktief betrokke om te verseker dat die brose vredesproses wat in Soedan en Suid-Soedan aan die gang is op dreef bly, in belang van die mense van daardie soewereine state, in ander soewereine state en in Afrika.
tgt: South Africa is also actively involved in ensuring that the fragile peace process underway in Sudan and South Sudan holds, in the interests of the people of those sovereign states and other sovereign countries and the African continent.

src: Suid-Afrika word internasionaal beskou as 'n eerlike en betroubare vredesmakelaar met sowat 3 000 Suid-Afrikaanse troepe betrokke in vredesmissies onder die vaandel van die AU en die VN.
tgt: South Africa is regarded internationally as an honest and reliable peace broker with about 3000 South African troops involved in such peace keeping missions under the auspices of the AU and the UN.

src: Suid-Afrika bevorder samewerking tussen Suid-Afrika en ander lande, asook geïntegreerde ontwikkeling op die vasteland.
tgt: South Africa promotes cooperation between South Africa and other countries and integrated development on the continent.

src: Suid-Afrika gebruik die Afrika Renaissance en Internasionale Samewerkingsfonds vir, onder meer, die bevordering van demokrasie, goeie regering en die voorkoming en oplossing van konflik.
tgt: South Africa uses the African Renaissance and International Co-operation Fund to, amongst other things, enhance the promotion of democracy, good governance and the prevention and resolution of conflict.

src: Suid-Afrika belê 'n groot deel van sy finansiële, militêre, tegniese en menslike hulpbronne in die bereiking van vrede, veiligheid en voorspoed op die vasteland van Afrika.
tgt: South Africa invests a great deal of its financial, military, technical and human resources towards achieving peace, security and prosperity on the African continent.

src: Die voordele van hierdie beleggings dring weldra deur tot die lande waar Suid-Afrika aktief is.
tgt: The benefits of these investments are slowly being realised in the countries in which South Africa is active.

src: Hierdie lande sluit Soedan en Suid-Soedan in.
tgt: These countries include Sudan and South Sudan.

src: Ondanks die feit dat Suid-Afrika 'n lid van die Byeenkoms van Staatspartye van die Roomse Statuut van die Internasionale Strafhof is, moet die land sy verpligtinge teenoor die hof balanseer met sy verpligtinge teenoor die AU en sy verpligtinge teenoor individuele state, insluitend dié in Afrika, ooreenkomstig die internasionale verdrae wat die land gesluit het.
tgt: Despite being a member of the Assembly of State Parties to the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court, South Africa has to balance its obligations to the ICC with its obligations to the African Union and its obligations to individual states, including those in Africa, in terms of the international treaties which it has concluded.

src: Suid-Afrika merk op dat selfs permanente lede van die Veiligheidsraad wat nie ondertekenaars van die Roomse Statuut van die Internasionale Strafhof is nie, volwaardig mag deelneem aan besprekings oor die ICC en verwysings deur die Veiligheidsraad van toestande in 'n land na die ICC.
tgt: South Africa notes that even Permanent Members of the Security Council which are not signatories to the Rome Statute on the International Criminal Court may participate fully in discussions on the ICC and referrals by the Security Council of a situation in a country to the ICC.

src: Daardie lande het stappe gedoen om te verseker dat hul amptenare en militêre personeel nie onderwerp word aan die jurisdiksie van die ICC nie.
tgt: Those countries have taken steps to ensure that their officials and military personnel will not be subjected to the jurisdiction of the ICC.

src: Suid-Afrika merk ook dat daar teenstrydighede in verskeie artikels in die Roomse Statuut van die Internasionale Strafhof oor vrywaring vir hoofde van state is.
tgt: South Africa also notes the contradictions in various articles in the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court on indemnity for Heads of States.

src: Artikel 27 bepaal soos volg:Irrelevante amptelike hoedanigheid.
tgt: Article 27 provides as follows: Irrelevance of official capacity.

src: Hierdie statuut is van gelyke toepassing op alle persone sonder enige onderskeid gegrond op amptelike hoedanigheid.
tgt: This Statute shall apply equally to all persons without any distinction based on official capacity.

src: In die besonder, sal ‘n persoon se amptelike hoedanigheid as hoof van 'n staat of regering, lid van 'n regering of 'n parlement, verkose verteenwoordiger of regeringsamptenaar hom in geen geval van kriminele verantwoordelikheid ingevolge hierdie statuut vrystel nie, en sal ook op sigself nie gronde wees vir die vermindering van vonnis nie.
tgt: In particular, official capacity as a Head of State or Government, a member of a Government or parliament, an elected representative or a government official shall in no case exempt a person from criminal responsibility under this Statute, nor shall it, in and of itself, constitute a ground for reduction of sentence.

src: Immuniteite of spesiale prosedure-reëls wat aan die amptelike hoedanigheid van 'n persoon gekoppel mag wees, hetsy ingevolge nasionale of internasionale wet, sal die Hof se uitoefening van sy jurisdiksie oor so 'n persoon nie verhoed nie.
tgt: Immunities or special procedural rules which may attach to the official capacity of a person, whether under national or international law, shall not bar the Court from exercising its jurisdiction over such a WEBTOKEN first glance, this article confers the ICC with jurisdiction over anyone, irrespective of that person’s official status.

src: Me die eerste oogopslag, verleen hierdie artikel jurisdiksie aan die ICC oor enige persoon, ongeag van daardie persoon se amptelike status.
tgt: However, Article 98 provides as follows: Cooperation with respect to waiver of immunity and consent to surrender.

src: Maar, artikel 98 bepaal as volg:Samewerking met betrekking tot opheffing van immuniteit en toestemming tot oorgawe.
tgt: The Court may not proceed with a request for surrender or assistance which would require the requested State to act inconsistently with its obligations under international law with respect to the State or diplomatic immunity of a person or property of a third State, unless the Court can first obtain the cooperation of that third State for the waiver of the immunity.

src: Die Strafhof mag nie voortgaan met 'n versoek om uitlewering of bystand wat van die versoekte staat sal vereis om onkonsekwent op te tree rakende sy verpligtinge onder internasionale reg ten opsigte van die land of diplomatieke immuniteit van 'n persoon of eiendom van 'n derde land nie, tensy die strafhof eers die samewerking van daardie derde land vir die opheffing van die immuniteit verkry.
tgt: The Court may not proceed with a request for surrender which would require the requested State to act inconsistently with its obligations under international agreements pursuant to which the consent of a sending State is required to surrender a person of that State to the Court, unless the Court can first obtain the cooperation of the sending State for the giving of consent for the surrender.

src: Artikel 98(2) is betekenisvol en ondubbelsinnig.
tgt: Article 98(2) is significant and unambiguous.

src: Dit stel duidelik dat die ICC nie die uitlewering van 'n persoon deur die versoekte staat mag versoek as dit daartoe sal lei dat daardie staat sy internasionale verpligtinge sal skend nie, tensy die ICC self eers die samewerking van die stuurstaat kan kry.
tgt: It clearly states that the ICC may not request the surrender of a person by the requested State, if that would result in the requested state breaching its international obligations, unless the ICC itself can first obtain the cooperation of the sending State.

src: Me ander woorde, artikel 98(2) plaas 'n verpligting op die ICC om lande te help om lasbriewe vir inhegetnisname uit te reik.
tgt: In other words, the Article 98(2) places an obligation on the ICC to assist countries to execute warrants of WEBTOKEN is abundantly clear that the ICC was aware that South Africa may have difficulties in executing the warrant of arrest for President Al-Bashir, because of its international obligations.

src: Dit is baie duidelik dat die ICC bewus was dat Suid-Afrika probleme met die uitreiking van ’n lasbrief vir die inhegtenisname van President Al-Basjir kon ervaar weens sy internasionale verpligtinge.
tgt: The ICC had on 28 May 2015, already, invited South Africa to hold consultations with it regarding the execution of the warrant of arrest in accordance with Article 97 which provides in clear and unequivocal terms that where a State Party receives a request in relation to which it identifies problems which may impede or prevent the execution of the request, that State shall consult with the Court without delay in order to resolve the matter.

src: Die ICC het Suid-Afrika reeds op 28 Me 2015 genooi om hom te raadpleeg oor die uitreik van ’n lasbrief in ooreenstemming met artikel 97, wat in duidelike en ondubbelsinnige terme bepaal dat waar 'n staatparty 'n versoek ontvang waarvolgens probleme geïdentifiseer word wat die uitvoering van die versoek kan verhoed of belemmer, daardie staat sonder versuim die strafhof kan raadpleeg om die saak op te los.
tgt: Such problems may include the fact that execution of the request in its current form would require the requested State to breach a pre-existing treaty obligation undertaken with respect to another State.

src: Die ICC moes bewus gewees het dat Suid-Afrika in die uitreiking van die lasbrief, sy bestaande verdragsverpligtinge teenoor die AU sou verbreek het.
tgt: The ICC must have been aware that South Africa would, in the execution of the warrant, breach its existing treaty obligations with the AThat must be the only plausible reason why the ICC had invited South Africa to consult with it.

src: Dit moes die enigste geloofwaardige rede gewees het waarom die ICC Suid-Afrika genooi het om hom te raadpleeg.
tgt: Having extended an invitation to South Africa to consult with it, the ICC had a duty to consult in good faith with South Africa and to assist it to comply with its obligations to the ICC and the AU.

src: Nadat 'n uitnodiging aan Suid-Afrika gerig is om hom te raadpleeg, was dit die ICC se plig om in goeder trou met Suid-Afrika oorleg te pleeg en om die land te help om sy verpligtinge teenoor die ICC en die AU na te kom.
tgt: South Africa accepted the invitation by the ICC to consult with it in terms of Article In fact, South Africa had a number of issues with the validity of and the execution of the warrants of arrest and South Africa’s international obligations which arise from its membership of the AU.

src: Suid-Afrika het die ICC se uitnodiging om hom ingevolge artikel 97 te raadpleeg, aanvaar.
tgt: South Africa is obliged to give effect to a decision taken by the AU at Sirte in Libya on 3 July 2009 that its members must not cooperate with the ICC, pursuant to the provisions of Article 98 of the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court until the Security Council has considered the request by the AThe AU has requested the Security Council to defer its decision to refer the situation in Darfur to the ICC for investigation.

src: Trouens, Suid-Afrika het verskeie kwessies geïdentifiseer rakende die geldigheid en die uitreiking van die lasbriewe vir inhegtenisname, asook ten opsigte van Suid-Afrika se internasionale verpligtinge wat uit sy lidmaatskap van die AU voortspruit.
tgt: The AU had made the request in terms of Article 16 of the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court, as the AU believes that the involvement of the ICC in the matter will pose a threat to peace and security on the African continent.

src: Suid-Afrika is verplig om uitvoering te gee aan 'n besluit wat op 3 Julie 2009 deur die AU by Sirte in Libië geneem is.
tgt: South Africa has a particular interest in the decision of the AU because of South Africa’s involvement in the peace process in Sudan and South Sudan.

src: Die AU het die versoek ingevolge artikel 16 van die Roomse Statuut van die Internasionale Strafhof gemaak, aangesien die AU glo dat die betrokkenheid van die ICC 'n bedreiging vir vrede en veiligheid in Afrika sal inhou.
tgt: South Africa accepted the invitation by the ICC to consult with it in terms of Article 97 in good faith and hoped for a constructive, fruitful and meaningful discussion on the difficulties experienced by South Africa in executing the warrant of arrest.

src: 'n Aanvanklike vergadering is op 12 Junie 2015 met die ICC gehou.
tgt: A second meeting, for that purpose, was scheduled to take place on Monday, 15 June 2015.

src: 'n Tweede vergadering vir dié doel is vir Maandag 15 Junie 2015 gereël.
tgt: However, the ICC sought an earlier meeting and such a meeting was arranged for Sunday 14 June 2015 at 12h.

src: Die werklike raadpleging ingevolge artikel 97, is geskeduleer om op daardie datum plaas te vind.
tgt: However, late on the night of Saturday, 13 June 2015, the Prosecutor of the ICC made an urgent application to the ICC in the following terms: “Prosecutor’s Urgent Request for an Order clarifying whether Article 97 Consultations with South Africa have concluded and that South Africa is under an Obligation to Immediately Arrest and Surrender Omar Al Bashir.”The Prosecutor made the Urgent Request to the ICC, without giving any notice whatsoever to South Africa.

src: "Die aanklaer het die dringende versoek aan die ICC gerig, sonder om Suid-Afrika hoegenaamd in kennis te stel.
tgt: The Prosecutor asked that details of the Urgent Request remain confidential, but that the decision of the ICC is made public.

src: Die aanklaer het gevra dat die besonderhede van die dringende versoek vertroulik bly, maar dat die besluit van die ICC openbaar gemaak word.
tgt: The ICC heard the matter immediately and issued its Decision.

src: In effek het die ICC, sonder om Suid-Afrika se saak aan te hoor, besluit dat die raadpleging ingevolge artikel 97 afgehandel is en dat Suid-Afrika onder 'n verpligting was om President Omar al-Basjhir in hegtenis te neem en uit lewer.
tgt: In effect the ICC, without hearing South Africa, decided that the Article 97 consultations had ended and that South Africa was under an obligation to arrest and surrender President Omar Al-Bashir.

src: Soos reeds genoem, is die besluit gemaak sonder enige kennisgewing aan Suid-Afrika.
tgt: That decision was made, as already mentioned, without any notice to South Africa.

src: Suid-Afrika as 'n staatparty tot die Roomse Statuut van die Internasionale Strafhof en as 'n lid van die Byeenkoms van Staatpartye is geregtig op ’n kennisgewing van die aanklaer se dringende versoek aan die ICC en om oor die saak aangehoor te word, veral aangesien die raadpleging reeds gereël was.
tgt: South Africa as a State Party to the Rome Statute on the International Criminal Court and as a member of the Assembly of State Parties was entitled to notice of the Prosecutor’s Urgent Request to the ICC and to be heard on the matter, especially as consultations had been arranged.

src: Suid-Afrika se soewereiniteit as 'n nasie dui ook daarop dat die land daarop geregtig is om gelyk en met respek behandel te word, ongeag van die omstandighede.
tgt: South Africa’s sovereignty as a nation also suggests that it is entitled to be treated equally and with respect, irrespective of to the circumstances.

src: Dit wil voorkom asof die ICC se uitnodiging aan Suid-Afrika om hom ingevolge artikel 97 te raadpleeg nie in goeder trou of in 'n ernstige en opregte poging om Suid-Afrika te help, gerig is nie.
tgt: It would appear that the ICC had not extended the invitation to South Africa to consult with it in terms of Article 97 in good faith and in a serious and sincere effort to assist South Africa.

src: Suid-Afrika het dus besluit om sy deelname aan die Roomse Statuut van die Internasionale Strafhof te hersien.
tgt: South Africa has, therefore, decided to review its participation in the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court.

src: Twee artikels in die Statuut van Rome is belangrik vir oorweging rakende die standpunt wat Suid-Afrika oor toekomstige samewerking met die ICC behoort in te neem.
tgt: Two articles in the Rome Statute are important for considering the position South Africa should take regarding its future cooperation with the ICC.

src: Dit is artikels 119 en 127.ARTIKEL 119Beslegting van geskille.
tgt: These are articles 119 and 127.ARTICLE 119Settlement of disputes.

src: Enige geskil oor die geregtelike funksies van die strafhof sal deur die beslissing van die hof geskik word.
tgt: Any dispute concerning the judicial functions of the Court shall be settled by the decision of the Court.

src: Enige ander geskil tussen twee of meer staatpartye met betrekking tot die interpretasie of toepassing van hierdie statuut, wat nie deur middel van onderhandelinge binne drie maande van hul aanvang, geskik is nie, sal na die Byeenkoms van Staatspartye verwys word.
tgt: Any other dispute between two or more States Parties relating to the interpretation or application of this Statute which is not settled through negotiations within three months of their commencement shall be referred to the Assembly of States Parties.

src: Die Vergadering kan self probeer om die geskil te besleg of kan aanbevelings maak oor aanvullende maniere om die geskil te besleg, insluitende verwysing na die Internasionale Geregshof in ooreenstemming met daardie hof se wette.
tgt: The Assembly may itself seek to settle the dispute or may make recommendations on further means of settlement of the dispute, including referral to the International Court of Justice in conformity with the Statute of that Court.

src: Artikel 119 het betrekking op twee situasies:Eerstens, geskille oor die geregtelike funksies van die ICC en tweedens, 'n geskil tussen twee of meer staatspartye met betrekking tot die vertolking of toepassing van die Roomse Statuut .Wat die eerste kwessie betref, kan Suid-Afrika wel 'n geskil met die ICC hê oor die besluit wat geneem is het op grond van die aanklaer se dringende versoek om 'n bevel om vas te stel of raadpleging ingevolge artikel 97 met Suid-Afrika afgehandel was, en dat Suid-Afrika onder 'n verpligting was om President Omar al-Basjir onmiddellik in hegtenis te neem en uit te lewer.
tgt: Article 119 deals with two situations:Firstly, disputes concerning the judicial functions of the ICC and secondly, any dispute between two or more State Parties relating to the interpretation or application of the Rome WEBTOKEN relation to the first above, South Africa may well have a dispute with the ICC regarding the Decision which it made pursuant to the Prosecutor’s Urgent Request for an Order clarifying whether Article 97 Consultations with South Africa have concluded and that South Africa is under an Obligation to Immediately Arrest and Surrender President Omar Al Bashir.

src: Suid-Afrika sal formele samesprekings met die ICC oor die saak hou met die oog om die ICC se uitgangspunt oor hoe artikel 97 vertolk moet word te probeer verstaan.
tgt: South Africa will enter into formal negotiations with the ICC on the matter with the view to understand the ICC’s reasoning and how it interprets Article 97.South Africa also wants to understand, from the ICC, what its obligations are in terms of Article 98(2) to a requested State which cannot in violation of an international obligation execute a warrant of arrest.

src: Suid-Afrika wil ook van die ICC weet wat sy verpligtinge is ingevolge artikel 98(2) teenoor 'n versoekte staat wat nie in skending van 'n internasionale verpligting 'n lasbrief vir inhegtenisname kan uitreik nie.
tgt: South Africa also intends raising the matter at the next meeting of the Assembly of State Parties to the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court.

src: Suid-Afrika is ook van voorneme om die saak by die volgende byeenkoms van die Byeenkoms van Staatspartye tot die Roomse Statuut van die Internasionale Strafhof aanhangig te maak.
tgt: Given the complexity of the technical and legal concerns which we have, South Africa will also consider referring the matter to the International Court of Justice for a decision on the matter.

src: Dit was die eerste keer dat 'n lidstaat deur die ICC genooi is om hom te raadpleeg oor probleme rakende die uitvoering van 'n lasbrief wat kan lei tot die Staatsparty se verbreking van sy internasionale verpligtinge.
tgt: Article 97 had never been used before by the ICThis was the first time a State Party had been invited by the ICC to consult with it regarding the difficulties which it may have in executing a warrant of arrest which may result in the State Party breaching its international obligations.

src: Die ICC moes die saak ernstig opneem en albei partye was verplig om in goeder trou te onderhandel.
tgt: The ICC was required to take the matter seriously and both parties were obliged to negotiate in good faith.

src: Suid-Afrika kan as 'n laaste uitweg ook oorweeg om uit die ICC te onttrek.
tgt: South Africa, may as a last resort also consider withdrawing from the ICSuch a decision will only be taken when South Africa has exhausted all the remedies available to it in terms of the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court, the Charter of the United Nations and other international law instruments.

src: So 'n besluit sal eers geneem word wanneer Suid-Afrika alle ander moontlike oplossings uitgeput het wat ingevolge die Roomse Statuut van die Internasionale Strafhof, die Handves van die Verenigde Nasies en ander internasionale regshulpbronne beskikbaar is.
tgt: Article 127 deals with the withdrawal from the ICC and provides amongst others.

src: 'n Staatsparty kan deur ’n skriftelike kennisgewing wat aan die Sekretaris-generaal van die Verenigde Nasies gerig is, uit hierdie statuut onttrek.
tgt: A State Party may, by written notification addressed to the Secretary-General of the United Nations, withdraw from this Statute.

src: Die onttrekking word van krag een jaar ná die datum van ontvangs van die kennisgewing, tensy die kennisgewing 'n later datum spesifiseerSuid-Afrika sal in onmiddellike gesprek tree met die Afrika-unie en sy Staatspartye oor hoe Afrika-geskilbeslegtingsmeganismes sonder versuim geïmplementeer kan word "om te verseker dat die mees ernstige misdade van kommer vir die internasionale gemeenskap as 'n geheel nie ongestraf bly nie en dat doeltreffende vervolging van sulke misdade verseker moet word deur die neem van maatreëls op nasionale vlak en deur die verbetering van internasionale samewerking.
tgt: South Africa will enter into immediate discussion with the African Union and its member states on how African dispute resolution mechanisms can be implemented without delay “to ensure that the most serious crimes of concern to the international community as a whole must not go unpunished and that their effective prosecution must be ensured by taking measures at the national level and by enhancing international cooperation.”More particularly, South Africa will enter into multilateral and bilateral negotiations with other African countries to expedite the reform of the African Court on Human and Peoples Rights and other regional tribunals.

src: "Mer spesifiek sal Suid-Afrika multilaterale en bilaterale samesprekings met ander Afrika-lande voer om die hervorming van die Afrika-hof vir Meseregte en ander plaaslike tribunale te bespoedig.
tgt: This will ensure that serious crimes against humanity can be promptly and efficiently dealt with by these bodies and that a complementarity scheme exists whereby such crimes may be prosecuted by either the ICC or the regional bodies.

src: Dit sal verseker dat ernstige misdade teen die mensdom vinnig en doeltreffend deur hierdie liggame hanteer kan word en dat 'n bykomende bepaling bestaan waarvolgens sulke misdade vervolg kan word deur óf die ICC of die plaaslike liggame.
tgt: South Africa will shortly make arrangements to enter into formal discussions with the ICC on the matters which are of concern to it.

src: Suid-Afrika sal binnekort reëlings tref vir formele samesprekings met die ICC oor sake wat van belang is.
tgt: South Africa will prepare a report in respect of its interaction with the ICC in terms of Article 97 and the difficulties which it experienced in terms of Article 98(2) and submit that to the next meeting of the Assembly of State Parties.
