tgt: This is to effect the assigned responsibility for the marine manufacturing Delivery Unit under the Operation Phakisa initiatives to establish a composite Boat-Building Cluster in the Eastern Cape.

src: Die projek is goedgekeur in ooreensteming met die bepalings van Artikel 57 van die Wet op Nasionale Hawens, 2005 (Wet 12 van 2005).
tgt: The approval is in terms of Urgent Section 57 of the National Ports Act, 2005 (Act 12 of 2005).

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Afrika-handves oor Statistiek aan die Parlement vir bekragtiging voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the African Charter on Statistics to Parliament for ratification.

src: Die handves is 'n beleidsraamwerk vir die ontwikkeling van statistiek in Afrika, waarin die professionele beginsels, wat die produksie en bestuur van statistiek op nasionale, streeks- en kontinentale vlak beheer, uiteengesit word.
tgt: The charter is a policy framework for the development of statistics in Africa, which sets out the professional principles governing the production and management of statistics at national, regional and continental levels.

src: Statistiek is die hoeksteen vir doeltrefffende monitering en evaluering wat verseker dat doelwitte en uitkomste bereik word.
tgt: Statistics are the bedrock for effective monitoring and evaluation, and ensure that objectives are achieved and outcomes are met.

src: Die handves bepaal riglyne vir die produksie van goeie gehalte statistiek vir die monitering van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan, asook regeringsprogramme en -prioriteite.
tgt: The charter provides guidelines for the production of good quality statistics needed to monitor the NDP, and government programmes and priorities.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Departement van Beplanning, Monitering en Evaluering (DPME) voortgaan met die Twende Mbele-program om te kan belê in samewerking rondom monitering en evaluering regoor Afrika.
tgt: Cabinet approved that the Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation (DPME) takes forward the Twende Mbele Programme in order to invest in collaboration around monitoring and evaluation across Africa.

src: Die Twende Mbele-program sal Suid-Afrika help om op bestaande informele vennootskappe te formaliseer en daarop voort te bou dit kan bilaterale ooreenkomste insluit.
tgt: The Twende Mbele Programme will assist South Africa to build on and formalise existing informal partnerships, which may include bilateral agreements.

src: Dit steun die stryd om die lewensgehalte van Suid-Afrikaners te verbeter, wat gekoppel is aan die strewe na 'n beter Afrika en 'n beter wêreld.
tgt: This supports the struggle for a better life in South Africa, which is linked with the pursuit of a better Africa in a better world.

src: Wetsontwerpe.
tgt: Bills.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp op die Uitbreiding van Sekerheid van Verblyfreg, 2015 aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Extension of Security of Tenure Amendment Bill, 2015 to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp wysig die Wet op die Uitbreiding van Sekerheid van Verblyfreg, 1997 (Wet 62 van 1997) om die regte van inwoners te versterk, uiteen te sit en te beskerm.
tgt: The Bill amends the Extension of Security of Tenure Act, 1997 (Act 62 of 1997) so as to strengthen, clarify and protect the rights of occupiers.

src: Die wysigings spruit voort uit die Beleid oor Sekerheid van Verblyfreg en Uitsettings in Kommersiële Boerderygebiede, en het ten doel om 'n oplossing vir onsekerhede rakende verblyfreg te vind deur maatreëls oor herverdeling van grond binne doeltreffende wetlike beskerming te kombineer met maniere om geskille op te los.
tgt: The amendments, which are from the Land Tenure Security and Evictions Policies in Commercial Framing Areas, aim to find a solution to tenure insecurities by combining land redistribution measures within effective legal protection and dispute-resolution mechanisms.

src: Bestaande ingestelde maatreëls en vermoëns was tot dusver nie voldoende om die gehalte en omvang van konflikte oor grondregte en sekerheid van verblyfreg in kommersiële boerderygebiede te hanteer nie.
tgt: Existing institutional arrangements and capacities have not been sufficient to address the quality and scale of land-rights conflicts and tenure securities found in commercial farming areas.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: As deel van die Erfenismaand-vierings in September, sal President Jacob Zuma die Matola-monument en Vertolkingsentrum in Mosambiek op Vrydag, 11 September 2015, onthul en die standbeeld van Hoofman Bhambhatha in Greytown, KwaZulu-Natal op 22 September 2015.
tgt: As part of Heritage Month celebrations in September, President Jacob Zuma will unveil the Matola Memorial and Interpretative Centre in Mozambique on Friday, 11 September 2015, and the Chief Bhambhatha Sculpture in Greytown, KwaZulu-Natal on 22 September 2015.

src: Die President sal ook op Erfenisdag, wat op 24 September 2015 gevier word, die hoofrede by Vleifontein Machado in Limpopo lewer.
tgt: The President will also deliver a keynote address on Heritage Day in Vleifontein Machado in Limpopo on 24 September 2015.

src: Die tema vir vanjaar se Erfenismaand is: "Ons inheemse kennis, ons erfenis: Vir die identifisering, bevordering en bewaring van Suid-Afrika se lewende erfenis.".
tgt: The theme for this year’s Heritage Month celebration is: “Our indigenous knowledge, our heritage: Towards the identification, promotion and preservation of South Africa’s living heritage.”South Africans are encouraged to explore our natural heritage by visiting national parks which will offer free entrance from 14 to 18 September 2015, as part of the 10th annual South African National Parks Week.

src: Suid-Afrikaners word aangemoedig om ons land se natuurlike erfenis te verken deur nasionale parke te besoek, wat as deel van die 10de jaarlikse Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Parke-week, tussen 14 en 18 September 2015 gratis toegang bied,.
tgt: The Department of Basic Education will conduct the fifth Annual National Assessments (ANA) during September 2015 to track progress of learning outcomes in literacy and mathematics among grades 1 to 9.The ANA generates standardised evidence for monitoring the progress of government interventions and also guide the development of targeted interventions.

src: Die Departement van Basiese Onderwys sal gedurende September 2015 die vyfde Jaarlikse Nasionale Asseserings (ANA) onderneem om die vordering van leeruitkomste in geletterheid en wiskunde onder graad 1- tot 9-leerders te bepaal.
tgt: Parents and guardians are encouraged to support learners during the assessment period and to ensure that the results are used to address any development areas.

src: Die ANA-rooster vir 2015 is beskikbaar by: www.
tgt: The ANA timetable for 2015 is on available on: www.

src: education.
tgt: education.

src: gov.
tgt: gov.

src: zaDie Kabinet doen ’n beroep op onderwysers om leerders se behoeftes voorop te stel deur te verseker dat die assesserings sonder onderbrekings verloop.4 Die Kabinet bedank Suid-Afrikaners wat aan die Internasionale Geletterdheidsdag op 8 September 2015 deelgeneem het om ’n leeskultuur en die belangrikheid van geletterdheid te bevorder.
tgt: zaCabinet calls on teachers to put the needs of the learners first by ensuring that the ANA continues uninterrupted.4 Cabinet thanks South Africans who took part in the International Literacy Day that took place on 8 September 2015 to encourage the culture of reading and promote the importance of literacy.

src: Die stigtingsdokument van ons demokrasie, die Vryheidsmanifes, verklaar dat dit ons strewe is dat "die deure van leer vir almal oop sal wees.”Die Departement van Basiese Onderwys doen hierdie maand ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om aan 'n geletterdheidsveldtog deel te neem wat daarna mik om lees in ons gemeenskappe aan te moedig.
tgt: Our founding documents of this Democracy the Freedom Charter stated that we will strive for “the doors of learning shall be open to all.

src: Die Kabinet versoek elkeen om boeke aan skoolbiblioteke te skenk en om van hulle tyd af te staan om vir kinders in hul gemeenskappe te lees.
tgt: Cabinet calls on every one to donate books to school libraries, contribute our times to go an read for children in our communities.

src: Die Nasionale Jaarlikse Thusong-dienssentrumweek van 13 to 18 September 2015 is daarop gemik om die sentrums en mobiele eenhede bekend te stel deur die Regering se die dienste nader na die mense te neem.
tgt: The National Annual Thusong Service Centre Week from 13 to 18 September 2015 will profile the services of the centres and mobile units in bringing government services closer to South Africans.

src: Dit maak deel uit van Staatsdiensmaand.
tgt: This forms part of Public Service Month.

src: Die Kabinet moedig Suid-Afrikaners aan om gebruik te maak van die verskeidenheid van dienste en inligting wat deur die Thusong-dienssentrums aangebied word om hulself te ontwikkel en te bemagtig.
tgt: Cabinet encourages South Africans to use the variety of services and information offered by the Thusong Service Centres to advance and empower themselves.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om uitsonderlike staatsamptenare of staatsinstellings te eer deur hulle voor 30 September 2015 te nomineer vir die 3de Nasionale Batho Pele-toekennings vir Uitenemendheid 2015, onder die tema: "Batho Pele - mense eerste".
tgt: Cabinet calls on South Africans to honour exceptional public servants or government institutions by nominating them before 30 September 2015 for the 3rd National Batho Pele Excellence Awards 2015, which will take place under the theme: “Batho Pele – Putting People First”.

src: Gelukwense.7 Die Kabinet verwelkom die aankondiging deur die Federasie van die Statebondspele se Algemene Vergadering dat Durban die gasheer sal wees vir die 2022 Statebondspele dit sal die eerste keer wees dat hierdie glansgeleentheid in Afrika plaasvind .Durban sal van die 2010 FIFA Wêreldbeker-infrastruktuur gebruik maak om die spele aan te bied, wat na verwagting R20 miljard tot die ekonomie sal bydra dit sal lei tot 'n bykomende groei van R11 miljard in die bruto binnelandse produk.8 Die Kabinet wens ons atlete geluk met hul 13de plek by die 15de Wêreld-atletiekbyeenkoms in Beijing, China en dat hulle een goue en twee bronsmedaljes ingepalm het.9 Die Kabinet wens Bafana Bafana ook geluk met hul oorwinning in die 21ste Mandela-uitklopreeks waar hulle Senegal met 1-0 geklop het.
tgt: The last AU Summit held in South Africa called on all AU member states to take advantage of the UN General Assembly platform to include the issue of the Security Council reform among their foreign policy priorities in their engagements with non-African partners in particular, to include in their statements during the debates of the United Nations General Assembly, the need to correct the historical injustice on the African continent.6 Cabinet noted that South Africa will host the 2nd Summit of the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation (FOCAC) on 04-05 December 2015.

src: Die oorwinning volg nadat hulle oor die naweek teen Mauritanië verloor het ons hoop dat dit die span se vertroue om vir die Afrikabeker-toernooi te kwalifiseer sodoende ’n hupstoot gekry het.
tgt: The South African Government will be working closely with the Government of China, the African Group of Ambassadors in Beijing and Addis Ababa, and the AU Commission on the preparations leading up to the FOCAC Summit.

src: Deur hul oorwinning in die Mandela-uitklopreeks, het die Suid-Afrikaanse Sokkervereniging hul skenking aan die Nelson Mandela-kinderfonds vanR1 miljoen tot R1, 5 miljoen verhoog.10 Die Kabinet wens die Springbokspan sterkte toe vir 8ste Rugby-wêreldbeker wat van 18 September tot 31 Oktober 2015 deur Engeland aangebied word, en doen 'n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om agter ons nasionale span te verenig.11 Die Kabinet wens saam met die President die Universiteit van die Witwatersrand geluk met die groot ontdekking van nuwe fossiele by Maropeng by die Wieg van die Mesdom-wêrelderfenisgebied in die Wes-Rand, Gauteng.
tgt: Congratulatory messages.7 Cabinet welcomes the announcement by the Commonwealth Games Federation General Assembly that Durban will host the 2022 Commonwealth Games, making it the first time that this prestigious event will take place on African WEBTOKEN will make use of the FIFA 2010 World Cup infrastructure to host the event, which is expected to deliver up to R20 billion to the economy, translating into an additional R11 billion gross domestic product growth.8 Cabinet congratulates our athletes for ending 13th at the 15th World Championships in Athletics in Beijing, China and winning one gold and two bronze medals.9 Cabinet also wishes to congratulate Bafana Bafana for winning the 21st edition of the Mandela Challenge, beating Senegal 1-0.

src: Hierdie nuwe merkwaardige ontdekking volg ná intensiewe navorsing deur wetenskaplikes onder die vaandel van die Departement van Wetenskap en Tegnologie en die Nasionale Navorsingstigting se Sentrum vir Uitnemendheid by die Universiteit van die Witwatersrand.12 Die Kabinet dra saam met die President sy gelukwense oor aan die Vergadering van die Rooms-Katolieke Kerk vir die formele erkenning aan MnrTshimangadzo Samuel Benedictus Daswa as die eerste Heilige in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: The victory follows the loss to Mauritania over the weekend and we hope that this will boost the confidence of the team to qualify for the African Cup of WEBTOKEN winning the Mandela Challenge, the South African Football Association increased their donation to the Nelson Mandela Children’s Fund from R1 million to R1, 5 million.10 Cabinet wishes the Springbok squad well in the 8th Rugby World Cup hosted by England from 18 September to 31 October 2015 and calls on South Africans to unite behind our national team.11 Cabinet joins the President in congratulating the University of Witwatersrand on the major new fossil discoveries at Maropeng in the Cradle of Humankind World Heritage Site in the West Rand, Gauteng.

src: Die seremonie, waartydens die Katolieke Kerk MnrTshimangadzo Samuel Benedictus Daswa salig sal verklaar, sal op 13 September 2015 in Thohoyandou, Limpopo, plaasvind.
tgt: This new remarkable discovery follows intensive research by the scientists under the auspices of the Department of Science and Technology and the National Research Foundation Centre of Excellence at the University of Witwatersrand.12 Cabinet joins the President in congratulating the congregation of the Catholic Church for formal recognition of Mr Tshimangadzo Samuel Benedict Daswa as the first Saint in South Africa.

src: Daswa was 'n skoolhoof in Limpopo.
tgt: The ceremony will take place on 13 September 2015 in Thohoyandou, Limpopo, the Catholic Church will hold ceremony at which Mr Tshimangadzo Samuel Benedict Daswa.

src: Hy is in Februarie 1990 geslaan en gestenig, en het doodgebrand vir sy Katolieke oortuigings.
tgt: He was beaten, stoned and burnt to death for his Catholic beliefs in February 1990.

src: Belangrike kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Key issues in the environment.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die voorgestelde voorneme van die Padverkeer-bestuurskorporasie en provinsiale verkeersowerhede om 'n 24-uur-skof vir verkeersbeamptes in te stel om die slagting op ons paaie hok te slaan.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the proposed intensions between the Road Traffic Management Corporation and provincial traffic authorities to introduce a 24-hour shift for traffic officers to address the carnage on our roads.

src: Die Kabinet herinner alle padgebruikers daaraan dat padveiligheid almal se verantwoordelikheid is en dat die sukses van padveiligheidsveldtogte daarvan afhang dat almal die padveiligheidsreëls nakom.
tgt: Cabinet reminds all road users that road safety is everyone’s responsibility and the success of road-safety campaigns depends on all people obeying the rules of the road.

src: In afwagting van die skoolvakansie wat binnekort landwyd begin, sal die Departement van Vervoer sy padveiligheidsveldtog uitbrei.
tgt: As we enter the schools holiday season, the Department of Transport will heighten its road safety campaign.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op motoriste om die slagting op ons paaie te stuit deur padtekens te gehoorsaam, om nie onder die invloed van alkohol te bestuur nie, en nie met onpadwaardige voertuie op ons paaie te bestuur nie.
tgt: Cabinet calls on motorist to stop the carnage on our roads by respecting the road signs, motorists not to drive whilst under the influence of alcohol, unroadworthy vehicles should not be on our roads.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die 14de Wêreld-bosboukongres wat tans in Durban gehou word en deur 3 200 afgevaardigdes bygewoon word.
tgt: Cabinet has noted the XIV World Forestry currently taking place in Durban and attended by 3 200 delegates.

src: Die kongres is die eerste wat in Afrika plaasvind, en word bygewoon deur verteenwoordigers van verskillende sektore soos regerings, nie-regeringsorganisasies, en die private sektor, asook wetenskaplike en professionele liggame.
tgt: The congress, the first to be held in Africa, includes people representing different sectors such as government, non-governmental organisations, private sector, and scientific or professional bodies.

src: Die wye deelname en inklusiewe besprekings oor bosboukwessies sal verseker dat dit wêreldwyd by hoofstroom-agendas oor volhoubare ontwikkeling en die bou van nuwe vennootskappe ingesluit word.
tgt: The broad participation and inclusive discussion on forestry issues will facilitate their mainstreaming in global agendas on sustainable development and building new partnerships.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die verklaring wat deur die Amerikaanse diplomatieke sending na Suid-Afrika uitgereik is wat waarsku dat ekstremiste Amerikaanse belange in Suid-Afrika kan teiken.
tgt: Cabinet has noted the statement issued by the US Diplomatic Mission to South Africa warning that extremists may target American interests in South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet benadruk dat die Departement van die Minister van Staatsveiligheid die publiek verseker dat die veiligheid van alle Suid-Afrikaners steeds voorkeur geniet.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates the department of the Minister of State Security assures the public that the safety of all South Africans remains the priority.

src: Ons wetstoepassingsagentskappe bly waaksaam om die land se inwoners en hul eiendom te beskerm.
tgt: Our law enforcement agencies remain vigilant to protect its residents and their property.

src: Die Kabinet dra saam met President Zuma sy innige meegevoel oor aan die familie, vriende en kollegas met die afsterwe van Regter Thembile Lewis Skweyiya.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Zuma in conveying condolences to the family, friends and colleagues on the passing of Justice Thembile Lewis Skweyiya.

src: Hy het 'n geweldige bydrae tot die land gemaak as 'n anti-apartheidsprokureur, menseregte-aktivis, Regter van die Hooggeregshof en Regter van die Konstitusionele Hof.
tgt: He made a tremendous contribution to the country as an anti-apartheid lawyer, human rights activist, High Court Judge and Justice of the Constitutional Court.

src: Die Kabinet dra ook sy medelye oor aan die familie en onderdane van sy Majesteit Koning Lekunutu Cavendish Mota van Batlokwa ba Mota in die Vrystaat.
tgt: Cabinet also sends its condolences to the family and subjects of his Majesty, King Lekunutu Cavendish Mota of Batlokwa ba Mota in the Free State.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die betrokke klaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Ms Mmabatho Ramagoshi – Adjunk-direkteur-generaal: Beleidskoördinering en Kennisbestuur by die Departement van Vroue.
tgt: Ms Mmabatho Ramagoshi – Deputy Director-General: Policy Coordination and Knowledge Management at the Department of Women.

src: Implementering van belangrike regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of key government programmes.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling op 20 September 2015 van die sewende uitgawe van die Ontwikkelingsaanwysers (2014), wat die jongste stand van Suid-Afrika se ontwikkeling aandui.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the launch of the seventh edition of the Development Indicators (2014) on 20 September 2015, which presented an update on the state of South Africa’s development.

src: Die aanwysers skep ’n beter begrip van die impak wat regeringsbeleid en verskillende diensleweringsinisiatiewe op die land se ontwikkeling het.
tgt: The indicators create a better understanding of the impact of various government policies and service-delivery initiatives on the country’s development.

src: Die aanwysers bevorder ook debatvoering oor die uitdagings wat ons land in die gesig staar en dien as merkers wat help om die mylpale in ons reis na sosiale verandering te definieer.
tgt: The indicators also promote a debate on the challenges faced by our country and act as markers that help define the milestones in our journey of social change.

src: Dit inspireer Suid-Afrikaners om saam te werk om die land se lang- en medium-termyndoelwitte te bereik soos verwoord in die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NDP) – Visie 2030 en die Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk.
tgt: They serve as an inspiration for us to work together to achieve our long and medium-term goals as articulated in the National Development Plan (NDP) – Vision 2030 and the Medium Term Strategic Framework.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die aanstelling van 154 distrikslanddroste in verskeie landdroshowe landwyd.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the appointment of 154 district magistrates in various magistrates’ courts countrywide.

src: Van belang is dat 90 van hulle vroue is, wat 59 persent van alle aangestelde kandidate verteenwoordig.
tgt: Of significance is that 90 of them are women, who represent 59 percent of all appointed candidates.

src: Die feit dat 141 van die landdroste swart en 13 wit is, sal die rasse- en geslagstransformasie van die laer howe aansienlik verbeter.
tgt: The fact that 141 of the magistrates are black and 13 are white will significantly improve the racial and gender transformation of the lower courts.

src: Die jongste aanstellings volg op die aanstelling van 57 plaaslike landdroste op 2 Februarie 2015 dit bring die totale aantal landdroste wat vanjaar aangestel is, op 211 te staan, wat uniek is in ons 21 jaar van demokrasie.3 Die Kabinet verwelkom die plasing van Suid-Afrika onder die boonste drie in die 2015 Oop-begrotingindeks, wat die wêreld se enigste onafhanklike, vergelykbare maatstaf van begrotingsdeursigtigheid, -deelname en -toesig is.
tgt: The latest appointments follow the appointment of 57 regional magistrates on 2 February 2015, which brings the total of magistrates appointed this year to 211, which is unprecedented in our 21 years of democracy.

src: Dit maak Suid-Afrika 'n wêredleier op die gebied van begrotingsdeursigtigheid.
tgt: This profiles South Africa as a global leader in budget transparency.

src: Sommige van die hervormings wat tussen 2010 en 2015 in die land geïmplementeer is, sluit 'n nuwe raamwerk vir strategiese planne en jaarlikse prestasieplanne in, asook die Regering se verbintenis om betrokke te raak by burgerlike samelewingsorganisasies om groter deelname aan die begrotingsproses te verseker.4 Die Kabinet verwelkom die aankondiging dat Suid-Afrika as Hoofvoorsitter van die Oop-regeringsvennootskap (ORV) oorneem.
tgt: Some of the reforms that the country implemented between 2010 and 2015 included a new framework for strategic plans and annual performance plans, and government’s commitment to engage with civil-society organizations to ensure increased participation in the budget process.

src: Die ORV is 'n multilaterale inisiatief wat daarop gemik is om te verseker dat regerings hul daadwerklik daartoe verbind om deursigtigheid te bevorder, burgers te bemagtig, korrupsie te beveg en nuwe tegnologieë aan te wend om regeringsbestuur te versterk.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the announcement that South Africa will take over as Lead Chair of the Open Government Partnership (OGP).

src: Suid-Afrika, Brasilië, Indonesië, Meiko, Noorweë, die Filippyne, die Verenigde Koninkryk en die Verenigde State van Amerika is die stigterslede van hierdie inisiatief.
tgt: The OGP is a multilateral initiative to secure concrete commitments from governments to promote transparency, empower citizens, fight corruption and harness new technologies to strengthen governance.

src: Suid-Afrika onderneem om tydens sy termyn as Hoofvoorsitter die politieke profiel van die ORV te verhoog om deelname en aanspreeklikheid op die vlak van staatshoofde te verseker.
tgt: During its tenure as Lead Chair South Africa undertakes to raise the political profile of the OGP to ensure participation and accountability at the level of Heads of State.

src: Suid-Afrika sal ook daarop fokus om die ORV in die hoofstroom van die internasionale multilaterale agenda by die Verenigde Nasies se Algemene Vergadering te plaas, asook by die Groep van 20 en op ander platforms.
tgt: South Africa will also focus on mainstreaming the OGP in the international multilateral agenda at the United Nations (UN) General Assembly (UNGA), the Group of 20 and other platforms.

src: Belangrike Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet steun die versoek van die Statebond-sekretariaat, dat Suid-Afrika gasheer sal wees vir die tweede Statebondkonferensie oor Jeugwerk in Maart 2016.
tgt: Cabinet supports that South Africa host the second Commonwealth Conference on Youth Work in March 2016, on request from the Commonwealth Secretariat.

src: Die Departement van Beplanning, Monitering en Evaluering sal die konferensie saam met die Statebond-sekretariaat, die Universiteit van Suid-Afrika en die Nasionale Jeugontwikkelingsagentskap reël.
tgt: The Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation will partner with the Commonwealth Secretariat, University of South Africa and the National Youth Development Agency in arranging the conference.

src: Hierdie konferensie is 'n belegging in die ontwikkeling van Suid-Afrika se groeiende jeugbevolking, en bied 'n platform om die ontwikkeling van jeugwerkers te professionaliseer en hulle as primêre verskaffers van dienste aan die jeug te bevorder.
tgt: This conference is an investment in the development of South Africa’s increasing youth population, and it will provide a platform to professionalize the development of youth workers and promote them as primary providers of services to youth.

src: Die Kabinet keur die Riglyne oor Goeie Sakepraktyk vir Suid-Afrikaanse Maatskappye in Afrika goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Guidelines of Good Business Practice for South African Companies Operating in Africa.

src: Hierdie riglyne is ’n vrywillige stel beginsels ooreenkomstig wette en internasionaal erkende standaarde wat verantwoordelike sake-optrede op die vasteland van Afrika bevorder.
tgt: These guidelines are a voluntary set of principles consistent with laws and internationally recognized standards that promote responsible business conduct on the African continent.

src: Hulle voorsien ‘n gidsraamwerk vir Suid-Afrikaanse maatskappye om volhoubare ekonomiese ontwikkeling in Afrika te bevorder.
tgt: They provide a guiding framework for South African companies to promote sustainable economic development in Africa.

src: Dit moedig Suid-Afrikaanse maatskappye ook aan om hulle betrokkenheid en praktyke met die Regering se integrasie- en ontwikkelingsdoelwitte in Afrika te belyn, en om wedersyds vertroue en voordeel vir die maatskappye en die gemeenskappe waarbinne hulle bedryf word, te bou.
tgt: They also encourage South African companies to align their involvement and practices with government’s integration and development objectives in Africa and to build mutual confidence, trust and benefit for the companies and the societies in which they operate.

src: Die Kabinet keur die bekragtiging van die Bylae tot die Institusionalisering van die Suider-Afrikaanse Doeane-unie (SADU) se Spitsberaad, goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the ratification of the Annex on the Institutionalization of the Southern African Customs Union (SACU) Summit.

src: Die beraad, wat uit die staatshoofde van elke lidland bestaan, sal politieke en strategiese rigting aan SADU voorsien.
tgt: The summit, which comprises Heads of State or Government of each member state, will provide political and strategic direction to SACAll SACU member states need to sign the agreement so that the summit can become the highest decision making institution of the SACCabinet approved the issuing of a Letter of Support to the African Union Commission for the Internet Service Providers’ Association in the application process for the hosting of the Regional Internet Exchange Point.

src: Dit dra by tot plaaslike integrasie en die bou van 'n veilige, betroubare infrastruktuurnetwerk en -dienste om aan die eise van die gevestigde inligting- en kennissamelewing te voldoen.
tgt: This contributes to regional integration and the building of a secure, reliable infrastructure network and services to meet the demands of the established information and knowledge society.

src: Dit smee sterker vennootskappe en samewerking tussen Afrika-entiteite en posisioneer Suid-Afrika ook as 'n wêreldleier in die ontwikkeling, bedryf en gebruik van Inligting- en Kommunikasietegnologie (IKT).
tgt: This forges stronger partnership and cooperation between African entities and also positions South Africa as a global leader in the development, roll-out and use of Information and Communications Technology (ICT).

src: Deur streeksverkeer plaaslike te hou sal die koste om te kommunikeer verminder dit sal ook werkskepping, innovasie, entrepreneurskap en platforms vir elektroniese regeringsdienste bevorder, en verseker dat Afrika beheer het oor die inhoud en data.
tgt: Keeping regional traffic local will lower the cost to communicate and promote job creation, innovation, entrepreneurship and platforms for e-government services, as well as ensure that Africa is in control of its content and data.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat Suid-Afrika mede-gasheer sal wees van die tweede Ministeriële Forum vir China-Afrika Gesondheidsontwikkeling onder die tema: "Bevorder die beskikbaarheid van gesondheidsorgdiens in Afrika, verbeter China-Afrika se samewerking in openbare gesondheid in die post-Ebola era".
tgt: Cabinet approved for South Africa to co-host the second Ministerial Forum for China-Africa Health Development under the theme: “Promoting the availability of healthcare service in Africa, Improving China-Africa’s Cooperation in Public Health in post-Ebola era” from 4 to 6 October 2015 in Cape Town.

src: Dié inisiatief, wat van 4 tot 6 Oktober 2015 in Kaapstad gehou word, volg op die Forum vir China-Afrika-samewerking, wat gesondheid voorop stel as 'n belangrike deel van China-Afrika-samewerking.
tgt: This initiative is a result of the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation, which places health as an important part of the China-Africa cooperation.

src: China het onlangs onderneem om beduidende hulpbronne beskikbaar te stel om die verspreiding van Ebola in Wes-Afrika te help stuit.
tgt: Recently, China pledged significant resources to help stem the spread of the Ebola outbreak in West Africa.

src: Wetsontwerpe.
tgt: Bills.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Nasionale Wysigingswetsontwerp op Omgewingsbestuur, 2015 vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the publication of the National Environmental Management Laws Amendment Bill, 2015 for public comment.

src: Hierdie wysigingswetsontwerp wysig die Wet op Nasionale Omgewingsbestuur, 1998 (Wet 107 van 1998), asook verskeie spesifieke omgewingsbestuurswetgewing.
tgt: This Bill amends the National Environmental Management Act, 1998 (Act 107 of 1998) and a number of specific environmental management legislations.

src: Die wysigings versterk onder meer geïntegreerde omgewingsbestuur, nakomings- en toepassingsmaatreëls, biodiversiteit en bewaring, bestuur van luggehalte en afvalbestuur.
tgt: The amendments strengthen, among other things, integrated environmental management, compliance and enforcement measures, biodiversity and conservation, air quality management and waste management.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Vlugtelinge, 2015 aan die Parlement, voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the introduction of the Refugees Amendment Bill, 2015 to Parliament.

src: Die wysigings verhoog die doeltreffendheid en effektiewe funksionering van die asielstelsel se aansoekproses, en is deel van die breër oorsig oor die Migrasiebeleid wat onderweg is.
tgt: The amendments increase the efficiency and effective functioning of the application process of the asylum system, and are part of the broader review of the Migration Policy that is underway.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wetsontwerp op die Justisie-geadministreerde Fonds, 2015 aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the introduction of the Justice Administered Fund Bill, 2015 into Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp skep 'n wetgewende raamwerk wat aanspreeklikheid sal verhoog en die Ouditeur-generaal se ouditbevindinge sal hanteer deur die verbetering van organisatoriese doeltreffendheid en die transformasie van regsdienste.
tgt: The Bill creates a legislative framework that will increase accountability and address the audit findings by the Auditor-General by enhancing organizational efficiency and transforming the justice services.

src: Die Wetsontwerp maak ook voorsiening vir die vestiging van 'n Justisie-geadministreerde Fonds om die bestuur, beheer, belegging en gebruik van geld uit derde party-fondse (ook genoem 'geld in trust'), soos instandhouding en borgtoggelde, te reguleer.
tgt: The Bill also provides for the establishment of a Justice Administered Fund to regulate the management, control, investment and usage of money from Third Party Funds (also referred to as ‘Monies in Trust’), such as maintenance and bail monies.4 Cabinet approved the introduction of the Border Management Agency (BMA) Bill, 2015 into Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp is daarop gemik om die GBA te vestig, wat veilige oorgrensreis, die fasilitering van handel, en nasionale veiligheidsimperatiewe binne die konteks van Suid-Afrika se plaaslike, Afrikaverwante en internasionale verpligtinge te balanseer.
tgt: The Bill aims to establish the BMA, which will balance secure cross-border travel, trade facilitation and national security imperatives within the context of South Africa’s regional, African and international obligations.

src: Hierdie enkele owerheid vir grenswetstoepassing bied die potensiaal vir meer koste-effektiewe dienste, verbeterde sekuriteit en beter bestuur van die grensomgewing.
tgt: This single authority for border law enforcement provides the potential for more cost-effective services, enhanced security and better management of the border environment.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: President Jacob Zuma sal ’n Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging na die Verenigde Nasies (VN) se 70ste Algemene Vergadering in New York, VSA lei onder die tema: “Die Verenigde Nasies op 70: die pad vorentoe vir vrede, sekuriteit en menseregte”.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will lead a South African delegation to the 70th UNGA in New York, United States under the theme: “The United Nations at 70: the road ahead for peace, security and human rights”.

src: Die VN se Spitsberaad oor Volhoubare Ontwikkeling, word van 25 tot 27 September 2015 gehou voor die aanvang van die Algemene Vergadering, vir die goedkeuring van die Post-2015-ontwikkelingsagenda.
tgt: The UN Sustainable Development Summit from 25 to 27 September 2015 is being convened immediately prior to the UNGA for the adoption of the Post-2015 Development Agenda.

src: Die nuwe agenda vir volhoubare ontwikkeling sal dien as die wegspringplek vir optrede deur die internasionale gemeenskap en deur nasionale regerings om gedeelde welvaart en welsyn vir almal oor die volgende 15 jaar te bevorder.
tgt: The new sustainable development agenda will serve as the launch pad for action by the international community and by national governments to promote shared prosperity and well-being for all over the next 15 years.

src: Op 25 September 2015, sal Sy Heiligheid Pous Francis die VN se Algemene Vergadering toespreek, en die Algemene Debat vind van 28 September tot 6 Oktober 2015 plaas.
tgt: On 25 September 2015, His Holiness Pope Francis will address the UNGA, and the General Debate takes place from 28 September to 6 October 2015.

src: Suid-Afrika is tevrede dat die doelwitte van volhoubare ontwikkeling steeds die wêreld se aandag op die stryd teen armoede, ongelykheid en volhoubare ontwikkeling sal vestig.
tgt: South Africa is satisfied that the sustainable development goals will continue to focus global attention on fighting poverty, inequality and sustainable development.

src: Die Department van Vervoer sal die Vervoermaand-veldtog van 1 tot 31 Oktober 2015 van stapel stuur onder die tema "Saam beweeg ons Suid-Afrika vorentoe".
tgt: The Department of Transport will implement the October Transport Month (OTM) campaign from 1 to 31 October 2015 under the theme “Together we move South Africa forward”.

src: Vervoermaand word jaarliks gehou as 'n fokusmaand wat daarop gemik is om bewustheid te skep van infrastruktuurprojekte met groot sosio-ekonomiese gevolge vir vervoer, soos pad-, lugvaart-, maritieme, spoor- en openbare vervoer.
tgt: The OTM is held annually as a focus month that is aimed at showcasing infrastructure projects with major socio-economic spin-offs in the modes of transport such as road, aviation, maritime, rail and public transport.

src: Sleutelprojekte sluit in die amptelike opening van padinfrastruktuurontwikkelings soos die R71 Moria-projek (verbetering van wisselaarveiligheid) die Umgeni-wisselaar en die Denneysville-Sasolburgpad in die Vrystaat deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Padagentskap Beperk, in samewerking met die provinsiale departemente van paaie en vervoer.
tgt: Key projects will include the official opening of road infrastructure developments such as the R71 Moria Project (interchange safety improvement) Umgeni Interchange and the Denneysville Sasolburg Road in the Free State by the South African National Roads Agency Limited, in collaboration with provincial departments of roads and transport.

src: Vervoermaand sal ook gebruik word om bewustheid te verhoog van die 365-dae-padveiligheidsveldtog, wat deur die departement gelei word en in samewerking met die vervoerentiteite wat 'n padveiligheidsmandaat het, die private sektor en nie-winsgewende organisasies geïmplementeer word.
tgt: The OTM will also be used to heighten the 365-Days Road Safety campaign, which is led by the department and implemented together with transport entities with a road safety mandate and private sector and non-profit organizations.

src: Die Padvervoer-bestuurskorporasie sal 24-uurskofte vir verkeersbeamptes in werking stel om padsterftes te bekamp.
tgt: The Road Traffic Management Corporation will introduce 24-hour working shifts for traffic officers to curb road carnages.

src: Die Regering het ook 'n kwalifikasie vir verkeersbeamptes ontwikkel ooreenkomstig die Nasionale Kwalifikasieraamwerk (NKR) 4 tot 6 NKR om die verkeersberoepe verder te professionaliseer.
tgt: Government has also developed a qualification for traffic officers from National Qualifications Framework (NQF) 4 to NQF 6 in order to further professionalize the traffic fraternity.

src: Die Padongelukkefonds (POF) sal voortgaan om ná-ongeluksorg en verwante bystand aan die slagoffers van padongelukke en hul naasbestaandes wat geraak word, te bied, en om ook na gemeenskappe uit te reik deur die POF-op-die-pad-veldtog.
tgt: The Road Accident Fund (RAF) will continue to provide post-crash care and related support to road-accident victims and affected families, and also reach out to communities through the RAF-on-the-road campaign.

src: Suid-Afrika sal vir die eerste keer gasheer wees vir die Suid-Afrikaanse Internasionale Konferensie oor Hernunbare Energie wat van van 4 tot 7 Oktober 2015 in Kaapstad gehou word onder die tema: “Energiehernuwing vir Afrika”.
tgt: South Africa will for the first time host the South African International Renewable Energy Conference from 4 to 7 October 2015 in Cape Town, under the theme: “Re-energizing Africa”.

src: Die konferensie sal fokus op hernubare energie-geleenthede vir produseerders van hernubare energie in Suid-Afrika en Afrika, as die volgende beleggingsbestemming.
tgt: The conference will profile renewable energy opportunities available in South Africa and Africa to producers of renewable power, as their next investment destination.

src: Suid-Afrika, deur middel van sy Verkygingsprogram vir Hernubare Energie deur Onafhanklike Kragprodusente, word een van die grootste markte vir hernubare energie.
tgt: South Africa, through its Renewable Energy Independent Power Producers Procurement Programme, is becoming one of the biggest markets for renewable energy.

src: In die toekoms sal biomassa, windkrag, sonkrag en hidrokrag 11,4 gigawatt van hernubare energie tot die rooster bydra.
tgt: In future biomass, wind power, solar power and hydropower will contribute gigawatts of renewable energy to the grid.

src: Die Departement van Wetenskap en Tegnologie ondersteun die land se energiebeleid deur navorsing en tegnologie-ontwikkeling in lae- en koolstofvrye tegnologie wat gekommersialiseer en geïmplementeer kan word om energiesekerheid en -toegang vir alle Suid-Afrikaners te verhoog.
tgt: The Department of Science and Technology is supporting the country’s energy policies through research and technology development in low and carbon-free technologies that can be commercialized and rolled out, to increase energy security and access to all South Africans.

src: Verdere pogings om ons energie te diversifiseer sluit die ontwikkeling van tegnologie vir waterstof-brandstofselle in, met toepassing vir huishoudelike bystandselektrisiteit en primêre elektrisiteitsvoorsiening, elektriese voertuie – veral in die mynbou- en vermaaklikheidsektore – vir mynbouvoertuie, uitbreiding van die reikwydte van gholfkarretjies en mobiele kommunikasie-basisstasies.
tgt: Further efforts to diversify our energy portfolio include the development of hydrogen fuel cells technologies with applications in domestic back-up and primary electricity provision, electric vehicles -especially in the mining and entertainment sector - for mining vehicles ,range extension in golf carts and mobile communication base stations.

src: Ons is nou in staat om verskillende komponente in 'n wye reeks van energie-genererende toestelle vir hierdie toepassings wat tans getoets word, te vervaardig en te integreer.
tgt: We are now capable of manufacturing and integrating various components into a whole range of energy generating devices for these applications that are currently undergoing testing.

src: Die voordeel van ons waterstof- en brandstof-seltegnologieë-program is die gebruik van platinum wat ook geleenthede skep in die motorkatalisator-omsittermark om veredeling van een van ons volopste minerale te bevorder.
tgt: The benefit of our hydrogen and fuel cell technologies Programme is the use of platinum which will also open opportunities into the automotive catalytic converter market and promote beneficiation of one of our most abundant minerals.

src: In dié verband, het ons ons vennootskap met die private sektor gevestig en versterk om finale toetse te doen en om verskillende komponente en volle energie-oplossings te kommersialiseer.
tgt: In this regard, we have established and are strengthening our partnership with the private sector to do final tests and commercialize various components and full energy solutions.

src: Die Regering vier Maatskaplike Ontwikkelingsmaand in Oktober deur klem te lê op armoedeverligtingsprogramme en sy voetspoor uit te brei deur Projek Mikondzo om alle kwesbare Suid-Afrikaners te bereik.
tgt: Government will celebrate Social Development Month in October by highlighting poverty-alleviation programmes and extending its footprint through Project Mikondzo to reach all vulnerable South Africans.

src: Sedert die bekendstelling van Projek Mikondzo in 2013, het regeringsamptenare meer as 900 wyke met hoë vlakke van armoede en werkloosheid besoek om ’n beter begrip van gemeenskappe se diverse behoeftes te WEBTOKEN deel van die gebeure in Oktober, vier die Departement van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling ook die 10de herdenking van die Suid-Afrikaanse Agentskap vir Maatskaplike Sekerheid (SASSA), wat maatskaplike toelaes voorsien waarby miljoen mense tans baat, en wat oor die afgelope dekade gehelp het om armoede te verminder en voedselsekerheid onder arm huishoudings te verbeter.
tgt: Since the inauguration of Project Mikondzo in 2013, government officials have visited more than 900 wards with high levels of poverty and unemployment to better understand the diverse needs of WEBTOKEN part of the October events, the Department of Social Development will also mark the 10th anniversary of the South African Social Security Agency (SASSA), which provides social grants currently benefitting million people, and has over the past decade assisted to reduce poverty and improve food security among poor households.

src: Die departement het ook die aansoektydperk vir studiebeurse in Maatskaplike Werk oopgestel, en mense wat belangstel word aangemoedig om voor 31 Oktober 2015 aansoek te doen.
tgt: The department has also opened the application period for social-work scholarships and interested people are encouraged to apply before 31 October 2015.

src: Mer inligting is beskikbaar by WEBTOKEDie Kabinet bring hulde aan al ons opvoeders op Wêreld Onderwysersdag op 5 Oktober 2015, en bedank hulle vir hul betrokkenheid, toewyding en geduld met die voorbereiding van die ontwikkelende breinkrag van die jeug en ons leerders vir die toekoms.
tgt: More information is available on WEBTOKECabinet salutes all our educators on World Teachers Day on 5 October 2015 and conveys its gratitude to them for their commitment, dedication and patience in preparing the young and the growing minds of our learners for the future.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op belangstellende jong Suid-Afrikaners om vanaf 1 Oktober 2015 aansoek te doen vir die Funza Lushaka-beursprogram, 'n meerjarige program ter bevordering van onderwys as 'n beroep.
tgt: Cabinet calls on interested young South Africans to apply for the Funza Lushaka Bursary Programme, a multi-year programme to promote teaching as a profession, from 1 October 2015.

src: Mer inligting is beskikbaar by WEBTOKEDie Kabinet moedig alle Suid-Afrikaners, veral die jeug, aan om onderwys as 'n loopbaan van keuse te verken.
tgt: More information is available on WEBTOKECabinet calls on all South Africans, especially the youth to explore teaching as a career of choice.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om ons sportsterre te eer deur hulle voor die einde van September 2015 vir die 2015 Sporttoekennings te nomineer.
tgt: Cabinet calls on South Africans to celebrate our sports stars by nominating them for the 2015 Sport Awards before the end of September 2015.

src: Mer inligting is beskikbaar by WEBTOKEDie Departement van Sport en Ontspanning Suid-Afrika sal van 5 tot 10 Oktober 2015 Jeugkampe in al die provinsies aanbied vir jeugdiges tussen die ouderdomme van 15 en 23 jaar.
tgt: More information is available on WEBTOKEThe Department of Sports and Recreation South Africa will from 5 to 10 October 2015 hold Youth Camps in all provinces for 15 to 23-year-olds.

src: Jeugkampe is deel van ’n wyer regeringsprogram om jong mense te ontwikkel, en met die nodige waardes, vaardighhede en kennis toe te rus wat hulle kan help om verantwoordelike burgers te word.
tgt: Youth camps are part of a broader government programme to develop young people, empower them with the requisite values, skills and knowledge that can assist them to become responsible citizens.

src: Die Kabinet moedig Suid-Afrikaners aan om die eerste jaarlikse Nasionale Ontspanningsdag, wat op 2 Oktober 2015 plaasvind, te ondersteun.
tgt: Cabinet has urged South Africans to support the first annual National Recreation Day, which will take place on 2 October 2015.

src: Op 10 Desember 2014, het die Kabinet verklaar dat die eerste Vrydag van Oktober elke jaar Nasionale Ontspanningsdag moet wees.
tgt: On 10 December 2014, Cabinet declared that the first Friday of October each year should be National Recreation Day.

src: Dié dag sal 'n geleentheid vir alle Suid-Afrikaners bied om aktief aan ontspanningsaktiwiteite deel te neem wat hulle gesondheid en welstand verbeter.
tgt: This day will provide an opportunity to all South Africans to actively participate in recreational activities that will improve their health and well-being.

src: ’n Gesonde en aktiewe burgery is 'n belangrike faktor in die verwesenliking van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsprogram se doelwitte.
tgt: A healthy and active citizenry is a key factor in realizing the NDP objectives.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Protea-kriektetspan sterkte toe met hul kriekettoer na Indië van 29 September tot 7 Desember 2015, en wens die Springbokke ook sterkte toe met hul beslissende Wêreldbekerwedstryd vandag (Saterdag).
tgt: Cabinet wishes the Proteas squad well for their cricket tour of India from 29 September to 7 December 2015, and also wishes the Springboks well ahead of their crucial World Cup game today (Saturday).

src: Die Kabinet moedig Suid-Afrikaners aan om ons spanne te ondersteun wanneer hulle in verskeie sporttoernooie meeding.
tgt: Cabinet encourages South Africans to support our teams as they compete in various competitions.

src: Die Kabinet se standpunt oor belangrike kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on key issues in the environment.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die Regering se R22-miljoen-belegging in die verdere ontwikkeling van geriewe by Maropeng.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes government’s R22-million investment to further develop the facilities at Maropeng to include a 500-seater amphitheatre and renovate the visitors’ centre to cater for the expected influx of new visitors.

src: Dit sluit ’n amfiteater met sitplek vir 500 mense in, asook die opknapping van die besoekersentrum om voorsiening te maak vir die verwagte invloei van nuwe besoekers.
tgt: This follows the historic discovery of Homo Naledi at the Cradle of Humankind Word Heritage Site.

src: Dit volg op die historiese ontdekking van Homo Naledi by die Wieg van die Mesdom Wêreld Erfenisterrein.
tgt: Cabinet noted recent developments around the Annual National Assessments (ANA) and urges all parties to work towards a solution that prioritises and protects the rights of the learners.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van onlangse ontwikkelings rondom die Jaarlikse Nasionale Assesseringstoetse (ANA) en doen ’n ernstige beroep op al die partye om saam te werk om ’n oplossing te vind wat leerders se regte eerste stel en beskerm.
tgt: The ANA are a critical tool to identify gaps so as to ensure targeted intervention for the development of learners and teachers.

src: Terwyl die Regering kennis neem van onderwysers se bekommernisse, wys hy daarop dat onderwys die belangrikste prioriteit moet wees.
tgt: While government notes the concerns raised by teachers, it maintains that education should be the main priority.

src: Die Kabinet sluit aan by die res van die land om hulde te bring aan Tshimangadzo Samuel Benedictus Daswa, 'n 43-jarige onderwyser van Tshitanini in Limpopo, wat op 2 Februarie 1990 gesterf het vir sy sterk godsdienstige oortuigings.
tgt: Cabinet joins the rest of the country in paying tribute to Blessed Tshimangadzo Samuel Benedict Daswa, a 43-year-old schoolteacher from Tshitanini village in Limpopo, who was killed on 2 February 1990 for his strong religious beliefs.

src: Dit is ook die eerste keer in die geskiedenis van die Rooms-Katolieke Kerk van Suider-Afrika dat 'n Suid-Afrikaner as 'n geseënde martelaar van Christus erken word.
tgt: This is also the first time in the history of the Catholic Church of Southern Africa that a South African was recognised as a Blessed Martyr of Christ.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om hulde te bring aan Suid-Afrika se eerste plaaslike martelaar deur ons te verbind om in vrede en harmonie saam te leef en mekaar se grondwetlike en menseregte te respekteer.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to pay homage to South Africa’s first home-grown martyr by committing ourselves to ensuring that we all live together in peace and harmony, and respect one another’s constitutional and human rights.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense oor aan die Black Mamba Anti-Poaching Unit.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the Black Mamba Anti-Poaching Unit, a South African ranger group consisting of women, which won the Champions of the Earth award, a top UN environmental prize.

src: Die Mambas kry erkenning vir die impak wat hulle in die stryd teen stropery gemaak het en vir hul moedige optrede.
tgt: The Mambas were recognized for the impact they have made in combating poaching and their courageous actions.

src: Hierdie impak blyk duidelik uit die feit dat die 26-lid-eenheid sedert sy ontstaan in 2013, gehelp het om ses stropers in hegtenis te neem, die stel van strikke met 76 persent te verminder, meer as 1 000 strikke te verwyder, en vyf stroperskampe en twee bosvleiskombuise buite werking te stel.
tgt: This impact is evident because since its inception in 2013, the 26-member unit has helped to arrest six poachers, reduced snaring by 76 per cent, and removed over 1 000 snares, and put five poachers’ camps and two bush meat kitchens out of action.

src: Die Kabinet het eervolle vermelding gemaak van die genomineerdes en wenners van die 2015 Mbokodo-toekennings, ’n vennootskap tussen die Departement van Kuns en Kultuur en die private sektor.
tgt: Cabinet commends the nominees and winners of the 2015 Mbokodo Awards, a partnership between the Department of Arts and Culture and the private sector.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense oor aan die Hoof van die Nasionale Tesourie se Gespesialiseerde Ouditdienste, MeZanele Mxunyelwa, wat as 2015 se Gesertifiseerde Ondersoeker van die Jaar aangewys is deur die Vereniging van Gesertifiseerde Bedrogondersoekers.
tgt: Cabinet congratulated National Treasury’s head of specialised audit services, Ms Zanele Mxunyelwa, who was named the 2015 Certified Examiner of the Year by the Association of Certified Fraud Examiners.

src: Hierdie gesogte toekenning bevestig dat die Regering die stryd teen bedrog en korrupsie versnel het, wat ’n waarskuwing is aan mense wat beplan om by korrupte en bedrieglike aktiwiteite betrokke te raak om hulle daarvan te weerhou.
tgt: This top award confirms that government has stepped up the fight against fraud and corruption, and those planning corrupt and fraudulent activities have been warned to refrain from doing so.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy medelye oor aan die familie en vriende van Reggie Vandeyar, ’n politieke aktivis wat talle veldtogte gelei het, insluitend die uitdagingsveldtog, en 10 jaar op Robben-eiland deurgebring het.
tgt: Cabinet conveys its condolences to the family and friends of Reggie Vandeyar, a political activist who was at the forefront of many campaigns, including the defiance campaign and spent 10 years on Robben Island.

src: Hy was ’n afgevaardigde by die Congress of the People wat die Vryheidshandves goedgekeur het, en hy het saam met verskeie gemeenskappe gewerk.
tgt: He was a delegate to the Congress of the People that adopted the Freedom Charter and he worked with various communities.

src: Hy is op 20 September 2015 ter ruste gelê tydens ’n spesiale amptelike provinsiale begrafnis.
tgt: He was laid to rest at the Special Provincial Official Funeral on Sunday, 20 September 2015.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy medelye oor aan die familie en vriende van wyle MnrWandile Dlamini wat op 21 September 2015 oorlede is.
tgt: Cabinet conveys its condolences to the family and friends of the late Mr Wandile Dlamini who passed away on 21 September 2015.

src: MnrDlamini, wat ook as “Quesh” bekend was, was ’n politieke aktivis en voormalige lid van Umkhonto we Sizwe.
tgt: Popularly known as “Quesh”, Mr Dlamini was a political activist and former member of Umkhonto we Sizwe.

src: Hy was eers in Lesotho en later in Zambië in ballingskap tot die ontbanning van die ANTen tye van sy dood, was hy as Algemene Bestuurder in diens van die Staatsveiligheidsagentskap.
tgt: Whilst in exile he was based in Lesotho and later in Zambia until the unbanning of the ANAt the time of his death he was working as the General Manager in the State Security Agency.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die betrokke klaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: SASSA:a. MnrTsakeriwa Joseph Chauke as Hoof Finansiële Beampte enb.
tgt: SASSA:Mr Tsakeriwa Joseph Chauke as the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) andMr Abraham Sonny-Boy Mahlangu as the Executive Manager: ICICT B-BBEE Charter Council:6.

src: MnrAbraham Sonny-Boy Mahlangu as Uitvoerende Bestuurder: Inligtings kommunikasie tegnologie.
tgt: Telecommunications sub-sectorMr Lucky Mokgabudi Masilela (South African Communications Forum) andMs Sarah-Jane Capazario (Internet Service Providers’ Association).

src: Inligtingskommunikasietegnologie van die B-BBEE Charter Council:6.
tgt: Electronic sub-sectorMr Raletlhogonolo Andile Tlhoaele (Communications Cabling Association of Southern Africa) andMr Mduduzi Odysseus Mkhonza (Black IT Forum).

src: MnrLucky Mokgabudi Masilela (Suid-Afrikaanse Kommunikasieforum enb.
tgt: Information Technology sub-sectorMr Gavin Pieterse (Information Technology Association) andMr Adrian Schofield (Institute of Information Technology Profssionals of South Africa).

src: MeSarah-Jane Capazario (Vereniging van Internetdiensverskaffers).
tgt: RegulatorCouncillor Katharina Pillay (Independent Communications Authority of South Africa).

src: MnrRaletlhogonolo Andile Tlhoaele (Suider-Afrikaanse Vereniging van Kommunikasie-kabelaanleg [Communications Cabling Association of Southern Africa]) enb.
tgt: WomenMs Nokuzola Nelly Ehrens (South African Communications Forum).

src: MnrMduduzi Odysseus Mkhonza (Black IT Forum).
tgt: YouthMs Morwesi Ramonyai (Young Entrepreneurs South Africa).

src: Implementering van die belangrikste Regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of Key Government Programmes.

src: Die Kabinet ondersteun die inisiatiewe wat die Minister van Finansies, Nhlanhla Nene, in die Meiumtermynbegroting-beleidsverklaring aangekondig het.
tgt: Cabinet supports the initiatives announced by Finance Minister Nhlanhla Nene in the Medium Term Budget Policy Statement.

src: Hierdie inisiatiewe sal die ekonomie deur tye van traer wêreldwye ekonomiese groei en wisselvalligheid lei.
tgt: These initiatives will guide the economy through times of slower global economic growth and volatility.

src: Suid-Afrika het vordering gemaak op die gebied van maatskaplike en ekonomiese transformasie en om die struikelblokke wat ekonomiese groei kortwiek, die hoof te bied.
tgt: South Africa has made progress in social and economic transformation and in addressing barriers to economic growth.

src: Minister Nene het die bestedingsraamwerk van die land vir die volgende drie jaar voorgelê.
tgt: Minister Nene presented the country’s expenditure framework for the next three years.

src: Die bestedingsraamwerk sal verseker dat die Regering op koers bly met die uitvoering van sy programme soos uiteengesit in die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan.
tgt: The expenditure framework will ensure government remains on cause in implementing its programmes as spelt out in the National Development Plan.

src: Die sleutelprioriteite bly die kern van die mediumtermyn-bestedingsplanne.
tgt: The key priorities remain at the centre of the medium-term expenditure plans.

src: Die Kabinet ondersteun die Regering se kostebesparingsmaatreëls wat sal verseker dat prioriteite geensins in gedrang kom nie.
tgt: Cabinet further supports the cost containment measures of government which will ensure the priorities of government are not compromised in any way.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die uitkomste van President Jacob Zuma se werkbesoek aan die Demokratiese Republiek van die Kongo (DRK) van 16 tot 17 Oktober 2015.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the outcomes of the working visit by President Jacob Zuma to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) from 16 to 17 October 2015.

src: Oor die volgende dekade gaan die binasionale kommissie die inwerkingstelling van gesamentlike ekonomiese projekte verskerp, veral die Grand Inga-hidrokragprojek.
tgt: Over the next decade the Bi-National Commission will intensify the implementation of joint economic projects, in particular the Grand Inga Hydropower Project.

src: Die projek sal bykomende energie aan die land en die Suider-Afrikaanse streek voorsien.
tgt: The project will result in additional source of energy to the county’s energy grid and to the Southern African Region.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa se werkbesoek aan Stockholm, Swede, van 18 tot 20 Oktober 2015.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the successful conclusion of the working visit by Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa to Stockholm, Sweden from 18 to 20 October 2015, where he co-chaired the 9th session of the South Africa-Sweden Bi-National Commission, which saw the launch of the environment, energy and water sub-committee.

src: Sleutelkabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet het sy steun toegesê aan die G20-lande se Hoëvlakbeginsels oor Voordelige Deursigtigheid van Eienaarskap.
tgt: Cabinet has approved the endorsement of the G20 countries’ High Level Principles on Beneficial Ownership Transparency.

src: Die beginsels stel maatreëls voor wat elke lidland moet tref om die misbruik van regspersone en regsaangeleenthede oor eienaarskap te voorkom.
tgt: The Principles sets out measures which each member country will have to take to prevent the misuse of legal persons and legal arrangements on ownership.

src: Die Kabinet keur verder die oprigting van die interdepartementele komitee goed wat sal toesig hou oor die inwerkingstelling van en verslagdoening oor die land se aksieplan.
tgt: Cabinet further approved the setting up of the inter-departmental Committee that will oversee the implementation and reporting of the Country’s Action Plan.

src: Die Departement van Staatsdiens en Administrasie sal die komitee byeenroep.
tgt: The Committee will be convened by the Department of Public Service and Administration.

src: Hoëvlakbeginsels sal die deursigtigheid van regspersone verbeter en reëlings is belangrik om die integriteit en deursigtigheid van die wêreldwye finansiële stelsel te beskerm.
tgt: High level principles will improve the transparency of legal persons and arrangements is important to protect the integrity and transparency of the global financial system.

src: Voorkoming van die misbruik van hierdie entiteite vir onwettige bedrywighede soos korrupsie, belastingontduiking en geldwassery steun die G20-doelwitte om groei deur beleggings uit die privaat sektor te verhoog.
tgt: Preventing the misuse of these entities for illicit purposes such as corruption, tax evasion and money laundering supports the G20 objectives of increasing growth through private sector investment.

src: Die Kabinet keur Suid-Afrika se voorsitterskap van die Bestuurskomitee van die Oop Regeringsvennootskap (ORV) in 2015-2016 goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved South Africa’s taking up of the Chairpersonship Open Government Partnership (OGP) Steering Committee in 2015-2016.

src: Die Kabinet onderskryf ook Suid-Afrika se derde ORV Nasionale Konsepaksieplan.
tgt: Cabinet also endorsed South Africa’s draft 3rd OGP National Action Plan.

src: Die ORV is ’n wêreldwye inisiatief bestaande uit ’n koalisie van die voorste regerings en burgerlike organisasies wat saamwerk om deursigtigheid en aanspreeklikheid in regering te bevorder.
tgt: The OGP is a global initiative comprised of a coalition of leading governments and civil society organizations working to advance transparency and accountability in government – with the goals of increasing the responsiveness of government to citizens, countering corruption, promoting economic efficiencies, harnessing innovation, and improving the delivery of services.

src: Sedert die ontstaan van die ORV is Suid-Afrika ’n aktiewe lid van die reëlingskomitee, die hoogste besluitnemende liggaam.
tgt: Since the inception of the OGP, South Africa has been an active member of the Steering Committee, which is the highest decision-making body.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Internasionale Konvensie oor die Siviele Aanspreeklikheid vir Skade weens Skeepsoliebesoedeling, 2001 aan die Parlement vir bekragtiging voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved that the International Convention on the Civil Liability for Bunker Oil Pollution Damage, 2001 be submitted to Parliament for ratification.

src: Die Skeepsoliekonvensie verseker dat alle deelnemers baat by die herstel van die skade wat weens 'n ongeluk veroorsaak is.
tgt: The Bunkers Oil Convention ensures all the participants benefit on the reparation on damages that occur as a result of accident on its shores.

src: Die konvensie geld net vir skeepsolieongelukke wat nie deur ander internasionale konvensies gedek word nie.
tgt: This convention will only be applicable to ship oil accidents that are not covered by other international conventions.

src: Suid-Afrika is nie aanspreeklik vir ekonomiese verlies of opruimingskoste voortspruitend uit die storting van skeepsolie binne die waters van sy interne, territoriale en eksklusiewe ekonomiese sones nie.
tgt: South Africa will not be liable for economic loss or cleaning-up costs arising from a release of bunker oil in its internal, territorial and exclusive economic zone waters but liability will be on the ship–owner or the insurer.

src: Die konvensie verseker ook dat voldoende, vinnige en doeltreffende vergoeding beskikbaar is vir mense wat skade ly weens oliestortings wanneer dit as brandstof op skepe vervoer word.
tgt: The Convention also ensures that adequate, prompt, and effective compensation is available to persons who suffer damage caused by spills of oil, when carried as fuel in ships’ bunkers.

src: Die Kabinet keur die muntontwerpe van die Suid-Afrikaanse Munt vir die numismatiese herdenking en sirkulasiemuntstukke van 2015 en 2016 goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the South African Mint Company’s coin designs for the 2015 and 2016 numismatic commemorative and circulation coins.

src: Die temas weerspieël Suid-Afrika se erfenis (van die hede en die verlede), sy fauna en flora en sy maatskaplike prestasies, en is in pas met wêreldwye numismatiese tendense.
tgt: The themes reflect South Africa’s heritage (both past and present), its fauna and flora and its social achievements and they also fall-in with worldwide numismatic trends.

src: a) Die 2015 Herdenkingmuntreeks – 200-jaar-herdenking van die Naamgewing van Griekwastadb) Die 2015-viering van ’n Suid-Afrikaanse munt – Die sekretarisvoëlc) Die 2016-protea-reeks – Lewe van 'n legende: NR Mandelad) Die 2016-natura-reeks – Jagters van die Nag (die gevlekte hiëna)e) Die 2016-reeks van Suid-Afrikaanse reptiele (die Kaapse dwergverkleurmannetjie)f) Die 2016-Biosfeer-reservaatreeks (Kaapse Weskus-biosfeer)g) Die 2016 silwer reeks – Suid-Afrika se beskermde marienegebiede.
tgt: a) The 2015 Commemorative Coin Series – 200 Year Anniversary of the Coinage of Griqua Townb) The 2015 Celebrating South Africa Coin – The Secretary Birdc) The 2016 Protea Series – Life of a Legend: NR Mandelad) The 2016 Natura Series – Nocturnal Hunters (The Spotted Hyena)e) The 2016 South African Reptiles Series (The Cape Dwarf Chameleon)f) The 2016 Biosphere Reserve Series (Cape West Coast Biosphere)g) The 2016 Silver Series – South Africa’s Marine Protected Areas.

src: Wetsontwerpe.
tgt: Bills.

src: Die Kabinet keur die Spesiale Begrotingswetsontwerp vir die Nuwe Ontwikkelingsbank vir tertafellegging in die Parlement goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the New Development Bank Special Appropriation Bill for introduction in Parliament.

src: Daarvolgens sal Suid-Afrika sy eerste kapitaalpaaiement van R2 miljard aan die nuwe Brics-Ontwikkellingsbank in die finansiële jaar 2015/2016 oorbetaal.
tgt: This will enable South Africa to pay its, first capital instalment of R2 billion to the BRICS led New Development Bank in the 2015/2016 financial year.

src: Die Nuwe Ontwikkelingsbank is ’n multilaterale ontwikkelingsbank wat deur die Brics-lande (Brasilië, Rusland, Indië, China en Suid-Afrika) bedryf word om groter samewerking op finansiële en ontwikkelingsgebied tussen die vyf ontluikende markte te bevorder.
tgt: The New Development Bank is a multilateral development bank operated by the BRICS states (Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa) to foster greater financial and development cooperation among the five emerging markets.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp op die Nasionale Gesondheidslaboratoriumdiens, 2015 in die Staatskoerant gepubliseer word vir openbare kommentaar.
tgt: Cabinet approved publication of the National Health Laboratory Service Amendment Bill, 2015 in the Government Gazette, for public comments.

src: Die wysigings versterk die beheer en befondsingsmeganisme van die Nasionale Gesondheidslaboratoriumdiens om toegang tot gesondheidsorg te verbeter.
tgt: The amendments strengthen the governance and funding mechanism of the National Health Laboratory Service so as to enhance access to health care.

src: Die Wetsontwerp verseker verder dat dit die Nasionale Gesondheidslaboratorium se kernmandaat is om diagnostiese gesondheidslaboratoriumdienste aan die publiek te lewer.
tgt: The Bill further ensures that the National Health Laboratory’s core mandate is to provide diagnostic health laboratory services to the public.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Finansiële Wetsontwerp, 2015 by die Parlement ingedien word.
tgt: Cabinet approved submission of the Finance Bill, 2015 to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp maak voorsiening vir die magtiging van ongemagtigde uitgawes deur die nasionale Regering as 'n direkte opdrag aan die Nasionale Inkomstefonds.
tgt: The Bill provides for the authorization of national government unauthorized expenditure as a direct charge against the National Revenue Fund.

src: Dit volg op artikel 34 van die Wet op die Bestuur van Openbare Finansies, 1999, en gee uitvoering aan die aanbevelings van die Nasionale Vergadering se Komitee oor Openbare Rekeninge.
tgt: It follows section 34 of the Public Finance Management Act, 1999 and gives effect to the recommendations of the National Assembly’s Committee on Public Accounts.

src: Die Wetsontwerp verseker gesonde en volhoubare bestuur van die nasionale Regering se finansiële sake en dat alle uitgawes in ooreenstemming met die heersende wetgewende raamwerk gemagtig word.
tgt: The Bill ensures sound and sustainable management of the financial affairs of national government and that all expenditure is authorized in accordance with the prevailing legislative framework.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: President Jacob Zuma sal die derde Spitsberaad van die Indië-Afrikaforum tussen 26 en 29 Oktober 2015 in Nieu-Delhi, Indië, bywoon.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will attend the 3rd India-Africa Forum Summit between 26 and 29 October 2015 in New Delhi, India.

src: Die 2015-spitsberaad is uitgebrei om al 54 Afrika-lande in te sluit.
tgt: The 2015 Summit has been expanded to include all 54 African nations and will boost trade as well as address common challenges.

src: President Jacob Zuma het Mosambiek se President, Filipe Nyusi, gister by die Uniegebou in Pretoria onthaal.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma hosted Mozambican President Filipe Nyusi at the Union Buildings in Tshwane yesterday.

src: Die twee lande deel sterk ekonomiese bande soos blyk uit die meer as 60 bilaterale ooreenkomste en memorandums van verstandhouding wat verskeie sektore dek.
tgt: Both countries share strong economic ties demonstrated by the over 60 bilateral agreements and memoranda of understanding covering various sectors.

src: Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa se werkbesoek aan Havana, Kuba, van 22 tot 26 Oktober 2015, sal politieke en ekonomiese betrekkinge tussen die twee lande verder versterk.
tgt: Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa’s working visit to Havana, Cuba from 22 to 26 October 2015, will further strengthen political and economic relations between the two countries.

src: Die Afrika-unie gaan vanaf 19 Oktober tot 7 November 2015 die AMANI AFRIKA (Vrede in Afrika) II Veldopleidingsoefening by die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Weermag se vegopleidingsentrum te Lohatla in die Noord-Kaap hou.
tgt: The African Union is conducting the AMANI AFRICA (Peace in Africa) II Field Training Exercise at the South African Army Combat Training Centre at Lohatla in the Northern Cape from 19 October to 7 November 2015.

src: Nagenoeg 5 400 lede van die weermag, polisie en burgerlike komponente verteenwoordigend van vyf plaaslike ekonomiese gemeenskappe van die AU sal aan die oefening deelneem.
tgt: Approximately 5 400 members from the military, police and civilian components representing five of the Regional Economic Communities of the AU will participate in the exercise.

src: Die doel is om die strydvaardigheid van die Afrika-bystandsmag en sy vermoë vir vinnige ontplooiing te evalueer om vredesendings te onderneem ter bereiking van volle operasionele vermoë teen Desember 2015 .
tgt: The aim is to evaluate the state of readiness of the African Standby Force and its Rapid Deployment Capability to undertake peacekeeping missions towards the achievement of Full Operational Capability by December 2015.

src: Die Kabinet wens alle leerders, veral die matriekklas van 2015, sterkte toe met hul Nasionale Seniorsertifikaat- (NSS) eksamen, wat op 26 Oktober 2015 begin en tot 27 November 2015 duur.
tgt: Cabinet wishes all students and particularly the Class of 2015 well with their 2015 National Senior Certificate (NSC) examinations, which begins on 26 October 2015 and continues until 27 November 2015.

src: Vanjaar is 801 688 kandidate geregistreer om die eksamen te skryf waarvan 674 232 voltydse en 127 456 deeltydse leerders is.
tgt: This year 801 688 candidates are registered to sit for the examination of which 674 232 are full-time and 127 456 are part-time.

src: Nog ’n sukses is die groter getal leerders wat hul skoolopleiding voltooi het.
tgt: Another success in an increased number of learners who have completed their schooling years.

src: Alle ouers en voogde word aangemoedig om hul kinders met hul voorbereiding te ondersteun.
tgt: All parents and guardians are encouraged to support their children in their preparations.

src: Die Departement van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling gaan van 3 November tot 3 Desember 2015 Nasionale Maand vir Bewustheid van die Regte van Gestremdes vier, wat ook die Internasionale Dag van Persone met Gestremdhede sal insluit.
tgt: The Department of Social Development will mark National Disability Rights Awareness Month from 3 November to 3 December 2015, which also marks International Day of Persons with Disabilities.

src: Die maand bied ’n platform vir die Regering, die burgerlike samelewing, sakelui en arbeid om na te dink oor die vordering wat gemaak is ter bevordering en beskerming van die regte van persone met gestremdhede.
tgt: This month provides a platform for government, civil society, business and labour to take stock of progress made in promoting and protecting the rights of persons with disabilities.

src: Die Kabinet moedig Suid-Afrikaners aan om struikelblokke uit die weg te ruim wat mense met gestremdhede verhoed om voluit deel te neem aan die samelewing en die ekonomie.
tgt: Cabinet urges South Africans to continue breaking down the barriers, which prevent persons with disabilities from fully participating in society and the economy.

src: Die Staatsinligtingstegnologie-agentskap (SITA) hou vanjaar die 10de Staatstegnologiekonferensie (GovTech), wat op dienslewering binne die openbare Inligtingskommunikasietegnologie (IKT) fokus.
tgt: The State Information Technology Agency (SITA) will this year host the Tenth Government Technology Conference, which focuses on public sector ICT service delivery.

src: GovTech 2015 vind plaas vanaf 25 tot 28 Oktober 2015 onder die tema Vennootskap vir Dienslewering, met die subtema Verbind Gemeenskappe vir Ontwikkeling en Groei.
tgt: GovTech 2015 takes place from 25 to 28 October 2015 under the theme: “Partnering for Service Delivery”, with a sub-theme of ‘Connecting Communities for Development and Growth’.It will also see the launch the ICT Public Service Delivery Awards.

src: Dit ondersteun ‘South Africa Connect’, soos aangekondig deur President Jacob Zuma in sy 2014-Staatsrede, deur ’n platform te bied om praktiese en progressiewe oplossings vir ’n ontwikkelende land te vind deur middel van IKT-hulpmiddels.
tgt: It supports ‘South Africa Connect’, as announced by President Jacob Zuma in his 2014 State of the Nation Address, by providing a platform to find practical and progressive solutions to a developing nation using ICT tools.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed da ’n Nasionale Imbizo-fokusweek van 30 November tot 6 Desember 2015 onder die tema Saam beweeg ons Suid-Afrika vorentoe aangebied word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the hosting of a National Imbizo Focus Week from 30 November to 6 December 2015 under the theme: “Together We Move South Africa Forward”.

src: Hierdie tydperk van direkte kommunikasie sal aandui dat daar vordering is met die inwerkingstelling van inisiatiewe van die Negepuntplan om die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie te laat groei.
tgt: This period of direct communication will demonstrate progress in delivering on initiatives of the Nine Point Plan to grow the South African WEBTOKEN also provides a platform for public participation and meaningful dialogue to revive the economy.

src: Dit bied ook ’n platform vir openbare deelname en betekenisvolle dialoog om die ekonomie ’n hupstoot te gee.
tgt: Members of the Executive are urged to dedicate time to contribute towards extending the reach of this campaign to areas across the country.

src: Die klem moet op die versterking van vennootskappe en verhale van begunstigdes geplaas word.
tgt: Emphasis should be placed on amplifying partnerships and stories from beneficiaries.

src: Die GCIS is verantwoordelik vir die koördinering van die veldtog en sal omvattende hulpmiddels, insluitend belangrike boodskappe asook ’n mediaplan, versprei.
tgt: GCIS is responsible for the coordination of the campaign and will be disseminating a comprehensive toolkit, including key messages and a media plan.

src: Die Kabinet se standpunt oor belangrike kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on key issues in the environment.

src: Volgehoue hoë temperature oor groot dele van die land benadruk verantwoordelike watergebruik deur alle burgers van die land.
tgt: Persistently high temperatures over large parts of the country underscores responsible water use by all.
