src: Die Kabinet moedig alle Suid-Afrikaners aan om water spaarsamig te gebruik en hierdie kosbare hulpbron te bewaar.
tgt: Cabinet encourages all South Africans to use water sparingly and conserve this precious resource.

src: Inwoners in KwaZulu-Natal word aangemoedig om aan waterbeperkings te voldoen aangesien die provinsie tans die ergste droogte in baie jare ondervind.
tgt: Residents in KwaZulu-Natal are urged to adhere to water restrictions as the province experiences the worst drought in years.

src: Suid-Afrikaners moet water bespaar deur motors met emmers te was, tuine saans nat te maak, watermeters vir ’n hoë verbruik te monitor en waterlekkasies te herstel.
tgt: South Africans must save water by not using a hosepipe to wash cars, watering gardens in the evening, monitoring water meters for high consumption and fixing water leaks.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy meegevoel oor aan die familie en vriende van diegene wat gesterf het toe die steierwerk van die Great Walk-voetgangerbrug naby Graystonrylaan in Sandton ineengestort het.
tgt: Cabinet conveys its condolences to the family and friends of those who lost their lives when scaffolding on the Great Walk Bridge on Grayston Drive in Sandton collapsed.

src: Die Kabinet wens alle beseerdes ’n spoedige herstel toe.
tgt: Cabinet also wishes those injured a speedy recovery.

src: Die Kabinet loof alle nooddienste, die Stad Johannesburg en die Gautengse Provinsiale Regering vir hul vinnige reaksie asook vervoermaatskappye in Gauteng wat pendelaars te hulp gesnel het.
tgt: Cabinet commends all emergency services, the City of Johannesburg and the Gauteng Provincial Government for their quick response as well as transporters in Gauteng who stepped in to assist commuters.

src: Die Kabinet spreek sy dank uit teenoor pendelaars vir hul geduld tydens die opruimingswerk.
tgt: Cabinet extends its gratitude to commuters for their patience during the clean-up operations.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep dat die ondersoek na die gebeure deeglik en gou afgehandel sal word om die oorsaak van die voorval te bepaal en ’n herhaling daarvan te voorkom.
tgt: Cabinet urges for the investigation that is underway to be thorough and swift so as to get to the root cause of the incident and prevent a recurrence.

src: Die Kabinet versoek die publiek om geduldig te wees terwyl die ondersoek aan die gang is.
tgt: Cabinet requests patience while the investigation is underway.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die 2015/16-uitslae van die Wêreld Ekonomiese Forum se jaarlikse Wêreldmededingindheidsindeks, waarin Suid-Afrika met sewe plekke gestyg het, van 56ste tot 49ste uit 140 lande.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the 2015/16 results of the World Economic Forum’s annual Global Competitiveness Index, which saw South Africa rise seven places from 56 to 49 of 140 countries.

src: Die grootste verbeteringe was op die gebiede van gesondheid en primêre onderwys (ses plekke hoër), doeltreffende arbeidsmark (ses plekke hoër), tegnologiese gereedheid (16 plekke hoër), en innovering (vyf plekke hoër).
tgt: South Africa’s biggest improvements are in the areas of: health and primary education (up 6 places), labour market efficiency (up 6 places), technological readiness (up 16 places), and innovation (up 5 places).This demonstrates that working together we are doing more.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op die sakesektor en burgerlike samelewing om steeds met die Regering saam te werk om ons ekonomie te verbeter.
tgt: Cabinet calls on business and civil society to continue partnering with government to take our economy onto a higher trajectory.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Nywerheidsontwikkelingskorporasie (NOK), wat vanjaar sy 75ste verjaardag vier, baie geluk.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the Industrial Development Corporation (IDC) which is celebrating its 75th Anniversary this month.

src: Die NOK is ’n nasionale hulpbron wat oor die afgelope 21 jaar van demokrasie, wesentlik tot verhoogde belegging, die voortsetting van industrialiseringsgeleenthede en die transformasie van die ekonomie bygedra het.
tgt: The IDC is a national resource and over the past 21 years of democracy, it has contributed very significantly to increased investment, pursuing industrialization opportunities and transformation of the economy.

src: Sedert 1994 het die NOK R150 miljard in Suid-Afrika en die res van Afrika belê.
tgt: Since 1994, the IDC has invested R150 billion in South Africa and the rest of Africa.

src: Hiervan is R60 miljard in maatskappye belê waarin swart Suid-Afrikaners ’n aandeel van minstens 25% het.
tgt: Of this R60 billion as invested in companies in which black South Africans hold at least 25% equity.

src: R20 miljard is in dié tydperk in die res van Afrika belê ter verbetering van groei en ontwikkeling in Afrika asook om geleenthede vir die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie te skep.
tgt: R20 billion was invested over this period in the rest of Africa, helping to strengthen African growth and development and also contributing to creating opportunities for the South African economy.

src: Oor die afgelope vyf jaar het dit ook ’n bykomende R103 miljard van beleggingsvennote uit die private sektor getrek, wat die organisasie se totale belegging op R163 miljard te staan WEBTOKEN die huidige klimaat waartydens die ekonomie groot uitdagings in die gesig staar, moet die NOK sy bydrae tot die ekonomie en die effek daarvan op transformasie verdiep en op die bevordering van swart nyweraars en jeugbemagtiging fokus.
tgt: In the past five years, it has also attracted an additional R103 billion from private sector investor partners, bringing its investment impact to R163 WEBTOKEN a period that the economy faces new challenges and headwinds, the IDC will be expected to strengthen further its contribution to the economy and to deepen its impact on transformation, focused on promoting black industrialists and youth empowerment.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Springbokke geluk dat hulle vir die halfeindstryd van die Wêreldbeker-toernooi in Engeland gekwalifiseer het en doen ’n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om ons nasionale rugbyspan te ondersteun in hul poging om die Wêreldbeker vir die derde keer huis toe te bring.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the Springboks for qualifying from the semi-finals of the Rugby World Cup in England and urges South Africans to support our national rugby team as they strive to bring the World Cup home for the third time.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Amajimbo’s sterkte toe terwyl hulle om die o.17-FIFA-wêreldbeker in Chili vanaf 17 Oktober tot 8 November 2015 meeding.
tgt: Cabinet wishes the Amajimbos well as they compete in the U-17 FIFA World Cup in Chile from 17 October to 8 November 2015.Cabinet congratulates Orlando Pirates for reaching the finals of the 2015 Orange CAF Confederation Cup and Banyana Banyana for qualifying for the 2016 Olympic Games.6 Cabinet also extends its condolences to the family and friends of former 2013 African Cup of Nations (Afcon) and African Nations Championship (Chan) Local Organising Committee CEO and SABC Executive‚ Mvuzo Mbebe who passed away on Monday night.7 Cabinet is deeply saddened by the passing of Mlungisi Sisulu, the second son of Walter and Albertina Sisulu, and conveys its condolences to his family and WEBTOKEN Sisulu played an active role in ANC underground structures in the 1980s, harbouring Umkhonto weSizwe units in his small shop in Soweto‚ known as Shop 7‚ at great risk to himself.

src: Die Kabinet wens Orlando Pirates geluk dat hulle die eindstryd van die 2015 Orange CAF Konfederasiebeker gehaal het en vir Banyana Banyana dat hulle vir die 2016 Olimpiese Spele gekwalifiseer het.6 Die Kabinet dra sy meegevoel oor aan die familie en vriende van Mvuzo Mbebe, die voormalige uitvoerende hoof van die 2013 Afrikabeker-toernooi en Afrika-nasieskampioenskap se plaaslike reëlingskomitee en SAUK uitvoerende hoof, wat Maandagnag oorlede is.7 Die Kabinet is diep geroer deur die afsterwe van Mlungisi Sisulu, die tweede seun van Walter en Albertina Sisulu, en dra sy meegevoel aan die familie en vriende oor.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Jacob Zuma in conveying condolences to the family and friends of one of South Africa’s finest actors, Sammy Moeti who passed away on Monday, 13 October 2015, after a long illness.8 Cabinet discussed extensively the recent student protests against university fee increases for 2016 academic year.

src: Die Kabinet simpatiseer met studente wat voel dat die koste verbonde aan hoër onderwys te duur is en dat dit ontoeganklik vir veral arm gesinne is.
tgt: Cabinet sympathizes with the concerns of the students who find the cost for higher education too expensive and inaccessible to the students coming from poor families.

src: Onderwys is een van die kernelemente om die huidige uitdagings van armoede, ongelykheid en werkloosheid wat die land in die gesig staar te verminder.
tgt: Education is one of the core elements to reduce the current challenges of poverty, inequalities and unemployment the country is facing.

src: Ons Grondwet bepaal dat elkeen die reg het op basiese onderwys en verdere onderwys, wat die staat deur redelike maatreëls toeganklik moet maak.
tgt: Our Constitution provides that everyone has the right to basic education and further education, which the State through reasonable measures must make available and accessible.

src: Die huidige Regering het sedert 1994 toegang tot onderwys ’n prioriteit gemaak.
tgt: The current government has since 1994, made access to education a priority focus area.

src: Die Nasionale Finansiële Hulpskema vir Studente (NSFAS) wat behoeftige studente bystaan, het oor die jare van R300 miljoen tot R9,5 miljard gegroei.
tgt: The National Student Fund Aid Scheme (NSFAS) which has contributed to the needy students has increased over the years from R300m to R9, 5bn.

src: In die huidige akademiese jaar, ondersteun die Regering sowat 45 000 arm en akademies verdienstelike studente.
tgt: In this academic year, government is supporting 45 000 poor and academically deserving students.

src: Die Minister van Hoër Onderwys en opleiding het die Kabinet ingelig oor beraadslaging met alle betrokkenes om ’n oplossing vir die kwessie oor studiegeld te vind.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed by the Minister of Higher Education and training on the current interaction he is having with all the relevant stakeholders to find a solution to the fees increases.

src: Die Kabinet is ook beoordeel op die werk wat gedoen is om die bestuur van NSFAS te verbeter.
tgt: Cabinet was also appraised on the work that is been done towards improving the management of NSFAThe recommendations are to be tabled to Cabinet in its next cycle.

src: Die Kabinet het verder kennis geneem van die onlangs gestigte Presidensiële Taakspan met die mandaat om stygende universiteitsgeld te ondersoek.
tgt: Cabinet further noted the recently established Presidential Task Team which has been mandated to look into the escalating university fees.

src: Die span bestaan uit verteenwoordigers van studente, universiteitsrade en die departement.
tgt: This team comprises of representatives of students, University Councils and the Department.

src: Die span sal na verwagting binnekort sy werk afhandel waarna dit oor die bevindinge verslag sal doen.
tgt: The team is expected to finalize its work and report as soon as it has concluded its task.

src: Die Kabinet glo die pogings deur die President en die Minister van Hoër Onderwys het reeds en gaan nog baie doen om studente se kommer die hoof te bied.
tgt: Cabinet believes that the efforts led by both the President and Minister of Higher Education have and will go a long way in addressing the concerns of students.

src: Die erns waarmee die Regering studente se griewe hanteer, het die President genoop om die leierskap van studente en universiteite vandag byeen te roep om die erns van die kwessie te bepaal en ’n oplossing daarvoor te vind.
tgt: The seriousness with which the government looks at the grievance of the students, has led the President to call the leaderships of the students and university today so as to get to the depth of the issues with a view to finding a solution.

src: Die President sal die land later oor die kwessie toespreek aangesien dit ’n saak van nasionale belang is.9 Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die vordering van die Interministeriële Komitee oor Immigrasieregulasies, wat deur die Adjunkpresident gelei is.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the progress on the Inter- ministerial committee on Immigration Regulations which was led by the Deputy President.

src: Die President het die Interministeriële Komitee in die lewe geroep om die onbedoelde gevolge vasn die regulasies soos deur belanghebbendes in die toerismebedryf geopper is, te ondersoek.
tgt: The President had set up this IMC so as to investigate the unintended consequences that were raised by the stakeholders in the tourism sector.

src: Nadat aspekte wat aangepas kan word om die veiligheidsoorwegings en die onbedoelde gevolge te hanteer, ondersoek en verken is, het die komitee die volgende aanbevelings gemaak:Aansoek in persoon:Toegewings wat binne die volgende drie maande van krag sal wordDie Departement van Binnelandse Sake (DBS) sal aansoeke deur die pos aanvaar van lande waar geen Suid-Afrikaanse missies is nie.
tgt: Having investigated and explored areas that can be adjusted to deal with both the security consideration and the unintended consequences the IMC made the following recommendations.

src: Daarna sal biometrie en foto's van reisigers met hul aankoms by grensposte vasgelê word.
tgt: Thereafter, the biometrics and photos of those travellers will be captured on arrival at ports of entry.

src: Hierdie toegewing sal slegs op ’n besoekers-/mediese visum van toepassing wees.
tgt: This concession will only be applicable to visitors/medical Visa.

src: Die DBS sal biometrie (insluitend vingerafdrukke en foto's) by grensposte in werking stel.
tgt: The DHA will implement the biometrics (including fingerprints and photos) at ports of entry starting.

src: Die maatreëls sal eerstens by die OR Tambo-lughawe, die King Shaka-lughawe en die Kaapstadse Internasionale Lughawe in werking gestel word.
tgt: The pilot sites will be at OR Tambo Airport King Shaka Airport and Cape Town International Airport.

src: Die DBS sal ’n program vir ’n geakkrediteerde toerismemaatskappy (GTM) vir China, Indië en Rusland bekend stel met moontlike uitbreiding na ander lande van wie visums vereis word.
tgt: DHA will introduce an Accredited Tourism Company (ATC) Programme for China, India and Russia with possible extension to other visa requiring countries.

src: Die DBS sal steeds langtermynvisums vir veelvuldige binnekoms aan gereelde reisigers uitreik.
tgt: DHA will continue to issue a long-term Multiple Entry Visa to frequent travellers.

src: Dit sal vir ’n tydperk van meer as drie maande, maar nie langer nie as drie jaar geldig wees.
tgt: This will be valid for a period exceeding 3 months but not exceeding 3 years.

src: Toegewings wat binne drie maande tot een jaar van krag sal weesDie DBS sal visumfasiliteringsentrums in China, Indië, die Verenigde Koninkryk, Nigerië, die Demokratiese Republiek van die Kongo, Angola, Ghana, Kenia en Uganda uitbrei.
tgt: DHA will increase Visa Facilitation Centres (VHC) in China, India, United Kingdom, Nigeria Democratic Republic of Congo, Angola, Ghana, Kenya and Uganda.

src: Die DBS sal die opening van visumfasiliteringsentrums in Zimbabwe, die VAE en Botswana versnel.
tgt: The DHA will fast-track the opening of VFC in Zimbabwe, UAE and Botswana.

src: Toegewings wat ná ’n jaar van krag sal wordDie DBS sal voorvluginspeksies (insluitend operasionele sentrums) by internasionale lughawens in werking stel.
tgt: The DHA will install systems for pre-flight checks (including operation-centres) at international airports.

src: Die DBS sal gevorderde stelsels vir die verwerking van passasiers opgradeer om ’n rekord van passasiersname te hou om risiko-assessering te verbeter.
tgt: The DHA will upgrade Advance Passenger Processing (APP) systems and implement a Passenger Name Record (PNR) to enhance risk assessment.

src: Die DBS sal die outomatisering van die visum-en-toelatingstelsel finaliseer.
tgt: The DHA will finalise the automation of the visa and permitting system.

src: Vereistes vir kinderreisigers: Suid-Afrikaanse kindersWat betref Suid-Afrikaanse kinders (wat na die buiteland reis), het die komitee die inwerkingstelling van die huidige reisvereistes vir kinders aanvaar, insluitende ouers se toestemming deur middel van beëdigde verklarings om kinders te beskerm.
tgt: Child-travel requirements: South African WEBTOKEN respect of South African children (outbound travel) the IMC accepted the implementation of the current child-travel requirements, including the parental consent affidavits as these seek to protect children.

src: Toegewings wat binne die volgende drie maande van krag sal wordSkoolhoofde sal briewe uitreik wat sal bevestig dat kinders toestemming het om op skooltoere te reis.
tgt: Concessions to be effective within the next 3 WEBTOKEN principals will issue letters confirming the permission for children to travel on school tours.

src: Hierdie magtiging sal ook uitgebrei word en geregistreerde sportliggame insluit.
tgt: This authority will also be extended to include registered sports bodies.

src: Die geldigheid van ouers se beëdigde verklaring van toestemming sal uitgebrei word na ’n tydperk nie langer nie as ses maande.
tgt: The validity of the Parental Consent Affidavit will be extended to a period no longer than 6 months.

src: Toegewings wat binne die volgende drie maande tot ’n jaar van krag sal wordDie term “onverkorte geboortesertifikaat” sal verander na “geboortesertifikaat met besonderhede van ouers”.Besonderhede van die ouers sal in paspoorte gedruk word, sodat ouers wie se besonderhede gedruk is dus nie nodig sal hê om geboortesertifikate by hulle te hê nie.
tgt: The term “Unabridged Birth Certificate” will be changed to “Birth Certificate containing parental details”Details of parents will be printed in passports, so that parents whose particulars are printed would therefore not be required to carry birth certificates.

src: Vereistes vir kinderreisigers: buitelandse kindersWat betref inkomende reisigers, neem die komitee die standpunt in dat waar ’n visum vereis word, die voorsiening van oorspronklike geboortesertifikate of gesertifiseerde afskrifte van vereiste dokumente moet voortgaan tydens die visumaansoekproses, aangesien dit strookmet praktyke in verskeie ander lande.
tgt: Child-travel requirements: foreign WEBTOKEN respect of inbound travellers, the IMC took the position that where visas are required, provision of original birth certificates or certified copies of required documents should continue during the visa application process as this is in line with practise in many other WEBTOKEN respect of children from visa-exempt countries, the IMC recommended a dispensation in terms of which:Travellers will be strongly advised to bring along proof of the relation and consent from the absent parent/s or guardian/sAll the other administrative issues affecting the relevant departments will be resolved through inter-departmental engagements.

src: Wat betref kinders van lande wat van visums vrygestel is, beveel die komitee aan dat:Reisigers sterk aangeraai moet word om bewys te lewer van die verhouding en toestemming van die afwesige ouer/s of voog/de.
tgt: Cabinet endorsed these recommendations and believes these will address the unintended consequences that were raised and also the safety of the children will not in any way be compromised.

src: Implementering van die belangrikste Regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of key government programmes.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die Loodsprojek vir Ondernemingsontwikkeling van R20 miljoen.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the R20-million Enterprise Development pilot project.

src: Dié twee-jaar-loodsprojek het ten doel om Suid-Afrika se nywerheidsparke te vernuwe, gespesialiseerde nywerheidsgeriewe te vestig en die integrasie van plaaslike ekonomiese ontwikkeling te ondersteun om die kleinsakesektor te versterk.
tgt: This two-year pilot programme aims to revitalise South Africa’s industrial parks, establish specialised industrialised facilities and support the integration of local economic development in order to bolster the small business sector.

src: Die projek is ’n vennootskap met die Departemente van Handel en Nywerheid, Kleinsakeontwikkeling, Nasionale Tesourie en die Middelinkomstetoelaag van die Afrika-ontwikkelingsbank.
tgt: The project is a partnership with departments of trade and industry, small business development, National Treasury, and the Middle Income Grant of the African Development Bank.

src: Die projek beoog om ’n bydrae te maak tot werkskepping en die verligting van armoede in agtergeblewe gemeenskappe, en om toegang tot tegnologie en vaardighede vir klein-, medium- en mikro-ondernemings (KMMO's) te verbeter.
tgt: The project envisages to contribute towards job creation, reduce poverty in depressed communities, and improve access to technology and skills for small, medium and micro enterprises (SMMEs).The initiative will offer support to the SMME sector until December 2017.

src: Op grond van sy sukses, sal die Regering dit oorweeg om die projek landwyd bekend te stel.
tgt: Based on its successes, government will consider rolling it out across the country.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van die Gesamentlike Operasionele Sentrum deur President Jacob Zuma in Skukuza.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the launch by President Jacob Zuma of the Joint Operation Centre in Skukuza.

src: Hierdie sentrum sal operasies teen renosterstropery in daardie gebied koördineer.
tgt: This centre will coordinate operations against the scourge of rhino poaching in that area.

src: Sleutelkabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet het die Swartnyweraarsbeleid, wat deel is van die Nywerheidsbeleid-aksieplan (NBAP) goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Black Industrialists Policy, which is part of the Industrial Policy Action Plan (IPAP).

src: Hierdie beleid is in ooreenstemming met die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan en die Negepuntplan wat President Zuma in vanjaar se staatsrede aangekondig het.
tgt: This policy is in line with the National Development Plan and the Nine-Point Plan announced by President Zuma in the 2015 State of the Nation Address.

src: Dit is ook deel van die Regering se breë nywerheidsinisiatief om die nywerheidsbasis te verbreed en nuwe entrepreneursdinamika in die ekonomie te pomp.
tgt: It is also part of government’s broad industrialization initiatives to expand the industrial base and inject new entrepreneurial dynamism in the economy.

src: Die beleid vereis sterker beleidsingrypings deur die Staat om die land se nywerheidsektor uit te brei en die ekonomie te laat groei deur toegewyde ondersteuning aan swart nyweraars soos uitgelig in die NBAP.
tgt: It calls for bolder policy interventions on the part of the State to expand the industrial base of the country and grow the economy through dedicated support to black industrialists as highlighted in the IPAP.

src: Hierdie beleid sal op die groei en internasionale mededingendheid van ondernemings in swart besit fokus.
tgt: This policy will focus on the growth and global competitiveness of black-owned enterprises.

src: Die bedoeling is om tot die verandering in die demografie van die nywerheidsektor by te dra en swart nyweraars te betrek, wat volgens sommige onderbenut word in terme van werk, inkomste, belasting en innovering.
tgt: The intention is to contribute towards shifting the demographic composition of South Africa’s industrial sector and engage black industrialists, who are regarded as the underused sources of jobs, revenue, taxes and innovation.

src: Die beleid sal help dat maatskappye in swart besit en bestuur betekenisvol aan die waardekettings van die nywerheidsektor deelneem.
tgt: The policy will facilitate meaningful participation of majority black-owned and managed companies in the value chains in the industrial sector of the economy.

src: Die Minister van Handel en Nywerheid sal 'n afsonderlike mediakonferensie hou om hierdie beleid te uiteen te sit.
tgt: The Minister of Trade and Industry will hold a separate media briefing to unpack this policy.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat Suid-Afrika se derde Nasionale Verslag oor die inwerkingstelling van die Cartagena-protokol oor Bioveiligheid, vir voorlegging aan die Sekretariaat van die Konvensie oor Biologiese Diversiteit voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved South Africa’s Third National Report on the Implementation of the Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety, for submission to the Secretariat of the Convention on Biological Diversity.

src: Die protokol bepaal die bewegings van lewende gemodifiseerde organismes, ook bekend as geneties gemodifiseerde organismes wat die gevolg is van moderne biotegnologie, van een land na ’n ander.
tgt: The protocol governs the movements of Living Modified Organisms, also known as Genetically Modified Organisms resulting from modern biotechnology, from one country to another.

src: Suid-Afrika is die negende grootste produsent van geneties gemodifiseerde gewasse in die wêreld en bly die pionier in die aanvaarding van sodanige gewasse.
tgt: South Africa is the ninth largest producer of genetically modified crops in the world and remains the pioneer for the adoption of genetically modified crops.

src: Dit is in lyn met artikel 24 van die Grondwet, wat volhoubare benutting van biodiversiteit bepleit.
tgt: This is aligned to Section 24 of the Constitution, which advocates for sustainable use of biodiversity.

src: Die Kabinet keur Suid-Afrika se aanvanklike aanbod van dienste ingevolge die besluit van die 9de Wêreldhandelsorganisasie (WHO) se ministeriële konferensie goed om voorkeurbehandeling aan die mins ontwikkelde lande (MOL) te verleen.
tgt: Cabinet approved South Africa’s initial services offer in terms of the decision of the 9th World Trade Organization’s (WTO) Ministerial Conference to grant preferential treatment to Least Developed Countries (LDCs).South Africa is committed to implement the WTO agreement, which provides preferential support to the LDCs.

src: Suid-Afrika is verbind tot die WHO-ooreenkoms, wat voorkeurbystand aan die MOL bied.
tgt: Of the 34 countries classified as LDCs, 25 are from Africa.

src: Van die 34 lande wat as MOL geklassifiseer word, is 25 in Afrika.
tgt: South Africa’s initial offering will be in services in the financial services, telecommunications, tourism and transport sectors.

src: Suid-Afrika se eerste aanbieding sal bestaan uit finansiële dienste, en dienste uit die telekommunikasie-, toerisme- en vervoersektore.
tgt: Such an offering forms part form of easing market access for services and service providers into the markets of non-LDCs.

src: Die Kabinet keur 'n hersiene 5,5%-lewenskoste-aanpassing aan lede van die Suid-Afrikaanse Meseregtekommissie (SAMRK) goed met ingang 1 April 2015.
tgt: Cabinet approved a revised remuneration of 5.5% cost-of-living adjustment to be paid to members of the South African Human Rights Commission (SAHRC) with effect from 1 April 2015.

src: Dit is in lyn met artikel 9 (1) van die SAMRK-wet , 2013 (Wet 40 van 2013).
tgt: This is in line with Section 9(1) of the SAHRC Act, 2013 (Act 40 of 2013).

src: Die Kabinet keur die indiening van Suid-Afrika se gekombineerde Tweede Chemiese Verslag onder die Afrika-handves vir Meseregte en die eerste verslag onder die Protokol vir die Afrika-handves oor Vroueregte in Afrika goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of South Africa’s combined Second Periodic Report under the African Charter on Human and People’s Rights and the Initial Report under the Protocol to the African Charter on the Rights of Women in Africa.

src: Die verslag aan die Afrika-unie-kommissie is 'n evaluering van prestasies en uitdagings wat uitvoering gee aan burgerlike, politieke, sosio-ekonomiese en kulturele regte.
tgt: The report to the African Union (AU) Commission is an evaluation of achievements and challenges in giving effect to civil, political, socio-economic and cultural rights.

src: Dit is in lyn met Suid-Afrika as ondertekenaar van die AU-protokol van die Afrika-Handves vir Meseregte oor die Regte van Vroue in Afrika.
tgt: This is in line with South Africa being party to the AU Protocol to the African Charter on Human and People’s Rights on the Rights of Women in Africa.

src: Die Kabinet keur die bekendstelling van 'n Lesotho-bedeling goed wat op 1 Februarie 2016 sal begin.
tgt: Cabinet approved the introduction of a Lesotho dispensation to commence from 1 February 2016.

src: Dit volg op die spesiale bedeling wat in 2010 aan Zimbabwe toegestaan is, wat sedertdien uitgebrei is.
tgt: This follows the special dispensation that was granted to Zimbabwe in 2010, which has subsequently been extended.

src: Hierdie bedeling sal help om die vloei van arbeid van Lesotho-burgers wat na Suid-Afrika kom en die huidige immigrasiemeganismes oortree, beter te bestuur.
tgt: This dispensation will assist in better management of the labour flow of Lesotho nationals who come to South Africa in violation of the current immigration mechanisms.

src: Die Minister van Binnelandse Sake sal meer besonderhede tydens 'n mediakonferensie in 'n later stadium bekend maak.
tgt: The Minister of Home Affairs will provide more details at a media briefing at a later stage.

src: Die Minister van Finansies het die Kabinet ingelig oor die inwerkingstelling van die Wysigingswet op Belastingwette van 2013 en 2014 wat op 1 Maart 2016 in werking tree.
tgt: The Minister of Finance briefed Cabinet on the implementation of the Taxation Laws Amendment Act of 2013 and 2014 to take effect 1 March 2016.

src: Hierdie hervormings is daarop gemik om die belasting van aftredebydraes en-voordele te vereenvoudig.
tgt: These reforms are aimed at harmonizing and simplifying the taxation of retirement contributions and benefits.

src: Die uitbreiding van die belastingvoordeel om voorsorgfondse te dek sal maak dat meer as een miljoen werknemers meer geld in hul sak sal hê.Dit sal ook keer dat hoërinkomstegroepe belasting vermy deurdat ’n maksimum van 27,5% tot R350 000 van vergoeding of belasbare inkomste aftrekbaar sal wees.
tgt: Extending the tax benefit to cover members’ provident funds will enable over one million workers to enjoy a higher take-home salary.

src: Die Minister het die Kabinet ook ingelig oor die beginsel van annuïtisering vir alle aftreefondse, waarvolgens diegene wat by belastingaftrekkings baat ook ’n deel van hul spaargeld by aftrede sal moet annuïtiseer.
tgt: This will also prevent tax avoidance practices by higher-income earners to a maximum of per cent of remuneration or taxable income up to R350 000.The Minister also briefed Cabinet on the principle of annuitisation for all retirement funds, whereby those benefitting from the tax deduction also have to annuitise part of their savings at retirement.

src: Hierdie hervormings sal ná uitgebreide konsultering met alle belanghebbendes binne en buite die Nasionale Ekonomiese Ontwikkelings- en Arbeidsraad in werking gestel word, en minstens 33 vergaderings is sedert 2012 met die arbeids- en nywerheidsektore gehou.
tgt: These reforms are being implemented after extensive consultations with all stakeholders within and outside the National Economic Development and Labour Council, with at least 33 meetings held with labour and industry since 2012.

src: Die meeste belanghebbendes het hul volle steun toegesê aan die hervormings wat op 1 Maart 2016 in werking tree.
tgt: The overwhelming majority of stakeholders have indicated their full support for proceeding with the reforms on 1 March Bills.

src: Die Kabinet keur die indiening van die Uitsaaiwet-wysigingswetsontwerp van 2015 aan die Parlement goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Broadcasting Amendment Bill of 2015 to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp wysig die Uitsaaiwet, 1999 (Wet 4 van 1999) om ’n stabiele korporatiewe bestuursmodel te ontwikkel wat stabiliteit en volhoubaarheid aan die Suid-Afrikaanse Uitsaaikorporasie (SAUK) oor die lang termyn sal verseker.
tgt: The Bill amends the Broadcasting Act, 1999 (Act 4 of 1999) so as to develop and implement a stable corporate governance model that ensures long-term stability and sustainability of the South African Broadcasting Corporation (SABC).Government is committed to a strong, independent and relevant public broadcaster, which is accountable to the shareholder, the public and Parliament.

src: Die vermoë om sy mandaat na te kom hang van die SAUK-raad se vermoë af om strategiese rigting aan die openbare uitsaaier te gee.
tgt: The ability to discharge its mandate is dependent on the optimal performance of the SABC Board in providing strategic direction to the public broadcaster.

src: Die Kabinet keur die Versekeringswysigingswet van 2015 vir voorlegging in die Parlement goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the Insurance Bill of 2015 to be introduced in Parliament.

src: Die wetsontwerp maak voorsiening vir ’n gekonsolideerde wetlike raamwerk vir die ekonomiese toesig van die versekeringsektor in ooreenstemming met internasionale standaarde vir die regulering van die versekeringsektor.
tgt: The Bill provides a consolidated legal framework for the prudential supervision of the insurance sector that is consistent with international standards for insurance regulation.

src: Die wetsontwerp bevorder die huidige vereistes vir risikobestuur, kapitaal en bestuur.
tgt: The Bill enhances the current risk management, capital and governance requirements.

src: Dit vervang en konsolideer wesentlike dele van die Langtermynversekeringswet, 1998 (Wet 52 van 1998) en die Korttermynversekeringswet, 1998 (Wet 53 van 1998) met betrekking tot ekonomiese toesig.
tgt: It replaces and consolidates substantial parts of the Long-term Insurance Act, 1998 (Act 52 of 1998) and the Short-term Insurance Act, 1998 (Act 53 of 1998) relating to prudential supervision.

src: Die Kabinet het die Konsepwet oor Myneksplorasie en Finansies in Afrika in die Staatskoerant vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer.
tgt: Cabinet approved the publication of the Draft African Exploration Mining and Finance Bill in the Government Gazette, for public comment.

src: Die wetsontwerp vestig hiermee die Korporasie vir Myneksplorasie en Finansies in Afrika deur wetgewing.
tgt: The Bill establishes the African Exploration Mining and Finance Corporation through legislation.

src: Dit definieer ook sy mandaat en strategiese doelwitte.
tgt: It also defines its mandate and strategic objectives.

src: Dit versterk die bestuur en toesig van die entiteit.
tgt: It strengthens the governance and oversight of the entity.

src: Die Kabinet keur die bekendstelling van die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Beskermde Bekendmakings, 2015, in die Parlement goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the introduction of the Protected Disclosures Amendment Bill of 2015 in Parliament.

src: Die wetsontwerp verbreed die toepassing van die Wet op Beskermde Bekendmakings, 2000 (Wet 26 van 2000) buite die tradisionele verhouding tussen werkgewer en werknemer.
tgt: The Bill extends the application of the Protected Disclosures Act, 2000 (Act 26 of 2000) beyond the traditional employer and employee relationship.

src: Die wysigings reguleer gesamentlike aanspreeklikheid, stel 'n plig in om openbaarmakings te ondersoek, maak voorsiening vir immuniteit teen siviele en strafregtelike aanspreeklikheid in sekere omstandighede, en kriminaliseer opsetlike vals openbaarmakings.
tgt: The amendments regulate joint liability, introduce a duty to investigate disclosures, provide for immunity against civil and criminal liability in certain circumstances and criminalise intentional false disclosures.

src: Die wetsontwerp dra by tot die Regering se verbintenis om bedrog en korrupsie uit te roei deur fluistervinke te beskerm.
tgt: The Bill contributes to government’s commitment to fight fraud and corruption by strengthening the protection of whistleblowers.

src: Die Kabinet keur die bekendstelling van die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Administratiewe Beregting van Padverkeersmisdrywe van 2015 in die Parlement goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the introduction of the Administrative Adjudication of Road Traffic Offences Amendment Bill of 2015 in Parliament.

src: Die wetsontwerp wysig die Wet op Administratiewe Beregting van Padverkeersmisdrywe, 1998 (Wet 46 van 1998).Die wetsontwerp sal die Padverkeeroortredingsagentskap en uitreikingsowerhede help om finansieel stabiel te bly en doeltreffendheid met die bediening van kennisgewings aan oortreders te verbeter.
tgt: The Bill amends the Administrative Adjudication of Road Traffic Offences Act, 1998 (Act 46 of 1998).The Bill will assist the Road Traffic Infringement Agency and the issuing authorities to be financially stable, and it also introduces efficiencies in serving notices to infringers.

src: Komende gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: President Zuma sal die G20-beraad op 15 en 16 November 2015 in Antalya, Turkye, bywoon.
tgt: President Zuma will attend the G20 Summit on 15 and 16 November 2015 in Antalya, Turkey, where the focus will be on inclusive and robust growth through collective action.

src: Die fokus van die besoek sal op inklusiewe en sterk groei deur gesamentlike optrede wees.
tgt: Leaders at the summit will discuss inclusiveness, implementation and investment to achieve strong, sustainable and balanced growth at a global level.

src: President Zuma sal op 10 November 2015 'n amptelike besoek aan Berlyn, Duitsland, bring, waar Kanselier Angela Mekel hom sal ontvang.
tgt: President Zuma will undertake an Official Visit to Berlin, Germany on 10 November 2015, where he will be hosted by Chancellor Angela Merkel.

src: Die President sal ook 'n hoflikheidsbesoek aan President Joachim Gauck bring.
tgt: The President will also pay a courtesy call to President Joachim Gauck.

src: Die twee lande sal tydens die besoek hul verbintenis herbevestig om bilaterale en ekonomiese betrekkinge te versterk.
tgt: During the visit the two countries will reconfirm their commitment to further enhance bilateral and economic relations.

src: President Zuma gaan die Eerste Minister van Nederland, Mark Rutte, op 17 November 2015 by die Uniegebou in Pretoria ontvang.
tgt: President Zuma will receive Dutch Prime Minister Mark Rutte at the Union Buildings on 17 November 2015.Following this, Prime Minister Rutte will lead a business delegation to Johannesburg and Cape Town which will focus on agriculture, healthcare, transport, infrastructure, water and energy.

src: Hierna sal Rutte ’n sake-afvaardiging na Johannesburg en Kaapstad lei wat op landbou, gesondheidsorg, vervoer, infrastruktuur, water en energie sal fokus.
tgt: South Africa will host the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation Summit in Johannesburg on 4 and 5 December 2015.

src: Suid-Afrika sal die Forum vir die Beraad oor Samewerking tussen China en Afrika in Johannesburg op 4 en 5 Desember 2015 aanbied.
tgt: The objectives of the summit are to profile the 5-10 Year Strategic Programme for Cooperation between South Africa and China (2015-2024) and to promote bilateral agreements between the two countries.

src: Die beraad sal die strategiese program vir samewerking tussen Suid-Afrika en China oor vyf en 10 jaar (2015-2024) profileer en bilaterale ooreenkomste tussen die twee lande bevorder.
tgt: Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa will lead a high-level delegation on an Official Visit to the Islamic Republic of Iran from 7 to 9 November 2015, to further bilateral political and economic relations between the two countries.

src: Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa sal ’n hoëvlakafvaardiging tydens ’n amptelike besoek aan die Islamitiese Republiek van Iran van 7 tot 9 November 2015 lei.
tgt: President Zuma will on 6 November 2015 conduct a Siyahlola monitoring visit to Bushbuckridge in Mpumalanga, which will focus on water and sanitation.

src: Nagenoeg 16 600 huishoudings sal by Fase 1 van die Regering se waterprojek in die gebied baat, wat water lewer aan 24 dorpe in die Bosbokrand Plaaslike Munisipaliteit.
tgt: A total of 16 600 households are benefitting from Phase 1 of government’s water project in the area, which delivers water to 24 villages in the Bushbuckridge Local Municipality.

src: Die Regering bly daartoe verbind om te verseker dat alle Suid-Afrikaners toegang tot basiese dienste het.
tgt: Government remains committed to ensuring that all South Africans have access to basic services.

src: Tussen 2002 en 2014 het die persentasie van huishoudings wat toegang tot water het van 80 tot 86% gestyg, en sanitasie het van 62 tot 80% gestyg.
tgt: Between 2002 and 2014, the percentage of households that have access to water increased from 80 per cent to 86 per cent, while sanitation increased from 62 per cent to 80 per cent.

src: President Zuma sal die inhuldiging van die verkose president van die Verenigde Republiek van Tanzanië, sy Eksellensie John Pembe Magufuli op 5 November 2015 bywoon.
tgt: President Zuma will attend the inauguration of the President-elect of the United Republic of Tanzania, His Excellency Mr John Pembe Magufuli, on 5 November Congratulatory message.

src: Die Kabinet wens die staatsamptenare geluk wat benoem is vir die 3de Nasionale Batho Pele-toekennings vir Uitnemendheid.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the public servants who were nominated in the 3rd National Batho Pele Excellence Awards.

src: Die toekennings vind op 13 November 2015 by Emperor's Palace, Gauteng, plaas onder die tema: "Batho Pele - Mese Eerste".
tgt: The awards take place on 13 November 2015 at Emperor’s Palace, Gauteng under the theme: “Batho Pele – Putting People First”.

src: Hulle beloon beste praktyk, goeie prestasie en meet burgers se tevredenheid ten opsigte van die Regering se prestasie.
tgt: They reward best practice, good performance and gauge citizens’ satisfaction towards government performance.

src: Die Kabinet wens die regerings en die mense van die Republiek van die Ivoorkus en die Verenigde Republiek van Tanzanië geluk met hul vreedsame verkiesings.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the government and the people of both the Republic of Côte d’Ivoire and the United Republic of Tanzania for holding peaceful elections.

src: Die grootskaalse deelname deur Ivoorkussers en Tanzaniërs aan die algemene verkiesings weerspieël hul begrip van hoe belangrik dit is om ’n mens se burgerlike plig en fundamentele regte uit te oefen.
tgt: The massive participation by the Ivoirians and Tanzanians in the general elections reflects their understanding of the importance of exercising their civic duty and fundamental rights.

src: Dit is 'n aanduiding van die volwassewording van die demokratiseringsproses op die vasteland.
tgt: It is an indication of the maturation of the democratization process on the continent.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Springbok-span geluk met hul prestasie tydens die Internasionale Rugbyraad se 2015-rugbywêreldbeker.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the Springbok team for their performance in the International Rugby Board 2015 World Cup.

src: Die span het die bronsmedalje huis toe gebring.
tgt: The team brought home the bronze medal.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Suid-Afrikaanse swemspan geluk met hul deelname aan die FINA/airweave Wêreldbeker-swemtoernooi in Doha, Katar.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the South African swimming team for concluding the FINA/airweave Swimming World Cup in Doha, Qatar.

src: Cameron van der Burgh het 'n goue medalje in die 100 m-borsslag ingepalm.
tgt: Cameron van der Burgh won a gold medal in the 100 metres breaststroke race, Chad le Clos in the 100 metres butterfly also managed a fourth place finish in the 200 metres backstroke win.

src: Op sy beurt het Chad le Clos ook ’n goue medalje in die 100 m-vlinderslag gewen en 'n vierde plek in die 200 m-rugslag behaal.
tgt: Michael Meyer won silver in the 200 metres individual medley.

src: Michael Meer het silwer in die 200-meter individuele wisselslag behaal.
tgt: Douglas Erasmus won a bronze medal in the fast pace 50 metres freestyle.

src: Douglas Erasmus het 'n brons medalje in die snelle 50 m-vryslag gewen, Kaylene Corbett het die agtste plek in die 50-borsslag-eindronde behaal en Calvyn Justus het agtste in die 200 m-vryslag geëindig.
tgt: Kaylene Corbett came eighth in the 50 metres breaststroke final while Calvyn Justus also finished eighth in the 200 metres freestyle.

src: Konferensies.
tgt: Conferences.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom afgevaardigdes wat die 4de BRICS Internasionale Kompetisie-konferensie van 12 tot 13 November 2015 by die Inkosi Albert Luthuli-konferensiesentrum in Durban bywoon met die tema: "Meedinging en Inklusiewe Groei".Dit bring kenners in mededingingsreg byeen om te kyk hoe mededingingsbeleid kan bygra tot inklusiewe groei en ekonomiese ontwikkeling in die BRICS-lande (Brasilië, Rusland, Indië, China en Suid-Afrika).Suid-Afrika se sterk mededingingregulasies stel burgers in staat om vrylik aan die nasionale ekonomie deel te neem.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes delegates attending the 4th BRICS International Competition Conference from 12 to 13 November 2015 at the Inkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre, Durban under the theme: “Competition and Inclusive Growth”.This brings together experts in competition law to explore how competition policy can contribute to inclusive growth and economic development in BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa) countries.

src: Suid-Afrika mededingingregulasies dra tot groter burgerlike deelname by en het ’n groot bydrae gelewer om kartelle en prysvasstelling uit te roei.
tgt: South Africa’s strong competition regulation enables citizens to participate fairly in the national economy.

src: Dit het ’n leidende rol gespeel in die toepassing van oorwegings van openbare belang in samesmeltings en verkrygings.
tgt: It promotes the involvement of more people in the productive sectors of the economy and levels the playing field in business.

src: Die Minister van Vervoer, Dipuo Peters, sal die Tweede Wêreldkonferensie vir Ministers van Vervoer vanaf 18 tot 20 November 2015 in Brasilië bywoon.
tgt: Transport Minister Dipuo Peters will attend the Second Global Conference for Ministers of Transport from 18 to 20 November 2015 in Brazil, where South Africa will table its Mid-Term Country Report of progress made on the implementation of the United Nations Decade of Action for Road Safety 2011-2020 Global Plan.

src: Tydens die konferensie sal Suid-Afrika sy Middeltermyn-landsverslag voorlê wat sal handel oor die vordering wat gemaak is oor die inwerkingstelling van die Verenigde Nasies se Wêreldplan van ’n Dekade van Aksie vir Padveiligheid 2011 tot 2020.Suid-Afrika het hom daartoe verbind om teen 2020 padongelukke met die helfte, van 13 967 tot minder as 7 000 te verminder.
tgt: South Africa committed itself to reduce road carnage by 50 per cent from 13 967 to below 7 000 by 2020.

src: Suid-Afrika maak tans beduidende vordering om die doelwitte soos uiteengesit in die Wêreldplan van ’n Dekade van Aksie vir Padveiligheid 2011 tot 2020 te behaal, ondanks uitdagings waarmee die land te kampe het.
tgt: South Africa is making significant strides in achieving the targets as set out in the Decade of Action for Road Safety 2011-2020 Global Plan, despite challenges currently facing the country.

src: Die Kabinet se standpunt oor belangrike kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on key issues in the environment.

src: Die uitwissing van beperkings wat tot werkskepping kon lei bly ’n topprioriteit vir die Regering.
tgt: Addressing constraints to job creation remains a top priority for government.

src: Die Meiumtermyn-begrotingbeleidsverklaring het aangedui dat wêreldwye ekonomiese groei verlangsaam het.
tgt: The Medium Term Budget Policy Statement highlighted a global economic growth that has slowed, with depressed commodity prices and increased unemployment in many parts of the world.

src: Dit het tot laer kommoditeitspryse en stygende werkloosheid in baie dele van die wêreld gelei.
tgt: This was reflected in the Quarterly Labour Force Survey, which for the third quarter of 2015 recorded unemployment at per cent, marginally up from per cent in the same quarter last year.

src: Dit beklemtoon die noodsaaklikheid vir alle sektore om met die Regering saam te werk ter ondersteuning van inisiatiewe om werkgeleenthede te skep en meer Suid-Afrikaners aan die werk te kry.
tgt: This underscores the need for all sectors to work with government in support of the country’s initiatives to create employment opportunities and get more South Africans into work.

src: Die Regering is besig om deur middel van die negepuntplan groei te stimuleer en werk te skep deur nuwe geleenthede in strategiese ekonomiese gebiede te ontsluit.
tgt: Government, through the Nine-Point Plan, is working to ignite growth and create jobs by unlocking new opportunities in strategic economic areas.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom President Zuma se aankondiging van ’n nulpersentstyging in klasgelde by tersiêre instellings vir die 2016 akademiese jaar.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the announcement by President Zuma of a zero-percent increase at tertiary institutions for the 2016 academic year.

src: Die besluit bring broodnodige geldelike verligting, veral aan die armes, werkersklas en laermiddelklasgesinne met universiteitstudente.
tgt: This decision brings much needed monetary relief, especially to the poor, working class and lower middle class families with university students.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom verder die besluit van die President om ’n kommissie aan te stel om die kwessies wat studente geopper het te ondersoek.
tgt: Cabinet further welcomes the decision by the President to establish a commission to look into all the issues raised by the students.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die ingrypings deur die Departement van Water en Sanitasie om gemeenskappe in KwaZulu-Natal en die Vrystaat by te staan wat gebuk gaan onder droogte.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the interventions by the Department of Water and Sanitation to assist communities in KwaZulu-Natal and the Free State affected by the recent drought.

src: Gebiede wat water van die land se groter opgaardamme in landelike gebiede ontvang, het genoeg water omdat die opgaardamme tans sowat 66% vol is.
tgt: Areas that are supplied by the country’s larger regional water supply dams and schemes remain water secure as these systems are currently in a positive water balance with a national average dam storage at 66 per cent full.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die stigting van 'n interministeriële komitee (IMK) oor watersekerheid onder voorsitterskap van die Minister van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake, Pravin Gordhan.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the establishment of an Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC) on Water Security chaired by Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs Minister Pravin Gordhan.

src: Die IMK bestaan uit ministers van landelike ontwikkeling en grondhervorming, water en sanitasie, en landbou, bosbou en visserye.
tgt: The IMC consists of Ministers of Rural Development and Land Reform Water and Sanitation, and Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries.

src: Die komitee sal verdere ingrypings aan die gemeenskappe wat die ergste onder droogte gebuk gaan, bespreek en voorstel.
tgt: The committee will discuss and propose further interventions to the communities mostly affected by the drought.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van verwikkelinge in Nigerië rakende MTN se boete van VSA $ 5,2 miljard deur die Nigeriese Kommunikasiekommissie.
tgt: Cabinet noted developments in Nigeria regarding MTN’s US$5.2 billion fine by the Nigerian Communications Commission.

src: Die Kabinet vertrou dat die besprekings tussen MTN en die Nigeriese owerhede tot ’n spoedige oplossing van die geskille sal lei sodat MTN sal kan voortgaan om in die Nigeriese ekonomie te belê.
tgt: Cabinet trusts that the discussions underway between MTN and Nigerian authorities will result in the speedy resolution of the disputes so as to ensure MTN continues its business of investing in the Nigerian economy.

src: Die Kabinet neem met hartseer kennis van die ontydige dood van Chumani Nqakula, seun van die Minister van Verdediging en Militêre Veterane, Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula en Charles Nqakula, 'n lid van die Parlement.
tgt: Cabinet was saddened about the untimely death of Chumani Nqakula, the son of Defence and Military Veterans Minister Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula and Charles Nqakula, a Member of Parliament.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy innige meegevoel aan die Nqakula-familie en vriende oor.
tgt: Cabinet conveys its sincerest condolences to the Nqakula family and friends.

src: Die Kabinet dra ook sy innige meegevoel oor aan die familie en naasbestaandes van die Minister van Staatsdiens en Administrasie, Ngoako Ramatlhodi, ná die afsterwe van sy 95-jarige ma, Elizabeth Mmatlou Ramatlhodi.
tgt: Cabinet extends its heartfelt condolences to the family and relatives of Public Service and Administration Minister Ngoako Ramatlhodi, on the passing of his 95-year-old mother, Mmatlou Elizabeth Ramatlhodi.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan verifikasie van kwalifikasies en uitklarings.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: MnrMogojare Richard Seleka as die Direkteur-generaal (DG) in die Departement van Openbare Ondernemings, en.
tgt: Mr Mogojare Richard Seleka as the Director-General (DG) in the Department of Public Enterprises and.

src: Die Kabinet prys die Departement van Meslike Nedersettings vir die toekenning van huise in die Savanna City-projek vir Geïntegreerde Meslike Nedersettings aan behoeftiges in die Sedibeng-distriksmunisipaliteit.
tgt: Cabinet commends the progress made by the Department of Human Settlements in the Savanna City Integrated Human Settlements project in the Sedibeng District Municipality.

src: Vooraanstaande Suid-Afrikaners het belanghebbers in die bedryf, insluitend burgemeesters en beamptes van die Sedibeng-distriksmunisipaliteit, het gehelp om tydens die bekendstelling die voltooide huise te verf en tuin te maak.
tgt: Completion of the sustainable and integrated, new town development project, in ten years, will provide 18 399 Integrated housing units which include “Breaking New Ground Houses” and bonded houses, educational facilities, clinics, crèches, churches and retail sitesSince the beginning of construction early this year over 1 000 of the 18 399 houses are being built with over 100 completed.

src: Sowat 18 000 huise is gebou waarby veral bejaardes, mense met gestremdhede en gesinne waarvan kinders en vroue aan die hoof staan, baat.
tgt: Prominent South Africans joined industry stakeholders, including mayors and officials from the Sedibeng District Municipality, in working on three houses for the oldest beneficiaries.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom verder die aankondiging dat die departement volgende jaar ’n projek gaan bekend stel waarvolgens 60 000 huise gebou sal word.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the upgrading of the R25 (P6-1) road, a 42-kilometre road that links Gauteng and Limpopo.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die vordering wat gemaak is met die Tshepo "hoop" 10 000-projek, wat sal help om werkloosheid in die Stad Tshwane onder die jeug uit te wis.
tgt: The project, which stretches between Bapsfontein and Bronkhorstspruit, has employed more than 200 people.

src: Die Ministerie van Vervoer sal dus hierdie kabinetsbesluit aan die IMO-raadsvergadering, wat vanaf 23 November tot 4 Desember 2015 plaasvind, oordra.
tgt: President Zuma will lead a delegation to the 21st session of the Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) and the 11th Session of the Conference of Parties serving as the Meeting of Parties to the Kyoto Protocol (CMP11) to be held from 30 November to 11 December 2015 in Paris, France.

src: Die besoek is daarop gemik om die 5-10-jaarraamwerk oor samewerking tussen China en Suid-Afrika te finaliseer en die inwerkingstelling van ooreenkomste sedert die sluiting van die Beijing-verklaring in 2010 verder te voer.
tgt: In line with South Africa’s national interest as an African and developing country that will require post-2020 support, South Africa will continue to defend the UNFCCC’s core principles of equity and WEBTOKEN the Group of 77+China meeting, South Africa will seek to maintain and strengthen the unity of developing countries to obtain a Paris Agreement that is fair, ambitious, science-based and that produces the development space of developing countries.

src: Suid-Afrika sal tydens die byeenkoms van die Groep van 77+ China, poog om die eenheid onder ontwikkelende lande te versterk en te handhaaf om ’n Parys-ooreenkoms te sluit wat regverdig en ambisieus is, en op wetenskap berus, asook ontwikkelingsruimte bied vir ontwikkelende lande.
tgt: South Africa continues to make progress in the fight against HIV and AIDS, having expanded the country’s HIV treatment programme, with over three million people on antiretroviral treatment, further reducing mother-to-child transmission and recording improved tuberculosis indicators.

src: President Zuma sal die 16 Dae van Aktivisme-veldtog vir Geen Geweld teen Vroue en Kinders op 25 November 2015 in Naauwpoort, Mahikeng, bekend stel onder die tema: “Sluit my in: Saam beweeg ons 'n nie-gewelddadige Suid-Afrika vorentoe”.
tgt: Cabinet encourages South Africans to participate in the Izimbizo events planned across the country during National Imbizo Focus Week from 30 November to 6 December 2015.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om hierdie veldtog te ondersteun en om dié tyd te gebruik om gemeenskappe te inspireer en in vennootskap met die Regering geweld teen vroue en kinders te beëindig – #Count my In.
tgt: National Imbizo Focus Week will take place under the theme: “Together we move South Africa forward” and will update communities on government’s implementation of the Nine-Point Plan towards igniting economic growth and creating jobs, as outlined by President Zuma in his February 2015 State of the Nation Address.

src: Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa sal op 21 November 2015 ’n Regeringsafvaardiging lei tydens sy gereelde skakeling met die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Redakteursforum as deel van die Regering se verbintenis en deurlopende program om verhoudings met die media te versterk.
tgt: Members of the Executive will also use the opportunity to galvanise community participation in tackling various social ills, including matters relating to violence against women and children.

src: Die Regering gaan redakteurs oor belangrike kwessies en toekomsplanne inlig en redakteurs ’n geleentheid gee om sake van belang met die Regering op te neem.
tgt: December is Reconciliation Month and South Africa will mark Reconciliation Day on 16 December in Port Elizabeth, Eastern Cape under the theme: “Bridging the divide: Building a common South African nationhood towards a national developmental state”.

src: Suid-Afrika gaan Wêreldvigsdag vier onder die tema "Vir 'n MIV-vrye generasie: STAAN OTREE OBESKERZERO – dit is 'n beroep op gemeenskappe om daadwerklik op te tree”.
tgt: The month has a special significance for the nation as it promotes reconciliation, peace and social cohesion on which the country’s new democratic dispensation was founded.

src: Vanjaar se tema val saam met die Verenigde Nasies se Wêreldvigsdagtema vir 2011 tot 2015: “Kom by Zero uit”.
tgt: Cabinet encourages all South Africans to use the month to reach out to one another as the nation continues to work together to build a united and prosperous nation.

src: Die Kabinet bedank alle belastingbetalers dat hulle die Regering help om broodnodige dienste te verskaf wat sal help om die lewens van duisende gemeenskappe oor die hele land te verbeter.
tgt: Cabinet supports the actions of the Government Committee of Ministers on Water Scarcity and Drought to mitigate the effects of the drought and urges communities to use water sparingly in order to secure future supply.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Departement van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling se Beheersentrum vir Geslagsgebaseerde Geweld (BSVGG) geluk met hul toekenning vir die Wêreld se Beste Kontaksentrum.
tgt: Government has added R96,6 million to the initial R352,6 million set aside to support the country’s drought relief efforts.

src: Die Kabinet het by president Zuma en die internasionale gemeenskap aangesluit en die onlangse terreuraanvalle in Beiroet (Libanon), Bagdad (Irak), Yola (Nigerië) en Parys (Frankryk), wat tot die verlies van onskuldige lewens en die vernietiging van eiendom gelei het, veroordeel.
tgt: Members of the Southern African Customs Union (SACU) Council of Ministers met on 11 November 2015 in Windhoek, Namibia on the eve of the inauguration of the SACU headquarters and the informal discussion by the SACU Heads of State and Government.

src: Suid-Afrika veroordeel ten sterkste alle aanvalle op onskuldige burgerlikes en beklemtoon sy standpunt dat terrorisme, ongeag die vorm of streek, onaanvaarbaar is.
tgt: The council used the opportunity to reflect on the progress made on the Six-Point Plan since their last meeting and re-emphasized their commitment to SACThe council agreed that SACU should move beyond revenue-sharing to a developmental initiative that will support integration in the region.

src: President Zuma verwelkom die finalisering van die 15 aksiepunte van die G20/Organisasie vir Ekonomiese Samewerking en Ontwikkeling se projek vir Basis-erosie en die Verskuiwing van Wins, wat noodsaaklik is om regverdigheid en die beveiliging van die inkomstebasis in sub-Sahara-Afrika te verseker.
tgt: Cabinet commends South African filmmaker Reina-Marie Loader whose documentary ‘Horn’ received many accolades, including a nomination for the Rhino Conservation Awards 2015 in July in the category Best Awareness, Education and Funding, and winning the award for the Best Conservation Film at the 2015 International Film Festival in New York City, USCabinet extends its condolences to the family and friends of the Deputy Minister of Water and Sanitation, Ms Pamela Tshwete, on the loss of her mother, Mama Ruth Nomzi Zondeki.

src: Lede van die Suider-Afrikaanse Doeane-unie (SADU) se Ministersraad het op 11 November 2015 in Windhoek, Namibië vergader, op die vooraand van die inhuldiging van die SADU-hoofkwartier en informele bespreking deur die SADU-staatshoofde en die Regering.
tgt: Cabinet extends its condolences to the government of New Zealand , family, friends and the New Zealand Rugby Union on the loss of the rugby superstar, Jonah Tali Lomu, who has made a huge impact on the game.

src: l. Implementering van die belangrikste Regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of key government programmes.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die ondertekening van 26 ooreenkomste ter waarde van R94 miljard, tydens die onlangse staatsbesoek deur die President van China, Xi Jinping.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the signing of 26 agreements to the value of R94 billion during the recent State Visit by Chinese President Xi Jinping.

src: Die ondertekende ooreenkomste sluit in R12 miljard vir die bou van ’n motor-vervaardigingsaanleg in Suid-Afrika, ’n lening van $500 miljoen aan Eskom vir die ontwikkeling van infrastruktuur en ’n befondsingswaarborg vir Transnet van $2,5 miljard van die Chinese Ontwikkelingsbank.
tgt: The signed agreements included R12 billion to build a car-manufacturing plant in South Africa, a US$500 million loan facility to Eskom for infrastructure development and a US$2.5 billion funding guarantee for Transnet from the China Development Bank.

src: As deel van die Tweede Forum vir Samewerking tussen China en Africa (FSCA), het President Xi Jinping $60 miljard vir ontwikkeling in Afrika beloof.
tgt: As part of the 2nd Forum on China-Africa Cooperation (FOCAC), President Xi Jinping pledged US$60 billion for development in Africa.

src: Die FSCA se aanvaarding van ’n nuwe verklaring en aksieplan (2016–2018) konsolideer die groeiende wedersydse vennootskap tussen Afrika en China, wat nuwe handels- en beleggingsgeleenthede sal ontsluit en sal help om ekonomiese groei te stimuleer.
tgt: The adoption of a new Declaration and Plan of Action (2016-2018) at FOCAC consolidates the growing mutual partnership between Africa and China, which will unlock new trade and investment opportunities to help stimulate economic growth.

src: Die ekonomie het ’n verdere hupstoot gekry met die aankondiging van Suid-Afrika se BMW-groep dat hy R6 miljard in sy aanleg by Rosslyn, Pretoria, gaan belê.
tgt: The economy further received an economic boost with South Africa’s BMW Group announcing an investment of R6 billion at its plant in Rosslyn, Pretoria, which bears testament to the important partnership that exists between business and government, and the role that business is playing in the development of the economy.

src: President Zuma het nasionale ordes toegeken aan Suid-Afrikaanse burgers en vooraanstaande buitelandse burgers wat tot die opheffing van die mensdom bygedra het.
tgt: On Tuesday, 8 December, President Zuma bestowed National Orders to South African citizens and eminent foreign nationals who have contributed to the upliftment of humanity.

src: Die toekenning van nasionale ordes is ’n geleentheid om te besin en ’n viering van ons trots in ons mense.
tgt: The National Orders are a moment of great reflection, celebration and pride for our people.

src: Dit vier ons mense se prestasies, opofferings en pogings om Suid-Afrika ’n beter plek te maak.
tgt: They celebrate human achievement, human sacrifice and human endeavours that make our country a better place.

src: Ons bring hulde aan die ontvangers van die 2015 nasionale ordes.
tgt: We salute the recipients of the 2015 National Orders.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om water spaarsamig te gebruik.
tgt: Cabinet appeals to all South Africans to use water sparingly.

src: Dit is ter ondersteuning van ’n aantal maatreëls om watertekorte te verlig, wat deur die hittegolf van die afgelope paar weke vererger is.
tgt: This is in support of a number of measures taken to alleviate the water shortages, which have been exacerbated by the heatwave the country has experienced in the past weeks.

src: Hoewel die onlangse reën in dele van die land verligting gebring het, gaan die land steeds onder ernstige watertekorte gebuk, wat ons almal noop om water spaarsamig en verantwoordelik te gebruik.
tgt: Whilst the recent rainfalls in some parts of the country provided some relief, the country’s water shortage remains a real challenge and requires all of us to use water sparingly and responsibly.

src: Die Kabinet het sy waardering teenoor alle Suid-Afrikaners uitgespreek vir deelname aan vanjaar se veldtog van 16 Dae van Aktivisme vir Geen Geweld teen Vroue en Kinders, wat gister ten einde geloop het.
tgt: Cabinet expressed its appreciation to all South Africans for participating in this year’s 16 Days of Activism for No Violence against Women and Children campaign, which ended yesterday.

src: Onlangse navorsing dui op groot getalle nuwe MIV-infeksies, veral onder jong vroue en meisies in Afrika tussen die ouderdomme van 15 en 24 jaar.
tgt: Recent research indicates high numbers of new HIV infections, particularly among young women and girls in Africa between 15 and 24 years of age.

src: Suid-Afrikaners word aangemoedig om hul aktivisme verder te voer in hul alledaagse optrede as deel van die #365 Days Campaign-veldtog van Geen Geweld teen Vroue en Kinders en die #CountMen-veldtog wat volgende jaar heeljaar gehou sal word.
tgt: South Africans are encouraged to take forward their activism into everyday action as part of the #365 Days Campaign of No Violence Against Women and Children and the #CountMeIn campaign that unfolds throughout the year ahead.

src: Deur die #365 Days Campaign en #CountMen, moet die land lede van die gemeenskap, veral mans, mobiliseer om met die Regering saam te werk om dié euwel te bestry.
tgt: Through the #365 Days Campaign and #CountMeIn, the country needs to continue mobilising members of society, especially men, to join hands with government in dealing with this scourge.

src: Dit is die nasie se verantwoordelikheid, individueel en gesamentlik, om die verspreiding van die virus te stuit deur na ons eie gesondheid en dié van ander om te sien.
tgt: It is the responsibility of the nation, both individually and collectively, to stop the spread of the virus by taking care of our own health and that of others.

src: Die Kabinet waardeer die WNNR se vordering in die ontwikkeling van ’n bio-vervaardigingsproses vir MIV-teenliggaampies.
tgt: Cabinet has appreciated the progress that has been made by the Council for Scientific and Industrial Research in developing a bio-manufacturing process for HIV antibodies.

src: Dit bring die gesondheidsektor ’n stap nader aan ekonomies lewensvatbare voorkomende behandeling.
tgt: This brings the health industry a step closer to an economically viable preventative treatment.

src: Terwyl die land steeds na ’n geneesmiddel vir MIV en vigs soek, word van Suid-Afrikaners verwag om veilige seks te beoefen om nuwe infeksies te voorkom en by die ABC-beginsels van onthouding, getrouheid aan een lewensmaat en die gebruik van kondome te hou (Abstain, Be faithful and Condomise).6 Die Kabinet loof alle leerders, studente, onderwysers, dosente, skole en hoëronderwysinstellings vir die suksesvolle voltooiing van die akademiese jaar, ondanks verskeie uitdagings deur die jaar.
tgt: Whilst the country still struggles to find the cure for HIV and AIDS, South Africans are still expected to practice safe sex and observe the ABC (Abstain, Be faithful and Condomise) principles of preventing new infections.

src: Die Kabinet wens leerders wat ingestem het om eksamens uit te stel wat vir 2016 hergeskeduleer is, sterkte toe met die eksamens wat voorlê.
tgt: Cabinet also wishes those who agreed to postpone examinations rescheduled for 2016 well in their coming examinations.

src: Die Departement van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling, in samewerking met die Departement van Verdediging en die Nasionale Jeugontwikkelingsagentskap, gaan vanjaar sy sesde Nasionale Jeugkamp hou.
tgt: The Department of Social Development, in collaboration with Department of Defense and National Youth Development Agency, will hold its 6th National Youth Camp.

src: Dit is ’n jeugontwikkelingsprogram wat daarop gemik is om gedrag en gesindhede te verander en die jeug te bemagtig oor die geleenthede wat tot hul beskikking is.
tgt: This is a youth leadership development programme that seeks to change behaviour, attitudes and empower the youth about opportunities at their disposal.

src: Die kamp help ook met mentorskap en leer jong seuns om verantwoordelike volwasse mans te word en vroue te waardeer en te respekteer.8 ’n Ooreenkoms tussen die Minister van Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding, dr Blade Nzimande, en BRICS-vennote – Brasilië, Rusland, Indië en China – is daarop gemik om ’n raamwerk vir toekomstige samewerking in die onderwys te ontwikkel.
tgt: The camp also assists with mentoring and teaching young boys to grow into men who value and respect women.

src: Die ooreenkoms dek algemene onderwys, opvoedkundige beleidstrategieë, kolleges vir tegniese en beroepsonderwys en opleiding (TBOO) asook hoër onderwys.
tgt: A joint agreement signed between the Minister of Higher Education and Training Minister, Dr Blade Nzimande, and BRICS partners – Brazil, Russia, India and China – is aimed at developing a framework for future cooperation in education.

src: TBOO-kolleges het die potensiaal om ekonomiese geleenthede vir jong mense te ontsluit en die uitdagings van werkloosheid, ongelykheid en armoede wat gemeenskappe teister, die hoof te bied.
tgt: TVET colleges hold the potential to unlock economic opportunities for our young people, while addressing the challenges of unemployment, inequality and poverty affecting communities.

src: Die ooreenkoms sal die gehalte van onderwys en opvoeding van onderwysers verbeter en verbind BRICS-universiteite daartoe om gesamentlike navorsingsprojekte te ondersteun, gesamentlike programme op nagraadse, doktorale en nadoktorale vlakke asook die gesamentlike publisering van wetenskaplike bevindings aan te moedig.9 Die Departement van Wetenskap en Tegnologie het die Wetenskapforum Suid-Afrika onder die tema "stimulering van gesprekke oor wetenskap" aangebied.
tgt: The agreement, which will improve the quality of teaching and teachers’ education, also commits BRICS universities to support joint research projects, encourage collaborative programmes at postgraduate, doctoral and postdoctoral levels and the co-publishing of scientific results.

src: Mer as 45 lande het aan die debat oor die wisselwerking tussen wetenskap, tegnologie en innovering en die samelewing, spesifiek in die konteks van ontwikkeling, deelgeneem.
tgt: The Department of Science and Technology hosted the Science Forum South Africa under the theme “Igniting conversations about science”.

src: Die forum het ook gehelp om Suid-Afrika se strategiese internasionale vennootskappe vir wetenskap, tegnologie en innovering te versterk.10 Suid-Afrika gaan op die Raad van die Internasionale Maritieme Organisasie verteenwoordig word.
tgt: Over 45 countries participated in debates on the interface between science, technology and innovation and society, specifically in the context of development.

src: Dit is ’n groot stap ter verwesenliking van die land en die vasteland se potensiaal in die maritieme sektor.
tgt: This is a major step towards realising the country and the continent’s potential in the maritime sector.

src: Die organisasie is verantwoordelik vir die aanvaarding van besluite oor globale maritieme sake, wat wissel van die oseaan-ekonomie, reddingsinisiatiewe asook sake rakende veiligheid ter see.
tgt: The organisation is responsible for adopting decisions on global maritime affairs, ranging from the Oceans Economy, rescue initiatives and safety and security matters at sea.

src: Deelname aan hierdie liggaam sal help om die land se maritieme potensiaal deur middel van die Blou Oseane Ekonomiese Strategie en Operasie Phakisa te ontsluit.
tgt: The participation in this body will support government’s programme of unlocking the country’s maritime potential through the Blue Oceans Economy Strategy and Operation Phakisa, which aims to create over one million jobs by 2033.

src: Die programme is daarop gemik om meer as een miljoen werksgeleenthede teen 2033 te skep.‎1.11 Die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Weermag het die afgelope week begin met die opgradering van die Salisbury-eiland Vlootstasie in Durban tot ’n ten volle funksionele vlootbasis.
tgt: The South African National Defence Force commenced in the past week a process to upgrade Salisbury Island Naval Station in Durban into a fully functional naval base.

src: Die opgradering sal verdediging verbeter en tot die oseaan-ekonomie bydra.12 Die Departement van Gesondheid, in vennootskap met Soul City en Times Meia, het ’n kanaal op DStv bekend gestel, wat gemik is op gesondheid en lewenstyl, genaamd The Good Life Network.
tgt: The upgrading of facilities will improve defence capabilities and also contribute towards the ocean economy.

src: Dit is beskikbaar op DStv-kanaal 199.
tgt: The Department of Health, in partnership with Soul City and Times Media, launched a dedicated health and lifestyle channel The Good Life Network on DStv channel 199.

src: Die kanaal bied diverse, vermaaklike en oorspronklike plaaslik vervaardigde inhoud oor voeding, gesondheid en fiksheid, menseregte, jeugseksualiteit, MIV en TB, asook die regte van verbruikers en geslagskwessies.
tgt: The channel offers diverse, entertaining and original home-grown content on nutrition, health and fitness, human rights, youth sexuality, HIV and TB, as well as consumer and gender rights.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om na dié programme te kyk.
tgt: Cabinet calls on South Africans to watch the channel.

src: Sleutelkabinetsbesluite.1 Die Kabinet het die publisering van die Witskrif oor die Nasionale Gesondheidsversekering (NGV) vir Suid-Afrika, vir openbare kommentaar goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the publication of the White Paper on the National Health Insurance (NHI) for South Africa, for public comment.

src: Die NGV is deel van die Regering se omvattende hervormings in die gesondheidsektor.
tgt: The NHI is part of government’s major health sector reforms.

src: Die beleid is ’n voorlegging van die Regering se vermoë om mediese dienste aan almal wat sy gesondheidsgeriewe besoek te bied.
tgt: The policy proposes government’s ability to offer medical services to all who visit its health facilities.

src: Dit sal deur ’n sentrale fonds gefinansier word wat ook vir private mediese praktisyns wat aan die skema wil deelneem beskikbaar sal wees.
tgt: It will be funded through a central fund that will also be made available to private medical practitioners who want to participate in the scheme.

src: Sodra dit gefinaliseer is, sal beleid geleidelik ingefaseer word en hoofsaaklik op gebiede wat onderbedien word fokus.
tgt: Once finalised, the policy will be phased in over the years and focus mainly on commencing in underserviced areas.

src: Die Minister van Gesondheid, dr Aaron Motsoaledi, het die media oor die bekendstelling van die NGV ingelig.2 Die Kabinet het die Nasionale Geïntegreerde Vroeëkinderontwikkelingsbeleid (VKO) goedgekeur.
tgt: The Minister of Health, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi, will today brief the media on the roll-out of the NHCabinet approved the National Integrated Early Childhood Development (ECD) Policy.

src: Die beleid is in oorleg met verskeie belanghebbendes in die sektor ontwikkel.
tgt: The policy was developed in consultation with various stakeholders in the sector.

src: Dit het in Februarie 2015 deur ’n openbare konsulteringsproses gegaan.
tgt: It went through public consultation in February 2015.

src: Die geïntegreerde VKO-beleid sal verseker dat alle jong kinders en hul versorgers toegang tot omvattende VKO-dienste, vanaf bevrugting tot graad R het.
tgt: This integrated ECD policy will ensure all young children and their caregivers are able to access comprehensive quality ECD services from conception to Grade The policy extends the service to eight-year-old children with developmental difficulties.

src: Die beleid maak verder voorsiening vir ’n moniterings- en evalueringsraamwerk om te verseker dat dit doeltreffend aan alle kinders, ongeag ras, geslag of geloofsoortuiging gebied word.3 Die Kabinet het die Witskrif oor die Regte van Persone met Gestremdhede en die implementeringsmatriks goedgekeur.
tgt: The policy further provides a monitoring and evaluation framework to ensure it is effectively implemented to all children irrespective of race, gender or religion.

src: Dit is in lyn met die gestremdheids-inklusiewe Volhoubare Ontwikkelingsdoelwitte, wat in September 2015 deur die Verenigde Nasies se Algemene Vergadering goedgekeur is.
tgt: This is aligned to the disability-inclusive Sustainable Development Goals, adopted by the United Nations (UN) General Assembly (UNGA) in September 2015.

src: Die beleid sal integrasie en gelykheid vir persone met gestremdhede versnel.4 Die Kabinet het die publisering van die Nasionale Sanitasiebeleid vir openbare kommentaar goedgekeur.
tgt: The policy will accelerate transformation and redress regarding full inclusion, integration and equality for persons with disabilities.
