src: Ons moet daardie vordering beskerm sodat orde by al ons universiteite herstel en bewaar word.
tgt: We must protect that progress and allow order to be restored and preserved at all our universities.

src: Die Kabinet doen ook 'n beroep op alle belanghebbendes om saam te werk sodat ons universiteite leiers van inklusiewe betrokkenheid en transformasie kan word.
tgt: Cabinet also calls upon all stakeholders to work together so that our universities become leaders of inclusive engagement and transformation.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die voorgestelde samesmelting van drie bottelerary- ondernemings vir die Coca-Cola-maatskappy in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Cabinet notes the proposed merger of three bottling operations for the Coca Cola Company in South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis dat die saak voor die Meedingingstribunaal aangehoor sal word.
tgt: Cabinet notes the matter will be heard before the Competition Tribunal.

src: Die Kabinet spreek sy kommer uit oor voorgestelde werkverliese en 'n afname in indiensneming weens samesmeltingtransaksies.
tgt: Cabinet expresses its concern at proposed job losses and reduction in employment in merger transactions.

src: In die lig van die hoë werkloosheidsvlakke, doen die Kabinet 'n beroep op maatskappye om seker te maak dat daar nie 'n verlies aan werkgeleenthede sal wees nie en dat indiensnemingdvlakke in stand gehou word.
tgt: In view of the high levels of unemployment, Cabinet calls on companies to ensure jobs are not lost and aggregate employment levels are maintained.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Suid-Afrikaanse Ambassadeur by die Wêreldhandelsorganisasie (WHO), mnrXavier Carim, geluk met sy verkiesing as voorsitter van die Liggaam vir die Skikking van Geskille van die WHO se Algemene Vergadering.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the South African Ambassador to the World Trade Organisation (WTO), Mr Xavier Carim, who has been elected to chair the Dispute Settlement Body of the WTO General Council.

src: Die Algemene Vergadering is die hoogste besluitnemingsliggaam van die WHO tussenin die Ministeriële Vergadering.
tgt: The General Council is the highest decision-making body of the WTO in between the Ministerial Conference.

src: Die aanstelling van Ambassadeur Carim is ’n gedeeltelike erkenning van die belangrike rol wat Suid-Afrika in die WHO speel en gedeeltelike getuienis van Ambassadeur Carim se eienskappe.
tgt: The appointment of Ambassador Carim is in part recognition of the important role South Africa plays in the WTO and in part testimony to Ambassador Carim’s qualities.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van Barclays PLC se aankondiging dat hy van voorneme is om sy 62,3 persent aandeelhouding in die Barclays Africa Group Limited (BAGAL) oor die volgende twee tot drie jaar te verminder.
tgt: Cabinet noted Barclays PLC’s announcement of its intention to reduce its per cent shareholding in Barclays Africa Group Limited (BAGL) over the next two to three years.

src: Barclays PLC, in die besonder die uitvoerende hoof, het met beide die Nasionale Tesourie en die Reserwebank 'n oop gesprek gevoer, en ons verwelkom die maatskappy se verbintenis tot implementering van sy nuwe strategie op 'n manier wat die impak op die ekonomieë waarin Barclays PLC en BAGL bedryf word, tot ’n minimum sal beperk.
tgt: Barclays PLC, in particular the CEO, has engaged both the National Treasury and the Reserve Bank in an open dialogue, and we welcome the company’s commitment to implement its new strategy in a way that will minimise the impact on the economies in which BAGL operates.

src: Die Reserwebank sal saam met Barclays PLC en BAGL werk om te verseker dat enige potensiële risiko's uit die transaksie verminder sal word en gepaste maatreëls getref sal word om kapitaalvloei wat uit die transaksie voortspruit, te bestuur.
tgt: The Reserve Bank will work with Barclays PLC and BAGL to ensure that any potential risks from the transaction are mitigated and appropriate measures will be taken to manage capital flows arising from the transaction.

src: Die Kabinet bring hulde aan al die finaliste en wenners van die Nasionale Onderwystoekennings wat op 27 Februarie 2016 oorhandig is.
tgt: Cabinet salutes all the finalists and winners of the National Teaching Awards which took place on 27 February 2016.

src: Hierdie toegewyde onderwysers laat ons land vooruitgaan deur te verseker dat hulle gemotiveerde leerders in hul klaskamers oplei, wat tot die ontwikkeling van Suid-Afrika sal bydra.
tgt: These dedicated teachers move our country forward by ensuring that their classrooms produce motivated learners that will contribute towards the development of South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Markteater in Johannesburg geluk met die viering van sy 40ste bestaansjaar.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the Market Theatre in Johannesburg for celebrating its 40th year of existence.

src: Gedurende die apartheidsera het die teater 'n simbool van die stryd teen apartheid geword deur Suid-Afrika se ware storie te vertel.
tgt: During the apartheid era the theatre became a symbol of the Struggle by telling the true South African story.

src: Die Kabinet wens die musiekonderwyser, mnrChad Hendricks van Retreat op die Kaapse Vlakte geluk dat hy die gesogte Len van Zyl Kompetisie vir Dirigente in Kaapstad gewen het.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates music teacher, Mr Chad Hendricks, from Retreat in the Cape Flats for winning the prestigious Len van Zyl Conductors’ Competition in Cape Town.

src: Sy prys sluit 'n beurs in wat hom in staat stel om vir drie maande by die Verenigde State se Philadelphia-orkes te studeer en deur die bekende prof Victor Yampolsky in Chicago opgelei te word.
tgt: His prize includes a three-month United States scholarship during which Mr Hendricks will study at the Philadelphia Orchestra and be trained by renowned Profssor Victor Yampolsky in Chicago.

src: Die Kabinet wens rolprentvervaardiger, MnrAnant Singh, geluk dat hy die derde plek behaal het vir sy film Shepherds and Butchers in die Panorama Audience Awarfor Fiction Film by die Belynse Internasionale Filmfees.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates film producer, Mr Anant Singh, for being awarded third place for the film Shepherds and Butchers in the Panorama Audience Award for Fiction Film at the Berlin International Film Festival.

src: Dit is ‘n baie belangrike prestasie aangesien die film teen 51 vollengte films van 33 lande meegeding het.
tgt: This is a major achievement as the film competed against 51 feature-length films from 33 countries.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die betrokke uitklaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Verlenging van mnrLionel October se kontrak as Direkteur-generaal (DG) in die Departement van Handel en Nywerheid, vir 'n tydperk van vyf jaar.
tgt: Extension of the contract for Mr Lionel October as the Director-General (DG) in the Department of Trade and Industry, for a period of five years.

src: Aanstelling van dr Mantlhake J Maboya as Adjunk-DG (ADG): Kurrikulumbeleid en Monitering in die Departement van Basiese Onderwys.
tgt: Appointment of Dr Mantlhake J Maboya as the Deputy DG (DDG): Curriculum Policy and Monitoring in the Department of Basic Education.

src: Aanstelling van me Shamilla Chettiar as ADG: Beleid en Kennisdienste in die Departement van Toerisme.
tgt: Appointment of Ms Shamilla Chettiar as the DDG: Policy and Knowledge Services in the Department of Tourism.

src: Aanstelling van mnrMbulelo Tshangana as DG in die Departement van Meslike Nedersettings.
tgt: Appointment of Mr Mbulelo Tshangana as the DG in the Department of Human Settlements.

src: Heraanstelling van mnrKutoane Obed Kutoane as die Hoof Uitvoerende Beampte van die Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa SOC Beperk.
tgt: Reappointment of Mr Kutoane Obed Kutoane as the Chief Executive Officer of the Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa SOC Limited.

src: Aanstelling van mnrVuyo Mafata as Vergoedingskommissaris: Vergoedingsfonds in die Departement van Arbeid.
tgt: Appointment of Mr Vuyo Mafata as the Compensation Commissioner: Compensation Fund in the Department of Labour.

src: Belangrike Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet het die vorderingsverslae van die uitsette vir die derde kwartaal vir die tydperk Oktober-Desember 2015 evalueer.
tgt: Cabinet assessed the Third Quarter Outcomes Progress Reports for the period October to December 2015.

src: Die verslae toon beduidende vordering in die implementering van die regeringprogramme wat 'n regstreekse uitwerking op die verbetering van Suid-Afrikaners se lewens het.
tgt: The reports show significant progress in the implementation of government programmes that have a direct impact on improving the lives of South Africans.

src: Die verslae bewys dat die Regering vordering gemaak het om die teikens wat in die Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk 2014-2019 gestel word, te bereik.
tgt: The Outcomes Progress Reports provide evidence that government has made progress in achieving the targets set out in the Medium Term Strategic Framework 2014-2019.

src: Dit bring ons ook nader aan die verwesenliking van Visie 2030, soos verwoord in die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NDP), wat daarop gemik is om armoede, werkloosheid en ongelykheid die hoof te bied.
tgt: They also take us closer to realising Vision 2030, as articulated in the National Development Plan, which aims to tackle poverty, unemployment and inequality.

src: Die Kabinet het kennis geneem van die redelike vordering wat gemaak is om die sleutelteikens en uitsette te bereik.
tgt: Cabinet noted the reasonable progress that was made to achieve the key targets and outputs.

src: Die Kabinet het opgemerk dat hoewel beduidende vordering ten opsigte van die meeste van die aanwysers gemaak is, daar steeds gebiede is wat gekoördineerde ingrypings deur die Regering verg.
tgt: Cabinet has noted that while significant progress was made in respect of most of the indicators, there are still areas that require coordinated interventions by government.

src: Implementering van belangrike regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of key government programmes.

src: Die Kabinet bedank alle Suid-Afrikaners wat ag geslaan het op die Onafhanklike Verkiesingskommissie (OVK) se oproep om tydens die naweek van 5 en 6 Maart te registreer, hul registrasiestatus na te gaan en hul besonderhede op die kieserslys op datum te bring.
tgt: Cabinet has expressed its gratitude to all South Africans who responded to the call by the Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) for people to register, check their registration status and update their details on the voters’ roll on the weekend of 5 and 6 March 2016.

src: Sowat drie miljoen mense het stemlokale landwyd besoek en 544 552 van die nuwe registrasies (78,6%) was jonger as 30 jaar, wat Suid-Afrikaners se gewilligheid om by die bou van ons demokrasie betrokke te raak, demonstreer.
tgt: About three million people visited polling stations countrywide and 544 552 of the new registrations (78.6%) were under the age of 30, which demonstrates the willingness by South Africans to participate in building our democracy.

src: Die Kabinet spoor Suid-Afrikaners aan om hul demokratiese reg uit te oefen deur te registreer en doen ’n dringende beroep op diegene wat voorheen geregistreer het om hul registrasiebesonderhede te verifieer aangesien 'n aantal faktore tot veranderings in die kieserslys gelei het.
tgt: Cabinet calls on South Africans to exercise their democratic right by registering and urges those who have registered previously to verify their voter registration details as a number of factors have led to changes in the voters’ roll.

src: Die finale registrasienaweek vind op 9 en 10 April 2016 plaas wanneer alle stemlokale weer vanaf 8:00 tot 17:00 oop sal wees.
tgt: The final registration weekend will take place on 9 and 10 April 2016 when all voting stations will again be open from 8:00 to 17:00.

src: Dit sal die laaste geleentheid vir kiesers wees om te registreer en hul registrasiebesonderhede by hul stemlokale op datum te bring.
tgt: This will be the last opportunity for voters to register and update their registration details at their voting stations.

src: Registrasie is egter ook deurlopend aan die gang by die plaaslike kantore van die OVK, van Maandag tot Vrydag gedurende kantoorure, totdat die kieserslys vir die 2016 munisipale verkiesings sluit op die dag waarop die verkiesing aangekondig word.
tgt: However, registration is ongoing at local IEC offices during office hours from Monday to Friday, until the voters’ roll for the 2016 Municipal Elections closes on the day the elections are promulgated.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel die geweld wat die laaste registrasienaweek in sommige gebiede bederf het, en benadruk dat geen persoon ander Suid-Afrikaners mag verhoed om hul demokratiese reg om te registreer uit te oefen nie.
tgt: Cabinet condemns the violence in some areas that marred the recent registration weekend and reiterates that no person may prevent any South African from exercising their democratic right to register to vote.

src: Die Kabinet doen verder 'n beroep op almal wat hiervoor verantwoordelik was, om hulle te weerhou van sulke kriminele aktiwiteite en vir diegene wat daardeur geraak is, om die oortreders by wetstoepassingsagentskappe aan te kla.
tgt: Cabinet further calls on all those responsible to desist from such criminal activities and for those affected to report them to law-enforcement agencies.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle wetstoepassingsagentskappe om sterk op te tree teen mense wat die wet oortree.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all law-enforcement agencies to take strong action against law-breakers.

src: President Jacob Zuma sal Port Elizabeth op 8 April 2016 besoek om die vordering wat met die ontwikkeling van mariene-vervoerinfrastruktuur gemaak is as deel van die Oseaanekonomie-inisiatief in die land, te inspekteer.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will visit Port Elizabeth on 8 April 2016 to inspect progress made in developing marine transport infrastructure as part of the country’s Oceans Economy initiative.

src: Die oseaan-ekonomie is een van die drie strome van Operasie Phakisa en bring die land nader aan die ontsluiting van Suid-Afrikaanse oseane se potensiaal om tot tot R177 miljard tot die bruto binnelandse produk by te dra en meer as een miljoen nuwe werkgeleenthede te skep.
tgt: The Oceans Economy is one of the three streams of Operation Phakisa and takes the country closer to unlocking the potential of South Africa’s oceans, which has the potential to contribute up to R177 billion to the gross domestic product and create over one million new jobs.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die suksesvolle afsluiting van President Zuma se staatsbesoek aan die Federale Republiek van Nigerieë van 8 tot 9 Maart 2016, wat bestaande bilaterale politieke, ekonomiese en sosiale bande versterk het.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the successful conclusion of the State Visit by President Zuma to the Federal Republic of Nigeria from 8 to 9 March 2016, which enhanced existing bilateral political, economic and social ties.

src: Een van die mylpale van die besoek was die bevordering van die Bi-nasionale Kommissie tot staatshoofvlak, wat ekonomiese ontwikkeling tussen die twee lande prioritiseer.
tgt: One of the milestones of the visit was the elevation of the Binational Commission to a Head of State level, which prioritises economic development between the two countries.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die oopstel van Nigerië se ekonomie aan Suid-Afrikaanse maatskappye in verskeie sektore soos ingenieurswese, telekommunikasie, konstruksie, lugvaart, media, gasvryheid, bankwese, vermaak, eiendom, kleinhandel, en olie- en gaseksplorasiedienste.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the opening of Nigeria’s economy to South African companies in various sectors such as engineering, telecommunications, construction, aviation, media, hospitality, banking, entertainment, property, retail, and oil and gas exploration services.

src: Die Kabinet sien uit na die toename in die aantal Nigeriese beleggings in Suid-Afrika wat tweerigting-handel tussen die twee lande sal bevorder.
tgt: Cabinet looks forward to the increase in the number of Nigerian investments in South Africa that will promote two-way trade between the two nations.

src: Die uitkomste van hierdie betrokkenheid tussen twee van die grootste ekonomieë op die vasteland, sal plaaslike ekonomieë integreer, en sodoende die gemeenskaplike mark uitbrei en bestaande inisiatiewe van ekonomiese groei en werkskepping in Afrika bevorder.
tgt: The outcomes from this engagement between two of the largest economies on the continent will integrate regional economies, thereby increasing the common market and elevating existing initiatives of economic growth and employment in Africa.

src: Dit dui daarop dat Suid-Afrika steeds 'n mededingende beleggingsbestemming is ondanks moeilike wêreldwye ekonomiese toestande, en dit sal tot werkgeleenthede en vaardigheidsontwikkeling vir Suid-Afrikaners lei.
tgt: This demonstrates that South Africa remains a competitive investment destination despite a troubled global economy, and will result in job opportunities and skills development for South Africans.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van Suid-Afrika se deelname aan die 60ste Sessie van die Verenigde Nasies (VN) se Kommissie op die Status van Vroue (CSW60) wat in New York, VSA vanaf 14 tot 24 Maart 2016 plaasvind onder die tema: "Bemagtiging van vroue en die skakel na volhoubare ontwikkeling".
tgt: Cabinet noted that South Africa will be participating at the 60th Session of the United Nations (UN) Commission on the Status of Women (CSW60) taking place in New York, USA from 14 to 24 March 2016 under the theme: “Women’s empowerment and its link to sustainable development”.

src: Die sessie vind plaas in 'n belangrike jaar vir Suid-Afrika, aangesien drie sleutelmylpale gevier word, naamlik die 20ste herdenking van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996, die 40ste herdenking van die Soweto-jeugopstand, en die 60ste herdenking van die 1956 vroue-opmarsSuid-Afrika het 'n verslag aan die VN CSW60 voorgelê, wat ons 'n geleentheid bied om 'n maatstaf te stel vir die vordering wat ons sedert die begin van demokrasie gemaak het.
tgt: The session is taking place in an important year for South Africa as it marks three important milestones, namely the 20th Anniversary of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996, 40th Anniversary of the Soweto Youth Uprising and the 60th Anniversary of the 1956 women’s march.

src: Dit is belangrik om daarop te let dat Suid-Afrika sedert die demokratiese bestel, onder meer deelgeneem het aan die 4de Wêreldkonferensie van Vroue in 1995, en die Beijing Verklaring en Platform vir Aksie in dieselfde jaar onderteken het.
tgt: South Africa has presented a report to the UN CSW60 and this gives us an opportunity to benchmark the progress we have made since the dawn of democracy.

src: Ooreenkomstig resolusie E/RES/2013/18 van die VN se Ekonomiese en Maatskaplike Raad, is Suid-Afrika daartoe verbind om voort te gaan met die implementering van die Beijing Verklaring en Platform vir Aksie, wat 'n bloudruk vir die bemagtiging en bevordering van vroue is.
tgt: It is important to note that since the democratic dispensation South Africa, among other things, participated in the 4th World Conference of Women in 1995, and signed the Beijing Declaration and Platform for Action in the same WEBTOKEN line with resolution E/RES/2013/18 of the UN Economic and Social Council, South Africa is committed to continue implementing the Beijing Declaration and Platform for Action, which is a blueprint for women’s empowerment and advancement.

src: Die Kabinet verleen sy goedgkeuring aan die voorlegging van die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Plaaslike Regering: Munisipale Strukture van 2016 aan die Parelement.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Local Government: Municipal Structures Amendment Bill of 2016 to Parliament.

src: Wysigings word aangebring om die Wet op Plaaslike Regering: Munisipale Strukture, 1998 (Wet 117 van 1998), wat voor die eerste demokratiese plaaslike regeringsverkiesings van 5 Desember 2000 verorden is.
tgt: Amendments are being made to the Local Government: Municipal Structures Act, 1998 (Act 117 of 1998), which was enacted prior to the first democratic local government elections which took place on 5 December 2000.The amendments will improve the administration of local government elections and among other changes, seek to:a) amend criteria for Category A municipalitiesb) remove all references to district management areasc) clarify the date of assumption of office by a councillord) determine the President must set and call the date for the municipal electionse) allow for extension in the declaration of results of an electionf) require a municipal manager to inform the IEC of ward vacanciesg) determine that a Member of the Executive Council calls and sets the date for by-electionsh) clarify the quorum requirements for a council meetingi) clarify the circumstances for the casting vote of a councillor presiding during a council meetingj) increase variance of the number of voters in each ward during a council meeting andk) increase variance of the number of voters in each ward during a demarcation to clarify the allocation of excessive seats in local municipalities.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: President Zuma - as mede-voorsitter, saam met Frankryk se President François Hollande, van die Hoëvlak-kommissie op Gesondheidsindiensneming en Ekonomiese Groei - sal die formele bekendstelling van die kommissie in Lyon, Frankryk op Woensdag 23 Maart 2016 bywoon.
tgt: President Zuma – as co-chair with French President François Hollande of the High-Level Commission on Health Employment and Economic Growth – will attend its formal launch in Lyon, France on Wednesday, 23 March 2016.

src: Die kommissie fokus op die behoefte aan professionele gesondheidswerkers in die middel- en lae-inkomstelande.
tgt: The commission focuses on the need for health professionals in middle and low-income countries.

src: Hierdie VN-inisiatief sal na verwagting gesondheidsekerheid wêreldwyd verhoog en inklusiewe ekonomiese groei bevorder, wat sal bydra tot die implementering van die 2030 Agenda vir Volhoubare Ontwikkeling.
tgt: This UN initiative is expected to increase health security worldwide and promote inclusive economic growth, which contributes to the implementation of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.

src: President Zuma onderneem 'n staatsbesoek aan die Koninkryk van Saoedi-Arabië van 27 tot 28 Maart 2016, wat bestaande verhoudings tussen die twee lande sal versterk.
tgt: President Zuma will undertake a State Visit to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia from 27 to 28 March 2016, which will strengthen existing relations between the two countries.

src: Die President sal die 4de Spitsberaad oor Kernveiligheid in Washington, VSA van 31 Maart tot 1 April 2016 bywoon.
tgt: The President will attend the 4th Nuclear Security Summit in Washington, USA from 31 March to 1 April 2016.

src: Die beraad sal die ontwikkelende bedreiging van kernterrorisme bespreek en stappe uitlig wat deur die internasionale gemeenskap geneem kan word om die gebruik van hoogsverrykte uraan te minimaliseer, kwesbare materiaal te beveilig, kernsmokkelary teen te werk, en pogings tot kernterrorisme op te spoor en te ontwrig.
tgt: The summit will discuss the evolving threat of nuclear terrorism and highlight steps that can be taken by the international community to minimise the use of highly enriched uranium, secure vulnerable materials, counter nuclear smuggling and deter, detect and disrupt attempts at nuclear terrorism.

src: President Zuma sal die viering van Meseregtedag by die Moses Mabhida-stadion in KwaZulu-Natal op Maandag, 21 Maart 2016 lei, onder die tema: "Suid-Afrika verenig teen rassisme."
tgt: President Zuma will lead Human Rights Day celebrations at the Moses Mabhida Stadium in KwaZulu-Natal on Monday, 21 March 2016 under the theme: “South Africa united against racism.” As announced in the 2016 State of the Nation Address, this year’s Human Rights Day will lay the foundation for a long-term programme of building a non-racial society.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om te verenig teen rassisme en dit te veroordeel - hetsy dit in ons huise, gemeenskappe, sosiale byeenkomste, werkplekke of op sosiale media is.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to unite against and denounce racism – be it in our homes, communities, social gatherings, workplaces or on social media.

src: Ons moet almal saamwerk om 'n verenigde, nie-rassige en nie-seksistiese demokrasie te skep.
tgt: We must all work together to achieve a united, non-racial and non-sexist democracy.

src: Lede van die Uitvoerende Vergadering sal tydens die Nasionale Imbizo Fokusweek tussen 4 en 10 April 2016 met alle Suid-Afrikaners regoor die land gesprek voer, onder die tema: "Saam beweeg ons Suid-Afrika vorentoe: Groei Suid-Afrika" Die week val saam met die Parlementêre Kiesafdelingweek en die herdenking van Vryheidsmaand.
tgt: Members of the Executive will interact with South Africans across the country during the National Imbizo Focus Week between 4 and 10 April 2016, under the theme: “Together we move South Africa forward: Grow South Africa.” The week coincides with the Parliamentary Constituency Week and the commemoration of Freedom Month.

src: Die Kabinet moedig Suid-Afrikaners om aktief deel te neem aan hierdie gebeure en om betrokke te raak by politieke hoofde.
tgt: Cabinet encourages South Africans to actively participate in these events and to engage with political principals.

src: Die Imbizo Fokusweek sal die implementering van die Negepunt-plan wat daarop gemik is om ekonomiese groei te stimuleer en broodnodige werkgeleenthede te skep, na vore bring.
tgt: The Imbizo Focus Week will highlight the implementation of the Nine-Point Plan that aims to boost economic growth and create much-needed jobs.

src: Dit sal ook die suksesse van plaaslike regerings uitlig, insluitend prestasies wat deur die plaaslike regering opknappingsprogram - Terugkeer na Basiese Waardes – teweeggebring is.
tgt: It will also profile local government successes, including achievements yielded through the local government revitalisation plan – the Back-to-Basics approach.

src: Die week val ook saammet die finale registrasienaweek voor die 2016 munisipale verkiesings, wat 'n verdere geleentheid vir leiers skep om Suid-Afrikaners deur kieseropvoeding aan te spoor en te mobiliseer om te registreer en hul stembesonderhede te verifieer.
tgt: The week will also coincide with the final registration weekend ahead of the 2016 Municipal Elections, further providing an opportunity for principals to galvanise and mobilise South Africans through voter education outreaches to register and verify their voting details.

src: Adjunk-president Cyril Ramaphosa sal die 2de Spitsberaad oor die Ontwikkeling van Meslike Hulpbronne, wat by die Gallagher-konferensiesentrum in Midrand op 29 en 30 Maart 2016 gehou word, open onder die tema: "Vennootskap vir vaardighede – 'n oproep tot aksie".
tgt: Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa will open the 2nd Human Resource Development Council Summit taking place at the Gallagher Convention Centre in Midrand on 29 and 30 March 2016 under the theme: “Partnership for skills – A Call to Action”.

src: Die beraad bring belanghebbendes van regoor die hoëronderwyssektor bymekaar om te help met die ontwikkeling van die sektor en om vennootskappe te smee wat sterker hoëronderwysinstellings, wat bedryfsgereed is, te skep.
tgt: The summit brings together stakeholders from across the higher education sector to assist in its development and forge partnerships that create stronger industry-ready higher education institutions.

src: Nasionale Waterweek 2016 sal van 14 tot 22 Maart onder die tema: "Water vir mense, water deur mense" plaasvind.
tgt: National Water Week 2016 will take place from 14 to 22 March under the theme: “Water for people, water by people”.

src: Die week sal op water as 'n mensereg fokus deur bewustheid te kweek oor die lot van mense wat nie toegang tot skoon drinkbare water het nie.
tgt: The week will profile water as a human right by raising awareness of the plight of people who do not have access to clean drinkable water.

src: Die Departement van Waterwese en Sanitasie is nog besig om van die emmerstelsel ontslae te raak en het reeds 78,8% van die emmerstelsel in formele nedersettings in Suid-Afrika uitgewis.
tgt: The Department of Water and Sanitation is still in the process of eradicating the bucket system and has thus far eradicated 78.8% of the bucket system in formal settlements in South Africa.

src: Sewe provinsies het uitstekend gevaar met 'n gemiddelde 90% uitwissing.
tgt: Seven provinces have performed excellently with an average 90% eradication.

src: Die provinsies wat algehele uitwissing in formele nedersettings bereik het, is KwaZulu-Natal, Noordwes, Mpumalanga en Gauteng.
tgt: Those that have achieved total eradication in formal settlements are KwaZulu-Natal, North West, Mpumalanga and Gauteng.

src: Die Wes-Kaap het 99,8% bereik.
tgt: The Western Cape has reached 99.8% clearance.

src: Van 'n teiken van 26 120 vir die Noord-Kaap, Oos-Kaap, Noordwes en Vrystaat, het sowat 11 650 tot op datum die proses afgehandel.
tgt: From a target of 26 120 for the Northern Cape, Eastern Cape, North West and Free State, some 11 650 systems have been completed to date.

src: Hoewel die onlangse reën verligting gebring het, word die uitwerking van die droogte steeds in sommige dele van die land gevoel.
tgt: While the recent rainfall brought some relief, the impact of the drought continues to be felt in some parts of the country.

src: Suid-Afrikaners moet voortgaan om water spaarsamig te gebruik en waterbesparende inisiatiewe te implementeer.
tgt: South Africans must continue to use water sparingly and implement water-saving initiatives.

src: Die Regering het intussen R1 miljard bewillig om die droogtekrisis die hoof te bied.
tgt: Government has since provided R1 billion to deal with the drought crisis.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die vordering wat gemaak word deur die vyfjaarprogram, “War on Leaks” onder die tema: "Elke druppel tel".
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the progress being made by the five-year War on Leaks programme under the theme: “Every drop counts”.

src: Die program het ten doel om 15 000 jong mense met die minimum kwalifikasie van graad 12 of N3 te werf, op te lei en te ontplooi as loodgieters, ambagsmanne en wateragente.
tgt: The programme aims to recruit, train and deploy 15 000 young people with the minimum qualification of Grade 12 or N3 as plumbers, artisans and water agents.

src: Die Kabinet se standpunt oor belangrike kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on key issues in the environment.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op betogers om met die uiterste selfbeheersing op te tree en hul griewe binne die grense van die wet en die Grondwet te lug.
tgt: Cabinet appeals to protesters to act with the utmost restraint and express their grievances within the confines of the law and the Constitution.

src: Vandalisme en skade aan eiendom oorskry die grense van die reg om protes aan te teken en is die werk van onbesonne kriminele elemente.
tgt: Vandalism and damage of property goes beyond the limits of the right to protest and is the work of misguided criminal elements.

src: Wetstoepassingsagentskappe sal die reg handhaaf deur mense wat eiendom vernietig by universiteite, ander instellings van hoër onderwys, in gemeenskappe en tydens protesoptrede, te arresteer en aan te kla.
tgt: Law-enforcement agencies will uphold the law by apprehending and charging those who destroy property at universities, other institutions of higher learning, in communities and during protest action.

src: Die Minister van Finansies het die Kabinet ingelig oor die onlangse reise wat hy saam met verskeie belanghebbendes, insluitend sakeleiers, na die VSA en die Verenigde Koninkryk onderneem het.
tgt: The Minister of Finance briefed Cabinet on the recent roadshows that he undertook to the US and United Kingdom with various stakeholders, including business leaders.

src: Die Kabinet is daartoe verbind om seker te maak dat die land saamwerk om te verseker dat ons nie afgegradeer word nie.
tgt: Cabinet is committed to ensuring that the country works together to ensure that we are not downgraded.

src: Die besoeke bied die Regering die geleentheid om 'n aantal inisiatiewe wat geïmplementeer is om uitdagings te hanteer, te deel.
tgt: The visit offers government the opportunity to share a number of initiatives implemented to deal with challenges.

src: Dit sluit in gesamentlike optrede om inklusiewe groei te versnel, maatreëls om fiskale konsolidering te bespoedig, die implementering van ons R870 miljard Infrastruktuur-beleggingsprogram en vordering met die oplos van die energiebeperkings, insluitend deur die hernubare energie.
tgt: These include collaborative actions to accelerate inclusive growth, measures to fast-track fiscal consolidation, speed up implementation of our R870 billion Infrastructure Investment Programme and progress made in resolving the energy constraints, including through renewable energy.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle sektore om al die positiewe programme en ingrypings om ons ekonomie te beveilig oor te dra.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all sectors to communicate all the positive programmes and interventions undertaken to safeguard our economy.

src: Dit is belangrik vir alle sektore om te verseker dat die land se ekonomie sterk is.
tgt: It is important for all sectors to ensure that the country’s economy is resilient.

src: In dié verband, het die Kabinet ook opdrag gegee aan die Inter-Ministeriële Komitee oor Belegging om alle belangrike ekonomies-verwante besluite te versnel.
tgt: In this regard, Cabinet has also instructed the Inter-Ministerial Committee on Investment to fast track all key economic-related decisions.

src: Die Kabinet benadruk dat die veerkragtigheid van die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie op gesonde ekonomiese beginsels en praktiese beleid gebou is.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates that the resilience of the South African economy is built on sound economic fundamentals and practical policies.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van 'n hofsaak deur die Kamer van Mynwese dat die Mynbouhandves as ongrondwetlik en ongeldig verklaar moet word.
tgt: Cabinet noted a court case brought by the Chamber of Mines for the Mining Charter to be declared unconstitutional and void.

src: Die Kabinet benadruk dat die beginsels van die Mynbouhandves gemik is op die transformasie van die mynbedryf om die historiese wanbalanse wat deur apartheidveroorsaak is, reg te stel sodat die bedryf ooreenstem met die veranderinge in die algehele transformasie van Suid-Afrika se maatskaplike, politieke en ekonomiese landskap.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates that the principles of the Mining Charter are aimed at transforming the mining industry to redress historical imbalances engendered by apartheid so that the industry is consistent with the changes in South Africa’s overall transformation of its social, political and economic landscape.

src: Gemeenskapsopheffing is ook 'n belangrike fokuspunt om te verseker dat mynontwikkeling nie sekere gemeenskappe uitsluit nie.
tgt: Community upliftment is also a key focus area to ensure that mining development does not exclude relevant communities.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle padgebruikers, veral dié wat gedurende die komende vakansietydperk reis, om verantwoordelikheid vir hul eie veiligheid en dié van ander padgebruikers te neem.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all road users, especially those travelling over the upcoming holiday period, to play their part by taking responsibility for their own safety and that of other road users.

src: Die beëindiging van die bloedbad op ons paaie bly 'n nasionale prioriteit.
tgt: Ending the road carnage remains a national priority.

src: Motoriste moet bedag wees, die padreëls gehoorsaam, nie drink en bestuur nie, by die spoedgrens hou en seker te maak dat hul voertuie padwaardig is.
tgt: Drivers must be alert, obey the rules of the road, not drink and drive, keep to the speed limit and ensure that their vehicles are roadworthy.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense oor aan al die wenners van die toekennings vir die Nasionale Regte van Gestremdes, wat op 11 Maart 2016 plaasgevind het.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates all the winners of the National Disability Rights Awards held on 11 March 2016.

src: Hierdie toekennings gee erkenning aan mense met gestremdhede en mense wat hulle beywer vir die regte van gestremdes, wat tydens 2015 uitgeblink het.
tgt: These awards recognised persons with disabilities and disability rights activists who have excelled during 2015.

src: Die Kabinet loof al die wenners van die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisidiens (SAPD) se 3de Jaarlikse Toekennings vir Voortreflikheid, wat hulde bring aan voortreflike prestasies deur lede van die SAPD, reserviste, en lede van gemeenskapspolisieforums.
tgt: Cabinet salutes all the winners of the 3rd South African Police Service (SAPS) Annual National Excellence Awards, which pay tribute to excellence by SAPS members, reservists and members of community police forums.

src: Die Kabinet loof mede-skrywers Mandla Dube en Leon Otto van Pambili Meia vir die film Kalushi: The Story of Solomon Mahlangu.
tgt: Cabinet applauds co-writers Mandla Dube and Leon Otto of Pambili Media for the film Kalushi: The Story of Solomon Mahlangu.

src: Suid-Afrikaners word aangemoedig om na hierdie politieke riller oor die transformasie van 'n 19-jarige jong man van Mamelodi, oos van Pretoria, tot ’n ikoon van die stryd teen apartheid, te gaan kyk.
tgt: South Africans are encouraged to watch this political thriller about the transformation of a 19-year-old young man from Mamelodi, east of Pretoria, into a Struggle icon.

src: Die Kabinet beklemtoon dat die Regering, deur die departemente van Handel en Nywerheid en Kuns en Kultuur, sal voortgaan om die ontwikkeling van die kunste te ondersteun deur Suid-Afrikaanse verhale te vier en te vertel.
tgt: Cabinet reiterated that government will, through the departments of Trade and Industry and Arts and Culture, continue to support the growth of the arts industry in celebrating and telling the South African story.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense oor aan sosiale aktivis Vader Michael Lapsley as wat die internasionale 2016 Openbare Vryheidsprys in die kategorie ‘Global Peace and Reconciliation – Internationally-Reputed Peacemaker’, gewen het.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates social justice activist Father Michael Lapsley for receiving the international 2016 Public Peace Prize in the category ‘Global Peace and Reconciliation – Internationally-Reputed Peacemaker’.

src: Die Kabinet loof Pieter du Preez dat hy genomineer is vir die Laureus Wêreld-Sportman van die Jaar met ’n Gestremdheid, na aanleiding van sy uitstekende prestasie in 2015.
tgt: Cabinet applauds Pieter du Preez for being nominated for the Laureus World Sportsperson of the Year with a Disability Award, following his outstanding performances in 2015.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense oor aan Wayde van Niekerk, wat naelloopgeskiedenis gemaak het deur die eerste atleet in die wêreld te word om 100 meter in minder as 10 sekondes, 200 meter in minder as 20 sekondes, en 400 meter in minder as 44 sekondes af te lê soos deur die Internasionale Vereniging van Atletiekfederasies bevestig.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates Wayde van Niekerk who made sprinting history by becoming the first man in history to run all three races: the 100m in under 10 seconds‚ the 200m in under 20 seconds and the 400m in under 44 seconds‚ as confirmed by the International Association of Athletics Federations.

src: Aanstellings.
tgt: Appointments.

src: Geen aanstellings in hierdie Kabinetsvegadering.
tgt: No appointments announced in this Cabinet meeting.

src: Implementering van belangrike regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of key government programmes.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die prestasies wat deur President Jacob Zuma uitgelig is tydens sy besoek aan Port Elizabeth se hawe in die Oos-Kaap, om die vordering met die implementering van Operasie Phakisa: Oseaan-ekonomie-inisiatief te evalueer.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the achievements highlighted by President Jacob Zuma during his site visit to the Port of Port Elizabeth in the Eastern Cape, to assess progress made on the implementation of the Operation Phakisa: Oceans Economy initiative.

src: Die Regering het beleggings ten bedrae van ongeveer R17 miljard in die oseaan-ekonomie ontsluit.
tgt: Government has unlocked investments amounting to about R17 billion in the Oceans Economy.

src: Sedert sy ontstaan, is meer as 4 500 werksgeleenthede in verskeie sektore geskep.
tgt: Since its inception, over 4 500 jobs have been created in various sectors.

src: Twee van die nege sleepbote wat deur die Suider-Afrikaanse Skeepswerf vir die Transnet Nasionale Hawe-owerheid (TNHO) in Durban se hawe gebou is, is bestem vir Port Elizabeth se hawe.
tgt: Two of the nine tugboats being built by the Southern African Shipyards for Transnet National Ports Authority (TNPA) in the Port of Durban are destined for the Port of Port Elizabeth.

src: President Zuma het die eerste sleepboot in Port Elizabeth se hawe, die Mvezo, wat na oudpresident Nelson Mandela se geboorteplek vernoem is, te water gelaat.
tgt: President Zuma launched the first tugboat in Port Elizabeth, named the Mvezo, after the birthplace of former President Nelson Mandela.

src: Die TNHO het meer as R7 miljard toegewys om ons hawens te verbeter.
tgt: The TNPA has allocated over R7 billion to improve our ports.

src: Die President het die opgeknapte en herboude sleephelling en inlei-hawehoofde binne Port Elizabeth se hawe besigtig dit sal 12 meer vaartuie kan akkommodeer in vergelyking met die huidige twee.
tgt: The President viewed the refurbished and reconstructed slipway and lead-in jetties within the Port of Port Elizabeth that will be able to accommodate 12 more vessels as compared to the current two.

src: Die Kabinet bedank alle belastingbetalers wat vir die 2015/16-boekjaar in vennootskap met die Regering die land se inkomste-invordering vir die eerste keer tot R1 triljoen laat styg het.
tgt: Cabinet thanks all taxpayers who have partnered with government in the 2015/16 financial year to take our revenue collection to R1 trillion for the first time.

src: Danksy die belastingbydraes van inskiklike Suid-Afrikaners en doeltreffende invordering deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Inkomstediens, is die Regering in staat om beter broodnodige dienste te voorsien, wat tot die verbetering van Suid-Afrikaners se lewens bydra.
tgt: This is a clear demonstration of the strength of our thriving economy even under difficult WEBTOKEN is through the tax contributions of compliant South Africans and the effective collection by the South African Revenue Service that government is better able to provide much-needed services that contribute to improving the lives of South Africans.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom President Zuma se aankondiging dat 3 Augustus 2016 as die datum vir die 2016 munisipale verkiesings aangewys is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes President Zuma’s announcement of 3 August 2016 as the date for the 2016 Local Government Elections.

src: Die Regering is ingenome dat die twee registrasienaweke, naamlik 5 tot 6 Maart en 9 tot 10 April, 'n groot aantal potensiële kiesers na die stemlokale gelok het, veral kiesers wat vir die eerste keer gaan stem en die jeug.
tgt: Government is pleased that the two registration weekends on 5 – 6 March and 9 – 10 April saw large numbers of potential voters visiting the voting stations, especially first-time voters and the youth.

src: Die Kabinet bedank almal wat gereageer het op die oproep om te registreer, asook diegene wat hul besonderhede op die kieserslys nagegaan het.
tgt: Cabinet thanks all those who responded to the call to register and check their details on the voters’ roll.

src: Dit is danksy ons kollektiewe deelname dat ons demokrasie van krag tot krag gaan.
tgt: It is through our collective participation that our democracy moves from strength to strength.

src: Die Kabinet doen verder ’n beroep op alle burgers wat nog nie geregistreer het nie of nie hul besonderhede nagegaan het nie, om die kantore van die Onafhanklike Verkiesingskommissie in hul plaaslike munisipaliteite te besoek en hul besonderhede op die kieserslys (voorsien adresse) by te werk of te registreer, sodat hulle op 3 Augustus kan stem.
tgt: Cabinet urges all citizens who have not yet registered or checked their details to visit offices of the Independent Electoral Commission in their local municipalities and update their details on the voters’ roll (provide addresses) and register to vote during the 3 August polls.

src: Kiesers kan ook ’n SMS met hul ID-nommer na 3281.0 stuur of die inbelsentrum by 0800 11 8000 skakel om hul status te verifieer.
tgt: Voters can also SMS their ID number to 3281.0 or call the contact centre on 0800 11 8000 to verify their status.

src: Deur te registreer verseker jy dat jou naam op die kieserslys is sodat jy kan stem.
tgt: Registration secures your name on the voters’ roll so that you can be able to vote.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op burgers om hul demokratiese reg om te stem waarvoor ons so hard geveg het, op 3 Augustus 2016 by die munisipale stembusse uit te oefen.
tgt: Cabinet calls on citizens to exercise our hard won democratic right to vote in the 2016 Local Government Elections on 3 August 2016.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die amptelike bekendstelling deur President Zuma van die Departement van Binnelandse Sake se eKanaal-loodsprojek.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the official launch of the eChannel Pilot Project of the Department of Home Affairs (DHA) by President Zuma.

src: Deur hierdie nuwe innoverende stelsel kan burgers nou aanlyn aansoek doen vir hul slim ID-kaarte en lang toue vermy.
tgt: This new innovative system allows citizens to apply for their Smart ID cards online and avoid long queues.

src: Dié gesamentlike onderneming deur vier groot banke - Absa, FNB, Nedbank en Standard Bank - om 'n aanlynaansoekplatform vir slim ID-kaarte en paspoorte bekend te stel, sal kliënte in staat stel om kiosks van die Departement van Binnelandse Sake te besoek om hul vingerafdrukke en foto's in te dien nadat hulle afsprake en betalings aanlyn gemaak het.
tgt: This collaboration with four major banks – ABSA, FNB, Nedbank and Standard Bank– to introduce an online application platform for Smart ID cards and passports will enable customers to visit DHA kiosks to submit their fingerprints and pictures after having made appointments and payments online.

src: eKanaal is deel van die departement se algehele moderniseringstrategie om die departement se dienste van papier na digitaal om te skakel, 'n proses wat ook die skoonmaak van die bevolkingsregister sal insluit.
tgt: eChannel is part of the department’s overall modernisation strategy to move services from paper to digital, a process which will include the cleaning of the population register.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die sukses van die onlangse Imbizo-fokusweek onder die tema "Saam beweeg ons Suid-Afrika vorentoe", waartydens regeringsamptenare met gemeenskappe regoor die land gesprek gevoer het.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the success of the recently held Imbizo Focus Week under the theme ‘Together we move South Africa forward’, which saw government officials interacting with communities throughout the country.

src: Die Kabinet prys Suid-Afrikaners wat aan meer as 36 programme regoor die land deelgeneem het en sodoende verseker dat die Regering op die geïdentifiseerde behoeftes van gemeenskap kan reageer.
tgt: Cabinet commends those South Africans who participated in over 36 programmes across the country, which ensured that government responded to identified community needs.

src: Die Imbizo-fokusweek het gemeenskappe bemagtig met inligting oor regeringsprogramme.
tgt: The Imbizo Focus Week has empowered communities with information on government programmes.

src: Die Departement van Meslike Nedersettings het 'n konferensie van die Verenigde Nasies (VN) oor informele nedersettings, met die klem op die fenomenale tempo van verstedeliking en die groei van krotbuurte, suksevol aangebied.
tgt: The Department of Human Settlements hosted a very successful United Nations (UN) conference dealing with informal settlements, emphasising the phenomenal rate of urbanisation and the growth of slums.

src: Een miljard mense in die wêreld woon nou in krotbuurte.
tgt: Now one billion people in the world live in slums.

src: Suid-Afrika het sedert 1994 miljoene huise gebou as deel van pogings om beter lewens vir almal te verseker.
tgt: South Africa has since 1994 built millions of houses as part of ensuring a better life for all.

src: WetsontwerpeDie Kabinet het die volgende konsepwetsontwerpe goedgekeur:.
tgt: BillsCabinet approved the following draft Bills:.

src: Wetsontwerp op die Beskerming van Kritieke Infrastruktuur van 2016 vir publikasie in die Staatskoerant en openbare kommentaar.
tgt: Critical Infrastructure Protection Bill of 2016 to be published in the Government Gazette for public comment.

src: Die Wetsontwerp herroep die Wet op Nasionale Sleutelpunte, 1980 (Wet 102 van 1980), en poog om die proses waarvolgens kritieke infrastruktuur geïdentifiseer en verklaar word op 'n deursigtige en verantwoordelike wyse te belyn.
tgt: The Bill repeals the National Key Points Act, 1980 (Act 102 of 1980), and seeks to align the process of identifying and declaring critical infrastructures in a transparent and accountable manner.

src: Dit sal voorts ook verseker dat alle kritieke infrastruktuur vir die land se nasionale veiligheid, geïdentifiseer en voldoende beskerm word.
tgt: It will also further ensure that all critical infrastructures for the national security of the country are identified and adequately protected.

src: Die Wetsontwerp maak voorsiening vir die oprigting van 'n vasgestelde raamwerk om die beskerming van die kritieke infrastruktuur te moniteer en te administreer.
tgt: The Bill provides for the setting up of an institutional framework to monitor and administer the protection of the critical infrastructures.

src: Dit definieer verder die funksies van die raadgewende liggaam wat die Minister van Polisie sal adviseur oor die verklaring van kritieke infrastruktuur.
tgt: It further defines the functions of the body that will advise the Minister of Police in the declaration of critical infrastructures.

src: Wysigingswet op Verenigings vir Gemeenskaplike Eiendom van 2016 wat gepubliseer sal word vir openbare kommentaar.
tgt: The Communal Property Associations Amendment Bill of 2016 to be published for public comment.

src: Die Wetsontwerp wysig die huidige Wet op Verenigings vir Gemeenskaplike Eiendom, 1996 (Wet 28 van 1996).Die wetsontwerp sal die demokratiese regeringsproses van die bestaande Verenigings vir Gemeenskaplike Eiendom of bestaande trustentiteite wat toesig hou oor gemeenskaplike grond, versterk.
tgt: The Bill amends the current Communal Property Associations Act, 1996 (Act 28 of 1996).The Bill will strengthen the democratic governance process of the existing Communal Property Associations or existing Trust entities that oversee communal land.

src: Die gewysigde wetsontwerp maak voorsiening vir die vestiging van die Registrateur in die Departement van Landelike Ontwikkeling en Grondhervorming, en definieer die funksies van hierdie amp.
tgt: The amended Bill provides for the setting up of the Registrar in the Department of Rural Development and Land Reform, and defines the functions of this office.

src: Wanneer die wetsontwerp as ’n wet geproklameer word, sal dit die regulering van bestuursinstellings versterk word en staatsondersteuning aan hierdie instellings sal verbeter.
tgt: Once this Bill is passed into law, it will strengthen the regulation of governance institutions and enhance State support to WEBTOKEN will enable communities to acquire, hold and manage properties through effective statutorily established administration entities supported by government.

src: Die bekendstelling van die Wetsontwerp op Internasionale Arbitrasie van 2016 aan die Parlement.
tgt: The introduction of the International Arbitration Bill of 2016 to Parliament.

src: Die internasionale arbitrasieproses is 'n noodsaaklike hulpmiddel om sake oor landsgrense te doen.
tgt: The international arbitration process is an essential tool for doing business across the borders of the country.

src: Dit sal toegang tot regsdienste vir maatskappye wat sake buite die land doen verbeter, asook vir buitelandse maatskappye in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: It will improve access to justice services for companies doing business outside the country and foreign companies in South Africa.

src: Die Wetsontwerp herroep die Wet op die Erkenning en Toepassing van Buitelandse Arbitrasietoekennings, 1977 (Wet 40 van 1977) en wysig ook die huidige Wet op die Beskerming van Besighede, 1978 (Wet 99 van 1978).
tgt: The Bill repeals the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards Act, 1977 (Act 40 of 1977) and also amends the current Protection of Business Act, 1978 (Act 99 of 1978).

src: Die voorgestelde wetsontwerp is in lyn met die Modelwet op Internasionale Handelsarbitrasie, wat deur die VN se Kommissie oor Internasionale Handelsreg aanvaar is.
tgt: The proposed Bill aligns with the Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration, which has been adopted by the UN Commission on International Trade Law.

src: Die publikasie van die Konsepwysigingswet op die Nasionale Navorsingstigting van 2016 in die Staatskoerant vir openbare kommentaar.
tgt: The publication of the draft National Research Foundation Amendment Bill of 2016 in the Government Gazette for public comment.

src: Die Wetsontwerp wysig die Wet op die Nasionale Navorsingstigting, 1998 (Wet 23 van 1998).Die wetsontwerp sal Suid-Afrika se mededingendheid in navorsingsontwikkeling en -hernuwing verbeter deur doeltreffende, voldoende en gekoördineerde bestuur van openbare betrokkenheid by wetenskap en die voorsiening van en toegang tot navorsingsinfrastruktuur te verbeter.
tgt: The Bill amends the National Research Foundation Act, 1998 (Act 23 of 1998).The Bill will improve South Africa’s competitiveness in research development and innovation through effective, adequate and coordinated management of public engagement with science, and improved research infrastructure provision and access.

src: Dit sal ook die deelnemendheid en doeltreffendheid van navorsingsontwikkeling en die voorsiening van innovering verbeter om Suid-Afrikaners se lewensgehalte te verbeter deur beter belyning met regeringsprioriteite.
tgt: It will also improve the responsiveness and effectiveness of research development and innovation provision, to improve the quality of life of South Africans through better alignment with government priorities.

src: Belangrike Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet het die Witskrif oor Polisiëring goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet adopted the White Paper on Policing.

src: Die konsepwitskrif is vir die eerste keer in Maart 2015 vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer.
tgt: The draft White Paper was first published for public comment in March 2015.

src: Die witskrif maak voorsiening vir 'n polisiediens wat partydig is teenoor aktiewe burgery en op die bestaande polisiëringsomgewing reageer.
tgt: The paper provides for a police service that is biased towards active citizenry and responds to the existing policing environment.

src: Dit maak ook voorsiening vir 'n Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens en ’n metropolisiediens wat aanspreeklik en professioneel is.
tgt: It also provides for a South African Police Service and metro police that is accountable and professional.

src: Die Witskrif vra ook vir die vestiging van 'n Nasionale Polisieraad wat benewens ander take, verantwoordelik sal wees vir die opstel van objektiewe kriteria vir die werwing, keuring en aanstelling van nuwe rekrute in die polisiediens.
tgt: The White Paper also calls for the establishment of a National Police Board which, amongst other tasks, will be responsible for setting up the objective criteria for the recruitment, selection and appointment of new recruits in the police services.

src: Die Kabinet het die Witskrif oor Veiligheid en Sekuriteit goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet adopted the White Paper on Safety and Security.

src: Die Witskrif, wat reeds in Februarie 2015 vir openbare konsultasie uitgestuur is, fokus op 'n geïntegreerde en ontwikkelingsbenadering tot veiligheid buite polisiëring.
tgt: The White Paper, which has already been out for public consultation in February 2015, focuses on an integrated and developmental approach to safety beyond policing.

src: Dit poog om leiding te gee oor voorkomende veiligheidsmaatreëls vir gemeenskappe.
tgt: It seeks to guide on preventative safety measures for communities.

src: Die Witskrif identifiseer al die betrokke departemente en gemeenskapsgebaseerde organisasies wat tot gemeenskappe se veiligheid bydra.
tgt: The White Paper identifies all the relevant departments and community-based organisations that contribute to the safety of communities.

src: Die Kabinet het die Konsepbeleid oor die Tradisionele Praktyk van Inisiasie in Suid-Afrika goedgekeur en goedkeuring aan die Departement van Tradisionele Sake verleen om nasionale wetgewing oor inisiasie op te stel.
tgt: Cabinet approved the draft Policy on the Customary Practice of Initiation in South Africa and approved for the Department of Traditional Affairs to commence drafting national legislation on initiation.

src: Die beleid het reeds 'n uitgebreide openbare raadplegingsproses met alle tersaaklike belanghebbendes ondergaan.
tgt: The policy has already gone through an extensive public consultation process with relevant stakeholders.

src: Die beleid voorsien riglyne wat verseker dat die tradisionele gebruik van die jaarlikse inisiasie van jong seuns beskerm word sonder om hul veiligheid te kompromitteer.
tgt: The policy provides guidelines that ensure the protection of the traditional custom of the annual initiation of young boys without compromising their safety.

src: Dit maak deel uit van stappe deur die Regering om toepaslike en aanvaarbare gebruike te versterk.
tgt: This forms part of the steps that government is taking to reinforce appropriate and acceptable customs.

src: Dit herstel 'n aanvaarbare vlak van verantwoording aan diegene wat inisiasieskole bestuur en ouers wat hul kinders na hierdie skole stuur.
tgt: It restores an acceptable level of accountability to those that run initiation schools and parents that send their children to these schools.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die aanbevelings van die ondersoekkomitee oor die haalbaarheid van handel in renosterhorings as een van die opsies om die land se renosterbevolking te bewaar.
tgt: Cabinet approved the recommendations made by the Committee of Inquiry on the feasibility of trading in rhino horns as one of the options to preserve the country’s rhino population.

src: Die aanbevelings word onderskryf deur die Interdepartementele Tegniese Adveskomitee en die Inter-ministeriële Komitee wat aangestel is om die moontlike wettiging van kommersiële internasionale handel in renosterhoring te ondersoek.
tgt: The recommendations were endorsed by the Interdepartmental Technical Advisory Committee and the Inter-Ministerial Committee appointed to investigate the possibility of legalising commercial international trade in rhino horn.

src: Die aanbevelings steun Suid-Afrika se geïntegreerde strategiese bestuursbenadering om ’n oplossing vir renosterstropery en onwettige handel in renosterhorings te vind.
tgt: The recommendations endorse South Africa’s integrated strategic management approach to resolving the poaching of rhino and illegal trade in rhino.

src: Die komitee beveel aan dat daar gehou word by die huidige benadering waarvolgens die land se voorraadvlakke behou word, in teenstelling met handel in renosterhorings.
tgt: The committee recommends that the current mode of keeping the country’s stock levels be kept as opposed to the trading in rhino horns.

src: Die land se strategiese benadering behels sekuriteit bemagtiging van gemeenskappe biologiese bestuur reaktiewe wetgewende bepalings wat doeltreffend geïmplementeer en afgedwing word en aanvraagbestuur.
tgt: The country’s strategic approach entails security community empowerment biological management responsive legislative provisions that are effectively implemented and enforced and demand management.

src: Die Kabinet het goedkeuring verleen vir die volgende gedenkmuntontwerpe vir 2016:a) Die National Geographic muntreeks – Grootkatte-inisiatief: ‘Die Cheetah’.b) Die Sterlingsilwer kroon- en tiekiemuntreeks – Suid-Aftikaanse uitvindings: ‘Dolosse’.Die muntstukontwerpe met hul verklarings sal in die Staatskoerant gepubliseer word en sal dan deur die normale kanale vervaardig en verkoop sword.
tgt: Cabinet approved the following 2016 commemorative coin designs:a) The National Geographic Coin Series – Big Cats Initiative: ‘The Cheetah’.b) The Sterling-silver crown and tickey coin series ‘South African inventions – ‘Dolosse’.The coin designs, together with their proclamations, will be printed in the Government Gazette, and will then be manufactured and sold through the normal channels.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: President Zuma sal tussen 18 en 22 April 2016 werksbesoeke aan lidlande van die Suider-Afrikaanse Doeane-unie (SACU) wat Namibië, Botswana, Lesotho en Swaziland insluit, onderneem.
tgt: President Zuma will between the 18 and 22 April 2016 undertake working visits to member states of the Southern Africa Custom Union (SACU) which include Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho and Swaziland.

src: Die besoeke sal die belangrike rol wat SACU speel ter bevordering van streeksintegrasie en ekonomiese ontwikkeling van al sy lede, verbeter.
tgt: The visits will enhance the important role that SACU plays in promoting regional integration and economic development of all its members.

src: Die President sal op 23 en 24 April 2016 'n staatsbesoek aan die Islamitiese Republiek van Iran onderneem om politieke en ekonomiese betrekkinge tussen die twee lande te versterk.
tgt: The President will undertake a State Visit to the Islamic Republic of Iran on 23 and 24 April 2016 to strengthen political and economic engagements between the two countries.

src: Die President sal die Nasionale Vryheidsdagvierings op 27 April 2016 in Limpopo se Giyani-stadion lei onder die tema: "Saam bou ons beter gemeenskappe - Plaaslike Regering is almal se besigheid".Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners en sektore om hul patriotisme te bewys deur aan die verskillende geleenthede ter herdenking van Vryheidsmaand deel te neem.
tgt: The President will lead the National Freedom Day celebrations on 27 April 2016 in Limpopo, Giyani Stadium under the theme: “Together building better communities – Local Government is everyone’s business”.Cabinet calls on all South Africans and sectors to demonstrate their patriotism by participating in the various events commemorating Freedom Month.

src: Gedurende die komende weke, sal departementele begrotingsredes in die Parlement gehou word.
tgt: During the upcoming weeks, Parliament will be holding departmental Budget Votes.

src: Die onderskeie departementele bestuurders sal hul operasionele planne vir die boekjaar 2016/17 uiteensit.
tgt: The respective departmental Executives will unpack their operational plans for the 2016/17 financial year.

src: Lede van die publiek sal ingelig word oor die Regering se diensleweringsprogramme.
tgt: Members of the public will be informed about service-delivery programmes of government.

src: Die Kabinet se posisie oor belangrike kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on key issues in the environment.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die reaksie en die daaropvolgende verskoning deur President Zuma na anleiding van die Konstitusionele Hof se uitspraak oor die nakoming van regstellende stappe wat in 'n verslag van die Openbare Beskermer uiteengesit is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the response and subsequent apology by President Zuma to the Constitutional Court judgment relating to compliance with remedial actions set out in a report of the Public Protector.

src: Die Kabinet bestudeer die uitspraak om vas te stel of enige ander optredes onderneem moet word om die rol van die Staatsdiens te versterk.
tgt: Cabinet is studying the judgment to establish if there are any other actions to be undertaken to strengthen the role of the Public Service.

src: Die Konstitusionele Hof se uitspraak versterk en handhaaf grondwetlike demokrasie in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: The Constitutional Court judgment reinforces and asserts South Africa’s constitutional democracy.

src: Die Kabinet het kennis geneem van die optrede deur vier banke wat opdrag gegee het om die bankrekening van 'n maatskappy te sluit.
tgt: Cabinet noted the actions by the four banks that gave notice to close the bank account of a company.

src: Terwyl die Kabinet waardering het vir die banke se terme en voorwaardes, kan die dade toekomstige potensiële beleggers wat sake in Suid-Afrika wil doen afskrik.
tgt: Whilst Cabinet appreciate the terms and conditions of the banks, the acts may deter future potential investors who may want to do business in South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die ministers van Finansies, van Arbeid en van Minerale Hulpbronne konstruktiewe gesprekke met die banke moet onderneem om 'n blywende oplossing vir hierdie kwessie te vind.
tgt: Cabinet has endorsed that the Ministers of Finance, Labour and Mineral Resources should open a constructive engagement with the banks to find a lasting solution to this matter.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Minister van Gesondheid, dr Aaron Motsoaledi geluk met die USAID-TB internasionale toekenning wat hy ontvang het ter erkenning van sy leierskap in die globale stryd teen tuberkulose (TB), asook vir die voorspraak wat hy gemaak vir Suid-Afrikaanse en streeksinisiatiewe rakende die skandering, behandeling en voorkoming van TB TB/MIV-mede-infeksie en multi-middelweerstandige TDie Kabinet verwelkom Suid-Afrika se nominasie as die 2016 ontvanger van die toekenning vir Voortreflike Diplomatieke Diens deur die Raad van Wêreldsake (World Affairs Council) in Washington, DAs die eerste Afrika-land om hierdie toekenning te ontvang, erken dit die land se besondere toewyding aan globale onderwys, internasionale sake en globale kommunikasie ter beoverdering van ons nasionale belange.
tgt: Cabinet congratulated the Minister of Health, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi, who received the USAID-TB international award in recognition of his leadership in the global fight against tuberculosis (TB) as well as championing South Africa's and regional initiatives in the screening, treatment and prevention of TB TB/HIV co-infection and multi-drug resistant TCabinet welcomes the nomination of South Africa as the 2016 recipient of the Distinguished Diplomatic Service Award by the World Affairs Council in Washington, DAs the first African country to receive this award, it recognises the country’s outstanding commitment to global education, international affairs and global communications to advance our national interests.

src: Die Kabinet prys die Minister van Internasionale Betrekkinge en Samewerking, me Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, vir haar bydrae tot Suid-Afrika internasionale betrekkinge, wat aangedryf word deur die visie van 'n "verenigde Afrika-vasteland wat vreedsame, demokratiese, nie-rassige, nie-seksisties en voorspoedig is, en wat bydra tot 'n regverdige en billike wêreld.
tgt: Cabinet commends the Minister of International Relations and Cooperation, Ms Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, for her contribution to South Africa’s international engagements, which are driven by the vision of a “united African continent that is peaceful, democratic, non-racial, non-sexist and prosperous, and which contributes to a just and equitable world.”.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die aanstelling deur President Zuma van Advkaat Jan Lekhoa Mothibi, as die Hoof van die Spesiale Ondersoekeenheid, en wens hom alles van die beste toe met sy nuwe verantwoordelikhede in die stryd teen korrupsie en wanadministrasie.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the appointment by President Zuma of Advocate Jan Lekhoa Mothibi, as the Head of the Special Investigating Unit, and wishes him all the best in his new responsibilities of combating corruption and maladministration.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy innige meegevoel aan die familie Makwetu en die Pan Africanist Congress met die afsterwe van mnrClarence Makwetu.
tgt: Cabinet conveys its heartfelt condolences to the Makwetu family and the Pan Africanist Congress on the passing of Mr Clarence Makwetu.

src: MnrMakwetu sal onthou word vir sy enorme bydrae en persoonlike opofferings tydens die bevrydingsbeweging en die vestiging van die nuwe demokratiese Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Mr Makwetu will be remembered for his immense contribution and personal sacrifices to the liberation movement and the establishment of the new democratic South Africa.

src: Die President het 'n spesiale provinsiale amptelike begrafnis vir dié bevrydingstrydstaatmaker aangekondig.
tgt: The President declared a Special Provincial Official Funeral for the liberation struggle stalwart.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy innige meegevoel oor aan die familie Naidoo met die afsterwe van mnrKumaran Naidoo.
tgt: Cabinet conveys its heartfelt condolences to the Naidoo family on the passing of Mr Kumaran Naidoo.

src: MnrNaidoo was die Waarnemende Direkteur-generaal van die Departement van Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling.
tgt: Mr Naidoo was the Acting Director-General of the Department of Economic Development.

src: Hy was voorheen die Hoof Finansiële Beampte van die Departement van Handel en Nywerheid.
tgt: He previously served as the Chief Financial Officer of the Department of Trade and Industry.

src: MnrNaidoo het ’n geweldige groot bygedrae tot finansiële bestuur in die Staatsdiens gelewer.
tgt: Mr Naidoo has contributed immensely in financial management within the Public Service.

src: Die Kabinet spreek sy waardering uit vir die bydrae van mnrWilliam Smith, wat as Kabinetsekretariaat gedien het.
tgt: Cabinet expressed its appreciation on the contribution made by Mr William Smith, who served as Cabinet Secretariat.

src: MnrSmith het aan die einde van Maart ná 27 jaar in die Staatsdiens afgetree.
tgt: Mr Smith retired at the end of March after serving the Public Service for 27 years.

src: Die Kabinet wens hom voorspoed toe vir sy aftrede.
tgt: Cabinet wishes him well on his retirement.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die Verslag van die Kommissie van Ondersoek na bewerings van bedrog, korrupsie, onbehoorlikheid of onreëlmatigheid in die verkryging van die Strategiese Verdedigingspakket (Kommissie vir Wapenaankope) wat vanoggend deur die President uitgereik is.
tgt: The Cabinet was briefed about the Report of the Commission of Inquiry into Allegations of Fraud, Corruption, Impropriety or Irregularity in the Strategic Defence Procurement Package (Arms Procurement Commission) which was released by the President this morning.

src: Die verslag het geen bewyse van oortreding, omkopery, bedrog of korrupsie in die wapenaankopeproses gevind nie.
tgt: The Report has found no evidence of wrongdoing, bribery, fraud or corruption in the arms procurement process, As Government we welcome the findings of the Commission.

src: Ons is vrygespreek van skuld en ons het ook jare lank aangevoer dat daar geen oortreding plaasgevind het nie en dat die aankope bo verdenking was.
tgt: We have been vindicated as we have stated over many years that there was no wrongdoing and that the procurement had been above board.

src: Ons vertrou dat die bevindings nou hierdie lang uitgerekte saak sal afsluit.
tgt: We trust that the findings will bring closure to this long drawn out matter.

src: Saam met President Zuma, bedank ons Regter Willie Seriti en Regter Thekiso Musi asook al die getuies, onder wie voormalige president Thabo Mbeki die getuienisaanvoerders regspanne personeel en diegene wat tot die sukses van die Kommissie bygedra het.
tgt: We join President Zuma in thanking Justice Willie Seriti and Judge Thekiso Musi, all the witnesses, including former President Thabo Mbeki, evidence leaders, legal teams, staff and those who contributed to making the work of the Commission a success.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die betrokke uitklaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: MnrSiyabonga Gama as Groep Uitvoerende Direkteur en mnrGarry Pita as Groep Finansiële Hoof van Transnet.
tgt: Mr Siyabonga Gama as Group Executive and Mr Garry Pita as Group Chief Financial Officer of Transnet.

src: Implementering van Belangrike Regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of Key Government Programmes.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom President Jacob Zuma se Staatsbesoek aan die Islamitiese Republiek van Iran om ekonomiese en handelsbande tussen die twee lande uit te brei, deur die ondertekening van verskeie ooreenkomste en verbintenisse.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes President Jacob Zuma’s State Visit of to the Islamic Republic of Iran, which escalates economic and trade relations between both countries, through the signing of several agreements and commitments.

src: President Jacob Zuma en President Hasan Rouhani het samewerking verstewig op die gebiede van handel onderwys en vaardigheidsontwikkeling wetenskap en tegnologie energie, insluitend petrochemiese gaseksplorasie en raffinadirykapasiteit landbou mynbou en minerale infrastruktuurontwikkeling en vervoer finansies, bankwese en versekering en toerisme.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma and President Hasan Rouhani strengthened cooperation in the fields of trade, education and skills development science and technology energy, including petrochemical gas exploration and refining capacity agriculture mining and mineral beneficiation infrastructure development and transport finance, banking and insurance and tourism.

src: Samewerking op al hierdie gebiede lewer ’n bydrae tot die implementering van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan.
tgt: All of which contributes to the implementation of the National Development Plan.

src: Op die internasionale front het die twee leiers ooreengekom om, in belang van die ontwikkelende wêreld, die beroep om die Verenigde Nasies te hervorm, veral die VN se Veiligheidsraad, te versterk.
tgt: On the international front, the two leaders agreed to intensify the call for the reform of the United Nations especially the UN Security Council, in the interests of the developing world.

src: Hierdie uitkomste ondersteun die President se werksbesoek aan die Verenigde Arabiese Emirate (VAE).
tgt: These outcomes reinforced the President’s Working Visit to the United Arab Emirates (UAE) where both states renewed their commitment towards the consolidation and elevation of bilateral relations, particularly in the trade, investment and economic fields into a comprehensive strategic partnership.

src: Tydens dié besoek het albei lande hul verbinding tot die konsolidasie en opheffing van bilaterale betrekkinge, veral op die gebiede van handel, belegging en ekonomie, in ’n omvattende strategiese venootskap, herbevestig.
tgt: This built on President Jacob Zuma’s State Visit in November 2011 which saw the establishment of the SA-UAE Joint Commission that accelerated total trade momentum between the two countries from R13 billion in 2011 to R27 billion in 2015.South Africa and the UAE also agreed to expand cooperation to take advantage of opportunities in the Ocean Economy, to promote the export of South African agricultural products, manufactured products and particularly defence procurement and partnerships.

src: Dit bou voort op President Jacob Zuma se staatsbesoek in November 2011, wat tot die vestiging van die SA-VAE Gesamentlike Kommissie gelei het en die algehele handelsmomentum tussen die twee lande van R13 miljard in 2011 tot R27 miljard in 2015 versnel het.
tgt: The visit also promoted South African infrastructure building capacity targeting opportunities for South African companies at EXPO 2020 in Dubai, as well as cooperation in the field of peace, security and stability.

src: Suid-Afrika en die VAE het ook ooreengekom op groter samewerking om voordeel te trek uit geleenthede in die oseaan-ekonomie, om die uitvoer van Suid-Afrikaanse landbouprodukte, vervaardigde produkte en veral verdedigingsverskaffing en vennootskappe te bevorder.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the firm measures that have been put in place by the Minister of Sport and Recreation Fikile Mbalula to reconstruct the fragmented and deeply discriminatory sport and recreation landscape through its Transformation Charter.

src: Die besoek het verder Suid-Afrikaanse infrastruktuurontwikkeling en geleenthede vir Suid-Afrikaanse maatskappye by EXPO 2020 in Dubai bevorder, en samewerking op die gebied van vrede, seskuriteit en stabiliteit verstewig.
tgt: This will accelerate transformation towards a unified sport system underpinned by the principles of democracy, equity, transparency, demographic representation, access and increased participation in line with the aspirations of the National Development Plan.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die streng maatreëls wat deur die Minister van Sport en Ontspanning, Fikile Mbalula, ingestel is om die gefragmenteerde, diep diskriminerende sport- en ontspanningsomgewing deur sy Transformasie-handves te rekonstrueer.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the budget votes being presented by various departments with extensive reports outlining the progress made towards improving the lives of South Africans.

src: Dit sal transformasie versnel deur ’n verenigde sportstelsel, wat deur die beginsels van demokrasie, gelykheid, deursigtigheid, demografiese verteenwoordiging, toegang en verhoogde deelname gerugsteun word ooreenkomstig die doelwitte van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan.
tgt: This demonstrates implementation of the Medium Term Strategic Framework which takes us closer to the realisation of Vision 2030 of the National Development Plan.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die begrotingsredes wat deur verskillende ministers aagebied word, met uitgebreide verslae oor die vordering wat gemaak word om Suid-Afrikaners se lewens te verbeter.
tgt: Cabinet calls on South Africans to follow the budget votes on various media platforms to better understand Government’s Programme of Action.

src: Dit dui op die implementering van die Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk, wat ons nader bring aan die verwesenliking van Visie 2030 van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan.
tgt: Cabinet calls for continued commitment to secure meaningful workplace transformation in view of the findings from the 16th Commission for Employment Equity Annual Report for all designated employers which was launched under the theme “Transformation does make business sense”.

src: Die verslag help die Regering om die status van diensbillikheid in die land en die vordering wat in 2015 met werkplektransformasie gemaak is, te verstaan.
