tgt: The Report helps government to understand the status of employment equity in the country and its progress in workplace transformation for the year 2015.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Departement van Meslike Nedersettings geluk met die lewering van 4,3 miljoen huise en behuisinsgeleenthede sedert die begin van demokrasie.
tgt: Cabinet congratulated the Department of Human Settlements on the delivery of 4, 3 million houses and housing opportunities since the dawn of democracy.

src: Dié geleenthede sluit in 2 806 235 ten volle gesubsidieerde huise (BNG-huise), 121 784 maatskaplike/huurhuise, 6 329 Finansieel-gekoppelde Individuele Subsidie-programhuise en 986 608 terreine met dienste.
tgt: These opportunities include 2, 806 235 fully subsidized houses (BNG houses), 121 784 social/rental housing, 6329 Financial Linked Individual Subsidy Programme and 986 608 serviced sites.

src: Hierdie historiese mylpaal het huise aan meer as 20 miljoen mense voorsien, en om dié prestasie te vier het die departement 'n nasionale veldtog van stapel gestuur om die sukses van die land se profiel bekend te stel.
tgt: This historic milestone has provided a roof for more than 20 million people and to celebrate this achievement the department has launched a national campaign to profile the country’s success.

src: Die nasionale bekendstelling is in Cosmo City, een van die geïntegreerde prioriteitsprojekte regoor die land wat ook sy tiende bestaansjaar gevier het, gehou.
tgt: The national launch took place in COSMO City, one of the integrated priority projects around the country which is also celebrating ten years of its existence.

src: Die Kabinet bedank alle Suid-Afrikaners vir hul bydraes, toewyding en harde werk om te verseker dat die waardigheid van Suid-Afrikaners in nood herstel is deur die voorsiening van menslike nedersettings.
tgt: Cabinet thanked all South Africans for their contributions, dedication and hard work in ensuring that the dignity of South Africans in need is restored through human settlements.

src: Die Kabinet prys die Sekretaris-generaal van die Verenigde Nasies vir die sameroeping van die hoëvlak-ondertekeningseremonie van die Parys-ooreenkoms, wat in Desember 2015 deur 176 partye aanvaar is.
tgt: Cabinet commends the United Nations Secretary-General for convening the High-Level Signing Ceremony of the Paris Agreement, which was adopted by 176 Parties in December 2015.

src: Die ondertekening van die Parys-ooreenkoms was die eerste stap in die implementering daarvan, wat internasionale pogings sal lei om die vrystelling van kweekhuisgasse te beperk en al die gepaardgaande uitdagings van klimaatsverandering die hoof te bied.
tgt: The signing of the Paris Agreement marked the first step in its implementation which will guide international efforts to limit greenhouse gas emissions and to meet all the associated challenges posed by climate change.

src: Die Kabinet sien uit dat alle partye hul onderskeie plaaslike bekragtigingsprosedures moet afhandel om tydige inwerkingtreding moontlik te maak, sodat die Parys-ooreenkoms teen 2020 ten volle geïmplementeer kan word.
tgt: Cabinet looks forward to the conclusion of the respective domestic ratification procedures, by all, to enable timely entry into force for full implementation of the Paris Agreement by 2020.

src: Die Kabinet neem ook kennis dat die Departement van Omgewingsake in vennootskap met die Departement van Toerisme, van 10 April tot 13 Me 2016 leweringslaboratoriums byeenbring, getiteld "Biodiversiteit-lab: Laat die ekonomiese bydrae van Suid-Afrika se biologiese hulpbronne groei".Die doel is om die ekonomiese potensiaal van Suid-Afrika se ryk biologiese diversiteit te ontsluit.
tgt: Cabinet also notes that the Department of Environmental Affairs has partnered with the Department of Tourism in convening delivery labs titled “Biodiversity Lab: Growing the economic contribution of South Africa’s biological resources” from 10 April to 13 May 2016.The aim is to realise the economic potential of South Africa’s rich biological diversity which is articulated in the draft National Biodiversity Economy Strategy that was approved by Cabinet in July 2015 for public participation.

src: Belangrike Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die Nywerheidsbeleid-aksieplan (IPAP) 2016/17 - 2018/19, wat 'n belangrike pilaar van die President se Negepunt-plan is en tot die implementering van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan bydra.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Industrial Policy Action Plan (IPAP) 2016/17 – 2018/19, which is a key pillar of the President’s Nine-Point Plan and contributes towards implementation of the National Development Plan.

src: Dit is die agtste jaarlikse herhaling van opeenvolgende industrialiseringsplanne deur die Regering, wat op die prestasies, beleidsplatforms en programme van die vorige herhalings voortbou.
tgt: This is the eighth annual iteration of successive government industrialisation plans which builds on the achievements, policy platforms and programmes of previous iterations.

src: IPAP 2016/17 streef na 'n hoër-impak industriële beleid in moeilike ekonomiese omstandighede.
tgt: IPAP 2016/17 seeks to achieve a higher impact industrial policy in difficult economic circumstances.

src: Dit sluit die deurlopende gevolge van die wêreldwye ekonomiese resessie in, met inbegrip van die staalkrisis en kommoditeitinsinking, asook die ernstige droogte en ander beduidende binnelandse beperkings.
tgt: These include the on-going effects of the global economic recession including the steel crisis and commodity slump as well as the severe drought and other significant domestic constraints.

src: Prestasies uit die vorige jaar sluit in die behoud van ongeveer 67 000 werksgeleenthede en die skep van 'n geraamde 7 000 nuwe behoorlike werksgeleenthede in die sektor vir klere en tekstiel, leer en skoene.
tgt: Achievements from the previous year include the saving of approximately 67 000 jobs and the creation of an estimated 7 000 new decent jobs in the Clothing and Textile Leather and Footwear sector.

src: Die sub-sektor vir agro-verwerking is een van die grootste binnelandse vervaardigingsektore deur indiensneming, wat ’n geraamde 216 090 werksgeleenthede in 2015 geskep het in vergelyking met 208 822 in 2014.
tgt: The Agro-processing sub-sector is one of the largest domestic manufacturing sectors by employment, providing an estimated 216 090 jobs in 2015 compared to 208 822 in 2014.

src: Dit het in 2015/16 meer as R600 miljoen se beleggings gelok, wat die grondslag gelê het vir die versterking van ondernemingsontwikkeling met die klem op landelike gemeenskappe.
tgt: Over R600 million worth of investment was attracted in 2015/16, laying the basis for strengthening enterprise development with a focus on rural communities.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die Finale Raamwerk vir Geïntegreerde Stedelike Ontwikkeling en die 2016/19 Implementeringsplan.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Final Integrated Urban Development Framework and 2016/19 Implementation Plan.

src: Die algehele uitkoms van die Raamwerk vir Geïntegreerde Stedelike Ontwikkeling is ruimtelike transformasie.
tgt: The overall outcome of the Integrated Urban Development Framework is spatial transformation.

src: Dit dui op 'n nuwe bedeling vir Suid-Afrikaanse stede en dorpe, wat stedelike groei sal lei na 'n volhoubare groeimodel van kompakte, samehangende en gekoördineerde stede en dorpe, wat veiliger is, hulpbrondoeltreffend is en goeie plekke is om te werk en leef.
tgt: This marks a new deal for South African cities and towns, which will steer urban growth towards a sustainable growth model of compact, connected and coordinated cities and towns, which are safer, resource efficient and good places to work and live in.

src: Dit is in reaksie op die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan se opdrag om 'n stedelike ontwikkelingsbeleid te ontwikkel wat behoorlike beplanning, infrastruktuurbeleggings, bestuur om groei te bevorder en die ekonomiese potensiaal van ons stede en dorpe te ontsluit, sal verseker.
tgt: This responds to the National Development Plan directive to develop an urban development policy that will ensure proper planning, infrastructure investments and management to support growth and unlock the economic potential of our cities and towns.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Nasionale Konsepbeleid vir Loopbaanontwikkelingsdienste – Bou ’n doeltreffende en effektiewe Geïntegreeerde Loopbaanontwikkelingstelsel vir Suid-Afrika, in die Staatskoerant vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer word.
tgt: Cabinet approved publication of the Draft National Career Development Services Policy – Building an effective and Integrated Career Development Services System for South Africa, in the Government Gazette for public comment.

src: Waanneer die konsepbeleid geïmplementeer word, sal dit ’n gekoördineerde benadering tot gehalte loopbaanontwikkelingsdienste vir alle burgers voorsien.
tgt: The draft Policy once implemented will provide a coordinated approach to quality career development services for all citizens.

src: Dit sal hulle in staat stel om ingeligte loopbaankeuses te maak sodat hulle werk kan kry, ’n bydrae tot die gemeeskap kan lewer en die Suid-Afrikaane ekonomie kan help om te groei.
tgt: This will enable them to make informed career choices to obtain employment, contribute to society and build the South African WEBTOKEN Development Services plays a key role in helping labour markets work and education systems meet their goals.

src: Dit dra by tot die vewesenliking van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan se aanbevelings om ekonomiese groei en indiensneming te bevorder, om werkers in toepaslike poste te plaas en om meer vaardighede te ontwikkel en ‘n toename in gegradueerdes te verseker.
tgt: This contributes towards the achievement of the National Development Plan recommendations of promoting economic growth and employment, matching of employed workers to jobs and increasing skills development and the number of university graduates.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die implementering van die Nasionale Evalueringstelsel en het die 2014/15 Jaarverslag en die vyfde Nasionale Evalueringsplan vir 2016/17 tot 2018/19 goedgekeur as deel van die strewe om dienslewering te verbeter.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on implementation of the National Evaluation System and approved the Annual report 2014/15 and the fifth National Evaluation Plan for 2016/17 to 2018/19, as part of the drive to improve service delivery,The National Evaluation System emanates from the National Evaluation Policy Framework which ensures that credible and objective evidence from evaluations is incorporated in processes of planning, budgeting, organisational improvement, policy review, as well as on-going programme and project management so as to improve performance.

src: 47 evaluerings is reeds voltooi of is aan die gang dit dek R75 miljard van regeringsbesteding.
tgt: Forty-seven (47) evaluations have been completed or are underway, covering R75 billion of government expenditure.

src: Tot op datum is 15 evalueringsverslae goedgekeur en 12 is in die Parlement ter tafel gelê.
tgt: Fifteen (15) evaluation reports were approved and 12 tabled at Cabinet to date.

src: 14 verbeteringsplanne word geïmplementeer en die vordering wat hiermee gemaak word dui reeds op wesenlike veranderings om die impak te verbreed.
tgt: Fourteen (14) improvement plans are being implemented and progress on these reflects substantial changes, to widen impact.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die evalueringsbevindings en goedgekeurde aanbevelings met die doel om die impak van die implementering van die Uitgebreide Openbarewerkeprogram se sosiale sektor (EPWP-SS) te verhoog.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the evaluation findings and approved recommendations with a view to increase impact from the implementation of the Expanded Public Works Programme Social Sector (EPWP-SS).This Programme plays an important social protection role for unemployed able bodied adults, by drawing them into productive work and receiving a monthly stipend of an average amount of R1 517.

src: Die meerdeheid sosialesektorprogramme voorsien gespesialiseerde dienste aan kwesbare en arm gemeenskappe.
tgt: Most of the social sector programmes provide specialised services to vulnerable and poor communities.

src: Die EPWP-SS het vinnig tussen fase een en fase twee gegroei met programme wat van vyf tot 22 toegeneem het.
tgt: The EPWP-SS grew rapidly between phase one and phase two, from 5 to 22 programmes which resulted in the sector achieving 175 769 work opportunities in phase one and 866 246 work opportunities in phase two, well above the 750 000 target.

src: Dit het gelei tot 175 769 werksgeleenthede in die eerste fase en 866 246 werksgeleenthede in fase twee, veel meer as die teiken van 750 000.Die aanbevelings fokus op die verbetering van implementering om ondoeltreffendheid rakende besluitneming te verminder, en toepassing (betaling van toelae) en voorsiening van opleiding, sowel as koördinering, te bevorder.
tgt: The recommendations focus on improving implementation to reduce inefficiencies in decision-making, implementation (payments of stipends) and provision of training, as well as coordination.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die bevindings en onderskryf die aanbevelings van die ontwerp- en implementeringsevaluering van die Ontwikkelingstoelae vir Stedelike Nedersettings en sy verbeteringsplan.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the findings and endorsed the recommendations of the design and implementation evaluation of the Urban Settlement Development Grant and its Improvement Plan.

src: Die bevindings ondersteun die behoud van die Ontwikkelingstoelae vir Stedelike Nedersettings as 'n aanvullende toelae vir die befondsing van 'n wyer konsep van volhoubare en billike menslike nedersettings tot voordeel van arm en matige inkomste huishoudings.
tgt: The findings support retaining the Urban Settlement Development Grant as a supplementary grant that funds a wider notion of sustainable and equitable human settlements for the benefit of poor and moderate income households.

src: Dit is deurslaggewend vir die bereiking van die Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk se doelwitte, naamlik die voorsiening van 1 495 miljoen behuisingsgeleenthede in leefomgewings van gehalte teen 2019.
tgt: This is instrumental in achieving the targets from the Medium Term Strategic Framework provision of 1 495 million housing opportunities in quality living environments by 2019.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die verslag oor die Implementering en Impakevaluering van die Program vir Tegnologie en Meslike Hulpbronne vir Industrie, asook die bestuursreaksie op die verslag en die verbeteringsplan wat deur die Departement van Handel en Nywerheid voorgelê is.
tgt: Cabinet approved the report on the Implementation and Impact Evaluation of the Technology and Human Resources for Industry Programme, the management response to the report and the improvement plan submitted by the Department of Trade and Industry.

src: Die program is in 1992 deur die Departement van Handel en Nywerheid bekend gestel om vaardigheidsontwikkeling op die gebiede van wetenskap, ingenieurswese en tegnologie te bevorder.
tgt: This Programme was introduced by the Department of Trade and Industry in 1992 to strengthen skills development in science, engineering and technology.

src: Dit dra by tot werkskepping deur ’n stroom van hoogs geskoolde navorsers en tegnologiebestuurders vir die industrie te lewer en deur deelnemende sakeondernemings se mededingendheid te verbeter.
tgt: It contributes to job creation by producing a flow of highly skilled researchers and technology managers for industry and by improving the competitiveness of the participating business organisations.

src: Die program is 'n geldige, belangrike en doeltreffende element van innovasie-ondersteuning wat aansienlike waarde vir geld, beide in terme van tegnologie-ontwikkeling en die ontwikkeling van menslike hulpbronne en bedryfsverwante vaardighede, bied.
tgt: The Programme is a valid, important and efficient element of innovation support that offers considerable value for money both in terms of technology development and developing human resources and industry-related skills.

src: Dit vergelyk ook gunstig met sommige internasionale programme.
tgt: It also compares favourably to some international programmes.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die bevindings van die Ministeriële Taakspan se ondersoekverslag na die bewerings van 'onderwysposte te koop', waarby individue, onderwysersunies en amptenare van sekere provinsiale onderwysdepartemente betrek is.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the findings of the Report by the Ministerial Task Team probe into the allegations of the ‘educator posts for sale’ involving individuals, teacher unions and officials of certain Provincial Education Departments.

src: Die Kabinet onderskryf aanbevelings om die bevindings stelselmatig en doelgerig te WEBTOKEN sy finale verslag bied die Ministeriële Taakspan 'n kritiese beoordeling van die rol wat alle belanghebbendes in die proses van keuring en werwing van onderwysers speel.
tgt: Cabinet endorsed recommendations to deal systematically and pointedly with the WEBTOKEN its final Report the Ministerial Task Team provides a critique of the role played by all stakeholders in the process of the selection and recruitment of WEBTOKEN also notes the significant problems in the current system of appointments to posts in the basic education sector and provides recommendations to assist the Department of Basic Education and the basic education sector in general to address the identified challenges.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Nasionale Wysigingswetsontwerp op Bosbou aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved submission of the National Forest Amendment Bill to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp wysig die Nasionale Bousbouwet, 1998 (Wet No.
tgt: The Bill amends the National Forests Act, 1998 (Act No.

src: 84 van 1998).Implementering van die wysigings sal volhoubare bosboubestuur verbeter en sal ook kwesbare groepe wat van bosbou afhanklik is vir hul lewensbestaan, se betrokkenheid by die Nasionale Bosbouadviesraad, aanmoedig.
tgt: 84 of 1998).Implementation of the amendments will improve sustainable forest management and also encourage participation of vulnerable groups, who rely on forestry for their livelihoods, into the National Forests Advisory Council.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: President Jacob Zuma sal op 12 Me 2016 die inhuldiging- en eedafleggingseremonie van Uganda se President Yoweri Museveni in Kampala bywoon.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will attend the inauguration and swearing-in ceremony of Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni in Kampala on 12 May 2016.

src: Dié uitgaande besoek sal bilaterale betrekkinge tussen Suid-Afrika en Uganda verder verstewig.
tgt: The outgoing visit will further strengthen bilateral relations between South Africa and Uganda.

src: President Jacob Zuma sal op 29 April 2016 tydens 'n Nasionale Dag van Gebed by die ABSA-stadion in Durban optree.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will officiate a National Day of Prayer to be held at ABSA Stadium in Durban on 29 April 2016.

src: Godsdiensleiers en leiers van burgerlike groepe sal by die Regering aansluit om vir die verdere konsolidasie van demokrasie, nasionale eenheid, en sosiale samehorigheid, asook vir die suksesvolle en vreedsame verloop van die 2016 plaaslike verkiesings te bid.
tgt: Religious leaders and leaders of civil society formations will join government in praying for the further consolidation of democracy, national unity, social cohesion as well as successful and peaceful 2016 Local Government Elections.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die Departement van Kuns en Kultuur se planne om in Me 2016 gasheer te wees vir Afrika-maand onder die tema: "Die bou van 'n beter Afrika en 'n beter wêreld".
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on plans by the Department of Arts and Culture to host Africa Month in May 2016 under the theme: “Building a Better Africa and a Better World” as part of the continent’s celebration of the establishment of the Organisation of Africa Unity, now the African Union and the work it has done.

src: Dit sal saamval met die vasteland se viering van die stigting van die Organisasie van Afrika Eenheid, nou bekend as die Afrika-unie, en die werk wat hulle gedoen het.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will launch Africa Month on the National Day of Prayer on 29 April WEBTOKEN 2016 Africa Month will focus on women and youth development initiatives, while we commemorate the 60th year of the Women’s March and the 40th year of the Youth Uprisings in Soweto.

src: Suid-Afrikaners word aangemoedig om deel te neem aan die multi-dissiplinêre program wat 'n wye verskeidenheid van aktiwiteite insluit, soos visuele kunste, teater, musiek, lesings en colloquia, asook die 10de herdenking van die Afrika Wêrelderfenisfonds.
tgt: South Africans are urged to participate in the multi-disciplinary programme that involves a wide range of activities including visual arts, theatre, music, lectures and colloquia as well as the 10th anniversary of the African World Heritage Fund.

src: Afrika-maand dien as 'n platform om ons bande te verstewig en ons te herverbind tot Pan-Afrikanisme en Afrika Renaissance deur die mense van die vasteland nader aan mekaar te bring.
tgt: Africa Month serves as a platform to reconnect and recommit ourselves to Pan Africanism and African Renaissance in bringing the people of the continent closer.

src: Op 20 Me 2016 sal die Regering die nasionale eeufeesviering van die Universiteit van Fort Hare op die universiteit se Alice-kampus in die Oos-Kaap lei.
tgt: On 20 May 2016 government will lead the national celebration of the centenary of the University of Fort Hare at the Alice campus in the Eastern Cape.

src: Ter voorbereiding vir die hooffees, het President Jacob Zuma 'n inter-ministeriële komitee aangestel om dié historiese eeufeesviering te beplan en te koördineer.
tgt: In preparation for the main celebration, President Jacob Zuma has established an Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC) to plan and coordinate the historic centenary celebration.

src: Hierdie historiese onderwysinstelling het tydens ons vryheidstryd as 'n baken gedien dit staan ook bekend as die "smeltkroes van Afrika-leierskap" aangesien dit die alma mater is van anti-apartheidstryders soos die groot ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo en Govan Mbeki.
tgt: This historic learning institution served as a beacon during our struggle for freedom and is also known as the “crucible of African leadership” with it being the alma mater of anti-apartheid struggle figures such as the great ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo and Govan Mbeki.

src: Dit is die enigste Suid-Afrikaanse universiteit waar vyf staatshoofde gestudeer het: Nelson Mandela van Suid-Afrika, Yusuf Lule van Uganda, Robert Mugabe van Zimbabwe, Ntsu Mokhehle van Lesotho en Sir Seretse Khama van WEBTOKEN deel van die Universiteit van Fort Hare eeufeesvierings, doen die Kabinet ’n beroep op die alumni en lede van die publiek om hul herinneringe van Fort Hare te deel vir die veldtog ‘Vertel Jou Storie’ met behulp van die hashtag #MyFortHare.
tgt: It is the only Southern African university to have produced five heads of state: Nelson Mandela of South Africa, Yusuf Lule of Uganda, Robert Mugabe of Zimbabwe, Ntsu Mokhehle of Lesotho and Sir Seretse Khama of WEBTOKEN part of the University of Fort Hare’s centenary celebrations Cabinet calls on the Alumni and members of the public to share their Fort Hare memories for the Tell Your Story campaign using the hashtag #MyFortHare.

src: Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa sal die Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging na die 26ste Wêreld Ekonomiese Forum (WEF) Afrika tussen 11 en 13 Me in Rwanda lei.
tgt: Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa will lead the South Africa delegation to the 26th World Economic Forum (WEF) Africa in Rwanda between 11 and 13 May 2016.

src: Die forum word onder die tema “Verbind Afrika se hulpbronne deur digitale transformasie” aangebied.
tgt: The forum is hosted under the theme: “Connecting Africa’s Resources through Digital Transformation”.Government through its Nine-Point Plan is advancing the country’s own digital transformation.

src: Deur middel van sy Negepunt-plan bevorder die Regering die land se eie digitale transformasie.
tgt: It is rolling out the first phase of its broadband initiative that will connect more than 5 000 government facilities in eight district municipalities over a three-year period.

src: Befondsing vir 'n bedrag van R740 miljoen is ter ondersteuning van die bekendstelling toegeken.
tgt: Funding to the tune of R740 million has been allocated in support of the rollout.

src: INDABA 2016, wat van 7 tot 9 Me 2016 by die Inkosi Albert Luthuli-konvensiesentrum in Durban gehou word, is 'n Pan-Afrika-platform vir die bevordering van ons toerismeprodukte aan internasionale kopers.
tgt: INDABA 2016 at the Inkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre in Durban from 7 to 9 May 2016, is a Pan-African platform that will promote our tourism products to international buyers.

src: Toerisme, as een van die die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan se ses pilare van ekonomiese groei, het in 2014 altesaam R357 miljard tot ons BBP bygedra en ondersteun nege persent van die algehele indiensneming in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Tourism, as one of the six pillars of economic growth of the National Development Plan, contributed R357 billion to our GDP in 2014 and supported 9 per cent of total employment in South Africa.

src: Die Wêreldraad vir Reis en Toerisme is van mening dat toerisme teen 2025 so veel as R560 miljard tot ons BBP sal bydra en meer as twee miljoen werksgeleenthede sal ondersteun.
tgt: The World Travel and Tourism Council estimates that tourism will contribute R560 billion to our GDP by 2025 and will support over two million jobs.

src: Die bevordering van die impak wat toerisme op die oseaan-ekonomie het, is 'n onmisbare pilaar van die Negepunt-plan, gerugsteun deur die onontginde potensiaal van ons oseane, wat tot ekonomiese groei kan bydra.
tgt: Growing the Tourisms impact in the Oceans Economy is a critical pillar of the Nine-Point Plan, informed by the untapped potential of our oceans, which can contribute to economic growth.

src: Die oseaan- ekonomie en toerisme bied geweldige geleenthede vir ekonomiese groei en werkskepping.
tgt: The oceans economy and tourism provide tremendous opportunities for economic growth and job creation.

src: Ter viering van Werkersdag op 1 Me 2016, benadruk die Kabinet die land se verbintenis tot die beskerming van werkers se regte deur middel van ons progressiewe arbeidswetgewing.
tgt: In commemoration of Workers’ Day on 1 May 2016, Cabinet reiterates the country’s commitment to protect worker rights through our progressive labour legislation.

src: Sedert 1994 het die Regering deur middel van wetgewing soos die Wet op Arbeidsverhoudinge, die Wet op Basiese Diensvoorwaardes, die Wet op Gelyke Indiensneming en Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid, werkers se regte bevorder.
tgt: Since 1994 government has through legislation such as the Labour Relations Act, the Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Employment Equity Act and Occupational Health and Safety advanced workers’ rights.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n ernstige beroep op graad 12-leerders om aansoekvorms te begin aflaai of aanlyn aansoek te doen by hoëronderwysinstellings as deel van die Doen nou Aansoek/Khetha-beroepsleidingsveldtog,Die veldtog wat jaarliks deur die Departement van Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding onderneem word, sal landwyd tot September 2016 duur om leerders te help om ingeligte keuses te maak wanneer hulle by hoëronderwysinstellings aansoek doen.
tgt: Cabinet urges Grade 12 learners to start downloading application forms or apply online to institutions of higher learning as part of the Apply Now/ Khetha Career Guidance Campaign.

src: Leerders word aangemoedig om die Career Development Services Centre te kontak deur middel van ’n SMS of 'n "please call me" op 072 204 5056 of 086 999 0123 of ’n e-pos te stuur na EMAILTOKEN die Facebook-blad by WEBTOKEN te besoek of gebruik te maak van Twitter by WEBTOKEN Die Kabinet se standpunt oor belangrike kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: The Campaign undertaken annually by the Department of Higher Education and Training, will run nationally until September 2016 and assists learners in making informed choices when applying to institutions of higher learning.

src: Die Kabinet moedig belanghebbendes aan om kommentaar te lewer oor die hersiende Konsephandves vir Breëbasis Swart Ekonomiese Bemagtiging vir die Suid-Afrikaanse Myn- en Mineralebedryf, 2016, wat in die Staatskoerant gepubliseer is.
tgt: Cabinet encourages relevant stakeholders to comment on the draft reviewed Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Charter for the South African Mining and Minerals Industry, 2016 which was published in the Government Gazette.

src: Die hersiende konsepmynbouhandves integreer die Regering se transformasiebeleid en -wetgewing verder om die gemak waarmee sake gedoen word te verbeter en om duidelikheid, voorspelbaarheid en sekerheid oor regulering te skep.
tgt: The draft reviewed Mining Charter further integrates government’s transformation policies and legislation to enhance the ease of doing business, create regulatory clarity, predictability and certainty.

src: Dit is ook in lyn met die bepalings van die Wet op Breëbasis Swart Ekonomiese Bemagtiging, 2003 (Wet No.
tgt: It is also aligned to the provisions of the Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Act, 2003 (Act No.

src: 53 van 2003) en die Gedragskode vir Goeie Praktyk (DTI-kodes).
tgt: 53 of 2003) and the Codes of Good Practice (DTI Codes).

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis dat goedkeuring vir die voorgestelde verkryging van SAB Miller deur AB InBev deur die mededingingsowerheid oorweeg word.
tgt: Cabinet notes that approval of the proposed acquisition of SAB Miller by AB InBev is under consideration by the competition authorities.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die Minister van Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling en AB InBev se ooreengekome benadering tot die mededingingsowerheid met betrekking tot verskeie kwessies van openbare belang.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the agreed approach by the Minister of Economic Development and AB InBev to the competition authorities on a range of public interest issues.

src: Die maatskappy se verbintenis dien as 'n gids vir ander maatskappye oor kwessies van openbare belang rakende samesmeltings en verkrygings in soortgelyke omstandighede.
tgt: The commitment by the company serves as a guide, on public interest issues, to other companies in merger and acquisitions in similar circumstances.

src: Dit sluit 'n ooreengekome verbintenis deur die maatskappy in om R1 miljard oor die volgende vyf jaar te bestee om kleinskaalse boerdery en die ontwikkeling van plaaslike verskaffers, nuwe ondernemings, tegnologie vir energie- en waterdoeltreffendheid, en jeugontwikkeling te bevorder.
tgt: This includes an agreed commitment by the company to spend R1 billion over the next five years to promote small-scale farming and local supplier development, new enterprises, energy and water efficiency technologies and youth development.

src: Die verbintenis tot werkgeleenthede, insluitend 'n onderneming om onwillekeurige afdanking van werkers weens die samesmelting te verhoed, en om indiensnemingsvlakke by die maatskappy vir die volgende vyf jaar in stand te hou, is deel van 'n baanbrekersooreenkoms tussen die maatskappy en die Regering om industrialisering, kleinsakeontwikkeling en werkskepping te ondersteun.
tgt: The commitment on jobs including an undertaking to avoid involuntarily retrenchment of workers as a result of the merger and to maintain employment levels at the company for the next five years, are part of a ground-breaking agreement between the company and government to support industrialisation, small business development and job creation.

src: In 'n afsonderlike ontwikkeling neem die Kabinet kennis van die inwerkingtreding van bepalings van die Wysigingswet op Meedinging wat dit 'n kriminele oortreding vir direkteure en bestuur maak om saam te span in die vasstelling van pryse, tenders of markte.
tgt: In a separate development, Cabinet notes the coming into effect of provisions of the Competition Amendment Act that makes it a criminal offence for directors and management to collude in the fixing of prices, tenders or markets.

src: Hierdie bepalings is deel van maatreëls om die stryd teen kartelle wat die ekonomie benadeel en hoë pryse op verbruikers afdwing, te verskerp.
tgt: These provisions are part of the measures to step up the fight against cartels that damage the economy and impose high prices on consumers.

src: Ons doen ’n beroep op besighede in Suid-Afrika om te kompeteer op grond van laer pryse, meer innovasie, verbeterde gehalte van goedere wat aangebied word, en beter diens aan kliënte, eerder as op samespanning.
tgt: We call on businesses in South Africa to compete based on lower prices, more innovation, improved quality of goods offered or superior service to customers rather than on collusion.

src: Die Kabinet het kennis geneem van die hoogs gereguleerdheid van die banksektor in Suid-Afrika – en wêreldwyd – en die behoefte vir Suid-Afrika om aan internasionale standaarde soos Basel III en die anti-geldwasseryregulasies van die Financial Action Task Force (FATF), wat voorheen deur die Kabinet goedgekeur is, en deur onderliggende wetgewing wat deur die Regering ondersteun word, te voldoen.
tgt: Cabinet noted how highly regulated the banking sector is in South Africa - and globally, and the need for South Africa to comply with international standards like Basel III and Anti-money laundering regulations of the Financial Action Task Force (FATF), which have been previously approved by Cabinet, and supported by underlying legislation approved by Government.

src: Die “Twin Peaks”-stelsel sal ook markoptrede in die bankwese en die breër finansiële sektor reguleer.
tgt: The Twin Peaks system will also regulate market conduct in the banking and broader financial sector.".

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die uitkomste van die 2016 Internasionale Monetêre Fonds en die Wêreldbankgroep se Lentebyeenkoms wat onder die tema "Globale uitdagings, globale oplossings" plaasgevind het.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the outcomes from the WEBTOKENternational Monetary Fund and World Bank Groups Spring Meeting which took place under the theme “Global Challenges, Global Solutions”.

src: 'n Drieledige benadering om groei op 'n globale vlak aan te vuur, is voorgestel om lande aan te moedig om al hul beleidsmag te gebruik om groei aan te spoor dit wil sê monetêre, fiskale en strukturele hervormings.
tgt: A three-pronged approach to ignite growth at a global level was proposed, encouraging countries to use all policy levers to spur growth, i. e. monetary, fiscal and structural reforms.

src: Lande met monetêre en fiskale ruimte is aangemoedig om meer te doen om vraag te stimuleer, maar implementering van strukturele hervormings is ook van kritieke belang vir almal.
tgt: Countries with monetary and fiscal space were encouraged to do more to boost demand however, implementation of structural reforms was critical for all.

src: Vir baie lande sluit dit onder meer belegging in infrastruktuur, innovasie en verbetering van regulering in.
tgt: For many this includes investment in infrastructure, innovation and improving the regulatory environment, amongst others.

src: Die Kabinet herinner alle stemgeregtigdes wat nog nie geregistreer het nie, of nie hul besonderhede nagegaan het nie, dat daar nog geleentheid is om dit by hul plaaslike Onafhanklike Verkiesingskommissie (OVK) se kantoor te doen.
tgt: Cabinet reminds all those eligible voters who have not yet registered and verified their details that they can still do so by visiting their local Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) Office.

src: Dit is nodig om seker te maak dat jou naam op die kieserslys is, sodat jy as ’n stemgeretigde in staat sal wees om op 3 August 2016 jou demokratiese reg om te stem uit te oefen.
tgt: This is needed to secure your name on the voters’ roll which will enable eligible voters to exercise their democratic right on 3 August 2016.Cabinet urges eligible voters to ensure that they meet the requirement of providing their address to their local Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) office.

src: Verkiesingsnavrae kan aan die OVK se kontaksentrum gerig word by 0800 11 8000, wat van Maandae tot Vrydae vanaf 7-uur soggens tot 9-uur saans oop is.
tgt: Election queries can be directed to the IEC contact centre on 0800 11 8000, which is open Monday to Friday, from 7am to 9pm.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense oor aan Transnet, die Nasionale Vervolgingsgesag, die SABC en die departemente van Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding Internasionale Betrekkinge en Samewerking en die Departement van Justisie en Grondwetlike Ontwikkeling met hul prestasie om deur die internasionale maatskappy UNIVERSUM aangewys te word as die "Aantreklikste Werkgewers" in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates Transnet, National Prosecuting Authority, SABC and the Departments of Higher Education and Training, International Relations and Cooperation, and Justice and Constitutional Development for being ranked “Most Attractive Employers” in South Africa by employer branding company, UNIVERSUCabinet commends Minister of Science and Technology, Naledi Pandor, who received an Order of Merit from the Federal Republic of Germany for her contribution to the development of science globally.

src: Die Kabinet prys die Minister van Wetenskap en Tegnologie, Naledi Pandor, wat 'n Orde van Verdienste van die Federale Republiek van Duitsland ontvang het vir haar bydrae tot die ontwikkeling van wetenskap wêreldwyd.
tgt: The merit has been awarded to people from around the world for their achievements in political, social or intellectual spheres.

src: Die orde word aan mense van regoor die wêreld toegeken vir prestasies in die politieke, sosiale of intellektuele sfere.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the Environmental Affairs Director-General Nosipho Ngcaba for receiving the 2015/16 Lifetime Achievement Eco-Logic Award from environment publication, The Enviropaedia.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Direkteur-generaal van Omgewingsake, Nosipho Ngcaba, geluk met sy 2015/16 Lifetime Achievement Eco-Logi-toekenning van die omgewingspublikasie, The Enviropaedia.
tgt: Cabinet applauds artist Kemang Wa Lehulere for becoming "Artist of the Year" for 2017 which is supported by Deutsche Bank.

src: Die Kabinet loof kunstenaar Kemang Wa Lehulere vir sy toekenning as "Kunstenaar van die Jaar" vir 2017, wat deur Deutsche Bank ondersteun word.
tgt: Wa Lehulere, who explores the relevance of the artistic gesture in post-Apartheid South Africa, will present his first institutional solo exhibition in Germany at the Deutsche Bank KunstHalle in Berlin next year.

src: Wa Lehulere, wat die toepaslikheid van die artistieke gebaar in post-apartheid Suid-Afrika verken, sal sy eerste institusionele solo-uitstalling volgende jaar in Duitsland by die Deutsche Bank Kunsthalle in Berlyn hou.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the Department of Tourism for winning the Best Public Policy/Support prize in the 2016 African Responsible Tourism Awards.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Departement van Toerisme geluk met sy toekenning as beste Openbare Beleid/Ondersteuning in die 2016 Afrika Verantwoordelike Toerismetoekennings.
tgt: This accolade is awarded to a public sector department, authority or entity that has made a clear commitment and contribution to advancing responsible tourism.

src: Die toekenning gaan na 'n openbare sektor departement, -gesag of -entiteit wat hom duidelik verbind en ’n bydrae lewer tot die bevordering van verantwoordelike toerisme.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates golfer Branden Grace for winning his first PGA Tour at the RBC Heritage in Hilton Head, UCabinet is saddened by the death of Bertie Lubner who made significant contributions to the development of South Africa as a business leader, philanthropist and honorary life chairman of the SA Jewish Board of Deputies.

src: Die Kabinet wens gholfspeler Branden Grace geluk met sy oorwinning in sy eerste PGA-toernooi by die RBC Heritage in Hilton Head, VSDie Kabinet neem met leedwese kennis van die dood van Bertie Lubner, wat as 'n sakeleier, filantroop en ere-lewensvoorsitter van die SA Joodse Raad van Afgevaardigdes, betekenisvolle bydraes tot die ontwikkeling van Suid-Afrika gelewer het.
tgt: Cabinet extends its deepest condolences to the friends and families of the ten victims (Tiisetso Tselo, Sesi Mtshali, Sana Sibeko, Mphikeleli Malindi, Gugulethu Sithole, Vusi Nkabinde, Daphney Linda, Sicelo Kheswa, Sphamandla Gedle and Simphiwe Nhlapo) of a tragic bus crash while they were returning from the ANC Manifesto Rally in Port Elizabeth.

src: Die Kabinet wens ook diegene wat in die ongeluk beseer is 'n spoedige herstel toe.
tgt: Cabinet also wished a speedy recovery to those who were injured.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy meegevoel oor aan die familie en vriende van dr Herman Nditsheni Netshidzivhani, Suid-Afrika se eerste swart vrugbaarheidspesialis.
tgt: Cabinet conveyed its condolences to the family and friends of Dr Herman Nditsheni Netshidzivhani, South Africa’s first black fertility specialist.

src: As stigter van die vrugbaarheidskliniek in die Park Lane-hospitaal in Johannesburg, het Netshidzivhani baie Suid-Afrikaners gehelp om hul eie gesinne te begin.
tgt: As a founder of the fertility clinic in the Park Lane Hospital in Johannesburg, Netshidzivhani helped many South Africans start their own families.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy meegevoel oor aan die familie en vriende van Dene Smuts, voormalige Demokratiese Alliansie Parlementslid.
tgt: Cabinet conveyed condolences to the family and friends of Dene Smuts, former Democratic Alliance Member of Parliament.

src: Die Kabinet huldig haar vir die waardevolle bydrae wat sy tot die ontwikkeling van ons konstitusionele demokrasie gelewer het.
tgt: Cabinet salutes her sterling contribution to the development of our constitutional democracy.

src: Die Kabinet wens saam met President Jacob Zuma vir Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela ’n spoedige herstel toe en doen ’n beroep op die publiek om die familie se privaatheid in hierdie tyd te respekteer.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Jacob Zuma in wishing Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela a speedy recovery and urges that the privacy of the family be respected during this time.

src: Winnie Mandela word hoog geag vir haar rol in ons vryheidstryd, wat bygedra het tot die beëindiging van onderdrukkende staatsbeleid en die vestiging van demokrasie in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Winnie Mandela is widely respected for her role in our struggle for freedom which contributed to ending oppressive policies and bringing democracy to South Africa.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die betrokke uitklaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Paul Steenkamp tot die Nasionale Advesraad vir Innovasie.
tgt: Paul Steenkamp to the National Advisory Council on Innovation.

src: Clarinda Elizabeth Simpson as Hoof Finansiële Beampte van SENTECLumko Caesario Mtimde as Hoof Uitvoerende Beampte van die Universele Dienste- en Toegangsagentskap van Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Clarinda Elizabeth Simpson as the Chief Financial Officer of SENTECLumko Caesario Mtimde as the Chief Executive Officer of the Universal Services and Access Agency of South Africa.

src: Heraanstelling van Adv Rory Wayne Voller as Adjunk-kommissaris van die Kommissie vir Maatskappye en Intellektuele Eiendom.
tgt: Rory Wayne Voller as the Deputy Commissioner of the Companies and Intellectual Property Commission.

src: Verlenging van die kontrak vir Lungisa Fuzile as Direkteur-generaal van die Nasionale Tesourie.
tgt: Extension of the contract for Lungisa Fuzile as the Director General of the National Treasury.

src: Verlenging van die kontrak vir Nosipho Ngcaba as Direkteur-generaal van die Departement van Omgewingsake.
tgt: Extension of the contract for Nosipho Ngcaba as the Director General of the Department of Environmental Affairs.

src: N Mafu as Adjunk-direkteur-generaal: Bemagtiging en Belanghebbendes in die Departement van Militêre Veterane.
tgt: N Mafu as the Deputy Director-General: Empowerment and Stakeholder Management in the Department of Military Veterans.

src: TLM Makotoko as Hoof Operasionele Beampte vir die Departement van Omgewingsake.
tgt: TLM Makotoko as the Chief Operations Officer for the Department of Environmental Affairs.

src: Implementering van belangrike regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of Key Government Programmes.

src: Die Kabinet het kennis geneem van die Minister van Finansies se vorderingsverlsag aan die President oor die vordering van die Regering se raadpleging met die private sektor en arbeid oor die ekonomie.
tgt: Cabinet took note of the report-back by the Minister of Finance to the President, on the progress of Government’s consultations with the private sector and labour on the economy.

src: Die President het die Minister opdrag gegee om gesprekvoering met hierdie maatskaplike vennote te lei ten einde ’n strategie met maatreëls op te stel om die ekonomie te laat groei en die land se kredietgradering te behou.
tgt: The President mandated the Minister to lead engagements with these social partners to map out a strategy and come up with measures for growing the economy and preserving the country’s credit rating.

src: Die Kabinet is tevrede dat hierdie werk tot konkrete inisiatiewe gelei het wat die land se ekonomiese vooruitsigte sal verbeter.
tgt: Cabinet is pleased that this work has culminated in concrete initiatives that will improve the country’s economic prospects.

src: Die President het Maandag verskeie prioriteitsinisiatiewe aangekondig wat die volgende insluit: (1) 'n gesamentlike private- en openbaresektorfonds vir kleinsake-ondersteuning, (2) die hantering van beperkings op die verhoging van belegging om inklusiewe groei te versnel, (3) mede-beleggings in infrastruktuur deur die Regering en die private sektor gerugsteun deur die ervaring van die suksesvolle Program vir Onafhanklike Kragprodusente en (4) die versterking van ondernemings in staatsbesit om hul finansiële volhoubaarheid te verseker en hul rol in die bestuur van ontwikkeling te verstewig.
tgt: The President announced several priority initiatives on Monday, which include: (1) a joint private and public sector fund for Small Business Support, (2) addressing constraints to increasing investment in order to accelerate inclusive growth, (3) government and private sector co-investment in infrastructure drawing on experience of the successful Independent Power Producer Programme and (4) strengthening State Owned Enterprises to ensure their financial sustainability and reinforcing their role in driving development.

src: Hierdie aankondigings is ’n bewys van wat die land kan bereik wanneer alle sosiale vennote bymekaarkom om dieselfde doel te bereik.2 Die Kabinet is steeds vol vertroue dat die Regering se aggressiewe fiskale konsolidasie die historiese R1 triljoen-invordering deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Inkomstediens (SAID), asook die vyf korttermyningrypings wat onlangs aangekondig is, die Negepunt-plan komplementeer om 'n ommekeer in ons ekonomiese lotgevalle te verseker.
tgt: These announcements are testament to what this country can achieve when all social partners come together to work towards the same goal.

src: SAID se verhoogde inkomste-invordering sal die Regering verder in staat stel om dienste te lewer wat die lewensgehalte van alle burgers sal verbeter.3 Die Kabinet verwelkom die aankondiging van die graderingsagentskap, Moody's Investor Services, wat die afgelope week bevestig het dat die land se kredietgradering op twee kerwe bokant sub-beleggingsgraad staan.
tgt: Cabinet remains confident that government’s aggressive fiscal consolidation, the historic R1 trillion collection by the South African Revenue Service and the recently announced five short-term interventions, all complement the Nine Point plan so as to ensure a turn-around in our economic fortunes.

src: Toe Moody's die gradering bevestig het, het hulle opgemerk dat Suid-Afrika besig om 'n keerpunt ná jare van swak groei te bereik en dat die aggressiewe konsolidasiemaatreëls in die 2016-begroting die Regering se skuld tot BBP in die huidige jaar WEBTOKEN die partye het ooreengekom dat gesamentlike pogings versterk moet word om stukrag te aan ekonomiese herstel te gee.
tgt: The increased revenue collection by SARS will further enable Government to deliver services that will improve the quality of lives of all its citizens.

src: Ons het ook kennis geneem dat die Minister van Finansies se werk met maatskaplike vennote 'n kredietgraderingswerkstroom insluit wat potensiële hervormings en ingrypings sal identifiseer om Suid-Afrika se sterk kapitaalmarkte en beleggingsgraad-kredietgradering te behou.4 Die President het waardering vir die onderskeie Ministers se begrotingsposte wat aaandag gee aan die behoeftes van alle Suid-Afrikaners.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the announcement by ratings agency, Moody’s Investor Services, which over the past week reaffirmed the country’s credit rating at two notches above sub-investment grade.

src: Die begrotingposte demonstreer verder dat die Regering en die arbeid- en sakesektore meer as ooit saamwerk om maniere te vind om groei opnuut aan te vuur en 'n beter lewe vir almal te skep.
tgt: The progress reports and plans emanating from the Departmental Budget Votes demonstrates that South Africa is a nation at work, with government leading the way, in building a better life for all.

src: Dit sluit in kragtige implementering van die Negepunt-plan, wat President Jacob Zuma in sy 2015-Staatsrede aangekondig het, asook Operasie Phakisa, wat ontwerp is om implementering van oplossings vir kritieke ontwikkelingsgebiede te versnel.
tgt: Concrete measures have been put in place to reduce the negative impact of the global economic downturn on our economy, and to prepare for robust growth when the economic cycle turns positive.

src: Hierdie programme gee aandag aan kritieke kwessies van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan, soos die vermindering van armoede en werkloosheid.5 Die Kabinet stel Suid-Afrikaners gerus dat dringende aandag gegee word aan die kwessie van werkloosheid in die land deur die implementering van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP) se ekonomiese ingrypings soos uiteengesit in die Negepunt-plan, wat daarop gemik is om groei aan te vuur en werk te skep in die belangrikste ekonomiese sektore.
tgt: This includes vigorous implementation of the Nine Point Plan, announced by President Jacob Zuma in his 2015 State of the Nation Address as well as Operation Phakisa, designed to fast track implementation of solutions to critical development areas.

src: Die Regering gebruik alle beskikbare inisiatiewe, insluitend sy Nywerheidsbeleid-aksieplan (IPAP) om meer arbeidabsorberende produksie- en dienstesektore te skep om werkloosheid, wat ook beïnvloed word deur die moeilike internasionale en plaaslike ekonomiese toestande, te pak.
tgt: Cabinet reassures South Africans that the country’s unemployment situation is being addressed through the implementation of the country’s National Development Plan (NDP) through the Nine Point Plan economic intervention which seeks to ignite growth and boost jobs in key sectors of our economy.

src: Die Regering beklemtoon die belangrikheid van die ontwikkeling van noue samewerking met die nuutste plaaslike industriële maatskappye, wat nie net betrokke is by die ontwikkeling van infrastruktuur, vervoer en logistiek nie, maar oor 'n wye verskeidenheid van sektore in die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie as 'n geheel, wat tegnologies gevorderd, uitvoergereed en arbeidsintensief is.
tgt: Government is using all available initiatives including its Industrial Policy Action Plan (IPAP) to create more labour absorbing production and services sectors to address unemployment which has been further impacted by the difficult global and local economic conditions.

src: Terwyl die Kwartaalikse Arbeidsmagopname vir die eerste kwartaal van 2016 'n toename in werkloosheid tot 26,7 persent op 'n kwartaal-tot-kwartaalbasis toon, is die 2016-indiensnemingsvlakke hoër met 204 000 mense in diens in vergelyking met die eerste kwartaal van 20.6 Die Kabinet verwelkom die oorhandiging deur President Jacob Zuma van die nuwe Jeugsentrum in Beaufort-Wes in die Wes-Kaap, wat ‘n geleentheid aan die jeug bied om hulself te bemagtig.
tgt: Minister of Trade and Industry, Rob Davies launched the eighth annual iteration of the IPAP 2016/17 to 2018-19 on 9 May 2016 at a 100% black-owned casting and machining foundry in Gauteng.

src: Die sentrum het ‘n verskeidenheid fasiliteite wat geleenthede bied vir die holistiese ontwikkeling van jong mense asook vir die wyer gemeenskap.
tgt: Government emphasizes the importance of developing close cooperation with cutting-edge local industrial companies involved not just in infrastructure development, transport and logistics, but across a wide range of technologically sophisticated, export ready and labour intensive sectors of the South African economy as a totality.

src: Die fasiliteite in hierdie jeugsentrum sal geleenthede aan jong mense uit arm gemeenskappe bied wat hulle sal bemagtig om beter te kan deelneem aan en ’n positiewe bydrae te lewer tot hul gemeenskappe en die land.
tgt: While the Quarterly Labour Force Survey for the first quarter of 2016 recorded an increase in unemployment to per cent on a quarter on quarter basis, 2016 employment levels are higher by 204 000 employed people when compared with the first quarter of 2015.

src: Die ten volle toegeruste vaardigheidsentrum wat deur die Suid-Kaapkollege bedryf word, sal opleiding in sake-administrasie, rekenaarvaardigheid vir eindgebruikers, en vroeë kinderontwikkeling aan 200 jeugdiges van die Nasionale Landelike Jeugdienskorps (NARYSEC) per jaar, bied.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the handover of the Beaufort West Youth Hub, in Western Cape by President Jacob Zuma, which provides a facility to the youth, where they can empower themselves.

src: Ooreenkomstig die Regering se verbintenis tot samewerking en goeie staatsbestuur, het hierdie beraad deelnemers uit verskeie burgerlike-samelewingorganisasies van regoor die wêreld gelok, wat in gemeenskappe oor verskillende sektore buite die tradisionele burgelike-samelewingorganisasies gevestig is, en wat altyd deel van die vennootskap was.8 Die Kabinet neem kennis van die goedkeuring vir samesmelting van drie botteleringsaanlegte om die vasteland se grootste botteleringsaanleg, Coca-Cola Beverages Africa te vorm.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the recently held 2016 Open Government Partnership (OGP) Africa Regional Meeting which was hosted by South Africa under the theme "Open Government for Sustainable Development in Africa" from 5 to 6 May 2016.This gathering comes seven months after South Africa became the Lead Chairperson of the Open Government Partnership.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die ooreenkoms, wat op openbare-belangevoorwaardes gegrond is, vir die samesmelting tussen die Regering en die partye van die Coca-Cola Beverages Africa-samesmelting dit steun ons pogings vir groter industrialisering in die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie.
tgt: Open government principles are crucial for achieving a much broader range of sustainable development goals, linking openness to governance for the improvement of the vulnerable and poor around the world.

src: Die ooreenkoms beveilig gesamentlik indiensnemingsvlakke in die maatskappy vir 'n tydperk van drie jaar beskerm werkers in die bedingingseenheid van afleggings wat met die samesmelting verband hou ondersteun lokalisering van die voorsieningsketting en is daartoe verbind om voorheen benadeelde boere en verskaffers aan die maatskappy, te ontwikkel.
tgt: The Open Government Partnership and Open Government is also a key enabler that will assist the global community to achieve the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.

src: Hierbenewens is R400 miljoen verbind tot finansiering van ondernemingsontwikkeling in die landbou-waardeketting, asook ’n bykomende R400 miljoen inkrementele belegging om stroomafverspreiding en kleinhandelvermoëns te ontwikkel met gepaardgaande vaardigheidsontwikkelling en -opleiding.
tgt: This Regional Summit was the biggest Open Government Partnership (OGP) Regional summit ever organised by the OGP with very substantive outcomes coming out of each session throughout the WEBTOKEN keeping with governments commitment to partnership and good governance, this summit attracted participants from various Civil Society Organisations (CSO) from around the world that are rooted in communities across different sectors outside the traditional CSO’s that have always been part of the partnership.8 Cabinet notes the approval of the merger of three bottling plants to form the continent's largest bottling plant, Coca-Cola Beverages Africa.

src: Die ikoniese Appletiser-merk sal steeds in Suid-Afrika vervaardig word.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the agreement on public interest conditions for the merger between government and the Coca-Cola Beverages Africa merger parties that can support our efforts for greater industrialisation in the South African economy.

src: Die ooreenkoms maak yskasruimte in verkoelers wat deur Coca-Cola besit of verskaf word, beskikbaar aan kleiner kleinhandelaars: tien persent yskasruimte sal beskikbaar wees vir mededingerprodukte van kleiner produsente in kleinhandelondernemings waar slegs verkoelers wat deur Coca-Cola voorsien is, beskikbaar is.
tgt: The agreement safeguards aggregate employment levels in the company for a period of three years, protects workers in the bargaining unit from merger-related retrenchments, supports localisation of the supply chain and commits to develop historically disadvantaged farmers and suppliers to the company.

src: Dit maak die mark oop vir nuwe toetreders en klein botteleerders, wat help om beperkende sakepraktyke wat klein- en mediumgrootte ondernemings uit markte hou, te verhoed.
tgt: Furthermore, R400 million has been committed to fund enterprise development in the agricultural value chain and another R400 million incremental investment to develop downstream distribution and retail capabilities with associated skills development and training.

src: Hierbenewens sal die maatskappy se langtermynbelegging in die land se ekonomiese en maatskaplike ontwikkeling verstewig word deur die vestiging van die saamgesmelte entiteite se hoofkantoor in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: The iconic Appletiser brand will continue to be produced in South Africa.

src: Die ooreenkoms volg op 'n onlangse soortgelyke ooreenkoms met Annhauser Beush InBev wat verband hou met die aankoop van SAB Miller.
tgt: The agreement opens fridge space in coolers owned or supplied by Coca-Cola to smaller retailers: ten percent of fridge space will be available to rival products from smaller producers in retail establishments where only Coca-Cola supplied coolers are available.

src: Die klem wat hierdie ooreenkomste op diens, lokalisering en kleinsake-ontwikkeling plaas, dui op die belangrikheid om korporatiewe samesmeltings met openbarebelange-kwessies te balanseer en stel 'n standaard vir maatskappye wat soortgelyke samesmeltings of verkrygings oorweeg.9 Die Kabinet neem kennis van die bekendstelling van die Mpact Polymers R350 miljoen bottel-tot-bottel-aanleg in vennootskap met Coca-Cola.
tgt: This opens the market to new entrants and small bottlers, helping to avoid restrictive business practices that keep small and medium-sized businesses out of WEBTOKEN addition, the company's long term investment in the country's economic and socialdevelopment will be enhanced through the establishment of the merged entity's headquarters in South Africa.

src: Die Nywerheids-ontwikkelingskorporasie (NOK) het 'n R210 miljoen-leningsfasiliteit asook R30 miljoen vir sy 21% aandelebelang, en die Departement van Handel en Nywerheid het 'n belastingaansporing ingevolge artikel 12 (I) toegestaan.
tgt: Cabinet noted the launch of the Mpact Polymers R350 million bottle-to-bottle plant in partnership with Coca-Cola.

src: Die herwinningsaanleg verskaf werk aan 80 mense, asook 1 000 werkgeleenthede vir afvalinsamelaars.
tgt: This initiative is in response to the Government's legal framework working through the Environmental Affairs' National Waste Management Strategy goal to promote recycling enterprises.

src: Vennootskappe soos hierdie is 'n belangrike dryfkrag vir ekonomiese groei deur die skep van duisende werksgeleenthede in die herwinningsekonomie wat sowat R50 miljard werd is.
tgt: The plant is a first of its kind on the African continent diverting 29 000 tonnes (polyethylene terephthalate) PET waste bottles with an estimated saving of 186 000 cubic metres of landfill space and will contribute to reduction of Carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions of approximately 53 000 tonnes per annum.

src: Plastiekherwinning alleen bied tans inkomstegeleenthede vir meer as 60 000 afvalinsamelaars.
tgt: The Industrial Development Corporation (IDC) provided a R210 million loan facility as well as R30m for its 21% equity stake and the Department of Trade and Industry granted a section 12(I) tax incentive.

src: Dit het daartoe gelei dat die Sekuriteitsgroepering 'n multi-dissiplinêre, multi-sektorale ingryping in werking gestel het om renosters in Suid-Afrika te beskerm.11 Die Kabinet wens die land geluk met die aanbieding van 'n suksesvolle 2016 Toerisme-indaba in Durban, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Mpact Polymers, state of the art recycling plant complies with EU food safety specifications and is the first such factory in Africa which also meets Coca-Cola’s full certification protocol for PET bottles.10 Cabinet welcomes the report-back on the Integrated Strategic Management of Rhinoceros which has shown that South Africa has turned the tide on rhino poaching.

src: Die indaba wat op Maandag 9 Me 2016 geëindig het, het tot talle suksesvolle wisselwerkings tussen 1 047 uitstallers uit 18 Afrika-lande en 1 856 kopers van regoor die wêreld gelei.
tgt: The Integrated Strategic Management Approach was adopted by Cabinet in August 2014 which saw the Security Cluster implementing a multi-disciplinary, multi-sectoral intervention to protect rhino in South Africa.11 Cabinet congratulates the country for hosting a successful 2016 Tourism Indaba in Durban Kwazulu-Natal, which concluded on Monday, 9 May 2016 with numerous successful interactions between 1 047 exhibitors from 18 African countries and 1 856 buyers from across the globe.

src: Vanjaar was die Indaba gasheer vir 3 000 meer vergaderings as verlede jaar.
tgt: This year, INDABA hosted 3000 more meetings than last year.

src: Altesaam 14 000 sakevergaderings het oor die drie dae van die Indaba plaasgevind, wat 'n beduidende ekonomiese voordeelpotensiaal bied.
tgt: In total 14 000 business meetings took place over the three days of INDABA, presenting a significant economic benefit potential.

src: Die geleentheid is ook deur 575 nasionale en internasionale joernaliste bygewoon.
tgt: The event was also attended by 575 national and international journalists.

src: Die Indaba het op die bedryf se klein-, medium- en mikro-ondernemings (KMMO's) gefokus met die klem op produkte en dienste van belowende klein reisondernemings.
tgt: The INDABA focussed on the industry's small, medium and micro enterprises (SMMEs) showcasing products and services from promising small travel businesses.

src: 70 ondernemings het voordeel getrek uit werksessies oor hoe om toegang tot die mark te verkry en te groei.
tgt: 70 enterprises gave workshops on how to access the market - and grow.

src: KMMO's het die potensiaal om groot ondrnemings geword.
tgt: SMMES have the potential to become big business.

src: Die Indaba het die rol wat KMMO’s in die ekonomiese ontwikkeling van beide ontwikkelde en ontwikkelende lande, in die groei van die toerismesektor speel, versterk.
tgt: The INDABA has bolstered the role SMMEs play in the economic development of both developed and developing countries, in growing the tourism sector.

src: Ontsluiting van KMMO's se potensiaal is een van die kritieke aandrywers van werksgeleenhede in die Negepunt-plan, wat die ekonomie sal laat groei en transformeer en werkgeleenthede sal skep.
tgt: Unlocking the potential of SMMEs is one of the critical job drivers in the Nine-Point Plan that will grow and transform the economy and create jobs.

src: Belangrike Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet het die implementering van die Waarheid- en Versoeningskommissie (WVK) se aanbevelings en voorgestelde opsies vir die implementering van die rehabilitasieprojekte vir gemeenskappe, bespreek.
tgt: Cabinet discussed the implementation on the Truth and Reconciliation Commission’s (TRC) recommendations and proposed options for the implementation of the Community Rehabilitation Projects.

src: Realisering van gemeenskapsrehabilitasieprojekte sal die ongeregtighede van die verlede herstel deur middel van die rehabilitasie van 128 gemeenskappe wat aan geweld en vernietiging onderwerp was tydens die konfliktydperk (1 Maart 1960 tot 10 Me 1994).Die Departement van Justisie en Grondwetlike Ontwikkeling sal bydraes van toepaslike rolspelers (openbaar en privaat) vra om voldoende hulpbronne te verseker wat holistiese tussenkomste in die 128 gemeenskappe, wat deur die WVK geïdentifiseer is, teweeg sal bring op 'n saak-tot-saakbasis wat kan verskil in waarde, maar met 'n maksimumwaarde van R30 miljoen.
tgt: Realisation of Community Rehabilitation Projects redress the injustices of the past through the rehabilitation of 128 communities that were subjected to acts of violence and destruction during the conflict period (1 March 1960-10 May 1994).The Department of Justice and Constitutional Development will solicit contributions from relevant stakeholders (public and private) in order to secure adequate resources to bring about holistic interventions in these 128 communities, identified by the TRC on a case by case basis that might differ in value but to a maximum value of R30 million.

src: Dit sal verseker dat die projekte haalbaar en volhoubaar is om gemeenskappe se strewes te verwesenlik.
tgt: This will ensure that Projects are feasible and sustainable in order to realise community aspirations.

src: Dit dra by tot die verwesenliking van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan deur die verbreding van maatskaplike samehorigheid en eenheid, die herstel van die ongelykhede van die verlede en die verwesenliking van 'n bekwame, etiese ontwikkelingstaat wat sy burgers met waardigheid behandel.2 Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die uitkomste van die Wêreld Konferensie oor Radiokommunikasie (WRK-15) wat van 2 tot 27 November 2015 in Genève, Switserland gehou is.
tgt: This contributes to the realisation of the National Development Plan through broadening social cohesion and unity, redressing the inequalities of the past and the realisation of a developmental, capable and ethical state that treats citizens with dignity.2 Cabinet was briefed on the outcomes of the World Radiocommunications Conference (WRC-15) which was held from 2 to 27 November 2015 in Geneva, Switzerland.

src: Suid-Afrika het die Afrika-groeponderhandelinge gelei, wat daartoe gelei het dat die streek bykomende spektrum vir mobiele breëband verseker en Afrika het daarin geslaag om die laer UHF-spektrum vir digitale terrestriële televisie te beskerm.
tgt: South Africa led the Africa Group negotiations that led to the region securing additional spectrum for mobile broadband and Africa managed to protect the lower UHF spectrum for digital terrestrial television.

src: Mer spektrumtoekennings is vir maritieme, lugvaart- en ruimtedienste bewillig.
tgt: More spectrum allocations were made for maritime, aeronautical and space services.

src: Die Nasionale Radiofrekwensieplan (NRFP) sal bygewerk word om die besluite van die WRC-15, wat op 1 Januarie 2017 in werking tree, te weerspieël.
tgt: The National Radio Frequency Plan (NRFP) will be updated to reflect the decisions of the WRC-15, which come into force 01 January 2017.

src: Die toekenning van spektrum binne die NRFP sal opdragplanne fasiliteer vir die verskillende dienste wat noodsaaklik is om ekonomiese, kulturele en maatskaplike voordeel te trek deur die gebruik van die spektrum as 'n natuurlike hulpbron.
tgt: The allocation of spectrum within the NRFP will facilitate assignment plans for the different services which are critical to achieving economic, cultural and social benefits through the use of spectrum as a natural resource.

src: Ter ondersteuning van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan se doelwitte, sal die spektrum gebruik word vir die implementering van die nasionale breëband, asook vir digitale terrestriële televisie, satellietkommunikasie en openbare beskerming en rampverligting, sowel as ander dienste.3 Die Kabinet is ingelig oor Besluite wat deur die Afrika-unie (AU) se Beraad vir Staatshoofde en die Regering in Junie 2015 in Johannesburg geneem is om die vasgestelde jaarlikse bydraes deur die lidlande in 2016 te hersien ten einde sy vermoë om sy programme uit te voer te verbeter.
tgt: In supporting the National Development Plan goals, the spectrum will be used for national broadband rollout, digital terrestrial television, satellite communication and public protection and disaster relief, as well as other services.3 Cabinet was briefed on the Decisions taken by the Assembly of the African Union (AU) Heads of State and Government in Johannesburg in June 2015 to revise the assessed annual contributions by Member States from 2016, in order to enhance its ability to carry out its programmes.

src: Die Kabinet het die implementering van Suid-Afrika se nuwe vasgestelde bydrae tot die AU goedgekeur ooreenkomstig die vergadering se besluit oor 'n nuwe assesseringskaal.
tgt: Cabinet approved implementation of South Africa’s new assessed contribution to the AU in line with the Assembly Decision of a new Scale of Assessment.

src: Dit is gegrond op die beginsels van solidariteit, regverdige betaling en vermoë om te betaal, op 'n wyse wat verseker dat geen enkele land 'n buitensporige deel van die begroting dra nie.
tgt: This is based on the principle of solidarity, equitable payment as well as capacity to pay, in a manner that ensures that no single country bears a disproportionate share of the budget.

src: Komende gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: President Jacob Zuma sal op 19 Me 2016 'n staatsbesoek aan Doha, Katar onderneem om politieke en ekonomiese betrekkinge tussen die twee lande te versterk.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will conduct a State Visit to Doha, Qatar on 19 May 2016 to strengthen political and economic relations between the two countries.

src: Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa, as President Jacob Zuma se spesiale gesant na Suid-Soedan, sal Juba op 16 Me 2016 besoek.
tgt: Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa, as the Special Envoy of President Jacob Zuma to South Sudan, will visit Juba on 16 May 2016.

src: Dit is ’n belangrike datum vir die Suid-Soedanese aangesien hulle die dag van bevryding van die Sudan People's Liberation Army vier.
tgt: This day is significant to the South Sudanese as they mark the Sudan People's Liberation Army Day.

src: Die Adjunkpresident sal tydens sy besoek die implementering van die vredesooreenkoms monitor.
tgt: During his visit the Deputy President will monitor implementation of the peace agreement.

src: Suid-Soedan het aan die einde van April 2016 'n mylpaal bereik met die inhuldiging van die oorgangsregering van nasionale eenheid.
tgt: South Sudan reached a milestone at the end of April 2016 with the swearing in of the transitional government of national unity.

src: President Jacob Zuma sal die nasionale en Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap (SAOG) van die Universiteit van Fort Hare se eeufeesviering op 20 Me 2016 lei.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will lead the national and Southern African Development Community (SADC) celebration of the University of Fort Hare Centenary on 20 May 2016.

src: Die Universiteit se bydrae tot die opleiding van roemryke alumni in die land en in Suider-Afrika gee ’n hupstoot aan die Afrika-maandvieringe.
tgt: The university’s contribution to producing illustrious alumni in the country and Southern Africa bolsters Africa Month celebrations.

src: Die Kabinet moedig mense aan om deel te neem aan die Afrika-maand multidissiplinêre program, wat verskillende generasies en genres betrek onder die tema "Die Bou van 'n Beter Afrika en 'n Beter Wêreld".
tgt: Cabinet encourages people to participate in the Africa Month multi-disciplinary programme that involves different generations and genres under the theme “Building a Better Africa and a Better World”.

src: Alle aktiwiteite beklemtoon die sentrale rol van plaaslike gemeenskappe en bestaan uit verskeie dissiplines, insluitend musiek, poësie, dans, film, kookkuns, mode, handwerk en ontwerp, intellektuele verbintenisse en 'n paar gesamentlike werke deur Suid-Afrikaanse kunstenaars en hul eweknieë op die vasteland assok die diaspora.
tgt: All activities emphasise the centrality of local communities and comprise various disciplines including: music, poetry, dance, film, cuisine, fashion, craft and design, intellectual engagements and some collaborative work from South African artists and their counterparts in the continent and the Diaspora.

src: Die Internasionale Dag vir Gesinne word op 15 Me 2016 gevier onder die internasionale tema "Gesinne, Gesonde Lewens en Volhoubare Toekoms", wat verband hou met die 2030 Agenda vir Volhoubare Ontwikkeling (in 2015 aangeneem).
tgt: The International Day for Families will be celebrated on 15 May 2016 under the international theme “Families, healthy lives and Sustainable Future” which relates to the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development (adopted in 2015).

src: Die Internasionale Dag vir Gesinne is deur die Algemene Vergadering van die Verenigde Nasies geproklameer en fokus op gesinne: kinders en jeugdigdes se gesondheid en welstand balans tussen werk en gesin gesondheidsuitkomste en 'n beter lewensgehalte vir ouer persone.
tgt: The International Day for Families was proclaimed by the United Nations General Assembly and focuses on Families: children’s and youth’s health and well-being work-family balance and health outcomes and better quality of life for older persons.

src: Die Departement van Water en Sanitasie sal Sanitasie- en Higiëneweek van 16 to 20 Me 2016 lei onder die tema: "Dit gaan nie oor spoel nie".
tgt: From 16 to 20 May 2016 the Department of Water and Sanitation will lead Sanitation and Hygiene Week under the theme: “It’s not about flushing”.

src: Die veldtog sal bewustheid oor die belangrikheid van sanitasie verhoog en sanitasie beste praktyke bevorder.
tgt: The campaign will raise awareness on the importance of sanitation and promote sanitation best practices.

src: 'n Belangrike program is die uitroei van die emmertoiletstelsel vordering sluit in die algehele uitwissing van emmertoilette in formele nedersettings in KwaZulu-Natal, Noordwes, Mpumalanga en Gauteng.
tgt: A key programme is the Bucket Eradication Programme progress includes total eradication of bucket toilets in formal settlements in KwaZulu-Natal, North West, Mpumalanga and Gauteng.

src: Die Wes-Kaap het 99,8 persent voltooiing bereik.
tgt: The Western Cape reached per cent completion.

src: Vordering in ander provinsies sluit die uitwissing van 20 560 emmertoilette in: Vrystaat (4 056) Oos-Kaap (2 672) Noord-Kaap (2 421) en Noordwes (398).Die Minister van Water en Sanitasie, Nomvula Mokonyane, sal van 15 to 20 Me 2016 aan die 84ste Internasionale Komitee vir Groot Damme (ICOLD) by the Sandton-konvensiesentrum deelneem.
tgt: Progress in other provinces includes the eradication of 20 560 bucket toilets: Free State (4 056), Eastern Cape (2 672) Northern Cape (2 421) and North West (398).Water and Sanitation Minister, Nomvula Mokonyane will participate in the 84th International Committee on Large Dams (ICOLD) at the Sandton Convention Centre from 15 to 20 May 2016.

src: Dié platform sal geleentheid bied om kennis uit te ruil oor die ontwerp, konstruksie, onderhoud en impak van groot damme.
tgt: The platform will share knowledge of the design, construction, maintenance and impact of large dams.

src: Dit sal ook besigtigingstoere van groot damme in Suider-Afrika insluit en sal ’n bydrae lewer tot ons pogings om water te bewaar.
tgt: It will also include tours of large dams in Southern Africa and will contribute to our water conservation efforts.

src: As deel van die Geïntegreerde Nasionale Strategie vir Geletterdheid en Syferkundigheid, sal die Departement van Basiese Onderwys gasheer wees vir die 2016 Spelling Bee om leerders se prestasie in tale te verbeter.
tgt: As part of the Integrated National Literacy and Numeracy Strategy, the Department of Basic Education is hosting the 2016 Spelling Bee to improve learners’ performance in languages.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle skole, onderwysers en ouers om laerskoolleerders aan te moedig om vir die 2016 Spelling Bee in te skryf voordat inskrywings op 31 Me sluit.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all schools, teachers and parents to encourage primary school learners to enter the 2016 Spelling Bee before entries close on 31 May 2016.

src: Vir meer inligting besoek WEBTOKEDie Kabinet se standpunt oor belangrike kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: For more information visit WEBTOKECabinet’s position on key issues in the environment.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel die blatante rassisme wat deur sommige individue in ons land getoon word, veral op sosiale netwerke, ten sterkste.
tgt: Cabinet strongly condemns the blatant racism that was displayed by some individuals in our country, particularly on social network platforms.

src: Sulke gedrag is teenstrydig met die etos van ons Grondwet, verskanste verantwoordelikhede en waardes, en skend die regte van ons mense.
tgt: Such behaviour goes against the ethos of our Constitution, enshrined responsibilities and values, and violates the rights of our people.

src: Dit het geen plek in ons demokratiese samelewing nie.
tgt: This has no place in our democratic society.

src: Die Kabinet betreur in die besonder die rassistiese opmerkings wat toegeskryf word aan 'n senior lid van die regbank, ‘n Regter van die Hooggeregshof, Mabel Jansen.
tgt: In particular Cabinet lamented the racist comments attributed to a senior member of the Judiciary, the High Court Judge Mabel Jansen.

src: Die uitsprake, veral deur 'n gewaardeerde lid van die regbank, is nie in ooreenstemming met wat ons samelewing van lede van die regbank verwag nie.
tgt: The pronouncements especially by an esteemed member of the judiciary are not in keeping with what our society expects from members of the judiciary.

src: Die regbank moet altyd onpartydig en bo verdenking optree.
tgt: The Judiciary should always act impartially and in a manner that is beyond reproach.

src: Verdraagsaamheid en respek was 'n hoeksteen van ons vryheidstryd en bly 'n noodsaaklike deel van Suid-Afrika se demokratiese grondslag.
tgt: Tolerance and respect has been a cornerstone of our struggle for freedom and remains an essential part of South Africa’s democratic foundation.
