src: Laat ons weer saamstaan teen die verdeeldheid van rassisme in ons samelewing.
tgt: Let us unite again to jointly defeat the divisiveness of racism in our society.

src: Die Departement van Justisie en Grondwetlike Ontwikkeling beplan om sulke kwessies te hanteer deur die bekendstelling van wetgewing wat rassisme en in besonder haatspraak, pak.
tgt: The Department of Justice and Constitutional Development plans to deal with such matters through the introduction of legislation to address racism and in particular hate speech.

src: Die Kabinet doen voorts ‘n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om mekaar te respekteer ooreenkomstig ons Handves van Meseregte.
tgt: Cabinet further calls for all South Africans to respect each other as envisaged in our Bill of Rights.

src: Die Kabinet beklemtoon President Jacob Zuma se veroordeling van die vernietiging van 24 skole deur mense wat na bewering inwoners van die Vhembe-distrik in Limpopo is.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates President Jacob Zuma’s condemnation of the destruction of 24 schools by people purported to be residents of the Vhembe district in Limpopo.

src: Die vernietiging van opvoedkundige infrastruktuur benadeel ons kinders en ondermyn die land se poging om gehalte-onderwys te voorsien.
tgt: This destruction of educational infrastructure disadvantages our children and undermines the country’s effort to provide quality education.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom President Jacob Zuma se ontmoeting met die Koning van die Vhavenda, Thovhele Toni Mphephu Ramabulana, wat op versoek van sy majesteit op 8 Me 2016 plaasgevind het om kwessies in Vuwani op te los.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the meeting by President Jacob Zuma with King of the Vhavenda, Khosikhulu Thovhele Toni Mphephu Ramabulana which was at the request of his majesty on the 8 May 2016 to resolve issues in Vuwani.

src: President Jacob Zuma het 'n taakspan onder leiding van die Departement van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake aangestel om die proses te lei waarvolgens 'n pakket van sosiale infrastruktuur-projekte vir die Makhado Plaaslike Munisipaliteit ontwikkel word.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma has put in place a task team led by the Department of Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs to lead the process of developing a package of social infrastructure projects for the Makhado Local Municipality.

src: Die Kabinet bedank die ministeriële taakspan onder leiding van Minister Desmond van Rooyen vir die vordering wat gemaak is om hierdie saak op te los en spreek sy waardering uit vir die rol wat die kantoor van Premier Stanley Mathabatha, en die Uitvoerende Burgemeester van Vhembe, Tshitereke Matibe asook die Uitvoerende Burgemeester van Thulamela, Grace Mahosi, en die Uitvoerende Burgemeester van Makhado, David Mutavhatsindi gespeel het.
tgt: Cabinet thanks the ministerial Task Team led by Minister Desmond van Rooyen for the inroads made to resolve this matter and appreciates the role played by the Office of Premier Stanley Mathabatha, and the Executive Mayor of Vhembe, Tshitereke Matibe the Executive Mayor of Thulamela, Grace Mahosi and the Executive Mayor of Makhado, David Mutavhatsindi.

src: Tydens taakspanvergaderings, het die tradisionele leiers hulle daartoe verbind om met die Regering saam te werk om die krisis op te los.
tgt: During Task Team meetings, the attending traditional leaders made commitments to work with government to resolve the crisis and condemned the destruction of property and violence and called for the urgent resolution of the situation.

src: Hulle het die vernietiging van eiendom en geweld veroordeel en dring aan op ’n dringende oplossing vir die situasie.
tgt: At these meetings traditional leaders and the Task Team reaffirmed the outcomes of the meeting with the President and resolved to report progress to the President.

src: Die ministeriële taakspan is tans besig om samesprekings met alle belanghebbendes te voer as 'n deurlopende poging deur die Regering om die situasie in Vuwani en die omliggende dorpe te normaliseer.
tgt: As we speak the ministerial Task Team is engaging with all stakeholders as a continuing effort by government to normalise the situation in Vuwani and its surrounding villages.

src: Die Kabinet bedank die lede van die gemeenskap en tradisionele leierskap wat ingegryp het om die oorblywende skole te beskerm en 'n omgewing vir voortgesette dialoog te skep.
tgt: Cabinet thanks those members of the community and traditional leadership that have intervened to protect the remaining schools and creating an environment for ongoing dialogue.

src: Daar kan geen geldige rede wees om die sinnelose vernietiging van kritieke openbare infrastruktuur soos skole te regverdig nie.
tgt: There can be no valid reason to justify the senseless destruction of critical public infrastructure such as schools.

src: Inwoners wat skuldig is aan die afbrand van ons openbare geriewe sal met die volle mag van die wet te doen kry.
tgt: Those residents who are found guilty of burning our public facilities will face the full might of the law.

src: Die Kabinet herinner Suid-Afrikaners daaraan dat ons demokrasie aan alle burgers verskeie platforms bied om hul besorgdheid uit te spreek en om deur konstruktiewe betrokkenheid vriendskaplike oplossings te vind.
tgt: Cabinet reminds South Africans that our democracy affords all citizens a number of platforms to express their concerns and embark on constructive engagement towards an amicable solution.

src: Inwoners van hierdie distrik word aangemoedig om enige elemente wat die toekoms van ons kinders vernietig, te isoleer en hulle aan die wetstoepassingsagentskappe te WEBTOKEN 'n afsonderlike, maar verwante voorval het die Kabinet met groot kommer kennis geneem van aanhoudende geweld, ontwrigting van onderwys en die afbrand van die verkeersdepartement se fasiliteite in die Grabouw-gebied van die Wes-Kaap.
tgt: Residents of this district are encouraged to isolate any elements who are leading and destroying the future of our children and report them to the law enforcement WEBTOKEN a separate but related incident Cabinet noted with great concern the continuing violence, disruption of schooling and the burning of the traffic department facilities in the Grabouw area of the Western Cape.

src: Die Kabinet benadruk dat diegene wat skuldig bevind word aan kriminele aktiwiteite aan die volle mag van die wet onderwerp sal word.3 Die Kabinet dra sy meegevoel oor aan die familie en vriende van diegene wat gesterf het as gevolg van die vloede in gebiede van KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates that the full might of the law will be applied to those found guilty of criminal activity.

src: Die Regering voorsien rampbestuurdienste en verligting aan die slagoffers.4 Die Kabinet herinner Suid-Afrikaners om steeds water spaarsamig te gebruik om voldoende toevoer vir toekomstige gebruik te verseker, want daar is nog gebiede in die land wat droogte ervaar.
tgt: Cabinet conveys its condolences to the family and friends of those who lost their lives due to the flooding in areas of KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Regeringsbystand verlig steeds die vernietigende uitwerking van die droogte deur kort-, medium- en langtermyn begrotingstoewysings om interdepartementele programme te finansier wat op die spesiale behoeftes van gebiede wat deur die droogte geraak word, en die behoefte om waterverliese in 'n kritieke voorsieningsnetwerke, reageer.
tgt: Government is providing disaster management services and relief to victims.

src: Die Regering het 'n inter-ministeriële taakspan oor dienslewering aangestel, met verteenwoordiging vanuit verskillende sektore.
tgt: Cabinet reminds South Africans to continue using water sparingly to secure sufficient supply for future use, as there are still areas in the country which are experiencing drought conditions.

src: Die benadering wat deur die Regering gebruik word om die droogte en grondagteruitgang die hoof te bied, fasiliteer samehangende en geïntegreerde inter-regeringsreaksies, naamlik die Landcare-program, Werk vir Water, Werk op Vuur en Werk vir Vleilande, wat tot werkskepping, voedselsekuriteit, vaardigheidsontwikkeling, bewaring, grondrehabilitasie en herstel, sowel as landelike ontwikkeling bydra.
tgt: Government support continues to lessen the devastating effects of the drought through short, medium and long term budget allocations to fund interdepartmental programmes that respond to the special needs of drought-affected areas and the need to address water losses in critical supply networks.

src: Die koms van die huidige droogte noodsaak die gebruik van tegnologie wat veerkragtigheid WEBTOKEN sodanig het Suid-Afrika in 2015 die gebruik van droogtebestande geneties gemodifiseerde mielies goedgekeur om aandag te gee aan die kwessie van voedselsekuriteit.
tgt: As part of the mitigation measures taken to offset the effects of the drought, dam operating rules have been applied to 35 dams and 4 systems where restrictions are currently applied with regard to the water resource (mandatory restrictions on domestic and agricultural use).To mitigate the effects of the drought on water users, the Department of Water and Sanitation has spent over R500 million on emergency and short-term interventions in KwaZulu-Natal, Free State, North West, Eastern Cape, Mpumalanga, Limpopo, Western Cape and Northern Cape.

src: Ons verbeter ook innoverende ontwerpe en tegnologieë wat nodig is vir die herstel van geaffekteerde gebiede om grondagteruitgang te stuit en grondproduktiwiteit in stand te WEBTOKEN deel van hierdie geïntegreerde benadering het Suid-Afrika hom verbind tot ’n vennootskap met die Verenigde Nasies se Konvensie om Verwoestyning te Bekamp se Globale teiken-ondersteuningsprogram en om 'n begunstigde van die program te word.
tgt: The medium to long term interventions are intended to ensure that we are more climate change resilient, which reduces the risks for future drought mitigation.

src: Deur hierdie tussenkomste sluit ons aan by die wêreldwye implementering van nasionale vrywillige teikens as deel van die bereiking van die Volhoubare Ontwikkelingsdoelwitte.
tgt: The approach employed by government in addressing the drought and land degradation problem, facilitates coherent and integrated intergovernmental responses, namely, the Landcare programme, Working for Water, Working on Fire and Working for Wetlands, that contribute to job creation, food security, skills development, conservation, land rehabilitation and restoration as well as rural development.

src: Die sleutelbeginsel van grondagteruitgangneutraliteit bevestig die rol van plaaslike gemeenskappe in die ontwerp- en implementeringsmaatreëls om grondagteruitgang te stuit en om te keer.
tgt: The advent of the current drought necessitates use of technologies that advance resilience.

src: Die Strategie vir Aanpassing by Klimaatsverandering wat onlangs beslis is, identifiseer prioriteistussenkomste en harmonieer belangrike sektorale aanpassinsplanne vir water, landbou, biodiversiteit, gesondheid, menslike nedersettings, en ramprisikovermindering in 'n omvattende Nasionale Aanpassingplan.
tgt: As such in 2015 South Africa approved the use of drought tolerant genetically modified maize to address the issue of food security.

src: Die verwydering van indringerspesies deur die Werk-vir-Water-program uit besmette opvanggebied en waterlope dra by tot beter waterkwaliteit en-kwantiteit.5 Die Kabinet het met kommer kennis geneem van die staking by die Suid-Afrikaanse Poskantoor (SAPO) waarvan die gevolge ’n uitwerking het op sy herposisionering om 'n beter diens aan Suid-Afrikaners te lewer.
tgt: We are also enhancing innovative designs and technologies required in the restoration of affected areas to arrest soil degradation and sustain land WEBTOKEN part of this integrated approach South Africa has committed to partner and become a beneficiary of the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD) Global target setting support programme.

src: Implementering van belangrike Regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of Key Government Programmes.

src: Die Fort Hare-eeufeesviering, voorgegaan deur President Jacob Zuma, was 'n groot sukses.
tgt: The Fort Hare centenary celebrations which were officiated by President Jacob Zuma were a success.

src: Honderde gaste, insluitend alumni en die President van Zimbabwe, Robert Mugabe, asook diplomate het hierdie toonaangewende mylpaal in die Suid-Afrikaanse geskiedenis bygewoon.
tgt: Hundreds of guests, including Alumni and Zimbabwean President Robert Mugabe as well as diplomats attended this prestigious milestone in South Africa’s history.

src: Dit geleentheid het saamgeval met Afrikamaand, wat die stigting van die destydse Organisasie vir Afrika-Eenheid, deesdae die Afrika-Unie (AU), herdenk.
tgt: This coincided with Africa Month, which commemorates the founding of the then Organisation of African Unity, now called the African Union (AU).

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die vordering wat gemaak is om die griewe van studente op te los, wat nie op die beskadiging van eiendom moes uitloop nie.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the progress made in resolving students’ issues, which should not have caused the destruction to property.

src: Tydens President Jacob Zuma se werkbesoek aan die Republiek van Uganda, het albei staatshoofde tot die verbetering van bilaterale betrekkinge ingestem en die politieke en veiligheidskwessies in die Republiek van Burundi en die ooste van die Demokratiese Republiek van die Kongo bespreek.
tgt: On a working visit by President Jacob Zuma to the Republic of Uganda, both Heads of State agreed to strengthen bilateral relations, and discussed the political and security situation in the Republic of Burundi and eastern Democratic Republic of Congo.

src: President Jacob Zuma het ook die inhuldigingseremonie van President Yoweri Museveni bygewoon.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma also attended the inauguration ceremony of President Yoweri Museveni.

src: Suid-Afrika en Uganda het tot dusver 20 bilaterale ooreenkomste onderteken en sowat 70 Suid-Afrikaanse maatskappye doen tans sake in Uganda.
tgt: South Africa and Uganda have so far 20 signed bilateral agreements, with approximately 70 South African companies currently operating in Uganda.

src: In 2015 het uitvoere van Suid-Afrika na Uganda R1,7 miljard beloop en dié van invoere na Suid-Afrika, R98 miljoen.3 Die Kabinet verwelkom die suksesvolle voltooiing van President Jacob Zuma se staatsbesoek aan Katar en die ondertekening van verskeie ooreenkomste en ondernemings, soos die ooreenkomste oor samewerking op die gebied van verdediging en polisie, asook op die gebied van kuns, kultuur en erfenis.
tgt: In 2015, South African exports to Uganda amounted to R.7 billion while South African imports totaled R98 million.

src: Die oprigting van 'n gesamentlike beleggingskomitee om toesig te hou oor die inwerkingstelling van ooreenkomste, benewens die gestruktureerde bilaterale konsultasies, verhoog bilaterale betrekkinge tot 'n strategiese vlak.
tgt: The establishment of a Joint Investment Committee to oversee the implementation of agreements in addition to the structured Bilateral Consultations enhances and elevates bilateral relations to a strategic level.

src: Die President se interaksie met die Suid-Afrika-Katar-Sakeforum het samewerking op sakegebied bevorder en het ten doel om die ekonomieë van albei lande te diversifiseer.
tgt: The President's interaction with the South Africa-Qatari Business Forum promoted Business-to-Business cooperation aimed at diversifying both economies.

src: Aangesien albei lande as maritieme lande beskou word, is die potensiaal vir samewerking met betrekking tot die oseaan-ekonomie ook bespreek.
tgt: With both countries qualifying as maritime countries the potential for cooperation in the Oceans Economy was also discussed.

src: 'n Aantal Suid-Afrikaanse maatskappye, hoofsaaklik in die petrochemiese sektor, doen in Katar sake.
tgt: A number of South African companies, mainly in the Petrochemical-related sector operate in Qatar.

src: Een van Suid-Afrika se vernaamste beleggings in die Midde-Ooste is Sasol, wat 'n belangrike rol in die ontwikkeling van gasreserwes in Katar speel.
tgt: One of South Africa's largest investments in the Middle East is Sasol, which plays an important role in the development of Qatar’s gas reserves.

src: Ander kwessies wat bespreek is, sluit in handel en ekonomiese betrekkinge, asook vrede in die wêreld en die streek, sowel as veiligheidskwessies.4 President Jacob Zuma het veroeding vir grond oorhandig as deel van Fase 1 van die afhandeling van grondeise in die Nasionale Krugerwildtuin.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma handed over compensation for land as part of Phase 1 of the settlement of claims on the Kruger National Park.

src: In totaal is R84 miljoen aan ses gemeenskappe, drie van Limpopo en drie van Mpumalanga, oorhandig.
tgt: A total of R84 million was awarded to six communities, three from Limpopo, and three from Mpumalanga.

src: Wat grondoppervlak betref, kom dit neer op 318 000 ha.
tgt: In terms of land area this portion measured 318 000 hectares.

src: Die afhandelingsproses het die belangrikheid van die Nasionale Krugerwildtuin in ag geneem en lewensvatbare geldelike vergoeding verseker, aangesien die eisers nie na die gebied kan terugkeer nie.
tgt: The settlement model took into account the significance of the Kruger National Park and assured viable financial compensation as claimants are not able to return to their land.

src: Dit strook met billike vergoeding ingevolge die Regering se grondhervormingsprogram en dui op 'n belangrike mylpaal in die land se WEBTOKEN die gemeenskappe nog verder te bemagtig, genereer die eenpersent-gemeenskapstoerismefonds nagenoeg R6,5 miljoen per jaar vir die gemeenskap.
tgt: This is in line with equitable redress under government’s land restitution programme and marks an important milestone in the country’s transformation WEBTOKEN further empowering these communities, a 1 per cent community tourism fund has been generating approximately R.5 million per annum for community beneficiation.

src: Dit het gelei tot die bou van verskeie onderriggeriewe, insluitend 'n administrasieblok by die Hoërskool Dumisani, 'n rekenaarlaboratorium by die Hoërskool Masiza, wetenskaplaboratoriums by die hoërskole Tlakulani en Sibusisiswe, asook 'n kombuis en speelterrein vir graad R-leerders van die Laerskool Takheleni.
tgt: This has resulted in the building of a number of education facilities including an administration block at Dumisani High School, a computer laboratory at Masiza High School, science laboratories at Tlakulani and Sibusisiswe high schools, a kitchen facility and playground for Grade R learners at Takheleni Primary School.

src: Die bou van vier wetenskaplaboratoriums, een elk by die die Hoërskool Mbuyane, die Sekondêre Skool Mahlale, die Hoërskool Lepato en die Sekondêre Skool Makuya is in oorleg met die gemeenskappe vir 2016/17 geoormerk.
tgt: In 2016/17 in consultation with the affected communities, the building of four science laboratories in Mbuyane High School Mahlale Secondary School Lepato High School and Makuya Secondary School, covering both Limpopo and Mpumalanga provinces have been prioritised.

src: Die Kabinet het die belangrikheid van die vennootskap tussen gemeenskappe met veelvuldige etniese groepe benadruk om maatskaplike samehorigheid te bewerkstellig.
tgt: Cabinet emphasised the importance of the partnership between multi ethnic communities which contributes to social cohesion.

src: Suid-Afrika se grondrestitusiemodel word uit vorige ondervinding aangepas en word tans gegrond op die skepping van volhoubare ekonomiese voordeel in plaas van die problematiese oordrag van 'n enkelbedrag wat gemeenskappe dikwels sonder enige voordeel gelaat het.
tgt: South Africa’s land restitution model is evolving based on prior experiences and is now underpinned by creating sustainable economic benefit rather than the troubled once-off financial transfers which often left communities no better off.

src: Fase 2 van die afhandeling van die grondeis bestaan uit projekte wat sal verseker dat die gemeenskappe oor die langer termyn by sakegeleenthede binne die Krugerwildtuin baat.5 Die uitkomste van die Spitsberaad oor die Integrasie van Vergoedingstelsels onder die tema “Toegang tot billike en volhoubare vergoedingstelsels vir alle werkers” gelei deur die ministers van gesondheid en van arbeid, Aaron Motsoaledi en Mildred Oliphant onderskeidelik, en ondersteun deur die adjunkministers van minerale hulpbronne, van gesondheid en van arbeid, is ontvang.
tgt: Phase 2 of the settlement claim will consist of projects aimed at ensuring the communities continue to benefit in the longer term from business opportunities within the Park.

src: Die ministers van die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap (SAOG), Suid-Afrikaanse mynbou en georganiseerde arbeid asook die verenigings vir voormalige mynwerkers het aan die spitsberaad deelgeneem.
tgt: The outcomes from the Summit on the Integration of Compensation Systems under the theme “Access to equitable, fair and sustainable compensation system for all workers” led by the Ministers of Health and Labour, Aaron Motsoaledi and Mildred Oliphant, and supported by the Deputy Ministers of Mineral Resources, Health, Labour and Mineral Resources were recieved.

src: Deur middel van die voorgestelde geïntegreerde vergoedingstelsel gaan die Regering seker maak dat mynwerkers en voormalige mynwerkers markverwante vergoeding ontvang om volhoubare welsyn vir hulle en hul gesinne te verseker.
tgt: The summit focused on occupational health and safety with a view to develop an integrated compensation system for South Africa.

src: In samewerking met die werkersverteenwoordigers en mynbousektor, poog die Regering om 'n moniterings-en-evalueringstelsel in werking te stel wat aansporings aan maatskappye sal gee wat aan goeie veiligheids- en kompensasiebeginsels voldoen.6 Die Kabinet verwelkom die opening van die land se eerste Ontwikkelingsentrum vir die Biovervaardigingsnywerheid (BNOS) in Pretoria deur die Departement van Wetenskap en Tegnologie.
tgt: Ministers from the Southern African Development Countries (SADC) region South African Mining Industry and organised labour as well as the ex-mineworkers associations also participated at the Summit.

src: Maatskappye wat deur die BNOS ondersteun word het toegang tot bioproduksiegeriewe, ondersteuning in navorsing en ontwikkelingslaboratoriums.
tgt: It supports SMMEs involved in bio-manufacturing by enabling them to exploit market opportunities.

src: Die eerste fase sal permanente en tydelike werkgeleenthede skep en die ekonomiese invloed hiervan word op R250 miljoen per jaar in die volgende vyf jaar beraam.
tgt: The initial phase will result in the creation of permanent and temporary jobs with the economic impact projected at R250 million per annum in the next five years.

src: Tans ondersteun die BNOS 19 ondernemings waarvan 16 in swart besit is dit sluit 10 swart vroue-ondernemings in.
tgt: Currently the BIDC is supporting 19 enterprises of which 16 are owned by black entrepreneurs, including 10 black women-owned enterprises.

src: Daarbenewens is 55 permanente en 171 tydelike werkgeleenthede reeds geskep, en sowat 54 bied indiensopleiding aan.7 Die aankondiging deur die Minister van Energie, Tina Joemat-Pettersson, om 'n gasbeleid te ontwikkel, stuur die land in die rigting van 'n ekonomie met volhoubare aardgas.
tgt: In addition, 55 permanent and 171 temporary jobs have already been created, with 54 interns trained.

src: Die bekendstelling van gas as 'n bykomende bron van krag in Suid-Afrika se energiemengsel sal die afhanklikheid van steenkool verminder en voldoende, diverse en veilige energiebeskikbaarheid aan inwoners en die ekonomie, nou en in die toekoms, verseker.
tgt: The announcement by the Minister of Energy, Tina Joemat-Pettersson to develop a Gas Policy guides the country towards a sustainable natural gas economy.

src: Dit sal ook die land se vermoë om 'n hergeïndustrialiseerde ekonomie, 'n hoër en inklusiewe groeikoers en werkskepping te realiseer, verbeter.
tgt: The introduction of gas as an additional source of power in South Africa’s energy mix will lessen the dependence of coal and ensure sufficient, diverse and secure energy availability to citizens and the economy, now and into the future.

src: Intussen is die Departement van Energie besig met 'n gas-tot-krag-program, wat 3 726 MW sal opwek en as katalisator vir die ontwikkeling van die plaaslike gasbedryf sal dien, wat ontginning in 'n beleggergunstige omgewing sal bevorder.
tgt: This will also increase the country’s trajectory of realising a re-industrialised economy, a higher and inclusive growth path and job WEBTOKEN the interim the Department of Energy is undertaking a gas-to-power programme, which will deliver 3,726MW of electricity and also serve as a catalyst for the development of a local gas industry which will encourage upstream exploration in an investor friendly enabling environment.

src: Werkgeleenthede wat direk en indirek met dié industriële ontwikkeling verband hou, kom neer op nagenoeg 1,25 miljoen voltydse ekwivalente werksgeleenthede oor 25 jaar.
tgt: Employment opportunities associated directly and indirectly with this industry development will amount to 1, 25 million full time equivalent job opportunities over a 25 year period.

src: Oor die korter termyn sal die gas-tot-krag-program help om trae ekonomiese groei te verskans en sodoende werkverliese voorkom.8 Die amptelike bekendstelling van die Nasionale Energiebesparingsveldtog tydens die 2016 Week van Munisipaledienste-konferensie, aangebied deur die Departement van Energie, bou voort op die Regering se energiebesparingsveldtog, wat in 2015 deur President Jacob Zuma bekend gestel is.
tgt: In the shorter term the gas-to-power programme will contribute to buffer economic output decreases and help prevent job losses.

src: 'n Veldtog om toestelle na te gaan, word ook binnekort bekend gestel om energiedoeltreffendheid te meet en verbruikers 'n keuse te gee wanneer hulle huishoudelike toestelle koop.
tgt: The official rollout of the national ‘Save Energy’ campaign during the 2016 African Utility Week Conference, led by the Department of Energy, builds on the government Energy Savings campaign launched by President Jacob Zuma in 2015.

src: Alle toestelle sal 'n etiket kry wat hul werkverrrigting met betrekking tot die minimum energieprestasiestandaard sal aandui.10 Die Kabinet neem kennis van die Missie vir die Inwaartse Verkryging van Energie in Afrika, wat deur die Departement van Handel en Nywerheid en die Suid-Afrikaanse Elektrotegniese Uitvoerraad aangebied word.
tgt: Also launching is an ‘Appliance Check’ campaign, an energy efficiency measure that will give consumers a choice when purchasing appliances.

src: Suid-Afrikaanse maatskappye met kundigheid in vervaardiging en ingenieurswesedienste is aan verteenwoordigers van kragverskaffers van Ethiopië, Kenia, Tanzanië, Suid-Soedan en Nigerië blootgestel.
tgt: South African companies with manufacturing and engineering service competencies were exposed to representatives of power utilities from Ethiopia, Kenya, Tanzania, South Sudan and Nigeria.

src: Dit posisioneer Suid-Afrikaanse maatskappye om beleggingsgeleenthede in kraginfrastruktuur in Afrika te benut, wat na raming tussen $2 miljard en $42 miljard per jaar oor die volgende 10 jaar sal beloop.11 Die Kabinet is bemoedig deur die bekendstelling van die langtermynoplossing vir die probleem van suur mynwater (SMW) in die Sentrale Kom in Germiston waarvan tweederdes deur die mynbou en eenderde deur watergebruikers befonds sal word.
tgt: This better positioned South African companies to participate in the investment opportunities of the power infrastructure roll-out for Africa estimated at between $20 billion and $42 billion a year over the next 10 years.

src: Dit volg op die suksesvolle voltooiing van die korttermyn-oplossing onder die Interministeriële Komitee oor suur mynwater.
tgt: Cabinet is encouraged by the launch of the Acid Mine Drainage (AMD) long-term solution at the AMD Central Basin in Germiston which will be two thirds funded by the mining sector and one third by water users.

src: In 2011 het die Regering aan die Trans-Caledon Tonnelowerheid, 'n staatsbeheerde instelling wat onder die Departement van Water en Sanitasie resorteer, 'n mandaat gegee om 'n korttermynoplossing vir suur mynwater in Gauteng te vind.
tgt: This follows the successful completion of the short-term solution under the Inter-Ministerial Committee on AMIn 2011 government mandated the Trans-Caledon Tunnel Authority, a State-owned entity under the Department of Water and Sanitation, to provide a short-term solution to the AMD challenge in Gauteng.

src: Die doel van die langtermynoplossing is om besoedelde water verder te behandel deur sulfate te verwyder sodat die water vir kommersiële, industriële of drinkwater aangewend kan word.12 Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle burgers van Lesotho wat onwettig in Suid-Afrika woon om voor 30 Junie 2016 vir ’n spesiale permit vir burgers van Lesotho by 'n visumdienssentrum aansoek te doen.
tgt: The purpose of the long-term solution is to further treat the contaminated water by removing sulphates and creating water for commercial use as either industrial or potable water.

src: Die spesiale permit word uitgereik kragtens 'n spesiale ooreenkoms rakende burgers van Lesotho wat in Suid-Afrika werk, studeer of sake doen en sedert 30 September 2015 om hierdie redes in die land is.
tgt: Cabinet appeals to all Lesotho nationals who are residing in South Africa illegally to apply for a Lesotho Special Permit at a Visa Facilitation Service Centre before 30 June 2016.

src: Daarbenewens, word burgers van Lesotho wat wat op bedrieglike wyse Suid-Afrikaanse dokumente verkry het, aangeraai om hulle aan die aangewese kantore van Binnelandse Sake oor te gee en 'n amnestiebrief te kry.
tgt: The Lesotho Special Permit is issued under a special dispensation for Lesotho nationals who are working, studying or running businesses in South Africa and have been in the country in such capacity before 30 September 2015.

src: Die amnestie verstryk op 31 Desember 2016.
tgt: This amnesty will expire on 31 December 2016.

src: Werkgewers wat burgers van Lesotho in diens neem, sal ook by hierdie permit baat.13 Die Kabinet verwelkom die aankondiging deur die Minister van Sport en Ontspanning, Fikile Mbalula, dat die SAUK weer plaaslike boksgevegte gaan uitsaai.
tgt: Employers of Lesotho nationals should also take advantage of this permit.

src: Die Sauk se programme "Boxing is Back" en "TKO" bereik reeds meer as 1,3 miljoen huishoudings.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the announcement by Sport and Recreation Minister Fikile Mbalula that local boxing is being broadcast again on SABTo date “Boxing is Back” and “TKO” programmes on SABC have reached over million households.

src: Die terugkeer van hierdie sport op televisie sal die inkomste van Boks Suid-Afrika 'n groot hupstoot gee, en vroueboks en ontluikende bokspromotors ondersteun.
tgt: The return of this sport to television, will greatly benefit the revenue of Boxing South Africa, strengthen women boxing and support upcoming promoters and boxers.

src: Sleutelkabinetsbesluite.1 Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die voltooiing van onderhandelinge en wetlike verfyning van die ekonomiese vennootskapsooreenkomste tussen die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap en die Europese Unie (EU).Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Ekonomiese Vennootskapsooreenkoms aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.1 Cabinet was briefed on the conclusion of negotiations and legal scrubbing of the Economic Partnership Agreement between the Southern African Development Community Group and the European Union (EU).

src: Die ooreenkoms sal 'n enkele handelsooreenkoms tussen die Suider-Afrikaanse Doeane-unie (SADU) en die EU daarstel.
tgt: The Agreement will establish a single trade regime between the Southern African Customs Union (SACU) and the EIt will also enhance South Africa’s preferential access to the European Union market for a range of agricultural products such as sugar, ethanol, wine, fisheries and fruit.

src: Die ooreenkoms bou voort op die Samewerkingsooreenkoms van Handel en Ontwikkelingsamewerking (SOHO) wat Suid-Afrika in 2000 met die EU gesluit het.
tgt: The EPA builds on the Trade and Development Cooperation Agreement (TDCA) that South Africa concluded in 2000 with the EU.

src: Die ooreenkoms gee Suid-Afrika bykomende ruimte ten opsigte van beleid op verskeie gebiede.
tgt: The Economic Partnership Agreement provides South Africa with additional policy space in several areas.

src: Suid-Afrika het ook 'n bilaterale protokol oor geografiese aanwysers met die EU beding weens die groeiende belangstelling in die beskerming van wynname en gespesialiseerde landbouprodukname.
tgt: South Africa also negotiated a bilateral Protocol on Geographical Indicators with the EU, due to growing interest in protecting wine names and specialised agricultural product names.

src: As sodanig, sal 102 wynname ingevolge die ooreenkoms en drie landbouprodukname – rooibos, heuningbos, en Karoolam – beskerm word.
tgt: As such, 102 wine names will be protected under the Agreement and three agricultural product names namely Rooibos, Honeybush, Karoo Lamb.

src: Die ooreenkoms strook met die beginsels van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan om Suid-Afrika se industrialisering en uitvoer na die EU te bevorder.
tgt: The Agreement ensures in line with the National Development Plans objectives that South Africa advances industrialisation and promotes South African exports into the EU market.

src: Belangriker nog, die ooreenkomste bevorder die ontwikkeling van plaaslike waardekettings in Afrika en dra sodoende by tot streeksintegrasie.2 Die Kabinet keur dat die Groenskrif oor Internasionale Migrasie in die Staatskoerant gepubliseer word vir openbare kommentaar.
tgt: Most importantly, the EPA promotes the development of regional value chains in Africa thus contributing to regional integration.2 Cabinet approved the publication of the Green Paper on International Migration in the Government Gazette for public comment.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor verdere samesprekings met belanghebbendes rakende die Groenskrif vir 2016/17.Die Groenskrif strook met die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan en bepaal dat om armoede te beëindig en behoorlike werk te skep, migrasie aangewend moet word om hierdie patrone te breek, deur ons vaardighede en kennis uit te brei en struikelblokke vir streekontwikkeling uit die weg te ruim.
tgt: Cabinet was also briefed on further stakeholder consultations and engagements on the Green Paper for 2016/17.The Green Paper is aligned to the National Development Plan and takes the position that to end poverty and create decent work, migration must be used to break these patterns, by growing our skills and knowledge base and by removing barriers to regional development.

src: Dit vereis dat Suid-Afrika strategies in die verdere ontwikkeling van 'n doeltreffende en veilige immigrasiestelsel belê.Die inwerkingstelling van internasionale migrasie sal ons nader aan 'n balans tussen ontwikkelingsbehoeftes en die land se integriteit en nasionale veiligheid bring.3 Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die Departement van Landbou, Bosbou en Visserye om saam met die Akwakultuurvereniging van Suider-Afrika van 26 tot 30 Junie 2017 die Wêreldakwakultuurvereniging-konferensie aan te bied.
tgt: This requires South Africa to invest strategically in the further development of an efficient and secure immigration system.

src: Dit is die eerste keer dat die Wêreldakwakultuur-konferensie in Afrika gehou word.
tgt: This will be the first time that the World Aquaculture Conference is held in Africa.

src: Die Regering het die akwakultuursektor benoem om 'n deurslaggewende rol in voedselsekerheid en ekonomiese groei in die land te speel.
tgt: The aquaculture sector has been prioritised by government to play a pivotal role in food security and economic growth of the country.

src: Akwakultuur vorm deel van die kerninisiatief van Operasie Phakisa: Oseaanekonomie.
tgt: Aquaculture has been included in the key initiative of Operation Phakisa: Oceans Economy.

src: Die aanbieding van hierdie konferensie sal Suid-Afrika in staat te stel om ontwikkeling van en belegging in die akwakultuursektor te bespoedig deur inligting en kennis asook netwerkgeleenthede te deel.
tgt: Hosting of this Conference will enable South Africa to fast-track development of and investment in the aquaculture sector through the information and knowledge sharing as well as the networking WEBTOKEN will also create an opportunity for the tourism sector to showcase the country’s tourism activities and the local farmers will also showcase their technology innovations at the tradeshow that will cater for more than 100 exhibitors from leading aquaculture nations worldwide.

src: Die aanbieding sal ook ’n geleentheid bied vir die toerismesektor om die land se toerisme-aktiwiteite ten toon te stel, terwyl plaaslike boere hul tegnologie-innoverings sal kan uitstal by die handelsuitstalling, waar meer as 100 uitstallers van die voorste akwakultuurlande regoor die wêreld teenwoordig sal wees.
tgt: African countries will also have an opportunity to participate and showcase their products which will have a positive impact on economic development for the aquaculture sector in the African region and South Africa.4 Cabinet was briefed on the refinements made to the Medium Term Strategic Framework (MTSF) Chapter on Outcome 12 and the 2016/17 Programme of Action.

src: Dit werp lig op die Kabinet se besluit om die MTSR se hoofstuk oor Uitkoms 12 - 'n doeltreffende en ontwikkelingsgeoriënteerde staatsdiens, vir die tydperk 2014-2019 en die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan – beter met mekaar te versoen.
tgt: This responds to the Cabinet decision to strengthen alignment between the MTSF Chapter on Outcome 12 – An efficient, effective and development orientated Public Service, for the period 2014-2019 and the National Development Plan.

src: Komende gebeure.1 In Junie vier ons die 40ste herdenking van die 16 Junie 1976-opstand, wat die sosio-politieke landskap in Suid-Afrika indringend verander het.
tgt: Upcoming events.1 June will see the commemoration of the 40th anniversary of the June 16 1976 uprising, which profoundly changed the socio-political landscape in South Africa.

src: Die herdenking val onder toesig van 'n interministeriële komitee.
tgt: The commemoration is being be overseen by an Inter-Ministerial Committee.

src: Jeugmaandvieringe onder die tema "Die jeug neem Suid-Afrika vorentoe" sal op 1 Junie 2016 by die Hector Petersen-gedenkmonument in Soweto, deur die Minister in die Presidensie, Jeff Radebe, bekend gestel word.
tgt: Youth Month will be launched on 1 June 2016 under the theme “Youth Taking South Africa Forward” at Hector Petersen Memorial, Soweto by Minister in the Presidency, Jeff Radebe.

src: Die program sal 'n maand lank duur en gekoördineer word deur die Nasionale Jeugontwikkelingsagentskap.
tgt: This will see a month long programme, coordinated by the National Youth Development Agency, dedicated to enabling and encouraging our youth to more easily take up opportunities across various sectors so as to better their lives and enable them to effectively contribute to the development of the economy and the country.

src: Die vieringe sal opbou tot die Nasionale Jeugdag-verrigtinge op 16 Junie 2016 waartydens President Jacob Zuma by die Orlando-stadion in Soweto sal optree.2 Die Departement van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling sal die Nasionale Kinderbeskermingsweek op die plaas Braakspruit, naby Klerksdorp op 29 Me 2016 bekend stel onder die tema: "Laat ons ons kinders beskerm en Suid-Afrika vorentoe beweeg".
tgt: This builds up to the National Youth Day proceedings on 16 June 2016, which will be officiated by President Jacob Zuma at Orlando Stadium in Soweto.2 The Department of Social Development will launch National Child Protection Week in Braakspruit Farm, Klerksdorp on 29 May 2016 under the theme: “Let Us All Protect Children to Move South Africa Forward”.

src: Die week sal saamval met ’n Internasionale Kinderdag op 1 Junie 2016, waartydens President Jacob Zuma die verrigtinge by 'n weeshuis en jeugsentrum in Atteridgeville, Gauteng, sal lei.
tgt: The week will coincide with an International Children’s Day event on 1 June 2016 which will be led by President Jacob Zuma at an orphanage and youth centre in Atteridgeville, Gauteng and conclude on 5 June 2016 in Amersfoort, Mpumalanga.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op gemeenskappe om hul kinders teen verwaarlosing, misbruik, geweld en uitbuiting te beskerm en sulke voorvalle by die owerhede aan te meld.3 Die Departement van Omgewingsake sal Wêreldomgewingsdag op 5 Junie 2016 aanbied en Suid-Afrikaners aanmoedig om positiewe stappe te doen om ons omgewing en die planeet te beskerm.
tgt: Cabinet urges communities to protect children against neglect, abuse, violence and exploitation by reporting all such incidences to the authorities.3 The Department of Environment Affairs will lead the country in marking World Environment Day on 5 June 2016 to mobilise South Africans to take positive environmental action to protect our planet.

src: Vanjaar se tema vir Wêreldomgewingsdag is: "Word wild vir lewe," en fokus op natuuurlewemisdaad en die skade wat dit veroorsaak.
tgt: This year’s World Environment Day theme: "Go Wild for Life," focusses on wildlife crime and the damage it causes.

src: Suid-Afrika se sukses met die bewaring van ons biodiversiteit stel die land bloot aan georganiseerde, transnasionale omgewings- en wildlewemisdaad.
tgt: South Africa’s success in conservation of our biodiversity has made the country a prime target for organised, transnational environmental and wildlife crime.

src: Dit het 'n verwoestende invloed op ekostelsels, 'n volhoubare lewensbestaan en toerisme.4 Die viering van Wêreldoseanedag op 8 Junie 2016 onder die tema "Gesonde Oseane, Gesonde Planeet" help om die invloed van oseane op ons land en die verskillende maniere waarop oseane tot ons ekonomie bydra, na vore te bring.
tgt: The impact of environmental and wildlife crime is devastating on ecosystems, sustainable livelihoods and tourism.4 The observance of World Oceans Day on 8 June 2016 under the “Healthy Oceans, Healthy Planet” allows us to highlight the impact of oceans on our country and the various ways in which oceans contribute to our economy.

src: Dit beklemtoon ook die uitdagings in die hantering van mariene besoedeling, die handhawing van oseane se kapasiteit om die wêreldklimaat te reguleer, die verskaffing van noodsaaklike ekostelseldienste en van 'n volhoubare lewensbestaan en veilige ontspanning.
tgt: It also highlights challenges in dealing with marine pollution, maintaining the oceans’ capacity to regulate the global climate, supplying essential ecosystem services and providing sustainable livelihoods and safe recreation.

src: Die Kabinet se standpunt oor belangrike kwessies in die omgewing.1 Die Regering fokus steeds daarop om ekonomiese groei te bevorder, bestaande poste te behou en meer volhoubare werksgeleenthede te skep deur met die sake- en arbeidsektore saam te werk.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on key issues in the environment.1 Government remains focused on reigniting economic growth, preserving existing jobs and creating more sustainable jobs through working together with business and labour.

src: Deur middel van ons program van strukturele hervormings en fiskale konsolidasie, sal die Regering besteding in toom hou om te verseker dat ons ekonomie sterker na vore kom wanneer die wêreldekonomie herstel.
tgt: Through our programme of structural reforms and fiscal consolidation, government will remain within its expenditure ceiling to ensure that our economy emerges stronger when the global economy recovers.

src: President Jacob Zuma het 'n paar doeltreffende ingrypings bekend gestel deur vennootskappe, plaaslik en internasionaal, om ekonomiese groei en werkskepping te bevorder.2 Die Kabinet neem kennis van die toenemende aantal beleggingsinisiatiewe wat onlangs aangekondig is wat dui op vertroue deur die internasionale beleggingsgemeenskap in die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma has led several effective interventions through partnerships, both domestically and internationally to boost economic growth and job creation.2 Cabinet noted the growing number of investment initiatives that have been announced in the country which demonstrate confidence by the international investment community in South Africa’s economy.

src: Dit toon verder dat ons land se ekonomie besig is om te herstel en dat ons steeds as 'n lewensvatbare beleggingsbestemming beskou word.
tgt: It further demonstrates that our country is on a path to recovery and continues to be a viable investment destination.

src: Die omvang van die volgende beleggings dui op internasionale motorprodusente se voortgesette vertroue in Suid-Afrika as 'n beleggingsbestemming en die Regering se ondersteunende beleidsomgewing.
tgt: The magnitude of the following investments demonstrates the continued confidence that global automotive producers have in South Africa as an investment destination, and the supportive policy environment that government is providing.

src: Dit sluit in die belegging deur Toyota vir 'n nuwe Toyota Hilux-en-Fortuner-vervaardigingsaanleg in Prospecton, Durban, wat deur President Jacob Zuma geopen is.
tgt: These include the investment by Toyota for a new Toyota Hilux and Fortuner manufacturing plant in Prospecton, Durban, which was opened by President Jacob Zuma.

src: Dit is moontlik gemaak deur die ondersteuning van die Departement van Handel en Nywerheid wat in die afgelope vyf jaar beleggings van meer as R25 miljard na die motorbedryf gelok het.
tgt: This was made possible through the support provided by the Department of Trade and Industry which has attracted investments of over R25 billion in the automotive industry in the past five years.

src: Hierdie beleggings sal meer as 4 000 werkgeleenthede skep die totale indiensneming van die aanleg staan reeds op meer as 8 000 werkgeleenthede.
tgt: This investment will support more than 4 000 jobs with total employment in the plant already exceeding 8 000 jobs.

src: Hierdie aanleg is deel van Toyota se R6,1 miljard-belegging in Suid-Afrika se vervaardigingsbedryf en plaaslike WEBTOKEN het verkryging in die voorraadketting op die plaaslike mark verhoog om verskaffers te ondersteun.
tgt: This plant is part of Toyota's injection of R.1 billion investment into South Africa's manufacturing industry and the country's local vehicle production.

src: Daarbenewens fokus die maatskappy op die werwing van vroulike tegnici en die verskaffing van meer geleenthede vir vroue in die arbeidsmag.4 Die Kabinet verwelkom ook BMW se aankondiging oor die bou van 'n nuwerwetse monteeraanleg van R6 miljard.
tgt: Toyota has increased local procurement in its supply chain to support local component suppliers, the company has also focused on recruiting female technicians and providing more opportunities to women in the workforce.4 Cabinet also welcomed the BMW announcement on the start of its R6 billion construction of a new, state-of-the-art body shop.

src: Die uitbreiding sal BMW in staat stel om die volgende generasie van die BMW X3 te vervaardig en uit te voer.
tgt: The expansion will enable BMW to produce and export the next generation of the BMW This demonstrates the Rosslyn Plant as being highly competitive within the global BMW production network both in terms of cost of production and quality.5 In another investment, the Minister of Trade and Industry launched a R100 million Dursots & All Joy Tomato Processing Plant in Modjadjiskloof near Tzaneen.

src: Die fabriek het tans 70 mense in diens en het die potensiaal om dit teen volgende jaar tot 300 te laat styg.
tgt: The factory currently employs 70 people with a potential increase of 300 by next year.

src: Dit sal ook 'n verdere 900 seisoenswerkgeleenthede skep.
tgt: It would also create a further 900 seasonal jobs.

src: Die maatskappy is van plan om 25% van sy produkte na die Midde-Ooste, China en die res van Afrika te stuur.
tgt: The company has also initiated an export structure and plans on exporting 25% of its products to the Middle East, China and the rest of Africa.

src: Hierdie beleggings dui op die bestendige toepassing van die Negepuntplan en die Nywerheidsbeleidaksieplan (NBAP) wat fokus op waardetoevoeging uit die vervaardigingsbedryf, asook werkskepping en die verhoging van uitvoer om die ekonomie te laat groei en werk te skep.
tgt: These investments showcase the steady implementation of the Nine-Point Plan and the Industrial Policy Action Plan (IPAP) that focus on increasing manufacturing-based value addition, employment creation and export-intensity to grow the economy and create jobs.

src: Ondanks die moeilike wêreldekonomie is die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie gereed om te groei.6 Die Kabinet herinner alle stemgeregtigde kiesers om op 3 Augustus 2016 hul demokratiese reg verantwoordelik uit te oefen.
tgt: Despite global economic headwinds, the South African economy is poised to forge ahead.6 Cabinet reminds all eligible voters to responsibly exercise their democratic right on 3 August 2016.

src: Die Kabinet spreek sy dank uit aan alle kiesers wat geregistreer het en hul besonderhede nagegaan het, om te verseker dat hul name op die kieserslys verskyn, wat nou gesluit is.
tgt: Cabinet expresses its gratitude to all those voters who took the time to register and verify their details, to ensure that their name appears on the voters’ role, which is now closed.

src: Minister van Rooyen het die datum van die plaaslike regeringsverkiesings in die Staatskoerant gepubliseer en afgekondig.
tgt: Minister van Rooyen has gazetted and proclaimed the date of the local government elections, allowing for the commencement of the electoral processes in terms of the election timetable.

src: Me die aankondiging is die kieserslys vir deelname aan die komende verkiesing ook nou gesluit.
tgt: The announcement also closes the voter’s roll for registration to participate in the upcoming elections.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom politieke partye se ondertekening van die Verkiesingskommissie se gedragskode waardeur hulle hul verbind om by die reëls te hou en 'n vry en regverdige verkiesing te verseker.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the signing of the Electoral Code of Conduct by political parties pledging to abide by the rules and ensure that elections are free and fair.

src: Dit dui aan dat ons demokrasie verdiep en besig is om volwassenheid te bereik.7 Die Kabinet verwelkom die 2016 Spesiale Vergadering van Nasionale Lede gehou deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Vereniging vir Plaaslike Regering (SAVPR).
tgt: This demonstrates our maturing and deepening democracy.7 Cabinet welcomes the 2016 Special National Members Assembly held by the South African Local Government Association (SALGA).

src: Dit gebeur te midde van die land se oorgang na die volgende termyn van plaaslike regering voor die 2016 munisipale verkiesings.
tgt: This comes as the country gears itself for a transition into the next term of local government ahead of the 2016 municipal elections.

src: Die vergadering fokus op vordering wat die afgelope 16 jaar en tydens hierdie termyn van plaaslike regering gemaak is.
tgt: The Assembly reflected on the progress made over the last 16 years and during this term of local government.

src: Die rol van plaaslike regering in die lewering van dienste en die herstel van menswaardigheid is ook onder die loep geneem.
tgt: The role of local government in the delivery of services and the restoration of human dignity was also profiled.

src: Sleuteluitdagings is ook bespreek en 'n herverbintenis tot die DKRTS se Terugkeer na die Basiese Beginsels-program is gemaak.
tgt: Key challenges were also addressed and a recommitment made to the COGTA Back to Basics programme.

src: Dit baan die weg vir die vierde demokratiese termyn van plaaslike regering deur 'n ondersteuningsprogram vir munisipaliteite te verskaf en die oorgang te bestuur om stabiliteit en ononderbroke dienslewering aan Suid-Afrikaners te verseker.8 Die Kabinet spreek sy kommer uit oor die ontwrigting in die Parlement, wat al meer voorkom en al hewiger raak.
tgt: This paves the way for the fourth democratic local government term by providing a support programme for municipalities and managing the transition to ensure stability and uninterrupted service provision to the people of South Africa.8 Cabinet expressed concern at the disruptions in Parliament, which are increasing in frequency and intensity.

src: Die Parlement is 'n instelling van ons demokrasie waarvoor ons hard geveg het en 'n openbare platform wat almal moet respekteer.9 Die Kabinet loof die werk van die Interministeriële Komitee onder leiding van die Minister van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake, Des van Rooyen, en die provinsiale taakspan, om normaliteit in Vuwani te herstel, maar neem kennis van die uitdagings wat steeds in ander gebiede voortduur.
tgt: Parliament is an institution of our hard fought democracy and a public platform which must be respected by all.9 Cabinet commends the work of the Inter-Ministerial Committee led by Minister of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs Des van Rooyen and the provincial task team to restore normality to Vuwani, while noting that challenges continue in some parts.

src: Die Regering het onverpoosd met gemeenskappe saamgewerk om kwessies op te los en dienste, insluitend onderwys, te herstel.
tgt: Government has worked tirelessly engaging communities in a bid to resolve issues and bring services, including education back into operation.

src: Die verskaffing van tydelike klaskamers het verseker dat akademiese aktiwiteite kon voortgaan.
tgt: The provision of temporary classrooms has ensured the resumption of academic activities.

src: Die Regering doen weer 'n beroep op gemeenskappe en leiers om kwessies deur middel van die regte kanale en platforms te hanteer wat daargestel is om dialoog te bewerkstellig.
tgt: Government again calls on communities and leaders to raise issues through channels and platforms which have been established to enable dialogue.

src: Dit kommerwekkende optrede om die opvoeding van ons kinders in gedrang te bring, is onaanvaarbaar.
tgt: This unprecedented action of holding the education of our children hostage is unacceptable.

src: Die Kabinet loof die wetstoepassingsagentskappe vir hul werk wat gelei het tot die inhegtenisneming van 34 mense, wat verdink word dat hulle aan die vernietiging van 28 skole deelgeneem het en die toekoms van die jong mense wat hierdie broodnodige geriewe wil gebruik, in gedrang gebring het.
tgt: Cabinet commends all law enforcement agencies for the work done which resulted in the arrest of 34 individuals, who are suspected of participating in the destruction of 28 schools, who in effect shattered the future of those young people who are still utilising these much needed facilities.

src: Die Kabinet loof die gemeenskappe en burgerlike organisasies wat ingespring het om op te ruim en geld in te samel om die skole te heropen.
tgt: Cabinet commends those communities and civil society organisations who rolled up their sleeves to clean up and raise funds to reopen local schools.

src: Ouers, voogde en die gemeenskap word versoek om leerders by te staan om hul werk in te haal volgens die geskeduleerde werkplan van die Departement van Basiese Onderwys.
tgt: All parents, guardians and community members are requested to assist children to catch up with the scheduled work plan of the Department of Basic Education.

src: Die IMK sal by belanghebbendes en gemeenskappe betrokke bly om te verseker dat die hele gebied kalm is en weer normaal funksioneer.10 Die Kabinet het besin oor die protesoptrede in Hammanskraal en aangedui dat die Departement van Meslike Nedersettings saam met die Gautengse Departement van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake en Meslike Nedersettings, asook die uitvoerende burgemeester van Tshwane, Raadslid Kgosientso Ramokgopa, gaan saamwerk om in die gebied in te gryp.
tgt: The IMC will continue to engage with stakeholders and communities to ensure that the entire area is calm and returns to normality.10 Cabinet deliberated on the protests in Hammanskraal and indicated that the Department of Human Settlements is leading an intervention in the area together with the Gauteng Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs and Human Settlements, and the Executive Mayor of Tshwane, Cllr Kgosientso Ramokgopa.

src: Die Kabinet betreur die dood van twee kontrakteurs wat betrokke was by die uitsettings in Hammanskraal en betuig sy innige meegevoel met die betrokke families.
tgt: Cabinet regrets the death of two contractors involved in the Hammanskraal removals and expresses its sympathy with the families of the bereaved.

src: Wetstoepassingsagentskappe moet die moordenaars vind en hulle aan die kaak stel.11 Die Kabinet wens die Suid-Afrikaanse Uitsaaikorporasie geluk met sy besluit om 90% plaaslike musiek oor al sy radiostasies uit te saai om plaaslike musiek te bevorder.
tgt: Law enforcement agencies should redouble their efforts to find the killers and bring them to justice.11 Cabinet congratulates the South African Broadcasting Corporation’s decision to play 90 per cent local music across all its radio stations so as to promote our home-grown content.

src: Die besluit weerspieël die Regering se uitsaaibeleid wat die kulturele en maatskaplike struktuur van Suid-Afrika beveilig, aanmoedig en versterk.
tgt: The decision reflects government’s broadcasting policy which encourages the safeguarding, enrichment and strengthening of the cultural and social fabric of South Africa.

src: Hierdie blootstelling dien ook as motivering vir alle opkomende Suid-Afrikaanse talent.
tgt: This exposure is also motivating to all the upcoming South African talent.

src: Die Kabinet moedig alle burgers aan om ons plaaslike musiekbedryf te ondersteun aangesien dit 'n beduidende bydrae tot die ekonomie sal maak en diverse kulture in die land sal bewaar.12 Die Kabinet neem kennis van die ondersoek oor nege buitelandse vissersbote deur die Departement van Landbou Bosbou en Visserye en prys die gekombineerde optrede saam met die Suid-Afrikaanse Vloot, die Departement van Visserye en die Suid-Afrikaanse Maritieme Veiligheidsowerheid wat daartoe gelei het dat vier van die vaartuie aangekeer is.
tgt: Cabinet encourages all citizens to support our local music industry which will make a significant contribution to the economy and preserve the country’s diverse cultures.12 Cabinet noted the investigation of nine foreign fishing vessels by Department of Agriculture Forestry and Fisheries and commends the combined operation involving the South African Navy, the Department of Fisheries and the South African Maritime Safety Authority which resulted in four of the vessels being arrested.

src: Dit dui op die erns waarmee die Regering ons territoriale en eksklusiewe ekonomiese sone beskerm.
tgt: The capturing of these vessels indicates our seriousness as a country to protect our territorial and exclusive economic zone.

src: Ons mariene hulpbronne is 'n bron van voedselsekerheid en speel 'n belangrike rol om die doelwitte van Operasie Phakisa na te kom en moet beskerm word.13 Die Kabinet verwelkom die vrystelling van die verslag van die ministeriële taakspan wat Minister Angie Motshekga aangestel het om bewerings oor die verkoop van poste van onderwysers deur lede van onderwysersvakbonde en departementele amptenare in provinsiale onderwysdepartemente te ondersoek.14 Die Kabinet wens die Suid-Afrikaaners geluk wat die 2016 Maatskaplike Entrepreneurstoekennings ontvang het.
tgt: Our marine resources are a source of food security and play a huge role in realising our goals in Operation Phakisa and must be protected.13 Cabinet welcomed the release of the report of the ministerial task team appointed by Minister Angie Motshekga to investigate allegations into the selling of posts of educators by members of teachers unions and departmental officials in provincial education departments.14 Cabinet congratulated the South African recipients, entrepreneur Luvuyo Rani and The Clothing Bank, who were among the winners of 2016 Social Entrepreneurs awards by the Schwab Foundation for Social Entrepreneurship which was presented at the fringes of the World Economic Forum (WEF) Africa, Kigali Rwanda.15 Cabinet salutes and extends its good wishes to the former Deputy Chief Justice Dikgang Moseneke who retired from the Bench after joining the Constitutional Court in 2002.

src: Ons het kennis geneem van die internasionale graderingsagentskappe Fitch, Standard & Poor's en Moody's se graderings vir Suid-Afrika, wat die land se beleggingsgraad-kredietgradering en stabiele vooruitsigte bevestig het.
tgt: We have noted the reviews by international rating agencies Fitch, Standard & Poor’s and Moody’s, which reaffirmed South Africa’s investment grade credit rating and maintained its stable outlook.

src: Die graderings bevestig die voortgesette werk deur die Regering om die ekonomie reg te ruk en gee die land die nodige ruimte om planne hiervoor uit te voer.
tgt: The rating reviews affirm the continuing work by government to turn the economy around and give the country the necessary space to continue implementing its intervention plans.

src: Die toegewyde werk van Suid-Afrikaners aangevoer deur die Regering, die sake- en arbeidsektore, het verseker dat Suid-Afrika rommelstatus vrygespring het.
tgt: The dedicated work of Team South Africa constituted by government, business and labour is ensuring that South Africa avoids a junk status rating.

src: Suid-Afrika is besig om programme van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP) in werking te stel wat sal verseker dat die land 'n beleggingsbestemming bly.
tgt: South Africa is implementing programmes from the National Development Plan (NDP) which will ensure that the country remains an investment destination.

src: Dit dui daarop dat as ons saamwerk, ons die ekonomie weer op dreef kan kry, beleggings lok en broodnodige werkgeleenthede vir Suid-Afrikaners skep.
tgt: This demonstrates that working together we can reignite our economy, attract investment and create much-needed jobs for South Africans.

src: Ondanks die feit dat Suid-Afrika se reële bruto binnelandse produk (BBP) in die eerste kwartaal van 2016 met 1,2% ingekrimp het, volgens syfers van Statistieke Suid-Afrika (SSA), is die Regering reeds besig met belangrike ingrypings in dié sektore wat die meeste geraak word, soos landbou, vervoer, elektrisiteit en mynbou, wat tans deur Operasie Phakisa aandag geniet, om beperkings op groei uit die weg te ruim.
tgt: Even though South Africa’s real gross domestic product (GDP) contracted by 1.2% in the first quarter of 2016, according to figures released by Statistics South Africa (Stats SA), government is already implementing key interventions in those sectors most impacted on such as agriculture, transport, electricity and mining, which are being addressed through Operation Phakisa, to unblock the constraints to growth.

src: Die sentralisering van skattings vir BBP is nou in SSA gevestig.
tgt: The centralisation of estimates for GDP is now located in Stats SHistorically, the responsibilities for the compilation and dissemination of South Africa’s system of national accounts were that Stats SA was responsible for the annual and quarterly production-based estimates of GDP while the South African Reserve Bank published the quarterly expenditure-based estimates of GDAs government we address the needs of citizens and working together we are changing the lives of South Africans.

src: Wat betref die verantwoordelikheid vir die jaarlikse en kwartaallikse samestelling en verspreiding van Suid-Afrika se nasionale rekeningstelsels, was SSA in die verlede verantwoordelik vir die jaarlikse en kwartaallikse produksiegebaseerde skattings van die BBP, terwyl die Suid-Afrikaanse Reserwebank die kwartaallikse uitgawes gegrond op skattings van die BBP, bekend gemaak het.
tgt: The R116-million water treatment plant in Steytlerville, outside Port Elizabeth in the Eastern Cape, will combat water shortages.

src: Die Regering gee aandag aan landsburgers se behoeftes en as ons saamwerk, kan ons die lewens van Suid-Afrikaners verander.
tgt: This was launched by the Department of Trade and Industry (the dti), through its Critical Infrastructure Programme, the Department of Water and Sanitation, and the Baviaans Local WEBTOKEN a water-scarce country, this new water treatment plant will create the capacity for the community and businesses to access about 24 litres per second from eight to 10 litres, which is sufficient to meet the water demand of Steytlerville for the next 15 years.

src: As deel van die Regering se Spoorvernuwingsprogram verwelkom die Kabinet die die Passasierspooragentskap van Suid-Afrika se toetsing van die nuwe X'Trapolis Mea-pendeltreine.
tgt: In better enabling small businesses National Treasury and the Black Business Council established a centre which will assist small businesses with registration on the Central Supplier Database (CSD), e-tender queries and other client services of National Treasury.

src: Ter ondersteuning van kleinsakeontwikkeling het die Tesourie en die Swart Besigheidsraad 'n instapsentrum daargestel wat kleinsakeondernemings sal bystaan met registrasie op die sentrale verskaffersdatabasis (SVD), e-tendernavrae en ander kliëntedienste van die nasionale Tesourie.
tgt: We encourage prospective and current service providers to register on the CSD, which is the source of all supplier information for all spheres of government.

src: Dit gaan administratiewe rompslomp aansienlik verminder en maak dit makliker vir sakeondernemings, veral kleinsakeondernemings, om by ekonomiese geleenthede te baat en tot die ontwikkeling van ons ekonomie en die land by te dra.
tgt: The purpose of centralising government’s supplier database is to reduce duplication of effort and cost for both supplier and government while enabling electronic procurement processes.

src: Die adviesraad sal in noue samewerking met die Presidensiële Profssionele Werkgroep, wat deur President Jacob Zuma in die lewe geroep is, verseker dat kwessies wat swart professionele mense raak, aandag genietDie vergadering is nog 'n aanduiding van die gees van eenheid en samewerking om inklusiewe ekonomiese groei te stimuleer, met inagneming van die doel van SEB, sodat ons vordering kan maak met transformasie en 'n nie-rassige ekonomie.
tgt: The 5th Annual Waste Management Khoro, led by the Minister of Environmental Affairs under the theme “Promoting Innovation and Upscaling Enterprise Development” aims to improve service delivery, ensure the fast turnaround of waste-management programmes to promote the recycling economy, while bringing more of our communities into the mainstream economy, by accelerating access to job opportunities in the waste sector.

src: Suid-Afrika gaan vir die eerste keer aan 'n tweedaagse VIII Internasionale Inligtingstegnologieforum in Khanty-Mansiysk, Rusland, deelneem en deur Minister Faith Muthambi teenwoordig word.
tgt: The release of the local government audit outcomes for 2014/15 shows an improvement of audit results by municipalities from 2010/11 to 2014/15.The number of municipalities that received financially unqualified audit opinions with no findings increased from 13 to Furthermore, 18 additional municipal entities also achieved a clean audit status, taking the total number of clean audits to 72 in the current period.

src: Die forum vind vanaf 8 tot 9 Junie 2016 plaas en gebruik wetenskap en tegnologie om van die grootste uitdagings in ons onderwys- en gesondheidstelsels die hoof te bied.
tgt: There was a significant reduction in adverse and disclaimed opinions, which decreased from over 30% in 2010/11 to about 11% of municipalities in the current period.

src: Afgevaardigdes by die forum sluit in verteenwoordigers van die sakesektor, professionele verenigings, navorsers, opvoedkundiges en IT-kundiges van BRICS-lidlande (Brasilië, Rusland, Indië, China en Suid-Afrika).
tgt: This improvement in the audit outcomes of municipalities has been the result of the Back to Basics Programme, Operation Clean Audit, decisive leadership, improved financial and performance management and record keeping.

src: Die 5de jaarlikse Afvalbestuur-khoro, oftewel konferensie, onder leiding van die Minister van Omgewingsake onder die tema "Die bevordering van innovering en Stimulering van Ondernemingsontwikkeling" het ten doel om dienslewering te verbeter en 'n snelle ommeswaai van afvalbestuursprogramme te weeg te bring, om sodoende die ekonomie te stimuleer, en om meer gemeenskappe by die hoofekonomie te betrek, deur toegang tot werksgeleenthede in die afvalsektor te versnel.
tgt: Cabinet noted the judgement by the Supreme Court of Appeal declaring the Digital Broadcasting Migration Policy in 2015 unlawful, invalid and setting it aside.

src: President Zuma sal die opening van die die Nasionale Jeugdag-verrigtinge by Orlando-stadion in Soweto op 16 Junie 2016 waarneem, onder die tema: "Die jeug neem Suid-Afrika vorentoe".Hoogtepunte sluit in die President se toespraak en die kranslegging by die Hector Pieterson-gedenkteken.
tgt: Government, led by the Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs (CoGTA), is working with the Institutions of Traditional Leadership and all stakeholders to ensure that the 2016 initiation season pursues “Zero Deaths” which is driven through a theme – “We Love Our Tradition, We Value Life of Our Youth”.Families, parents and legal guardians must ensure that the young men only choose legally operating initiation schools, where pre-screening is done, and surgeons are well trained and well known by parents.

src: Ministers en adjunkministers was druk besig om deur die loop van die maand met mense, veral die jeug, gesprek te voer en hulle aan te moedig om geleenthede in verskeie sektore aan te gryp sodat hulle hul lewens kan verbeter en doeltreffend tot die ontwikkeling van die ekonomie en die land kan bydra.
tgt: The United Nation’s Secretary-General’s (UNSG) Advisory Board on Water and Sanitation recommended the establishment of a select Heads of State High Level Panel on Water to lead the advocacy initiative on water and adaptation, following the adoption of the 2030 Development Agenda by the UNSG in September 2015.The panel will accelerate the implementation of the Sustainable Development Goal 6 (clean water and sanitation), which has renewed focus on the profound impact of climate change on the water cycle.

src: Die Regering, onder leiding van die Departement van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake (DKRTS), werk saam met instansies en belanghebbendes in tradisionele leierskap aan die Geen Sterftes-veldtog met die tema "Ons koester ons tradisie, ons waardeer die lewens van ons jeug", om te verseker dat daar geen sterftes in die 2016 inisiasie-seisoen sal wees nie.
tgt: The effects of Desertification, Land Degradation and Drought impede efforts aimed at poverty eradication, safeguarding food security, enhancing water quality and quantity, resilience and adaptation to climate change as well as achieving sustainable WEBTOKEN this regard, South Africa has introduced a number of legislative tools, policies, strategies and practical programmes aimed at addressing desertification and land degradation at all levels.

src: Gesinne, ouers en voogde moet seker maak dat die jong mans slegs wettige inisiasieskole besoek, waar voorafgoedkeuring gedoen is, chirurge goed opgelei is en aan ouers bekend is.
tgt: These interventions contribute to conservation and socio-economic upliftment while creating job opportunities, skills development and enhancing livelihoods.

src: Daarbenewens skep dit werkgeleenthede, bevorder vaardigheidsontwikkeling en verbeter mense se lewensbestaan.
tgt: It will ensure that such groups have access to a specified core basket of social development services required to improve their standard of living and enhance their social welfare.

src: Dit sal die hersiene Witskrif vir Maatskaplike Welsyn bespoedig, wat fokus op die Regering se prioriteit om sorgsame, volhoubare en veilige gemeenskappe wat saamstaan te bou.
tgt: This is aligned to the NDP’s objectives of promoting innovation, improved productivity, more intensive pursuit of a knowledge economy and better exploitation of comparative and competitive advantage.

src: Die aanbevelings fokus op die prioriteite in die NOP, wat maatskaplike beskerming en ontwikkelingsgerigte maatskaplike welsyn beskou as 'n progressiewe manier om maatskaplike ontwikkeling te bereik.
tgt: The current policy revision is based on the need to align the Intellectual Property legislation with the digital era and developments at a multilateral level.

src: Dit is toegeken uit erkenning vir sy bydrae tot samewerking tussen Duitsland en Suid-Afrika tydens sy termyn as Minister van Wetenskap en Tegnologie.
tgt: He won the Africa Cup of Nations as both a player and coach, and contributed to soccer in Africa and the world.

src: e. Die Kabinet wens ook alle praktiserende Moslems 'n geseënde Ramadaan toe.
tgt: g. We also join the global community in paying tribute to the former heavyweight boxing champion and international sports icon Muhammad Ali.

src: Implementering van belangrike Regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of key government programmes.

src: Die kabinet het die vorderingsverslae oor die inwerkingstelling van die Regering se Program van Aksie en die uitkomste daarvan bespreek.
tgt: Cabinet deliberated on the fourth quarter progress reports of the implementation of the government Programme of Action (PoA) and the outcomes.

src: Die Regering maak goeie vordering om uitdagings die hoof te bied en gryp in om probleme met die inwerkingstelling van die plan van aksie uit die weg te ruim.
tgt: Government is making progress by addressing challenges and intervening to close the gaps in the implementation of the PoA.

src: Die Regering is daarvan oortuig dat dit vordering maak met die uitvoering van die Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk, en die Negepuntplan, asook om uiteindelik Visie 2030 van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP) te bereik.
tgt: Government is confident that it is making headway in the execution of the Medium Term Strategic Framework, Nine-Point Plan and ultimately achieve Vision 2030 of the National Development Plan (NDP).Government Communications (GCIS) is in the process of coordinating the PoA report-back media briefings to keep the nation informed.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die uitkomste van die Presidensiële Arbeidswerkgroep, wat op 21 Junie 2016 vergader het om die ekonomie en ander sosio-ekonomiese kwessies te bespreek.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the outcomes from the Presidential Labour Working Group, which met on 21 June 2016 to discuss the economy and other socio-economic issues.

src: Die werkgroep het ooreengekom om sy verbintenis tot samewerking te herbevestig om die uitdagings waarmee Suid-Afrika te kampe het, soos voorheen, die hoof te bied.
tgt: The meeting agreed to reaffirm its commitment to work together to overcome challenges facing South Africa as we have done so previously.

src: Ons moet voortbou op die vennootskappe en solidariteit wat ons in 2008 gesmee het toe ons en ons maatskaplike vennote 'n ooreenkoms bereik het wat werkers teen die wêreldwye ekonomiese krisis sou beskerm.
tgt: We need to build on the partnerships and solidarity forged in 2008 when social partners crafted a pact that protected workers from the global economic crisis.

src: Tydens die vergadering is besluit dat die beskerming van werk voorkeur moet geniet, dat werk geskep moet word – veral vir jong mense – en dat werktoestande vir alle werkers verbeter moet word om 'n beter lewe vir almal te skep.
tgt: The meeting resolved that priority must be to protect jobs, create more decent jobs – especially for young people – and improve working conditions of all workers in order to create a better life for all.

src: Die Regering en arbeid se beplande werkberaad sal Suid-Afrikaners in staat stel om aan gesprekke deel te neem oor hoe ons werk kan skep en die ekonomie kan laat groei te midde van die huidige moeilike ekonomiese klimaat.
tgt: The planned Jobs Summit by government and labour will allow South Africans to discuss how we can create jobs and grow our economy in the tough current economic climate.

src: Die Kabinet spreek sy opregte dank teenoor alle Suid-Afrikaners uit wat die 40ste herdenking van die Soweto-opstande gevier het, waartydens ons die heldhaftige stryd van jong mense in 1976 gedenk het.
tgt: Cabinet expresses its sincere gratitude and thanks to all South Africans who paid tribute and took time to honour the 40th Anniversary of the Soweto uprisings, which represents the heroic struggles of young people of 1976.

src: Nasionale Jeugdag is herdenk onder die tema "Die jeug neem Suid-Afrika vorentoe".President Jacob Zuma het op 16 Junie die nasionale herdenking by die Orlando-stadion gelei.
tgt: The National Youth Day was commemorated under the theme “Youth Moving South Africa Forward”.The national commemoration, which was led by President Jacob Zuma at Orlando Stadium on 16 June, was one of the events which were held across the country to honour the legacy of the 1976 generation.

src: Die Regering het ons land se jongmense gerus gestel dat die stryd om toegang tot onderwys vir almal 'n prioriteit vir die Regering bly.
tgt: Government reassures the young people of our country that the struggle for access to education for all remains a government priority.

src: Die Regering sal nie rus voordat hierdie doel bereik is nie.
tgt: Government will not rest until it has achieved this objective as reflected in the Freedom Charter and enshrined in the Bill of Rights in our Constitution, which this year marks 20 years of its adoption.

src: Dit is immers verskans in die Vryheidsmanifes en in die Meseregtehandves van die Grondwet, wat vanjaar 20 jaar oud is.
tgt: The continuing month-long programme has various initiatives by government, business and civil society elevating issues of youth through various activities.

src: Die voortgesette maand lange program behels verskeie inisiatiewe deur die Regering, die sakesektor en die burgerlike samelewing, en ge aandag verskeie kwessies waaroor die jeug ongelukkig is.
tgt: South Africa successfully hosted the 60th Consumer Goods Forum (CGF) Annual Global Summit, which was addressed by Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa.

src: Suid-Afrika het die 60ste Verbruikersgoedereforum (VGF) se jaarlikse wêreldspitsberaad suksesvol aangebied.
tgt: This reinforces the continent’s emergence as a consumer market which presents new WEBTOKEN South Africa, the consumer goods industry remains a major driver of economic growth.

src: Die land se sakeomgewing is stabiel en lewendig en help om handel en belegging aan te spoor.
tgt: The country’s business environment is stable, vibrant and conducive to increased trade and investment.

src: Plaaslike en buitelandse beleggings word beskerm deur toepaslike wetgewing.
tgt: Local and foreign investments are protected by relevant legal prescripts.
