src: Verskeie Suid-Afrikaanse maatskappye en internasionale konglomerate wat lede van die VGF is, dryf handel en belê in Suid-Afrika, wat tot die groei van die ekonomie asook werkskepping bydra.
tgt: Various South African companies and international conglomerates that are members of the CGF are trading and investing in South Africa, contributing to the growth of our economy and job creation.

src: Die nuwe handelsooreenkoms wat die Minister van Handel en Nywerheid, Rob Davies, met die Europese Unie (EU) onderteken het, word verwelkom.
tgt: The new trade deal that was signed by Trade and Industry Minister Rob Davies with the European Union (EU) was welcomed.

src: Dit sal beteken dat meer Suid-Afrikaanse landbouprodukte na Europa uitgevoer kan word.
tgt: This will see more South African agricultural products being exported to Europe.

src: Suid-Afrika het saam met Botswana, Lesotho, Mosambiek, Namibië en Swaziland die Ekonomiese Vennootskapsooreenkoms (EVO) onderteken wat met die EU beding is.
tgt: South Africa together with Botswana, Lesotho, Mozambique, Namibia and Swaziland signed the Economic Partnership Agreement (EPA) that was negotiated with the EU.

src: Die EVO sal dit makliker maak om Suid-Afrikaanse produkte, insluitende wyn, suiker en etanol, in Europa te bemark.
tgt: The EPA provides improved market access opportunities for South African products, including a significant improvement in quota for wine and new market access for sugar and ethanol.

src: Ingevolge die nuwe ooreenkoms sal die belastingvrye uitvoer van Suid-Afrikaanse wyn na die EU na verwagting verdubbel.
tgt: Under the new agreement, South Africa’s duty-free wine exports to the EU are expected to double.

src: Die oorsprongreëls met betrekking tot klerasie is ook vereenvoudig en sal die uitvoer van Suid-Afrikaanse klere na die EU bevorder.
tgt: The Rules of Origin on clothing have also been simplified and will encourage South African clothing exports to the EU.

src: Die EVO vervang die hoofstuk oor handel in die Ooreenkoms oor Handelsontwikkeling en Samewerking wat in 2000 tussen die EU en Suid-Afrika onderteken is.
tgt: The EPA replaces the trade chapter in the Trade Development and Cooperation Agreement, signed in 2000, between the EU and South Africa.

src: Die ooreenkoms maak ook voorsiening vir die beskerming van Suid-Afrikaanse geografiese aanduidings hoofsaaklik met betrekking tot Suid-Afrikaanse wynname, rooibos, heuningtee en Karoolam.
tgt: The agreement also provides for the protection of South African geographic indications which include mainly South African wine names, Rooibos, Honeybush and Karoo lamb.

src: Die belegging van R500 miljoen in ’n sentrum vir innovering in Johannesburg deur die Verenigde State se multinasionale maatskappy General Electric (GE), word verwelkom en dui daarop dat Suid-Afrika en die res van die vasteland 'n lewensvatbare beleggingsbestemming is.
tgt: The investment of a R500-million innovation centre in Johannesburg by the United States multinational, General Electric (GE), was welcomed and is a demonstration that South Africa and the continent are viable investment destinations.

src: Dit is die 10de sentrum van sy soort in die wêreld en die eerste in Afrika.
tgt: This is the group’s 10th such centre globally and its first in Africa.

src: Die gebou is ook die nuwe hoofkwartier van GE Healthcare, waar verskeie gesondheidsorgtegnologiëe ten toon gestel word.
tgt: The building is also the new headquarters for GE Healthcare, which showcases various healthcare technologies.

src: Dit bewys GE se langtermynverbintenis tot die vasteland en om innoverende oplossings vir Afrika se infrastruktuur- en gesondheidsorguitdagings te vind.
tgt: This demonstrates GE’s long-term commitment to both the continent and to finding innovative solutions to Africa’s infrastructure and healthcare problems.

src: Die sentrum het ten doel om die loopbaanaspirasies van meer as 100 ingenieurs uit voorheen benadeelde agtergronde te verbeter.
tgt: The centre aims to enhance the career aspirations of over 100 engineers from previously disadvantaged backgrounds.

src: Daar is ook voorsiening gemaak vir gesamentlike projekte en die prototipering van oplossings – 'n vennootskap tussen Transnet en GE vir die lokalisering van verskeie spoorprojekte.
tgt: Space has also been allocated for collaborative projects and solution prototyping with Transnet partnering with GE on various rail localisation projects.

src: Die sentrum streef ook daarna om klein ondernemings te ontwikkel sodat hulle die plaaslike mark en moontlik GE se wêreldvoorsieningsketting kan voorsien.
tgt: The centre also aspires to support the development of small businesses capable of supplying the local market and potentially GE’s global supply chains.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle ander multinasionale ondernemings om GE se voorbeeld te volg.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all other multinationals to emulate the example set by GCabinet welcomes the completion of the first phase of the revitalised Botshabelo Industrial Park in the Free State, which was launched by Minister Davies.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die voltooiing van die eerste fase van die verbeterde Botshabelo Nywerheidspark in die Vrystaat, wat deur Minister Davies van stapel gestuur is.
tgt: The first phase of the revitalisation includes the security infrastructure upgrade, fencing, street lighting and critical electricity requirements at a cost of R24 million.

src: Dit is deel van die R189 miljoen wat in ses geprioritiseerde parke belê is en verband hou met die Nywerheidsbeleidaksieplan (NBAP).
tgt: This is part of the R189 million invested in covering six prioritised parks linked to the Industrial Policy Action Plan (IPAP).

src: Die Botshabelo Nywerheidspark sal werk skep vir die mense van Botshabelo en omliggende gebiede.
tgt: The Botshabelo Industrial Park will create employment for the people of Botshabelo and surrounding areas, promote industrialisation and the growth of small businesses and cooperatives, attract investments and encourage manufacturing.

src: Dit sal ook industrialisering en die groei van klein ondernemings en koöperasies bevorder, beleggings lok en vervaardiging aanmoedig.
tgt: In responding to the water needs of the Moqhaka Local Municipality, Cabinet welcomes the launch of the Kroonstad Waste Water Treatment Works by the Minister of Water and Sanitation, Ms Nomvula Mokonyane.

src: Die gebied gaan gebuk onder droogte en lae watervlakke wat al kritieke status bereik.
tgt: The area has been plagued by the recent drought and has seen water levels reaching critical status.

src: Ingrypings vir die kort- en mediumtermyn-pogings sluit in die boor van nuwe boorgate en die verbetering van bestaande boorgate in Kroonstad om watervoorsiening in die gebied aan te vul.
tgt: Water tankers have been handed over and short and medium-term efforts include drilling and refurbishing boreholes in Kroonstad to augment the supply of water.

src: President Zuma het die 6de Gewone Spitsberaad van die Internasionale Konferensie van die Groot Mee-streek (IKGMS) met die tema "Versnelling van die doeltreffende implementering van die verdrag en sy protokolle vir 'n meer demokratiese en stabiele Groot Mee-streek" bygewoon.
tgt: President Zuma attended the 6th Ordinary Summit of International Conference of the Great Lakes Region (ICGLR) themed: “Accelerating the effective implementation of the Pact and its Protocols for a more democratic and stable Great Lakes Region”.

src: Afgevaardigdes het die politieke en veiligheidsituasie in die Groot Mee-streek, insluitend Suid-Soedan, Burundi, die Demokratiese Republiek van die Kongo en die Republiek van Sentraal-Afrika bespreek.
tgt: The summit discussed, amongst other issues, the political and security situation in the Great Lakes Region including South Sudan, Burundi, the Democratic Republic of Congo and Central African Republic, and a full report of the ICGLR Summit will be presented at the next African Union (AU) Summit.

src: 'n Volledige verslag van die IKGMS-spitsberaad sal tydens die volgende Afrika-unie-spitsberaad voorgelê word.
tgt: President Zuma said there was now an increasing glimmer of hope that the previously intractable issues of conflict and instability in the Great Lakes Region would be resolved.

src: Die Nasionale Studente Finansiële Hulpskema (NSFHS) het sedert sy ontstaan al meer as 1,7 miljoen studente wat tersiêre onderrig ontvang, bygestaan.
tgt: The National Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS) has funded over million tertiary education students since its inception.

src: Die skema bied finansiële hulp aan studente uit behoeftige en werkersklasgesinne.
tgt: The scheme provides financial aid to students from poor and working class families.

src: Om volhoubaarheid te verseker, vorder die NSFHS die terugbetaling van lenings in.
tgt: To ensure that this is done in a sustainable manner, NSFAS collects student loan repayments.

src: Die terugbetalings verseker dat die skema fondse beskikbaar het vir toekomstige studente.
tgt: The repayments ensure that the scheme has funds available for future generations of students.

src: Dit bevorder toegang tot en sukses in hoër en verdere onderwys en opleiding in navolging van Suid-Afrika se doelwitte rakende nasionale en menslikehulpbronontwikkeling.
tgt: This promotes access to, and success in, higher and further education and training, in pursuit of South Africa’s national and human resource development goals.

src: Die Kabinet moedig alle NSFHS-begunstigdes wat werk het aan om met die NSFAS in verbinding te tree en reëlings vir terugbetaling van hul lenings te tref.
tgt: Cabinet encourages all NSFAS beneficiaries who are employed to contact NSFAS offices and start repaying their NSFAS loans.

src: Dit is jou verantwoordelikheid om jou deel te doen om ander studente te help wat nou finansiële hulp nodig het.
tgt: It is your responsibility to play your part in helping other students who are now in need of financial aid.

src: Sleutelkabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die alternatiewe Internet-inisiatief genaamd digitale voorwerpargitektuur (DVA) om die bestuur van inligting te verbeter.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the alternative Internet initiative to improve information management, called the Digital Object Architecture (DOA).

src: Die Kabinet het verdere belegging goedgekeur vir die ontwikkeling en benutting van die DVA-inisiatief en vir Suid-Afrika om 'n multiprimêre administrateur van die globale DVA-netwerk te wees.
tgt: Cabinet approved further investment in the development and uptake of the DOA initiative and for South Africa to be a Multi-Primary Administrator of the global DOA network.

src: Hierdie tegnologie help om die NOP se doelwitte te bereik deur die Staat se kapasiteit te verbeter om innoverende oplossings vir ingewikkelde uitdagings te vind.
tgt: This technology contributes towards achieving the goals of the NDP by enhancing the capacity of the State to find innovative solutions to complex challenges.

src: Dit verbeter ook dienslewering deur middel van programme soos e-Regering en kubersekerheid.
tgt: It also enhances service delivery through programmes such as e-government and cybersecurity.

src: Die voordele verbonde aan die gebruik van DVA om inligting te bestuur sal nuwe plaaslike vermoëns in internettegnologie bevorder en pasgemaakte sagtewareoplossings gegrond op oopbron-sagteware ontwikkel.
tgt: The benefits of using DOA to manage information will grow and build new local capabilities in Internet technology and develop tailor-made software solutions based on Open-Source Software.

src: Dit sal bydra tot die ontwikkeling van die plaaslike sagtewarebedryf en die verbetering van inligtingsbestuurstelsels en uitvoerverdienste.
tgt: This will contribute to developing both the local software industry and improving information management systems and export earnings.

src: 'n Verdere voordeel is dat die DVA versoenbaar is met die meeste bestaande argitektuur op die internet.
tgt: A further benefit is that the DOA is compatible and interoperable with most existing architectures within the Internet.

src: Dit sal die Regering in staat stel om herhalende koste van sagtewarestelsels uit te skakel.
tgt: This will enable government to cut on the recurring costs of proprietary software systems.

src: Na aanleiding van 'n versoek van die AU-kommissie, het die Kabinet goedgekeur dat Suid-Afrika die Afrika-Internetbestuursforum (AIBF) in Oktober 2016 aanbied.
tgt: Following a request from the AU Commission, Cabinet approved for South Africa to host the African Internet Governance Forum (IGF) in October 2016.

src: Internetbestuur dek verskeie maatskaplike en politieke kwessies.
tgt: Internet Governance covers a wide range of social and political issues.

src: Dit sluit in deelname aan die aanlyn-ekonomie, intellektuele eiendom, kuberveiligheid en privaatheid, en toegang tot belangrike tegniese hulpbronne, soos domeinname en internetprotokol-adresse wat internetdienste moontlik maak.
tgt: These include participation in the online economy, intellectual property, cyber-security and privacy and access to key technical resources, such as domain names and Internet Protocol addresses that make Internet services WEBTOKEN the African IGF provides a platform for Africa to develop strategies for participation in the global Internet economy which is critical for the development of economies in Africa.

src: Die internetekonomie in Suid-Afrika is tans sowat R59 miljard werd.
tgt: Currently the Internet economy is worth around R59 billion in South Africa.

src: Die forum bied ook 'n platform vir regerings in Afrika om doelgerig 'n gemeenskaplike posisie oor internetbestuur in te neem.
tgt: The forum also provides a platform for African governments to set the agenda to adopt a common position on Internet Governance.

src: Dit volg op die uitkomste van die Wêreldspitsberaad van die Verenigde Nasies se Algemene Vergadering in Desember 2015 oor die Hoëvlakoorsig van die Inligtingsgemeenskap.
tgt: This follows the outcomes from the United Nations General Assembly World Summit on the Information Society High Level Review in December 2015.This reaffirms the Tunis Declaration, that Internet Governance is a global resource that should be managed in a multilateral, transparent and democratic process, with the full involvement of all stakeholders.

src: Dit herbevestig die Tunisië-verklaring, ingevolge waarvan internetbestuur 'n internasionale hulpbron is wat in 'n multilaterale, deursigtige en demokratiese proses bestuur moet word en alle belanghebbendes ten volle moet betrek.
tgt: African governments will also have an opportunity to engage on critical components of the Internet value chain with a view to promote the equitable distribution and use of Internet resources.

src: Komende gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: President Zuma het op 23 Junie die Vulindlela Landelik Verbeterde Volksbehuisingsproses (EPHP) in die Umsunduzi Plaaslike Munisipaliteit in KwaZulu-Natal besoek ter viering van die meer as vier miljoen huise en behuisingsubsidies sedert die begin van demokrasie in 1994.Die Regering het in KwaZulu-Natal meer as 700 000 huise en subsidies gelewer, insluitend 12 000 huise in die Vulindlela Landelike Behuisingsprojek wat deur die EPHP gebou word.
tgt: Today, 23 June 2016 President Zuma is visiting Vulindlela Rural Enhanced People’s Housing Process (EPHP) in Umsunduzi Local Municipality in KwaZulu-Natal to celebrate the delivery of more than four million government houses and subsidies since the dawn of our democracy in WEBTOKEN KwaZulu-Natal, government has delivered over 700 000 houses and subsidies including 12 000 units in the Vulindlela Rural Housing Project which were built through the EPHThe EPHP is a process where beneficiaries are actively involved in the decision-making over the housing process and product, and play a role in the building of their houses.

src: President Zuma onderneem tussen 10 en 12 Julie 2016 'n staatsbesoek aan Frankryk om verhoudings tussen die twee lande verder te verbeter.
tgt: President Zuma will undertake a State Visit to France between 10 and 12 July 2016, as part of further strengthening relations between the two countries.

src: Die President sal onder meer op 12 Julie 2016 die honderdjarige herdenking van die Slag van Delvillebos bywoon.
tgt: During the visit the President will attend the Centenary Commemoration of the Battle of Delville Wood of World War I, on 12 July 2016, where many South African soldiers lost their lives.

src: Die slag, wat tydens die Eerste Wêreldoorlog plaasgevind het, het baie Suid-Afrikaanse soldate se lewens geëis.
tgt: While the Delville Wood Memorial is dedicated to South African soldiers, the apartheid government’s policies at the time excluded black South Africans who died during the war while their white counterparts were buried at the Delville Wood Memorial.

src: Hoewel die Delvillebos-gedenkteken aan gesneuwelde Suid-Afrikaanse soldate gewy is, het die beleid van die apartheidsregering swart Suid-Afrikaners wat tydens die oorlog gesneuwel het, uitgesluit terwyl hul wit eweknieë by die Delvillebos-gedenkteken begrawe is.
tgt: The memorial is undergoing a significant transformation to reflect the historical role played by black South Africans in the First and Second World Wars and to accord them the necessary recognition.

src: In die lig hiervan gaan die President ook by Arques-la-Bataille aan swart soldate hulde bring.
tgt: In this regard, the President will also pay tribute to black soldiers at Arques-la-Bataille.

src: President Zuma sal vanaf 13 tot 17 Julie 2016 'n Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging na die 27ste Gewone Sessie van die Vergadering van die AU, in Kigali, Rwanda lei.
tgt: President Zuma will lead a South African delegation to the 27th Ordinary Session of the Assembly of the AU, scheduled to take place from 13 to 17 July 2016 in Kigali, Rwanda.

src: Die beraad vind plaas onder die tema "2016, Jaar van Meseregte in Afrika met spesifieke klem op die Regte van die Vrou."
tgt: The summit will take place under the theme: “2016, African Year of Human Rights with a particular focus on Women’s Rights.” The year 2016 marks important milestones in the continental and global women’s agenda for gender equality and women empowerment.

src: In die jaar 2016 vind belangrike mylpale op die vasteland en oor die wêreld heen plaas, wat handel oor die vrou, geslagsgelykheid en die bemagtiging van vroue.
tgt: Continentally, it is the 30th anniversary of the coming into force of the African Charter on Human and People’s Rights in 1986 and the beginning of the second phase of the African Women’s Decade 2010-2020.

src: Dit is die 30ste herdenking van die inwerkingtreding van die Afrika-handves oor Meseregte in 1986 en die begin van die tweede fase van Afrika se Vroue-dekade 2010-2020.Wêreldwyd word 36 jaar sedert die aanvaarding van die VN se Konvensie oor die Uitwissing van alle vorme van Diskriminasie teen Vroue gevier.
tgt: Globally, 2016 commemorates 36 years since the adoption of the UN Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women and the 21st anniversary of the 1995 Beijing Declaration and Platform for Action, which is the key global policy on gender equality.

src: Staatshoofde en die Regering gaan die verslag van AU-vrede-en-veiligheidsraad bespreek om vrede op die vasteland te bewerkstellig.
tgt: The Heads of State and Government will consider the report of the AU Peace and Security Council on the state of peace in Africa.

src: Daarbenewens gaan die AU se voorgestelde begroting vir 2017 bespreek en goedkeur word.
tgt: Furthermore, the summit will consider and approve the AU’s 2017 proposed budget.

src: President Zuma lei op 28 Junie 2016 'n Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging na die buitengewone beraad van die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap (SAOG) in Gaborone, Botswana.
tgt: President Zuma will also lead a South African government delegation to the Extra-Ordinary Summit of the Southern African Development Community (SADC) Double Troika, to be held in Gaborone, Republic of Botswana on 28 June 2016.

src: Die beraad sal na verwagting die politieke en veiligheidsituasie in die SAOG-streek bespreek, met besondere aandag aan die situasie in Lesotho.
tgt: The summit is expected to consider the political and security situation in the SADC region, paying particular attention to the situation in the Kingdom of Lesotho.

src: Die land is gereed om die 21ste Internasionale Wêreldvigskonferensie van 18 tot 22 Julie 2016 in die Inkosi Albert Luthuli Internasionale Konferensiesentrum in Durban aan te bied.
tgt: The country is ready to host the 21st International World Aids Conference from 18 to 22 July 2016 at the Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre in Durban.

src: Die begin van die konferensie val saam met Internasionale Nelson Mandeladag op 18 Julie.
tgt: The beginning of the conference coincides with Nelson Mandela International Day on 18 July.

src: Suid-Afrikaners word aangemoedig om ons storie te deel en die positiewe ommeswaai in Suid-Afrika sedert die internasionale vigskonferensie in Durban in 2000 aangebied is, ten toon te stel.
tgt: South Africans are encouraged to share our story and showcase the positive turnaround in South Africa since the International AIDS Conference was last hosted in Durban in 2000.South Africa has invested heavily in its AIDS response in the last six years, resulting in the largest HIV-treatment programme in the world, which has saved millions of lives and increased life expectancy.

src: Suid-Afrika het oor die afgelope ses jaar baie gedoen om vigs te bestry dit het tot die grootste MIV-behandelingsprogram ter wêreld gelei, wat miljoene mense se lewens gered het en lewensverwagting merkbaar laat styg het.
tgt: Other achievements include the HIV Counselling and Testing (HCT) Campaign that tested 18 million South Africans for HIV and AIDS within a period of 18 months, with 10 million South Africans testing annually.

src: Ander prestasies sluit in die veldtog vir MIV-berading en -toetsing waardeur 18 miljoen Suid-Afrikaners binne die bestek van 18 maande vir MIV en vigs getoets is en waardeur 10 miljoen Suid-Afrikaners deurgaans jaarliks ​​getoets word.
tgt: AIDS-related deaths in South Africa declined from 320 000 in 2010 to 140 000 in 2014, and mother-to-child transmission of HIV was reduced from 70 000 babies in 2004 to less than 7 000 in 2015.TB is a key link and although TB deaths have declined from 70 000 in 2009 to less than 40 000 in 2014.

src: TB is 'n belangrike skakel en hoewel TB-sterftes van 70 000 in 2009 tot minder as 40 000 in 2014 gedaal het, bly TB die grootste oorsaak van dood van alle aansteeklike siektes in ons land en in die wêreld.
tgt: TB remains the biggest killer of all infectious diseases in our country and globally.

src: Die Regering het duisende mense in die kwesbare sektore van korrektiewe dienste, mynwese en semi-myngemeenskappe suksesvol gekeur.
tgt: Government has successfully screened thousands of people in the vulnerable sectors of correctional services, mining and peri-mining communities.

src: Die voorkomingsprogram prioritiseer meisies en jong vroue in die ouderdomsgroep 15 tot 24 jaar en het ten doel om infeksies, tienerswangerskappe, en seksuele en geslagsgebaseerde geweld te verminder, asook om meisies tot matriek in die skool te hou, ekonomiese geleenthede vir jong vroue te skep en hul weg te hou van ouer mans.
tgt: The prevention programme also prioritises girls and young women in the age group 15-24 years and aims to reduce infections reduce teenage pregnancy reduce sexual and gender-based violence keep girls in school until matric and increase economic opportunities for young women to try and wean them away from predatory older men.

src: Die Regering vier van 22 en 26 Junie 2016 Staatsdiensweek wat deel is van Batho Pele-program (Mese Eerste).
tgt: Government is currently observing the Public Service Week from the 22 and 26 June 2016, which is part of government’s Batho Pele (People First) programme.

src: Die bevordering van goeie etiek, hoë moreel en trots onder staatsamptenare bevorder die lewering van hoë gehalte dienste.
tgt: The promotion of good ethics, high morale and pride in public servants encourages the culture of providing quality services.

src: Die Regering neem ook kennis dat ons vandag, 23 Junie 2016, Afrikastaatsdiensdag, vier, wat verskillende regeringsfere aanspoor om saam te werk en beperkte hulpbronne meer doeltreffend te gebruik om beter resultate te lewer.
tgt: Government also notes that today, 23 June 2016 is Africa Public Service Day, which encourages different spheres of government to work together and make more efficient use of limited government resources for improved results.

src: Die Kabinet moedig alle staatsamptenare aan om aan die voorpunt van dienslewering in die land te wees en die week te gebruik om innoverende maniere te vind om dienste aan Suid-Afrikaners te lewer.
tgt: Cabinet encourages public servants to be at the forefront of the country’s service delivery and to use the week to explore innovative ways to provide services to South Africans.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die besluit van die Munisipale Afbakeningsraad om 'n konferensie oor afbakening en ruimtelike transformasie op 23 en 24 Junie 2016 aan te bied.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the decision by the Municipal Demarcation Board to host a conference on Demarcation and Spatial Transformation on 23 and 24 June 2016.

src: Afgevaardigdes van staatsdepartemente en plaaslike munisipaliteite, asook uit ander lande sal die konferensie bywoon.
tgt: The conference will include delegates from government departments, municipalities, as well as other countries.

src: Die konferensie bied 'n geleentheid vir holistiese besprekings oor afbakening, veral rakende die kwessie van grensveranderinge en openbare deelname.
tgt: The conference provides a platform for a holistic discussion on demarcations, especially the issue of boundary changes and public participation.

src: Die stem van gemeenskappe in hierdie proses is noodsaaklik en alle pogings om groter en meer inklusiewe openbare deelname te verseker word verwelkom.
tgt: The voice of communities is essential in this process and all efforts to ensure greater and more inclusive public participation are welcomed.

src: Vanaf Vrydag 1 Julie 2016 kan belastingbetalers amptelik begin om hul belastingopgawes vir 2016 in te dien.
tgt: From Friday, 1 July 2016, taxpayers can officially commence completing and submitting their 2016 income tax returns.

src: Die Belastingseisoen is deesdae 'n belangrike vennootskap tussen die Regering en belastingbetalers wat 'n belangrike bydrae tot die land se inkomste maak.
tgt: Tax Season has grown into an important partnership between government and taxpayers who make a vital contribution to our country’s revenue WEBTOKEN represents the single biggest annual engagement between the South African Revenue Service and taxpayers, when more than four million taxpayers submit their income tax returns.

src: Die Kabinet moedig alle belastingbetalers aan om hul jaarlikse inkomstebelastingopgawes vanaf 1 Julie 2016 in te dien.
tgt: Cabinet encourages all taxpayers to submit their annual income tax returns from 1 July 2016.

src: Danksy belastingbetalers het Suid-Afrika vir die boekjaar 2014/15 nagenoeg R1 biljoen ingewin.
tgt: It is through the efforts of compliant taxpayers that South Africa recorded a historic revenue collection of R1 trillion for the 2014/15 financial year.

src: Die Kabinet se standpunt oor belangrike kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on key issues in the environment.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel die onlangse vlaag van geweld in en rondom die Stad Tshwane en doen 'n beroep op burgers om wetsgehoorsaam te wees en nie geweldadig op te tree nie.
tgt: Cabinet condemns the recent spate of violence in and around the City of Tshwane and calls on citizens to refrain from breaking the law and violent protests.

src: Geen mate van ongelukkigheid kan geweld en die vernietiging van eiendom regverdig nie.
tgt: No amount of grievance can justify violence and the destruction of property.

src: Mese wat hulle skuldig maak aan sulke kriminele dade sal met die volle mag van die gereg te doen kry.
tgt: Those found guilty of perpetrating such criminal acts will face the full might of the law.

src: Suid-Afrika is 'n grondwetlike demokrasie waar elke landsburger aan demokratiese prosesse kan deelneem.
tgt: South Africa is a constitutional democracy where each citizen has the opportunity to participate in democratic processes.

src: Sodanige kriminele gedrag maak inbreuk op die regte en vrye beweging van ander.
tgt: Such criminal behaviour infringes on the rights and free movement of others.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op gemeenskappe om met wetstoepassingsagentskappe saam te werk en diegene wat hulle aan kriminele aktiwiteite skuldig maak, aan die kaak te stel.
tgt: Cabinet calls on communities to work with law-enforcement agencies to root out those who disrespect others’ constitutional rights.

src: Die uitspraak van die Konstitusionele Hof in die saak van Mhlophe versus die Onafhanklike Verkiesingskommissie (OVK) baan die weg vir plaaslike verkiesings om op 3 Augustus 2016 voort te gaan met behulp van die kiesersrol wat deur die OVK gesertifiseer is ná die proklamasie van die verkiesingsdatum.
tgt: The Constitutional Court judgment in the matter of Mhlophe versus Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) paves the way for the local government elections to proceed on 3 August 2016 using the voter’s roll certified by the IEC following the proclamation of the election date.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle geregistreerde kiesers om hul demokratiese reg uit te oefen waarvoor hulle so hard gewerk het en om vir die plaaslike regering van hul keuse te gaan stem.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all registered voters to exercise their hard won democratic rights and elect the local government representatives of their choice.

src: Die Regering gaan met die OVK en ander belanghebbendes saamwerk om te verseker dat die uitspraak van die Konstitusionele Hof volledig geïmplementeer word.
tgt: Government will work with the IEC and all other stakeholders to ensure that the judgment of the Constitutional Court is fully implemented.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom Eskom se aankondiging dat al vier eenhede van die nuwe Ingula hidroëlektriese kragstasie voor skedule tot die kragnetwerk gesinkroniseer is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the announcement by Eskom that it had synchronised all four units at its new Ingula hydroelectric power plant to the national grid ahead of schedule.

src: Die projek van R25 miljard verbeter die land se energiesekerheid met die lewering van 1 332 MW tydens spitstye.
tgt: The R25-billion project enhances the country’s future energy security by adding 1 332 Megawatts during times of peak demand.

src: Die aanleg is op koers om teen 2017 volledig in bedryf te wees.
tgt: The plant is on track for full commercial operation in 2017.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die brandbestryders wat in Kanada ontplooi is om bosbrande daar te help bestry, terug in die land.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed back the firefighters who were deployed to Canada to help fight wildlands fires.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse span is teruggeroep na goeie reën daar uitgesak het.
tgt: The South African team was demobilised following heavy rains.

src: Werk op Vuur is 'n regeringsprogram wat daarop gemik is werk te skep en geïntegreerde brandbestryding in Suid-Afrika te bewerkstellig.
tgt: Working on Fire is a government-funded, job-creation programme focusing on implementing Integrated Fire Management in South Africa.

src: Mer as 5 000 jong mans en vroue is as brandbestryders opgelei en by meer as 200 basisse oor die hele land gevestig.
tgt: More than 5 000 young men and women have been fully trained as wildfire firefighters and are stationed in more than 200 bases across South Africa.

src: Die brandbestryders kom uit gemarginaliseerde gemeenskappe en is opgelei in brandbewustheid en -opvoeding, asook in brandvoorkoming en-beheervaardighede.
tgt: Firefighters are recruited from marginalised communities and trained in fire awareness and education, prevention and fire-suppression skills.

src: Soortgelyke regeringsprogramme sluit in Werk vir Water en Werk vir Energie waardeur die Regering in arbeidsintensiewe aktiwiteite belê wat werk skep en ons natuurlike hulpbronne beskerm.
tgt: Similar government programmes include ‘Working for Water’ and ‘Working for Energy’ where government invests in labour-intensive activities that create jobs and protect our natural resources.

src: Die Departement van Omgewingsake ondersoek tans die brandbestryders se loondispuut om 'n regverdige uitkoms vir alle belanghebbendes te beding.
tgt: Following their return, the Department of Environmental Affairs is investigating the pay dispute by the firefighters for a fair outcome for all stakeholders.

src: Die Kabinet spreek sy innige meegevoel teenoor die volgende uit:Familie en vriende van die radio-en-TV-persoonlikheid Hope Zinde wat in die 90's as joernalis by die SAUK gewerk het en ’n voormalige raadslid van die SAUK was.
tgt: Cabinet sends its sincere condolences to the following:Family and friends of radio and television personality Hope Zinde who worked as a journalist at the SABC in the 90s and was also a former SABC board member.

src: Die Regering en landsburgers van die Verenigde State van Amerika ná die skietvoorval in Orlando, Florida, waartydens sowat 50 mense gesterf het en talle beseer is.
tgt: Government and the people of the United States of America following the shooting in Orlando, Florida, which left about 50 people dead and scores injured.

src: Die uitspraak deur die Umzinto-gelykheidshof in KwaZulu-Natal van die afgetrede eiendomsagent Penny Sparrow, wat skuldig bevind is aan haatspraak, dien as 'n herinnering dat sulke gedrag nie geduld sal word nie en dat ons howe onwrikbaar die regte van alle slagoffers van rassisme sal handhaaf, veral die stemloses wat hulself nie kan verdedig nie.
tgt: The sanction of retired estate agent Penny Sparrow by the Umzinto Equality Court in KwaZulu-Natal, who was found guilty of hate speech, is a reminder that such behaviour will not be tolerated and that our courts will steadfastly uphold the rights of all victims of racism, especially those who are voiceless and unable to defend themselves.

src: Die Kabinet is bekommerd dat hoewel ons reeds 22 jaar van demokrasie vier, die Suid-Afrikaanse Meseregtekommissie 'n toename in aangemelde gevalle van blatante rassisme en haatspraak ontvang.
tgt: Cabinet is concerned that even though we are 22 years into democracy, the South African Human Rights Commission reports an increase in reported incidents of open racism and hate speech.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om te onthou dat ons diversiteit ons sterk maak.
tgt: Cabinet calls on South Africans to remember that it is our diversity that makes us strong.

src: Ons moet almal daarna streef om nie-rassige samelewing te bou.
tgt: We should all strive to build non-racial society.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die nodige uitklarings.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Oorgrenspadvervoeragentskap:a. Heraanstelling van Sipho Khumalo as Uitvoerende Hoof vir vyf jaar.
tgt: Cross-Border Road Transport Agency:a. Reappointment of Mr Sipho Khumalo as the Chief Executive Officer for a five-year period.

src: Implementering van Belangrike Regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of Key Government Programmes.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling deur President Jacob Zuma van die Ncora-grootmaatwatersuiweringswerke in die Oos-Kaap, wat ons mense se lewensgehalte verbeter.
tgt: In improving the lives of our people, Cabinet welcomes the launch of the Ncora Bulk Water Treatment Works Project in the Eastern Cape by President Jacob Zuma.

src: Die R64 miljoen watersuiweringsaanleg sal tot voordeel van 17 887 gesinne uit 208 dorpe in die vier omliggende gebiede strek.
tgt: The R64 million water treatment plant is estimated to benefit 17 887 families from 208 villages in the four surrounding area.

src: Dit het 188 werkgeleenthede geskep waarby die plaaslike bevolking, die jeug en vroue die meeste gebaat het.
tgt: It has created 188 jobs, with local people, youth and women being major beneficiaries.

src: Die R18 miljard opknapping- en opgraderingsprojek van die Vaal Gamagara- watervoorsieningskema in die Noord-Kaap, wat deur die Minister van Waterwese en Sanitasie, Nomvula Mokonyane, bekend gestel is sal met voltooiing 150 000 mense in drie dorpe en 22 nedersettings bedien.
tgt: The launch of the R18 billion Vaal Gamagara Water Supply Scheme refurbishment and upgrade project in Northern Cape by the Minister of Water and Sanitation, Nomvula Mokonyane will serve close to 150, 000 people in 3 towns and 22 villages on completion.

src: Hierbenewens het die bekendstelling van die R15 miljoen Jericho Landelike Watervoorsieningsprojek die sekerheid van watervoorsiening aan die gemeenskappe van Jericho in Madibeng Plaaslike Munisipaliteit verbeter.
tgt: Also, the launch of the R15 million Jericho Rural Water Supply Project has increased the security of water supply to the communities of Jericho in Madibeng Local Municipality.

src: Die Regering se belegging in vervoerinfrastruktuur skep ’n veilige, betroubare, doeltreffende en bekostigbare openbare vervoerdiens regdeur die land.
tgt: Government’s investment in transport infrastructure is creating a safe, reliable, efficient and affordable public transport service across the country.

src: Die newevoordeel van verbeterde vervoertoestande is groter beleggingsvertroue en ekonomiese ontwikkeling.
tgt: The spin-off from improved travel conditions is greater investor confidence and economic development.

src: Die R190 miljoen belegging Ballito-kruising en die P455-hoofpadopgradering, wat deur die Minister van Vervoer, Dipuo Peters, bekend gestel is, is modelle vir slim medebefondsing.
tgt: The official opening of the R190 million investment Ballito Interchange and the P455 main road upgrade by the Minister for Transport, Dipuo Peters are models for smart co-funding with R123 million from SANRAL and R67 million from the KwaDukuza Municipality.

src: Die belegging, wat uit R123 miljoen van SANRAL en R67 miljoen van die KwaDukuza Munisipaliteit, bestaan, dien as ’n katalisator vir verdere groei en belegging met die P455-hoofpadopgradering wat die ontwikkeling van ’n nuwe R1 miljard kleinhandelskompleks, wat na verwagting in 2017 voltooi sal word, ontsluit.
tgt: These serve as catalysts for further growth and investment with the P455 main road upgrade unlocking the development of a new R1 billion retail complex which is due for completion in WEBTOKEN state-of-the-art trains procured by the Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa will be launched later in the year.

src: Nuwe moderne treine, wat deur die Passasierspooragentskap van Suid-Afrika aangekoop is, sal later vanjaar bekend gestel word.
tgt: These trains will assist with the improvement of the services and train availability for the Mamelodi train commuters.

src: Hierdie treine sal help om die dienste en die beskikbaarheid van treine vir treinpendelaars in Mamelodi te verbeter.
tgt: An additional 70 new commuter buses will be procured in the City of Johannesburg which will better connect residents and improve economic efficiency in the country’s financial hub.

src: Hierdie beleggings verander ons stedelike landskap in reaksie op ons mense se behoeftes.
tgt: These investments are changing our urban landscape in response to the needs of our people.

src: Op 16 Julie 2016 sal die Minister van Wetenskap en Tegnologie, Naledi Pandor, opdrag gee vir 16 skottels om MerKAT uit te brei.
tgt: On 16 July 2016, Minister of Science and Technology, Naledi Pandor will commission 16 dishes to expand MeerKAT, a project of Square Kilometre Array South Africa (SKA SA), 90 kilometres northwest of Carnarvon.

src: Dit is 'n projek van die Square Kilometre Array Suid-Afrika (SKA SA), 90 kilometer noordwes van Carnarvon.
tgt: The MeerKAT telescope has produced remarkable images of the sky using just four of the eventual 64 dishes installed revealing never before seen radio galaxies in the distant universe.

src: Die wetenskaplike belofte wat MerKAT inhou geniet wêreldwye belangstelling en is nou binne ons bereik.
tgt: The scientific promise of MeerKAT is receiving worldwide interest and is now within our reach.

src: Dit is 'n bewys van die toegewyde werk van honderde ingenieurs, wetenskaplikes, bestuurders en ander personeel, asook van die Suid-Afrikaanse en internasionale nywerheidsvennote, en die ondersteuning van die Regering en die mense van Suid-Afrika.
tgt: It is a testament to the dedicated work of hundreds of engineers, scientists, managers and other staff, as well as of the South African and international industrial partners, and the support of the government and people of South Africa.

src: Die Nasionale Kunstefees wat jaarliks in Grahamstad gehou word, vind plaas oor ’n tydperk van 11 dae vanaf 30 Junie to 10 Julie 2016.
tgt: The National Arts Festival hosted annually in Grahamstown takes place over 11 days from 30 June to 10 July 2016.

src: Hierdie multidissiplinêre fees, die grootste jaarlikse viering van die kunste op die Afrika-kontinent, dra by tot die verwesenliking van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan waarvolgens "kuns en kultuur kragtige ruimtes vir debat skep oor die plek waar 'n samelewing hom bevind en waarheen hy gaan".Dit word ondersteun deur die Mzansi Golden Economy-strategie, wat die kulturele bedrywe in Suid-Afrika herposisioneer om doeltreffend en volkome tot ekonomiese groei en werkskepping by te dra.
tgt: This multidisciplinary festival, the biggest annual celebration of the arts on the African continent, contributes in realising the National Development Plan which advocates that “arts and culture open powerful spaces for debate about where a society finds itself and where it is going”.It is supported through the Mzansi Golden Economy strategy, which repositions the cultural industries in South Africa to effectively and comprehensively contribute to economic growth and job creation.

src: Deur die Mzansi Golden Economy Open Call-proses, vestig die Departement van Kuns en Kultuur ook 'n -ebuutfonds vir jonger kunstenaars.
tgt: Through the Mzansi Golden Economy Open Call process, the Department of Arts and Culture is also establishing a Debut Fund for younger artists.

src: Die doel is om geleenthede vir jong kunstenaars te skep om hul eerste boek te publiseer, hul eerste toneelstuk op die planke te bring, hul eerste album te produseer of hul eerste uitstalling te hou.
tgt: The aim is to create opportunities for young artists to publish their first book, produce their first play, produce their first album or host their first exhibition.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die nuutgeboude Keimoes-polisiestasie in die Noord-Kaap, wat misdaadvoorkomingsdienste nader aan die mense bring.
tgt: In bringing crime prevention services closer to the people, Cabinet welcomes the newly built Keimoes police station in the Northern Cape, which serves an estimated 23 000 WEBTOKEN Phola in Mpumalanga, the donation of a police station to the community by Eskom’s Kusile power station in partnership with KCW JV contractor demonstrated the impact of working together.

src: Dit bedien ’n geraamde 23 000 mense in die WEBTOKEN Phola in Mpumalanga, het die skenking van ’n polisiestasie aan die gemeenskap deur die Eskom Kusile-kragstasie in vennootskap met KCW JV-kontrakteur, die trefkrag van samewerking gedemonstreer.
tgt: The construction of the station, valued at R3 million, has created job opportunities and empowered people with skills and knowledge to create a safer environment.

src: Suid-Afrika was van 28 tot 29 Junie 2016 gasheer vir die Statebond se Plaaslike Regeringsforum – Suider-Afrika Streekskonferensie.
tgt: South Africa hosted the Commonwealth Local Government Forum – Southern Africa Regional conference on 28 to 29 June 2016.

src: Die konferensie is onder die tema, "Aanvuur van Volhoubare en Mesgesentreerde Sosio-ekonomiese Ontwikkeling in Sub-Sahara-Afrika", aangebied.
tgt: This conference convened under the theme, “Igniting Sustainable and People Centered Socio-Economic Development in sub-Saharan Africa”, reflected on the role of African governments in championing the new development Agenda of the Sustainable Development Goals which conclude in 2030, and realise its objectives within the context of Africa Agenda 2063.

src: Dit het die rol van Afrika-regerings as voorstaanders van die nuwe ontwikkelingsagenda vir die Volhoubare Ontwikkelingsdoelwitte wat in 2030 ten einde loop, binne die konteks van Afrika se Agenda 2063 bespreek.
tgt: The SDGs define the development agenda at local level to be essentially about making municipal spaces more socially inclusive, economically productive, environmentally sustainable and resilient to climate change and other risks.

src: Die volhoubare ontwikkelingsdoelwitte definieer die ontwikkelingsagenda op plaaslike vlak as ’n manier om hoofsaaklik munisipale ruimtes meer sosiaal inklusief, ekonomies produktief, omgewingsvolhoubaar en bestand teen klimaatsverandering en ander risiko's te maak.
tgt: We welcome the outcomes of the first ever Municipal Demarcation Board (MDB) conference on Demarcation and Spatial Transformation that took place from 23 – 24 June 2016.

src: Ons verwelkom die uitkomste van die heel eerste konferensie van die Munisipale Afbakeningsraad (MAR) oor Afbakening en Ruimtelike Transformasie wat van 23 tot 24 Junie 2016 plaasgevind het.
tgt: The conference was convened under the theme, “Reviewing the Past and Mapping the Future” focusing attention on key issues related to demarcation and examining challenges facing the metropolitan system of governance and the necessity of delimiting wards every five years.

src: Die rol om volhoubare munisipaliteite te verseker het onder die soeklig gekom as 'n integrale deel van die afbakeningsproses.
tgt: The role of ensuring sustainable municipalities came under the spotlight as an integral part of the demarcation process.

src: Bydraes wat deur die konferensie gelewer is, sal voortgaan om die ontwikkeling en implementering van afbakening en ruimtelike ontwikkeling te vorm.
tgt: Contributions from the conference will continue to shape the development and implementation of demarcation and spatial development policies.

src: Belangrike Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.

src: Ter voorbereiding vir die komende plaaslike verkiesings op 3 Augustus 2016 is die Kabinet ingelig oor die stand van gereedheid ten opsigte van veiligheid en sekuriteit.
tgt: In preparation for the upcoming Local Government Elections on 3 August 2016, Cabinet was briefed on the State of Preparedness, as relates to safety and security.

src: Deur die Nasionale Gesamentlike Operasionele en Intelligensiestruktuur (NATJOINTS), is operasies in plek om 'n veilige omgewing te skep wat sal verseker dat mense in Suid-Afrika veilig is en voel.
tgt: Through the National Joint Operational and Intelligence Structure (NATJOINTS), operations are in place to create a safe and secure environment to ensure that people in South Africa are and feel safe.

src: Daarbenewens het die SAPD, die Nasionale Vervolgingsgesag die Departement van Justisie en Grondwetlike Ontwikkeling en die Regshulpraad die Saakbestuursprotokol van die Geïntegreerde Plaaslike Verkiesings onderteken om die Wet op Verkiesingsmisdrywe af te dwing.
tgt: This is key in contributing towards the credibility of the upcoming WEBTOKEN addition the SAPS, National Prosecuting Authority, Department of Justice and Constitutional Development and the Legal Aid Board have entered into the Local Government Elections Integrated Case Management Protocol to enforce the Electoral Offences Act.

src: Die Kabinet is ook ingelig oor die lopende voorbereidings vir die Derde Konferensie van die Verenigde Nasies oor Behuising en Volhoubare Verstedeliking (Habitat III) wat van 17 tot 20 Oktober 2016 deur die Algemene Vergadering van die Verenigde Nasies in Quito, Ecuador gehou word.
tgt: Cabinet was also briefed on the on-going preparations for the Third United Nations Conference on Housing and Sustainable Urbanisation (Habitat III) to be held by the General Assembly of the United Nations in Quito in Ecuador from 17 to 20 October 2016.Habitat III aims to secure a renewed global commitment to addressing housing and sustainable urbanisation for the next 20 years through the adoption of a forward-looking, action orientated outcome agreement.

src: Habitat III het ten doel om 'n hernude internasionale verbintenis tot die hantering van behuising en volhoubare verstedeliking vir die volgende 20 jaar te vestig deur die bekragtiging van 'n toekomsgerigte, aksie-georiënteerde uitkomsooreenkoms.
tgt: Cabinet supports the Common African Position on Habitat III that will be tabled at African Union Summit of Heads of State and Government in Kigali, in July 2016.

src: Dit vorm die basis vir Suid-Afrika se onderhandelingstandpunt.
tgt: This forms the basis for South Africa’s negotiating position.

src: Samesprekings om 'n Suid-Afrikaanse Habitat III-uitkomstestandpuntdokument saam te stel is tans aan die gang.
tgt: Consultations are ongoing to inform a South African Habitat III outcome position document.

src: Suid-Afrika het in April 2016 ook tot die internasionale voorbereidings bygedra deur die aanbied van 'n Habitat III tematiese konferensie oor informele nedersettings onder die tema "Lei verandering in die stad: Van krotbuurte tot geïntegreerde, veilige, veerkragtig en volhoubare menslike nedersettings".
tgt: South Africa also contributed to the international preparations by hosting a Habitat III Thematic Conference on informal settlements in April 2016 under the theme “Leading change in the City: From slums to integrated, safe, resilient and sustainable human settlements” which adopted the Pretoria Declaration as a formal input into the Habitat III draft outcome document.

src: Die Pretoria-verklaring is tydens die konferensie aanvaar as 'n formele inset tot die Habitat III-konsepuitkomstedokument.
tgt: The decision by the Minister of Trade and Industry to designate the Musina-Makhado Special Economic Zone in the Vhembe Region of Limpopo, and to grant a Special Economic Zone Licence to the Limpopo Economic Development Agency was ratified by Cabinet.

src: Die Minister van Handel en Nywerheid se besluit om die Musina-Makhado Spesiale Ekonomiese Sone in die Vhembe-streek van Limpopo aan te wys, en om 'n lisensie vir ’n Spesiale Ekonomiese Sone aan die Limpopo Ekonomiese Ontwikkelingsagentskap toe te staan, is deur die Kabinet bekragtig.
tgt: The Hoi Mor Consortium will plan, develop, manage and market the South African Energy and Metallurgical Industrial Park within the zone.

src: Die Hoi Mor Konsortium sal die Suid-Afrikaanse Energie en Meallurgiese Nywerheidspark binne die sone beplan, ontwikkel, bestuur en bemark.
tgt: The designated zone will promote industrial development in the region with a specific focus on mineral beneficiation, agro-processing, petro-chemicals, and other light industries as envisaged in the Nine Point Plan.

src: Die aangewese sone sal nywerheidsontwikkeling in die streek bevorder met 'n spesifieke fokus op minerale veredeling en landbouverwerking, asook petrochemiese en ander ligte nywerhede soos deur die Negepuntplan in die vooruitdsig gestel.
tgt: This Special Economic Zone is anchored through an investment of over R40 billion in an Energy and Metallurgical Industrial Cluster.

src: Die implementering van verskeie projekte oor die volgende vyf jaar sal na verwagting meer as 21 000 werkgeleenthede skep.
tgt: The implementation of various projects over the next five years is expected to create over 21 000 jobs.

src: Die Musina-Makhado-streek is ook deel van die Trans-Limpopo Ruimtelike Ontwikkelingsinisiatief en is goed geposisioneer vir streeksintegrasie en skakeling met Mosambiek, Zimbabwe en Botswana.
tgt: The Musina-Makhado region is also part of the Trans-Limpopo Spatial Development Initiative and is well positioned for regional integration and linkages with Mozambique, Zimbabwe and Botswana.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Verslag oor die Prestasie van die Belastingaansporingsprogram vir Navorsing en Ontwikkeling (N&O) 2014/15 aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Report on the Performance of the Research and Development (R&D) Tax Incentive Programme 2014/15 to Parliament.

src: Die Regering bied 'n N&O-belastingaansporing om die private sektor aan te moedig om N&O in Suid-Afrika te onderneem.
tgt: Government offers an R&D tax incentive so as to encourage the private sector to undertake R&D in South Africa.

src: Die aansporing bestaan 'n 150% belastingaftrekking op uitgawes vir N&O-aktiwiteite wat deur die Minister van Wetenskap en Tegnologie goedgekeur is.
tgt: The incentive consists a 150% tax deduction on expenditure incurred on R&D activities approved by the Minister of Science and Technology.

src: Vanaf November 2006 tot Februarie 2015 het 876 maatskappye by hierdie aansporing betrokke geraak en eise van altesaam R6 miljard vir N&O-belastingaftrekkings ingedien.
tgt: This can be accessed by companies of all sizes in all sectors of the economy.876 companies participated in this incentive from November 2006 to February 2015, claiming R6 billion in R&D tax deductions.

src: ’n Geraamde R33,3 miljard se N&O-uitgawes is in hierdie tydperk deur die aansporing ondersteun.
tgt: It is estimated that R.3 billion in R&D expenditure was supported through the incentive in this period.

src: Resultate deur maatskappye wat voordeel hieruit getrek het, sluit onder meer in: 765 wetenskaplike publikasies 649 konferensieverrigtinge 1 062 nuwe produkte bekend gestel 111 vorme van intellektuele eiendom en 33 plaaslike en internasionale patente.
tgt: Some of the results by companies which benefited include: 765 scientific publications 649 conference proceedings 1062 new products launched 111 forms of intellectual property and 33 local and international patents.

src: Die Intellektuele Eiendom (IE) Raadplegende Raamwerk is deur die Kabinet goedgekeur.
tgt: The Intellectual Property (IP) Consultative Framework was approved by Cabinet.

src: Die IE Raadplegende Raamwerk het ten doel om deurlopende betrokkenheid by die regeringsvennote en die samelewing in die algemeen te fasiliteer ten einde Suid-Afrika se IE-beleid te formuleer.
tgt: The IP Consultative Framework aims to facilitate what will be continuous engagement with governmental partners and society at large towards the formulation of South Africa’s IP Policy.

src: Die hoofdoel is om die konsultasieproses in die formulering van Suid-Afrika se IE-beleid te versterk om te verseker dat dit algemeen verteenwoordigend is van die Regering asook die standpunte van geaffekteerde rolspelers in die breër samelewing.
tgt: The key objective is to strengthen the consultative process in the formulation of South Africa’s IP policy to ensure that it is broadly representative of government and the perspectives of affected stakeholders in the broader society.

src: Die Regering sal verseker dat die IE-beleid eiendomsreg ooreenkomstig die Grondwet respekteer.
tgt: Government will ensure that the IP policy respects property rights as enshrined in the Constitution while striking appropriate balances with public interest and responds to South Africa’s unique innovation and development dynamics.

src: Dit sal ’n toepaslike balans met openbare belang handhaaf en op Suid-Afrika se unieke innovasie- en ontwikkelingsdinamika reageer.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the outcomes from the High Level meeting of the General Assembly on the World Summit on Information Society which was held from 15 to 16 December 2015.South Africa led the process on behalf of G77+China, and outcomes reached were in keeping with the South African position.

src: Die Departement van Telekommunikasie en Posdienste sal weldra Suid-Afika se Ontwikkelingsagenda vir Inligting- en Kommunikasietegnologie ontwikkel.
tgt: The Department of Telecommunications and Postal Services will be developing South Africa’s Information and Communications Technology development agenda in due course.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens se Verbeteringstrategie vir Openbare Orde Polisiëring.
tgt: Cabinet approved the South African Police Service Public Order Policing Enhancement Strategy.

src: Dit versterk regeringsprogramme en -inisiatiewe wat op die handhawing van vrede en stabiliteit in die land gerig is.
tgt: This reinforces government programmes and initiatives aimed at maintaining peace and stability in the country.

src: Dit het ’n impak op die vertroue van buitelandse beleggers en dra by tot die verwesenliking van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan.
tgt: This impacts on the confidence of foreign investors and contributes to the realisation of the National Development Plan.

src: Openbare orde en die oppergesag van die reg is die grondslag wat verseker dat alle mense in Suid-Afrika veilig is en veilig voel.
tgt: Public order and the rule of law is the basis to ensure that all people in South Africa are and feel safe.

src: Komende gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n broep op alle Suid-Afrikaners en alle sektore om saam af te tel na die 21ste Internasionale Vigs-konferensie van 18 tot 22 Julie 2016 by die Albert Luthuli Internasionale Konvensiesentrum in Durban onder die tema “Toegang to Gelyke Regte Nou”.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans and all sectors to participate as the country counts down to the 21st International AIDS Conference under the theme “Access Equity Rights Now”, from 18 to 22 July 2016, at the Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre in WEBTOKEN part of the build up to AIDS 2016 and to mobilise all sectors, Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa, as the Chairperson of the South African National Aids Council, will lead the five-day countdown at the Union Buildings on 13 July 2016.

src: As deel van die opbou na Vigs-2016 en om alle sektore te mobiliseer, sal Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa, as Voorsitter van die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Vigsraad, die vyfdag-aftel na die Uniegebou op 13 Julie 2016 lei.
tgt: #5Days to #AIDS2016 has been created to ensure a platform of interaction.

src: #5Days to #AIDS2016 is geskep om ’n platform vir interaksie te verseker.
tgt: In addition #1Day to #AIDS2016 will be used from 17 July 2016 which will mark the one day count down.

src: Landsburgers word aangemoedig om rooi, wit of swart klere te dra organisasies word aangemoedig om opvoedkundige materiaal en kondome by strategiese punte te vertoon en plekke van aanbidding om spesiale gebedsdienste te hou en gedenkkerse aan te steek.
tgt: Citizens are encouraged to wear red, white or black clothing, organisations to display educational material and condoms at strategic points, and places of worship to conduct special prayer services and light memorial candles.

src: Mobilisering van alle sektore is die sleutel tot die opbou na Vigs-2016.
tgt: Mobilisation of all sectors is key in the build up to AIDS 2016.

src: Besonderhede oor hierdie en ander aktiwiteite is beskikbaar by WEBTOKENelson Mandela Internasionale Dag op 18 Julie herinner ons aan ons plig om die lewens van diegene wat minder bevoorreg as ons is te verbeter.
tgt: The details of these and other activities can be found on WEBTOKENelson Mandela International Day on 18 July is a reminder of our duty to improve the lives of those less fortunate than us.

src: "Daar is geen einde aan beter doen nie.
tgt: "There is no end in doing better.

src: Ons moet dit weer en weer doen."
tgt: We have to do it again and again."

src: Ons moedig alle Suid-Afrikaners aan om 67 minute van hul tyd af te staan om by onbaatsugtige diens betrokke te raak, want deur saam te staan in 'n gesamentlike poging kan ons die wêreld verander.
tgt: We encourage all South Africa’s people to use 67 minutes of their time to engage in selfless service because together through a collective effort we can change the world.

src: Vanjaar is die fokus op onderwys en geletterdheid, voedselsekuriteit, skuiling en die omgewing.
tgt: This year the focus will be on education and literacy, food security, shelter and the environment.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om hul kant te bring deur te help om groentetuine te vestig, vir kinders te lees, skole te verf en by te dra tot die ontwikkeling van gemeenskappe.
tgt: Cabinet calls on South Africans to Play Their Part by helping to establish food gardens, reading to children, painting schools and contributing towards the development of communities.

src: Suid-Afrika vier vanjaar die 60ste herdenking van die Vrouemars onder die tema: "Vroue verenig om Suid-Afrika vorentoe te beweeg".
tgt: This year South Africa commemorates the 60th anniversary of the Women’s March, under the theme: “Women united in moving South Africa forward” to reaffirm Governments commitment to strive towards a society free from all forms of discrimination and to move South Africa Forward by raising awareness about the critical role that women play in the country’s socio-economic development.

src: Dit herbevestig die Regering se verbintenis tot 'n samelewing vry van alle vorme van diskriminasie en om Suid-Afrika vorentoe te beweeg deur bewustheid oor die kritieke rol wat vroue in die land se sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling speel te verhoog.
tgt: The empowerment of women is an integral part of social cohesion and nation building.

src: Die 60ste herdenking van Nasionale Vrouedag op 9 Augustus 2016 sal die geskiedenis van vroue se stryd na vore te bring deur 'Haar Storie' te vertel.
tgt: The 60th commemoration of the National Women’s Day on 9 August, 2016 will highlight the history of struggle of women, through telling ‘HerStory’.

src: Die bydrae van vroue in die stryd teen onderdrukking en diskriminasie, asook die prestasies deur vroue onder demokrasie sal uitgelig word.
tgt: The contribution women made in the struggle against oppression and discrimination as well as the achievements by women under democracy will be highlighted.

src: 'n Openbare opvoedingsprogram deur middel van verskeie regeringskommunikasiekanale, die burgerlike samelewing en die privaatsektor sal onderneem word met ’n opbou van aktiwiteite in al die provinsies in aanloop tot Vrouedag op 9 Augustus.
tgt: A public education programme through various communication channels by government, civil society and the private sector will be undertaken with a build-up of activities in all provinces leading to Women’s Day on 9 August.

src: Die hoofgeleentheid tydens Vrouedag sal by die Uniegebou in Pretoria plaasvind.
tgt: The main Womens Day event will take place at the Union Buildings in Pretoria.

src: Die dag sal begin met 'n parade vanaf Bosman-stasie tot by die Lilian Ngoyi-plein, waar President Jacob Zuma die Lewende Monument vir Vroue sal onthul.
tgt: The day will start with a parade from Bosman Station to the Lilian Ngoyi Square where President Jacob Zuma will open the Women’s Living Monument.

src: Die formele verrigtinge sal ook voorafgegaan word deur die opmars van vroue uit verskillende dele van die stad na die Uniegebou.4 Die Minister van Telekommunikasie en Posdienste, Dr Siyabonga Cwele, sal die Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging na die Pan-Afrika-posunie (Papu) se Gevolmagtigde Konferensie geskeduleer vir 22 tot 23 Julie in Yaoundé, Kameroen lei.
tgt: The formal proceedings will also be preceded by the march of women from various parts of town to the Union Buildings.4 The Minister of Telecommunications and Postal Services Dr Siyabonga Cwele will lead the South African delegation to the Pan African Postal Union (PAPU) Plenipotentiary Conference scheduled for 22-23 July in Yaoundé, Cameroon.

src: Die konferensie is daarop gemik om Afrika se posisie voor die Kongres van die Wêreldposunie (UPU), van 19 September tot 7 Oktober in Istanboel, Turkye te finaliseer.
tgt: The conference aims to finalise Africa’s position ahead of the Universal Postal Union (UPU) Congress, scheduled for 19 September- 7 October in Istanbul, Turkey.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan Suid-Afrika se voorneme om vir herverkiesing tot die UPU-bestuursliggaam te staan.
tgt: Cabinet approved South Africa’s intentions for the country to stand for re-election in the UPU Governance body, in line with the foreign policy objectives of reforming the governance of global institutions and to champion the developmental agenda.

src: Dit is in ooreenstemming met die doelwitte van die land se buitelandse beleid om die bestuur van globale instellings te hervorm en om die ontwikkelingsagenda te bevorder.
tgt: The PAPU and UPU are focused on improving integration and interoperability between designated postal operators and other key stakeholders in order to strengthen the universal postal services globally to ensure that they reduce the digital divide and provide access to communications and financial services.

src: Die Kabinet se standpunt oor belangrike kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on key issues in the environment.

src: Suid-Afrikaners het met waardering kennis geneem dat president Jacob Zuma 3 Augustus 2016 as 'n openbare vakansiedag verklaar het om alle kwalifiserende en geregistreerde kiesers in staat te stel om vrylik te stem op dié dag.
tgt: South Africans noted with appreciation that President Jacob Zuma declared 3 August 2016 as a public holiday to enable all eligible and registered voters to vote freely on the day.

src: Terwyl die OVK sal poog om te verseker dat verkiesings vry en regverdig is, is dit ook die primêre verantwoordelikheid van alle die belanghebbendes, insluitende gemeenskappe en politieke partye.
tgt: While the IEC will endeavour to ensure that elections are free and fair, it is the primary responsibility of all the stakeholders including communities and political parties.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n dringende beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om vrede en kalmte te bevorder in aanloop tot, tydens en ná die 2016 plaaslike verkiesings.
tgt: Cabinet would like to urge all South Africans to ensure peace and calm ahead of, during and post the 2016 local government elections.

src: Die wetstoepassingsagentskappe sal nie enige ontwrigtende optrede wat daarop gemik is om kiesers te verhoed om te stem, verdra nie.
tgt: The law enforcement agencies will not tolerate any disruptive actions aimed at disenfranchising voters.

src: Ons doen ’n beroep op alle geregistreerde kiesers wat nie in staat sal wees om op 3 Augustus te stem nie, om by die OVK aansoek te doen vir 'n spesiale stem.
tgt: We encourage all registered voters who will not be able to vote on 3rd of August to apply for a special vote with the IEAll South Africans are encouraged to participate in the nomination process for the 2017 National Orders Awards.

src: Nasionale Ordes is die hoogste eer wat ’n land, deur sy President, aan sy burgers en vooraanstaande buitelandse burgers toeken.
tgt: National Orders are the highest awards that a country, through its President, bestows on its citizens and eminent foreign nationals.

src: Lede van die publiek word genooi om mense wat na hul mening verdien om die land se hoogste eer te ontvang, te nomineer.
tgt: Members of the public are invited to nominate persons they believe deserve to receive the country’s highest honours.

src: Lede van die publiek moet 'n kort motivering oor die persoon wat genomineer word aanheg.
tgt: Members of the public must attach a short motivation on the person nominated and nominations forms can be accessed on The Presidency website.

src: Ons verwelkom die bevindinge van die 2016 Verslag oor die Stand van Suid-Afrikaanse Stede (SOCR), wat op 22 Junie 2016 deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Stedenetwerk vrygestel is.
tgt: We welcomed the findings from the 2016 State of the South African Cities Report (SOCR) released on 22 June 2016 by the South African Cities Network.

src: Die SOCR bied 'n vyfjaar-perspektief op die prestasies en toestande van die land se grootste stede en bepaal die ontwikkelingsagenda deur noodsaaklik boodskappe oor die beplanning, ontwikkeling en bestuur van stede aan die volgende geslag van burgerlike leiers oor te dra.
tgt: The SOCR presents a 5-year perspective on the performance and conditions of the country’s largest cities and sets the development Agenda by communicating essential messages about the planning, development and management of cities to the next generation of civic leaders.

src: Hierdie verslag verhoog optrede om ons stede te verebeter en om hulle meer inklusiewe en produktiewe plekke te maak vir die inwoners.
tgt: This report elevates actions to make our cities better, more inclusive and productive places for those who live in them.

src: Tussenkomste deur die Regering begin nou om vrugte af te werp en munisipaliteite wat deur inisiatiewe soos Terugkeer na Basiese Beginsels ondersteun word, reageer positief en toon tekens van verbetering.
tgt: Government interventions are beginning to bear fruit and municipalities supported through initiatives such as Back to Basics are responding positively and showing signs of improvement.

src: Dit is 'n verdere aanduiding van die vordering wat gemaak is in die dekonstruksie van ruimtelike beplanning uit die apartheidsera en die verbetering van dienslewering.
tgt: It is a further indication of the progress made in deconstructing apartheid spatial planning and improving service delivery.

src: Dit beklemtoon die vele prestasies wat bygedra het om ons stedelike landskappe in demokratiese ruimtes te omskep waarin alle burgers vry is om met mekaar om te gaan.
tgt: It underscores the many achievements that have transformed our urban landscape into democratic spaces in which all citizens are free to interact.

src: Dit weerspieël die Ouditeur-generaal se verslag oor munisipale finansies wat 'n aansienlike verbetering in oudituitkomste gedurende die afgelope vyf boekjare van 2010/11 tot 2014/15 getoon het.
tgt: This echoes the Auditor-General’s Report on Municipal Finances that showed a considerable improvement in Audit Outcomes in the past 5 financial years from 2010/11 to 2014/15.

src: Die 2015 verslag oor die Finansiële Sensus van Munisipaliteite wat onlangs deur Statistieke Suid-Afrika vrygestel is, is 'n verdere aanduiding dat die Regering in staat is om gehalte basiese dienste aan die mense te lewer.
tgt: The 2015 Financial Census of Municipalities report released recently by Statistics South Africa is another indication that government is able to provide quality basic services to the people.

src: Volgens Statistieke SA se 2016 Gemeenskapsopname, is die land se groeiende bevolking beter daaraan toe as voorheen.
tgt: According to Stats SA’s 2016 Community Survey, the country’s growing population is better off than before.

src: Die Kabinet bevestig dat hy mediavryheid ondersteun, asook vryheid van uitdrukking en die reg van enige persoon om inligting in Suid-Afrika te bekom.
tgt: Cabinet reaffirmed its support for media freedom, freedom of expression and the right of any person to access information in South Africa.

src: Hierdie regte, wat deeglik in die Grondwet verskans is, sal altyd gehandhaaf en beskerm word.
tgt: These rights, well enshrined in the Constitution, will always be upheld and protected by all.

src: Die rol van die SABC as die openbare uitsaaier bly noodsaaklik vir die ontwikkeling van ons jong demokrasie.
tgt: The role of the SABC as the public broadcaster remains vital for the development of our young democracy.

src: Die huidige bespreking oor redaksionele besluite deur die SABC met betrekking tot die uitsaai van tonele van geweld en vernietiging van eiendom, moet op ’n konstruktiewe wyse gevoer word sodat dit ons demokrasie kan te versterk.
tgt: The current discussion over the SABC’s editorial decisions regarding the broadcasting of images of violence and destruction of property should be held in a constructive manner that would serve to strengthen our democracy.

src: Die Kabinet is steeds vol vertroue dat die openbare uitsaaier sal voortgaan om die belange van al die mense van Suid-Afrika te dien.
tgt: Cabinet remains confident that the public broadcaster will continue to serve the interests of all the people of South Africa.

src: Suid-Afrika se verbetering met 14 plekke in die Wêreldbank se 2016 Logistieke Werkverrigtingindeks, dui aan dat Suid-Afrika beslis oop is vir besigheid.
tgt: South Africa's improvement by 14 places in the World Bank's 2016 Logistics Performance Index tells us that South Africa is certainly open for business.

src: Suid-Afrika is in die 20ste plek uit 160 lande wat deur die opname beoordeel is ’n verbetering vanaf 34ste in 2014.
tgt: South Africa stands at 20th of 160 countries assessed by the survey, moving up from 34 in 2014.

src: Die gemak van beweging van goedere en dienste lewer ’n beduidende bydrae tot ’n land se mededingendheid, veral as 'n bestemming vir belegging.7 Die Kabinet het ’n verslag ontvang van die ministers van Minerale Hulpbronne van Arbeid en van Finasies na aanleiding van hul opbouende gesprekvoering met belanhebbendes in die bankwese.
tgt: The ease of movement for goods and services contribute significantly to a country’s competitiveness, particularly as a destination for investment.

src: Die uitkoms van hierdie verslag sal weldra bekend gemaak word.8 Die Kabinet verwelkom die 2016 Gemeenskapsopnameverslag deur Statistieke Suid-Afrika, wat die vordering aandui wat ons as 'n nasie op sleutegebiede van dienslewering gemaak het, veral in die lewensverwagting van ons mense.
tgt: Cabinet received a report from the Ministers of Mineral Resources, Labour and Finance following their constructive engagement with stakeholders in the banking industry.

src: Hierdie statistieke is 'n belangrike maatstaf vir die Regering om ingeligte strategiese beplanning te doen, veral wat betref die nuwe en inkomende administrasie van plaaslike regerings na afloop van die verkiesings op 3 Augustus.
tgt: These statistics are an important yardstick to inform strategic planning for government particularly the new and incoming administration of local government following the elections on 3rd of August.

src: Die Regering sal ingryp om die uitdagings wat in die verslag uitgelig word aan te pak deur middel van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan se Visie 2030, wat ’n plan van die mense deur die mense is.9 Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense oor aan die volgende:Nkosinathi Maphumulo, algemeen bekend as Black Coffee, wat die eerste Suid-Afrikaner is om die gesogte prys van die Black Entertainment Television (BET) vir die Beste Internasionale Optrede: Afrika-toekenning te ontvang.
tgt: Government will intervene to address the challenges highlighted in the report through the National Development Plan Vision 2030, which is the plan of the people by the people.9 Cabinet congratulates the following:Nkosinathi Maphumulo, popularly known as Black Coffee, for becoming the first South African to win the prestigious Black Entertainment Television (BET) Best International Act: Africa Award.

src: Bafana Bafana, wat die 2016 uitgawe van die COSAFA-beker gewen het.
tgt: Bafana Bafana for winning the 2016 Edition of the COSAFA Cup.

src: Die prestasie van dié span, wat hoofsaaklik uit onder 23-spelers bestaan, is ’n goeie aanduiding van die land se toekomstige sukses in die internasionale arena.
tgt: The team which comprised mostly of under 23 players bodes well for the country’s future success in the international arena.

src: Die Springbokke, wat in die derde toets oor Ierland geseëvier het om die toetsreeks te wen.
tgt: The Springboks on their victory over Ireland in the third test to win the series.

src: Die wenners van die 18de Nasionale Wetenskap- en Tegnologieforum-toekennings, wat die belangrikste wetenskap-, ingenieurswese-, tegnologie- en innovasie-toekennings in Suid-Afrika is.
tgt: The winners of the 18th National Science and Technology Forum Awards which are the most significant science, engineering, technology and innovation (SETI) awards in South Africa.

src: Die toekennings vereer buitengewone bydraes tot wetenskap, ingenieurswese, tegnologie en innovasie deur uitnemedheid aan te moedig en te beloon.
tgt: The awards honour outstanding contributions to SETI by encouraging and rewarding excellence.

src: Die Stad Tshwane wat internasionale erkenning ontvang het by die Wêreld Wi-Fi-Dagtoekennings vir mees innoverende stad- of regeringsprogram om die digitale kloof te oorbrug.
tgt: The City of Tshwane which received international recognition at the World Wi-Fi Day Awards for Most Innovative City or Government Program to bridge the Digital Divide.

src: Die toekennings is tydens die Wireless Global-kongres in die Verenigde Koninkryk oorhandig.
tgt: The awards were held at the Wireless Global Congress in the United Kingdom.

src: Die Tshwane Gratis Wi-Fi (bekend as TshWi-Fi) het 1,8 miljoen burgers in die hoofstad aanlyn gekoppel in die grootste ontplooiing van munisipale gratis Wi-Fi op die Afrika-vasteland.
tgt: The Tshwane Free Wi-Fi (knowns as TshWi-Fi) brought million citizens in the Capital City online in the biggest deployment of municipal Free Wi-Fi on the African continent.

src: Die bekendstelling was die gevolg van 'n vennootskap met die projek Isizwe.10 Die Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel:Me lande wat onlangsse terreuraanvalle beleef het, insluitend Somalië, Turkye, Bangladesh en Irak.
tgt: The rollout was the result of a partnership with Project Isizwe.10 Cabinet extends its condolences:To countries which have experienced recent terror attacks, including Somalia, Turkey, Bangladesh and Iraq.

src: Suid-Afrika staan stewig agter die internasionale gemeenskap in die veroordeling van all vorme van terrorisme.
tgt: South Africa stands firmly with the international community in condemning all forms of terrorism.

src: Me die heengaan van die hoogs aangeskrewe akademikus, skrywer en denke-leier, Profssor Adam Small.
tgt: On the passing of highly regarded academic, author and thought leader, Profssor Adam WEBTOKEN the family and friends of Limpopo Agriculture MEC Joy Matshoge who died in a car accident in Mokopane, WEBTOKEN the family of accomplished businessman Don Mkhwanazi who played an instrumental role in black economic empowerment and driving economic transformation in the country.

src: Hy was die stigter van die Black Management Forum.
tgt: He was the founder of the Black Management Forum.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die betrokke uitklaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Advesraad van die Nasionale Kantoor vir die Bestuur van Intellektuele Eiendom vir 'n tydperk van vier jaar:a) MeMorné Barradasb) Dr Antonel Olckersc) MnrMkhetwa Alvin Maluleked) Dr Carol Bernice Nonkweloe) ProfDeresh Ramjugernathf) MeMary Tumelo Mashabela (heraanstelling)g) MnrDuncan Raftesath (heraanstelling)h) MnrMcLean Sibanda (heraanstelling en Voorsitter) eni) MnrVishen Pillay.
