tgt: Advisory Board of the National Intellectual Property Management Office for a period of four years:a) Ms Morne Barradasb) Dr Antonel Olckersc) Mr Mkhetwa Alvin Maluleked) Dr Carol Bernice Nonkweloe) ProfDeresh Ramjugernathf) Ms Mary Tumelo Mashabela (re-appointment)g) Mr Duncan Raftesath (re-appointment)h) Mr McLean Sibanda (re-appointment and Chairperson) andi) Mr Vishen Pillay.

src: Nasionale Instituut vir Radioaktiewe Afvalwegdoening:a) Sekondering van Dr. Wolsey Otto Barnard van die Departement van Energie as Waarnemende Hoof Uitvoerende Beampte vir 'n tydperk van drie jaar.
tgt: National Radioactive Waste Disposal Institute:a) Secondment of Dr. Wolsey Otto Barnard, from the Department of Energy, as the Acting Chief Executive Officer, for a 3 year period.

src: Direksie van die Nasionale Energiereguleerder van Suid-Afrika: a) MnrYusuf Adam.
tgt: Board of Directors of the National Energy Regulator of South Africa:a) Mr Yusuf Adam.

src: Die Kabinet het sy Lekgotla van 16 tot 19 Augustus 2016 in die Sefako Makgatho Presidensiële Gastehuis in Pretoria gehou.
tgt: Cabinet held its Lekgotla from 16 to 19 August 2016 at Sefako Makgatho Presidential Guesthouse in Pretoria.

src: Die Augustus 2016-Kabinet-Lekgotla was die halfpadmerk van die Vyfde Administrasie se ampstermyn.
tgt: The August 2016 Cabinet Lekgotla marked the halfway point of the Fifth Administration’s term of office.

src: Die Kabinet-Lekgotla het Suid-Afrika geluk gewens met die vreedsame, vrye en regverdige plaaslike-regeringsverkiesing wat op 3 Augustus 2016 plaasgevind het.
tgt: Cabinet Lekgotla took time to congratulate South Africa for a peaceful, free and fair Local Government Election that took place on the 3rd of August 2016.The Lekgotla took place in the context of a continuing sub-optimal economic outlook occasioned by various internal and external factors, as well as an ever-present threat to our sovereign credit ratings.

src: Die Lekgotla is gehou in die lig van die voortslepende sub-optimale ekonomiese vooruitsigte weens verskeie interne en eksterne faktore, asook die voortslepende bedreiging van ons soewereine kredietgradering.
tgt: The Lekgotla provided an opportunity for Cabinet to collectively reflect on the implementation of Government’s programme of action and provided crucial lessons for a much nuanced and effective implementation of the National Development Plan, which underpins the Medium Term Strategic Framework 2014-2019.Firm decisions were taken on concrete actionable plans which will take implementation of the Medium-Term Strategic Framework 2014-2019 and the Nine Point Plan to a higher level.

src: Die Lekgotla was 'n geleentheid vir die Kabinet om oor die implementering van die Regering se plan van aksie te besin en het belangrike lesse gebied vir die genuanseerde en doeltreffende implementering van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan, wat die Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk (MTSR) 2014-2019 onderskryf.
tgt: These plans require all sectors, which includes government, civil society, business and labour, to roll up their sleeves and work together to ensure that together we take South Africa on a sustainable social development and economic growth trajectory.

src: Daadwerklike besluite is geneem oor doelgerigte aksieplanne wat implementering van die MTSR 2014-2019 en die Negepuntplan verder sal voer.
tgt: Concrete plans have been put in place to deepen implementation in the next financial year, which also allows government to align its Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) to the implementation of the Nine-Point Plan.

src: Die Kabinet-Lekgotla het op ses kernareas gefokus:1.
tgt: The Cabinet Lekgotla focused on six key areas:1.

src: Eerstens is daar gesamentlik oor 'n internasionale en plaaslike makro-ekonomiese ontleding ooreengekom met verdere voorstelle vir ekonomiese en fiskale konsolidasie in die volgende jaar en daarna.
tgt: First, a global and domestic macro-economic analysis was deliberated on together with further proposals for economic and fiscal consolidation in the next year and beyond.

src: Dit stel die Kabinet in staat om ekonomiese groei en fiskale besluite binne die konteks van die internasionale ekonomie te rig.
tgt: This enabled Cabinet to locate its economic growth and fiscal decisions within the global economic context.

src: Die wêreldekonomie sal na verwagting verder herstel, maar tot 'n mindere mate as wat voorheen beraam is, aangesien Brittanje se uittrede uit die Europese Unie 'n ongunstige invloed op wêreldwye ekonomiese groei het.
tgt: Global recovery is still expected to strengthen but to a lesser degree than previously estimated, as Brexit impacts unfavourably on global growth.

src: Afrika suid van die Sahara weerspieël uitdagende makro-ekonomiese toestande namate die vasteland se groot ekonomieë by laer kommoditeitspryse aanpas.
tgt: Sub-Saharan Africa is reflecting challenging macroeconomic conditions as its major economies adjust to lower commodity process.

src: Ander risiko's sluit in moontlike kwesbaarheid in die Europese bankstelsel, finansiële stabiliteit in ontluikende markte, geopolitieke risiko's, klimaats- en gesondheidsrisiko's.
tgt: Other risks include potential vulnerability in the Euro banking system financial stability in emerging markets geopolitical risks, climatic and health risks.

src: Die mediumtermynraamwerk handhaaf maatskaplike winste in 'n verswakkende ekonomiese omgewing.
tgt: The medium-term framework sustains social gains in a weakening economic environment.

src: Die Regering bly daartoe verbind om sy mediumtermyn fiskale teikens te haal en sal verdere stappe doen na gelang van die omstandighede.
tgt: Government remains committed to meeting its medium-term fiscal targets and will take additional steps to do so as conditions warrant.

src: Die staat se toekomstige verpligtinge sal afhang van hervormings wat op doeltreffende bestuur gegrond is en met deelname deur die private sektor.
tgt: Future commitments of the state will depend on reforms that are based on effective governance, and with participation from the private-sector.

src: Tweedens het die Kabinet-Lekgotla ook oor die implementering van die Negepuntplan besin om die land se ekonomie te laat groei, soos deur President Jacob Zuma in sy Staatsrede in Februarie 2015 aangekondig.
tgt: Second, the Cabinet Lekgotla Cabinet also reflected on the implementation of the Nine-Point Plan to grow the South African economy which was announced by President Jacob Zuma in his State of the Nation Address in February 2015.

src: Die klem was op die belangrikste programme en projekte om die implementering van die Negepuntplan in die volgende finansiële jaar te verdiep.
tgt: The focus was on key programmes and projects to deepen the implementation of the Nine-Point Plan in the next financial year.

src: Dit het gelei tot die aanvaarding van belangrike projekte met 'n hoë impak vir die volgende finansiële jaar en daarna wat gemik is op 'n beduidende positiewe invloed op die ekonomie deur kernhefbome te ontsluit.
tgt: This led to the adoption of key high-impact projects for the next financial year and beyond which aim to have a substantial positive impact on the economy through unlocking key levers.

src: Die Kabinet het strategiese besluite geneem om te verseker dat die Nywerheidsbeleidaksieplan verder gevoer word.
tgt: Cabinet took strategic decisions to secure higher impact implementation of the Industrial Policy Action Plan including:That the Department of Public Enterprises and National Treasury will consolidate procurement for locomotives into a single institution (Transnet) to ensure efficiency and compliance with the localisation requirements.

src: Dit sluit in:Dat die Departement van Openbare Ondernemings en die Nasionale Tesourie die verkryging van lokomotiewe in 'n enkele instelling (Transnet) sal konsolideer om doeltreffendheid en nakoming van lokaliseringsvereistes te verseker.
tgt: Finalising the evaluation of financial incentives for business to strengthen conditionalities and achieve greater value for money to enhance more inclusive growth.

src: Finalisering van die evaluering van finansiële aansporings vir die sakesektor om voorwaardes te versterk en beter waarde vir geld te verkry om inklusiewe groei te verbeter.
tgt: A trade statistics architecture developed by the South African Reserve Bank, National Treasury, SARS and Stats SA will identify and hold illicit financial flows.

src: Ontwikkeling van handelstatistiekargitektuur deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Reserwebank, die Nasionale Tesourie, die Suid-Afrikaanse Inkomstediens en Statistieke Suid-Afrika sal die onwettige vloei van geld identifiseer en daarop beslag lê.Die bekendstelling van wetswysigings om die 30% wat opsygesit is ('n nuwe Wetsontwerp op Verkryging ontwikkel deur die Nasionale Tesourie) teen Maart 2017 te implementeer en die potensiaal van KMMO's en koöperasies, asook dié van townships en landelike ondernemings te ontsluit.
tgt: Introducing legislative amendments to implement the 30% set asides (a new Procurement Bill developed by National Treasury) by March 2017 and unlock the potential of SMME’s, cooperatives and the township and rural enterprises.

src: Die implementering van die nuwe Voorkeurverkrygingsregulasies teen die einde van Augustus 2016 as 'n tussentydse maatreël tot hierdie radikale ingryping.
tgt: Implementing the new Preferential Procurement Regulations by end August 2016 as an interim measure to this radical intervention.

src: Die Regering sal bly fokus op arbeidsintensiewe sektore, insluitend die behoefte aan meganismes vir groter invloed op werksgeleenthede, soos die gebruik van aansporingprogramme waaronder die klerasie-, tekstiel-, leer-en-skoeiselwaardeketting landbouverwerking en sakeprosesdienste.
tgt: Government will continue to focus on labour-intensive sectors, including the need for various mechanisms to support greater impact on jobs, such as the use of our incentive programmes, amongst others: clothing, textiles, leather and footwear value-chain agro-processing and business process services.

src: Die suksesvolle ingrypings in die Oseane-ekonomie sal projekte stimuleer om kus- en mariene toerisme uit te brei en sodoende meer werk skep.
tgt: The successful Oceans Economy intervention will scale up projects to expand coastal and marine tourism in order to realise significant job creation.

src: Om die energie-uitdagings in die land die hoof te bied, gaan die Departement van Energie die Geïntegreerde Energieplan en Geïntegreerde Hulpbronplan vir Elektrisiteit teen die einde van 2016 voltooi om sekerheid oor elektrisiteitspryse en belegging in opwekkingsvermoë te verkry.
tgt: To resolve the energy challenges in country, the Department of Energy will complete the Integrated Energy Plan and Integrated Resource Plan for Electricity by the end of 2016 to provide certainty on electricity pricing and investment in the generation capacity.

src: Die Interministeriële Komitee oor Belegging, onder voorsitterskap van President Jacob Zuma sal 40 prioriteitsbeleggingsprojekte in die Regering koördineer.
tgt: The Inter Ministerial Committee on Investment, Chaired by President Jacob Zuma will coordinate 40 priority investment projects across government.

src: Hierdie 40 projekte sluit in landbouverwerking en landbouparke, energie en infrastruktuur, vervaardiging en diensteprojekte.
tgt: These 40 projects include the agro-processing and agri-parks, energy and infrastructure, manufacturing and services projects.

src: Hierdie projekte is gekies op grond van hul grootskaalse ekonomiese invloed wat verband hou met die Negepuntplan, dat hulle binne die volgende twee jaar in werking kan tree en verdere belegging en gemeenskapsvoordele kan bewerkstellig.
tgt: These projects were selected based on having a high-scale economic impact linked to the Nine-Point Plan being able to take-off within the next two years and able to crowd-in further investment and community benefits.

src: Die Departement van Handel en Nywerheid sal die strategie vir die ontplooiing van plaaslik ontwikkelde tegnologieë teen die einde van 2016 finaliseer.
tgt: Department of Trade and Industry will finalise the strategy for the deployment of locally developed technologies by the end of 2016.

src: Daarbenewens sal die Departement van Wetenskap en Tegnologie en die Nasionale Tesourie bykomende fondse verkry om die Sektorinnoveringsfonds in stand te hou en uit te brei deur middel van die Ondersteuningspakket vir Ekonomiese Meedinging.
tgt: Further, the Department of Science and Technology and the National Treasury will secure additional funds to sustain and expand the Sector Innovation Fund through the Economic Competitive Support Package.

src: Waterbesparing en die vermindering van vermorsing bly 'n prioriteit.
tgt: Priority continues to be placed on water saving and minimisation of water losses.

src: Teen September 2016 sal ooreenkomste met munisipaliteite met hoë vlakke van waterverliese gesluit wees om die plasing van agente te vergemaklik en 'n duidelike befondsingsmodel sal daarvoor opgetel word.
tgt: By September 2016, agreements are to be completed with municipalities with high water losses, to facilitate placement of agents, and a clear funding model is to be completed.

src: Die IKT-beleid sal gefinaliseer en goedgekeur word om die Suid-Afrikaanse Verbindingstrategie in skole, gesondheidsgeriewe en regeringskantore in werking te stel.
tgt: In fast tracking the implementation of the South African Connect Strategy to connect schools, health facilities and government offices, the ICT Policy will be finalised and approved.

src: 'n Aksiekomitee vir Breëband sal in die lewe geroep word om implementering te versnel.
tgt: A Broadband War Room will be established to accelerate implementation.

src: Derdens het die Bestuurskomitee van die Presidensiële Koördinerende Kommissie vir Infrastruktuur (PICC) 'n hoëvlakverslag by die lekgotla voorgelê oor die implementering van die nasionale infrastruktuurontwikkelingsprogram asook daadwerklike planne vir die implementering van infrastruktuur in die volgende finansiële jaar en daarna.
tgt: Thirdly, the Presidential Infrastructure Coordinating Commission (PICC) MANCO presented the Lekgotla with a high-level report on the implementation of the national infrastructure development programme as well as concrete infrastructure implementation plans in the next financial year and beyond.

src: Die werk van die PICC is nou in lyn met dié van die Negepuntplan.
tgt: The work of the PICC is closely aligned to that of the Nine-Point Plan.

src: Vierdens is 'n opsomming van 'n vorderingsverslag oor die implementering van die mediumtermyn strategiese raamwerk (MTSR) 2014-2019 voorgelê, wat konsentreer op 'n hersiening van die belangrikste aspekte van die MTSR 2014-2019 om implementering in die volgende finansiële jaar te verbeter.
tgt: Fourthly, a summarised progress report on the implementation of the Medium-Term Strategic Framework (MTSF) 2014-2019 was presented, which concentrated on a review of key aspects of the MTSF 2014-2019 so as to improve implementation in the next financial year.

src: Hoewel erkenning gegee is aan die werk wat tot op datum aan die Negepuntplan verrig is, is erken dat versnelde implementering nodig is om ekonomiese groei te bevorder.
tgt: Whilst acknowledging the work done to date in the 9-Point Plan, it was also acknowledged that accelerated implementation is necessary to enhance economic growth.

src: 'n Aksieplan om groter besteding aan munisipale instandhouding van infrastruktuur te verseker en om behoorlike finansiële batebestuur af te dwing sal ontwikkel en geïmplementeer word om die lewensduur en gehalte van ons infrastruktuurbates uit te brei.
tgt: An action plan to ensure greater expenditure on municipal infrastructure maintenance and to enforce proper financial asset management will be developed and implemented to extend the lifespan and quality of our infrastructure assets.

src: Die Kabinet het besluit om 'n nasionale proses van stapel te stuur om ’n maatskaplike ooreenkoms tussen arbeid, die sakesektor en die Regering te bewerkstellig om ekonomiese groei te stimuleer en werkverliese te verminder.
tgt: Cabinet resolved to initiate a national process towards the negotiation of a Social Compact between labour, business and government to stimulate economic growth and mitigate job losses.

src: Vyfdens, benewens die MTBR se aanpassing by die Negpuntplan, het die Nasionale Tesourie en die Departement van Beplanning, Monitering en Evaluering ook hul aanbevelings voorgelê oor werk wat in die afgelope jaar gedoen is om die nasionale begroting by die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan asook die mediumtermyn strategiese raamwerk (MTSR) 2014-2019 aan te pas.
tgt: Fifth, over and above the alignment of the MTEF to the Nine-Point Plan, the National Treasury and the Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation presented their recommendations on work done in the past year to align the national budget to the National Development Plan as well as to the Medium-Term Strategic Framework (MTSF) 2014-2019.

src: Die Regering het 'n stel prioriteite vir die 2017/18 begroting geïdentifiseer wat fokus op die besteding aan infrastruktuurinstandhouding, die bevordering van ondersteuning vir vaardigheidsontwikkeling en die handhawing van daadwerklike besteding aan die armes.
tgt: Government has identified a set of budget priorities for 2017/18 which focusses on maintaining infrastructure spend, strengthening support for skills development and maintaining real levels of spending on the poor.

src: Werk aan die identifisering van doeltreffendhede en besparing oor die res van die MTBR sal voortgaan.
tgt: Work on identifying efficiencies and savings over the remainder of the MTEF will continue.

src: Ten sesde het die Lekgotla ook besin oor vordering en die volgende stappe tot die hervorming van maatskappye in staatsbesit sedert die Kabinet-Lekgotla van Februarie 2015.
tgt: Sixth, the Lekgotla also reflected on progress made and the next steps in the reform of state-owned companies (SOCs) since the Cabinet Lekgotla of February 2015.

src: Dit is in die lig van die belangrike rol wat maatskappye in staatsbesit speel in die radikale sosio-ekonomiese transformasie soos uiteengesit in die Vyfde Administrasie se plan.
tgt: This is in view of the important role played by SOCs in the radical socio-economic transformation advocated in the programme of the Fifth Administration.

src: Die implementering van die stabiliseringsprogram het met gemengde welslae gevorder.
tgt: The implementation of the stabilisation programme has progressed with varying degrees.

src: Versterking van leierskap om die omkeerstrategieë uit te voer, is noodsaaklik.
tgt: Strengthening of leadership to execute the turnaround strategies remains critical.

src: Eskom is grootliks gestabiliseer met verbetering in beide operasionele en finansiële prestasie.
tgt: Eskom has largely been stabilised with both operational and financial performance improving.

src: Die Interministeriële Komitee sal bly toesig hou oor 13 ander spesifieke ingrypings by maatskappye in staatsbesit.
tgt: The Inter Ministerial Committee will continue to oversee thirteen (13) other SOC specific interventions.

src: Die Lekgotla het die finalisering van die Model van Eienaarskap van Aandeelhouding geprioritiseer, wat die wetgewende raamwerk vir hervorming van maatskappye in staatsbesit teen November 2016 sal toelig.
tgt: The Lekgotla placed priority on the finalisation of the Shareholder Ownership Model, which will inform the legislative framework for SOC reform by November 2016.

src: Daar sal ook begin word met die skepping van die Presidensiële Koördinerende Raad van Maatskappye in Staatsbesit wat President Zuma oor strategiese besluite en intervensies sal inlig om maatskappye in staatsbesit te skep wat 'n transformerende rol in 'n ontwikkelingstaat sal speel.
tgt: Work will also start for the creation of the Presidential SOCs Coordinating Council which will provide President Zuma line of sight on strategic decisions and interventions to create SOCs that play a transformative role in a capable developmental state.

src: Die besluite en planne van die Kabinet-Lekgotla sal die implementering van die Regering se program van aksie versterk en vertroue skep dat Suid-Afrika op koers is met volhoubare maatskaplike ontwikkeling en ekonomiese groei.
tgt: The decisions and plans from the Cabinet Lekgotla will bolster implementation of government’s programme of action and gives confidence that South Africa is on a sustainable social development and economic growth trajectory.

src: Spesiale Amptelike Begrafnis.1 Die Kabinet spreek sy meegevoel uit oor die afsterwe van die voormalige Minister van Sport en Ontspanning, ds Arnold Makhenkesi Stofile.
tgt: Special Official Funeral.1 Cabinet is saddened by the passing away of the former Minister of Sports and Recreation, Reverend Arnold Makhenkesi Stofile.

src: As 'n veteraan politieke aktivis, was hy betrokke by alle regeringsfere, op verskeie provinsiale, nasionale en internasionale strukture.2 President Jacob Zuma het verklaar dat ds Stofile 'n spesiale staatsbegrafnis sal kry ingevolge Kategorie 2 van die Beleid oor Begrafnisse vir Staats- en Provinsiale amptenare.
tgt: As a veteran political activist, he participated in all pillars of government, at various provincial, national and international structures.2 President Jacob Zuma declared that Reverend Stofile will be accorded a Special Official Funeral in terms of Category 2 of the State Official and Provincial Official Funeral Policy.

src: Om hulde aan hierdie groot leier van ons land te bring, is die amptelike roudiens vir wyle ds Stofile vandag om 11:00 by die Abbotsford Christensentrum in Oos-Londen gehou.
tgt: As we remember this great leader of our country, the official memorial service for the late Rev.

src: Implementering van belangrike Regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of Key Government Programmes.

src: President Jacob Zuma het 'n afvaardiging van die Suid-Afrikaanse Regering na die 36ste Gewone Spitsberaad van Staatshoofde van die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap (SAOG) gelei wat van 30 tot 31 Augustus 2016 gehou is met die tema "Mobilisasie van Hulpbronne vir Belegging in Infrastruktuur vir Volhoubare Energie vir 'n Inklusiewe Industrialisasie van die SAOG en die welvaart van die streek".Die beraad het gefokus op die behoefte om industriële en infrastruktuurontwikkeling te verbeter en sodoende integrasie en handel binne die streek te verbeter om stukrag te verleen aan die SAOG se agenda vir volhoubare ontwikkeling.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma led a South African Government delegation to the 36th Ordinary Southern African Development Community (SADC) Summit of Heads of State which took place from 30 to 31 August 2016 under the theme: “Resource Mobilisation for Investment in Sustainable Energy Infrastructure for an Inclusive SADC Industrialisation and for the Prosperity of the Region”.The Summit focused on the need to improve both industrial and infrastructure development to enhance integration and foster intra-regional trade in addressing SADC’s sustainable development agenda.

src: Wat betref die politieke en veiligheidsituasie in die streek, het die beraad gefokus op hervormings in die grondwetlike, openbare en veiligheidsektore in die Koninkryk van Lesotho, asook op nasionale versoening, die implementering van die SAOG-padkaart vir Madagaskar en die nasionale dialoog vir voorbereidings vir nasionale verkiesings in die Demokratiese Republiek die Kongo.
tgt: On the political and security situation in the region, the focus was on constitutional, public and security sector reforms in the Kingdom of Lesotho, national reconciliation, implementation of the SADC Roadmap on Madagascar and the national dialogue towards preparations for national elections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

src: Die Kabinet sluit hom aan by president Jacob Zuma en bedank die SAOG-ledestate vir hul vertroue in Suid-Afrika deur die land as voorsitter van die SAOG vanaf Augustus 2017 te verkies.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Jacob Zuma is extending gratitude to SADC Member States for the trust and confidence in electing South Africa as the incoming Chair of SADC in August 2017.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die geskiedkundige belegging van R11 miljard deur Beijing Automobile International Corporation (BAIC) vir die bou van 'n motorvervaardigingsaanleg in die Coega-nywerheidsontwikkelingsone.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the historic R11 billion investment by the Beijing Automobile International Corporation (BAIC) to establish an automotive manufacturing plant in the Coega Industrial Development Zone.

src: Die transaksie is die grootste van sy soort in Afrika in die laaste 40 jaar en herbevestig die land as 'n topbeleggingsbestemming vir internasionale motorvervaardigers.
tgt: The deal is the biggest automotive investment in Africa in the last 40 years and reaffirms the country as a top investment destination for global automotive producers.

src: Dit is moontlik gemaak danksy Suid-Afrika se bevorderlike beleidsomgewing, veral die Motorvervaardigingsontwikkelingsprogram wat reeds motorvervaardigers van oor die hele wêreld gelok het.
tgt: This was made possible through South Africa’s supportive policy environment, in particular the Automotive Production and Development Programme which has attracted automotive producers from across the world.

src: Die BAIC-belegging is 'n uitvloeisel van die Forum vir Samewerking tussen China en Afrika wat in Desember 2015 in Johannesburg gehou is, en waartydens president Jacob Zuma en die Chinese premier, Xi Jinping, nie minder nie as 26 bilaterale ooreenkomste ter waarde van ongeveer R100 miljard onderteken het.
tgt: The BAIC investment is an outcome of the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation (FOCAC) that was held in Johannesburg in December 2015, where President Jacob Zuma and Chinese President Xi Jinping signed no less than 26 bilateral agreements valued at approximately R100 billion.

src: Die projek posisioneer die Oos-Kaap as 'n kern vir die motorbedryf en het die potensiaal om die voerketting van komponente, werkskepping en ekonomiese ontwikkeling uit te brei.
tgt: The project positions the Eastern Cape as an automotive hub and has the potential of deepening the component supply chain, job creation and economic development.

src: Na verwagting sal 2 500 direkte en meer as 10 600 indirekte werksgeleenthede in die sektor geskep word.
tgt: It is expected to create 2 500 jobs directly and more than 10 600 jobs indirectly.

src: Vroeër vanjaar het Toyota aangekondig dat hulle die nuwe Toyota Hilux- en Fortuner-modelle plaaslik gaan vervaardig as deel van 'n belegging van R6,1 miljard.
tgt: Earlier this year Toyota announced that it would manufacture the new Toyota Hilux and Fortuner models as part of a R.1 billion investment while BMW is to construct a R6 billion a state-of-the-art body shop.

src: Hierdie beleggings help om nasionale prioriteite soos die aansporing van ekonomiese groei, die behoud van bestaande werksgeleenthede en die skepping van nuwe werkgeleenthede te verwesenlik.
tgt: These investments help advance our national priorities of reigniting economic growth, preserving existing and creating more jobs in the economy.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van die eerste koöperatiewe finansiële instelling vir landelike vroue in kunsvlyt deur die minister van landelike ontwikkeling en grondhervorming, Gugile Nkwinti.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the first Co-operative Financial Institution for Rural Women in Arts and Craft by the Minister of Rural Development and Land Reform, Gugile Nkwinti.

src: Die Mzansi Landelike, Korporatiewe Finansiële-Instellingkoöperasie Vir Kuns En Kunsvlyt, , wat vroeër vanjaar geregistreer is, sal as 'n bankdiensplatform dien vir landelike handwerkers wat lede van koöperasies is wat in KwaZulu-Natal, die Oos-Kaap, Limpopo en Mpumalanga gestig is.
tgt: The Mzansi Rural Arts and Craft Financial Institution Cooperative, which was registered earlier this year, will serve as a banking platform for rural crafters who are members of cooperatives that have been established in KwaZulu-Natal, the Eastern Cape, Limpopo and Mpumalanga.

src: Die instelling gee hierdie vroue toegang tot die nasionale betaalstelsel, geoutomatiseerde sakebedrywighede, akkurate, omsigtige verslagdoening en sal lede in staat te stel om transaksies by betaalpunte, OTM's en met ander koöperatiewe finansiële instellings oor die hele land te beklink.
tgt: The Institution allows these women access to the National Payment System, automated operations, accurate prudential reporting and will enable members to transact at point of sale, ATM and with other co-operative financial institutions across South Africa.

src: Van die belangrikste uitkomste van ondersteuning sluit in die verkryging van geldige registrasiesertifikate, bankrekeninge, belastingklaringsertifikate en skakeling met nuwe markte, plaaslik en internasionaal.
tgt: Some of the key outcomes of the support provided include the acquisition of valid registration certificates, bank accounts, tax clearance certificates and linkages to new markets local and international markets.

src: Die inisiatief is deel van 'n holistiese poging om vroue in landelike gebiede met vaardighede en kennis te bemagtig sodat hulle suksesvolle ondernemings kan bedryf.
tgt: The initiative is part of a holistic effort to empower women in rural areas with skills and knowledge to create successful enterprises.

src: Danksy die Minister van Landelike Ontwikkeling en Grondhervorming se bekendstelling van die 50/50-beleid, het die eerste plaas in KwaZulu-Natal die loodsfase betree van die beleidsraamwerk op die versterking van die relatiewe regte van mense wat op grond werk.
tgt: The launch of the 50/50 policy by Minister of Rural Development and Land Reform, has seen the first farm entering the pilot phase of the Policy Framework on Strengthening the Relative Rights of People Working the Land, in KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Die plaas, Westcliffe, wat 514 hektaar groot is, bestaan uit 270 hektaar suikerriet, 140 hektaar boomplantasies en 10 hektaar kool onder besproeiing.
tgt: The 514 hectares Westcliffe farm comprises of 270 hectares of sugar cane, 140 hectares of timber and 10 hectares of irrigated cabbage operation.

src: Ingevolge die ooreenkoms sal werkers en plaaseienaars mede-eienaars van die boerdery in die uMshwathi plaaslike munisipaliteit naby Greytown word.
tgt: The agreement will see workers and farm owners become co-owners of the farming enterprise in uMshwathi local municipality, near Greytown.

src: Die beleid is onder andere daarop gemik om verblyfreg vir plaaswerkers te bewerkstellig, om patrone van grondeienaarskap te transformeer en werkers te bemagtig om aandele in boerderye te bekom.
tgt: Among other things, the policy aims to secure tenure for farm workers while seeking to transform land ownership patterns in the country and empowering workers to acquire shares in farming enterprises.

src: Die 50/50-beleidsraamwerk het dit ten doel om ekonomiese transformasie van die landbousektor te bevorder.
tgt: The 50/50 policy framework also aims to improve economic transformation of the agricultural sector.

src: Die doel van die 2016 Colloquium oor Transformasie in die Gedrukte Meia van die Departement van Kommunikasie was om transformasie en diversiteit in die media te berdeneer en het aan verskeie aktiewe belanghebbendes in die media 'n platform gebied om transformasie in die media, aanspreeklikheid en diversiteit te bespreek.
tgt: The 2016 Colloquium on Print Media Transformation which was hosted by the Department of Communications to discuss transformation and diversity in the country’s media provided a platform to a range of stakeholders active in the media environment to discuss the country’s media transformation, accountability and diversity priorities.

src: Die colloquium het op die hele waardeketting in die gedrukte media gefokus, van eienaarskap tot drukwerk, verspreiding, navorsing en reklame.
tgt: The colloquium, which focused on the entire value chain in the print media space, from ownership through to printing, distribution, research and advertising, will inform a concept paper related to the transformation and reform of traditional and new media in South Africa.

src: Dit sal die raamwerk skep vir 'n konsepdokument rakende transformasie en hervorming van tradisionele en nuwe media in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: South Africa marks Tourism Month in September under the theme: “Tourism for All” to promote the country’s rich tourism offerings to all South Africans.

src: Suid-Afrika vier in September Toerismemaand met die tema "Toerisme vir Almal" om die land se ryk toerismehulpbronne aan alle Suid-Afrikaners beskikbaar te stel.
tgt: Cabinet encourages everyone to work together to ensure that barriers that prevent access are removed and all South Africans are afforded the opportunity, and cultivate the interest to explore our fascinating and beautiful country.

src: Ons doen ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om die verskillende kulture in ons land te vier in die lig van Erfenismaand in September met die tema "Meslike skatte en Legendes: Ons lewende erfenis".Ons moedig Suid-Afrikaners aan om trots te wees op ons lewende erfenis en aktief hierdie erfenis te bevorder, te versterk en te bewaar.
tgt: We call on all South Africans to celebrate our nations diverse cultures as the country marks Heritage Month in September under the theme: “Human Treasures and Legends: our Living Heritage”.South Africans are encouraged to take pride in our living heritage and play an active role in affirming, promoting and preserving it.

src: Dit is belangrik dat ons ons lewende menslike skatte op alle vlakke van ons samelewing vier.
tgt: It is important that as a nation we celebrate our Living Human Treasures in all areas of our society.

src: Vanjaar is dit 20 jaar sedert Erfenisdag in 1996 geproklameer is en ons moet die dag gebruik om ons gedeelde erfenis te omhels en op die vordering vir die skepping van 'n verenigde Suid-Afrika sedert 1994 te bou.
tgt: This year’s commemoration marks 20 years since Heritage Day was proclaimed in 1996 and we must use the day to embrace our shared heritage to build on our progress since 1994 in creating a united South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die 2016-Staatsdiensmaand in September met die tema "Staatsdiens vir die inklusiewe groei maak saak: Neem Batho Pele na die volgende vlak om die staatsdiens vorentoe te neem".Vanjaar se Staatsdiensmaand vind plaas tydens die vyfde administrasie en 'n maand ná die plaaslikeregeringsverkiesings.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the 2016 Public Service Month during September under the theme “Public Services for the Inclusive Growth Matter: Taking Batho Pele to the next level in moving the Public Service Forward”.This year’s Public Service Month also takes place mid-way through the fifth administration and a month after the local government elections.

src: Die maandlange program vorm 'n integrale deel van die Batho Pele-Opknappingstrategie, wat daarop gemik is om goeie etiek, moreel, trots en professionaliteit van staatsamptenare te herbou deur die voorsiening van openbare goedere en dienste.
tgt: The month-long programme is an integral part of the Batho Pele Revitalisation Strategy which aims to rebuild good ethics, morale, pride and professionalism of government employees in the provision of public goods and services.

src: Staatsamptenare sal vandeesmaand met landsburgers en openbare belangegroepe skakel rakende die behoefte aan doeltreffende dienslewering.
tgt: Public Service employees across government will use this month to engage and interact with citizens and other public stakeholders about the need for efficient delivery of services.

src: Die doel hiervan is om die implementering van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan te versterk deur 'n bekwame staat te help bou en transformasie en ontwikkeling te help bevorder.
tgt: This forms part of strengthening the implementation of the National Development Plan by contributing towards building a capable state that plays a developmental and transformative role.

src: Die jaarlikse Thusong-dienssentrumweek vind plaas van 19 tot 23 September 2016 met die tema "Thusong-dienssentrums - Neem die staatsdiens vorentoe: Ons behoort, ons gee om, ons dien".
tgt: Thusong Service Centre Annual Week from 19 to 23 September 2016 will be held under the theme “Thusong Service Centres – Moving the Public Service forward: We Belong, We Care, We Serve”.

src: Tydens die week kom inligting, dienste en geleenthede wat in Thusong-dienssentrums oor die hele land beskikbaar is, onder die loep.
tgt: The week highlights government information, services and opportunities that are available in Thusong Service Centres across the country.

src: Geleenthede is beplan om die week te herdenk en die prestasies van die sentrums sedert hul stigting in 1999 uit te lig.
tgt: Events have been planned to commemorate the week and profile the achievements of the centres since their establishment in 1999.

src: Die Regering het die handelsmerk en kommunikasiestrategie van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP) bekend gestel.
tgt: Government launched the National Development Plan (NDP) brand and communication strategy.

src: Die visuele identiteit van die NOP sal Regeringskommunikasie saamsnoer en vordering rakende die implementering van die NOP deur middel van 'n herkenbare handelsmerk uitlig.
tgt: The NDP visual identity will unify and profile government communication efforts on progress in the implementation of the NDP through a recognisable brand identity.

src: Sleutelkabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet keur Suid-Afrika se oorkoepelende benadering tot deelname aan vanjaar se G20-beraad goed wat onder die Chinese presidensie, op 'n oorkoepelende werkstema besluit het, naamlik "Vir 'n innoverende, lewenskragtige, interkonnektiewe en inklusiewe wêreldekonomie".Die hooffokus van die G20-beraad is om multilaterale samewerking te verhoog om die wêreldekonomie te herstel, stabiliteit in die internasionale finansiële stelsel mee te bring, volhoubare groei oor die lang termyn te bewerkstellig en wêreldwye ekonomiese bestuur te verbeter.
tgt: Cabinet approved South Africa’s overarching approach for its participation in this year’s G20 which under the Chinese Presidency, adopted an overarching theme of working “Towards an Innovative, Invigorated, Interconnected and Inclusive World Economy”.The primary focus of the G20 is to increase multilateral cooperation for the recovery of the global economy, to bring stability to the global financial system, to promote long-term sustainable growth and to strengthen global economic governance.

src: President Jacob Zuma sal die G20-beraad in Hangzhou, China, op 4 en 5 September 2016 bywoon.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will attend the G20 Summit in Hangzhou, China on 4 and 5 September 2016 hosted.

src: Suid-Afrika sal tydens die G20-beraad strategiese visie verleen om 'n ekonomiese en internasionale beleidplatform te help skep wat die beste moontlike uitkomste vir Suid-Afrika, Afrika en die ontwikkelende wêreld sal meebring.
tgt: South Africa’s participation in the G20 is to provide strategic foresight in establishing an economic and international policy platform that will drive and negotiate the best possible outcomes for South Africa, Africa and the developing world.

src: 'n Rekordgetal afgevaardigdes van ontwikkelende lande sal vanjaar se G20-beraad bywoon.
tgt: The G20 Summit will, for the first time in history, have a record number of developing countries in attendance.

src: Die 2015/16 Nasionale Jaarlikse misdaadsyfers, wat saamgestel is uit misdaadsyfers van polisiestasies, is goedgekeur en sal op 2 September 2016 gepubliseer word.
tgt: The release of the 2015/16 National Annual Crime Statistics, which are generated from crime data that are reported at station level was also approved and will be published on 2 September 2016.The release of the statistics contribute towards the strategic outcome of ‘All people in South Africa are and feel safe’.The crime statistics are in important indicator of governments fight against crime in partnership with communities, labour and business.

src: Die statistiek moet gesien word binne die konteks van bevolkingsgroei en die ekonomie.
tgt: The statistics should be viewed within the context of population growth and economic circumstance.

src: Die Kabinet het 'n verslag oor die uitkomste van die twaalfde sitting van die partykonferensie by die Verenigde Nasies se Konvensie oor die Bekamping van Verwoestyning in Ankara, Turkye, vanaf 12 tot 23 Oktober 2015 ontvang.
tgt: Cabinet received a report on the Outcomes of the Twelfth Session of the Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD COP12) which was held in Ankara, Turkey from 12 to 23 October 2015.South Africa was identified as one of the beneficiaries of the UNCCD target setting support programme, which will assist countries to formulate it national voluntary targets in line with national circumstances and development priorities.

src: Suid-Afrika aanvaar die omvattendheid van die konvensie en die behoefte om alle lande te dien wat met verwoestyning, grondagteruitgang en droogte te kampe het.
tgt: South Africa embraces the universality of the Convention and the need to serve all countries affected by desertification, land degradation and drought which will in turn ensure that such issues are taken care of wherever they happen both at national and global levels.

src: Dit sal op sy beurt verseker dat sodanige kwessies aandag op nasionale en internasionale vlak aandag geniet.
tgt: This will ensure inclusivity and improve North-South relations and cooperation.

src: Dit sal inklusiwiteit en verbeterde noord-suid-betrekkinge en samewerking teweeg bring.
tgt: Cabinet approved the co-hosting of the 2nd World Breastfeeding Conference by the Department of Health and the International Baby Food Action Network, from 11 to 14 December 2016, under the theme “Let’s invest in creating an enabling environment for mothers and babies”.This signals South Africa’s commitment to strengthen the call to protect, promote and support breastfeeding and further enhance the infant and young child nutrition agenda.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die mede-aanbieding van die 2de Wêreldborsvoedingkonferensie deur die Departement van Gesondheid en die Internasionale Babavoedselaksienetwerk van 11 tot 14 Desember 2016 onder die tema "Kom ons belê in 'n gunstige omgewing vir moeders en babas".Dit bewys Suid-Afrika se verbintenis tot die beskerming, bevordering en ondersteuning van borsvoeding en bevorder voeding onder babas en jong kinders.
tgt: This contributes to achieving one of the nine long term health goals set out in the National Development Plan reducing maternal, infant and child mortality.

src: Die Doelwitte vir Volhoubare Ontwikkeling plaas ook klem op die verbetering van voeding.
tgt: The Sustainable Development Goals also place emphasis on improving nutrition.

src: Een van ses internasionale teikens vir voeding in die Omvattende Implementeringsplan oor Voeding vir Moeders, Babas en jong Kinders is om die koers vir uitsluitlike borsvoeding in die eerste ses maande ná geboorte teen 2025 tot minstens 50% te verhoog.
tgt: The Comprehensive Implementation Plan on Maternal, Infant and Young Child Nutrition, has one of six global targets for nutrition to increase the rates of exclusive breastfeeding in the first six months to at least 50% by 2025.Breastfeeding is one of the best value investments in child survival.

src: Suboptimale borsvoedingspraktyke dra jaarliks by tot 800 000 sterftes (13% van alle sterfgevalle) onder kinders onder vyf in ontwikkelende lande, asook die hoë voorkoms van wanvoeding, 'n groot uitdaging in openbare gesondheid in Afrika.
tgt: Sub-optimal breastfeeding practices contribute annually to 800 000 deaths (13% of all deaths) among under-five children in the developing world as well as to the high prevalence of malnutrition, which is a major public health challenge in Africa.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Departement van Gesondheid die 17de Internasionale Konferensie oor Meisynereguleringsowerhede aanbied, wat vanaf 27 November tot 2 Desember 2016 in samewerking met die Wêreldgesondheidsorganisasie (WGO) sal plaasvind.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the Department of Health to host the 17th International Conference of Drug Regulatory Authorities, from 27 November to 2 December 2016, in cooperation with the World Health Organisation (WHO).

src: Dit weerspieël die Regering se verbintenis om internasionale gesondheidskwessies te pak deur regulasies eenvormig te maak en veiligheid, doeltreffendheid en gehalte van medisyne en mediese toestelle te verbeter.
tgt: This reflects government’s commitment in addressing global health challenges on harmonisation of regulations and improve the safety, efficacy and quality of medicines and medical devices.

src: Hierdie raadplegende forum vir medisynereguleringsowerhede van die 194 WGO-lidlande het ten doel om die regulering van medisyne en mediese toerusting te bekyk en regulerende beginsels meer eenvormig te maak.
tgt: This consultative forum for medicine regulatory authorities of the 194 WHO member countries aims to address the regulation of medicines and medical devices and harmonisation of regulatory WEBTOKEN will strengthen the national medicines regulatory authority, the Medicines Control Council, and systems for medical products.

src: Die aanbieding sal die Meisynebeheerraad en stelsels vir mediese produkte versterk.
tgt: Discussions will also contribute towards informing harmonisation and uplifting regulatory standards in Africa and the Southern African Development Community (SADC).It also gives recognition of South Africa as a global role-player in the regulatory oversight of medicines and related products.

src: Die land sal kan deelneem aan die formulering van internasionale medisynebeleid wat verpligtend vir WGO-lidlande kan word.
tgt: The country will have an opportunity to participate in the formulation of international drug policies that may become mandatory on WHO member countries.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die vordering oor die inwerkingstelling van die Wet op Openbare Administrasiebestuur, No 11 van 2014.
tgt: Cabinet was also briefed on progress made on the implementation of the Public Administration Management Act, No 11 of 2014.

src: Die wet skep 'n eenvormige stelsel van openbare administrasie op al drie vlakke van regering om die waardes en beginsels van openbare administrasie soos vervat in artikel 195 (1) van die Grondwet uit te bou.
tgt: This Act establishes a uniform system of public administration at all three spheres of government to promote and entrench the values and principles governing public administration as in section 195 (1) of the Constitution.

src: Die Wet maak voorsiening vir die vestiging van twee strukture naamlik:
tgt: The Act provides for the establishment of two structures namely:

src: die Kantoor van Standaarde en Nakoming en (ii) 'n Tegniese Bystandeenheid.
tgt: Office of Standards and Compliance and (ii) Technical Assistance Unit.

src: 'n Trapsgewyse benadering gaan gevolg word om die strukture in te voer.
tgt: A staggered implementation approach has been adopted to establish these.

src: Die Departement van Staatsdiens en Administrasie (DSA) het die eerste stel regulasies saamgestel wat op 15 Julie 2016 vir openbare kommentaar in die Staatskoerant gepubliseer is.
tgt: The Department of Public Service and Administration (DPSA) compiled a first set of regulations which were gazetted for public comment on 15 July 2016.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse Buro vir Standaarde en ander instellings werk tans saam om 'n wettige meganisme te ontwikkel wat tot die operasionalisering en vestiging van die Kantoor van Standaarde en Nakoming sal lei.
tgt: Collaboration is underway with the South African Bureau of Standards and other national setting bodies to develop a legal instrument which will lead to the operationalisation and establishment of the Office of Standards and Compliance.

src: Die DSA is besig om norme en standaarde, en bestuursreëlings op te stel wat vir die implementering van die toepaslike norme voorsiening sal maak.
tgt: DPSA is also in the process of investigating and developing a framework of norms and standards, including the establishment of the governance arrangements model that will allow for the implementation of the applicable norms.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van 'n verslag oor asielstatistiek vir Januarie tot Desember 2015.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on a report on the asylum statistics for the period January to December 2015.

src: Die Kabinet ondersteun 'n multi-departementele taakspan vir die bespreking van die bestuur van asielsoekers wie se aansoeke finaal verwerp is.
tgt: Cabinet supported the establishment of a multi-departmental task team to discuss the process on managing final rejected asylum seekers.

src: Die verslag help met ingeligte bestuur van immigrasie om die bestuur van asielsoekers en vlugtelinge te verbeter.
tgt: The Report contributes to informed management of immigration so as to improve the management of asylum seekers and refugees.

src: Volgens inligting van die Nasionale Immigrasie-inligtingstelsel, is 62 159 nuwe asielsoekers geregistreer, teenoor 71 914 in 2014 en 70 010 in 2013.
tgt: According to information sourced from the National Immigration Information System, 62 159 new asylum seekers were registered, against 71 914 registered in 2014 and 70 010 in 2013.

src: Nagenoeg 60 640 geregistreerde gevalle van asiel is tussen Januarie en Desember 2015 op Vlugtelingstatusbepalingsvlak beoordeel en afgehandel.
tgt: 60 640 registered asylum cases were adjudicated and finalised at the Refugee Status Determination level between January and December 2015.

src: Hiervan is 2 499 asielgevalle goedgekeur, 4 093 as ongegrond verwerp en 44 048 verwerp as klaarblyklik ongegrond, misbruikend en bedrieglik.
tgt: Of these adjudicated cases: 2 499 asylum cases were approved, 4 093 asylum cases were rejected as unfounded and 44 048 asylum cases were rejected as manifestly unfounded, abusive and fraudulent.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van vordering met die Wetsontwerp op die Grensbestuurowerheid (GBO), 2016 wat vir voorlegging aan die Parlement op 23 September 2015 goedgekeur is.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on progress made with the Border Management Authority (BMA) Bill, 2016 which was approved for submission to Parliament on 23 September 2015.

src: Hierdie wetsontwerp is oorspronklik op 8 Oktober 2015 aan die Parlement voorgelê.
tgt: This Bill was originally submitted to Parliament on 8 October 2015.

src: Die sosio-ekonomiese implikasies van die beoogde skepping van die Grensbeheerowerheid vereis dat dit ook aan die NEOAR voorgelê word, wat op 13 Oktober 2015 gedoen is.
tgt: The socio-economic implications, of the envisaged establishment of the Border Management Authority, required that it also be submitted to NEDLAC, this was done on 13 October 2015.There was an extensive NEDLAC consultations process on the Bill between November 2015 and May 2016.

src: Tussen November 2015 en Me 2016 was daar uitgebreide gesprekvoering deur NEOAR oor die wetsontwerp.
tgt: On 12 May 2016 a final NEDLAC report on the BMA Bill, 2016 was approved by the NEDLAC Management Committee.

src: Op 12 Me 2016 is 'n finale NEOAR-verslag oor die GBO-wetsontwerp van 2016 deur die NEOAR-bestuurskomitee goedgekeur.
tgt: The Bill was certified on 18 May 2016 by the Office of the Chief State Law Advisor for introduction into Parliament.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis dat die GBO-wetsontwerp van 2016 hierna op 25 Me 2016 aan die Parlement voorgelê is en die eerste besprekings daaroor het op 6 Augustus 2016 in die Parlement plaasgevind.
tgt: Cabinet noted that the BMA Bill, 2016 was subsequently introduced into Parliament on 25 May 2016 and the first deliberations on this Bill took place in Parliament on 6 August 2016.Cabinet approved that the Department of Home Affairs (DHA) and the South African Revenue Service (SARS) fast-track the finalisation of the Memorandum of Understanding relating to the secondment of relevant SARS staff to DHA to support current border management and coordination efforts in the border environment.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp oor Verenigings van Gemeenskaplike Eiendom, 2016 aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the introduction of the Communal Property Associations Amendment Bill, 2016 to Parliament.

src: Die wetsontwerp wysig die Wet op Verenigings van Gemeenskaplike Eiendom, 1996 (Wet No 28 van 1996), om dit by die land se breër mandaat oor grondhervorming te laat inpas.
tgt: The Bill amends the Communal Property Associations Act, 1996 (Act No 28 of 1996), by aligning it to the broader land reform mandate of the WEBTOKEN promotes democratic governance and sustainable use of communal land administered by communal property associations on behalf of communities.

src: Dit bevorder demokratiese regering en volhoubare gebruik van gemeenskaplike grond wat namens gemeenskappe deur verenigings van gemeenskaplike eiendom bestuur word.
tgt: It strengthens the regulation of governance institutions and enhances state support to them.

src: Dit versterk die regulering en verbetering van staatsondersteuning aan bestuursinstellings.
tgt: The Bill seeks to establish a Communal Property Associations Office that is headed by a Registrar of Communal Property Associations.

src: Die wetsontwerp het dit ten doel om 'n kantoor vir verenigings van gemeenskaplike eiendom onder leiding van 'n registrateur van verenigings van gemeenskaplike eiendom te vestig.
tgt: Communities will be better enabled to acquire, hold and manage properties through effective statutorily established community resource and allocation management and administration entities, supported by government.

src: Die bekendstelling van die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Geregtelike Aangeleenthede, 2016 in die Parlement wat daarop gemik is om talle wette met betrekking tot regspleging te wysig ten einde aandag te skenk aan praktiese en tegniese kwessies om behoorlike regspleging te verseker, is ook goedgekeur.
tgt: The introduction of the Judicial Matters Amendment Bill, 2016 into Parliament which seeks to amend numerous laws having a bearing on the administration of justice in order to address practical and technical issues, to ensure the smooth administration of justice has also been approved.

src: Die wysigings is van so 'n aard dat dit nie prakties is om individuele wysigingswette deur te voer nie.
tgt: The amendments are of such a nature that it is not practical to promote individual Amendment Acts to effect these amendments to the laws in question.

src: Die wysigings is divers en kan verbind word met die volgende belangrike doelwitte van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan: om te verseker dat alle mense veilig voel gegrond op 'n onafhanklike en billike strafregstelsel maatskaplike samehorigheid om 'n ontwikkelings-, bekwame en etiese staat wat burgers met waardigheid behandel na te streef en ekonomiese insluiting.
tgt: The amendments are of a diverse nature and can be linked to the following key targets of the National Development Plan, namely to ensure that all people are and feel safe based on an independent and fair criminal justice system social cohesion to realise a developmental, capable and ethical state that treats citizens with dignity and economic inclusion.

src: Komende gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: President Jacob Zuma sal Suid-Afrika se afvaardiging na die VN se 71ste Algemene Vergadering tussen 13 en 26 September in New York lei met die tema "Die Doelwitte vir Volhoubare Ontwikkeling: 'n Universele hupstoot om ons wêreld te transformeer.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will lead South Africa’s delegation to the 71st United Nations General Assembly (UNGA 71) between 13 and 26 September in New York under the theme: "The Sustainable Development Goals: a universal push to transform our world.

src: "Dit bied 'n geleentheid vir lidlande om bestek op te neem van die doeltreffendheid van die Verenigde Nasies, veral in die lig daarvan dat die organisasie onlangs sy 70ste bestaansjaar gevier het.
tgt: "This presents an opportunity for member states to take stock of the effectiveness of the United Nations, particularly as the organisation recently celebrated its 70th anniversary.

src: Beraadslagings oor hervorming van die VN word verwag, insluitend die hervorming van die Algemene Vergadering, verbetering van die werk van die Ekonomiese en Maatskaplike Raad, en hervorming van die Veiligheidsraad om lidmaatskap in permanente en niepermanente kategorieë uit te brei.
tgt: Deliberations are expected on UN reform, including on the revitalisation of the UNGA improvement of the work of the Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC) and reform of the UN Security Council (UNSC) to expand its membership in both the permanent and non-permanent categories.

src: Dit sal ook die laaste keer wees dat Ban Ki-Moon die Algemene Vergadering as sekretaris-generaal sal toespreek.
tgt: This will also be the last time that Ban Ki-moon addresses the UN General Assembly as its Secretary-General.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens (SAPD) gaan die jaarlikse Nasionale Herdenkingsdag op 4 September 2016 aanbied ter herdenking van polisielede wat hul lewens tussen 31 Maart 2016 en 1 April 2015 in die uitvoering van hul pligte verloor het.
tgt: The South African Police Service (SAPS) will host the annual National Commemoration Day on 4 September 2016, to remember all members of the SAPS who lost their lives between the 1 April 2015 to 31 March 2016, while performing their duties in an endeavour to ensure safety and security in South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet se standpunt oor belangrike kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on key issues in the environment.

src: Kabinet spreek sy kommer uit oor voortgesette openbare geskille tussen verskillende partye oor die Valke se ondersoek na kwessies wat met die SAID verband hou.
tgt: Cabinet expressed its concern over continued public spats between various parties on the matter related to the Hawks investigation into SARS-related issues.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle betrokkenes, insluitende lede van die Kabinet, vir selfbeheer en op te hou om openbare uitsprake oor die aangeleentheid te maak.
tgt: Cabinet called on all those concerned, including members of Cabinet acting in various capacities, to exercise restraint and cease making public statements directed at any protagonist in this matter.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle partye om fatsoenlik op te tree en om ander met respek te behandel in plaas daarvan om mekaar in die openbaar aan te val.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all parties to act with dignity and decorum and to respectfully approach the relevant parties instead of taking to public platforms.

src: Die Kabinet sluit by president Zuma aan en spreek sy volle vertroue in die Minister van Finansies uit wat in samewerking met verskeie ander lede van die uitvoerende gesag, die sakesektor, arbeid en die burgerlike samelewing, uitstekende werk doen om vertroue onder plaaslike en buitelandse beleggers in die ekonomie te skep.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Zuma in expressing full confidence in the Minister of Finance who, together with various other members of the Executive, business, Labour and civil society, has been doing a sterling job in building confidence in our economy among domestic and foreign investors.

src: Die Kabinet doen egter 'n beroep op alle partye om staatsinstellings wat met wetstoepassing belas is te respekteer en met hulle saam te werk.
tgt: Cabinet equally called on all parties to respect and cooperate with state organs tasked with law enforcement.

src: Die uitvoerende gesag sal alles in sy vermoë doen om die ekonomie en die werk waarvoor maatskappye in staatsbesit verantwoordelik is, te beskerm.
tgt: The Executive continues to do all it can to protect the economy, and the important developmental work that state-owned entities are responsible for.

src: Alle staatsagentskappe moet hul mandaat uitvoer op 'n manier wat nie die werk van die Regering destabiliseer of 'n negatiewe invloed op die ekonomie het nie.
tgt: All state agencies have a responsibility to carry out their mandate in a manner that does not destabilise the work of government or negatively affect the economy.

src: President Jacob Zuma het die spitsberaad van die Sesde Tokio Internasionale Konferensie oor Afrika-ontwikkeling in Nairobi, Kenia, op 27 en 28 Augustus 2016 bygewoon.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma attended the Sixth Tokyo International Conference on African Development (TICAD VI) Summit was held in Nairobi, Kenya from 27 to 28 August 2016.

src: Dit was die eerste keer dat die spitsberaad sedert sy ontstaan in 1993 in Afrika gehou is.
tgt: This was the first time that TICAD was held in Africa since its inception in 1993.TICAD-VI afforded the Heads of State and Governments from Africa an important opportunity to monitor the progress and implementation of previous TICAD agreements which aim to speed up the growth and development of Africa.

src: Die spitsberaad bied staatshoofde en regerings van Afrika 'n belangrike geleentheid om vordering en inwerkingstelling van vorige ooreenkomste vir versnelde groei en ontwikkeling in Afrika te monitor.
tgt: TICAD-VI also took place in the first year of the implementation of the global and regional development agendas, namely the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and Agenda 2063 and its First Ten-Year Implementation Plan.

src: In ooreenstemming met hierdie ontwikkelingsagendas het die beraad kwessies bespreek waarmee Afrika sedert die laaste beraad in Yokohama, Japan, in 2013 te kampe het.
tgt: Being fully in line with these development agendas, TICAD-VI discussed thematic issues that Africa has been facing since the last TICAD-V in Yokohama, Japan in 2013.

src: Dit sluit in industrialisering, gesondheid en maatskaplike stabiliteit.
tgt: These include industrialisation, health, and social stability.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom premier Shinzo Abe se belofte dat Japan $30 miljard oor die volgende drie jaar in Afrika gaan bestee om die bou van infrastruktuur 'n hupstoot te gee.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s pledge that Japan will mobilise a total of $30 billion in private- and public-sector funds to invest in Africa over next three years to boost infrastructure building in Africa.

src: Die beraad het beleggings in die privaat sektor, die industrialisering van ekonomieë in Afrika, die skepping van volhoubare ekonomiese strukture, gesondheid en voorkoming van pandemies soos Ebola en zika, die stryd teen terrorisme, onderwys en bemagtiging van arm jeugdiges om te verhoed hulle by ekstremistiese groepe en terrorisme aansluit, breedvoerig bespreek.
tgt: The assembly made extensive and deep discussions on private-sector investment, the industrialisation of economies in Africa, creating sustainable economic structures, health and prevention against pandemics such as Ebola and Zika, the fight against terrorism, educating and empowering poverty-stricken youths to prevent them from being lured to extremist groups and terrorism.

src: Die staatshoofde het hul opnuut verbind tot ontwikkeling in Afrika met as grondbeginsels 'n oop en inklusiewe gesprekvoering, betrokkenheid van belanghebbendes, belyning van agendas, klem op ontwikkeling van mense en doeltreffende inwerkingstelling met geïntegreerde opvolgmeganismes.
tgt: The heads of state and government reiterated their commitment to continue strengthening TICAD process with the guiding principles of open and inclusive forum, engagement of multi-stakeholders, alignment with African prior agendas, emphasis on people centered development, and effective implementation with integrated follow-up mechanisms.

src: Die voorvalle van rassisme by die Pretoria High School for Girls wek kommer.
tgt: The incidents of racism levelled against Pretoria High School for Girls are of concern.

src: Die Kabinet loof leerders vir hul dapperheid om die rassisme en vooroordeel by die skool bloot te lê.
tgt: Cabinet commends the bravery of the learners for exposing the racism and prejudice at the school.

src: Hulle is inderdaad aktiviste van maatskaplike verandering, wat nodig is om ons land van sy verdelende verlede weg te beweeg en nader aan die verwesenliking van die doelwitte van 'n meer verenigde Suid-Afrika te bring.
tgt: They are indeed activists of social change, who are needed in taking our country away from its divisive past and closer to realising the objectives of a more united South Africa.

src: Ons doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om mekaar te respekteer en te verenig teen die verdeeldheid van rassisme in ons samelewing.
tgt: We call on all South Africans to respect each other and unite against the divisiveness of racism in our society.

src: Ons demokratiese reis is op verdraagsaamheid en respek geskoei.
tgt: Our democratic journey is built on tolerance and respect.

src: Ons sluit by miljoene Suid-Afrikaners aan en wens Suid-Afrika se Olimpiese span geluk met hul uitstekende prestasie by die 2016 Olimpiese Spele in Rio.
tgt: We also join millions of South Africans in congratulating Team South Africa for a sterling performance at the 2016 Rio Olympic Games.

src: Die span het tien medaljes in verskeie kategorieë gewen, insluitend twee goue medaljes.
tgt: The team did the country proud by winning ten medals across various disciplines, including two gold medals.

src: Die uitstekende prestasie van Wayde van Niekerk toe hy goud in die 400 m gewen het en daarmee 'n wêreldrekord geslaan het, en die pragtige vertoning deur Caster Semenya in die 800 m sal ons nog lank bybly.
tgt: The blistering performance by Wayde Van Niekerk in winning gold in the 400m and smashing the world record, and the stunning run by our golden girl Caster Semenya in the 800m will live long in our collective memories.

src: Die Kabinet wens Suid-Afrikaners en die OVK geluk met die suksesvolle plaaslikeregeringsverkiesing.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates South Africans and the IEC for their part in ensuring yet another successful Local Government Election.

src: Rade van oor die hele land het burgemeesters, speakers en hoofswepe verkies in 'n klinkende oorwinning vir demokrasie in aksie.
tgt: Across the country, councils have met to elect mayors, speakers and chief whips in a resounding vote for democracy in action.

src: Die Kabinet moedig landsburgers aan om steeds deur middel van wykskomitees en ander meganismes wat gemeenskappe in plaaslike regering insluit, deel te neem.
tgt: Cabinet encourages citizens to continue to participate through Ward Committees and other mechanisms that include communities in local government.

src: Die boete van R1,5 miljard aan ArcelorMittal, die land se grootste staalvervaardiger, vir prysvasstelling en samespanning in die staalbedryf is die grootste boete teen 'n maatskappy wat tot nog toe deur die mededingingsowerhede gehef is.
tgt: The announcement of a R1, 5 billion fine payable by ArcelorMittal, the country's largest steel-maker, for price-fixing and collusion in the steel industry is the largest single fine imposed against a single company by the competition authorities.

src: Die maatskappy het ook onderneem om as deel van die skikking met die owerhede, R4,6 miljard in nuwe kapitaalbesteding te belê om sy aanlegte op te gradeer en mededingendheid te verbeter.
tgt: The company also undertook, as part of the settlement with the authorities, to invest R4,6 billion in new capital spending to upgrade its plants and improve competitiveness.

src: Die skikking maak verder voorsiening vir 'n prysmeganisme wat ’n limiet op die maatskappy se winsmarge vir vlakstaalprodukte vir vyf jaar sal plaas.
tgt: The settlement further provides for a pricing mechanism that will cap the company's margin on flat steel products for a period of five years.

src: Dit maak deel uit van 'n verskerpte optrede teen die misbruik van markkragte en prysvasstelling wat die ekonomie ondermyn, onnodige koste op fabrieke laer af in die waardeketting plaas en plaaslike werksgeleenthede in gedrang bring.
tgt: This is part of a crackdown against abuse of market power and price-fixing that undermines the performance of the economy, imposes unnecessary costs on downstream factories and damages local jobs.

src: Die Regering bly verbind tot die bevordering van ekonomiese groei deur belegging en om samespanning, wat ekonomiese stagnasie veroorsaak, te voorkom.
tgt: Government remains committed to promoting investment-led economic growth, not collusion-induced economic stagnation.

src: Ons doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om water spaarsamig te gebruik deur saam te werk kan ons bestendige watervoorsiening verseker en ons waterinfrastruktuur beskerm.
tgt: We call on all South Africans to use water efficiently and conserve it by working together we can ensure a steady supply of water and also protect our vital water infrastructure.

src: Daar is 'n voortslepende droogte in verskeie dele van die land en die geïntegreerde Vaalrivierstelsel in Gauteng verkeer tans onder geweldige druk.
tgt: There are persistent drought conditions in several parts of the country with Gauteng now being impacted with the Integrated Vaal River System under severe pressure.

src: Om die situasie die hoof te bied, gaan die Departement van Water en Sanitasie in samewerking met SALGA, die Departement van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake en munisipaliteite waterbeperkings in Ekurhuleni, Johannesburg, Tshwane en Mogale City instel.
tgt: To deal with the current situation, the Department of Water and Sanitation working with SALGA, CoGTA and municipalities will impose restrictions on water consumption in Ekurhuleni, Johannesburg, Tshwane and Mogale City.

src: Stedelike watervoorsiening sal met 15% verminder word en water vir besproeiing sal met 20% gesny word.
tgt: Urban supply will be reduced by 15 per cent and water for irrigation will be reduced by 20 per cent.

src: Die beperkings is onvermydelik en sal van krag bly totdat die situasie verbeter.
tgt: The restrictions are unavoidable and will remain in place to secure water supply until the situation eases.

src: Die halfjaarlikse Bevolkingskatting deur Statistieke Suid-Afrika toon dat die Suid-Afrikaanse bevolking tot 55,9 miljoen mense gegroei het, dat die lewensverwagting nou 62 jaar is en dat die kindersterftesyfer op 33,7 per 1 000 lewende geboortes beraam word.
tgt: The findings of the Mid-Year Population Estimates by Statistics SA showed South Africa’s population grew to million people with life expectancy at 62 years and infant mortality estimated at per 1 000 live births.

src: Die Kabinet is bekommerd oor die styging in die voorkoms van MIV van 11,2% verlede jaar tot 12,7% in 2016, wat neerkom op 'n geskatte 7 miljoen mense wat met MIV leef.
tgt: Cabinet was concerned over the increase in the HIV prevalence rate from per cent last year to per cent in 2016 translating into an estimated 7.03 million people living with HIV.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om met die Regering saam te werk om nuwe infeksies te voorkom deur ten minste een keer per jaar vir MIV te toets, veiliger seks te beoefen en vir mans en seuns om mediese besnydenis te oorweeg.
tgt: Cabinet appeals to all South Africans to work with government to prevent new infections by getting tested at least once a year, practising safer sex and for men and boys to heed the call and to consider medical circumcision.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die beslissing deur die Konstitusionele Hof oor die Wysigingswet op die Herstel van Grondregte, wat in 2014 gepromulgeer is om die land se grondhervormingproses te heropen.
tgt: Cabinet noted the Constitutional Court ruling on the Restitution of Land Rights Amendment Act, which was enacted in 2014, to reopen the country’s land restitution process.

src: Die hof het die Parlement twee jaar gegun om die wet deur te voer of om 'n nuwe wetsontwerp te aanvaar.
tgt: The Court gave Parliament two years to re-enact the law or to pass a new Act.

src: Die beslissing beteken geen nuwe aansoeke kan verwerk word voordat 'n nuwe wet vir die indiening van eise deurgevoer is nie.
tgt: The ruling means no new applications can be lodged until a new Act re-opening the lodgement of claims is passed.

src: Die Kommissie op die Herstel van Grondregte sal 'n mediakonferensie hou wat die pad vorentoe sal aandui in ooreenstemming met die hofbeslissing.
tgt: The Commission on Restitution of Land Rights will be conducting a media briefing to guide the way forward following the ruling.

src: Suid-Afrika gaan die 35ste Internasionale Geologiekongres by die Kaapstadse Internasionale Konferensiesentrum van 27 Augustus tot 4 September 2016 aanbied.
tgt: South Africa is hosting the 35th International Geological Congress at the Cape Town International Convention Centre from 27 August to 4 September 2016.The Congress aims to contribute to the advancement of fundamental and applied research in the geological sciences.

src: Die kongres het ten doel om fundamentele en toegepaste navorsing in geologiese wetenskappe te bevorder.
tgt: The event will showcase the region’s world-famous geology and geoheritage together with its geological and scenic sites.

src: Geologiese uitdagings in die veld sal ook ondersoek word.
tgt: Geological challenges in the field will also be examined.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy meegevoel oor aan die familie en vriende van die voormalige kabinetsminister en premier van die Oos-Kaap, ds.
tgt: Cabinet conveys its condolences to the family and friends of the former Cabinet Minister and Premier of the Eastern Cape Province, Reverend Arnold Makhenkesi Stofile.

src: Stofile was 'n veteraanaktivis wat aan alle vlakke van die Suid-Afrikaanse stryd deelgeneem het - van ondergrondse en massamobilisasie tot internasionale solidariteit en formele samestelling van regeringstrukture.
tgt: Reverend Stofile was a veteran political activist who participated in all pillars of the South African struggle, from the underground and mass mobilisation drives, to international solidarity and the formal constitution of government structures.

src: Die Kabinet spreek ook sy meegevoel uit aan die families van die lede van die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Weermag wat hul lewens in die busongeluk op Clarens in die Vrystaat verloor het.
tgt: Cabinet also expresses its condolences to the families of the South African National Defence Force members who lost their lives in the bus accident at Clarens in the Free State.

src: Die Kabinet sluit by president Jacob Zuma aan en betoon sy meegevoel aan president Sergio Mattarella, die regering en mense van Italië ná die aardbewing wat Sentraal-Italië geruk het en tot die dood van mense en groot skade in verskeie dorpe gelei het.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Jacob Zuma in sending condolences to H. E President Sergio Mattarella, the Government and the people of Italy following the earthquake that struck central Italy, which resulted in the deaths of citizens and extensive damage in several towns.

src: Ons wens die beseerdes ’n spoedige herstel toe.
tgt: We also wish the injured a speedy recovery.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan verifikasie van kwalifikasies en uitklarings.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Implementering van belangrike Regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of key government programmes.

src: Die Kabinet is bemoedig deur die groei in die bruto binnelandse produk (BBP) van 3,3% in die tweede kwartaal van 2016 soos deur Statistieke Suid-Afrika vrygestel.
tgt: Cabinet is encouraged by the growth in the gross domestic product (GDP) of 3.3% in the second quarter of 2016 released by Statistics South Africa.

src: Die 8,1%-styging in vervaardiging en 11,8% in mynbou en steengroewe demonstreer die veerkragtigheid van die ekonomie in hierdie moeilike ekonomiese omgewing.
tgt: The 8.1% increase in manufacturing and 11.8% in mining and quarrying demonstrates the resilience of the economy in this tough economic environment.

src: Die BBP het met R25 miljard gestyg, meer as in die eerste kwartaal van 2016, tot 'n geskatte R1,06 miljard.
tgt: The GDP grew by R25 billion more than the first quarter of 2016 to an estimated R1 068 billion.

src: Ons herhaal die beroep deur die Regering, die sakesektor en die burgerlike samelewing om die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP), deur middel van die Negepuntplan, te ondersteun sodat ons die ekonomie kan stimuleer en werksgeleenthede kan beskerm.
tgt: We reiterate the call for government, business and civil society to consolidate the social compact in the implementation of the National Development Plan (NDP), through the Nine-Point Plan so as to further counteract the current economic conditions and stimulate growth to support the economy and help save jobs.

src: Dit is duidelik dat wanneer alle vennote - die Regering, sakesektor en arbeid - saamwerk, ons die ekonomie kan laat groei en werkgeleenthede kan skep.
tgt: This a clear demonstration that when all partners – government, business and labour – work together we can achieve economic growth and ultimately create much-needed jobs.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die aankondiging dat die tweede 800 MW-eenheid by die Meupi-kragstasie in Limpopo by die kragnetwerk gevoeg is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the announcement that the second 800 megawatts (MW) unit at the Medupi Power Station project in Limpopo had been synchronised to the grid.

src: Eenheid 5 van die kragsentrale, een van ses wat gebou word as deel van die 4 800 MW-projek, sal teen Maart 2018 kommersieel in werking gestel word.
tgt: Unit 5 of the power station, which is one of six being built as part of the 4 800 MW project, will become commercially operational by March 2018.This is the second of the power station’s six units to come on stream.

src: Die eerste eenheid, Eenheid 6, het in Maart 2015 begin om krag aan die netwerk te lewer.
tgt: The first unit, or Unit 6, began feeding power into the grid in March 2015 and has entered commercial operation.

src: Die hele projek, bestaande uit ses eenhede, sal na verwagting teen 2020 voltooi wees.
tgt: The entire six-unit Medupi project is expected to be completed in 2020.This contributes to the stabilisation of the grid which strengthens reliable electricity supply for South Africa.

src: Dit sal help om die kragnetwerk te stabiliseer en betroubare elektrisiteitsvoorsiening aan Suid-Afrika te bied.
tgt: Cabinet congratulated Eskom for the synchronisation milestone, which is part of a broader build-programme acceleration, being driven by the new leadership.

src: Die Kabinet bevestig sy verbintenis tot die Program vir die Verkryging van Onafhanklike Kragprodusente, wat beduidende nuwe kragkapasiteit sal genereer om die ekonomie te stimuleer.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates its commitment to the Independent Power Producers Procurement Programme, which will develop and produce a significant share of the new electricity capacity as a critical component that underpins economic activity and growth.

src: Dit sal bydra tot die diversifisering van die vraag en aard van kragopwekking.
tgt: This will contribute to the diversification of both the supply and nature of energy production.
