src: Benewens die deurvoer van vaardighede en nuwe beleggings, stel dit ook 'n maatstaf vir prestasie en pryse.
tgt: In addition to introducing new skills and securing new investment in the industry, it will also benchmark performance and pricing.

src: Die program word ondersteun deur die NOP, wat die behoefte identifiseer het om in ekonomiese infrastruktuur te belê sodat die land sy medium- en langtermyn- ekonomiese en maatskaplike doelwitte kan bereik.
tgt: This supports the NDP, which identifies the need for South Africa to invest in a strong network of economic infrastructure designed to support the country’s medium- and long-term economic and social objectives.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die ondertekening van 'n ooreenkoms tussen die Passasierspooragentskap van Suid-Afrika en China Communications Construction Company Beperk om inisiatiewe vir infrastruktuurontwikkeling te ondersoek, insluitende die Moloto-spoorkorridor wat Gauteng en Mpumalanga sal verbind.
tgt: Cabinet also noted the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa and China Communications Construction Company Limited to explore various infrastructure development initiatives, including the Moloto Rail Development Corridor which links Gauteng and Mpumalanga.

src: Die ooreenkoms is tydens die 2de Forum vir Belegging in Afrika onderteken wat deur president Jacob Zuma in Guangzhou, China bygewoon is.
tgt: The MoU was signed at the 2nd Investment Africa Investment Forum attended by President Jacob Zuma in Guangzhou, Guangdong Province, in China.

src: Die projek sal lewe in die ekonomie in en om die korridor blaas en sodoende uitdagings rakende veiligheid, doeltreffendheid, betroubaarheid, bekostigbaarheid en algehele integrasie met ander openbarevervoerdienste die hoof te bied.
tgt: The project will serve as a catalyst for economic development initiatives within and around the corridor to resolve challenges of safety, efficiency, reliability, affordability and overall integration with other public transport services.

src: Dit sal ook die lewensgehalte van mense in die gebied verbeter deur lang reistye te verkort.
tgt: It would also improve the quality of life for people in the area by cutting the long commuting distances.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die vorderingsverslae vir die eerste kwartaal vir die tydperk April tot Junie 2016 rakende die implementering van uitkomste.
tgt: Cabinet was apprised on the progress reports for quarter one, for the period April to June 2016, on the implementation of Outcomes.

src: Die Aksieprogram van Uitkomste voer die doelwitte van die NOP in en bring Suid-Afrika nader aan die doelwitte van Visie 2030.
tgt: Implementation of the Outcome Programme of Action implements the objectives of the NDP, which is South Africa’s blueprint to take us closer to realising Vision 2030.

src: Dit kom neer op die teikens in die Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk, wat deel is van die eerste vyf jaar van die inwerkingstelling van NOP 2030 vir 2014 tot 2019.
tgt: This translates into the targets set out in the Medium Term Strategic Framework, which is government’s first five-year implementation plan of the NDP 2030, covering the period from 2014 to 2019.There have been improvements in health status reflected in key population health indicators such as enhanced life expectancy, reduced under-five mortality and reduced maternal mortality.

src: Volgens die aanwysers vir kernbevolkingsgesondheid, was daar verbetering in die stand van gesondheid soos verbeterde lewensverwagting, minder sterftes onder kinders onder vyf en minder moedersterftes.
tgt: There has been improved provision of basic services, including grid and non-grid electricity connections, potable water in dwellings, sanitation and solid waste management.

src: Daar is egter steeds agterstande in sommige gebiede.
tgt: However, there are still backlogs in some places.

src: Sedert 1994 was daar volgehoue en verbeterde voorsiening van maatskaplike bystand aan meer as 16 miljoen begunstigdes, wat 'n beduidende invloed op die lewens van armes het.
tgt: Since 1994 there has been sustained and improved provision of social assistance to over 16 million beneficiaries, and evidence that this is having a significant impact on the lives of the poor.

src: Die GCIS werk tans met staatsdepartemente saam om deur media-inligtingsessies mense in kennis te stel van die hoogtepunte uit die kwartaalverslae.
tgt: The GCIS is coordinating with departments to secure Cluster Media briefings to unpack highlights from the quarterly reports.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die imbizo deur die minister in Die Presidensie vir beplanning, monitering en evaluering en die voorsitter van die nasionale beplanningskommissie, Jeff Radebe, oor tussenkomste om die betaling van leweransiers (of diensleweraars) deur die Regering binne die vereiste 30 dae te versnel.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the Imbizo hosted by the Minister in The Presidency for Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation and Chairperson of the National Planning Commission, Jeff Radebe, on interventions implemented to fast-track the payment of suppliers (or service providers) by government within the stipulated 30-day period.

src: Sedert die stigting van die spesiale eenheid in die Departement van Beplanning, Monitering en Evaluering (DPME) om die probleem van niebetaling van verskaffers binne die vereiste 30 dae te pak, is 17 668 fakture van R340 miljoen tot en met Junie 2016 betaal.
tgt: Since the establishment of the Special Unit in the Department of Planning Monitoring and Evaluation (DPME) to tackle the problem of non-payment of suppliers within the required 30 days, the number of legitimate invoices paid as at June 2016 was 17 668 to the value of R340 million.

src: Die DPME en die Tesourie het ook meer hulpbronne beskikbaar gestel om uitdagings rakende betalings aan verskaffers die hoof te bied.
tgt: The DPME and National Treasury have also devoted more resources to the effort of addressing the challenges of payment of suppliers.

src: Vir dié doel is 'n instapsentrum by die kantoor van die Tesourie gevestig om verskaffers se navrae te hanteer.
tgt: To this end, a walk-in centre has been established at National Treasury’s offices to attend to suppliers’ queries.

src: Hierbenewens is die DPME en sy vennote besig om sukkelende departemente by te staan om seker te maak dat verskaffers betyds betaal word.
tgt: Additionally, the DPME special unit and its partners are rolling out a targeted support programme to identified struggling departments to understand and address the challenges that lead to non-payment or late payments of suppliers.

src: Tydens hierdie besoeke word die hele waardeketting van betaling beoordeel, struikelblokke word geïdentifiseer en departemente word bygestaan om maatreëls vir betaling deur te voer.
tgt: During these visits, the entire value chain of payment of invoices is assessed, blockages are identified and departments are assisted with implementation of improvement measures.

src: Belangrike Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.

src: Suid-Afrika sal die 17de sitting van die Konferensie van die Partye (COP17) van die Konvensie oor Internasionale Handel in Bedreigde Spesies (CITES) by die Sandton-konferensiesentrum vanaf 24 September tot 5 Oktober 2016 aanbied.
tgt: South Africa will host the 17th Meeting of the Conference of Parties (COP17) to the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES) at the Sandton Convention Centre from 24 September to 5 October 2016.

src: Me 181 partye bly CITES een van die wêreld se gesaghebbendste owerhede vir die bewaring van biodiversiteit deur die regulering van handel in natuurlewe.
tgt: With 181 Parties, CITES remains one of the world's most powerful tools for biodiversity conservation through the regulation of trade in wild fauna and flora.

src: CITES se partye en waarnemers verwag om by robuuste besprekings betrokke te raak en oplossings te vind om die werk wat reeds rakende handel in natuurlewe gedoen word, verder te voer.
tgt: CITES Parties and observers are expected to engage in robust discussions and come up with resolutions that take forward the work already underway around the trade in flora and fauna.

src: Suid-Afrika is 'n wêreldleier op die gebied van natuurbewaring danksy sy deelname aan multilaterale omgewingsooreenkomste soos CITES, die Konvensie oor Migrerende Spesies en die Konvensie oor Biologiese Diversiteit.
tgt: South Africa is a world leader in the field of wildlife conservation through its active participation in multilateral environmental agreements such as CITES, the Convention on Migratory Species and the Convention on Biological Diversity.

src: Ons land se unieke stelsel van beskermde gebiede beslaan sowat 5,5% van die land se oppervlak en sluit ses wêrelderfenisgebiede en vier biosfeerreservate in.
tgt: Our country’s unique system of protected areas comprises roughly 5,5% of the country's surface area, six World Heritage Sites and four biosphere reserves.

src: Die Minister van Telekommunikasie en Posdienste, dr Siyabonga Cwele, sal die Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging by die 26ste Wêreldkongres oor Poswese van die Wêreldposunie (UPU) lei, wat van 20 September tot 7 Oktober 2016 in Istanbul, Turkye plaasvind.
tgt: The Minister of Telecommunications and Postal Services, Dr Siyabonga Cwele, will lead the South African delegation at the 26th World Postal Congress of the Universal Postal Union (UPU) to be held in Istanbul, Turkey from 20 September to 7 October 2016.

src: Die UPU is 'n gespesialiseerde agentskap van die Verenigde Nasies (VN) wat fokus op die modernisering van die poswese en diversifisering van posprodukte om 'n wêreldwye poswesegrondgebied in stand te hou wat aan die behoeftes van die 21ste eeu voldoen.
tgt: The UPU is a specialised agency of the United Nations (UN) that focusses on modernising the postal sector and diversifying postal products to sustain a universal postal territory that meets the needs of the 21st century.

src: Die kongres is van kritieke belang vir Suid-Afrika aangesien die Suid-Afrikaanse Poskantoor ’n belangrike rolspeler in die Regering se dienslewering is en met die NOP belyn is as deel van die hantering en vestiging van finansiële en regeringsdienste in landelike en onderbediende gemeenskappe.
tgt: This congress is critical for South Africa, as the South African Post Office is key a player of government service delivery and is aligned to the NDP, through the national address and roll-out of financial and government services to rural and underserved communities.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die vordering rakende voorbereidings vir die Statebondspele 2022 wat in Durban gehou sal word.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on progress regarding preparations for the Commonwealth Games 2022 to be staged in the City of Durban.

src: Belegging in infrastruktuur vir die Spele sal na verwagting bydra tot blywende voordele vir die gasheerstad.
tgt: Investment in infrastructure for the Games is expected to contribute to the lasting benefits of the host city, which will also make use of the infrastructure legacy of the 2010 FIFA World Cup.

src: Hierdie bykomende blootstelling aan internasionale markte sal ook geleenthede skep om toerisme en direkte buitelandse beleggings te lok en te verbeter.
tgt: This added exposure to global markets will also provide opportunities to attract and enhance tourism and foreign direct investment.

src: Die 2022 Statebondspele sal na verwagting tot R20 miljard tot die ekonomie bydra, wat neerkom op 'n bykomende R11 miljard in BBP-groei.
tgt: The 2022 Commonwealth Games is expected to deliver up to R20 billion in output to the economy, translating into an additional R11 billion GDP growth.

src: Dit posisioneer die land verder as 'n sporttoerismebestemming en bied ook geleenthede vir Suid-Afrika se sportspanne.
tgt: This further positions the country as a sport tourism destination and also provides opportunities for Team South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die dagvaarding deur die Openbare Beskermer op die sekretaris van die Kabinet.
tgt: Cabinet noted the subpoena served on the Secretary of Cabinet by the Public Protector.

src: Die dagvaarding vereis dat die sekretaris verklarings van Kabinetslede en notules van die Kabinet tussen November 2015 en April 2016 voorlê, wat die aanstelling van waarnemende ministers in plek van ministers wat in die buiteland was, op rekord geplaas het.
tgt: The subpoena requests the Secretary of Cabinet to provide the declarations of Cabinet members and the minutes of Cabinet, in the period November 2015 to April 2016, that record the appointment of acting Ministers while the incumbent Ministers were abroad.

src: Die Kabinet het ingestem om die verklarings te voorsien.
tgt: Cabinet agreed to provide the Public Protector with the declarations.

src: Aangesien die president, ministers en adjunkministers kragtens artikels 91 en 98 van die Grondwet aanstel, is hierdie sake nie aan die Kabinet voorgelê nie en is hierdie rekords dus nie as Kabinetsbesluite genotuleer nie.
tgt: However, since the President of South Africa appoints Ministers and Deputy Ministers under sections 91 and 98 of the Constitution, such matters have not come before Cabinet and therefore these records have not been minuted as Cabinet decisions.

src: Wetsontwerpe.
tgt: Bills.

src: Die publikasie van die Wysigingswetsontwerp op die Nasionale Drankwet 2016 is vir wyer openbare raadpleging goedgekeur.
tgt: Publication of the National Liquor Amendment Bill of 2016 was approved for wider public consultation.

src: Dit wysig die Nasionale Drankwet, 2003 (Wet 59 van 2003).
tgt: This amends the National Liquor Act, 2003 (Act 59 of 2003).

src: Dit is saam met die finale Nasionale Drankbeleid goedgekeur, wat die doeltreffendheid van die Wet ondersoek en die opstel van die wetsontwerp vergemaklik het.
tgt: This was approved together with the final National Liquor Policy, which addresses challenges hampering the effectiveness of the Act and facilitated the drafting of the Bill.

src: Die wetsontwerp fokus op die sosio-ekonomiese impak van drank, die trae pas van transformasie, standaardisering van die belangrikste aspekte van regulering en die verbetering van regulerende samewerking, die uitroei van die vervaardiging en handel in onwettige alkohol asook uitdagings rakende reguleringskapasiteit binne die Nasionale Drankowerheid.
tgt: The Bill addresses the socio-economic impact of liquor, the slow pace of transformation, standardisation of key aspects of regulation and improved regulatory collaboration, eradicating the manufacturing and trading in illegal and illicit alcohol as well as challenges regarding regulatory capacity within the National Liquor Authority.

src: Hierdie tussenkoms fokus ook op die vermindering van sosio-ekonomiese skade en ander koste van drankmisbruik, die herstrukturering van die drankbedryf en die verbetering van samewerking tussen alle regeringsfere.
tgt: This intervention also focuses on reducing socio-economic harms and other costs of liquor abuse, restructuring the liquor industry and enhancing cooperation between all spheres of WEBTOKEN is aligned to the NDP priorities of ensuring effective governance, social protection and employment creation.

src: Dit is in lyn met die NOP-prioriteite om doeltreffende bestuur, maatskaplike beskerming en werkskepping te verseker.
tgt: It will amongst others, prevent illegal trading, enhance education and awareness programmes, and assist in enhanced programmes on rehabilitating those who are addicted.

src: Die Kabinet het ook die Konsepwysigingswetsontwerp van die Nasionale Dobbelwet van 2016 vir wyer openbare kommentaar goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet also approved the draft National Gambling Amendment Bill of 2016 for wider public comment.

src: Die wetsontwerp hanteer uitdagings wat die doeltreffendheid van die Nasionale Dobbelwet, 2004 (Wet 7 van 2004) belemmer.
tgt: The Bill addresses challenges hampering effectiveness of the National Gambling Act, 2004 (Act 7 of 2004).The Bill aims to ensure that cooperative governance and oversight functions are improved and that regulatory certainty and negative effects of gambling are drastically reduced.

src: Die wetsontwerp het ten doel om te verseker dat samewerkende regering en toesighoudende funksies verbeter en dat regulerende sekerheid en die negatiewe uitwerking van dobbel drasties verminder word.
tgt: It will focus on enhancing existing gambling activities and no new gambling activities will be introduced.

src: Dit sal op die verbetering van bestaande dobbelaktiwiteite fokus en geen nuwe dobbelaktiwiteite sal bekendgestel word nie.
tgt: The Bill will ensure that vulnerable groups such as minors and problem gamblers are protected and will be able to access assistance from organisations such as the National Gambling WEBTOKEN is strategically aligned with the priorities outlined in the NDP with a view to ensure effective governance, social protection, employment creation, recreation and leisure.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Die Minister van Internasionale Betrekkinge en Samewerking, me Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, sal 'n afvaardiging lei na die 17de Spitsberaad van die Beweging van Onverbonde Lande (NAM) onder die tema "Vrede, Soewereiniteit en Solidariteit vir Ontwikkeling" wat van 17 tot 18 September 2016 in Venezuela gehou word.
tgt: The Minister of International Relations and Cooperation, Ms Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, will lead a delegation to the 17th Non-Aligned Movement (NAM) Summit under the theme “Peace, Sovereignty and Solidarity for Development” to be held in Venezuela from 17 to 18 September 2016.NAM is the largest grouping outside the UN and it allows developing nations to influence global affairs and ensure that their interests are taken into consideration.

src: NAM is die grootste groepering buite die VN en gee ontwikkelende lande die geleentheid om wêreldsake te beïnvloed en te verseker dat hul belange in ag geneem word.
tgt: President Zuma will lead a delegation to the 71st Session of the UN General Assembly (UNGA) to be held at the UN Headquarters in New York from 18 to 22 September 2016.On 1 January 2016, the 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, adopted by world leaders in September 2015 officially came into force.

src: Oor die volgende 15 jaar sal lande pogings in werking stel om alle vorme van armoede te beëindig, ongelykhede te beveg en klimaatsverandering te pak.
tgt: Over the next 15 years, countries will mobilise efforts to end all forms of poverty, fight inequalities and tackle climate change, while ensuring that no one is left behind.

src: Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa sal die nasionale Erfnisdagviering op 24 September 2016 by Galeshewe-stadion in Kimberley in die Noord-Kaap lei.
tgt: Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa will lead the national Heritage Day celebration on 24 September 2016 at Galeshewe Stadium, Kimberley, Northern Cape.

src: Dit word gehou onder die tema "Viering van Meslike Skatte deur ons Afrika-identiteit te Handhaaf".
tgt: This is celebrated under the theme: “Celebrating Human Treasures by Asserting our African Identity”.

src: Die Internasionale Konferensie oor Volhoubare Ontwikkeling vind van 21 tot 22 September 2016 in New York plaas onder die tema: "Beweeg Vooruit: Die Volhoubare Ontwikkelingsdoelwitte in Praktyk".Die doel van die konferensie is om praktiese, bewese oplossings vir volhoubare ontwikkelingsdoelwitte te identifiseer en te deel.
tgt: The International Conference on Sustainable Development takes place in New York from 21 to 22 September 2016 under the theme: “Moving Forward: The SDGs in Practice.”The aim of the conference is to identify and share practical, evidence-based solutions that can support the SDGs.

src: Die konferensie bring belanghebbendes van regerings, die akademie, die VN, internasionale agentskappe, nieregeringsorganisasies en voetsoolvlakorganisasies byeen.
tgt: The conference brings together stakeholders from government, academia, the UN, international agencies, non-governmetal organisations and grassroots organisations.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die vyfjaarherdenking van die Oop Regeringvennootskap (ORV) naas die Verenigde Nasies se Algemene Vergadering in New York op 20 September 2016.Tydens hierdie geleentheid sal die posisie van hoofvoorsitter van die ORV amptelike deur Suid-Afrika oorhandig word.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the five year anniversary event of the Open Government Partnership (OGP) on the margins of the UNGA, in New York on 20 September 2016.This event will see the official handover of the position of, Lead Chair of the OGP by South Africa.

src: Staatshoofde, leiers van burgerlike samelewings en ander belanghebbendes wat ’n deurslaggewende rol in die sukses van die ORV gespeel het, sal die geleentheid bywoon.
tgt: It will be attended by Heads of State and Government, civil society leaders and others stakeholders who have been instrumental to OGP’s success.

src: Suid-Afrika het die posisie van hoofvoorsitter van die vennootskap by die Meiko-spitsberaad in Oktober 2015 aanvaar.
tgt: South Africa assumed the position of Lead Chair of the Partnership at the Mexico Summit in October 2015.Since eight Heads of State and Government partnered with nine civil society leaders to launch the Open Government Partnership on the margins of UNGA in 2011, this dynamic partnership has grown to 70 governments and thousands of civil society organisations across the world, with over 3 000 specific commitments to increase transparency and accountability of governments and to improve public participation.

src: Sedert agt staatshoofde met nege leiers van burgerlike samelewings in 2011 begin saamwerk het in oorleg met die Verenigde Nasies se Algemene Vergadering om die ORV deur te voer, het die vennootskap aansienlik gegroei.
tgt: The Minister of Telecommunications and Postal Services, Dr Siyabonga Cwele, will lead the South African delegation to the UN’s Broadband Commission meeting that will take place in New York on 18 September 2016.The commission is tasked with looking into strategies of connecting the four billion people who are presently not connected to broadband or fast Internet, in a cost efficient manner.

src: Tans bestaan dit uit 70 regerings- en duisende burgerlike organisasies van oor die hele wêreld en meer as 3 000 spesifieke verbintenisse om deursigtigheid en aanspreeklikheid van regerings en openbare deelname te verbeter.
tgt: This year’s meeting will evaluate and review present strategies and decide on future course of action to enhance the use of broadband for sustainable development.

src: Die Minister van Telekommunikasie en Posdienste, dr Siyabonga Cwele, sal die Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging na die vergadering van die VN se Breëbandkommissie lei, wat op 18 September 2016 in New York plaasvind.
tgt: Transport Month in October 2016 will be hosted under the theme: “Together we move South Africa Forward.” The month-long programme will showcase transport infrastructure projects, promote the use of public transport and advance the country’s road safety initiatives.

src: Ons belegging in openbare vervoer is deel van die bou en bedryf van 'n geïntegreerde openbare vervoernetwerk oor die hele land.
tgt: Our investments in transport are positioning the country as an attractive investment destination.

src: Die Kabinet se standpunt oor belangrike sake in die omgewing.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on key issues in the environment.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die uitkomste van die G20-leiersberaad, waar die belange van die suide bevorder is en wat deur Pesident Jacob Zuma bygewoon is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the outcomes from the G20 Leaders’ Summit, attended by President Jacob Zuma, where interests of the South were advanced.

src: Die beraad het onder die tema "Op pad na 'n Innoverende, Versterkte, Onderling Verbinde en Inklusiewe Wêreldekonomie" die volgende prioriteitsake bespreek:i) Baan 'n nuwe weg vir groeiii) Mer doeltreffende wêreldwye ekonomiese en finansiële bestuuriii) Robuuste internasionale handel en beleggingiv) Inklusiewe en onderling verbinde ontwikkeling env) Ander kwessies wat die wêreld raak, soos antimikrobiese weerstand (AMR).In sy poging om innovering as 'n belangrike drywer van groei vir individuele lande en die wêreldekonomie te versterk, onderskryf die G20 die Bloudruk oor Innoverende Groei as 'n nuwe agenda wat beleid en maatreëls in en oor die gebiede van innovering, die nuwe industriële revolusie en die digitale ekonomie omvat.
tgt: The Summit which was held under the theme: “Towards An Innovative, Invigorated, Interconnected and Inclusive World Economy” discussed the following priority areas: i) Breaking a New Path for Growth, ii) More Effective and Efficient Global Economic and Financial Governance, iii) Robust International Trade and Investment, iv) Inclusive and Interconnected Development, and v) Other issues affecting the World such as Anti-Microbial Resistance (AMR).In bolstering innovation as a key driver of growth for individual countries and the global economy, the G20 endorsed the Blueprint on Innovative Growth as a new agenda encompassing policies and measures in and across the areas of innovation, the new industrial revolution and the digital economy.

src: Die G20 se Aksieplan vir die Nuwe Industriële Revolusie gryp verder die geleentheid aan wat die nuwe industriële revolusie bied vir nywerhede, veral vervaardiging en verwante dienste.
tgt: Further, The G20 New Industrial Revolution Action Plan seizes the opportunity that the new industrial revolution presents for industry, particularly manufacturing and related services.

src: Dit sluit in steun vir industrialisering in ontwikkelende lande, veral dié in Afrika, asook die mins ontwikkelde lande.
tgt: This includes support for industrialisation in developing countries, especially those in Africa and Least Developed Countries (LDCs).

src: Die bekendstelling van die G20 se Inisiatief vir die Ondersteuning van Industrialisasie in Afrika en die Mins Ontwikkelde Lande versterk ook inklusiewe groei en ontwikkelingspotensiaal deur vrywillige WEBTOKEN bydrae tot die bou van 'n oop en veerkragtig finansiële stelsel om volhoubare groei en ontwikkeling te ondersteun, is Suid-Afrika se voorstel dat onwettige finansiële vloei van onbehoorlike prysbepaling deur die Wêreldhandelsorganisasie ondersoek moet word, aanvaar.
tgt: Also, the launch of the G20 Initiative on Supporting Industrialisation in Africa and LDCs strengthens inclusive growth and development potential through voluntary policy WEBTOKEN contributing to the building of an open and resilient financial system to support sustainable growth and development, South Africa’s proposal that illicit financial flows from trade mispricing be studied by the World Trade Organisation, was accepted.

src: Die aanpak van hierdie uitdaging kan geld vir regerings in Afrika beskikbaar stel om volhoubare ontwikkeling te bereik en ontwikkelingsprogramme deur te voer.
tgt: Addressing this challenge holds the potential to unlock finances that could be used by African governments to implement the Sustainable Development Goals and their development programmes.

src: Die Kabinet benadruk dit dat alle Suid-Afrikaners daarvoor verantwoordelik is om daadwerklik water te bespaar en dit oordeelkundig te gebruik.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates that it is the responsibility of all South Africans to make a concerted effort to save water and use it wisely, this includes fixing leaking taps and taking care of public infrastructure within communities.

src: Dit sluit die herstel van lekkende krane in asook die instandhouding van openbare infrastruktuur in gemeenskappe.
tgt: The drop in national dam levels has necessitated the imposing of water restrictions in a number of provinces and most recently, the Gauteng Province.

src: Die daling in die watervlak van nasionale damme het waterbeperkings in sommige provinsies, insluitend Gauteng, genoodsaak.
tgt: We need to work together to support our communities in distress by reporting vandalism and theft of infrastructure to the relevant authorities.

src: Die Regering is bewus van die ontberings van ons mense in die gebiede wat die ergste getref is, en die Interministeriële Taakspan oor Droogte het die versterking van ingrypings vir hulpverlening aan gebiede in nood uiteengesit.
tgt: Government is mindful of the hardships experienced by our people in the most affected areas and the Inter-Ministerial Task Team on Drought has outlined the intensification of relief interventions to distressed areas.

src: Lang- en korttermyningrypings word deurgevoer en monitering en evaluering van alle pogings duur voort.
tgt: Long and short term interventions are being implemented while monitoring and evaluation of all efforts is on-going.

src: Die Departement van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake, deur middel van die Nasionale Rampbestuursentrum, gaan ook voort om die land se te droogte- en waterskaarstesituasie te bestuur in samewerking met al die sektore en die private sektor.
tgt: The Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, through the National Disaster Management Centre, continues to coordinate the country’s drought and water scarcity situation in collaboration with all the sectors and private sector.

src: Die Kabinet prys saam met die hele land die prestasie van Suid-Afrika se Paralimpiese span wat van 7 tot 18 September by die Rio 2016 Paralimpiese Spele in Brasilië deelgeneem het.
tgt: Cabinet joins the nation in commending the performance of Team South Africa who are at the Rio 2016 Paralympics in Brazil from 7 to 18 September.

src: Hierdie atlete maak ons trots en bou voort op ons puik reputasie as goeie presteerders by die Paralimpiese Spele.
tgt: These athletes are making our nation proud and continue to build on our stellar reputation of performing well at the Paralympics.

src: Die Kabinet wens die span geluk met hulle nege medaljes: drie goue, drie silwer en drie brons.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the team for winning nine medals: three gold, three silver and three bronze.

src: Die Kabinet wens die volgende atlete geluk met hul goue medaljes: die swemmer, Kevin Paul Hilton Langenhoven, vir verspring en Charl du Toit in die 100-meterwedloop.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the following athletes for winning gold medals: swimmer Kevin Paul, Hilton Langenhoven in long jump and Charl du Toit in the 100-metre track.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die Suid-Afrika Polisiediens (SAPD) se vrystelling van die 2015/16-misdaadstatistiek, wat 'n algehele dalende misdaadtendens weerspieël.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the release the 2015/16 crime statistics by the South Africa Police Service that reflect an overall trend that crime in the country has decreased.

src: Hoewel die polisie vordering gemaak het om sekere soorte misdaad te bestry wek die styging in geweldsmisdaad, veral moord, nog kommer.
tgt: While the progress made by SAPS in bringing down the levels of certain types of crimes is applauded, there remains concern over the increase of violent crime, especially murder.

src: Die bekamping van misdaad is almal se verantwoordelikheid.
tgt: Fighting crime is everyone’s responsibility.

src: Ons moet almal met die polisie saamwerk om veiliger gemeenskappe, veiliger stede en 'n veiliger land te verwesenlik.
tgt: We all need to work with SAPS to realise our common objective of safer communities, safer cities and a safer country.

src: Dit sal samewerking tussen die verskillende wetstoepassingsafdelings verbeter om misdaadvlakke te verminder.
tgt: This will increase collaboration between the different law-enforcement arms to reduce crime levels.

src: Die Kabinet herinner belastingbetalers wat hul belastingopgawes per hand of per pos indien dat die sperdatum van 23 September 2016 vir die indiening van hul opgawes vir die 2016 belastingseisoen vinnig nader.
tgt: Cabinet reminds taxpayers who submit their tax return manually or by post that the 23 September 2016 deadline for filing their returns for the 2016 tax season is fast approaching.

src: Die Kabinet bedank belastingbetalers wat reeds hul opgawes ingedien het.
tgt: Cabinet wishes to thank taxpayers who have already filed their returns.

src: Die inkomste wat deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Inkomstediens ingesamel word, help die staat om dienste aan miljoene Suid-Afrikaners wat dit die nodigste het te verskaf.
tgt: The revenue collected by SARS aids government in providing services to millions of South Africans who need it the most.

src: Die Kabinet erken die stryd wat jong mense ervaar as hulle probeer om self hul studies voort te sit.
tgt: Cabinet recognises the struggles that young people encounter as they try to educate themselves.

src: Die Regering bly verbind tot die versekering van gehalte- en bekostigbare onderwys vir almal.
tgt: Government remains committed to ensuring quality and affordable education for all.

src: Befondsing wat deur die Nasionale Studentehulpfonds beskikbaar gestel word, staan nou op R14 582 miljard, en help dat arm, hardwerkende studente toegang tot al die 26 openbare universiteite en 50 openbare kolleges vir Tegniese Beroepsonderwys en Opleiding kan kry.
tgt: Funding made available through the National Student Financial Aid Scheme now stands at R14 582 billion, and helps to ensure that poor hard working students can access education at all 26 public universities and 50 public Technical Vocational Education and Training (TVET) colleges.

src: Volgens Statistieke Suid-Afrika se 2015 Algemene Huishoudelike Opname "verbeter die opvoedkundige bereikingsuitkomste steeds met beter toegang tot onderwysinstellings en -dienste.
tgt: According to Statistics South Africa’s 2015 General Household Survey: ‘Educational attainment outcomes continue to improve with improved access to educational facilities and services.

src: Onder individue van 20 jaar en ouer, het die persentasie wat graad 12 bereik het as hul hoogste vlak van onderwys in 2002 toegeneem van 21,9% tot 28% in 2015.
tgt: Among individuals aged 20 years and older, the percentage who attained Grade 12 as their highest level of education increased from 21,9% in 2002 to 28,0% in 2015.

src: Die persentasie van hierdie individue met tersiêre kwalifikasies het verder verbeter van 9,3 % tot 14,1%.” Die Kabinet bly verbind tot 'n gefasseerde verwesenliking van gratis onderwys vir die armes, binne fiskale bekostigbaarheid.
tgt: The percentage of these individuals with tertiary qualifications furthermore improved from 9,3% to 14,1%’.

src: Ons langtermynvisie vir hoër onderwys sal beïnvloed word deur die Kommissie van Ondersoek na Befondsing en Opleiding in Hoër Onderwys, wat tans in sitting is en sy werk na verwagting teen 30 Junie 2017 sal voltooi.
tgt: Cabinet remains committed to a phased realisation of free education for the poor, within fiscal affordability.

src: Ons doen ’n beroep op alle belanghebbendes om die kommissie by te staan om sy werk te voltooi.
tgt: We call on all stakeholders to give the Commission of Inquiry into Higher Education Funding and Training a chance to complete its work.

src: Deur saam te werk kan ons oplossings vind wat beide prakties en volhoubaar is.
tgt: By working together we can find solutions that are both practical and sustainable.

src: Die Kabinet is bekommerd oor die oplewing in gewelddadige betogings in sommige hoëronderwysinstelling.
tgt: Cabinet is concerned at the resurgence of violent protests in some institutions of higher learning.

src: Die vernietiging van eiendom is 'n misdaad wat die aandag aftrek van wettige kwessies.
tgt: The destruction of property is a crime that detracts from legitimate issues.

src: Die hulpbronne wat vernietig is, insluitend 'n biblioteek by die Universiteit van KwaZulu-Natal, asook boeke en infrastruktuur is onaanvaarbaar en vernietig die kennis wat oor tyd heen versamel is.
tgt: The resources destroyed, including a library, as witnessed at University of KwaZulu-Natal, books and infrastructure is unacceptable and destroys the knowledge capital accumulated over time.

src: Dit is kriminele dade waarvoor die wetstoepassingsagentskappe streng moet optree.
tgt: These are acts of criminality for which the law enforcement agencies must respond firmly.

src: Hierdie dade plaas 'n stremming op die reeds beperkte hulpbronne tot onderwys aan die armes.
tgt: These acts place a strain on already limited resources to provide education to the poor.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op studenteleierskap om aan te sluit by die oproep vir die beskerming van waardevolle universiteitsinfrastruktuur en -hulpbronne wat deel is van alle Suid-Afrikaners se algemene nasionale erfenis.
tgt: Cabinet calls on student leadership to join the call for the protection of valuable university infrastructure and resources which is part of the common national heritage of all South Africans.

src: Die Regering het studente se griewe gehoor en dit geniet tans ons volle aandag.
tgt: Government has heard the issues raised by students, which is receiving our full attention.

src: Ons werk saam met alle betrokke partye om 'n blywende oplossing te vind.
tgt: We are working together with all parties concerned to find a lasting solution.

src: Die Kabinet betreur die tragiese verlies van lewens van die onwettige mynwerkers wat in die verlate Langlaagte-myn gesterf het.
tgt: Cabinet regrets the tragic loss of lives of those illegal miners who died in the derelict Langlaagte mine.

src: Hierdie sterftes beklemtoon die gevare van onwettige mynbou, aangesien hierdie onwettige bedrywighede die lewens van die gemeenskap in gevaar stel.
tgt: These fatalities highlight the dangers of illicit mining as these unlawful activities put the lives of the community at risk.

src: Die Departement van Minerale Hulpbronne werk saam met wetstoepassingsagentskappe om oortreders en veral die leiers van hierdie groepe wat handel in onwettige minerale dryf te vervolg.
tgt: The Department of Mineral Resource is working with law enforcement agencies to ensure that perpetrators are brought to book and in particular the main ringleaders who continue to trade in illegal minerals.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle belanghebbendes om saam te werk om onwettige mynbou in die land uit te wis.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all stakeholders to work together to eradicate illegal mining in the country.

src: Die departement werk saam met mynmaatskappye en het reeds meer as 200 ongebruikte mynbedrywighede wat met onwettige mynbou verband hou.
tgt: The department is working together with mining companies and has closed more than 200 disused mining operations related to illegal mining.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Departement van Basiese Onderwys geluk dat hy die VN se Opvoedkundige, Wetenskaplike en Kulturele Organisasie (Unesco) se Internasionale Geletterdheidstoekenning vir sy Kha Ri Gude-massageletterdheidsveldtog ontvang het.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the Department of Basic Education on winning the UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organisation (UNESCO) International Literacy award for its Kha Ri Gude Mass Literacy Campaign.

src: Die UNESCO Internasionale Geletterdheidpryse beloon uitnemendheid en innovering op die gebied van geletterdheid.
tgt: The UNESCO International Literacy Prizes reward excellence and innovation in the field of literacy.

src: Die Kha Ri Gude-massageletterdheidsveldtog is ingestel om die nasionale koers van ongeletterdheid in Suid-Afrika te verminder, en het reeds 4,7 miljoen mense in beide landelike en stedelike gebiede bevoordeel.
tgt: The Kha Ri Gude Mass Literacy Campaign was introduced to reduce the national rate of illiteracy in South Africa, and has benefitted 4.7-million people in both rural and urban areas.

src: Kursusse word in al die 11 amptelike tale, insluitend Braille, aangebied.
tgt: It is offered in the 11 official languages, including braille.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense oor aan die Suid-Afrikaanse sopraan Pretty Yende wie se opgang van 'n nederige begin in Piet Retief tot internasionale sterstatus 'n inspirasie vir ons almal is.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates South African soprano Pretty Yende whose rise to international stardom from humble beginnings in Piet Retief are an inspiration to all of us.

src: Haar prestasies sluit onder meer in dat sy aanstaande maand in ‘n hoofrol in die Italiaanse opera Lucia di Lammermoor by die Opera Bastille in Parys sal optree en in Desember die titelrol in Romeo et Juliette by die Meropolitan Operahuis in New York vertolk.
tgt: Amongst other performances, she is set to headline the Italian opera Lucia di Lammermoor at the Opéra Bastille in Paris next month and in December she will play the title role in Roméo et Juliette at the Metropolitan Opera House in New York.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense oor aan Me Esther Mahlangu, die wêreldbekende Ndebele-kunstenaar en ontvanger van Suid-Afrika se Nasionale Orde van Ikhamanga.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates Ms Esther Mahlangu, the world renowned Ndebele artist and recipient of South Africa’s National Order of Ikhamanga.

src: Mama Mahlangu en BMW vier die 25ste herdenking van hul ikoniese samewerking van 5 tot 9 Oktober 2016 by die Frieze Art Fair in Londen.
tgt: Mama Mahlangu and BMW mark the 25th Anniversary of their iconic collaboration at the Frieze Art Fair in London between the 5 and 9 October 2016.

src: Die Kabinet sluit aan by Suid-Afrikaners wat die lewe van Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela op haar 80ste verjaardag vier.
tgt: Cabinet joins South Africans in celebrating the life of Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela on her 80th birthday.

src: Algemeen bekend as die “Moeder van die Vryheidstryd”, is Mama Winnie 'n ikoniese strydros en inspirasie vir vroue se veerkragtigheid wêreldwyd.
tgt: Popularly known as the “Mother of the Struggle”, Mama Winnie is an iconic struggle stalwart and inspiration for women’s resilience across the globe.

src: Familie en vriende van die Suid-Afrikaans-gebore internasionaal bekende operasanger, Johan Botha.
tgt: Family and friends of South Africa-born internationally acclaimed opera singer, Mr Johan Botha.

src: MnrBotha sal onthou word vir sy strelende en kragtige stem wat in verskillende operateaters en -sale oor die wêreld heen gehoor is, insluitend die Weense Staatsopera wat hom 'n Kammersänger gemaak, 'n titel wat aan voortreflike sangers van opera- en klassieke musiek in Oostenryk en Duitsland toegeken word.
tgt: Mr Botha will be remembered for his soothing and powerful voice which was heard in various opera theatres and halls across the globe including the Vienna State Opera which made him a Kammersänger, a title that is bestowed on distinguished singers of opera and classical music in Austria and Germany.

src: Familie, vriende en kollegas van die Transnet-treindrywer en -assistent wat gesterf het toe 'n Transnet-goederetrein by die Delvillewoodstasie ontspoor het na 'n grondverskuiwing in Hillcrest, wes van Durban.
tgt: Families, friends and colleagues of the Transnet train driver and train assistant who died when a Transnet goods train derailed at the Delvillewood train station following a landslide in Hillcrest west of Durban.

src: Die mense van Tanzanië ná 'n aardbewing van 5,7 op die Richterskaal, wat 'n aantal lewens geëis het.
tgt: People of Tanzania following a magnitude earthquake that claimed a number of lives.

src: Ons gedagtes en gebede is met die families van diegene wat gesterf het of beseer is.
tgt: Our thoughts and prayers are with the families of those who died and were injured.

src: Implementering van belangrike regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of key government programmes.

src: Die Regering is ten volle toegewy tot die opheffing van ons mense en om dié rede bly onderwys een van ons topprioriteite.
tgt: As government we are deeply committed to the upliftment of our people, hence education remains one of our apex priorities.

src: Dit blyk duidelik uit die toekenning van hulpbronne waarvolgens hoër onderwys en opleiding een van die instellings is waaraan die grootste deel van vanjaar se nasionale begroting toegewys is met 'n bykomende 18% vir 2016/17.Ondanks ekonomiese probleme ken die Regering steeds hulpbronne toe as 'n bewys van sy verbintenis tot die verbetering van toegang tot hoër onderwys en tot onderwys in die algemeen.
tgt: We have demonstrated this through the allocation of resources, where Higher Education and Training was one of the biggest beneficiaries of this year’s national budget, receiving an additional 18% for 2016/17.Despite economic difficulties we continue allocating resources as a demonstration of our support to broaden access to Higher Education, and education in general.

src: Die Regering voorsien vanjaar R1,9 miljard van die R2,3 miljard tekort wat weens die subsidiëring van die 2016-verhoging ontstaan het.
tgt: Government this year provided R.9-billion of the R.3-billion shortfall resulting from the subsidisation on the 2016 increase.

src: Mer as R4,5 miljard word in die boekjaar 2016/17 aan die Nasionale Studentehulpskema beskikbaar gestel om arm studente te help om aan hoër onderwysinstellings te studeer.
tgt: More than R.5 billion has been reprioritized in the 2016/17 financial year to make it available to the National Student Financial Aid Scheme to enable poor students to access higher education.

src: Die Regering is deeglik bewus daarvan dat 'n belegging in die opvoeding van ons kinders tot ekonomiese groei sal bydra, wat noodsaaklik is om die driedubbele uitdaging van werkloosheid, armoede en ongelykheid die hoof te bied.
tgt: Government is fully aware that an investment in the education of our children will contribute to a higher trajectory of economic growth, which is needed to address the triple challenges of unemployment, poverty and inequality.

src: Die Regering het gehoor gegee aan studente se pleidooie en sal die fooi-aanpassings van werkende en middelklas-universiteitstudente vir die 2017 akademiese jaar subsidieer.
tgt: Government has heard and responded to the pleas of students and will subsidise the fee adjustments for poor working and middle class university students for the 2017 academic year.

src: Studente wie se ouers of voogde kan bekostig om vir universiteitsopleiding te betaal moet voortgaan om dit te doen, want onderwys is almal se verantwoordelikheid, nie net die Regering s’n nie.
tgt: Students whose parents or guardians can afford to pay for a university education must and should continue to do so, because education is a responsibility of all not only government.

src: Die aanpassing neem die kwessie van bekostigbaarheid vir studente en hul ouers in ag, asook die behoefte om te verseker dat hoëronderwysinstellings finansieel lewensvatbaar bly.
tgt: The adjustment takes into account the issue of affordability for students and their parents, as well as the need to ensure that institutions of higher learning remain financially viable.

src: Die tussentydse verslag van die Raad vir Hoër Onderwys het 'n inflasiegekoppelde aanpassing deur die bank vir 2017 voorgestel.
tgt: The interim report by the Council on Higher Education proposed an inflation-linked fee adjustment across the board for 2017.

src: Die Regering aanvaar die aanbeveling van 'n voorgestelde 8%-aanpassing in klasgeld vir universiteite en tegniese en beroepsonderwys- en opleidingskolleges, terwyl gapingbefondsing voorsien sal word om die aanpassing vir arm en middelklasstudente te dek.
tgt: Government accepted the recommendation of a proposed 8% fee adjustment at universities and Technical and Vocational Education and Training colleges, while at the same time providing the gap funding to cover the adjustment for poor and missing middle students.

src: Terwyl die Presidensiële Kommissie van Ondersoek na Befondsing vir Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding sy werk voltooi, moet ons universiteitstelsel steeds funksioneer sodat vaardighede vir die ekonomie geskep kan word en jong Suid-Afrikaners, asook studente van lande oor die wêreld, in die besonder die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap (SAOG), bemagtig kan word.
tgt: While the Presidential Commission of Inquiry into Higher Education and Training Funding completes its work, our university system has to continue functioning, producing skills for the economy, and empowering young South Africans and students from countries around the world, in particular the Southern African Development Community (SADC).

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op studente en studenteleiers in die besonder, om hul griewe op ’n gepaste wyse te lug in ooreenstemming met die Grondwet, wat ’n riglyn vir alle Suid-Afrikaners is.
tgt: Cabinet appeals to students and student leaders in particular, to raise their concerns appropriately according to the Constitution, which guides all South Africans.

src: Geweld het die studente se onlangse protesoptrede gekenmerk terwyl die land moes toekyk hoe eiendom gevandaliseer en vernietiging word, biblioteke afgebrand word en 'n universiteitswerker gesterf het.
tgt: Recent violence marred student protests when the country witnessed vandalism, destruction of property, burning of libraries and now even the death of a university worker.

src: President Jacob Zuma het die regeringsgroepering vir Justisie, Misdaadvoorkoming en Sekuriteit (JCPS) opdrag gegee om aandag te gee aan die chaos wat ons hoëronderwysinstellings verwoes.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma has instructed the Justice, Crime Prevention and Security Cluster (JCPS) to deal with the mayhem that is destroying our institutions of higher learning.

src: Die President sal later vandag met die ministers van die JCPS-groepering vergader.
tgt: The President will be meeting with the Ministers from the JCPS Cluster later today.

src: Wetstoepassingsagentskappe wat binne die wet optree, sal alles in hul vermoë doen om diegene wat vir die kriminele aktiwiteite verantwoordelik is, op te spoor.
tgt: Law-enforcement agencies, who are acting within the confines of the law, will leave no stone unturned in finding those responsible for the criminal activities witnessed.

src: Ons verwelkom die aankondiging deur die Departement van Basiese Onderwys dat alles op dreef is vir die 2016 Nasionale Senior Sertifikaateksamen.
tgt: In welcoming the announcement by the Department of Basic Education that it is all systems go for the 2016 Grade 12 National Senior Certificate examination, we urge all stakeholders to work together to ensure that our institutions of higher learning are in a position to receive the Class of 2016 in order to secure a brighter future for our children.

src: Ons versoek egter ook alle belanghebbers om saam te werk om te verseker dat ons hoëronderwysinstellings gereed is om die 2016-matrikulante te ontvang om vir hulle 'n beter toekoms te verseker.
tgt: All stakeholders, especially parents and guardians, need to be actively involved in finding lasting solutions to the education funding challenge.

src: Die graad 12-eksamen duur van 26 Oktober tot 29 November 2016.
tgt: The Grade 12 examinations run from 26 October to 29 November 2016.

src: Die Minister van Basiese Onderwys sal die uitslag van die 2016 graad 12-eksamens op 4 Januarie 2017 aankondig.
tgt: The Minister of Basic Education will announce the outcome of the 2016 Grade 12 exams on 4 January 2017.

src: Altesaam 677 141 voltydse en 150 183 deeltydse kandidate is vir die 2016-eksamen ingeskryf.
tgt: For the 2016 examinations, there are 677 141 full-time and 150 183 part-time candidates, which is 9 000 more candidates than in 2015, demonstrating government’s commitment to ensuring that more of our young people complete their basic education so that they are able to participate in the economy.

src: Dit is 9 000 meer kandidate as in 2015 en is ’n bewys van die Regering se verbintenis om te verseker dat meer van ons jong mense hul basiese onderwys voltooi, sodat hulle ’n bydrae tot die ekonomie kan lewer.
tgt: Cabinet wishes the Class of 2016 well as they embark on the final phase of their school careers.

src: Die Kabinet wens die 2016-matrikulante sterkte toe met die finale fase van hul skoolloopbane.
tgt: As the world commemorates World Teachers’ Day on 5 October 2016, Cabinet applauds all our teachers and commends them for their dedication and hard work in laying the foundation for our future leaders.

src: Die toewyding en deursettingsvermoë van ons onderwysers hef ons mense op en moedig ons leerders aan om steeds beter termynpunte te behaal.
tgt: The dedication and resilience of our teachers has uplifted our people and continues to propel our children to a brighter future.

src: Die Ekonomie.
tgt: The Economy.

src: Die Kabinet is bemoedig deur die resultate van die voortgesette wisselwerking tussen die Regering en nyweraars onder leiding van President Zuma deur die Presidensiële Inisiatief vir Uitvoerende Hoofde om vertroue in die ekonomie te bou, ekonomiese groei te stimuleer en 'n soewereine kredietafgradering af te weer.
tgt: Cabinet is encouraged by the outcomes of the continued engagement between government and captains of industry led by President Zuma through the Presidential CEO Initiative to build confidence in the economy, reignite economic growth and avert a sovereign credit rating downgrade.

src: Vordering sluit 'n indiensnemingsprogram vir die jeug in wat ten doel het om 'n miljoen jong mense oor drie jaar in betaalde internskappe in die privaat sektor te plaas.
tgt: Progress includes a youth employment programme to place one million youth in paid internships over three years in the private sector, including the establishment of a South African Small and Medium Enterprise Fund with R1,5 billion to invest in small enterprises.

src: In ooreenstemming met die Regering se Negepuntplan, is aandag ook aan die ontleding van agt ekonomiese sektore gegee om areas vir nuwe beleggings en groei te WEBTOKEN die toekoms sal die saksektor deur die volgende projekte met die Regering saamwerk: Die vestiging van 'n landbougroeifonds kapasiteit om toerismebemarking te ondersteun ’n toename in die aantal opgeleide verpleegsters en die vernuwing van kwynende industriële gebiede, veral in die Vaaldriehoek.
tgt: In line with government's Nine-Point Plan, work has also been done to analyse eight economic sectors and identify areas for new investment and growth.

src: Vordering is ook gemaak met die implementering van die Nasionale Strategie vir Navorsing, Ontwikkeling en Innovering op die gebied van Brandstofseltegnologie (HySA-strategie).
tgt: Going forward business will partner with government through the following projects: establishment of an Agricultural Growth Fund capacity to support tourism marketing increasing the numbers of nurses trained and the revitalisation of declining industrial areas, specifically in the Vaal Triangle.

src: Die Kabinet het die HySA-strategie in 2007 goedgekeur vir die skep van kennis en om die ontwikkeling van hoëwaarde- kommersiële produkte in die waterstof- en brandstofseltegnologiesektor deur die veredeling van die land se platinumgroep-metaalhulpbronne in staat te stel.
tgt: Progress has also been made in implementing the National Hydrogen and Fuel Cell Technologies Research, Development and Innovation Strategy (HySA Strategy).

src: Dit het ook die potensiaal om lokalisering te bevorder met die oog op die bevordering van swart nyweraars.
tgt: This also holds the potential to advance localisation with a view to strengthen black industrialists.

src: Hierdie Suid-Afrikaanse innovering dra by tot internasionale innovering deur die kommersialisering van tegnologie, terwyl dit 25% van die waterstof- en brandstofselmark verkry, wat na raming R1,37 miljard teen 2020 sal beloop.
tgt: This South African innovation involves contributing to international innovation through technology commercialisation while capturing 25% of the Hydrogen and Fuel Cell market, which translates to R.37 billion in 2020.

src: Die Kabinet keur die bekendstelling goed van die nuwe regulasie wat die verhouding tussen die werkgewer en die werknemer rakende saketransaksies met die Staat beheer.
tgt: Cabinet approved the introduction of the new regulation governing the relationship between the employer and the employee in relation to doing business with the State.

src: Die regulasie, wat in die Staatskoerant gepubliseer is, bring die Wet op Publieke Administrasie, 2014 (Wet 11 van 2014) in werking.
tgt: The gazetted regulations bring into effect the Public Administration Management Act, 2014 (Act 11 of 2014).

src: Die oorhandiging van die eerste 500 huise by die Savanna City Geïntegreerde Meslikenedersettingsprojek is deel van die Regering se pogings om behoorlike behuising aan behoeftiges te verskaf en hulle te help om hul waardigheid te herwin deur toe te sien dat hulle hul reg tot voldoende en gehaltebehuising kan geniet.
tgt: The handover of the first 500 houses at the Savanna City Integrated Human Settlements Project, which was led by the Minister of Human Settlements, Ms Lindiwe Sisulu, is part of government’s efforts in providing decent housing to needy people and to help restore their dignity by ensuring that they enjoy the right to adequate and quality shelter.

src: Me voltooiing van die projek binne die volgende vyf jaar, sal daar meer as 18 000 huise wees, waarvan 500 aan militêre veterane toegeken sal word.
tgt: When completed in the next five years, the project will have over 18 000 houses, 500 of which will be allocated to military veterans.

src: Die Nasionale Forum vir Internetbestuur en die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap se Internetwisselpunt is suksesvol van stapel gestuur deur die Minister van Telekommunikasie en Posdienste, dr Siyabonga Cwele en die Kommissaris van die Afrika-unie (AU), dr Elham Ibrahim.
tgt: The National Internet Governance Forum, and the Southern Africa Development Community Internet Exchange Point have been successfully launched by the Minister of Telecommunications and Postal Services, Dr Siyabonga Cwele and African Union (AU) Commissioner Dr Elham Ibrahim.

src: Die Nasionale Forum vir Internetbestuur (AfIGF) het ’n standpunt vir die land ontwikkel ter voorbereiding vir die vyfde AfIGF, wat van 16 tot 18 Oktober 2016 in eThekwini, KwaZulu-Natal, plaasvind.
tgt: The National Internet Governance Forum (AfIGF) developed a country position, in preparation for the Fifth AfIGF from 16 to 18 October 2016, in eThekwini, KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Die AfIGF sal tot goedkoper internettoegang in die streek lei omdat internetverkeer tussen Afrika-lande sal sirkuleer.
tgt: The AfIGF will lead to lower costs to access the Internet in the region because the Internet traffic will circulate among African countries.

src: Hierdie ontwikkelings beklemtoon hoe belangrik dit vir Suid-Afrika en die AU is om aktief by die internetekonomie betrokke te wees, en nie net verbruikers te wees nie.
tgt: These developments underscore the importance that South Africa and the AU attach to meaningful participation in the Internet economy and not just as consumers.

src: Dit bring ons ook nader aan die skep van 'n meer inklusiewe digitale ekonomie en ’n kennissamelewing soos in die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NDP) vervat.
tgt: These also take us closer to creating a more inclusive digital economy and knowledge society, as envisaged in the National Development Plan (NDP).

src: Die Regering is daartoe verbind om toe te sien dat die internet algemeen toeganklik vir alle Suid-Afrikaners sal wees, wat sal bydra tot die skep van 'n inklusiewe gemeenskap.
tgt: Government is committed to ensuring that the Internet is universally accessible to all South Africans, which contributes to the creation of an inclusive society.

src: Die Afrikalugruim-en-verdedigingslugskou is suksesvol deur die Departement van Verdediging, Krygkor, SA Aerospace, die Vereniging van Maritieme en Verdedigingsbedrywe, Denel en die Kommersiële Lugvaartvereniging van Suid-Afrika aangebied.
tgt: The Africa Aerospace and Defence Air show and Defence Exhibition was successfully hosted by the Department of Defence, Armscor, SA Aerospace, Maritime and Defence Industry Association, Denel and the Commercial Aviation Association of South Africa.

src: Dit het ’n geleentheid vir Suid-Afrika se verdedigingsbedrywe gebied om hul vermoëns aan die internasionale gemeenskap te bemark.
tgt: This platform allowed South Africa’s defence industries to market their capabilities to the international community, and this year also saw the largest number of exhibitors and national pavilions represented by various countries.

src: Die Kabinet se standpunt oor belangrike kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on key issues in the environment.

src: Die Kabinet stem saam met die verklaring wat op 23 September deur die Presidensie uitgereik is oor die heraanstelling van die SAUK se Operasionele Hoof.
tgt: Cabinet fully aligns itself with the statement issued by The Presidency on 23 September, on the matter of the Chief Operations Officer (COO) of the SABCabinet respects the ruling of the Supreme Court of Appeal (SCA) confirming the setting aside of the appointment of Mr Hlaudi Motsoeneng as COO of the SABC.

src: Die Kabinet respekteer die uitspraak van die Appèlhof wat die tersydestelling van die aanstelling van mnr Hlaudi Motsoeneng as bedryfshoof van die SAUK bevestig.
tgt: Cabinet calls on the SABC Board to abide by the letter and spirit of the SCA ruling.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op die SAUK-raad om by die letter en gees van die Appèlhof se uitspraak te hou.
tgt: Attempts to subvert the SCA ruling through legally suspect interpretations border on violating the constitutional principle of legality and challenge the constitutionally assigned judicial authority of our courts.

src: Pogings om die Appèlhof se uitspraak te ondermyn deur interpretasies wat wettig verdag is, grens aan oortreding van die grondwetlike legaliteitsbeginsel en tart die grondwetlik bepaalde geregtelike gesag van die howe.
tgt: The decision to reappoint Mr Motsoeneng in a new position shows disrespect of a rule of law.

src: Die Kabinet herinner die Raad aan Artikel 165 van die Grondwet, dat 'n bevel of beslissing wat deur 'n hof uitgereik is, alle persone op wie en staatsorgane waarop dit van toepassing is, daartoe verbind.
tgt: Cabinet reminded the Board of Section 165 of the Constitution: that an order or decision issued by a court binds all persons to whom and organs of state to which it applies.

src: Faith Muthambi, beveel om dringend stappe te doen om hierdie saak met die SAUK-raad op te neem.2 Die Kabinet verwelkom die resultate van Suid-aAfrika se deelname aan die 71ste Algemene Vergadering van die Verenigde Nasies (VNAV) onder leiding van President Zuma.
tgt: Cabinet directed the Minister of Communications, Ms Faith Muthambi, to urgently take steps to address this matter with the SABC Board.2 Cabinet welcomes the outcomes from South Africa’s participation at the 71st United Nations General Assembly (UNGA), which was led by President Zuma.

src: Dit het van 20 tot 26 September 2016 met die tema "Die Volhoubare Ontwikkelingsdoelwitte: 'n universele poging om ons wêreld te transformeer", plaasgevind.
tgt: This took place from 20 to 26 September 2016 under the theme “The Sustainable Development Goals: A universal push to transform our world”.During this session world leaders adopted the New York Declaration which expresses the political will and commitment to protect the rights of refugees and migrants.

src: Wêreldleiers het tydens hierdie sessie die New York-verklaring aanvaar, wat uiting gee aan die politieke wil en verbintenis om die regte van vlugtelinge en immigrante te beskerm.
tgt: The commitments pave the way to negotiations aimed at an international conference and the adoption of a global compact for safe, orderly and regular migration in 2018.Our country once again reiterated its call for the strengthening of the institutions of global governance, including the UN, specifically the Security Council and advocated for the urgent reform of these institutions with the aim of correcting the historical injustice against Africa reflected in outdated structures.

src: Die verpligtinge baan die weg na onderhandelings om 'n internasionale konferensie te hou en die sluit van 'n wêreldverdrag vir veilige, ordelike en gereelde migrasie in 2018.Suid-Afrika het weer sy oproep vir die versterking van wêreldbestuursinstellings, insluitend die VN, spesifiek die Veiligheidsraad, herhaal en die dringende hervorming van hierdie instellings bepleit met die doel om die historiese onreg teen Afrika, wat in verouderde strukture weerspieël word, reg te stel.
tgt: President Zuma co-hosted with President Francois Hollande, of France the UN High-Level Commission on Health Employment and Economic Growth on 20 September 2016.

src: President Zuma was medegasheer saam met President Francois Hollande van Frankryk, van die VN se Hoëkommissie oor Gesondheidsindiensneming en Ekonomiese Groei op 20 September 2016.
tgt: The commission was established by the UN Secretary-General and it aims to engage leaders at the highest level to encourage the creation of new employment opportunities in the health sector globally.

src: Die verslag van die kommissie wat deur die Algemene Vergadering aanvaar is, maak aanbevelings aan lidlande, wat wissel van opleidingsbehoeftes, voortgesette onderwys en die behoefte om op primêre gesondheidsorg te fokus.
tgt: The Report of the Commission which was adopted by the General Assembly, makes recommendations to Member States, ranging from training needs, continuing education and the need to focus on primary health care.

src: Dit sluit 'n verbintenis in om 40 miljoen gesondheidswerkers teen 2030 op te lei.
tgt: This includes a commitment to train 40 million health workers by 2030.The official handover of the Open Government Partnership (OGP) leader chair position to France was done by President Zuma during the five-year anniversary event on the margins of the UNGDuring South Africa’s tenure as chair of the OGP we championed the Open Government Declaration on the implementation of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, which will see OGP member countries incorporating Sustainable Development Goals in their OGP countries’ action plans.

src: President Zuma het die leierskap van die Vennootskap vir Oop Regering (VOR) amptelik aan Frankryk oorhandig tydens die vyfjaarviering op die rand van VNAOnder Suid-Afrika se dienstyd as voorsitter van die VOR was ons ’n kampvegter vir die Oop Regering-verklaring oor die deurvoer van die 2030 Agenda vir Volhoubare Ontwikkeling.
tgt: South Africa also prioritised legislative openness, open data, and broadening civil society participation to include grass root organisation and vulnerable groups within the OGKey Cabinet decisions.

src: Dit sal toesien dat VOR-lidlande die volhoubare ontwikkelingsdoelwitte by hul VOR-aksieplanne insluit.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the assessment by the Academy of Science of South Africa on South Africa’s technical readiness to support the shale gas industry, including the recommendations on actions to be implemented by relevant departments.

src: Suid-Afrika het ook wetgewende openheid, oop data, en groter deelname deur die burgerlike samelewing om grondvlakorganisasies en kwesbare groepe binne die VOR in te sluit, geprioritiseer.
tgt: In the transition to low carbon technologies while improving energy security, South Africa is considering shale gas as a potential contributor to the country’s future energy mix.

src: Die verslag, wat vrygestel sal word vir openbare insae, bespreek verskeie kwessies wat aandag moet kry om die land ten volle gereed te maak.
tgt: The report, which will be released for public consumption, raises a number of issues that require attention in order to bring the country to a full state of readiness.

src: Dit sluit in die bevordering van die regulerende, lisensiëring- en die moniteringsowerhede die versekering dat Suid-Afrika die nodige vaardighede het steun aan toepaslike maatskappye om die ekonomiese geleenthede te ontgin die instel van maatreëls om natuurlike hulpbronne te beskerm en navorsing.
tgt: These include: strengthening the regulatory, licensing and monitoring authorities, ensuring that South Africa has the requisite skills supporting relevant companies to exploit the economic opportunities, putting in place measures that will protect natural resources, and commencing with research.

src: Die verslag sal as basis dien vir die opstel van die plan vir skaliegasnavorsing, ontwikkeling en innovering.
tgt: The report will be used as the basis to develop the shale gas research, development and innovation plan.

src: Vordering is gemaak met Operasie Phakisa vir landbou, grondhervorming en landelike ontwikkeling.
tgt: Progress has been made on Operation Phakisa for Agriculture, Land Reform and Rural Development.

src: Deur Operasie Phakisa wil die Regering groei bevorder om voedselsekerheid in Suid-Afrika op alle vlakke te bewerkstellig.
tgt: Through Operation Phakisa government seeks to expand growth, with the view to make South Africa a food secure nation at all levels.

src: Sedert Me 2016 is uitgebreide raadplegingsessies oor ’n tydperk van vier maande gehou.
tgt: Since May 2016, extensive consultation sessions were conducted over a four-month period.

src: Die belangrikste besprekingsessie vind oor 'n tydperk van vyf weke van 25 September tot 28 Oktober 2016 plaas.
tgt: The actual LAB is taking place over a five-week period from 25 September and 28 October 2016.

src: Die hoofdoel is om die formulering van die vereiste en implementeerbare ingrypings tot groter ekonomiese insluiting vir die sektor te verseker.
tgt: The primary objective is to ensure the formulation of required and implementable interventions towards greater economic inclusion for the sector.

src: Operasie Phakisa: Landbou en Grondhervorming poog om een miljoen werkgeleenthede te skep en een miljoen hektaar teen 2019 te beplant, soos deur die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP) in die vooruitsig gestel.
tgt: Operation Phakisa: Agriculture and Land Reform seeks to create one million jobs, and plant one million hectares by 2019, as envisioned in the NDCabinet approved the Capacity-building Strategic Framework for District and Local Municipalities in support of the Agri-parks Programme.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die program vir ’n strategiese raamwerk vir kapasiteitsbou in streeks- en plaaslike munisipaliteite ter ondersteuning van die Agriparkeprogram.
tgt: The Agri-parks Programme has become the cornerstone of government’s priority to Revitalise Agriculture and Agro-processing Value Chain, which is one of the priorities of the Nine-Point Plan.

src: Al 44 distriksmunisipaliteite is by hierdie program betrek.
tgt: All 44 district municipalities have been included in this programme.

src: Dit sal agriparke as 'n belangrike meganisme om die NOP se voorgestelde landelike ontwikkelingstrategie deur te voer, vestig.
tgt: This will position Agri-parks to serve as an important mechanism to execute the NDP’s proposed rural development strategy due to their potential for supporting small-scale agricultural production and stimulating agro-processing in rural areas.

src: Hulle het die potensiaal om kleinskaalse landbouproduksie en die stimulering van landbouverwerking in landelike gebiede te ondersteun.
tgt: Cabinet also approved the National Integrated Information Communication Technology (ICT) Policy White Paper, which replaces the separate White Papers on Telecommunications (1996) and Postal Services (1998).This integrated ICT Policy outlines how government will ensure that the sector fulfils its potential to facilitate inclusive social and economic transformation in South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet verleen ook goedkeuring aan die Witskrif oor ’n Nasionale Geïntegreerde Beleid vir Inligtingskommunikasietegnologie (IKT), wat die afsonderlike Witskrifte oor Telekommunikasie (1996) en Posdienste (1998) vervang.
tgt: The Minister of Telecommunications and Postal Services, Dr Cwele, will convene a separate media briefing to further unpack this policy.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Afrika-telekommunikasie-unie (ATU) se Konvensie van 1999 aan die Parlement voorgelê word vir bekragtiging ooreenkomstig Artikel 231 (2) van die Grondwet.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the African Telecommunications Union (ATU) Convention of 1999 to Parliament for ratification in terms of Section 231(2) of the Constitution.

src: Die ATU is 'n orgaan wat algemene toegang in Afrika en die gebruik van IKT op die vasteland bevorder, soos die vestiging van infrastruktuur, radiofrekwensiespektrum en standaard-interoperabiliteit.
tgt: The ATU is an organ that promotes universal access in Africa and the use of ICTs – such as infrastructure roll-out, radio-frequency spectrum and standard-interoperability – on the continent.

src: Suid-Afrika se deelname strook met die NOP en buitelandse beleidsdoelwitte om die land wêreldwyd beter te posisioneer en die AU-instelling te versterk om aan die buitelandse beleid se ontwikkelingsdoelwitte te voldoen.
tgt: South Africa’s participation is in line with the NDP and foreign policy objectives of better positioning country globally and strengthening the AU institution in order to fulfil the developmental foreign policy objectives.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die voorgestelde institusionele raamwerk vir die vestiging van ’n multiprimêre administrateur vir Digitalevoorwerpargitektuur (DVA), met die voorgestelde naam, die MISAVA Agenskap vir Digitale Identifisering.
tgt: Cabinet approved the proposed institutional framework for the establishment of the Multi-Primary Administrator of the Digital Object Architecture (DOA), with the proposed name being MISAVA Agency for Digital Identifier.

src: Inwerkingstelling van die DVA kan Suid-Afrika se IKT-mededingendheid ter voorbereiding van deelname aan die Vierde Industriële Revolusie, ’n hupstoot gee.
tgt: Implementation of the DOA has the potential to position South Africa by bolstering ICT competitiveness in readiness to participate in the Fourth Industrial Revolution.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan Suid-Afrika se hersiene standpunt oor die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap (SAOG) se voorstel vir die ontwikkeling van 'n ooreenkoms met betrekking tot die vestiging van die Noord-suid-korridor-Bestuursintstelling (NSCMI).Die SAOG se ministers van vervoer het ingestem om die NSCMI te vestig om aandag aan bedryfsondoeltreffendheid en knelpunte langs die Noord-suid-korridor te gee.
tgt: Cabinet approved South Africa’s revised position to the Southern African Development Community’s (SADC) proposal for the development of a memorandum of understanding regarding the establishment of the North South Corridor Management Institution (NSCMI).The SADC Ministers of Transport agreed to establish an NSCMI to address operational inefficiencies and bottlenecks along the North South Corridor.

src: Die Kabinet keur ook goed dat die Minister van Vervoer die vergadering van ministers van die Noord-suid-korridor tydens 2016/17 aanbied.
tgt: Cabinet also approved for the Minister of Transport to host the North South Corridor Ministers of Transport meeting during 2016/17.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die ontwikkeling van 'n nuwe reeks gedenk- en sirkulasiemunte deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Munt en sy raad van direkteure, in samewerking met die Minister van Finansies.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the development of a new series of commemorative and circulation coins that would represent culture, freedom and democracy, by the South African Mint and its Board of Directors, in conjunction, with the Minister of Finance.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die bekendstelling en ontwerpe van die nuwe R10- en R5-sterlingsilwergedenkmunte die nuwe R5-gedenkmunt (½ oz.)
tgt: Cabinet approved the introduction and designs of the new R10 and R5 Sterling-silver commemorative coins the new R5 (1/2 oz.)

src: van 24 karaat goud tot die Natura-muntreeks vir 2017 ena.
tgt: 24-carat gold commemorative coin to the Natura Coin Series for 2017 anda.

src: Ontwerpe van die volgende gedenkmuntreekse:Die 2017-Natura-muntreeksDie 2017-sterlingsilwer-muntreeks enDie 2017-sterlingsilwer-R2-kroon- en 2½ c-tiekiereeks.
tgt: Designs of the following commemorative coin series:The 2017 Natura Coin SeriesThe 2017 Sterling-silver Coin Series andThe 2017 Sterling-silver R2 Crown and 2½ c Tickey series.

src: b.
tgt: b.

src: Die volgende 2017-Krugerrandmunt:Die heruitreiking van die jaargang 1967-Krugerrand in 2016Bekendstelling van nuwe Krugerrande tot die 2017-reeks.
tgt: The following 2017 Krugerrand coins:The re-issue of the vintage 1967 Krugerrand in 2016 andIntroduction of new Krugerrands to the collection in Bills.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Maatskaplike Bystand van 2016 vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer word.
tgt: Cabinet approved publication of the Social Assistance Amendment Bill of 2016 for public comment.

src: Dit wysig die Wet op Maatskaplike Bystand, 2004 (Wet 13 van 2004).Die Wysigingswetsontwerp het ten doel om voorsiening te maak vir bykomende betalings en/of voordele wat verband hou met maatskaplike bystand.
tgt: This amends the Social Assistance Act, 2004 (Act 13 of 2004).

src: Wysigings sal begrafnisvoordele en bykomende voordele vir weeskinders en kinders aan die hoof van huishoudings verseker.
tgt: The Amendment Bill seeks to provide for additional payments and/or benefits linked to social assistance.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor Suid-Afrika se voorbereidings en keur die strategie goed vir deelname aan die komende 8ste BRICS-beraad, wat deur die Interministeriële BRICS-Komitee gelei sal word.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on South Africa’s preparations and approved the strategy for participation in the upcoming 8th BRICS Summit, being led by the BRICS Inter-Ministerial Committee.

src: Die tema van die 8ste BRICS-beraad, wat van 15 tot 16 Oktober 2016 in Goa, Indië, gehou word, is "Bou Deelnemende, Inklusiewe en Gesamentlike Oplossings".Die Kabinet is ook ingelig oor die vordering van die nuwe Ontwikkelingsbank van Afrika se streeksentrum.
tgt: The 8th BRICS Summit will be held under the theme “Building Responsive, Inclusive and Collective Solutions (BRICS)” from 15 to 16 October 2016 in Goa, India.

src: Suid-Afrika sal voortgaan om die inwerkingtreding van BRICS se nuwe ontwikkkelingsbank te ondersteun.
tgt: Cabinet was also briefed on the status of operationalisation of the New Development Bank Africa Regional Centre.

src: Dit sluit in dat Suid-Afrika gasheer vir die Afrika-streeksentrum in Johannesburg sal wees.
tgt: South Africa will continue to support the coming into operation of the BRICS New Development Bank, which includes hosting the Africa Regional Centre in Johannesburg.

src: Die gevestigde eerste BRICS finansiële instellings, soos die nuwe ontwikkelingsbank en die voorwaardelike reserwe-indeling, dien as katalisatorinstellings om industrialisering en infrastruktuurprogramme in Suid-Afrika en die vasteland te versterk.
tgt: The established first BRICS financial institutions, such as the New Development Bank and Contingent Reserve Arrangement serve as catalytic institutions to leverage industrialisation and infrastructure programmes in South Africa and the continent.

src: Die Kabinet keur die Suid-Afrikaanse onderhandelingsmandaat goed wat as basis sal dien vir betrokkenheid by die 28ste Vergadering van die Partye tot die Montreal-protokol oor Stowwe wat die Osoonlaag Vernietig (Montreal MOP 28).
