tgt: Cabinet approved the South African negotiating mandate to serve as the basis for engagement at the 28th Meeting of the Parties to the Montreal Protocol on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer (Montreal MOP 28) to be held from 10 to 14 October 2016, in Kigali, Rwanda.

src: Die Montreal-protokol was baie doeltreffend met die uitfasering van stowwe wat die osoon vernietig.
tgt: The Montreal Protocol has been very effective in terms of phasing out Ozone Depleting Substances.

src: Dit sluit aan by ons Grondwet, wat bepaal dat die vermindering van armoede en die bevordering van sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling binne die konteks van volhoubare ontwikkeling moet plaasvind.
tgt: This links to our Constitution which provides that poverty reduction and socio-economic development should be advanced within the context of sustainable development.

src: Die VN se derde Konferensie oor Behuising en Volhoubare Verstedeliking (Habitat III) deur die VNAV sal in Quito, Ecuador, van 17 tot 20 Oktober 2016 plaasvind.
tgt: The Third UN Conference on Housing and Sustainable Urbanisation (Habitat III) will be held by the UNGA in Quito, Ecuador from 17 to 20 October 2016.

src: Dit het ten doel om 'n nuwe stedelike agenda te aanvaar, 'n aksiegeoriënteerde dokument op te stel wat wêreldwye standaarde van prestasie in volhoubare stedelike ontwikkeling sal neerlê, en die manier waarop ons bou, bestuur en in stede woon te hersien deur samewerking met toegewyde vennote, toepaslike belanghebbers, en stedelike rolspelers op alle regeringsvlakke sowel as die private sektor.
tgt: It aims to adopt a New Urban Agenda an action-oriented document which will set global standards of achievement in sustainable urban development, rethinking the way we build, manage, and live in cities through drawing together cooperation with committed partners, relevant stakeholders, and urban actors at all levels of government as well as the private sector.

src: Die Internasionale Konferensie oor Navorsingsinfrastruktuur (ICRI 2016) word van 3 tot 5 Oktober 2016 in Kaapstad deur die Departement van Wetenskap en Tegnologie en die Europese Kommissie aangebied.
tgt: The International Conferences on Research Infrastructures (ICRI 2016) will be hosted in Cape Town from 3 to 5 October 2016 by the Department of Science and Technology and the European Commission.

src: Die konferensie het ten doel om die noodsaaklike rol van wêreldwye navorsingsinfrastruktuur in die hantering van groot uitdagings en as splipunte vir innovering na vore te bring, te besin oor behoeftes, ontwikkeling en volhoubaarheid van wêreldwye en plaaslike navorsingsinfrastruktuur, en die moontlikheid van 'n internasionale rigtingwyser te bespreek.
tgt: The conference aims to highlight the essential role of global research infrastructures in addressing grand challenges and as hubs for innovation reflecting on needs, development and sustainability of global/regional research infrastructures and discussing the possibility to move towards an international roadmap.

src: Suid-Afrika het bewys gelewer van sy wetenskap- en tegnologienavorsingsvermoë en word erken as die natuurlike tuiste van sommige van die wêreld se mees beduidende navorsingsinfrastruktuur.
tgt: South Africa has demonstrated its science and technology research capability, and is acknowledged as a natural home of some of the world's most significant research infrastructures.

src: Deur ICRI 2016 aan te bied sal die land vinniger tot ’n kennisgebaseerde ekonomie, soos in die NDP vervat, ontwikkel.
tgt: The hosting of ICRI 2016 will augment the country's progression to becoming a knowledge-based economy as envisaged in the NDCabinet welcomes the announcement of the first phase milestone towards switching-off of the analogue transmitter on 28 October 2016 by Communications Minister Faith Muthambi, in the core towns of the Square Kilometre Array (SKA) areas in the Northern Cape, in the town of Carnavon within the Kareeberg Local Municipality.

src: Mer as 86% van huishoudings in die SKA-omgewing is reeds verbind en geniet digitale terrestriële televisiedienste in hul huise.
tgt: Over 86% of households in the SKA areas have been connected and are enjoying digital terrestrial television services in their homes.

src: Die migrasie is in lyn met die NOP se doelwit om kragtige, betroubare, veilige en bekostigbare IKT-infrastruktuur te skep.
tgt: The migration is also in line with the NDP to create a robust, reliable, secure and affordable ICT infrastructure.

src: Dit sal landelike en stedelike mense, rykes en armes, verbind sodat alle Suid-Afrikaners met behulp van tegnologie meer doeltreffend sake kan doen en kan kommunikeer.
tgt: It will connect rural and urban, rich and poor ensuring that South African citizens transact and communicate more effectively with the use of technology.

src: In Oktober vier die Regering Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling-maand met die tema "Saam beweeg ons Suid-Afrika vorentoe na sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling".
tgt: Government will celebrate Social Development Month in October under the theme “Together moving South Africa forward to Socio-Economic Development” and through the Department of Social Development (DSD), will hold country-wide dialogues to better understand the diverse needs of communities.

src: Deur die Departement van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling (DMO) sal gesprekke landwyd gevoer word om die uiteenlopende behoeftes van gemeenskappe beter te verstaan.
tgt: The DSD, together with the National Development Agency (NDA) and the South African Social Security Agency, will inform communities of the various social security programmes available to them and how these can be accessed.

src: Die Kabinet moedig alle sektore aan om die Regering te help om toe te sien dat daar aan die behoeftes van die mees kwesbare mense in ons gemeenskappe voldoen word.
tgt: Cabinet encourages all sectors to assist government in ensuring that the needs of the most vulnerable in our society are taken care of.1 October 2016 marks the International Day for Older Persons, which will be commemorated as part of the first week of October.

src: In die eerste week van Oktober sal dié dag gevier word deur bewustheid te skep van negatiewe stereotipes en wanopvattings oor ouer persone en veroudering.
tgt: This will be dedicated to draw attention to challenging negative stereotypes and misconceptions about older persons and ageing.

src: Die Departement van Sport en Ontspanning en die Vereniging vir Internasionale Sport vir Almal bied die 6de The Big Walk op 2 Oktober 2016 by die Fonteinedaloord in Pretoria aan.
tgt: The Department of Sports and Recreation and the Association for International Sport for All will host the 6th edition of “The Big Walk” on 2 October 2016 at the Fountains Valley Resort, Pretoria.

src: Die Kabinet moedig Suid-Afrikaners aan om 'n aktiewe, gesonde lewenstyl te volg om die hoë voorkoms van lewenstylsiektes en vetsug die hoof te bied.
tgt: Cabinet encourages South Africans to embrace an active, healthier lifestyle so as to tackle the high incidence of lifestyle diseases and obesity.

src: 19 Oktober 2016 is die 30ste herdenking van die vliegongeluk wat die lewe van die Mosambiekse President, Samora Moises Machel, asook die lewens van 34 van sy landsburgers, insluitend vlieëniers en joernaliste, geëis het.
tgt: 19 October 2016 marks the 30th anniversary of the plane crash that claimed the life of Mozambican President, Samora Moises Machel and 34 of his country men and women, including pilots and journalists.

src: Die mense van Mosambiek het tot die bevryding van Suid-Afrika en ander lande op die subkontinent bygedra.
tgt: The people of Mozambique contributed towards the liberation of South Africa and other countries in the subcontinent.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse Regering, in samewerking met die Regering van die Republiek van Mosambiek, sal die 30ste herdenking by die ongelukstoneel in Mbuzini, Mpumalanga, op 17 Oktober 2016, gedenk.
tgt: The government of the Republic of South Africa, in collaboration with the government of the Republic of Mozambique, will host the 30th anniversary commemorations at the crash site in Mbuzini, Mpumalanga on 17 October 2016.This contributes to the Department of Arts and Culture establishing a resistance and liberation heritage route that will link all liberation heritage route sites in South Africa, the SADC and the continent.

src: Die familie en vriende van Suid-Afrika se musieklegende en een van die pioniers van die kwaito-musiekgenre, Mduduzi Tshabalala, algemeen bekend as Mandoza.
tgt: The family and friends of South African music legend and one of the pioneers of Kwaito music genre, Mduduzi Tshabalala, popularly known as Mandoza.

src: Sy musiek, wat nog steeds deur alle Suid-Afrikaners waardeer word, het 'n unieke kruiskulturele karakter.
tgt: His music achieved a unique cultural crossover which continues to be appreciated by all South Africans.

src: Die familie en vriende van die veteraanjoernalis, redakteur en skrywer, Allister Sparks, wat op die ouderdom van 83 oorlede is.
tgt: The family and friends of veteran journalist, editor and author Allister Sparks who passed away at the age of Sparks used his position as editor of the Rand Daily Mail in the early 1980s to expose the unjust apartheid government.

src: Sparks het sy pos as redakteur van die Rand Daily Mail in die vroeë 1980's gebruik om die onregverdige apartheidsregering aan die kaak te stel.
tgt: He was a Nieman Fellow at Harvard University and South African correspondent for a number of international publications, including The Washington Post and The Economist.

src: Hy was 'n Nieman-genoot aan Harvard-universiteit en Suid-Afrikaanse korrespondent vir verskeie internasionale publikasies, insluitend The Washington Post en The Economist.
tgt: The people of India, on the passing of His Divine Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj, the spiritual head of the Swaminarayan Hindu faith community in India.

src: Sy Heiligheid is bekend vir die belangrike bydrae wat hy tot Indië se spirituele lewe en kultuur gemaak het deur die bou van tempels en opvoedkundige instellings in Indië asook in ander lande.
tgt: His Divine Holiness is renowned for the great contribution he made to Indian spirituality and culture by building temples, mandirs and educational institutions both in India and other countries.

src: Die families van diegene wat tydens die gewelddadige voorvalle in die Demokratiese Republiek die Kongo (DRK) gesterf het, en wens die beseerdes 'n spoedige herstel toe.
tgt: To the families of all those who lost their lives during the violent incidences that took place in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and those injured are also wished a speedy recovery.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op al die partye in die DRK om betrokke te raak by die inklusiewe nasionale dialoog wat deur mnr Edem Kodjo namens die AU moontlik gemaak word en deur plaaslike en internasionale instellings ondersteun word.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all the parties in the DRC to participate in the Inclusive National Dialogue, which is facilitated by Mr Edem Kodjo on behalf of the AU, and supported by regional and international institutions.

src: Aan die familie en vriende van Shimon Peres, die afgetrede Israeliese staatsman wat 'n Nobelprys gedeel het vir die smee van 'n vredesooreenkoms tussen Israel en Palestina.
tgt: To the family and friends of Shimon Peres, the Israeli elder statesman who shared a Nobel Prize for forging a peace deal between Israelis and Palestinians.

src: Mnr Peres was 'n konstante bron van krag vir toekomstige geslagte in Israel.
tgt: Mr Peres served as a constant force for generations in Israeli politics.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense aan die volgende oor:.
tgt: Cabinet conveyed its congratulation to the following:.

src: Die Wetenskaplike en Nywerheidsnavorsingsraad vir sy jongste vingerafdruktegnologie wat wetstoepassing- en forensiese personeel aansienlik sal help met die uitvoer van hul pligte.
tgt: The Council for Scientific and Industrial Research on its new-generation fingerprint sensing technology that will better aid law-enforcement and forensic personnel in their work.

src: Die prototipetoestel, wat deur die Departement van Wetenskap en Tegnologie befonds is, kan gebruik word om oppervlakke te skandeer en vingerafdrukke te lig sonder die gebruik van die afstoftegniek of die risiko van besoedeling.
tgt: The prototype device, funded by the Department of Science and Technology, can be used to scan areas and lift fingerprints without the use of dusting or the risk of contamination.

src: Dr Ismail Bhorat en sy span vir die pionierswerk op 'n ongebore kind by die Inkosi Albert Luthuli Sentrale Hospitaal.
tgt: Dr Ismail Bhorat and his team for the ground-breaking operation on an unborn child at the Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital.

src: Dit is die eerste operasie in Suid-Afrika op 'n fetus en het die land internasionaal in die kollig geplaas.
tgt: This is the first operation to be performed on a foetus in the country and has placed South Africa on the world stage.

src: Mamelodi Sundowns, dat hulle die finaal van die Konfederasie van Afrika-sokkerkampioeneliga gehaal het toe hulle Zesco United geklop het.
tgt: Mamelodi Sundowns for reaching the final of the Confederation of African Football Champions League after beating Zesco United.

src: Hierdie oorwinning is nie net 'n prestasie vir Sundowns nie, maar ook vir Suid-Afrikaanse sokker.
tgt: This victory is not only good for Sundowns but will benefit South African football as a whole.

src: Dit gee ons spelers broodnodige blootstelling en ervaring om met die beste op die Afrika-vasteland en die wêreld mee te ding.
tgt: It gives our players the much needed exposure and experience they need to compete with the best in the African continent and the world.

src: Die Kabinet wens Brad Binder geluk met sy geskiedkundige oorwinning in die Moto3-Wêreldkampioenskap.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates Brad Binder for his historic Moto3 World Championship win.

src: Die 21-jarige motorfietsjaer is die eerste Suid-Afrikaner sedert 1980 om 'n Grand Prix-titel te beklink nadat hy sy eerste Moto3-kampioenskap gewen het.
tgt: The 21-year-old motorcycle racer became the first South African since 1980 to clinch a Grand Prix title after winning his maiden Moto3 championship.

src: Die Kabinet bedank alle Suid-Afrikaners wat aan verskeie aktiwiteite deelgeneem het om ons uiteenlopende kulture tydens Erfenismaand te vier en te respekteer.
tgt: And Cabinet extends its gratitude to all South Africans who took part in various activities to celebrate and respect our diverse cultures during Heritage Month.

src: Die treffende manier waarop ons kulture uitgebeeld en ons ryk erfenis onderskryf is, het landwyd weerklink.
tgt: The vibrant display of our different cultures and sharing of our rich heritage reverberated across our country.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy beste wense aan die volgende oor:.
tgt: Cabinet conveyed its best wishes to the following:.

src: Die Kabinet wens Aartsbiskop Desmond Tutu 'n spoedige herstel toe ná sy operasie.
tgt: Cabinet wishes Archbishop Emeritus Desmond Tutu a speedy recovery from his operation.

src: En dra saam met die res van Suid-Afrika sy goeie wense oor aan Mama Winnie Mandela op haar haar 80ste verjaardag.
tgt: And joins South Africa in wishing Mama Winnie Mandela well on reaching her 80th birthday.

tgt: Ms Kate Molotoi.

src: Me Hlonela Lupuwana (heraanstelling)j. Mnr Lawrence Mavundla (heraanstelling).
tgt: Ms Hlonela Lupuwana (reappointment) andj.

src: Implementering van belangrike Regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of Key Government Programmes.

src: Die Kabinet wens alle studente alles van die beste toe met die voorbereiding van hul finalejaareksamens.
tgt: Cabinet wishes all students well as they embark on their final year examinations.

src: Die Klas van 2016 word aangemoedig om gefokus te bly wanneer hulle die 2016 Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat-eksamen aanpak, wat op 24 Oktober 2016 begin en op 29 November 2016 eindig.
tgt: The Class of 2016 are encouraged to stay focussed as they embark on 2016 National Senior Certificate Examinations which officially starts on 24 October 2016 and ends on 29 November 2016.

src: Die Kabinet herhaal sy beroep op die land om alle pogings om die 2016-akademiese program te red, te ondersteun.
tgt: Cabinet wishes to reiterate its call for the country to support all efforts to save the 2016 academic programme.

src: Die Regering lei hierdie pogings deur die ministeriële taakspan, wat met studente, ouers, universiteite en belanghebbers saamwerk en bewys lewer van ons kollektiewe verbintenis om oplossings te vind om ons hoëronderwyssektor te normaliseer.
tgt: These efforts led by government through the Ministerial Task Team working with students, parents, universities and stakeholders are a demonstration of our collective commitment to find solutions to normalise our higher education sector.

src: Die Kabinet het begrip vir studente se besorgdheid oor die uitdagings waarvoor hulle te staan kom met betrekking tot hoë studiegelde, akkommodasie, handboeke, vervoer en lewenskoste.
tgt: Cabinet shares the sentiments expressed by students with regards to the challenges they face on high costs of tuition fees, accommodation, textbooks, transport and living expenses.

src: Indien hierdie akademiese jaar verlore gaan en die universiteite en kolleges nie vanjaar 'n finale oplossing vind nie, sal bykans 'n miljoen matrikulante in 2017 nie tot hoër onderwys toegelaat word nie.
tgt: If the academic year is lost, the universities and colleges do not reach a finality this year, almost a million matriculants will not be admitted into higher education, in 2017.

src: Die uitkringeffek sal 'n invloed op alle studente vanaf die eerste tot finale jaar hê, en uiteindelik ook op ons ekonomie aangesien geen nuwe geskoolde gegradueerdes die arbeidsmark sal kan betree nie.
tgt: The ripple effect is such that all students from first year to final year would be affected and ultimately our economy as no new skilled graduates will enter the job market.

src: Studente wat as mediese dokters, ingenieurs, rekenmeesters, onderwysers en in verskeie ander beroepe sou gegradueer het, sal dus nie meer in 'n posisie wees om die ekonomie te betree nie.
tgt: Consequently, those who would have graduated as medical doctors, engineers, accountants, teachers and various professions will no longer be in a position to enter the economy.

src: Die Kabinet ondersteun die reg op onderwys soos dit in ons Vryheidshandves en Grondwet vervat is en in die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan geprioritiseer word, ten volle.
tgt: Cabinet fully supports the rights to education that are contained in our Freedom Charter and Constitution, and prioritised in the National Development Plan.

src: Ons ondersteun ook die reg op toegang tot hoër onderwys, veral vir arm mense.
tgt: We further support the right to access higher education, particularly for the poor.

src: Die Vryheidshandves bepaal dat hoër onderwys en tegniese opleiding aan almal beskikbaar gestel moet word deur middel van staatsubsidies en beurse wat op grond van verdienste toegeken word.
tgt: The Freedom Charter says “higher education and technical training shall be opened to all by means of state allowances and scholarships awarded on basis of merit.”The Constitution further states “Everyone has the right to further education which the state through reasonable measures must make progressively available and accessible.”In appreciation of the magnitude of the challenges in higher education, President Jacob Zuma has further broadened the composition of the Ministerial Task Team with the inclusion of Minsters of Communications, Human Settlements, Finance and Social Development.

src: Die Regering het verskeie voorstelle van verskeie belangegroepe en belanghebbers ontvang.
tgt: Government has received several proposals that have been put forward by various constituencies and stakeholders.

src: 'n Tegniese proses is tans aan die gang om hierdie voorstelle te evalueer en sodra die werk afgehandel is, sal opsies om die huidige uitdagings die hoof te bied, voorgelê word.
tgt: A technical process is underway to evaluate them and once work is completed, options will be provided to address the current challenges.

src: Die Regering sal ook stappe doen om hulpbronne trapsgewys beskikbaar te stel aan alle NSFAS-kwalifiserende studente om die volle koste van studie aan universiteite en kolleges vir tegniese en beroepsonderrig en -opleiding (TVET-kolleges) op die lang termyn te dek.
tgt: Government will further take steps to make resources available to all NSFAS qualifying students progressively to cover the full costs of study at universities and TVET colleges over the long term.

src: Die Regering sal ook planne ontwikkel om die uitdagings vir die "vermiste middel"-studente, wat nie ingevolge die huidige NSFAS-reëls kwalifiseer nie maar steeds nie sonder hulp die volle koste van studie kan dra nie, die hoof te bied.
tgt: Government will also develop mechanisms to address the challenges faced by “missing middle” students who don’t qualify under current NFSFAS rules but are unable to afford the full cost of study without some form of assistance.

src: Al hierdie maatreëls sal infaseer word teen 'n tempo en skaal wat afhang van die groeitempo in inskrywings en beskikbare hulpbronne.
tgt: All of these will be phased at a pace and scale that depends on the rate of growth in enrolment and available resources.

src: Die Presidensiële Kommissie van Ondersoek na Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding sit sy werk voort en sal die Regering help om 'n langtermynoplossing vir toegang tot hoër onderwys, veral vir behoeftige studente te vind.
tgt: The Presidential Commission of Inquiry into Higher Education and Training is continuing with its work and will assist government to come up with a long term solution for access to higher education particularly for the poor.

src: Die Minister van Finansies sal op 26 Oktober 2016 die Meiumtermynbegroting-beleidsverklaring ter tafel lê, wat die breë fiskale raamwerk oor die medium termyn uiteen sal sit.
tgt: The Minister of Finance will table the Medium Term Budget Policy Statement on 26 October 2016 that will set out the broad fiscal framework over the medium WEBTOKEN the 2016/17 financial year, government has allocated a tremendous amount of resources to higher education, which saw the Department of Higher Education and Training receiving a budget allocation of R.2 billion.

src: Die Regering het gedurende die 2016/17-finansiële jaar 'n geweldige hoeveelheid hulpbronne aan hoër onderwys toegewys, met die Departement van Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding wat 'n begrotingstoewysing van R49,2 miljard ontvang het.
tgt: Cabinet believes that it is only through our investment in education as a country that we will make meaningful progress in addressing the triple challenges of unemployment, poverty and inequality.

src: Die Kabinet glo dat ons land slegs deur belegging in onderwys betekenisvolle vordering sal maak om die drievoudige uitdagings van werkloosheid, armoede en ongelykheid die hoof te bied.
tgt: Government has responded to the pleas of students and will subsidise the 2017 fee adjustment of up to 8%, to pay the fee increase through a gap-funding grant on behalf of all poor, working class and so called “missing middle” students, i. e. students with a family household income of up to R600 000 per annum.

src: Die Regering het op studente se pleidooie gereageer en sal die aanpassing van studiegelde vir 2017 tot 8% subsidieer om die studiegelde-verhoging te betaal deur middel van 'n gapingbefondsingstoelae namens behoeftige studente, die werkersklas en die sogenaamde "vermiste middel"-studente, dit wil sê studente met 'n gesinsinkomste van tot R600 000 per jaar.
tgt: This means that both NSFAS qualifying students and “missing middle” students will experience a no fee increase, as government will pay the percentage fees adjustment.

src: Hierdie subsidie sal ongeveer R2,5 miljard bedra, wat 70% van alle voorgraadse studente dek.
tgt: This subsidy will amount to about R.5 billion, which covers over 70% of all undergraduate students.

src: Alle belanghebbers moet onmiddellik daaraan begin werk om gunstige omstandighede en 'n bevorderlike klimaat te skep sodat die akademiese program sonder versuim hervat kan word.
tgt: All stakeholders must immediately work towards creating conditions and a conducive climate for the academic programme to resume without delay.

src: Om die progressiewe verwesenliking van die reg op verdere onderwys te verseker, sal die Regering in oorleg met tersaaklike belanghebbers 'n padkaart ontwikkel vir die transformasie van universiteite en TVET-kolleges om geleenthede te skep vir toegang, sukses, finansiering en ondersteuning vir studente en instellings.
tgt: To ensure the progressive realisation of the right to further education, government will develop a roadmap, working with relevant stakeholders, for the transformation of universities and TVET colleges to create opportunities for access, success, financing and support for students and institutions.

src: Verskeie belanghebbers, met inbegrip van ander studente, banke en die sakesektor, het verskillende voorstelle ingedien oor hoe ons hoër onderwys kan finansier, veral vir behoeftige studente.
tgt: Several stakeholders including among others students, banks and business have presented different proposals on how we can finance higher education particularly for the poor.

src: Die Ministeriële Taakspan sal dus al die belanghebbers onder een sambreel byeenbring om 'n padkaart te ontwikkel wat die weg vir 'n oplossing sal baan.
tgt: Therefore, Ministerial Task Team will bring all stakeholders under one roof to develop a roadmap that will pave way for a solution.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die hervatting van klasse in verskeie universiteite, en spoor alle studente aan om terug te keer klas toe.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the resumption of classes in many of our universities, and urges all students to return to class.

src: Dit is tans 'n kritiese tyd vir die akademiese program en die eksamens is om die draai.
tgt: This is a critical period for the academic programme with examinations around the corner.

src: Die Regering glo dat studente se knelpunte deur dialoog aangepak kan word terwyl die akademiese program voortgaan.
tgt: Government believes that the concerns of students can be addressed through dialogue while the academic programme is underway.

src: Die Kabinet is steeds bekommerd oor die uitbreek van gewelddadige protesoptrede op sommige kampusse regoor die land.
tgt: Cabinet remains concerned at the outbreak of violent student protests on some university campuses around the country.

src: Hoewel die reg op protesoptrede ingevolge die Grondwet beskerm word, is daar geen plek vir geweld, intimidasie en die vernietiging van eiendom nie.
tgt: While the right to protest is protected under the Constitution, there is no room for the violence, intimidation and the destruction of property.

src: Alle belanghebbers moet alles in hul vermoë doen en alle nodige stappe te neem om die akademiese program te red, omdat die gevolge van 'n verlore akademiese jaar noodlottig vir die ekonomie, studente en matrikulante sal wees.
tgt: All stakeholders must do everything in their power and take every steps necessary to save the academic programme as the consequences facing are will be dire to the economy, students and matriculants.

src: Onderwys is almal se verantwoordelikheid laat ons dus saamwerk om ter wille van ons kinders en ons land se toekoms normaliteit in hoër onderwys teweeg te bring.
tgt: Education is everyone’s responsibility, let us all work collectively together to bring about normality to higher education for the future of our children and for the future of our country.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die belegging van R3 miljard deur Marriot International waardeur die wêreld se grootste hotelgroep vyf nuwe hotelle gaan oprig.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the R3 billion investment by Marriot International that will see the world’s largest hotel group complete five new hotels.

src: Dié aankondiging is 'n duidelike bewys van die beleggersvertroue in die land en die positiewe toekomsvooruitsigte van die plaaslike ekonomie.
tgt: The announcement demonstrates the investor confidence in the country and positive future prospects of the local economy.

src: Suid-Afrika is deur die Emerging Markets Newspaper, 'n geaffilieerde van die IMF/Wêreldbankjaarvergaderings, aangewys as die beste land vir skuldbestuur en voortreflike effekte-uitreiking in Afrika suid van die Sahara.
tgt: South Africa was named as the best country for debt management and sovereign bond issuance in sub-Saharan Africa by Emerging Markets Newspaper, an affiliate of the IMF/World Bank Annual Meetings.

src: Die toekenning volg op die Wêreldbank se erkenning van ons land se uitnemendheid op die gebied van skuldinamika/samestelling.
tgt: The award comes after the World Bank acknowledged the country’s excellence in debt dynamics/composition.

src: Hierdie eerbetoon is bewys dat die land steeds suksesvol in internasionale kapitaalmarkte is en dat die ekonomie oordeelkundig bestuur word.
tgt: These accolades are a testament to the success the country continues to enjoy in global capital markets and the prudent manner in which the economy is managed.

src: Die eerste Staatsbesoek aan Kenia deur 'n Suid-Afrikaanse staatshoof sedert demokrasie, is onlangs deur President Jacob Zuma onderneem.
tgt: The first Kenyan State Visit by a South African head of state, President Jacob Zuma, since democracy, included a business delegation to the Kenya-South Africa Business Forum, which explored investment and trade opportunities.

src: Die besoek het 'n sake-afvaardiging na die Kenia-Suid-Afrika-Sakeforum ingesluit, wat beleggings- en handelsgeleenthede ondersoek het.
tgt: The following Memorandums of Understanding were signed: police cooperation, biodiversity conservation and management and the Lamu-Port Southern Sudan-Ethiopia Transport Corridor.

src: Die volgende memorandums van verstandhouding is onderteken: polisiesamewerking biodiversiteitsbewaring en -bestuur en die Lamu-Hawe-Suid-Soedan-Etiopië-Vervoerkorridor.
tgt: The Second Session of the Bi-National Commission between the South Africa and the Republic of Namibia underscored our collective commitment with a range of bilateral, regional and international issues being reviewed.

src: Die Meorandum van Verstandhouding oor Hoër Onderwys is gefinaliseer, insluitend die ondertekening van die Opdrag van die Gesamentlike Komitee van Kenners oor die Oranjeriviergrens.
tgt: The Memorandum of Understanding on Higher Education has been finalised, including the signing of the Terms of Reference of the Joint Committee of Experts on the Orange River Boundary.

src: Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa se werksbesoek aan Viëtnam en Singapoer was daarop gerig om toekomstige handels- en beleggingsmoontlikhede te ontsluit en Singapoerse ondernemings in staatsbesit te lok om deur openbare-privaatvennootskappe in Suid-Afrika te belê, ooreenkomstig Suid-Afrika se Negepuntplan.
tgt: Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa’s working visit to Vietnam and Singapore was used to unlock future areas of trade and investment, and to attract Singaporean State Owned Enterprises to invest in South Africa through Public Private Partnerships, in line with South Africa's Nine-Point Plan.

src: Singapoer het hom ook verbind om Suid-Afrika met vaardigheidsontwikkeling by te staan en om die aantal opleidingskursusse vir Suid-Afrikaanse studente wat ingevolge die Singapoer-samewerkingsprogram aangebied word, uit te brei.
tgt: Commitment was also secured for Singapore to assist South Africa with skills development and to increase the number of training courses for South African students offered under the Singapore Co-operation Programme.

src: President Jacob Zuma het die jaarlikse Konferensie van Hoofde van die Suid-Afrikaanse Missies toegespreek, wat 'n platform gebied het om idees oor vraagstukke en prioriteite te deel en die missies beter toe te rus om ons land te verteenwoordig.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma addressed the annual South African Heads of Mission Conference which provided a platform for all our heads of mission to share ideas on issues and priorities which better enables them to continue representing our country.

src: As buitelandse verteenwoordigers is dit hul verantwoordelikheid om vriendskappe en vennootskappe te kweek wat ons sal help om die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan se doelwitte te bereik, naamlik inklusiewe groei, werksgeleenthede en beter lewensomstandighede vir ons mense.
tgt: As our representatives abroad they have a responsibility to build friendships and partnerships that will help us achieve our goals from the National Development Plan, that of inclusive growth, jobs and a decent life for our people.

src: In reaksie op die behoeftes van gemeenskappe en sakeondernemings sal die Minister van Water en Sanitasie, Nomvula Mokonyane, eerskomende Vrydag 21 Oktober 2016 'n sooispitseremonie vir die konstruksie van fase een van die R18-miljard Vaal Gamagara-waterprojek lei.
tgt: In responding to the needs of communities and businesses, Minister of Water and Sanitation Nomvula Mokonyane will turn the sod for the construction of Phase One of the R18 billion Vaal Gamagara Water Project, this Friday, 21 October 2016.

src: Ná voltooiing van fase een sal 14 veeplase, 12 myne, sonkragparke, en die gemeenskappe van Kathu, Olifantshoek en Hotazel voordeel uit die projek trek, wat 'n bevolking van 23 499 mense insluit.
tgt: On completion of Phase One, beneficiaries will include 14 livestock farms, 12 mines, solar parks, and the communities of Kathu, Olifantshoek, and Hotazel, benefitting a population of 23 499.

src: Die bekendstelling van die R49-miljoen eerste fase van die opgeknapte Isithebe Nywerheidspark in Mandeni, KwaZulu-Natal, vorm deel van die Program vir die Herlewing van Nywerheidsparke van die Departement van Handel en Nywerheid, en is as 'n prioriteit vir hernuwing aangewys.
tgt: The launch of the R49-million first phase of the revitalised Isithebe Industrial Park in Mandeni, KwaZulu-Natal, forms part of the Revitalisation of Industrial Parks Programme of the Department of Trade and Industry, and has been prioritised for renewal.

src: Die oogmerk is om nywerheidsparke in staatsbesit regoor die land te vernuwe ten einde industrialisasie te bevorder en hul bydrae tot werkskepping en die land se ekonomiese groei te verhoog.
tgt: The aim is to regenerate state-owned industrial parks across the country in order to promote industrialisation and increase their contribution to job creation and the country’s economic growth.

src: Nywerhede wat vanuit Isithebe werk, lewer 'n betekenisvolle bydrae tot die gebied se ekonomie en voorsien meer as 20 000 werksgeleenthede.
tgt: Industries operating from Isithebe contribute significantly to the economy of the area, providing over 20 000 jobs.

src: Tydens die herlewingsprogram is 15 klein, mikro- en mediumondernemings vir die projek aangestel, wat R6,3 miljoen beloop en 162 mense in diens geneem het.
tgt: During the revitalisation programme 15 small micro medium enterprises were appointed for the project to the value of R.3 million with 162 people employed.

src: Die aankondiging dat Suid-Afrika by 'n nuwe handelsooreenkoms met die Europese Unie (EU) sal baat, beteken dat Suid-Afrikaanse produkte voorkeurmarktoegang tot die EU sal geniet.
tgt: The announcement, that South Africa will benefit from a new trade deal with the European Union (EU), will see improved access for South African products having preferential market access in the EThe Economic Partnership Agreement (EPA) under the SADC-EU EPA framework replaces the trade provisions of the existing bilateral trade agreement between South Africa and the EU, known as the Trade, Development and Cooperation Agreement (TDCA).

src: Die Ekonomiese Vennootskapsooreenkoms (EPA) wat deel is van die SADC-EU EPA-raamwerk, vervang die handelsbepalings van die bestaande bilaterale ooreenkoms tussen Suid-Afrika en die EDit staan bekend as die EU-ooreenkoms vir Handel, Ontwikkeling en Samewerking (TDCA).
tgt: The EPA provides new market access for sugar and ethanol as well as improved market access for wines, flowers, dairy and fruit products.

src: Die EPA bied nuwe marktoegang vir suiker en etanol asook beter marktoegang vir wyn, blomme, suiwel- en vrugteprodukte.
tgt: The Commission for the Conservation of Southern Bluefin Tuna has increased South Africa’s Total Allowable Catch of the Southern Bluefin Tuna allocation from 150 tons to 450 tons for the 2018-2020 fishing seasons.

src: Die Kommissie vir die Bewaring van Suider-Afrikaanse Blouvin-tuna het Suid-Afrika se toewysing vir Totale Toelaatbare Vangs van die Suidelike Blouvin-tuna vir die 2018-2020-visvangseisoen van 150 ton tot 450 ton verhoog.
tgt: This is essential to South Africa’s job creation priorities as it will provide permanent employment in the fisheries sector and will inject much needed export revenue for the country.

src: Die aanstelling van suksesvolle bieërs deur die Departement van Energie vir die eerste Steenkoolgebaseerde Onafhanklike Kragprodusenteprogram (IPP) is 'n sleutelelement van die Regering se inisiatief om die land se energievoorsiening te waarborg.
tgt: The appointment of successful bidders by the Department of Energy for the first Coal-based Independent Power Producer Programme (IPP) is a critical part of government’s initiative to secure the country’s energy supply.

src: Die twee suksesvolle bieërs sal oor die volgende vyf jaar 863.3MW tot die energierooster toevoeg.
tgt: The two successful bidders will add 863.3MW to the energy grid in the next five years.

src: Die aanstelling lok 'n belegging van meer as R40 miljard, wat gebruik sal word om infrastruktuur in die energiesektor te ontsluit, plaaslike verkryging te stimuleer en 6 613 werksgeleenthede gedurende konstruksie en 13 524 deur operasionele werksaamhede te skep.
tgt: The appointment attracts an investment of more than R40 billion which will be used to unlock infrastructure in the energy sector, stimulate local procurement and create 6 613 jobs during construction and 13 524 through operations.

src: Hoewel Suid-Afrika se energiebouplan die ontwikkeling van fossielbrandstofbates insluit, bly die land verbind tot die oorgang na 'n laekoolstofekonomie, met voorkeur van skoonenergie-alternatiewe.
tgt: While South Africa’s energy build plan incorporates the development of fossil fuel assets, the country is committed to the transition of a low-carbon economy, with priority to clean energy alternatives.

src: Deur die Hernubare Energie IPP is 6 376 MW elektrisiteit in ses bie-rondtes van 102 onafhanklike kragprodusente verkry.
tgt: Through the Renewable Energy IPP, 6 376 MW of electricity have been procured from 102 Independent Power Producers in six bid rounds.

src: Hiervan is 2 200 MW elektriese opwekkingskapasietit uit 44 IPP-projekte aan die nasionale rooster verbind.
tgt: Of this, 2 200 MW of electrical generation capacity from 44 IPP projects has been connected to the national grid.

src: As deel van Vervoermaand word 'n aantal sleutelvervoerinfrastruktuurprojekte en -inisiatiewe in werking gestel om mense en plekke beter te verbind, nuwe werksgeleenthede te skep en die manier waarop Suid-Afrikaners reis, te WEBTOKEN dié verband neem die Kabinet kennis van die belegging ten bedrae van R24 miljoen deur die Gauteng Departement van Paaie en Vervoer om die D904-pad, wat ook as die ou Evatonpad bekend staan, te herstel.
tgt: As Transport Month unfolds a number of key transport infrastructure projects and initiatives are being rolled out to better connect people and places, which is creating new jobs and changing the way South Africans WEBTOKEN this regard Cabinet recognises the R24 million investment by the Gauteng Department for Roads and Transport to repair the D904 road, which is also known as the old Evaton Road.

src: Die rehabilitasie van die bestaande pad sal tot korter reistye en beter padveiligheid vir motoriste, fietsryers en voetgangers lei.
tgt: The rehabilitation of the existing road will lead to improved travelling time, and will ensure better road safety for motorists, cyclists and pedestrians.

src: Tydens die Vyfde Afrika-Internetbestuursforum in Durban, is die vasteland se standpunt gefinaliseer, wat die bereiking van Agenda 2063 se doelwitte ondersteun ter voorbereiding vir die Internetbestuursforum wat in Desember 2016 in Mesiko gehou word.
tgt: The successful hosting of the Fifth Africa Internet Governance Forum in Durban saw the meeting finalise the continental position, which supports the attainment of the goals of Agenda 2063, ahead of the Internet Governance Forum to be held in Mexico in December 2016.

src: Suid-Afrika het die Veelparty-ooreenkoms vir Administrateursdiens met die DONA-stigting onderteken.
tgt: South Africa signed the Multi-Party Administrator Service Agreement with the DONA Foundation.

src: Die Regering se tussenkoms om korrupsie en wanpraktyke te bestry en nywerhede aanspreeklik te hou, het gelei tot 'n ooreenkoms met sewe genoteerde konstruksiemaatskappye oor 'n program van inisiatiewe wat transformasie in die bedryf sal versnel.
tgt: The interventions by government to combat corruption, malpractices and hold industries accountable has led to an agreement with seven listed construction companies on a programme of initiatives, which will accelerate transformation in the industry.

src: Die ooreenkoms behels 'n aantal beginsels soos finansiële bydraes vir ontwikkelingsprojekte verbintenisse tot transformasie in die sektor 'n raamwerk om eise deur die openbare sektor by te lê en verbintenisse tot integriteit deur hoof uitvoerende beamptes (HUB’s).Sleutelbeginsels van die ooreenkoms sluit in 'n boete van R1,4 miljard wat deur die mededingingsowerhede opgelê word en wat die maatskappye in die Nasionale Inkomstefonds moet inbetaal.
tgt: The agreement has a number of elements, including: Financial contribution for development projects Transformational commitments in the sector a Framework to settle claims by the public sector and Integrity Commitments by Chief Executive Officers.

src: 'n Verdere R1,5 miljard sal tot 'n fonds bygedra word wat gerig is op maatskaplike beleggingsinisiatiewe om voorheen benadeelde gemeenskappe te ondersteun.
tgt: Key foundations of the agreement include a R1,4 billion fine imposed by the competition authorities which will be paid by the companies into the National Revenue Fund.

src: 'n Verbintenis tot transformasie sal deur al sewe maatskappye gemaak word, hetsy in die vorm van 'n 'billikheidsmodel' ingevolge waarvan minstens 40% van die aandele in die maatskappy aan swart Suid-Afrikaners terugverkoop sal word of 'n 'vennootskapsmodel' waarvolgens 'n maatskappy met tot drie konstruksievennootmaatskappy in swart besit sal saamwerk om hulle te help om omset gelykstaande aan 25% van sy eie omset te genereer.
tgt: A further R1,5 billion will be contributed to a fund to support social investment initiatives targeting previously disadvantaged communities.

src: Die waarde van hierdie verbintenis sal na raming 'n jaarlikse omset van meer as R9 miljard aan die einde van die ooreenkomstydperk bedra.
tgt: A transformation commitment will be introduced by each of the seven companies, which may take the form of either an ‘equity model’, where at least 40% of the shares in the company will be sold to black South Africans or the ‘partner model’ where a company will work with up to three black-owned construction partner companies’ to help them generate turnover equal to 25% of its own turnover.

src: 'n Verbintenis tot integriteit sal deur elke HUB onderteken word waarin hulle hul verbind tot 'n verskeidenheid stappe om te verseker dat geen samespanning of korrupte praktyke in die maatskappy in sy omgang met mededingers, die Regering of ander privaatsektorkliënte voorkom nie.
tgt: An integrity commitment will be signed by each CEO that commits to wide-ranging steps to ensure no collusive or corrupt practices in the company, in its dealings with competitors, government or other private sector clients.

src: Die skikkingsooreenkoms maak voorsiening vir die finalisering van bepaalde formele prosesse binne die volgende paar weke.
tgt: The settlement agreement provides for certain formal processes to be finalised within the next few weeks and these are being processed and attended to and an announcement will be made on conclusion of these processes.

src: Suid-Afrikaners word aangemoedig om kennis te neem van die inligting wat deur die 2015/16 Jaarverslae in die Parlement bekend gemaak word.
tgt: South Africans are encouraged to engage with the information being shared through the 2015/16 Annual Report presentations to Parliament.

src: Die inligting lewer bewys dat die Regering se aksieplan uitgevoer word, asook dat vordering gemaak word met die Meiumtermyn- Strategiese Raamwerk en die uitvoer van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan.
tgt: The information demonstrates implementation of Governments Programme of Action, as well as progress on the Medium Term Strategic Framework and implementation of the National Development Plan.

src: Die Kabinet moedig Suid-Afrikaners ook aan om hul menings te deel oor die ekonomie en ander kwessies waarop hulle wil hê die Regering moet fokus in die komende Meiumtermynbegroting-beleidsverklaring (MTPBS), wat op 26 Oktober 2016 deur die Minister van Finansies, Pravin Gordhan, voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet also encourages South Africans to share their views on the economy and other issues they would like government to highlight in the upcoming Medium Term Budget Policy Statement (MTPBS), to be presented by Finance Minister Pravin Gordhan on 26 October 2016.

src: Bydraes kan gestuur word na Facebook: National Treasury South Africa Twitter @TreasuryRSA deur mondelinge voorleggings en op die webtuiste van die Nasionale Tesourie.
tgt: Contributions can be sent through Facebook: National Treasury South Africa, Twitter @TreasuryRSA, oral representations and the National Treasury website.

src: Sleutelkabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.

src: Dit is in ooreenstemming met die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan en bevat die volgende strategiese vervoerdryfkragte: langtermynbeplanning en -prioritisering, fokus op veiligheid, betroubaarheid en bekostigbaarheid van vervoer om verder te kyk as net vervoer aangesien die meeste ondoeltreffendhede en probleme die gevolg van swak grondgebruik en beplanning is die bevordering van gedragsveranderings deur die persepsie van openbare vervoer te verander en 'n ontwikkelings- en maatskaplik inklusiewe beplanningsbenadering.
tgt: Cabinet approved the broad principles of the National Transport Master Plan 2050 (NATMAP) Synopsis Update Report, which is aligned to the National Development Plan and has the following strategic transport thrusts: long term planning and prioritisation, focusing on safety, reliability and affordability of transport looking beyond transport as most inefficiencies and ills are the result of poor land use and planning promoting behavioural change by changing the perception of public transport and a developmental and socially inclusive planning approach.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die voorlegging van die hersiene Internasionale Telekommunikasieregulasies (ITR’s) Dubai 2012 aan die Parlement vir bekragtiging.
tgt: Cabinet approved submission of the revised International Telecommunication Regulations (ITRs), Dubai 2012, to Parliament for ratification.

src: Die ITR’s is 'n internasionale verdrag en vorm deel van die Administratiewe Regulasies van die Internasionale Telekommunikasie-Unie.
tgt: The ITRs constitute an international treaty, and forms part of the Administrative Regulations of the International Telecommunications Union.

src: Die ITR's is in ooreenstemming met die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan, in die besonder die bevordering van ekonomiese groei en groter inklusiwiteit deur die ontwikkeling van 'n sterker breëband- en telekommunikasienetwerk en laer pryse.
tgt: The ITRs are aligned to the National Development Plan, in particular the promotion of economic growth and greater inclusion through the development of a stronger broadband and telecommunications network and lower prices.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die voorlegging van die Wêreldradiokommunikasie-konferensie (WRC-15) se Final Acts aan die Parlement vir bekragtiging, ooreenkomstig artikel 231(2) van die Grondwet.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the World Radio Communication Conference (WRC-15) Final Acts, to Parliament for ratification, in line with Section 231(2) of the Constitution.

src: Sleutelkwessies wat by die WRC-15 aanvaar is, sluit in ontplooiing van universele breëband en universele uitsending, satellietkommunikasiedienste, lugvaart- en maritieme dienste en die oseane-ekonomieprogramme, rampverligtings- en nooddienste, asook toekomstige programme om ekonomiese transformasie te ondersteun.
tgt: Key issues adopted at the WRC-15 include universal broadband roll-out, universal broadcasting roll-out, satellite communication services, aircraft services, maritime and the ocean economy programmes, disaster relief and emergency services, as well as future programmes to support economic transformation.

src: WRC-15-uitkomste bied ook sekerheid aan die uitsaaidiens deur die beskerming van die spektrum vir digitale terrestriële televisie.
tgt: WRC-15 outcomes also provides certainty to broadcasting service by protecting Digital Terrestrial Television (DTT) spectrum.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die indiening van die Final Acts van die Internasionale Telekommuniksie Unie (ITU) se Gevolmagtigde Konferensie van Guadalajara 2010 by die Parlement vir bekragtiging ingevolge Artikel 231(2) van die Grondwet.
tgt: Cabinet approved submission of the Final Acts of the International Telecommunications Union (ITU) Plenipotentiary Conference of Guadalajara 2010, to Parliament for ratification in terms of Section 231(2) of the Constitution.

src: Die Gevolmagtigde Konferensie is die hoogste besluitnemingsliggaam van die ITU, wat 'n gespesialiseerde agentskap van die Verenigde Nasies is en vir die internasionale stelsel van elektroniese kommunikasie verantwoordelik is.
tgt: The Plenipotentiary Conference is the top policy-making body of the ITU, which is a specialised agency of the United Nations responsible for managing the global system of electronic communications.

src: Die werk van die ITU is met die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan belyn, aangesien dit sterk op die ontwikkeling van Ekonomiese Infrastruktuur in die IKT-sektor fokus.
tgt: The work of the ITU is aligned to the National Development Plan, as it is strongly focused on the development of Economic Infrastructure in the ICT sector.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die vordering met die instelling en uitvoer van die Breëband-strategiekomitee (Broadband War Room).
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the progress made on the establishment and implementation of the Broadband War Room.

src: Die Kabinet-lekgotla van 2016 het besluit dat die Breëband-strategiekomitee ingestel moet word om die uitvoer van SA Connect, die nasionale breëbandbeleid, te WEBTOKEN deel van die strategiekomitee se opdrag is verskeie sleutelkwessies geïdentifiseer wat 'n direkte uitwerking op die suksesvolle ontplooiing van bekostigbare, vinnige, betroubare en veilige internet sal hê.
tgt: The August 2016 Cabinet Lekgotla resolved that the Broadband War Room must be established to expedite the implementation of SA Connect, the national broadband WEBTOKEN part of the Terms of Reference of the war room, several critical issues were identified that have a direct impact on the successful rollout of affordable, fast, reliable and secure internet.

src: Dit sluit in die uitskakeling van vertragings met die toewysing van hoëvraagspektrum breëbandkonnektiwiteit ontplooiing en befondsing aandag aan ondoeltreffende markstrukture bespoediging van oorgang na digitale uitsendings ontwikkeling van ’n e-regeringstrategie rasionalisering van IKT-entiteite in staatsbesit die voorsiening van die nodige kapasiteit aan die Reguleerder en die uitskakeling van duplisering in beheer van die IKT-sektor.
tgt: These include addressing the delays in the allocation of high demand spectrum broadband connectivity rollout and funding addressing ineffective market structures fast-tracking digital broadcasting migration development of e-government strategy rationalisation of ICT State-Owned Entities and capacitating the Regulator and addressing duplicity in governance of the ICT sector.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring dat die Parys-ooreenkoms oor Klimaatsverandering aan die Parlement voorgelê word vir bekragtiging.
tgt: Cabinet approved that the Paris Agreement on Climate Change be submitted to Parliament for ratification.

src: Die Parys-ooreenkoms is 'n regsinstrument wat die proses vir universele aksie oor klimaatsverandering verder sal rig.
tgt: The Paris Agreement is a legal instrument that will further guide the process for universal action on climate change.

src: Dit verbind alle lande tot 'n gemeenskaplike doelwit om kollektief saam te werk teen die bedreiging van klimaatsverandering in die konteks van volhoubare ontwikkeling en pogings om armoede uit te wis. Dit stel die doelwit om die styging in gemiddelde aardtemperatuur tot ver onder 2 grade Celsius te beperk.
tgt: It brings all nations into a common cause of acting collectively to the threat of climate change, in the context of sustainable development and efforts to eradicate poverty.

src: Die Parys-ooreenkoms sal op 4 November 2016 van krag word, dertig dae ná die datum waarop minstens 55 partye by die Konvensie wat altesaam vir minstens 55% van die totale wêreldwye kweekhuisgasvrystellings verantwoordelik is, hul dokumente vir bekragtiging ingedien het.
tgt: It sets the goal of holding the increase in global average temperature to well below 2 degrees Celsius.

src: Suid-Afrika se bekragtiging van die Parys-ooreenkoms stuur 'n positiewe boodskap uit oor ons voortgesette verbintenis om by te dra tot die internasionale poging om die uitdaging van klimaatsverandering die hoof te bied.
tgt: The Paris Agreement will enter into force on 4 November 2016, thirty days after the date on which at least 55 Parties to the Convention accounting in total for at least 55 % of the total global greenhouse gas emissions have deposited their instruments of ratification.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die Konsep Nasionale Beleid oor Voorligting- en Advesdienste en sy implementeringsplan.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Draft National Policy on Extension and Advisory Services and its implementation Plan.

src: Die beleid is daarop gerig om 'n regulerende raamwerk te vestig om die doeltreffendheid, produktiwiteit, billikheid, omgewings- en ekonomiese volhoubaarheid van die landbou-, bosbou en visseryesektor te verbeter.
tgt: The Policy aims to set a regulatory framework to enhance the efficiency, productivity, equity, environmental and economic sustainability of the agriculture, forestry and fisheries sectors.

src: Dit sal toesien dat alle sektore in die landbou-, bosbou- en visseryewaardekettings (van produsente tot verwerkers) geleenthede vir die bevordering van hul ondernemings en lewensonderhoud kan verken.
tgt: This will ensure that all sectors in the agriculture, forestry and fisheries value chains (from producers to processors) are able to explore opportunities for the advancement of their enterprises and livelihoods.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die finale konsep van die verfynde Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk (MTSF) 2014-2019 vir Uitkoms 2, naamlik ’n Lang en Gesonde Lewe vir alle Suid-Afrikaners.
tgt: Cabinet approved the final draft of the refined Medium Term Strategic Framework (MTSF) 2014-2019 for Outcome 2 “A long and Healthy Life for All South Africans”.

src: Dit dien as bousteen vir die uitvoer van Hoofstuk 10 van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan 2030.Die MTSF 2014-2019 is verfyn om die nuutste getuienis van die gesondheidsektor se werklike prestasie teen die mikpunte in die MTSF 2014-2019 in te sluit, asook die aanvaarding van die Doelwitte vir Volhoubare Ontwikkeling 2030 deur Suid-Afrika en om prosesaanwysers te verminder.
tgt: This serves as the building block to implement Chapter 10 of the National Development Plan 2030.The MTSF 2014-2019 was refined to incorporate latest evidence of the health sectors actual performance against the targets in the MTSF 2014-2019 adoption of the Sustainable Development Goals 2030 by South Arica, and to reduce process indicators.

src: Ná goedkeuring deur die Kabinet sal die Minister in Die Presidensie verantwoordelik vir Beplanning, Monitering en Evaluering, Jeff Radebe, die bevinding van die 2015 Bestuur van Prestasie-assesseringshulpmiddel (MPAT) vrystel.
tgt: Following Cabinet approval, the Minister in the Presidency responsible for Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation Jeff Radebe will release the findings of the 2015 Management Performance Assessment Tool (MPAT).

src: Die verslag voorsien gekonsolideerde leer van die MPAT-assesserings asook gevallestudie-ontledings vanaf 2011 tot 2015.Die MPAT is in werking gestel om hervormings in bestuurspraktyke in staatsdepartemente te vergemaklik.
tgt: The report provides consolidated learning of the MPAT assessments and case studies analysis from 2011 until 2015.MPAT has been implemented to facilitate reforms in managerial practices in government departments.

src: Dit dra by tot die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan, wat verklaar dat Suid-Afrika tussen nou en 2030 'n staat moet vestig wat meer bekwaam, meer professioneel en meer responsief teenoor die behoeftes van sy burgers is.
tgt: This contributes to the National Development Plan which states that between now and 2030 South Africa needs to have established a state that is more capable, more professional and more responsive to the needs of its citizens.

src: Die 2015-resultate toon dat die MPAT daarin geslaag het om inkrementele verbeterings in bestuurspraktyke te bewerkstellig dit het egter oor nasionale departemente en provinsies gewissel.
tgt: The 2015 results show that MPAT has succeeded in facilitating incremental improvements in management practices however, it varies across national departments and provinces.

src: Daar is eilande van uitnemendheid met betrekking tot bestuurspraktyke in die Regering, maar swak bestuursleierskapspraktyke bly 'n groot uitdaging en dra by tot administratiewe mislukkings.
tgt: There are pockets of excellence with regard to management practices throughout government but weak managerial leadership practices remain a major challenge and contribute to administrative failures.

src: Die Kabinet ondersteun 'n meer geïntegreerde en holistiese benadering ter ondersteuning van verbeterings, wat deur die Departement van Beplanning, Monitering en Evaluering gelei sal word.
tgt: Cabinet supports a more integrated and holistic approach to support improvements, which will be led by the Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation.

src: Wetsontwerpe.
tgt: Bills.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wetsontwerp op die Voorkoming en Bestryding van Haatmisdade en Haatspraak vrygestel word vir openbare kommentaar.
tgt: Cabinet approved that the Prevention and Combating of Hate Crimes and Hate Speech Bill be published for public comment.

src: Die Wetsontwerp is daarop gerig om haatmisdade en haatspraak as oortredings te klassifiseer en maatreëls te in te stel om hierdie oortredings te voorkom en te bestry.
tgt: The Bill seeks to create the offences of hate crimes and hate speech and to put in place measures to prevent and combat these offences.

src: Dit het ten doel om die toenemende aantal rassevoorvalle te verminder, asook ander tipes misdadige gedrag wat deur vooroordeel, partydigheid of onverdraagsaamheid aangevuur word, in die vorm van haatmisdade en haatspraak, wat in die onlangse verlede voorgekom het.
tgt: The aim is to address the increasing number of racial incidents and to further address other types of criminal conduct motivated by bias, prejudice or intolerance, in the form of hate crimes and hate speech, which have occurred in the recent past.

src: Dit is in ooreenstemming met die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan wat die klem plaas op die behoefte aan volgehoue veldtogte teen rassisme, seksisme, homofobie en xenofobie en om te verseker dat alle mense veilig voel en is.
tgt: This is aligned to the National Development Plan which highlights the need for sustained campaigns against racism, sexism, homophobia and xenophobia and that all people are and feel safe.

src: Komende gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Borskankerbewustheidsmaand in Oktober verteenwoordig 'n nasionale poging deur die openbare en privaat gesondheidsdienste om bewustheid van die siekte te verhoog.
tgt: Breast Cancer Awareness Month in October, represents a national effort by public and private health care to raise awareness of the disease.

src: Vroeë opsporing van die toestand kan tot doeltreffende behandeling lei.
tgt: Early detection of the condition can lead to effective treatment.

src: Alle mans en vroue moet gereeld bors-selfondersoeke doen en ook kliniese ondersoeke by hul naaste gesondheidsorgfasiliteit ondergaan.
tgt: All women and men should conduct regular self-examination and undergo screening through their nearest health care facility.

src: Die Departement van Gesondheid sal vanaf 31 Oktober tot 3 November 2016 die 40ste Wêreldhospitaalkongres van die Internasionale Hospitaalfederasie (IHF) In Durban aanbied onder die tema ‘Hantering van die Uitgaing van Pasiëntgesentreerde Sorg en Veiligheid’.Die Kongres bied 'n unieke internasionale forum wat multidissiplinêre uitruiling van kennis, kundigheid en ervaring in gesondheidsektorbestuur en -dienslewering vergemaklik.
tgt: The Department of Health will host the 40th World Hospital Congress of the International Hospital Federation (IHF) under the theme, "Addressing the Challenge of Patient - centered Care and Safety”, in Durban from 31 October to 3 November 2016.The Congress provides a unique global forum which facilitates multidisciplinary exchange of knowledge, expertise and experiences in health sector management and service delivery.

src: Die Kabinet se standpunt oor belangrike kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on key issues in the environment.

src: Die Kabinet bevestig sy steun vir die Minister van Finansies, Pravin Gordhan, wat ingevolge artikel 35 van die Grondwet onskuldig is totdat die teendeel deur 'n geregshof bewys word.
tgt: Cabinet has affirmed its support for Finance Minister, Pravin Gordhan who under Section 35 of the Constitution is innocent until proven otherwise by a court of law.

src: Die Kabinet het steeds vertroue in die land se strafregtelike stelsel en die regverdige en billike regsprosesse wat ons demokratiese era kenmerk.
tgt: Cabinet remains confident in the country’s criminal justice system and the fair and just judicial processes which have defined our democratic era.

src: Hierdie prosesse moet toegelaat word om hul loop te neem.
tgt: These processes must be allowed to take their course.

src: Die uitkomste van die 8ste BRICS-beraad, wat vanaf 15 tot 16 Oktober 2016 in Goa, Indië, gehou is met die tema ‘Bou Deelnemende, Inklusiewe en Kollektiewe Oplossings (BRICS)’, het aan BRICS-leiers die geleentheid gebied om interaktiewe tafelronde-besprekings te hou oor die versterking van intra-BRICS-samewerking.
tgt: The outcomes from the 8th BRICS Summit, which was held from 15 to 16 October 2016 under the theme “Building Responsive, Inclusive and Collective Solutions (BRICS)” in Goa, India, saw BRICS leaders hold interactive roundtable discussions on strengthening intra-BRICS cooperation and reflecting on global issues such as international conflicts, the fight against terrorism, and reform of the global system of governance, notably the democratisation of the United Nations and the Bretton Woods Institutions.

src: Hulle het ook besin oor globale kwessies soos internasionale konflik, die stryd teen terrorisme en die hervorming van die globale beheer-en-bestuurstelsel, in die besonder die demokratisering van die Verenigde Nasies en die Bretton Woods-instellings.
tgt: The adoption of the Goa Declaration and Action Plan, highlighted the strong foundation that BRICS has made in terms of establishing institutional mechanisms for tangible cooperation.

src: Die aanvaarding van die Goa-verklaring en die gepaardgaande plan van aksie beklemtoon die stewige fondament wat BRICS gelê het met betrekking tot die vestiging van institusionele meganismes vir tasbare samewerking.
tgt: The possibility of setting up an independent BRICS Rating Agency based on market-oriented principles, in order to further strengthen the global governance architecture, was also welcomed.

src: Die moontlike instelling van 'n onafhanklike BRICS-graderingsagentskap wat op markgerigte beginsels gegrond is om die globale beheerstruktuur te versterk, is ook verwelkom.
tgt: During the visit to Goa, the Cipla Pharmaceuticals Company and the Dube Industrial Development authorities signed an agreement to establish a bio-logics facility.

src: Tydens die besoek aan Goa het die Cipla farmaseutiese maatskappy en die Dube nywerheidsontwikkelingsowerhede 'n ooreenkoms onderteken vir die vestiging van 'n bio-logiese fasiliteit.
tgt: This R.3 billion investment will result in the first plant on the African continent, producing affordable anti-cancer drugs based on bio-technology processes.

src: Die Kabinet bring hulde aan die mense van Mosambiek vir hul eensgesindheid en opofferings tydens ons vryheidstryd.
tgt: Cabinet pays tribute to the people of Mozambique for their solidarity and sacrifice in our struggle for freedom.

src: Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa en die Minister van Kuns en Kultuur, Nathi Mthethwa, het die 30ste gedenkdiens van wyle Samora Machel bygewoon.
tgt: Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa and the Minister of Arts and Culture, Nathi Mthethwa, attended the commemoration of the 30th anniversary service of the late Samora Machel, the founding father and President of Mozambique, who died under suspicious circumstances in Mbuzini.

src: Hy is die grondlegger en eertydse President van Mosambiek, wat onder verdagte omstandighede in Mbuzini gesterf het.
tgt: In honouring the memory of great African leaders like Samora Machel, Julius Nyerere, Oliver Tambo and Nelson Mandela, we remember that leadership to them meant dedicated service to Africa to advance the interests of the people of Africa.

src: Ons bou voort op ons gemeenskaplike geskiedenis en geniet sterk diplomatieke en ekonomiese verhoudings om ekonomiese groei te bevorder, werksgeleenthede te skep en ongelykheid te verminder.
tgt: We are building on our common history and enjoy strong diplomatic and economic relations to boost economic growth, create employment and reduce inequality.

src: Die instelling van die Maputo-ontwikkelingskorridor, wat die hawe van Maputo met ons land se nywerheidskern verbind, is 'n belangrike deel van ons pogings om handel en belegging te bevorder en streeksintegrasie te bewerkstellig.
tgt: The creation of the Maputo Development Corridor, which links the port of Maputo with our country’s industrial heartland, is a vital part of our effort to promote trade and investment and foster regional integration.

src: Die Kabinet wens Advkaat Busisiwe Joyce Mkhwebane geluk met haar aanstelling as Openbare Beskermer van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika vir 'n tydperk van sewe jaar, met ingang van 15 Oktober 2016.
tgt: Cabinet extends its good wishes to Advocate Busisiwe Joyce Mkhwebane on her appointment as Public Protector of the Republic of South Africa for a period of seven years with effect from 15 October 2016.

src: Die Kabinet vertrou dat Advkaat Mkhwebane die nasie goed sal dien en sal voortgaan om in alle Suid-Afrikaners se belang op te tree.
tgt: Cabinet is confident that Advocate Mkhwebane will serve the nation well and will continue to act in the best interest of all South Africans.

src: Die Kabinet bedank Advkaat Thuli Madonsela vir haar diens aan die land en haar bydrae om 'n sterk bewustheid van die Kantoor van die Openbare Beskermer onder Suid-Afrikaners te vestig.
tgt: Cabinet expresses its gratitude to Advocate Thuli Madonsela for serving the country and placing the office of the Public Protector uppermost in the minds of citizens.

src: Die Kabinet herdenk Meiavryheidsdag, bekend as "Swart Woensdag", saam met Suid-Afrika se media en loof die mediabedryf vir die rol wat dit gespeel het om die land se demokrasie te versterk.
tgt: Cabinet joins South Africa's media in commemorating the anniversary of Media Freedom Day known as "Black Wednesday" and commends the media industry for the role they have played in strengthening the country's democracy.

src: Op 19 Oktober 1977 het die apartheidsregime die The World en Weekend World beveel om hul publikasies te staak, wat massa-aanhoudings en die verbanning van joernaliste tot gevolg gehad het.
tgt: On 19 October 1977, the apartheid regime ordered The World and Weekend World to cease publication and sparked the mass detention and banning of journalists.

src: Ons demokratiese grondwet beskerm uitdruklik die mediavryheid waarvoor ons hard geveg het en wat 'n kritieke rol in die bevordering van nasionale eenheid en gelykheid vir almal speel.
tgt: Our democratic Constitution explicitly protects our hard fought media freedoms that are recognised as playing a critical role in the advancement of national unity and equality for WEBTOKEN we reflect on the progress South Africa has made in entrenching media freedom, Cabinet congratulates SANEF on its 20th anniversary which will be celebrated next week.

src: Terwyl ons besin oor die vordering wat Suid-Afrika gemaak het om mediavryheid te verskans, wens die Kabinet SANEF geluk met sy 20ste herdenking, wat volgende week gevier word.
tgt: Cabinet extends the hand of solidarity to the people of Nigeria and to the families of the girls who remain in captivity, following the news that 21 of the 2019 schoolgirls kidnapped by Boko Haram militants have been freed.

src: In reaksie op die nuus dat 21 van die 2019 skoolmeisies wat deur Boko Haram-soldate gevange geneem is, vrygelaat is, reik die Kabinet 'n hand van eensgesindheid uit na die mense van Nigerië en die families van die meisies wat steeds in aanhouding bly.
tgt: Cabinet calls on the international community to renew its efforts in assisting the Nigerian authorities to secure the girls' release in particular for all African countries and the African Union to lend support to assisting Nigeria in finding the missing children.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op die internasionale gemeenskap om hernude pogings aan te wend om die meisies se vrylating te bewerkstellig, en versoek veral alle Afrika-lande en die Afrika-unie om Nigerië te help en te ondersteun om die vermiste kinders op te spoor.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Jacob Zuma in extending condolences to the Government and people of the Republic of Haiti and other nations in the Caribbean following destructive Hurricane Matthew that claimed the lives of hundreds of people and destroyed infrastructure.

src: Die Kabinet dra saam met President Jacob Zuma sy meegevoel oor aan die Regering en mense van die Republiek van Haiti en ander lande in die Karibiese See nadat die vernietigende Orkaan Matthew honderde menselewens geëis en infrastruktuur vernietig het.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Zuma in extending condolences to the government and people of the Kingdom of Thailand following the passing of King Bhumibol Adulyadej.

src: Die Kabinet dra ook saam met President Zuma sy meegevoel oor aan die Regering en mense van die Koninkryk van Thailand ná die afsterwe van Koning Bhumibol Adulyadej.
tgt: Cabinet also sends condolences to the family and friends of struggle icon Mewa Ramgobin.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy meegevoel oor aan die familie en vriende van die vryheidstryd-ikoon Mea Ramgobin.
tgt: He founded the South African Committee for the release of Political Prisoners, and was among the first supporters of the Release Mandela campaign.

src: Hy het die Suid-Afrikaanse Komitee vir die Vrylating van Politieke Gevangenes gestig, en was een van die eerste ondersteuners van die Release Mandela-veldtog.
tgt: Mewa Ramgobin was also the former President of the Natal Indian Congress and Chairperson of Phoenix Settlement Trust, founded by Mahatma Gandhi in 1904.

src: Mea Ramgobin was ook die voormalige president van die Natal Indiese Kongres en Voorsitter van die Phoenix Settlement Trust, wat in 1904 deur Mahatma Gandhi in die lewe geroep is.
tgt: Cabinet has noted that President Jacob Zuma has received and accepted the resignation of Mr Krish Naidoo and Mr Vusi Mavuso as members of the Board of the South African Broadcasting Corporation (SABC).The Portfolio Committee on Communications has initiated steps to begin its inquiry into the Board of the SABC, with regard to its fitness to hold office, in terms of section 15A of the Broadcasting Act of 1999.Cabinet congratulated the following:.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis dat President Jacob Zuma die bedanking van mnrKrish Naidoo en mnrVusi Mavuso as lede van die Direksie van die Suid-Afrikaanse Uitsaaikorporasie (SABC) ontvang en aanvaar het.
tgt: South Africa’s Ambassador to Vienna Tebogo Seokolo on his appointment as Chair of the Board of Governors of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA).

src: Die Portefeuljekomitee oor Kommunikasie het stappe ingestel om sy ondersoek na die Direksie van die SABC te begin oor die geskiktheid van die direksielede om hul amp te beklee ingevolge artikel 15A van die Wet op die Uitsaaiwese van 1999.Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense aan die volgende oor:.
tgt: The Board of Governors is the major policy-making organ of the IAEParks Tau on his election as the President of the United Cities and Local Government (UCLG) organisation, an umbrella body for Local Government in the World, on 15 October 2016, in Colombia.

src: Suid-Afrika se Ambassadeur in Wene, Tebogo Seokolo, met sy aanstelling as Voorsitter van die Beheerraad van die Internasionale Atoomenergie-agentskap (IAEA).
tgt: Antonio Guterres, on his election to the position of United Nations (UN) Secretary-General from 1 January 2017 to 31 December 2021.

src: Die Beheerraad is die vernaamste beleidmakende orgaan van die IAEParks Tau met sy verkiesing as die President van die United Cities and Local Government (UCLG), 'n oorkoepelende liggaam vir plaaslike regering in die wêreld, op 15 Oktober 2016, in Kolombië.
tgt: He brings a wealth of experience having served as Prime Minister of Portugal from 1995 to 2002 and as the UN High Commissioner for Refugees from June 2005 to December 2015.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse joernaliste wat tydens die CNN MultiChoice Afrika-Joernalistoekennings erkenning vir hul werk ontvang het.
tgt: The South African journalists, who claimed recognition at the CNN MultiChoice African Journalist Awards.

src: Ancillar Mangena van Forbes Africa het die Maggie Eales Wales Young Journalist Award gewen.
tgt: Ancillar Mangena of Forbes Africa won the Maggie Eales Wales Young Journalist Award.

src: Jay Caboz, ook van Forbes Africa, het die Energy & Infrastructure Award gewen en die Economic and Business Award gesamentlik gewen is deur Diana Neille, Richard Poplak, Shaun Swingler en Sumeya Gasa van die Daily Maverick Chronicle.
tgt: Jay Caboz, also from Forbes Africa, won the Energy & Infrastructure Award, while the Economic and Business Award was jointly won by Diana Neille, Richard Poplak, Shaun Swingler and Sumeya Gasa of the Daily Maverick Chronicle.

src: Die Mail & Guardian se Mia Malan was die wenner in die Features Award kategorie, en die Sunday Times se fotograaf James Oatway die Mohammed Amin Photography Award ingepalm het.
tgt: Mail & Guardian’s Mia Malan won the Features Award Category, while Sunday Times photographer James Oatway won the Mohammed Amin Photography Award.

src: Mamelodi Sundowns met hul oorwinning van 3-0 teen die Egiptiese span, Zamalek, tydens die eerste been van die Afrika-kampioeneliga.
tgt: Mamelodi Sundowns for their 3-0 win against the Egyptian team, Zamalek, which was the first leg of the African Championship League Final.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om saam te staan en Sundowns te ondersteun om die ster huis toe te bring.
tgt: Cabinet calls on South Africans to unite and support Sundowns to bring home the star.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die betrokke klarings.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: MnrSiphamandla Kenneth Mthethwa as Hoof Uitvoerende Beampte van Sentech.
tgt: Mr Siphamandla Kenneth Mthethwa as the Chief Financial Officer of Sentech.

src: Implementering van belangrike Regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of Key Government Programmes.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Minister van Finansies, Pravin Gordhan, en die span by die Nasionale Tesourie geluk met die gebalanseerde en weldeurdagte begroting.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates Finance Minister Pravin Gordhan and the team at National Treasury for delivering a balanced and well thought-out budget.

src: Die Meiumtermyn-begrotingbeleidsverklaring (MTBBV) bied 'n geleentheid aan die burgerlike samelewing, sowel as die arbeid- en die sakesektor om met die Regering saam te werk om ons land se ekonomiese doelwitte te bereik.
tgt: The Medium Term Budget Policy Statement (MTBPS) provides an opportunity for civil society, labour and business to work together with government to achieve the economic objectives of our country.

src: Die Kabinet steun die inisiatiewe wat in die MTBBV aangekondig is om die ekonomie deur hierdie moeilike ekonomiese tye te lei, inklusiewe ekonomiese groei te bereik en staatshulpbronne doeltreffend te gebruik.
tgt: Cabinet supports the initiatives announced in the MTBPS to guide the economy through these difficult economic times, achieve inclusive economic growth and efficiently use state resources.

src: Die Kabinet bedank die meer as 4,5 miljoen belastingbetalers wat hul belastingopgawes gedurende die 2016-belastingseisoen ingedien het en herinner alle nie-voorlopige belastingbetalers wat nog hul belastingopgawes moet indien om dit so gou moontlik te doen, aangesien die sperdatum van 25 November 2016 vinnig nader kom.
tgt: Cabinet thanks the more than 4, 5 million taxpayers who submitted their tax returns during the 2016 Tax Season and reminds all non-provisional taxpayers who still have to submit a tax return to do so as the deadline for submission on 25 November 2016 is fast approaching.

src: Patriotiese belastingbetalers help om die lewens van miljoene Suid-Afrikaners te verbeter deur in vennootskap met die Regering te werk in die uitvoer van broodnodige dienste en maatskaplike ondersteuning oor gemeenskappe heen.
tgt: Patriotic taxpayers are helping to improve the lives of millions of South Africans by partnering with government as it rolls out much needed services and social support across the communities.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om betrokke te raak by ons inisiatiewe om die ekonomie te ontwikkel deur nuwe werksgeleenthede te skep en 'n spaarkultuur te vestig.
tgt: Cabinet calls on South Africans to join our efforts in growing the economy by creating new jobs, and adopting a culture of saving.
