src: Deur saam te werk, kan ons seker maak dat ons ekonomiese groei 'n hupstoot kry.
tgt: Working together we can ensure that we boost economic growth.

src: Die Kabinet ondersteun die oproepe om 'n vinnige en doeltreffende ondersoek na die beweerde gyselaarsituasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Inkomstediens.
tgt: Cabinet supports calls for a quick and effective investigation into the alleged hostage situation at the South African Revenue Service.

src: Sulke tipe voorvalle het 'n negatiewe uitwerking op die publiek se vertroue in ons wetstoepassingsowerhede en moet spoedig hanteer word.
tgt: Incidents such as these have a negative impact on public confidence in our law enforcement authorities and need to be quickly addressed.

src: Die befondsing van hoër onderwys bly 'n prioriteit vir die Regering en die bykomende R17 miljard wat oor die volgende drie jaar aan universiteite toegewys is, sal verder help om die las op finansieel behoeftige, arm en die sogenaamde ‘vermiste middel’-studente te verlig.
tgt: Funding higher education remains a priority for government and the additional R17 billion allocated to universities over the next three years will help to further ease the burden on financially needy poor and missing middle students.

src: Hierdie befondsing sal ook verseker dat meer studente toegang tot hoër onderwys verkry, aangesien R9,2 miljard daarvan aan NSFAS toegewys sal word.
tgt: This funding will also ensure that more students are able to access higher education as R.2 billion of this funding will be allocated to NSFAS.

src: Dié befondsing word verwelkom, maar die onmiddellike prioriteit is egter nou om die leerproses te hervat.
tgt: This funding is welcomed, however the immediate priority now is to resume learning.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om alle pogings om die 2016-akademiese program te red, te steun.
tgt: Cabinet calls on South Africans to support all efforts to save the 2016 academic programme.

src: Dit is nou die tyd om protesoptrede te staak, terug te keer klas toe en die akademiese jaar sonder verdere vertragings te voltooi.
tgt: Now is the time to end all protests, return to class and complete the academic year without further delays.

src: Die Regering glo dat dialoog om aandag aan studente se eise te gee kan plaasvind terwyl die akademiese program voortgaan.
tgt: Government believes that dialogue to address the demands of students can take place while the academic programme is underway.

src: Ons herbevestig die reg op protes, maar dit moet binne die perke van die wet plaasvind en op 'n manier wat nie op ander se regte inbreuk maak nie.
tgt: We reaffirm the right to protest but this must be done within the confines of the law and in a manner that does not infringe on the rights of others.

src: Die Regering se vordering om hoër onderwys toeganklik te maak, blyk uit Statistiek Suid-Afrika se Verslag oor die Finansiële Statistiek van Hoëronderwysinstellings wat in 2015 uitgereik is.
tgt: Government’s advances in making higher education accessible are borne out by the Statistics South Africa Financial Statistics of Higher Education Institutions 2015 report.

src: Dit dui aan dat studente-inskrywings in hoër onderwys van 2006 tot 2015 met 32,5% gestyg het.
tgt: It shows that student enrolment in Higher Education grew by per cent from 2006 to 2015.

src: Daarbenewens het toelaes deur die Regering aan hoër onderwys oor die tienjaartydperk tussen 2006 en 2015 met 144% gestyg.
tgt: Further, grants by national government to Higher Education increased by 144 per cent over a ten year period from 2006 to 2015.

src: Regeringstoelaes en onderrigfooie maak die grootste deel van universiteite se inkomste uit, met regeringsbesteding wat 43% van universiteitsinkomste uitmaak en klasgelde 34%.
tgt: Government grants and tuition fees account for the bulk of university income, with government spending accounting for 43 per cent of university income and tuition fees accounting for 34 per cent.

src: Hierdie bevindings lewer bewys van die Regering se verbintenis tot onderwys en herbevestig ons beroep op diegene wat dit kan bekostig om hul billike deel te betaal.
tgt: These findings demonstrate government’s commitment to education and reaffirms our call for those who can afford to pay their fair share, and reveals that tuition fees remain an important part of overall funding.

src: Dit dui ook daarop dat klasgelde 'n belangrike deel van algehele befondsing bly.
tgt: Progress has also been made by the Ministerial Task Team appointment by the Minister of Higher Education and Training, Blade Nzimande, to develop a support and funding model for Poor and “Missing Middle” students.

src: Vordering is ook gemaak deur die Ministeriële Taakspan wat deur die Minister van Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding, Blade Nzimande, aangestel is om 'n ondersteunings- en befondsingsmodel vir behoeftige en vermiste middel-studente te ontwikkel.
tgt: A blueprint entitled the Ikusasa Student Financial Aid Programme (ISFAP), underwent an engagement process, which saw various inputs incorporated, and agreement obtained across all key stakeholders for the future governance structure of ISFAP.

src: ISFAP maak verskeie aanbevelings, wat tans vir implementering oorweeg word.
tgt: The Ikusasa Student Financial Aid Programme makes various recommendations which are currently under consideration for implementation.

src: Die voorgestelde model en aanbevelings wat in die verslag vervat is, sal baie help om nie net arm en ‘vermiste middel’-studente se befondsingsprobleme op te los nie, maar ook ander uitdagings wat Suid-Afrika in die gesig staar, soos om:die hoë druipsyfer van arm en werkersklasstudente in die hoëronderwys-en-opleidingsektor te verlaag,die indiensneembaarheid van die befondse gegradueerdes te verbeter,die land se vaardigheidsprofiel te verbeter, endie vennootskap tussen die Regering, die privaat sektor en hoëronderwysinstellings om arm en ‘vermiste middel’-studente te ondersteun, te verbeter.
tgt: The proposed model and recommendations contained in the report, will go a long way in not only addressing the funding problems faced by poor and “missing middle” students, but also in addressing amongst other challenges which South Africa faces, including:Reducing the high dropout rates of poor and working class students in the higher education and training sector,Improving the employability of the funded graduates,Improving the skills profile of the country,Improving the partnership between government, the private sector and higher education institutions in supporting poor and “missing middle” students.

src: Die ISFAP-bloudruk voorsien finansiële hulp aan arm en ‘vermiste middel’-studente om die volle koste van hul studie te dek.
tgt: The ISFAP blueprint provides poor and “missing middle” students financial assistance to cover the full cost of study.

src: Terwyl dit ten volle gesubsidieerde onderwys aan arm studente in die vorm van beurse en toelaes aanbeveel, stel dit ook voor dat beurse en toelaes aan ‘vermiste middel’-studente stelselmatig verminder word namate hul huishoudelike inkomste styg, en skets ook scenario's van hoe dit bereik kan word deur fondse van sowel die openbare as privaat sektor te mobiliseer.
tgt: While recommending a fully subsidized education to the poor in the form of bursaries and grants, it also proposes progressively reducing bursaries and grants to the “missing middle” students as household income increases and sketches scenarios of how this can be achieved by mobilising funds from both the public and private sectors.

src: Die bekendstelling van die Toerismeonderneming-ontwikkelingsinkubator in Pilanesberg in Noordwes deur die Minister van Toerisme, Derek Hanekom, sal 'n kanaal vir ekonomiese inklusiwiteit deur lewensvatbare toerismeondernemings skep.
tgt: The launch of the Tourism Enterprise Development Incubator, in Pilanesberg in the North West by the Minister of Tourism Derek Hanekom, will create a conduit for economic inclusion through viable tourism businesses.

src: Dit versterk die toerismesektor se bydrae tot die bou van 'n inklusiewe ekonomie.
tgt: This enhances the tourism sector’s contribution to building an inclusive economy.

src: Die loodsinkubator sal op 50 KMMO's in die Bojanala-distrik gerig wees en sal hulle drie jaar lank ondersteun om volhoubaar te word.
tgt: The pilot incubator will target 50 SMMEs in the Bojanala District and will support them for three years to become sustainable.

src: Die Toerismeonderneming-ontwikkelingsinkubator verskaf sakeondersteuning aan toerismeondernemings.
tgt: The Tourism Enterprise Development Incubator provides business support to tourism enterprises.

src: Die bekendstelling van die Ngwaabe Geïntegreerde Energiesentrum op 4 November 2016 deur die Departement van Energie in samewerking met strategiese vennote, is deel van 'n program om Geïntegreerde Energiesentrums in armoede-nodusgebiede te vestig.
tgt: The launch of Ngwaabe Integrated Energy Centre on 4 November 2016 by the Department of Energy, in collaboration with strategic partners is part of a programme to establish Integrated Energy Centres in poverty nodal areas.

src: Hierdie eenstop-energiesentrum bied toegang tot veilige en bekostigbare energiehulpbronne vir arm huishoudings.
tgt: This one-stop energy shop provides access to safe and affordable energy resources for poor WEBTOKEN addition, it provides information on safe, efficient and environmentally sustainable use of energy sources.

src: Dit bevorder ook die KMMO-sektor en ontwikkel werksgeleenthede deur energieverwante sakeondernemings.
tgt: It also promotes the SMME sector and grows job opportunities through energy related businesses.

src: Die Windaba-konferensie en -uitstalling wat van 2 tot 4 November 2016 by die Kaapstad Internasionale Konvensiesentrum plaasvind met die tema “Towards 100% renewables” versterk ook die Regering se inisiatiewe vir hernubare energie.
tgt: The Windaba Conference and Exhibition which is taking place from 2 to 4 November 2016 at the Cape Town International Convention Centre under the theme “Towards 100% renewables” also boosts government’s renewable energy WEBTOKEN brings together stakeholders involved in the wind energy value chain on the African continent and in South Africa in particular.

src: Dit bring belanghebbers wat by die windenergie-waardeketting op die Afrika-vasteland, en in Suid-Afrika in die besonder, betrokke is, byeen.
tgt: In addition, the 11th Annual 2016 Southern African Energy Efficiency Convention from 8 to 9 November 2016 at Emperors Palace in Johannesburg will focus on a range of energy-related fields.

src: Die 11de Jaarlikse 2016 Suider-Afrikaanse Konvensie oor Energiedoeltreffendheid sal ook vanaf 8 tot 9 November by Emperors Palace in Johannesburg op 'n verskeidenheid energieverwante kwessies fokus.
tgt: Areas that will be covered include energy engineering, efficiency improvement, facilities and building management, renewable and alternative energy, co-generation, power generation, energy services and sustainability.

src: Terreine wat gedek sal word sluit in energie-ingenieurswese, doeltreffendheidsverbetering, fasiliteit- en boubestuur, hernubare en alternatiewe energie, mede-opwekking, kragopweking, energiedienste en volhoubaarheid.
tgt: Today, President Jacob Zuma will co-chair the Inaugural Session of the Zimbabwe-South Africa Bi National Commission with President Robert Mugabe.

src: Die hoofdoelwit is om bilaterale betrekkinge en samewerking tussen die twee lande te verstewig en die potensiaal vir nouer bande op die terreine van onder meer handel, belegging, mynbou, water, energie, infrastruktuurontwikkeling, vervoer en IKT te vestig.
tgt: The main objective is to deepen bilateral relations and cooperation between the two countries and to strengthen and develop the potential that exists for closer ties in the fields of trade, investment, mining, water, energy, infrastructure development, transport, and ICT, among WEBTOKEN date, the two countries have signed more than 38 Memoranda of Understanding and Agreements, which cover a broad range of areas, which include among others, trade and investment, immigration and consular matters, defence, agriculture, the environment, energy, health, as well as arts and culture.

src: Tot op hede het die twee lande meer as 38 memorandums van verstandhouding en ooreenkomste onderteken, wat 'n wye verskeidenheid terreine dek soos handel en belegging, immigrasie- en konsulaatkwessies, verdediging, landbou, die omgewing, energie, gesondheid, asook kuns en kultuur.
tgt: The successful hosting of the Annual Diplomatic Fair by the Department of International Relations and Cooperation and Proudly South Africa at the Union Buildings on 29 October 2016 in Pretoria serves as a key platform to educate the general public about diplomacy and South Africa’s foreign policy objectives.

src: Die suksesvolle aanbieding van die Jaarlikse Diplomatieke Fees deur die Departement van Internasionale Betrekkinge en Samewerking en Proudly South Africa by die Uniegebou in Pretoria op 29 Oktober 2016, dien as 'n belangrike platform om die algemene publiek oor diplomasie en die doelwitte van Suid-Afrika se buitelandse beleid in te lig.
tgt: This event brought together embassies, high commissions and international organisations accredited to South Africa to showcase and promote cultural diplomacy through creative expressions such as arts, music and cuisine from around the world.

src: Hierdie gebeurtenis het ambassades, hoë kommissarisse en internasionale organisasies wat in Suid-Afrika geakkrediteer is, byeen gebring om kulturele diplomasie deur kreatiewe uitdrukking soos kuns, musiek en cuisine van regoor die wêreld te vertoon en te bevorder.
tgt: Over 60 diplomatic missions and several private businesses showcased their products and opportunities this year.

src: Belangrike kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Key Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Spesiale Kabinetsvergadering van 1 November 2016 het vorderingsverslae van die werk van die Inter-Ministeriële Komitee oor die Hervorming van Maatskappye in Staatsbesit (SOC), onder voorsitterskap van Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa, ontvang.
tgt: The Special Cabinet of 1 November 2016, received progress reports on the work of the Inter-Ministerial Committee on State Owned Companies (SOC) Reform, chaired by Deputy President, Cyril Ramaphosa.

src: Dit spruit voort uit die implementering van die 2010 Presidensiële Hersieningskommissie van SOC's, wat deur die Kabinet bekragtig is, se aanbevelings.
tgt: This emanates from the implementation of Cabinet endorsed recommendations from the 2010 Presidential Review Commission of SOCs.

src: Die Kabinet het die gefaseerde benadering tot die implementering van hierdie aanbevelings herbevestig.
tgt: Cabinet reaffirmed the phased approach to implementation of these recommendations.

src: Die Kabinet herbeklemtoon dat alle ondernemings in staatsbesit doeltreffend en finansieel lewensvatbaar moet wees.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates that all state owned entities must be efficient, and financially viable.

src: 'n Stel besluite is geneem om die sentrale beleidsdoelwit na te streef, naamlik om SOC's te versterk om hulle in staat te stel om hul ontwikkelingsdoelwitte te bereik:Die Kabinet het die Raamwerk vir Privaatsektordeelname vir Infrastruktuurlewering bekragtig, wat as riglyn vir samewerking tussen SOC's en die privaat sektor sal dien.
tgt: A suite of decisions was taken to pursue the central policy objective of strengthening SOCs to enable them to meet their developmental objectives.

src: Die Kabinet het die Riglyn vir die Vergoeding en Aansporingstandaarde vir Direkteure van SOC's aanvaar.
tgt: Cabinet endorsed a Private Sector Participation framework for infrastructure delivery which will guide collaboration between SOCs and the private sector.

src: Die Kabinet het die breë strekking van 'n riglyn vir die aanstelling van direksies en uitvoerende direkteure bekragtig, waarvoor die Departement van Openbare Dienste en Administrasie 'n oorlegplegingsproses met provinsies en munisipaliteite sal onderneem voordat die Kabinet dit goedkeur.
tgt: Cabinet adopted the guideline for the remuneration and incentive standards for directors of SOEs.

src: Die eerste konsep van 'n nuwe Regeringsbelanghebberbeleid is vir verdere oorlegpleging aanbeveel.
tgt: Cabinet endorsed the broad thrust of a guide for the appointment of boards and executive officers, for which, the Department of Public Service and Administration will undertake a consultation process with provinces and municipalities, before Cabinet approval.

src: Dit sal in die uitvaardiging van oorkoepelende SOC-wetgewing kulmineer.
tgt: This will culminate in the promulgation of an over-arching SOC legislation.

src: Die Nasionale Tesourie het 'n voorstel vir die bepaling en kosteberekening van ontwikkelingsmandate van staatsondernemings ontwikkel.
tgt: National Treasury developed a proposal for determining and costing developmental mandates of state enterprises, the introduction of this approach will help streamline commercial and non-commercial activities of SOCs.

src: Die implementering van hierdie benadering sal help om SOC's se kommersiële en nie-kommersiële aktiwiteite te WEBTOKEN hierdie maatreëls plaas die SOC's in 'n beter posisie om tot die uitvoer van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan by te dra deur infrastruktuur te bou, die ekonomie te laat groei, nywerhede uit te brei, te help om gesofistikeerde vaardighede te ontwikkel, werksgeleenthede te skep en ander transformasiedoelwitte te bevorder.
tgt: These better position the SOCs to contribute towards the implementation of the National Development Plan: building infrastructure, growing the economy, expanding industry, helping develop high-end skills, creating jobs and advancing other transformation objectives.

src: Die Kabinet het die Geïntegreerde Energieplan (GEP) gepubliseer om aan belanghebbers en ander belangstellende partye die geleentheid te bied om daaroor in gesprek te tree.
tgt: Cabinet approved that the Integrated Energy Plan (IEP) be published for public discussion to afford stakeholders and interested parties to engage with it.

src: Die GEP is in die Nasionale Energiewet, 2008 (Wet No.
tgt: The IEP is anchored in the National Energy Act, 2008 (Act No.

src: 34 van 2008) vervat.
Dit is daarop gemik om as riglyn vir toekomstige energie-infrastruktuurbeleggings en beleidsontwikkeling te dien, wat Suid-Afrika se toekomstige energielandskap sal vorm.
tgt: It seeks to guide future energy infrastructure investments and policy development which will shape the future energy landscape of South Africa.

src: Geïntegreerde energiebeplanning is noodsaaklik om te verseker dat daar in die huidige en toekomstige energie-diensbehoeftes op die doeltreffendste en maatskaplik voordeligste wyse voorsien word, terwyl dit dringende nasionale kwessies soos armoedeverligting en werkskepping bevorder en nadelige uitwerkings op die omgewing minimaliseer.
tgt: Integrated energy planning is required to ensure that current and future energy service needs can be met in the most efficient and socially beneficial manner, while controlling economic costs, serving national imperatives such as poverty alleviation and job creation and minimising adverse impacts on the environment.

src: Die IEP voorsien 'n langtermynvisie van hoe Suid-Afrika energie optimaal as 'n meganisme om mededingend te bly kan gebruik, wat 'n inherente kopskuif vereis oor hoe verskillende energiehulpbronne benut word.
tgt: The IEP provides a long-term vision of how South Africa can use energy optimally as a mechanism to remain competitive, which inherently requires a shift in how various energy resources are utilised.

src: Die Kabinet het sy besluit van 10 Junie 2015 om die Suid-Afrikaanse Kernenergiekorporasie as die implementeringsagent vir die nuwe Kernkrag-bouprogram aan te wys, gewysig.
tgt: Cabinet amended its decision of 10 June 2015 to designate the South African Nuclear Energy Corporation as the implementing Agent for the Nuclear New Build Programme.

src: Die besluit het Eskom destyds in staat gestel om eerder op die Meupi-, Kusile- en Ingula-projekte en die energieuitdagings wat die land ervaar het, te fokus.
tgt: This decision, at the time, allowed Eskom to focus on the Medupi, Kusile and Ingula projects and the energy challenges the country was experiencing.

src: Die Kabinet het Eskom as eienaar-operateur en verkryger van kernkragaanlegte aangewys ooreenkomstig die Kernenergiebeleid van 2008.
tgt: Cabinet designated Eskom as the Owner Operator and Procurer for Nuclear Power Plants in accordance with the Nuclear Energy Policy of 2008.

src: Eskom het 'n veiligheidsrekord van meer as 30 jaar se werksaamhede by die Koeberg-kernkragaanleg, wat ook die enigste kernkragaanleg in Afrika is, en ontwikkel reeds sedert 2007 die verslae oor die omgewingsimpakassessering en kernterreinveiligheid vir moontlike kernkragaanlegte.
tgt: Eskom has more than 30 years of safe operation of the Koeberg Nuclear Power Plant, which is also the only Nuclear Power Plant in Africa, and has been developing the Environmental Impact Assessment and nuclear Site Safety Reports for possible nuclear power plants since 2007.Cabinet also approved designating the South African Nuclear Energy Corporation as the Owner Operator and Procurer for Nuclear Fuel Cycle and Multi-Purpose Reactor.

src: Die Kabinet het ook die aanwysing van die Suid-Afrikaanse Kernenergiekorporasie as die eienaar-operateur en verkryger vir die kernbrandstofsiklus en veeldoelige reaktor goedgekeur.
tgt: The Department of Energy will continue to act on its mandate as the policy setting and coordinating department of the Nuclear Build Programme.

src: Die Departement van Energie sal voortgaan om sy mandaat as die beleidmakende en koördinerende departement van die Kernkragbouprogram te vervul.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the progress regarding the update of the Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) and approved that public consultation be undertaken on the base case and assumptions.

src: Sedert die IRP 2010-30, het verskeie ontwikkelings die energiesektor beïnvloed.
tgt: Since the IRP 2010-30 there has been a number of developments affecting the energy sector.

src: Die IRP-bywerkingsproses balanseer verskeie doelwitte om voorsieningsekerheid te verseker ten einde elektrisiteitskoste te minimaliseer, werkskepping en lokalisering te bevorder, negatiewe omgewingsuitwerkings en watergebruik tot ’n minimum te beperk en voorsieningshulpbronne te diversifiseer.
tgt: The IRP update process balances a number of objectives to ensure security of supply so as to minimise cost of electricity, to promote job creation and localisation, to minimise negative environmental impacts, minimise water use and to diversify supply sources.

src: Die eerste mylpaal, naamlik die samestelling van veronderstellings vir gebruik in die GHP, is voltooi hangende openbare oorlegpleging.
tgt: The first milestone which is the compilation of assumptions to be used in the IRP has been completed, pending public consultation.

src: Die tweede mylpaal oor die ontwikkeling van die grondslaggeval, naamlik 'n minimumkoste¬-plan is voltooi.
tgt: The second milestone on the development of the base case which is a least cost plan has been completed.

src: Die derde mylpaal, naamlik 'n scenario-ontleding, word tans ontwikkel.
tgt: The third milestone which is a scenario analysis is underway.

src: Die vierde mylpaal is beleidsaanpassing.
tgt: And the fourth milestone, is policy adjustment.

src: Die Kabinet het 'n vorderingsverslag oor ontwikkelings in die onderhandelingsposisie by die Wêreldhandelsorganisasie ontvang en ooreengekom oor die behoefte vir 'n ontwikkelingsfokus in die ná-Nairobi-werkprogram en ter voorbereiding van die Elfde Ministeriële Konferensie van die WHO (MC11).
tgt: Cabinet received an update on developments in the negotiating position at the World Trade Organisation and agreed on the need for a development focus in the post-Nairobi work programme and in preparation for Eleventh Ministerial Conference of the WTO (MC11) to be held in Argentina in December 2017.This is in line with the National Development Plan’s objectives of developing appropriate policy responses in a dynamic global environment.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die besluite wat op 11 Maart by 'n vergadering van die President se Koördinerende Raad geneem is.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the resolutions taken by the President’s Coordinating Council meeting held on 11 March 2016.

src: Dit is 'n statutêre liggaam wat ingevolge die Intergovernmental Relations Framework Act, 2005 (Wet No 13 van 2005) ingestel is, en wat die drie sfere van die Regering byeenbring oor kwessies van gemeenskaplike en nasionale belang, met die oog op die versterking van koöperatiewe staatsbestuur.
tgt: This is a statutory body established in terms of the Intergovernmental Relations Framework Act, 2005 (Act No13 of 2005), which brings together the three spheres of government on matters of common interest and national importance with a view to strengthening co-operative governance.

src: Van die kwessies wat bespreek is, sluit in die uitvoer van die Terugkeer na Basiese Beginsels-program, vorderingsverslae oor die instelling van herafgebakende munisipaliteite die Regering se reaksie op droogte en watertekorte en 'n hersiening van die Suid-Afrikaanse Immigrasieregulasies, 2014.
tgt: Issues which were discussed included: Implementation of the Back to Basics Programme, progress report on the establishment of newly re-determined municipalities government’s response to drought and water shortages and review of South African Immigration Regulations, 2014.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die publikasie van die Konsepwitskrif oor Brandweerdienste vir openbare kommentaar.
tgt: Cabinet approved publication of the draft White Paper on Fire Services, public comments.

src: Dit gee 'n uiteensetting van die belangrikste beleidsvoorstelle en -opsies wat die grondslag vorm vir die hersiening van wetgewing oor brandweerdienste, wat die uitgediende Wet op Brandweerdienste, 1987 (Wet No.
tgt: It outlines key policy proposals and options that form the basis for a reviewed fire services legislation that will replace the outdated Fire Brigades Services Act, 1987 (Act No.

src: Dit sluit aan by die Terugkeer na Basiese Beginsels-benadering deur brandweerdienste te verplig om voortdurend in wisselwerking met die gemeenskappe wat hulle dien te tree sodat hulle kan saamwerk om brandrisiko's te verminder en toereikende reaksiestrategieë en -stelsels te verseker om vinnig en doeltreffend op brande en ander verwante insidente te reageer.
tgt: 99 of 1987).This resonates with the Back to Basic approach, by placing an obligation on fire services to constantly engage with communities they serve to work together to reduce fire risks and ensure adequate response strategies and systems to respond to fires and other related incidents rapidly and effectively.

src: Die witskrif herposisioneer die brandweerdienste van die voorheen reaksiegeöriënteerde brandweerdienste tot 'n benadering wat op brandrisikovermindering gebaseer is.
tgt: The White Paper repositions the fire services from response orientated fire services towards a fire risk reduction based approach.

src: Dit dra by tot doeltreffende rampbestuur en brandweerdienste deur brandveiligheid en -voorkoming, veral gemeenskapsgebaseerde brandrisikovermindering, as die middelpunt van brandweerdienste te posisioneer.
tgt: This contributes to effective integrated disaster management and fire services, by placing fire safety and prevention, particularly community-based fire risk reduction, at the centre of fire services delivery which will significantly contribute to the creation of safer communities as highlighted in the National Development Plan.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wetsontwerp op die Padongelukkefonds, 2016 by die Parlement ingedien word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the introduction of the Road Accident Fund Amendment Bill, 2016 in Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp wysig die Padongelukkefondswet, 1996 (Wet No 56 van 1996) wat voorsiening maak vir die betaling van vergoeding vir verlies of skade wat wederregtelik deur die bestuur van motorvoertuie veroorsaak is.
tgt: The Bill amends the Road Accident Fund Act, 1996 (Act No 56 of 1996) which provides for the payment of compensation for loss or damage wrongfully caused by the driving of motor vehicles.

src: Die Wetsontwerp is in ooreenstemming met die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan en met Uitkoms 13, wat voorsiening maak vir 'n inklusiewe en reaktiewe maatskaplike-beskermingstelsel deur doeltreffende dienslewering en vroegtydige mediese ingryping te verseker.
tgt: The Bill is aligned with the National Development Plan and with Outcome 13 which provides for an inclusive and responsive social protection system by ensuring efficient service delivery and early medical intervention to assist with recovery and return to work, and no-fault cover to ease the financial burden on those who are disadvantaged.

src: Komende gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Lede van die Uitvoerende Gesag oor die drie Regeringsfere sal gedurende die Nasionale Imbizo-fokusweek tussen 7 en 11 November 2016 met Suid-Afrikaners landwyd kommunikeer met die tema “Saam beweeg ons Suid-Afrika vorentoe: Ons toekoms – laat dit werk".
tgt: Members of the Executive across the three spheres of government will interact with South Africans countrywide during the National Imbizo Focus Week between 7 and 11 November 2016, under the theme “Together we move South Africa forward: “Our future – make it work”.

src: Die Kabinet moedig alle Suid-Afrikaners aan om aan hierdie gebeure deel te neem en met politieke hoofde te kommunikeer 'n ingeligte en aktiewe burgery is noodsaaklik om Visie 2030 van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP) te verwesenlik.
tgt: Cabinet encourages all South Africans to actively participate in these events and engage with political principals, as an informed and active citizenry is a critical to deliver on Vision 2030, of the National Development Plan (NDP).

src: Die program vir die Imbizo-fokusweek sal op WEBTOKEN beskikbaar wees.
tgt: The Imbizo Focus Week programme will be available on WEBTOKESouth Africa marks National Disability Rights Awareness Month under the theme: “Persons with disabilities - equal participants in shaping a sustainable future” from 3 November and concludes with International Day of Persons with Disabilities, on 3 December 2016.

src: Suid-Afrika herdenk vanaf 3 November die Nasionale Maand vir die Bewustheid van Gestremdes se Regte met die tema “Mese met gestremdhede – gelyke deelnemers aan die vorming van ’n volhoubare toekoms”.
tgt: The month long programme will be used to mobilise society and decision-makers to take responsibility for ensuring that persons with disabilities have equitable access.

src: Programme sal ook bewustheid verhoog oor mense met gestremdhede se deelname aan die ontwikkeling van volhoubare en samehorige gemeenskappe.
tgt: Programmes will also raise awareness on the participation of persons with disabilities in building sustainable and cohesive communities.

src: Inligting oor die regte van mense met gestremdhede sal ook beskikbaar gestel word om hulle bemagtiging te ondersteun.
tgt: Information on the rights of persons with disabilities will also be made accessible to support their empowerment.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om die regte en lewensgehalte van mense met gestremdhede ooreenkomstig ons verbintenis tot die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan te bevorder ten einde toegang tot dienste te verbeter, in die besonder wat betref gehalte-onderwys en indiensneming van mense met gestremdhede.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to advance the rights and quality of life of people with disabilities in line with our commitment in the National Development Plan to increase access to services, particularly in quality education and employment for people with disabilities.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om die veldtog 16 Dae van Aktivisme vir Geen Geweld teen Vroue en Kinders te ondersteun.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to support the 16 Days of Activism for No Violence Against Women and Children campaign.

src: Suid-Afrika het die veldtog in 1998 aanvaar as een van die ingrypingstrategieë vir die skepping van 'n samelewing wat vry van geweld is.16 Dae is 'n internasionale veldtog wat jaarliks tussen 25 November en 10 Desember plaasvind.
tgt: South Africa adopted the campaign in 1998 as one of the intervention strategies towards creating a society free of violence.16 Days is an international campaign which takes place every year from 25 November to 10 December.

src: Die veldtog is daarop gerig om bewustheid onder Suid-Afrikaners te verhoog oor die negatiewe uitwerking van geweld teen vroue en kinders.
tgt: The campaign aims to raise awareness amongst South Africans about the negative impact of violence against women and children.

src: Dit doen ook 'n beroep op elke persoon om standpunt teen geweld teen vroue en kinders in te neem.
tgt: It also calls on every person to take a stand against violence against women and children.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan Suid-Afrika se onderhandelingsmandaat wat sal dien as grondslag vir gesprekvoering by die 22ste Sitting van die Konferensie van die Partye by die Verenigde Nasies se Raamwerkkonvensie oor Klimaatsverandering (COP22), en die 12de Sitting van die Konferensie van die Partye wat as die Vergadering van die Partye by die Kioto Protokol (CMP12) dien, wat vanaf 7 tot 18 November 2016 in Bab Ighli, Marrakech, Morokko gehou word.
tgt: Cabinet approved South Africa’s negotiating mandate to serve as the basis for engagement at the 22nd Session of the Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP22), and the 12th Session of the Conference of the Parties serving as the Meeting of the Parties to the Kyoto Protocol (CMP12), to be held from 7 to 18 November 2016 in Bab Ighli, Marrakech, Morocco.

src: Die onderhandelingsposisie is in ooreenstemming met die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan wat omgewingsvolhoubaarheid bevorder, asook die Grondwet, wat bepaal dat die omgewing vir huidige en toekomstige geslagte bewaar moet word.
tgt: The negotiating position is in line with the National Development Plan which promotes environmental sustainability as well as the Constitution, which states that the environment should be preserved for present and future generations.

src: Die Kabinet se standpunt oor belangrike kwessies in die omgewing Die besluit deur die Nasionale Vervolgingsgesag (NVG) om aanklagte van bedrog teen die Minister van Finansies, Pravin Gordhan, terug te trek, bring die kwessie tot 'n einde en maak dit nou moontlik vir die land om al sy energie daarop toe te spits om die ekonomie te ontwikkel, beleggersvertroue te bevorder en 'n internasionale kredietafgradering te voorkom.
tgt: The decision by the National Prosecuting Authority (NPA) to withdraw fraud charges against Finance Minister Pravin Gordhan brings the matter to finality and allows the country to direct all efforts to advance the economy, build investor confidence and avert an international credit rating downgrade.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die uitwerking van die droogte op Suid-Afrika se watervoorrade, met 'n besondere fokus op Gauteng wat van water uit die Geïntegreerde Vaalrivierstelsel voorsien word.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the impact of the drought on water supplies in South Africa with a particular focus on Gauteng which is supplied with water from the Integrated Vaal River system.

src: Suid-Afrika het die laagste reënval sedert 1904 gehad (114 jaar) met uitsonderlike hoë temperature wat in Oktober en November 2015 ervaar is.
tgt: South Africa received the lowest rainfall since 1904 (114 years) with extremely high temperatures experienced in October and November of 2015.This has severely impacted on our water supplies with national average dam levels decreasing to 48.4% compared with the same time last year when levels were at 66.6%.

src: Dit het 'n beduidende uitwerking op ons watervoorrade gehad, met nasionale gemiddelde damvlakke wat tot 48,4% gedaal het, vergeleke met dieselfde tyd verlede jaar toe die vlakke op 66,6% gestaan het.
tgt: We are still very much in a neutral situation and it is very likely that we can expect an extended period of WEBTOKEN could take at least two to three years to see any significant recovery in dam capacity and this could even extend to five years.

src: Ons is steeds grotendeels in 'n neutrale posisie en ons kan heel waarskynlik 'n hersteltydperk verwag.
tgt: We are therefore still in for a long road to recovery.

src: Me betrekking tot die Geïntegreerde Vaaldamstelsel wat uit 14 damme bestaan wat water aan Gauteng voorsien, staan die stelsel tans op 49,1% vergeleke met 67,9% verlede jaar dieselfde tyd.
tgt: With regard to the Integrated Vaal River System consisting of 14 dams which supplies water to Gauteng, the system is currently at 49.1% compared with 67.9% at the same time last year.

src: Hierdie stelsel voorsien water aan die meeste van ESKOM se steenkoolkragstasies, SASOL, besproeïingsgebruikers en myne en nywerhede in Oos-Mpumalanga, Noordwes, die Vrystaat en die Noord-Kaap, en ondersteun dus 45% van die land se ekonomie en 35% van die bevolking.
tgt: This system also provides water to the bulk of the ESKOM coal fired power stations, SASOL, irrigation users and mines and industries in Eastern Mpumalanga, North West, Free State and Northern Cape, thus supporting approximately 45% of the country's economy and 35% of the population.

src: 80% van die water uit die Vaaldamstelsel word deur huishoudelike verbruikers gebruik.
tgt: 80% of the water from the Vaal system is used by domestic consumers.

src: Dit is die derde week gedurende hierdie droogte dat die stelsel onder 50% is.
tgt: This is the third week that the system is below 50% during this drought.

src: Die Vaaldam is nou op 26,4%, die Katsedam op 38,4%, die Sterkfonteindam op 91,5% en die Grootdraaidam is op 66,3%.
tgt: The Vaal Dam is now at 26.4%, Katse dam is at 38.4%, Sterkfontein Dam at 91.5% and Grootdraai Dam is at 66.3%.

src: Beperkings van 15% vir stedelike gebruik en 20% vir besproeiingsgebruik is ingestel ingevolge die kennisgewing in die Staatskoerant van 12 Augustus.
tgt: Restrictions of 15% for urban use and 20% for irrigation use have been imposed as published in the Government gazette on 12 August.

src: Hierdie beperkings is verpligtend.
tgt: These restrictions are mandatory.

src: 'n Tegniese taakspan is saamgestel om die implementering van die beperkings te monitor.
tgt: A Technical Task Team has been established to monitor the implementation of the restrictions.

src: Rand Water is die grootste verskaffer van drinkbare water na Gauteng en die mikpunt is om die voorsiening vanaf Rand Water met 687 miljoen liter per dag te verminder.
tgt: Rand Water is the main supplier of potable water into Gauteng and the target is to reduce the supply from Rand Water by 687 million litres per day.

src: Alle munisipaliteite in die voorsieningsgebied het spesifieke mikpunte vir vermindering in hul watergebruik ontvang.
tgt: All Municipalities within the supply are have been given specific targets to meet in respect of reducing their water consumption.

src: Die aanvanklike benadering was inkrementeel, met 'n geleidelike vermindering in voorsiening vanaf 5% met 'n trapsgewyse styging tot 15% deur die hoofkleppe te reguleer.
tgt: The initial approach has been an incremental one with a gradual reduction in supplies, starting at 5% and gradually increasing to 15% by throttling the main valves.

src: Vanaf 3 Oktober is daar na 'n volumegebaseerde beperking oorgeskakel.
tgt: From 3 October we shifted to a volume based WEBTOKEN is important that all consumers comply with the restrictions to make sure that we can stretch our available water supplies.

src: Gauteng is besig om 'n Gesamentlike Operasionele Sentrum te vestig om nakoming te monitor en af te dwing.
tgt: The province of Gauteng is setting up a Joint Operations Centre (JOC) to monitor and ensure compliance.

src: Alle munisipaliteite is ook beveel om met onmiddellike ingang operasionele sentrums te vestig en om te verseker dat kommunikasie met verbruikers verbeter.
tgt: All Municipalities have also been directed to establish operation centres with immediate effect and to ensure that communication with consumers is improved.

src: Die Vaaldam sal teen 25% gehou word deur water vanaf die Sterkfonteindam deur te pomp.
tgt: The Vaal dam will be kept at 25% and this will be achieved by transferring water from Sterkfontein dam.

src: Dit is nodig om die integriteit van innames vir ESKOM, Rand Water en SASOL te beskerm.
tgt: This is necessary to protect the integrity of intakes for ESKOM, Rand Water and SASOReleases will commence on 7 November and continue for a minimum of 54 days to 30 December.

src: Die minimumuitlating wat in hierdie stadium beplan word, is 190 miljoen kubieke meter water, wat die watervlakke in die Sterkfonteindam met ongeveer 7% sal laat daal.
tgt: The minimum release planned at this stage is 190 million cubic metres of water which will drop the Sterkfontein dam by approximately 7%.

src: Die doel van die trapsgewyse uitlating is om enige gevaar vir gemeenskappe rivier af van Sterkfontein te beperk en skade aan rivieroewers wat vir 'n lang tyd droog was, sover moontlik te voorkom.
tgt: The staggered release is to minimise any danger to communities downstream of Sterkfontein and to minimise damage to river banks which have been dry for a considerable period of time.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om water doeltreffend te gebruik en dit te bewaar.
tgt: Cabinet calls on South Africans to use water efficiently and conserve it.

src: Alle watergebruikers moet die waterbeperkings nakom waar dit geïmplementeer word en met die munisipaliteite saamwerk om water te spaar.
tgt: All water users must adhere to water restrictions where they are being implemented, and continue to save water, working with municipalities.

src: Die Regering doen alles in sy vermoë om die huidige toestande te temper en werk saam met alle belanghebbers in gebiede wat deur die droogte geraak word.
tgt: Government is doing all it can to mitigate against the current conditions and is working with all stakeholders in drought affected areas.

src: Die Voorsitter van die Afrika-unie, dr Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, het die byeenkoms van Afrika-redakteurs en Persbeamptes van al 54 lidlande van die Afrika-Unie met die tema “Verdiep Afrika se Narratief en Kapasaiteit om Agenda 2063 te Lewer” aangebied.
tgt: The African Union Commission Chairperson, Dr Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma hosted the engagement between African Editors and Press Officers from all 54 African Union member States, under the theme “Deepening Africa’s Narrative and Capacities to Deliver Agenda 2063”.

src: Agenda 2063 doen 'n beroep op alle vlakke van die Afrika-samelewings en die Afrika-diaspora om saam te werk om 'n welvarende en verenigde Afrika te bou wat op gedeelde waardes en 'n gemeenskaplike bestemming gegrond is.
tgt: Agenda 2063 calls for all segments of the African society and the African Diaspora to work together to build a prosperous and united Africa based on shared values and a common destiny.

src: Deelnemers het oor die Afrika-Unie se mylpale gedurende die afgelope vier jaar besin, en 'n beter begrip verkry van Agenda 2063 en hoe Afrika-media die voortou kan neem om dit te populariseer en te dryf.
tgt: Participants reflected on African Union milestones over the past four years, gained a better understanding of Agenda 2063 and how African media can be at the forefront of popularising and driving it.

src: Die rol van akkurate verslagdoening in die vorming van 'n Afrika-narratief en bepleiting van media-eienaarskap onder Afrikane is ook bespreek.
tgt: The role of accurate reporting in shaping an African narrative and advocating for media ownership amongst Africans was also discussed.

src: Die Kabinet skaar hom by die herdenking van die lewe van OR Tambo as 'n bewys van die respek en waardering vir die rol wat hy gespeel het ter bevordering van die agenda van 'n nie-rassige, nie-seksistiese, demokratiese en welvarende Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Cabinet joins in the commemoration of the life and times of OR Tambo as a demonstration of the respect and appreciation for the role he played in driving the agenda of a non-racial, non-sexist, democratic and prosperous South Africa.

src: Die Departement van Kuns en Kultuur het reeds begin met die beplanning van OR Tambo-eeufeesvierings in 2017.Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense aan die volgende oor:.
tgt: The department of Arts and Culture has already commenced with the planning of the Centenary Celebration of OR Tambo in 2017.Cabinet congratulated the following:.

src: Mamelodi Sundowns, wat die nuwe Afrika-sokkerkampioene is nadat hulle die Afrika-Konfederasie-sokkerkampioeneliga gewen het.
tgt: Mamelodi Sundowns who are the new African football champions after winning the Confederation of African Football Champions League.

src: Die Kabinet bedank al die ondersteuners en alle Suid-Afrikaners wat die span wat Suid-Afrika so trots gemaak het, ondersteun het.
tgt: Cabinet thanks all the supporters and all South Africans for rallying behind the team, which did South Africa proud.

src: Sundowns sluit hom aan by nog 'n Suid-Afrikaanse span, Orlando Pirates, wat die Afrika topklubkampioenskap in 1995 gewen het en die land se eerste ster van hierdie kompetisie ingepalm het.
tgt: Sundowns joined another South African team, Orlando Pirates who won Africa's top club championship in 1995 to earn the country the first star of this competition.

src: Die wenners van die 14de Jaarlikse Openbaresektor-innoveringstoekenning van die Sentrum vir Staatsdiensinnovering.
tgt: The winners of 14th Annual Centre for Public Service Innovation Public Sector Innovation Awards who will go on to compete for the coveted Public Sector Innovator of the Year Award.

src: Die toekennings bevorder en moedig beste praktyke in openbaresektor-innovering aan, en vier die suksesse van individue en spanne in alle regeringsfere.
tgt: The awards promote and encourage best practices in public sector innovation and celebrate the successes of individuals and teams at all spheres of government.

src: Dit dien as 'n hulpmiddel vir die uitbreiding van innovering en moedig ander aan om vir beter dienslewering te innoveer.
tgt: It serves as a tool for expanding innovation and encouraging others to innovate for improved service delivery.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy meegevoel aan die volgende oor:.
tgt: Cabinet conveyed its condolences to the following:.

src: Die familie en vriende van die voormalige Adjunkminister van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling, me Bongi Maria Ntuli, wat haar mense gedien het en 'n toegewyde aktivis vir geslagsgelykheid was.
tgt: To the family and friends of the former Deputy Minister of Social Development, Ms Bongi Maria Ntuli who was a servant of the people and a dedicated gender activist.

src: Betoon saam met die President sy medelye met die familie en vriende van die fotojoernalis, mnrJuda Ngwenya, wie se ikoniese foto’s ons geskiedenis gedokumenteer het en ons gedwing het om gesprekke te voer oor ons land en vasteland se welsyn.
tgt: Joins the President in extending condolences to the family and friends of photojournalist, Mr Juda Ngwenya whose iconic images documented our history and compelled us to have conversations about the wellbeing of our country and continent.

src: Die familie en vriende van Abram Thuri Phago, wat gesterf het toe twee treine op die spoorverdeling naby Tembisa in Johannesburg gebots het, en wens die beseerdes 'n spoedige herstel toe.
tgt: To the family and friends of Abram Thuri Phago who died when two trains collided on the rail split near Tembisa in Johannesburg and wishes those who were injured a speedy recovery.

src: Die Departement van Vervoer sal met PRASA en die Spoorwegveiligheidsreguleerder saamwerk om die Raad van Ondersoek te bespoedig vir die volledige ondersoek na die oorsaak van die ongeluk om 'n herhaling van sulke noodlottige voorvalle te voorkom.
tgt: The Department of Transport will be working with Prasa and Railway Safety Regulator to fast track the Board of Inquiry into the full investigation to determine the root cause of the accident to prevent a recurrence of such fatal accidents.

src: Die familie van die studenteleier van die Tshwane Universiteit vir Tegnologie, Lesego Benjamin Phehla, wat as gevolg van 'n ongeluk in Soshanguve gesterf het.
tgt: To the family of Tshwane University of Technology student leader Lesego Benjamin Phehla who died as a result of an accident in Soshanguve.

src: Die mense van Kameroen ná die tragiese treinongeluk tussen Yaoundé en Douala waarin 79 mense gesterf het.
tgt: To the people of Cameroon following the tragic train accident between Yaoundé and Douala which left 79 people dead.

src: Die Kabinet wens ook die honderde mense wat beseer is 'n spoedige herstel toe.
tgt: Cabinet also wishes the hundreds who were injured a speedy recovery.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die betrokke klarings.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Verlenging van die kontrak van dr Sam Makhudu Gulube as Sekretaris van Verdediging.
tgt: Extension of the contract of Dr Sam Makhudu Gulube as Secretary of Defence.

src: Mnr Z. Dangor as Direkteur-Generaal van die Departement van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling.
tgt: Mr ZU Dangor as Director-General to the Department of Social Development.

src: Mnr Robert Nkuna in die pos van Direkteur-Generaal van die Departement van Telekommunikasie en Posdienste.
tgt: Mr Robert D Nkuna to the position of Director-General to the Department of Telecommunications and Postal Services.

src: Dr. Thulani Dlamini as die Hoof Uitvoerende Beampte van die Wetenskaplike en Nywerheidsnavorsingsraad.
tgt: Dr Thulani Dlamini as the Chief Executive Officer of the Council for Scientific and Industrial Research.

src: Implementering van belangrike Regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of Government Programmes.

src: Die kwartaallikse vorderingsverslae vir die tydperk 1 Julie tot 30 September 2016 is aan die Kabinet voorgelê.
tgt: The quarterly outcomes progress reports were presented to Cabinet for the period 1 July to 30 September 2016.

src: Hierdie verslae monitor die implementering van die Regering se Program van Aksie ooreenkomstig die bepalings van die Meiumtermyn- Strategiese Raamwerk en die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan.
tgt: These reports monitor the implementation of Government’s Programme of Action in line with the provisions of the Medium Term Strategic Framework and the National Development Plan.

src: Die ministers in die onderskeie regeringsgroeperings sal hul groeperigsmedia-inligtingsessies deur die GCIS koördineer om later vandeesmaand verslag te doen oor die departementele mylpale wat in hierdie tydperk bereik is.
tgt: Respective Cluster Ministers, through the GCIS, will coordinate cluster media briefings to present departmental milestones reached in the period, later this month.

src: Enkele hoogtepunte uit die kwartaallikse vorderingsverslae in die oorsigtydperk sluit in:Ekonomie.
tgt: Some highlights from the Quarterly Outcomes Progress Reports in the period under review:Economy.

src: Die Departement van Kleinsakeontwikkeling het in die kwartaal onder oorsig 149 ondernemings ondersteun.
tgt: The Department of Small Business Development supported 149 enterprises in the quarter under review.

src: Hierbenewens is 104 koöperasies deur die Koöperatiewe Aansporingskema ondersteun.
tgt: In addition, 104 cooperatives were supported through the Co-operative Incentive Scheme.

src: Hierdie intervensies ontsluit die potensiaal van KMMO's, koöperasies, township- en landelike ondernemings.
tgt: These interventions are unlocking the potential of SMMEs, cooperatives, township and rural enterprises.

src: In die landbousektor is 172 nuwe landbouondernemings en 23 nie-landbouondernemings deur verskeie inisiatiewe ondersteun.
tgt: In the agricultural sector - 172 new agricultural enterprises and 23 non-agricultural enterprises were supported through various initiatives.

src: 'n Bykomende 337 bestaande KMMO's is geïdentifiseer en sal deur opleiding en marktoegang ondersteun word.
tgt: An additional 337 existing SMMEs were identified and will be supported with training and market access.

src: Hierbenewens, is 240 koöperasies deur die Koöperatiewe Aansporingskema ondersteun.
tgt: 240 cooperatives were supported through the Cooperative Incentive Scheme.

src: Die werk van die Interministeriële Komitee oor Belegging begin vrugte afwerp.
tgt: The work of the Inter-Ministerial Committee on Investment is starting to bear fruit.

src: Tydens die kwartaal onder oorsig het Invest SA 'n beleggingspyplyn ten bedrae van R18,2 miljard gefasiliteer, hoofsaaklik in grootskaalse gas-tot-kragprojekte.
tgt: During the quarter under review, Invest SA facilitated an investment pipeline amounting to R.2 billion mostly in large scale gas to power projects.

src: Die stryd teen misdaad en korrupsieDie bestryding van misdaad en korrupsie bly een van die Regering se topprioriteite.
tgt: The fight against crime and corruptionFighting crime and corruption remains a top priority of government.

src: Ons is vasbeslote om ons gemeenskappe te suiwer van misdadigers en sal aanhou werk vir 'n veilige Suid-Afrika waar al die landsburgers veilig voel en is.
tgt: We are resolute to rid our communities of criminals and we will continue to work towards a safer South Africa where all citizens are and feel safe.

src: Vennootskappe tussen gemeenskappe en die Regering is nodig om misdaad en korrupsie te bestry.
tgt: Partnerships between communities and government are needed to fight against crime and corruption.

src: Daar word berig dat 98,9% van alle polisiestasies 'n funksionele gemeenskapspolisiëringsforum het, wat tot 'n veilige en geborge omgewing vir sy inwoners bydra.
tgt: 98.9% police stations were reported to have functional Community Police Forums which contribute to a safe and secure environment for its citizens.

src: Vordering word voortdurend gemaak in die stryd teen korrupsie.
tgt: Progress is being continually made in the fight against corruption.

src: Altesaam 58 mense is gedurende die verslagtydperk skuldig bevind as deel van pogings om korrupsie onder regeringsamptenare te verminder.
tgt: Fifty-eight (58) persons were convicted in relation to reducing corruption amongst government officials in the reporting period.

src: Vyf mense is skuldig bevind aan korrupsie of misdrywe wat met korrupsie verband hou, waar die bedrag per geval meer as R5 miljoen is en die waarde van uitgereikte batebevriesingsbevele R185 miljoen is.
tgt: Five (5) persons were convicted for corruption or offences relating to corruption where the amount involved per case is more than R5 million and value of freezing orders obtained are R185 million.

src: GrondDie wiele van vergoeding draai stadig maar seker om die menswaardigheid van diegene wat gedurende apartheid gely het, te herstel.
tgt: LandThe wheels of restitution are moving to restore the dignity of those who suffered during apartheid.

src: Beduidende vordering is reeds gemaak om die waardigheid van die mense wat benadeel is te herstel.
tgt: Substantial progress was made to restore the dignity of those who suffered during apartheid.

src: 54 400 hektaar (ha) strategies geleë grond is verkry en toegewys en 51 188 ha is aan kleinhoeweprodusente toegewys.
tgt: 54 400 hectares (ha) of strategically located land was acquired and allocated and 51 188 ha were allocated to smallholder producers.

src: Altesaam 6 530 ha van die verworwe grond is aan plaasbewoners en huurarbeiders toegeken.
tgt: 6 530 ha of the acquired land was allocated to farm dwellers and labour tenants.

src: Van die 112 grondeise wat afgehandel is, is 57 in die landelike gebiede, wat tot voordeel strek van 2 553 mense in 467 huishoudings.
tgt: Of the 112 land claims that were settled 57 were in the rural areas benefiting 2 553 people in 467 households.

src: Die Hoofgrondeise-kommissaris het onlangs die Fase 2-indiening vir die skikking van die Masinenge-gemeenskap se grondeis goedgekeur, asook dié van die Mtshali-familie deur die betaling van finansiële vergoeding.
tgt: Recently, the Chief Land Claims Commissioner approving the Phase 2 Submission for the settlement of the Masinenge Community land claim and the Mtshali Family claim through the payment of financial compensation.

src: Die totale waarde van die skikking is R7 100 608 tot voordeel van 64 huishoudings, wat as slagoffers van grondonteiening bevestig is.
tgt: The total value of the Masinenge settlement is R7, 100,608.00 for the benefit of 64 households who were verified as victims of land dispossession.

src: Die Kommissie vir die Herstel van Grondregte het gedurende die tydperk 1 April 2016 tot 31 Oktober 2016 sowat R1 miljard as vergoeding aan grondeisers wat van hul grondregte ontneem is, betaal.
tgt: The Commission on Restitution of Land Rights has, during the period 1 April 2016 to 31 October 2016 paid-out close to a billion rand in compensation to land claimants who were dispossessed of their rights in land.

src: Die bevindings van die onlangse verslag van die Instituut vir Rasseverhoudinge: “Life in South Africa: Reasons for Hope” dui daarop dat Suid-Afrika vandag beter daaraan toe is as 20 jaar WEBTOKEN 2015 was die reële BBP per capita 33% hoër as in 1994 groei in besteebare inkomste per capita het gestyg van R23 686 in 1994 tot R33 660 in 2015 ('n styging van 42%), die totale aantal mense met werk het, het verdubbel van 7,9-miljoen in 1994 tot 15,6-miljoen in 2015 toegang tot formele behuising het met 131,3% gestyg tussen 1996 en 2016 universiteitinskrywingsyfers het met 281,4% gestyg van 211 756 in 1985 tot 807 663 in 2014 die aantal nuwe MIV-infeksies het gedaal van 646 806 in 1999 tot 321 497 in 2015 daar was 'n styging van 62,5% in professionele gesondheidsorgwerkers in die openbare sektor tussen 2000 en 2015 en die moordsyfer het sedert 1994 met 49,3% gedaal.
tgt: The findings of the recent Institute of Race Relations report: “Life in South Africa: Reasons for Hope” shows that life in South Africa is better today compared to 20 years WEBTOKEN 2015 real per capita GDP was 33 per cent higher than in 1994 disposable income growth per capita increased from R23,686 in 1994 to R33,660 in 2015 (an increase of 42 per cent), the total number of people with jobs doubled from 7.9-million in 1994 to 15.6-million in 2015 access to formal housing increased by 131.3 per cent from 1996 to 2016 university enrolment rates increased by 281.4 per cent from 211,756 in 1985 to 807,663 in 2014 the number of new HIV infections dropped from 646,806 in 1999 to 321,497 in 2015 there has been a per cent increase in healthcare professionals in the public sector between 2000 to 2015 and the murder rate has fallen by per cent since 1994.These highlight that while there are challenges, life for South Africans has improved over the past two decades.

src: Die Kabinet moedig alle sektore van die samelewing aan om op die land se vordering sedert die begin van demokrasie voort te bou.
tgt: Cabinet encourages all sectors of society to continue to build on the advances of our nation since the dawn of democracy.

src: Daar is steeds meer positiewe as negatiewe aspekte in die land.
tgt: There remain more positives for the country than there are negatives.

src: Implementering van die Regering se Program van Aksie:.
tgt: Implementation of Governments Programme of Action:.

src: Die Regering se vyfde Nasionale Imbizo-fokusweek, wat van 7 tot 13 November 2016 gehou is met die tema “Together we move South Africa forward: Our future – make it work“ het aan Suid-Afrikaners die geleentheid gebied om aktief met die Regering in gesprek te tree.
tgt: Government’s fifth National Imbizo Focus Week which was held from 7 to 13 November 2016 under the theme “Together we move South Africa forward: Our future – make it work“ saw South Africans actively engaging with government.

src: Hierdie tydperk van intensiewe wisselwerking dra verder by tot 'n ingeligte en aktiewe burgery 'n kritieke element om die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP) se Visie 2030 te verwesenlik.
tgt: This period of intense interaction further contributes to an informed and active citizenry a critical element in delivering the National Development Plan (NDP) Vision 2030.President Jacob Zuma initiated the week during an Imbizo at Marhulana Primary School in Tembisa, Gauteng where a fully equipped computer laboratory was handed over.

src: Die opening van die Swartkopfonteinpad en -brug tussen Suid-Afrika en Botswana ontsluit 'n nuwe hoofstuk in die verbinding van die Suid-Afrikaanse grenspos by Swartkopfontein met Botswana se grenspos by Ramotswa.
tgt: The opening of the Swartkopfontein road and bridge between South Africa and Botswana unlocks a new chapter in linking the South African border posts at Swartkopfontein to Botswana’s border post at Ramotswa.

src: Die opgegradeerde pad-en-bruginfrastruktuur, teen 'n belegging van R78,5 miljoen, het gelei tot die skep van 51 heeltydse werksgeleenthede oor die kontraktydperk van 23 maande, met arbeid wat uit albei lande verkry is.
tgt: The upgraded road and bridge infrastructure, at an investment of R.5 million resulted in 51 full time jobs being created over the 23-month contract period, with labour sourced from both countries.

src: Die Program vir die Herlewing van Nywerheidsparke onder leiding van die Minister van Handel en Nywerheid, Rob Davies, skep werksgeleenthede in en om townships en landelike gemeenskappe.
tgt: The Revitalisation of Industrial Parks Programme, under the Minister of Trade and Industry, Rob Davies is creating jobs in and around townships and rural communities.

src: Die program is uitgevoer in reaksie op 'n oproep deur President Jacob Zuma om onder meer volskaalse industrialisering en inklusiewe groei te bewerkstellig.
tgt: The programme was implemented in response to a call by President Jacob Zuma to work towards full scale industrialisation and inclusive growth amongst others.

src: Die Departement van Handel en Nywerheid het tot dusver R22,5 miljoen in die herlewing van die Komani-nywerheidspark belê.
tgt: The Department of Trade and Industry has so far invested R.5m in the revitalisation of the Komani Industrial Park.

src: Gedurende die eerste fase van die herlewingsprogram is sewe klein, medium- en mikro-ondernemings as subkontrakteurs aangestel, ten bedra van R5,3 miljoen.
tgt: During the 1st phase of the revitalisation programme, seven small micro medium enterprises were appointed as sub-contractors to the value of R5, 3million.

src: Altesaam 71 plaaslike arbeiders is in diens geneem, waarvan 63% jeugdiges is.
tgt: Seventy-one local labourers were employed, of which 63 per cent were youth.

src: Die Program vir Swart Nyweraars, wat daarop gemik is om meer rolspelers in die vervaardigingsektor te vestig, het tot op datum 22 swart nyweraars ondersteun en 1 500 werksgeleenthede geskep.
tgt: The Black Industrialist programme, with an objective to increase role-players in the manufacturing sector, has to date supported 22 Black Industrialists and 1500 jobs have been created.

src: Die program het 'n kapitaalinspuiting van R1,5 miljard ontvang om hierdie nyweraars te ondersteun.
tgt: R.5 billion has been injected to support these industrialists.

src: Die Globale Entrepreneurskapweek (GEW) is verlede Vrydag in Johannesburg bekend gestel deur Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa, met die ondersteuning van Minister Lindiwe Zulu.
tgt: The Global Entrepreneurship Week was launched in Johannesburg last Friday by Deputy President, Cyril Ramaphosa, supported by Minister Lindiwe Zulu.

src: Dit vind van 14 tot 20 November 2016 plaas en is die grootste byeenkoms van uitvinders en entrepreneurs wat beginbesighede loods deur idees na die werklikheid om te skakel, ekonomiese groei te dryf en sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling te stimuleer.
tgt: It is taking place from 14 to 20 November 2016, and is the largest gathering of innovators and entrepreneurs who launch start-ups by bringing ideas to life, driving economic growth and stimulating socio-economic development.

src: Die Kabinet gee erkenning aan ons sake- en maatskaplike vennote vir hul rol om die GEW na Suid-Afrika te bring, naamlik die Gauteng Provinsiale Regering, die Stad Johannesburg, Hollard, Microsoft, IDC, SABS, SAB, SEA Africa, die Global Entrepreneurship Network en die Kauffman-stigting.
tgt: Cabinet recognises business and social partners in bringing GEW to South Africa, namely the Gauteng Provincial Government, City of Johannesburg, Hollard, Microsoft, IDC, SABS, SAB, SEA Africa, the Global Entrepreneurship Network and the Kauffman Foundation.

src: Mer as 80 vennootskapsfunksies sal gedurende hierdie tydperk plaasvind.
tgt: Over 80 partner events will take place during this period.

src: Die GEW is 'n voorloper tot die Globale Entrepreneurskapskongres (GEC), wat in Maart 2017 die eerste keer op die Afrika-vasteland aangebied word, en wat na verwagting meer as 5 000 afgevaardigdes uit 160 lande sal lok.
tgt: The GEW is a lead-up to the Global Entrepreneurship Congress (GEC) which will be hosted for the first time on the African continent in Johannesburg during March 2017, where over 5 000 delegates from 160 countries are expected to attend.

src: Minister Nomvula Mokonyane het op 14 November 2016 die Drakenstein-afvalwaterbehandelingsaanleg geopen en dit aan die Drakenstein-munisipaliteit in die Wes-Kaap oorhandig.
tgt: Minister Nomvula Mokonyane on 14 November 2016 launched the Drakenstein Waste Water Treatment Plant and handed it over to the Drakenstein Municipality in the Western Cape.

src: Die projekwaarde van ongeveer R 171 000 000 het die plaaslike owerheid en gemeenskap bevoordeel deur die voorsiening van ervaring en opleiding in konstruksie, die werwing van plaaslike mense en die verkryging van materiaal van plaaslike verskaffers en vervaardigers.
tgt: The project value is approximately R 171 000 000 and has benefited the local authority and community by providing experience and training in construction recruitment of local people and sourcing of materials from local suppliers and manufacturers.

src: Die voorsiening van 'n basiese waterdiens aan die gemeenskap dra by tot die verbetering van die watergehalte in die Bergrivier en verlig die negatiewe uitwerking van swak gehalte besproeiingswater.
tgt: The provision of a basic water service to the community contributes to the improvement of the quality of water in the Berg River and alleviates the negative impact of poor quality irrigation water.

src: Water en sanitasie vorm die kern van volhoubare ontwikkeling.
tgt: Water and sanitation are at the very core of sustainable development.

src: Die Departement van Water en Sanitasie onderneem tans 'n Sanitasieveldtog wat sy hoogtepunt sal bereik met Wêreldtoiletdag op 19 November 2016.
tgt: The Department of Water and Sanitation is embarking on a Sanitation Campaign which will culminate with World Toilet Day on 19 November 2016, which is used to create awareness, to educate and apply efforts to ensure that everyone has access to decent sanitation services.

src: Dit is daarop gerig om bewustheid te skep, mense op te voed en pogings aan te wend om te verseker dat almal toegang tot behoorlike sanitasiedienste het.
tgt: South Africa has committed itself to accelerate the provision of water and sanitation services, and as such restore the dignity particularly of those people from previously disadvantaged communities.

src: Die program vir die uitwissing van die emmerstelsel is daarop gerig om die nalatenskap van 'n emmerstelsel as vorm van sanitasie in vier provinsies, naamlik die Oos-Kaap, die Vrystaat, Noordwes en die Noord-Kaap, uit te wis. Altesaam 25 091 emmers is tot nou toe uitgewis en nog 27 147 emmers bly nog oor.
tgt: The Bucket Eradication Programme is aimed at addressing the legacy of bucket toilets as a form of sanitation system in four provinces, namely the Eastern Cape, Free State, North West and the Northern Cape.

src: Die suksesvolle voltooiing deur jongmense van die Nasionale Landelike Jeugdienskorps (NARYSEC) se program op 17 November 2016 is aanvullend tot die Regering se werkskeppingsprogramme en -inisiatiewe.
tgt: The graduation of young people from the four-year National Rural Youth Corps (NARYSEC) programme on 17 November 2016 complements government's job creation programmes and initiatives.

src: Die program, wat in 2010 van stapel gestuur is, is gemik op jeugvaardigheidsontwikkeling- en werkskepping om jong mense uit landelike gebiede van werksoekers in werkskeppers te omskep.
tgt: The programme, which was launched in 2010, is a youth skills development and employment programme that helps to transform young people in the rural areas from being job seekers to creators of jobs.

src: Die Uitgebreide Openbare Werke-program (UOWP) se Munisipale Beraad vind van 15 tot 17 November 2016 by die St George Konferensiesentrum in Gauteng plaas met die tema “See, Feel and Experience Public Employment Programmes”.
tgt: The Expanded Public Works Programme (EPWP) Municipal Summit is underway from 15 to 17 November 2016 under the theme “See, Feel and Experience Public Employment Programmes”, at St George Conference Centre in Gauteng.

src: Die UOWP is 'n sleutelregeringsinisiatief, wat bydra tot behoorlike werk en volhoubare lewensonderhoud, onderwys, gesondheid, landelike ontwikkeling, voedselsekerheid en grondhervorming, asook tot die die stryd teen misdaad en korrupsie.
tgt: EPWP is a key government initiative, which contributes to decent work and sustainable livelihoods, education, health, rural development, food security and land reform, including the fight against crime and corruption.

src: Die beraad fokus op die praktiese komponente van die program deur 'n geleentheid te bied om ervarings en beste praktyke te deel.
tgt: The summit focuses on the practical components of the programme by providing an opportunity to share experiences and best practices.

src: Dit versterk die Regering se pogings om werksgeleenthede en vaardigheidsverwerwing te verskaf deur opleiding, wat help om arm op te hef.
tgt: This enhances government efforts of providing employment opportunities and skills acquisition through training which in turn revitalises poor communities.

src: Mer as sewe miljoen werksgeleenthede is tussen 2004 en 2016 deur die UOWP geskep.
tgt: More than 7 million work opportunities have been created through EPWP from 2004 to 2016.

src: Dit dui op die suksesvolle uitvoer van die program deur al die sfere van die Regering, munisipaliteite en die burgerlike samelewing.
tgt: This indicates successful implementation of the programme by all spheres of government, municipalities and civil society.

src: Fase drie van die UOWP is nou in sy derde jaar van bedryf, waartydens universele beginsels wat die uitvoer van die program beheer, bekendgestel is.
tgt: EPWP Phase 3 is in its third year of implementation – and has seen the introduction of universal principles which govern the implementation of the programme and its main task is to promote community involvement where EPWP projects are implemented.

src: Dit maak ook deursigtigheid met betrekking tot werwing moontlik.
tgt: This also allows transparency in terms of recruitment.

src: Die suksesvolle oorskakeling van analoë na digitale uitsendings vir inwoners in die omgewing van die Square Kilometre Array in die Noord-Kaap beteken dat hierdie inwoners onder die eerstes is om die volle omvang van die voordele van verbeterde klank- en wêreldgehalte wat met digitale televisie gepaardgaan, te ervaar.
tgt: The successful migration from analogue to digital broadcasting for residents within the Square Kilometre Array area in the Northern Cape, means that these residents are among the first to experience the full range of benefits of improved sound and picture quality associated with digital television.

src: Die aankondiging deur Minister Muthambi om die oorskakelingsproses na digitale uitsendings teen Desember 2018 in 'n provinsiaal gefasseerde benadering af te handel, is reeds aan die gang en het in die Noord-Kaap en Limpopo begin.
tgt: The announcement by Minister Muthambi to complete the process of migrating to the broadcasting digital system by December 2018 in a provincial phased approach is underway, having already started in the Northern Cape and Limpopo.

src: Registrasies is oop in die Vrystaat, Mpumalanga en Limpopo.
tgt: Registrations are open in the Free State, Mpumalanga and Limpopo.

src: Registrasie sal ook in 'n later stadium in Noordwes, die Oos-Kaap, KwaZulu-Natal, die Wes-Kaap en in Gauteng begin.
tgt: Registrations will also open in the North West, Eastern Cape, KwaZulu-Natal, Western Cape and Gauteng at a later stage.

src: Die analoogafskakeling vorm deel van die land se digitale migrasieproses.
tgt: The analogue switch off forms part of the country’s Broadcasting Digital Migration process in the country.

src: Arm huishoudings wat vir die regeringsubsidie kwalifiseer, word gevra om by hul plaaslike poskantoortakke vir gratis dekodeerders (die sogenaamde STB's) te registreer.
tgt: Poor households who qualify for the government subsidy are urged to register for free STBs at their local Post Office branches.

src: Die Kabinet is ook ingelig oor die plan om die oorskot van politieke aktiviste wat gedurende apartheid gehang is, op te grawe.
tgt: Cabinet was also briefed on the plan to exhume the remains of political activists who were hanged during apartheid.

src: Minstens 130 politieke gevangenes is tussen 1960 en 1990 vir politiekverwante oortredings gehang, waarná die doodsvonnis afgeskaf is.
tgt: There were at least 130 political prisoners who were hanged for politically-related offences between 1960 and 1990, after which the death penalty was suspended.

src: Hierdie patriotte sal behoorlik in hul geboorteplekke herbegrawe word.
tgt: These patriots will be properly buried in their places of origin.

src: Dié proses volg op die openbare bekendstelling van die Galgopgrawingsprojek op 23 Maart 2016 by die Kgosi Mampuru II Korrektiewe Sentrum, en begin met die opgrawe van die oorskot van 83 politieke aktiviste oor 'n tydperk van ses maande voor die einde van 2016/17.
tgt: This process follows the public launch of the Gallows Exhumation Project on 23 March 2016 at the Kgosi Mampuru II Correctional Centre, to commence with the exhumation of the remains of 83 political activists over a period of six months before the end of 2016/17.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die suksesvolle afloop van die derde sitting van die Bi-Nasionale Kommissie tussen Botswana en Suid-Afrika onder leiding van President Jacob Zuma en sy eweknie President Seretse Khama Ian Khama om ekonomiese samewerking tussen die twee lande verder te versterk.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the successful conclusion of the 3rd Session of the Bi-National Commission between Botswana and South Africa led by President Jacob Zuma and his counterpart President Seretse Khama Ian Khama to further deepen economic cooperation between the two WEBTOKEN tracking work on the Lesotho Highlands Water Transfer Project, implementation of the Southern African Development Community (SADC) Industrialisation Strategy and Regional Indicative Strategic Development Plan to create regional value chains and manufacturing capacities, and cooperation in border management to combat cross-border crimes such as rhino and elephant poaching, were among the areas explored.

src: Bespoediging van die werk aan die Lesotho-hooglandwateroorplasingsprojek, implementering van die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap (SAOG) se Industrialiseringstrategie en Streeksaanduidende Strategiese Ontwikkelingplan om streekswaardekettings en vervaardigingsvermoëns te skep, en samewerking in grensbestuur om oorgrensmisdade soos renoster- en olifantstropery te bestry, was onder die onderwerpe wat bespreek is.
tgt: South Africa reaffirmed its support for the SADC candidate for the post of the AU Commission Chairperson, Honourable Dr. Pelonomi Venson-Moitoi, the Minister of International Affairs and Cooperation of the Republic of Botswana.

src: Suid-Afrika het sy steun vir die SAOG-kandidaat vir die pos van AU-Kommissievoorsitter, die Agbare Dr. Pelonomi Venson-Moitoi, die Minister van Internasionale Aangeleenthede en Samewerking van die Republiek van Botswana, bevestig.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma concluded a successful Working Visit to Addis Ababa, in the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia where he attended the African Union (AU) High Level Committee on Libya meeting to review and discuss the peace and security situation in Libya.

src: Die komitee het die situasie bespreek en ooreengekom oor 'n aantal kwessies wat sal help om 'n blywende oplossing te vind vir die uitdagings wat Libiërs in die gesig staar.
tgt: The Committee discussed and agreed on a number of issues that would help find a lasting solution to challenges facing the people of Libya.

src: As lede van die AU wil ons vrede en stabiliteit in Libië sien en die komitee het ooreengekom dat ons as Afrika alles in ons vermoë moet doen om al die betrokke partye in Libië te oortuig om 'n Afrika-oplossing vir die land se probleme te vind.
tgt: As members of the African Union we want to see peace and stability in Libya and the committee agreed that as Africa we need to extensively persuade all involved parties in Libya to find an African solution to the problems facing the country.

src: President Zuma was ook betrokke by die Tweede Buitengewone Beraad van die Volunteering Nations of the African Capacity for Immediate Response to Crises (ACIRC).
tgt: President Zuma also participated in the Second Extraordinary Summit of the Volunteering Nations of the African Capacity for Immediate Response to Crises (ACIRC).

src: Die doel van hierdie beraad was om die status van die ACIRC-mag te bespreek teen die agtergrond van die UTULIVU AFRICA I en II Command Post Exercises (CPX) se optrede, asook om die beloofde vermoëns vanaf Me 2014 tot April 2015 te bekragtig.
tgt: The aim of this Summit was to discuss the status of the ACIRC Force following the conduct of the UTULIVU AFRICA I and II Command Post Exercises (CPX) and the verification of the pledged capabilities from May 2014 to April 2015.

src: Vrywilligerlande van die ACIRC, wat Suid-Afrika insluit, het besluit om die leiding te neem om Afrika-oplossings vir Afrika-uitdagings te bewerkstellig sonder die ingryping van eksterne magte.
tgt: Volunteering countries to the ACIRC, which include South Africa, resolved to take a lead in bringing about African solutions for African challenges without the intervention of external forces.

src: Komende gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Die 16 Dae van Aktivisme vir Geen Geweld teen Vroue en Kinders vind jaarliks vanaf 25 November (Die Internasionale Dag vir die Uitwissing van Geweld teen Vroue) tot 10 Desember (Internasionale Meseregtedag) plaas.
tgt: The 16 Days of Activism for No Violence against Women and Children takes place annually from 25 November (International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women) to 10 December (International Human Rights Day).
