src: Ander belangrike herdenkingsdae gedurende hierdie tydperk is Wêreldvigsdag op 1 Desember en die Internasionale Dag van Persone met Gestremdhede op 3 Desember.2016 se tema vir die 16 Dae van Aktivisme is “Sluit my in: saam beweeg ons 'n nie-gewelddadige Suid-Afrika vorentoe” en word onderlê deur 'n jaarlange benadering om deurlopend met gemeenskappe saam te werk.
tgt: Other key commemorative days during this period include World Aids Day on 1 December and the International Day for People with Disabilities on 3 December.

src: President Jacob Zuma sal op 25 November 2016 die Nasionale Dialoë bekendstel, waarvolgens distriksminusipaliteite dialoogsessies deur die loop van die jaar gaan byeenroep.
tgt: The 2016 theme for the 16 Days of Activism is “Count me in: together moving a non-violent South Africa forward” and is being sustained through a year-long approach in working continuously with communities.

src: Die dialoë sal vaardigheidsontwikkeling en bemagtiging vir gemeenskappe, veral vir vroue, behels, asook die verbetering van dienslewering wat betref toegang tot geregtigheid, berading en gesondheidsdienste.
tgt: The dialogues will incorporate skills development and empowerment for communities, especially for women, as well as service delivery improvement in terms of access to justice and counselling and health services.

src: Dit is alle Suid-Afrikaners se plig om aktief deel te neem aan die stryd teen geweld en teen vroue- en kindermishandeling.
tgt: All South Africans have a duty to be active participants in the fight against violence against women and child abuse.

src: Die Minister van Internasionale Betrekkinge en Samewerking, Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, en die Minister van Natuurlike Hulpbronne en die Omgewing van die Russiese Federasie, MnrSergey Donskoy, sal as gesamentlike voorsitters optree van die 14de Sitting van die Gesamentlike Tussenregeringskomitee oor Handel en Ekonomiese Samewerking (ITEC) tussen Suid-Afrika en Rusland, wat op Vrydag, 18 November 2016, in Pretoria plaasvind.
tgt: International Relations and Cooperation Minister Maite Nkoana-Mashabane and the Minister of Natural Resources and Environment of the Russian Federation, Mr Sergey Donskoy, will co-chair the 14th Session of the Joint Intergovernmental Committee on Trade and Economic Cooperation (ITEC) between South Africa and the Russia on Friday, 18 November 2016, in Pretoria.

src: Hierdie sitting is daraop gerig om ooreen te kom oor spesifieke aksieplanne om die deurvoer van bestaande verbintenisse in alle ITEC-sektore te bespoedig, met inbegrip van handel, belegging en bankwese minerale hulpbronne energie landbou, bosbou en visserye vervoer wetenskap, tegnologie en die ruimte waterhulpbronne, onderwys en justisie.
tgt: This session is expected to agree on specific plans of action to expedite implementation of existing commitments within all the sectors of ITEC, including trade, investment and banking mineral resources energy agriculture, forestry and fisheries transport science, technology and space water resources and education and justice.

src: Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa sal op 19 November 2016 'n afvaardiging van ministers en nie-regeringsbelanghebbers lei na die Ekspo oor Jeugloopbaanontwikkeling by die Nkowankowa-stadion in die Groter Tzaneen Plaaslike Munisipaliteit, Limpopo.
tgt: Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa will lead a delegation of ministers and non-governmental stakeholders on 19 November 2016 to the Youth Career Development Expo at the Nkowankowa Stadium in the Greater Tzaneen Local Municipality, Limpopo.

src: Die ekspo sal loopbaanleiding en inligting oor verdere ondewys en opleiding aan leerders in Graad 10 tot 12, werklose jongmense en jeugdiges wat voortydig die skool verlaat, verskaf.
tgt: The expo will provide career guidance and information on further education and training opportunities to learners who are in Grades 10 to 12, to unemployed youth, and to youth who have dropped out from high school.

src: Dié ekspo is deel van die Regering se pogings om jong mense te help ontwikkel, veral sodat hulle aan die ekonomie kan deeleneem en hul regmatige plek in ons samelewing kan inneem.
tgt: The Youth Career Development Expo is part of government’s work to advance young people, particularly their participation in the economy, so that they can take their rightful place in our society.

src: Na afloop van die plaaslikeregeringsverkiesings, bly openbare deelname aan die bestuur van gemeenskappe steeds van sleutelbelang om munisipale beplanning op 'n manier te beïnvloed wat die beste in Suid-Afrikaners se behoeftes sal voorsien.
tgt: Following the Local Government Elections, public participation in the governance of communities remains critical to influence municipal planning, in a manner which best addresses the needs of citizens.

src: Die Wet Op Plaaslike Regering: Munisipale Strukture, 1998, vereis onder meer dat munisipaliteite struksture moet skep waardeur gemeenskappe en gemeenskapsorganisasies geraadpleeg word in die uitoefening van hul funksies en magte.
tgt: The Local Government Municipal Structures Act, 1998, requires amongst others municipalities to develop mechanisms to consult communities and community organisations in performing their functions and exercising their powers.

src: Hierdie strukture staan algemeen bekend as wykskomitees en vorm 'n noodsaaklike skakel tussen wyksraadslede, die gemeenskap en die WEBTOKEN die komende maande sal wykskomitees verkies word om hul gemeenskappe te dien en landsburgers moet hul verkiesbaar stel om op hierdie strukture te dien.
tgt: These structures are commonly known as Ward Committees, and provide a vital link between Ward Councillors, the community and the WEBTOKEN the coming months Ward Committees will be elected to serve their communities and citizens must avail themselves to participate in these elections and to serve on these structures.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die suksesvolle en vreedsame munisipale wykstussenverkiesings wat onlangs in ses provinsies gehou is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the successful and peaceful municipal ward by-elections held recently in six provinces.

src: Suid-Afrikaners het weereens hul verbintenis tot politieke verdraagsaamheid getoon, wat bewys lewer van die volwassenheid van ons grondwetlike demokrasie.
tgt: South Africans have again demonstrated their commitment to political tolerance which is a testament to the maturity of our constitutional democracy.

src: Die SA Sporttoekenningseremonie 2016 sal op 27 November 2016 by die Sand du Plessis-teater in Mangaung, Vrystaat, gehou word.
tgt: The SA Sport Awards Ceremony 2016 will be held on 27 November 2016 at the Sand du Plessis Theatre, Mangaung, Free State.

src: Stemlyne vir die Mese se Keuse-sportster van die Jaar met sy uitsaaivennoot SABC Sport is oop en sal op 27 November 2016 om 21:00 sluit.
tgt: Voting lines for the People’s Choice Sports Star of the Year with its broadcast partner SABC Sport are open and will close on 27 November 2016 at 21h.

src: Die Kabinet wens al die genomineerdes vir die toekenning van die Mese se Keuse- sportster van die Jaar geluk.
tgt: Cabinet commends all the People’s Choice Sports Star of the Year Nominees.

src: Die Kabinet se standpunt oor belangrike kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Cabinet’s position on issues in the environment.

src: Die uitwerking van klimaatsverandering word ervaar deur uiterste weerstoestande in die vorm van wisselvallige reënval, droogte, uitermatige hitte en fratsvloede.
tgt: The impact of Climate Change is being felt through the severe weather conditions in the form of inconsistent rainfall, drought conditions, excessive heat and flash flooding.

src: Die fratsvloede in Gauteng en Mpumalanga het gelei tot lewensverlies, ontwortelde gemeenskappe veral in informele gebiede, en die vernietiging van infrastruktuur soos paaie, brûe en eiendom.
tgt: The flash floods in Gauteng and Mpumalanga resulted in the loss of lives, displaced communities especially in informal areas and destroyed infrastructure such as roads, bridges and property.

src: Die Kabinet spreek sy meegevoel uit teenoor die families en vriende van diegene wat hul lewens in die oorstromings verloor het en wens alle beseerdes 'n spoedige herstel toe.
tgt: Cabinet conveys its condolences to the family and friends of those who lost their lives in the flooding and wishes those injured a speedy recovery.

src: Suid-Afrikaners se gedagtes en gebede is met diegene wie se geliefdes nog vermis word.
tgt: The nations thoughts and prayers are with those whose loved ones are still missing.

src: Die land se rampbestuurspanne bly in gereedheid regoor die land, veral in gebiede waar meer reën verwag word.
tgt: The country’s Disaster Management teams remain on alert across the country, especially in areas where more rains are expected.

src: Almal moet gehoor gee aan vroeë waarskuwings van slegte weerstoestande en betyds daarop reageer.
tgt: All people must respect and respond to early warning of harsh weather.

src: President Jacob Zuma, vergesel van Gauteng se Premier, David Makhura, en die Minister van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Aangeleenthede, Des van Rooyen, het die gebied geïnspekteer en huise besoek wat by die Stjwetla informele nedersetting langs die Jukskeirivier oorstroom het.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma accompanied by Gauteng Premier David Makhura and Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs Minister Des van Rooyen inspected the area and visited homes that were flooded at the Stjwetla informal settlement along the Jukskei River.

src: President Zuma het 'n inter-regeringstussenkoms onder leiding van Minister van Rooyen opdrag gegee om die Jukskeirivier te fortifiseer deur die oewers met steunwalle te versterk om die uitwerking van fratsvloede op gemeenskappe te verminder.
tgt: President Zuma has directed an intergovernmental intervention led by Minister van Rooyen to harness the Jukskei River and buttress its banks to reduce the impact of flash floods on communities.

src: Die Kabinet bedank gemeenskapgebaseerde NRO's, wyksraadslede en vrywilligers wat tot die inwoners se hulp gekom het.
tgt: Cabinet thanks Community based NGOs, Ward Councillors and volunteers who came to the aide of residents.

src: Die onlangse reën moet Suid-Afrikaners egter nie 'n valse gevoel van sekuriteit gee nie, omdat verskeie dele van die land steeds droogtetoestande ervaar.
tgt: The recent rains should however not draw South Africans into a false sense of security as various parts of the country continue to experience drought conditions.

src: Die Regering het water uit die Sterkfonteindam na die Vaaldam oorgeplaas as 'n korttermynmaatreël om die situasie te help verlig en 'n bykomende R212-miljoen aan droogtehulp toegewys om boere in provinsies wat tot droogterampgebiede verklaar is te help.
tgt: Government has released water from the Sterkfontein Dam to Vaal Dam as a short term measure to help ease the situation and made an additional R212-million available in drought aid to support farmers in provinces that have been declared drought disaster areas.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om kennis te neem van die uitwerking wat hul optrede op die omgewing het en om alles moontlik te doen om water te bespaar.
tgt: Cabinet calls on South Africans to be conscious of the impact their actions have on the environment and do all they can to save water.

src: Internasionale graderingsagentskappe Moody’s, Fitch en Standard and Poors sal binne die volgende paar weke hul besluit oor die land se beleggingsgraderingskoers bekend maak.
tgt: International ratings agencies Moody’s, Fitch and Standard and Poors will in the coming weeks announce their decision on the country’s investment rating grade.

src: Die Regering het met die sakesektor, burgerlike samelewing en arbeid saamgewerk om die land se planne tot konkrete optrede om te skakel, wat sal verseker dat Suid-Afrika 'n beleggingsgegradeerde land bly.
tgt: Government has been working with business, civil society and labour to translate the country’s plans into concrete actions that will ensure South Africa remains an investment grade country.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle sektore om saam met die Regering 'n verenigde front te bied om ons land se beleggingstatus te beskerm.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all sectors to join government in a united front to protect our country’s investment status.

src: Die vrystelling van die Ouditeur-Generaal, Kimi Makwetu, se 2015/16-ouditresultate van die nasionale en provinsiale departemente en hul entiteite, herbeklemtoon hoe belangrik dit is om die volgende basiese beginsels behoorlik en konsekwent uit te voer: die deurvoer van planne om gebreke in finansiële beheermaatreëls aan te vul op grond van verbintenisse wat reeds gemaak is die voorsiening van doeltreffende leierskap en monitering van die bereiking van prestasieteikens en die hersiening en monitering van die nakoming van sleutelwetgewing en wetgewing oor finansiële aangeleenthede.
tgt: The release of the 2015/16 audit results by the Auditor-General, Kimi Makwetu of national and provincial departments and their entities underscores the importance of performing the following basics properly and consistently: implementing plans to address deficiencies in financial controls based on commitments already made providing effective leadership and monitoring achievement of performance targets and reviewing and monitoring compliance with key laws and legislation over financial matters.

src: Die ouditresultate van nasionale geouditeerdes het 'n algehele verbetering van 8% getoon 30% van die geouditeerdes het skoon ouditresultate gehad en 14% was óf uitstaande, óf weerhoudings óf het negatiewe ouditresultate gehad.
tgt: Audit outcomes of national auditees showed an overall improvement of 8 per cent 30 per cent of the auditees had a clean audit status and 14 per cent were either outstanding, disclaimed or had adverse opinions.

src: Op provinisiale vlak het die meeste departemente bevindings oor die nakoming van sleutelwetgewing en die gehalte van hul jaarlikse prestasieverslae gekry.
tgt: The provincial level showed that the majority of departments had findings on compliance with key legislation and on the quality of their annual performance reports.

src: Die Kabinet neem met kommer kennis van die risiko's en uitdagings wat in die ouditresultate uitgelig word.
tgt: Cabinet noted with concern the risks and challenges as highlighted in the audit results.

src: Dit verbind die Regering daartoe om die dringende vraagstukke wat geïdentifiseer is op te los en finansiële beheermaatreëls vir beter ouditresultate te versterk.
tgt: It has committed government to address the pressing issues that have been identified and strengthen financial controls towards better audit outcomes.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die ongeveer 11 000 afgevaardigdes wat aan die 19de AfricaCom- konferensie in Kaapstad tussen 15 en 17 November deelgeneem het met die tema “Harnessing the transformative power of Africa’s digital revolution: the internet as an engine for economic development and social empowerment”.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the approximately 11 000 delegates who are participating at the 19th AfricaCom conference which is being held in Cape Town from 15 to 17 November 2016 under the theme “Harnessing the transformative power of Africa’s digital revolution: the internet as an engine for economic development and social empowerment”.

src: Die konferensie is deur die Minister van Telekommunikasie en Posdienste, Dr Siyabonga Cwele, toegespreek.
tgt: The conference was addressed by Minister of Telecommunications and Postal Services Dr Siyabonga Cwele and had over 350 speakers.

src: AfricaCom het 'n breë platform geword vir die bevordering van die digitale ekonomie in Afrika vir sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling en bemagtiging ter ondersteuning van Afrika se Agenda 2063-program.
tgt: AfricaCom has become a broad platform in developing the digital economy in Africa for socio-economic development and empowerment in support of Africa’s Agenda 2063 programme.

src: Die konferensie lok leiers in IKT, entrepreneurs en innoveerders uit Afrika en besluitnemers uit meer as 140 lande.
tgt: The conference attracts leaders of ICT, entrepreneurs and innovators from Africa and decision makers from over 140 countries.

src: Vanjaar se konferensie het gefokus op die ontwikkeling van digitale vaardighede, die bemagtiging van vroue in tegnologie, tegnologie om gestremdhede te verlig en die ondersteuning van die African Tech Start-up Ecosystem.
tgt: This year’s conference focused on digital skills development, empowering women in technology, technology to tackle disabilities and supporting the African Tech Start-up Ecosystem.

src: Dit het 'n middel voorsien om die doelwitte van die NOP te bereik met betrekking tot digitale transformasie, ekonomiese ontwikkeling en maatskaplike bemagtiging.
tgt: This provided a vehicle to realise the objectives of the NDP in terms of digital transformation, economic development and social empowerment.

src: Die Kabinet is verheug dat baie studente in hoëronderwysinstellings regoor die land positief gereageer het op oproepe om die 2016 akademiese program te red.
tgt: Cabinet is pleased that many students in higher education institutions across the country have responded positively to calls to save the 2016 academic programme.

src: 'n Aantal instellings het met hul finalejaar-eksamens begin.
tgt: A number of institutions have started their final year examinations.

src: Ons moedig studente aan om op die voltooiing van hul studies te bly fokus en die Kommissie van Ondersoek na die Lewensvatbaarheid van Gratis Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding die geleentheid te bied om sy werk af te handel.
tgt: We encourage students to remain focused on completing their studies and allow the Commission into the Feasibility of Fee-Free Higher Education and Training to complete its work.

src: Die werk wat deur die Nasional Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling- en Arbeidsraad (Nedlac) gedoen word, word erken, waar die Nasionale Tesourie voorstelle ingedien het oor hoe ons gratis onderwys vir tersiêre studente kan bewerkstellig.
tgt: The work undertaken through NEDLAC is acknowledged, where the National Treasury presented proposals on how we could realise free education for tertiary students.

src: 'n Verklaring hieroor sal teen die einde van November 2016 gefinaliseer word.
tgt: A declaration will be finalised at the end of November 2016.The call by national church leaders and other faith leaders for solutions to the challenges in higher education are most welcome.

src: Die oproep deur nasionale kerkleiers en ander godsdiensleiers om oplossings vir die uitdagings in hoër onderwys te vind word verwelkom.
tgt: Their support in mediation, prayer and peace efforts, along with their call for the 2016 academic year to be successfully concluded are welcomed.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die beslissing van die Konstitusionele Hof oor die Elektroniese Nasionale Verkeersinligtingstelsel (eNATIS), wat nou deur die Regering geadministreer sal word.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the Constitutional Court decision on the Electronic National Traffic Information System (eNATIS) which will now be administered by government.

src: Ons het ook kennis geneem van die uitspraak van die Konstitusionele Hof dat die aansoek deur Terry Crawford-Browne om die wapentransaksie-kommissie ter syde te stel, nie in die belang van geregtigheid is nie.
tgt: We also noted the Constitutional Court Ruling that the application by Terry Crawford-Browne, to have the arms deal commission set aside, was not in the interest of justice.

src: Die Seriti Kommissie van Ondersoek wat die 1999- multimiljardrand-transaksie ondersoek het, het bevind dat daar geen bewyse van korrupsie, bedrog of onreëlmatighede ten opsigte van enige van die kontrakte was nie.
tgt: The Seriti Commission of Inquiry that probed the 1999 multi-billion-rand deal found that there was no evidence that any of the contracts were tainted by evidence of corruption, fraud or irregularities, this report was released by President Jacob Zuma in April 2016.

src: Die Kabinet is bekommerd oor die aanhitsing van rassespanning en -geweld deur openbare figure, wat afbreuk doen aan ons duur verworwe vryheid.
tgt: Cabinet is concerned at the incitement of racial tensions and violence by public figures which detracts from our hard won freedom.

src: Suid-Afrikaners moet negatiewe invloede soos die rassistiese aanranding van Rethabile Mlotshwa veroordeel dit benadeel ons mede-Suid-Afrikaners en dra nie by tot ubuntu in ons land nie.
tgt: South Africans must condemn detrimental influences such as the racist assault of Rethabile Mlotshwa which only serves to harm our fellow South Africans and does not add to the Ubuntu of our nation.

src: Ons moet ook steeds wet en orde respekteer en ons uitspreek teen ongrondwetlike oproepe om grond in ons gemeenskappe onregmatig te beset.
tgt: We should also continue to respect the rule of law and speak out against unconstitutional calls to illegally occupy land in our communities.

src: Die Kabinet respekteer die bedanking van mnr Brian Molefe as Groep Uitvoerende Beampte van Eskom en wens hom alles van die beste toe vir die toekoms.
tgt: Cabinet respects the resignation of Mr. Brian Molefe as Group Chief Executive of Eskom and wishes him well in his future endeavours.

src: MnrMolefe het meegewerk tot die ontwikkeling van Eskom se omkeerstrategie, wat nou begin om positiewe resultate te toon.
tgt: Mr. Molefe has been instrumental in developing Eskom’s turnaround strategy which is beginning to yield positive results.

src: Die Kabinet vertrou dat hy 'n sterk bestuurspan agterlaat wat steeds Eskom se mandaat en die deurvoer van die omkeerstrategie gestand sal doen.
tgt: Cabinet is confident that he has left behind a strong executive team who will continue to deliver on Eskom’s mandate and implementation of the turnaround strategy.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die bewerings in 'n dokumentêre program op Al Jazeera teen die Minister van Staatsveiligheid, mnrDavid Mahlobo, en merk op dat die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens die bewerings ondersoek.
tgt: Cabinet noted the allegations in an Al Jazeera documentary against Minister of State Security, Mr David Mahlobo, and noted that the South African Police Services are investigating the allegations.

src: Die Kabinet beklemtoon dat die Regering aan die voorpunt van die stryd teen omgewingsmisdaad is.
tgt: Cabinet highlighted that government has been at the forefront in the fight against environmental crimes, this includes work done within the security services as part of government’s efforts to curb transnational organised crime and to ensure that justice prevails against those involved in syndicates.

src: Die Minister van Finansies, Pravin Gordhan, wat tydens die 2016 Sunday Times Top 100 Companies Awards deur Suid-Afrikaners se nywerheidsleiers erken is.
tgt: Finance Minister, Pravin Gordhan who was recognised at the 2016 Sunday Times Top 100 Companies Awards by South Africa’s captains of industry.

src: Hierdie erkenning deur die sakegemeenskap is 'n bewys dat ons almal saam die nodige wilskrag het om Suid-Afrika in 'n beter plek te omskep.
tgt: This acknowledgement by the business community signals that we are in this together, and that collectively we have the will to change South Africa into a better place.

src: Die gesamentlike pogings deur die Regering, die sakesektor, arbeid en die burgerlike samelewing kry al meer momentum ter verwesenliking van die NOP se Visie 2030.
tgt: The collective efforts of government, business, labour and civil society is moving onto higher trajectory to realising Vision 2030 of the NDFrancois Groepe who was re-appointed as the Deputy Governor of the South African Reserve Bank, by President Jacob Zuma, for a period of five years with effect from 1 January 2017.

src: Francois Groepe, wat deur President Jacob Zuma vir 'n vyfjaartydperk as die Adjunk-goewerneur van die Suid-Afrikaanse Reserwebank aangestel is met ingang van 1 Januarie 2017.
tgt: Gift of the Givers foundation founder Imtiaz Sooliman, who was awarded the Global Citizen Award by the international advisory firm Henley & Partners.

src: Dit lewer bewys dat Suid-Afrikaners ons land se naam hoog hou deur mense in nood onbaatsugtig by te staan.
tgt: This demonstrates that South African citizens are flying the flag high by giving so selflessly to people in need.

src: Uitvoerende Sjef, Martin Kobald, 'n uitmuntende Suid-Afrikaanse kookkunsvakman, wat tot vise-president van die World Association of Chefs Societies verkies is.
tgt: Executive Chef Martin Kobald, a culinary extraordinaire in South Africa, who has been elected as vice -president of the World Association of Chefs Societies.

src: Afrika se groenste hotel, Hotel Verde, wat by Kaapstad Internasionale Lughawe geleë is, is tydens die 15de jaarlikse Skål International Sustainable Tourism Awards wat in Monaco gehou is, aangewys as die internasionale wenner in die kategorie vir Stedelike Akkommodasie.
tgt: Africa’s Greenest Hotel, Hotel Verde situated at Cape Town International Airport was voted the global winner in the Urban Accommodation category during the 15th annual Skål International Sustainable Tourism Awards, held in Monaco.

src: Suid-Afrika se Sewes-rugbyster Seabelo Senatla, wat as Wêreldrugby se manlike Sewes-speler van die Jaar aangewys is vir sy uitmuntende prestasies in 2016.
tgt: South African Sevens star Seabelo Senatla, who was named World Rugby Men's Sevens Player of the Year for his stellar performances in 2016.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse vleuel het 66 drieë in 10 wedstryde in die 2015/16-reeks aangeteken – die tweede hoogste in die 17 jaar van die reeks se bestaan.
tgt: The South African flyer crossed for 66 tries in 10 events in the 2015-16 series - the second-highest in the 17-year history of the series, this is an inspiration to young rugby players.

src: Dit is ook die tweede agtereenvolgende jaar dat Suid-Afrika die toekenning wen.
tgt: This is also the second year in a row that a South African has won the award.

src: Suid-Afrikaanse gouemedaljewenner, Wayde van Niekerk, wat deur die Vereniging van Nasionale Olimpiese Komitees as die manlike atleet van die Olimpiese Spele aangewys is tydens die toekenningseremonie in Doha.
tgt: South African gold medalist Wayde van Niekerk who was named male athlete of the Olympic Games by the Association of National Olympic Committee’s Awards which were held in Doha.

src: Brad Binder, wat sy titeloorwinning in Moto3 op 'n hoogtepunt afgesluit het met sy oorwinning in die laaste byeenkoms van die seisoen op die Valencia-renbaan in Spanje.
tgt: Brad Binder who capped off his title-winning Moto3 campaign with victory in the season finale at Valencia racing circuit in Spain.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Proteas geluk met hul Toetsreeksoorwinning oor Australië asook Bafana Bafana met hul oorwinning oor Senegal in 'n kwalifiserende wedstryd vir die Wêreldbeker-toernooi.
tgt: Cabinet congratulated the Proteas on their Test series victory over Australia as well as Bafana Bafana with their victory over Senegal in a World-Cup qualifier match.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Springbokke alles van die beste toe met hul wedstryd teen Italië en vertrou dat die nederlaag teen Engeland slegs die span sal aanvuur.
tgt: Cabinet wishes the Springboks well in their match against Italy and is confident that the defeat by England only serves to strengthen the team.

src: Die Kabinet bedank alle Suid-Afrikaners wat weereens agter ons nasionale spanne verenig het deur na die verskillende wedstryde te kyk en ons landsvlag se kleure of hul gunstelingspan se hemde te dra.
tgt: Cabinet thanks all South Africans who once again united behind our national teams by watching the various matches and wearing the colours of our flag or the shirt of their favourite team.

src: Kom ons gaan voort om ons gevoel van nasionale trots aan te gryp en te koester wanneer ons spanne die land se vlag omhoog laat wapper.
tgt: Let us continue to embrace and capture the sense of our national pride as our teams fly the country’s flag.

src: Die Kabinet sluit hom aan by President Jacob Zuma om Donald John Trump geluk te wens met sy verkiesing as die 45ste President van die Verenigde State van Amerika (VSA) en vertrou dat toekomstige betrekkinge tussen Suid-Afrika en die VSA tot albei lande se voordeel sal strek.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Jacob Zuma in congratulating Donald John Trump who was elected as the 45th President of the United States of America (USA) and is confident that future engagements between South Africa and the USA will be of benefit to both countries.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die betrokke klarings.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: M. S.Matebesi as Adjunk-direkteur-generaal: Korporatiewe Diensteb) Mnr T. Maruping as Adjunk-direkteur-generaal: Werkloosheidsversekeringsfonds.
tgt: Department of Labour:a) Mrs MSB Matebesi as Deputy Director General: Corporate Services, andb) Mr TS Maruping as Deputy Director General Unemployment Insurance Fund.

src: Me C. Duma as Adjunk-direkteur-generaal: Korporatiewe Dienste, Departement van Toerisme.
tgt: Ms CL Duma as Deputy Director General: Corporate Services at the Department of Tourism.

src: Mnr Ratshisusu, as Adjunk-kompetisiekommissaris.
tgt: Mr H Ratshisusu as Deputy Competition Commissioner.

src: Mnr Enver Daniels as die Adjunk-voorsitter van die Kompetisie-tribunaal.
tgt: Mr Enver Daniels as the Deputy Chairperson of the Competition Tribunal.

src: Prof Cheadle as 'n deeltydse lid van die Kompetisie-tribunaal.
tgt: ProfH Cheadle as a part time member of the Competition Tribunal.

src: Me die einde van die jaar in sig, gedenk die Kabinet saam met die res van Suid-Aftrika die derde herdenking van Nelson Mandela se afsterwe op 5 Desember 2013.“Ons daaglikse optrede as gewone Suid-Afrikaners moet ’n wesenlike Suid-Afrikaanse realiteit skep wat die mensdom se geloof in geregtigheid sal versterk, vertroue in die edelheid van die menslike siel sal verskerp en alle hoop vir ’n glorieryke lewe vir almal sal handhaaf.” – Nelson Mandela Madiba het die waardes van ons grondwet en die visie van 'n vrye, regverdige en verenigde volk wat die grondslag vorm van die samelewing waarvoor ons moet werk, WEBTOKEN dit te kan bereik, moet Suid-Afrikaners deur 'n gedeelde visie van 'n beter samelewing verenig word.
tgt: As the year closes, Cabinet joins South Africans in commemorating the third anniversary of Nelson Mandela's passing on 5 December 2013.“Our daily deeds as ordinary South Africans must produce an actual South African reality that will reinforce humanity’s belief in justice, strengthen its confidence in the nobility of the human soul, and sustain all our hopes for a glorious life for all.” – Nelson MandelaMadiba subscribed to the values of our Constitution and the vision of a free, just and united nation that underpins the society that we must work towards.

src: Die Kabinet loof die doeltreffende vennootskap van Team South Africa – wat uit regeringsgeledere, die sakesektor, die arbeidsektor en ander Suid-Afrikaners saamgestel is – vir hul samewerking om Suid-Afrika se beleggingsgradering te beveilig.
tgt: Implementation of government programmesSouth African Economy Cabinet commends the effective partnership of Team South Africa – constituted by government, business, labour and all South Africans – for working together to safeguard South Africa’s investment rating.

src: Deur hul harde werk en verenigde optrede is die ekonomie en beleggersvertroue in hierdie moeilike ekonomiese tye gestabiliseer.
tgt: Through hard work and unified action, the economy and investor confidence has been stabilised in these difficult economic times.

src: President Jacob Zuma het Team SA aangevoer om verskillende sektore te laat saamwerk ten einde ons ekonomie weer te laat opvlam, belegging te lok en werksgeleenthede te skep.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma initiated Team SA to get different sectors to work together to reignite our economy, attract investment and create jobs for our people.

src: Hierdie positiewe ontwikkelings behoort ons aan te spoor om selfs harder te werk om Suid-Afrika vorentoe te laat beweeg.
tgt: These positive developments should motivate us to work even harder to move South Africa forward.

src: Moody’s Investor Services, Fitch Ratings en Standard & Poor’s het Suid-Afrika se soewereine skuldkredietstatus bó sub-beleggingstatus gehou.
tgt: Moody’s Investor Services, Fitch Ratings and Standard & Poor’s kept South Africa's sovereign debt credit rating status above sub-investment grade.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van agentskappe se besorgdheid oor sekere kwessies en ons bespoedig saam met ons maatskaplike vennote bepaalde ingrypings om die ekonomie te verbeter.
tgt: Concerns raised by the agencies have been noted and together with our social partners we are fast tracking interventions to turnaround the economy.

src: Die Kabinet is steeds vol vertroue dat die pad wat in die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP) uiteengesit word, asook die Regering se beplande fiskale konsolidasie en die implementering van die Negepuntplan, Suid-Afrika sal help om 'n beleggingsgraadland te bly.
tgt: Cabinet remains confident that the path set out in the National Development Plan (NDP) and government’s planned fiscal consolidation, together with the implementation of the Nine-Point Plan, will help South Africa remain an investment-grade country.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis dat Suid-Afrika se bruto binnelandse produk (BBP) in die derde kwartaal met 0.2% gegroei het.
tgt: Cabinet notes that South Africa’s gross domestic product (GDP) grew by 0.2% in the third quarter.

src: Die vernaamste bydraers tot BBP-groei was die mynbou-en-steengroefsektor, finansies, vaste eiendom en sakedienste, en algemene regeringsdienste.
tgt: The main contributors to GDP growth were the mining and quarrying sector, finance, real estate and business services, and general government services.

src: Die landbou, bosbou en visseryesektor het met -0.3% gekrimp, vervaardiging met -3.2% elektrisiteit, gas en water met -2.9% en handel, spyseniering en akkommodasie met -2.1%.
tgt: The agriculture, forestry and fishing sector contracted by -0.3% manufacturing by -3.2% electricity, gas and water by -2.9% and trade, catering and accommodation by -2.1%.

src: Die droogte is steeds die belangrikste bydraende faktor tot die daling in die landbousektor.
tgt: Drought is still the largest contributor to the decline in the agriculture sector.

src: Die oorhandiging van titelaktes aan vyf Bahurutshe-gemeenskappe deur die Minister van Landelike Ontwikkeling en Grondhervorming, mnrGugile Nkwinti, is een van die grootste grondeise wat by Motsane Wildsplaas buite Zeerust in Noordwes bygelê is.
tgt: The handover of title deeds to five Bahurutshe communities by the Minister of Rural Development and Land Reform, Mr Gugile Nkwinti, is one of the biggest land claims to be settled at Motsane Game Farm outside Zeerust in the North West.

src: Mer as 54 280 hektaar, wat 'n wildsplaas insluit, word herstel.
tgt: More than fifty-four thousand (54 280) hectares of land, which includes a game farm, is being restored.

src: Die bekendstelling van die loodsprojek van die Beleidsraamwerk oor die Versterking van die Relatiewe Regte van Mese wat die Grond Bewerk (50/50-beleid) vir Noordwes by die Stars Away Farm in Ottoshoop, Zeerust, volg op 'n ooreenkoms ingevolge waarvan plaaswerkers en die boer mede-eienaars van die boerderyonderneming sal word.
tgt: Also, the launch of the pilot project of the Policy Framework on Strengthening the Relative Rights of People Working the Land (50/50 policy) for North West at the Stars Away Farm in Ottoshoop, Zeerust, follows the conclusion of an agreement which will see farmworkers and the farmer become co-owners of the farming enterprise.

src: Waterinfrastruktuur is deel van die Regering se Nasionale Infrastruktuurplan om die ekonomiese landskap te transformeer en terselfdertyd werksgeleenthede te skep en die lewering van basiese dienste te verbeter.
tgt: Water infrastructure is part of government’s National Infrastructure Plan to transform our economic landscape while creating new jobs and strengthening the delivery of basic services.

src: Die bekendstelling van die Mokolo- en Krokodilrivier (Wes) Wateraanvullingsprojek lewer bewys van die Regering se verbintenis om sy mense se behoeftes te voorsien.
tgt: The launch of the Mokolo and Crocodile River (West) Water Augmentation Project demonstrates government’s commitment to respond to the needs of citizens.

src: Die wateroordraginfrastruktuur voorsien water aan die Lephalale Plaaslike Munisipaliteit, Eskom se kragstasies (Matimba en Meupi), die Zeeland-watersuiweringsaanleg, en Exxaro se Grootegelukmyn.
tgt: The water transfer infrastructure supplies water to the Lephalale Local Municipality, Eskom's power stations (Matimba and Medupi), the Zeeland water treatment plant, and Exxaro's Grootegeluk Mine.

src: Dit vervoer ook water vanaf die Krokodilrivierwes naby Thabazimbi na die Lephalale-gebied.
tgt: It also transfers water from the Crocodile River West near Thabazimbi to the Lephalale area.

src: Die Welgedacht Afloopwater-suiweringsaanleg naby Springs, Gauteng, is uitgebrei om die groter vraag na afloopwatersuiwering te WEBTOKEN die besoedeling in die Vaalrivierstelsel te verminder, het die Departement van Water en Sanitasie die Oranjeville Afloopwater-suiweringsaanleg in die Mesimaholo Distriksmunisipaliteit en die Leeuwkuil Afloopwater-suiweringsaanleg in die Emfuleni Distriksmunisipaliteit teen 'n koste van R44,4 miljoen opgeknap.
tgt: The Welgedacht Wastewater Treatment Works near Springs, Gauteng, underwent an extension to cope with the increased demand for wastewater WEBTOKEN order to alleviate the pollution in the Vaal River System, the Department of Water and Sanitation refurbished the Oranjeville Waste Water Treatment Plant in the Metsimaholo District Municipality and Leeuwkuil Waste Water Treatment Plant in the Emfuleni District Municipality at a cost of R.4 million.

src: Daarbenewens is meer as R300 miljoen opsygesit om 26 wanfunksionele afloopwater-suiweringsaanlegte in dele van Gauteng en die Vrystaat op te knap.
tgt: Also, over R300 million has been set aside to upgrade 26 dysfunctional waste water treatment works in parts of Gauteng and the Free State.

src: Die Kommissie van die Oranje-Senqurivieropvanggebied vergader vanaf 5 tot 9 Desember 2016 by Emperors Palace in Kemptonpark.
tgt: The Orange-Senqu River Basin Commission is currently underway from 5 to 9 December 2016 at Emperors Palace in Kempton Park.

src: Suid-Afrika, Lesotho, Botswana en Namibië is lidlande van die kommissie.
tgt: South Africa, Lesotho, Botswana and Namibia are the member countries to the commission.

src: Die kommissie sorg dat die bestuursraamwerk van die strategiese oorgrenswaterhulpbronne uitgevoer word met die oog op die langtermynontwikkelingsdoelwitte in die opvanggebied.
tgt: The commission implements the strategic trans-boundary water resources management framework and works towards the long-term development goals in the basin.

src: Die nuwe Pan-Afrikaplatform, Afrikahandelsweek 2016, het van 28 November tot 2 Desember plaasgevind met die tema: “Bevordering van Sosio-ekonomiese Strukturele Transformasie deur Intra-Afrikahandel”.
tgt: The new Pan-African platform, Africa Trade Week 2016 was held from 28 November to 2 December under the theme: “Advancing Socio-Economic Structural Transformation through Intra-Africa Trade”.

src: Dit het 'n omvattende, geïntegreerde en inklusiewe platform vir beleidsdialoog tussen verskeie handelsverwante belanghebbers verskaf.
tgt: This provided a comprehensive, integrated and inclusive platform for policy dialogue between various trade-related constituencies.

src: Die Minister van Handel en Nywerheid, dr Rob Davies, het oor die Vryhandelsgebied vir die Vasteland (CFTA) se onderhandelinge gepraat, wat tydens die Afrika-Unie (AU) se vergadering op 15 Junie 2016 in Suid-Afrika bekendgestel is.
tgt: The Minister of Trade and Industry, Dr Rob Davies, engaged on the Continental Free Trade Area (CFTA) Negotiations, which was launched during the African Union (AU) Assembly held in South Africa on 15 June 2015.

src: Die CFTA beoog om intra-Afrikahandel te bevorder en 'n geïntegreerde Afrika van eenmiljard mense en BBP van ongeveer 2,6 triljoen Amerikaanse dollar te bou.
tgt: The CFTA aims to boost intra-Africa trade and to build an integrated Africa of one billion people and GDP of approximately trillion US dollars.

src: Die tweede sitting van die Wetenskapforum Suid-Afrika word van 8 tot 9 Desember by die WNNR se Internasionale Konferensiesentrum in Pretoria gehou met die tema “Aanvuur van gesprekke oor wetenskap”.
tgt: The second edition of Science Forum South Africa is being held under the theme “Igniting conversations about science” from 8 to 9 December at the CSIR International Convention Centre.

src: Beleidmakers, studente, akademici en die publiek sal gesprek voer oor kwessies rakende wetenskap, tegnologie en innovering.
tgt: Scientists, policy-makers, students, academics and the public are engaging on pertinent issues around science, technology and innovation.

src: Die fokus is op geesteswetenskappe met debatte oor die minimumbestaansloon en die 60%-uitsaksyfer aan Suid-Afrikaanse universiteite.
tgt: The focus is on social sciences, and debates include the minimum living wage and the reported 60% dropout rate at South Africa’s universities.

src: Ander onderwerpe sluit in migrasie weens klimaatsverandering, openbare persepsies van geneties gemodifiseerde organismes, voedselsekerheid en hoe geesteswetenskappe Afrika se toekoms kan vorm.
tgt: Other topics include climate change-induced migration, public perceptions of genetically modified organisms, food security, and how social science can shape Africa’s future.

src: Die onlangse Nasionale Konferensie van die Suid-Afrikaanse Vereniging vir Plaaslike Regerings (SALGA) wat van 28 November tot 1 Desember 2016 gehou is, het afgesluit met 'n hernude verbintenis tot die Terugkeer na Basiese Beginsels-program en die bevordering van 'n inklusiewe lewenswyse deur die uitvoer van die Geïntegreerde StedelikeOntwikkelingsraamwerk (IUDF).
tgt: Local Government The recently held South African Local Government Association (SALGA) National Conference from 28 November to 1 December 2016 concluded with a recommitment to the Back to Basics programme and to promote inclusive living through the implementation of the Integrated Urban Development Framework (IUDF).

src: Die IUDF ondersteun die visie wat daarop gerig is om "leefbare, veilige, hulpbrondoeltreffende stede en dorpe te skep wat maatskaplik geïntegreerd, ekonomies inklusief en internasionaal mededingend is, en waar inwoners aktief aan die stadslewe kan deelneem".Aktivisme vir Geen Geweld teen Vroue en Kinders.
tgt: The IUDF espouses the vision of creating “liveable, safe, resource-efficient cities and towns that are socially integrated, economically inclusive and globally competitive, where residents actively participate in urban life”.

src: Die 2016-veldtog 16 Dae van Aktivisme vir Geen Geweld teen Vroue en Kinders met die tema: “Sluit my in: saam beweeg ons 'n nie-gewelddadige Suid-Afrika vorentoe”, is onlangs deur President Zuma van stapel gestuur.
tgt: The current 16 Days of Activism for No Violence against Women and Children 2016 campaign under the theme: “Count Me In: Together Moving a Non-Violent South Africa Forward”, launched by President Zuma, has set in motion the #365 days of Activism.

src: As deel van pogings om regeringsdienste vir almal, veral kwesbare mese, meer toeganklik te maak, is 'n hulpmiddel vir gestremdes by die 24-uur Beheersentrum vir Geslagsgebaseerde Geweld bekend gestel.
tgt: As part of broadening access of government services to all, especially those who are vulnerable, the launch of a disability enhancement tool for the 24-hour Gender-Based Violence (GBV) Command Centre will enable members of the deaf community to access and use the professional counselling services of the centre.

src: Die Kabinet herbeklemtoon sy veroordeling van alle handelinge van geweld wat deur vooroordeel aangevuur word.
tgt: Cabinet underscores its condemnation to any and all acts of violence motivated by prejudice.

src: Die Regering gee steeds aandag aan die veiligheid van lesbiese, gay, biseksuele, transgender- en intersekspersone.
tgt: Government continues to address the safety issues of lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and intersex persons.

src: Die Wetsontwerp op die Voorkoming en Bestryding van Haatmisdade en Haatspraak, wat in die oorlegplegingsfase is, sal afdwinging en vervolging versterk.
tgt: The Prevention and Combating of Hate Crimes and Hate Speech Bill, which is in the consultative phase, will strengthen enforcement and WEBTOKEThe World AIDS Day commemoration on 1 December 2016, under the theme “It is in our hands to end HIV and TB”, led by Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa, was boosted by the launch of new clinical trials for the HIV and AIDS vaccine known as HVTN 702.Cabinet applauds the South African scientists who are leading this critical research.

src: Die proefneming is een van die grootstes ter wêreld en getuig van die wetenskaplike en mediese gemeenskap se bekwaamheid.
tgt: The trial is one of the biggest in the world and bears testimony to the competency of the scientific and medical fraternity.

src: Die Regering sit sy vennootskap voort met alle belanghebbers – insluitend die Phila-vigsveldtog en die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Vigsraad – om 'n vigsvrye generasie te skep, nuwe MIV-infeksies te verhoed, die TB-epidemie te beëindig en alle Suid-Afrikaners aan te moedig om gesonde, verantwoordelike keuses te maak.
tgt: Government continues in its partnership with all stakeholders – including PHILA and the South African National AIDS Council – to achieve an AIDS-free generation, stop all new HIV infections, end the TB epidemic and encourage all our citizens to make healthy, responsible choices.

src: Suid-Afrika het sy mikpunte vir antiretrovirale (ARV) behandeling bereik en ons het nou die grootste ARV-program ter wêreld, met 3,4 miljoen mense wat in 2015 die behandeling ontvang het.
tgt: South Africa has achieved its targets for antiretroviral (ARV) treatment and we now have the largest ARV programme in the world, with million people on treatment in 2015.

src: Die mikpunt vir die voorkoming van moeder-na-kind-oordrag is bereik, met 'n beduidende daling van meer as 3,5% in 2010 tot 1,8% in 2014.
tgt: The prevention of mother-to-child transmission target was reached, with a marked decline from more than 3.5% in 2010 to 1.8% in 2014.

src: Seksuele oordrag van MIV onder die jeug tussen 15 en 24 jaar oud het van 410 000 in 2011 tot 330 000 in 2014 gedaal.
tgt: Sexual transmission of HIV among youth aged 15-24 years declined from 410 000 in 2011 to 330 000 in 2014.

src: TB-infeksies en TB-sterftes het gedaal, maar die mikpunt van 'n 50%-daling in TB-sterftes is nie bereik nie.
tgt: New TB infections and TB deaths declined, but the targets to achieve a 50% reduction in TB deaths were not reached.

src: Mer as 800 miljoen manskondome en meer as 20 miljoen vrouekondome is die afgelope finansiële jaar versprei.
tgt: Over 800 million male condoms and over 20 million female condoms were distributed in the last financial year.

src: Gedurende die MIV-toetsingsveldtog is meer as 35 miljoen MIV-toetse oor 'n vyfjaartydperk gedoen.
tgt: The HIV-testing campaign saw 35 million HIV tests done over the five-year period.

src: Suid-Afrika het meer as 300 GeneXpert-masjiene landswyd ontplooi en meer as 2,1 miljoen GeneXpert-toetse is uitgevoer.
tgt: South Africa has over 300 GeneXpert machines deployed countrywide and over million GeneXpert tests have been conducted.

src: Suid-Afrika het in 2016 die universele toets-en-behandelingsprogram in werking gestel, waarvolgens alle MIV-positiewe mense behandeling kry, ongeag hul CD4-seltellings.
tgt: In 2016 South Africa implemented the universal test and treat programme where every HIV-positive person is put on treatment regardless of their CD4 cell count.

src: 'n Vergadering van SAOG-ministers wat vir rampbestuur verantwoordelik is, is op 26 November 2016 in Mauritius gehou onder die voorsitterskap van die Minister van Koöperatiewe Regering en Tradisionele Sake, mnrDes Van Rooyen.
tgt: Disaster Management A meeting of SADC Ministers responsible for disaster risk management took place on 26 November 2016 in Mauritius chaired by the Minister of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, Mr Des Van Rooyen.

src: Die vergadering het die strategie vir streeksrampweerbaarheid- en respons goedgekeur en 'n taakspan op die been gebring om die voorstel vir ’n rampweerbaarheid- en responsfonds te finaliseer.
tgt: The meeting approved the Regional Disaster Preparedness and Response Strategy and set up a Task Force to finalise the proposal on the disaster preparedness and response fund.

src: Die SAOG-sekretariaat sal 'n gesamentlike vergadering van die ministers wat vir rampbestuur en finansies verantwoordelik is, belê om die voorgestelde rampweerbaarheid en responsfonds te bespreek.
tgt: The SADC secretariat will convene a joint meeting of Ministers for Disaster Management and Finance to consider the proposed disaster preparedness and response fund.

src: Jeug.
tgt: Youth.

src: As deel van die program om jong mense te ontwikkel, is die vyfde Nasionale Jeugkamp by 3 Suid-Afrikaanse Infanteriebataljon naby Kimberley in die Noord-Kaap deur die Departement van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling en Die Departement van Verdediging en Militêre Veterane geopen, met die tema #40YearsOn – Youth still moving South Africa forward.
tgt: As part of the programme to develop young people, the fifth national Youth Camp at the 3 South African Infantry Battalion, was opened next to Kimberley in the Northern Cape by the departments of Social Development and Defence and Military Veterans, under the theme #40YearsOn – Youth still moving South Africa forward.

src: Dit bring 1 000 jong mense vanuit verskillende rasse-, geslag-, klas- en taalgroepe uit al die provinsies byeen met die oog op die bevordering van ’n nasionale identiteit, nasiebou, maatskaplike samehorigheid, patriotisme en aktiewe burgery onder Suid-Afrika se jeug.
tgt: This brings together 1 000 young people across race, ethnicity, gender, class and language from all provinces with a view to promote national identity, nation-building, social cohesion, patriotism and active citizenry among young people of South Africa.

src: Hulle sal die talle uitdagings wat die jeug in die gesig staar tydens die jeugkamp bespreek.
tgt: Discussions will be held around the many challenges they face as youth.

src: Sedert die eerste Nasionale Jeugkamp in 2012 het die jong deelnemers verskeie projekte wat op ontwikkeling gerig is in hul gemeenskappe onderneem.
tgt: Since the first National Youth Camp in 2012, youth participants have undertaken a number of projects in their communities aimed at bringing about development.

src: Die jeugkamp bied aan jong mense, wat nou in eie reg leiers in hul gemeenskappe is, die geleentheid om hul ervarings met ander jong mense te deel.
tgt: The Youth Camp provides an opportunity for young people, who are now leaders in their own right in their communities, to share their experiences with other youth.

src: Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan.
tgt: National Development Plan.

src: Die NOP is 'n langtermynvisie en -plan wat as bloudruk dien vir die werk wat gedoen moet word om teen 2030 'n welvarende samelewing vir Suid-Afrika te skep.
tgt: The NDP is a long-term vision and plan that serves as a blueprint for the work that needs to be done to achieve a prosperous society for South Africa by 2030.

src: Die kernprioriteite van die NOP is om armoede, werkloosheid en ongelykheid te verminder.
tgt: The core priorities of the NDP are to reduce poverty, unemployment and inequality.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle sektore van die samelewing, insluitend die sakesektor, arbeid en die burgerlike samelewing, om by te dra tot die bevordering van die NOP se handelsmerkidentiteit.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all sectors of society, business, labour and civil society to play their part in advancing the brand identity of the NDP by highlighting the implementation of the NDP through co-branding initiatives that are catalytic in implementing the plan.

src: Dit kan gedoen word deur die implementering van die NOP uit te lig deur wedersydse handelsmerkaktiwiteite wat as katalisator vir die implementering van die plan sal dien.
tgt: Cabinet undertook a photoshoot to symbolise a call to action that sees all sectors of society using the NDP brand identity.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet ondersteun die Minister van Vervoer, me Dipuo Peters, in haar opdrag aan die Transnet Nasionale Haweowerheid, ingevolge artikel 79, subartikel (1) van die Nasionale Hawewet, 2005 (Wet 12 van 2005).
tgt: Cabinet supports the Minister of Transport, Ms Dipuo Peters, in directing Transnet National Ports Authority, in terms of Section 79, subsection (1) of the National Ports Act, 2005 (Act 12 of 2005), to amend the Terminal Operator’s Agreement to allow the Strategic Fuel Fund to handle cargoes of Liquefied Petroleum Gas at the Port of Saldanha Bay.

src: Dit behels die wysiging van die Terminaaloperateursooreenkoms om die Strategiese Brandstoffonds toe te laat om vragte vloeibare petroleumgas by die Saldanhabaaihawe te hanteer.
tgt: The Strategic Fuel Funds current lease and license will also be extended with a minimum of 25 years to provide commercial and operational certainty for sustainable investment in the oil and gas sector.

src: Die Strategiese Brandstoffonds se huidige huurkontrak en lisensie sal ook met minstens 25 jaar verleng word om kommersiële en operasionale sekerheid vir volhoubare investering in die olie-en-gassektor te verseker.
tgt: This is in line with government priorities relating to Operation Phakisa on growing the Oceans Economy and broader goals outlined in the NDP, to promote economic growth and to boost job creation.

src: Dit is in ooreenstemming met die Regering se prioriteite wat met Operasie Phakisa verband hou, naamlik om die Oseane-ekonomie te ontwikkel en breër doelwitte wat in die NOP uiteengesit word te bevorder, ten einde ekonomiese groei te verbeter en werkskepping aan te moedig.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the status of the Acid Mine Drainage “Emergency Works” project that was implemented as a short-term solution for Acid Mine Drainage mitigation in the Witwatersrand goldfields.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die status van die “Noodwerke”-projek vir dreinering van suur mynwater, 'n korttermynoplossing om suur mynwater in die Witwatersrandse goudvelde te dreineer.
tgt: A long-term solution will be implemented in line with recommendations set down by the Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC).Being a water-scarce country, the Acid Mine Drainage project capitalises on water conservation and reuse, ensuring the provision of adequately treated drinking water and a move away from the sole reliance on clean water in industrial applications.

src: Die projek verlig ook besoedeling en ander negatiewe uitwerkings.
tgt: Further, the project also mitigates pollution and other negative impacts.

src: Die Kabinet het die Nasionale Sanitasiebeleid, 2016 vir implementering goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the National Sanitation Policy, 2016 for implementation.

src: Dit volg op 'n omvattende tydperk van oorlegpleging vir insette.
tgt: This follows an extensive period of consultation for inputs.

src: Ingevolge die beleid is mense se welsyn die middelpunt van ontwikkeling dit is toekomsgerig wat betref beter dienslewering, innovering en toepaslike tegnologie om volhoubaarheid vir die verbetering van arm mense se lewensgehalte te verseker.
tgt: The policy places the well-being of people at the centre of development and is forward looking in terms of improved levels of services, innovation and appropriate technology to ensure sustainability to improve the lives of the poor.

src: Die Kabinet keur die vrystelling van die Nasionale Misdaadstatistiekverslag vir die eerste twee kwartale van 2016/17 deur die Minister van Polisie, mnrNkosinathi Nhleko, goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the release of the National Crime Statistics report for the first two quarters of 2016/17, by the Minister of Police, Mr Nkosinathi Nhleko.

src: Die kwartaallikse vrystellings stel die Regering in staat om sleutelmikpunte te monitor, in die besonder die vermindering van gerapporteerde ernstige misdade soos in die Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk uiteengesit.
tgt: The quarterly releases enables government to monitor key targets, in particular the reduction of reported serious crimes, as set out in the MTSF and could be used as early warning to strengthen the crime-prevention operations and strategies of various government departments.

src: Minister Nhleko sal hierdie misdaadstatistiek voor 31 Januarie 2017 bekend maak.
tgt: Minister Nhleko will release these crime statistics before 31 January 2017.

src: Die Kabinet het die Land se Tweede Verslag oor die Implementering van die Afrika-handves oor die Regte en Welsyn van die Kind (Kinderhandves) goedgekeur vir voorlegging aan die Afrika-Unie (AU) in Januarie 2017.Die Kinderhandves is in 1990 deur die AU aanvaar en is 'n omvattende instrument wat regte uiteensit en universele beginsels en norme vir die status van kinders omskryf.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Second Country Report on the implementation of the African Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child (Children’s Charter) for submission to the AU in January 2017.The Children's Charter was adopted by the African Union in 1990 and is a comprehensive instrument that sets out rights and defines universal principles and norms for the status of children.

src: Die land se tweede verslag gee 'n uiteensetting van die vordering wat gemaak is met die implementering van 'n suite van regeringswye beleide en wetgewing om kinderregte te bevorder, te beskerm en te verwesenlik.
tgt: The Second Country Report outlines progress made on the implementation of a suite of government-wide policies and legislation to promote, protect and realise children’s rights.

src: Die verslag erken ook deurlopende en progressiewe pogings om die uitvoer van programme en projekte vir die bevordering van kinders se regte te versterk.
tgt: The report also recognises the continuous and progressive efforts to strengthen implementation of programmes and projects to promote the rights of children.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die uitkomste van die 17de Vergadering van die Konferensie van Partye (CoP17) van die Konvensie oor Internasionale handel in Bedreigde Spesies (CITES), wat van 24 September tot 5 Oktober in Suid-Afrika aangebied is.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the outcomes from the 17th Meeting of the Conference of Parties (CoP17) to the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES), which was hosted by South Africa from 24 September to 5 October 2016.Parties agreed to measures and actions to be implemented within the mandate of the Convention to ensure legal international trade remains sustainable and illegal trade is eradicated.

src: Die partye het ingestem tot die implementering van maatreëls en optrede binne die mandaat van die konvensie om te verseker dat wettige internasionale handel volhoubaar bly en onwettige handel uitgewis word.
tgt: Parties also agreed to recognise that people need to benefit from the sustainable utilisation of its natural resources, including from legal international trade.

src: Partye het ook ooreengekom om te erken dat mense by die volhoubare benutting van hul natuurlike hulpbronne moet baat, insluitend dié uit wettige internasionale handel.
tgt: Cabinet approved South Africa’s negotiating positions for the 13th Meeting of the CoP to the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD COP13) and its protocols to be held in Cancun, Mexico from 4 to 17 December 2016.CBD COP13 will consider the following key issues: Resource Mobilisation Mainstreaming and the Integration of Biodiversity within and across sectors and Marine and Coastal Biodiversity.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die Regering se vordering in reaksies op die aanvalle op buitelandse burgers en die oplossing van die kernoorsake van die probleem.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on progress made by government in responding to the attacks on foreign nationals and addressing the root causes.

src: Onder leiding van die Interministeriële Komitee oor Migrasie het die Regering Operasie Fiela geïmplementeer, wat die geweld onder beheer gebring het.
tgt: Guided by the IMC on Migration, government implemented Operation Fiela, which brought the violence under control.

src: Altesaam 702 operasies is tussen 1 Julie en 30 September 2016 uitgevoer.
tgt: From 1 July to 30 September 2015, 702 operations were conducted, which led to 9 741 arrests of which 3 158 were of foreign WEBTOKEN on the root cause of the attacks determined that there was an increased competition for economic opportunities, resources and public services between foreign nationals and poor unemployed South Africans residing in townships and informal WEBTOKEN approval of the White Paper on International Migration is planned for March 2017, and will include the “First Safe Country” principle that will assist in managing refugees and asylum seekers.

src: Ondersoeke na die kernoorsake van die aanvalle het aan die lig gebring dat buitelandse burgers en arm, werklose Suid-Afrikaners wat in townships en informele nedersettings woon, toenemend meededing om ekonomiese geleenthede, hulpbronne en openbare dienste.
tgt: Cabinet was updated on implementation of the National Evaluation System detailed in the Annual Report on Evaluation 2016 to 2017 and also approved the sixth National Evaluation Plan 2017 to 2018.The National Evaluation System is being institutionalised across government and is building a body of evidence following 16 economic evaluations: six agricultural/ rural evaluations seven human settlements evaluations and an evidence map five children evaluations and four safety evaluations (with two additional safety evaluations starting).Cabinet reinforced that departments should allocate necessary funding for effective and efficient monitoring and evaluation to ensure the effectiveness and efficiency of programmes.

src: Die Nasionale Evalueringstelsel word regdeur die Regering geïnstitusionaliseer en dit ontwikkel bewysmateriaal op grond van 16 ekonomiese evaluasies: ses landbou/landelike evaluasies sewe menslikenedersetting-evaluasies en 'n bewyskaart vyf kinderevaluasies en vier veiligheidsevaluasies (met nog twee bykomende veiligheidsevaluasies wat in die beginfase is).Die Kabinet herbeklemtoon dat departemente die nodige befondsing vir doeltreffende monitering en evaluering moet toewys om die doeltreffendheid van programme te verseker.
tgt: Cybercrimes and Cybersecurity Bill of 2016, which strengthens the criminal justice system as envisaged in the NDP, by combatting cybercrime, establishing capacity to deal with cybersecurity and protecting critical information WEBTOKEN contributes towards building safer communities as envisaged in the National Development Plan.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die bevindings en aanbevelings van die studie wat deur die Departement van Staatsdiens en Administrasie onderneem is oor die geografiese toeganklikheid van Thusong-dienssentrums, die Regering se eenstopdienssentrums wat inligting en dienste aan gemeenskappe voorsien.
tgt: In this regard, government is committed to put in place measures to build confidence and trust in the secure use of Information Communications Technologies.

src: Die studie beveel 'n regverdiger verspreiding van sentrums aan en die saamgroepering van dienspunte van sleuteldepartemente om te verseker dat soveel mense moontlik toegang tot die dienste kan verkry, reisafstande en -koste verminder word en om die behoefte aan bykomende belegging in infrastruktuur te beperk.
tgt: Traditional Courts Bill of 2016, contributes to realising a developmental, capable and ethical state by regulating the role and functions of the institution of traditional leadership in the resolution of disputes, in accordance with the Constitution of South Africa.

src: Op 9 Desember 2016 sal die Regering, in vennootskap met die Verenigde Nasies (VN) se Kantoor vir Dwelms en Misdaad en die Universiteit van Suid-Afrika weereens die Internasionale Teenkorrupsiedag herdenk met die tema: “Verenig Teen Korrupsie”.
tgt: The national event to commemorate the Day of Reconciliation on Friday, 16 December 2016 under the theme “Bridging the Divide towards a Non-Racial Society”, will take place at Gopane Black Aces Ground, Zeerust in North West.

src: Korrupsie word deur 'n stel meganismes bestry, soos die Gedragskode vir die Staatsdiens die instelling van gespesialiseerde teenkorrupsie-eenhede soos die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens (SAPD) se Eenheid vir Georganiseerde Misdaad die Direktoraat vir Prioriteitsmisdade die Nasionale Vervolgingsgesag se Gespesialiseerde Handelsmisdaadeenheid die Batebeslagleggingseenheid en die Finansiële Intelligensiesentrum.
tgt: The deployment of police members and trainees at various malls across the country forms part of the Back-to-Basics approach of the SAPS to improve visibility, enhance policing and curb various crimes which tend to spike during the festive season.

src: Hulle pogings word deur die Gespesialiseerde Handelsmisdaadhowe en die skepping van die nasionale en sektorale teenkorrupsie-blitslyne versterk.
tgt: Cabinet urges all South Africans, in line with the responsibilities outlined in our NDP, to be part of the solution and ensure a safe and enjoyable festive season for WEBTOKEN South Africans take to the road to visit loved ones and family members, please be alert and ensure that vehicles are roadworthy.

src: In 2016 vier ons die 20ste herdenking van die ondertekening van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996 deur oud-President Nelson Mandela in Sharpeville op 10 Desember 1996.Die Grondwet het die grondslag vir 'n demokratiese en oop samelewing gelê, waarin die Regering op die wil van die mense gegrond is.
tgt: Adherence to the speed limit, wearing safety belts and not driving while under the influence are non-negotiables in ensuring your own safety and that of other people around you.

src: Dit is geïmplementeer deur bilaterale vergaderings met uitgesoekte regeringsministerieë, vergaderings met potensiële beleggers, gesprekke met verskeie handelskamers asook deelname aan nasionale skoue en toerismepromosiegeleenthede.
tgt: These included: AfricaCom Africa Internet Governance Forum COP17) to the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES) the 35th International Geological Congress the 21st International AIDS Conference and many others.

src: MnrAlvin P Rapea as die Sekretaris van Polisie.
tgt: Mr Siyabulela Tsengiwe as Chief Commissioner of the International Trade Administration Commission.

src: Implementering van Regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of Government Programmes.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom President Jacob Zuma se 2017-Staatsrede met die tema "Radikale Transformasie van die Ekonomie".
tgt: Cabinet welcomes President Jacob Zuma’s 2017 State of the Nation Address (SoNA) under the theme "Radical Transformation of the Economy”.

src: Dit is gelewer by die halfpadmerk van hierdie vyfde administrasie se ampstermyn waartydens 2017 as die Jaar van Oliver Reginald Tambo en die jaar van die versterking van eenheid verklaar is.
tgt: This was at the halfway mark of this Fifth Administration’s term of office which saw 2017 being declared the Year of Oliver Reginald Tambo and the year of deepening unity.

src: President Jacob Zuma het die vordering uiteengesit wat gemaak is om die visie van 'n nasionale demokratiese samelewing te verwesenlik en die belangrikste optrede wat nodig is om vinniger 'n verenigde, nie-rassige, nie-seksistiese, demokratiese en welvarende samelewing te bereik.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma outlined progress we are making in realising our vision of a National Democratic Society and the key actions required to move us closer and faster to a united, non-racial, non-sexist, democratic and prosperous society.

src: Die President het besin oor die implementering van die regering se program en het konkrete aksieplanne vir doeltreffende implementering van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan, wat die Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk 2014-2019 onderskryf, aangekondig.
tgt: The President reflected on the implementation of Government’s programme and announced concrete actionable plans for effective implementation of the National Development Plan, which underpins the Medium Term Strategic Framework (MTSF) 2014-2019.

src: Dit het duidelik uit die 2017-Staatsrede geblyk dat gekonsolideerde pogings deur die regering, die sakesektor en arbeid om die Negepuntplan te implementeer, reeds 'n uitwerking het.
tgt: SoNA 2017 clearly demonstrated that consolidated efforts by government, business and labour in implementing the Nine Point Plan are beginning to have an impact.

src: Die Kabinet benadruk die President se oproep om pogings te verskerp wat daarop gemik is om radikale ekonomiese transformasie te dryf, sowel as pogings om die implementering daarvan te versnel.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates the President’s call to intensify efforts aimed at driving radical economic transformation and efforts to fast-track implementation.

src: Ministers in die verskillende groeperings hou tans post-Staatsrede media-inligtingsessies om die regering se 2017/18-Program van Aksie deur te werk.
tgt: Cluster Ministers are in the process of post-SoNA media briefings to elaborate on Government’s 2017/18 Programme of Action.

src: Die 2017/18-Begrotingsrede sal die toekenning van hulpbronne aan die verskillende regeringsprogramme soos deur die President uitgelig, verder uitstippel.
tgt: The 2017/18 Budget Speech will further map out the allocation of resources to the various government programmes as highlighted by the President.

src: Die uitkomste van die konferensie oor Belegging in Afrika se Mynwese wat in Kaapstad gehou is, dui op die and se mededingende voordeel op die gebied van mynbou en verwante terreine.
tgt: The outcomes of the Investing in African Mining Conference that was held in Cape Town demonstrates the country’s competitive advantage in the areas of mining and related fields.

src: Die mynbousektor is steeds die hoeksteen van die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie dit dra 8% tot die land se BBP by, neem ongeveer 460 000 mense in diens en verdien buitelandse valuta.
tgt: The mining sector remains the cornerstone of the South African economy contributing 8 per cent to the country’s GDP, employing around 460 000 people and earning foreign exchange.

src: Suid-Afrika is steeds 'n produktiewe en bevredigende bestemming vir beleggers in mynbou met 'n geskatte $2,5 tot $3 triljoen in nie-energie mineralereserwes steeds in plek.
tgt: South Africa continues to be a productive and rewarding destination for investors in mining with an estimated $2.5 to 3 trillion in non-energy mineral reserves still in-situ.

src: Die wysigings tot die Wet op die Ontwikkeling van Minerale en Petroleum-hulpbronne teen Junie 2017 en die publikasie van die hersiene Mynbouhandves teen Maart 2017, dra by tot die skep van 'n bemagtigende regulerende omgewing, wat belegging, handel en ondernemingsontwikkeling op 'n billike en sosiaal verantwoordelike wyse aanmoedig.
tgt: The amendments to the Mineral and Petroleum Resources Development Act by June 2017 and gazetting of the revised Mining Charter by March 2017 contribute to the creation of an enabling regulatory environment which encourages investment, trade and enterprise development in an equitable and socially responsible manner.

src: Die konferensie is versterk deur Invest Africa wat 'n platform vir sakeleiers, beleggers en entrepreneurs bied om insig en blootstelling te kry aan inligting en geleenthede in Afrika.
tgt: The Indaba was bolstered by Invest Africa which is a platform for business leaders, investors and entrepreneurs to gain insight and exposure to information and opportunities from Africa.

src: Dit is ook bekend as die Voluntary Rebuilding Programme (VRP).Hierdie ooreenkoms stel maatskappyvlak-teikens vir transformasie, hetsy deur die verkoop van 'n minimum van 40% van die aandele aan swart Suid-Afrikaners of deur vennootskappe met kleiner konstruksiemaatskappye in swart besit, om hulle te help om hul omset tot 25% van die genoteerde maatskappy-omset te verhoog oor 'n tydperk van sewe jaar.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the Settlement Agreement reached between the construction industry and Government, also known as the Voluntary Rebuilding Programme (VRP).This Agreement sets company-level targets for transformation, either through the sale of a minimum of 40% of shares to black South Africans or through partnerships with smaller black-owned construction companies, to help increase their turnover to 25% of the listed company turnover, over a seven-year period.

src: Dit is die verreikendste sektor-ooreenkoms oor transformasie wat tot op datum met die regering gesluit is en kan help om uitvoering te gee aan die regering se visie van radikale ekonomiese transformasie.
tgt: This is the most far-reaching sector agreement on transformation reached with government to date and can help to give effect to Government's vision of radical economic transformation.

src: Dit is ook 'n model wat vir transformasie in ander sektore opgestel kan word.
tgt: It is also a model that can be drawn on for transformation in other sectors.

src: Die Kabinet wens die ondertekenaars van die ooreenkoms geluk en doen ’n beroep op alle ander konstruksiemaatskappye in die sektor wat nie tans partye tot die ooreenkoms is nie, om hierdie voorbeeld te volg en aan te sluit by die vennootskap.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the signatories to the agreement and urges all other construction companies in the sector who are not currently parties to the agreement, to follow this lead and join in the partnership that is being built, through making similar commitments in order to further boost the transformation of the sector.

src: Die Kabinet loof alle maatskaplike vennote by die Nasionale Ekonomiese, Ontwikkelings- en Arbeidsraad (Nedlac) vir die historiese ooreenkoms oor die bekendstelling van 'n nasionale minimum loon van R20 per uur met ingang van nie later nie as Me 2018 nie.
tgt: Cabinet applauds all social partners at the National Economic Development and Labour Council (Nedlac) on the historic agreement on the introduction of a National Minimum Wage of R20 an hour with effect from no later than May 2018.The agreement on a National Minimum Wage and other measures to strengthen labour stability and collective bargaining is an important step in creating a more equal, just and prosperous society as envisaged in the National Development Plan (NDP).The national minimum wage, which is a floor below which no worker may be paid, will significantly improve the lives of millions of low paid workers and begin to address the challenge of wage inequality.

src: Die ooreenkoms oor 'n nasionale minimum loon en ander maatreëls om arbeidstabiliteit en kollektiewe bedinging te versterk, is 'n belangrike stap in die skep van 'n meer gelyke, regverdige en voorspoedige samelewing in ooreenstemming met die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP).Die nasionale minimum loon, wat vasgestel is op 'n vlak waaronder geen werker betaal mag word nie, sal die lewens van miljoene laagbetaalde werkers aansienlik verbeter en is ’n begin om die uitdaging van loonongelykheid te pak.
tgt: The wage has been set at an initial level that will make a real difference in the lives of ordinary South Africans while minimising any adverse effects on employment.

src: Die loon is vasgestel op 'n aanvanklike vlak wat werklik 'n verskil in die lewens van gewone Suid-Afrikaners sal maak, terwyl dit enige nadelige uitwerking op indiensneming sal minimaliseer.
tgt: Businesses that are unable to afford the national minimum wage may apply for a temporary exemption, while measures are being considered to assist fragile sectors of the economy.

src: Die uitdaging van werkloosheid bly een van die regring se belangrikste prioriteite en alle programme en ingrypings is daarop gerig om dié situasie om te keer, veral in die moeilike ekonomiese omgewing.
tgt: The unemployment challenge remains a top government priority and all programmes and interventions are geared towards turning the situation around, especially in this tough economic environment.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die toename in werksgeleenthede in die vierde kwartaal van 2016 toe 235 000 werksgeleenthede, volgens die kwartaallikse arbeidsmagopname, geskep is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the increase in jobs in the economy over the fourth quarter of 2016 when 235 000 jobs were created, according to the Quarterly Labour Force Survey.

src: Die toename is grootliks te danke aan indienseming in die land se dienstesektor, gevolg deur vervoer en vervaardiging.
tgt: The increase was largely driven by employment in the country’s services sector, followed by transport and manufacturing.

src: Die toename in werksgeleenthede deur die kwartaal, het tot 'n effense afname in die werkloosheidsyfer tot 26,5%, gelei.
tgt: The growth in jobs over the quarter resulted in a slight decrease in the unemployment rate to 26.5%.

src: Die Kabinet bedank alle ouers, onderwysers, dosente en administrateurs vir die suksesvolle begin van die 2017 akademiese jaar.
tgt: Cabinet thanks all parents, teachers, lecturers and administrators on the successful start of the 2017 academic year.

src: Onderwys is een van ons belangrikste prioriteite en ’n deurslaggewende faktor in die bereiking van Visie 2030 van die NODie Kabinet prys die toewyding van die Klas van 2016 en is verheug oor die toename in die prestasiekoers van 70,7% tot 72,5% in 2016.
tgt: Education is one of our key priorities and central to achieving Vision 2030 of the National Development Plan (NDP).

src: Die Kabinet wens alle leerders alles van die beste toe en sien daarna uit dat die prestasiekoers in 2017 nog verder styg.
tgt: Cabinet commends the dedication of the Class of 2016 as we celebrate the achievement rate increase from per cent in 2015 to per cent in 2016.

src: Die Kabinet loof ook die deursettingsvermoë van die leerders wat tussen 11 Februarie en 18 Maart 2017 aanvullende matriekeksamens skryf.
tgt: Cabinet wishes all learners well and looks forward to further improvement in the achievement rate from the Class of 2017.Cabinet also commends the learners who will be sitting for the supplementary matric examination between 11 February 2017 and 18 March 2017 for their perseverance.

src: As deel van die regering se pogings om die gemeenskap aan te vuur om die reg op onderwys te beskerm, sal die Departement van Prestasiemonitering en -Evaluering die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan se Terugskooltoe-izimbizo op 25 Februarie 2017 in al die provinsies aanbied.
