tgt: As part of government efforts to galvanise society to protect the right to education, the Department of Performance Monitoring and Evaluation will convene the National Development Plan Back to School Izimbizo on 25 February 2017 in all provinces.

src: Onderwys is die grondslag vir alle regeringsprogramme en al die lede van die Uitvoerende Raad gaan deelneem.
tgt: Education is the foundation for all government programmes and all Members of the Executive will be WEBTOKEN members are invited to join members of Cabinet, Members of Parliament, Premiers and leaders in local government as they visit schools, tertiary institutions and other educational centres.

src: In ooreenstemming met die voorskrifte van die Vryheidsmanifes wat aanvoer dat "hoër onderwys en tegniese opleiding aan almal beskikbaar gemaak sal word met behulp van staatstoelaes en beurse, wat op grond van meriete toegeken word", befonds die regering deur middel van die Nasionale Studentehulpskema meer as 20 000 nuwe studente by 23 universiteite.
tgt: In line with the prescripts of the Freedom Charter that “higher education and technical training shall be opened to all by means of state allowances and scholarships awarded on the basis of merit”, Government through the National Student Financial Aid Scheme is funding more than 20 000 new students at 23 universities.

src: Dit is bykomend tot die 107 000 terugekerende studente van 25 universiteite en 737 747 terugkerende studente van 35 tegniese en beroepsonderwys- en opleidingskolleges.
tgt: This is in addition to the 107 000 returning students from 25 universities and 737 747 returning students from 35 Technical and Vocational Education and Training colleges.

src: Die regering gaan voort om verskeie modelle te verken in die soeke na volhoubare oplossings vir befondsing en om geleenthede vir die armes en die middelklas beskikbaar te stel om naskoolse onderwys en opleiding voort te sit.
tgt: Our government continues to explore various models in finding sustainable solutions to funding and opening up opportunities for the poor and the middle-class to pursue post school education and training.

src: Die Ikusasa Finansiële Bystandsprogram (ISFAP) is 'n innoverende openbare-private-vennootskap onder leiding van die Departement van Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding wat die studente in die "vermiste middelgroep" help.
tgt: The Ikusasa Student Financial Aid Programme (ISFAP) is an innovative public private partnership led by the Department of Higher Education and Training (DHET) that assists the “missing middle”.The project is being piloted with six universities and one technical and vocational education training (TVET) college and will be funding the studies of approximately 1 500 students studying in a number of general formative degrees, as well as seven professional qualifications and one artisan qualification for the duration of their studies.

src: Die projek word by ses universiteite en 'n tegniese en beroepsonderwys en -opleidingkollege geloods.
tgt: They will also receive academic support, social support, life skills training, mentoring and medical support where required.

src: Mer as R200 miljoen, wat hoofsaaklik uit die private sektor verkry sal word, sal nodig wees om die loodsprogram te laat slaag.
tgt: More than R200 million will be needed to enable the pilot to succeed and will mainly be sourced from the private sector.

src: Die Tweede Wêreldvaardighede-kompetisie van Suid-Afrika word vanaf 13 tot 17 Februarie 2017 deur die Departement van Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding by die Inkosi Albert Luthuli Internasionale Konferensiesentrum in Durban aangebied.
tgt: The second World Skills South Africa Competition which is being hosted by the Department of Higher Education and Training at the Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre in Durban from 13 to 17 February 2017, celebrates the talent of young artisans and technicians in the WEBTOKEN also serves as an advocacy programme to highlight the importance of the artisanal sector in the country’s economy.

src: Die wenners sal Suid-Afrika by die Internasionale Wêreld Vaardighede-kompetisie in Abu Dhabi in die Verenigde Arabiese Emirate in Oktober 2017 verteenwoordig.
tgt: Winners go on to represent South Africa at the World Skills International Competition in Abu Dhabi in the United Arab Emirates in October 2017.

src: President Jacob Zuma se onaangekondigde besoek aan die Nyanga Polisiestasie in Kaapstad het saamgeval met die vrystelling van die 2015/16 Opname oor Slagoffers van Misdaad deur Statistieke Suid-Afrika.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma’s unannounced visit to Nyanga Police station in Cape Town coincided with the release of the 2015/16 Victims of Crime Survey by Statistics South Africa.

src: Deur dié suksesvolle besoek, wat deel van die Presidensiële Siyahlola-moniteringsprogram is, is eerstehandse inligting ingewin oor die werk wat gedoen word om misdaad in die gebied te bestry.
tgt: The successful visit, as part of the Presidential Siyahlola Monitoring programme, gained first-hand account of work that is being done to fight crime in the area.

src: Departemente in die groepering vir Justisie, Misdaadvoorkoming en Sekuriteit gee tans aandag aan uitdagings by hierdie polisiestasie.
tgt: Departments from the Justice, Crime Prevention and Security Cluster are in the process of attending to challenges faced by the Police Station.

src: Die Opname oor Slagoffers van Misdaad is belangrik omdat dit die regering in die formulering van ’n beleid in die stryd teen misdaad lei.
tgt: The Victims of Crime Survey is important as it guides government in formulating its policies in the fight against crime.

src: Dit is in ooreenstemming met een van die regering se prioriteite, naamlik dat alle mense in Suid-Afrika veilig moet wees en voel.
tgt: This is in line with the government priority that All People in South Africa Are and Feel Safe.

src: Die resultate help om ook toekomstige werk wat in dié verband gedoen gaan word te lei en om die goeie nuus oor prestasies gedurende die afgelope vyf jaar by die mense se persepsies en ervarings te laat aanpas.
tgt: The results assist in guiding further work that needs to be done, to match the good news on achievements over the last five years, with perceptions and experiences of citizens.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet decisions.

src: Evaluering van die Doeltreffendheid van die Implementering van Omgewingsbestuur in die Mynbousektor het die Departement van Omgewingsake se bestuursreaksie en verbeteringsplan ingesluit.
tgt: The Implementation Evaluation of the Effectiveness of Environmental Governance in the Mining Sector, included the management response and improvement plan by the Department of Environmental AffairsThe National Environmental Management Act, 1998 defines the environmental management approach that should be integrated across all sectors, including the mining sector.

src: Die doel is om te verseker dat die omgewingsimpak van mynbedrywighede doeltreffend verlig of bestuur word.
tgt: The objective is to ensure that the environmental impacts of mining activities are effectively mitigated or managed.

src: Die evaluering beoordeel die toepaslikheid en doeltreffendheid van die wetgewing en die implementering daarvan om hierdie doelwit te bereik.
tgt: The evaluation assessed the relevance and effectiveness of the legislation and its implementation to achieve this objective.

src: Die Kabinet ondersteun die ‘Een Omgewing-stelsel’ soos voorgestel in die verbeteringsplan, met 'n mandaat om bykomende vaartbelyningsmaatreëls, soos die verdere aanpassing van spesifieke omgewingsbestuurswette te oorweeg.
tgt: Cabinet supports the ‘One Environment System’ as proposed in the Improvement Plan with a mandate to consider additional streamlining measures such as further alignment of Specific Environmental Management Acts.

src: Die Kabinet ondersteun ook samesprekings oor die sluiting van myne om beskerming van die omgewing te verseker en om sosio-ekonomiese risiko’s aan omliggende gemeenskappe te verminder.
tgt: Cabinet also supports a discussion on mine closures to ensure environmental protection and to reduce socio-economic risk to surrounding communities.

src: Die 2015/16 Navorsing en Ontwikkeling-(N&O) Belastingaansporingsjaarverslag wat tans aan die Parlement voorgelê word, dui daarop dat die N&O-belastingaansporingsprogram privaatsektor N&O-belegging bevorder.
tgt: The 2015/16 Research and Development (R&D) Tax Incentive Annual Report which is being submitted to Parliament, shows how the R&D Tax Incentive programme is promoting increased private sector R&D investment.

src: Dit verbeter ekonomiese kakpasiteit om werkskepping te verhoog en sodoende ook die oordrag van kennis en vaardigheidsontwikkeling te verhoog.
tgt: This is required to increase the economy’s capacity to boost employment creation, as well as to increase positive spillovers through knowledge transfer and skills development.

src: Van Maart 2015 tot Februarie 2016, het die Departement van Wetenskap en Tegnologie altesaam 189 N&O-belastingaansporingsaansoeke van 147 maatskappye ontvang.
tgt: From March 2015 to February 2016, the Department of Science and Technology received 189 R&D tax incentive applications from 147 companies.

src: Dit bring die totale aantal maatskappye wat aan die aansporingsprogram deelneem sedert sy ontstaan in November 2006, op 962 te staan.
tgt: This increased the total number of companies participating in the incentive programme since its inception in November 2006, to 962.

src: Die Nasionale Tesourie het geskat dat daar in hierdie tydperk, danksy die N&O-belastingaansporing, net meer as R6 miljard in belastinginkomste ’n uitgemaakte saak was.
tgt: In this period the National Treasury estimates that just over R6 billion in tax revenue was foregone as a result of the R&D tax incentive.

src: Oor dieselfde tydperk het die aansporing ongeveer R36,1 miljard in R&O-uitgawes ondersteun.
tgt: Over the same period the incentive supported about R.1 billion in R&D expenditure.

src: Van die 962 maatskappye, is 47% klein en medium ondernemings, 12% is groot ondernemings (omset van R41 tot R100 miljoen) 32% is baie groot ondernemings (R100 miljoen en hoër) en 8% het nie hul omsetgrootte bekend gemaak nie.
tgt: Of the 962 companies, 47% are Small and Medium Enterprises, 12% are large enterprises (turnover R41 million to R100 million) 32% are very large enterprises (R100 million and above) and 8% did not disclose their turnover size.

src: Die Kabinet het goedkeuring verleen vir die bekendstelling van 'n proses om die regering se begroting vir N&O-aktiwiteite te koördineer.
tgt: Cabinet approved the introduction of a process for the coordination of the government’s budget for Research & Development (R&D) activities.

src: Die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan dui aan dat N&O en innovasie 'n sleuterol kan speel in die verbetering van die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie se mededingendheid en in die ondersteuning van sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling en werkskepping.
tgt: The National Development Plan notes that R&D and innovation have a key role to play in improving the competitiveness of the South African economy and in supporting socio-economic development and employment.

src: Suid-Afrika se kritieke nasionale wetenskaplike infrastruktuur is verouderd en daar is ’n dringende behoefte aan tegnologiese opgradering en modernisering om doeltreffende dienslewering te handhaaf.
tgt: South Africa’s critical national scientific infrastructure is obsolete and in urgent need of technological upgrading and modernising to sustain effective service delivery.

src: Hierdie soort infrastruktuur is groot en duur, en sal gekoördineerde belegging deur verskeie departemente verg.
tgt: Such infrastructure is large and expensive, and would require coordinated investment across departments.

src: Die voorgestelde begrotingskoördinasie sal oor die medium termyn 2016/17 en 2019/20 ingefaseer word.
tgt: The proposed budget coordination will be phased in over the medium term 2016/17 and 2019/20.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die vordering wat gemaak is met die Square Kilometre Array- (SKA) en MerKAT-projekte, die beplande oprigting van die saamgesmelte Suid-Afrikaanse Radio-astronomie Observatorium, en die aanbied van die Hydrogen Epoch of Re-ionisation Array- (HERA) teleskoop op die SKA-terrein.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the progress made in the Square Kilometre Array (SKA) and MeerKAT projects, the planned establishment of the merged South African Radio Astronomy Observatory, and the hosting of the Hydrogen Epoch of Re-ionisation Array (HERA) telescope on the SKA site.

src: Die SKA en MerKAT is een van 18 strategiese infrastruktuurprojekte van die Presidensiële Infrastruktuur Koördinerende Kommissie.
tgt: The SKA and MeerKAT constitute one of eighteen Strategic Infrastructure Projects of the Presidential Infrastructure Coordinating Commission.

src: Hierdie mega infrastruktuurprojekte dra by tot die NOP deur hul potensiaal om ekonomiese ontwikkeling te bevorder, ekonomiese geleenthede te ontsluit en die bevordering van werkskepping.
tgt: These mega infrastructure projects contribute to the National Development Plan through their potential to promote economic development, unlock economic opportunities and promote job creation.

src: Goeie vordering word gemaak met die voorbereidings vir SKA-1 in Suid-Afrika, insluitend die verkryging van grond en onderhandelings oor die internasionale verdrag en die verkrygingsproses.
tgt: Good progress is being made on the preparations for SKA-1 in South Africa including the acquisition of land and negotiations on the international treaty and the procurement process.

src: In die tien jaar van sy bestaan, het die SKA SA se Meslikekapitaal-ontwikkelingsprogram meer as 800 beurse, met uitgebreide ondersteuning aan skole in Carnarvon, toegeken.
tgt: In its ten years the SKA SA Human Capital Development Programme awarded over 800 bursaries, with extensive support to schools in Carnarvon.

src: Die MerKAT se "eerste lig"-beeld van die radio-lug, wat met slegs 16 antennas geproduseer is, wys meer as 1300.3 radiosterrestelsels in die verre heelal, wat bewys dat dit die beste radioteleskoop in die Suidelike Halfrond is en, sodra dit voltooi is, die beste teleskoop van sy soort in die wêreld behoort te wees.
tgt: The MeerKAT “first light” image of the radio sky produced with only 16 antennae shows more than 1300.3 radio galaxies in the distant universe, demonstrating that it is the best radio telescope in the Southern Hemisphere and should be the world’s best telescope of its kind, once completed.

src: Die volledige stel van 64 antennas sal teen Maart 2018 geïnstalleer en operasioneel wees en word met 75% plaaslike inhoud gebou om die plaaslike bedryf voor te berei vir groter deelname.
tgt: The full complement of 64 antennae will be installed and operational by March 2018, and is being built with 75% local content so as to prepare the local industry for deeper participation.

src: HERA is 'n aanvullende wetenskaplike eksperiment om begrip van die vorming van vroeë sterrestelsels te bevorder en word hoofsaaklik deur die National Science Foundation van die VSA in vennootskap met die Universiteit van Cambridge befonds.
tgt: HERA is a complementary scientific experiment to advance understanding of early galaxy formation and if funded mainly by the National Science Foundation of the United States in partnership with Cambridge University.

src: Die konsep van 'n enkele radio-astronomie-observatorium, wat bekend staan as die Suid-Afrikaanse Radio-astronomie-sterrewag sal die verskillende projekte en aktiwiteite van die Suid-Afrikaanse radio-astronomielandskap konsolideer.
tgt: The concept of a single radio astronomy observatory, to be known as the South African Radio Astronomy Observatory will consolidate the different projects and activities of the South African radio astronomy landscape.

src: 'n Enkele nuwe nasionale fasiliteit onder die Nasionale Navorsingstigting sal help om wetenskaplike doeltreffendheid te bevorder.
tgt: There are efficiency gains to be made with a single new National Facility under the National Research Foundation.

src: Die Witskrif oor ’n Beleid vir Nasionale Burgerlike Lugvaart, wat veiligheid, sekuriteit en omgewingsnakoming bevorder en verbeter, is goedgekeur.
tgt: The White Paper on National Civil Aviation Policy, which promotes and enhances civil aviation safety, security and environmental compliance, was approved.

src: Dit bevorder ook Suid-Afrika se nasionale belang en vergemaklik die uitbreiding van handel en toerisme.
tgt: It also promotes the national interest of South Africa and facilitates the expansion of trade and tourism.

src: Hierbenewens bevorder dit die ontwikkeling van ’n doeltreffende en produktiewe lugvaartnywerheid, wat plaaslik sowel as internasionaal kan meeding.
tgt: Further it promotes the development of an efficient and productive aviation industry, which is capable of competing both locally and internationally.

src: Die Kabinet keur ook die Nasionale Lughawe-ontwikkelingsplan goed wat deur die Witskrif oor Nasionale Burgelike Lugvaart-beleid ingewy is om aandag te gee aan die gapings tussen die huidige lughawenetwerk en die toekomstige gewenste toestand.
tgt: Cabinet also approved the National Airports Development Plan which was initiated by the White Paper on National Civil Aviation Policy to address the gaps between the current airport network and the future desired WEBTOKEN will guide and support both overall network planning and the development of individual airports integrated within their broader spatial and transport contexts, in consultation with key airport stakeholders.

src: Lughawe-infrastruktuur is 'n integrale deel van die Suid-Afrikaanse vervoerstelsel en dra by tot die sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling van die land deur die fasilitering van plaaslike en internasionale toerisme en handel.
tgt: Airport infrastructure is an integral part of the South African transport system and contributes to the socio-economic development of the country by facilitating domestic and international tourism and trade.

src: Die konsep Omvattende Maritieme Vervoerbeleid 2016, is vir openbare kommentaar goedgekeur.
tgt: The draft Comprehensive Maritime Transport Policy 2016, was approved, for public comments.

src: Dit bied 'n nasionale raamwerk om die geïntegreerde bestuur, groei, ontwikkeling en transformasie van die maritieme sektor te lei, met die oog op die ontsluiting van die maritieme sektor se volle potensiaal en die verbetering van sy bydrae tot die sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling van die land terwyl dit ook tot internasionale handel bydra.
tgt: This provides a national framework to guide the integrated governance, growth, development and transformation of the maritime sector, with a view to unlock the maritime sectors’ full potential and enhance its contribution to the socio-economic development objectives of the country, while contributing to international trade.

src: Dit is in ooreenstemming met regeringsprioriteite wat verband hou met Operasie Phakisa oor die groei van die oseane-ekonomie en breër doelwitte van die NOP 2030, sowel as die Nasionale Infrastruktuurplan om ekonomiese groei te bevorder en werkskepping te stimuleer.
tgt: This is in line with Government priorities relating to Operation Phakisa on growing the Oceans Economy and broader goals from the National Development Plan 2030 and the National Infrastructure Plan to promote economic growth and to boost job creation.

src: Wetsontwerpe.
tgt: Bills.

src: Voorlegging aan die Parlement van die Konsepwetsontwerp op Mariene Ruimtelike Beplanning, 2016.
tgt: Submission of the Draft Marine Spatial Planning Bill, 2016 to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp maak voorsiening vir ’n wetlike raamwerk vir die ontwikkeling van 'n mariene ruimtelikebeplanningstelsel wat ekonomiese groei bevorder en word moontlik gemaak deur die koördinering van beplanning in verskeie sektore.
tgt: The Bill provides a legal framework for the development of a marine spatial planning system that promotes economic growth and is facilitated by coordinating planning across multiple WEBTOKEN will promote good ocean governance by ensuring involvement of all sectors in joint management and planning in the ocean space.

src: Dit sal deeglike oseanebestuur bevorder deur te verseker dat alle sektore gesamentlik betrokke is by die bestuur en beplanning van die seeruimte.
tgt: It will also facilitate: conflict resolution (amongst the users of space and regulatory authorities) enhancement of information knowledge and management in South African ocean space.

src: Dit sal ook konflikoplossing vergemaklik (onder die gebruikers van ruimte- en regulerende owerhede) en inligting, kennis en bestuur in Suid-Afrika se seeruimte verbeter.
tgt: The Bill will work towards sustainable development, rather than only conservation or environmental protection, with a view to contribute to more general social and economic objectives.

src: Dit is ook 'n belangrike inisiatief van die eerste operasie Phakisa (oseane-ekonomie) om ons ekonomiese potensiaal te ontsluit.
tgt: It is also a key initiative of the first Operation Phakisa (Ocean Economy) to unlock our economic potential.

src: Voorlegging van die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Landbouprodukstandaarde aan die Parlement.
tgt: Submission of the Agricultural Products Standards Amendment Bill to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp wysig die Wet op Landbouprodukstandaarde, 1990 (Wet No.
tgt: The Bill amends the Agricultural Products Standards Act, 1990 (Act No.

src: 119 van 1990).Die Wetsontwerp het ten doel om die regulatoriese raamwerk vir landbouproduksie, gesondheid en voedselveiligheid van sekere landbouprodukte te versterk.
tgt: 119 of 1990)The Bill aims to strengthen the regulatory framework for agricultural production, health and food safety of certain agricultural products.

src: So 'n regulerende raamwerk bevorder voedselveiligheid en skep 'n gunstige omgewing vir groter en volhoubare produksie.
tgt: Such a regulatory framework promotes food safety and creates an enabling environment for increased and sustainable production.

src: Dit sal billike handelspraktyke en verbruikersbeskerming verbeter.
tgt: This will increase fair trade practices and consumer protection.

src: Publikasie van die Konsepwetsontwerp op Elektroniese Registrasie van Aktesstelsel, 2016, vir openbare kommentaar.
tgt: Publication of the Draft Electronic Deeds Registration Systems Bill, 2016, for public comment.

src: Die Wetsontwerp fasiliteer die ontwikkeling, vestiging en instandhouding van 'n elektroniese akteregistrasiestelsel.
tgt: The Bill facilitates the development, establishment and maintenance of an electronic deeds registration system that will provide, amongst other things, for the effective registration of large volumes of deeds as a result of our Government’s land reform measures, improved turn-around times for providing registered deeds and documents to clients provide country-wide access to deeds registration services enhanced accuracy of examination and registration availability of information to the public and security features including confidentiality.

src: Dit sal onder meer voorsiening maak vir die doeltreffende registrasie van groot volumes aktes wat voortspruit uit die regering se grondhervormingsmaatreëls, verbeterde omkeertye vir die verskaffing van geregistreerde aktes en dokumente aan kliënte landwye toegang tot akteregistrasiedienste verbeterde akkuraatheid van ondersoeke en registrasie beskikbaarheid van inligting aan die publiek en sekuriteitsfunksies soos vertroulikheid.
tgt: This also supports the National Development Plan call for measures to be implemented in all government departments and sectors that effectively manage information and technology to ensure that South Africa does not fall victim to a ‘digital divide’.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Issues in the Environment.

src: Die Kabinet dra saam met President Jacob Zuma sy meegevoel oor aan die familie en vriende van geestelike siek pasiënte wat in Gauteng gesterf het.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Jacob Zuma in extending condolences to the families and friends of mentally ill patients who died in Gauteng.

src: Die Regering en die gemeenskap in die algemeen, het 'n verantwoordelikheid om kwesbare mense te beskerm en te versorg.
tgt: Government, and society at large, has a responsibility to protect and care for the vulnerable.

src: Die Kabinet prys die Minister van Gesondheid, dr Aaron Motsoaledi dat hy die Gesondheidombudsman aangestel het om alle oortredings deur gesondheidsinstellings en gesondheidspraktisyns te ondersoek.
tgt: Cabinet commends the Minister of Health, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi for appointing the Health Ombudsman to investigate all wrong doings committed by health institutions and health practitioners.

src: Die Premier van Gauteng, David Makhura, se optrede gebaseer op die verslag van die Gesondheidsombudsman, word ook verwelkom.
tgt: Further, the action being taken by the Premier of Gauteng, David Makhura, based on the report of the Health Ombudsman, is welcomed.

src: Die Kabinet doen verder 'n beroep op premier Makhura om seker te maak dat toepaslike dissiplinêre stappe geneem word teen almal wat onbehoorlik of nalatig opgetree het.
tgt: Cabinet further calls on Premier Makhura to ensure that appropriate disciplinary action is taken against all who may have conducted themselves improperly or negligently.

src: Die Kabinet is bekommerd oor die wanordelike gedrag by die opening van die Parlement wat nie net inbreuk maak op die regte van ander in die Parlement nie, maar op die regte van alle Suid-Afrikaners.
tgt: Cabinet was concerned about the disorderly behaviour displayed at the Opening of Parliament which not only infringe on the rights of others in Parliament, but on the rights of all South Africans.

src: Die Parlement is een van Suid-Afrika se basiese demokratiese instellings, wat deur die Grondwet gevestig is om uitvoer te gee aan die Handves van Meseregte en rekenskap te gee aan die mense van Suid-Afrika, wat ons vertrou met die verantwoordelikheid om hulle na 'n beter lewe te lei.
tgt: Parliament is one of South Africa’s founding democratic institutions, established by the Constitution, to uphold the Bill of Rights and account to the people of South Africa – all of whom have entrusted us with the responsibility of leading them towards a better life.

src: Lede van die Parlement, as verteenwoordigers van die mense, moet die belange van alle Suid-Afrikaners voorop stel en die rol van hierdie belangrike instelling handhaaf.
tgt: Members of Parliament, as representatives of the people must put the interests of all South Africans first and reassert the role of this important institution.

src: Die Kabinet is in kennis gestel oor Tropiese Sikloon Dineo, wat van vandag af, Donderdag 16 Februarie 2017, kan lei tot ernstige storms en swaar reën tot die naweek, Sondag 19 Februarie 2017.
tgt: Cabinet was apprised on Tropical Cyclone Dineo, with South Africa set to experience severe storms and heavy rains starting from today, Thursday, 16 February 2017 until the weekend - Sunday 19 February 2017.The Cyclone will affect Mpumalanga, the extreme northern parts of Kwa Zulu Natal and Limpopo.

src: Die sikloon sal Mpumalanga, die uiterste noordelike dele van KwaZulu-Natal en Limpopo raak, en meer spesifiek die Krugerwildtuin, Enhlanzeni, Vhembe, Mopani en die Waterberg-distriksmunisipaliteite.
tgt: This will mostly affect – Kruger National Park, Enhlanzeni, Vhembe, Mopani and Waterberg district Municipalities.

src: Die oostelike dele van Limpopo kan ook hoë reënval van ongeveer 200 mm oor 'n tydperk van 24 uur, kry.
tgt: The eastern parts of Limpopo may also experience high levels of rainfall on Friday, estimated at 200 mm over a 24-hour period.

src: Die Nasionale Rampbestuursentrum en die Nasionale Gesamentlike Operasiesentrum, wat uit verskillende staatsdepartemente en instansies bestaan, het die situasie beoordeel en drie provinsiale gesamentlike operasiesentrums in Limpopo, Mpumalanga en KwaZulu-Natal geaktiveer.
tgt: The National Disaster Management Centre (NDMC) and the National Joint Operations Centre (NATJOC) comprising of various government departments and institutions have assessed the situation and activated three Provincial Joint Operations Centres (PROVJOC) in Limpopo, Mpumalanga and KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Hierdie multi-sektorale eenhede sal hulp verleen indien nodig om die veiligheid van gemeenskappe te verseker en om die impak te verminder.
tgt: This multi-sectoral approach will assist where the need arises to ensure safety of communities and to minimise the impact.

src: Die Regering doen 'n beroep op alle gemeenskappe wat geraak word om uiters versigtig te wees in afwagting van die sikloon.
tgt: Government is appealing to all affected communities to take extra care ahead of this coming cyclone.

src: Gemeenskappe word ontmoedig om oorstroomde paaie, brûe en riviere oor te steek.
tgt: Communities are discouraged from crossing flooded roads, bridges and rivers.

src: Ons doen ook 'n beroep op ouers, versorgers en voogde om seker te maak dat kinders veilig is tydens die storms.
tgt: We also urge parents, care givers and guardians to ensure the safety of their children during the storms.

src: Gemeenskappe moet saamwerk om hul mense se veiligheid te verseker.
tgt: Communities must work together to ensure the safety of people.

src: Luister asseblief na waarskuwings en inligting oor die sikloon, wat oor alle plaaslike radiostasies uitgesaai word.
tgt: Please listen for warnings and information on Tropical Cyclone Dineo which is being broadcast across all local radio stations.

src: Die Kabinet gee sy volle steun aan die ingryping en gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid van die regeringsafvaardiging, wat deur die Minister van Binnelandse Sake, Malusi Gigaba, en Gauteng se LUR vir Gemeenskapsveiligheid, Sizakele Nkosi-Malobane gelei word, by kwessies wat gemeenskappe in die gebied raak, veral sake rondom polisiëring en die beweerde onwettige aktiwiteite van immigrante.
tgt: Cabinet fully supports the intervention and community engagement by the government delegation, being led by Minister of Home Affairs, Malusi Gigaba, and the Gauteng Community Safety MEC Sizakele Nkosi-Malobane to engage on issues affecting communities in the area, in particular matters around policing and the alleged illegal activities of migrants.

src: Die Kabinet ondersteun die Minister se oproep van 'n “volledige staatbenadering" tot wettige kwessies wat deur gemeenskappe geopper word.
tgt: Cabinet supports the Minister’s call for “a whole of state approach” to these legitimate issues raised by communities, which will be addressed through: the establishment of a Border Management Authority that will help in better managing our borders, documentation of all people living in South Africa, effective policing and ensuring compliance to the laws and the Constitution of the Republic by citizens and foreign nationals.

src: Aandag sal aan hierdie kwessies gegee word deur die vestiging van 'n Grensbestuursowerheid wat sal help om die land se grense beter te bestuur, opnames te maak van alle mense wat in Suid- Afrika woon, en doeltreffende polisiëring en die nakoming van die wette en die Grondwet van die Republiek deur burgers en buitelanders te verseker.
tgt: Cabinet gives full support to the security cluster, to ensure that these matters are resolved to the satisfaction of the South African public.

src: Beter dialoog rondom polisiëring tussen gemeenskappe en die owerhede is hiervoor nodig.
tgt: This will require better dialogue around policing between communities and the authorities.

src: Die Kabinet vra ook vir verantwoordelike openbare kommentaar deur alle leiers en verteenwoordigers en dat kwessies op 'n verantwoordelike wyse hanteer moet word.
tgt: Cabinet further wishes to call for responsible public comments by all leaders and representatives, issues must be handled in a responsible manner.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel die aanvalle op ondersteuners, spelers en beamptes tydens die Absa Premierliga-wedstryd tussen Mamelodi Sundowns en Orlando Pirates op Loftus Versfeld waartydens 13 mense beseer is.
tgt: In a separate incident, Cabinet condemns the attacks on fans, players and officials during the Absa Premiership match between Mamelodi Sundowns and Orlando Pirates at Loftus Versfeld which left 13 people injured.

src: Sulke gedrag en dade van vandalisme bring die sport in oneer, plaas die land in ’n swak lig en vereis streng optrede van sokkerowerhede wat vinnig moet optree om te verseker sulke dade nie weer plaasvind nie.
tgt: Such behaviour and acts of hooliganism brings the sport into disrepute, reflects negatively on the country and requires stringent action from soccer authorities that must act swiftly to ensure such acts are not repeated.

src: Simpatie en gelukwense.
tgt: Sympathy and congratulatory messages.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy meegevoel oor aan familie, vriende en die rugbybroederskap ná die afsterwe van die voormalige Springbok-kaptein, Joost van der Westhuizen.
tgt: Cabinet expresses its condolences to family, friends and the rugby fraternity on the passing of former Springbok captain Joost van der Westhuizen.

src: President Jacob Zuma het ook verklaar dat 'n spesiale amptelike provinsiale begrafnis gehou sal word om dié Suid-Afrikaanse rugby-held te gedenk.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma had also declared a Special Provincial Official Funeral to commemorate the South African rugby legend.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die verkiesing van Chad se Minister van Buitelandse Sake, Moussa Faki Mahamat, as die nuwe Voorsitter van die AU-Kommissie.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the election of Chad's Foreign Minister, Moussa Faki Mahamat, as the new Chairperson of the African Union Commission, replacing South Africa's Dr Nkosazana-Dlamini Zuma.

src: Hy volg Suid-Afrika se dr Nkosazana-Dlamini Zuma op.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the appointment of Minister Jeff Radebe, as a South African ambassador for Global Citizens, and will form part of a movement of eight million Global Citizens across the world.

src: Dit is 'n netwerk van top bekendes, beleidmakers, sakeleiers, aktiviste en belanghebbendes wat daartoe verbind is om die die wêreld se grootste uitdagings die hoof te bied en om ’n einde te maak aan uiterste armoede.
tgt: This is a network of top celebrities, policymakers, business leaders, activists and stakeholders committed to tackling the world's biggest challenges and ending extreme poverty.

src: Hierdie werk is in lyn met die doelwitte van die NOP om armoede te beëindiging en ongelykheid te verminder.
tgt: It’s work is aligned to the National Development Plan goals of ending poverty and reducing inequality, and benefits the development framework for the continent - Agenda 2063.

src: Die Minister van Wetenskap en Tegnologie, Naledi Pandor, word vandag deur die Amerikaanse Vereniging vir die Bevordering van Wetenskap vereer vir haar rol in wetenskapdiplomasie in Boston in die VSDie Kabinet wens die wenners van die jaarlikse Ubuntu-toekennings geluk.
tgt: The Minister of Science and Technology, Naledi Pandor, is also being honoured by the American Association for the Advancement of Science for her role in science diplomacy in Boston, United States, today.

src: Dit is deur die Departement van Internasionale Betrekkinge en Samewerking aangebied om Suid-Afrikaanse burgers wat 'n aktiewe rol speel om 'n positiewe beeld van Suid-Afrika internasionaal uit te dra, te vereer.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the winners of the annual Ubuntu Awards, hosted by the Department of International Relations and Cooperation to celebrate South African citizens who play an active role in projecting a positive image of South Africa internationally.

src: Die wenners sluit in Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Siyabulela Xuza, Pretty Yende, Esther Mahlangu, Gertrude Shope, en die Chinese ambassadeur Tian Xuejun.
tgt: These included: Winnie Madikizela-Mandela Siyabulela Xuza Pretty Yende Esther Mahlangu Gertrude Shope and Chinese Ambassador Tian Xuejun.

src: Sasol, die organisasie Babies Behind Bars en die Desmond Tutu MIV-stigting is ook vereer.
tgt: Sasol, Babies Behind Bars and the Desmond Tutu HIV Foundation were also recognised.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Suid-Afrikaanse sewesspan, ook bekend as die Blitsbokke, geluk met hulle oorwinning by die Sydney Rugby Sewes Wêreldreekstoernooi.
tgt: Cabinet also congratulates the South African Sevens team also known as the Blitzboks for winning the Sydney Rugby Sevens World Series tournament.

src: Dit is hul tweede oorwinning sedert die begin van die jaar nadat hulle in Januarie die HSBC Wellington Sewes gewen het.
tgt: This is their second win since the beginning of the year after the Blitzboks won the HSBC Wellington Sevens in January.

src: AaanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die betrokke klaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: MeClaire Busetti tot die Raad van die Nasionale Navorsingstigting.
tgt: Ms Claire Busetti to the National Research Foundation Board.

src: MnrKW Vukela as die Adjunk-direkteur-generaal: Dienslewering by die Departement van Staatsdiens en Administrasie.
tgt: Mr KW Vukela as the Deputy Director-General: Service Delivery at the Department of Public Service and Administration.

src: MeJL Meer as die Hoof Finansiële Beampte by die Staatsdrukkery.
tgt: Ms JL Meyer as the Chief Financial Officer at Government Printing Works.

src: Implementering van regeringsprogramme.
tgt: Implementation of Government Programmes.

src: Die Kabinet ondersteun die ondernemings wat in die 2017 Nasionale Begroting gemaak is om radikale ekonomiese transformasie te bevorder en meer Suid-Afrikaners vir inklusiewe groei by die ekonomie te betrek.
tgt: Cabinet supports the commitments made in the 2017 National Budget to advance radical economic transformation and draw more South Africans into the economy towards inclusive growth.

src: In die breë erken die begroting dat groei sonder transformasie die patroon van ongelykheid sal versterk.
tgt: In the main the budget acknowledges that growth without transformation would only reinforce the inequitable patterns from the past.

src: Herverdeling ter ondersteuning van onderwys, gesondheidsdienste en munisipale dienste in landelike gebiede bly die sentrale dryfkrag van ons bestedingsprogramme.
tgt: Redistribution in support of education, health services and municipal functions in rural areas remains the central thrust of our spending programmes.

src: Verkrygingshervormings verbeter steeds die doeltreffendheid van openbare besteding en skep geleenthede vir kleinsakedeelname.
tgt: Procurement reforms continue to improve the effectiveness of public spending and opening opportunities for small business participation.

src: Begrotingstoekennings ondersteun ekonomiese groei en ontwikkeling: R3,9 miljard vir klein, medium en mikro-ondernemings en koöperasies R4,2 miljard vir industriële infrastruktuur in spesiale ekonomiese sones en nywerheidsparke R1,9 miljard vir breëband-implementering, R3,9 miljard vir die Wetenskaplike en Nywerheidnavorsingsraad 'n bykomende R494 miljoen vir toerismebevordering 'n bykomende R266 miljoen om die akwakultuursektor te ondersteun en aan die doelwitte van die Oseane-ekonomie Operasie Phakisa te voldoen, asook besteding aan landbou, landelike ontwikkeling en grondhervorming ten bedrae van bykans R30 miljard teen 2019/20.Die begroting speel 'n sentrale rol in transformasie deur die bevordering van herverdeling en om skaars hulpbronne tot katalitiese beleggings in menslike en fisiese kapitaal te herlei.
tgt: Budget allocations support economic growth and development: R.9 billion for small, medium and micro enterprises and cooperatives R.2 billion for industrial infrastructure in special economic zones and industrial parks R.9 billion for broadband implementation, R.9 billion for the Council for Scientific and Industrial Research, an additional R494 million for tourism promotion, an additional R266m to support the aquaculture sector and realise the goals of the Oceans Economy Phakisa Operation, and spending on agriculture, rural development and land reform amounting to nearly R30 billion by 2019/20.The budget plays a central role in transformation by promoting redistribution and directing scarce resources towards catalytic investments in human and physical capital.

src: Ter erkenning van die behoefte om in die jeug se toekoms te belê, verseker die begroting dat behoeftige studente toegang tot tersiêre onderwys kan kry.
tgt: In recognition of our need to invest in the future of youth, the budget ensures that financially needy students can access tertiary education.

src: Die Nasionale Studente Finansiële Hulpskema (NSFAS) voorsien befondsing vir meer as 300 000 nuwe en terugkerende studente vir studie aan universiteite en kolleges vir Tegniese en Profssionele Onderwys en Opleiding (TVET) regoor die land in 2017.
tgt: The National Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS) has provided funding to over 300 000 new and returning students to study at universities and Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) colleges across the country in 2017.

src: Na verwagting sal nog 100 000 studente vanjaar by die fonds baat.
tgt: The fund expects to add a further 100 000 students this year.

src: Die R15 miljard wat deur die Regering aan NSFAS toegeken is, sal help om die finansiële las van behoeftig studente en die ontbrekende middelstudente te verlig.
tgt: The R15 billion allocated to NSFAS by government will assist in alleviating the financial burden faced by financially needy and missing middle students.

src: Na aanleiding van die suksesvolle bekendstelling van Operasie Phakisa in sektore soos die oseane-ekonomie, gesondheid en basiese onderwys, het President Jacob Zuma Operasie Phakisa vir landbou, grondhervorming en landelike ontwikkeling op 24 Februarie 2017 geloods.
tgt: Following the successful launch of Operation Phakisa in sectors such as the Oceans Economy, Health and Basic Education, President Jacob Zuma launched the Operation Phakisa for Agriculture, Land Reform and Rural Development on 24 February 2017.

src: Operasie Phakisa is afgelei van die “Big Fast”-resultate wat Maleisië suksesvol gebruik het om vinnige ekonomiese transformasie te bewerkstellig.
tgt: Operation Phakisa is derived from Malaysia’s Big Fast Results methodology which Malaysia used successfully to achieve rapid economic transformation and having been successfully adapted to South African conditions, it now forms part of our Nine Point Plan Implementation toolkit.

src: Nadat dit suksesvol vir Suid-Afrikaanse toestande aangepas is, is dit nou deel van ons Negepuntplan as 'n implementeringshulpmiddel.
tgt: Operation Phakisa for Agriculture, Land Reform and Rural Development seeks to achieve inclusive growth, as prescribed by the vision of the NDP and aims at contributing to stimulating economic growth, fostering job creation, and transforming the agricultural value chain.

src: Operasie Phakisa vir landbou, grondhervorming en landelike ontwikkeling beoog om inklusiewe groei te bewerkstellig, soos voorgeskryf deur die visie van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP) en het ten doel om by te dra tot die stimulering van ekonomiese groei, die bevordering van werkskepping en die transformasie van die landbou-waardeketting.
tgt: It further seeks to ensure equitable access to land, both towards economic development and agrarian transformation.

src: Die program sal bestaande modelle vir produsentondersteuning hersien en sal finansieringsmodelle ontwikkel wat op die versnelling van grondhervorming gerig is, gegewe die Regering se dringende behoefte om vordering te maak met voedselsekuriteit.
tgt: The programme will review existing producer support models and develop finance models aimed at fast tracking land reform, given the urgent need for government to make progress in food security.

src: Hierbenewens poog die program om aandag te gee aan beperkings ten opsigte van gelyke toegang tot grond wat betref ekonomiese ontwikkeling sowel as landboutransformasie.
tgt: Furthermore, the programme seeks to address constraints in ensuring equitable access to land, both towards economic development and agrarian transformation.

src: Dit sluit in grondhervorming, landelike ontwikkeling, arbeid, graan, vee, tuinbou en steun aan produsente.
tgt: These include land reform, rural development, labour, grains, livestock, horticulture and producer support.

src: In 2016 het meer as 10 miljoen toeriste Suid-Afrika besoek, dit is 13% meer as in 2015.
tgt: In 2016, over 10 million tourist arrivals were recorded in South Africa, a 13 per cent increase from 2015.

src: Ons florerende toerismebedryf lewer bewys van die noue samewerking tussen die Regering, georganiseerde arbeid en die sakesektor onder leiding van die Departement van Toerisme saam met SA Toerisme om die volle ekonomiese voordele van ons toerismebates te ontsluit.
tgt: Our thriving tourism industry is testament to the close collaboration between government, organised labour and business led by the Department of Tourism together with South African Tourism to unlock the full economic benefits of our tourism assets.

src: Ons doen 'n beroep op alle bedryfsvennote om toerisme steeds verder te ontwikkel en te bevorder, sodat plaaslike gemeenskappe kan baat by die skep van werksgeleenthede en infrastruktuurontwikkeling.
tgt: We call on all industry partners to continue developing and promoting tourism so that it may benefit local communities through jobs and infrastructure development.

src: As deel van die Regering se fokus om die potensiaal van KMMO's en township-ondernemings te ontsluit, bied Suid-Afrika die Wêreld Entrepreneurskap-kongres tussen 13 en16 Maart 2017 in Johannesburg aan.
tgt: As part of Government focus to unlock the potential of SMME’s and township enterprises, South Africa will host the Global Entrepreneurship Congress between the 13 and16 March 2017 in Johannesburg.

src: Die kongres is 'n inter-dissiplinêre byeenkoms vir voorstaanders van beginnersondernemings wat 4 000 afgevaardigdes van meer as 150 lande lok.
tgt: The congress is an inter-disciplinary gathering of start-up champions that attracts 4 000 delegates from more than 150 countries.

src: Oorwoë leiers, entrepreneurs, beleggers, navorsers en beleidmakers wat deel is van 'n wêreldwye beweging wat entrepreneurskap bevorder as 'n manier om ekonomieë te op te bou en lewensgehalte te verbeter, sal die kongres bywoon.
tgt: Thought-leaders, entrepreneurs, investors, researchers and policymakers who have become part of a global movement that advances entrepreneurship as a means to build economies and improve human welfare, will attend.

src: Dit is die eerste keer dat die kongres in Afrika aangebied word en is 'n geleentheid vir Suid-Afrika en die res van die vasteland om sy ondernemingsgees aan te vuur.
tgt: This is the first time the congress will be hosted in Africa and provides an opportunity for South Africa and the rest of the continent to ignite its entrepreneurial spirit.

src: Suid Afrika herdenk die begin van Meseregtemaand op 1 Maart 2017 onder die tema "Die Jaar van OR Tambo: Eenheid in Aksie in die bevordering van menseregte" om bewustheid te verhoog en respek vir basiese menseregte te bevorder.
tgt: South Africa commemorated the start of Human Rights Month on 1 March 2017 under the theme: “The Year of OR Tambo: Unity in Action in Advancing Human Rights” to raise awareness and promote respect for basic human rights.

src: Meseregtemaand sal deur die loop van die maand oral in die land gevier word, wat uiteindelik tot die nasionale viering van Meseregtedag op 21 Maart in Ginsberg, King William's Town in die Oos-Kaap sal lei.
tgt: Human Rights Month will be celebrated across the country leading to the national celebrations on Human Rights Day on 21 March 2017 in Ginsberg, King William’s Town in the Eastern Cape.

src: Op dié dag sal President Jacob Zuma amptelik die gedenkterrein waar Steve Bantu Biko begrawe is, aan die Biko-familie oorhandig.
tgt: On the day, President Jacob Zuma will officially handover the memorial grave site of Steve Bantu Biko to the Biko-family.

src: Dit is deel van die viering en bevordering van eenheid ooreenkomstig OR Tambo se visie.
tgt: This is part of celebrating and promoting unity in line with the vision of OR Tambo.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die uitslag van die Meedingingskommissie se ondersoek na beweerde buitelandsevaluta-samespanning en wag vir die resultaat van die Meedingingstribunaal se verrigtinge, insluitende sy bevindinge en besluit oor die gepaste straf.
tgt: Cabinet also noted the outcome of the Competition Commission investigation into alleged foreign exchange collusion and awaits the conclusion of the Competition Tribunal proceedings, including its findings and decision on the appropriate sanction.

src: Nasionale Waterwetmaand word in Maart 2017 gevier met die tema "Meseregte vir water en sanitasie".
tgt: As we commemorate National Water Month in March 2017 under the theme: “Human Rights for Water and Sanitation”, all South Africans are reminded to conserve water to ensure sustainability of future supply.

src: Alle Suid-Afrikaners word daaraan herinner om water spaarsamig te gebruik om die volhoubaarheid van toekomstige watervoorrade te verseker.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the proposal by the United Nations Educational Scientific and Cultural Organisation (UNESCO) to host World Water Day in South Africa on 22 March 2017 under the theme: “Waste Water the untapped resource”.President Jacob Zuma who is a member of the United Nations High Level Panel on Water Action Plan will open the event, by launching the World Water Development Report 2017 on wastewater and related activities.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die vordering wat gemaak is met die verspreiding van veevoer om boere in die land se droogtegeteisterde gebiede by te staan.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the progress made on the distribution of animal feeds to support farmers in the country’s drought affected areas.

src: Dié inisiatief is deel van die R212 miljoen wat in 2016/17 deur die Regering bewillig is om boere regdeur die land wat deur die droogte geraak is te help.
tgt: The initiative is part of the R212 million in support, which government has made available in 2016/17 to assist affected farmers across the country.

src: Provinsies het ook R198 miljoen beskikbaar gestel deur regverdige aandelebefondsing en fondse uit die Program vir die Voorkoming en Verligting van Ramprisiko’s is gebruik om boorgate te sink en voorbrande te maak.
tgt: Provinces have also made R198 million available through equitable share funding, and funds from the Prevention and Mitigation of Disaster Risk programme were used to drill boreholes and construct fire breaks.

src: Om te help om die probleme rondom die watertekort in die Wes-Kaap op te los, moet pogings aangewend word om bykomende alternatiewe watertoevoerbronne beskikbaar te stel ingeval dit in die komende seisoen nie genoeg reën WEBTOKEN oormatige watergebruik verder aan bande te lê, het die Departement van Water en Sanitasie die landbousektor van 10% bykomende waterbeperkings in kennis gestel.
tgt: In order to assist with the difficulties with regard to water availability in the Western Cape, attempts need to be instituted to provide greater comfort in the form of additional alternate water supply sources that must be on standby should inadequate water be received for this WEBTOKEN further curb excessive water use, the Department of Water and Sanitation has informed the agricultural sector of 10% additional water restrictions.

src: Die waterbeperkings sal van krag wees totdat die damme tot 85% van hul kapasiteit bereik.
tgt: The water restrictions will remain until the dams fill up to 85% of their capacity.

src: Terwyl die land verheug is oor die onlangse broodnodige reëns, wat baie sal help om die gevolge van die droogte te verlig, word damme en riviere toenemend voller.
tgt: As the country welcomes the much needed rains which will go a long way in relieving the country from the effects of drought, dams and rivers are showing signs of increasing volumes.

src: Die moontlikheid van kitsvloede is steeds hoog.
tgt: The possibility of flash flooding remains high.

src: Ons vra gemeenskappe om op hul hoede te wees vir kitsvloede, wat tot sterftes kan lei en eiendom en infrastruktuur kan vernietig.
tgt: We call on communities to remain vigilant of flash flooding which could lead to the loss of life, destruction to property and infrastructure.

src: Die Regering en sy agentskappe monitor die situasie en is gereed om op te tree waar nodig.
tgt: Government and its agencies are actively monitoring the situation and are ready to act where necessary.

src: President Jacob Zuma lewer sy jaarlikse toespraak aan die Nasionale Huis van Tradisionele Leiers op 3 Maart 2017.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will deliver his annual address to the National House of Traditional Leaders on 3 March 2017.Emanating from the Address a Programme of Action will be developed and implemented by the House and the Department of Traditional Affairs.

src: Die amptelike opening van die Huis val saam met die viering van sy 20ste bestaansjaar.
tgt: The official opening of the house will also celebrate 20 years since it was constituted.

src: President Jacob Zuma sal 'n Suid-Afrikaanse regeringsafvaardiging na die Buitengewone Beraad van die SAOG op 18 Maart 2017 in die Koninkryk van Swaziland lei.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will lead a South African government delegation to the SADC Extraordinary Summit on 18 March 2017, in the Kingdom of Swaziland.

src: Die SAOG dien steeds as die primêre bron vir Suid-Afrika se buitelandse beleid om streeksontwikkeling en integrasie in suider-Afrika te WEBTOKEN verwagting sal die beraad gesprek voer oor, onder meer, die toestand van vrede en veiligheid in die streek, met spesifieke klem op ontwikkelings in die Koninkryk van Lesotho en die Demokratiese Republiek van die Kongo, sowel as die implementering van die Hersiene Aanwysende Strategiese Plan.
tgt: SADC continues to serve as the primary vehicle for South Africa’s foreign policy to achieve regional development and integration within our WEBTOKEN is expected that the Summit will deliberate on, amongst other things, the state of peace and security in the region, with particular focus on the developments in the Kingdom of Lesotho and the Democratic Republic of Congo and the implementation of the Revised Regional Indicative Strategic Plan.

src: Suid-Afrika, as die inkomende voorsitter van die SAOG, is geskeduleer om die volgende SAOG Gewone Beraad in Augustus 2017 aan te bied.
tgt: South Africa as the incoming Chair of SADC is scheduled to host the next SADC Ordinary Summit in August 2017.

src: President Jacob Zuma onderneem op 8 Maart ’n amptelike staatsbesoek aan Indonesië.
tgt: On 8 March President Jacob Zuma will undertake an official State Visit to Indonesia.

src: Suid-Afrika en Indonesië is albei van die grootste ekonomieë in hul streke respektiewelik en beskik oor ryk natuurlike en maritime hulpbronne.
tgt: Both South Africa and Indonesia are one of the largest economies in their respective regions, and endowed with rich natural and maritime resources.

src: Dit sal voorafgegaan word deur die Leiersberaad van die Indiese Oseaan Randgebied-assosiasie (IORA) van 6 tot 7 Maart 2017, wat saamval met die viering van IORA se 20ste bestaansjaar.
tgt: This will be preceded by the Leaders' Summit of the Indian Ocean RIM Association (IORA) from 6 to 7 March 2017, which will also commemorate IORA's 20th anniversary.

src: Tydens die vergadering sal President Widodo die voorsitterskap van IORA aan Suid-Afrika oorhandig.
tgt: At that Summit, President Widodo will hand over the chairship of IORA to South Africa.

src: Suid-Afrika en Indonesië is albei stigterslede van IORDit bestaan uit 21 lande wat aan die Indiese Oseaan geleë is.
tgt: South Africa and Indonesia are both founding members of IORA, which comprises 21 coastal states of the Indian Ocean.

src: Suid-Afrika het van 2015 tot vroeg-2017 as visevoorsitter gedien, en sal van 2017 tot 2019 as voorsitter dien.
tgt: South Africa served as Vice Chair from 2015 to early 2017 and will serve as Chair from 2017 to Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring dat die Konsepbeleid vir die Bestuur van Mynwater vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the gazetting of the draft Mine Water Management Policy for public comment.

src: Mynwaterbestuur, insluitend suur mynwater, bly 'n groot omgewingsuitdaging.
tgt: Mine Water Management, including Acid Mine Drainage, remains a major environmental challenge.

src: Die beleid verskaf die basis om partye potensieel aanspreeklik te hou vir negatiewe gevolge en skade deur suur mynwaterdreinering wat besoedelding en/of enige ander negatiewe uitwerkings het wat daarmee verband hou.
tgt: The Policy provides the basis for holding parties potentially liable for negative effects and damages of Acid Mine Drainage related pollution and/or any other negative impacts that can be related to it.

src: Die beleid poog ook om metodes voor te stel wat deur mynhuise ondersoek kan word om hul water beter te bestuur.
tgt: The policy also seeks to propose mechanisms that mining houses should explore to better manage their water.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die vorderingsverslag van die Inter-Ministeriële Komitee vir die Opknapping van Behoeftige Myngemeenskappe se implementering van toepaslike bevindings wat volg op sy Normbepalingstudietoer van die Australiese Mynbedryf van 24 tot 28 Augustus 2015.Die studietoer is gegrond op die vinnige beoordeling van die beleid en regulerende stelsels waarvolgens die mynbousektor bestuur word.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the progress report of the Inter-Ministerial Committee for the Revitalisation of Distressed Mining Communities’ implementation of relevant findings from its Australian Mining Industry Benchmarking Study tour of 24 to 28 August 2015.The study tour was premised on the Rapid Appraisal of the Policy and Regulatory Systems Governing the Mining Sector which compared the policy and legislative frameworks governing the mining sector as well as the practices of mining companies in Australia, Chile, South Africa and Zambia.

src: Vorderingshoogtepunte sluit in vennootskappe tussen die Regering en mynmaatskappye rakende die lewering van behoorlike behuising en lewensomstandighede vir mynwerkers en lede van die gemeenskap.
tgt: Highlights of progress include partnerships between government and mining companies in delivering decent housing and living conditions for mine workers and community members A review of mining companies water treatment plants is being conducted to assess the possibility of infrastructure partnerships.

src: Mynmaatskappye se waterbehandelingsaanlegte word ook geïnspekteer om die moontlikheid van infrastruktuurvennootskappe te evalueer.
tgt: The development of mining towns spatial transformation plans has been finalised for five municipalities.

src: Hierbenewens is die ontwikkeling van ruimtelike transformasieplanne vir myndorpe vir vyf munisipaliteite gefinaliseer.
tgt: Catalytic economic development projects are being implemented in labour sending areas, with an emphasis on the advancement of the agriculture sector in mining communities and fast tracking of increased access to medical assessments for ex-mineworkers, community members and current mineworkers.

src: Katalitiese ekonomiese ontwikkelingsprojekte word in gebiede geïmplementeer waarheen arbeid gestuur word, met die klem op die bevordering van die landbousektor in myngemeenskappe.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the Departments of Labour and Mineral Resources to study the different Australian mine commuting models to assist long haul South African migrant mineworkers to commute home more frequently.

src: Verbeterde toegang tot mediese ondersoeke vir gewese mynwerkers, gemeenskapslede en huidige mynwerkers sal ook versnel word.
tgt: Cabinet also approved for the Department of Health work closely with the Department of Mineral Resources and other partners in the provision of supportive services to ex-mineworkers in dealing with occupational diseases, with a view to reducing and preventing mine related occupational health challenges.

src: Dit is in 2007 van stapel gestuur om die aantal bekwame onderwysers wat in prioriteitsgebiede spesialiseer te verhoog.
tgt: It has made an important contribution to a substantial increase in enrolment in initial teacher education.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die Nasionale anti-Bendebedrywighede-strategie om bendebedrywighede in al sy manifestasies te bestry aan die hand van 'n volle regeringsbenadering.
tgt: Success indicators are the adoption of four complementary strategies: The Mzansi Golden Economy Strategy the Social Cohesion Strategy the National Development Plan and the New Growth Path Strategy and fully established Department of Arts and Culture agencies with Boards.

src: Dit strook met die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan se bepaling wat verseker dat mense in Suid-Afrika veilig voel by hul huise, skole en werkplekke, en gemeenskapslewe sonder vrees kan geniet.
tgt: South Africa has also made substantive progress in recognising the importance of indigenous languages in policy and legislation.

src: Die Kabinet dra saam met President Jacob Zuma sy meegevoel oor aan die familie van Regter Essa Moosa, wat 'n skitterende lig van die regbank was en Suid-Afrika voortreflik gedien het voordat hy in 2011 as 'n regter van die Wes-Kaapse hooggeregshof afgtree het.

src: a. Ekonomiese Transformasie.
tgt: Economic Transformation.

src: Ekonomiese transformasie vereis radikale verandering in die produktiewe basis van die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie dit vereis ook 'n verandering in die deelnemingspatrone van voorheen benadeelde mense aan die ekonomie.
tgt: Economic Transformation requires radical change in the productive base of the South African economy it also requires changing the patterns of participation by previously disadvantaged individuals in the economy.

src: Na aanleiding van die regering se aankondiging dat dit op die medium termyn 100 swart nyweraars sal skep om ekonomiese transformasie teweeg te bring, is 27 swart nyweraars reeds sedert die instelling van die program ondersteun, waarvan nege in hierdie kwartaal.
tgt: Following Government’s announcement that it would create 100 black industrialists over the medium term to bring about economic transformation, 27 Black Industrialists have been supported since the inception of the programme, 9 of which were supported in this quarter.

src: Die regering se steun het tot 'n geprojekteerde privaatsektorbelegging van altesaam R956 miljoen, gelei, terwyl 1 053 werksgeleenthede na verwagting geskep sal word.

src: Die doel is om 'n mensgesentreerde, kennisgebaseerde samelewing te ontwikkel, wat die Suid-Afrikaanse samelewing en die ekonomie transformeer op grond van toegang tot en benutting van moderne inligtingskommunikasietegnologieë.Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring vir die publikasie van die Nasionale e-Regering- strategie en -roeteaanwyser vir openbare kommentaar.
tgt: The Integrated Criminal Justice System is geared towards strengthening the cooperation and integration of law enforcement agencies in realising the strategic objective of the National Development Plan – of building safer communities and creating a resilient anti-corruption Criminal Justice System.

src: Dit gee 'n uiteensetting van die strategiese raamwerk vir 'n multi-sektorale vennootskap om vordering te maak met die vermindering van siektes en sterftes wat met MIV, TB en SOS'e verband hou.
tgt: The Task Team chaired by the Deputy Minister in the Presidency provides a strategic platform for decision-makers in government, civil society and the private sector to discuss collective action that will accelerate transformation in the creative industry.

src: Dit is belyn met die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan, wat erkenning gee aan die stremmende uitwerking wat MIV en TB op nasionale ontwikkeling het.
tgt: Issues that are dealt with include: piracy, copyright protection and infringement, local content and airplay, social security including income smoothing, organisation the industry in particular performers, transformation of the sector and skills development.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die Ministeriële Komitee se Verlsag oor die Konsep Beleidsraamwerk vir Gestremdheid in die Naskoolse Onderwys- en Opleidingstelsel, wat aanbevelings maak vir die ontwikkeling van 'n Strategiese Gestremdheidbeleidsraamwerk.
tgt: The work of the Task Team supports government’s Mzansi Golden Economy, which facilities employment creation, enhances both social equity and competitiveness and mobilises domestic investment around activities that could create sustainable employment.

src: Dit gee uitdrukking aan die Grondwet se bepaling rakende die verwydering van hindernisse tot die integrasie van kwesbare groepe in die hoofstroomsamelewing as deelnemende lede van die samelewing.
tgt: Working with many industry players and across government departments, the Task Team initiated a number of interventions to unlock and optimize the performance industry throughout the value chain some of which include the introduction of the Copyright Amendment Bill and the Performers Protection Bill to Parliament improvement of frequency of anti-piracy raids etc.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring vir die indiening van die Hersiene Konvensie oor die Erkenning van Studies, Sertifikate, Diplomas, Grade en ander Akademiese Kwalifikasies in Hoër Onderwys in Afrika-state aan die Parlement vir bekragtiging.
tgt: Cabinet approved South Africa’s revised offer in the Southern African Development Community (SADC) Trade in Services Negotiation relating to the construction and transport sectors.

src: Hierdie hersiene konvensie het ten doel om 'n gunstige omgewing oor Afrika-state heen te skep vir die erkenning van hoëronderwyskwalifikasies soos sertifikate, diplomas, grade en ander akademiese kwalifikasies ten einde groter mobiliteit aan leerders, akademici en werkers deur die vasteland te vergemaklik.
tgt: Service liberalisation represents a key step in the deeper integration of SADC and contributes to the establishment of a regional market that will support the emergence and development of regional firms to provide services to a larger regional market.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring vir die publikasie van die Nasionale Beleid vir 'n Geïntegreerde Loopbaanontwikkelingstelsel vir Suid-Afrika, vir openbare kommentaar.
tgt: This contributes to the National Development Plan’s objectives of promoting regional economic integration and the development of the African continent.

src: Die beleid maak voorsiening vir 'n bevorderlike omgewing vir die lewering van loopbaanontwikkelingsdiensdienste deur beleid, riglyne, protokolle, meganismes, strukture, gedeelde verantwoordelikhede en samewerking.
tgt: Cabinet approved the tabling of the accession to the Amended Nairobi Convention for the Protection, Management and Development of the Marine and Coastal Environment of the Western Indian Ocean, in Parliament.

src: Dit sal verseker dat alle landsburgers van alle ouderdomme, toegang tot gehalte loopbaaninligting en loopbaanontwikkelingsdienste deur hul lewens sal hê, om hulle in staat te stel om beter en meer ingeligte beroeps- en lewenskeuses te maak.
tgt: This provides a mechanism for regional cooperation, coordination and collaborative actions in the Eastern and Southern African region.

src: Dit sal help om hoër vlakke van indiensneming en volhoubare ekonomiese groei in die land te verhoog en landsburgers se volle deelname aan die algehele ontwikkeling van Suid-Afrika te bevorder.
tgt: This will enable Contracting Parties to harness resources and expertise from a wide range of stakeholders and interest groups towards solving interlinked problems of the coastal and marine environment including critical national and transboundary issues.

src: Die losmaak van dienste is 'n belangrike stap om die SAOG verder te integreer en by te dra tot die totstandkoming van 'n streeksmark wat die ontwikkeling van streeksmaatskappye ondersteun om dienste aan groter streeksmarkte te lewer.
tgt: The Bill also seeks to regulate the prescription of the areas of jurisdiction of the Provincial Councils, to provide that only practicing legal practitioners may perform certain acts or render certain services, to further regulate the duties of banks in respect of trust accounts, to regulate the duration of the National Forum on the Legal Profssion and to provide for the dissolution date of the law societies.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die resultate van die 22ste sitting van die Konferensie van Partye (COP22) oor die Verenigde Nasies se Klimaatsverandering-konvensie (UNFCCC), en die 12de sitting van die Konferensie van Partye, wat as die Byeenkoms van die Partye tot die Kyoto-protokol (CMP 12) dien, wat van 7 tot 18 November 2016 in Marrakech, Marokko gehou is.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will convene the third Presidential Local Government Summit from 6 to 7 April 2017 under the theme ”Transforming Municipal Spaces for Radical Social and Economic Development”.The Summit will focus on strengthening the local government system as part of the second phase of the Back to Basics programme.

src: In die afgelope 18 jaar het ons demokratiese instellings gebou, die staatsdiens omskep, basiese dienslewering uitgebrei, die ekonomie gestabiliseer en ons regmatige plek in die gemeenskap van nasies gevestig.
tgt: Over the past 15 years, SANParks has progressively increased the number of Public Private Partnership’s transactions, covering a wide range of projects, including accommodation, restaurants, retail, activities, Skukuza airport and the Table Mountain Aerial Cableway.

src: Die Kabinet bevestig die verbintenisse wat deur President Jacob Zuma gemaak is tydens sy toespraak by die 17de Nasionale Onderwyserstoekennings, naamlik dat stappe gedoen sal word teen onderwysers wat steeds lyfstraf in skole toepas.
tgt: The Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC) on Comprehensive Social Security, chaired by President Jacob Zuma has been hard at work to ensure that Government continues to pay more than 17 million social grants to qualifying beneficiaries from 1 April 2017.Beneficiaries receiving social grants from merchants and banks will be paid on 1 April 2017 while those using SASSA pay points will be paid from 3 April 2017.

src: Die Groepering vir Justisie, Misdaadvoorkoming en Sekuriteit, gelei deur President Jacob Zuma, bevestig sy verbintenis tot die stryd teen misdaad en doen 'n beroep op gemeenskappe om verdagte aktiwiteite by die betrokke owerhede aan te meld.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates the commitments made by President Jacob Zuma’s during his address at the 17th National Teachers' Awards: that Action will be taken against teachers who continue to use corporal punishment in schools, this is unlawful and action will be taken against teachers who break the law and violate the dignity and personal safety of children.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy innige meegevoel oor aan die familie en geliefdes van die legendariese akteur en rolprentmaker mnrJoe "Sdumo" Mafela, algemeen bekend as 'Sdumo.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma has declared a Special Official Funeral for the late Rivonia Treason Trialist and stalwart of the liberation struggle for a free and democratic South Africa, Mr Ahmed “Kathy” Kathrada.

src: Direksie van die Agentskap vir Tegnologiese Innovering:MnrEdward Christen Kieswetter (voorsitter)Dr Steven LennonMeJoy Sebenzile MatsebulaMnrThabiso RamasikeMeFuzlin Levy-HassenMePatience Lethabo MlenganaMnrMzwandile MadikizelaDr Jan van de LoosdrechtDr Judy Coates, enProfRoy Marcus.
tgt: Cabinet conveyed condolences to the family and friends of Bloemfontein Celtic founder Dr Petrus Rantlai Molemela.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 26 April 2017 op die vooraand van die 23ste nasionale Vryheidsdagvierings, by die Uniegebou vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 26 April 2017, at the Union Buildings, on the eve of the 23rd national Freedom Day celebrations.

src: President Jacob Zuma was voorsitter van die vergadering, waartydens die nuwe lede van die Uitvoerende Raad verwelkom is.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma chaired the Cabinet meeting, which welcomed the new Members of the Executive who further complement the existing leadership in government in spear heading implementation of government’s Programme of Action for radical economic transformation and inclusive socio-economic growth.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Departement van Landbou, Bosbou en Visserye as mede-aanbieder van die Wêreld Akwakultuur-vereniging se konferensie in Kaapstad van 26 tot 30 Junie 2017, optree.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries to co-host the World Aquaculture Society conference in Cape Town from 26 to 30 June 2017.This contributes to Operation Phakisa Aquaculture Lab which aims to increase aquaculture growth by five-fold in the next five years from 4 000 tons to 20 000 tons, to create 15 000 jobs and increase the contribution of aquaculture towards GDP.

src: Dit sal bydra tot Operasie Phakisa se Akwakultuur-laboratorium, wat daarop gerig is om die akwakultuur-groeikoers binne die volgende vyf jaar vyf keer te verhoog van 4 000 ton tot 20 000 ton, om 15 000 werksgeleenthede te skep en die bydrae van akwakultuur tot die bruto binnelandse produk (BBP) te verhoog.
tgt: Aquaculture presents a good opportunity to diversify fish production to satisfy local demand, food security, export opportunities and create jobs.

src: Akwakultuur bied 'n gulde geleentheid om visproduksie te diversifiseer en sodoende aan die plaaslike vraag te voldoen, sowel as om voedselveiligheid, uitvoergeleenthede en werksgeleenthede te bevorder.
tgt: Hosting the conference will promote the sector, enhance investment by private sector and donors, and assist in fast-tracking aquaculture development locally through insights from aquaculture strategies from other nations.

src: Deur die konferensie plaaslik aan te bied, sal die sektor bevorder word, beleggings deur die private sektor en donateurs sal toeneem, en die ontwikkeling van die plaaslike akwakultuurbedryf sal versnel deur insig in ander lande se akwakultuurstrategieë te verkry.
tgt: Cabinet approved the establishment of an Inter-Ministerial Committee to oversee and provide strategic direction during the preparations for and hosting of the 37th Ordinary Southern African Development Community (SADC) Summit of Heads of State and Government to be held in August 2017.The SADC Summit will take place under the theme “Partnering with the Private Sector in Developing Industry and Regional Value Chains”, emphasising the need to address critical factors to implement and achieve SADC’s Industrial Strategy and Action Plan.

src: Suid-Afrika sal sy posisie as voorsitter van die SAOG gebruik om die land se nasionale belange strategies te bevorder soos uiteengesit in die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan om streeksekonomiese geleenthede en sekuriteitsverwante sake te versterk.
tgt: The celebration of Africa Month contributes to the decolonisation of the African continent through a variety of government and civil society projects under the theme: “A Year of OR Tambo: Building a Better Africa and a Better World”.Africa Month contributes to the Pan African call for African unity and co-operation, and is used as a platform by all African Union Member States to take stock of progress made towards realising Agenda 2063.The government-wide month long programme, which will be available on WEBTOKEN, goes beyond the arts and culture sector to embrace the contributions of the South African Government through economic, political and social factors impacting on the development of the continent.

src: Die Departement van Kuns en Kultuur sal 'n derde uitgawe van Afrika-maand in Me 2017 aanbied.
tgt: Activities and dialogues are celebratory and educational, all have political and socio-economic benefits for the people of South Africa and the rest of the continent to celebrate their Africaness and recommit to building communities grounded on positive shared African values and principles.

src: Dit vorm deel van Suid-Afrika se bydrae tot die vasteland se viering van die transformasie van die Organisasie van Afrika-eenheid, wat op 25 Me 1963 gestig is, tot die huidige Afrika-Unie, en sy verwante instellings en programme.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the successful hosting of the International Federation of Library Associations (IFLA) and Institutions Annual World Library and Information Congress held in South Africa, Cape Town from 15 to 21 August 2015.The IFLA Cape Town Declaration will be submitted to the African Union Ministers of Culture for concurrence, support and implementation.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die suksesvolle aanbieding van die Internasionale Federasie van Biblioteekverenigings (IFLA) en -Instellings se Jaarlikse Wêreldbiblioteek- en Inligtingskongres, wat van 15 tot 21 Augustus 2015 in Kaapstad gehou is.
tgt: Government’s commitment to bolster the economy was reaffirmed during the successful engagement between the Minister of Finance, Malusi Gigaba with investors and the global finance community during the visit to the United States of America for the International Monetary Fund and World Bank Spring Meetings.

src: Die IFLA Kaapstad-verklaring sal aan die Afrika-ministers van kultuur voorgelê word vir goedkeuring, ondersteuning en implementering.
tgt: Minister Gigaba also interacted with domestic investors and the NEDLAC Special Executive Committee chaired by Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa.

src: Die regering se verbintenis om die ekonomie ’n hupstoot te gee is herbevestig tydens suksesvolle samesprekings tussen die Minister van Finansies, Malusi Gigaba, met beleggers en die wêreldwye finansiële gemeenskap tydens ’n besoek aan die Verenigde State van Amerika vir die Internasionale Montêre Fonds en die Wêreldbank se Lentevergaderings.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma’s launch of the Maluti-A-Phofung Special Economic Zone (MAP-SEZ) in Tshiame, Harrismith, in the Eastern Free State, on 25 April 2017 demonstrates governments’ promotion of industrial development which is key to the nation’s long-term economic success and prosperity.

src: Minister Gigaba het ook samesprekings gevoer met binnelandse beleggers en die Nedlac Spesiale Uitvoerende Komitee, onder voorsitterskap van Adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa.
tgt: The priority sectors for the MAP-SEZ are automotive, agro-processing, logistics, ICT, pharmaceuticals and general processing.

src: Die verbintenisse het beklemtoon dat die regering se beleidsoriëntering ná omsigtige fiskale dissipline en streng fiskale konsolidasie soos in die 2017 Nasionale Begroting uitgelig, onveranderd sal bly.
tgt: This creates opportunities for manufacturing as well as a regional and international trade environment with an added value chain within the Maluti-A-Phofung Municipality.

src: Die bekendstelling deur President Jacob Zuma van die Maluti-A-Phofung Spesiale Ekonomiese Sone (MAP-SEZ) in Tshiame, Harrismith, in the Oos-Vrystaat op 25 April 2017, lewer bewys van die regering se pogings om industriële ontwikkeling te bevorder dit is ’n sleutelfaktor vir die land se langtermyn ekonomiese sukses en voorspoed.
