tgt: The Special Economic Zones also continue to play a role in attracting Foreign Direct Investment (FDI).This 1038-hectare MAP-SEZ launch forms a key part of the implementation of the Industrial Policy Action Plan which designates Special Economic Zones to accelerate local economic growth and development in specific regions of the country.

src: Die prioriteitsektore vir die MAP-SEZ is logistieke, motor-, landbou-, IKT-, farmaseutiese en algemene prosessering.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the A. Kearney’s 2017 Foreign Direct Investment Confidence report, which indicates that South Africa is the 25th most attractive destination for foreign direct investment globally, the first from the African Continent.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die A. Kearney 2017 Buitelandse Direkte Beleggingsvertrouensverslag, wat daarop dui dat Suid-Afrika die 25ste aantreklikste bestemming vir buitelandse direkte belegging wêreldwyd is.
tgt: The country’s attractiveness as an investment destination of choice was further highlighted in the African Economic Outlook 2016 report, which places South Africa fourth among the leading African investment destinations in 2015 after Egypt ($10.2 billion), Mozambique ($4.7 billion) and Morocco ($4.2 billion) with $3.6 billion in foreign investment.

src: Die land word gelys saam met ander ontwikkelende lande soos China (3de), Indië (8ste) Brasilië (16de) en Meiko (17de).Hierdie posisie toon dat Suid-Afrika se strategiese vennootskap met buitelandse beleggers momentum kry en dui verder daarop dat ons land se bloudruk vir ontwikkeling resultate lewer.
tgt: The 27th World Economic Forum on Africa will take place at the Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre in Durban from 3 to 5 May 2017 under the theme: “Achieving Inclusive Growth: Responsive and Responsible Leadership.”Cabinet welcomes this opportunity for South Africans to engage in dialogue on potential investment opportunities, deeper regional integration and a renewed commitment towards sustainable growth and development in WEBTOKEN is home to some of the world’s fastest growing economies which have attracted increasing interest from global investors.

src: Verbetering van korttermyn ekonomiese vooruitsigte en langtermynbeleggings in die land se vervaardigingsektor is aangehaal as 'n paar van die belangrikste dryfvere vir Suid-Afrika se verbeterde gradering op die indeks.
tgt: South Africa is the most diversified economy on the continent and plays an integral role in Africa’s advancement.

src: In ’n afsonderlike verlsag, lys die jongste Afrika-beleggingsindeks 2016 deur Quantum Global se onafhanklike navorsingsafdeling, Suid-Afrika as die vierde aantreklikste beleggingsbestemming in Afrika ná Botswana, Marokko en Egipte.
tgt: The commitment by South Africa and Oman to enhance trade relations, at a business forum on 27 March 2017 between Trade and Industry Minister Rob Davies and his Omani counterpart, Dr Ali Bin Masoud Al-Sunaidy, enables South African businesspeople to take advantage of the opportunities that Oman presents, particularly for agricultural and agro-processing industries.

src: Suid-Afrika het ook goed gevaar op die groeifaktor van die BBP, die gemak om sake in die land te doen en 'n beduidende bevolking.
tgt: Further, the Department of Trade and Industry’s investment mission to Ghana and Nigeria between the 20 and 25 March 2017 contributed to identifying and creating export markets for South African value-added products and services.

src: "Die Kabinet verwelkom hierdie geleentheid vir Suid-Afrikaners om in gesprek te tree oor moontlike beleggingsgeleenthede, dieper streeksintegrasie en hernude toewyding tot volhoubare groei en ontwikkeling in Afrika.
tgt: Increasing trade on the continent and fostering partnerships with African partners can lead to poverty alleviation, increased trade flows, industrial development and subsequent creation of more jobs, which is key to the economic development of Africa.

src: Afrika is die tuiste van sommige van die wêreld se vinnigste groeiende ekonomieë wat toenemende belangstelling van wêreldwye beleggers lok.
tgt: The Minister of Small Business Development, Lindiwe Zulu led the South African delegation at the Estonia business forum which was hosted by the South African Chamber of Commerce and Industry.

src: Suid-Afrika is die mees gediversifiseerde ekonomie op die vasteland en speel 'n integrale rol in Afrika se vooruitgang.
tgt: With Estonia’s economy consisting of 90 per cent SMMEs, South Africa’s partnership bolsters government’s commitment to job creation and the promotion of small, medium-sized and micro enterprises (SMMEs).

src: Suid-Afrika en Oman het hulle tydens 'n sakeforum op 27 Maart 2017 tussen die Minister van Handel en Nywerheid, Rob Davies, en sy Omani-eweknie, dr. Ali Bin Masoud Al-Sunaidy, daartoe verbind om handelsbetrekkinge te bevorder.
tgt: The resilience of our farming sector supported by early warning systems and research, notwithstanding the Fall Army Worm infestation and the drought, was demonstrated by the 2017 estimated commercial maize crop size, which is 84% bigger than the 2016 crop, which was the smallest crop since 2007.

src: Dit stel Suid-Afrikaanse sakemanne in staat om voordeel te trek uit die geleenthede wat Oman bied, veral in landbou- en landbouverwerkingsnywerhede.
tgt: The three main maize producing areas, namely the Free State, Mpumalanga and North West provinces are expected to produce 82% of the 2017 crop.

src: Ander Izimbizo’s sluit in: die bekendstelling van die Sentrum vir Entrepreneurskap by Goldfields se Tegniese en Beroepsonderrig en -Opleidingkollege in Welkom, in die Vrystaat deur die Minister van Kleinsakeontwikkeling, me Lindiwe Zulu.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma led the 23rd national Freedom Day celebrations on 27 April 2017 under the theme “The year of OR Tambo: Together deepening democracy and building safer and crime-free communities”.The President’s engagement in Manguzi, Umhlabuyalingana forms part of a national anti-crime campaign, which is also a follow-up to the Presidential Siyahlola Monitoring Programme in March 2017.

src: Die sentrum dra by om die uitdaging van jeugwerkloosheid te pak deur in die vroeë stadium van die ondernemingsreis toepaslike ondersteuning aan jongmense te bied.
tgt: It highlights the need for urgent action to address cross-border crime especially car hijackings.

src: President Jacob Zuma het die 23ste nasionale Vryheidsdagvieringe op 27 April 2017 gelei onder die tema "Die jaar van OR Tambo: Saam versterk ons demokrasie en bou veiliger en misdaadvrye gemeenskappe ".Die President se betrokkenheid by Manguzi, Umhlabuyalingana, vorm deel van 'n nasionale teen-misdaadveldtog.
tgt: In Freedom month we celebrate the contribution to our freedom and democracy, of former ANC President and national hero, Oliver Reginald Tambo, who would have turned 100 years old this year had he lived.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op die jeug om hul regte en verantwoordelikhede omsigtig uit te oefen en om diegene wat vir ons vryheid geveg het te respekteer, sodat dit deur almal in ons demokratiese land geniet kan word.
tgt: Through the co-operation agreements both nations are committed to forge close mutual technical co-operation, teacher training and expertise exchanges in the field of education, particularly in Mathematics, Science and Technology as building blocks for the growth of knowledge economies.

src: Die interninisteriële komitee oor die Mes-tot-Mes-uitruilmeganisme onder leiding van Minister Nathi Mthethwa, het vise-premier Lui Yandong en afgevaardigdes van die Volksrepubliek van China ontvang.
tgt: Cabinet thanks all government departments, NGOs, professionals and businesses who are supporting the affected families as well as learners and staff members from Mahlenga High School and Refano Primary School during this difficult period.

src: Die Kabinet sluit ook aan by President Jacob Zuma in die uiting van diep hartseer en skok oor die afsterwe van 18 skoolkinders en twee volwassenes tydens 'n verskriklike minibustaxi-ongeluk in Bronkhorstspruit, buite Pretoria.
tgt: Cabinet acknowledges the work done by the Inter Ministerial Committee, led by the Minister of Cooperative Government and Traditional Affairs Mr Des Van Rooyen and the visit by Safety and Security Minister, Fikile Mbalula, and endorses the view that criminal activities including damage and destruction of property will not be tolerated.

src: Ons herhaal die oproep van President Zuma aan wetstoepassingsagentskappe dat die oorsaak van die ongeluk so gou as moontlik ondersoek moet word.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma is scheduled to meet with VhaVenda King Toni Mphephu Ramabulana and traditional leaders from Vhembe district in a bid to bring stability.

src: Die Kabinet bedank alle staatsdepartemente, NRO's, professionele persone en besighede wat die betrokke families, sowel as leerders en personeel van Mahlenga High School en Refano Primary in hierdie moeilike tydperk ondersteun.
tgt: Cabinet emphasises that money and resources spent on replacing damaged schools was meant for other programmes.

src: Die slagting op ons paaie, veral tydens vakansies in Suid-Afrika, bly 'n groot vron van nasionale kommer.
tgt: Cabinet also called for calm and stability following violent protests in Lichtenburg town and Blydeville Township, in Ditsobotla Local Municipality, North West.

src: Die Kabinet is bekommerd oor die onlangse opswaai in geweld in Vuwani na aanleiding van die besluit van die Munisipale Afbakeningsraad om dit in 'n nuwe munisipaliteit in te sluit.
tgt: Cabinet appeals to the Coligny community, in North West to stop their violent protests and allow the South African Police Service in Coligny to complete their investigation into the death of a child, to ensure that justice is served.

src: Die Kabinet erken die werk wat deur die Interministeriële Komitee gedoen is, gelei deur die Minister van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake, mnr Des Van Rooyen, en die besoek van die Minister van Veiligheid en Sekuriteit, Fikile Mbalula, en onderskryf die siening dat kriminele aktiwiteite insluitend skade en vernietiging van eiendom nie geduld sal word nie.
tgt: Government commends law enforcement agencies for their response in bringing perpetrators of violence against women and children to WEBTOKEN this regard, Cabinet welcomes the swift actions taken by the Hawks’ Human Trafficking Unit and the South African Police Service’s Tactical Response Team who arrested a Durban-based pastor on a charge of human trafficking in Port WEBTOKEN is the duty and responsibility of all South Africans to work with authorities to protect our women and children from predators and to ensure that we do our part in making our communities safer.

src: Die Kabinet het ook ‘n beroep gedoen vir kalmte en stabiliteit ná gewelddadige betogings in Lichtenburg en Blydeville-township in Ditsobotla Plaaslike Munisipaliteit, Noordwes.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Jacob Zuma in sending condolences to the family and friends of legendary boxing mentor and trainer, Nick Durandt, who was known for his ability to produce champion boxers and for taking young boys out of the streets and making champions out of them.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 10 Me 2017 te Tuynhuys, Kaapstad vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 10 May 2017, at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.

src: Wêreld Ekonomiese Forum oor Afrika.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die suksesvolle aanbieding van die 27ste Wêreld Ekonomiese Forum oor Afrika, waar President Jacob Zuma die Suid-Afrikaanse span, staatshoofde en regerings van die vasteland van Afrika, globale leiers in handel en nywerheid en die leiers van die burgerlike samelewing, gelei het.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the successful hosting of the 27th World Economic Forum on Africa, which saw President Jacob Zuma leading Team South Africa, Heads of State and Governments from the African continent, global captains of industry and commerce and civil society leadership.

src: Die konferensie is gehou onder die tema: Behaal inklusiewe groei: responsiewe en verantwoordelike leierskap.2 Hierdie 27ste sessie van die Wêreld Ekonomiese Forum oor Afrika het aan die wêreld bevestig dat Suid-Afrika deel bly van die potensiële beleggingsbestemming op die vasteland van Afrika.
tgt: The conference was held under the theme: “Achieving inclusive growth: responsive and responsible leadership”.

src: Die organiseerders het bevestig dat meer as 1 000 afgevaardigdes die geleentheid bygewoon het, 'n ongekende getal vergeleke met die vorige WEFA.3 Die sterk gees van vennootskap tussen die regering en die sakegemeenskap tydens WEFA was uiters positief.
tgt: The organisers confirmed that more than 1 000 delegates attended the event, a number that is unprecedented when compared with the previous WEF on Africa.

src: Die betekenisvolle gesprek het Suid-Afrika die geleentheid gebied om die vordering wat gemaak word met inklusiewe ekonomiese groei bekend te maak en om te wys dat Suid-Afrika oop is vir sake.
tgt: The strong spirit of partnership between government and the business community during WEF on Africa was extremely positive.

src: Suid-Afrika is steeds daartoe verbind om op koers te bly met die implementering van sy Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan om armoede, ongelykheid en werkloosheid te verminder.
tgt: The rich discussion afforded South Africa an opportunity to showcase progress it was making towards an inclusive economic growth and to demonstrate that South Africa is open to business.

src: Vervoer.1 Die bekendstelling van die Passasierspooragentskap van Suid-Afrika (PRASA) se nuwe treine en treindiens deur President Jacob Zuma op 9 Me 2017 by die Pretoria-stasie, is deel van die regering se volgehoue verbintenis om bekostigbare en betroubare openbare vervoer te verseker en die land se ekonomiese infrastruktuur te bevorder.2 Die nuwe Merorail-treine maak deel uit van die nuwe vloot wat in die volgende 10 tot 15 jaar deur die regering bekendgestel sal word as deel van PRASA se moderniseringsprogram.
tgt: South Africa remains committed to staying on course in implementing its National Development Plan (NDP) to reduce levels of poverty, inequality and unemployment.

src: Dit is die begin van die operasionalisering van die Franse en Brasiliaanse ooreenkoms wat tussen PRASA en Alstom onderteken is.3 Die nuwe moderne Merorail-treine bied ongeëwenaarde gerief en diens, en sal pendelaars se reiservaring transformeer.
tgt: The launch of the new Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa (PRASA) trains and train service by President Zuma on 9 May 2017 at the Pretoria Station is part of government’s ongoing commitment to ensure affordable and reliable public transport, and boost the country’s economic infrastructure.

src: Dit is deel van die regering se ekonomiese ontwikkeling deur middel van massiewe infrastruktuurontwikkeling, wat ook gestremheidsvriendelik is.4 Die Kabinet het 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners gedoen om trots te wees op die nuwe treine en hulle teen dade van vandalisme te beskerm.
tgt: The new Metrorail (People's) trains are part of the new fleet that will be rolled out by government over the next 10 to 15 years as part of PRASA’s Modernization Programme.

src: Vuwani-protes.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom President Zuma se suksesvolle ingryping in Vuwani, Limpopo.
tgt: This initiative will create thousands of sustainable jobs and job opportunities, with the manufacturing plant for the new trains underway in Nigel, Ekurhuleni.

src: Die President het onderneem om terug te keer na die gemeenskap van Vuwani om met die gemeenskap te kommunikeer op 'n datum wat nog bevestig moet word met Sy Majesteit Koning Yoni Mphephu Ramabulana en al die betrokke belanghebbendes in die gebied.5 Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op ouers en die gemeenskap om die departementele ingrypings te ondersteun om te verseker dat leerders terugkeer skool toe sodat hulle op hul studies kan fokus en agterstallige werk inhaal deur middel van intervensies wat by alle skole bekend gestel word.
tgt: The President met with His Majesty King Toni Mphephu Ramabulana of Vha-Venda and other community stakeholders to find amicable solutions to issues raised.

src: Gewelddadige protes.1 Die Kabinet doen ’n ernstige beroep op gemeenskappe om hulle te weerhou van geweld, intimidasie en plundering wanneer hulle hul griewe lug.
tgt: The meeting accepted His Majesty's proposal that the Vhembe District Municipality should provide services to the people of Vuwani while a lasting solution on the demarcation issue is being sought.

src: WetsontwerpeDie Kabinet verleen goedkeuring dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp vir Lughawensmaatskappye, 2017 en die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Lugverkeer- en Navigasiedienste aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet reiterated that it remains committed to the fiscal policy trajectory outlined in the Budget Speech 2017 the implementation of reforms to improve governance in state-owned companies maintain the expenditure ceiling and ensuring stabilization of government debts.

src: Die wysigings aan hierdie twee wetsontwerpe is daarop gerig om 'n permanente regulerende struktuur te voorsien.
tgt: Government’s programme on fast-tracking the implementation of structural reforms aimed at boosting economic growth, as contained in the Nine-Point Plan, remains relevant to addressing some of the issues raised by investors.

src: Die wysigings maak voorsiening vir die opstel van appèlmeganisme-komitees, wat bystand sal verleen in die oplossing van enige dispuutaangeleenthede.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the recently released report by EY Consultancy firm on the Foreign Direct Investment in Africa.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.1 President Jacob Zuma sal die openingsrede lewer by die 2017 Toerisme-indaba, wat vanaf 16 tot 18 Me 2017 by die Inkosi Albert Luthuli Internasionale Konferensiesentrum in Durban aangebied word.
tgt: The report names South Africa as one of the largest economic hub and that it is ranked second in the 2017 Africa Attractiveness Index.

src: SANW-ontplooiing.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die besluit van President Jacob Zuma om die ontplooiing van lede van die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Weermag (SANW) in die Demokratiese Republiek van die Kongo (DRK) uit te brei.
tgt: Cabinet approved that South Africa joins the Smart Africa Alliance.

src: Dit is 'n poging om by te dra tot vrede en stabiliteit op die vasteland van Afrika, en veral in die streek, ooreenkomstig ons internasionale verpligtinge en ons buitelandse beleid om by te dra tot 'n beter Afrika en 'n beter wêreld.2 Altesaam 1 371 lede van die SANW word in die DRK ontplooi ter ondersteuning van die Verenigde Nasies se Stabiliseringsmissie.
tgt: This is an African-led collaboration focusing on developing relevant solutions and sharing resources to address the development challenges facing the continent.

src: Die ontplooiing is verleng van 1 April 2017 tot 31 Maart 20.3 Ons ontplooiings op die vasteland is ter volgehoue ondersteuning van streeks- en kontinentale prosesse om op krisisse te reageer en oplossings te vind, vrede en veiligheid te bevorder, streeksintegrasie te versterk, intra-Afrikahandel beduidend te verhoog en volhoubare ontwikkeling in Afrika te bevorder.
tgt: South Africa will benefit both economically and politically through its participation in Smart WEBTOKEN positioning the South African industry and expertise at the heart of Smart Africa’s development agenda, South Africa will contribute to the growth of local business in the region.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 24 Me 2017 te Tuynhuys, Kaapstad vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 24 May 2017, at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing.1 Die Kabinet is bekommerd oor die toenemende voorkoms van mishandeling en geweld teen vroue in ons samelewing.
tgt: Issues in the environment.1 Cabinet is concerned with the rising incidences of abuse and violence against women in our society.

src: Na aanleiding van onlangse voorvalle waarby intieme vriende betrokke was, het verskeie dapper en moedige vroue hul teen hierdie skending van hul regte uitgespreek.2 Die Kabinet erken dat ons land steeds 'n patriargale samelewing het en doen as sodanig 'n beroep op mense om meer te doen om die plaag van vrouemoord en mensesmokkelary te bestry.3 Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle sektore van die samelewing om saam te staan teen hierdie plaag asook teen enige vorm van geweld teenoor vroue en kinders, en om met die polisie en die regstelsel saam te werk om die skuldiges te vervolg.4 President Jacob Zuma doen 'n ernstige beroep dat 'n einde gebring moet word aan die voortgesette geweld teen vroue en kinders.
tgt: Recent incidents involving intimate partner violence have seen many brave and courageous women speaking out against this violation of their rights.2 Cabinet acknowledges that as a country we continue to have a patriarchal society and as such calls for more to be done to fight the scourge of femicide and human trafficking.3 Cabinet calls on all sectors of society to join hands in defeating this scourge, oppose any form of violence committed against women and children, and work with the police and justice system in order to bring perpetrators to justice.

src: Die Kabinet het die regeringsgroepering vir Sosiale Beskerming, Gemeenskaps- en Meslike Ontwikkeling opdrag gegee om 'n program van aksie vir die land saam te stel wat as 'n dryfveer sal dien om die misbruik van vroue en kinders te stuit.5 Die Kabinet verwelkom die uitslae van die 2016 Suid-Afrikaanse Demografiese en Gesondheidsopname deur Statistieke Suid-Afrika, wat die gesondheidstatus van Suid-Afrikaners en die omvang en gehalte van gesondheidsprogramme meet.
tgt: Cabinet has instructed the Social Protection, Community and Human Development Cluster to put in place a programme of action that will drive the country in the fight to stop the abuse of women and children.5 Cabinet welcomes the results of the 2016 South African Demographic and Health Survey by Statistics South Africa, which measures the health status of South Africans, and the reach and quality of health programmes.

src: Die opname meld onder meer 'n daling van 20% in kindersterftes en 'n daling van 11% in die aantal vroue en mans wat tabak rook.
tgt: The survey amongst others reports a 20% drop in infant mortality and a 11% drop in the number of women and men who smoke tobacco.

src: Die uitslae toon dat die beleidstussenkoms wat deur President Zuma se administrasie ingestel is, ’n positiewe uitwerking het.
tgt: The results demonstrate that the policy interventions that were put in place by President Zuma’s administration are yielding positive results.

src: Die Kabinet is egter bekommerd oor die aantal Suid-Afrikaners wat steeds onbeskermde seks met verskeie mense het.
tgt: Cabinet, however, is concerned about the number of South Africans that still continues to engage in unprotected sex with multiple partners.

src: Sowat 32% van vroue en 42% van mans het aangedui dat hulle nog nooit vir MIV getoets is nie, ondanks die regering se pogings om bewustheid oor MIV-toetsing te verhoog.
tgt: Some 32% and 42% of women and men respectively indicated that they have never been tested for HIV despite government efforts to raise awareness on HIV testing.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om persoonlike verantwoordelikheid vir hul gesondheid en welsyn te neem, veilige seks te beoefen en gereeld getoets te word vir MIV sowel as vir alle oordraagbare en nie-oordraagbare siektes.6 Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op ouers en voogde om te verseker dat hul kinders teen kindersiektes ingeënt word.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to take personal responsibility for their health and well-being, practice safe sex and get tested regularly for HIV and all communicable and non-communicable diseases.6 Cabinet calls on parents and guardians to ensure their children are vaccinated against childhood diseases.

src: Die Kabinet bly daartoe verbind om te verseker dat kinders geïmmuniseer word om lewensbedreigende aansteeklike siektes uit te skakel.
tgt: Cabinet remains committed to ensuring children are immunised to eliminate life threatening infectious diseases.

src: Die Kabinet verseker ouers en voogde dat die middels wat deur die Departement van Gesondheid toegedien word, veilig is.7 Die Kabinet verwelkom die eerste fase van die opgeknapte Vulindlela Heights-nywerheidsgebied in Mthatha in die Oos-Kaap.
tgt: Cabinet reassures parents and guardians that the drugs administered by the Department Health are safe.7 Cabinet welcomed the first phase of the revitalised Vulindlela Heights Industrial in Mthatha in the Eastern Cape.

src: Dit is deel van die land se Herlewing van Nywerheidsparke-program (Revitalization of Industrial Parks Programme.
tgt: This is part of the country’s Revitalisation of Industrial Parks Programme.

src: Dit is die tweede van sy soort in die Oos-Kaap en een van ses parke regdeur die land wat opgeknap word.
tgt: It is the second of its kind in the Eastern Cape and one of six parks being revitalised across the country.

src: Die regering herstel nywerheidsparke om werkskepping te bevorder en om inklusiewe groei te verseker.
tgt: Government is revitalising industrial parks to boost job creation and ensure inclusive growth.

src: Die verskuiwing van ekonomiese aktiwiteite weg van stedelike sentrums is ook deel van die regering se ekonomiese transformasiepogings.
tgt: The move of economic activities away from urban centres is also part of government’s economic transformation efforts.

src: Inligting oor hoe om voordeel te trek uit geleenthede wat by ons nywerheidsparke beskikbaar is, sowel as om toegang tot regerings- en aansporingsprogramme, en beleggingsgeleenthede in verskeie sektor te verkry, is beskikbaar by WEBTOKEN of deur die Departement van Handel en Nywerheid (die dti) se kliëntekontaksentrum by 0861 843 3.8 Die Kabinet het met spyt kennis geneem van General Motors Suid-Afrika (GMSA) (Edms) Bpk se besluit om die vervaardiging en verkoop van Chevrolet-voertuie in die land uit te faseer.
tgt: Information on how to take advantage of opportunities available at our industrial parks, access government support and incentives programmes, and investment opportunities in various sectors is available at WEBTOKEN or through the Department of Trade and Industry’s (the dti) Customer Contact Centre on 0861 843 3.8 Cabinet has noted with regret the decision by General Motors South Africa (GMSA) (Pty) Ltd to phase out the manufacturing and sale of Chevrolet vehicles in the country.

src: Dit hou ernstige gevolge in vir mense wat hul werk sal verloor, asook vir ons ekonomie.
tgt: This holds dire consequences for those who will lose their job and for our economy.

src: Die regering bly verbind om die land se motorsektor, wat noodsaaklik is vir die ekonomie en werkskepping, te ondersteun.
tgt: Government remains committed to support the country’s automotive sector, which is critical for the economy and job creation.

src: Die dti werk steeds saam met alle belanghebbendes om die impak te versag.
tgt: The dti continues to work with all stakeholders to mitigate the impact.

src: Om produksie, werkskepping en uitvoerintensiteit te verhoog, het ons onlangs die negende fase van die Nywerheidsbeleidaksieplan (IPAP) geloods om ons optrede te lei.
tgt: To increase manufacturing, employment creation and export intensity, we recently launched the ninth phase of the Industrial Policy Action Plan (IPAP) to guide our actions.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis dat Isuzu, wat die afgelope jare met GMSA saamgewerk het, GMSA se bedrywighede sal oorneem.9 Die Kabinet het kennis geneem van die agteruitgang van die droogtesituasie in die Wes- en Oos-Kaap.
tgt: Cabinet notes that Isuzu, which has been partnering with GMSA over the years in South Africa, will take over the operations from GMSA.9 Cabinet has noted the deterioration of the drought situation in the Western Cape and Eastern Cape.

src: Die Kabinet doen derhalwe ’n ernstige beroep op gemeenskappe om die waterbeperkings wat deur die provinsies ingestel is, te ondersteun.
tgt: Cabinet calls on the communities to support the water restrictions introduced by the provinces.

src: 'n Span wat uit beamptes van die Departement van Water en Sanitasie en die Nasionale Rampbestuurskomitee bestaan en wat saam met die provinsies en plaaslike regerings werk, was aktief betrokke by planne om te versker dat kort- tot mediumtermynoplossings versnel word om watersekerheid op die lang termyn in die provinsie te verseker.
tgt: A team comprising officials from the Department of Water and Sanitation, the National Disaster Management Committee working with the provinces and local government, had been actively engaged in ensuring that short to medium-term solutions are fast-tracked to guarantee the water security of the province in the long term.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners, insluitende huishoudelike gebruikers, sakeondernemings, mynbou, energie en landbou om saam te werk deur water meer spaarsamig te gebruik.10 Die Kabinet verwelkom die besprekingsdokument oor die Teenkorrupsie-strategie, wat die Nasionale Teenkorrupsie-strategie sal lei.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans including domestic users, businesses, mining sector, energy and agriculture to work together and use water more sparingly.10 Cabinet welcomed the released Anti-Corruption Strategy discussion document, which will inform the National Anti-Corruption Strategy.

src: Die Kabinet nooi die publiek uit om skriftelike insette te maak op die Departement van Beplanning, Monitering en Evaluering se webwerf: www.
tgt: Cabinet invites the public to make written inputs through the Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation website: www.

src: dpme.
tgt: dpme.

src: gov.
tgt: gov.

src: za.
tgt: za.

src: Die stryd teen korrupsie bly een van die regring se belangrikste prioriteite.
tgt: The fight against corruption remains one of the main priorities for government.

src: Korrupsie en ’n gebrek aan integriteit in die private sowel as openbare sektor het ’n nadelige uitwerking op ons land se ontwikkeling.11 Die Kabinet spreek sy kommer uit oor die onlangse wêreldwye kuberaanval, wat as die grootste kuberaanval ooit beskou word.
tgt: Corruption and integrity failures in both the private and public sector have a detrimental effect on our country’s development.11 Cabinet expressed concern at the recent global cyber-attack, which has been reported as the biggest cyber-attack to date.

src: Die Kabinet moedig alle Suid-Afrikaners aan om die nodige voorsorgmaatreëls te tref wanneer hulle gebruik maak van elektroniese kommunikasie of aanlyntransaksies.
tgt: Cabinet urges all South Africans to take the necessary precautions when using electronic means of communicating or transacting.

src: Die gebruik van geaktiveerde antivirusprogrammatuur wat gereeld die kuberomgewing skandeer, word ook aanbeveel.12Die Kabinet is bekommerd oor die onlangse ontwikkelings by Eskom.
tgt: The use of updated antivirus software which scans the environment frequently is also recommended.12 Cabinet is concerned about the recent developments at Eskom.

src: Die Kabinet het waardering vir die feit dat die heraanstelling van mnrBrian Molefe as Hoof Uitvoerende Beampte van Eskom in die hof en in die Parlement aangehoor sal word, en sal hierdie prosesse respekteer.
tgt: Cabinet appreciates that the matter regarding the re-employment of Mr Brian Molefe as the Chief Executive Officer of Eskom is before courts and in Parliament, and shall therefore respect these processes.

src: Die President het egter 'n Interministeriële Komitee (IMK) aangestel wat bestaan uit die ministers van Openbare Ondernemings Energie Finansies en Justisie en Korrektiewe Dienste.
tgt: The President has, however, set up an Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC) comprising the Ministers of Public Enterprises, Energy, Finance and Justice and Correctional Services.

src: Die IMK is versoek om die feite in te samel en leiding aan die Kabinet te gee oor hoe om sulke sake in die toekoms te hanteer.
tgt: The IMC is asked to gather the facts in order to guide Cabinet on how to deal with such matters in future.

src: Die sameroeper is die Minister van Justisie en Korrektiewe Dienste, mnrMichael Masuthaha.
tgt: The convenor is the Minister of Justice and Correctional Services, Mr Michael Masutha.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.1 Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring vir die publikasie van die Hersiene Breedgebaseerde Swart Ekonomiese Bemagtigingshandves vir die Suid-Afrikaanse Mynbou- en Mineralebedyf in 2017.Die Minister van Minerale Hulpbronne, Mosebenzi Zwane, sal 'n inligtingsessie aanbied sodra die handves in die Staatskoerant aangekondig is.2 Die Kabinet onderskryf die goedgekeurde Nasionale Radiofrekwensieplan 2017 deur die Ministerie van Telekommunikasie en Posdienste.
tgt: Cabinet decisions.1 Cabinet approved the publication of the Reviewed Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Charter for the South African Mining and Minerals industry in 2017.Mineral Resources Minister Mosebenzi Zwane will provide a briefing once the charter has been gazetted.2 Cabinet endorsed the approved National Radio Frequency Plan 2017 by the Ministry of Telecommunications and Postal Services.

src: Die toekenning van spektrum deur die Wêreld Radiokommunikasiekonferensie het 'n beduidende uitwerking op Suid-Afrika se ekonomiese groei.
tgt: The allocation of spectrum by the World Radiocommunication Conference has a significant impact on the economic growth of South Africa.

src: Die Nasionale Radiofrekwensieplan 2017 is 'n omvattende bron van radiofrekwensiespektrum wat aan verskillende radiokommunikasiedienste toegewys is.
tgt: The National Radio Frequency Plan 2017 is a comprehensive source of radio frequency spectrum allocation for different radiocommunication services.

src: Die hersiene Nasionale Radiofrekwensieplan 2017 verseker dat Suid-Afrika belyn is met die goedgekeurde Internasionale Radioregulasies wat by die Konferensie van die Internasionale Telekommunikasie Unie in 2015 aanvaar is.3 Die Kabinet het die Veiligheidstrategie vir Binnelandse Waters goedgekeur.
tgt: The revised National Radio Frequency Plan 2017 ensures South Africa is aligned with the approved International Radio Regulations that were adopted in the 2015 International Telecommunication Union conference.3 Cabinet approved the Inland Waterways Safety Strategy.

src: Deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Maritieme Veiligheidsowerheid, stel die strategie standaarde vas en verbeter prosedures vir die uitreik van pemitte en lisensies aan bote wat op binnelandse waterweë bedryf word.
tgt: The strategy, through the South African Maritime Safety Authority, sets standards and enhances procedures for permitting and licensing arrangements for boats operating on inland waterways.

src: Dit sal die veiligheid van klein vaartuie op Suid-Afrika se binnelandse waterweë verseker.4 Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die Padvragstrategie.
tgt: This will ensure the safety of small vessels on South Africa’s inland waterways.4 Cabinet approved the Road Freight Strategy.

src: Die strategie is daarop gerig om 'n geïntegreerde regulerende en operasionele raamwerk te skep, wat Suid-Afrika in staat sal stel om die beste internasionale standaarde van padvrag-bedrywighede te bereik.
tgt: The strategy aims to create an integrated regulatory and operational framework, which will enable South Africa to achieve best international standards of road-freight operations.

src: Die aanbevelings van hierdie strategie sal die doeltreffendheid van handhawing verbeter, padveiligheid bevorder, die beskerming van infrastruktuur verbeter, die impak op die omgewing verminder, en 'n geïntegreerde raamwerk skep vir gehaltegereguleerde mededinging waarbinne die padvragsektor kan voortgaan om aan die behoeftes van die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie te voldoen.5 Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die Suid-Afrikaanse Muntmaatskappy se ontwerpe vir die 2017- en 2018-numismatiese gedenk- en WEBTOKEN samewerking met die Kabinet is 'n nuwe reeks ontwikkel wat kultuur, vryheid en demokrasie verteenwoordig onder die tema: "Ter Viering van Suid-Afrika".
tgt: The recommendations in this strategy will enhance the efficiency of enforcement, promote road safety, improve the protection of the infrastructure, reduce environmental impacts, and create an integrated framework of quality-regulated competition within which the road freight sector can continue to serve the needs of the South African economy.5 Cabinet approved the South African Mint Company’s designs for the 2017 and 2018 numismatic commemorative and circulation WEBTOKEN collaboration with Cabinet, a new series was developed that represents culture, freedom and democracy under the theme: “Celebrating South Africa”.

src: Die eeufees van die vryheidsveteraan Oliver Reginald Tambo se geboorte is gekies as die eerste onderwerp wat uitgebeeld word.
tgt: The centenary of Struggle stalwart Oliver Reginald Tambo’s birth was chosen as the first subject to be depicted.

src: Bekendstelling van die nuwe R50-muntstuk (1oz, sterling-silwer), R500-muntstuk (1oz, 24-karaat goud) en R50-muntstuk (basismetaal-allooi) wat die 100-jarige herdenking van OR Tambo se geboortedatum vier.
tgt: The introduction of the new R50 (1oz, sterling-silver) coin, R500 (1oz, 24-carat gold) coin and R50 (base metal alloy) coin celebrating the 100-year anniversary of OR Tambo’s birthdate.

src: Ontwerpe vir die volgende 2017- en 2018-herdenkingsmuntstukreeks is ontwikkel:a.
tgt: Designs for the following 2017 and 2018 commemorative coin series have been developed:2017 coin series: Oliver Reginald Tambo Centenary Celebration2017 circulation coin: R5 coin depicting the Order of the Companies of OR Tambo2017 Protea coin series: Life of a Legend – Nelson Mandela2017 R1 coin series: Reptiles of South Africa – the Puff Adder2018 UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) Man and the Biosphere coin series: The Waterberg Biosphere Reserve2018 coin series: National Geographic Society ‘Big Cats Initiative’ – The Lion2018 coin: 2018 FIFA World Cup RussiaTUpcoming events.1 Cabinet calls on all South Africans to support the Child Protection Week from 28 May to 4 June under the theme: “Let us all protect children to move South Africa forward”.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.1 Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om Kinderbeskermingsweek vanaf 28 Me tot 4 Junie met die tema: "Laat ons almal kinders beskerm om Suid-Afrika vorentoe te beweeg."
tgt: The annual commemoration of Africa Day marks the founding of the Organisation of African Unity in WEBTOKEN we end Africa Month, Cabinet calls on all South Africans to partner with our fellow Africans residing in South Africa and elsewhere on the continent to ensure the prosperity for our region and the rest of WEBTOKEN is also incumbent on all who reside within our borders, South Africans and foreign nationals alike to adhere to the laws of the country.

src: Dit is die plig en verantwoordelikheid van alle Suid-Afrikaners – ouers, voogde, individue en gemeenskappe – om ons kinders te WEBTOKEN 'n samelewing is dit ons plig om meer te doen om te verseker dat die kwesbaarste mense in ons samelewing nie mishandel word nie.
tgt: Together we must fight the scourge of human trafficking, abductions, and the abuse of women and children.

src: Gedurende die maand sal die regering verskeie funksies aanbied, insluitend jeuguitstallings, dialoë en jeug-entrepreneurskerns om geleenthede wat vir die jeug beskikbaar is uit te lig, en om die opvoedkundige en leierskapwaardes van OR Tambo te bevorder.
tgt: Congratulatory messages.1 Cabinet congratulates the Stellenbosch University and Tygerberg Academic Hospital medical team comprising of ProfAndre van der Merwe, Dr Alexander Zuhlke, ProfRafique Moosa, Dr Amir Zarrabi and Dr Zamira Keyser.

src: Die Kabinet moedig alle jeugdiges aan om gebruik te maak van die verskillende ondersteunings- en opvoedkundige programme wat deur die regering beskikbaar gestel word om hul vooruitsigte te verbeter en hul deelname aan die ekonomie te bevorder.3 Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op werkgewers om by te dra tot die inisiatief Neem 'n meisiekind werk toe op 25 en 26 Me.
tgt: They recently performed a second penis transplant, making it the first medical centre in the world to successfully perform this procedure twice.

src: Die doel is om jong meisies van graad 10 tot graad 12 aan verskillende loopbaanmoontlikhede bloot te stel.4 President Zuma bied op Donderdag 25 Me 2017 die nasionale 2017-Afrika-dagviering by die Sefako Makgatho Presidensiële Gastehuis in Pretoria aan.
tgt: The success of this procedure in the hands of our transplant team is testimony to the high level of skill and expertise that exists in the public health sector in South Africa.2 Cabinet congratulated iSimangaliso Wetland Park for receiving the Audit Excellence Award at the South African Institute of Chartered Accountants (SAICA) Public Sector Excellence Awards earlier this month.

src: Die jaarlikse viering van Afrika-dag herdenk die onstaan van die Organisasie vir Afrika-eenheid in 1963.Terwyl Afrika-maand ten einde loop, doen die Kabinet ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om met ons mede-Afrikane wat in Suid-Afrika en elders op die vasteland woon, saam te werk om die welvaart van ons streek en die res van Afrika te verseker.
tgt: iSimangaliso was declared South Africa’s first World Heritage Site in December 19.3 Cabinet congratulates the Working on Fire programme for receiving a plaque from the Alberta Government in Canada commemorating the assistance provided by the programme in managing wildfires in their Province in 2016.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Issues in the Environment.

src: Die Kabinet herhaal President Jacob Zuma se oproep aan Suid-Afrikaners om saam te staan teen geweld en mishandeling van vroue en kinders en doen ’n ernstige beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om dringend op te tree om hierdie plaag in ons gemeenskappe uit te wis. Dit volg op die President se besoek aan Elsiesrivier in Kaapstad ter ondersteuning van die Stryd teen Misdaad-Imbizo.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates President Jacob Zuma’s call for South Africans to unite against violence and abuse of women and children, and calls on all South Africans to take urgent steps to eradicate this scourge in our communities.

src: Hierdie besoek het weer eens die die kwesbaarheid van vroue en kinders in ons gemeenskap na vore gebring.
tgt: This visit once again highlighted the vulnerability of women and children in our society.

src: Die President het onderneem om terug te keer na die gebied om ondersoek in te stel na al die uitdagings rakende misdaad en moord, veral met betrekking tot kinders, en hoe wetstoepassingagentskappe hul diens aan die gemeenskap kan verbeter.
tgt: The President undertook to return to the area to look into the many challenges of crime and murder, especially of children and how law-enforcement authorities would improve their services to the community.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die vrystelling van die Algemene Huishoudelike Opname 2016, wat toon dat daar steeds vordering is met die implementering van regeringsprogramme om Suid-Afrikaners se lewens te verbeter, veral dié in voorheen benadeelde gemeenskappe.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the release of the General Household Survey 2016, which continues to show progress in the implementation of government programmes to improve the lives of South Africans, especially the previously disadvantaged communities.

src: Die statistieke toon dat die regering veral vorder met die voorsiening van behuising die aantal Suid-Afrikaanse huishoudings wat in HOP- of gesubsidieerde wooneenhede woon, het van 5% in 2002 tot 13,5% in 2016 toegeneem.
tgt: The statistics show that government is making inroads in providing housing, with South African households living in ‘RDP’ or state-subsidised dwellings increasing from 5% in 2002 to 13, 5% in 2016.

src: Die opname wys ook dat die regering se maatskaplike bystandsprogramme van 12,7% in 2003 tot 29,7% in 2016 toegeneem het.
tgt: The survey also shows that government’s social-assistance programmes indicates an increase from 12, 7% in 2003 to 29,7% in 2016.There is also a marked increase in access to water, electricity and sanitation, which is an important marker for the South African Government’s ambition to redress the wrongs of apartheid and provide basic services to all the people.

src: Die Kabinet het egter opgemerk dat terwyl hoër onderwysinskrywings aan die toeneem is, hoewel teen 'n stadige pas, slegs 3,3% van swart Suid-Afrikaners tussen 18 en 29 jaar studeer, in teenstelling met 18,8% van Indiese /Asiatiese individue en 17,5% van die blanke bevolking in hierdie ouderdomsgroep.
tgt: Cabinet has, however, noted that while higher education enrolments are on the increase, albeit at a slow pace, only 3, 3% of black Africans aged 18 to 29 years were studying as opposed to 18, 8% of Indian/Asian individuals and 17, 5% of the white population in this age group.

src: Slegs 3,5% van die gekleurde bevolking het gedurende 2016 studeer.
tgt: Only 3, 5% of the coloured population was studying during 2016.The survey further indicated a decrease from 23, 8% to 11, and 8% of households that experienced hunger, which shows progress in addressing communities living in extreme poverty.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die Kwartaalikse Arbeidsmagopname vir die eerste kwartaal, wat daarop dui dat 144 000 werksgeleenthede deur die ekonomie bygevoeg is.
tgt: Cabinet noted the Quarterly Labour Force Survey for the first quarter of the year that showed the economy adding 144 000 jobs.

src: Hierdie syfers spruit uit 'n toename van 433 000 bykomende werksoekers.
tgt: These numbers were offset by an increase in the number of job-seekers by 433 00 people.

src: Die Kabinet bevestig sy verbintenis om in vennootskap met die private sektor en arbeid sy pogings voort te sit om die land se uitdagings rakende werkloosheid die hoof te bied.
tgt: Cabinet reaffirms its commitment to continue partnering with the private sector and labour in its attempts to address the country’s unemployment challenges.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van die opgeknapte Babelegi-nywerheidspark in Hammanskraal as deel van die regering se planne om ekonomiese ontwikkeling en werkskepping in die gebied te versnel.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the refurbished Babelegi Industrial Park in Hammanskraal as part of government’s plans to accelerate economic development and job creation in the area.

src: Die projek van R42 miljoen is deel van die regering se Program vir die Hernuwing van Nywerheidsparke en is een van ses parke in die land wat hernu word vir groter ekonomiese en nywerheidsontwikkeling.
tgt: The R42-million project is part of government’s Revitalisation of Industrial Parks Programme and one of six parks that are being revitalised across the country for broader economic and industrial development.

src: Die Kabinet moedig plaaslike nywerhede en besighede aan om dit te oorweeg om hul uitbreidingsbedrywighede na nywerheidsparke te neem en om gebruik te maak van die verskillende ondersteuningsmaatreëls wat beskikbaar is om hul ondernemings verder te ontwikkel.
tgt: Cabinet encourages local industries and businesses to consider expanding operations to industrial parks to access the various support measures which are available to further develop their businesses.

src: Die Kabinet is deur die Minister van Finansies, Malusi Gigaba, ingelig oor die jongste stand van Suid-Afrika se bruto binnelandse produk (BBP), wat in die eerste kwartaal van 2017 met 0,7% ingekrimp het.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed by Minister of Finance, Mr Malusi Gigaba, on the latest South Africa’s Gross Domestic Product (GDP) figures, which contracted by 0,7% in the first quarter of 2017.

src: Hierdie swakker-as-verwagte BBP-uitslag is aansienlik laer as die 2017-begrotingsoorsig, wat die 2017 BBP-groei teen 1,3% geprojekteer het.
tgt: This worse-than-expected GDP outcome is significantly lower than the 2017 Budget Review, which projected 2017 GDP growth at 1, 3%.

src: Dit word onder meer toegeskryf aan die inkrimping van die vervaardigings-, handel-, spysenierings- en akkommodasiebedrywe.
tgt: This has been attributed to, among other things, the contraction of the manufacturing, trade, catering and accommodation industries.

src: Die ekonomie word nietemin ondersteun deur groei in die mynbou- en steengroefbedryf, wat met 12,8% toegeneem het.
tgt: The economy was nevertheless supported by growth in the mining and quarrying industry which increased 12.8%.

src: Die landbou-, bosbou- en visserybedryf het in die eerste kwartaal van 2017 met 22,2% verbeter.
tgt: The agriculture, forestry and fishing industry rebounded in the first quarter of 2017 with an increase of 22, 2%.There are green shoots that the country can leverage to boost its own economic growth outlook.

src: Daar is belowende faktore wat die land ’n hupstoot kan gee om sy eie ekonomiese groeivooruitsigte te verhoog.
tgt: These include improving global growth, stabilising commodity prices, more favourable climate conditions, reliable electricity supply and less volatile labour WEBTOKEN a matter of urgency, Cabinet calls on business, labour and the broader society to partner with government to intensify our growth programme and improve confidence so as to arrest the decline and set the economy on a higher trajectory, to achieve inclusive economic growth.

src: Dit sluit in die verbetering van wêreldwye groei, stabilisering van kommoditeitspryse, gunstiger klimaatstoestande, betroubare kragvoorsiening en minder vlugtige arbeidsverhoudinge.
tgt: In this regard the Minister of Finance will meet with business leaders in a bid to formulate strategies to counter economic recession and achieve inclusive growth.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n dringende beroep op die sake- en arbeidsektor, asook die breër samelewing om met die regering saam te werk om ons groeiprogram te versterk en vertroue te verbeter sodat ekonomiese agteruitgang gestuit kan word en om inklusiewe ekonomiese groei te WEBTOKEN dié verband sal die Minister van Finansies met sakeleiers vergader vir die formulering van strategieë om ’n ekonomiese resessie teen te werk en inklusiewe groei te bereik.
tgt: Cabinet endorsed a full media briefing by the Minister of Finance to share with South Africans the interventions government will embark upon within the current budget framework.

src: Voorts herbevestig die Kabinet ook die goedgekeurde begrotingsraamwerk vir die land.
tgt: Cabinet further reaffirms the adopted budget framework for the country.

src: Die graderingsagentskappe Fitch en Standard & Poor's het Suid-Afrika se langtermyn buitelandse valuta skuldgraderings van 'BB +' bevestig.
tgt: The rating agencies Fitch and Standard & Poor’s affirmed South Africa’s long-term foreign currency debt ratings of ‘BB+’.This comes amid Minister Gigaba’s engagements with the private sector to ensure that the joint work of government, business, labour and civil society continues, and that the pledges made are fulfilled.

src: Dit kom te midde van Minister Gigaba se betrokkenheid by die private sektor om te verseker dat die gesamentlike werk van die regering, die sakesektor, arbeid en die burgerlike samelewing voortduur, en dat die beloftes wat gemaak is, nagekom word.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates that South Africans must continue to act in unison, especially during difficult times and work even harder to ensure that the country reclaims its investment grade status.

src: Die Kabinet beklemtoon dat Suid-Afrikaners voortdurend moet saamwerk, veral tydens moeilike tye en nog harder moet werk om te verseker dat die land sy beleggingsgraadstatus herwin.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes deliberations at the inaugural Joint Administration Committee for the Common Market of the South (MERCOSUR) and the Southern Africa Customs Union (SACU) recently held in the country.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom beraadslagings by die eerste Gesamentlike Administrasiekomitee vir die Gemeenskaplike Mark van die Suide (MERCOSUR) en die Suider-Afrikaanse Doeane-Unie (SADU) wat onlangs in die land gehou is.
tgt: The parties agreed to jointly consider opportunities to promote the MERCOSUR-SACU Preferential Trade Agreement (PTA) by including their trade promotion agencies, chambers of commerce, private sector, and their respective embassies and foreign missions.

src: Die MERCOSUR-SACU-ooreenkoms bied plaaslike uitvoerders die geleentheid om 'n mark van meer as 280 miljoen mense te bereik.
tgt: The MERCOSUR-SACU agreement provides local exporters with the opportunity to tap into a market of more than 280-million people.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op al die land se uitvoerders om voordeel te trek uit die PTA, aangesien plaaslike produkte nou die MERCOSUR-blok kan betree teen voorkeur doeaneregte.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all the country’s exporters to take advantage of the PTA as local products are now able to enter the MERCOSUR bloc at preferential duty rates.

src: Die Kabinet betreur die besluit van die Verenigde State van Amerika (VSA) om uit die Parys-ooreenkoms te onttrek.
tgt: Cabinet expressed regret at the decision of the United States of America (USA) to withdraw from the Paris Agreement.

src: Die Parys-ooreenkoms, wat teen 2020 ten volle in werking sal tree, is vooropgestel deur bydraes wat deur lande self bepaal word teenoor gesamentlike ooreengekome globale doelwitte.
tgt: The Paris Agreement, which will be fully operational by 2020, is premised on contributions determined by countries themselves towards collectively agreed global goals.

src: Suid-Afrika het die VSA versoek om sy posisie te heroorweeg en hom tot die multilaterale proses te herverbind.
tgt: South Africa has called on the USA to reconsider its position and recommit to the multilateral process.

src: Die Meorandum van Verstandhouding tussen Novartis, die Suid-Afrikaanse Meiese Navorsingsraad en die Departement van Wetenskap en Tegnologie, baan die weg om die volume en kwaliteit van kliniese proewe te bevorder en navorsingsvermoë op die vasteland te bou.
tgt: The Memorandum of Understanding between Novartis, the South African Medical Research Council and the Department of Science and Technology, paves the way to boost the volume and quality of clinical trials and build research capability on the continent.

src: Die ooreenkoms sal gesamentlike navorsingsprogramme in bepaalde oordraagbare en nie-oordraagbare siektes toelaat, Suid-Afrikaanse pasiënte se toegang tot innoverende medisyne verbeter, en die land sowel as die vasteland se navorsings- en ontwikkelingsvermoëns bou.
tgt: The agreement will allow for joint research programmes in selected communicable and non-communicable diseases, improve South African patients' access to innovative medicines, and build the country and continent's research and development capabilities.

src: Die Kabinet glo dat daar ruimte is vir meer openbare-private vennootskappe, en is daarvan oortuig dat dit die weg kan baan om die talle dringende uitdagings wat ons in die gesig staar die hoof te bied.
tgt: Cabinet believes that there is room for more public-private partnerships, and is convinced that these can lead the way in addressing the many pressing challenges we face.

src: Die Kabinet Verwelkom die 2017-verslag van die Internasionale Kongres- en Konvensievereniging, wat Suid-Afrika steeds op sy ranglys plaas as die voorste bestemming vir sakebyeenkomste in Afrika en die Midde-Ooste.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the 2017 Report from the International Congress and Convention Association, which continues to rank South Africa as the top business events destination in Africa and the Middle East.

src: Die verslag is in Me 2017 in Frankfort, Duitsland, vrygestel.
tgt: The report was released in May 2017 in Frankfurt, Germany.

src: Suid-Afrika bly een van die wêreld se gewildste toeristebestemmings en bly ook bo aan die ranglys van die Wêreld Ekonomiese Forum Reis se wêreldwye reis- en toerisme-mededingendheidsindeks, soos in April 2017 vrygestel.
tgt: South Africa remains one of the world’s most popular tourist destinations and continues to top the rankings also on the World Economic Forum Travel’s global travel and tourism competitiveness index as released in April 2017.Cabinet would like to see more of South Africa’s smaller towns and cities bidding for smaller meetings where they can meet the hosting requirements.

src: Die Kabinet wil graag sien dat meer van Suid-Afrika se kleiner dorpe en stede kleiner vergaderings aanbied waar hulle aan die gasheervereistes kan voldoen.
tgt: This will help to improve the geographic distribution of tourism beyond the major centres and spread the wealth generated by these events more equitably.

src: Dit sal help om die geografiese verspreiding van toerisme buite die groot sentrums te verbeter en die inkomste wat deur hierdie gebeure gegenereer word, meer billik te versprei.
tgt: Cabinet calls on South Africans to be vigilant of fake news, in particular the increase in false posts on social media over missing, kidnapped and abducted girls and women.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om te waak teen vals nuus, veral die toename in vals plasings op sosiale media oor vermiste, ontvoerde en weggevoerde meisies en vroue.
tgt: The recent outbreak of violence in KwaMashu, near Durban over fake reports of children being abducted in the area and the alleged abduction of a girl in Naledi, Soweto by persons in a Toyota Quantum with registration number included went viral on social media, which was later found to be untrue.

src: Die onlangse vlaag van geweld in KwaMashu, naby Durban oor vals verslae van kinders wat in die gebied ontvoer word en die beweerde wegvoering van 'n meisie in Naledi, Soweto deur persone in 'n Toyota Quantum met ’n bepaalde registrasienommer, het soos ’n veldbrand op sosiale media versprei, en het later geblyk onwaar te wees.
tgt: These hoaxes, fake news and the dissemination of false information cause panic among our communities and waste time and resources of the police.

src: Ons doen 'n ernstige beroep op mense om nie goedsmoeds enige nuus op sosiale media te plaas alvorens hul die egtheid daarvan geverifieer het nie.
tgt: We appeal to people not to repost and disseminate fake news on social media, until they have verified the authenticity.

src: Die Kabinet het met groot kommer kennis geneem van die mediaverslae oor die sogenaamde ‘uitgelekte e-posse’ waarin berig word dat ministers, amptenare en private individue by beweerde oortredings betrokke is.
tgt: Cabinet has noted with serious concern the media reports on the ‘leaked emails’ that are purported to implicate Ministers, officials and private individuals in alleged wrongdoing.

src: Die Kabinet bly ten volle verbind tot goeie bestuur en wys terselfdertyd daarop dat alle persone, ingevolge ons Grondwet, as onskuldig beskou word totdat hulle skuldig bevind is.
tgt: Cabinet remains fully committed to good governance and at the same time, it also notes that all persons are presumed innocent until proven guilty in terms of our Constitution.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n ernstige beroep op enigeen wat inligting oor enige oortreding deur regeringsamptenare of ministers het om dit by die wetstoepassingsagentskappe aan te meld sodat die nodige ondersoeke gedoen kan word.
tgt: Cabinet urges all who have information about any wrongdoing by government officials or Ministers to inform the law-enforcement agencies so that investigations can be WEBTOKEN is aware that some cases have already been opened, and the police are undertaking the necessary investigations.

src: Enigeen wat deur die e-posse geraak word, word aangemoedig om met die wetstoepassingsagentskappe saam te werk.
tgt: All who are affected by the emails are urged to cooperate with the law-enforcement agencies.

src: President Zuma het die bewerings wat deur 'n Sondagkoerant gepubliseer is, dat hy 'n huis in Dubai in die Verenigde Arabiese Emirate besit, weerlê.
tgt: President Zuma has rebutted the allegation that was published by a Sunday newspaper that he owns a house in Dubai in the United Arab Emirates.

src: KabinetsbesluiteDie Kabinet is in kennis gestel van die vierde kwartaallikse prestasievorderingsverslae vir 2016/17 (Januarie-Maart 2017) oor die implementering van prioriteitsuitkomste.
tgt: Cabinet was apprised of the 4th performance quarterly progress reports for 2016/17 (January-March 2017) on the implementation of priority outcomes.

src: Die Kabinet se toesig oor die implementering van die Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk 2014 tot 2019, lei tot verbeterde dienslewering.
tgt: Cabinet’s oversight over the implementation of the Medium Term Strategic Framework 2014 to 2019, results in improved service delivery.

src: Dit bring ons nader aan die verwesenliking van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP) se Visie 2030.Die regering het aansienlike vordering gemaak met die implementering van sy 14 prioriteitsuitkomste en die bevordering van die NOP-doelwitte.
tgt: This takes us closer to the realization of the National Development Plan’s (NDP) Vision 2030.Government has made considerable progress in implementing its 14 priority outcomes and advancing the objectives of the NDChallenges affecting implementation and action required to improve delivery were also identified.

src: Die GCIS koördineer regeringsgroeperings se media-inligtingsessies wat geskeduleer is om van 9 tot 18 Junie 2017 plaas te vind.
tgt: The GCIS is coordinating cluster media briefings, which are scheduled to take place from 9 to18 June 2017.

src: 'n Bygewerkte skedule sal op WEBTOKEN gepos word.
tgt: An updated schedule will be posted to WEBTOKEUpcoming events.

src: President Zuma het Jeugmaand tydens 'n vergadering van die Presidensiële Jeugwerkgroep van stapel gestuur onder die tema ‘Die Jaar van OR Tambo: Bevorder Jeug Ekonomiese Bemagtiging’.
tgt: President Zuma launched Youth Month under the theme “The Year of OR Tambo: Advancing Youth Economic Empowerment”, with a meeting of the Presidential Youth Working Group.

src: Dit het die regering en leiers van jeugorganisasies bymekaar gebring, waar hulle bestek geneem het van vordering in die sosio-ekonomiese vooruitgang van ons land se jeug.
tgt: This brought together government and leaders of youth organisations, who took stock of progress in the socio-economic advancement of young people.

src: Ministers en adjunkministers sal betrokke wees by verskeie aktiwiteite wat daarop gemik is om jeugontwikkeling en bemagtiging te bevorder.
tgt: Ministers and Deputy Ministers will engage in various activities aimed at promoting youth development and empowerment.

src: Die Nasionale Jeugdag-herdenkingskonferensie vind op 16 Junie 2017 in Ventersdorp, Noordwes plaas.
tgt: The National Youth Day commemoration event will take place in Ventersdorp, North West on 16 June 2017.

src: Hierdie jaar is die 41ste herdenking van die Soweto-opstand en die herdenking dien as 'n herinnering dat ons land se jeug aan die voorpunt van ons vryheidstryd was.
tgt: This year marks the 41st anniversary of the Soweto Uprising and the commemoration serves as a reminder that young people in the country were at the forefront of our Struggle.

src: Die Kabinet moedig alle jeugdiges aan om deel te neem aan Jeugdagaktiwiteite en om gebruik te maak van al die hulp en hulpbronne wat die regering beskikbaar stel om hul vooruitsigte te verbeter en hul deelname aan die ekonomie te bevorder.
tgt: Cabinet encourages all young people to participate in Youth Day activities and to make use of all the support and resources that government has made available to improve their prospects and advance their participation in the economy.

src: Jeugkonferensie oor plaaslike regeringDie Minister van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake, Des van Rooyen, sal die Konferensie oor Plaaslike Regering van 19 tot 22 Junie 2017 belê onder die tema ‘Jeugdiges in beheer van ontwikkeling’.
tgt: Local Government Youth ConferenceThe Minister of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, Mr Des van Rooyen, will convene the Local Government Conference from 19 to 22 June 2017, under the theme “Young people taking charge in development”.

src: Die konferensie sal die Plaaslike Regering se Jeugontwikkelingsforum van stapel laat loop.
tgt: The conference will launch the Local Government Youth Development Forum.

src: Dit sal jeugdiges in staat stel om die vordering van plaaslike regering teen die bereiking van die Nasionale Jeugbeleid 2020 te hersien.
tgt: This will enable young people to review the progress of local government against the achievement of the National Youth Policy 2020.

src: Dit sal ook vennootskappe tussen die regering, die sakesektor en die burgerlike samelewing versterk in die ontwikkeling van jong leiers in die plaaslike omgewing.
tgt: It will also strengthen partnerships between government, business and civil society in developing young leaders in the local space.

src: Die Minister van die Staatsdiens en Administrasie, Faith Muthambi, sal die Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging na Afrika-Staatsdiensdag lei, wat in Kigali, Rwanda plaasvind van 21 tot 23 Junie 2017.
tgt: Minister of Public Service and Administration, Ms Faith Muthambi, will lead the South African delegation to attend the Africa Public Service Day in Kigali, Rwanda from 21 to 23 June 2017.

src: Vanjaar se tema is: ‘Vestig 'n Burgergesentreerde Diensleweringskultuur: Vennootskap met die Jeug vir Afrika se Transformasie’.Die tema bied geleenthede om ondersoek in te stel na hoe die Staatsdiens 'n burgergesentreerde diensleweringskultuur definieer en daarop reageer, wat bepaal word deur die manier waarop dinge tans gedoen word.
tgt: The theme for this year is: “Entrenching a Citizen-Centred Service Delivery Culture: Partnering with the Youth for Africa’s Transformation.” The theme offers opportunities to scrutinise on how the Public Service defines and responds to a citizen-centred service delivery culture that is defined by the way things are currently done.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel met die familie en vriende van die pendelaar wat gesterf het tydens ’n botsing tussen twee Merorail-treine naby die Elandsfonteinstasie in Ekurhuleni, en wens diegene wat in die ongeluk beseer is ’n spoedige herstel toe.
tgt: Cabinet extends its condolences to the family and friends of the commuter who died when two Metrorail trains collided near the Elandsfontein station in Ekurhuleni and wishes a speedy recovery to those injured in the accident.

src: Die Kabinet versoek dat die ondersoek na die oorsaak van die ongeluk versnel word om ’n herhaling van so ’n noodlottige ongeluk te voorkom.
tgt: Cabinet calls for the investigation into the root cause of the accident to be fast-tracked to prevent a recurrence of such fatal accidents.

src: Die Kabinet, saam met die internasionale gemeenskap, veroordeel die jongste terreuraanval in die Verenigde Koninkryk (VK) ten sterkste.
tgt: Cabinet joined the international community in strongly condemning the latest terrorist attack in the United Kingdom (UK).

src: Talle mense is in die aanval, wat op 3 Junie 2017 in Londen plaasgevind het, beseer en sommiges het gesterf.
tgt: The attack, which took place on the night of 3 June 2017 in the City of London, claimed the lives of several people and left others injured.

src: Die aanval in Londen het binne twee weke ná die Manchester-aanval plaasgevind, waartydens talle mense, veral jeugdiges en kinders, gesterf het.
tgt: The attack in London occurred within a fortnight of the one in Manchester, where many civilians, mainly youth and children, lost their lives.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel met die regering en mense van die VK, veral die familie en geliefdes van die oorledenes, en wens die beseerdes 'n spoedige herstel toe.
tgt: Cabinet extended its condolences to the government and people of the UK, in particular the families and loved ones of the deceased, and wished the injured a speedy recovery.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel met die familie en vriende van prof Babatunde Osotimehin, wat hierdie week oorlede is.
tgt: Cabinet extends its condolences to the family and friends of ProfBabatunde Osotimehin, who passed away this week.

src: ProfOsotimehin was die Uitvoerende Direkteur van die Verenigde Nasies se Bevolkingsfonds.
tgt: ProfOsotimehin was the Executive Director of the United Nations Population Fund.

src: Hy het die afgelope jaar ’n sleutelrol gespeel om die kwessies van seksuele en reproduktiewe gesondheid in Afrika aan te pak.
tgt: He was key in driving the issues of sexual and reproductive health in Africa in recent years.

src: Hy het onvermoeid gewerk om die seksuele en reproduktiewe gesondheid en regte van vroue en jeugdiges in Afrika en wêreldwyd te bevorder.
tgt: He worked tirelessly to promote the sexual and reproductive health and rights of women and young people in Africa and worldwide.

src: Hy was aktief betrokke by veldtogte vir lesbiese, gay, biseksuele, transseksuele en interseksuele regte.
tgt: He campaigned actively for Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer and Intersex rights.

src: Kaapse storms en knysna-brandeDie Kabinet neem kennis van die storms wat die meeste dele van die Wes-Kaap geraak het en die daaropvolgende skade.
tgt: Cape Storms and Knysna FiresCabinet noted the storms that have affected most parts of the Western Cape and the subsequent damage.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel met die families van diegene wat lewens en eiendom verloor het tydens hierdie rampe die jongste syfer is agt.
tgt: Cabinet sends its condolences to the families of those who lost lives and property during these disasters the latest figure reported is eight.

src: Kaapstad se Rampbestuursentrum word aangemoedig om sy bes te doen om lewens en eiendom te red, insluitend in die Knysna-omgewing waar brande steeds woed.
tgt: The Cape Town Disaster Risk Management Centre is encouraged to do its best in saving lives and property, including in the Knysna area where there are raging fires.

src: Ons doen 'n beroep op alle inwoners om alle veiligheidsmaatreëls na te kom.
tgt: We call upon the people to adhere to safety measures.

src: Gelukwense.
tgt: Congratulations.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom President Jacob Zuma se besluit om Luitenant-Generaal Lesetja Mothiba as die nuwe waarnemende Nasionale Polisiekommissaris aan te stel.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes President Jacob Zuma’s decision to appoint Lieutenant General Lesetja Mothiba as the new Acting National Police Commissioner.

src: Die Kabinet wens ons atlete en sportlui geluk met hul nominasies in agt kategorieë van die 2017 Jaarlikse Streeksporttoekennings, wat in Suid-Afrika aangebied is.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates our athletes and sportsmen and women for being nominated in eight categories of the 2017 Regional Annual Sport Awards, which was hosted by South Africa.

src: Die Afrika-Unie se Sportraad Streek 5 is een van vyf streke wat die verantwoordelikheid het om sport in die Afrika-unie te ontwikkel.
tgt: The African Union Sports Council Region 5 is one of the five regions entrusted with the responsibility to develop sport under the African Union.

src: Lede van die streek is: Angola, Botswana, Lesotho, Malawi, Mosambiek, Namibië, Suid-Afrika, Swaziland, Zambië en Zimbabwe.
tgt: Members of the region are: Angola, Botswana, Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, Namibia, South Africa, Swaziland, Zambia and Zimbabwe.

src: Wayde van Niekerk het die titel Sportsman van die Jaar gewenCaster Semenya het die titel Sportvrou van die Jaar gewenAnna Botha het die titel Afrigter van die Jaar gewen, enMamelodi Sundowns is as die Span van die Jaar aangewys.
tgt: Wayde van Niekerk won Sportsman of the YearCaster Semenya won Sportswoman of YearAnna Botha won Coach of the YearMamelodi Sundowns won Team of the Year.

src: Die Kabinet wens die mense van Lesotho geluk met hulle land se vreedsame verkiesing en wens ook die verkose eerste minister, mnrThomas Thabane, en sy party geluk met hul oorwinning in die verkiesing.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the people of Lesotho for the peaceful elections and further congratulates the Prime Minister-elect Mr Thomas Thabane and his party on winning the elections.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderworpe aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die toepaslike klaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Direkteur-generaal (DG): Departement van Beplanning, Monitering en Evaluering, me Nompumelelo Zandile Mpofu.
tgt: Director-General (DG): Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation, Ms Nompumelelo Zandile Mpofu.

src: DG: Nasionale Tesourie, mnrDondo Mogajane.
tgt: DG: National Treasury, Mr Dondo Mogajane.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 21 Junie 2017 teTuynhuys, Kaapstad vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 21 June 2017, at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing.1 Die Kabinet het besin oor onlangse aankondigings deur die drie belangsrikste graderingsagentskappe.
tgt: Cabinet reflected on the recent announcements by the three major ratings agencies.

src: Al drie graderingsagentskappe het soortgelyke kwessies uitgelig, soos, onder meer, die stadige tempo van hervormings wat groei verbeter, die prestasie van maatskappye in staatsbesit en politieke risiko's.
tgt: All three ratings agencies raised similar issues such as the slow pace of growth-enhancing reforms, the performance of state-owned companies (SOCs) and political risks, among other issues.

src: Die Kabinet het sy vertroue uitgespreek in die regering se stelselmatige ingrypings om die land se ekonomiese uitdagings te pak, asook in werk wat onderneem word om die prestasie van maatskappye in staatsbesit te verbeter.
tgt: Cabinet expressed confidence in its systematic interventions to address the country’s economic challenges as well as work undertaken to strengthen the performance of the SOCs.

src: Die regering bly op koers in die handhawing van sy fiskale raamwerk, die versekering van beleidsekerheid, en stappe om inklusiewe groei en ekonomiese transformasie te bevorder.
tgt: Government remains on track in maintaining its fiscal framework, ensuring policy certainty, and working to ensure inclusive growth and economic transformation.

src: Die Kabinet beklemtoon dat die grondslag vir 'n hoër groeikoers en sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling reeds gelê is.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates that the foundation for a higher growth path and socio-economic development has already been WEBTOKEN focuses on improving investor and consumer confidence by fast-tracking the implementation of the structural reforms for economic growth.

src: President Jacob Zuma het die werksessie van die Advesraad vir Swart Ekonomiese Bemagtiging op Dinsdag 20 Junie 2017 saamgeroep, waar die klem op radikale sosio-ekonomiese transformasie geval het.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma convened the Black Economic Empowerment (BEE) Advisory Council workshop on Tuesday, 20 June 2017, which focused on radical socio-economic transformation.

src: Die werksessie het onder meer aandag gegee aan die stelselmatige en strukturele implementeringsuitdagings van die Wet op Breëbasis Swart Ekonomiese Bemagtiging, 2003 (Wet 53 van 2003) en die voorgestelde aanbevelings om die regering se doelwitte rakende radikale sosio-ekonomiese transformasie te bereik.
tgt: The workshop, amongst others, addressed the systematic and structural implementation challenges of the Broad-Based BEE Act, 2003 (Act 53 of 2003) and the proposed recommendations to realise government’s objectives on radical socio-economic transformation.

src: Die vennootskap tussen die regering, die saksektor, arbeid en die burgerlike samelewing is van kritieke belang om vertrouensvlakke te bevorder sodat ons deur saam te werk, ons beleggingsgraderings kan herwin en in stand kan hou.2 Me die einde van Jeugmaand in sig, bedank die Kabinet alle sektore regdeur die land wat aan die aktiwiteite deelgeneem het.
tgt: The partnership between government, business, labour and civil society is critical to boost confidence levels, so that working together we can reclaim and maintain investment-grade ratings.

src: Dit is bemoedigend dat duisende jeugdiges by verskeie bemagtigingsaktiwiteite wat gedurende Jeugmaand deur departmente, regeringsentiteite en die private sektor aangebied is, betrokke was.
tgt: As Youth Month draws to a close, Cabinet thanks all sectors who participated in activities across the country.

src: Vanjaar is die 41ste herdenking van die 1976 Soweto Studente-opstand en deur dié gebeurtenis te herdenk word ons daaraan herinner dat ons land se jeug aan die voorpunt van die vryheidstryd was.
tgt: The participation of thousands of young people in the various Youth Month empowerment activities that were hosted by departments, government entities and the private sector is encouraging.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op die jeug om gebruik te maak van al die ondersteuning en hulpmiddels wat die regering bied om hul vooruitsigte te verbeter en hul deelname aan die ekonomie te bevorder.3 Die Kabinet veroordeel die onlangse geweld en intimidasie van pendelaars tydens die betogings deur taxi-eienaars.
tgt: Cabinet calls on youth to use all the support and resources that government has made available to improve their prospects and advance their participation in the economy.

src: Sulke optrede hoort nie tuis in 'n demokratiese samelewing nie.
tgt: Such actions are out of place in a democratic society.

src: Vreedsame ingrypings oor enige aangeleentheid sal altyd voordelig wees vir alle betrokkenes.
tgt: Peaceful interventions on any matter will always be beneficial to all parties involved.

src: Die daaropvolgende ooreenkoms tussen die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Taxivereniging en SA Taxi Finance Holdings is verdere bevestiging dat vreedsame dialoog sulke kwessies kan oplos sonder om onskuldige mense te benadeel en die ekonomie te ontwrig.
tgt: The subsequent agreement between the South African National Taxi Association and SA Taxi Finance Holdings is further confirmation that peaceful dialogue can resolve such issues without impacting on innocent people and disrupting the economy.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom hierdie besluit, wat in die beste belang van pendelaars en die taxibedryf is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes this decision, which is in the best interest of commuters and the taxi industry.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die dialoog wat tans tussen die Departement van Vervoer en die leierskap van die taxibedryf plaasvind om 'n blywende oplossing te vind.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the dialogue currently taking place between the Department of Transport and the leadership of the taxi industry in finding a lasting solution.

src: Die departement sal samesprekings voer met ontwikkelingsfinansieringsinstellings om alternatiewe opsies vir taxi-finansiering te vind.
tgt: The department will be engaging development finance institutions to seek alternative taxi finance options.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy innigste meegevoel met almal wat geliefdes verloor het tydens die onlangse rampe in die Wes- en Oos-Kaap.
tgt: Cabinet conveys its deepest sympathy to all who lost loved ones during the recent disasters in the Western and Eastern Cape respectively.

src: 'n Aantal inwoners het ook ontheming en die verlies van eiendom gely.
tgt: A number of residents also suffered displacement and loss of property.

src: Die Kabinet prys die vinnige geïntegreerde benadering en reaksie van die regering, die sakesektor en deursnee Suid-Afrikaners wat gesinne wat deur die rampe geraak is bygestaan het.
