tgt: This will enable the completion of the disposal of Aventura.

src: Die wetsontwerp is in Maart 2017 vir openbare raadpleging uitgestuur.
tgt: The Bill went out for public consultation in March 2017.

src: Om wetgewing met ontwikkelings in die onderwysomgewing te belyn, keur die Kabinet goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Basiese Onderwyswette van 2017 in die Staatskoerant vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer word.
tgt: In aligning legislation with developments in the education landscape, Cabinet approved for the publication of the Basic Education Laws Amendment Bill of 2017 in the Government Gazette for public comment.

src: Die wetsontwerp volg op die hersiening van alle basiese onderwyswetgewing met die doel om organisatoriese doeltreffendheid te verbeter om skoolbestuur, leierskap en aanspreeklikheid te versterk.
tgt: The Bill is the outcome of the review of all basic education legislation with a view to enhancing organisational efficiency so as to improve school governance, leadership and accountability, transforming education services, and protecting vulnerable groups to ensure the well-being of learners.

src: Wysigings aan die Suid-Afrikaanse Skolewet, 1996 (Wet 84 van 1996) en die Wet op Indiensneming van Opvoeders, 1998 (Wet 76 van 1998) is voorgestel.
tgt: Amendments were proposed to the South African Schools Act, 1996 (Act 84 of 1996), and the Employment of Educators Act, 1998 (Act 76 of 1998).

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: In September vier ons Erfenismaand, Toerismemaand, Boomplantweek, Openbare Diensmaand, Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplanmaand en Thusong Dienssentrumweek.
tgt: In September we will mark Heritage Month, Tourism Month, Arbor Week, Public Service Month, National Development Plan (NDP) Month and Thusong Service Centre Week.

src: Verdere besonderhede oor hierdie gebeure sal deur die betrokke departemente gekommunikeer word.
tgt: Further details on these events will be communicated by the relevant departments.

src: As voorsitter van die SAOG, sal Suid-Afrika die SAOG-IKT-vergadering van Ministers van 4 tot 7 September 2017 aanbied om die vordering wat gemaak is met die toepassing van die SAOG-kommunikasie- en IKT-program te bespreek.
tgt: As the chair of the SADC, South Africa has offered to host the SADC ICT Ministers Meeting from 4 to 7 September 2017 to discuss progress made on the implementation of the SADC Communications and ICT Programme.

src: Ministers Ayanda Dlodlo en Siyabonga Cwele sal die Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging lei.
tgt: Minister Ayanda Dlodlo and Minister Siyabonga Cwele will lead the South African delegation in this meeting.

src: Die vergadering is daarop gerig om leiding te gee oor strategiese kommunikasie en IKT-probleme, en ook om die uitvoer van besluite wat by vorige vergaderings gemaak is, te monitor.
tgt: The meeting is to provide guidance on strategic communications and ICT issues and also track implementation of decisions made at previous meetings.

src: Suid-Afrika sal die vergadering ook gebruik om toegang tot bekostigbare IKT-infrastruktuurdienste te bevorder.
tgt: South Africa will use the meeting to promote access to affordable ICT infrastructure services, thereby positioning the country as a regional infrastructure hub and promoting small, medium and micro enterprises under the overall SADC industrialisation and regional integration agendas.

src: Dit sal help om die land as 'n plaaslike infrastruktuur-spilpunt te vestig en klein-, medium- en mikro-ondernemings te bevorder onder die oorhoofse SADC-industrialiserings- en streeksintegasiedagenda.
tgt: The 9th Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa (BRICS) Summit will take place in Xiamen, China from 4 to 5 September 2017.

src: Die 9de Brasilië, Rusland, Indië, China en Suid-Afrika (BRICS) -beraad vind in Xiamen, China plaas van 4 tot 5 September 2017.
tgt: The theme of China’s BRICS Chairpersonship is: “BRICS: Stronger Partnerships for a Brighter Future”.Total bilateral trade between South Africa and other BRICS countries amounted to US$29 billion in 2016.

src: Suid-Afrika se grootste uitvoerbestemming binne BRICS bly China, gevolg deur Indië, Brasilië en dan Rusland.
tgt: South Africa’s biggest export destination within BRICS remains China, followed by India, Brazil and then Russia.

src: Dieselfde geld vir invoere, met China as die grootste bron van invoere.
tgt: The same pattern is also evident in imports, with China remaining the biggest source of imports.

src: Die 2017 BRICS-beraad sal vyf sleutelprioriteite insluit, naamlik die versterking van samewerking, bevordering van wêreldwye bestuur, uitruil van mense, bevordering van institusionele verbeteringe en die bou van breër vennootskappe.
tgt: The 2017 BRICS Summit will feature five key priorities namely, deepening cooperation, strengthening global governance, undertaking people-to-people exchanges, advancing institutional improvements and building broader partnerships.

src: Suid-Afrika se strategiese fokus in BRICS is om handel met toegevoegde waarde te bevorder, belegging na die land se produktiewe sektore te lok en samewerking te verbeter om ons ontwikkelingsdoelwitte te bevorder.
tgt: The strategic focus for South Africa in BRICS is to promote value-added trade, attract investment into the country’s productive sectors and enhance cooperation to advance our development objectives.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van Suid-Afrikaanse maatskappye se deelname aan die 53ste Maputo Internasionale Handelskou, algemeen bekend as FACIM, wat van 28 Augustus tot 3 September 2017 in Mosambiek gehou word.
tgt: Cabinet noted the participation of South African companies in the 53rd edition of the Maputo International Trade Fair, commonly known as FACIM, which is taking place in Mozambique from 28 August to 3 September 2017.

src: FACIM is jaarliks 'n internasionale multisektorale handelskou, wat Mosambiek as 'n aantreklike bestemming vir handel en belegging bevorder.
tgt: FACIM is an international multi-sectoral trade fair held annually to showcase Mozambique as an attractive destination for trade and investment.

src: Twintig maatskappye is deur die Departement van Handel en Nywerheid (die dti) befonds, terwyl 10 deur die Mpumalanga Ekonomiese Groei-agentskap ondersteun is.
tgt: Twenty companies were funded by the Department of Trade and Industry (the dti) while 10 were supported by the Mpumalanga Economic Growth Agency.

src: Die maatskappye verteenwoordig verskeie sektore soos chemikalieë, agroverwerking, klere en tekstiele, ingenieurswese, mynbou en kapitale toerusting, asook die elektro-tegniese en beboudeomgewingsektore.
tgt: The companies represented various sectors including chemicals, agro-processing, clothing and textile, engineering, mining and capital equipment, and electro-technical and built environment sectors.

src: Mosambiek is Suid-Afrika se derde grootste handelsvennoot in die SAOG-streek, naas Botswana en Namibië.
tgt: Mozambique is South Africa’s third largest trade partner in the SADC region, after Botswana and Namibia.

src: Handel tussen die twee lande het van R29 miljard in 2012 tot R43 miljard in 2016 gestyg.
tgt: Trade between the two countries increased from R29 billion in 2012 to R43 billion in 2016.

src: Daar is tans 300 Suid-Afrikaanse maatskappye wat in Mosambiek sake doen.
tgt: There are currently 300 South African companies operating in Mozambique.

src: Die deelname van die Suid-Afrikaanse maatskappye in FACIM het verlede week by die Binasionele Kommissie besondere vermelding ontvang as een van die platforms wat sakegemeenskappe in die twee lande kan gebruik om moontlike samewerking en vennootskappe te betrek om handel en belegging tussen die lande te versterk.
tgt: The participation of the South African companies in FACIM received a particular recognition during last week’s Binational Commission as one of the platforms that business communities in the two countries can use for engaging on possible cooperation and partnerships for increasing trade and investment between our countries.

src: Die Minister van Binnelandse Sake, prof Hlengiwe Mkhize, sal aan die Ministeriële Migrasiedialoog vir Suider-Afrika deelneem, wat vanaf 2 tot 4 September 2017 in die Koninkryk van Swaziland gehou word.
tgt: The Minister of Home Affairs, Profssor Hlengiwe Mkhize, will participate in the Ministerial Migration Dialogue for Southern Africa to be held in the Kingdom of Swaziland from 2 to 4 September 2017.

src: Die oorhoofse doelwit van die geleentheid is die bevordering van dialoog tussen die SAOG-lidlande om die bestuur van migrasies in die streek te verbeter.
tgt: The overall objective of the event is to foster dialogue among SADC member states to improve migration governance in the region.

src: Kwessies wat ondersoek moet word, sluit in staatloosheid, migrasie, grensbestuur en arbeidsmigrasie.
tgt: Issues to be explored include statelessness, migration, border management and labour migration.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Messages.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy diepe meegevoel oor aan:die Minister van Polisie, Fikile Mbalula en sy gesin ná die afsterwe van sy ma, Mama Emma Mbalula.
tgt: Cabinet expressed its deepest and heartfelt condolences to:Police Minister Fikile Mbalula and his family following the passing of his mother, Mama Emma Mbalula.

src: Mag hulle krag vind om die pyn wat die heengaan van 'n moeder meebring, te hanteer.
tgt: May they find strength to cope with the difficulty and deep-seated pain that the passing of a mother brings to any home.

src: die geliefdes van drie mynwerkers wat dood verklaar is ná 'n ondergrondse ineenstorting by die Kusasalethu-myn naby Carletonville in Gauteng weens seismiese aktiwiteit, wat 1,8 op die Richterskaal geregistreer het.
tgt: the loved ones of three mineworkers who have been confirmed dead following an underground collapse of the Kusasalethu Mine near Cartonville in Gauteng, due to seismic activity registering on the Richter Scale.

src: Die Kabinet is hoopvol dat die ander twee vermiste mynerwerkers deur soekspanne wat tans na hulle soek, gered sal word en is verlig dat tientalle myners te midde van die voorval veilig na die oppervlak gebring is.
tgt: Cabinet is hopeful that the two other missing miners will be rescued by search teams currently on the ground and is relieved that dozens of miners were brought safely to the surface amid the incident.

src: die regering en mense van die Republiek van Sierra Leone ná een van die ergste vloede op ons vasteland.
tgt: the Government and people of the Republic of Sierra Leone following one of the worst floods in our continent.

src: Hierdie natuurramp het groot dele van die land verwoes, wat tot talle sterftes en vernietiging van eiendom gelei het en 'n katastrofiese humanitêre krisis veroorsaak het.
tgt: This natural disaster devastated significant parts of the country, resulting in massive loss of life, destruction of property and leaving behind a catastrophic humanitarian crisis.

src: Suid-Afrika het deur DIRCO 'n bedrag van R8 miljoen aan rampverligting geskenk.
tgt: Through the DIRCO, South Africa pledged R8 million to assist in disaster relief.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense oor aan alle Moslems wat die Haj (pelgrimstog) suksesvol voltooi het en wens Moslems 'n vreugdevolle 'Eid-al-Adha'.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates all Muslims who have successfully performed the Haj (pilgrimage) and wishes all Muslims a joyous ‘Eid-al-Adha.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderworpe aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die toepaslike klaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: MINISTERIE VAN KOMMUNIKASIEPrivaatsak X860, Pretoria, 0001, Tel: +27 12 473 0164 Faks: +27 12 473 0585Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 13 September 2017 by Tuynhuys in Kaapstad vergadering.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 13 September 2017, at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.

src: Kwessies in die Omgewing.
tgt: Issues in the environment.

src: Ekonomie.
tgt: Economy.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die positiewe groei in die bruto binnelandse produk (BBP) van 2,5% in die tweede kwartaal van 2017, wat die land uit 'n tegniese resessie geneem het.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the positive growth in the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of 2.5% in the second quarter of 2017, which has moved the country out of a technical recession.

src: Statistiek Suid-Afrika het die syfers wat 'n jaar-tot-jaar-groei van 1,1% verteenwoordig, verlede week vrygestel.
tgt: Last week, Statistics South Africa released the figures, which represent a year-on-year growth of 1.1%.

src: Hoewel dit versigtig optimisties is, is die Kabinet oortuig dat dit die eerste positiewe tekens is van wat hopelik die begin van die land se ekonomiese herstel is, wat stewig op die implementering van die Negepunt-plan gebou is.
tgt: Although cautiously optimistic, Cabinet is convinced the country is seeing the first positive signs of what is hopefully the start of the country’s economic recovery firmly built on the implementation of the Nine-Point Plan, which aims to grow the South African economy and create much-needed jobs.

src: Die plan is daarop gemik is om die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie te laat groei en broodnodige werksgeleenthede te skep.
tgt: This has resulted in the launch of four industrial parks and the rise in net exports of agricultural raw products on average by 14.6% a year since The Black Industrialist Programme has supported 62 projects that have attracted R26 billion in private-sector investment and created 19 859 jobs to date.

src: Ter ondersteuning van lokalisering is 21 produkte en sektore vir plaaslike produksie aangewys.
tgt: To support localisation, 21 products and sectors have been designated for local production.

src: Operasie Phakisa het tot dusver 'n geraamde R24,6 miljard in belegging in die oseane-ekonomie ontsluit, waarvan die regering R15 miljard bygedra het.
tgt: Operation Phakisa has so far unlocked an estimated R.6 billion in investment in the oceans economy, with Government contributing R15 billion of this amount.

src: Hoewel die beleggings hoofsaaklik betrekking het op infrastruktuurontwikkeling in hawens, mariene vervaardiging in veral bootbou, akwakultuur en wetenskaplike opnames in die olie- en gassektor, het verskeie staatsdepartemente aansienlike bydraes gelewer om die groei van hierdie sektor te verseker.
tgt: Although the investments are mainly in infrastructure development in ports, marine manufacturing in particular boatbuilding, aquaculture and scientific surveys in the oil and gas sector, several Government departments have made substantial contributions to ensure the growth of this sector.

src: Altesaam 6 517 werksgeleenthede is in die verskillende sektore geskep.
tgt: A total of 6517 jobs had been created in the various sectors.

src: Die Kabinet doen weer ’n beroep op alle sektore van die samelewing, veral die regering, die sakesektor en die burgerlike samelewing, om voort te bou op die positiewe momentum wat in die tweede kwartaal verkry is om hoër ekonomiese groei en ontwikkelingskoerse te handhaaf en om werksgeleenthede te red.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates calls to all sectors of society, particularly government, business and civil society, to build on the positive momentum gained during the second quarter to sustain higher rates of economic growth and development, and to help save jobs.

src: Die Minister van Finansies, Malusi Gigaba, gaan voort om met verskeie sektore gesprek te voer oor die inklusiewe ekonomiese groei-aksieplan, wat na verwagting vertroue in die land sal aanmoedig.
tgt: The Minister of Finance, Mr Malusi Gigaba, continues to engage with various sectors on the inclusive economic growth action plan, which is set to inspire confidence in the country.

src: Die Minister sal verder daaroor uitbrei wanneer hy op 18 Oktober 2017 in Kaapstad die Beleidsverklaring oor die Meiumtermynbegroting in die Parlement uitreik.
tgt: The Minister will further unpack this when he delivers the Medium Term Budget Policy Statement in Parliament, Cape Town, on 25 October 2017.

src: InvestSA se Eenstopbestemming (One Stop Shop) – Wes-Kaap.
tgt: InvestSA One Stop Shop – Western Cape.

src: Die Kabinet prys die bekendstelling van die eerste provinsiale InvestSA-Eenstopbestemming.
tgt: Cabinet commended the launch of the first provincial InvestSA One Stop Shop.

src: President Jacob Zuma het die InvestSA-Eenstopbestemming in die Wes-Kaap amptelik geloods en het die regering se verbintenis tot die verbetering van die beleggingsklimaat in Suid-Afrika as 'n aantreklike bestemming vir potensiële beleggers, bevestig.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma officially launched the InvestSA One Stop Shop in the Western Cape and affirmed government’s commitment to improving the investment climate in South Africa, which is an attractive destination for potential investors.

src: Die InvestSA-Eenstopbestemming verlaag die koste en vergemaklik saketransaksies in die land deur strategiese leiding te voorsien, regulatoriese ondoeltreffendheid uit te skakel en rompslomp vir beleggers te verminder.
tgt: The InvestSA One Stop Shop lowers the cost of doing business and eases doing business in the country by providing strategic guidance, reducing regulatory inefficiencies and cutting red tape for investors.

src: Die regering se Nasionale InvestSA-Eenstopbestemming is in Maart vanjaar bekend gestel en die dti sal InvestSA-Eenstopbestemmings in al nege provinsies vestig – eers in die Wes-Kaap, gevolg deur KwaZulu-Natal en Gauteng.
tgt: Government’s National InvestSA One Stop Shop was launched in March this year and through the dti, InvestSA One Stop shops will be established in all nine provinces – first in the Western Cape and followed by KwaZulu-Natal and Gauteng respectively.

src: 5 de Herdenking van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP)1.
tgt: 5th Anniversary of the National Development Plan (NDP)1.

src: Die Kabinet vier saam alle Suid-Afrikaners die 5de herdenking van die NOP, wat op 12 September 2012 deur die Parlement aanvaar is as die land se sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkelingsbloudruk om die drieledige uitdaging van armoede, werkloosheid en ongelykheid teen 2030 die hoof te bied.
tgt: Cabinet joins South Africans in celebrating the 5th Anniversary of the NDP, which was adopted by Parliament on 12 September 2012 as the country’s socio-economic development blueprint to tackle the triple challenge of poverty, unemployment and inequality by As the country’s roadmap towards prosperity, the NDP belongs to all South Africans and represents the hopes and aspirations from all sectors of society, for a better South Africa.

src: As die land se padkaart na voorspoed, behoort die NOP aan alle Suid-Afrikaners en verteenwoordig die hoop en aspirasies van alle sektore van die samelewing, vir 'n beter Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to rally behind the NDP Vision 2030.

src: BRICS-beraad.
tgt: BRICS Summit.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van 'n suksesvolle 9de Brasilië, Rusland, Indië, China en Suid-Afrika (BRICS) Beraad wat van 3 tot 5 September 2017 in Xiamen in die Volksrepubliek van China (PRC) plaasgevind het onder die tema: "BRICS: Sterker vennootskap vir 'n blinker toekoms".
tgt: Cabinet noted a successful 9th Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa (BRICS) Summit, held in Xiamen in the People’s Republic of China (PRC) from 3 to 5 September 2017 under the theme: “BRICS: Stronger Partnership for a Brighter Future”.

src: Die beraad verteenwoordig 'n belangrike mylpaal in die bou van sterker solidariteit en samewerking tussen ontluikende markte en ontwikkelende lande om die 2030-agenda vir volhoubare ontwikkeling in werking te stel.
tgt: The summit sets an important milestone towards building stronger solidarity and cooperation among emerging markets and developing countries to implement the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.

src: Suid-Afrika se vennootskap in BRICS is gemik op die bevordering van die land se nasionale belange, sowel as die bevordering van streeksintegrasie en 'n meer omvattende wêreldwye bestuurstelsel.
tgt: South Africa’s partnership in BRICS is premised on advancing the country’s national interests, promoting regional integration and advocating a more inclusive global governance system.

src: Bilaterale handel tussen Suid-Afrika en ander BRICS-lande het verlede jaar altesaam $29 miljard beloop.
tgt: Total bilateral trade between South Africa and other BRICS countries amounted to US$29 billion last year.

src: Suid-Afrika se grootste uitvoerbestemming binne BRICS bly China, gevolg deur Indië, Brasilië en Rusland.
tgt: South Africa’s biggest export destination within BRICS remains China, followed by India, Brazil and Russia.

src: China bly ook die grootste bron van Suid-Afrikaanse invoere.
tgt: The same pattern is also evident in imports, with China remaining the biggest source of South African imports.

src: Hoewel Suid-Afrika oor volop natuurlike hulpbronne beskik, is dit van kritieke belang om bystandsprogramme in werking te stel om ons industrialiseringsbeleid te ondersteun.
tgt: Even though South Africa has abundant natural resources, it is critical to implement beneficiation programmes to support our industrialisation policy.

src: Die aanvaarding van die BRICS Xiamen-verklaring en aksieplan het die sterk grondslag wat BRICS vir die vestiging van institusionele meganismes vir tasbare samewerking gelê het, na vore gebring.
tgt: The adoption of the BRICS Xiamen Declaration and Action Plan highlighted the strong foundation that BRICS has made in terms of establishing institutional mechanisms for tangible cooperation.

src: Die Kabinet is geëerd dat Suid-Afrika die inkomende voorsitter van BRICS is en beklemtoon sy doelwit om voort te bou op BRICS se program van ontwikkeling en voorspoed vir vennootlande, veral aangesien die land die 10de BRICS-beraad in 2018 aanbied.
tgt: Cabinet is honoured that South Africa is the incoming Chair of BRICS and entrenches its aim at the forefront to build on the BRICS programme of development and prosperity for partner countries, as it prepares to host the 10th BRICS Summit in 2018.

src: Suid-Afrika en Rusland onderteken ’n ooreenkoms.
tgt: South Africa and Russia sign agreement.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die ooreenkoms wat Suid-Afrika en Rusland tydens die 9de BRICS-beraad onderteken het.
tgt: Cabinet further welcomes the agreement signed between South Africa and Russia at the 9th BRICS Summit, which will yield an amount of US$400 million being invested in the development of South Africa’s oil and gas sector.

src: Dit sal 'n bedrag van US$400 miljoen oplewer, wat in die ontwikkeling van Suid-Afrika se olie- en gassektor belê sal word.
tgt: South Africa’s national oil company, PetroSA, and the Russian Federation geological exploration company, Rosgeo, have agreed to develop the exploration areas of blocks 9 and 11a off the South Coast of South Africa.

src: Suid-Afrika se nasionale oliemaatskappy PetroSA, en die Russiese Federasie se geologiese eksplorasiemaatskappy, Rosgeo, het ooreengekom om die eksplorasiegebiede van blokke 9 en 11a aan Suid-Afrika se Suidkus te ontwikkel.
tgt: The search for oil and gas resources in South Africa is highly strategic for the country’s energy security.

src: Rusland se Rosgeo sal geologiese eksplorasiewerk, sowel as die boor van verkenningsboorgate uitvoer.
tgt: Russia’s Rosgeo will conduct geological exploration work as well as drilling exploratory wells.

src: Die projek kan daartoe lei dat vier miljoen kubieke meter gas daagliks onttrek word en aan PetroSA se raffinadery vir gas-na-vloeistowwe in Mosselbaai in die Suidkus gelewer word.
tgt: The project could lead to four million cubic metres of gas being extracted daily and subsequently delivered to PetroSA’s Gas-To-Liquids refinery in Mossel Bay, on the South Coast.

src: Suid-Afrikaans uitvoermarkte.
tgt: South African export markets.

src: Die Kabinet wens die dti geluk met die aanvoer van 'n groep van 20 Suid-Afrikaanse maatskappye by die World Food Moscow 2017-uitstalling, wat tot 15 September 2017 duur.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the dti in leading a group of 20 South African companies to the World Food Moscow 2017 exhibition, which is underway until 15 September While promoting South Africa’s agro-processing industry, the participation of these local companies from the agro-processing sector, consolidates and establishes market presence of South Africa in Russia.

src: Terwyl dit die Suid-Afrikaanse agroverwerkingsbedryf bevorder, konsolideer en vestig die deelname van hierdie plaaslike maatskappye uit die agroverwerkingsektor, ook Suid-Afrika se markteenwoordigheid in Rusland.
tgt: Their participation is made possible through the Export Marketing and Investment Assistance Scheme of the dti, which is instrumental in developing export markets for South African products and services, as well as recruiting new foreign direct investment into the country.

src: Handel tussen Suid-Afrika en Rusland het aansienlik toegeneem van R5 miljard in 2012 tot byna R8 miljard in 2016.
tgt: Trade between South Africa and Russia increased significantly from R5 billion in 2012 to almost R8 billion in 2016.

src: Groot Suid-Afrikaanse uitvoere sluit in vrugte en neute, mangaanerts, drank, spiritualieë en asyn, wyn, elektriese masjinerie en toerusting.
tgt: Major South African exports include fruits and nuts, manganese ores, beverages, spirits and vinegar, wine, electrical machinery and equipment.

src: Kinderarbeid.
tgt: Child labour.

src: Die Kabinet is bekommerd oor onlangse voorvalle van kinderarbeid waarin kinders op plase in Noordwes en die Vrystaat gewerk het.
tgt: Cabinet is concerned about recent incidents of child labour in which children were found working on farms in the North West and Free State.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel hierdie onaanvaarbare misbruik en uitbuiting van kwesbare kinders.
tgt: Cabinet condemns this unacceptable abuse and exploitation of vulnerable children.

src: Die Kabinet prys die lede van die publiek wat die Departement van Arbeid hiervan in kennis gestel het.
tgt: Cabinet commends members of the public who alerted the Department of Labour which, together with the Department of Social Development, acted swiftly to deal accordingly with this heinous form of child abuse.

src: Die department het saam met die Departement van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling vinnig opgetree om hierdie afskuwelike vorm van kindermishandeling te pak.
tgt: Cabinet is pleased that the affected children have been relocated to places of safety and that the Department of Labour will intensify inspections and work together with law-enforcement agencies to bring perpetrators to book.

src: Ons kinders is die toekoms van die land.
tgt: Our children are the future of the country.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel enige vorm van kinderarbeid en doen ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om te alle tye waaksaam te wees en diegene wat die beginsels van ons Grondwet oortree aan te gee.
tgt: Cabinet condemns all forms of child labour and calls on all South Africans to remain vigilant at all times and report those violating the principles of our Constitution.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse Skolewet, 1996 (Wet 84 van 1996), tesame met die Kinderwet, 2005 (Wet 38 van 2005), stel dit duidelik dat alle kinders tussen die ouderdom van sewe en 15 jaar verplig is om skool toe te gaan.
tgt: The South African Schools Act, 1996 (Act 84 of 1996), together with the Children’s Act, 2005 (Act 38 of 2005), clearly directs that all children between the ages of seven and 15 are compelled to attend school.

src: Volgens die wet moet ouers en voogde verseker dat kinders in hierdie ouderdomsgroep gereeld geregistreer word en skool bywoon of die gevolge van nie-nakoming dra.
tgt: According to the law, parents and guardians should ensure that learners of this age group are registered and attend school regularly or face implications of not abiding.

src: Droogte.
tgt: Drought.

src: Die Kabinet bedank Suid-Afrikaners wat ag geslaan het op die oproep om water te bespaar.
tgt: Cabinet is grateful to those in South Africa who have heeded the call to save water.

src: Suid-Afrika is 'n waterskaars land en die aanhoudende droogtetoestande in dele van die land herinner ons daaraan om elke druppel te bespaar deur water verstandig en spaarsamig te gebruik.
tgt: South Africa is a water-stressed country and the persistent drought conditions in parts of the country are a reminder to all people to save every drop by using water wisely and sparingly.

src: Hoewel pogings om water te bespaar help om die druk op waterbronne te verlig, bewys die laer as normale seisoenale reën wat in die Wes-Kaap en KwaZulu-Natal ervaar is, dat daar nog meer gedoen moet word om water te bespaar.
tgt: Although efforts to save water help ease the pressure on water source the lower than normal seasonal rain reported in the Western Cape and KwaZulu-Natal is evidence that more needs to be done to conserve water.

src: Die Interministeriële Taakspan oor Droogte, gelei deur die Departement van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake, hou deurlopend die droogtetoestande dop en bied die nodige bystand deur toepaslike sektorafdelings om waternood te verlig.
tgt: The Inter-Ministerial Task Team on Drought, led by the Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, continues to monitor the drought conditions and offer the required support through relevant sector departments to mitigate the situation.

src: Die regering het R74 miljoen aan bystandsbefondsing toegeken in reaksie op die volgehoue droogte in die Wes-Kaap.
tgt: Government has allocated R74 million in relief funding to respond to the persistent drought in the Western Cape.

src: Die Departement van Water en Sanitasie maak ook vordering met voorbereidings vir die inwerkingstelling van die Bergrivier- na Voëlvlei-aanvullingskema.
tgt: The Department of Water and Sanitation is also making progress with preparations for the implementation of the Berg River to Voelvlei Augmentation Scheme.

src: Die rekord van die besluit oor die omgewingsimpakstudie behoort teen die einde van September uitgereik te word.
tgt: The record of decision for the Environmental Impact Assessment should be granted by the end of September.

src: Die Minister van Water en Sanitasie, Nomvula Mokonyane, het sedertdien die Trans-Caledon Tonnelowerheid opdrag gegee om die finansiering in plek te kry en die projek in werking te stel.
tgt: The Minister of Water and Sanitation, Ms Nomvula Mokonyane, has since directed the Trans-Caledon Tunnel Authority to raise the finance and implement the project.

src: Hulle het reeds met groot gebruikers begin onderhandel en sal binnekort die Minister nader om met die Minister van Finansies ooreen te kom oor leningsperke vir die projek.
tgt: They have already started engaging with major users and will shortly be approaching the Minister for concurrence with the Minister of Finance for borrowing limits for the project.

src: Die Kabinet doen weer eens ’n dringende beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om waterbewaring as deel van hul daaglikse lewe uit te oefen.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates calls to all in South Africa to ensure water conservation is exercised as part of their daily lives.

src: Lesotho.
tgt: Lesotho.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel saam met President Zuma die sinnelose moord op die Bevelvoerder van Lesotho se Weermag, General Khoantle Motšomotšo.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Zuma in condemning the senseless killing of Lesotho Defence Force Commander, General Khoantle Motšomotšo.

src: Hierdie jongste insident van geweld is onaanvaarbaar.
tgt: This latest incident of violence is unacceptable.

src: Dit is nou die plig van Lesotho se mense en leiers om te verseker dat kalmte en normaliteit dringend na die Koninkryk terugkeer.
tgt: It is now incumbent on the people and leadership of Lesotho to ensure that calm and normality returns to the Kingdom as a matter of urgency.

src: Ons vertrou steeds dat die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap (SAOG) se Ministeriële Feite-missie, Lesotho sal kan bystaan in die vestiging van toepaslike tussenkomste.
tgt: We remain hopeful that the Southern African Development Community (SADC) Ministerial Fact-Finding Mission will be able to assist Lesotho in determining appropriate interventions.

src: Die SAOG bly vasberade om demokrasie, vrede, sekerheid en stabiliteit in die streek te konsolideer, te verdedig en te onderhou deur samewerking met Lesotho se leiers.
tgt: The SADC remains resolute in its objective to consolidate, defend and maintain democracy, peace, security and stability in the region working with the leadership of Lesotho.

src: Libië1.
tgt: Libya.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die resultate van die Afrika-Unie (AU) se Hoëvlakkomitee van Staatshoofde se sitting oor Libië, wat in Brazzaville in die Republiek van die Kongo, gehou is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the outcomes from the African Union (AU) High Level Committee on Libya at the Level of Heads of State and Government, which was held in Brazzaville, in the Republic of Congo.

src: President Zuma was deel van die Hoëvlakkomitee wat pogings om 'n blywende oplossing vir die heersende konflik in Libië te vind, bespreek het.
tgt: President Zuma participated in the High Level Committee, which discussed and reviewed efforts towards finding a lasting solution to the prevailing conflict in Libya.

src: As lid van die Hoëvlakkomitee oor Libië ondersteun Suid-Afrika alle pogings van die AU wat daarop gemik is om 'n vreedsame oplossing vir die Libiese krisis te bewerkstellig.
tgt: As a member of the High Level Committee on Libya, South Africa supports all efforts of the AU aimed at bringing about a peaceful resolution to the Libyan crisis.

src: Die Kabinet beklemtoon President Zuma se stelling dat Suid-Afrika gereed is om Libië by te staan ná die land se heropbou- en ontwikkelingspogings en om ons ervarings met versoening, die bou van ’n grondwet en die demokratiese transformasie van die staat te deel.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates President Zuma’s assertion that South Africa is ready to assist Libya in Post-Reconstruction and Development efforts and to share our country’s experiences in reconciliation, constitution-building and the democratic transformation of the State.

src: Die Kabinet beklemtoon ook die belangrikheid van gekoördineerde en geharmoniseerde internasionale betrokkenheid in Libië.
tgt: Cabinet also reiterates the importance of coordinated and harmonised international engagement in Libya.

src: Konferensie van Partye (CoP13)1.
tgt: Conference of the Parties (CoP13)1.

src: Die Kabinet bevestig Suid-Afrika se deelname, as 'n ondertekenaar van die Verenigde Nasies se VN-Konvensie oor die Bekamping van Woestynvorming, aan die 13de Sessie van COP13 wat in Ordos, China plaasvind van 6 tot 16 September Na verwagting sal die konferensie 'n nuwe strategiese raamwerk vir 2018-2030 finaliseer en aanneem.
tgt: Cabinet acknowledges that South Africa, as a signatory to the United Nations (UN) Convention to Combat Desertification, is participating in the 13th Session of the COP13 currently taking place in Ordos, PRC from 6 to 16 September It is envisaged that the conference will finalise and adopt a new strategic framework for 2018-2030 organised under the theme “Towards a Healthy Land for Present and Future Generations”.

src: Suid-Afrika het onderneem om seker te maak dat beleide omgesit word in konkrete aksies.
tgt: South Africa will work to ensure that policies are turned into concrete actions.

src: Suid-Afrika sal met alle lande in Afrika saamwerk om die lande se posisiessowel as dié van die vasteland te bevorder.
tgt: South Africa will work with all countries in Africa in advancing the country’s positions and that of the continent.

src: Die hoëvlakgedeelte van hierdie konferensie sal politieke leiding oorweeg en voorsien oor uitdagings wat verband hou met woestynvorming, grondagteruitgang en droogte.
tgt: The High Level Segment of this conference will consider and provide political guidance on challenges to emerging issues in desertification, land degradation and drought.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om die omgewing te beskerm en te koester sodat dit vir toekomstige geslagte bewaar bly.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to protect and take care of the environment in order to conserve it for future generations.

src: Openbare vervoeroperateurs.
tgt: Public transport operators.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel die dade van geweld, die afbrand van operateurs se voertuie en dade van intimidasie tussen die Meer Taxi-operateurs en die E-Hailing-vennote wat by Sandton in Johannesburg plaasgevind het.
tgt: Cabinet condemns the acts of violence, torching of operators’ vehicles and acts of intimidation between the Meter Taxi Operators and the E-Hailing Partners that took place at Sandton, in Johannesburg.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op wetstoepassingsagentskappe om daders van geweld en intimidasie binne die grense van ons Grondwet vas te vat.
tgt: Cabinet calls on law-enforcement agencies to deal with perpetrators of violence and intimidation within the confines of our Constitution.

src: Hierdie insidente doen afbreuk aan die land se daadwerklike pogings om 'n klimaat van vryhandel en regverdige mededinging te skep.
tgt: These developments detract from the country’s concerted efforts in creating a climate of free trade and fair competition.

src: Raadslede.
tgt: Councillors.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel die aanvalle en moord van raadslede in sommige provinsies en dra sy diepste meegevoel oor aan die families en vriende van dié wat vermoor is.
tgt: Cabinet condemns the attacks and killings of councillors in some provinces and extends its deepest condolences to the families and friends of those murdered.

src: Dit is in stryd met die etos van die Grondwet, en doen afbreuk aan ons ontwikkelingsdemokrasie en die reg van mense om hul openbare verteenwoordigers te verkies.
tgt: This goes against the ethos of the Constitution, and detracts from our developmental democracy and the right of people to elect their public representatives.

src: Sedert die begin van die jaar was daar verskeie sterftes in KwaZulu-Natal en onlangs is sterftes ook in die Oos-Kaap aangemeld.
tgt: Since the beginning of the year, there have been several deaths in KwaZulu-Natal and recently, deaths have also been reported in the Eastern Cape.

src: Hierdie geweld het jong aktiviste se lewens geneem, insluitend die vreeslose voormalige Sekretaris-Generaal van die ANC se Jeugliga (ANCYL), Sindiso Magaqa, wat nog ’n groot bydrae sou kon lewer om 'n voorspoedige Suid-Afrika te bou.
tgt: This violence has taken the lives young activists, including the fearless former African National Congress Youth League Secretary-General Sindiso Magaqa, who still had much to contribute in building a prosperous South Africa.

src: Ons doen 'n beroep op politieke partye om verdraagsaamheid onder hulle lede te bevorder en versoek gemeenskappe om die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens te ondersteun met hul ondersoeke.
tgt: We call on political parties to promote tolerance amongst their members and call on communities to support the South African Police Service in their investigations.

src: Erfenismaand.
tgt: Heritage Month.

src: Die Kabinet moedig alle Suid-Afrikaners aan om Erfenismaand vanjaar te vier onder die tema: "Die Jaar van Oliver Reginald Tambo: Vier ons bevrydingserfenis ".
tgt: Cabinet encourages all South Africans to continue to observe this year’s Heritage Month under the theme: “The Year of Oliver Reginald Tambo: Celebrating our Liberation Heritage”.

src: Hierdie maand val saam met die eeufees van OR Tambo se geboorte, 'n patriot van Afrika, wat hom onwrikbaar daaraan toegewy het om die mense van Suid-Afrika, die vasteland en die wêreld te dien.
tgt: This month coincides with the centenary birth of OR Tambo, an African Patriot, who showed an unwavering commitment to serve the people of South Africa, the continent and the world.

src: Ons gedenk ook die 40ste herdenking van die dood van Steve Bantu Biko, wat brutaal deur die apartheidsregering vermoor is.
tgt: We have also marked the 40th anniversary of the death of Steve Bantu Biko, who was brutally murdered by the apartheid regime.

src: Die Minister van Kuns en Kultuur, Nathi Mthethwa, het 'n feesprogram vir die maand vrygestel.
tgt: The Minister of Arts and Culture, Mr Nathi Mthethwa, has released a programme of celebration for this month.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die 1ste kwartaallikse prestasie-vorderingsverslae vir 2017/18 oor die implementering van prioriteitsuitkomste vir die tydperk tussen April en Junie 2017.
tgt: Cabinet was apprised on the 1st performance quarterly progress reports for 2017/18 on the implementation of priority outcomes for the period between April and June 2017.Government continues to make considerable progress in implementing the 14 priority outcomes, derived from the Medium Term Strategic Framework 2014-2019, which brings us closer to realising the NDP Vision 2030.

src: Die Kabinet is ook ingelig oor gebiede waar vertragings met die implementering ervaar is en het planne om lewering te bespoedig geëvalueer.
tgt: Cabinet was also briefed on areas that experienced delays in the implementation and appraised on actions required to fast-track delivery.

src: Ministeriële groeperings sal media-inligtingsessies gedurende die week van 6 tot 15 Oktober 2017 hou om die resultate van hierdie verslae te bespreek.
tgt: Cluster Ministerial media briefings will be held to brief on the outcomes of these reports during the week of 6 October until 15 October 2017.

src: Die skedule sal gereeld bygewerk word en op: WEBTOKEN geplaas word.
tgt: The schedule will be updated regularly and posted on WEBTOKECabinet has approved the proposal for South Africa to host the International Telecommunication Union Telecom World Exhibition in September 2018.

src: Die Kabinet keur die voorstel goed dat Suid-Afrika die Telecom-wêrelduitstalling van die Internasionale Telekommunikasie Unie in September 2018 aanbied.
tgt: This is an annual exhibition and forum for government and industry leaders to explore challenges, partnerships and solutions, and identify investment opportunities and best practices for socio-economic development through Information and Communication Technologies (ICTs).This will be the first time this event is held in Africa.

src: Dit bied 'n geleentheid aan die Suid-Afrikaanse IKT-bedryf om hul onderskeie produkte te vertoon.
tgt: During this event, the South African ICT industry will be afforded an opportunity to showcase their respective products.

src: Die land se toerismesektor sal ook by hierby baat.
tgt: The country’s tourism sector will also benefit during this period.

src: 3.Toekomstige Gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: President Zuma sal 'n Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging lei na die 72ste Gereelde Sitting van die VN se Algemene Vergadering in New York met die tema "Fokus op mense: strewe na vrede en 'n aangename lewe vir almal op 'n volhoubare planeet".
tgt: President Zuma will lead a South African delegation to the 72nd Regular Session of the UN General Assembly under the theme “Focusing on People: Striving for Peace and a Decent Life for All on a Sustainable Planet” in New York, United States of America.

src: Suid-Afrika sal volhou om hom tydens sy deelname aan die 72ste sessie vir die hervorming van die VN te beywer.
tgt: South Africa will continue to work on achieving reform at the UN as it participates in the 72th Session.

src: President Jacob Zuma, as voorsitter van die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap (SAOG), sal op 15 September 2017 'n buitengewone Dubbele Troika-beraad van Staatshoofde belê.Die Dubbele Troika-beraad vind plaas na aanleiding van die onlangse politieke en veiligheidsuitdagings in die Koninkryk van Lesotho.'
tgt: President Zuma, as the Chairperson of the SADC, will convene an Extraordinary Double Troika Summit of Heads of State and Government on 15 September 2017 in Pretoria.

src: n Hoëvlak Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging sal op 25 September 2017 sy eerste bodvoorlegging om die 2023 Rugby Wêreldbeker aan te bied, in Londen indien.
tgt: The Double Troika Summit is held as a result of the recent political and security developments in the Kingdom of Lesotho.

src: Suid-Afrika het 'n sterk bewese rekord vir die aanbied van sulke geleentede.
tgt: A high-level South African delegation will make its first bid presentation to host the 2023 Rugby World Cup in London on 25 September 2017.

src: Die Kabinet wil sy sterk steun van hierdie bod herbevestig en doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om dit ook te steun.
tgt: South Africa has a strong proven record of hosting such events.

src: Die geleentheid sal ’n beduidende bydrae lewer tot maatskaplike samehorigheid en nasiebou en sal ook as 'n katalisator vir sportontwikkeling dien.
tgt: Cabinet wishes to reiterate its strong support of this Bid and calls upon South Africans to support this Bid that will contribute immensely to social cohesion and nation-building, and also serve as a catalyst for sport development.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Messages.

src: Die Kabinet wens die burgers van Duitsland alle sukses toe met die voorbereidings vir die federale verkiesings op 24 September 2017 wanneer lede van die 19de Bundestag verkies word.
tgt: Cabinet wishes the citizens of Germany every success in preparation for Federal elections on 24 September 2017 to elect members of the 19th Bundestag, which in turn will elect a Chancellor and form a new government.

src: Duitsland is 'n belangrike belegger in Suid-Afrika, wat uitsien na volgehoue goeie verhoudings, samewerking en vennootskap.
tgt: Germany is a prominent investor in South Africa, which looks forward to continued relations, cooperation and partnership.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel met die Karibiese Eilande, asook dele van Kuba en die VSA ná die verwoesting wat deur die Orkaan Irma veroorsaak is.
tgt: Cabinet extends its sympathies to the Caribean as wells as parts of Cuba and the Unites Sates following the devastation caused by Hurricane Irma.

src: Innige medelye gaan na die geliefdes van diegene wat hul lewens en hul besittings in hierdie ramp verloor het.
tgt: Heartfelt condolences are extended to the loved ones of those who lost their lives and their belongings in this disaster.

src: Die Kabinet wens saam met ander Suid-Afrikaners vir Kevin Anderson geluk dat hy die eindstryd van die Amerikaanse Ope gehaal het.
tgt: Cabinet joins the nation in congratulating Kevin Anderson on making the finals of the US Open.

src: Hy is die eerste Suid-Afrikaanse speler wat sedert 1994 die eindstryd van 'n groot tenniskampioenskap haal.
tgt: He is the first South African player to make the final of a major tennis championship since 1994.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 27 September 2017 by die Uniegebou in Pretoria vergaderKwessies in die Omgewing.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 27 September 2017, at the Union Buildings, Pretoria.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom president Jacob Zuma se toepraak by die 72ste gereelde sitting van die UNGA in New York, VSA op 12 September 2017 met die tema “Fokus op mense: strewe na vrede en 'n aangename lewe vir almal op 'n volhoubare planeet”.
tgt: Issues in the environmentUnited Nations General Assembly (UNGA)Cabinet welcomed President Jacob Zuma’s address to the 72nd Regular Session of the UNGA in New York, USA on 12 September 2017, under the theme “Focusing on People: Striving for Peace and a Decent Life for All on a Sustainable Planet”.Deliberations focused, amongst others, on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) climate change peace and security issues and UN reforms, especially UN Security Council reform.

src: Besprekings het onder meer gefokus op die doelstellings vir volhoubare ontwikkeling (SDG's) klimaatsverandering vrede- en sekuriteitskwessies, assook VN-hervormings, veral die hervorming van die VN se Veiligheidsraad.
tgt: President Zuma also signed the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons, which reflects South Africa’s continued commitment towards the achievement of a world free from the threat posed by nuclear weapons and ensuring that nuclear technology is used for peaceful purposes only.

src: President Zuma het ook die Verdrag oor die Verbod op Kernwapens onderteken.
tgt: President Zuma hosted a centenary celebratory dinner in honour of the late former President of the African National Congress, Mr Oliver Reginald Tambo.

src: Dit weerspieël Suid-Afrika se volgehoue verbintenis tot die bereiking van 'n wêreld wat vry is van die bedreiging van kernwapens en om te verseker dat kerntegnologie net vir vreedsame doeleindes gebruik word.
tgt: Heritage MonthCabinet thanks all South Africans for celebrating Heritage Month in September and reiterates President Zuma’s Heritage Day message for all in the country to aspire for greater unity in WEBTOKEN the country concludes Heritage Month under the theme “The Year of Oliver Reginald Tambo: Celebrating our Liberation Heritage”, South Africans are encouraged to build on the values espoused in the Constitution and strengthen efforts to build a nation free from poverty, hunger, homelessness and WEBTOKEN fostering a spirit of heritage, Cabinet welcomes the agreement signed between South Africa and Tanzania, which is aimed at preserving the history of the liberation struggle.

src: Terwyl die land Erfenismaand afsluit met die tema "Die Jaar van Oliver Reginald Tambo: Die viering van ons Bevrydingserfenis", word Suid-Afrikaners aangemoedig om voort te bou op die waardes wat in die Grondwet vervat word en volgehoue pogings om 'n volk te bou wat vry is van armoede, honger, dakloosheid en ongelykheid.
tgt: It is a celebration of the spirit of solidarity and cooperation amongst Africa’s liberation movements and will see the construction of a museum, library and WEBTOKEN Tourism DaySouth Africa, under the leadership of the Minister of Tourism, Ms Tokozile Xasa, participated in World Tourism Day (27 September 2017) and the Tourism Month, under the theme “Sustainable Tourism – A Tool for Development”.

src: In die gees van Erfenismaand, verwelkom die Kabinet die ooreenkoms wat tussen Suid-Afrika en Tanzanië onderteken is, wat daarop gemik is om die geskiedenis van die bevrydingstryd te bewaar.
tgt: This provides a platform to support changes in policy, business practices and tourism consumer behaviour, towards a more sustainable tourism sector, which can contribute aggressively towards the attainment of the SDGs.

src: Dit vier die gees van solidariteit en samewerking tussen Afrika se bevrydingsbewegings wat tot die bou van 'n museum, biblioteek en argiewe sal lei.
tgt: During World Tourism Day, different countries and cultures celebrate a multiplicity of region-based activities such as the promotion of special tariffs and/or broadening access to facilities, mass-based free access to parks and gardens, and various engagements with stakeholders.

src: Dit bied 'n platform vir die bevordering van veranderinge in beleid, sakepraktyke en toerismeverbruikersgedrag, sodat 'n meer volhoubare toerismesektor geskep word, wat aggressief kan bydra tot die bereiking van die SDG's.
tgt: As a tourist destination, South Africa faces the prospects of growing its transversal tourism sectors to enable massive economic potential through the so-called traditional dominant tourism economic sectors.

src: Tydens Wêreldtoerismedag vier verskillende lande en kulture 'n verskeidenheid van streeksgebaseerde aktiwiteite, soos die bevordering van spesiale tariewe en/of die uitbreiding van toegang tot fasiliteite, massagebaseerde gratis toegang tot parke en tuine, en verskeie verbintenisse met belanghebbendes.
tgt: These include rural, medical, agro and cultural tourism.

src: Suid-Afrika het toerisme suksesvol bevorder deur middel van verskeie aantreklike fasiliteite soos ons parke, blouvlagstrande en wêreldgeakkrediteerde erfenisterreine.
tgt: Antiretroviral pricing agreementCabinet welcomes the ground-breaking pricing agreement reached by the Minister of Health, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi, in collaboration with a number of international organisations, to accelerate the availability of the first affordable single-pill HIV-treatment WEBTOKEN is estimated that the price reduction will result in savings of up to R.7 billion over the next six years.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n oproep op alle seksueel aktiewe Suid-Afrikaners, veral die jeug, om 'n gesonde lewenstyl te handhaaf, wat voorkomende maatreëls insluit, soos om altyd veilige seks te beoefen deur onthouding, getrouheid aan een maat, kondome te gebruik en gereeld vir MIV te toets.
tgt: As we revitalise public health infrastructure, we are also expanding opportunities for local communities to improve their lives through job creation and local enterprise WEBTOKEN Development MonthCabinet calls on South Africans to continue to uplift those less fortunate than themselves ahead of Social Development Month in WEBTOKEN Development Month is held annually to commemorate the many strides the country has made, in providing social assistance to the poor and the most vulnerable in South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om steeds diegene wat minder bevoorreg as hulself is op te hef in die gees van Maatskaplike-ontwikkelingmaand in Oktober.
tgt: Through this programme, government continues to redress the imbalances of the past by bringing quality public services closer to communities previously marginalised from the mainstream of socio-economic development.

src: Maatskaplike-ontwikkelingmaand word jaarliks gehou ter viering van die vordering wat die land gemaak het met die voorsiening van maatskaplike bystand aan armes en die kwesbaarste mense in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Thusong Service Centres also empower communities with the necessary skills and training to better their lives, through existing partnerships with government, parastatals and the private sector.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse regering se maatskaplike bystandsprogram is gebou op 'n vaste oortuiging dat maatskaplike sekerheidshulp 'n basiese mensereg is en die sleutel is tot die herstel van sy burgers se waardigheid.
tgt: South Africa supports the statement by UN Secretary-General, Mr António Guterres, who emphasised the responsibility of the Government of Myanmar to provide security to all affected communities, and further request for humanitarian agencies to be granted access to communities in need of assistance and protection.

src: Maatskaplike toelaes bring finansiële hulp aan miljoene huishoudings en verhef die kwesbares, sodat hulle lewensomstandighede met waardigheid verbeter.
tgt: Cabinet urges all parties to end the violence to avoid further human suffering and appeals that situation in the Rakhine State be resolved with the ambit of the law.

src: Deur bestaande vennootskappe met die regering, parastatale orgasnisasies en die private sektor, bemagtig Thusong-dienssentrums ook gemeenskappe met die nodige vaardighede en opleiding om hul lewens te verbeter.
tgt: The Minister of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, Mr Des van Rooyen, and His Majesty King Letsie III, the Head of State of the Kingdom of Lesotho, attended the event on Monday, 25 September 2017.The Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs started documenting the history of 13 Kingships/Queenships in 2011.

src: Die Kabinet beklemtoon die beroep op gemeenskappe om Thusong -dnssentrums steeds te gebruik om toegang tot basiese dienste soos Binnelandse Sake, Arbeid, Justisie, die Suid-Afrikaanse Maatskaplike Sekuriteitsagentskap en die Padongelukkefonds te verkry.
tgt: This book will assist in understanding the history of Bakoena Ba Mopeli and succession genealogy in order to preserve our history.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op die publiek om enige inligting wat wetstoepassingsowerhede kan bystaan te verskaf en versoek dat diegene wat skuldig bevind word swaar gestraf word.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all to work together to ensure the country’s transport infrastructure benefits all and encourages road users to take responsibility and apply road safety as part of their daily lives.

src: Die Minister van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake, Des van Rooyen, en sy Majesteit Koning Letsie III, die Staatshoof van die Koninkryk van Lesotho, het die geleentheid op Maandag 25 September 2017 bygewoon.
tgt: South Africa to host the 2nd Session of the South Africa-Zimbabwe Bi-National Commission (BNC)President Jacob Zuma will host his Zimbabwean counterpart, His Excellency President Robert Mugabe, who will be in South Africa on 03 October 2017 on the occasion of the 2nd Session of the South Africa-Zimbabwe BNThe Agreement establishing the BNC was signed in April 2015 and inaugurated in October 2016 in Harare, Zimbabwe.

src: Die Departement van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake het in 2011 die geskiedenis van 13 Koning-/Koninginskappe begin dokumenteer.
tgt: South Africa and Zimbabwe have good bilateral political, economic and social relations underpinned by strong historical ties dating back many years.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag, 18 Oktober 2017 by Tuynhuys in Kaapstad, vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 18 October 2017, at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.

src: Belangrike kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Issues on the environment.

src: Meiavryheidsdag.
tgt: Media Freedom Day.

src: Die Kabinet herdenk Meiavryheidsdag saam met alle Suid-Afrikaners op Donderdag, 19 Oktober 2017.
tgt: Cabinet joins South Africans in commemorating Media Freedom Day on Thursday, 19 October 2017.

src: Die media het ’n sleutelrol in die stryd teen apartheid gespeel, asook om die gruweldade en geweld wat deur die apartheidsregime gepleeg is, bloot te lê.
tgt: Media played a critical role in the fight against apartheid, exposing atrocities and brutality committed by the apartheid regime.

src: Dit is vanjaar 40 jaar sedert die apartheidsregime progressiewe koerante soos die World, die Weekend World en die Voice verban het.
tgt: This year marks 40 years since the apartheid regime banned progressive newspapers such as the World, the Weekend World and the Voice.

src: Vandag is mediavryheid stewig in Suid-Afrika se Grondwet verskans en bly steeds ’n fundamentele kenmerk van ons ontwikkelende nasie.
tgt: Today, media freedom is firmly entrenched in South Africa’s Constitution and remains a fundamental feature of our developing nation.

src: Die Kabinet moedig Suid-Afrikaners verder aan om toegang tot inligting te bevorder en die reg op mediavryheid op ’n verantwoordelike manier te gebruik om te help om ’n verenigde, nie-rassige, nie-seksistiese, demokratiese en welvarende Suid-Afrika vir almal te bou.
tgt: Cabinet further encourages South Africans to continue to promote access to information and use the right of media freedom responsibly to help build a united, non-racial, non-sexist, democratic and prosperous South Africa for all.

src: Oseane-ekonomie.
tgt: Oceans Economy.

src: Die Kabinet loof President Jacob Zuma vir die lewering van ’n vorderingsverslag aan belanghebbers oor die implementering van Operasie Phakisa vir die Oseane-ekonomie en doen ’n beroep op alle belanghebbers om steeds in vennootskap met die regering te bly werk om die ekonomiese potensiaal van ons oseane te ontsluit.
tgt: Cabinet commends President Jacob Zuma in delivering a progress report to stakeholders on the implementation of Operation Phakisa for the Oceans Economy and calls on all stakeholders to continue partnering with government to unlock the economic potential of our oceans.

src: Die Oseane-ekonomie het reeds ongeveer 4,4% tot Suid-Afrika se bruto binnelandse produk bygedra en die President se verslag aan belanghebbers toon duidelik die daadwerklike poging en ondersteuning van al die regeringsvennote om hierdie geweldige potensiaal te ontgin.
tgt: The Oceans Economy has already contributed about 4.4% to South Africa’s Gross Domestic Product and the President’s report to stakeholders strongly demonstrates the concerted effort and support of all government partners tapping into the vast potential.

src: Projekte met betrekking tot die Oseane-ekonomie het tot dusver altesaam R24,6 miljard in beleggings van die regering en privaat sektor ontsluit, en het meer as 6 500 werksgeleenthede geskep.
tgt: Oceans Economy projects have so far unlocked a combined R.6 billion in investment from government and the private sector, and have created more than 6 500 jobs.

src: Die grootste belegging in die Oseane-ekonomie, wat deur regeringsinisiatiewe gefasiliteer is, is gerig op die ontwikkeling van infrastruktuur, hoofsaaklik hawens, vervaardiging, bootbou, akwakultuur en wetenskaplike opnames in die olie-en-gassektor.
tgt: The largest investment in the Oceans Economy, facilitated through government incentives, was directed to infrastructure development, mainly ports, manufacturing, boatbuilding, aquaculture and scientific surveys in the oil and gas sector.

src: Die regering beplan om die grootste enkele bootboufasiliteit in suidelike Afrika op die been te bring.
tgt: Government plans to establish the single largest boatbuilding facility in southern Africa.

src: Die KwaZulu-Natal Bootboupark in Durban se hawe sal die potensiaal uit nuwe beleggings, uitvoere en werkskepping ontgin.
tgt: The KwaZulu-Natal Boatbuilding Park in the Port of Durban will harvest potential from new investment, exports and job creation.

src: Staatsbesoek aan Zambië.
tgt: State visit to Zambia.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die resultate van President Zuma se staatsbesoek aan die Republiek van Zambië vanaf 12 tot 13 Oktober 2017.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the outcomes from President Zuma’s State Visit to the Republic of Zambia from 12 to 13 October 2017.

src: Wisselwerking tussen President Zuma en sy Zambiese ampsgenoot Edgar Lungu het die bestaande goeie politieke, ekonomiese en kulturele betrekkinge tussen die twee lande verstewig.
tgt: Interactions between President Zuma and his Zambian counterpart Edgar Lungu strengthened existing good political, economic and cultural relations between the two countries, underpinned by strong historical ties dating back from the years of the liberation struggle.

src: Die twee staatshoofde het die OR Tambo Nasionale Erfenisterrein in Chelstone, Lusaka, amptelik geopen, ter ere van OR Tambo se bydrae tot suidelike Afrika se vryheidstryd.
tgt: The two Heads of State officially opened the OR Tambo National Heritage site in Chelstone, Lusaka, in honour of OR Tambo’s contribution to the liberation struggle of southern Africa.

src: Zambië bly een van Suid-Afrika se top handelsvennote in die streek en op die vasteland.
tgt: Zambia remains one of South Africa’s top trading partners in the region and the continent.

src: Ekonomiese samewerking tussen Suid-Afrika en Zambië groei steeds, met Suid-Afrikaanse uitvoere na Zambië wat in 2016 ongeveer R30 miljard bedra het.
tgt: Economic cooperation between South Africa and Zambia continues to grow, with South African exports to Zambia amounting to approximately R30 billion in 2016.

src: Die twee lande werk saam op verskeie terreine, insluitend handel en belegging, wetenskap en tegnologie, verdediging, landbou, die omgewing, energie en gesondheid.
tgt: The two countries cooperate in a variety of areas, including trade and investment, science and technology, defence, agriculture, environment, energy and health.

src: Werksbesoek aan Nigerië.
tgt: Working visit to Nigeria.

src: Die Kabinet wens President Zuma geluk dat hy vereer is deur ’n standbeeld en ’n straat in Nigerië wat na hom vernoem is tydens ’n werksbesoek om sosio-ekonomiese betrekkinge en ander vorms van samewerking tussen die twee lande te verstewig.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates President Zuma on being honoured with a statue and a street being named after him in Nigeria, during a working visit to strengthen socio-economic relations and other cooperations.

src: Die Staatsgoewerneur van die staat Imo, Rochas Okorocha, het die Imo-merietetoekenning aan President Zuma oorhandig.
tgt: The Imo State Governor, Rochas Okorocha, conferred on President Zuma the Imo Merit Award, the highest award in the State conferred on those who have made a difference in the development of their communities.

src: 17de Vergadering van die Indiese Oseaankom-vereniging (IORA) se Raad van Ministers.
tgt: 17th Indian Ocean Rim Association Council of Ministers (IORA) Meeting.

src: Suid-Afrika het die voorsitterskap van IORA tydens die 17de vergadering wat vanaf 14 tot 18 Oktober 2017 in Durban gehou is, aanvaar.
tgt: South Africa assumed Chair of the IORA during the 17th meeting held in Durban from 14 to 18 October 2017.

src: Die tema vir Suid-Afrika se ampstermyn is “Verenig die Volke van Afrika, Asië, Australasië en die Midde-Ooste deur Verbeterde Samewerking vir Vrede, Standvastigheid en Volhoubare Ontwikkeling”.
tgt: South Africa’s theme for its tenure is “Uniting the Peoples of Africa, Asia, Australasia and the Middle East through Enhanced Cooperation for Peace, Stability and Sustainable Development”.

src: Die Kabinet het deur hierdie voorsitterskap sy verbintenis herbevestig om streeksamewerking te bevorder op terreine soos die blou ekonomie bemagtiging van vroue bevordering van klein, medium en mikro-ondernemings jeugbemagtiging, en samewerking in die akademie, wetenskap en tegnologie.
tgt: Cabinet has reiterated its commitment through this chairpersonship to further regional cooperation in areas such as the blue economy women economic empowerment small, medium and micro enterprise promotion youth empowerment, and cooperation in academics, science and technology.

src: Jaarvergaderings van die Internasionale Monetêre Fonds (IMF) en die Wêreldbank.
tgt: Annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank.

src: Die Kabinet is deur die Minister van Finansies, mnrMalusi Gigaba, toegespreek na afloop van Suid-Afrika se deelname aan die IMF en die Wêreldbank se 2017 jaarvergaderings, wat vanaf 13 tot 15 Oktober plaasgevind het.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed by the Minister of Finance, Mr Malusi Gigaba, following South Africa’s participation at the 2017 IMF and World Bank annual meetings, which took place from 13 to 15 October 2017.

src: Die vergaderings het die geleentheid gebied om internasionale vordering oor ontwikkelingskwessies te evalueer en Suid-Afrika se eie inisiatiewe vir sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling, inklusiewe groei, werkskepping en armoedeverligting toe te lig.
tgt: The meetings provided an opportunity to assess international progress on development issues and inform South Africa’s own initiatives for socio-economic development, inclusive growth, employment creation and poverty alleviation.

src: Die Kabinet is ook ingelig oor die vergadering wat Minister Gigaba met soewereine kredietagentskappe en beleggers gehou het om Suid-Afrika se huidige beleide oor en benadering tot fiskale dissipline te herbevestig.
tgt: Cabinet was further briefed on the meeting Minister Gigaba held with sovereign credit rating agencies and investors to reaffirm South Africa’s current policies and approach to fiscal discipline.

src: Die Kabinet is tevrede met die versekering wat aan beleggers gegee is oor die regering se planne om die ekonomie te laat groei en die regering se verbintenis om beheerkwessies in Suid-Afrika se entiteite in staatsbesit aan te pak.
tgt: Cabinet is satisfied with the reassurance given to investors on government’s plans to grow the economy and government’s commitment to address governance issues in our state-owned entities.

src: Die Meiumtermyn-begrotingsbeleidsverklaring sal op 25 Oktober in Kaapstad in die Parlement ter tafel gelê word en sal ’n uiteensetting gee van die regering se bestedingsplanne oor die volgende drie jaar.
tgt: The Medium Term Budget Policy Statement will be tabled in Parliament, Cape Town, on 25 October and will outline government’s spending plans over the next three years.

src: Infrastruktuurontwikkeling.
tgt: Infrastructure development.

src: Die Kabinet prys die enorme hupstoot vir die regering se infrastruktuurontwikkeling met die amptelike oorhandiging van drie brûe deur President Zuma in Botlokwa, Limpopo op 17 Oktober 2017.
tgt: Cabinet applauded the massive boost in government’s infrastructure development with the official handover of three bridges in Botlokwa in Limpopo by President Zuma on 17 October 2017.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Padagentskap het die Botlokwa-brûe gebou dit sluit een padbrug en twee voetgangerbrûe op die N1 tussen Polokwane en Makhado in.
tgt: The South African National Roads Agency constructed the Botlokwa bridges, which consist of one road bridge and two pedestrian bridges on the N1 between Polokwane and Makhado.

src: Die Kabinet is positief dat hierdie projek reistoestande en veiligheid vir alle padgebruikers in die gebied aansienlik sal verbeter.
tgt: Cabinet is positive that this project will significantly improve travelling conditions and safety for all road users in the area.

src: Klein en mediumondernemings.
tgt: Small and medium enterprises.

src: Die Kabinet prys die Departement van Kleinsakeontwikkeling vir sy rol as medegasheer van vanjaar se Sjina Internasionale Klein- en Meiumonderneming (KMO)-skou, wat sal bydra tot die ontsluiting van die Sjinese mark vir Suid-Afrika se klein sakeondernemings en koöperasies.
tgt: Cabinet commends the Department of Small Business Development for co-hosting this year’s China International Small and Medium Enterprises (SME) Fair, as it contributes to unlocking the Chinese market for South Africa’s small businesses and cooperatives.

src: Die KMO-skou vind vanaf 10 tot 27 Oktober 2017 in Guangzhou, Sjina plaas.
tgt: The SME Fair is taking place in Guangzhou, China from 10 to 27 October 2017.

src: Klein sakeondernemings is die hartklop van ons gemeenskap en die dryfkrag vir ekonomiese groei en werkskepping in Suid-Afrika, en ons deelname aan die handelskou het marktoegang en geleenthede om ondernemings te ontwikkel, bevorder.
tgt: Small businesses are the heartbeat of our economy and engine for economic growth and job creation in South Africa, and our participation in the trade fair promoted market access and opportunities to grow businesses.

src: Die Kabinet is oortuig dat dit bewys lewer van die regering se verbintenis tot die doelwit om entrepreneurskap te bevorder en te handhaaf.
tgt: Cabinet is confident that this demonstrates government’s commitment to the goal of promoting and sustaining entrepreneurship.

src: Belegging in klein sakeondernemings sal ons land help om die heersende sosio-ekonomiese uitdagings aan te pak.
tgt: Investing in small businesses will help the country respond to current socio-economic challenges.

src: Toerisme.
tgt: Tourism.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van die Program vir Nasionale Toerismemonitors in Soweto, op Dinsdag 17 Oktober 2017, wat daarop gerig is om besoekerservarings te verryk en toeriste se veiligheid te verbeter.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the National Tourism Monitors Programme in Soweto, on Tuesday, 17 October 2017, which aims to enhance the visitor experience as well as improve the safety of tourists.

src: Die Departement van Toerisme, in vennootskap met die Gauteng Toerisme-owerheid, het die program in Vilakazistraat bekendgestel.
tgt: The Department of Tourism, in partnership with the Gauteng Tourism Authority, launched the programme in Vilakazi Street, which is the only street in the world boasting the residence of two Nobel Laureates – former President Nelson Mandela and Archbishop Emeritus Desmond Tutu.

src: Dit is die enigste straat ter wêreld wat met twee Nobelpryswenners se wonings spog, naamlik dié van voormalige President Nelson Mandela en Aartsbiskop Emeritus Desmond Tutu.
tgt: This programme is aligned to the National Development Plan (NDP) goals and aims to create employment for 200 youth, who will be trained to become monitors at tourism destinations for a 36-month period.

src: Hierdie program is met die doelwitte van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP) belyn, naamlik om werksgeleenthede vir 200 jeugdiges te skep.
tgt: Cabinet encourages business owners and communities in Gauteng to work with the tourism monitors to improve the safety of tourists and harness the economic potential from this industry.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom en wens die wetenskaplikes geluk wat aan die Suid- Afrikaanse Sterrewag (SAAO) en die Suider-Afrikaanse Groot Teleskoop (SALT) se teleskoopontdekkingsproses deelgeneem het.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes and congratulates the scientists who participated in the South African Astronomical Observatory (SAAO) and the Southern African Large Telescope (SALT) telescopes exploration.

src: Dit het gelei tot ongeëwenaarde internasionale samewerking om die oorsprong van die eerste bespeuring van gravitasiegolwe wat deur twee botsende neutronsterre voortgebring is, te ondersoek.
tgt: This resulted in an unprecedented international collaboration to investigate the origin of the first detection of gravitational waves produced by two colliding neutron stars.

src: Die botsing het ook ’n kilonova-ligontploffing veroorsaak.
tgt: The collision also resulted in a kilonova explosion of light.

src: ’n Kilonova is ’n sterrekundige gebeurtenis wat in ’n binêre stelsel voorkom wanneer twee neutronsterre of ’n neutronster en ’n gravitasiekolk saamsmelt.
tgt: A kilonova is an astronomical event that occurs in a binary system when two neutron stars or a neutron star and a black hole merge into each other.

src: Die ontdekking lui ’n nuwe era in astrofisika in dit is die eerste kosmiese gebeurtenis wat in sowel gravitasiegolwe as lig waargeneem is.
tgt: The discovery marks the birth of a new era in astrophysics, the first cosmic event observed in both gravitational waves and light.

src: SALT en ander SAAO-teleskope het sommige van die heel eerste data verskaf in wat een van die mees bestudeerde astrofisiese gebeurtenisse ooit blyk te wees.
tgt: SALT and other SAAO telescopes have provided some of the very first data in what is turning out to be one of the most-studied astrophysical events ever.

src: SALT en SAAO is twee van die 70 land- en ruimtegebaseerde sterrewagte wat die kataklismiese ontploffing van twee botsende neutronsterre waargeneem het onmiddellik nadat hul gravitasieskokgolwe deur die VSA-gebaseerde Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory, en die Europees-gebaseerde Virgo-opspoorder bespeur is.
tgt: SALT and SAAO are among the 70 ground- and space-based observatories that observed the cataclysmic explosion of two colliding neutron stars, immediately after their gravitational shock waves were detected by the United States-based Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory and the European-based Virgo detector.

src: Wêreldfees van Jeug en Studente.
tgt: World Festival of Youth and Students.

src: Rusland bied vanaf 14 tot 22 Oktober 2017 die 2017 Wêreldfees van Jeug en Studente aan, wat deur meer as 20 000 jeugdiges vanuit 150 lande bygewoon word.
tgt: Russia is hosting the 2017 World Festival of Youth and Students from 14 to 22 October 2017, which is being attended by more than 20 000 young people from 150 countries.

src: Die doel van die fees is om die jong mense van die wêreldgemeenskap byeen te bring rondom die idee van geregtigheid, die verstewiging van internasionale betrekkinge, en die ontwikkeling van inter-etniese en interkulturele verhoudings.
tgt: The purpose of the festival is to bring together the youth of the world community around the idea of justice, the strengthening of international relations, and the development of inter-ethnic and intercultural relations.

src: Kinderbeskerming.
tgt: Child protection.

src: Die Kabinet spreek sy kommer uit oor die ontstellende berigte van misdrywe teen kinders, soos die mees onlangse verslag oor die beweerde seksuele aanranding van meer as 80 leerders by die AB Xuma Primêre Skool in Orlando, Soweto deur ’n skolierpatrolliebeampte.
tgt: Cabinet has expressed concern following disturbing reports of crimes against children, the most recent one being the alleged sexual assault of more than 80 pupils at the AB Xuma Primary School in Orlando, Soweto by a scholar patrol guard.

src: Die provinsiale departement word geloof vir die spoedige optrede om die skool se senior bestuurspan met onmiddellike effek te skors, maatskaplike werkers te ontplooi en ’n ondersoek deur ’n onafhanklike liggaam te gelas.
tgt: The provincial department is commended for the prompt response by removing, with immediate effect, the senior management of the school, bringing on board social workers and instituting an investigation by an independent body.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle gemeenskappe in Suid-Afrika om saam te werk om al ons kinders teen enige vorm van gevaar of mishandeling te beskerm en om in vennootskap met die plaaslike polisie te help om ons gemeenskappe veilig te hou.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all communities in South Africa to work together to protect all children from any form of danger and abuse, and to partner with local police to keep our communities safe.

src: Eksamens.
tgt: Examinations.

src: Die Kabinet is vol vertroue dat die skole se eindeksamens sonder enige onderbrekings sal verloop, ná verlede week se massaprotesoptog onder leiding van die Suid-Afrikaanse Demokratiese Onderwysersunie (SADOU).
tgt: Cabinet is confident that end-of-year school examinations will proceed without interruption following this week’s mass demonstration led by the South African Democratic Teachers’ Union (SADTU).

src: SADOU het ’n memorandum oorhandig aan die Minister van Basiese Onderwys, me Angie Motshekga, wat onderneem het om die vraagstukke so spoedig moontlik op te los.
tgt: SADTU handed over a memorandum to the Minister of Basic Education, Ms Angie Motshekga, who has committed to resolving issues of concern as speedily as possibly.

src: Dit is belangrik dat alle belanghebbers saamwerk om ’n bevorderlike omgewing te skep waarin leerders in staat gestel word om op hul leerproses en eksamens te fokus.
tgt: It is important that all stakeholders work together to create a conducive environment to better enable learners to focus on learning and their examiniations.

src: Storms.
tgt: Storms.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy innige meegevoel oor aan die geliefdes van diegene wat tydens die onlangse storms in dele van die land gesterf het.
tgt: Cabinet expresses sincere condolences to the loved ones of those who lost their lives during the recent storms in some parts of the country.

src: Die Kabinet bedank ook al die vrywilligers, burgerlikesamelewingsorganisasies, gemeenskappe, noodlenigingswerkers en rampbestuurspanne vir hul bystand aan almal wat deur die storms geraak is.
tgt: Cabinet also extends its gratitude to all volunteers, civil-society organisations, communities, relief-aid workers and the Disaster Management teams for assisting those affected.

src: Die Minister van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Aangeleenthede, mnrDes van Rooyen, het in sy hoedanigheid as die hoof van die Nasionale Rampbestuursentrum in Suid-Afrika op 13 Oktober 2017 besoeke gebring aan gebiede in die eThekwini Meropolitaanse Munisipaliteit in KwaZulu-Natal, wat deur die storms en swaar reën getref is.
