tgt: The Minister of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, Mr Des van Rooyen, in his capacity as the head of the National Disaster Management Centre in South Africa, visited areas affected by storms and heavy rains in the eThekwini Metropolitan Municipality in KwaZulu-Natal on 13 October 2017 and Mogale City Local Municipality in Gauteng on 16 October WEBTOKEN a result of the heavy rains and storms that battered many parts of the country, 19 lives were lost and over 20 people injured.

src: Op 16 Oktober 2017 het hy gebiede wat in die Mogale City Plaaslike Munisipaliteit in Gauteng getref is, besoek.
tgt: Minister van Rooyen also visited the recent incidences in Philippi in the Western Cape where six family members, including three children, lost their lives due to the fire that ravaged three informal houses and a tuckshop.

src: Life Esidimeni.
tgt: Life Esidimeni.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die aanvang van die Life Esidimeni alternatiewe geskiloplossingsproses as ’n moontlike eerste stap vir families van die pasiënte wat gesterf het om berusting te vind.
tgt: Cabinet acknowledges the start of the Life Esidimeni alternative dispute resolution process as what could be the beginning of closure for families of patients who died.

src: Die Kabinet het volle vertroue in die afgetrede adjunkhoofregter van die Konstitusionele Hof, Dikgang Moseneke, wat as voorsitter in die saak optree, en wens die familielede alle sterkte toe terwyl hulle hierdie tragedie gedurende die pynlike ondersoekproses moet herleef.
tgt: Cabinet expresses full confidence in retired Constitutional Court Deputy Chief Justice Dikgang Moseneke, who is presiding over the matter and sincerely wishes family members strength as they observe what must be a difficult account of this tragedy.

src: Die ondersoek behoort nie net berusting te bring vir families wat deur die tragedie geraak word nie, maar hou ook lesse in vir die regering in die algemeen.
tgt: The investigation should not only assist in bringing closure to these affected families but also serve to provide lessons to government in general.

src: Die regering is verbind tot die voorsiening van gehaltedienste aan alle Suid-Afrikaners.
tgt: Government is committed to providing quality services to all South Africans.

src: Voëlgriep.
tgt: Avian Influenza.

src: Die Kabinet het die versekering van die Departement van Landbou, Bosbou en Visserye dat dié departement deurlopende waarnemings op plase regoor die land doen in ’n poging om te voorkom dat voëlgriep (HPAI) H5N8 verder versprei.
tgt: Cabinet has been assured that the Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (DAFF) is undertaking consistent surveillance on farms across the country in an effort to prevent the spread of the Avian Influenza (HPAI) H5N8 outbreak.

src: Hierdie spesifieke tipe voëlgriep is in voëls bespeur.
tgt: The strain of avian influenza has been detected in birds.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n dringende beroep op die publiek om nie siek of dooie voëls te hanteer nie en nie wilde voëls te probeer voer nie, maar eerder voëls wat vermoedelik siek is by die plaaslike owerhede aan te meld.
tgt: Cabinet urges the public to refrain from handling sick or dead birds and not attempt to feed wild birds but rather report birds suspected to be ill to local authorities.

src: Aanvalle op polisie.
tgt: Attacks on police.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel die aanval op ses lede van die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens in Vanderbijlpark, Gauteng op 10 Oktober 2017 deur lede van die gemeenskap.
tgt: Cabinet condemns the attack on six South African Police Service members in Vanderbijlpark in Gauteng on 10 October 2017 by members of the community.

src: Die wetstoepassingsagentskappe het die mandaat om die samelewing teen enige misdadige optrede te beskerm.
tgt: The law-enforcement agencies are mandated to protect society from any act of criminality.

src: Geen mate van woede kan dus aanvalle op wetstoepassingsagentskappe regverdig nie.
tgt: Therefore, no amount of anger can justify anyone attacking the law-enforcement agencies.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n dringende beroep op lede van die gemeenskap om met die polisie saam te werk om misdadigers in hegtenis te neem en Suid-Afrika vir almal veiliger te maak.
tgt: Cabinet urges members of that community to work with the police to apprehend criminal elements and help make South Africa safer for all.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet decisions.

src: Maatskaplikebehuisingsprogram.
tgt: Social Housing Programme.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor van die bevindings en aanbevelings van die Evaluering van die Uitwerkings en Implementering van die Maatskaplikebehuisingsprogram en die verbeteringsplan, met die doel om ruimtelike patrone uit die apartheidsera om te keer deur die ruimtelike plekbepalings en stedelike integrasie van behuisingsprojekte te verbeter.
tgt: Cabinet was apprised on the findings and recommendations of the Impacts and Implementation Evaluation of the Social Housing Programme and the improvement plan, with a view of overcoming apartheid spatial patterns by improving spatial location and urban integration of housing projects.

src: Die program bied bekostigbare huurakkommodasie vir lae- en middelinkomstehuishoudings in woonbuurte waar marktoestande hulle andersins sou uitsluit of ontoereikende behuising aan hulle sou toewys.
tgt: The programme offers affordable rental accommodation for low and middle-income households in neighborhoods where market conditions would otherwise exclude them or allocate inadequate housing.

src: Dit is die enigste program wat hefboomskuldfinansiering gebruik projekte se finansiële volhoubaarheid op die lang termyn in ag neem en ’n positiewe finansiële siklus skep met huurders wat huurgeld betaal en maatskaplikebehuisingsinstellings wat munisipale belasting, eiendomsbelasting en diensgelde aan munisipaliteite betaal.
tgt: This is the only programme that gears debt financing considers long-term financial sustainability of projects and creates a virtuous financial cycle with tenants paying rentals and social-housing institutions paying rates, taxes and service charges to municipalities.

src: Hierdie verslag help die betrokke departemente om hul onderskeie operasionele planne verder te verbeter.
tgt: This report assists the relevant departments in further improving their respective operational plans.

src: Die volledige verslag sal op die Departement van Prestasiemonitering en Evaluering se webblad (WEBTOKEN) gepubliseer word.
tgt: The full report will be placed on the website of the Department of Performance Monitoring and Evaluation (WEBTOKEN).

src: Nasionale Jeugdiens (NJD).
tgt: National Youth Service (NYS).

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die hersiene en verbeterde NJD Programraamwerk as deel van die ontwikkeling van jong mense as aktiewe landsburgers van Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Cabinet approved the revised and improved NYS Programme Framework as part of developing young people as active citizens of South Africa.

src: Die NJD stel jong mense in Suid-Afrika in staat om aktiewe burgers van die land te word en ’n positiewe bydrae tot die land se ontwikkeling te lewer terwyl hul op persoonlike en professionele vlak ontwikkel word.
tgt: The NYS is an enabler for young people in South Africa to become active citizens of the country and contribute positively to the country’s development while achieving personal and professional development.

src: Ingevolge die program sal jong mense deelneem aan aktiwiteite wat plaaslike gemeenskappe bevoordeel, terwyl hulle deur middel van dienslewering en leer hul vermoëns ontwikkel met die oog op geleenthede om arbeidsmarkte suksesvol te betree en entrepreneurs te word.
tgt: This will involve young people participating in activities that benefit local communities while developing their abilities through service and learning so that their opportunities to successfully enter labour markets and become entrepreneurs are bolstered.

src: Derde Afrika Forum vir Landbouadviesdienste-voorligtingsweek.
tgt: 3rd African Forum for Agricultual Advisory Services Extension Week.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring vir Suid-Afrika om as gasheer op te tree vir die Derde Afrika Forum vir Landbouadviesdienste-voorligtingsweek, wat vanaf 30 Oktober tot 3 November 2017 in KwaZulu-Natal gehou word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the hosting of the 3rd African Forum for Agricultural Advisory Services Extension Week, which will be held in KwaZulu-Natal from 30 October to 3 November 2017.

src: Die geleentheid is in ooreenstemming met die NOP en identifiseer voedselsekerheid as ’n manier om die drieledige uitdagings van werkloosheid, armoede en ongelykheid die stryd aan te sê.
tgt: The event is aligned to the NDP and identifies food security as a means to address the triple challenge of unemployment, poverty and inequality.

src: Die tema is: “Vehoog klimaatslim-landbou: integreer jeug, vroue en die digitale rewolusie” (Scaling up climate smart agriculture: integrating youth, women, and the digital revolution).
tgt: The theme is: “Scaling up climate smart agriculture: integrating youth, women, and the digital revolution”, and the event will be held under the leadership of the DAFF, in collaboration with the South African Society for Agricultural Extension and the African Forum for Agricultural Advisory Services.

src: Die geleentheid sal onder leierskap van die Departement van Landbou, Bosbou en Visserye gehou word, in samewerking met die Suid-Afrikaanse Vereniging vir Landbouvoorligting en die Afrika-forum vir Landbouadviesdienste.
tgt: This continental network for Agricultural Extension and Advisory Services (AEAS) in Africa provides a platform for mutual learning and innovation among AEAS providers across Africa and the world.

src: Die NOP bepleit ook ’n verbetering in vaardigheidsontwikkeling en -opleiding in die landbousektor, met inbegrip van die opleiding van ’n nuwe kader van voorligtingspraktisyns wat doelmatig op die behoeftes van kleinboere sal reageer.
tgt: The NDP also advocates for an improvement in skills development and training in the agricultural sector, including the training of a new cadre of extension practitioners who will respond effectively to the needs of smallholder farmers.

src: Wêreldwynhandelsgroep.
tgt: World Wine Trade Group.

src: As deel van pogings om handelsversperrings uit die weg te ruim, is die Kabinet ingelig oor Suid-Afrika se voorsitterskap van die Wêreldwynhandelsgroep vanaf April 2017 tot Me 2018.
tgt: In contributing to the removal of trade barriers, Cabinet was briefed on South Africa’s Chairship of the World Wine Trade Group from April 2017 to May 2018.

src: Suid-Afrika sal in sy hoedanigheid as voorsitter vanaf 1 tot 3 November 2017 die jaarvergadering van die Wêreldwynhandelsgroep in Kaapstad aanbied.
tgt: As chair, South Africa will host the annual meeting of the World Wine Trade Group in Cape Town from 1 to 3 November 2017.

src: Die groep het ten doel om internasionale handel in wyn te bevorder deur die uitruil van inligting, bespreking van reguleringskwessies in wynmarkte en gesamentlike optrede om handelsversperrings uit die weg te ruim.
tgt: The group aims to facilitate international trade in wine through information sharing, discussion of regulatory issues in wine markets and joint actions for the removal of trade barriers.

src: Opkomende produsente en uitvoerders in die Suid-Afrikaanse wynbedryf sal deur Suid-Afrika se deelname baat.
tgt: Emerging producers and exports of the South African wine industry benefit from South Africa’s participation.

src: Dit dra ook by tot die Negepuntplan en die NOP, wat beoog om nuwe lewe in die landbou- en landbouverwerkingsketting te blaas.
tgt: This contributes to the Nine-Point Plan and the NDP, which seek to revitalise the agriculture and agro-processing value chain.

src: Die doelwitte in die wynsektor is om die gebied waar wyn geproduseer word uit te brei, kleinprodusente te ondersteun en op bepaalde markte vir uitvoergroei te fokus.
tgt: In the wine sector, the aim is to increase the area under wine production, support smallholder producers and target certain markets for export growth.

src: Vyfde Jaarvergadering van die ID4AFRICA-beweging.
tgt: 5th Annual Meeting of ID4AFRICA Movement.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring dat Suid-Afrika as gasheer vir die Vyfde Jaarvergadering van die ID4AFRICA-beweging in 2019 sal optree.
tgt: Cabinet approved South Africa’s hosting of the 5th Annual Meeting of the ID4Africa Movement in 2019.

src: ID4Africa is ’n multi-belanghebberbeweging wat die deursigtige en verantwoordelike aanvaarding van digitale identiteit om sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling in Afrika te dryf, bevorder.
tgt: ID4Africa is a multi-stakeholder movement that promotes the transparent and responsible adoption of digital identity for driving socio-economic development in Africa.

src: Besprekings sal daarop gerig wees om die manier waarop burgerlike registrasie- en bevolkingsdata ingewin, gekoördineer en ontleed word te verbeter, en daardeur beleidsmakers van betroubare inligting te voorsien.
tgt: Discussions will seek to improve the way civil registration and vital statistics data is collected, coordinated and analysed, making available reliable information to policymakers.

src: Die aanbieding van hierdie konferensie sal Suid-Afrika help om sommige van die doelwitte van die NOP te bereik en bewustheid te skep van die strategiese waarde vir die Suid-Afrikaanse identiteitstelsels soos die vasleggingstelsel van bevolkingstatistiek vir paspoort- en slim identiteitsdokument (ID)-kaarte.
tgt: Hosting this conference will assist South Africa to realise some of the objectives of the NDP and create awareness of the strategic value for the South African identity systems such as the live capture system for passport and smart identity document (ID) cards.

src: Dit sal ook ander lande in die streek positief mobiliseer om die voordele van die slim ID-kaart in te sien.
tgt: It will also positively mobilise other countries in the region to appreciate the benefits of the smart ID card.

src: Nasionale misdaadstatistiek.
tgt: National crime statistics.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die nasionale misdaadstatistiek vir die tydperk 1 April 2016 tot 31 Maart 2017.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the national crime statistics for the period 1 April 2016 to 31 March 2017.

src: Die jaarlikse misdaadstatistiek stel die regering in staat om sleutelmisdaadbestrydingsmikpunte te monitor, wat in die Meiumtermyn- Strategiese Raamwerk 2014-2019 uiteengesit word.
tgt: The annual crime statistics enables government to monitor key crime fighting targets, as set out in the Medium Term Strategic Framework 2014-2019.

src: Die misdaadstatistiek word as ’n vroeë waarskuwingstelsel gebruik om verskillende departemente se misdaadvoorkomingsoefeninge en -strategieë te versterk.
tgt: The crime statistics are used as an early-warning mechanism to strengthen the crime-prevention operations and strategies of various departments.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die vrystelling van die verslag deur die Minister van Polisie, Fikile Mbalula.
tgt: Cabinet has approved the release of the report by the Minister of Police, Mr Fikile Mbalula.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming Events.

src: OR Tambo Eeufeesviering.
tgt: OR Tambo Centenary Celebration.

src: Die Kabinet is verheug dat voorbereidings vir die Eeufeesviering van die geboorte van OR Tambo in ’n gevorderde stadium is.
tgt: Cabinet is pleased that preparations for the centenary celebration of the birth of OR Tambo are at an advanced stage and calls on all South Africans to continually familiarise themselves with the legacy of our Struggle icon, the role he played in our liberation, and his values which still guide us today.

src: Die Kabinet doen voorts ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om hulle deurlopend te vergewis van die nalatenskap van ons vryheidstryd-ikoon, die rol wat hy in ons bevryding gespeel het en sy waardes wat ons vandag nog lei.
tgt: President Zuma declared 2017 the Year of OR Tambo under the theme: “Life and Legacy of OR Tambo” and he will, on Thursday, 19 October 2017, unveil a life-size statue of OR Tambo at the OR Tambo International Airport in Ekurhuleni, Gauteng.

src: President Zuma het 2017 as die Jaar van OR Tambo verklaar, met die tema: “Die Lewe en Nalatenskap van OR Tambo”.
tgt: South Africans are encouraged to join in centenary celebrations, which will culminate on 27 of October in Mbizana, Eastern Cape, which was the birth place of this Struggle icon 100 years ago.

src: Hy sal op Donderdag, 19 Oktober 2017, ’n lewensgrootte standbeeld van OR Tambo by die OR Tambolughawe in Ekurhuleni, Gauteng onthul.
tgt: Government continues to build on OR Tambo’s legacy since 1994, and our many gains as South Africans must be celebrated and defended.

src: Alle Suid-Afrikaners word aangemoedig om deel te neem aan die eeufeesvierings, wat op 27 Oktober ’n hoogtepunt bereik in Mbizana, in die Oos-Kaap, waar hierdie ikoon van die vryheidstryd 100 jaar gelede gebore is.
tgt: The Inter-Ministerial Committee tasked to prepare for the centenary celebrations, chaired by Minister Jeff Radebe, will on Friday, 20 October 2017, brief the media on the state of readiness.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Messages.

src: Somalië-aanval.
tgt: Somalia attack.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel die onlangse bomaanval buite ’n hotel in Mogadishu, Somalië ten sterkste.
tgt: Cabinet strongly condemns the recent bomb attack outside a hotel in Mogadishu, Somalia.

src: Minstens 300 mense het luidens berigte gesterf en honderde is beseer.
tgt: At least 300 people were reportedly killed and hundreds more left injured.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy meegevoel oor aan die geliefdes van diegene wat in die veragtelike aanval op onskuldige mense gesterf het.
tgt: Cabinet expresses condolences to the loved ones of those who perished in the heinous attack on innocent people.

src: Simpatiebetuiging aan die Lubisi-familie.
tgt: Condolences to the Lubisi family.

src: Die Kabinet dra ook sy innige meegevoel oor aan die direkteur-generaal in die Presidensie, Dr Cassius Lubisi, met die heengaan van sy vrou, me Lumka Lubisi, vroeër vandeesmaand.
tgt: Cabinet also expresses its heartfelt condolences to the Director-General in The Presidency, Dr Cassius Lubisi, following the loss of his wife, Ms Lumka Lubisi, earlier this month.

src: Die Kabinet wens die familie sterkte toe tydens hierdie hartseer tydperk.
tgt: Cabinet wishes the family strength during this difficult time of grief.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderworpe aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die toepaslike klaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Adjunk-direkteur-generaal (ADG): Opleidingsbestuur en -lewering, Nasionale Skool van die Regering, MnrS Manana Hoof Finansiële Beampte, Departement van Openbare Werke (DOW), MeR Sadiki Afdelingshoof: Konstruksiebestuur in die DOW, MnrB Mokhothu ADG: Openbare Finansies in die Departement van Nasionale Tesourie, Dr MP Modise ADG: Hospitale, Tersiêre Gesondheidsdienste en Meslike-hulpbronontwikkeling, Departement van Gesondheid, Dr WW Chitha Uitvoerende Direkteur van die Sentrum vir Staatsdiensinnovering, MeTE Rabebe Tussentydse Raad van die Passasierspooragentskap van Suid-Afrika:Advkaat Tintswalo Annah Nana Makhubele (SC) – (Voorsitter)Dr Natalie SkeepersProfJohn Maluleke en MeMagdelene Cheryl Reddy.
tgt: Deputy Director-General (DDG): Training Management and Delivery, National School of Government, Mr S Manana Chief Financial Officer, Department of Public Works (DPW), Ms R Sadiki Divisional Head: Construction Management in the DPW, Mr B Mokhothu DDG: Public Finance in the Department of National Treasury, Dr MP Modise DDG: Hospital Tertiary Health Services and Human Resource Development, Department of Health, Dr WW Chitha Executive Director of the Centre for Public Service Innovation, Ms TE Rabebe Interim Board of the Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa:Advocate Tintswalo Annah Nana Makhubele (SC) – (Chairperson)Dr Natalie SkeepersProfJohn Maluleke andMs Magdelene Cheryl Reddy.

src: Die Kabinet het by Tuynhuys in Kaapstad vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met at Tuynhuys in Cape Town.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Issues in the environment.

src: Meiumtermynbegrotingsbeleidsverklaring (MTBBV) 2017.
tgt: Medium Term Budget Policy Statement (MTBPS) 2017 Cabinet welcomes the MTBPS delivered by the Minister of Finance, Mr Malusi Gigaba, in Parliament, Cape Town, last week.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die MTBBV wat verlede week deur die Minister van Finansies, mnrMalusi Gigaba, in die Parlement in Kaapstad gelewer is.
tgt: The adjustment budget continues to drive inclusive growth and fiscal consolidation whilst protecting and promoting social expenditure in education, health, basic infrastructure and social security, which many fellow South Africans rely on to enjoy a better life.

src: Die aanpassingsbegroting gaan voort om inklusiewe groei en fiskale konsolidasie te dryf, terwyl sosiale besteding aan onderwys, gesondheid, basiese infrastruktuur en maatskaplike sekerheid, waarop baie mede-Suid-Afrikaners vir ’n beter lewe staatmaak, beskerm en bevorder word.
tgt: In a constrained fiscal space, government’s commitment to meet challenges in South Africa is demonstrated by interventions to grow township and rural economies, strengthen good governance at state-owned companies, as well as the additional significant allocation of funding higher education.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om saam te werk om pogings om die ekonomie te groei, te versterk.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to join increased efforts to grow the economy.

src: Arbeidsmagopname.
tgt: Labour Force Survey.

src: Die Kabinet erken met waardering die onlangs vrygestelde Kwartaallikse Arbeidsmagopname vir die derde kwartaal van 2017, wat daarop dui dat werkloosheid sedert die vorige kwartaal onveranderd gebly het teen 27,7%.
tgt: Cabinet appreciates the recently released Quarterly Labour Force Survey for the third quarter of 2017, which showed that unemployment remained unchanged from the previous quarter at 27.7%.

src: ’n Toename van 187 000 werksgeleenthede is gedurende die kwartaal in die formele sektor opgeteken en werksverliese van 71 000 en 25 000 is in onderskeidelik die informele sektor en landbousektor opgeteken.
tgt: The employment gains recorded in the formal sector of 187 000 over the quarter, the informal sector and agriculture sector recorded employment losses of 71 000 and 25 000 respectively.

src: Die regering bly daartoe verbind om alles in sy vermoë te doen om die uitdagings van werkloosheid te beveg en doen ’n beroep op die privaat sektor om hul deel te doen.
tgt: Government remains committed to doing everything possible to deal with the unemployment challenges and calls on the private sector to do their part.

src: Eeufeesviering van Oliver Reginald Tambo.
tgt: Centenary of Oliver Reginald Tambo.

src: Die Kabinet bedank alle Suid-Afrikaners vir hul deelname aan die vryheidsheld, OR Tambo, se eeufeesvierings, wat op Vrydag, 27 Oktober ’n hoogtepunt bereik het by Nkantolo in die Oos-Kaap.
tgt: Cabinet thanks all South Africans for celebrating the centenary of Struggle stalwart OR Tambo, which culminated in celebration on the Friday, 27 October 2017 at Nkantolo Village in the Eastern Cape.

src: As deel van die eeufeesvierings het President Jacob Zuma by ’n aantal verbeteringsprojekte opgetree, insluitend:Die oorhandiging van die Ludeke-dam in Mbizana, wat deur die Departement van Water en Sanitasie as deel van die Groter Mbizana-streeksgrootmaatwatervoorsieningskema gebou is’n Besoek aan die Nyameni-familie in Ludeke Village, waar die president elektrisiteit aangeskakel het as deel van die regering se breër landelike elektrifiseringsprogram in Mbizana en omliggende gebiedeDie verspreiding van fietse aan leerders by die OR Tambo Tegniese Hoërskool, as deel van die Departement van Vervoer se Shova Kalula-program, ter ondersteuning van leerders wat meer as drie kilometer ver skool toe stapDie skenking van rekenaars aan leerders in die Vukuzenzele Spesiale Skool vir leerders met gestremdhede, onder leiding van die Minister van Kommunikasie, Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane.
tgt: As part of the centenary celebrations, President Jacob Zuma officiated over improvement projects, including:The hand-over of the Ludeke Dam in Mbizana, which was built as part of the Greater Mbizana Regional Bulk Water Supply Scheme by the Department of Water and SanitationA visit to the Nyameni family in Ludeke Village where the President switched on electricity, as part of the broader government rural electrification programme in Mbizana and surrounding areasBicycles distributed to learners at OR Tambo Technical High School, as part of the Department of Transport’s Shova Kalula programme, which supports learners who walk more than three kilometres to schoolThe donation of computers to learners in the Vukuzenzele Special School for children with disabilities, led by the Minister of Communications, Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners en gemeenskappe om in vennootskap met wetstoepassingsagentskappe te werk om misdaad te bestry.
tgt: Crime Statistics Cabinet appeals to all South Africans and communities to partner with law-enforcement agencies to combat crime.

src: Die misdaadstatistiek wat onlangs deur die Minister van Polisie, mnrFikile Mbalula, vrygestel is, het aangedui dat daar op sommige terreine vordering met misdaadbestryding gemaak is, maar dat dit op ander gebiede steeds hoog bly.
tgt: The crime statistics released recently by the Minister of Police, Mr Fikile Mbalula, have indicated some areas where we made progress in combating crime and some areas where crime levels remain high.

src: Die Kabinet is oortuig daarvan dat ons almal slegs kan baat as ons saamwerk om veiliger gemeenskappe te skep wat in staat is om te ontwikkel.
tgt: Cabinet is convinced that it is only through working together that we can all benefit from creating safer communities that are able to develop.

src: Die misdaadstatistiek help die regering en die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens om sleutelmikpunte te monitor en dien as ’n vroeë waarskuwingsmeganisme om die misdaadbestrydingsoperasies en strategieë te versterk.
tgt: The crime statistics assist government and the South African Police Service to monitor key targets and serve as an early-warning mechanism to strengthen the crime-prevention operations and strategies.

src: Dit vorm deel van die misdaadvoorkomingstrategie om te verseker dat almal in ons land veilig voel en is.
tgt: It is part of the crime-prevention strategy to ensure that all people in the country are and feel safe.

src: Geslagsgebaseerde geweld (GGG).
tgt: Gender-based violence (GBV).

src: Die Kabinet beklemtoon weereens sy veroordeling van die seksuele misbruik en mishandeling van vroue en kinders, ongeag die beweerde oortreders se posisies in die samelewing.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates its condemnation of the sexual abuse of women and children, irrespective of the alleged perpetrators’ societal positions.

src: Die Kabinet moedig slagoffers aan om hierdie gruwelike misdade aan te meld by wetstoepassingsagentskappe, wat die bewerings van GGG moet ondersoek en daadwerklik binne die omvang van die wet moet optree om te verseker dat geregtigheid geskied.
tgt: Cabinet encourages victims to report these heinous crimes to law-enforcement authorities, who must investigate allegations of GBV and act firmly within the ambit of the law to ensure that justice is served.

src: Die 16-daeveldtog van Aktivisme vir Geen Geweld teen Vroue en Kinders is om die draai en die Kabinet keur vanjaar se tema goed, naamlik “Sluit My In: Saam Beweeg Ons ’n Nie-Gewelddadige Suid-Afrika Vorentoe”.
tgt: The 16 Days of Activism for No Violence Against Women and Children campaign is approaching and Cabinet has approved this year’s theme: “Count me In: Together Moving a Non-Violent South Africa Forward”.

src: Die Kabinet doen ook ’n beroep op landsburgers om mekaar oor die regte van vroue en kinders op te voed, asook oor die onderskeie opsies wat beskikbaar is om slagoffers van geweld te help.
tgt: Cabinet also calls on citizens to educate one another on the rights of women and children, and on the various recourse mechanisms that exist to help victims of violence.

src: Die Veldtog van 16 Dae van Aktivisme het by die Verenigde Nasies (VN) ontstaan, en vind jaarliks vanaf 25 November (Internasionale Dag vir die Uitskakeling van Geweld teen Vroue) tot 10 Desember (Internasionale Meseregtedag) plaas.
tgt: The 16 Days of Activism Campaign is a United Nations (UN) campaign, which takes place annually from 25 November (International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women) to 10 December (International Human Rights Day).

src: Suid-Afrikaners word aangemoedig om aktief by kampvegter- en bewusmakingsprogramme in hul onderskeie gemeenskappe en skole betrokke te raak.
tgt: South Africans are encouraged to actively join advocacy and awareness-raising programmes in their respective communities and sectors.

src: Toerismetransformasieberaad.
tgt: Tourism Transformation Summit.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle belanghebbers om die toerismesektor se transformasie-inisiatiewe te ondersteun, aangesien dit die ekonomie potensieel kan bevoordeel deur die bemagtiging van benadeelde gemeenskappe en die bevordering van werksverskaffing aan te dryf.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all stakeholders to support the tourism sector’s transformation initiatives as it potentially benefits the economy by empowering disadvantaged communities and driving employment growth.

src: Die Departement van Toerisme het op 30 en 31 Oktober 2017 die Nasionale Toerismetransformasieberaad aangebied met die tema: “Toerisme vir Almal: Transformeer, Groei en Handhaaf”.
tgt: The Department of Tourism hosted the National Tourism Transformation Summit on 30 and 31 October 2017 under the theme: “Tourism for All: Transform, Grow and Sustain”, which saw the release of the State of Sector Transformation Report and the launch of the Tourism Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (B-BBEE) Portal and Tourism Transformation Fund.

src: Staatsbesoek deur president Macky Sall van Senegal.
tgt: State Visit by President Macky Sall of Senegal.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die Staatsbesoek deur die President van die Republiek van Senegal, Sy Eksellensie Macky Sall, op 20 Oktober 2017.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the State Visit by the President of the Republic of Senegal, His Excellency Macky Sall on 20 October 2017.

src: Suid-Afrika en Senegal het kritieke streeks- en internasionale vraagstukke bespreek en ooreenkomste oor verskeie kwessies onderteken.
tgt: South Africa and Senegal exchanged views on critical regional and global issues and signed agreements in several areas.

src: Die twee lande het hartlike bilaterale politieke, ekonomiese en sosiale betrekkinge, wat op sterk historiese bande gegrond is en teruggevoer kan word na die jare van die vryheidstryd.
tgt: The two countries enjoy cordial bilateral political, economic and social relations underpinned by strong historical ties dating back to the years of the liberation struggle.

src: Die Ondertekening van die Meorandum van Verstandhouding oor die vestiging van ’n tweelingstadverhouding tussen Robbeneiland (wat deur die rassistiese apartheidsregime gebruik is om vryheidsvegters gevange te hou) en Gorée-eiland (die roete waarlangs Afrikane verskeep is vir ’n lewe van slawerny) versterk ons lande se kulturele en historiese bande nog verder, gepaardgaande met die herdenking van die Dakar-samesprekings in Besoek aan Suid-Afrika deur Indonesiese afvaardiging.
tgt: The signing of a Memorandum of Understanding on the twinning of Robben Island (used by the racist apartheid regime to incarcerate freedom fighters) and Gorée Islands (the route through which African people were shipped out for a life of slavery) further cements our countries’ cultural and historic ties as the 1987 Dakar Talks is commemorated.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die besoek aan Suid-Afrika deur Sultan Husain Abubakar Syah van Tidore in Indonesië.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the visit to South Africa by Sultan Husain Abubakar Syah of Tidore in Indonesia.

src: Die Tidore-afvaardiging het onder andere Muhammad Amin Farouk ingesluit, wat ’n afstammeling is van Tuan Guru, ’n vryheidsvegter wat in 1780 deur die Nederlanders gevange geneem en na Robbeneiland toe gestuur is.
tgt: The Tidore delegation included Muhammad Amin Farouk, a descendant of Tuan Guru, a freedom fighter who was captured by the Dutch and sent to Robben Island in 1780.

src: Tuan Guru (Imam Abdullah ibn Qadi Abdussalam) en drie van sy landgenote is ongeveer 12 jaar lank opgesluit en daarna in ballingskap in die Kaap gehou, waar hy ’n belangrike bydrae tot die ontwikkeling van die plaaslike gemeenskap en die bou van die eerste moskee gelewer het.
tgt: Tuan Guru (Imam Abdullah ibn Qadi Abdussalam) and three of his companions were imprisoned for about 12 years and thereafter kept in exile in the Cape, where he contributed greatly to the development of the local community and the building of the first mosque.

src: ’n Hele aantal Suid-Afrikaners se familiegeskiedenis kan na hom toe nagespeur word.
tgt: A number of South Africans trace their family history to him.

src: Die afvaardiging het die Nasionale Vergadering en die Nasionale Raad van Provinsies besoek, waar hulle deur die voorsittende beamptes, adjunkpresident Cyril Ramaphosa en die Minister van Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling, Ebrahim Patel, verwelkom is.
tgt: The delegation visited the National Assembly and the National Council of Provinces where they were welcomed by the presiding officers, Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa and Economic Development Minister Ebrahim Patel.

src: Die besoek het die aandag gevestig op die gemeenskaplike geskiedenis van koloniale heerskappy en die eeu-oue stryd om nasionale bevryding deur die mense van Indonesië en Suid-Afrika.
tgt: The visit highlighted the common history of colonial rule and the centuries-old fight for national liberation by the people of Indonesia and South Africa.

src: Vandag vier ons handels-, toerisme- en ander ekonomiese bande tussen die twee lande.
tgt: Today we celebrate trade, tourism and other economic links between the two countries.

src: Jaareindeksamens.
tgt: End-of-year examinations.

src: Die Kabinet is tevrede dat die jaareindeksamens wat tans by skole en ander leerinstellings plaasvind, ongehinderd voortgaan.
tgt: Cabinet is satisfied that the end-of-year examinations currently taking place at schools and other learning institutions are going ahead unhindered.

src: Onderwys is een van die sleuteldryfvere om ’n beter toekoms vir almal in die land te verseker.
tgt: Education is one of the key drivers towards a better future for all in the country.

src: Ouers en voogde word sterk aangespoor om leerders in hierdie tydperk steeds al die nodige ondersteuning te bied.
tgt: Parents and guardians are urged to continue to give the necessary support to learners during this period.

src: Die Departement van Basiese Onderwys se inhaalprogramme en ander inisiatiewe het leerders wat gedurende die jaar deur protesoptrede geraak is gehelp, en ’n positiewe uitkoms word verwag.
tgt: The Department of Basic Education’s catch-up programmes and other initiatives have assisted learners affected by protests during the year and a positive outcome is expected.

src: Maatskaplike samehorigheid.
tgt: Social cohesion.

src: Die Kabinet loof die wetstoepassingsagentskappe en die samewerking deur die gemeenskappe wat gehelp het om die skuldigbevinding van Willem Oosthuizen en Theo Jackson te bewerkstellig.
tgt: Cabinet commends the law-enforcement agencies and the collaboration from the communities who helped secure the conviction of Willem Oosthuizen and Theo Jackson.

src: Die twee het Victor Mlotshwa in ’n doodskis ingedwing en gedreig om petrol oor hom uit te gooi.
tgt: The two forced Victor Mlotshwa into a coffin and threatened to pour petrol on him.

src: Die uitspraak toon duidelik dat die Suid-Afrikaanse regstelsels die regte van alle landsburgers beskerm.
tgt: The judgement demonstrates that South African laws are firm in protecting the rights of all citizens.

src: Die Kabinet bevestig verder die reg van alle Suid-Afrikaners om as deel van ons konstitusionele demokrasie aan vreedsame protesoptrede deel te neem.
tgt: Cabinet further affirms the right of all South Africans to engage in peaceful protest as part of our constitutional democracy.

src: Die regte wat in die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996 voorgeskryf word, is egter nie absoluut nie en moet nie op ander mense se demokratiese regte inbreuk maak nie.
tgt: However, rights prescribed in the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996 are not absolute and must not infringe on the democratic rights of others.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel die versperring van openbare paaie, die vertoon van simbole van vorige onderdrukking en die vernietiging van nasionale simbole wat ’n weerspieëling van ons swaarverdiende demokrasie is.
tgt: Cabinet condemns the blocking of public roads, displaying of symbols of past oppression and destruction of national symbols which are a reflection of our hard-earned democracy.

src: Die Kabinet is daartoe verbind om ’n samehorige samelewing vir almal te bou en doen ’n beroep op alle landsburgers om hul deel op ’n verantwoordelike wyse en in die gees van samewerking te doen ten einde ’n verenigde, nierassige, nieseksistiese, demokratiese en welvarende Suid-Afrika te bou.
tgt: Cabinet is committed to its role to build a cohesive society for all and calls on all citizens to play their part responsibly and in the spirit of working together to build a united, non-racist, non-sexist, democratic and prosperous South Africa.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet Decisions.

src: Die Kabinet keur die 2015/16 Verslag oor die Stand van Plaaslike Regering in Suid-Afrika goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the 2015/16 Report on State of Local Government in South Africa.

src: Die verslag bied ’n uiteensetting van die vordering wat met die implementering van die Back to Basics (B2B) -program gemaak is.
tgt: The report outlines progress made in implementing the Back to Basics (B2B) Programme, a plan of action to ensure delivery of basic services, good governance and sound financial management.

src: Dit is ’n plan van aksie om die lewering van basiese dienste, goeie staatsbestuur en gesonde finansiële bestuur te verseker.
tgt: The report highlights areas of challenges and provides a base for the implementation of the second phase of the B2B Programme.

src: Die verslag sal aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: The report will be tabled to Parliament.

src: Die Kabinet ondersteun die voorgestelde wysigings aan die drie B-BBEE-sektorkodes.
tgt: Cabinet supported the proposed amendments of the three B-BBEE Sector Codes.

src: Die wysigings het betrekking op sektoruitdagings en kenmerkende eienskappe van transformasie wat andersins nie ten volle deur die generiese kodes geraak sal word nie.
tgt: The amendments address sector challenges and peculiarities on transformation that would otherwise not be addressed fully by the generic codes.

src: Die drie sektore is Landbou, Finansies en Konstruksie.
tgt: The three sectors are in Agriculture, Finance and Construction.

src: Die voorgestelde wysigings is met die tersaaklike belanghebbers bespreek.
tgt: The proposed amendments have been canvassed with the relevant stakeholders.

src: Al die gewysigde sektorkodes sal in die Staatskoerant aangekondig word.
tgt: All the amended sector codes will be gazetted.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die Nasionale e-Strategie en die publikasie daarvan in die Staatskoerant.
tgt: Cabinet approved the National e-Strategy and its publication in the Government Gazette.

src: Dit is in April 2017 vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer.
tgt: It was published in April 2017 for public comments.

src: Die e-strategie verwoord ’n gedeelde visie en paradigmaverskuiwing vanaf ’n inligtingsamelewing na ’n kennisekonomie en -samelewing.
tgt: The e-strategy articulates a shared vision and paradigm shift from information society to a knowledge economy and WEBTOKEN addresses challenges, including a digital divide between the rich and poor, between racial groups, different geographical locations and gender WEBTOKEN provides a platform for South Africans to integrate technology, which is relevant and related towards advancing development and economic prosperity for the benefit of society as a whole.

src: Die Departement van Telekommunikasie en Posdienste sal meer inligting oor hierdie strategie voorsien.
tgt: The Department of Telecommunications and Postal Services will provide more information on this strategy.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Nasionale e-Regeringstrategie en Padkaart in die Staatskoerant gepubliseer word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the National e-Government Strategy and Roadmap, to be published in the Government Gazette.

src: Dit sal deur die ontginning van digitale tegnologieë digitale transformasie na die openbare dienste bring en die voorsiening van beter gehalte dienste moontlik maak.
tgt: It will bring digital transformation to the public services and enable the provision of improved quality of services whilst tapping into digital technologies.

src: Die strategie is toegespits op onder meer die fragmentasie van e-regeringsinisiatiewe en duplisering van prosesse, databasisse, grootskaalse stelselonverenigbaarheid en ondoeltreffendhede.
tgt: The strategy targets, amongst others, fragmentation of e-government initiatives and duplication of processes, databases, large-scale system incompatibilities and inefficiencies.

src: Dit sal ook die gebruik van inligting-en-kommunikasietegnologie (IKT) uitbrei, en innovering in tegnologieë en toepassings vir e-Regering bevorder.
tgt: It will also increase the usage of information and communications technology (ICTs), foster innovation in technologies and applications for e-Government.

src: Die Kabinet keur die Ontwikkelingstrategie vir Klein-, Meium- en Mikrogrootteondernemings (KMMO’s) in die IKT-sektor goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the ICT Small, Medium and Micro-sized Enterprises (SMME) Development Strategy.

src: Dit is ’n sektorspesifieke ingryping om die uitdagings te pak waarvoor KMMO’s wat in die IKT-sektor sake doen, te staan kom.
tgt: This is a sector-specific intervention to address challenges facing SMMEs operating in the ICT sector.

src: Die strategie doen ingrypings aan die hand om die ontwikkeling en groei van klein sakeondernemings in die IKT-sektor te versnel, en terselfdertyd die opname en gebruik van IKT’s deur die algemene kleinsakesektor te bevorder.
tgt: The strategy proposes interventions to accelerate the development and growth of small enterprises in the ICT sector, while facilitating an increase in the levels of uptake and usage of ICTs by the general small business sector.

src: Die strategie beoog om beginner-IKT-ondernemings te ondersteun, bestaande ondernemings te versterk en ondersteuning na potensieel lewensvatbare KMMO’s uit te brei.
tgt: The strategy aims to support start-up ICT enterprises, strengthen existing enterprises and extend support to potentially viable SMMEs.

src: Die Kabinet keur die publikasie van die Verslag oor die Evaluering van die Nasionale Skoolvoedingsprogram goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the publication of the Report on the Evaluation of the National School Nutrition Programme.

src: Dit is ’n regeringsprogram met ’n jaarlikse begroting van R5,5 miljard, waardeur nege miljoen kinders uit arm gemeenskappe daagliks ’n voedsame maaltyd by die skool ontvang.
tgt: This a government programme with an annual budget of R.5 billion resulting in nine million children from poor communities receiving a daily nutritious meal at school.

src: Die verslag bied inligting oor areas van doeltreffende implementering asook areas waarop verbeter kan word.
tgt: The report provides areas of effective implementation and some areas that need improvement.

src: Die verslag sal op die webtuiste van die Departement van Beplanning, Monitering en Evaluering (WEBTOKEN) beskikbaar gestel word.
tgt: The report will be made available on the website of the Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation (WEBTOKEN).

src: Die Kabinet ondersteun Suid-Afrika se kandidatuur vir herverkiesing tot die tweejaarlidmaatskap van die Raad van die Internasionale Maritieme Organisasie (IMO).
tgt: Cabinet supports South Africa’s standing for re-election to the two-year membership of the International Maritime Organisation (IMO) Council.

src: Hierdie verkiesing sal tydens die 30ste Gereelde Sitting van die Vergadering vanaf 27 November tot 6 Desember 2017 in Londen, Verenigde Koninkryk, gehou word.
tgt: These elections will be held during the 30th Regular Session of the Assembly from 27 November to 6 December 2017 in London, United Kingdom.

src: Suid-Afrika is ’n maritieme nasie met nagenoeg 80% van ons internasionale handel wat per see geskied.
tgt: South Africa is a maritime nation with close to 80% of international trade done by sea.

src: Suid-Afrika se lidmaatskap in die IMO-raad dra by tot groter werkskepping wat voortspruit uit Operasie Phakisa: Oseaan-ekonomie.
tgt: South Africa’s membership in the IMO Council contributes to employment growth derived from the Operation Phakisa: Oceans Economy.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysiging aan die Montreal-protokol oor Stowwe wat die Osoonlaag beskadig om ook hidrofluoorkoolstof (HFK’s) in te sluit, aan die Parlement voorgelê en bekragtig word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the introduction to Parliament the ratification of the Amendment to the Montreal Protocol on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer to include hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs).

src: Hierdie wysigings is gerig op die uitfasering van HFK’s (die Kigali-ooreenkoms), wat sommige van die kweekhuisgasse is wat tot die beskadiging van die osoonlaag lei.
tgt: The amendment seeks to phase down HFCs (the Kigali Agreement), which are some of the greenhouse gasses contributing to the depletion of the ozone layer.

src: Suid-Afrika is reeds ’n ondertekenaar van die Montreal-protokol.
tgt: South Africa is already a signatory to the Montreal Protocol.

src: Die Kabinet keur ook goed dat die bekragtiging van die Minamata-konvensie oor Kwik aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet also approved the introduction into Parliament the ratification of the Minamata Convention on Mercury.

src: Dit bied geleenthede vir die beskerming van kwesbare groepe teen die skadelike uitwerkings van kwik op die omgewing en menslike gesondheid, veral vir diegene wat in gebiede woon waar mynboubedrywighede voorkom.
tgt: It provides opportunities for the protection of vulnerable groups, especially those staying in areas where there is mining activity, against the adverse consequences of mercury on the environment and human health.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die Verslag van die Kommissie van Ondersoek na Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding in die Republiek van Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the Report of the Commission of Inquiry into Higher Education and Training in the Republic of South Africa.

src: Die Presidensiële Fiskale Komitee sal binnekort vergader om die finansiële implikasies hiervan te ondersoek.
tgt: The Presidential Fiscal Committee will sit soon to interrogate financial implications.

src: Die Departement van Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding sal die tersaaklike beleide en wetgewing hersien, waar nodig.
tgt: The Department of Higher Education and Training will have to review relevant policies and legislation, where necessary.

src: President Zuma sal die verslag binnekort aan die publiek vrystel en die President se woordvoerder, dr Bongani Ngqulunga, sal ’n aankondiging oor dié aangeleentheid maak.
tgt: President Zuma will release the report to the public soon and the President’s spokesperson, Dr Bongani Ngqulunga, will make an announcement regarding this matter.

src: Wetsontwerpe.
tgt: Bills.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die Wetsontwerp op die Nasionale Minimumloon, wat die minimumloon aan die laags besoldigde werkers in die Suid-Afrikaanse arbeidsmark ten uitvoer bring.
tgt: Cabinet approved the National Minimum Wage Bill effecting the minimum wage to the lowest paid workers in the South African Labour Market.

src: Die Wetsontwerp vereis dat elke werker ’n loon betaal word wat nie minder as die nasionale minimumloon is nie, welke minimumloon jaarliks aangepas sal word.
tgt: The Bill calls for every worker to be paid a wage that is no less than the national minimum wage.

src: Die Kabinet keur ook goed dat die Wysigingswet op Basiese Diensvoorwaardes van 2017 aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Once this Bill takes effect employers will be expected to pay their workers no less than the national minimum, which is to be adjusted annually.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswet op Arbeidsverhoudinge van 2017 aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet also approved the submission to Parliament of the Basic Conditions of Employment Amendment Bill of 2017.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp: Munisipale Strukture van 2017 aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission to Parliament of the Labour Relations Amendment Bill of 2017.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wetsontwerp op Elektroniese Akteregistrasiestelsels van 2017 aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission to Parliament of the Local Government: Municipal Structures Amendment Bill of 2017.

src: Dit maak voorsiening vir die ontwikkeling van ’n elektroniese akteregistrasiestelsel (e-DRS) vir die verwerking van aktes, met die oog op die registrasie van groot volumes aktes wat deur die regering se grondhervormingsinisiatiewe genoodsaak word.
tgt: The Bill has already gone through public WEBTOKEN allows for the development of an electronic deeds registration system (e-DRS), for the processing of deeds, to effect the registration of large volumes of deeds as necessitated by Governments’ land reform initiatives.

src: As deel van die gebruik van IKT’s om ’n inklusiewe ekonomie te bou, keur die Kabinet goed dat die Wetsontwerp op die iKamva Nasionale e-Vaardigheidsinstelling van 2017 (iNeSI-wetsontwerp) in die Staatskoerant gepubliseer word vir openbare raadpleging en kommentaar.
tgt: As part of promoting the use of ICTs to build an inclusive economy, Cabinet approved the iKamva National e-Skills Institute Bill of 2017 (iNeSI Bill) to be gazetted for public consultation and comment.

src: Die iNeSI-wetsontwerp maak voorsiening vir die instelling van iNeSI as ’n openbare entiteit met sy eie magtigingswetgewing, om die e-vaardigheidstekort wat belegging, sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling en kapasiteitsontwikkeling in die land belemmer, te help uitwis.
tgt: The iNeSI Bill provides for the establishment of iNeSI as a public entity with its own enabling legislation, to address the e-skills shortage that hinders investment, socio-economic development and capacity development in the country.

src: Dit sal IKT-produksiekerns in elke provinsie vestig, wat iNeSI sal help om toepaslike programme en opleidingsmateriaal te ontwikkel en ontwerp, innoverende navorsing te bevorder en onderneem, en navorsingskapasiteit aan nagraadse studente te voorsien.
tgt: This will establish ICT production hubs in each province, which will then assist iNeSI to develop and design relevant programs and training material, promote and undertake innovative research, and provide research capacity to postgraduate students.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Posdienste in die Staatskoerant vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the publication of the Postal Services Amendment Bill in the Government Gazette for public comment.

src: Dit wysig die Wysigingswet op Posdienste No 124 van 1998.Die Wetsontwerp maak voorsiening vir die herstrukturering van die posdienssektor in die algemeen om by te dra tot die voorsiening van universele toegang tot innoverende e-dienste, terwyl dit steeds veilige tradisionele posdienste van hoë gehalte voorsien.
tgt: 124 of 1998.The Bill provides for the restructuring of the postal sector in general to contribute to the provisions of universal access to innovative e-services while continuing to provide quality and secure traditional postal services.

src: Dit dra by tot gelykheid en menswaardigheid deur middel van toegang tot inligting en bekostigbare posdienste, wat maatskaplike ontwikkeling bevorder en individue en gemeenskappe se lewensgehalte verhoog.
tgt: This contributes to equality and human dignity through access to information and affordable postal services, which facilitate social development and improve the quality of life for individuals and communities.

src: Toekomstige GebeureDie Kabinet erken ook enkele van die komende gebeure op die regering se kalender.
tgt: Upcoming eventsCabinet also acknowledged some of the upcoming events in the government calendar.

src: Presidensiële Siyahlola-moniteringsprogram.
tgt: Presidential Siyahlola Monitoring Programme.

src: President Zuma gaan op Vrydag, 3 November 2017 die Steve Biko Akademiese Hospitaal in Tshwane besoek om as deel van die Presidensiële Siyahlola-moniteringsprogram die lewering van gesondheidsorg daar te monitor.
tgt: President Zuma is scheduled to visit the Steve Biko Academic Hospital in Tshwane on Friday, 3 November 2017 to monitor the delivery of healthcare services as part of the Presidential Siyahlola Monitoring Programme.

src: Dit is vernoem na Steve Bantu Biko, die ontslape held van die vryheidstryd en voormalige mediese student aan die destydse Universiteit van Natal (tans die Universiteit van KwaZulu-Natal).President Zuma se besoek vorm deel van die voortgesette regeringsmoniteringsprogram wat daarop gerig is om die uitdagings wat openbare hospitale in die gesig staar te pak en om die land se gesondheidsorgstelsel, wat een van die regering se sleutelprioriteite is, te verbeter.
tgt: The hospital is one of the best performing public hospitals in the country and is named after Steve Bantu Biko, the late liberation struggle hero and former medical student at the then University of Natal (now called University of KwaZulu-Natal).President Zuma’s visit is part of the ongoing government monitoring programme that aims to address challenges facing public hospitals and to improve the healthcare system in the country, which is one of government’s key priorities.

src: Nasionale Maand van Bewustheid van Gestremdes se Regte.
tgt: National Disability Rights Awareness Month.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om die Nasionale Maand van Bewustheid van Gestremdes se Regte tussen 3 November en 3 Desember 2017 te steun.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to support National Disability Rights Awareness Month between 3 November and 3 December 2017, which also coincides with the International Day of Persons with Disabilities.

src: Suid-Afrikaners word aangemoedig om bewustheid te verhoog, die regte van mense met gestremdhede te beskerm, en ook erkenning te gee aan die vordering wat reeds gemaak is om mense met gestremdhede se uitdagings die hoof te bied.
tgt: South Africans are encouraged to raise awareness and protect the rights of people with disabilities, while recognising the gains that have been made to address challenges faced by people with disabilities.

src: Nasionale Kongres oor Plaaslike Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling.
tgt: National Local Economic Development Conference.

src: Die Departement van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake en die Departement van Kleinsakeontwikkeling sal op 9 en 10 November 2017 die eerste Nasionale Kongres oor Plaaslike Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling in Gauteng belê.
tgt: The Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs and Department of Small Business Development will convene the first National Local Economic Development Conference on 9 and 10 November 2017 in Gauteng.

src: Die konferensie is ’n strategiese platform vir dialoog tussen die openbare en privaat sektor oor aktuele en kritieke vraagstukke rakende die stimulering van plaaslike ekonomieë deur ’n bemagtigende omgewing te skep om inklusiewe ekonomiese ontwikkeling te bevorder.
tgt: The conference is a strategic platform for dialogue between public and private sector on topical and critical issues relating to stimulating local economies by creating an enabling environment to achieve inclusive economic development.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Messages.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die aankondiging dat meer as een miljard Amerikaanse dollar oor die volgende paar maande in die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie in tegnologie, onderwys en agri-ondernemings belê gaan word.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the announcement of over one billion US dollar to be invested over several months in the South African Economy in technology, education and agribusiness.

src: Die aankondiging is deur Ambassadeur Harold Doley Jr, die Goewerneur van die Afrika-ontwikkelingsbank gemaak.
tgt: This was announced by Ambassador Harold Doley, Jr, the Governor of the African Development Bank.

src: Die Kabinet wens dr Nono Simelela geluk met haar aanstelling as die Wêreldgesondheidsorganisasie (WGO) se Assistentdirekteur-generaal.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates Dr Nono Simelela on her appointment as World Health Organisation (WHO) Assistant Director-General.

src: Dr Simelela sal vanaf 13 November 2017 aan die hoof staan van die WGO se Afdeling vir Gesinne, Vroue, Kinders en Adolessente.
tgt: Dr Simelela will head the WHO Family, Women, Children and Adolescents Division from 13 November 2017.

src: Sy was die eerste swart vrou in Suid-Afrika wat as ’n ginekoloog gekwalifiseer het.
tgt: She is the first African woman to become a gynaecologist in South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die aankondiging dat Wêreldrugby Suid-Afrika as die voorkeurgasheerland vir die 2023 Rugbywêreldbekertoernooi aanbeveel het.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the announcement by World Rugby that has recommended South Africa as the preferred country to host the 2023 Rugby World Cup tournament.

src: Die Kabinet loof ook die werk van die Minister van Sport en Ontspanning, mnrThulas Nxesi, adjunkpresident Ramaphosa en die Suid-Afrikaanse Rugby-unie se bodspan.
tgt: Cabinet also commends the work of the Minister of Sport and Recreation, Mr Thulas Nxesi, Deputy President Ramaphosa and the South African Rugby Union bid team.

src: Wêreldrugby sal die finale besluit op 15 November 2017 aankondig.
tgt: World Rugby will announce the final decision on 15 November 2017.

src: Die Kabinet wens al die deelnemers en wenners van die 15de Jaarlikse Toekennings vir Innovering in die Openbare Sektor geluk.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates all participants and winners of the 15th Annual Public Sector Innovation Awards.

src: Hierdie toekennings gee erkenning aan suksesvolle en doeltreffende diensleweringsinisiatiewe wat deur die toepassing van innoverende benaderings, metodologieë en instrumente bereik is.
tgt: These awards recognise successful and effective service-delivery initiatives that have been achieved through the application of innovative approaches, methodologies and tools.

src: Die Kabinet wens SuperSport United FC geluk dat hulle tot die finaal van die CAF-konfederasiebeker deurgedring het deur die Tunisiese Club Africain met altesaam 3-1 en 4-2 te verslaan.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates SuperSport United FC for reaching the finals of the CAF Confederation Cup after beating Tunisian side Club Africa 3-1 and 4-2 on aggregate.

src: Die span, wat algemeen as Matsatsantsa bekend staan, sal volgende maand teen TP Mazembe te staan kom in die einstryd van die tweedevlak kontinentale klubkompetisie.
tgt: The team generally known as Matsatsantsa will meet TP Mazembe in the second-tier continental club competition final next month.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy medelye met die familie en vriende van Ian McLeod, wie se heengaan ’n verlies vir Suid-Afrikaanse sokker is.
tgt: Cabinet expressed its condolences to the family and friends of Ian McLeod, whose passing was a loss to South African football.

src: Hy was die eerste Suid-Afrikaner wat by ’n FIFA Wêreldbekertoernooi as skeidsregter opgetree het toe hy in 1998 in Frankryk in dié internasionale skouspel diens gedoen het.
tgt: He became the first South African to referee at a FIFA World Cup tournament, when he officiated in the 1998 global showpiece in France.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderworpe aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die toepaslike klaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Direkteure op die Direksie van die Uitvoerkredietversekeringskorporasie van Suid-Afrika SOC Beperk:a. MeLerato Herriette Mothae enb.
tgt: Directors to the Board of the Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa SOC Limited:a. Ms Lerato Herriette Mothae andb.

src: MeSisa Mayekiso.
tgt: Ms Sisa Mayekiso.

src: Voltydse lede van die Nasionale Verbruikerstribunaal:a. MeHazel Viloshni Devraj enb.
tgt: Full-time members to the National Consumer Tribunal:a. Ms Hazel Viloshni Devraj andb.

src: AdvJohn Rinton Simpson.
tgt: Adv John Rinton Simpson.

src: Heraanstelling van twee deeltydse lede van die Meedingingstribunaal:a. ProfImraan Valodia enb.
tgt: Reappointment of two part-time members of the Competition Tribunal:a. ProfImraan Valodia andb.

src: MnrAnton Roskan.
tgt: Mr Anton Roskan.

src: Direksie van die Raad op Geesteswetenskaplike Navorsing:a. ProfMvuyo Tom (Voorsitter)b. ProfLindiwe Zunguc.
tgt: Board of the Human Sciences Research Council:a. ProfMvuyo Tom – (Chairperson)b. ProfLindiwe Zunguc.

src: MeNasima Badshad.
tgt: Ms Nasima Badshad.

src: ProfRelebohile Moletsanee.
tgt: ProfRelebohile Moletsanee.

src: ProfHaroon Bhoratf.
tgt: ProfHaroon Bhoratf.

src: ProfShireen Hassimg.
tgt: ProfShireen Hassimg.

src: MePrecious Nompumelelo Sibiyah.
tgt: Ms Precious Nompumelelo Sibiyah.

src: ProfMark Bussaini.
tgt: ProfMark Bussaini.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 15 November 2017 by Tuynhuys in Kaapstad vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 15 November 2017 at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.

src: Kwessies in die Omgewing.
tgt: Issues in the environment.

src: Belegging.
tgt: Investment.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die Ford-motormaatskappy se R3-miljard-belegging in hul Silverton-aanleg in Pretoria, Gauteng.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes Ford Motor Company’s R3-billion investment into the Silverton Plant, Pretoria, Gauteng.

src: Hierdie belegging sal lei tot die skepping van direkte en indirekte werksgeleenthede weens die verwagte toename in produksie van die Ford Ranger-model.
tgt: This investment will result in the creation of direct and indirect jobs due to the expected increased production of its Ford Ranger model.

src: Sulke beleggings bevestig die werk wat die regering steeds doen om die ekonomie te laat groei en die uitdagings van werkloosheid die hoof te bied.
tgt: Such investments affirm the work that we continue to do as government in growing the economy and addressing the challenges of unemployment.

src: Deur die regering se R7,8-miljard-aansporingskema in die Motorproduksie- en Ontwikkelingsprogram is R28,5 miljard se privaat beleggings ontsluit.
tgt: Through government’s R.8 billion incentive scheme in Automotive Production and Development Programme, R.5 billion private investments have been unlocked.

src: Dit sluit Toyota se aankondiging in dat hulle hul nuwe Toyota Hilux- en Fortuner-modelle gaan vervaardig as deel van ’n R6,1-miljard-belegging.
tgt: These include the announcement by Toyota to manufacture their new Toyota Hilux and Fortuner models as part of R.1billion investment.

src: Hierbenewens beplan BMW ’n R6-miljard ultramoderne paneelklopwerkswinkel.
tgt: Also, BMW plans to construct a R6 billion state-of-the-art body shop.

src: Die Beijing Internasionale Outomobielkorporasie beplan ook ’n R11 miljard-belegging in ’n motorvervaardigingsaanleg in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: The Beijing Automobile International Corporation plans to invest R11 billion in an automotive manufacturing plant in South Africa.

src: 2017-belastingseisoen.
tgt: 2017 Tax Season.

src: Die Kabinet bedank alle belastingbetalers wat reeds hul belastingopgawes vir die 2016/17-belastingjaar ingedien het.
tgt: Cabinet extends its gratitude to all taxpayers who have already submitted their tax returns for the 2016/17 tax year.

src: Die inkomste wat deur inkomstebelasting gegenereer word, verseker dat die regering die nodige kapasiteit het om broodnodige dienste en maatskaplike bystand aan miljoene minder bevoorregte Suid-Afrikaners te bied.
tgt: The revenue generated from income tax ensures government has the capacity to provide much-needed services and social support to millions of less fortunate South Africans.

src: Die Kabinet herinner belastingbetalers daaraan dat die sperdatum vir die indiening van opgawes Vrydag 24 November 2017 is, en moedig almal aan om hul belastingopgawes betyds in te dien.
tgt: Cabinet reminds taxpayers that the deadline for submission is Friday 24 November 2017 and encourages them to submit their tax returns.

src: Stigtingskonferensie van die Nasionale Plaaslike Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling (PEO).
tgt: Inaugural National Local Economic Development (LED) Conference.

src: Die Kabinet is tevrede met die resultate van die onlangse Nasionale PEO-konferensie.
tgt: Cabinet is pleased with the outcomes of the recently held National LED Conference.

src: Dit is onder leiding van die Minister van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake, mnrDes van Rooyen, en die Minister van Kleinsake-ontwikkeling, me Lindiwe Zulu, gehou.
tgt: It was held under the leadership of the Minister of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, Mr Des van Rooyen and the Minister of Small Business Development, Ms Lindiwe Zulu.

src: Die konferensie het ’n geleentheid gebied om ’n nuwe agenda vir plaaslike ekonomiese ontwikkeling op te stel, met inagneming van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP) se prioriteite.
tgt: It presented an opportunity to craft a new South African Local Economic Development agenda guided by the National Development Plan (NDP) priorities.

src: Resultate van die konferensie sluit die bekendstelling van die eerste Ekonomiese Ontwikkelingsraad van Suid-Afrika (EDCSA) in, wat daarop gemik is om die ekonomiese ontwikkelingsektor te professionaliseer.
tgt: Its outcomes included the launch of the first Economic Development Council of South Africa (EDCSA), which aims to professionalise the economic development sector.

src: As ’n professionele liggaam, sal EDCSA die professionele optrede van die talle deelnemers aan verskillende ontwikkelingsinisiatiewe bestuur en moniteer.
tgt: As a professional body, the EDCSA will manage and monitor the professional conduct of the many practitioners who participate in the different development initiatives.

src: Die Kabinet neem ook kennis van die historiese bekendstelling van die Globale Entrepreneurskap-week (GEW) by die nuwe kampus vir beginnersondernemings, te 22 on Sloane, op 10 November 2017, waartydens Minister Zulu die welbekende entrepreneur, Sir Richard Branson ontvang het.
tgt: Cabinet noted also the historic launch of the Global Entrepreneurship Week (GEW) at 22 on Sloane, a new start-up campus, on the 10th of November 2017, in which the Minister of Small Business Development, Ms Lindiwe Zulu, hosted World entrepreneurship luminary, Sir Richard Branson.

src: Die kampus is die eerste wat deur die Globale Entrepreneurskap-netwerk geopen word.
tgt: The campus is the first one opened by the Global Entrepreneurship Network – offering direct and virtual support services to entrepreneurs throughout Africa as well as access to an international network of mentors, investors and entrepreneurial support organisations.

src: Dit bied direkte en virtuele ondersteuningsdienste aan entrepreneurs regoor Afrika, asook toegang tot ’n internasionale netwerk van mentors, beleggers en organisasies wat nuwe ondernemings ondersteun.
tgt: During Global Entrepreneurship Week, roughly 10 million participants take part in 35,000 events, activities and competitions in more than 165 countries around the world.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die verslag van die Kommissie van Ondersoek na die Uitvoerbaarheid van Gratis Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding in Suid-Afrika, wat op Maandag 13 November 2017 vrygestel is.
tgt: Heher Commission Report.1 Cabinet noted the release on Monday, 13 November 2017 of the Report of the Commission of Inquiry into the Feasibility of making High Education and Training Fee-free in South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om die verslag en sy implikasies vir die land te bestudeer, terwyl die regering die aanbevelings oorweeg.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to study the report and its implications for the country while the recommendations are being considered by government.2 The President will make a pronouncement on the report in due course after processing by the Inter-Ministerial Committee on Higher Education Funding and the Presidential Fiscal Committee.

src: Die President sal weldra ’n aankondiging maak oor die verslag, nadat dit deur die Inter-ministeriële Komitee oor Hoër Onderwysbefondsing en die Presidensiële Fiskale Komitee bespreek is.
tgt: Government remains determined to resolve the barriers to access higher education, and looks forward to concluding a sustainable solution for higher education funding.

src: Droogte.
tgt: Drought.

src: Die huidige watervlakke van die land se damme bly kommerwekkend, aangesien daar meer verdamping plaasvind as reënval.
tgt: The current dam levels in the country remain a concern as there is more evaporation than rainfall.

src: Die feit dat Suid-Afrika nie genoeg reën gekry het om die land se waterbronne voldoende aan te vul nie, beteken dat die droogtesituasie voortduur.
tgt: The fact that South Africa has not received sufficient rainfall to recharge our water sources to adequate levels means that the country is not yet out of the drought situation.

src: Voorspellings dui daarop dat dit eers vanaf Januarie 2018 behoorlike sal begin reën.
tgt: Forecasts predict that the country will only receive its major rainfall from the beginning of January 2018.

src: Die Kabinet wil die publiek verseker dat die nasionale, provinsiale en plaaslike regerings saamwerk om seker te maak dat Suid-Afrika se water nie opraak nie.
tgt: Cabinet wishes to assure the public that national, provincial and local government are cooperating and working together to ensure South Africa does not run out of water.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n ernstige beroep op almal in die land om hul deel te doen om water te bespaar en om dit oordeelkundig en spaarsamig te gebruik.
tgt: Cabinet encourages everyone to play their part in saving and using water wisely and sparingly.

src: Die Kabinet ondersteun President Jacob Zuma se tussentrede in sy hoedanigheid as Voorsitter van die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap (SAOG) in reaksie op die situasie in Zimbabwe.
tgt: Zimbabwe.1 Cabinet supports the intervention by President Jacob Zuma, in his capacity as Chair of SADC in response to the Zimbabwean situation.

src: Hy het spesiale gesante, die Minister van Verdediging en Militêre Veterane, me Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, en die Minister van Staatsveiligheid, adv Bongani Bongo afgevaardig.
tgt: He has sent Special Envoys, Minister of Defence and Military Veterans Ms Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula and State Security Minister, Adv Bongani Bongo.

src: Hulle sal samesprekings voer met President Robert Mugabe en Zimbabwe se Weermag.
tgt: They are to meet with President Robert Mugabe and the Zimbabwean Defence Force.

src: Daarna sal hulle Angola se President João Lourenço in sy hoedanigheid as Voorsitter van die SAOG se Orgaan vir Politiek, Verdediging en Veiligheid inlig.
tgt: Thereafter proceed to brief President João Lourenço as the Chairperson of the SADC Organ on Politics, Defence and Security.

src: Die Presidensie sal die vordering wat in dié verband gemaak word mettertyd kommunikeer.
tgt: Further updates on this matter will be communicated by the Presidency.

src: Vierkante Kilometer Reeks (SKA).
tgt: Square Kilometre Array (SKA).

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die ekonomiese en sosiale ontwikkelingsprestasies wat voortspruit uit die gefokusde belegging in maatskaplike ontwikkeling in die omgewing van die SKA Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the economic and social development achievements derived from the focused investment in social development in the region of the SKA South Africa.

src: Gemeenskappe rondom die SKA-omgewing baat steeds deur beter onderwys- en opleidingsprojekte, belegging in klein ondernemings en toenemende werksgeleenthede.
tgt: Communities neighbouring the SKA area continue to benefit through better education and training projects, investment in small businesses and increased job opportunities.

src: Die Departement van Wetenskap en Tegnologie, onder leiding van die Minister van Wetenskap en Tegnologie, me Naledi Pandor, sal ’n openbaredeelnameprogram vanaf 16 tot 19 November 2017 aanbied om dié prestasies saam met die gemeenskappe rondom Carnarvon in die Noord-Kaap te vier.
tgt: The Department of Science and Technology, under the leadership of the Minister of Science and Technology, Ms Naledi Pandor, will hold a public-participation programme to celebrate achievements with the communities around Carnarvon, Northern Cape from 16 to 19 November 2017.Cabinet decisions.

src: Tweede kwartaallikse prestasie-vorderingsverslae vir 2017/1.
tgt: Second performance quarterly progress reports for 2017/1.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die tweede kwartaallikse prestasie-vorderingsverslag vir 2017/18 (Julie tot September 2017) deur al vyf die regeringsgroeperings.
tgt: Cabinet was apprised on the second performance quarterly progress reports for 2017/18 (July to September 2017) by all the five clusters.

src: Dit maak deel uit van die Kabinet se breë monitering en evaluering van die Program van Aksie, wat uit die Meiumtermyn- Strategiese Raamwerk (MTSF) 2014 tot 2019 voortspruit.
tgt: This forms part of Cabinet’s broad monitoring and evaluation of the Programme of Action derived from the Medium Term Strategic Framework (MTSF) 2014 to 2019.

src: Die Departement van Beplanning, Monitering en Evaluering en die Ministeriële Groeperingkomitees sal media-inligtingsessies hou om hierdie verslae se vordering te bespreek.
tgt: The Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation and the Ministerial Cluster Committees will conduct media briefings to unpack the progress of these reports.

src: Die GCIS sal die media-inligtingsessies koördineer en die skedule mettertyd op WEBTOKEN publiseer.
tgt: The GCIS will coordinate the media briefings and publish the schedule on WEBTOKEN in due course.

src: Opdatering van adres-insamelingsinisiatief en toewysing van adresse.
tgt: Update on address harvesting initiative and assignment of addresses.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die vorderingsverslag ten opsigte van die implementering van die Konstitusionele Hof se uitspraak dat adresse aan die kieserslys toegewys moet word.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the progress report on the implementation of the Constitutional Court Judgement to assign addresses to the voters roll.

src: Die Kabinet waardeer die volle nakoming van die sesmaandelikse vorderingsverslae wat by die Konstitusionele Hof ingedien is.
tgt: Cabinet appreciated the full compliance with the six monthly progress reports submitted to the Constitutional Court.

src: Tot op hede het die Onafhanklike Verkiesingskommissie (OVK), in samewerking met staatsagentskappe, byna 75% sukses behaal met die insameling van potensiële kiesers se adresse.
tgt: To date the Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), working with other state agencies has attained almost 75% success in collecting the addresses of potential voters.

src: Die Kabinet is ook ingelig oor SAPO se plan om diegene wat nie fisiese adresse het nie, by te staan.
tgt: Cabinet was also briefed on the planned programme by the SAPO to assist those who do not have physical addresses.

src: Die Kabinet is tevrede met die vordering wat gemaak is en die samewerking deur SAPO, die OVK en ander staatsagentskappe met die toewysing van adresse.
tgt: Cabinet is pleased with the progress and the collaborative work conducted by SAPO, the IEC and other state agencies on the assignment of addresses project.

src: Die Kabinet doen verder ’n beroep op diegene wat nog nie hul adresse op datum gebring het nie om dit tydens die volgende kiesersregistrasieweek in Maart 2018 te doen.
tgt: Cabinet further calls on those who have not updated their addresses to do so during the next voter registration week in March 2018.Upcoming events.

src: Vierde sessie van die Suid-Afrika-Botswana Bi-nasionale Kommissie (BNK).
tgt: Fourth session of the South Africa-Botswana Binational Commission (BNC).

src: President Zuma onderneem op Vrydag 17 November 2017 ’n amptelike besoek na Gaborone in Botswana as medevoorsitter van die Vierde Sessie van die Suid-Afrika-Botswana BNSuid-Afrika en Botswana vergader jaarliks op staatshoofvlak binne die raamwerk van die BNK om bilaterale samewerking in oënskou te neem en kwessies van gesamentlike belang te bespreek.
tgt: President Jacob Zuma will undertake a working visit to participate in and co-chair the Fourth Session of the South Africa-Botswana BNC to be held in Gaborone, Botswana on Friday, 17 November 2017.

src: Die twee lande het goeie betrekkinge wat versterk word deur kulturele bande en geografiese nabyheid.
tgt: The two countries enjoy cordial relations which are informed by cultural ties and geographical proximity.

src: Hulle werk saam op verskeie gebiede soos onder meer vervoer, handel en belegging, gesondheid, en omgewingskwessies.
tgt: They cooperate on a number of issues including, transport, trade and investment, health, environmental issues etc.

src: Suid-Afrika is een van Botswana se belangrikste handelsvennote, met verskeie Suid-Afrikaanse maatskappye wat in daardie land sake doen.
tgt: South Africa is one of Botswana’s major trading partners, with several South African companies operating in that country.

src: Besoek deur die Staatspresident van Angola.
tgt: Angolan State President visit.

src: President Zuma sal Sy Eksellensie, die President van die Republiek van Angola, João Lourenço, op 23 November 2017 vir ’n historiese besoek aan Suid-Afrika ontvang.
tgt: President Zuma will host his Excellency, the President of the Republic of Angola, João Lourenço, for a historic State Visit to South Africa from 23 November 2017.

src: Dit sal sy eerste staatsbesoek na Suid-Afrika wees ná sy inhuldiging.
tgt: This will be his first state visit to our country after his inauguration.

src: Die twee lande het historiese en broederlike bande wat terugdateer na die dae van die vryheidstryd toe Angola Suid-Afrikaanse vryheidsvegters in verskeie kampe in daardie land gehuisves en ondersteun het.
tgt: The two countries have historical and fraternal ties dating back from the days of the liberation struggle when Angola housed and supported South African liberation cadres in various camps in that country.

src: Handel en ekonomiese samewerking tussen die twee lande het beduidend toegeneem in so ’n mate dat Suid-Afrika Angola se voorste handelsvennoot op die vasteland is.
