tgt: Trade and economic cooperation between the two countries has grown substantially, to the extent that South Africa is Angola’s number one trading partner on the continent.

src: Verskeie Suid-Afrikaanse maatskappye doen sake in Angola in uiteenlopende sektore, soos konstruksie, mynwese, behuising, kleinhandel, voedsel en drank, hotelwese en vryetydsbesteding, asook bankwese en mediese dienste.
tgt: Many South African companies are conducting business in Angola in a variety of sectors including construction, mining, housing, retail, food and beverages, hotels and leisure, banking and medical services.

src: Tydens sy besoek sal President Lourenço op Vrydag 24 November 2017 ’n lesing aanbied by die OR Tambo-gebou in Pretoria.
tgt: During his visit João Lourenço will also host a Lecture on 24 November 2017 at OR Tambo Building in Pretoria.

src: 16 Dae van Aktivisme.
tgt: 16 Days of Activism.

src: Die Kabinet sluit aan by alle Suid-Afrikaners wat standpunt inneem teen die mishandeling van vroue en kinders.
tgt: Cabinet joins all South Africans who are taking a stand against women and child abuse.

src: Die veldtog 16 Dae van Aktivisme vir Geen Geweld teen Vroue en Kinders vind tussen 25 November en 10 Desember plaas.
tgt: The 16 Days of Activism for No Violence against Women and Children campaign is taking place between 25 November and 10 December 2017.

src: Dit is die 19de jaar van die veldtog in Suid-Afrika en word vanjaar voortgesit onder die tema: “Sluit my in: Saam beweeg ons ’n nie-gewelddadige Suid-Afrika vorentoe”.
tgt: This is the 19th year of the campaign in South Africa and it will continue under the theme: “Count Me In: Together Moving a Non-Violent South Africa Forward”.

src: President Zuma sal die veldtog vir 16 Dae van Aktivisme op Saterdag 25 November 2017 in die Oos-Kaap van stapel stuur.
tgt: President Zuma will launch the 16 Days of Activism campaign in the Eastern Cape on Saturday, 25 November 2017.

src: Dit sal fokus op die voortsetting van nasionale besprekings wat mense aanmoedig om oor die euwel van geslagsgebaseerde geweld te praat.
tgt: It will focus on the continued roll-out of National Dialogues, which encourage people to talk about the scourge of gender-based violence.

src: Dit sal voorafgegaan word deur Internasionale Dag vir Mans op Sondag 19 November 2017, wat daarop gerig is om mans aan te spoor om ’n rol te speel in die bou van ’n veiliger samelewing en sterker maatskaplike samehorigheid.
tgt: This will be preceded by International Men’s Day on Sunday, 19 November 2017, which calls on men to play their part in building a safer and more socially cohesive society.

src: Die Departement van Justisie en Staatkundige Ontwikkeling sal die tweede reeks in die gemeenskapsradioveldtog, Let’s Talk Justice, voortsit.
tgt: The Department of Justice and Constitutional Development will undertake the second community radio campaign under its Let’s Talk Justice series, which brings government services to people by providing listeners with an opportunity to engage with officials on topical issues.

src: Die bekendstelling van ’n Hof vir Seksuele Misdrywe tydens die veldtog sal ook beter toegang tot die regstelsel bied.
tgt: The launch of a Sexual Offences Court during the campaign will also ensure better access to the justice system.

src: Die Kabinet vertrou dat ons die siklus van mishandeling deur samewerking kan stuit.
tgt: Cabinet is confident that by working together we can end the cycle of abuse.

src: Deur ons gesamentlike pogings kan ons mishandeling voorkom en sodoende ’n veiliger samelewing vir vroue en kinders skep.
tgt: Through our collective efforts we can act to prevent abuse while ensuring a safer society for women and children.

src: Alle Suid-Afrikaners word aangemoedig om ’n wit lint te dra as ’n simboliese onderneming om hierdie euwel uit ons samelewing te verdryf.
tgt: All people in South Africa are urged to wear a white ribbon as a symbolic pledge towards eliminating this scourge from our society.

src: Aanloop tot Wêreld-vigsdag.
tgt: Build up to World AIDS Day.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle gemeenskappe om deel te neem aan aktiwiteite rakende Rooilint-Vrydag – wat Wêreld-vigsdag op 1 Desember voorafgaan – en tot aan die einde van daardie maand.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all in society to participate in Red Ribbon Friday activations ahead of World AIDS Day on 1 December and up until the end of that month.

src: Die dra van ’n rooi lint is ’n simbool van solidariteit en verbinding tot die stryd teen MIV en vigs.
tgt: Wearing a red ribbon is a symbol of solidarity and commitment to the fight against HIV and AIDWorld AIDS Day is an opportunity for every community to unite in the fight against HIV, show support for people living with HIV and remember those who have passed on.

src: Wêreld-vigsdag bied ’n geleentheid vir gemeenskappe om saam te staan in die stryd teen MIV, ondersteuning te bied aan mense wat met MIV saamleef, en om diegene wat weens die siekte gesterf het, te onthou.
tgt: This year’s event will be held under the theme: “My Right to Know My Status, Prevention Is My Responsibility”, which links to the global theme: “The Right to Health”.

src: Vanjaar se tema is: “My reg om my status te ken, voorkoming is my verantwoordelikheid”, wat gekoppel word aan die wêreldwye tema: “Die reg tot gesondheid”.
tgt: This bolsters implementation of South Africa’s National Strategic Plan for HIV, Tuberculosis and Sexually-Transmitted Illnesses 2017 - 2022 (NSP), which is a key pillar in South Africa’s progress towards achieving universal healthcare as reflected in the NDP, which promotes a healthier, stronger and more equitable nation.

src: Nasionale Imbizo-fokusweek.
tgt: National Imbizo Focus Week.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op gemeenskappe om deel te neem aan die komende 7de Nasionale Imbizo-fokusweek, wat na verwagting vanaf 27 November tot 3 Desember 2017 gehou sal word.
tgt: Cabinet calls on communities to join participation in the upcoming 7th National Imbizo Focus Week, expected to be held from 27 November to 3 December 2017.

src: Onder leiding van die GCIS bevorder hierdie platform interaktiewe gesprekvoering tussen lede van die uitvoerende regering en gemeenskappe.
tgt: Under the leadership of the GCIS, this platform promotes interactive engagements between members of the Executive and communities.

src: Dit vind plaas binne die konteks van die eeufeesviering van Oliver Reginald Tambo, wat ’n voorstander van geslagsgelykheid was.
tgt: It is taking place within the context of the centennial of Oliver Reginald Tambo, who advocated for gender equality.

src: Die aktiwiteite is daarop gerig om die veldtog vir 16 Dae van Aktivisme te ondersteun.
tgt: The activities are aimed to support the 16 Days of Activism campaign.

src: Aktiwiteite sal op die nasionale kalender geplaas word en kan op die regering se webblad (WEBTOKEN) besigtig word.
tgt: Events will be placed on the national calendar and shared on the government website (WEBTOKEN).Bills.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die publikasie van ’n kennisgewing ingevolge artikel 74(5) van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996.
tgt: Cabinet approved the publication of a notice in terms of section 74(5) of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.

src: Die doel is om ’n nasionale en provinsiale konsultasieproses aan die gang te sit met die doel om wysigings aan provinsiale grense rakende die Matatiele Plaaslike Munisipaliteit in die Oos-Kaap en sekere gebiede van Ba Ga Mothibi in Noordwes te bewerkstellig.
tgt: The aim is to initiate a national and provincial consultation process for purposes of effecting changes to provincial boundaries in respect of the Matatiele Local Municipality in the Eastern Cape and certain areas of Ba Ga Mothibi in North West.

src: Die voorgenome herafbakening van die provinsiale grense spruit voort uit die gemeenskappe van die gebiede se wens om in die buurprovinsies hervestig te word.
tgt: The intended redetermination of the provincial boundaries emanates from the communities of the areas in question who wish to be relocated to neighboring provinces.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Messages.

src: Die Kabinet wens Frankryk geluk met sy verkiesing as gasheerland vir die 2023 Rugby Wêreldbeker.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates France as the preferred host of the 2023 Rugby World Cup and thanks government’s delegation, headed by Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa, Sport and Recreation Minister Thulas Nxesi and the South African Rugby Union, for the work done in promoting South Africa’s bid to host the event.

src: Die Kabinet wens Minister Naledi Pandor geluk met haar Toekenning as Voortreflike Opvoeder.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates Minister Pandor, who was awarded the Outstanding Educator Award.

src: Die toekenning is aan Minister Pandor oorhandig deur die Kanselier van die Universiteit van Suid-Afrika, voormalige President Thabo Mbeki.
tgt: The award was presented to Minister Pandor by the Chancellor of the University of South Africa, former President Thabo Mbeki.

src: Die Toekenning as Voortreflike Opvoeder, een van vier kategorieë, erken die bydrae van enige voortreflike opvoeder wat uitgeblink het in onderrig, leer, vaardigheidsontwikkeling en/of navorsing op hul deskundige gebied.
tgt: The Outstanding Educator Award, one of four categories, acknowledges the contribution of any outstanding educator who has excelled in or advanced teaching, learning, skills development and/or research in their area of expertise.

src: Die Kabinet prys die werk van die Suid-Afrikaanse Sterrewag, wat deel is van die Wyehoeksoektog na Planete se konsortium van planeetsoekers wat drie nuwe planete ontdek het.
tgt: Cabinet commends the work done by the South African Astronomical Observatory, which is part of the Wide Angle Search for Planets consortium of planet hunters who have detected three new planets.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense oor aan die deelnemers en wenners van die 2017 Govan Mbeki-toekennings wat hulde bring aan diegene in die konstruksiebedryf wat uitgeblink het in die lewering van behuising.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the participants and winners of the 2017 Govan Mbeki Awards, which honour those in the construction sector who have excelled in the delivery of houses.

src: Die Kabinet het vir sy laaste vergadering van 2017 by die Uniegebou in Pretoria byeengekom.
tgt: Cabinet convened for its last 2017 meeting at the Union Buildings in Pretoria.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring dat die Nasionale Toerismesektorstrategie (NTSS) 2016–2026 geïmplementeer word.
tgt: Cabinet DecisionsCabinet approved the National Tourism Sector Strategy (NTSS) 2016-2026 for implementation.

src: Die NTSS is gegrond op vyf strategiese pilare, naamlik bemarking, vergemakliking van toegang vir toeriste, beter besoekerservarings, bestemmingsbestuur en breëbasis-voordele.
tgt: The NTSS is anchored on five strategic pillars, namely marketing, facilitation of ease of access for tourists, enhance visitor experience, destination management and broad-based benefits.

src: Die volledige dokument is beskikbaar op die Departement van Toerisme se webblad: WEBTOKEDie Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die raamwerk vir die stigting van ’n Nasionale Breëbandnetwerkmaatskappy, wat gevorm sal word deur die samesmelting van Sentech en Broadband Infraco.
tgt: The full document is available on the Department of Tourism’s website: www.

src: Die ontwerpe van die muntstukke, met hul verklarings, sal in die Staatskoerant gepubliseer word: 2018 2oz, 22-karaat goue Krugerrand2018 24-karaat goue Natura-muntstukke (Opkoms van die dinosourusse – Archosauria)2018 24-karaat goue R1-muntstukke (Reptiele van Suid-Afrika – die papegaaibek-padloper)2018 bi-metaal R5-sirkulasiemuntstuk (Nelson Mandela-eeufees)2018 24-karaat goue en sterlingsilwer Protea-muntstukke (Lewe van ’n Legende – Nelson Mandela)2018 sterlingsilwer R2-kroon- en 2½-sent-tiekie-muntstukke (Suid-Afrikaanse uitvindings – Gerekenariseerde Tomografie) en2018 sterlingsilwer muntstukke met kleurafwerking (Voëls en Blomme van die Waterberg-Biosfeerreservaat).
tgt: Cabinet approved the convening and hosting of the following conferences:National Community Development Workers Programme Consultative Conference 2018 by the DPSInternational Association of Prosecutors 23rd Annual Conference, to be hosted by the National Prosecuting Authority in Durban during September 2018.2021 World Science Forum in South Africa.

src: Uitslae van die Bruto Binnelandse ProdukDie Kabinet is tevrede met Suid-Afrika se ekonomiese groei, wat op ’n jaarbasis bereken, met 2% in die derde kwartaal van 2017 gegroei het van ’n opwaarts hersiene 2,8% in die tweede kwartaal.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the designs and commemorative collectors’ and circulation coin series to be issued in 2018.The coin designs, with their proclamations, will be printed in the Government Gazette: 2018 2oz, 22-carat gold Krugerrand2018 24-carat gold Natura coin series (Rise of the dinosaurs – Archosauria)2018 24-carat gold R1 coin series (Reptiles of South Africa – the parrot beaked padloper)2018 bi-metal R5 circulation coin (Nelson Mandela Centenary)2018 24-carat gold and sterling-silver Protea coin series (Life of Legend – Nelson Mandela)2018 sterling-silver R2 Crown and 2 ½ Tickey series (South African inventions – Computed Tomography) and2018 sterling-silver colour finished coin series (Birds and Flowers of the Waterberg Biosphere Reserve).Issues in the EnvironmentGDP Growth ResultsCabinet is pleased with South Africa’s economy growth which grew by an annualised 2% in the third quarter of 2017, from an upwardly revised 2.8% in the second quarter.

src: Die sterker-as-verwagte prestasie is hoofsaaklik te danke aan die volgehoue sterk groei van die landbousektor, wat 0,9 persentasiepunte op grond van kwartaal-op-kwartaalgroei van 44,2%.Die landbou het goed presteer met drie agtereenvolgende kwartale se robuuste groei danksy hoër produksie van veldgewasse (soos mielies) in somerreënvalgebiede, en tuinbouprodukte.
tgt: The stronger-than-expected performance was mainly due to continued strong growth in the agriculture sector, which contributed percentage points to overall growth on the back of per cent quarter-on-quarter growth.

src: Mynbou en vervaardiging het ook bygedra tot die aangetekende groei, met mynbou en steengroewe wat met 6,6% toegeneem het en 0,5 persentasiepunte tot die groei bygedra het.
tgt: Strong performance in agriculture, which has seen three consecutive quarters of robust growth, was due to higher production of field crops (such as maize) in summer rainfall areas and horticultural products.

src: Die elektrisiteitsektor was die grootste naloper, wat met 5,5% gedaal het.
tgt: Mining and manufacturing also contributed to the growth recorded, with mining and quarrying increasing by 6.6% and contributing percentage points to growth.

src: Groei in huishoudelike verbruik van 2,6% was hoofsaaklik te danke aan besteding aan duursame goedere, wat 1,6 persentasiepunte van die2,6%-verhoging uitmaak.
tgt: The electricity sector was the biggest laggard, down by 5.5%.

src: Sterker as verwagte groei en die opwaartse hersiening tot die groeivlak van die tweede kwartaal beteken dat groei in 2017 0,9% kan bereik.
tgt: Stronger-than-expected growth and the upward revision to the second quarter growth outcomes means growth could reach per cent in 2017.This is higher than the per cent anticipated at the time of the Medium Term Budget Policy Statement.

src: Die regering moet verseker dat hierdie groeimomentum gehandhaaf word deur die implementering van die 14 maatreëls vir die versterking van vertroue, wat voortbou op die verbetering van verbruikersvertroue en die sakevertroue kan herstel.
tgt: Government needs to ensure that this growth momentum is maintained by continuing to implement the 14 confidence-boosting measures that build on improving consumer confidence and can restore business confidence.

src: InvestSA Eenstop-winkelDie Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van die InvestSA Eenstop-winkel in KwaZulu-Natal deur President Jacob Zuma as deel van pogings om dit makliker te maak om sake in Suid-Afrika te doen.
tgt: InvestSA One-Stop ShopCabinet welcomes the launch of the InvestSA One-Stop Shop in KwaZulu-Natal by President Jacob Zuma as part of efforts to improve the ease of doing business in South Africa.

src: Dit is die derde Eenstop-winkel wat in die land bekendgestel word.
tgt: This is the third One-Stop-Shop launched in the country.

src: Dit is daarop gemik om 'n bevorderlike omgewing te skep deur 'n fokuspunt van kontak vir beleggers te bied waar hulle toegang tot al die nodige dienste kan kry om projekte te bespoedig en die regering se rompslomp te verminder wanneer 'n onderneming begin word.
tgt: It aims to create a conducive environment by providing a focal point of contact for investors to obtain all services to fast-track projects and reduce government red-tape when starting a business.

src: Suid-Afrika–Angola-betrekkingeDie Kabinet verwelkom die ooreenkomste wat tydens Angola se President João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço se staatsbesoek aan Suid-Afrika onderteken is.
tgt: South Africa-Angola relationsCabinet welcomes the agreements signed during the State Visit to South Africa by Angolan President João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço.

src: Die volgende ooreenkomste is onderteken: Meorandum van Verstandhouding (MoU) oor die oprigting van 'n Presidensiële Bi-nasionale Kommissie MoU oor Samewerking op die gebied van die Omgewing Implementeringsriglyne vir die Visumkwytskelding Protokol oor Polisiesamewerking en 'n Ooreenkoms oor Onderlinge Administratiewe Bystand in Doeane-aangeleenthede.
tgt: The following agreements were signed: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on the creation of a Presidential Binational Commission, MoU on Cooperation in the Field of Environment, Implementation Guidelines for the visa waiver, Protocol on Police Cooperation and an Agreement on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Customs Matters.

src: Vyfde Spitsberaad van die AU-Europese Unie (EU)Die Kabinet verwelkom die resultate van die Vyfde AU-EU-Spitsberaad.
tgt: Fifth AU-EU SummitCabinet welcomes outcomes from the Fifth Summit of the AU-European Union (EU).

src: Die beraad het 'n geleentheid vir Suid-Afrika gebied om strategiese ekonomiese en diplomatieke betrekkinge te bevorder deur middel van verskeie besprekings by die beraad en tydens kantlynbyeenkomste soos die Sakebestuurs- en Jeugberaad, met die klem op inklusiewe ekonomiese groei, jeugwerk en entrepreneurskap.
tgt: The summit provided an opportunity for South Africa to enhance strategic economic and diplomatic relations through various engagements in the summit and in side events such as the Business Forum and Youth Summit, with a focus on inclusive economic growth, youth employment and entrepreneurship.

src: Slawehandel van migrante uit AfrikaDie Kabinet veroordeel saam met die internasionale gemeenskap die berigte van die opveiling van Afrika-migrante in Libië as slawe.
tgt: Slave trade of African migrantsCabinet joins the international community in condemning the reports of auctioning of African migrants in Libya as slaves.

src: Sulke onmenslike dade is teenstrydig met die ideale van die AU, en soortgelyke Afrika- en internasionale instrumente soos die Afrika Handves vir Meseregte en Volkeregte.
tgt: Such inhumane acts go against the ideals of the AU, and relevant African and international instruments, including the African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die owerheid se aankondiging dat hulle 'n transito- en vertrekfasiliteit in Tripoli sal opstel vir vlugtelinge en migrante wat internasionale beskerming nodig het.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the announcement by authorities that they will set up a transit and departure facility in Tripoli for refugees and migrants in need of international protection.

src: Uitbreek van ListeriosisDie Kabinet doen 'n beroep op mense om die nodige voorsorgmaatreëls te tref – soos om hul hande te was voordat hulle kos voorberei en rou of ongekookte kosse te vermy – om die verspreiding van Listeriosis te bekamp, terwyl ondersoeke voortgesit word om die bron van die bakterieë te vind.
tgt: Outbreak of ListeriosisCabinet appeals to all people to take the necessary precaution – such as washing their hands before preparing food and avoiding raw or uncooked foods – to curb the spread of Listeriosis, whilst investigations continue to establish the source of the bacteria.

src: Die siekte word veroorsaak deur bakterieë wat in grond, water, plantegroei en nie-gepasteuriseerde suiwelprodukte voorkom, en kan lei tot griepagtige simptome met diarree.
tgt: The disease is caused by a bacteria found in soil, water, vegetation and non-pasteurised dairy products, and may result in flu-like symptoms with diarrhoea.

src: Dit kan met antibiotika suksesvol behandel word, indien dit vroeg opgespoor word.
tgt: It can be successfully treated with antibiotics, if detected early.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om water steeds spaarsamig te gebruik, aangesien droogtetoestande voortduur.
tgt: Cabinet calls on South Africans to continue using water sparingly as the country still continues to experience drought/.

src: Ondanks die onlangse reën, daal damvlakke steeds landwyd.
tgt: Notwithstanding the recent rains, the dam levels nationally continue to decline.

src: Dit is as gevolg van die hoë temperature asook die gebrek aan konsekwente reën.
tgt: This is due to the high temperatures as well as that we did not as yet have consistent rains.

src: Die Kabinet is bemoedig deur progressiewe onderhandelinge met munisipaliteite wat diep in die skuld is om 'n oplossing vir hul munisipale skuld te vind.
tgt: Cabinet is encouraged by the progressive negotiations with the highly indebted municipalities towards finding a solution to the municipal debt.

src: Wysigingswetsontwerp op Maatskaplike Hulp van 2017Die wetsontwerp maak voorsiening vir verbeterde voordele rakende kindertoelae vir wees- en kwesbare kinders, insluitend dié in huishoudings met kinders aan die hoof.
tgt: BillsCabinet approved the submission to Parliament of following Bills.1 Social Assistance Amendment Bill of 2017.The Bill provides improved benefits with respect to child support grants for orphaned and vulnerable children, including those residing in child-headed households.2 Property Practitioners Bill of 2017 The Bill repeals the current Estate Agency Affairs Act, 1976 (Act 112 of 1976).

src: Wetsontwerp op Eiendomspraktisyns van 2017Die wetsontwerp herroep die huidige Wet op Eiendomsagentskapsake, 1976 Wet 112 van 1976).
tgt: It creates an enabling regulatory environment to enhance economic activity within the real estate industry while also addressing a need to ensure transformation in the sector.3 National Qualifications Framework Amendment Bill of 2016The Bill strengthens the current National Qualifications Framework Act, 2008 (Act 67 of 2008).

src: Dit skep ‘n bemagtigingsregulerende omgewing om ekonomiese aktiwiteit binne die eiendomsbesdryf te verbeter en gee ook aandag aan die behoefte om die sektor te transformeer.
tgt: It introduces measures to deal with issues of misrepresentation and imposes consequences on persons who misrepresent their qualifications or organisations that issue qualifications that are invalid.4 International Crimes Bill of 2017The Bill provides an improved legislative framework to deal with international crimes committed in South Africa and across our border.

src: Verklaring oor die Kabinetsvergadering van 28 Februarie 2018Die Kabinet het op Woensdag, 28 Februarie 2018, by Tuynhuys, Kaapstad, vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 28 February 2018, at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Issues in the environment.

src: Nasionale Begrotingsrede.
tgt: National Budget Speech.

src: Die Kabinet waardeer die uitsprake van oorweldigende vertroue in die 2018 Nasionale Begroting, wat verlede week in die Parlement, Kaapstad ter tafel gelê is.
tgt: Cabinet appreciates the overwhelming confidence expressed in the 2018 National Budget which was tabled in Parliament, Cape Town, last week.

src: In die onlangse gees van die hernuwing wat ons wonderlike nasie herbesiel het, doen die Kabinet ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om in vennootskap met die regering te werk om ons ekonomie te help groei en broodnodige werksgeleenthede te skep.
tgt: In the recent spirit of renewal that has gripped our great nation, Cabinet calls on all South Africans to partner with government to grow our economy and create much-needed jobs.

src: Die afname in besteding van R85 miljard oor die volgende drie jaar is ’n aanduiding van die regering se verbintenis tot fiskale versterking en die verstandige toewysing van hulpbronne om die ekonomie te laat groei.
tgt: The reduction in expenditure of R85 billion over the next three years demonstrates government’s commitment to fiscal consolidation and the prudent allocation of resources to grow the economy.

src: Die stappe wat aangekondig is om die tempo van skuldoploping te verlangsaam en die begrotingstekort in bedwang te hou, verbeter ons fiskale raamwerk aansienlik en versterk Suid-Afrikaners se vertroue in die toekomsvooruitsigte vir ons ekonomie.
tgt: The steps announced to slow the pace of debt accumulation and contain the budget deficit greatly improve our fiscal framework and give South Africans confidence in the future prospects of our economy.

src: Die Kabinet is vol vertroue dat die ingrypings in ons land se ekonomiese groei weerspieël sal word, sy ekonomiese posisie sal herbevestig en sy beleggingsgraderingstatus sal vrywaar.
tgt: Cabinet is resolute that the interventions will reflect in our country’s economic growth, affirm its economic standing and safeguard its investment grade status.

src: Die 2018 Nasionale Begroting ondersteun die armes in ons gemeenskap deur middel van ’n omvattende maatskaplike-hulpprogram en gratis tersiêre onderwys vir studente uit arm huishoudings.
tgt: The 2018 National Budget supports the poor in our society through a comprehensive social assistance programme and fee-free tertiary education for students from poor households.

src: In reaksie op die kommer wat uitgespreek is oor die verhoging in Belasting op Toegevoegde Waarde (BTW), oorweeg die Kabinet dit om die lys van basiese goedere wat ’n nultarief het, uit te brei.
tgt: As a response to the concern raised on the Value-Added Tax (VAT) increases proposed, Cabinet is considering expanding the list of basic goods that are zero-rated on VANelson Mandela Centenary.

src: Die Kabinet sluit hom aan by President Cyril Ramaphosa se beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om ’n gedeelde verbintenis om mense te dien te herbevestsig, terwyl ons die eeufeesherdenking van die geboorte van voormalige president Nelson Mandela vier.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Cyril Ramaphosa in his call on South Africans to reaffirm a shared commitment to serve people as we continue to celebrate the centenary of the birth of former President Nelson Mandela.

src: Madiba was die eerste president van ’n demokratiese Suid-Afrika en sou op 18 Julie 2018 100 jaar oud geword het.
tgt: Madiba is the first President of a Democratic South Africa and would have turned 100 years of age on 18 July 2018.

src: Madiba is ’n wêreldwye ikoon wat internasionaal as ’n kampvegter vir menseregte, nie-rassisme en nie-seksisme geëer word.
tgt: Madiba is a global icon who is revered worldwide as a Champion of Human Rights, non-racism and non-sexism.

src: Hy het ’n deurslaggewende rol gespeel om Suid-Afrikaners te verenig en het demokratiese eenheid regoor Afrika en die res van die wêreld geïnspireer.
tgt: He played a critical role in unifying South Africans, and inspiring democratic unity across Africa and the globe.

src: Die eerste viering van Nelson Mandela se eeufees het in Januarie 2018 gedurende die Afrika-unie se beraad in Addis Abeba, Ethiopië, plaasgevind.
tgt: The first celebration of Nelson Mandela’s centenary took place during the African Union Summit in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia in January 2018.

src: Verskeie geleenthede sal vanjaar regdeur die land gehou word om oor die lewe van Tata Madiba te besin.
tgt: A number of events will be held throughout the country this year to reflect on the life of Tata Madiba.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om hulle by die eeufeesvierings aan te sluit by hul werkplekke, skole, kerke en burgerlike organisasies.
tgt: Cabinet calls upon all South Africans to join in the centenary celebrations in their workplaces, schools, churches and civic organisations.

src: Dit doen ’n beroep op elkeen van ons om vanjaar die waardes van Nelson Mandela na te streef deur op ons onderskeie maniere te werk om ’n verenigde, nie-rassistiese, nie-seksistiese en welvarende land te bou.
tgt: It calls on each one of us this year to emulate the values of Nelson Mandela by working in our respective ways to build a united, non-racist, non-sexist and prosperous country.

src: Die land vier ook die eeufees van een van die groot dogters van die Afrika-vasteland, Mama Albertina Sisulu, wat haar lewe aan die emansipasie van vroue en die bevryding van Suid-Afrika gewy het.
tgt: The country also celebrates the centenary of one of the great daughters of the African soil Mama Albertina Sisulu, who dedicated her life to fight for the emancipation of women and the liberation of South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet sal tydens die volgende vergadering ’n program vir die eeufeesviering van Mama Albertina Sisulu uiteensit.
tgt: Cabinet will in the next meeting also outline a programme for the celebration of the Centenary of Mama Albertina Sisulu.

src: Droogte.
tgt: Drought.

src: Die Kabinet waardeer die onvermoeide pogings van die Interministeriële Komitee oor Droogte, in samewerking met belanghebbers in alle sfere van die regering en die samelewing, om die hardnekkige droogtetoestande waaronder verskeie dele van die land gebuk gaan, die hoof te bied.
tgt: Cabinet appreciates the relentless efforts made by the Inter-Ministerial Committee on Drought together with stakeholders in all spheres of government and society in dealing with the persistent drought conditions that have hit several parts of the country.

src: Benewens die feit dat Suid-Afrika ’n waterskaars land is, beïnvloed die uitwerkings van klimaatsverandering steeds die reënpatrone, wat veroorsaak dat ons damvlakke laag bly.
tgt: Apart from the fact that South Africa is a water-scarce country, the effects of global warming continue to affect the rain patterns, thus causing our dam levels to remain low.

src: Die Interministeriële Taakspan oor Droogte fasiliteer steeds werk tussen die nasionale regering, provinsies en munisipaliteite in alle gebiede wat deur die droogte geraak word.
tgt: The Inter-Ministerial Task Team on Drought continues to facilitate work between national government, provinces and municipalities in all drought-affected areas.

src: Dit sluit in die implementering van kort-, medium- en langtermynmaatreëls om die potensiële uitwerking van hierdie droogte te bestuur en te verlig.
tgt: This includes implementing short, medium and long-term measures to address and mitigate the potential impact of this drought.

src: Die regering het fondse beskikbaar gestel om die provinsies wat deur die droogte geraak word, van korttermynhulp te voorsien.
tgt: Government has made funds available to provide short-term assistance to affected provinces.

src: Dit het naamlik ’n bystandstoelae ter waarde van R473 miljoen en 'n bykomende R6 miljard in die 2018/19- finansiële jaar bewillig om waterinfrastruktuur in die Wes-Kaap, Oos-Kaap en Noord-Kaap aan te vul.
tgt: It has provided a relief grant worth R473 million and an additional R6 billion in the 2018/19 financial year to augment water infrastructure in the Western Cape‚ Eastern Cape and Northern Cape.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op almal om steeds met die regering saam te werk om water te bespaar deur dit op ’n verantwoordelike en spaarsamige manier te gebruik.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all to continue to work with government in conserving water by using it responsibly and sparingly.

src: Die Kabinet bly daartoe verbind om Suid-Afrika ’n voorkeurland vir besoekers sowel as potensiële beleggers te maak.
tgt: Cabinet remains committed to making South Africa a country of choice for visitors and potential investors alike.

src: Polisiemoorde.
tgt: Police killings.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel met die familie en vriende van die vyf polisiebeamptes en ’n voormalige soldaat wat onlangs wreedaardig vermoor is in ’n aanval op die Ngcobo Polisiestasie in die Oos-Kaap.
tgt: Cabinet expresses condolences to the families and friends of the five police officers and a former soldier who were recently brutally murdered in an attack on the Ngcobo Police Station in the Eastern Cape.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel ten sterkste enige sinlose moord op ons geregsdienaars.
tgt: Cabinet strongly condemns any senseless killing of our servicemen and women.

src: Die verlies van elke enkele polisiebeampte, soldaat of enige ander persoon wat ons samelewing en ons mense beskerm is onaanvaarbaar.
tgt: The loss of one police officer, soldier or any other person who serves to protect society and our people is unacceptable.

src: Die Kabinet het hom deur die Minister van Polisie verbind om alles in sy vermoë te doen om ons polisiestasies van die nodige hulpbronne te voorsien en te bemagtig om sulke aanvalle in die toekoms te voorkom.
tgt: Cabinet has committed, through the Minister of Police, to do whatever possible to capacitate our police stations to prevent such attacks in the future.

src: Die Kabinet doen verder ’n beroep op ouers en die breër samelewing om te verseker dat kinders te alle tye veilig gehou word en om met wetstoepassingsagentskappe saam te werk om die regte van ons kinders te beskerm.
tgt: Cabinet further appeals to parents and society at large to ensure children are kept safe at all times and to partner with law-enforcement agencies to protect the rights of our children.

src: Enige vorm van mishandeling teen ’n kind moet onmiddellik aan die kaak gestel en gerapporteer word.
tgt: Any form of abuse against a child must be exposed and reported immediately.

src: Deur met mekaar saam te werk, kan ons ons gemeenskappe veilig hou en verseker dat misdadige elemente nêrens ’n wegkruipplek het nie.
tgt: By working together, we can keep our communities safe and ensure that criminal elements have no place to hide.

src: Die Kabinet keur die Konsep- Hersiene Witskrif oor Nasionale Vervoerbeleid goed vir publikasie en openbare kommentaar.
tgt: Cabinet decisions Cabinet approved the Draft Revised White Paper on National Transport Policy to be published for public comments.

src: Die beleid beoog om ’n vervoerstelsel te voorsien wat met ander verwante sektorplanne geïntegreer is met die oog op die verlaging van pendelkoste sowel as die koste verbonde aan die bedryf van sakeondernemings.
tgt: The policy aims to provide a transport system that is integrated with other related sector plans so as to reduce both the cost of commuting and doing business.

src: Dit bring ook die land se vervoerplanne in ooreenstemming met internasionale vervoertendense.
tgt: It also aligns the country’s transportation plans to the global transportation trends.

src: Die Kabinet keur die Groenskrif oor Paaiebeleid vir Suid-Afrika goed vir publikasie en openbare kommentaar.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Green Paper on Roads Policy for South Africa to be published for public comments.

src: Die beleid voorsien die oorkoepelende raamwerk wat verseker dat Suid-Afrika se paaie beter bestuur word, veiliger is en alle vervoermiddele insluit om ’n volhoubare benadering tot paaiebestuur te bied.
tgt: The policy provides the overarching framework that ensures South Africa’s roads are better managed, safer and include all modes of transport to deliver a sustainable approach to roads management.

src: Dit dien as riglyn vir die padregulasies, infrastruktuur, veiligheid, padbefondsing en nie-gemotoriseerde vervoer.
tgt: It guides the road regulations, infrastructure, safety, road funding and non- motorised transport.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die bevindings van die 2015/16 Nasionale Opname van Navorsing en Eksperimentele Ontwikkeling (N&O-opname).
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the findings of the 2015/16 National Survey of Research and Experimental Development (R&D Survey).R&D is an integral part of the country’s socio-economic development.

src: Hierdie opname bestaan uit gesamentlike pogings van die regering, die nywerheidsektor en navorsingsinstellings.
tgt: This has been collective efforts of government, industry and research institutions.

src: Die verslag is beskikbaar op die webtuiste van die Departement van Wetenskap en Tegnologie (DST): WEBTOKEDie Kabinet verleen sy goedkeuring aan die ontwerpe van die 2018 gedenkversamelaarsmuntreeks, wat deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Muntmaatskappy uitgereik sal word.
tgt: The report is available on the Department of Science and Technology (DST) website: WEBTOKECabinet approved the designs of the 2018 commemorative collector’s coin series, which will be produced by the South African Mint Company.

src: Die 2018-ontwerpversameling sal die Nelson Mandela Eeufeesviering herdenk.
tgt: The 2018 designs collection will be celebrating the Nelson Mandela Centenary.

src: Hierdie versameling is voorafgegaan deur die 2017-gedenkmunte wat Suid-Afrika onder die tema Vryheid, Demokrasie en Kulture, gevier het.
tgt: These collections were preceded by the 2017 commemorative coins that celebrated South Africa under the theme of Freedom, Democracy and Cultures.

src: Wetsontwerpe.
tgt: Bills.

src: Die Kabinet keur die voorlegging van die Wetsontwerp op Gebruiklike Inisiasie van 2018 aan die Parlement goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Customary Initiation Bill of 2018 to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp is daarop gerig om die beheeraspekte van gebruiklike inisiasie te beskerm, te bevorder en te reguleer.
tgt: The Bill seeks to protect, promote and regulate the governance aspect of the practice of customary WEBTOKEN provides national norms and standards aimed at the protection of life and the prevention of injuries and all forms of abuse experienced by initiates.

src: Dit voorsien nasionale norme en standaarde wat gerig is op die beskerming van lewe en die voorkoming van beserings en alle vorme van mishandeling van inisiasie-kandidate.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the submission of the National Qualifications Framework Amendment Bill of 2016 to Parliament.

src: Die Kabinet keur die voorlegging van die Wysigingswetsontwerp op die Nasionale Kwalifikasieraamwerk van 2016 aan die Parlement goed.
tgt: The Bill, which amends the National Qualifications Framework Act, 2008 (Act 67 of 2008), strengthens the Act by improving measures to deal with issues of misrepresentation, imposes consequences on persons who misrepresent their qualifications or organisations that issue invalid WEBTOKEN also proposes regulations to ensure that fraudulent qualifications are referred to the relevant professional bodies (database of individuals who misrepresented their qualifications).

src: Dit handel ook oor die akkreditasie van buitelandse kwalifikasies.
tgt: It also addresses the accreditation of foreign qualifications.

src: Die Kabinet keur die Wetsontwerp op Spoorwegveiligheid van 2017 goed vir publikasie en openbare kommentaar.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Railway Safety Bill of 2017 to be published for public comments.

src: Die Wetsontwerp is gerig op die verbetering van spoorwegveiligheid en skep ’n beheerstruktuur vir toesighouding oor die werk van die Spoorwegveiligheidsreguleerder van Suid-Afrika.
tgt: The Bill seeks to improve railway safety and create a governance structure to oversee the work of the Rail Safety Regulator of South Africa.

src: Dit is ook in ooreenstemming met die Nasionale Spoorwegbeleid met betrekking tot die versterking van veilgheidsmonitering, en die bevordering en afdwinging van veiligheid in ons spoorweë.
tgt: It is also aligned to the National Rail Policy regarding the strengthening of safety monitoring, and the promotion and enforcement of safety in our railways.

src: Die Kabinet keur die Konsepwetsontwerp op die Ekonomiese Regulasie van Vervoer van 2017 goed vir publikasie en openbare kommentaar en oorlegpleging.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the Draft Economic Regulation of Transport Bill of 2017 to be published for public comments and consultation.

src: Die Wetsontwerp is gerig op die regstelling van die regulerings- en kapasiteitsleemtes rakende die voorsiening van ’n koste-effektiewe en doeltreffende vervoerstelsel.
tgt: The Bill addresses the regulatory and capacity gaps in respect of provision of a cost-effective and efficient transport system.

src: Toekomstige Gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: As voorsitter, sal Suid-Afrika van 1 tot 2 Maart 2018 gasheer wees vir die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap se Ministers van Arbeid, Werkverskaffing en Maatskaplike Sekerheid, by Kaapstad se Internasionale Konvensiesentrum.
tgt: South Africa will be hosting the Southern African Development Community Ministers of Labour, Employment and Social Security, as Chair, from 1 to 2 March 2018 at the Cape Town International Convention Centre.

src: Die tema van die konferensie is: “Horison behoorlike werk: Bevordering van konnektiwiteit, samehorigheid en inklusiwiteit”.
tgt: The theme of the conference is: “Horizon decent work: Advancing connectivity, coherence and inclusivity”.

src: Deelnemers sal maatskaplike vennote insluit soos die georganiseerde sakesektor, arbeid en die gemeenskap.
tgt: Participants will include social partners – organised business, labour and community.

src: President Ramaphosa sal in sy hoedanigheid as die Voorsitter van die SAOG van 2 tot 3 Maart 2018 raadgplegende besoeke bring aan Angola, Botswana en Namibië.
tgt: President Ramaphosa in his capacity as the Chair of SADC will undertake consultative visits to Angola, Botswana and Namibia from 2 to 3 March 2018.

src: Hy sal vergesel word deur die Minister van Internasionale Betrekkinge en Samewerking, Lindiwe Sisulu en die Minister van Verdediging en Militêre Veterane, Nosiviwe Maphisa Nqakula.
tgt: He will be accompanied by the Minister of International Relations and Cooperation Lindiwe Sisulu and Minister of Defence and Military Veterans Nosiviwe Maphisa Nqakula.

src: Suid-Afrika sal van 7 tot 9 Maart 2018 as medegasheer optree van die 17de Wêreldkonferensie oor Tabak en Gesondheid (WCTOH) in Kaapstad met die tema "Verenig die Wêreld vir ’n Tabakvrye Generasie".
tgt: South Africa will co-host the 17th World Conference on Tobacco or Health (WCTOH) from 7 to 9 March 2018 in Cape Town under the theme: “Uniting the World for a Tobacco-free Generation”.

src: Dit is die eerste keer dat die konferensie in Afrika aangebied word.
tgt: This is the first hosting in Africa.

src: Die WTCOH bepleit besliste en toegewyde optrede en bied ’n platform aan regerings, burgerlike organisasies, agentskappe van die Verenigde Nasies, internasionale organisasies, gesondheidswerkers en ander belanghebbers om gedeelde kennis en ervarings te bespreek, veral met betrekking tot die jeug en vroue wat aan tabakgebruik blootgestel word.
tgt: The WTCOH calls for committed action and provides a platform for governments, civil-society organisations, United Nations agencies, international organisations, health workers and other stakeholders to discuss shared knowledge and experiences, particularly regarding to youth and women who are exposed to tobacco WEBTOKEN the conference contributes towards addressing the National Development Plan’s goals by creating awareness and education on the harmful effects of tobacco use, and the need to intensify tobacco control measures.

src: Die OVK sal Kiesersregistrasiesentrums op 10 en 11 Maart open sodat stemgeregtigdes kan registreer of hul registrasiebesonderhede kan nagaan.
tgt: On the 10 and 11 March the IEC will open the Voting Registration Centres for people to come and register and check their registration details.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n ernstige beroep op alle stemgeregtigde burgers om hul stemlokale te besoek om die kiesersrol op datum te bring ter voorbereiding van die algemene verkiesing in 2019.
tgt: Cabinet urges all eligible voters to visit their voting stations to update the voters’ roll in preparation for the 2019 general elections.

src: Die Kabinet doen in die besonder ’n beroep op kiesers wat vir die eerste keer kwalifiseer om te stem om te verseker dat hulle hul grondwetlike demokratiese reg om te stem uitoefen deur te gaan registreer om te stem.
tgt: Cabinet particularly calls on first-time voters to ensure they participate in their constitutional democratic right to vote by going to register to vote.

src: Hierdie registrasienaweek is ’n mylpaal wat voortvloei uit ’n tweejaarprojek om die woonadresse van alle geregistreerde kiesers te verkry.
tgt: This registration weekend is a milestone towards the culmination of a two-year project to obtain the residential addresses of all registered voters.

src: Die stemlokale sal tussen 08:00 en 17:00 oop wees om nuwe kiesers te help registreer om te kan stem, sowel as om geregistreerde kiesers wat verhuis het te help om in hul toepaslike stemdistrik te herregistreer en hul adresbesonderhede op die kiesersrol by te werk.
tgt: The voting stations will be open between 08:00 and 17:00 to assist new voters to register to vote, and allow registered voters who have relocated to reregister in their correct voting district and update their address details on the voters’ roll.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Messages.

src: Die Kabinet wens al die onderwysers geluk wat by die 18de Nasionale Onderwystoekennings, wat op Saterdag 17 Februarie 2018 in Johannesburg plaasgevind het, vereer is.
tgt: Cabinet commends all teachers who were honoured at the 18th National Teaching Awards which took place in Johannesburg on Saturday, 17 February 2018.

src: Die toekennings erken voortreflike onderwys en leierskap in verskeie kategorieë, insluitend die Nelson Mandela Lewenslange Prestasietoekenning en die Profssor Kader Asmal-toekenning.
tgt: The awards recognised outstanding teaching and leadership in several categories, including the Nelson Mandela Lifetime Achievement Award and Profssor Kader Asmal Award.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel met Adjunkminister Obed Bapela met die heengaan van sy vrou Constance Bapela, wat ten tyde van haar afsterwe as raadslid gedien het.
tgt: Cabinet conveys its condolences to Deputy Minister Obed Bapela on the loss of his wife Constance Bapela, who served the country as a councillor at the time of her passing.

src: Die Kabinet betuig saam met President Ramaphosa sy meegevoel met die familie, vriende en kennisse van die politieke ekonoom en skrywer, prof Johannes “Sampie” Terreblanche, wat op die ouderdom van 84 oorlede is.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Ramaphosa in conveying condolences to the family, friends and associates of the political economist and author, ProfJohannes “Sampie” Terreblanche, who passed on at the age of Cabinet congratulates Minister Naledi Pandor on her recognition by Leiden University in the Netherlands as an Oort Honorary Visiting Profssor of Astronomy and Development.

src: Dit is ’n erkenning van die minister se buitengewone prestasie in die aanwending van wetenskap, in die besonder sterrekunde, as ’n instrument vir globale ontwikkeling tot voordeel van die samelewing.
tgt: This is in recognition of the Minister’s extraordinary accomplishment in harnessing science, particularly astronomy, as a tool for global development and societal benefit.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderworpe aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die toepaslike klaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: MeLerato Mataboge as Adjukdirekteur-generaal (ADG): Handel en Belegging Suid-Afrika, Departement van Handel en Nywerheid (die dti).
tgt: Ms Lerato Matabogeas Deputy Director-General (DDG): Tradeand Investment South Africa, Department of Trade and Industry (the dti).

src: MeShandokane Evelyn Masotja as ADG: Verbruiker- en Korporatiewe Regulering, die dti.
tgt: Ms Shandokane Evelyn Masotjaas DDG: Consumer and Corporate Regulation, the dti.

src: MeVuyelwa Vumendlini as ADG: Internasionale en Streeks- Ekonomiese Beleid, Nasionale Tesourie.
tgt: Ms Vuyelwa Vumendlini as DDG: International and Regional Economic Policy, National Treasury.

src: MnrJoseph Tebogo Leshope as Hoofbedryfsbeampte van SENTECMeVuyo Zitumane as Hoof Uitvoerende Beampte (HUB) van Amatola Water.
tgt: Mr Joseph Tebogo Leshope as Chief Operations Officer of SENTECMs Vuyo Zitumane as Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Amatola Water.

src: AdvSeeng Catherine Ntsaba-Letele as Hoofombudsman van die Gemeenskapskema-ombudsdiens.
tgt: Adv Seeng Catherine Ntsaba-Letele as Chief Ombud of the Community Schemes Ombud Service.

src: MnrEdward Mamadise as HUB van die Nasionale Reguleerder vir Verpligte Spesifikasies.
tgt: Mr Edward Mamadise as CEO of the National Regulator for Compulsory Specifications.

src: Dr Sagren Moodley as die verteenwoordiger van die DST op die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Natuurwetenskaplike Beroepe.
tgt: Dr Sagren Moodley as the representative from the DST on the South African Council for Natural Scientific Profssions.

src: Heraanstellings op die Patente-eksamenraad: a. MeShanaaz Tiry Mahomed b. MeSandra Cleiland c. ProfChristiena Maria van der Bank en d. AdvNhlanhla Paul Sibisi.
tgt: Reappointments to the Patent Examination Board:a. Ms Shanaaz Tiry Mahomedb.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 14 Maart 2018 by Tuynhuys in Kaapstad vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 14 March 2018, at Tuynhuys, Cape TownIssues in the environment.

src: Ekonomiese groei.
tgt: Economic growth.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die 1,3% ekonomiese groei in 2017.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the 1.3% growth in the economy in 2017.

src: Dit het toegeneem van 0,3% in 2016.
tgt: This is an increase from 0.3% in 2016.

src: Die feit dat die ekonomie onder moeilike omstandighede goed presteer het, dui op goeie ekonomiese vooruitsigte vir die toekoms.
tgt: The performance of the economy under difficult conditions bodes well for the country’s future economic prospects.

src: Die groeisyfers is ’n aanduiding dat die ekonomie op 'n opwaartse trajek is.
tgt: The growth figures signal that the economy is on an upward trajectory, with National Treasury expecting the economy to expand by 1.5% this year and accelerate to 2.1% in 2020.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle sektore van die samelewing om voort te bou op die positiewe momentum van 2017 en om saam met die regering te werk om sy planne te omskep in daadwerklike optrede, sodat ekonomiese groei gehandhaaf kan word en meer werk geskep word.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all sectors of society to build on the positive momentum of 2017, and work with government to translate its plans into concrete action to sustain economic growth and create jobs.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die goedgekeurde mosie om die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996 te wysig om die onteiening van grond sonder vergoeding toe te laat.
tgt: Land reform Cabinet welcomes the adopted motion to amend the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996 so as to allow for the expropriation of land without compensation.

src: Die regering het sedert 1994 hard gewerk om die nalatenskap van grondbesit onder kolonialisme en apartheid om te keer.
tgt: Government has since 1994 worked hard to reverse the legacy of land dispossession under colonialism and apartheid.

src: Binne die perke van die wet, het die regering heelwat gedoen om te verseker dat grond steeds produktief benut sal word, terwyl die herstelproses vir diegene wat deur grondonteiening geraak is, versnel word.
tgt: Working within the law, government has done much to ensure the continued productivity of the land, while speeding up the process of redress for those affected by land dispossessions.

src: Die saak is na die Grondwetlike Oorsigkomitee verwys, wat teen 30 Augustus 2018 aan die Parlement verslag moet doen.
tgt: The matter has been referred to the Constitutional Review Committee, which must report back to Parliament by 30 August 2018.

src: Die aanbevelings aan die Nasionale Vergadering sal beïnvloed word deur 'n reeks openbare verhore, gevolg deur komiteevergaderings.
tgt: The recommendations to the National Assembly will be informed by a series of public hearings followed by committee meetings.

src: Die Kabinet versoek alle belanghebbers om hul insette tydens hierdie gesprekvoeringsproses te lewer, aangesien dit sal help om die oplossings te vind wat ons land vorentoe sal neem.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all stakeholders to make their input during this process of engagement, which will guide the solutions to take our country forward.

src: As 'n sorgsame en mensgesentreerde regering sal alle belanghebbers tydens hierdie proses betrek word.
tgt: As a caring and people-centred government, all stakeholders will be engaged during this process.

src: Die Kabinet moedig gemeenskappe voorts aan om hulle nie skuldig te maak aan onwettige grondbesetting nie.
tgt: Cabinet further urges communities to desist from illegal land invasions.

src: Ons is 'n wetsgehoorsame en vredeliewende land en ons het voldoende maniere om kwessies te hanteer, insluitend grondkwessie.
tgt: We are a law-abiding and peace-loving country with adequate mechanisms of dealing with issues, including the land issue.

src: Suid-Afrika bly oop vir besigheid en ons verwelkom beleggings in landbou en boerdery.
tgt: South Africa remains open for business, and investments in agriculture and farming are welcomed.

src: Dit is in Suid-Afrika se belang om kommersiële boere te hê en hierdie proses kan verseker dat ons selfs meer suksesvolle kommersiële boere sal hê.
tgt: It is in South Africa's interests to have commercial farmers and this process can ensure we have even greater numbers of successful commercial farmers.

src: Nofingxana-gemeenskap se Double Drift Wildsboerdery-ekonomieprojek.
tgt: Nofingxana community’s Double Drift Wildlife Economy Project.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die Minister van Omgewingsake, Dr Edna Molewa, se bekendstelling van die Nofingxana-gemeenskap se Double Drift Wildsboerdery-ekonomieprojek by die Double Drift-natuurreservaat in die Oos-Kaap.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the Nofingxana community’s Double Drift Wildlife Economy Project, at Double Drift Nature Reserve in the Eastern Cape by the Minister of Environmental Affairs, Dr Edna Molewa.

src: Dit het die oordrag van die titelakte aan die Likhaya Lethu Gemeenskaplike Eiendomsvereniging (GEV) ingesluit namens die Minister van Landelike Ontwikkeling en Grondhervorming, me Maite Nkoana-Mashabane.
tgt: This included the handing over of the title deed to the Likhaya Lethu Communal Property Association (CPA) on behalf of the Minister of Rural Development and Land Reform, Ms Maite Nkoana-Mashabane.

src: Die Double Drift-gemeenskap is deur die Grondwet van 1913 van verblyf- en weidingsregte ontneem.
tgt: The Double Drift community was dispossessed of the residential and grazing rights by the 1913 Land Act.

src: In 1994 het hierdie gemeenskap 'n grondeis ingedien wat in 2012 afgehandel is en tot die Likhaya Lethu-GEV gelei het.
tgt: In 1994, this community lodged a land claim that was settled in 2012, resulting in Likhaya Lethu CPA being established.

src: Die Likhaya Lethu-GEV bestaan uit 1 500 lede van die Double Drift-gemeenskap en het R6 miljoen van die Departement van Omgewingsake ontvang om 'n wildsboerdery ekonomiese onderneming op die plaas Naudeshoek (1 400 hektaar) te ontwikkel.
tgt: The Likhaya Lethu CPA consists of 1 500 Double Drift Community members and received R6 million from the Department of Environmental Affairs to develop a wildlife economic business venture in the farm Naudeshoek (1 400 hectares).

src: Die transaksie is deur die Departement van Landelike Ontwikkeling en Grondhervorming verwerk.
tgt: The transaction was processed through the Department of Rural Development and Land Reform.

src: VBS Mutual Bank.
tgt: VBS Mutual Bank.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die Suid-Afrikaanse Reserwebank se aankondiging oor die VBS Mutual Bank.
tgt: Cabinet has noted the South African Reserve Bank announcement with regard to the VBS Mutual Bank.

src: Die kuratorskap wat aangestel is, sal die VBS Mutual Bank bystaan met die herstel van sy likiditeitsuitdagings en om die belange van die publiek en VBS-kliënte wat geld in die bank gedeponeer het te beskerm.
tgt: The appointed curatorship will support the VBS Mutual Bank to restore its liquidity challenges and serve the interests of the public and VBS depositors.

src: Die Kabinet bly verbind tot die diversifisering en transformasie van die finansiële sektor sonder om deposante se belange in gevaar te stel.
tgt: Cabinet remains committed to the diversification and transformation of the financial sector without jeopardising the interest of the depositors.

src: Beleggingsveldtog.
tgt: Investment campaign.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die 'CEOs Know'-veldtog deur Brand South Africa, in samewerking met Business Leadership South Africa, om Suid-Afrika as 'n beleggingsbestemming te bevorder.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the ‘CEOs Know’ campaign by Brand South Africa, in collaboration with Business Leadership South Africa, to promote South Africa as an investment destination.

src: Dit bou voort op ons wêreldklas-infrastruktuur deur InvestSA se One-Stop Shop, navorsings- en ontwikkelingsvermoëns, innovasie en 'n gevestigde vervaardigingsgrondslag om beleggers te ondersteun.
tgt: This builds on our world-class infrastructure through InvestSA One-Stop Shop, research and development capabilities, innovation and an established manufacturing base to support investors.

src: Nuwe groeigebiede is ook bekendgestel in die oseaan-ekonomie, hernubare energie, die groen ekonomie en skaalgas-eksplorasie.
tgt: New growth areas have also been opened in the oceans economy, renewable energy, the green economy and shale-gas exploration.

src: Die veldtog betrek ook uitvoerende hoofde van multinasionale korporasies wat in Suid-Afrika gebaseer wat hul insigte oor volgehoue belegging in Suid-Afrika deel.
tgt: The campaign features CEOs from multinational corporations based in South Africa sharing their insights on continued investment in South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet moedig alle Suid-Afrikaners aan om in die gees van "Thuma Mina" (Stuur My) wat oor ons land spoel, bydraes te lewer deur hul positiewe stories te deel om ons land se reputasie op te bou en sy beleggingstrekkrag te bevorder.
tgt: Cabinet encourages all South Africans in the spirit of “Thuma Mina” (Send Me) sweeping across our nation to play their part by sharing their positive stories to build our country’s reputation and grow its investment appeal.

src: Onafhanklike Kragprodusente- (IPPs) verkrygingsprogram.
tgt: Independent Power Producers (IPPs) Procurement Programme.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die hooggeregshofsaak wat deur twee nie-regeringsorganisasies aanhangig gemaak is ten opsigte van die regering se besluit om ’n kragaankoop-ooreenkoms met 27 IPP's te onderteken.
tgt: Cabinet has noted the High Court case filed by two non-governmental organisations regarding government’s decision to sign the power purchase agreements with 27 IPPs.

src: Die saak sal op 27 Maart 2018 deur die Hooggeregshof afgehandel word.
tgt: The matter will be concluded by the High Court on 27 March 2018.

src: In die gees van grondwetlikheid en die oppergesag van die reg word die ondertekening uitgestel.
tgt: In the spirit of constitutionalism and the rule of law, the signing has been postponed.

src: Die Kabinet bevestig sy verbintenis om die aangeleenthede rakende hierdie programme op te los.
tgt: Cabinet affirms the commitment to resolve the matters around these programmes.

src: Die Program vir die Aankoop van Hernubare Energie van Onafhanklike Kragprodusente sal verseker dat verbruikers in ons land toegang tot kostedoeltreffende en skoon energie het, en sal broodnodige belegging na Suid-Afrika lok.
tgt: The Renewable Energy Independent Power Producer Procurement Programme will ensure that consumers in our country have access to cost-efficient and clean energy, and will bring much-needed investment in South Africa.

src: Hierdie projekte sal 61 600 voltydse werksgeleenthede verskaf, waarvan 95% vir Suid-Afrikaanse burgers bestem sal wees en spesifiek op die jeug gemik sal wees.
tgt: These projects will provide 61 600 full-time jobs, 95% of which are for South African citizens, specifically targeting the youth.

src: Die Kabinet bevestig sy verbintenis tot 'n soliede openbare-private vennootskap terwyl ons die land se toekomstige energie-oorgangsdoelwitte en 'n beter lewe vir almal nastreef.
tgt: Cabinet reaffirms its commitment to a solid public-private partnership as we pursue our energy transition objectives of the future and a better life for all.

src: Dit is noodsaaklik vir skep van broodnodige beleid en regulatoriese sekerheid, en om Suid-Afrika se posisie as 'n energie-beleggingsbestemming van keuse te behou.
tgt: This is needed to bring much-needed policy and regulatory certainty, and maintain South Africa’s position as an energy investment destination of choice.

src: Listeriose.
tgt: Listeriosis.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy opregte medelye oor aan die vriende en familie van mense wat gesterf het weens Listeriose en wens diegene wat daarvan herstel spoedige beterskap toe.
tgt: Cabinet extends its heartfelt condolences to the friends and family of those who lost their lives after contracting Listeriosis, and wishes those who are recuperating a speedy recovery.

src: Dit het die lewens van meer as 180 mense geëis en altesaam 940 gevalle is in Suid-Afrika aangemeld.
tgt: More than 180 people died and 940 cases were reported in South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet is bemoedig deur die intensiewe pogings van die Departement van Gesondheid, die Nasionale Instituut vir Oordraagbare Siektes (NICD) en die Wêreldgesondheidsorganisasie om te keer dat die Listeria-bakterie versprei word.
tgt: Cabinet is encouraged by the intensive efforts by the Department of Health, the National Institute for Communicable Diseases (NICD) and the World Health Organisation to stop the listeria bacteria from spreading.

src: Om hierdie pogings te versterk, sal die Minister van Gesondheid, dr Aaron Motsoaledi, Donderdag 15 Maart 2018 met die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad op Verpleging vergader.
tgt: To further strengthen these efforts, the Minister of Health, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi, will meet with the South African Nursing Council on Thursday, 15 March 2018.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die positiewe vordering wat gemaak is om die bron van die dodelike Listeria-bakterie te identifiseer en te isoleer.
tgt: Cabinet acknowledges that the positive progress made in identifying and isolating the source of the deadly Listeriosis outbreak.

src: Die herroeping van voedselprodukte uit drie Enterprise- en Rainbow-vleisverwerkingsaanlegte – waar die bakterie gevind is – was 'n bepalende stap om te voorkom dat dit verder versprei.
tgt: The subsequent recall of food products from three Enterprise and Rainbow meat processing plants – where the bacteria was found – was a defining moment to stop the outbreak.

src: Die siekte, wat deur voedsel versprei word, is vir die eerste keer in Junie 2017 geïdentifiseer.
tgt: The food-borne disease was first identified in June 2017.

src: Listeriose is 'n ernstige en voorkombare siekte wat suksesvol met antibiotika behandel kan word.
tgt: Listeriosis is a serious and preventable illness that can be treated successfully with antibiotics.

src: Mese wat die grootste risiko loop om dit op te doen, is swanger vroue, baie jong babas, bejaardes en mense met 'n verswakte immuunstelsel.
tgt: Those most at risk are pregnant women, very young infants, elderly persons and people with a weakened immune system.

src: Mese wat simptome van koors, spierpyn, naarheid of diarree toon, moet hul mediese praktisyn of plaaslike kliniek dadelik raadpleeg.
tgt: People who show symptoms of fever, muscle aches, nausea or diarrhoea should visit their medical practitioner or local clinic immediately.

src: Die Kabinet is optimisties dat Suid-Afrika die siekte nou in bedwang sal kan hou en doen ’n beroep op die publiek om die vyf voedselveiligheidsreëls gedurende hierdie tyd na te kom:Was jou hande met seep en water voordat jy met voedsel werk en nadat jy toiletgeriewe gebruik hetMaak kos deeglik gaar en moenie halfgekookte kos eet nie, aangesien die Listeria-bakterie doodgaan wanneer kos goed gaar gemaak wordMoenie rou en gekookte kos saam hanteer nieHou kos by toepaslike temperature enMaak seker dat alle melkprodukte gepasteuriseer is of ten minste gekook word, en was voedsel wat nie gekook is nie met skoon lopende water voor inname of ten minste met voorafgekookte water.
tgt: Cabinet is optimistic that South Africa will defeat the current outbreak and urges all people to observe the five food safety rules during this time:Wash hands with soap and water before handling food, and after using a bathroomCook food thoroughly and do not eat half-cooked food as the Listeria bacteria will die when food is well cookedDo not handle raw and cooked food togetherKeep food at appropriate temperatures andMake sure that all milk products are pasteurised or at least parboiled and wash non-cooked food with clean running water before ingestion or at least with pre-boiled water.

src: Mese wat onseker is oor enige aspekte van Listeriose, kan die NICD skakel by 011 386 Maatskaplike toelaes.
tgt: Those with any uncertainty related to Listeriosis may contact the NICD on 011 386 Social grants.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die Suid-Afrikaanse Agentskap vir Maatskaplike Sekerheid (SASSA) se gereedheid om die hibriede model vir die verspreiding van maatskaplike toelaes aan begunstigdes vanaf 1 April 2018 te gebruik.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the state of readiness by the South African Social Security Agency (SASSA) to provide the hybrid model in the distribution of social grants to beneficiaries on 1 April 2018.

src: Dit is in ooreenstemming met die Grondwetlike Hof se uitspraak wat die huidige kontrak met Cash Paymaster Services (CPS) tot en met 31 Maart 2018 verleng.
tgt: This is in line with the Constitutional Court (ConCourt) judgement that ordered the extension of the current contract with the Cash Paymaster Services (CPS) up until 31 March 2018.

src: Die huidige SASSA-kaarte bly geldig tot Desember 2018.
tgt: The current SASSA cards remain valid until December 2018.

src: Die proses om die kaarte te verander sal op 'n naatlose wyse gedoen word wat nie die betaling van toelaes sal ontwrig nie.
tgt: The process of changing the beneficiary cards will be done in a seamless manner that will not disrupt the payment of grants.

src: Alle begunstigdes sal hulle toelaes deur hul onderskeie betaalpunte ontvang, wat kommersiële banke, die Suid-Afrikaanse Poskantoor (SAPO) en ander kleinhandelaars insluit.
tgt: All beneficiaries who receive their grants through their respective paypoints which includes commercial banks, South African Post Office (SAPO) and other retailers.

src: Die Kabinet bedank saam met die Onafhanklike Verkiesingskommissie (OVK) en President Cyril Ramaphosa alle Suid-Afrikaners wat gehoor gegee het aan die versoek om gedurende die afgelope naweek se kieserregistrasieveldtog te registreer om te stem of hul adresbesonderhede te hersien.
tgt: Cabinet has instructed the SASSA, together with the Government Communication and Information System (GCIS), to do everything possible to inform all the beneficiaries of any possible changes that may take place in the process of transition from CPS to the new hybrid model.

src: Die OVK het bekend gemaak dat die kiesersrol nou op 26 250 939 kiesers staan, wat volgens Statistieke Suid-Afrika se beramings vir mense van stemgeregtigde ouderdom, gelykstaande is aan 75% van die stemgeregtigde bevolking.
tgt: Of the 2.76 million plus voters who visited their voting stations:Just over million re-registered in their current voting districtMore than 800 000 changed their registration to a new voting districtAlmost 500 000 were voters registering for the first timeOf the new votes registrations, 82% were under the age of 30 and approximately 54% were womenGauteng saw the most new registrations at 23.69%, followed by KwaZulu-Natal with 18.78% and Limpopo with 17.03%.

src: Sowat 300 000 burgers wat stemlokale besoek het, is onder die bykans 2,8 miljoen kiesers vir wie die OVK voor die naweek nie adresse gehad het nie.
tgt: The Eastern Cape had the highest level of registration at 87%, followed by the Free State at just over 82%, and KwaZulu-Natal, Limpopo and Northern Cape at 79% respectively.

src: Onder leiding van die Minister van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake, Zweli Mkhize, het die regering 'n nasionale ramptoestand verklaar om die land se droogte- en waterkrisis te hanteer.
tgt: Cabinet joins the Minister of Sport and Recreation, Ms Thokozile Xasa, in denouncing the barbaric act of violence against a young triathlete, Mhlengi Gwala, who was attacked with a chainsaw while cycling in KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Die Kabinet spreek sy waardering uit teenoor alle Suid-Afrikaners wat steeds water bespaar, sowel as teenoor die Interministeriële Komitee oor Droogte wat in samewerking met belanghebbers op alle vlakke van die regering en die samelewing meedoënlose pogings aanwend om die voortdurende droogtetoestande wat verskeie dele van die land teister, te hanteer.
tgt: Cabinet wishes the athlete a speedy recovery and extends a warm thank you to the medical team of St Augustine Hospital who are caring for him.

src: Hoewel Suid-Afrika 'n waterskaars land is, is die Kabinet vol vertroue dat ons steeds 'n voorkeurbestemming vir toeriste is.
tgt: Crime has no place in our society and Cabinet calls on communities to work together with law-enforcement agencies to bring the criminals to book.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wetsontwerp op die iKamva Nasionale e-Vaardigheidsinstituut (iNeSI) van 2018 in die Parlement ter tafel gelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Prevention and Combating of Hate Crimes and Hate Speech Bill of 2018 into Parliament.

src: Die wetsontwerp maak voorsiening vir die vestiging van iNeSI as 'n regsentiteit met sy eie wetgewing om die kapasiteitsuitdagings van e-vaardighede (digitale vaardighede) in die land aan te pak.
tgt: The Bill aims to create the offences of hate crimes and hate speech, and to put in place measures to prevent and combat these offences.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wetsontwerp op Hidrografie van 2018 aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the iKamva National e-Skills Institute (iNeSI) Bill of 2018 to be submitted to Parliament.

src: Die wetsontwerp is daarop gerig om wetgewende status en erkenning te verleen aan die Hidrografiekantoor, wat sedert die ontstaan van hidrografiese dienste in Suid-Afrika in die Departement van Verdediging (Suid-Afrikaanse Vloot), bestaan het.
tgt: The Bill provides for the establishment of iNeSI as a legal entity with its own legislation to address e-skills (digital skills) capacity challenges in the country.

src: Dit is in ooreenstemming met die Internasionale Maritieme Organisasie en die Internasionale Konvensie vir die Veiligheid van Lewe op see, wat 'n internasionale maritieme verdrag is wat minimum veiligheidstandaarde vasstel in die bou, toerusting en bedryf van handelskepe.
tgt: The Bill seeks to recognise and grant legislative status to the Office of the Hydrographer, which has been in existence in the Department of Defence (South African Navy) since the inception of hydrographic services in South WEBTOKEN will enable the Hydrographer of the South African Navy to be recognised as the National Hydrographer.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Meseregtemaand/-dagDie tema vir die herdenking van 2018 se Nasionale Meseregtemaand/-dag is: "Die jaar van Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela: bevordering en versterking van 'n menseregte-kultuur regdeur die samelewing".Die nasionale geleentheid vind plaas op 21 Maart 2018 by die George Thabe-krieketveld, Sharpeville in Vereeniging.
tgt: Human Rights Month/DayThe 2018 National Human Rights Month/Day commemorations will be held under the theme: “The year of Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela: promoting and deepening a human rights culture across society”.The national event will take place on 21 March 2018 at George Thabe Cricket Pitch, Sharpeville in Vereeniging.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle sektore van die samelewing om deel te neem aan hierdie nasionale dag wat Suid-Afrika se menseregte-tradisie vier en mense soos Madiba vereer, wat die hoogste prys betaal het en opofferings gemaak het vir die vryheid wat ons vandag geniet.
tgt: Cabinet urges all sectors to pay homage to this national day, which celebrates South Africa’s human rights tradition and honours people such as Madiba who paid the ultimate price and sacrificed for the achievement of liberation and freedom that we enjoy today.

src: Nasionale Imbizo-fokusweekDie Nasionale Imbizo-fokusweek vind vanjaar van 9 tot 15 April 2018 plaas onder die tema: "Saam beweeg ons Suid-Afrika vorentoe."
tgt: National Imbizo Focus WeekThe National Imbizo Focus Week will take place from 9 to 15 April 2018 under the theme: “Together we move South Africa forward”.

src: Hierdie jaar vorm die Mandela-eeufeesviering 'n groot deel van die fokusweek onder die subtema: "Wees die nalatenskap".
tgt: This year, the Mandela Centenary celebration forms a big part of the focus week, under the sub-theme: “Be the legacy”.

src: Die Uitvoerende Bestuur sal met gemeenskappe in verskillende dele van die land gesprek voer.
tgt: The Executive will be engaging with communities in various parts of the country.

src: Die onderskeie ministers se programme sal binnekort bekend gemaak word.
tgt: The respective programmes of Ministers will be communicated in due course.

src: Jeugindiensneming President Ramaphosa sal na verwagting die Jeug-indiensnemingsinisiatief op 27 Maart 2018 by die Riversands Incubation Hub in Diepsloot bekendstel.
tgt: Youth employment President Ramaphosa is expected to launch the pilot of the Youth Employment Services initiative at the Riversands Incubation Hub in Diepsloot on 27 March 2018.

src: Die inisiatief, in samewerking met die private sektor, beoog om die volgende vyf jaar een miljoen jongmense te bemagtig om ekonomies aktief te word, hetsy as lede van die werksmag, of om hul eie ondernemings te bedryf, of om hul passie vir verdere studie uit te leef.
tgt: The initiative, in collaboration with the private sector, aims to empower one million young people over the next five years to become economically active, either as a member of the workforce or running their own businesses or finding their passion for further study.

src: Werksbesoeke aan Mosambiek en ZimbabwePresident Ramaphosa sal op Saterdag 17 Maart 2018 werksbesoeke na die Republiek van Mosambiek en die Republiek van Zimbabwe onderneem.
tgt: Working visits to Mozambique and ZimbabwePresident Ramaphosa will undertake working visits to the Republic of Mozambique and Republic of Zimbabwe respectively on Saturday, 17 March 2018.

src: Die besoeke sal hoofsaaklik fokus op die versterking van bilaterale verhoudinge met albei lande.
tgt: The visits will mainly focus on strengthening bilateral relations with the abovementioned countries.

src: Die President sal ook gesprek voer oor vrede en sekuriteit in die streek en die vasteland, en verder beraadslaag oor globale kwessies van gemeenskaplike belangBoodskappe.
tgt: The President will also exchange views on peace and security matters in the region and the continent, and further deliberate on global issues of mutual interest.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense oor aan Ntsiki Biyela, Suid-Afrika se eerste swart vroulike wynmaker, wat pas haar eie handelsmerk bekend gestel het.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates Ntsiki Biyela, South Africa’s first black woman winemaker who launched her own brand.

src: Sy het 'n graad in wingerdbou aan die Universiteit van Stellenbosch behaal, waarná sy 13 jaar werkservaring in die bedryf opgedoen het.
tgt: With a degree in viticulture from Stellenbosch University plus 13 years’ working experience, her Aslina Wines will in 2018 sell 12 000 bottles in the United States of America, Germany, Taiwan and Ghana.

src: Sy sal vanjaar 12 000 bottels van haar Aslina-wyne na die Verenigde State van Amerika, Duitsland, Taiwan en Ghana uitvoer.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates Caster Semenya on breaking the South African 1 000m record that stood for 35 years at the Athletix Grand Prix meeting held at Tuks in Pretoria.

src: Die Kabinet wens Caster Semenya geluk dat sy die Suid-Afrikaanse 1 000m-rekord wat reeds 35 jaar staan, tydens die Athletix Grand Prix-byeenkoms by Tuks in Pretoria, gebreek het.
tgt: Our golden girl won the race in a time of 2:35:44, beating the old record set in 1983 by Ilze Wicksell by almost two seconds.

src: Ons goue meisie het die wedren met 'n tyd van 2:35:44 gewen, waarmee sy die ou rekord wat in 1983 deur Ilze Wicksell opgestel is, met amper twee sekondes verbeter het.
tgt: Cabinet also commends Semenya for fulfilling her long-held goal to get a university qualification when she completed her Diploma in Sports Science at the North-West University in Potchefstroom.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy medelye oor aan die vriende en familie van die parlementslid me Loliwe Fazeka, wat verlede week in 'n motorongeluk in die Oos-Kaap gesterf het.
tgt: Cabinet expresses condolences to the friends and family of Honourable Member of Parliament, Ms Loliwe Fazeka, who was killed in a car crash in the Eastern Cape, last week.

src: Die Kabinet dra ook sy medelye oor aan die geliefdes van Suid-Afrika se Ambassadeur in Swede, me Faith Radebe, wat op Dinsdag 13 Maart 2018 oorlede is.
tgt: Cabinet also sends condolences to the loved ones of South Africa’s Ambassador to Sweden, Ms Faith Radebe, who passed on Tuesday, 13 March 2018.

src: Sy was voorheen die Inspekteur-Generaal van Intelligensiedienste in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: She was previously the Inspector-General of Intelligence in South Africa.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die toepaslike klaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Dr Philemon Mjwara as Direkteur-generaal van die Departement van Wetenskap en Tegnologie vir 'n verlengde kontraktydperk van drie jaar, wat op 1 April 2018 begin.
tgt: Dr Philemon Mjwara as Director-General of the Department of Science and Technology for an extended contract period of three years, commencing on 1 April Ms Memme Sejosengwe as Secretary-General at the Office of the Chief Justice for an extended contract period of three years, effective from 1 April Ms Thuli E Radebe, as Executive Director at the Centre of Public Service Innovation for an extended contract period of six months.

src: MeMeme Sejosengwe as Sekretaris-Generaal in die Kantoor van die Hoofregter vir 'n verlengde kontraktydperk van drie jaar, met ingang van 1 April MeThuli E Radebe, as Uitvoerende Direkteur by die Sentrum vir Openbare Dienste Innovasie vir 'n verlengde kontraktydperk van ses maande.
