tgt: Mr Thilivhali Archibald Ramawa as the Chief Financial Officer of the National Electronic Media Institute of South Africa.

src: MnrThilivhali Archibald Ramawa as Hoof Finansiële Beampte van die Nasionale Instituut vir Elektroniese Meia van Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Board of Sentech SOC Limited:a. Mr Magatho Mello (reappointment as non-executive director and Chairperson)b. Mr Lumko Mtimde (reappointment as non-executive director)c. Dr Sandile Malinga (non-executive director) andd.

src: Raad van Sentech SOC Beperk:a. MnrMagatho Melo (heraanstelling as Nie-uitvoerende Direkteur en Voorsitter)b. MnrLumko Mtimde (heraanstelling as Nie-uitvoerende Direkteur)c. Dr Sandile Malinga (Nie-uitvoerende Direkteur) en\d.
tgt: Ms Elizabeth Malaka (non-executive director).

src: MeElizabeth Malaka (Nie-uitvoerende Direkteur).
tgt: Board of Broadband Infraco:a. Mr Mandla Ngcobo (reappointment as non-executive director and Chairperson)b. Ms Nokuthula Selamolela (reappointment as non-executive director)c. Mr Gift Mphefu (non-executive director)d. Ms Zandile Matilda Kabini (non-executive director) ande.

src: Raad van Broadband Infraco:a. Mnr Mandla Ngcobo (heraanstelling as Nie-uitvoerende Direkteur en Voorsitter)b. MeNokuthula Selamolela (heraanstelling as Nie-uitvoerende Direkteur)c. MnrGift Mphefu (Nie-uitvoerende Direkteur)d. Me Zandile Matilda Kabini (Nie-uitvoerende Direkteur) ene.
tgt: Ms Jennifer Schreiner (non-executive director).

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 25 April 2018 by Tuynhuys, Kaapstad, vergaderKwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 25 April 2018, at Tuynhuys, Cape TownIssues in the environment.

src: Begrafnisse van staatmakerleiers en veterane Die Kabinet bedank almal regoor die wêreld, veral Suid-Afrikaners, vir hul gulhartige reaksie met die afsterwe ‘imbokodo’ Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, die vryheidstrydleier dr Zola Skweyiya en die vakbondleier Archie Sibeko.
tgt: Cabinet thanks all people around the world, especially South Africans, for their warm and generous response in the wake of the passing of ‘imbokodo’ Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Struggle stalwart Dr Zola Skweyiya and trade unionist Archie Sibeko.

src: Ons leiers het hul lewens aan die droom van ’n beter Suid-Afrika gewy, en ons landgenote word deur hul strewes geïnspireer.
tgt: Our stalwarts dedicated their lives to the dream of a better South Africa and our countrymen and women are drawing inspiration from their struggles.

src: Die Kabinet sluit hom ook aan by President Cyril Ramaphosa in sy huldeblyk aan die afgestorwe veteraandiplomaat, Ambassadeur George Nene, wat Suid-Afrika met onderskeiding en toewyding gedien het tydens sy ballingskap ter mobilisering van ons streek en vasteland om die bevryding van Suid-Afrika te verseker.
tgt: Cabinet also joins President Cyril Ramaphosa in paying tribute to the late Veteran diplomat, Ambassador George Nene, who served South Africa with distinction and dedication during his period in exile in mobilising our region and continent to secure the liberation of South Africa.

src: Protesoptrede in Noordwes Die Kabinet het beraadslaag oor die onstabiele situasie wat in Noordwes ontwikkel het en ’n aantal dienste negatief beïnvloed het, in die besonder gesondheidsdienste.
tgt: Cabinet deliberated on the unstable situation that has unfolded in North West, which has affected a number of services, particularly health services.

src: As ’n sorgsame regering het die Kabinet twee onmiddellike ingrypings goedgekeur om orde en stabiliteit in die gebied te herstel.
tgt: As a caring government, Cabinet has approved two immediate interventions to restore order and stability in the area.

src: Die Kabinet keur die aktivering van Artikel 100(1) van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996 goed om die klaarblyklike krisis die hoof te bied, veral in die gesondheidsektor.
tgt: Cabinet approved the invoking of Section 100(1) of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996 to address the apparent crisis, particularly in the health sector.

src: Die vernaamste doelwit van hierdie ingryping sal wees om:vertroue en gerustheid tussen die arbeidsektor en die regering te hersteldie provinsie te help om sy stelsels en bekwaamhede tot ’n nuwe normaliteit op te gradeerte verseker dat daar voldoen word aan die wetgewende en regulerende regeringsraamwerkdie arbeidsomgewing te stabiliseer, volhoubare dienslewering te herstel, personeel se veiligheid te verseker en finansiële bestuur te verbeter.
tgt: The main objective of this intervention will be to:restore trust and confidence between labour and governmentassist the province to upgrade its systems and capabilities to a new normalityensure compliance with the legislative and regulatory framework of governmentstabilise the labour environment, restore sustainable service delivery, ensure security of staff and improve financial management.

src: Die Kabinet het ook ’n taakspan van ministers opdrag gegee om Noordwes te besoek om die feite op voetsoolvlak te bepaal.
tgt: Cabinet also mandated a task team of Ministers to visit North West to establish the facts on the ground.

src: Hulle sal na verwagting binne die volgende twee weke ’n verslag indien.
tgt: They are expected to submit a report in the next two weeks.

src: Die terugvoering sal help om te bepaal of enige verdere ingrypings nodig sal wees.
tgt: The report back will assist in determining any further interventions that may still be required.

src: Die taakspan bestaan uit die ministers van Beplanning, Monitering en Evaluering (Sameroeper) Gesondheid, Finansies Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake, asook die Groepering van Ministers van Justisie, Misdaadvoorkoming en Sekuriteit.
tgt: The Task Team comprises the Ministers of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation (Convener) Health Finance Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, as well as the Justice, Crime Prevention and Security Cluster of Ministers.

src: Hoewel die Kabinet kennis neem van die knelpunte wat deur die gemeenskappe geopper is, veroordeel dit die dade van geweld, plundery en vernietiging van eiendom wat in sommige dele van die provinsie met die protesoptrede gepaardgegaan het, ten sterkste.
tgt: Whilst noting the concerns that were raised by communities, Cabinet strongly condemns the acts of violence, looting and destruction of property that accompanied protests in some areas of the province.

src: Loononderhandelingsproses in die staatsdiensDie Kabinet is ingelig oor die huidige loononderhandelings in die staatsdiens.
tgt: Public sector wage negotiations.1 Cabinet was briefed on the current Public Service wage negotiations.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n ernsitge beroep op die Departement van Staatsdiens en Administrasie, sowel as die mandaatgewende komitee, om so gou moontlik ’n oplossing vir die dooiepunt oor die loononderhandelings te vind.
tgt: Cabinet urged the Department of Public Service and Administration together with the mandating committee to work expeditiously to resolve the impasse on the wage negotiations.

src: Busstaking Die Kabinet versoek alle belanghebbers in die openbare-vervoersektor om die nasionale busstaking spoedig te beëindig.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all stakeholders in the public transport sector to bring a speedy end to the national bus strike.

src: Ons doen ’n ernstige beroep op al die partye om na die onderhandelingstafel terug te keer en ’n ooreenkoms te bereik wat in die beste belang van al die partye en die land is.
tgt: We urge all parties to return to the negotiation table so as to reach an agreement that is in the best interest of all parties and the country.

src: Geweld by Moses Mabhida-stadion Die Kabinet veroordeel die sinnelose geweld en kwaadwillige beskadiging van eiendom deur sokkergeesdriftiges nadat vandale die afgelope naweek die sokkerveld by Durban se Moses Mabhida-stadion tydens ’n Premier Sokkerligawedstryd bestorm het.
tgt: Violence at Moses Mabhida Stadium.

src: Wetstoepassingsagentskappe word dringend versoek om te verseker dat diegene wat by boewery en gewelddadige optrede by die wedstryd betrokke was, vir hul optrede aanspreeklik gehou word.
tgt: Cabinet condemns the senseless violence and malicious damage to property by soccer fans following a pitch invasion at Durban’s Moses Mabhida Stadium during a Premier Soccer League game at the weekend.

src: Die Kabinet versoek ’n spoedige ondersoek en die implementering van strenger sekuriteitsmaatreëls om die veiligheid van toeskouers en beamptes te verseker.
tgt: Law-enforcement agencies are urged to ensure that all those involved in hooliganism and acts of violence at the match are held responsible for their actions.

src: Dit doen ’n dringende beroep op alle rolspelers om hul samewerking tydens ondersoeke te verleen om sulke optrede in die toekoms te voorkom.
tgt: It urges all role players to cooperate with investigations to prevent future occurrences.

src: Gemeenskapsradiostasies.
tgt: Community radio stations.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die ooreenkoms wat bereik is om 15 gemeenskapsradiostasies wat deur Sentech opgeskort is weens versuim om seinverspreidingsgelde te betaal, weer aan te skakel terwyl daar na meer volhoubare oplossings gesoek word.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the agreement reached to reconnect 15 community radio stations that were suspended by Sentech for non-payment of signal distribution fees, while more sustainable solutions are being sought.

src: Die ooreenkoms is bereik nadat die regering met Sentech, die Nasionale Gemeenskapsradioforum, die Agentskap vir Meia-ontwikkeling en -diversiteit en die Onafhanklike Kommunikasie-owerheid van Suid-Afrika vergader het.
tgt: The agreement was reached after government met with Sentech, the National Community Radio Forum, the Media Development and Diversity Agency and the Independent Communications Authority of South Africa.

src: Die gemeenskapsradiosektor is ’n broodnodige kommunikasieplatform wat aan ons mense toegang tot inligting bied en help om ’n ingeligte burgery te vestig.
tgt: The community radio sector is a critical communication platform that gives our people access to information and which serves as a means to creating an informed citizenry.

src: Alle partye het ingestem om binnekort te vergader en met ’n blywende oplossing vorendag te kom, wat tot die volhoubaarheid van hierdie stasies sal lei.
tgt: All parties have agreed to convene soon to come up with a long-lasting solution that will result in the sustainability of these stations.

src: Vergadering van die Leiers van die Gemenebeslande Die Kabinet verwelkom die goedkeuring van die Program van Aksie vir die Gemenebes vir die volgende twee jaar.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the adoption of the Programme of Action for the Commonwealth for the next two years.

src: President Ramaphosa het ’n Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging na die Vergadering van die leiers van die Gemenebeslande (CHOGM 2018) van 19 tot 20 April 2018 gelei onder die tema “Saam na ’n Gemeenskaplike Toekoms”.
tgt: President Ramaphosa led a South African Delegation to the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM 2018) under the theme: “Towards a Common Future” from 19 to 20 April 2018.

src: Om Suid-Afrika as een van die wêreld se voorste beleggingsbestemmings vir opkomende markte te posisioneer, het President Ramaphosa ook die Afrikaleiers se Rondetafelgesprek van die Gemenebes se Sakeforum toegespreek en met senior internasionale beleggers en sakeleiers gesprek gevoer.
tgt: In positioning South Africa as one of the world’s leading emerging market investment destination, President Ramaphosa also addressed the African Leaders’ Roundtable of the Commonwealth Business Forum, and engaged with senior international investors and business leaders.

src: Hy het ’n uitnodiging aan toonaangewende beleggers en sakeleiers gerig om Suid-Afrika se veelverwagte Beleggingsberaad later vanjaar by te woon.
tgt: He also extended an invitation to leading investors and leaders of business to attend South Africa’s much anticipated Investment Summit scheduled for later this year.

src: Onder leierskap van President Ramaphosa het die Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging ook die geleentheid wat deur die CHOGM gebied is gebruik om sy stemwerwery vir Suid-Afrika se kandidatuur vir die Verenigde Nasies (VN) se Veiligheidsraad vir die termyn 2019–2020 voort te sit.
tgt: Under the leadership of President Ramaphosa, the South African delegation also used the opportunity presented by the CHOGM to continue lobbying for South Africa’s candidature to the United Nations (UN) Security Council for the term 2019 – 2020.

src: Hierdie verkiesing is vir 8 Junie 2018 in New York in die VSA, geskeduleer.
tgt: These elections are scheduled for 8 June 2018 in New York, USInvestment.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom President Ramaphosa se aanstelling van vier buitengewone gesante vir die werwing van belegging om met sowel binnelandse as buitelandse beleggers oor ekonomiese geleenthede in Suid-Afrika in gesprek te tree.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes President Ramaphosa’s appointment of four special envoys on investment to engage both domestic and foreign investors around economic opportunities in South Africa.

src: Hierdie gesante het opdrag ontvang om belegging op ’n gefokusde en koste-doeltreffende manier te lok.
tgt: These envoys are mandated to attract investment in a focused and cost-effective manner.

src: Die beleggingsveldtog sal ’n hoogtepunt bereik in met ’n groot beleggingskonferensie aan die einde van die jaar om meer as R1 triljoen se nuwe beleggings binne ’n tydperk van vyf jaar te verkry.
tgt: The investment drive will culminate in a major investment conference towards the end of the year to raise more than R1 trillion in new investments over five years.

src: Bekendstelling van Gauteng se InvestSA Eenstopwinkel.
tgt: Launch of Gauteng’s InvestSA One-Stop Shop.

src: Die Kabinet moedig plaaslike en internasionale beleggers sterk aan om die Provinsiale Eenstopwinkels se beleggingsfasiliteite wat regoor die land bekend gestel word te gebruik – die nuutste een is Gauteng se Eenstopwinkel.
tgt: Cabinet strongly encourages local and international investors to use the Provincial One-Stop Shop investment facilities being launched around the country – the latest being Gauteng’s One-Stop Shop.

src: Die InvestSA Eenstopwinkel is ’n presidensiële program wat daarop gerig is om belegging in Suid-Afrika te bevorder en te fasiliteer.
tgt: The InvestSA One-Stop Shop is a presidential programme to promote and facilitate investment in South Africa.

src: Die InvestSA Eenstopwinkel is reeds suksesvol in KwaZulu-Natal en die Wes-Kaap geïmplementeer.
tgt: Already, the InvestSA One-Stop Shop has been successfully implemented in KwaZulu-Natal and the Western Cape.

src: Eenstopwinkel-beleggingsentrums word in al die provinsies gevestig en sal gebruik word om die spesiale ekonomiese sones, provinsiale beleggingsagentskappe, plaaslike owerhede en die betrokke regeringsdepartemente wat by kwessies rakende regulering, registrasie, permitte en lisensiëring betrokke is te koördineer en inkorporeer.
tgt: One-Stop Shop investment centres are being rolled out in all the provinces, and will be used to coordinate and incorporate the special economic zones, provincial investment agencies, local authorities and the relevant government departments involved in regulatory, registration, permits and licensing matters.

src: Nuwe Poskantoor-SASSA Posbankkaarte Die Kabinet verwelkom die suksesvolle loodsimplementering van die nuwe kaarte van die Suid-Afrikaanse Maatskaplike Sekerheidsagentskap (SASSA) by uitgesoekte poskantore in die Wes-Kaap, wat begunstigdes van maatskaplike toelaes in staat stel om bestaande kaarte vir die nuwe Suid-Afrikaanse Poskantoor (SAPO)-SASSA Posbankkaarte om te ruil.
tgt: New Post Office-SASSA Post Bank cards.

src: Ontvangers van maatskaplike toelaes en kaarthouers kan hul bestaande kaarte nog tot Desember 2018 gebruik, maar die Kabinet moedig begunstigdes aan om hulle ou kaarte vanaf 2 Me tot aan die einde van September 2018 by hul naaste SASSA of SAPO om te ruil.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the successful pilot roll-out of new South African Social Security Agency (SASSA) cards at selected post offices in the Western Cape to allow social-grant beneficiaries to swap existing cards for the new South African Post Office (SAPO)-SASSA Postbank cards.

src: Hoër onderwys Die Kabinet verwelkom die vordering wat gemaak word met die implementering van gratis onderwys, waarvan besonderhede deur die Minister van Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding bekend gemaak is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the progress being made in the implementation of free education as detailed by the Minister of Higher Education and Training.

src: Die aankondiging van ’n beduidende verhoging in die grondlyntoewysing aan NSFAS, naamlik van R9,849 miljard in 2017/18 tot R35,321 miljard in 2020/21, lewer bewys van die regering se verbintenis om studente uit arm en werkersklashuishoudings by te staan.
tgt: The announcement of a significant increase in baseline allocation to NSFAS from R9,849 billion 2017/18 to R35,321 billion in 2020/21 demonstrates Governments commitment to assisting students from poor and working class households.

src: KMMO-ondersteuningsprogam.
tgt: SMME Support Programme.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van die Ondersteuningsprogram vir die Bevrodering van Indiensneming deur Klein, Meium en Mikro-ondernemings (KMMO’s), wat ’n vennootskap tussen die Departement van Kleinsakeontwikkeling (DSBD) en die Europese Unie is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the Employment Promotion through the small, medium and micro-sized enterprise (SMME) Support Programme, which is a partnership between the Department of Small Business Development (DSBD) and the European Union.

src: Dit sal KMMO’s ondersteun deur sakeontwikkelingsdienste, hulp met toegang tot markte, verbeterde toegang tot finansiering, en hulp om die administratiewe en regulatoriese las op klein sakeondernemings te verlig.
tgt: It will support SMMEs through business development services, assist them with access to markets, improve their access to finance, and help ease the administrative and regulatory burden on small businesses.

src: Die Kabinet loof almal wat betrokke was by die verwesenliking van ZACUBE-2, Afrika se grootste en mees gevorderde kubussatelliet.
tgt: Cabinet commends all those involved in the realisation of ZACUBE-2, which is Africa’s largest and most advanced cube satellite.

src: Die 4 kg-ZACUBE-2 satelliet – wat deur die Kaapse Skiereiland Universiteit van Tegnologie (CPUT) en die Frans-Suid-Afrikaanse Instituut van Tegnologie ontwikkel is en deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Ruimteagentskap bestuur word – is deur die Departement van Wetenskap en Tegnologie befonds.
tgt: The 4kg ZACUBE-2 satellite – which was developed by the Cape Peninsula University of Technology (CPUT) and the French South African Institute of Technology, and managed by the South African National Space Agency – was funded by the Department of Science and Technology.

src: Dit is die tweede nano-satelliet wat by die CPUT ontwikkel is.
tgt: It is the second nanosatellite to be developed at the CPUThe cube satellite has been sent to India for launching into space.

src: Dit sal help om data in te samel om ekonomiese groei in die oseane-ekonomie te ontsluit.
tgt: It will help gather data to unlock economic growth in the oceans economy.

src: Die nano-satelliet sal help om in die behoeftes van die Operasie Phakisa Oseane-ekonomieprogram te voorsien en sal ook help om mariene aktiwiteit langs Suid-Afrika se kus te monitor en bosbrande proaktief te bespeur.
tgt: The nanosatellite will assist in addressing the needs of the Operation Phakisa Oceans Economy programme and also help track marine activity along South Africa’s coast and proactively detect forest fires.

src: KwaZulu-Natal Mynbou-indaba.
tgt: KwaZulu-Natal Mining Indaba.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die uitslae van die tweedaagse KwaZulu-Natal Mynbou-indaba, waar afgevaardigdes beraadslaag het oor kwessies wat sal help om die sektor te transformeer en mynbouverwante waardekettinggeleenthede in die provinsie te ontsluit.
tgt: Cabinet welcome the outcome of the two-day KwaZulu-Natal Mining Indaba, where delegates deliberated on issues that will help in transforming the sector and unlock mining value-chain opportunities in the province.

src: Mynwese is een van die sleutelsektore wat ons kan help om ons ekonomie te transformeer en die Kabinet het ’n beroep op mynmaatskappye, arbeid en gemeenskappe gedoen om verhoudings te versterk ten einde volhoubare mynwese te bevorder.
tgt: Mining is one of the key sectors that can assist us to transform our economy and Cabinet has called on the mining companies, labour and communities to strengthen relations in order for mining to be sustainable.

src: KabinetsbesluiteDie Kabinet keur die Moniterings- en Evalueringsraamwerk vir die Nasionale Jeugbeleid (NYP) 2015–2020 goed.
tgt: Cabinet decisions Cabinet approved the Monitoring and Evaluation Framework for the National Youth Policy (NYP) 2015-2020.

src: Die raamwerk maak voorsiening vir toerekenbaarheid en doeltreffendheid ter bereiking van die NYP 2020-doelwitte.
tgt: The framework provides for accountability and efficiency in the achievement of the NYP 2020 objectives.

src: Die beleid is gerig op die verbetering van prestasie en dienslewering, veral in die jeugprogramme.
tgt: The policy aims to improve performance and enhance service delivery, particularly to the programmes of the youth.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring om as gasheer op te tree van die Jaarlikse Afrika-maand se program in Me 2018 onder die tema “’n Jaar van Nelson Mandela – Bou ’n Beter Afrika en ’n Beter Wêreld”.
tgt: Cabinet approved the hosting of the Annual Africa Month Programme for May 2018 under the theme: “A Year of Nelson Mandela – Building a Better Africa and a Better World”.

src: Gedurende Me-maand word die prestasies wat met die ontwikkeling van Afrika gemaak is gevier.
tgt: The month of May celebrates the achievements made in the development of Africa.

src: Die gebeure bereik ’n hoogtepunt met Afrika-dag op 25 Me ’n dag wat deur die Afrika-Unie verklaar is en in Afrika gevier word.
tgt: The events culminate in Africa Day on 25 May, which is a day declared by the African Union and celebrated in Africa.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die verslag en tussenkomste wat gemaak is oor die status van seksuele uitbuiting, mishandeling en ernstige wangedrag teen die ontplooide lede van die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Weermag (SANW) wat die VN se Stabiliseringsmissie in die Demokratiese Republiek van die Kongo ondersteun.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the report and interventions made on the status of sexual exploitation, abuse and serious misconduct cases against the deployed South African National Defence Force (SANDF) members that support the UN Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

src: Hoewel die Kabinet tevrede is met die tussenkomste wat gemaak is om hierdie vergrype te hanteer, veroordeel dit in die sterkste moontlike terme enige vorm van seksuele mishandeling en wangedrag deur die SANW-lede in die missie-gebiede.
tgt: Whilst Cabinet was satisfied with interventions made in addressing these abuses, it condemns in the strongest possible terms any form of sexual abuse and acts of misconduct by the SANDF members in the mission areas.

src: ’n Span is ontplooi om al die aangemelde bewerings te ondersoek.
tgt: A team was deployed to investigate all the reported allegations.

src: Hoewel sommige van die sake reeds gefinaliseer is, is ander reeds in die stadium van militêre verhore.
tgt: Although some of the cases have been finalised, others are already at the stage of military trials.

src: Al hierdie ondersoeke is op ’n deursigtige en verantwoordbare manier deur die militêre regsproses hanteer.
tgt: All these investigations have been conducted through the military legal process in a transparent and accountable manner.

src: Suid-Afrika sal soos gewoonlik in die toekoms ook vinnig reageer om sulke voorvalle te hanteer.
tgt: South Africa will as usual continue to react swiftly when dealing with such incidences.

src: Swak dissipline en misdadige gedrag in die geledere van die SANW word verag en sal nie geduld word nie.
tgt: Ill-discipline and criminal behaviour in the ranks of the SANDF is despised and will not be tolerated.

src: Diegene wat aan oortredings skuldig bevind word sal ingevolge die Gedragskode en Militêre Dissiplinêre Kode gestraf word.
tgt: Those found to have transgressed will be dealt with through the Code of Conduct and Military Disciplinary Code.

src: Die Kabinet steun verder die finalisering van die Wetsontwerp op Militêre Dissiplinêre Optrede, wat gerig is op algehele dissipline in die SANW, met inbegrip van die versterking van die definisie van seksuele uitbuiting en die verhoging van die minimum straf tot 10 jaar.
tgt: Cabinet further supported the finalisation of the Military Disciplinary Bill, which seeks to deal with overall discipline in the SANDF, including strengthening the definition of sexual exploitation and the minimum sanction increased to 10 years.

src: Die Kabinet keur die publikasie van die Wetsontwerp op die Beheer van Tabakprodukte en Elektroniese-leweringstelsels van 2017 in die Staatskoerant vir openbare kommentaar goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the publication of the Control of Tobacco Products and Electronic Delivery Systems Bill of 2017 in the Government Gazette for public comments.

src: Die Wetsontwerp herroep die Wet op die Beheer van Tabakprodukte, 1993 (Wet 83 van 1993) met die oog op die bevordering van openbare gesondheid en om die Suid-Afrikaanse tabakbeheerwetgewing te belyn met die Wêreldgesondheidsorganisasie se Raamwerkkonvensie oor Tabakbeheer.
tgt: The Bill repeals the Tobacco Products Control Act, 1993 (Act 83 of 1993) so as to promote public health and to align the South African tobacco control law with the World Health Organisation Framework Convention on Tobacco Control.

src: Dit dek sleutelkwessies met betrekking tot binnenshuise openbare areas, uitstalling van tabakprodukte by verkoopspunte, die gebruik van elektroniese toestelle en die instelling van ongemerkte verpakking van tabakprodukte.
tgt: It addresses key areas relating to indoor public areas, display of tobacco products at point of sale, use of electronic devices and the introduction of plain packaging of tobacco products.

src: Die Kabinet keur die publikasie van die Geïntegreerde Raamwerkwetsontwerp van 2018 in die Staatskoerant vir openbare kommentaar goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the publication of the Integrated Framework Bill of 2018 to be published in the Government Gazette for public comments.

src: Die Wetsontwerp is daarop gerig om gekoördineerde en geïntegreerde beplanning oor alle sfere van die regering heen te bereik, wat onderling versterkend is en op ’n samehangende manier die meer doeltreffende implementering van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP) sal bevorder.
tgt: The Bill seeks to achieve coordinated and integrated planning across all spheres of government, which are mutually reinforcing and work cohesively to promote more effective implementation of the National Development Plan (NDP).Institutionalising planning is in line with the NDP and seeks to give effect to the commitment in the Medium Term Strategic Framework 2014-2019 to establish mechanisms and capacity within the State to undertake long-term development planning.

src: Dit sal ’n meer gekoördineerde en deelnemende Staat bevorder, wat die strukturele veranderings wat vir inklusiewe groei benodig word meer doeltreffend sal bevorder.
tgt: It will promote a more coordinated and responsive State that would be more effective in promoting the structural changes required for inclusive growth, and for developing the country’s human resource base and a stronger democracy.

src: VryheidsdagDie Kabinet loof alle Suid-Afrikaners en sektore wat op verskillende maniere aan vandeesmaand se Vryheidsmaandvierings deelgeneem het.
tgt: Upcoming events Freedom DayCabinet commends all South Africans and sectors who are in various ways participating in the current Freedom Month celebrations.

src: President Ramaphosa sal op 27 April 2018 die programrede by die Nasionale vryheidsdagvierings by die Dr Petrus Molemela-stadion in Bloemfontein, Vrystaat lewer, onder die tema “Die jaar van Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela: na die volle verwesenliking van ons vryheid deur radikale sosio-ekonomiese transformasie”.Die geleentheid sal gevolg word deur die toekenning van die 2018 Nasionale Ordes op Saterdag 28 April 2018 in Pretoria, waar President Ramaphosa aan verdienstelike ontvangers die Orde van die Baobab, die Orde van Ikhamanga, die Orde van Luthuli en die Orde van die Kamerade van OR Tambo sal toeken.
tgt: President Ramaphosa will deliver the keynote address at the National Freedom Day celebration on 27 April 2018 at Dr Petrus Molemela Stadium in Bloemfontein, Free State under the theme: “The year of Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela: towards full realisation of our freedom through radical socio-economic transformation”.The event will be followed by the 2018 National Orders Awards on Saturday, 28 April 2018 in Pretoria, where President Ramaphosa will bestow to deserving recipients the Order of the Baobab, The Order of Ikhamanga, The Order of Luthuli and The Order of the Companions of OR Tambo.

src: Nasionale ordes is die hoogste toekenning wat Suid-Afrika deur die president aan landsburgers en lede van die internasionale gemeenskap oorhandig, wat ’n betekenisvolle bydrae gemaak het om die land ’n vrye, demokratiese en suksesvolle nasie te maak, wat verenig is in sy diversiteit.
tgt: National Orders are the highest awards that South Africa bestows, through the President, on citizens and members of the international community who have contributed meaningfully towards making the country a free, democratic and successful nation united in its diversity.

src: Medag-vieringsDie Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle werkers regoor die land om Werkersdag op Dinsdag 1 Me 2018 te vier en te besin oor die vordering wat gemaak is op die gebied van werkersregte sedert die aanbreek van ons demokrasie.
tgt: May Day celebrationsCabinet calls on all workers around the country to join in celebrating the Workers’ Day on Tuesday, 1 May 2018 and to reflect on the gains of workers’ rights since the dawn of democracy.

src: Hierdie dag dien as ’n herinnering dat werkplekke veilig moet wees en dat werkgewers meer moet doen om hul werkers se veiligheid te verseker, veral in die mynbousektor.
tgt: This day serves as a reminder that workplaces should be safe and that employers must do more to ensure the safety of their workers, especially in the mining sector.

src: Die Kabinet betuig ook sy innige simpatie aan die families, vriende en kollegas van die ses mynwerkers wat doodgebrand het toe die bus waarmee hulle op pad werk toe was aan die brand gesteek is deur ’n petrolbom wat deur onbekende aanvallers na die bus gegooi is.
tgt: Cabinet also expressed its heartfelt sympathy to the families, friends and colleagues of the six miners who were burnt to death when the bus taking them to work was set alight by a petrol bomb thrown by unknown attackers.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op lede van die gemeenskap om die polisie te help in hul pogings om hierdie saak spoedig op te los.
tgt: Cabinet called on community members to assist the police in their quest to swiftly crack this case.

src: BoodskappeDie Kabinet dra sy gelukwense oor aan die volgende:1.
tgt: MessagesCabinet congratulates:1.

src: Ndebele-kunstenaar Esther Mahlangu, wat ’n ere-doktorsgraad van die Universiteit van Johannesburg ontvang het ter erkenning van haar uitstaande bydrae tot Suid-Afrikaanse inheemse kuns en kultuur.
tgt: Ndebele artist Esther Mahlangu, who received an honorary doctorate from the University of Johannesburg in recognition of her outstanding contribution to South African indigenous arts and culture.

src: Span Suid-Afrika, wat ons vlag hoog laat wapper het tydens die Gemenebes-spele aan Australië se Goudkus, toe hulle sesde geëindig het met altesaam 37 medaljes (13 goud, 11 silwer en 14 brons).
tgt: Team South Africa who held our flag high at the Commonwealth Games on Australia's Gold Coast, when they finished sixth with a total of 37 medals (13 gold, 11 silver and 13 bronze).

src: Hul sukses is die resultaat van harde werk, vasberadenheid en uithouvermoë.
tgt: Their success is a result of hard work, determination and perseverance.

src: Dit is ’n inspirasie vir jong atlete en herbevestig dat sport deel van die maatskaplike bestel is wat ons as Suid-Afrikaners saambind.
tgt: This is an inspiration to young athletes and reaffirms that sport is part of the social fabric that binds us together as South Africans.

src: sluit in:Caster Semenya – vroue 800 m en 1500 mLuvo Manyonga – mans verspringNdodomzi Ntutu – mans T12 100 mHenri Schoeman – mans driekampTatjana Schoenmaker – vroue 100 m- en 200 m-borsslagChad le Clos – mans 50 m-, 100 m- en 200 m-vlinderslagCameron van der Burgh – mans 50m-borsslagAkani Simbine – mans 100 m enMartin Erasmus – mans 97 kg rofstoei.
tgt: Top achievers who won gold medals include:Caster Semenya – women’s 800m and 1500mLuvo Manyonga – men’s long jumpNdodomzi Ntutu – men’s T12 100mHenri Schoeman – men’s triathlonTatjana Schoenmaker – women’s 100m and 200m breaststrokeChad le Clos – men’s 50m, 100m and 200m butterflyCameron van der Burgh – men’s 50m breaststrokeAkani Simbine – men’s 100m andMartin Erasmus – men’s 97kg wrestling freestyle.

src: Profssor Sibongile Muthwa en Dr Geraldine Fraser-Moleketi met hul onlangse inhuldiging as onderskeidelik vise-kanselier en kanselier van die Nelson Mandela Universiteit.
tgt: Profssor Sibongile Muthwa and Dr Geraldine Fraser-Moleketi on their recent inauguration as vice-chancellor and chancellor respectively of the Nelson Mandela University.

src: Span Suid-Afrika met die inpalm van drie toekennings by die 10de Globale Entrepreneurskapskongres in Istanbul, Turkye in April 2018, ter erkenning van die land se verbintenis en toewyding tot die bevordering van KMMO’s.
tgt: Team South Africa for winning three awards at the 10th Global Entrepreneurship Congress in Istanbul, Turkey in April 2018, in recognition for the country’s commitment and dedication to advancing SMMEs.

src: Die Departement van Kleinsakeontwikkeling, saam met sy vennoot, 22 on Sloane, Afrika se grootste kampus vir aanvangsondernemings, het die Globale Entrepreneurskap se toekenning vir Land van die Jaar gewen.
tgt: The Department of Small Business Development with its partner, 22 on Sloane, Africa’s largest start-up campus, won the Global Entrepreneurship Country of the Year Award.

src: Span Suid-Afrika het ook die Handelsmerkvoorstander- (Brand Champions) en Navorsingsvoorstandertoekenning (Research Champions) ingepalm, wat Globale Entrepreneurskap-netwerklande van regoor die wêreld erken.
tgt: Team South Africa also won the Brand Champions and Research Champions Award, which recognises Global Entrepreneurship Network countries from around the world.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 9 Me 2018 by Tuynhuis, Kaapstad vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 9 May 2018, at Tuynhuys, Cape TownIssues in the environment.

src: Geslagsgebaseerde geweld (GGG).
tgt: Gender-based violence (GBV).

src: Die Kabinet herbeklemtoon sy veroordeling van geweld teen vroue en kinders en doen ’n beroep op almal in ons onderskeie strukture om standpunt in te neem teen geweld teen vroue, kinders en die lesbiese, gay-, biseksuele en transgender (LGBT)-gemeenskap.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates its condemnation of violence against women and children, and calls on all of us in our respective formations to take a stand in stopping violence against women, children and the Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual and Transgender communities.

src: Dit is elke Suid-Afrikaner se plig om ander in te lig oor die regte van vroue en kinders en oor die onderskeie regsmeganismes wat beskikbaar is om slagoffers van geweld te help.
tgt: It is the duty of every South African to educate one another on the rights of women and children, and on the various recourse mechanisms that exist to help victims of violence.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die besluit deur die Suid-Gauteng Hoë Hof om die veroordeelde moordenaar Sandile Mantsoe tot 32 jaar tronkstraf te vonnis vir die moord op sy voormalige vriendin Karabo Mokoena.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the decision by the South Gauteng High Court to sentence convicted murderer Sandile Mantsoe to 32 years in prison for the murder of his ex-girlfriend Karabo Mokoena.

src: Ander gevalle soos die ontdekking van die liggaam van die 10-jarige Katlego Joja in Mamelodi-Wes, oos van Pretoria en die moord op Zolile Khumalo deur ’n medestudent by die Mangosuthu Universiteit van Tegnologie in Durban, lewer bewys van die voortdurende uitdagings waarvoor ons as ’n nasie te staan kom.
tgt: Other cases such as the discovery of the body of 10-year-old Katlego Joja in Mamelodi West, east of Pretoria and the killing of Zolile Khumalo, by a former student, at the Mangosuthu University of Technology in Durban, is testimony to the continuing challenges we face as a nation.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy innige medelye met die Joja- en Khumalo-families.
tgt: Cabinet extends its heartfelt condolences to the Joja and Khumalo families.

src: Hoewel geregtelike en wetstoepassingsagentskappe die spesifieke taak opgelê is om te verseker dat die oortreders nie ongestraf bly nie, moet elkeen van ons as deel van die breër samelewing ’n rol speel om hierdie misdade te beëindig.
tgt: While justice and the law-enforcement agencies are seized with ensuring that the perpetrators do not go unpunished, as a society we all have a role to play in stopping these crimes.

src: Suid-Afrikaners word aangemoedig om aktief betrokke te raak by programme vir voorspraak en om bewustheid te bevorder in hul onderskeie gemeenskappe en sektore.
tgt: South Africans are encouraged to actively join advocacy and awareness-raising programmes in their respective communities and sectors.

src: Die Kabinet moedig ook die slagoffers van hierdie gruwelike misdade aan om dit aan te meld by wetstoepassingsagentskappe, wat alle bewerings van GGG moet ondersoek en streng binne die grense van die wet moet optree om te verseker dat geregtigheid geskied.
tgt: Cabinet also encourages victims to report these heinous crimes to law-enforcement authorities, who must investigate allegations of GBV and act firmly within the ambit of the law to ensure that justice is served.

src: ’n Afsonderlike, maar verwante kwessie, is dat die Verenigde Nasies (VN) se Algemene Vergadering 13 Junie tot Internasionale Dag vir Albinismebewustheid verklaar het.
tgt: In a separate but related issue, the United Nations (UN) General Assembly proclaimed 13 June as International Albinism Awareness Day.

src: Die veldtog is daarop gerig om bewustheid te versterk oor mense met albinisme hulle word ten volle deur die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996 beskerm.
tgt: The campaign aims to raise awareness about people living with albinism who are fully protected by the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.

src: Dit is alle Suid-Afrikaners se plig om hulself en ander in hul gemeenskappe oor albinisme in te lig ten einde die mites en wanbegrippe oor die toestand uit die weg te ruim.
tgt: It is the duty of all South Africans to educate themselves and others in the community on albinism so as to dispel myths and misconceptions.

src: Dit sal die trauma wat deur mense met albinisme en hul families ervaar word, aansienlik verlig.
tgt: This will alleviate the trauma experienced by people with albinism and their families.

src: Besluit van die Internasionale Vereniging van Atletiekfederasies (IAAF)2.1 Die Kabinet spreek sy kommer uit oor die ontwikkelings rakende die nuwe regulasies van die Internasionale Vereniging van Atletiekfederasies (IAAF).2 Die Kabinet verwelkom die werk wat deur die Departement van Sport en Ontspanning Suid-Afrika (SRSA) gedoen word, en die feit dat ’n hoëvlakpaneel van deskundiges op die verwante mediese en regsterreine deur SRSA byeengebring is.
tgt: International Association of Athletics Federations (IAAF) decision.

src: Hierdie paneel sal die regulasies noukeurig bestudeer en die wetenskaplike bewyse waarop die IAAF gesteun het, krities ondersoek.
tgt: Cabinet expressed concerns with the developments regarding to the new regulations of the International Association of Athletics Federations (IAAF).

src: Dit sal alle beskikbare navorsing en wetenskaplike bewyse asook verwante etiese kwessies evalueer en die bevindings gebruik om hierdie regulasies in die toepaslike forums te betwis.3 Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om alle atlete wat deur hierdie regulasies geraak mag word te ondersteun, op eie bodem sowel as in die res van die wêreld.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the work being done by the Department of Sport and Recreation South Africa and, the fact that a high level panel of experts in the related fields of medicine and law were assemble by SRSThis panel will study these regulations closely and interrogate the scientific evidence that the IAAF had relied upon.

src: Situasie in Noordwes.
tgt: Situation in North West.

src: Die Kabinet het die verslag deur die Interministeriële Taakspan (IMTS) oor Noordwes ontvang.
tgt: Cabinet was presented with the report by the Inter-Ministerial Task Team (IMTT) on North West.

src: Die verslag bevat besonderhede oor die voorlopige werk wat die afgelope twee weke gedoen is.
tgt: The report provided the preliminary work that has been done in the last two weeks.

src: Die Kabinet is tevrede met die vordering wat deur die IMTS gemaak is om die provinsie te probeer stabiliseer.
tgt: Cabinet was satisfied with the progress made by the IMTT in its efforts to stabilise the Province.

src: Die IMTS, onder leiding van die Minister in die Presidensie, dr Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma, sal met die vraagstukke in Noordwes belas bly.
tgt: The IMTT, led by Minister in The Presidency, Dr Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma, will remain seized with the North West issues.

src: ’n Breedvoerige media-inligtingsessie oor die resultate van die IMTS se werk sal volgende week in Noordwes gehou word.
tgt: A detailed media briefing on the outcomes of this work by the IMTT will be held in the North West next week.

src: Japan-Afrika Openbare-Privaat Ekonomiese Forum.
tgt: Japan-Africa Public-Private Economic Forum.

src: President Cyril Ramaphosa het die hoofrede tydens die eerste Japan-Afrika Openbare-Privaat Ekonomiese Forum gelewer.
tgt: President Cyril Ramaphosa delivered a keynote address at the inaugural Japan-Africa Public-Private Economic Forum held at the Sandton Convention Centre from 3 to 4 May 2018.

src: Die Forum is van 3 tot 4 Me 2018 by die Sandton Konvensiesentrum deur Suid-Afrika aangebied in samewerking met die Japannese regering en Japan se Eksterne Handelsorganisasie.
tgt: The forum was co-hosted by South Africa, together with the government of Japan and the Japan External Trade Organization.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die volgehoue verbintenis wat in 2016 gemaak is tydens die Tokio Internasionale Konferensie oor Afrika-ontwikkeling in Nairobi, Kenia, waartydens Japan beleggings van US$30 miljard in Afrika tussen 2016 en 2019 beloof het.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the continued commitment that was made at the Tokyo International Conference on African Development in Nairobi, Kenya in 2016, which saw Japan pledging US$30 billion in Africa between 2016 and 2019.

src: Mer as 100 Japannese maatskappye is in Afrika teenwoordig.
tgt: More than 100 Japanese companies have a presence in Africa.

src: Verenigde State (VSA) se Staal- en Aluminiumtariefverhoging.
tgt: United States (US) Steel and Aluminum Tariff increase.

src: Die Kabinet spreek sy teleurstelling uit oor die besluit van die VSA om Suid-Afrika nie vry te stel van die heffing van doeaneregte op staal en aluminium nie.
tgt: Cabinet expresses its disappointment on the decision by the US not to exempt South Africa from the application of steel and aluminum duties.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse regering sal steeds met Amerikaanse owerhede gesprek voer om ’n wedersyds aanvaarbare ooreenkoms te bereik.
tgt: The South African Government will continue to engage with US authorities to find a mutually acceptable outcome.

src: Die Kabinet moedig ook binnelandse uitvoerders aan om Amerikaanse kopers te beïnvloed om vir produkvrystellings aansoek te doen, aangesien Suid-Afrikaanse maatskappye nisprodukte en semi-verwerkte produkte vir verdere verwerking na die VSA uitvoer.
tgt: Cabinet also encourages domestic exporters to continue to lobby US buyers to apply for product exemptions, as South African companies export niche products and semi-processed products for further processing in the URevitalisation of Industrial Parks.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die eerste fase van die herlewing van diePhuthaditjhaba Nywerheidspark in die Vrystaat as ’n belangrike mylpaal in die implementering van die Program vir die Herlewing van Nywerheidsparke.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the completion of the first phase of the revitalisation of the Phuthaditjhaba Industrial Park in the Free State as an important milestone in implementing the Revitalisation of Industrial Parks Programme.

src: Die opknappings ter waarde van R50 miljoen sal meer plaaslike entrepreneurs lok om hul ondernemings hier te vestig danksy die verbeterde infrastruktuur en sekuriteit.
tgt: The R50-million upgrades will attract more local entrepreneurs to set up their operations due to the improved infrastructure and security.

src: Belegging.
tgt: Investment.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Departement van Handel en Nywerheid (die dti) en Aspen Pharmacare geluk met hul vennootskap, wat gelei het die aankondiging van ’n R1-miljardbelegging in ’n aanleg vir farmaseutiese middels in Port Elizabeth in die Oos-Kaap.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the partnership between the Department of Trade and Industry (the dti) and Aspen Pharmacare, which has resulted in the announcement of a R1-billion investment in the pharmaceutical drug plant in Port Elizabeth in the Eastern Cape.

src: Die farmaseutiese maatskappy het voordeel getrek uit die dti se 12I-Belastingaansporing, met ’n belastingkrediet van ongeveer R209 miljoen.
tgt: The pharmaceutical company benefited from the dti’s 12I Tax Incentive with a tax credit of about R209 million.

src: Die fasiliteit sal 500 nuwe werksgeleenthede skep.
tgt: The opening of the facility will create 500 new jobs.

src: Dit is ’n beduidende belegging wat Suid-Afrika se vervaardigingsruimte tot ’n nuwe vlak ophef en broodnodige werksgeleenthede vir die land skep.
tgt: This is a significant investment which is taking South Africa into a new level of manufacturing space and creating the necessary jobs that the country needs.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die nuwe reëls wat deur die Onafhanklike Kommunikasie-owerheid van Suid-Afrika voorgestel is om regulasies betreffende data-, SMS- en stemdienste te reguleer.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the new rules proposed by the Independent Communications Authority of South Africa to improve regulations around data, SMS and voice services.

src: Die veranderinge behels stappe om regverdige sakepraktyke in dataprysbepaling te verseker en om te voorkom dat verbruikers ongebruikte data verloor.
tgt: The changes are steps toward ensuring fairness in business practice around data pricing and ensure that consumers will not lose unused data.

src: Die markondersoek wat deur die Meedingingskommissie gedoen word, sal op bykomende maatreëls fokus om te verseker dat Suid-Afrikaanse datapryse breër digitale toegang ondersteun en ons voorberei vir die geleenthede wat die Vierde Nywerheidsrewolusie bied.
tgt: The Market Inquiry being conducted by the Competition Commission will highlight and focus on additional measures, to ensure South African data prices support broader digital access and prepare us for the opportunities created by the Fourth Industrial Revolution.

src: Mynbousektor.
tgt: Mining Sector.

src: Die Kabinet betreur saam met President Ramaphosa die sterftes van mynwerkers by die Sibanye-Stillwater Driefonteinmyn naby Carletonville aan die Wes-Rand en betuig sy meegevoel met die families en vriende van die oorledenes.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Ramaphosa in expressing sadness following the loss of lives of mineworkers at the Sibanye-Stillwater’s Driefontein Mine near Carletonville on the West Rand, and furthermore extends its condolences to the families and friends of the deceased.

src: Die Minister van Minerale Hulpbronne, MnrGwede Mantashe, sal die regering na verwagtings by ’n gededenkdiens wat hierdie week gehou word, verteenwoordig.
tgt: The Minister of Mineral Resources, Mr Gwede Mantashe, is expected to represent government at a memorial service to be held this week.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n dringende beroep op die mynbousektor om hul navorsing te bespoedig wat sal help om seismiese aktiwiteite in die myne vroegtydig te bespeur en lewens te red.
tgt: Cabinet urges the mining sector to fast-track their research that will assist us in the capability in detecting seismic activities in the mines and save lives.

src: VN se Kinderfonds (UNICEF).
tgt: UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF).

src: Die Kabinet spreek saam met President Ramaphosa sy waardering uit vir UNICEF se steun en samewerking in die bemagtiging van Suid-Afrika se jeug.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Ramaphosa in expressing appreciation for UNICEF’s support and cooperation in empowering the youth of South Africa.

src: Die Uitvoerende Direkteur van UNICEF, me Henrietta Fore, het op Maandag 7 Me 2018 ’n welwillendheidsbesoek aanPresident Ramaphosa gebring.
tgt: Executive Director of UNICEF, Ms Henrietta Fore, paid a courtesy call to President Ramaphosa on Monday, 7 May 2018.

src: Sy het ’n uiteensetting gegee van UNICEF se verslag oor Suid-Afrika se inisiatiewe op die terreine van onderwys, die ontwikkeling van werksvaardighede en ekonomiese geleenthede vir jongmense, veral vir diegene tussen 10 en 18 jaar oud.
tgt: She outlined UNICEF's report on South Africa's initiatives in the areas of education, work skills development and economic opportunities for young people, especially for those between 10 and 18 years old.

src: UNICEF het Suid-Afrika se pogings om geleenthede vir jongmense te skep om op ’n betekenisvolle manier aan die ekonomie deel te neem geprys, en hul bereid verklaar om ons land se skole met water en sanitasie te help.
tgt: UNICEF commended South Africa’s efforts to create opportunities for young people to participate meaningfully in the economy, and expressed willingness to assist our country’s schools with the provision of water and sanitation.

src: UNICEF het Suid-Afrika genooi om sy sukses op die terrein van jeugbemagtiging te deel in sy wêreldwye veldtog om geleenthede vir die jeug te bevorder – ’n duidelike teken van die verstewiging van ons land se betrekkinge met die VN.
tgt: UNICEF has invited South Africa to share its success on youth empowerment as part of its global campaign to advance opportunities for youth – a sure sign of our country’s strengthening relations with the UN.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet keur die Nywerheidsbeleidsaksieplan (IPAP) 2018/19–2020/21 goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Industrial Policy Action Plan (IPAP) 2018/19 – 2020/21.

src: Dit is die 10de herhaling van 'n aaneenlopende jaarlikse aksieplan wat met opeenvolgende driejaarsiklusse van die Meiumtermyn-bestedingsraamwerk belyn is.
tgt: This is the 10th iteration of a rolling annual action plan aligned to successive three-year cycles of the Medium Term Expenditure Framework.

src: Die hersiene IPAP bied ’n opsomming van die prestasies van die nywerheidsbeleid oor die afgelope nege jaar.
tgt: The revised IPAP summarises the achievements of the industrial policy over the past nine years.

src: Dit verskaf ’n ekonomiese ontleding van die internasionale en binnelandse ekonomie wat vir die nywerheidsbeleid ter sake is, gee ’n opsomming van die uitdagings en beperkings wat die optimale implementering van die nywerheidsbeleid in die gesig staar, asook ’n verskeidenheid dwarslopende en sektorspesifieke tydsgebonde sleutelaksieplanne wat aan die onderskeie departemente toegewys is.
tgt: It provides an economic analysis of the global and domestic economy relevant to industrial policy, summarises the challenges and constraints to the optimal implementation of the industrial policy, as well as a range of transversal and sector specific time-bound key action plans assigned to the respective departments.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Ooreenkoms oor die Driesydige Vryhandelsgebied (TFTA) in die Parlement ter tafel gelê word vir bekragtiging.
tgt: Cabinet approved that the Tripartite Free Trade Area (TFTA) Agreement be tabled in Parliament for ratification.

src: Die ooreenkoms vestig die Gemeenskaplike Mark vir Oos- en Suider Afrika, die Oos-Afrikaanse Gemeenskap en die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap.
tgt: The agreement establishes the Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa, East African Community and Southern African Development Community.

src: Hierdie TFTA is ’n sleutelprojek onder Afrika-leiding wat ’n deurslaggewende stap verteenwoordig om die vasteland se koloniale nalatenskap van klein gefragmenteerde markte te oorkom deur die bevordering van intra-Afrikabeleggings en deur meer buitelandse belegging na die vryhandelsgebied te lok.
tgt: This TFTA is a key Africa-led project that marks a decisive step to overcome the continent’s colonial heritage of small fragmented markets, by promoting intra-African investments and attracting more foreign investment into the free trade WEBTOKEN a result of regional integration efforts and stable economies, there has been strong growth in intra-African investments.

src: Danksy streeksintegrasiepogings en bestendige ekonomieë was daar reeds sterk groei in intra-Afrikabeleggings.
tgt: Cabinet approved South Africa’s Third National Communication Report for submission to the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).The primary objective of the UNFCCC is to achieve the stabilisation of greenhouse gas concentrations in the atmosphere to a level that would prevent dangerous anthropogenic activities from interfering with the climate system.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat Suid-Afrika se Derde Nasionale Kommunikasieverslag aan die VN se Konvensie oor Klimaatsverandering (UNFCCC) voorgelê word.
tgt: South Africa’s report contains an analysis of its progress from the initial National Communication to the Second National Communication and subsequently the Third Communication Report, as reviewed by the international community and domestic stakeholders.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Akwakultuur van 2018 aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Aquaculture Development Bill of 2018 to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp, wat die produk is van omvattende oorlegpleging met al die tersaaklike belanghebbers in die landbousektor, is daarop gerig om akwakultuurontwikkeling in die oseane-ekonomie te bevorder.
tgt: The Bill, which came out of full consultation with all the relevant stakeholders in the aquaculture sector, seeks to promote aquaculture development in the oceans economy.

src: Dit voorsien onder meer die bepalings van die sektor se institusionele reëlings en ’n uiteensetting van die lisensiëring- en permitvereistes vir akwakultuur, en maak voorsiening vir die vestiging van akwakultuurontwikkelingsones.
tgt: It provides, amongst others, the institutional arrangements of the sector sets out the licensing and permitting requirements for aquaculture and the establishment of the aquaculture development zones.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wetsontwerp op Beroepsgesondheid en-veiligheid van 2018 aan die parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Occupational Health and Safety Bill of 2018 to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp wysig die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid, 1993 (Wet 85 van 1993).
tgt: The Bill amends the Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993 (Act 85 of 1993).

src: Wanneer die Wetsontwerp aanvaar is, sal dit beter beskerming vir werkers bied ten opsigte van beserings en siektes in die werkplek bied.
tgt: Once adopted, the Bill will ensure greater protection of workers in respect of injuries and diseases at the workplace.

src: Die Wetsontwerp vestig ’n duidelik omskrewe Gesondheid-en-veiligheidsbestuurstelsel in ooreenstemming met internasionale beste praktyk.
tgt: The Bill establishes a clearly defined Health and Safety Management System and is in line with international best practice.

src: Dit maak ook voorsiening vir verpligte risikobepaling deur die werkgewer en die ontwikkeling en implementering van ’n werkplekspesifieke risikobestuursplan om die blootstelling van werknemers aan risiko tot ’n minimum te beperk.
tgt: It also provides for mandatory risk assessment to be conducted by the employer and a workplace-specific risk management plan developed and implemented to minimise the exposure of employees to risk.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Messages.

src: Gelukwense.
tgt: Congratulations.

src: Die Kabinet wens President Ramaphosa geluk dat hy deur die Internasionale Arbeidskonferensie (ILO) se Beheerliggaam uitgenooi is om as medevoorsitter van die Globale Kommissie oor die Toekoms van Werk op te tree.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates President Ramaphosa, who has been invited by the International Labour Conference (ILO) Governing Body to co-chair the Global Commission on Future of Work.

src: Die President is ook genooi om die konferensie, wat sy eeufees vier, toe te spreek.
tgt: The President has also been invited to address the conference, which is celebrating 100 years of existence.

src: Terwyl hy daar is, sal hy ook eer betoon aan en die Eeufeesviering van voormalige President Nelson Mandela gedenk.
tgt: Whilst there he, will pay homage and honour the Centenary of former President Nelson Mandela.

src: Die Kabinet bedank die Afrika-groep in die ILO-bestuursliggaam vir sy leiding in die gesprekvoering in Genève en waardeer die samesprekings wat deur die land se regerende party in hul plaaslike kiesafdelings gehou is.
tgt: Cabinet thanks the Africa Group in the ILO governing body for leading the discussion in Geneva and appreciates the discussions held by the country’s ruling party in their local constituencies.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy meegevoel oor aan die familie en vriende van wyle mnrDerek Keys, die voormalige Minister van Finansies, wat die eerste was om hierdie pos in ’n demokratiese Suid-Afrika te beklee.
tgt: Cabinet expresses condolences to the family and friends of the late former and first Minister of Finance of democratic South Africa, Mr Derek Keys, who played a significant role in the smooth handover of Treasury to a democratically elected government in 1994.

src: Ramadan.
tgt: Ramadan.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Moslemgemeenskap sterkte toe aan die begin van hul vastydperk vir die heilige maand van Ramadan volgende week.
tgt: Cabinet extends well wishes to the Muslim community as they begin fasting for the holy month of Ramadan next week.

src: Gedurende Ramadan vas Moslems vanaf sonsopkoms tot sonsondergang met die doel om hul spiritualiteit te verdiep.
tgt: During Ramadan, Muslims fast from sunrise to sunset, as they spend time deepening their spirituality.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming Events.

src: President Ramaphosa sal vandag, 10 Me 2018, die Departement van Verdediging en die Departement van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake (CoGTA) besoek as deel van sy pogings om met senior leierskap gesprek te voer om te verseker dat die regering se werk doeltreffend belyn word.
tgt: President Ramaphosa will today, 10 May 2018, visit the Department of Defence and Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs (CoGTA) respectively, as part of his efforts to engage with senior leadership to ensure that the work of government is effectively aligned.

src: Hierdie besoeke is deel van die verbintenis wat die President in sy eerste Staatsrede in Februarie 2018 aangekondig het, naamlik om elke nasionale departement in hierdie verband te besoek.
tgt: This visit is part of the President’s commitment announced in his maiden State of the Nation Address in February 2018 to visit every national department in this regard.

src: Adjunkpresident David Mabuza sal vandag, 10 Me 2018, die Derde Beraad van die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Meslike Hulpbronontwikkeling by Emperors Palace in Johannesburg toespreek onder die tema: ‘Vennootskappe vir die herlewing van werk en leer’.
tgt: Deputy President David Mabuza will today, 10 May 2018, address the 3rd Human Resource Development Council of South Africa Summit at Emperors Palace in Johannesburg under the theme: ‘Partnerships revitalising work and learning’.

src: Die tweedaagse beraad sal sleutelnywerheidsleiers, arbeidskenners en akademici byeenbring om oor verskeie kwessies te beraadslaag, insluitend voorstelle vir die hantering van werkloosheid onder die jeug, en om bemagtiging en die Vierde Nywerheidsrewolusie te bevorder.
tgt: The two-day summit will bring together key industry leaders, labour experts and academics to deliberate on various issues, including proposals to deal with youth unemployment, and advance empowerment and the Fourth Industrial Revolution.

src: Die Kabinet herhaal ook die uitnodiging aan Suid-Afrikaners om betrokke te raak by die jaarlange Eeufeesvierings van Tata Nelson Mandela en Mama Albertina Sisulu, wat gehelp het om die grondslag van die Suid-Afrikaanse demokrasie wat ons vandag geniet, te bou.
tgt: Cabinet also reiterates the invitation to South Africans to join the year-long Centenary celebrations of Tata Nelson Mandela and Mama Albertina Sisulu, who helped build the foundation of the South Africa’s democracy we enjoy today.

src: Die Interministeriële Komitee vir die Nelson Mandela- en Albertina Sisulu- eeufeesvirings, het die nasionale program vandeesweek van stapel gestuur.
tgt: The Inter-Ministerial Committee on the Nelson Mandela Centenary and Centenary of Albertina Sisulu launched the National Programme this week.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag, 23 Me 2018, by Tuynhuys, Kaapstad vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 23 May 2018, at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Issues in the environment.

src: Geslagsgebaseerde geweld (GGG).
tgt: Gender-Based Violence (GBV).

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel enige geweld teen vroue en kinders ten sterkste.
tgt: Cabinet strongly condemns the violence against women and children.

src: Die jongste gevalle soos dié van Nonkululeko Mpanza en Nompumelelo Mhlongo in Thokoza, Ekurhuleni Katlego Joja in Mamelodi, Tshwane Promise Mthembu in KwaZulu-Natal en Jabulile Nhlapo, die Unisa-student, bring die vlak van geweld wat die lewens van ons vroue en kinders bedreig, skerp na vore.
tgt: The most recent cases of Nonkululeko Mpanza and Nompumelelo Mhlongo in Thokoza, Ekurhuleni Katlego Joja in Mamelodi, Tshwane Promise Mthembu in KwaZulu-Natal and Jabulile Nhlapo, the Unisa student, brings into sharp focus the level of violence that threatens the lives of our women and children.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy innigste meegevoel met die families en vriende van hierdie vroue en kinders.
tgt: Cabinet expresses its deepest condolences to the families and friends of these women and children.

src: Die kwessie van misdaad teen vroue en kinders vereis dat ons almal aktief betrokke moet wees by die stryd.
tgt: The issue of crime against women and children requires all of us to actively be involved in fighting it.

src: Die Kabinet versterk steeds wetstoepassingsagentskappe om hulle toe te rus vir die stryd teen GGOnder die wetsontwerpe wat onlangs deur die Kabinet goedgekeur is, is die Wysigingswet op die Strafproseswet van 2018, wat die Strafproseswet, 1977 (Wet 51 van 1977) wysig.
tgt: Cabinet continues to strengthen law-enforcement agencies in the fight to stop GBAmongst the Bills approved in this last Cabinet is the Criminal Procedure Amendment Bill of 2018, which amends the Criminal Procedure Act, 1977 (Act 51 of 1977).

src: Die wetsontwerp sal die lys van seksuele misdrywe wat vervolg kan word, uitbrei, wat beteken dat seksuele sake selfs ná 20 jaar in die howe aangehoor sal kan word.
tgt: The Bill will extend the list of sexual offences in respect of the prosecution and significantly it will allow the sexual cases to go before courts even after 20 years.

src: Hierdie tussenkomste is bykomend tot verskeie maatreëls wat deur die regering in plek gestel is.
tgt: These interventions add to a number of measures that government has already put in place.

src: Altesaam 54 Thuthuzela-sorgsentrums is reeds regdeur die land geopen wat as eenstopfasiliteite dien om sekondêre viktimisasie te verminder en die tydperk waarbinne seksuele sake afgehandel word, te verminder.
tgt: A total of 54 Thuthuzela Care Centres across the country have been opened to serve as a one-stop facility to reduce secondary victimisation and reduce the time of finalising sexual cases.

src: Altesaam 75 toegewyde howe vir seksuele misdrywe is deur die regering gevestig om sake van seksuele geweld teen vroue beslissend te hanteer.
tgt: Government has set up 75 dedicated Sexual Offences Courts to deal decisively with sexual violence against women.

src: Verder het die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens 1 047 toegewyde fasiliteite vir GGG-slagoffers by polisiestasies landwyd ingestel, waar spesiale voorsiening vir slagoffers gemaak word en bystand gebied word.
tgt: Furthermore, the South African Police Service has established 1 047 dedicated facilities for victims at police stations countrywide to accommodate and assist victims of GBChild Protection Week will be held from 27 May to 2 June 2018.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op ouers, voogde en gemeenskappe om met wetstoepassingsagentskappe saam te werk om ons kinders te beskerm.
tgt: Cabinet calls on parents, guardians and communities to work with law-enforcement agencies to protect our children.

src: Die Kabinet herhaal sy dringende oproep aan mense wat vermoed dat hul kinders vermis is, om dit dadelik by hul naaste polisiestasie aan te meld.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates that if you suspect your child is missing, you must immediately report to your nearest police station.

src: As 'n vredeliewende en wetsgehoorsame samelewing, moet ons saamwerk om misdade teen vroue en kinders stop te sit.
tgt: We must work together as a peace-loving and law-abiding society to tackle all crimes against women and children.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op almal wat bewus is van enige misdade teen kinders om die tolvrye Childline te kontak by 0800 055 555 of die Crime Stop-noodlyn by 086 0010.111.
tgt: Cabinet calls on those aware of any crimes against children to contact the toll-free Childline on 0800 055 555 or Crime Stop on 086 0010.111.

src: As jy 'n vrou in nood is of as jy bewus is van 'n vrou in nood, skakel die GGG-beheersentrum se tolvry nommer by 0800 428 428 of (0800 GBV GBV).
tgt: If you are a woman in distress or if you are aware of a woman in distress, the GBV Command Centre’s toll-free number is 0800 428 428 or (0800 GBV GBV).

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op almal in die land om saam te werk en meer te doen om geweld teen vroue en kinders te voorkom, om oorlewendes van mishandeling te ondersteun en om oortreders voor die gereg te bring.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all of us to work together to do more to prevent violence against women and children, support survivors of abuse and bring perpetrators to justice.

src: Dit is elkeen van ons se plig om mense wat vroue en kinders seermaak, uitbuit of mishandel by die owerhede aan te gee, sodat die oortreders in hegtenis geneem en skuldig bevind kan word.
tgt: It is the duty of everyone to report those who hurt, exploit and abuse women and children so that the perpetrators can be arrested and convicted.

src: EkonomieDie Kabinet verwelkom die positiewe groei in indiensneming.
tgt: EconomyCabinet welcomes the positive growth in employment of two hundred and six thousand jobs reflected in the first quarter of 2018, from the latest Quarterly Labour Force Survey released by Statistics South Africa.

src: Die jongste jaarlikse arbeidsmag-opname, wat deur Statistiek Suid-Afrika vrygestel is, dui daarop dat 206 000 werksgeleenthede in die eerste kwartaal van 2018 geskep is.
tgt: The upswing in employment was driven by increases in six of the 10 industries.

src: Die werkloosheidsyfer onder ons jongmense bly egter hoog op 52,4%, met 'n absorpsiesyfer van slegs 12,2%.
tgt: The unemployment rate amongst our young people, however, remains high at 52.4%, with an absorption rate of only 12.2%.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle sektore van die samelewing om steeds saam te werk om jeugwerkloosheid die hoof te WEBTOKEN die gees van 'Thuma Mina - Stuur My', geïnspireer deur President Cyril Ramaphosa in sy eerste staatsrede in Februarie 2018, doen die Kabinet ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners, veral in die private sektor, om werk te skep en plaaslik te belê sodat meer Suid-Afrikaners by die ekonomie betrek kan word.
tgt: Cabinet calls on sectors of society to continue to pull together to tackle youth WEBTOKEN the spirit of ‘Thuma Mina – Send Me’ inspired by President Cyril Ramaphosa in his maiden State of the Nation Address in February 2018, Cabinet calls on all South Africans, in particular the private sector, to help create jobs and invest locally so that more South Africans can be drawn into the economy.

src: EnergieDie Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van die Xina Solar One gekonsentreerde sonkragprojek in die Noord-Kaap as 'n belangrike mylpaal.
tgt: EnergyCabinet welcomes as a milestone the launch of the Xina Solar One Concentrated Solar Power Project in the Northern Cape.

src: Dit is een van sewe gekonsentreerde sonkragprojekte onder die Departement van Energie se Hernubare Energie Onafhanklike Kragprodusente Verkrygingsprogram.
tgt: It is one of seven Concentrated Solar Power Projects under the Department of Energy’s Renewable Energy Independent Power Producer Procurement Programme.

src: Die Xina Solar One-aanleg sal skoon energie aan Eskom verskaf as deel van 'n 20-jaar-kragooreenkoms.
tgt: The Xina Solar One plant will provide clean energy to Eskom under a 20-year power purchase agreement.

src: Dit sal beteken dat 95 000 Suid-Afrikaanse huishoudings skoon energie sal ontvang, veral tydens spitstye.
tgt: This will translate into 95 000 South African households receiving clean energy, especially during peak hours.

src: Noordwes.
tgt: North West.

src: Die Kabinet het 'n tweede verslag van die Interministeriële Komitee in Noordwes ontvang en is tevrede met die vordering wat met die stabilisering van die provinsie gemaak word.
tgt: Cabinet received a second report from the Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC) on North West and is satisfied with the progress in stabilizing the province.

src: In sy vorige vergadering het die Kabinet goedgekeur dat Noordwes onder Artikel 100 (1) van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996 geplaas word.
tgt: In its previous meeting, Cabinet approved that North West be placed under Section 100 (1) of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.

src: Die Kabinet het ook die Interministeriële Komitee vergroot deur meer lede aan te stel, naamlik die ministers van Basiese Onderwys Staatsdiens en Administrasie Meslike Nedersettings Sosiale Ontwikkeling Toerisme Omgewingsake en Vervoer.
tgt: Cabinet also increased the members of IMC with the Ministers of Basic Education Public Service and Administration Human Settlements Social Development Tourism Environmental Affairs and Transport.

src: Die Interministeriële Komitee is gevra om die provinsie verder te ondersoek en die Kabinet te adviseer oor watter van die provinsiale departemente onder Artikel 100 (1)
tgt: The IMC was asked to do further work in the province and advise Cabinet on which of the provincial departments should be placed under Section 100 (1)

tgt: Department of Community Safety and Transport Management(3).

src: Die gewysigde konvensie is 'n belangrike mylpaal in internasionale pogings om die fisiese beskerming van kernmateriaal en -fasiliteite te versterk deur gemeenskaplike standaarde van beskerming vas te stel.
tgt: The IP Policy Phase I is informed among others by the Constitution, the NDP, the National Drug Master Plan, the National Industrial Policy Framework and the various iterations of the Industrial Policy Action WEBTOKEN will serve as an important policy instrument in promoting innovation, technology transfer, research and development, creative expression, consumer protection, industrial development and more broadly, economic growth.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Staatsaanspreeklikheid van 2018 aan die Parlement voorgelê word vir goedgekeuring.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Medical Schemes Amendment Bill of 2018 to be published in the Government Gazette for public comments.

src: Die Wetsontwerp wysig die Wet op Staatsaanspreeklikheid van 1957.
tgt: The Bill amends the Medical Schemes Act of 1998 (Act 131 of 1998) to align it with the National Health Insurance (NHI) White Paper and the Draft NHI Fund Bill.

src: Dit sal voorsiening maak vir ’n vereffeningstruktuur vir eise wat teen die Staat ingedien word in gevalle waar mense verkeerde mediese behandeling deur staatsamptenare ontvang het.
tgt: The Bill seeks, amongst others, to improve the regulation of the medical schemes industry and to also align the regulatory framework to the changes that have taken place over the past decade in the sector.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wetsontwerp op Nasionale Klimaatsverandering van 2018 vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the introduction of the State Liability Amendment Bill of 2018 to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp maak voorsiening vir die belyning van beleid wat Suid-Afrika se reaksie op klimaatsverandering beïnvloed.
tgt: The Bill amends the State Liability Act of 1957.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Strafproseswysigingswet van 2018, wat die Strafproseswet van 1977 wysig, aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the publication of the National Climate Change Bill of 2018 for public comment.

src: Die voorgestelde wysigingswetsontwerp sal die lys van seksuele misdrywe wat vervolg kan word uitbrei, wat dit moontlik sal maak om ’n aanklag selfs na verloop 20 jaar in te stel.
tgt: The Bill allows for the alignment of policies that influence South Africa’s climate change response.

src: Die saak het verklaar dat artikel 18 van die Strafproseswet van 1977 teenstrydig is met die Grondwet.
tgt: Cabinet approved the introduction of the Criminal Procedure Amendment Bill of 2018, which amends the Criminal Procedure Act of 1977 into Parliament.

src: Dit is ongeldig verklaar in die sin dat dit onder alle omstandighede die reg uitsluit om alle seksuele misdrywe te vervolg, behalwe dié wat in artikel 18 ,
tgt: The proposed Amendment Bill will extend the list of sexual offences in respect of the prosecution and significantly it allows for the charges to be instituted even after 20 years.
