src: Die wysigings sal aan die Nasionale Vervolgingsgesag wyer magte gee om seksuele misdrywe ooreenkomstig Hoofstuk 2 van die Grondwet te vervolg.
tgt: The amendments will allow the National Prosecuting Authority wider discretion to institute prosecutions in sexual offences in accordance with Chapter 2 of the Constitution.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Nelson Mandela Afrikadag-eeufeeslesingPresident Ramaphosa sal die Nelson Mandela Afrikadag-eeufeeslesing tydens die Afrika Renaissance-konferensie op 24 Me 2018 by die Inkosi Albert Luthuli Internasionale Konvensiesentrum in Durban lewer.
tgt: Nelson Mandela Africa Day Centenary LecturePresident Ramaphosa will deliver the Nelson Mandela Africa Day Centenary Lecture at the Africa Renaissance Conference, on 24 May 2018 at the Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre in Durban.

src: Die gebeurtenis maak deel uit van die jaarlange eeufeesvierings oor die hele Afrika-vasteland en wêreldwyd, van die lewe van ons eerste demokratiese president, Tata Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela, sowel as dié van ’n ikoon van die vryheidstryd, Mama Albertina Nontsikelelo Sisulu.
tgt: The event forms part of the yearlong centenary commemorations of the lives of our first democratic President, Tata Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela and Struggle icon Mama Albertina Nontsikelelo Sisulu, which are taking place across the continent and the globe.

src: AfrikadagAfrikadag word jaarliks op 25 Me oor die vasteland gevier om die stigting van die destydse Organisasie vir Afrika-eenheid - nou bekend as die Afrika-unie - in 1963 te herdenk.
tgt: Africa DayAfrica Day is held annually on 25 May across the continent to mark the founding of the then Organisation of African Unity – now known as the African Union – in 1963.

src: Dit vier Afrika se diversiteit en is 'n aansporing tot eenheid op die vasteland.
tgt: It is a celebration of Africa’s diversity and a call for unity in the continent.

src: Suid-Afrika vier Afrikadag met 'n maandlange Afrikamaand-fees van feestelike en opvoedkundige aktiwiteite met politieke en sosio-ekonomiese voordele vir die mense van Suid-Afrika en die vasteland.
tgt: South Africa is celebrating Africa Day with a month-long Africa Month festival of activities that are celebratory and educational, with political and socio-economic benefits for the people of South Africa and the Continent.

src: Die tema vir Afrikamaand is: "'n Jaar van Nelson Mandela – Bou ’n beter Afrika en 'n Beter Wêreld".Boodskappe.
tgt: The theme for Africa Month is: “A Year of Nelson Mandela – Building a Better Africa and a Better World”.Messages.

src: MegevoelDie Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel met die familie en vriende van die ontslape veteraanfotograaf en ontvanger van die Nasionale Orde van Ikhamanga, MnrSam Nzima, wat met sy kamera die brutaliteit van die apartheidsregering blootgestel het.
tgt: CondolencesCabinet expressed condolences to the family and friends of the late veteran photographer and recipient of the National Order of Ikhamanga, Mr Sam Nzima, who used his camera to expose the brutality of apartheid rule.

src: Hy sal veral onthou word vir sy ikoniese foto van Hector Pieterson op 16 Junie 1976, wat die wêreld gedwing het om kennis te neem en op te tree teen die wreedhede van die apartheidsregimeDie Kabinet betuig sy diepe meegevoel met die familie van Dr Phillip Nchipi Tabane, wat op 18 Me 2018 oorlede is na ‘n lang siekbed.
tgt: He will be remembered for his iconic photograph of Hector Pieterson‚ on 16 June 1976, which forced the world to take notice and act against the brutal apartheid regime.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel met die familie en vriende van MnrSonwabo Eddie Funde, die voormalige Suid-Afrikaanse Ambassadeur in Duitsland en Voorsitter van die Suid-Afrikaanse Uitsaaikorporasie (SAUK) se direksie.
tgt: Cabinet extends its deepest sadness and condolences to the family of Dr Phillip Nchipi Tabane, who passed on after a long illness on 18 May 2018.

src: Die Kabinet is diep bedroef oor die dood van twee jong meisies in Durban wat gesterf het toe ‘n muur op hulle ineengestort het.
tgt: Cabinet is deeply saddened following the deaths of two young girls who were killed after a wall collapsed in Durban.

src: Ons betuig ons innige meegevoel teenoor hulle families.
tgt: We extend our heartfelt condolences to their families.

src: GelukwenseDie Kabinet prys Vusumuzi Ndlovu wat die sewende plek behaal het in die Pellegrino Jong Sjef 2018-kompetisie, wat onlangs in Milaan gehou is.

src: Suid-Afrika is trots op Ndlovu se prestasie.
tgt: His accomplishment has made South Africa proud.

tgt: Cabinet congratulates the newly crowned International Boxing Federation (IBF)‚ World Boxing Association (WBA) Super and the Ring Magazine junior flyweight champion Hekkie "Hexecutioner" Budler, who became the first South African to hold two major world crowns simultaneously after winning the IBF and WBA junior-flyweight titles.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 6 Junie 2018 by die Uniegebou in Pretoria vergadering.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 6 June 2018, at the Union Buildings, Pretoria.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Issues in the environment.

src: EkonomieDie Kabinet neem kennis dat die bruto binnelandse produk (BBP) in die eerste kwartaal van 2018 met 2,2% gedaal het.
tgt: Economy Cabinet has noted the decline of 2,2% in the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) in the first quarter of 2018.

src: Statistieke Suid-Afrika (Stats SA) het die syfers hierdie week vrygestel.
tgt: Statistics South Africa (StatsSA) released the figures this week.

src: Die landbou-, mynbou- en vervaardigingsbedrywe het tot die afname in hierdie eerste kwartaal bygedra.
tgt: The agriculture, mining and manufacturing industries contributed to the decline in this first quarter.

src: Die Kabinet het die ministers van die Ekonomie-kluster opdrag gegee om dringend te vergader om die pad vorentoe met betrekking tot hierdie syfers te bespreek.
tgt: Cabinet has mandated the Economic Cluster Ministers to urgently meet to discuss the way forward with regard to these figures.

src: Die BBP-resultate beklemtoon die noodsaaklikheid dat alle sektore in die land moet saamwerk om Suid-Afrika se plaaslike ekonomie te verbeter.
tgt: The GDP results bring into sharp focus the need for all sectors of the country to work together to support South Africa’s local economy.

src: Die sake- en arbeidsektore moet steeds met die regering saamwerk ter bevordering van inisiatiewe soos die negepuntplan om ekonomiese groei te stimuleer en broodnodige werk te skep.
tgt: Business and labour need to continue to work with government in support of initiatives such as the Nine-Point Plan to stimulate economic growth and create much-needed jobs.

src: Een van die sleutelpilare is die Nyweheidsbeleid-aksieplan (IPAP), wat daarop gerig is om vervaardiging, werkskepping en uitvoere te verhoog.
tgt: One of its key pillars is the Industrial Policy Action Plan (IPAP), which focuses on increasing manufacturing, employment creation and exports.

src: Die Kabinet is vol vertroue dat die IPAP ons nywerheidsektor en die ekonomie sal help groei.
tgt: Cabinet is confident that the IPAP will help grow our industrial sector and economy.

src: Die regering sal later vanjaar 'n internasionale beleggingsberaad aanbied om Suid-Afrika as 'n beleggingsbestemming te bemark.
tgt: Later this year, government will host an International Investment Summit to profile South Africa as an investment destination.

src: Die doel van die beraad is om die volgende vyf jaar R1,2 miljard in nuwe beleggings te genereer, wat 'n beduidende uitwerking op ekonomiese groei en werkskepping sal hê.
tgt: The aim of the event is to work towards generating R1,2 trillion in new investments over the next five years, which will have a significant impact on economic growth and employment creation.

src: BeleggingsDie Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling op 5 Junie vanjaar van Yekani Manufacturing se nuwe wêreldklasfabriek in Oos-Londen in die Oos-Kaap, wat inligting- en kommunikasietegnologieprodukte vervaardig, en in algehele swart besit is.
tgt: Investments Cabinet welcomes the launch of a new world-class factory that manufactures information and communications technology products in East London in the Eastern Cape on 5 June 2018 by Yekani Manufacturing, a wholly black-owned company.

src: Die R1 miljard-belegging sal bykomend tot die bestaande werksmag van 450 mense, meestal jeug en vroue, 1 000 nuwe gehalte werksgeleenthede skep.
tgt: This R1-billion investment will create 1 000 new quality jobs in addition to the existing workforce of 450, mostly youth and women.

src: Hierdie belegging het voordeel getrek uit beide die Spesiale Ekonomiese Sone-infrastruktuur-aansporing en die Swart Nywerheidskema (BIS).
tgt: This investment has benefited from both the Special Economic Zone Infrastructure Incentive and the Black Industrialist Scheme (BIS).

src: Danksy die BIS het die Departement van Handel en Nywerheid (die dti) gedurende die voorafgaande twee boekjare aansporingsondersteuning aan 103 swart nyweraars goedgekeur.
tgt: The BIS saw the Department of Trade and Industry (the dti) approving incentive support to 103 black industrialists over the previous two financial years.

src: Altesaam 48 maatskappye, waarvan agt in die Oos-Kaap is, is ook ondersteun deur toegang tot markte te verkry.
tgt: Forty-eight companies were also provided with market access support, eight of which are in the Eastern Cape.

src: Nasionale Minimumloon (NML)Die Kabinet verwelkom die goedkeuring van die NML-wetsontwerp deur die Nasionale Vergadering en spreek sy waardering uit teenoor alle belanghebbendes by die Nasionale Ekonomiese, Ontwikkelings- en Arbeidsraad vir die rol wat hulle gespeel het om hierdie ooreenkoms te bereik.
tgt: National Minimum Wage (NMW)Cabinet welcomes the passing of the NMW Bill by the National Assembly.

src: Dit sit 'n proses aan die gang om die loongaping te verklein, veral vir die lae-inkomstegroepe.
tgt: This begins a process towards narrowing the wage gap, especially for the low income earners.

src: Sodra die wetsontwerp onderteken is, sal sowat 6,4 miljoen werkers in Suid-Afrika voordeel daaruit trek.
tgt: Approximately 6,4 million workers in South Africa will benefit once the Bill has been signed into law.

src: Die Kabinet erken egter dat nog heelwat werk gedoen moet word om die loonverskille wat nog steeds bestaan, uit die weg te ruim.
tgt: Cabinet, however, acknowledges that more work still needs to be done to close the wage disparities that still exist in the country.

src: Die wetsontwerp sal vervolgens aan die Nasionale Raad van Provinsies gestuur word vir instemming voordat die President dit as wet onderteken.
tgt: The Bill will now be sent to the National Council of Provinces for concurrence before the President signs it into law.

src: Basiese diensteDie Kabinet is tevrede met die uitslae van die Nie-finansiële Sensus van Munisipaliteite 2017 wat deur Stats SA vrygestel is.
tgt: Basic servicesCabinet is pleased with the results of the Non-financial Census of Municipalities 2017 released by StatsSThe results showed more consumers have received free basic services such as electricity, water and sanitation in 2017 as compared with 2016.

src: Die regering bly verbind tot die voorsiening van daaglikse basiese dienste aan al sy burgers, veral arm mense.
tgt: Government remains committed to providing daily basic services to all its citizens, especially poor people.

src: Die mees onlangse waterverwante projek is die Mhlathuze Waterprojek van R96 miljoen in Richardsbaai, KwaZulu-Natal, wat kraanwater aan meer as 6 000 huishoudings sal lewer.
tgt: The most recent water-related project is the R96-million Mhlathuze Water Project in Richards Bay in KwaZulu-Natal, which will deliver running tap water to more than 6 000 households.

src: Staatsdiens-loononderhandelingsDie Kabinet is deur die Minister van Staatsdiens en Administrasie ingelig oor die Staatsdiens se loononderhandelinge.
tgt: Public Service wage negotiationsCabinet received a briefing from the Minister of Public Service and Administration on the Public Service wage negotiations.

src: Die Kabinet waardeer alle belanghebbers se toewyding om 'n vriendskaplike oplossing te vind wat tot voordeel van alle rolspelers sal strek.
tgt: Cabinet appreciates the commitment by all stakeholders in finding an amicable solution that would benefit all role players.

src: Die Kabinet bevestig die regering se verbintenis om deurdringend met die arbeidsektor te beraadslaag sodat 'n werkbare ooreenkoms tussen alle betrokkenes bereik kan word.
tgt: Cabinet reaffirms government’s commitment to fully engage with labour so as to arrive at a workable deal for all involved.

src: Maatskaplike toelaesDie Kabinet verseker die begunstigdes van maatskaplike toelaes dat die regering die lewering van hierdie belangrike diens sal voortsit, soos deur die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996 bepaal.
tgt: Social grants Cabinet reassures beneficiaries of social grants that government will continue providing this important service, as mandated by the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.

src: Maatskaplike toelaes sal steeds betaal word en die proses om die ou Suid-Afrikaanse Maatskaplike Sekuriteitsagentskap- (SASSA) kaart te vervang met die nuwe een sal tot einde September 2018 voortgaan.
tgt: Social grants will continue to be paid and the process to replace the old South African Social Security Agency (SASSA) card with the new one will continue until the end of September 2018.

src: Die vennootskap tussen SASSA en die Suid-Afrikaanse Poskantoor lewer positiewe resultate aangesien meer begunstigdes sedert Me 2018 hul kaarte omgeruil het.
tgt: The partnership between SASSA and the South African Post Office is yielding positive results as more beneficiaries have since May 2018 been coming forward to swap their cards.

src: Die Kabinet moedig gemeenskappe aan om onlangse kort boodskappe te ignoreer wat begunstigdes van maatskaplike toelaes vra om te herregistreer vir hul maatskaplike toelaes om te voorkom dat hulle nie betaal word nie.
tgt: Cabinet urges communities to ignore recent short messages directing social-grant beneficiaries to re-register for their social grants to avoid not being paid.

src: Sulke misleidende boodskappe poog om verwarring onder die armes te skep en die regering te ontspoor in sy pogings om te verseker dat maatskaplike toelaes moeiteloos aan begunstigdes betaal word.
tgt: Such misleading messages seek to create confusion amongst the poor and derail government from ensuring that social grants are seamlessly paid to beneficiaries without failure.

src: NoordwesDie Kabinet het 'n derde vorderingsverslag van die Interministeriële Taakspan (IMT) oor Noordwes ontvang.
tgt: North WestCabinet received a third progress report from the Inter-Ministerial Task Team (IMTT) on North West.

src: Die Kabinet is tevrede met die vordering wat gemaak is om die toepaslike Artikel 100 (1)
tgt: Cabinet is satisfied with the progress made to operationalise the invoked Section 100(1)

src: en
tgt: and

src: in die Noordwes provinsiale departemente in werking te stel.
tgt: in the North West provincial departments.

src: Dit is voorts goedgekeur dat die IMT eenmaal per maand aan die Kabinet verslag sal doen om die spanne wat in die provinsie ontplooi is in staat te stel om hul werk voort te sit.
tgt: It was further approved that the IMTT will onwards report to Cabinet once a month to enable the teams deployed in the province to continue with the work.

src: Die Kabinet het op 7 Junie 2018 'n besoek aan Noordwes goedgekeur om die Noordwes Uitvoerende Komitee, die Provinsiale Wetgewer en die eksterne ouditeure wat verantwoordelik is vir die provinsie, in te lig.
tgt: Cabinet endorsed a visit to the North West on 7 June 2018 to brief the North West Executive, Provincial Legislature and the external auditors responsible for the province.

src: ProtesoptredeDie Kabinet veroordeel die onlangse aggresiewe protesoptrede regoor die land en is veral besorg oor die dade van geweld en die intimidasie van pasiënte en mediese personeel by die Charlotte Maxeke Akademiese Hospitaal in Johannesburg.
tgt: Protest action Cabinet condemns the recent violent protests around the country, and is especially saddened by the acts of violence and intimidation of patients and medical staff at the Charlotte Maxeke Johannesburg Academic Hospital.

src: Protesteerders wat hul reg uitoefen om protes aan te teken, moet dit doen sonder om die regte van ander, veral die kwesbares, te skend.
tgt: Protestors who exercise their rights to protest should do so without violating the rights of others, particularly the vulnerable.

src: Geen griewe regverdig die geweld en die dreigende gedrag wat die afgelope week gesien is nie.
tgt: No amount of grievance justifies violence and the threatening behaviour seen in the past week.

src: Veiligheid en sekuriteitDie Kabinet verwelkom en ondersteun die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens (SAPD) se stabilisering-ingrypingsplan, wat met die samewerking van alle Suid-Afrikaners sal poog om ons gemeenskappe veiliger te maak.
tgt: Safety and securityCabinet welcomes and supports the ‘stabilisation intervention plan’ by the South African Police Service (SAPS), which will partner with South Africans towards efforts to make our communities safer.

src: Die verhoogde sigbaarheid van polisiebeamptes in uniform, te voet en in voertuie, met die ondersteuning van die SAPD se lugvleuel, deurlopende kordon- en soektogbedrywighede, padblokkades en meedoënlose soeke na verdagtes, sal 'n belangrike bydrae lewer om te verseker dat mense in ons land veilig voel en veilig is.
tgt: The high-density visibility of uniformed police officers on foot and vehicles – supported by the SAPS air wing, continuous cordon and search operations, roadblocks and relentless search for wanted suspects – will go a long way in ensuring that people in our country are and feel safe.

src: Gemeenskappe word aangemoedig om enige inligting oor misdaad by hul plaaslike polisiekantoor aan te meld of die tolvrye Stop Misdaad-nommer 086 00 1011.1 te skakel.
tgt: Communities are encouraged to provide information relating to their safety to a local police station or call the toll-free Crime Stop number: 086 00 Cabinet appeals to members of the public to use the Crime Stop line responsibly.

src: Misbruik van hierdie fasiliteit kan 'n wettige noodoproep beïnvloed wat 'n lewe kon gered het.
tgt: An abuse of this facility may affect a legitimate emergency call that may have saved a life.

src: JeugmaandDie Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om tydens Jeugmaand, wat in Junie gevier word, by programme en projekte wat die jeug bemagtig betrokke te raak.
tgt: Youth Month Cabinet urges all South Africans to play their part in youth-empowerment programmes and projects during Youth Month in June.

src: Hierdie jaar is die eeufeesvierings van Tata Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela en Mama Albertina Nontsikelelo Sisulu.
tgt: This year is the centenary of Tata Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela and Mama Albertina Nontsikelelo Sisulu and Youth Month 2018 is embraced under the theme: “Live the legacy: Towards a socio-economically empowered youth”.Inspired by their iconic legacies, young people need to be empowered to take up a more active role in developing their communities with a view to working together to develop South Africa.

src: Om hierby aan te sluit, is die tema vir Jeugmaand 2018: "Leef die nalatenskap: na sosio-ekonomiese bemagtiging van die jeug".Jongmense moet inspirasie put uit hierdie rolmodelle se nalatenskap hulle moet bemagtig word om 'n meer aktiewe rol in die opheffing van hul gemeenskappe te speel en Suid-Afrika sodoende saam te ontwikkel.
tgt: Government is working hard to ensure that youth are able to access the many support and educational government programmes that would enhance their participation in the economy.

src: Die regering doen baie om te verseker dat die jeug toegang tot verskeie ondersteunings- en opvoedkundige regeringsprogramme verkry wat hul deelname aan die ekonomie sal verbeter.
tgt: Preliminary and mid-term examsCabinet calls on parents and guardians to support, within necessary means, children who are writing preliminary and mid-term examinations taking place across the country.

src: Voorbereidende en midtermyn-eksamensDie Kabinet doen 'n beroep op ouers en voogde regoor die land om hul kinders wat voorbereidende en midtermyn-eksamens skryf, na die beste van hul vermoëns te ondersteun.
tgt: Cabinet warmly appreciates the vital role child caregivers play in shaping our future leaders whilst creating conducive and safe environments for our children to learn.

src: Die Kabinet het groot waardering vir die belangrike bydrae van mense wat kinders versorg en opvoed om ons toekomstige leiers te word deur seker te maak dat hulle in bevorderlike en veilige omgewings kan leer en studeer.
tgt: We also encourage all learners to continue studying and striving to do their best.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die heropening van skole in verskillende dele van Noordwes, insluitend Koster en Rustenburg.
tgt: Cabinet also welcomes the reopening of schools in various parts of North West, including Koster and Rustenburg.

src: Dit volg op weke van protesoptogte en ontwrigting van onderrig in die gebied.
tgt: This comes after weeks of protests and disruptions in teaching and learning in the areas.

src: Die Kabinet moedig ouers, leerders en onderwysers aan om saam te werk om die verlore tyd te probeer inhaal en hulle ten volle te verbind tot inhaalprogramme.
tgt: Cabinet urges parents, learners and teachers to collaborate in trying to recover the lost time and fully commit to catch-up programmes.

src: Droogte en brandeDie Kabinet herinner Suid-Afrikaners daaraan dat die land steeds droogte ervaar.
tgt: Drought and fireCabinet reminds South Africans that the country is still experiencing drought.

src: Suid-Afrika is een van die 30 droogste lande in die wêreld en die laer as normale reënval het die situasie vererger.
tgt: South Africa is one of the 30-driest countries in the world and the lower-than-normal rainfalls have worsened the situation.

src: Almal moet steeds met die regering saamwerk om water te bespaar sodat daar genoeg sal wees vir almal.
tgt: All people must continue partnering with government to conserve water so as to ensure there is sufficient supply for all.

src: Me die winter op ons drumpel doen die Kabinet ’n beroep op gemeenskappe om spesiale aandag te gee aan die voorkoming van velbrande en brande in informele nedersettings.
tgt: As we enter the winter season, Cabinet calls on communities to take extra care to prevent shack and veld fires.

src: Die regering werk voortdurend saam met gemeenskappe om veiligheidsmaatreëls te bevorder omdat mense verskillende vorms van brandstof en verhitting gebruik om warm te bly, wat brande kan veroorsaak.
tgt: Government continues to work with communities to promote safety measures at this time when many use various forms of fuel and heating to keep warm.

src: Wetenskap en tegnologieDie Kabinet neem kennis van die astrologiese ontwikkelinge die afgelope naweek toe sterrekundiges wat met die Catalina Sky Survey in Arizona, VSA werk, 'n klein asteroïed (2018 LA) naby die maan se wentelbaan ontdek het, wat ure later op die Aarde neergestort het.
tgt: Science and TechnologyCabinet notes astrological developments over the past weekend when astronomers working with the Catalina Sky Survey in Arizona, USA, discovered a small asteroid (2018 LA) near the orbit of the Moon, which hours later made contact with Earth.

src: Die gevolglike ontploffing wat golwe van laefrekwensie-klank (infraklank) deur die atmosfeer gestuur het, is deur 'n infraklankmonitor in Suid-Afrika opgespoor, wat deel is van die Internasionale Moniteringstelsel se Verdrag oor die Omvattende Kerntoetsverbod.
tgt: The resultant explosion which sent waves of low-frequency sound (infrasound) rippling through the atmosphere were detected by an infrasound monitor in South Africa, which was deployed as part of the International Monitoring System of the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty.

src: Dit beklemtoon die toenemende vermoë van moderne lugopnames om asteroïdes te ontdek wat die Aarde teiken en bevestig Suid-Afrika se internasionaal erkende bevoegdheid op dié gebied.
tgt: This highlights the growing capability of modern sky surveys to discover asteroids targeting Earth and South Africa’s internationally recognised capability.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die 2016/17-verslag oor die werkverrigting van die Belasting-aansporingsprogram vir Navorsing en Ontwikkeling (N&O) aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the submission of the 2016/17 report on the performance of the Research and Development (R&D) Tax-Incentive Programme to Parliament.

src: Die aansporingsprogram stel maatskappye in staat om hul N&O-portefeuljes te diversifiseer, intellektuele eiendom te genereer en nuwe produkte te skep.
tgt: The incentive programme has enabled companies to diversify their R&D portfolio, generate intellectual property and create new products.

src: Die aansporingsprogram, wat in November 2006 ingestel is, word deur die Departement van Wetenskap en Tegnologie saam met die Suid-Afrikaanse Inkomstediens en Nasionale Tesourie bestuur.
tgt: The incentive programme, which was introduced in November 2006, is being implemented by the Department of Science and Technology together with the South African Revenue Service and National Treasury.

src: Van Maart 2016 tot Februarie 2017 is altesaam 153 N&O-belastingaansporingsaansoeke van 117 maatskappye ontvang, waarvan 58 eerste aansoekers was.
tgt: From March 2016 to February 2017, a total of 153 R&D tax-incentive applications were received from 117 companies, 58 of which were first-time applicants.

src: Die aansoeke was vir 571 N&O-projekte ter waarde van ongeveer R3,6 miljard.
tgt: The applications were for 571 R&D projects worth an estimated R3,6 billion.

src: Die Kabinet is tevrede met die toename in die aantal maatskappye wat in N&O belê en doen steeds meer om in N&O te belê.
tgt: Cabinet is pleased with the growth in the number of companies that invest in R&D and continues to call on business to invest more in R&D, which remains an important pillar of our efforts to grow the economy.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die 2016/17-opname oor die regering se befondsing vir wetenskaplike en tegnologiese aktiwiteite gepubliseer word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the publishing of the 2016/17 survey on government funding for Scientific and Technological Activities.

src: Die opname moniteer jaarliks die prestasie van die wetenskap- en tegnologiesektor, sowel as die sektor se bydrae tot Suid-Afrika se groei en ontwikkeling.
tgt: The survey annually monitors the performance of the science and technology sector, and its contribution to South Africa’s growth and development.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die begrotingsbeperkings wat tot die stadige groei van N&O-uitgawes in departemente gelei het.
tgt: Cabinet has noted the budget constraints that have resulted in slow growth in R&D expenditure across departments.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die hersiene Beleidsraamwerk vir Akkreditasie van Afleidingsdienste in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Cabinet approved the reviewed Policy Framework for Accreditation of Diversion Services in South Africa.

src: Die beleidsraamwerk is in 2010 in plek gestel ooreenkomstig die Wet op Kindergeregtigheid, 2008 (Wet 75 van 2008).
tgt: The policy framework was put in place in 2010 in line with the Child Justice Act, 2008 (Act 75 of 2008).

src: Die hersieningsproses poog om te verseker dat afleidingsdiensverskaffers en afleidingsprogramme te alle tye aan die minimum standaarde voldoen.
tgt: The reviewing process seeks to ensure that diversion service providers and diversion programmes are at all times compliant with the minimum standards.

src: Ses van die hoofstukke is gewysig om die gehalte en standaarde van dienste aan kinders wat die wet oortree, te verbeter.
tgt: Six of the chapters have been amended to improve the quality and standards of services provided to children found in conflict with the law.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Streeksbetrokkenheidstrategie vir Bioveiligheid in werking gestel word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Regional Engagement Strategy for Biosafety and its implementation.

src: Biotegnologie word erken as 'n belangrike potensiële aandrywer van ekonomiese groei en 'n belangrike hulpmiddel in die stryd teen honger en armoede, veral in ontwikkelende lande.
tgt: Biotechnology is recognised as an important potential driver of economic growth and a major tool in the fight against hunger and poverty, especially in developing countries.

src: Hierdie strategie sal intra-Afrika handel vergemaklik en die streek se mededingendheid op wêreldmarkte verbeter.
tgt: This strategy will facilitate intra-African trade and improve the region’s competitiveness in global markets.

src: Dit sal Suid-Afrika se medewerking en samewerking binne die Afrika-streek verbeter.
tgt: It will improve South Africa’s collaboration and cooperation within the African region.

src: Wetsontwerpe.
tgt: Bills.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Nasionale Wet op Gesondheidsversekering (NHI) van 2018 in die Staatskoerant gepubliseer word vir openbare kommentaar.
tgt: Cabinet approved the National Health Insurance (NHI) Bill of 2018 to be published in the Government Gazette for public comment.

src: Die Wetsontwerp poog om die NHI-fonds van Suid-Afrika as 'n openbare entiteit te vestig om sodoende voorsiening te maak vir volgehoue algemene toegang tot gesondheid wat bekostigbaar en van hoë gehalte is.
tgt: The Bill seeks to establish the NHI Fund of South Africa, as a public entity, so as to provide for a sustained universal health access that is affordable and of high quality.

src: Dit beskryf ook sy funksies, bevoegdhede en pligte.
tgt: It also sets out its functions, powers and duties.

src: Die Wetsontwerp bied 'n raamwerk vir die aktiewe aankoop van gesondheidsorgdienste deur die fonds namens gebruikers.
tgt: The Bill provides a framework for the active purchasing of healthcare services by the fund on behalf of users and creates mechanisms for the equitable, effective and efficient use of the resources of the fund to meet the health needs of users.

src: Die Minister van Gesondheid sal volgende week 'n mediakonferensie hou om hierdie wetsontwerp uiteen te sit.
tgt: The Minister of Health will next week hold a full media briefing to unpack this Bill.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wetsontwerp op Wetenskap en Tegnologiewette van 2017 aan die Parlement voorgelê.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the introduction of the Science and Technology Laws Amendment Bill of 2017 to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp versoen die bepalings wat die bedrywighede en bestuur van die openbare entiteite reguleer wat aan die Minister van Wetenskap en Tegnologie verslag doen.
tgt: The Bill harmonizes the provisions which regulate the operations and governance of the public entities that report to the Minister of Science and Technology.

src: Dit sal konsekwentheid verseker ten opsigte van alle vereistes waaraan voldoen moet word en prosesse wat gevolg moet word.
tgt: This will ensure consistency in all requirements to be met and processes to be followed.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Groep van Sewe (G7) -beraadDie Kabinet verwelkom die uitnodiging aan Suid-Afrika om die komende G7-beraad in Kanada by te woon.
tgt: Group of Seven (G7) SummitCabinet welcomes South Africa’s invitation to attend the upcoming G7 Summit in Canada.

src: Suid-Afrika het sewe jaar gelede aan die beraad deelgeneem en hierdie uitnodiging is 'n aanduiding van hernieude vertroue in die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie.
tgt: South Africa participated in the summit seven years ago and this invitation is an indication of renewed confidence in the South African economy.

src: Die regering sal poog om beleggers te nooi om kapitaal in ons ekonomie te belê.
tgt: Our government will seek to use the opportunity to invite investors to inject capital into our economy.

src: Belegging is nodig vir ekonomiese groei en werkskepping op 'n skaal wat die huidige vlakke van werkloosheid aansienlik sal verminder.
tgt: Investment is necessary for economic growth and job creation on a scale that will significantly reduce current levels of unemployment.

src: Suid-Afrika-Indië 125 jaar-herdenkingAs deel van die Nelson Mandela- en Albertina Sisulu-eeufeesvierings, verwelkom die Kabinet die herdenking op 7 Junie 2018 van Mahatma Gandhi se verwydering uit 'n trein by die Pietermaritzburg-stasie 125 jaar gelede.
tgt: South Africa-India 125 Years Anniversary Event As part of the Nelson Mandela and Albertina Sisulu centenary celebrations, Cabinet welcomes the commemoration on 7 June 2018 of Mahatma Gandhi’s removal from a train at Pietermaritzburg Station 125 years ago.

src: Hierdie gebeurtenis het Gandhi se filosofie van Satyagraha (passiewe politieke verset) aangespoor, wat 'n beduidende invloed op ons politieke leierskap gehad het en tot ons bevrydingstryd bygedra het.
tgt: This event spurred Gandhi’s philosophy of Satyagraha (truth-force), which had a significant influence on our political leadership and contributed to our liberation struggle.

src: Staatsbesoek: Saharawi Arabiese Demokratiese RepubliekPresident Cyril Ramaphosa het sy eweknie, die President van die Saharawi Arabiese Demokratiese Republiek, Brahim Ghali, tydens 'n staatsbesoek aan Suid-Afrika op 4 Junie 2018, ontvang.
tgt: Saharawi Arab Democratic Republic State VisitPresident Cyril Ramaphosa hosted his Saharawi Arab Democratic Republic counterpart, Brahim Ghali, on 4 June 2018 during a State Visit to the country.

src: Die Kabinet verklaar sy solidariteit met die Saharawi-volk in hul stryd om onafhanklikheid en doen ’n beroep op die internasionale gemeenskap om die nodige ondersteuning aan die Saharawi-mense te bied.
tgt: Cabinet expresses its solidarity with the people of Saharawi in their fight for independence and calls on the international community to provide the necessary support to the people of Saharawi.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Messages.

src: Die Kabinet betuig saam met President Ramaphosa sy innige meegevoel met die familie en vriende van die vyf seuns wat in ’n brand by die Masiya informele nedersetting in Philippi, Kaapstad gesterf het.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Ramaphosa in sending heartfelt condolences to the family and friends of the five boys who died in a blaze at the Masiya informal settlement in Philippi, Cape Town.

src: Die brand het ook 30 inwoners van die informele nedersetting dakloos gelaat.
tgt: The fire also displaced 30 residents of the informal settlement.

src: Die regering doen alles in sy vermoë om seker te maak dat daar behuising, vertroosting en veiligheid vir alle Suid-Afrikaners is.
tgt: Government is working hard to ensure that there is housing, security and comfort for all South Africans.

src: Gelukwense.
tgt: Congratulations.

src: Die Kabinet wens die ANC-veteraan Baba Andrew Mokete Mlangeni geluk met sy verjaarsdag.
tgt: Cabinet wishes African National Congress veteran Baba Andrew Mokete Mlangeni a happy belated birthday.

src: Baba Mlangeni het op Woensdag 6 Junie 2018, 93 jaar oud geword.
tgt: Baba Mlangeni celebrated his 93rd birthday on Wednesday, 6 June 2018.

src: Hy was een van die eerste vryheidsvegters wat vir militêre opleiding buite Suid-Afrika gestuur is.
tgt: He was among the first to be sent for military training outside South Africa and after being arrested on his return, he was found guilty and sentenced to life imprisonment on Robben Island.

src: Me sy terugkeer na Suid-Afrika is hy in hegtenis geneem, skuldig bevind en gevonnis tot lewenslange gevangenisstraf op Robbeneiland.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates Proteas fast bowler Kagiso “KG” Rabada, who stole the show at the Cricket South Africa Awards held recently in Sandton, Gauteng.

src: Hy het ses toekennings ontvang, insluitend die Krieketspeler- en die Spelers se Speler van die Jaar-toekennings.
tgt: He was recognised with six awards, including the Cricketer and Players’ Player of the Year awards.

src: Dit was 'n merkwaardige jaar vir jong Rabada wat onder meer die eerste plek op die wêreld se boulranglys in toetswedstrykrieket behaal het.
tgt: It has been a remarkable year for young Rabada who among other achievements, rose to the No 1 bowling ranking in the world in Test match cricket.

src: Hy is tans die toonaangewende paaltjiewagter vir 2018 en het ook die sewende plek behaal op die eendag-internasionale krieketranglys.
tgt: He is currently the leading wicket-taker for 2018 and also ranked No 7 in One Day International cricket.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die aanstelling van Siya Kolisi as die eerste swart kaptein van die Springbok-rugbyspan vir die driewedstryd-toetsreeks teen Engeland.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the appointment of Siya Kolisi as the first black captain of the Springbok team for the three match test series against England.

src: Ons is vol vertroue dat hy Suid-Afrika met trots as ons kaptein sal verteenwoordig, en ander sal inspireer deur sy optrede en leierskap op en buite die rugbyveld.
tgt: We are confident that he will do South Africa proud as our captain, and will inspire others by his actions and leadership on and off the field of play.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die aanstelling van die Minister van Finansies, Nhlanhla Nene, as voorsitter van die Nuwe Ontwikkelingsbank (NDB) se bestuur.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the appointment of Finance Minister Nhlanhla Nene as Chairperson of the New Development Bank (NDB) Board of Governors.

src: Die NDB is 'n multilaterale ontwikkelingsbank wat in 2014 deur Brasilië, Rusland, Indië, China en Suid-Afrika (BRICS) gestig is.
tgt: The NDB is a multilateral development bank established by Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa (BRICS) in 2014.

src: Dit het die mandaat om hulpbronne te mobiliseer vir infrastruktuur en volhoubare ontwikkelingsprojekte in BRICS en ander ontluikende ekonomieë en ontwikkelende lande.
tgt: It is mandated to mobilise resources for infrastructure and sustainable development projects in BRICS and other emerging economies and developing countries, complementing the efforts of multilateral and regional financial institutions for global growth and development.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderworpe aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die toepaslike klaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Heraanstelling van mnrEbrahim Mohamed as Kommissaris van die Nasionale Verbruikerskommissie.
tgt: Reappointment of Mr Ebrahim Mohamed as the Commissioner of the National Consumer Commission.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 20 Junie 2018 by die Uniegebou in Pretoria, vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 20 June 2018, at the Union Buildings, Pretoria.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Issues in the environment.

src: Verenigde Nasies se Sekuriteitsraad (UNSC).
tgt: United Nations Security Council (UNSC).

src: Die Kabinet spreek sy waardering uit teenoor die lede van die Verenigde Nasies (VN) vir hul oorweldigende steun aan Suid-Afrika om as nie-permanente lid van die UNSC vir die termyn 2019 tot 2020 te dien.
tgt: Cabinet extends appreciation to the members of the United Nations (UN) that overwhelmingly supported South Africa to serve as a non-permanent member on the UNSC for the term 2019 until 2020.

src: Die verkiesing volg op ’n eenparige besluit om ’n Globale Vredesberaad te belê ter ere van voormalige President Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela in September 2018 die eeufeesjaar van Suid-Afrika se grondlegger.
tgt: The election comes after a unanimous resolution to convene a Global Peace Summit in honour of former President Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela in September 2018, which is the centenary year of South Africa’s founding father.

src: Ons lidmaatskap van die UNSC word daaraan gewy om Madiba se nalatenskap te eer.
tgt: Our membership in the UNSC is dedicated to honour the legacy of Madiba.

src: Suid-Afrika sal sy lidmaatskap gebruik om die prioriteite van die Afrika-Unie se Agenda 2063 te bevorder.
tgt: South Africa will use its membership to advance the priorities of the African Union Agenda 2063, which is a strategic framework for the socio-economic transformation of the continent over the next 50 years.

src: Eskom-loononderandelings.
tgt: Eskom wage negotiations.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die ingryping deur die Minister van Openbare Ondernemings, Pravin Gordhan, in die loononderhandelingsgeskil tussen Eskom se bestuur en die arbeidsmag.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the intervention made by Public Enterprises Minister Pravin Gordhan in the wage-negotiations dispute between the Eskom management and labour.

src: Elektrisiteitsvoorsiening is een van die kritieke hefbome vir die land se ekonomiese ontwikkeling en werkskepping.
tgt: The supply of electricity is one of the critical levers in growing our economy and creating more jobs.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle partye om onverpoos daaraan te werk om die loongeskil suksesvol op te los ter wille van stabiliteit en ekonomiese vooruitgang in die land.
tgt: Cabinet appeals to all parties to work expeditiously in resolving the wage-increase negotiations for the sake of stability and the economic well-being of the country.

src: Betogings op hoofpaaie.
tgt: Protests on highways.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel ten sterkste die onlangse versperring van verskeie hoofpaaie deur betogers in sommige dele van die land.
tgt: Cabinet strongly condemns the recent blocking of several highways by protestors in some parts of the country.

src: Hoofpaaie is ’n kritieke deel van ons vervoerinfrastruktuur wat die vervoer van goedere en dienste van die verskillende ekonomiese sektore moontlik maak.
tgt: Highways are a critical part of our transport infrastructure that supports the transportation of goods and services of the various sectors of the economy.

src: Ons grondwetlike demokrasie maak voldoende voorsiening vir maniere waarop mense hul griewe kan lug sonder om chaos te veroorsaak.
tgt: Our constitutional democracy provides for platforms wherein people can raise their issues without causing any disruptions.

src: Aggressiewe misdade en ontwrigting sal nie geduld word nie en die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op regstoepassingsbeamptes om die nodige stappe te doen, binne die grense van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996, om te verseker dat die oortreders vervolg word.
tgt: Criminal acts of aggression and disruptions will not be tolerated and Cabinet calls on law-enforcement officers to take the necessary steps, within the confines of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996, to ensure that perpetrators are brought to justice.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet decisions.

src: Inligtingsweek oor die Program van Aksie Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die tweejaarlikse prestasievorderingsverslae vir die tydperk 1 Oktober 2017 tot 30 Maart 2018.
tgt: Cabinet was apprised on the bi-annual performance progress reports for the period starting 1 October 2017 until 30 March 2018.

src: Die Kabinet waardeer die vordering wat met verskeie van die 14 prioriteitsdoelwitte gemaak is en keur ook die voorgestelde ingrypings op gebiede waar minder vordering gemaak is goed.
tgt: Cabinet appreciated the progress made in a number of sub-outcomes of the 14 priority targets and also approved the proposed interventions in some of the areas that showed less progress.

src: Al die regeringsklusters sal media-inligtingsessies hou om die vordering te bespreek, sowel as die gebiede waar ingrypings nodig is.
tgt: All the clusters will conduct media briefings to unpack the progress and areas that require interventions.

src: Die GCIS sal die klustermedia-inligtingsessies koördineer en die skedule weldra op WEBTOKEN publiseer.
tgt: The GCIS will coordinate the cluster media briefings and publish the schedule on WEBTOKEN in due course.

src: Inligtingsessie oor samesprekings in die mynbousektor.
tgt: Briefing on the mining consultations.

src: Die Kabinet word deur die Minister van Minerale Hulpbronne, Gwede Mantashe, ingelig oor die twee-daglange vergadering wat in Maart 2018 gehou is met maatskaplike vennote wat die georganiseerde sake- en arbeidsektore verteenwoordig het.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed by Mineral Resources Minister Gwede Mantashe on the two-day meeting held in March 2018 with social partners represented by organised business and organised labour.

src: Al die maatskaplike vennote het saamgestem dat daar ’n behoefte bestaan om maatskaplike dialoog in die mynbousektor te laat herleef en kritieke ingrypings te identifiseer wat nodig is om te verseker dat die mynbousektor op ’n trajek van inklusiewe en volhoubare groei geplaas word.
tgt: All the social partners agreed on the need to resuscitate social dialogue in the mining sector and identify critical interventions required to ensure the mining sector is placed on a trajectory of inclusive and sustainable growth.

src: Die maatskaplike vennote het verder besin oor die afname in mynbouproduksie gedurende die laaste kwartaal asook die breër tendense rakende belegging, produksie en indiensneming in die mynbousektor.
tgt: The social partners further reflected on the last quarter decline in the mining production as well as the broader trends regarding mining investment, production and employment.

src: Hulle het saamgestem dat daar oor die gedeelde visie vir die mynbousektor besin moet word, en het die aanvullende aspekte en onderlinge afhanklikhede tussen transformasie en mededingendheid herbekragtig.
tgt: They agreed on the need to reflect on the shared vision for the mining sector, and re-endorsed the complementarities and interdependencies between transformation and competitiveness.

src: Die Kabinet is ook ingelig oor die twee multi-belanghebberspanne wat saamgestel is om die Mynbouhandves te finaliseer.
tgt: Cabinet was also briefed on the two multi-stakeholder teams established to finalise the Mining Charter.

src: Nadat al die oorlegplegingsprosesse afgehandel is, sal die handves vir finale aanvaarding aan die Kabinet voorgelê word.
tgt: Once all the consultation processes have been finalised, the charter will be presented to Cabinet for final adoption.

src: Konsep- Nasionale Begrotingsraamwerk vir 2019 (mandaatdokument) Die Kabinet keur die vrystelling van die prioritiseringsraamwerk vir Begroting 2019 goed, asook die bepaalde tydgrense waarbinne die prioritiseringsraamwerk vir Begroting 2020 voltooi moet word.
tgt: Draft National Budget Framework for 2019 (Mandate Paper).

src: Die raamwerk bevat voorstelle vir die prioriteitsprogramme vir Begroting 2019 wat die regering in staat sal stel om die drievoudige uitdagings van armoede, werkloosheid en ongelykheid met die beskikbare hulpbronne aan te pak.
tgt: Cabinet approved the release of the Budget Prioritisation Framework for Budget 2019 and also the timelines for the completion of the Budget Prioritisation Framework for Budget 2020.

src: Energie Die Kabinet keur die ontbinding- en skoonmaakverpligtinge verbonde aan die vorige uitgediende strategiese kernkragfasiliteite (Stadium 1) en huidige bedryfsfasiliteite (Stadium 2) by die Pelindaba-terrein goed.
tgt: The framework proposes the priority programmes for Budget 2019 that will enable government to tackle the triple challenges of poverty, unemployment and inequality within the available resources.

src: Hierdie verpligtinge word tans in die boeke van die Suid-Afrikaanse Kernenergiekorporasie weerspieël.
tgt: These liabilities are currently reflected in the books of the South African Nuclear Energy Corporation.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die proses in oorleg met die Nasionale Tesourie voortgesit word.
tgt: Cabinet approved that the process should be taken forward in consultation with the National Treasury.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Rondetafelgesprek van die Wêreld Ekonomiese Forum (WEF) President Cyril Ramaphosa sal op 28 Junie 2018 as gasheer optree vir die WEF Rondetafelgesprek by die Park Hyatt Hotel in Rosebank met die tema: “Vorming van Suid-Afrika se Ekonomiese Hernuwing – die Rol van die Sakesektor.” Die geleentheid sal ongeveer 100 plaaslike en buitelandse sakelui en Suid-Afrikaanse amptenare byeenbring om oor beleggingsgeleenthede en vennootskappe gesprek te voer.
tgt: President Cyril Ramaphosa will host the WEF Roundtable at the Park Hyatt Hotel in Rosebank on 28 June 2018 under the theme: “Shaping South Africa’s Economic Renewal - the role of Business.” The event will bring together about 100 local and foreign business people and South African Government officials to engage on investment opportunities and partnerships.

src: Die vergadering met die WEF-sakegemeenskap is ’n voorloper tot die regering se beleggingskonferensie wat vir later vanjaar beplan word, en wat daarop gerig is om belegging ter waarde van US$100 miljard oor vyf jaar te ontsluit.
tgt: The meeting with the WEF business community is a precursor to government’s Investment Conference planned for later in the year, which aims to mobilise investment of US$100 billion over five years.

src: Beraad van die Suider-Afrikaanse Doeane-Unie (SADU) President Ramaphosa sal ’n afvaardiging na die SADU-beraad op 29 Junie 2018 in Botswana lei.
tgt: Southern African Customs Union (SACU) Summit.

src: Die President sal van die geleentheid gebruik maak om ook die Sekretariaat van die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap (SAOG) te ontmoet en die inwerkingstelling van streeksprogramme te bespreek.
tgt: President Ramaphosa will lead a delegation that will attend the SACU Summit to be held on 29 June 2018 in Botswana.

src: As die huidige voorsitter van die SAOG, ondersteun Suid-Afrika deurlopend breër streeksintegrasie deur SADU en die SAOG, en tree as kampvegter op vir streeks-industraliasie en -integrasie deur middel van verskillende potensiële groeipaaie.
tgt: The President will use the gathering to meet the Southern African Development Community (SADC) Secretariat to discuss the implementation of regional programmes.

src: Die Suider Afrikaanse streek kom te staan voor toenemende onsekerheid en kwesbaarheid met betrekking tot watervoorsiening, wat saamval met die langdurige droogtetoestande waaronder verskeie dele van Suid-Afrika onlangs gebuk gegaan het.
tgt: As the current Chair of SADC, South Africa has consistently supported broader regional integration through the SACU and SADC, and champions regional industrialisation and integration through various potential growth paths.

src: Dit is daarop gerig om te verseker dat alle mense teen 2030 toegang tot skoon water en sanitasie sal hêBoodskappe.
tgt: The conference is expected to attract 2 000 delegates who will discuss ways to ensure the achievement of the UN Sustainable Development Goal number six, which centres around providing access to clean water and sanitation for all by 2030.Messages.

src: MeelyeDie Kabinet dra sy innige meegevoel oor aan:.
tgt: CondolencesCabinet expressed its deepest condolences to:.

src: Die familie en vriende van die Agbare Sibusiso Radebe, ’n ANC-parlementslid van Mpumalanga, wat tydens ’n kapingspoging in Gauteng vermoor is.
tgt: The family and friends of Honourable Sibusiso Radebe, an African National Congress Member of Parliament from Mpumalanga, who was killed during a hijacking attempt in Gauteng.

src: Agbare Radebe sal onthou word as ’n jeugaktivis wat hard gewerk het om Suid-Afrikaners se lewens te verbeter.
tgt: Honourable Radebe will be remembered as a youth activist who worked hard to improve the lives of South Africans.

src: Die familie en vriende van me Joyce Mashamba, wat ten tye van haar afsterwe die LUR vir Landbou in Limpopo was.
tgt: Family and friends of Ms Joyce Mashamba, who at the time of her passing was the MEC for Agriculture in Limpopo.

src: Die voormalige vryheidsvegter het sedert die aanbreek van demokrasie in verskillende provinsiale portefeuljes as LUR gedien.
tgt: The former freedom fighter served as an MEC in different provincial portfolios since the dawn of democracy.

src: Familie en vriende van mnrBilly Modise, Suid-Afrika se voormalige Hoof van Protokol en ontvanger van die Nasionale Orde van Luthuli.
tgt: Family and friends of Mr Billy Modise, who was South Africa’s former Chief of State Protocol and recipient of the National Order for Luthuli.

src: Hy is alombekend vir sy werk om gedurende die 1960's die anti-apartheidsbeweging in die Nordiese lande te bevorder.
tgt: He is well known for his work in building the anti-apartheid movement in the Nordic countries during the 1960s.

src: Die families van die drie mynwerkers wat by Sibanye-Stillwater se Kloof Ikamva-myn naby Westonaria in Gauteng gesterf het.
tgt: The families of the three miners who died at Sibanye-Stillwater’s Kloof Ikamva Mine near Westonaria in Gauteng and calls on all stakeholders in the sector to continue to prioritise safety in our mines.

src: Die Amampondo-gemeenskap met die afsterwe van die Koninginmoeder van Amampondo aseNyandeni, Koningin Fikelephi ‘Bongolethu’ Ndamase.
tgt: The Amampondo community on the passing of the Queen Mother of Amampondo aseNyandeni, Queen Fikelephi ‘Bongolethu’ Ndamase.

src: Die families en vriende van mnrIsmail Bassa en mnrSayaad Hitig, wat tydens ’n aanval op die Malmesbury-moskee in die Wes-Kaap gesterf het.
tgt: The families and friends of Mr Ismail Bassa and Mr Sayaad Hitig, who were killed during an attack on the Malmesbury mosque in the Western Cape.

src: GelukwenseDie Kabinet dra sy gelukwense oor aan die volgende mense:.
tgt: CongratulationsCabinet extends its congratulatory message to the following:.

src: Dr Robert Gess, ’n toonaangewende Suid-Afrikaanse navorser oor Devoniese marginale mariene ekostelsels en vroeë werweldiere of oervisse en vroeë vierpotiges.
tgt: Dr Robert Gess, a leading South African researcher on Devonian marginal marine ecosystems and early vertebrates or ancient fish and early tetrapods.

src: Hy het ’n fossiel ontdek wat vermoedelik 360 miljoen jaar oud is.
tgt: He uncovered what is believed to be a 360 million-year-old fossil.

src: Die twee nuwe spesies, genaamd Tutusius en Umzantsia, is Afrika se eerste bekende vierbeen-werweldiere, wat tot ’n allemintige 70 miljoen jaar terug dateer kan word.
tgt: The two new species, named Tutusius and Umzantsia, are Africa’s earliest known four-legged vertebrates dating back a remarkable 70 million years.

src: Hierdie ontdekking dra verder by om Suid-Afrika se reputasie as ’n wêreldleier in wetenskap en navorsing te verstewig.
tgt: This discovery further cements our place as a world leader in science and research.

src: Bongumusa Mthembu met sy derde oorwinning in die Comrades Marathon en Ann Ashworth met haar oorwinning in die vrouewedloop.
tgt: Bongumusa Mthembu for defending his Comrades Marathon title and Ann Ashworth for winning the women’s race.

src: Die Kabinet wens Xolani Luvuno, wat die marathon deur vasberadenheid en uithouvermoë met sy krukke voltooi het, ook geluk.
tgt: Cabinet also congratulates Xolani Luvuno for his determination and perseverance to finish the marathon using his crutches.

src: Dr Siyabonga Cwele, die Minister van Telekommunikasie en Posdienste, met sy verkiesing as die voorsitter van die Internasionale Telekomkommunikasie-satellietorganisasie (ITSO).
tgt: Dr Siyabonga Cwele, the Minister of Telecommunications and Postal Services, following his election as the Chairperson of the International Telecommunications Satellite Organisation (ITSO).

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag, 4 Julie 2018, by die Uniegebou, Pretoria, vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 4 July 2018, at the Union Buildings, Pretoria.

src: Kwessies in die Omgewing.
tgt: Issues in the environment.

src: Mandela-maandMe die oog op Nelson Mandela Internasionale Dag op 18 Julie 2018, doen die Kabinet ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om gehoor te gee aan die oproep “Wees die Nalatenskap”.
tgt: Mandela MonthCabinet calls on all South Africans to “Be the Legacy” as we approach Nelson Mandela International Day on 18 July 2018.

src: Die Verenigde Nasies (VN) het hierdie dag ingestel om nie Suid-Afrikaners nie, maar ook die internasionale gemeenskap die geleentheid te bied om ons voormalige president en internasionale ikoon, Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela, te vereer.
tgt: The United Nations (UN) adopted this day, which allows South Africans and the global community to honour our former President and an international icon, Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela.

src: Die regering het Julie tot Mandela-maand verklaar, omdat dit ook sy verjaarsdagmaand is.
tgt: Government has declared July as Mandela Month, which falls on his birthday month.

src: As deel van die eeufeesviering het verskillende sektore inisiatiewe geloods om eer te betoon aan die werk en nalatenskap van Madiba.
tgt: As part of the centenary celebration various sectors have embarked on a number of initiatives to pay tribute to the work and legacy of the late President Nelson Mandela.

src: Eerskomende Vrydag sal ’n spesiale eerbewys aan sy besondere belangstelling in werksgeleenthede en jong werkers betoon word, wanneer die inisiatief “Dra Suid-Afrika”, in samewerking met die Nelson Mandela Foundation (NMF) en die Suid-Afrikaanse Klere- en Tekstielwerkersunie, die Nelson Mandela T-hemp in Durban bekendstel.
tgt: On Friday, a special tribute to his concerns about jobs and young workers will be paid, when the Wear South Africa initiative, with the Nelson Mandela Foundation and the SA Clothing and Textile Workers Union (SACTWU) launches the Nelson Mandela t-shirt in Durban.

src: Die plaaslik vervaardigde T-hemp is by toonaangewende kleinhandelwinkels beskikbaar en wins uit die verkoop daarvan gaan na die NMF om aktiwiteite wat in ooreenstemming met sy visie en lewe is, te befonds.
tgt: The T-shirt is locally made, is available at leading retail stores and profits from the sale of the T-shirt will go to the Nelson Mandela Foundation to fund activities consistent with his vision and life.

src: Die Minister van Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling, mnrEbrahim Patel, sal gaste namens die regering toespreek.
tgt: The Minister of Economic Development will address guests on behalf of Government.

src: Die kabinet spoor alle Suid-Afrikaners aan om die Koop Plaaslik-veldtog te ondersteun en plaaslik vervaardigde klere met trots te dra.
tgt: Cabinet urges all South Africans to support the buy local campaign and to wear locally-made clothing with pride.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op elkeen van ons om betrokke te raak by die beweging vir verandering.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all people to become part of the movement for change.

src: Deur as ’n verenigde, nie-rassige en nie-seksistiese samelewing saam te werk, kan ons Madiba se nalatenskap handhaaf.
tgt: By working together as a united, non-racial and non-sexist society, we can uphold the legacy of Madiba.

src: DieKabinet doen ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om 67 minute van hul tyd op 18 Julie daaraan te wy om te help om behoeftiges se lewens te verbeter.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to dedicate their 67 minutes of their time on 18 July to contribute to making a change for the needy.

src: BeleggingDie Kabinet verwelkom die onlangse primêre notering van Old Mutual op die JSHierdie notering deur ’n maatskappy met ’n markkapitalisasie van US$10bn (R130 miljard) is ’n beduidende mosie van vertroue in Suid-Afrika en die plaaslike finansiële markte.
tgt: InvestmentCabinet welcomes the recent primary listing of Old Mutual on the JSThis listing by a company with a market capitalization of $10bn (R130bn), is a significant vote of confidence in South Africa and the local financial markets.

src: Die Kabinet neem met waardering kennis van die feit dat die primêre notering in Suid-Afrika, Old Mutual na sy Afrika-grondslag laat terugkeer en sy tydperk as ’n Londen-gebaseerde finansiëledienstegroep beëindig.
tgt: Cabinet appreciates that the primary listing in South Africa returns Old Mutual to its African roots and ends its period as a London-based financial services group.

src: Die verbintenis deur Old Mutual om ’n fonds ter waarde van R500 miljoen te skep om plaaslike ekonomiese ontwikkeling te bevorder, veral deur kleinsakeondernemings in swart besit, sal die land se pogings om ’n inklusiewe ekonomie te bou ’n hupstoot gee.
tgt: The commitment by Old Mutual to create a Fund of R500 million to promote local economic development, particularly by small, black-owned businesses, will boost the country’s efforts to build an inclusive economy.

src: Ons doen ’n beroep op ander maatskappye in die finansiële sektor om soortgelyke befondsingsinstrumente deur dialoog met die regering te ontwikkel.
tgt: We call on other corporates in the financial sector to develop similar developmental funding instruments through dialogue with Government.

src: Die Wêreld Ekonomiese Forum se onlangse Rondetafelbespreking oor Belegging het die geleentheid gebied om die potensiaal van Suid-Afrika as ’n bestemming vir groter en nuwe beleggings te bevorder.
tgt: The recent World Economic Forum Roundtable on Investment served to showcase the potential of South Africa as a destination for increased and new investment.

src: Die Rondetafelbespreking is deur ’n groot afvaardiging van hoof uitvoerende beamptes van binnelandse en internasionale firmas bygewoon, wat met President Cyril Ramaphosa en ’n afvaardiging van ministers gesprek gevoer het.
tgt: The Roundtable was attended by a large delegation of Chief Executive Officers of domestic and international firms, who interacted with President Ramaphosa and a delegation of Cabinet Ministers.

src: Die gesprekke het gehelp om maatreëls te identifiseer om beleggingsvlakke te verhoog en is ’n belangrike stap ter voorbereiding vir die beleggingskonferensie wat later vanjaar deur die president belê sal word.
tgt: The discussions were helpful in identifying measures to increase levels of investment and is a significant step towards the Investment Conference that will be convened by the President later this year.

src: GrondonteieningDie Kabinet waardeer die aanvang van die Parlement se proses vir openbare deelname om Artikel 25 van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996 te wysig.
tgt: Land expropriationCabinet appreciates the start of the Parliament’s public participation process to review Section 25 of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996 which will allow for the expropriation of land without compensation.

src: Dit sal voorsiening maak vir die onteiening van grond sonder vergoeding.
tgt: Parliament set up the Constitutional Review Committee to conduct public hearings countrywide after passing a motion on the expropriation of land without compensation.

src: Die Parlement het die Grondwetlike Hersieningskomitee ingestel om openbare verhore landwyd te hou, nadat ’n mosie oor die onteiening van grond sonder vergoeding aanvaar is.
tgt: These public hearings will take place in all the nine provinces until August 2018.Cabinet calls on all interested parties to participate peacefully in these hearings and appeals to the public to remain tolerant of varying views that may be expressed, in order to ensure that all have a fair opportunity to participate in the hearings.

src: Betaling van maatskaplike toelaesDie Kabinet is deur die Minister van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling, me Susan Shabangu, ingelig oor die onlangse wydverspreide vertragings in geskeduleerde uitbetalings van maatskaplike toelaes aan begunstigdes.
tgt: Minister Shabangu has assured Cabinet that the technical glitches were a result of the transition of the payments from an old system to a new South African Social Security Agency/South African Post Office system.

src: Khartoem-verklaringDie Kabinet verwelkom die ooreenkoms oor ’n permanente skietstilstand tussen Suid-Soedan se President Salva Kiir en Riek Machar, asook die ondertekening van die Khartoem-verklaring.
tgt: African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFRA)Cabinet welcomes South Africa’s signing of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) agreement with the AThe signing of this agreement by South Africa brings the number of countries who have signed to forty nine.

src: Dit skep die verwagting dat ’n ooreenkoms bereik kan word om die lande se vernietigende oorlog te beëindig.
tgt: The AfCFTA takes the continent closer to the creation of the world’s biggest free trade area.

src: Afrika Kontinentale Vryhandelsgebied (AfCFTA)Die Kabinet verwelkom Suid-Afrika se ondertekening van die AfCFTA-ooreenkoms met die ADie ondertekening van hierdie ooreenkoms met Suid-Afrika bring die aantal lande wat die ooreenkoms onderteken het, op 49 te staan.
tgt: African AgendaCabinet welcomes the 6th Southern African Customs Union (SACU) Summit held on 29 June 2018 in Botswana, which was attended by President Ramaphosa.

src: Die AfCFTA neem die vasteland ’n stappie nader aan die skep van die wêreld se grootste vryhandelsgebied.
tgt: The summit underscored the importance of the regional integration agenda that promotes economic integration, industrialisation and economic diversification of the SACU economies.

src: Afrika-agendaDie Kabinet verwelkom die 6de Beraad van die Suider-Afrikaanse Doeaneunie (SADU) wat op 29 Junie 2018 in Botswana gehou is en deur President Ramaphosa bygewoon is.
tgt: President Ramaphosa is currently hosting a State Visit by his Ghanaian counterpart, Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo, from 4 to 5 July 2018, to further strengthen bilateral relations between the two nations.

src: Handel- en beleggingsamewerking tussen die twee lande sluit in mynwese, kleinhandel, wetenskap en tegnologie, vervoer, toerisme, bankwese, telekommunikasie, konstruksie, dienste, franchise-toekenning, vervaardiging, visserye, reklame, lugvaart en energie.
tgt: The Women’s Month activities will mobilise society and build partnerships to decisively address key issues facing women and girls, particularly gender-based violence, women’s economic empowerment, access to land, harmful practices and other sectoral issues in the context of the National Development Plan (NDP) and South Africa’s international commitments.

src: Die Kabinet keur die konsepdokument en -plan vir Nasionale Vrouedag en Vrouemaand in Augustus 2018 goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the National Gambling Amendment Bill of 2018 to Parliament.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Nasionale Wysigingswet op Dobbelary van 2018 by die Parlement ingedien word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Competition Amendment Bill of 2018 to Parliament.

src: Die openbare oorlegplegingsproses oor die wetsontwerp met al die betrokke belanghebbers is reeds afgehandel.
tgt: The Bill has already been gazetted for public comment and discussed with all the relevant stakeholders.

src: Die wysigings maak voorsiening vir die uitbreiding van die mandaat van die mededingingsowerhede en die Uitvoerende Gesag om hoë vlakke van ekonomiese konsentrasie, beperkte transformasie in die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie en misbruik van markkrag deur dominante firmas aan te pak.
tgt: National Imbizo Focus WeekGovernment will embark on its National Imbizo Focus Week from 9 to 15 July 2018, where members of the Executive will engage directly with citizens across the WEBTOKEN of the cornerstones of democratic South Africa has been government’s steadfast commitment to embark on regular participatory and responsive public-engagement programmes to outline government policies and plans.

src: Die Wetsontwerp is reeds vir openbare kommentaar in die Staatskoerant gepubliseer en met al die tersaaklike belanghebbers bespreek.
tgt: Cabinet encourages all communities in the spirit of “Thuma Mina” to participate in the izimbizo with government officials and use the opportunity to address service-delivery challenges.

src: 100 Manne-optogOnder die sambreel van die nasionale “Stuur My – Thuma Mina”-veldtog onder leiding van die Regering se Kommunikasie- en Inligtingstelsel (GCIS) sal ’n geskiedkundige “100 Jaar van Nelson Mandela en Albertina Sisulu: Manne-optog teen Geweld teenoor Vroue en Kinders” op Dinsdag, 10 Julie 2018 plaasvind.
tgt: 10th BRICS SummitSouth Africa is ready to host, in the spirit of Ubuntu (Humanity), the 10th summit of the Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa (BRICS) bloc from 25 to 27 July 2018, at the Sandton Convention Centre in Gauteng.

src: Die optog, wat deur die GCIS gekoördineer word, sal om 10:00 by Kerkplein begin en op die suidelike grasperk van die Uniegebou in Pretoria eindig.
tgt: On Friday, 6 July 2018, President Ramaphosa is scheduled to engage with Team South Africa over breakfast on the readiness to host the 10th BRICS Summit.

src: Die kabinet nooi alle mans en seuns uit om op die “Stuur my – Thuma Mina”- oproep tot aksie te reageer deur aan die optog deel te neem en standpunt in te neem teen die plaag van geweld teen vroue en kinders.
tgt: The theme: “BRICS in Africa: Collaboration for Inclusive Growth and Shared Prosperity in the 4th Industrial Revolution”, reflects the core priorities of the BRICS members, notably to strive towards the creation of an inclusive society and global partnerships that will bring prosperity to all humankind.

src: 10de BRICS-beraadSuid-Afrika is gereed om in die gees van Ubuntu (Meslikheid) die 10de beraad van die Brasilië, Rusland, Indië, Sjina en Suid-Afrika (BRICS) -groep van 25 tot 27 Julie 2018 by die Sandton-konvensiesentrum in Gauteng aan te bied.
tgt: Roundtable of African Ministers of Arts and CultureThe Department of Arts and Culture is hosting the Roundtable of African Ministers of Arts and Culture in Durban from 5 to 6 July 2018.

src: Op Vrydag 6 Julie 2018, sal President Ramaphosa tydens ’n ontbytsessie met die Suid-Afrikaanse span gesprek voer oor hul gereedheid om die 10de BRICS-beraad aan te bied.
tgt: The event seeks to report on information access to profile the impact of library and information services within the context of the AU Agenda 2063, which is a strategic framework for the socio-economic transformation of the continent over the next 50 years.

src: Die tema, “BRICS in Afrika: Samewerking vir Inklusiewe Groei en Gedeelde Welvaart in die 4de Nywerheidsrewolusie”, weerspieël die kernprioriteite van die BRICS-groep, in die besonder die strewe na ’n inklusiewe samelewing en internasionale vennootskappe, wat sal help om welvaart vir alle mense te skep.
tgt: MeerKAT telescope/Square Kilometer Array (SKA) President Ramaphosa is expected to launch the 64-dish radio telescope, known as the MeerKAT, as a precursor to the SKA telescope.

src: Die tema belyn en verseker strategiese kontinuïteit met Suid-Afrika se voorsitterskap van sowel die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap en die Indiese Oseaan Randvereniging.
tgt: The MeerKAT is located 90 km outside the small town of Carnarvon in the Northern Cape.

src: Suid-Afrika sal sy voorsitterskap gebruik om kontinuïteit vir BRICS te verseker en om die fokus spesifiek op die geleenthede wat die Vierde Nywerheidsrewolusie bied, te laat val.
tgt: The MeerKAT telescope will be instrumental in significantly increasing knowledge of how the Universe was formed, how it works and what may shape its future.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy innige medelye met voormalige President Jacob Zuma en sy familie en vriende, met die afsterwe van sy seun, Vusi Nhlakanipho Zuma, vroeër vandeesweek.
tgt: Cabinet also expresses its condolences to the family and friends of the miner who died at the Sibanye-Stilwater’s Khomanani Mine in Driefontein in Mpumalanga and remains concerned over the safety of miners at the mine.

src: Die Kabinet betuig ook sy medelye met die familie en vriende van die mynwerker wat by die Sibanye-Stilwaters Khomanani-myn in Driefontein in Mpumalanga gesterf het en spreek weer eens sy kommer uit oor die veiligheid van mynwerkers by hierdie myn.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the decision by the UN Education, Scientific and Cultural Organisation to declare the Makhonjwa Mountains in Mpumalanga, also known as the Barberton Greenstone Belt, as a World Heritage Site.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle belanghebbers in die toerismesektor om al die erfenisterreine in Suid-Afrika te bemark, aangesien toerisme een van die versnellers is vir die ontwikkeling van ons ekonomie en werkskepping vir plaaslike mense.
