src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 22 Augustus 2018 by Tuynhuys in Kaapstad vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 22 August 2018 at Tuynhuys in Cape Town.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Issues In The Environment.

src: Ekonomie.
tgt: Economy.

src: Die onlangse ekonomiese ontwikkelinge in Turkye het tot ’n beduidende waardevermindering van ontluikende markte se geldeenhede, insluitend die Suid-Afrikaanse rand, gelei.
tgt: The recent economic developments in Turkey have led to a large depreciation of emerging market currencies, including the South African Rand.

src: Kapitaalbeweging uit hierdie markte het versnel en die opbrengs van effekte het gestyg, wat ekonomiese groei en werkskepping vertraag.
tgt: Capital outflows from these markets have accelerated and bond yields have risen, slowing down economic growth and job creation.

src: Turkye se beduidende buitelandse-valuta gedenomineerde laste en relatief lae buitelandse valuta-reserwes het die land vatbaar gemaak vir groot en skadelike kapitaaluitvloei, terwyl monetêre beleid in gevorderde ekonomieë begin normaliseer het.
tgt: Turkey’s large foreign currency denominated liabilities and relatively low levels of foreign currency reserves predisposed the country to large and damaging capital outflows, as monetary policy started to normalise in advanced economies.

src: Die Kabinet wys daarop dat Suid-Afrika verskeie sterk punte het, insluitend 'n onafhanklike sentrale bank, 'n inflasieteikenstelsel met inflasie konsekwent binne die teikenreeks, lae vlakke van buitelandse valuta-skuld en 'n duidelike fiskale konsolidasieplan.
tgt: Cabinet notes that South Africa has a number of strengths, including an independent central bank, an inflation-targeting regime with inflation consistently within the target range, low levels of foreign-currency debt and a clear fiscal consolidation plan.

src: Die Kabinet is verbind tot die handhawing van hierdie sterk punte.
tgt: Cabinet is committed to maintaining these strengths.

src: Die regering sal terselfdertyd voortgaan met hervormings om die groeipotensiaal van die ekonomie te verhoog en die geloofwaardigheid van ons beleidsbesluite te verbeter.
tgt: At the same time, government will continue to implement reforms to increase the growth potential of the economy and improve the credibility of our policy decisions.

src: Die regering sal voortgaan om met die sake-, arbeid- en burgerlike sektore saam te werk om vertroue in die ekonomie te herstel en die strukturele beperkings wat ekonomiese groei vertraag uit weg te ruim.
tgt: Government will continue to collaborate with business, labour and civil society to restore confidence in the economy and address the structural constraints to economic growth.

src: Deur saam te werk, kan ons planne omskep in daadwerklike optrede om die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie vorentoe te beweeg.
tgt: Working together we can translate our plans into concrete actions to move the South African economy forward.

src: Belasting op Toegevoegde Waarde (BTW).
tgt: Value-Added Tax (VAT).

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die verslag van die ministeriële paneel van kundiges wat die lys van items wat van BTW vrygestel is, hersien het en aanbeveel dat witbrood, broodmeel, koekmeel, sanitêre produkte en skooldrag ingesluit word.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the report by the Ministerial Panel of Experts which reviewed the list of zero-rated VAT items and recommended the inclusion of white bread, bread flour, cake flour, sanitary products and school uniforms.

src: Die Kabinet moedig Suid-Afrikaners aan om hul menings oor die verslag, wat tot 31 Augustus 2018 vir openbare kommentaar beskikbaar is, te lug.
tgt: Cabinet encourages South Africans to voice their opinions on the report, which is open for public comment until 31 August 2018.

src: Die Minister van Finansies, mnrNhlanhla Nene, sal hierná 'n ingeligte besluit maak oor watter voorstelle om te implementeer.
tgt: The Minister of Finance, Mr Nhlanhla Nene, will then make an informed choice on which proposals to implement.

src: Voorleggings kan skriftelik aan EMAILTOKEN gerig word.
tgt: Submissions can be made in writing to EMAILTOKEN Women’s Month.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle burgers om steeds saam te werk om die veiligheid en bemagtiging van vroue in ons samelewing te verseker.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all citizens to continue with the drive to ensure the safety and empowerment of women in our society.

src: Ons loof alle sektore van die samelewing wat inisiatiewe begin het wat daarop gemik is om geslagsgebaseerde geweld (GBV) te beveg.
tgt: We commend all sectors of society for heading up initiatives aimed at fighting gender-based violence (GBV).

src: Hoewel Vrouemaand tot 'n einde kom, huldig die Kabinet steeds vroue in dieselfde gees as wat ons die vroue huldig wat in 1956 na die Uniegebou in Pretoria marsjeer het in protes teen 'n wrede regime wat gepoog het om diskriminerende paswette te gebruik om hul waardigheid te ondermyn.
tgt: As Women's Month draws to a close, Cabinet continues to honour women in the same spirit that we honour the women of 1956 who marched to the Union Buildings in Pretoria in defiance of a brutal regime that sought to use discriminatory pass laws to undermine their dignity.

src: Sedert die begin van ons demokrasie in 1994, is beduidende vordering gemaak om te verseker dat vroue dieselfde regte geniet as hul manlike eweknieë in onderwys, indiensneming, eiendom, erfenis en geregtigheid.
tgt: Since the start of our democracy in 1994, great strides have been made to ensure that women enjoy the same rights as their male counterparts in education, employment, property, inheritance and justice.

src: In die bestuur van 'n inklusiewe ekonomie werk ons hard om die volle deelname van vroue in die ekonomie te verseker en 'n inklusiewe ekonomie te bestuur.
tgt: In driving an inclusive economy, we are working hard to ensure the full participation of women in the economy and driving an inclusive economy.

src: As deel van die Vrouedagvierings, bied die Departement van Landbou, Bosbou en Visserye, in vennootskap met die Departement van Landelike Ontwikkeling en Grondhervorming en Total South Africa, op Donderdag 23 Augustus 2018 sy 19de Jaarlikse Vroulike Entrepreneur-toekennings in Oos-Londen in die Oos-Kaap aan.
tgt: As part of celebrating Women’s Month, the Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries – in partnership with the Department of Rural Development and Land Reform, and Total South Africa – will on Thursday, 23 August 2018 hold its 19th Annual Female Entrepreneur Awards in East London in the Eastern Cape.

src: Die regering beplan om saam met sy vennote 'n nasionale gender-beraad te hou om eenstemmigheid te bereik oor die beste maniere om geslagsgebaseerde geweld te hanteer.
tgt: Government, together with its partners, will hold a National Gender Summit to forge consensus on how best to deal with GBThe Minister of Police, Mr Bheki Cele, has recommitted members of the South African Police Service (SAPS) to prioritise cases that involve the abuse of women and children.

src: Wanneer 'n vrou of 'n kind 'n misdaad of mishandeling aanmeld, moet dit opgevolg word met die dringendheid wat dit verdien en ten volle ondersoek en afgehandel word.
tgt: When a woman or a child reports a crime or abuse, it must be followed up with the urgency it deserves and taken to its full conclusion.

src: GrondonteieningDie Kabinet bedank Suid-Afrikaners wat deelgeneem het aan die openbare parlementêre verhore oor die moontlike hersiening van Artikel 25 van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996, wat daarop gemik is om grondonteiening sonder vergoeding toe te laat.
tgt: Land expropriation Cabinet thanks South Africans who participated in the parliamentary public hearings into the possible review of Section 25 of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996 to allow for the expropriation of land without compensation.

src: Die Parlement se konstitusionele hersieningskomitee het verhore in alle provinsies afgesluit.
tgt: Parliament’s Constitutional Review Committee has concluded hearings in all Provinces.

src: Beraadslaging oor hierdie verhore, sowel as skriftelike insette sal nou deur die Parlement oorweeg word.
tgt: The deliberations on these hearings as well as written inputs will now be considered by Parliament.

src: Besprekings oor grondbesit in Suid-Afrika is noodsaaklik en deur saam te werk kan ons verseker dat grondhervormings verder daartoe bydra om ons ekonomie, veral in die landbousektor, verbeter en die ongelykhede met betrekking tot grondbesit in ons land uit die weg te ruim.
tgt: Discussions on the issue of land ownership in South Africa is vital and working together we can ensure that land reforms can further assist in growing our economy particularly in the agricultural sector and address the land ownership inequalities in our country.

src: President Cyril Ramaphosa het 'n interministeriële komitee onder voorsitterskap van Adjunkpresident David Mabuza aangestel, om maatreëls te koördineer en te implementeer om die herverdeling van grond te versnel, die uitbreiding van sekerheid oor verblyfreg, die voorsiening van landboubystand en die herstel van ruimtelike ongelykheid binne 'n wye en omvattende grondherverdeling- en landbou-ontwikkelingsprogram.
tgt: President Cyril Ramaphosa has appointed an Inter-Ministerial Committee chaired by Deputy President David Mabuza to coordinate and implement measures to accelerate the redistribution of land, the extension of security of tenure, the provision of agricultural support and the redress of spatial inequality, within a broad and comprehensive land redistribution and agricultural development programme.

src: Sanitasie geskik vir onderwys (SAFE) -inisiatief.
tgt: Sanitation Appropriate for Education (SAFE) Initiative.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling deur President Ramaphosa van die SAFE-inisiatief as deel van die regering se reaksie op die sanitasie-uitdagings wat sommige van die land se armste skole in die gesig staar.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the launch by President Ramaphosa of the SAFE Initiative, as part of government’s response to the sanitation challenges facing some of the country’s poorest schools.

src: Die SAFE-inisiatief word deur die Departement van Basiese Onderwys gelei, in vennootskap met die National Education Collaboration Trust en die Nelson Mandela- stigting.
tgt: The SAFE Initiative is led by the Department of Basic Education, in partnership with the National Education Collaboration Trust and the Nelson Mandela Foundation.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle sektore van die samelewing, insluitend groot sake-ondernemings en nie-regeringsorganisasies, om die inisiatief, wat gerig is op die verligting van infrastruktuur-agterstande by skole in arm gemeenskappe, te ondersteun.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all sectors of society, including big business and non-governmental organisations, to support the initiative that is aimed at alleviating infrastructure backlogs for schools in poor communities.

src: Nasionale Studente Finansiële Hulpskema (NSFAS)Die Kabinet is deur die Minister van Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding, me Naledi Pandor, ingelig oor die uitdagings wat NSFAS in die gesig staar.
tgt: National Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS)Cabinet was briefed by the Minister of Higher Education and Training, Ms Naledi Pandor, on the challenges facing the NSFAIn order to stabilise and decisively address the challenges faced by the NSFAS in the disbursement of funds to deserving students, Cabinet supported the appointment of the Administrator, Dr Randall Carolissen.

src: Om die uitdagings wat NSFAS ervaar met die uitbetaling van fondse aan verdienstelike studente te stabiliseer en daadwerklike die hoof te bied, ondersteun die Kabinet die aanstelling van die administrateur, dr Randall Carolissen.
tgt: The appointment of the Dr Carolissen effectively dissolves the current NSFAS Board.

src: Die Administrateur, in samewerking met die bestuur, sal toegewyde aandag gee aan die agterstande en ander uitdagings wat die entiteit in die gesig staar om te verseker dat studentebefondsing vir 2019 optimaal geadministreer word, en dat alle uitstaande kwessies van 2017 en 2018 opgelos word.
tgt: The Administrator together with the management will work towards dealing decisively with backlogs and other challenges facing the entity so as to ensure student funding is administered optimally for 2019, and that all outstanding issues for 2017 and 2018 are resolved.

src: PersoneelinkortingsDie Kabinet is besorg oor onlangse aankondigings van moontlike afleggings en werksverliese in sommige nywerhede, insluitend mynbou en die media.
tgt: RetrenchmentsCabinet is concerned by recent announcements over possible retrenchments and job losses in some industries, including mining and media.

src: Ons herhaal ons beroep op die saksektor om afleggings slegs as 'n laaste uitweg te oorweeg, en om ander beskikbare en innoverende maniere te ondersoek om werksgeleenthede te behou.
tgt: We reiterate our appeal to business to consider retrenchment only as a last resort, and to explore other available and innovative ways to sustain jobs.

src: Die regering werk steeds saam met die sake- en arbeidsektor en is oortuig daarvan dat ons die ekonomie deur samewerking kan laat groei en nuwe werksgeleenthede kan skep.
tgt: Government continues to partner with business and labour, and remains convinced that working together, we can grow our economy and create new jobs.

src: UitsaaiweseDie Kabinet verwelkom die nuus dat die SAUK Engelse Premierliga-wedstryde sal vertoon.
tgt: BroadcastingCabinet welcomes the news that the SABC will screen English Premiership League games.

src: Terwyl dit 'n inkomstegeleentheid vir die SAUK mag wees, hoop die regering dat die vertoning van hierdie wedstryde nie plaaslike sport sal benadeel nie en ook nie die openbare uitsaaier se finansiële posisie sal verswak nie, gegewe die huidige likiditeitsuitdagings.
tgt: While this may be a revenue opportunity for the SABC, government hopes that the screening of these games will not sacrifice local sports and also worsen the financial position of the public broadcaster, given its current liquidity challenges.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die uitnodiging om aansoek te doen vir die lisensiëring van spektrum vir die voorsiening van subskripsie-uitsaaidienste deur die Onafhanklike Kommunikasie-owerheid van Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Cabinet notes the Invitation to Apply for the licensing of spectrum for the provision of subscription broadcasting services by the Independent Communications Authority of South Africa.

src: Terwyl sake rakende lisensiëring, ooreenkomstig Artikel 192 van die Grondwet, die eksklusiewe domein van die reguleerder is, moet die lisensiëringproses op ‘n manier geskied wat nie gratis uitsaaisdienste (free-to-air) destabiliseer tydens die oorgang van analoog na digitaal of onmededingende optrede aanmoedig nie.
tgt: While matters pertaining to licensing are the exclusive domain of the regulator, consistent with Section 192 of the Constitution, the licensing process should be done in a manner that does not destabilize the free-to-air platform during the transition from analogue to digital or encourages uncompetitive behaviour.

src: Dit moet verseker dat nuwe lisensiehouers regverdig en openlik kan meeding.
tgt: It should ensure that new licensees are able to compete fairly and openly.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet Decisions.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die ooreenkoms waarvolgens die Afrika Kontinentale Vryhandelsgebied gevestig sal word, vir bekragtiging aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Agreement establishing the African Continental Free Trade Area to Parliament for ratification.

src: Hierdie ooreenkoms sal toegang tot nuwe en dinamiese markte in die res van Afrika verseker, veral nuwe markte in Wes- en Noord-Afrika.
tgt: This agreement will result in access to new and dynamic markets in the rest of Africa, in particular new markets in West Africa and North Africa.

src: Dit sal ook uitvoergeleenthede vir Suid-Afrikaanse produkte bied.
tgt: It will also provide export opportunities for South African products.

src: Dit sal verder ook belyn wees met die geïntegreerde ontwikkelingsbenadering op die vasteland en sal nywerheidsontwikkeling, belegging en werkskepping op die vasteland stimuleer.
tgt: This will also be in line with the integrated development approach in the continent.

src: Studie oor spektrumlisensiëringDie Kabinet het die bevinding van die opdragstudie deur die Wetenskaplike en Nywerheidsnavorsingsraad goedgekeur, wat daarop gerig was om die hoeveelheid spektrum vir oop toegang en lisensiëring vir die bedryf te bepaal.
tgt: Study on spectrum licensingCabinet approved the outcome of the commissioned study by the Council for Scientific and Industrial Research, which sought to determine the amount of spectrum for open access and licensing to the industry.

src: Die studie bevestig dat die spektrum gelisensieer kan word aan beide die Wireless Open Access Network (WOAN) en die bedryf.
tgt: The study confirms that spectrum can be licensed to both the Wireless Open Access Network (WOAN) and the industry.

src: Dit sal onder meer aan die nasionale beleidsverpligtinge voldoen, die koste van kommunikasie stabiliseer.
tgt: This will, amongst others, achieve the national policy obligations, cost of communication remove the entry barriers for small and medium companies, and sustain the current investments.

src: die toegangsperke vir klein en medium maatskappye uit die weg ruim en die huidige beleggings handhaaf.
tgt: The Minister of Telecommunications and Postal Services, Dr Siyabonga Cwele, will hold a full media briefing to unpack this report.

src: Vordering met NoordwesDie Kabinet het die vierde vorderingsverslag oor die Artikel 100 (1) -ingryping in Noordwes ontvang.
tgt: Progress on North WestCabinet received the fourth progress report on the Section 100(1) intervention in North West.

src: Die Kabinet is tevrede met die implementeringsfase, waartydens verskeie mylpale bereik is met betrekking tot die institusionalisering van die projek in die provinsie.
tgt: Cabinet is satisfied with the implementation stage, with several milestones reached in terms of the institutionalization of the project in the province.

src: Die Meorandum van Verstandhouding van die Interministeriële Taakspan (IMTT) op Noordwes tussen die nasionale en provinsiale regering is ondertekenVyf administrateurs vir die departemente wat onder Artikel 100 (1) b geplaas is, is aangestel en formeel as rekenpligtige beamptes bevestigDie amptelike verslae en riglyne tussen die onderskeie nasionale ministers en provinsiale LUR'e is onderteken ooreenkomstig Artikel 100 (1)
tgt: The Memorandum of Understanding between the national and provincial government has been signed from the Inter-Ministerial Task Team (IMTT) on North West Five administrators for the departments placed under Section 100(1)b have been appointed and formally installed as accounting officersThe protocols and directives between the respective National Ministers and provincial MECs have been signed in line with Section 100(1) andAn overall coordinator for the management of the North West intervention has been appointed.

src: en'n Algehele koördineerder vir die bestuur van die Noordwes-ingryping is aangestel.
tgt: Cabinet further expressed appreciation to the immediate intervention by the South African National Defense Force (SANDF) and the Municipal Infrastructure Support Agent to the sewage crisis in the Ditsobotla Local Municipality in North West.

src: Die Kabinet spreek sy waardering uit vir die onmiddellike ingryping deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Weermag (SANW) en die Munisipale Infrastruktuur-ondersteuningsagent om die rioolkrisis in die Ditsobotla Plaaslike Munisipaliteit in Noordwes te pak.
tgt: The spillage of the sewerage, which had become a health hazard to the community, has been cleared.

src: Die Kabinet prys die werk wat tot op hede deur die administrateurs onder leiding van die IMTT gedoen is, met Minister Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma as voorsitter.
tgt: Cabinet commended the work that has been done to date by the Administrators under the leadership of the IMTT, chaired by Minister Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma.

src: Geïntegreerde Hulpbronplan (IRP)Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die publikasie van die hersiende Geïntegreerde Hulpbronplan vir openbare insette.
tgt: Integrated Resource Plan (IRP)Cabinet approved the publication of the updated Integrated Resource Plan for public input.

src: Die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan identifiseer die behoefte vir Suid-Afrika om in 'n sterk netwerk van ekonomiese infrastruktuur te belê, wat geskep is om die land se medium- en langtermyn ekonomiese en sosiale doelwitte te bevorder.
tgt: The National Development Plan identifies the need for South Africa to invest in a strong network of economic infrastructure designed to support the country’s medium- and long-term economic and social objectives.

src: Energie-infrastruktuur is 'n kritieke komponent wat ekonomiese aktiwiteit en groei regoor die land bevorder dit moet kragtig en omvangryk genoeg wees om in nywerheids-, kommersiële en huishoudelike behoeftes te voorsien.
tgt: Energy infrastructure is a critical component that underpins economic activity and growth across the country it needs to be robust and extensive enough to meet industrial, commercial and household needs.

src: Die finalisering van die Geïntegreerde Hulpbronplan sal rolspelers in die bedryf sowel as verbruikers gerusstel oor die sekerheid van elektrisiteitsvoorsiening op die medium- tot langtermyn.
tgt: The finalisation of the IRP will provide the necessary certainty to industry players as well as consumers in so far as security of electricity supply in the medium to long term is concerned.

src: Die Minister van Energie, mnrJeff Radebe, en die departement sal die konsepverslag op Vrydag 24 Augustus met die Nasionale Ekonomiese Ontwikkelings- en Arbeidsraad bespreek.
tgt: The Minister of Energy, Mr Jeff Radebe, and the department will engage the National Economic Development and Labour Council EXCO on Friday, 24 August on the draft report, which will also be published in the Government Gazette and the Department of Energy’s website (WEBTOKEN) by not later than Monday, 27 August Cabinet approved the Government Communication Policy, which will be applicable across government.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die implementering van die Finale Strategie vir die Hantering van Lugbesoedeling in Suid-Afrika se Digbevolkte Lae-inkomste Gemeenskappe.
tgt: The strategy provides a coordinated approach in reducing air pollution associated with fossil fuel in dense low-income communities.

src: Die strategie bied 'n gekoördineerde benadering tot die vermindering van lugbesoedeling wat verband hou met fossielbrandstof in digevolkte lae-inkomste gemeenskappe.
tgt: The current air circulation in these communities exceed the National Ambient Air Quality Standards set out in the National Environmental Management: Air Quality Act, 2004 (Act 39 of 2004).

src: Die strategie maak voorsiening vir ingrypings om besoedeling te verminder en beveel 'n bewusmakingsprogram aan wat die gesondheidsimpak van voortgesette besoedeling sal beklemtoon.
tgt: The strategy provides for interventions to reduce pollution and recommends an awareness programmes that will highlight the health impact of continued pollution.

src: Dit bied ook alternatiewe energie-opsies.
tgt: It also provides for alternative energy options.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die Groen Vervoer Strategie, wat sal bydra tot die vermindering van kweekhuisgas-uitstraling (GHG) in die omgewing.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Green Transport Strategy, which will contribute towards reducing the emission of greenhouse gas (GHG) in the environment.

src: Tans verteenwoordig die vervoersektor 10,8% van die totale GHG-uitstraling, waarvan padvervoer vir 91,2% verantwoordelik vir.
tgt: Currently, the transport sector accounts for 10, 8% of the total GHG emissions, with road transport being responsible for 91.2% of these GHG emissions.

src: Die strategie stel 'n aantal ingrypings voor wat uitstraling sal verminder.
tgt: The strategy introduces a number of interventions that will provide less emissions.

src: Dit beveel alternatiewe vervoermiddels aan wat minder GHG in die omgewing sal uitstraal.
tgt: It recommends alternative modes of transportations that emit less GHG in the environment.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die handves vir die vestiging van die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap (SAOG) se Lugvaartveiligheidsorganisasie (SASO) aan die Parlement voorgelê word vir goedkeuring.
tgt: The strategy has already gone through public consultations in Cabinet approved submission of the charter establishing the Southern African Development Community (SADC) Aviation Safety Organisation (SASO) to Parliament for approval.

src: Die handves voorsien 'n wetlike en institusionele raamwerk vir die vestiging van SASO, wat daarop gerig is om die SAOG-lidlande te help met toesig oor hul burgerlike lugvaartveiligheid.
tgt: The charter provides a legal and institutional framework to establish SASO, to assist SADC Member States with their civil aviation safety oversight.

src: Dit sal ook die ontwikkeling van doeltreffende burgerlike lugvaartinfrastruktuur in die SAOG-lidlande fasiliteer.
tgt: It will also facilitate the development of efficient and effective civil-aviation infrastructure in SADC Member States.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die Witskrif oor Kuns, Kultuur en Erfenis van 2018.
tgt: Cabinet approved the White Paper on Arts, Culture and Heritage of 2018.

src: Die Witskrif herroep elemente van die Witskrif oor Kuns, Kultuur en Erfenis van 1996.
tgt: The White Paper revokes elements of the White Paper on Arts, Culture and Heritage of 1996.

src: Die Witskrif is 'n samevatting van die hersiening van die 1996-Witskrif, wat prestasies in alle fasette van kuns, kultuur en erfenis waardeer het en wat weerspieël is op gebiede wat 'n uitdaging vir die bevordering van nasiebou en sosiale samehorigheid in ons demokrasie was.
tgt: The White Paper is a culmination of the review of the 1996 White Paper, which appreciated the achievements in all the facets of arts, culture and heritage and reflected on areas that remained a challenge in advancing nation-building and social cohesion in our democracy.

src: Die Witskrif is daarop gerig om 'n dinamiese, lewendige en 'n getransformeerde Suid-Afrikaanse kuns, kultuur- en erfenissektor te skep, wat sal bydra tot nasiebou, sosiale samehorigheid en sosio-ekonomiese insluiting.
tgt: The White Paper aims for a dynamic, vibrant and a transformed South African arts, culture and heritage sector that will contribute towards nation-building, social cohesion and socio-economic inclusion.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die Nasionale Beleidsraamwerk vir Onderwater Kulturele Erfenis, wat ’n samevoeging is van die Verenigde Nasies se Opvoedkundige, Wetenskaplike en Kulturele Organisasie se Konvensie, die Wet op Nasionale Erfenishulpbronne, 1999 (Wet 25 van 1999) en ander tersaaklike nasionale wetgewing.
tgt: Cabinet approved the National Policy Framework on Underwater Cultural Heritage, which synergizes the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organisation Convention, the National Heritage Resources Act, 1999 (Act 25 of 1999) and other relevant national legislation.

src: Die beleid word ondersteun deur die beginsel dat kulturele erfenis aan alle mense van Suid-Afrika behoort.
tgt: The policy is underpinned by the principle that cultural heritage belongs to all people of South Africa.

src: Dit identifiseer 'n verskeidenheid belanghebbendes en optredes om onderwater kulturele erfenis te bevorder, en om bewusmaking van die betekenis en kapasiteitsbou daarvan te bevorder.
tgt: It identifies a range of stakeholders and actions to promote underwater cultural heritage, and to create awareness of its significance and capacity building.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die Suid-Afrikaanse Poskantoor se 2018- en 2019-Jaarlikse Seëlprogram.
tgt: Cabinet approved the 2018 and 2019 Annual Stamp Programme from the South African Post Office.

src: Die seëls weerspieël Suid-Afrika se diverse kultuur, nasionale identiteit, geskiedenis, ryk erfenis, helde en heldinne en die omgewing, sowel as sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling.
tgt: The stamps reflect South Africa’s diverse culture, national identity, history, rich heritage, heroes and heroines, the environment as well as socio-economic development.

src: Die seëls dien ook as klein ambassadeurs vir Suid-Afrika terwyl hulle dwarsoor die wêreld deur die posnetwerk reis.
tgt: The stamps further serve as small ambassadors for South Africa as they travel across the world through the postal network.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die ontwerpe van die gedenkmunte wat in 2019 deur die Muntmaatskappy uitgereik sal word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the designs of the commemorative collectors’ coin series to be issued in 2019 by the Mint Company.

src: Wetsontwerpe.
tgt: Bills.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Kieswette van 2018 aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Electoral Laws Amendment Bill of 2018 to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp wysig drie dele van wetgewing, naamlik die Wet op die Verkiesingskommissie, 1996 (Wet 51 van 1996) die Kieswet, 1998 (Wet 73 van 1998) en die Wet op Plaaslike Regering: Munisipale Verkiesing, 2000 (Wet 27 van 2000).Die Wetsontwerp bring 'n aantal wysigings aan om die verkiesingsprosesse van die Onafhanklike Verkiesingskommissie (OVK) aan te pas.
tgt: The Bill amends three pieces of legislation, namely the Electoral Commission Act, 1996 (Act 51 of 1996) Electoral Act, 1998 (Act 73 of 1998) and the Local Government: Municipal Electoral Act, 2000 (Act 27 of 2000).The Bill makes a number of amendments to adjust the Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) election processes.

src: Sommige van die voorgestelde veranderinge bepaal dat die OVK alle beskikbare bronne van data kan gebruik om inligting te verkry wat nodig is om die nasionale gemeenskaplike kieserslys saam te stel en in stand te hou.
tgt: Some of the proposed changes provides that the IEC can use all available sources of data to obtain information necessary to compile and maintain the national common voters’ roll.

src: Dit maak ook voorsiening vir die verbod op die gebruik van die OVK se naam en sy akroniem, sy logo-ontwerpe of materiële gebruik van enige iets wat in besit van die OVK is.
tgt: It also provides for the prohibition of the use of the name and its acronym, logo designs or material use or owned by the IECabinet approved submission of the Electronic Communications Amendment Bill to Parliament.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Elektroniese Kommunikasie aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: The Bill amends the Electronic Communication Act, 2005 (Act 36 of 2005) to give effect to the National Integrated ICT Policy White Paper, for the transformation of South Africa into an inclusive, and innovative knowledge and digital society.

src: Dit maak ook voorsiening vir die transformasie van die sektor deur die handhawing van breëbasis swart ekonomiese bemagtiging.
tgt: It also provides for the transformation of the sector through enforcement of broad-based black economic empowerment.

src: Dit maak verder voorsiening vir die vermindering van die koste van kommunikasie.
tgt: Amongst others, it provides for the lowering of the cost of communications.

src: Dit verminder ook duplisering van infrastruktuur en moedig diensgebaseerde mededinging deur 'n WOAN-diens aan.
tgt: It also reduces infrastructure duplications and encourages service-based competition through a WOAN service.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Finansiële Aangeleenthede van 2018 vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer word.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the publication of the Financial Matters Amendment Bill of 2018 for public comment.

src: Die wysigings is in vyf dele van wetgewing verdeel: Die Insolvensiewet van 1963 om die regulering van die oor-die-toonbank-afgeleide mark te versterk, ooreenkomstig G20-verpligtingeDie Wet op Militêre Pensioene van 1976, om diskriminerende voorsiening die hoof te bied en geslagsneutraalheid te verseker deur verskillende soorte verhoudings te erkenDie Bankwet van 1990, om kwalifiserende maatskappye in staatsbesit toe te laat om aansoek te doen vir banklisensies, onderworpe aan goedkeuring deur die Uitvoerende GesagDie Wet op Regeringsdienspensioene van 1996, om die skoonbreekbeginsel in die geval van egskeiding te verander om te verseker dat lede se pensioenuitbetalings aan voormalige eggenote met egskeiding nie omgeskakel word na 'n skuldverpligting nie enDie Wet op die Ouditprofessie van 2005, om die uitdagings en beperkings waarmee die Onafhanklike Regulerende Raad vir Ouditeurs te doen kry in die uitvoer van sy regulatoriese en toesighoudende verantwoordelikhede, die hoof te bied.
tgt: The amendments are in five pieces of legislations:The Insolvency Act of 1963, to strengthen the regulation of over-the-counter derivative market, in line with G20 commitmentsThe Military Pensions Act of 1976, to address discriminatory provision and ensure gender neutrality to recognise different types of relationshipsThe Banks Act of 1990, to allow for qualifying state-owned companies to apply for banking licences, subject to Executive approvalThe Government Employment Pension Law of 1996, to change the clean break principle in the case of divorce, ensuring that members’ pension pay outs to former spouses on divorce are not converted to a debt obligation andThe Auditing Profssion Act of 2005, to address challenges and limitations that the Independent Regulatory Board for Auditors faces in discharging its regulatory and oversight responsibilities.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Militêre Dissipline Wetsontwerp van 2018 aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Military Discipline Bill of 2018 to Parliament.

src: Dit hanteer die administrasie van die militêre regstelsel, die skep en aanstelling van militêre polisiedienste en dissiplinêre verhore.
tgt: It addresses the administration of military judicial system, creation and appointment of military police services, and disciplinary hearings.

src: Die Wetsontwerp sal die huidige Wet op Militêre Dissipline Aanvullende Maatreëls, 1999 (Wet 16 van 1999) herroep.
tgt: The Bill will repeal the current Military Discipline Supplementary Measures Act, 1999 (Act 16 of 1999).

src: Hierdie wetsontwerp sal die militêre dissipline van die SANW met die VN belyn, veral ten opsigte van soldate tydens vredesopdragte.
tgt: This Bill will align SANDF Military Discipline to the UN, especially on soldiers in peacekeeping missions.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Maatskappye van 2018 in die Staatskoerant gepubliseer word vir openbare kommentaar.
tgt: Cabinet approved publication of the Companies Amendment Bill of 2018 in the Government Gazette for public comment.

src: Die Wetsontwerp wysig die Maatskappywet, 2008 (Wet 71 van 2008).
tgt: The Bill amends the Companies Act, 2008 (Act 71 of 2008).

src: Dit verminder die regulatoriese en administratiewe laste vir sake-eienaars en verhoog Suid-Afrika se aantreklikheid vir potensiële beleggers.
tgt: It reduces the regulatory and administrative burdens to business owners and enhances South Africa’s attractiveness to potential investors.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming Events.

src: Toerismemaand, wat in September gevier word, is reeds op 16 Augustus 2018 in Tsitsikamma in die Oos-Kaap van stapel gestuur onder die tema: "Toerisme en die digitale transformasie".
tgt: Tourism Month in September was launched on 16 August 2018 in Tsitsikamma in the Eastern Cape, under the theme: “Tourism and the digital transformation”, which mirrors the theme of the UN World Tourism Organisation World Tourism Day taking place on 27 September 2018.According to the World Travel and Tourism Council report released in November 2016, tourism employs 1.55 million people directly and indirectly in South Africa, and its direct contribution to the gross domestic product is R118 billion.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om hierdie belangrike sektor van die ekonomie te ondersteun.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to support this vital sector of the economy.

src: Dit is ook belangrik dat ons 'n meer inklusiewe toerismesektor tot stand bring, wat entrepreneurskap, ekonomiese geleenthede en werksgeleenthede in ons gemeenskappe ontsluit.
tgt: It is also important that we work towards a more inclusive tourism sector that unlocks entrepreneurship, economic opportunities and jobs in our communities.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die 2018-program vir Staatsdiensmaand onder die tema: "Thuma Mina: Openbare Diens aan die Mese: Batho Pele: "Ons behoort, ons gee om en ons dien".
tgt: Cabinet approved the 2018 Public Service Month Programme under the theme: “Thuma Mina: Taking Public Service to the People: Batho Pele: “We Belong, We Care and We Serve”.

src: Die volledige maandprogram van aktiwiteite sal op die regering se webwerf beskikbaar gestel word (WEBTOKEN).
tgt: The full-month programme of activities will be made available through the government website (WEBTOKEN).

src: Die SAPD se Nasionale Herdenkingsdag op 2 September 2018, word reeds op 31 Augustus van stapel gestuur met herdenkingsaktiwiteite.
tgt: SAPS National Commemoration Day on 2 September 2018, with commemoration activities commencing from 31 August.

src: Dit is ter herinnering aan polisiebeamptes en reserviste wat in die uitvoer van hul pligte dood is en dus die hoogste prys in diens van die land betaal het.
tgt: This is in memory of police officials and reservists who were killed in the line of duty, having paid the highest price in service of the nation.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om die lewens van hierdie helde en heldinne wat aan diens gesterf het, te erken en te vier.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to recognise and celebrate the lives of these heroes and heroines who died in the line of duty.

src: 'n Beroep word op alle gemeenskappe regoor die land gedoen om die landsvlag teen halfstok te hang en om 'n oomblik van stilte tydens alle godsdienstige seremonies in die tydperk 31 Augustus tot 2 September 2018 te hou as 'n simbool van steun aan die SAPSuid-Afrika sal die Internasionale Konferensie oor Wetenskap, Tegnologie, Ingenieurswese en Bestuur, wat deur die internasionale navorsingsgemeenskap gereël is, van 24 tot 25 Augustus 2018 in Kaapstad aanbied.
tgt: It calls on all communities across the country to fly the flag at half-mast, and to observe a moment of silence in all religious ceremonies during the period 31 August to 2 September 2018, as a symbol of support to the SAPSouth Africa will host the International Conference on Science, Technology, Engineering and Management, organised by the Research World, from 24 to 25 August 2018 in Cape Town.

src: Die konferensie, wat geleenthede aan deelnemers bied om hul idees en ervarings met 'n wêreldwye gehoor te deel, bevestig weer dat Suid-Afrika 'n voorkeurbestemming vir wêreldgebeure is.
tgt: The conference, which will provide opportunities for participants to share their ideas and experiences with a global audience, reaffirms that South Africa is a premier destination for global events.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om deel te neem aan aktiwiteite om Erfenismaand in September te vier.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to participate in activities to celebrate Heritage Month in September.

src: Erfenismaand word jaarliks herdenk om die publiek aan te moedig om hul eenheid in diversiteit te vier en om 'n land te bou waar sy mense vir mekaar omgee en mekaar respekteer.
tgt: Heritage Month is observed annually to encourage the public to celebrate their unity in diversity and to continue to build a country where its people care for each other and respect one another.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Messages.

src: Nominasies vir Nasionale OrdesDie Kabinet beklemtoon President Ramaphosa se uitnodiging aan die publiek om burgers, sowel as vooraanstaande buitelanders wat volgens hulle die land se hoogste eerbewyse verdien, te nomineer vir Nasionale Ordes.
tgt: Nominations for National OrdersCabinet reiterates President Ramaphosa’s invitation to members of the public to nominate citizens and eminent foreign nationals that they believe deserve to receive the country’s highest honours, the National Orders.

src: Die sperdatum vir nominasies is 7 September EidDie Kabinet dra sy goeie wense oor aan die Moslemgemeeskap in Suid-Afrika en regdeur die wêreld met die herdenking van Eid-ul-Adha op Woensdag 22 Augustus 2018.
tgt: The deadline for nominations is 7 September EidCabinet conveyed best wishes to the Muslim community in South Africa and around the world on the celebration of Eid-ul-Adha yesterday, Wednesday 22 August 2018.

src: Mer as 2 500 Moslems het van Suid-Afrika na die Koninkryk van Saoedi-Arabië gereis om by ’n geraamde twee miljoen Moslems van regoor die wêreld aan te sluit vir die Hajd-pelgrimstog.
tgt: More than 2 500 Muslims from South Africa have travelled to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia to join an estimated two million Muslims from around the world for the Hajj pilgrimage.

src: Die Kabinet betuig saam met President Ramaphosa sy meegevoel aan die naasbestaandes en vriende van Mama Zondeni Sobukwe, wat liefderik as die “Moeder van Azania” bekend gestaan het.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Ramaphosa in expressing condolences to the family and friends of Mama Zondeni Sobukwe, who was affectionately known as “Mother of Azania”.

src: President Ramaphosa het ’n amptelike kategorie 2-begrafnis vir haar aangekondig.
tgt: President Ramaphosa has declared a Special Official Funeral Category 2 for her.

src: Sy was ’n heldin van die weerstandsbeweging teen apartheid en ’n vryheidsvegter vir alle Suid-Afrikaners tot en met die aanbreek van demokrasie in die land.
tgt: She was a heroine of resistance and a fighter for the freedom of all South Africans, who continued her activism into our democratic dispensation.

src: Op 28 April 2018 – en as ’n verlenging van Vryheidsdagvierings – het President Ramaphosa die Nasionale Orde van Luthuli in Silwer aan Mama Sobukwe toegeken.
tgt: On 28 April 2018 – and as an extension of Freedom Day celebrations – President Ramaphosa bestowed the National Order of Luthuli in Silver on Mama Sobukwe.

src: Sy was die eggenoot van die Pan Africanist Congress se stigterspresident, Robert Mangaliso Sobukwe.
tgt: She was also the wife of Pan Africanist Congress founding President Robert Mangaliso Sobukwe.

src: Vanjaar is ook die 40ste herdenking van MnrSobukwe se dood.
tgt: The year 2018 also marks the 40th anniversary of the death of Mr Sobukwe.

src: Mama Sobukwe sal op Saterdag 25 Augustus 2018, by die Kroonvaal-begrafplaas in Graaff-Reinet in die Oos-Kaap ter ruste gelê word.
tgt: Mama Sobukwe will be laid to rest on Saturday, 25 August 2018, at the Kroonvale Cemetery in Graaff-Reinet in the Eastern Cape.

src: Die Kabinet betuig saam met President Ramaphosa sy meegevoel met die heengaan van Sy Eksellensie, Kofi Atta Annan, voormalige VN Sekretaris-Generaal (VNSG).
tgt: Cabinet also joins President Ramaphosa in expressing condolences on the passing of His Excellency Kofi Atta Annan, former UN Secretary-General (UNSG).

src: MnrAnnan was die eerste swartman uit Afrika om VNSG te word en het sy posisie gebruik om die Afrika-agende te bevorder.
tgt: Mr Annan was the first black African to become UNSG and he used his position to advance the African agenda.

src: Sy dood is ’n groot verlies vir die internasionale gemeenskap.
tgt: His death is a great loss to the global community.

src: Die Kabinet betuig voorts ook sy meegevoel met die heengaan van die wêreldbekende Amerikaanse sanger en burgerregte-aktivis, Aretha Franklin.
tgt: Cabinet also expresses its condolences on the passing of world-renowned singer and United States civil-rights activist, Aretha Franklin.

src: Die Kabinet betuig saam met die internasionale gemeenskap sy meegevoel met die Italiaanse regering en sy mense, asook die slagoffers se naasbestaandes ná die ineenstorting van die Morandi-motorbrug in die land se noord-westelike stad, Genoa.
tgt: Cabinet joins the international community in sending condolences to the Italian Government and people, and the families of the victims, following the collapse of the Morandi motorway bridge in the north-western Italian city of Genoa.

src: Die Kabinet wens die beseerdes ’n spoedige herstel toe.
tgt: Cabinet also wishes the injured a speedy recovery.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel met die naasbestaandes en vriende van die wêreldbekende politieke ekonoom en Afrika-akademikus, Samir Amin, wat op 12 Augustus in die ouderdom van 86 oorlede is.
tgt: Cabinet expresses its condolences to the family and friends of world-renowned political economist and African academic Samir Amin, who passed away on 12 August at the age of Throughout his life he was a tireless advocate for Third World liberation, and his thinking transformed the way we understand capitalism and imperialism.6 Cabinet also conveys its condolences to the government and the people of India on the loss of lives during the recent floods and landslides in the state of Kerala.7 Condolences were also sent to the government and people of Sudan following the drowning of 24 school children in the Nile River.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 5 September 2018 by Tuynhuys, Kaapstad vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 5 September 2018 at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Issues in the environment.

src: Ekonomie.
tgt: Economy.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle sektore in Suid-Afrika om die regering te ondersteun in sy inisiatiewe om ekonomiese groei te bevorder ná die vrystelling van groeisyfers wat aandui dat ons ekonomie in die tweede kwartaal met nulpunt 7% gekontrakteer het van 'n hersiene -2,6% in die eerste kwartaal.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all sectors of South Africa to rally behind government-led initiatives to boost economic growth following the release of growth figures showing our economy contracted by zero point 7 per cent in the second quarter from a revised -2.6 percent in the first quarter.

src: Hoewel sommige sektore van die ekonomie, soos mynbou, konstruksie en finansiering, verbeterde groei getoon het, was dit onvoldoende om die inkrimping in ander sektore, veral die landbousektor, ten volle te verreken.
tgt: Although some sectors of the economy, such as mining, construction and finance, recorded an improvement in growth, this was insufficient to offset fully the contraction in other sectors, in particular the agricultural sector.

src: Wat uitgawes betref, het netto-uitvoere sterk herstel, maar dit is geneutraliseer deur 'n afname in huishoudelike uitgawes en 'n beduidende afname in inventarisse.
tgt: From the expenditure side, net exports recorded a strong recovery, however this was offset by a contraction in household expenditure and very large draw down in inventories.

src: Beleggingsgroei deur private maatskappye het toegeneem, terwyl beleggings deur die openbare sektor gekrimp het.
tgt: Investment growth by private companies increased, while investment by the public sector contracted.

src: Die stygende onbestendigheid in wêreldwye markte en die BBP-uitslag vereis dat die regering pogings versnel om beperkinge tot ekonomiese groei te verwyder, terwyl kwesbare groepe ondersteun moet word.
tgt: The rising volatility in global markets and the GDP outcome require that government accelerates efforts to unblock constraints to economic growth while providing support to vulnerable groups.

src: Ekonomiese groei het die afgelope vier jaar beduidend afgeneem.
tgt: Economic growth has slowed down significantly over the last four years.

src: Dit weerspieël faktore soos droogtetoestande in die landbousektor en lae kommoditeitspryse, maar ook huishoudelike strukturele beperkinge wat beleggings- en werkskepping ontmoedig het.
tgt: This reflects factors such as drought conditions in the agricultural sector and low commodity prices but also domestic structural constraints, which have discouraged investment and employment creation.

src: Die regering het onder meer onderneem om die visumstelsel volledig te hervorm om die toerismesektor te ondersteun sleutelmynwetgewing te finaliseer om die mynbedryf te ondersteun en die finansies van ondernemings in staatsbesit verder te stabiliseer.
tgt: Government has committed, to amongst others, a complete overhaul of the visa system to support the tourism sector, the finalisation of key mining legislation to support the mining sector and further stabilise the finances of State-owned enterprises.

src: Die komende werks- en beleggingsberade, sowel as die voorgestelde regeringstimuluspakket, sal besonderhede verskaf oor hervormings wat nodig is om groei aan te dryf.
tgt: The upcoming job and investment summits, as well as the proposed government stimulus package, will provide details on reforms needed to drive growth.

src: Die Kabinet bevestig die regering se verbintenis tot fiskale volhoubaarheid en 'n hersiene fiskale raamwerk sal in die Meiumtermyn-begrotingsbeleidsverklaring voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet affirms government’s commitment to fiscal sustainability and a revised fiscal framework will be presented in the Medium Term Budget Policy Statement.

src: Besoek aan die Verenigde Koninkryk (VK) en Noord-Ierland.
tgt: United Kingdom (UK) and Northern Ireland visit.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom saam met President Cyril Ramaphosa die suksesvolle werksbesoek van Eerste Minister Theresa May van die Verenigde Koninkryk van Groot-Brittanje en Noord-Ierland.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Cyril Ramaphosa in welcoming the successful working visit by Prime Minister Theresa May of the UK of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.

src: Dit hou verbeterde voordele vir Suid-Afrika in deur versterkte bilaterale handel en belegging.
tgt: It will yield improved benefits for South Africa through strengthened bilateral trade and investment.

src: Die Verenigde Koninkryk is een van Suid-Afrika se grootste buitelandse beleggers, met meer as 650 Britse firmas teenwoordig in ons mark.
tgt: The UK is one of the largest foreign investors in South Africa, with over 650 British firms present in our market.

src: Tydens die bilaterale samesprekings is moontlike vennootskappe en samewerking bespreek.
tgt: During the bilateral engagements, potential partnerships and efforts were discussed.

src: Eerste Minister May het ook die SS Medi Bell aan Suid-Afrika se hoofbevelvoerder, President Ramaphosa, en die mense van Suid-Afrika, oorhandig ter herdenking aan die meer as 600 Suid-Afrikaners wat gesterf het toe die SS Medi meer as 100 jaar gelede in die Engelse kanaal gesink het.
tgt: Prime Minister May also handed over the SS Mendi Bell to South Africa’s Commander-in-Chief, President Ramaphosa, and the people of South Africa, to commemorate the sacrifice of over 600 South Africans who perished when the SS Mendi sank in the English Channel over 100 years ago.

src: Forum vir China-Afrika-samewerking (FOCAC) -beraad.
tgt: Forum on China-Africa Cooperation (FOCAC) Summit.

src: Die Kabinet skenk aandag aan die Beijing-aksieplan (2019-2021), wat die uitkomste van die FOCAC-beraad, waartydens President Ramaphosa en China se President Xi Jinping mede-voorsitters was, uiteensit.
tgt: Cabinet considered the Beijing Action Plan (2019-2021), which details the outcomes of the FOCAC Summit co-chaired by President Ramaphosa and Chinese President Xi Jinping.

src: Om China en Afrika se omvattende strategiese en samewerkende vennootskap te bou, het China hom verbind tot die implementering van 10 samewerkingsplanne met Afrika.
tgt: To build the China-Africa comprehensive strategic and cooperative partnership, China committed to implementing 10 cooperation plans with Africa.

src: Dit is op die gebiede van industrialisering die modernisering van landbou infrastruktuur finansiële dienste groen ontwikkeling handels- en beleggingsfasilitering armoedeverligting en openbare welsyn openbare gesondheid en mens-tot-mens-uitruilings, sowel as vrede en veiligheid.
tgt: These are in the areas of industrialisation agricultural modernisation infrastructure financial services green development trade and investment facilitation poverty reduction and public welfare public health people-to-people exchanges, and peace and security.

src: Oor die tydperk sal samewerking tussen die twee lande ondersteun word deur die tema: "China en Afrika: na 'n selfs sterker gemeenskaplikheid met 'n gedeelde toekoms deur middel van wen-wen-samewerking.”4.
tgt: Over the period, cooperation between the two sides will be underpinned by the theme: “China and Africa: Towards an even stronger community with a shared future through win-win cooperation.”4.

src: Brandstofprys.
tgt: Fuel price.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die onveranderde brandstofprys vir hierdie maand as 'n eenmalige tydelike verligting vir gebruikers van openbare vervoer, motoriste en verbruikers, terwyl die Departement van Energie ander maatreëls ondersoek.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the unchanged fuel price for this month as a once-off temporary relief for users of public transport, motorists and consumers, while other measures are being sought by the Department of Energy (DoE).

src: Globale faktore, insluitende die verhoging van die ru-olieprys en die negatiewe sentiment rondom ontluikende markte, het daartoe gelei dat die brandstofprys sedert April vanjaar vinnig in Suid-Afrika gestyg het.
tgt: Global factors including the increase of the price of crude oil and the negative sentiment around emerging markets have led to the cost of fuel rising rapidly in South Africa since April this year.

src: Die Kabinet het sy kommer uitgespreek oor die stygings en die nadelige uitwerking op die algemene verbruiker, insluitend onder meer die uitwerking wat verband hou met die inflasionêre impak, aangesien produsente die stygings na die kleinhandelsektor oordra.
tgt: Cabinet has expressed concern about increases and the detrimental effects on the general consumer, including amongst others, effects relating to the inflationary impact as producers pass on the increases to the retail sector.

src: Me die oog hierop, het die Minister van Energie, mnrJeff Radebe, namens die regering 'n spesiale ingryping gedoen om die publiek teen nog 'n skerp styging in die brandstofprys te beskerm, met die uitsondering van die toename van 4,9 sent per liter in die kleinhandelmarge van petrol om voorsiening te maak vir die jaarlikse salarisverhogings van werknemers, soos petroljoggies by motorhawens.
tgt: Taking this into account, the Minister of Energy, Mr Jeff Radebe, made a special intervention on behalf of government to cushion the public against yet another steep increase in the fuel price, with the exception of the cents per litre increase in the retail margin of petrol to cater for the annual salary increases of employees, such as petrol attendants, at fuel stations.

src: Terwyl wêreldwye uitdagings ’n impak op die ekonomie het, is die Kabinet tevrede dat hierdie ingryping geen impak op die fiskus het nie, aangesien fondse gebruik word wat reeds in die brandstofprysstruktuur is.
tgt: At a time when the economy is being impacted by global headwinds, Cabinet is pleased that this intervention has no impact on the fiscus as it uses funds that are already in the fuel-pricing structure.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om die debat oor die kwessie van grondhervorming te gebruik om nasiebou en sosiale samehorigheid te versterk.
tgt: Land reform Cabinet calls on all South Africans to use the debate around the issue of land reform to strengthen nation-building and social cohesion.

src: Die ontplooiende parlementêre proses sal duidelikheid bring en ons toelaat om as ’n nasie vorentoe te beweeg.
tgt: The unfolding parliamentary process will bring clarity and allow us to move forward as a nation.

src: Die deursigtige, reëls-gebaseerde en grondwetlike proses is in ooreenstemming met ons verbintenis om gesamentlik oplossings te vind vir die bevordering van ons samelewing.
tgt: The transparent, rules-based and constitutional process is in keeping with our commitment to jointly arrive at solutions for the betterment of society.

src: Die Kabinet is oortuig dat hierdie proses ons sal toelaat om 'n grondhervormingsmodel saam te stel wat vir almal werk.
tgt: Cabinet is convinced this process will allow us to determine a land reform model that works for everyone.

src: Deur saam te werk, kan ons 'n beter nasie bou waar die drome en strewes van al ons mense ‘n werklikheid word.
tgt: By working together, we can build a better nation where the dreams and aspirations of all our people are realised.

src: Water.
tgt: Water.

src: Die Kabinet is tevrede dat die Departement van Water en Sanitasie die bou van die Cornelis-rivierdam in die Vrystaat voltooi het.
tgt: Cabinet is pleased that the Department of Water and Sanitation has completed the construction of the Cornelis River Dam in the Free State.

src: Die dam, wat tot voordeel van 2 690 huishoudings en 'n geraamde 10 674 mense sal strek, sal die tekort aan water vir gemeenskappe in Warden en Ezenzeleni onder die Phumelela Plaaslike Munisipaliteit, verlig.
tgt: The dam, which is set to benefit 2 690 households and an estimated 10 674 people, will ease water challenges faced by the community of Warden and Ezenzeleni under the Phumelela Local Municipality.

src: Suid-Afrika ervaar steeds watertskaarste as gevolg van droogtetoestande en die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op almal in die land om hierdie hulpbron spaarsamig en oordeelkundig te gebruik en om waterwys te bly.
tgt: South Africa is still experiencing water shortages as a result of drought conditions and Cabinet appeals to all people to use this resource sparingly and to remain water wise.

src: Onderwys.
tgt: Education.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Departement van Basiese Onderwys (DBO) geluk met die suksesvolle oorhandiging van die Laerskool Delft Suid, buite Kaapstad in die Wes-Kaap.
tgt: Cabinet congratulated the Department of Basic Education for successfully handing over the Delft South Primary School, outside Cape Town in the Western Cape.

src: Die skool is gebou deur die departement se inisiatief vir die Versnelde Lewering van Infrastruktuur by Skole (ASIDI) teen 'n koste van R75 miljoen.
tgt: The school was built through the department’s Accelerated Schools Infrastructure Delivery Initiative (ASIDI) at a cost of R75 million.

src: Dit bestaan uit 45 klaskamers, 'n rekenaar- en wetenskaplaboratorium, 'n biblioteek en 'n voedselsentrum.
tgt: It consists of 45 classrooms, a computer and science laboratory, library as well as a nutrition centre.

src: Dié moderne nuwe fasiliteit sal 'n bevorderende leer- en onderrigomgewing aan ongeveer 1 580 leerders uit die Delft-gemeenskap bied.
tgt: The new state-of-the-art facilities will provide a conducive learning and teaching environment to about 1 578 learners from the Delft community.

src: Dit is die finale skool uit 25 skole wat deur die DBO se inisiatief aan die Wes-Kaap oorhandig is.
tgt: This is the final school out of 25 schools handed over to the Western Cape through the National Department of Education’s initiative.

src: Tot dusver het die ASIDI-program nasionaal 205 205 moderne skole gebou.
tgt: To date, the ASIDI programme has built 205 state-of-the-art-schools nationally.

src: Altesaam 685 skole is voorsien van betroubare watervoorsiening, ongeveer 486 skole is voorsien van ordentlike sanitasiegeriewe en 372 skole is vir die eerste keer aan die elektrisiteitsnetwerk gekoppel.
tgt: A total of 685 schools have been provided with reliable water supply, some 486 schools have been provided with decent sanitation facilities and 372 schools have been connected to the electricity grid for the first time.

src: 2019-aansoeke om die Nasionale Finansiële Hulpskema vir Studente (NSFAS).
tgt: 2019 National Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS) applications.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die oorweldigende reaksie van voornemende studente na aanleiding van die amptelike opening van die 2019 NSFAS-aansoeksproses op 3 September.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the overwhelming response from prospective students following the official opening of the 2019 NSFAS application process on 03 September.

src: Mer as 45 000 potensiële en huidige studente het die eerste dag op die NSFAS-webwerf ingeteken.
tgt: Over 45 000 potential and current students logged onto the NSFAS website on the first day.

src: Daar is ook vordering gemaak om die agterstand van uitstaande betalings aan studente uit te klaar.
tgt: Progress has also been made to clear the backlog of outstanding payments to students.

src: Die aansoekproses is gebaseer op 'n nuwe stelsel wat befondsingsbesluite vinniger maak, terwyl aansoeke nou maklik deur studente ingevul word, ongeag hul ligging.
tgt: The application process is based on a new system which makes funding decisions quicker while applications are now easily filled in by students regardless of their location.

src: Listeriose.
tgt: Listeriosis.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die verklaring dat die uitbreek van Listeriose verby is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the declaration that the Listeriosis outbreak is over and it strongly demonstrates the impact of the emergency collaborative response plan by the Department of Health (DoH) and the National Institute for Communicable Diseases, supported by the World Health Organisation, to control and end the outbreak.

src: Dit is ’n sterk aanduiding dat die Departement van Gesondheid (DvG) en die Nasionale Instituut vir Oordraagbare Siektes se noodhulp-samewerkingsplan ondersteun deur die Wêreldgesondheidsorganisasie, die uitbreek beheer en beëindig het.
tgt: The DoH has put in place a surveillance system to prevent a recurrence.

src: Alle fabrieke wat voorbereide vleis en hoender maak, moet ingevolge die bygewerkte higiëne-regulasies van Regulasie R607, wat op 14 Junie 2018 gepubliseer is, bestuurstelsels vir voedselveiligheid in plek hê.
tgt: All factories that make ready-to-eat processed meat and chicken need to have food safety management systems in place, according to Regulation R607 published on 14 June 2018.

src: Die Kabinet prys die vinnige optrede van die Minister van Gesondheid, dr. Aaron Motsoaledi, om die bewerings van vervalste kos en kos wat verval het in Suid-Afrika te ondersoek.
tgt: Cabinet commends the swift action taken by the Minister of Health, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi, to look into the allegations of fake and expired foods in South Africa.

src: Die DvG het 'n verskeie klagtes ontvang en het sy kommer uitgespreek oor ongeverfieerde kosverwante video's wat op sosiale media sirkuleer.
tgt: The DoH has received a high volume of complaints and noted concerns about unauthenticated food-related videos that are circulating on social media.

src: Sedert Augustus is blits-inspeksies by verskeie kospersele uitgevoer en dit word steeds in verskillende dele van die land gedoen.
tgt: Since August, inspection blitzes have taken place at various food premises and they continue in different parts of the country.

src: Daarbenewens is die kosbedryf versoek om die egtheid van potensiële vervalste kos te bevestig terwyl ander regeringsowerhede van die departemente van Landbou Bosbou en Visserye en Handel en Nywerheid, insluitend die Nasionale Verbruikerskommissie (NVK), betrokke is by die bevestiging van openbare eise van gekompromitteerde gehaltestandaarde.
tgt: In addition, the food industry has been requested to confirm the authenticity of potential counterfeit foodstuffs while other government regulatory authorities from the departments of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, and Trade and Industry, including the National Consumer Commission, are involved in confirming public claims of compromised quality standards.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op die publiek om waaksaam te wees in die onderskeidende terme wat met kos verband hou: Die beste voor-datum verwys na die lang raklewe van droë en ingemaakte produkte, en is nie 'n aanduiding van veiligheid nie.
tgt: Cabinet appeals to the public to be vigilant in differentiating terms related to food:The best-before date refers to the long shelf life of dry and canned products, and is not an indicator of safety.

src: Die verkoopsdatum word gebruik vir bederfbare kos wat gewoonlik in 'n yskas gestoor word, en dit is volgens wêreldwye owerhede vanaf Julie vanjaar nie meer van toepassing nie.
tgt: The sell-by date is used for perishable food usually stored in a refrigerator and from July this year became no longer relevant, according to global authorities.

src: Die gebruiks- of vervaldatum is die vervaldatum en beteken dat die kos nie meer smaaklik of eetbaar sal wees na dié datum nie.
tgt: The use-by or expiry date is the expiry date and means that food bearing this mark is no longer palatable after this date.

src: Vir bederfbare kos beteken dit dat dit nie meer geëet moet word nie.
tgt: For perishable food, this means it can no longer be consumed.“Counterfeit goods” are typically goods sold under another company’s brand name while the term “fake food” has been used by social media to refer to food that does not contain food substances.

src: "Valsgoedere" is tipies goedere wat onder 'n ander maatskappy se handelsnaam verkoop word, terwyl die term "vervalste kos" deur sosiale media gebruik word om te verwys na voedsel wat nie voedselstowwe bevat nie.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates calls on members of society to produce tangible evidence of foodstuff made from potentially harmful substances and chemicals.

src: Die Kabinet herhaal oproepe aan gemeenskappe om tasbare bewyse te lewer van kos wat van potensieel skadelike stowwe en chemikalieë gemaak is.
tgt: Furthermore, Cabinet condemns attacks on and looting of shops as a response to the sale of suspicious foods.

src: Sulke kriminele dade sal nie geduld word nie en wetstoepassingsagentskappe sal nie huiwer om persone wat hierdie kriminele dade aanhits of uitvoer in hegtenis te neem of te vervolg nie.
tgt: Such criminal acts will not be tolerated and Law-enforcement agencies will not hesitate to arrest and prosecute persons found inciting or carrying out these criminal acts.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n dringende beroep op mense wat bewus is van verdagte kosse om die DvG-blitslyn op 011 386 2003/6 te skakel en die NVK op 012 428 Betaling van maatskaplike toelaes.
tgt: Cabinet urges members of the public who are aware of suspicious foods to call the DoH hotline on 011 386 2003/6 and the National Consumer Commission hotline on 012 428 Payment of social grants.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die vorderingsverslag van die Minister van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling, Susan Shabangu, oor die vennootskap tussen die Suid-Afrikaanse Maatskaplike Sekerheidsagentskap (SASSA) en die Suid-Afrikaanse Poskantoor (SAPO) om die betaling van maatskaplike toelaes van Cash Paymaster Services oor te neem met ingang van 1 Oktober 2018.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the progress report by Social Development Minister, Susan Shabangu, on the partnership between South African Social Security Agency (SASSA) and the South African Post Office (SAPO) to take over the payments of social grants from Cash Paymaster Services with effect from 1 October 2018.

src: SASSA het tot dusver sowat vyf en 'n half miljoen ou kaarte vervang met die nuwe SASSA goue kaart, maar duisende moet nog omgeruil word.
tgt: SASSA has so far replaced about five and a half million old cards with the new SASSA gold card but thousands still need to be exchanged.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op kaarthouers om die ruil te maak.
tgt: Cabinet strongly appeals to holders of old cards to make the switch.

src: SAPO sal ook die betaling van kontant aan ontvangers wat nie kontant van kitsbanke of handelaars kon onttrek nie, oorneem.
tgt: SAPO will also take over the payment of cash to those recipients who were unable to withdraw cash from ATMs or merchants.

src: Vir meer inligting kan ontvangers van maatskaplike toelaes SASSA se tolvrynommer op 0800 60 10 11 gedurende kantoorure skakel.
tgt: For further information, social-grant beneficiaries can call the SASSA toll-free number on 0800 60 10 11 during office hours.

src: Treinongeluk.
tgt: Train accident.

src: Die Kabinet wens die pendelaars wat beseer is toe twee Merorail-treine by die Eloff-uitbreiding in Selby, suid van Johannesburg gebots het, 'n vinnige herstel toe en doen ’n beroep dat die ondersoek na die oorsaak van die ongeluk bespoedig moet word om 'n herhaling voorkom.
tgt: Cabinet wishes the commuters who were injured when two Metrorail trains collided at the Eloff Extension in Selby, south of Johannesburg, a speedy recovery and calls for the investigation into the cause of the accident to be fast-tracked to prevent a recurrence.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die 2017/18 Nasionale Misdaadstatistieke deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens bekend gemaak is.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the release of the 2017/18 National Crime Statistics by the South African Police Service.

src: Die jaarlikse misdaadstatistieke stel die regering in staat om belangrike teikens te monitor, veral die vermindering van aangemelde ernstige misdade, soos uiteengesit in die Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk 2014-2019.
tgt: The annual crime statistics enable government to monitor key targets, in particular the reduction of reported serious crimes, as set out in the Medium Term Strategic Framework 2014-2019.

src: Die misdaadstatistieke kan ook as vroeë waarskuwingsaanwysers gebruik word om misdaadvoorkomingsaktiwiteite en -strategieë van verskeie staatsdepartemente te versterk.
tgt: The crime statistics could also be used as early-warning indicators to strengthen crime-prevention operations and strategies of various government departments.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die vordering wat gemaak is met die bestuur van dissipline van staatsamptenare wat met 'n staatsinstelling sake doen.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on progress made in the management of discipline of public-service employees conducting business with an organ of state.

src: Die bevordering van regverdige administratiewe optrede deur senior regeringsamptenare is 'n kritieke deel van die opbou van 'n oop en verantwoordbare regering ooreenkomstig die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996 en die bou van 'n bekwame staat ooreenkomstig die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NDP): Visie 2030.
tgt: Promoting just and fair administration actions by senior government officials is a critical part of building an open and accountable government, as envisaged in the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996 and the building of a capable state as envisioned in the National Development Plan (NDP): Vision 2030.

src: van die Staatsdiensregulasies van 2016, wat staatsdienswerknemers verbied om sake te doen met 'n staatsinstelling, asook Regulasie 18 van die Staatsdiensregulasies van 2016, wat vereis dat lede van die Senior Bestuursdiens hul finansiële en ander private belange moet openbaar.
tgt: Progress has been made in terms of implementing Regulation 13 of the Public Service Regulations (PSR) of 2016, which prohibits public-service employees from conducting business with an organ of state, as well as Regulation 18 of the PSR of 2016, which requires members of the Senior Management Service (SMS) to disclose their financial and other private interests.

src: Die Kabinet keur ook goed dat staatsdepartemente se betrokke uitvoerende gesag die implementering van Regulasie 13
tgt: Cabinet also approved that relevant Executive Authority of government departments should monitor implementation of Regulation 13 of the PSR of 2016, take appropriate disciplinary steps and submit a report thereof to the Minister of Public Service and Administration (MPSA) by the end of each financial year.

src: Die eerste verslag vir voorlegging aan die Minister moet teen 31 Maart 2019 ingedien word.
tgt: The first report is due for submission to the MPSA by the 31 March 2019.

src: In 2016 en 2017 het die Departement van Staatsdiens en Administrasie staatsdienswerkers geïdentifiseer wat as verskaffers op die Sentrale Verskaffersdatabasis geregistreer is, soos deur die Nasionale Tesourie voorsien.
tgt: In 2016 and 2017, the Department of Public Service and Administration identified public-service employees registered as suppliers on the Central Supplier Database, as supplied by National Treasury.

src: Departemente is versoek om bewustheid te skep, inligting te verifieer en verslag te doen oor vordering met implementering van die stappe wat teen oortreders geneem is.
tgt: Departments were requested to create awareness, to verify information and to report progress with implementation on the steps taken against transgressors.

src: Teen die einde van April 2018 het 96% van alle senior bestuurders hul openbaarmakings ingedien met behulp van die eDisclosure-stelsel.
tgt: By the end of April 2018, 96% of all SMS members submitted their disclosures using the eDisclosure System.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die vordering wat met die Nasionale Skool vir Regering (NSG) se befondsingsmodel gemaak is.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on progress made on the National School of Government (NSG) Funding Model.

src: Die Kabinet het 'n pakket van verpligte opleidingsprogramme goedgekeur wat deur die NSG geloods is om vinnige intervensies vir kapasiteitsontwikkeling te onderneem en om die staatsdiens te professionaliseer.
tgt: Cabinet approved a suit of mandatory and compulsory training programmes to be piloted by the NSG to undertake rapid capacity development interventions and to professionalize the public service.

src: Die direkte betaling aan die NSG vir verpligte programme deur toepaslike diensdepartemente uit hul opleidingsbegrotings is ook goedgekeur.
tgt: The direct payment for compulsory programmes to the NSG by relevant employing departments from their training budgets was also approved.

src: Dit sal lei tot 'n ontwikkelende openbare administrasie wat goeie vordering maak om Visie 2030 van die NDP te bereik deur 'n bekwame en ontwikkelende staat te bou wat deur samewerking met 'n aktiewe burgerskap, 'n meedoënlose bestuur teen armoede, werkloosheid en sosiale ongelykheid lei.
tgt: This will lead to a developmental public administration that goes further in attaining Vision 2030 of the NDP by “building a capable and developmental state, which working together with an active citizenry, leads a relentless drive against poverty, unemployment and social inequality.”4.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Witskrif oor Wetenskap, Tegnologie en Innovasie van 2018 vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the publication of the White Paper on Science, Technology and Innovation of 2018, for public comment.

src: Die Minister van Wetenskap en Tegnologie, me Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane, sal weldra 'n volledige inligtingsessie verskaf.
tgt: The Minister of Science and Technology, Ms Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane, will provide a full briefing in due course.

src: Die Kabinet keur ook goed dat die Nasionale Beskermde Gebiede Uitbreidingstrategie (NPAES) vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer word.
tgt: Cabinet also approved the publication of the National Protected Areas Expansion Strategy (NPAES) for public comment.

src: Die NPAES is 'n strategiese plan van 20 jaar wat in lyn is met die NODie klem val op die uitbreiding van beskermde gebiede, met spesifieke verwysing na ekonomiese groei, transformasie en volhoubaarheid.
tgt: The NPAES is a 20-year strategic plan aligned to the NDP, focusing on expanding the protected areas estate, with specific focus on economic growth, transformation and sustainability.

src: Die NPAES beklemtoon hoe skaars menslike en finansiële hulpbronne doeltreffend toegewys kan word om koste-effektiewe beskermde gebiedsuitbreiding, ekologiese volhoubaarheid en veerkragtigheid teen klimaatsverandering te bereik.
tgt: The NPAES highlights how scarce human and financial resources can be efficiently and effectively allocated to achieve cost-effective protected area expansion, ecological sustainability and resilience to climate change.

src: Suid-Afrika se netwerk van beskermde gebiede sluit in wêreld erfenisterreine, nasionale parke, natuurreservate, spesiale natuurreservate, beskermde omgewings, beskermde mariene gebiede, bergopvangsgebiede, spesiaal beskermde bosgebiede en woudnatuurreservate.
tgt: South Africa’s protected area network includes world heritage sites, national parks, nature reserves, special nature reserves, protected environments, marine protected areas, mountain catchment areas, specially protected forest areas, and forest nature reserves.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat Suid-Afrika se Onderhandelingsposisies vir die 13de Vergadering van die Konvensie van Kontrakterende Partye tot die Ramsar-konvensie oor Vleilande (Ramsar COP 13) van 21 tot 29 Oktober 2018 in Dubai, Verenigde Arabiese Emirate gehou word.
tgt: Cabinet approved South Africa’s Negotiating Positions for the 13th Meeting of the Conference of Contracting Parties to the Ramsar Convention on Wetlands (Ramsar COP 13) to be held in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, from 21 to 29 October 2018.

src: Die breë doelstellings van die Ramsar-konvensie is om die bewaring en oordeelkundige gebruik van alle vleilande te verseker.
tgt: The broad objectives of the Ramsar Convention are to ensure the conservation and wise use of all wetlands.

src: In Suid-Afrika is vleilande, waarvan 48% bedreig is, die mees bedreigde van alle ekostelsels.
tgt: In South Africa, wetlands are the most threatened of all ecosystems, with 48% of them critically endangered.

src: Dit dra by tot die bestuur van waterhulpbronne as deel van 'n proaktiewe benadering tot droogtebestuur.
tgt: This contributes to water resources management as part of a proactive approach to drought management.

src: Wetsontwerpe.
tgt: Bills.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswet op Vergoeding vir Beroepsbeserings en -siektes van 2018 vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer word.
tgt: Cabinet approved publication of the Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Disease Amendment Bill of 2018 for public comment.

src: Die Wetsontwerp, wat die Wet op Vergoeding vir Beroepsbeserings en -siektes, 1993 (Wet 130 van 1993) wysig, erken huishoudelike werkers wat voorheen uitgesluit is van die Wet, as werknemers wat voordele moet ontvang, sowel as die verbetering van bestaande voordele.
tgt: The Bill, which amends the Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act, 1993 (Act 130 of 1993) recognises domestic workers, who were excluded from the Act, as employees for the purpose of benefits, as well as improving existing benefits.

src: Die wysigings verbeter die voordele wat aan werknemers en hul afhanklikes betaalbaar is, en beoog om beseerde en siek werknemers te help om gerehabiliteer te word en weer in ’n werksomgewing en hul gemeenskappe geïntegreer te word.
tgt: The amendments improve the benefits payable to employees and their dependents, and aim to assist injured and diseased employees to be rehabilitated and reintegrated into the workplace and society.
