src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Kinderregte van 2018 aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the introduction of the Child Justice Amendment Bill of 2018 into Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp wysig die Wet op Kinderregte, 2008 (Wet 75 van 2008) om die minimum ouderdom van kriminele bevoegdheid van 'n kind te hersien deur dit van die ouderdom van 10 jaar tot 12 jaar te verhoog.
tgt: The Bill amends the Child Justice Act, 2008 (Act 75 of 2008) in order to review the minimum age of criminal capacity of a child by increasing it from the age of 10 to 12 years.

src: Die wetsontwerp verbeter die handhawing van die regte van kinders in stryd met die wet.
tgt: The Bill goes further in upholding the rights of children in conflict with the law.

src: Die Wetsontwerp ontkoppel ook die kwessie van kriminele bevoegdheid van afleiding, deur die verwydering van die vereiste om kriminele bevoegdheid vir doeleindes van afleiding en voorlopige navrae te bewys.
tgt: The Bill also de-links the issue of criminal capacity from diversion, by removing the requirement to prove criminal capacity for purposes of diversion and preliminary inquiries.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp op die Burgerlike Lugvaart van 2018 by die Parlement ingedien word.
tgt: Cabinet approved submission of the Civil Aviation Amendment Bill of 2018 to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp, wat die Wet op Burgerlike Lugvaart, 2009 (Wet 13 van 2009) wysig, sal die regulasies vir lugvaartveiligheid, -sekuriteit en omgewingsbeskerming versterk om volhoubaarheid en stabiliteit van die burgerlike lugvaartbedryf te verseker.
tgt: The Bill, which amends the Civil Aviation Act, 2009 (Act 13 of 2009), will strengthen the aviation safety, security and environmental protection regulatory frameworks to ensure sustainability and stability of the civil-aviation industry.

src: Dit sal verseker dat Suid-Afrika steeds die land se internasionale verpligtinge op die gebied van burgerlugvaart nakom, wat ondersteuning van ons ekonomiese ontwikkeling versterk as 'n katalisator vir toenemende handel, toerisme en werkskepping.
tgt: This will ensure that South Africa continues to meet her international obligations in the civil-aviation arena, which strengthens support to our economic development as a catalyst for increased trade, tourism and job creation.

src: Die Wetsontwerp maak ook voorsiening vir onder meer die operasionele onafhanklikheid van ondersoeke na vliegtuigongelukke en verwante voorvalle, en om teenstrydighede en tekortkominge reg te stel.
tgt: The Bill also provides for, amongst others, the operational independence of the aircraft accident and incident investigation, and to rectify inconsistencies and shortcomings.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Thusong Dienssentrumweek.
tgt: Thusong Service Centre Week.

src: Binne die konteks van Staatsdiensmaand, bied die jaarlikse Thusong Dienssentrum Week van 17 tot 21 September 2018 onder die tema: "Thuma Mina: Openbare Dienste aan die Mese", nog 'n platform vir die regering om openbare dienste aan na die publiek te neem.
tgt: Within the context of Public Service Month, the annual Thusong Service Centre Week from 17 to 21 September 2018 under the theme: “Thuma Mina: Taking Public Services to the People”, provides another platform for government to take public services to the people.

src: Thusong Dienssentrums is eenstopsentrums vir toegang tot regeringsdienste en -inligting.
tgt: Thusong Service Centres are one-stop centres for access to government services and information, and the 133 Thusong Service Centres countrywide are centres of hope, access, redress, equality and empowerment for those previously marginalised from the mainstream of socio-economic development.

src: Die 133 Thusong Dienssentrums landwyd is sentrums van hoop, toegang, regstelling, gelykheid en bemagtiging vir diegene wat voorheen gemarginaliseer is uit die hoofstroom van sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling.
tgt: Government is working on installing a Queue Management System that will reduce the process flow to enable reduction in waiting time.

src: Die stelsel sal landwyd in alle sentrums geïnstalleer word, met die fokus ook op inligting- en kommunikasietegnologie (IKT) -konnektiwiteit, wat 'n aktiveerder vir beter dienslewering is.
tgt: The system will be installed in all centres countrywide with focus also on information and communications technology (ICT) connectivity, which is an enabler for service delivery.

src: 2018 ITU Telekom-wêreldkonferensie.
tgt: 2018 ITU Telecom World Conference.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die Internasionale Telekommunikasie-unie (ITU) se Internasionale Telekom-wêreldkonferensie in Durban van 9 tot 13 September 2018 onder die tema "Innovasie vir slimmer digitale ontwikkeling".
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the 2018 International Telecommunication Union (ITU) Telecom World Conference in Durban from 10 to 13 September 2018, under the theme “Innovation for Smarter Digital Development”.

src: Die geleentheid, wat vir die eerste keer in Afrika aangebied word, bied 'n geleentheid vir 'n groter deelname van Afrika-lande aan die bevordering van IKT in Afrika as 'n bestuurder van ontwikkeling en innovering.
tgt: The event, which is coming to Africa for the first time, provides an opportunity for increased participation of African countries towards bolstering ICT in Africa as a driver of development and innovation.

src: Die jaarlikse konferensie lok meer as 9 000 afgevaardigdes van regoor die wêreld.
tgt: The annual conference attracts more than 9 000 delegates from around the world, with government and industry leaders exploring and identifying investment opportunities and best practices for socio-economic development through ICKey issues for discussion include: 5G for smarter digital development, collaborating on cybersecurity, digital financial services and satellites for a smarter digital development.

src: Die ITU Telekom-wêreldkonferensie 2018 word aangebied in 'n tyd waarin Suid-Afrika belangrike nasionale projekte in werking stel.
tgt: The ITU Telecom World Conference 2018 is hosted at a time when South Africa is implementing key national projects which include the National e-Government Strategy focusing on digital transformation of government services and the National ICT Small, Medium and Micro Enterprises (SMME) Support Strategy, which seeks to unlock the potential of the South African ICT SMMEs sector.

src: Dit sluit in die nasionale e-regeringstrategie wat fokus op die digitale transformasie van regeringsdienste en die nasionale IKT-ondersteuningsstrategie vir klein, medium en mikro-ondernemings (SMME), wat daarop gemik is om die potensiaal van die Suid-Afrikaanse IKT-KMMO-sektor te ontsluit.
tgt: These tools are creating an enabling environment for the sector’s growth and ensuring their sustainability.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Messages.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy diepste meegevoel aan die:die naasbestaandes en die hele Tshwane Universiteit van Tegnologie-gemeenskap ná die dood van Katlego Monareng.
tgt: Cabinet conveys its deepest condolences to the:grieving family and entire Tshwane University of Technology community following the death of Katlego Monareng.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op mense om kalm te bly terwyl die polisie-ondersoek aan die gang is om te verseker dat elkeen wat vir die ontydige dood verantwoordelik is, voor die volle mag van die wet te staan sal kom.
tgt: Cabinet calls for calm while the police investigation is underway to ensure that whoever is responsible for the untimely death faces the full might of the WEBTOKEN and friends of the eight people who died in an explosion at the Denel munitions factory in Somerset West in the Western Cape.

src: familie en vriende van die agt mense wat in 'n ontploffing by die Denel-ammunisiefabriek in Somerset-Wes in die Wes-Kaap gesterf het.
tgt: loved ones of those who died in a fatal fire that broke out at a building shared by the Gauteng Provincial Government’s departments of Health, Human Settlements and Cooperative Governance.

src: Gelukwense.
tgt: Congratulations.

src: Die Kabinet wens die mense van Zimbabwe geluk met die suksesvolle oorgang na 'n nuwe regering onder leiding van President Emmerson Mnangagwa, wat op 26 Augustus 2018 amptelik ingehuldig is.
tgt: Cabinet congratulated the people of Zimbabwe for successfully transitioning into a new government led by President Emmerson Mnangagwa, who was inaugurated on 26 August 2018.

src: President Ramaphosa het by ander Afrika-leiers in Harare aangesluit om die geleentheid mee te maak.
tgt: President Ramaphosa joined other African leaders in Harare to witness the occasion.

src: Die Kabinet ondersteun President Ramaphosa se verbintenis tot noue samewerking met Zimbabwe om die bestaande historiese, politieke en broederlike verhoudings te verbeter, met spesifieke klem op die bevordering van ekonomiese samewerking.
tgt: Cabinet supports President Ramaphosa’s commitment to work closely with Zimbabwe to enhance the historical, political and fraternal relations, with particular emphasis on strengthening economic cooperation.

src: Die Kabinet prys die Wetenskaplike en Nywerheidsnavorsingsraad, en spesifiek sy vroulike navorsers, dat gesondheidsnavorsing onderneem word om die land se gesondheidsorgstelsel te verbeter.
tgt: Cabinet commends the Council for Scientific and Industrial Research, and specifically its female researchers, on health research being undertaken to improve the country’s healthcare system.

src: Dit sluit in:
tgt: These include:

src: 'n diabetes-opsporingskyfie om bloedsuikervlakke te monitor deur asem te analiseer (ii) ontwikkeling van probiotika vir gebruik in die produksie van braaikuikens, kabeljou en perlemoen, wat sal help met die produksie van natuurlike dierprodukte, wat vry is van antibiotika, chemikalieë en groeistimulante (iii) en verdere stamselnavorsing.
tgt: a diabetes-detecting chip to monitor blood sugar levels by analysing breath (ii) development of probiotics for use in the production of broiler chickens, dusky-cob and abalone, which will assist in the production of natural animal products, free of antibiotics, chemicals and growth stimulants (iii) and further stem cell research.

src: Die Kabinet wens ook vir dr Evodia Setati, 'n senior navorser van die Universiteit van Stellenbosch se Departement Wingerd- en Wynkunde geluk met haar Toekenning vir Voortreflike Vrouewetenskaplike by die jaarlikse Suid-Afrikaanse Vroue in Wetenskaptoekennings in Polokwane op 23 Augustus 2018.
tgt: Cabinet also congratulates Dr Evodia Setati, a senior researcher at the University of Stellenbosch’s Department of Viticulture and Oenology, who won the Distinguished Women Scientists Award at the annual South African Women in Science Awards held in Polokwane on 23 August 2018.

src: Die Kabinet wens Caster Semenya geluk met haar indrukwekkende oorwinning in die 800-meter-wedloop van die derde Diamond League-eindstryd in Switserland.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates Caster Semenya on her impressive performance in winning her third Diamond League final in the 800 metre event in Switzerland.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderworpe aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die toepaslike klaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant WEBTOKEN Jacob Ganny Mbele as the Deputy Director-General (DDG): Energy Programmes and Projects in the DoMs Hilda Dikeledi Mhlongo as the DDG: Corporate Services in the DoE.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 19 September 2018 by die Uniegebou in Pretoria vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 19 September 2018 at the Union Buildings, Pretoria.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Issues in the environment.

src: Ekonomie.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die aanbod deur die sakesektor om professionele mense uit die privaat sektor aan die regering te sekondeer.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the offer extended by business for the secondment of private-sector professionals to government.

src: Dit volg op ’n voorbereidende vergadering van President Cyril Ramaphosa met sakeleiers, spesiale beleggingsverteenwoordigers en die HUB-inisiatief, wat die opkomende Werkgeleenthedeberaad en Beleggingskonferensie voorafgaan.
tgt: This emerged from a preparatory meeting held by President Cyril Ramaphosa with business leaders, special investment envoys and the CEO Initiative, ahead of the upcoming Job Summit and Investment Conference.

src: Die vergadering is dit eens dat daar ’n dringende behoefte bestaan om Suid-Afrika se ekonomie te verbeter deur die implementering van die stimuluspakket en die beloofde groeiversterkingshervormings.
tgt: The meeting agreed that South Africa’s economic recovery demands urgent implementation of the stimulus package and promised growth-enhancing reforms.

src: Voorstelle vir die vestiging van ’n infrastruktuur-ontwikkelingsinisiatief, wat privaatsektorbefondsing en kundigheid oor die lewering van dienste insluit, is ook bespreek.
tgt: Proposals were also discussed to establish an infrastructure-development initiative that draws in private-sector funding and delivery expertise.

src: Beleggingsveldtog.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom ook die beleggingsinisiatief-besoek aan Japan, wat deur die Departement van Handel en Nywerheid gelei is.
tgt: Cabinet also welcomes the investment drive to Japan led by the Department of Trade and Industry.

src: Die inisiatief is daarop gerig om beleggings ter waarde van US$100 biljoen oor die volgende vyf jaar na die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie te lok.2 Japan is al ’n geruime tyd een van Suid-Afrika se langtermyn top-10-beleggingsvennote.
tgt: This is part of the broader drive that seeks to attract US$100 billion worth of investments into the South African economy over the next five years.

src: Me meer as 140 van sy maatskappye wat hier sake doen, word Suid-Afrika as ’n vervaardigingspilpunt vir toegang tot Afrika beskou.
tgt: Japan has been a long-term Top 10 investment partner of South Africa, with more than 140 of its companies operating in our country, which is seen as a regional manufacturing hub into Africa.

src: Die Kabinet moedig maatskappye aan om nie net in Suid-Afrika te belê nie, maar om ook hul beleggings uit brei.
tgt: Cabinet encourages companies to both invest and expand in South Africa.

src: Opleidingsprogramme.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van die R22-miljoen opleidingsprojek deur die Minister van Arbeid, Mildred Oliphant, wat werk sal skep op die gebiede van lugvaart, maritieme kommersiële duik en landbou.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the R22-million training project by the Minister of Labour, Ms Mildred Oliphant, which will create employment in the aviation, maritime commercial diving and agricultural sectors.

src: Die projek word onderneem in vennootskap met die Dr John Langalibalele Dube Instituut en die Werkloosheidsversekeringsfonds (WWF), wat ’n entiteit van die Departement van Arbreid is.
tgt: The project is being undertaken in partnership with the Dr John Langalibalele Dube Institute and the Unemployment Insurance Fund (UIF), an entity of the Department of Labour.

src: Die projek fokus op vorige WWF-bydraers, wat hul werk verloor het.2 Die eerste groep begunstigdes sluit 50 WWF-bydraers van Durban se Virginia-lughawe in asook 50 bydraers van die maritieme kommersiële duikprojek in Scottsburg, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: The project will focus on the former contributors to the UIF who lost their jobs.

src: 100 landelike vroue van Emadungeni sal ook opgelei word om koöperatiewe ondernemings te begin vir die kweek van organiese vrugte, groente en katoen.
tgt: The first group of beneficiaries includes 50 UIF contributors from the Durban Virginia Airport 50 from the maritime commercial diving project in Scottsburg, KwaZulu-Natal, and 100 rural women from Emadungeni will be trained towards forming a cooperative to plant and grow organic fruit, vegetables and cotton, including value-chain processing.

src: Hierdie koöperatiewe ondernemings het ’n ooreenkoms met Pick n Pay onderteken om groente te verskaf, en met die Departement van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling vir die verkryging van materiaal om skoolklere te vervaardig.
tgt: These cooperatives have signed an agreement with Pick n Pay for vegetable supply and with the Department of Social Development to source material for the manufacture of school uniforms.

src: Binnelandse Sake.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die amptelike opening deur President Ramaphosa van nuwe kantore vir die Departement van Binnelandse Sake by Hluhluwe in KwaZulu-Natal.2 Die uitgebreide voorsiening van siviele dienste aan gemarginaliseerde gemeenskappe speel ’n deurslaggewende rol in die bevordering van demokrasie en maatskaplike geregtigheid.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the official opening by President Ramaphosa of new offices for the Department of Home Affairs at Hluhluwe in KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Dit maak deel uit van die regering se onderneming om dienste nader aan gemeenskappe te neem.
tgt: The expanded roll-out of civic services to marginalised communities plays a key role in enabling and deepening democracy and social justice.

src: Uitsaai- en digitale migrasieprogram.1 Die Kabinet is tevrede met die vordering wat gemaak word met die migrasieproses van analoog na digitaal.
tgt: Cabinet is satisfied with the progress being made in migrating the country from analogue to digital.

src: As deel van die aftelling na Desember 2018 vir die Vrystaat se analoogafskakeling, word die eerste sender op 20 September 2018 in Senekal in die Vrystaat aangeskakel.
tgt: As part of the countdown to December 2018 for the Free State Analogue Switch-Off, the first transmitter in Senekal in the Free State will be switched off on 20 September 2018.

src: Dit is in lyn met die ooreenkoms wat gemaak is met die Internasionale Telekommunikasie-unie.2 ’n Kommunikasieveldtog is aan die gang om te verseker dat al die betrokke huishoudings gereed is vir die afskakeling.
tgt: This is in line with the commitment agreed to with the International Telecommunication Union.

src: Huishoudings wat ’n analoë TV-stel het en beplan om ’n nuwe een te koop, word aangeraai om een te koop met ’n geïntegreerde digitale skakelaar.
tgt: A communication campaign is underway to ensure that all households are ready for the switch-off.

src: Huishoudings met ’n inkomste van meer as R3 200 per maand, het die opsie om ’n nuwe geïntegreerde digitale TV-stel met ’n ingeboude digitale terrestriële TV-dekodeerder te koop, wat by al die vernaamste kleinhandel afsetgebiede beskikbaar is.
tgt: Households with analogue television (TV) sets looking to buy new ones are advised to choose those with an integrated digital tuner.

src: Afleggings.1 Ooreenkomstig President Ramaphosa se versoek vir ’n moratorium op die besnoeiing van poste weens die land se ekonomiese klimaat, beklemtoon die Kabinet sy beroep op werkgewers om afleggings as ’n laaste uitweg te beskou, en om eers ander beskikbare en innoverende maniere om koste te bespaar deeglik te ondersoek om poste te behou.
tgt: In line with President Ramaphosa’s call for a moratorium on job cuts resulting from the economic conditions in the country, Cabinet reiterates its appeal to employers that retrenchments must be a last resort, and that other available and innovative ways to contain costs be thoroughly explored to sustain jobs.

src: Misdaadstatistieke.1 Die Kabinet onderskryf die regering se groepering vir Justisie, Misdaadvoorkoming en Sekuriteit se dringende ingryping om ’n strategie saam te stel vir die hantering van verskeie kwessies wat deur die onlangse misdaadstatistieke na vore gekom het.
tgt: Cabinet endorses the intervention by the Justice, Crime Prevention and Security Cluster to urgently engage on a comprehensive strategy to deal with various issues emanating from the recently released crime statistics.

src: Dit sluit die onlangse Nasionale Beraad oor die Voorkoming van Misdaad en Geweld in, met die tema “Bou veiliger gemeenskappe deur ’n geïntegreerde, ontwikkelende benadering tot die voorkoming van misdaad en geweld”.
tgt: This includes the recently held National Summit on Crime and Violence Prevention held under the theme “Building safer communities through an integrated, developmental approach to crime and violence prevention”, which developed a joint vision on safety as a collective responsibility, and provided a platform for key stakeholders and experts to engage on the effective implementation of the 2016 White Paper on Safety and Security across all sectors.

src: Voorvalle van geweld.1 Die Kabinet is diep bekommerd oor die vlakke van geweld in ons samelewing en doen ’n dringende beroep op alle sektore, gemeenskappe en wetstoepassingsagentskappe om saam te werk om te verseker dat skole en openbare plekke veilig is.2 Die voorvalle van geweld wat op verskeie plekke in die land uitgebreek het, is onaanvaarbaar en druis teen die Grondwet in.
tgt: Cabinet is deeply concerned by the level of violence in our society and calls on all sectors, communities and law-enforcement agencies to work together to ensure that schools and public spaces are safe and secure.

src: Die Kabinet prys die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens vir hul spoedige reaksie om diegene wat vermoedelik by voorvalle van openbare geweld betrokke was en in besit van vermeende gesteelde goedere was, in hegtenis te neem.
tgt: Cabinet commends the South African Police Service for the swift responses in arresting those suspected of being involved in public violence and possession of suspected stolen goods.

src: Uitbreek van klebsiella Die Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel met die naasbestaandes van die ses babas wat dood is weens die uitbreek van klebsiella pneumoniae by die Thelle Mogoerane-hospitaal in Vosloorus.2 Die uitbraak is tans onder beheer.
tgt: Klebsiella outbreak.

src: Die Minister van Gesondheid, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi, het intussen die oorplasing van babas en hul moeders na die Nelson Mandela-kinderhospitaal en Charlotte Maxeke Johannesburg Akademiese Hospitaal respektiewelik aangekondig.3 Dit gee die provinsiale Departement van Gesondheid ’n geleentheid om die omgewing skoon te skrop en te ontsmet, asook om sonder enige steurings aandag te gee aan strukturele kwessies.
tgt: Cabinet extends condolences to the families of the six babies who died following an outbreak of Klebsiella pneumoniae at the Thelle Mogoerane Hospital in Vosloorus.

src: Dit stel maatreëls voor om ons ekonomie uit verskeie verwante portefeuljes aan te vuur.
tgt: Stimulus packageCabinet deliberated and approved the proposed stimulus package which proposes measures to reignite our economy from a number of related portfolios.

src: ’n Meia-inligtingsessie onder leiding van President Ramaphosa word op Vrydag 21 September gehou om die pakket bekend te stel.
tgt: A media briefing led by President Cyril Ramaphosa will held on Friday 21 September to present this package.

src: Visum-verwante hervormingsDie Kabinet het ook ’n gesamentlik verslag van die ministers van Binnelandse Sake en van Toerisme respektiewelik, ontvang.
tgt: VISA related reformsCabinet also received a joint report from the Ministers of Home Affairs and Tourism respectively, on a number of visa-related reforms which will make it easier for tourists, business people and academia to come to South Africa.

src: Dit het betrekking op verskeie visum-verwante hervormings, wat dit makliker sal maak vir toeriste, sakelui en akademici om Suid-Afrika te besoek.
tgt: The reforms include amendments to the regulations applying to foreign minors travelling to South Africa, which will be gazetted in October.

src: Samesprekings oor visum-kwytskelding en verslapping van visum-regulasies vir sekere lande, word ook gefinaliseer.
tgt: Negotiations on visa waivers and relaxation of visa requirements for certain countries are also being finalised.

src: Mer besonderhede sal hierdie week aangekondig word.
tgt: Further details will be announced this week.

src: Wetsontwerpe.
tgt: Bills.

src: Die Kabinet keur die volgende wetsontwerpe vir openbare kommentaar goed:12.1 Wysigingswetsontwerp op Diensbillikheid van 2017.
tgt: Cabinet approved the following Bills for publication for public comment:.

src: Die wysigings is daarop gerig om die voldoeningsmeganismes te versterk en maak voorsiening vir die opstel van sektorspesifieke numeriese teikens rakende diensbillikheid.
tgt: The amendments seek to strengthen the compliance mechanisms and will allow for the setting up of employment equity sector-specific numerical targets.

src: Die Minister van Arbeid, in oorlegpleging met die sektor se belanghebbers, sal sektorspesifieke numeriese teikens rakende diensbillikheid opstel.2 Wysigingswetsontwerp op Finansiëlesektorwetgewing van 2018: Die wysigings is daarop gerig om die voorwaardes vir kuratorskap van banke, insluitend onderlinge en koöperatiewe banke, asook sekere nie-banke, te wysig.
tgt: The Minister of Labour, in consultation with the sector’s stakeholders, will be able to set employment equity sector-specific numerical targets.

src: Die wysigings sal verseker dat indien hierdie finansiële instellings probleme ervaar, hulle bygestaan kan word op ’n manier wat kwesbare deponeerders beskerm met minimale ontwrigting vir die finansiële stelsel en die breër ekonomie.
tgt: Financial Sector Laws Amendment Bill of 2018: The amendments seek to strengthen the curatorship provisions for banks, including mutual and cooperative banks, and certain non-banks.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming Events.

src: Erfenisdag.1 Die 2018 Nasionale Erfenisdagvierings vind by die Riverview-stadion in Kokstad, KwaZulu-Natal plaas onder die tema: “Die Jaar van Nelson Mandela: Vooruitgang van Suid-Afrika se erfenislandskap”.
tgt: Heritage Day The 2018 National Heritage Day celebration under the theme: “The Year of Nelson Mandela: Advancing transformation of South Africa’s heritage landscape”, takes place at the Riverview Stadium in Kokstad, KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Dit is deel van ’n maandlange program van aktiwiteite wat gerig is op die transformasie, bevordering en bewaring van Suid-Afrika se ryk en diverse erfenis, nasionale identiteit, nasiebou en maatskaplike samehorigheid.2 Die Erfenisdagvierings bring hulde aan Adam Kok en die Griekwa-gemeenskap vir hul moed, vasberadenheid en standvastigheid om weerstand te bied teen koloniale besetting.3 Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op die publiek om hul eenheid in verskeidenheid te vier, en dat elkeen sy deel bydra tot die bou van ’n land waar almal vir mekaar omgee en mekaar respekteer.
tgt: This is part of the month-long programme of activities which are addressing issues of transformation, promotion and preservation of South Africa’s rich and diverse heritage, national identity, nation-building and social cohesion.

src: Verenigde Nasies se Algemene Vergadering (UNGA)14.1 As deel van UNGA se bydrae tot voormalige President Nelson Mandela se eeufeesjaar, hou die organisasie op 24 September 2018 ’n hoëvlak voltallige vergadering oor globale vrede, wat bekend staan as die Nelson Mandela Vredesberaad, ter ere van Nelson Mandela se eeufeesjaar.2 Die voltallige vergadering sal na verwagting ’n politieke verklaring aanvaar wat deur die UNGA-lidlande beding is.
tgt: The Heritage Day celebration is in honour of Adam Kok and the Griqua community for their courage, determination and fortitude in resisting colonial occupation.

src: President Ramaphosa neem op 26 September 2018 ook deel aan die VN se hoëvlakvergadering oor TTB kom baie wyd in Afrika voor en lande met die hoogste TB-syfers ter wêreld is op dié vasteland.
tgt: In contributing towards the centenary of former President Nelson Mandela, the UNGA will on 24 September 2018 hold a high-level plenary meeting on global peace known as the Nelson Mandela Peace Summit, in honour of the centenary of the birth of Madiba.

src: Direksie van Rand Water:a. AdvFaith Matshidiso Hashatse (Voorsitter)b. MeMassacha Khulekelwe Glynnis Mbonambi (Adjunkvoorsitter)c. MnrLL Makibinyaned.
tgt: CongratulationsCabinet congratulates the Minister of Small Business Development, Ms Lindiwe Zulu, for being admitted to the highest level of the Order of Rio Branco (Ordem de Rio Branco), and the Grand Cross from the Government of Brazil.

src: MnrProtas Thamsanqa Philij.
tgt: Ms Phindile Sweetness Mbanjwae.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 10 Oktober 2018 by Tuynhuys in Kaapstad vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 10 October 2018 at Tuynhuys in Cape Town.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Issues in the environment.

src: Ekonomie en beleggingsveldtog.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom praktiese tussenkomste soos die verbintenis om plaaslike produkte te koop, ’n meer aggressiewe benadering tot die bevordering van invoere, ingypings in die landbouwaardeketting en steun vir klein en mediumondernemings.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the practical interventions such as the commitment to buy local products, a more aggressive approach to increasing exports, interventions in agricultural value chains and support for small and medium enterprises.

src: Hierdie aankondigings het gespruit uit die onlangse tweedaagse Werkberaad, wat onder beskerming van die Nasionale Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling- en Arbeidsraad belê is.2 Die uitkoms van die Werkberaad volg op die bekendstelling van die Ekonomiese Stimulus-en-Herstelplan, wat daarop gerig is om ekonomiese groei te herstel en broodnodige werksgeleenthede te skep.
tgt: These announcements came out of the recent two-day Job Summit, which was convened under the National Economic Development and Labour Council.2 The outcome of the Job Summit follows the announcement of the Economic Stimulus and Recovery Plan, which seeks to restore economic growth and create much-needed jobs.

src: Die Mynbouhandves – wat in oorleg met die mynbousektor, arbeid, geaffekteerde gemeenskappe en ander belanghebbers ontwikkel is – verduidelik die dringendheid van groei, volhoubaarheid en transformasie.3 Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle belanghebbers om by die Mynbouhandves betrokke te raak ten einde stabiliteit in die mynbousektor te skep.
tgt: The new Mining Charter – which was finalised in consultation with the mining industry, labour, affected communities and other stakeholders – clarifies the imperatives of growth, sustainability and transformation.

src: Binnelandse Sake se Kokstad-kantoor en oorhandiging van titelaktes.1 Die Kabinet sluit hom aan by President Cyril Ramaphosa om die Departement van Binnelandse Sake te loof vir die suksesvolle opening van sy Kokstad-kantoor in KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all stakeholders to engage with the Mining Charter so as to finalise and create stability in the mining sector.

src: Die President het die Binnelandse Sake-kantoor geopen as deel van die regering se program om die voetspoor van Binnelandse Sake se diensleweringspunte uit te brei om aan landsburgers se vraag na ID-slimkaarte en ander dokumente te voldoen.2 President Ramaphosa het ook 443 titelaktes aan begunstigdes van die Franklin-behuisingsprojek oorhandig.
tgt: Kokstad Home Affairs office and handover of title deeds.

src: Dit is deel van die vergoedingsprogram om te verseker dat begunstigdes die volle voordele van huiseienaarskap geniet en toegang tot die formele eiendomsmark kry.3 Die Kabinet maak ook van hierdie geleentheid gebruik om Suid-Afrikaners aan te moedig om hul ID’s te gaan afhaal sodra hulle ’n kennisgewing ontvang dat dit gereed is.
tgt: The President opened the Home Affairs office as part of government’s programme to expand the footprint of Home Affairs service-delivery points to meet citizens’ demands for Smart ID cards and other documents.

src: Betaling van maatskaplike toelae.1 Die Kabinet is deur die Interministeriële Komitee: Maatskaplike Toelae, onder voorsitterskap van Minister Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, ingelig.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes South Africa’s first small-scale cooperatives in the fishing sector, namely the Port Nolloth and Hondeklipbaai cooperatives in the Northern Cape, which were launched by the Minister of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, Mr Senzeni Zokwana.

src: Alle kontantbegunstigdes wat deur CPS geraak is, is migreer en CPS is in kennis gestel dat sy kontrak met ingang 30 September 2018 beëindig word.3 Die Kabinet spreek sy waardering uit vir die toegewyde toesighoudende werk onder leiding van die Interministeriële Komitee met die ondersteuning van die Tegniese Taakspan van Direkteurs-Generaal.
tgt: The fishing rights give dignity to local fishermen, who have been fishing illegally, in that they are now protected for the first time.3 The two small-scale fishing communities who will be benefiting from this policy have received basic training on cooperatives and have been assisted to register cooperatives for the purpose of applying for 15-year fishing rights.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op die Westbury-gemeenskap en alle ander gemeenskappe om met die polisie saam te werk om te verseker dat misdaad, dwelms en bendebedrywighede in hul onderskeie omgewings uitgeroei word.
tgt: It further extends its appreciation to the work of the officials from SAPO, South African Social Security Agency and, the departments of Social Development Telecommunications and Postal Services Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation National Treasury South African Police Service and GCICabinet thanks all the social-grant beneficiaries for their cooperation during this transition.

src: Vervoermaand Vanjaar se Vervoermaand-program plaas die klem op die belangrikheid van vervoerinfrastruktuur, soos die see-, lug-, spoor- en padsektore as instaatstellers van ekonomiese groei.
tgt: Cabinet commends the law-enforcement agencies in carrying out an intensive multi-disciplinary investigation relating to incidents at shopping malls, retail stores and mosques which has resulted in the arrest of nineteen suspects.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op die publiek om openbare vervoer te gebruik en padveiligheidsinisiatiewe regdeur die jaar aktief te implementeer.
tgt: It involved the Justice, Crime Prevention and Security Cluster.

src: Die Kabinet wens die span navorsers van die Universiteit van die Witwatersrand geluk met ’n historiese en suksesvolle leweroorplanting van ’n MIV-positiewe moeder na haar MIV-negatiewe kind.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the name change of Grahamstown, in the Eastern Cape, to Makhanda, in honour of Xhosa prophet, philosopher and military man who fought against colonialism.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag, 24 Oktober 2018 te Tuynhuys in Kaapstad vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 24 October 2018 at Tuynhuys in Cape Town.

src: Kwessies in die Omgewing.
tgt: Issues in the environment.

src: Meiumtermynbegrotingsrede (MTBR) Die Kabinet verwelkom die intree-MTBR deur die Minister van Finansies Tito Mboweni, wat gegrond is op die sterk oortuiging dat Suid-Afrika vernuwe kan word.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the maiden MTBPS by Finance Minister Tito Mboweni, which is based on the strong conviction that South Africa can be renewed.

src: Die 2018-MTBR beklemtoon die moeilike ekonomiese en fiskale keuses waarvoor die regering oor die volgende drie jaar te staan gaan kom.
tgt: The 2018 MTBPS highlights the difficult economic and fiscal choices confronting government over the next three years.

src: Ekonomiese groei vir 2018 is afwaarts hersien van 1,5% tot 0,7%, en die internasionale omgewing bly steeds uitdagend vir ontluikende markte se ekonomieë.
tgt: Economic growth for 2018 has been revised down from 1.5% to 0.7%, and the global environment remains challenging for emerging market economies.

src: Die 2018-MTBR gee gevolg aan die President se ekonomiese stimulus-en-herstelplan, wat deur fiskale en monetêre stabiliteit ondersteun sal word.
tgt: The 2018 MTBPS gives effect to the President’s growth economic stimulus and recovery plan, which will be underpinned by fiscal and monetary stability.

src: Die regering bly verbind tot fiskale volhoubaarheid, maar daar was sedert die tertafellegging van die 2018-begroting in Februarie vanjaar ’n verlies van beheer.
tgt: Government remains committed to fiscal sustainability, but there has been slippage since the tabling of the 2018 Budget in February this year.

src: Die regering bly ook verbind tot die stabilisering en vermindering van skuld.
tgt: Government remains committed to stabilizing and bringing down debt.

src: Teen die agtergrond van ’n moeilike ekonomiese en fiskale omgewing, prioritiseer die voorgestelde verdeling van inkomste steeds groot maatskaplikebestedingsprogramme wat basiese onderwys, gesondheid, maatskaplike welsyn, sanitasie en elektrisiteitsdienste ondersteun.
tgt: Against the backdrop of a difficult economic and fiscal environment, the proposed division of revenue continues to prioritise large social spending programmes that support basic education, health, social welfare, water, sanitation and electricity services.

src: Presidensiële Gesondheidsberaad.
tgt: Presidential Health Summit.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die resultate van die Presidensiële Gesondheidsberaad, wat daarop gerig is om die verskillende uitdagings wat die gesondheidstelsel in die gesig staar, op te los.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the outcomes of the Presidential Health Summit which aim to address the various challenges facing the public health system.

src: Die resultate sal die voorbereidings vir die implementering van die Nasionale Gesondheidsversekering versterk.
tgt: The outcomes will strengthen the preparations for the implementation of the National Health Insurance.

src: Grondhervorming.
tgt: Land reform.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die konsekwente implementering van grondhervormings- en herstelprogramme wat die ongeregtighede van die verlede regstel en help om die ekonomie te laat groei.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the consistent implementation of land reform and restitution programmes that redresses the past injustices and help to grow the economy.

src: President Cyril Ramaphosa het ’n grondrestitusie-seremonie gelei, waartydens 4 586 hektaar grond aan die gemeenskap van KwaMkhwanazi in Empangeni, KwaZulu-Natal, oorhandig is.
tgt: President Cyril Ramaphosa led a land restitution ceremony, where over 4 586 hectares of land were handed to the community of KwaMkhwanazi in Empangeni, KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Die KwaMkhwanazi-gemeenskap sal ook ná-vestigingspakkette en ondersteuning ontvang wat hulle sal help om die potensiële rykdom van die grond optimaal te benut.
tgt: The KwaMkhwanazi community will also receive post-settlement packages and support that will assist them to maximise the potential wealth of the land.

src: Dit hef gemeenskappe van bestaansboere op tot kommersiële deelnemers en eienaars van sakeondernemings oor die totale waardekettings van die bates op hulle grond.
tgt: This shifts communities from subsistence to commercial participants and owners of businesses across the value chains of the assets on their land.

src: Die regering is daartoe verbind om die volhoubaarheid van opkomende landbou-ondernemings te ondersteun, wat 262 grondhervormingsverwante projekte insluit om jeugdiges en vroue in al die provinsies te bevoordeel.
tgt: Government is committed to supporting the sustainability of emerging agricultural enterprises, which includes 262 land reform-related projects to benefit youth and women across all provinces.

src: Vernietiging van openbare infrastruktuur.
tgt: Destruction of public infrastructure.

src: Die Kabinet spreek sy kommer uit oor die vernietiging van vervoerinfrastruktuur.
tgt: Cabinet expressed concern on the destruction of transport infrastructure.

src: Dit ondermyn die regering se verbintenis om dienste na histories benadeelde gemeenskappe te neem.
tgt: This undermines government's commitment to take services to historically disadvantaged communities.

src: Geen mate van ontevredenheid regverdig die vernietiging van openbare eiendom nie.
tgt: No amount of unhappiness should result in the destruction of public property.

src: Sulke optrede beroof slegs die arm mense van broodnodige dienste.
tgt: Such destruction serves to rob the poor of much-needed services.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op lede van die publiek om waaksaam te wees en met wetstoepassingsagentskappe saam te werk om die skuldiges aan die kaak te stel.
tgt: Cabinet calls on members of the public to be vigilant and work with law enforcement agencies to bring those responsible to account.

src: Die Kabinet neem ook kennis dat die Kluster vir Justisie, Misdaadvoorkoming en Sekuriteit hierdie saak dienooreenkomstig sal hanteer.
tgt: Cabinet further noted that the Justice, Crime Prevention and Security Cluster will deal with this matter accordingly.

src: Aanstellingsproses van die Nasionale Direkteur van Openbare Vervolging (NDOV) Die Kabinet verwelkom die nuwe benadering tot die aanstelling van die NDOPresident Ramaphosa het ’n raadgewende paneel aangestel om individue wat geskik is vir oorweging vir die pos van Hoof van die Nasionale Openbare Vervolgingsgesag te identifiseer en onderhoude met hulle te voer.
tgt: National Director of Public Prosecutions (NDPP) appointment process.

src: Die paneel het vandeesweek die eerste keer vergader en sal na verwagting teen 7 Desember 2018 ’n kortlys met name aan die President voorlê.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the new approach of appointing the NDPPresident Ramaphosa appointed the Advisory Panel to identify and conduct interviews with individuals worthy of consideration to occupy the position of the Head of the National Prosecuting Authority.

src: Die Kabinet beraadslaag oor die uitspraak van die Konstitusionele Hof oor die private gebruik, kweek en besit van dagga deur ’n volwasse persoon vir sy/haar persoonlike verbruik en die uitwerking van hierdie uitspraak.
tgt: Constitutional Court Judgement.1 Cabinet deliberated on the Constitutional Court Judgement on the use, cultivation and possession of cannabis by an adult person in private for his/her personal consumption and its impact.

src: Lede van die publiek word versoek om hulle te vergewis van die uitspraak, aangesien die gebruik van dagga in ’n openbare plek verbode is.
tgt: Members of the public are requested to familiarise themselves with the judgement as the use of cannabis in a public place is prohibited.

src: Die Kabinet besef dat die uitspraak binne die konteks van ander wette bestaan, wat van toepassing kan wees op die gebruik, besit en kweek van dagga.
tgt: Furthermore, the judgement did not decriminalise the dealing in cannabis.2 Cabinet acknowledges that the judgement exists in the context of other laws which may be applicable to the use, possession and cultivation of cannabis.

src: Die Kabinet win advies oor die saak in.
tgt: Cabinet is taking advice on the matter.

src: Skoolveiligheidsberaad.
tgt: School Safety Summit.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die onlangse Skoolveiligheidsberaad wat onder leierskap van die Minister van Basiese Onderwys, Angie Motshekga, gehou is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the recently held School Safety Summit hosted under the leadership of Basic Education Minister Angie Motshekga.

src: Die beraad het onderwys- en eksterne belanghebbers byeengebring om oplossings te vind vir veiligheidsvraagstukke waarvoor die land se skole te staan kom, asook om die weg te baan vir veiliger omgewings in skole.
tgt: The summit brought together education and external stakeholders to find solutions to safety issues facing the country’s schools as well as to pave the way forward for safer environments in schools.

src: Dit volg op voorvalle van geweld by sommige skole, insluitend die tragiese dood van die 24-jarige onderwyser, mnrGadimang Daniel Mokolobate, wat deur ’n leerder aan die Ramotshere Sekondêre Skool in Zeerust, Noordwes doodgesteek is.
tgt: This follows incidents of violence at some schools, including the tragic death of the 24-year-old teacher, Mr Gadimang Daniel Mokolobate, who was fatally stabbed by a learner at the Ramotshere Secondary School in Zeerust, North West.

src: Alle belanghebbers het saamgestem dat geweld in die algemeen, en in skole in die besonder, onaanvaarbaar is en dat verdere samewerking nodig is om te verseker dat skole veiliger vir leerders sowel as onderwysers word.
tgt: All stakeholders agreed that violence in general, and in schools in particular, is not acceptable and that further cooperation is required to ensure that schools become safer for both learners and teachers.

src: Matriekeksamen Die Kabinet wens alle leerders, veral Graad 12-leerders, alles van die beste toe vir die eksamentydperk.
tgt: Cabinet wishes all learners, especially Grade 12 learners, well over this period.

src: Die departement sal vanjaar vir die eerste keer ook ’n eksamen in Suid-Afrikaanse Gebaretaal op huistaalvlak aan 58 dowe kandidate in 10 skole afneem.
tgt: For the first time, the department will this year also administer an examination in South African Sign Language at Home Language level to 58 deaf candidates across 10 schools.

src: Die eksamentydperk strek oor vyf-en-’n-half weke en eindig op 28 November.
tgt: The examination extends over five-and-a-half weeks and will conclude on 28 November.

src: Leerders regoor die land sal ook ’n vrywillige eed onderteken om die integriteit van eksamens te handhaaf deur nie aan enige wanpraktyke deel te neem nie.
tgt: Learners across the country will also sign a voluntary pledge to commit to upholding the integrity of the examinations by not participating in any malpractice.

src: Ouers en voogde word aangemoedig om leerders gedurende hierdie kritieke tydperk in hul akademiese reis te ondersteun.
tgt: Parents and guardians are encouraged to support learners during this critical period in their academic journey.

src: Dit is ook van uiterste belang om leerders te motiveer om hul skoolopleiding te voltooi.
tgt: It is also vital to motivate learners to finish their schooling.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet keur die verklaring van 20 Mariene Beskermde Gebiede (MBG’s) as deel van die Operasie Phakisa: Oseaan-ekonomie MBG’s Verteenwoordigende Raamwerk goed.
tgt: Cabinet has approved the declaration of 20 Marine Protected Areas (MPAs) as part of the Operation Phakisa: Ocean Economy MPAs Representative Network.

src: Die voordeel van die bykomende aanwysing sal onder meer voorsiening maak vir verdere ontwikkeling van ekotoerisme en die bevordering van toegang tot hulpbronne vir kleinskaalse visserye wat volhoubaar bestuur word.
tgt: The benefit of the additional designation will, amongst others, allow for further development of the ecotourism and promotion of access to sustainably managed resources for small-scale fisheries.

src: Die voorgestelde aanwysings volg op onderhandelings met al die betrokke belanghebbers.
tgt: The proposed designations followed negotiations with all the relevant stakeholders.

src: Die MBG’s sal in die Staatskoerant gepubliseer word.
tgt: The MPAs will be published in the Government Gazette.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan Suid-Afrika se Hersiene en Belynde Tweede Nasionale Aksieprogram (NAP) om Woestynvorming en Gronddegradering te bestry en die Gevolge van Droogte te Verlig (2018-2030).
tgt: Cabinet approved South Africa’s Revised and Aligned Second National Action Programme (NAP) to Combat Desertification, Land Degradation and Mitigate the Effects of Drought (2018-2030).

src: Die doel van die NAP is om ’n bydrae tot die bewaring en volhoubare gebruik van grond en ander natuurlike hulpbronne te lewer.
tgt: The NAP seeks to contribute towards the conservation and sustainable use of our land and other natural resources.

src: Suid-Afrika het in 1997 die Verenigde Nasies se Konvensie om Woestynvorming te Bestry, bekragtig.
tgt: South Africa ratified the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification in 1997.

src: Ingevolge Artikel 9 van die konvensie word daar van partye verwag om ’n NAP te ontwikkel, voor te berei en te implementeer as die sentrale element van die strategie om woestynvorming te bestry en die gevolge van droogte teen te werk.
tgt: In accordance with Article 9 of the convention, parties are required to develop, prepare and implement a NAP as the central element of the strategy to combat desertification and mitigate the effects of drought.

src: Suid-Afrika het sy eerste NAP in 2004 ontwikkel.
tgt: South Africa developed its first NAP in 2004.Bills.

src: Die Kabinet keur die publikasie van die Kinderwysigingswet in die Staatskoerant vir openbare kommentaar goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the publication of the Children’s Amendment Bill in the Government Gazette for public comments.

src: Die wetsontwerp beoog om die koördinasie van die kindersorg-en-beskermingstelsel deur interdepartementele en intersektorale samewerking te versterk.
tgt: The Bill seeks to strengthen coordination of the child-care and protection system through interdepartmental and intersectoral collaboration.

src: Die wysigings is in reaksie op die uitspraak van die Noord-Gauteng Hoëhof van November 2017, waartydens die Departement van Maatskaplike Welsyn beveel is om die nodige wysigings aan die Kinderwet, 2005 (Wet 38 van 2005) op te stel met die oog op ’n regsoplossing vir die bestuur van die pleegsorgstelsel.
tgt: The amendments respond to the North Gauteng High Court Judgement of November 2017, wherein the Department of Social Development was ordered to prepare and introduce the necessary amendments to the Children’s Act, 2005 (Act 38 of 2005) in respect to the legal solution towards the management of the foster-care system.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswet op Posdienste by die Parlement ingedien word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the introduction of the Postal Services Amendment Bill to Parliament.

src: Die wetsontwerp gee gevolg aan die Witskrif oor die Nasionale Geïntegreerde IKT-beleid wat in September 2016 deur die Kabinet goedgekeur is.
tgt: The Bill gives effect to the National Integrated ICT Policy White Paper that was approved by Cabinet in September 2016.The intended outcomes are to have a competitive, viable and sustainable South African Post Office that provides/facilitates universal services and access as well as the transformation of the postal sector.

src: Die wetsontwerp maak ook voorsiening vir ’n benadering om fisiese adresse aan landelike en tradisionele gemeenskappe toe te ken.
tgt: The Bill also provides an approach to assigning physical addresses to rural and traditional communities.

src: Hierdie wetsontwerp het reeds die openbare-oorlegplegingsproses voltooi.
tgt: This Bill has already gone through public consultation.

src: Toekomstige Gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Suid-Afrikaanse Internasionale BeleggingskonferensiePresident Ramaphosa tree op Vrydag, 26 Oktober 2018, as voorsitter op tydens Suid-Afrika se eerste Beleggingskonferensie by die Sandton Konferensiesentrum in Johannesburg.
tgt: South African International Investment ConferencePresident Ramaphosa will on Friday, 26 October 2018, preside over South Africa’s inaugural Investment Conference at the Sandton Convention Centre in Johannesburg.

src: Dit vorm deel van verskeie pogings om beleggings te lok en ons ekonomie te laat groei.
tgt: This is part of a combination of efforts to attract investments and grow our economy.

src: Daarbenewens sal die vier beleggingsgesante wat deur die President aangestel is, aan die konferensie verslag doen oor die vordering wat tot dusver gemaak is.
tgt: Additionally, the four investment envoys who were appointed by the President will report back to the conference on progress made.

src: Beraad van die Groep van Twintig (G20)President Ramaphosa is deur die Federale Kanselier van Duitsland, Dr Angela Mekel, genooi om aan die G20-Beleggingsberaad – Duitse Sakeondernemings en die Kompak met Afrika (KmA)-lande, asook aan ’n Besigheidstafelronde deel te neem, wat albei op 30 Oktober 2018 in Berlyn, Duitsland gehou word.
tgt: Group of Twenty (G20) SummitPresident Ramaphosa has been invited by the Federal Chancellor of Germany, Dr Angela Merkel, to participate in the G20 Investment Summit – German Business and the Compact with Africa (CwA) Countries, and a Business Roundtable, both of which will be held in Berlin, Germany on 30 October 2018.The G20 Investment Summit will bring together German business and CwA Countries to explore investment opportunities under the framework of the G20 Partnership with Africa.

src: Die G20-Beleggingsberaad sal Duitse sakeondernemings en KmA-lande byeenbring om beleggingsgeleenthede binne die raamwerk van die G20-vennootskap met Afrika te ondersoek.
tgt: German investors will present flagship projects currently undertaken in the CwA Countries and explore further opportunities on the continent.

src: Die President sal die beraad in sy hoedanigheid as medevoorsitter van die G20-Afrika-adviesgroep bywoon.
tgt: The President will attend the summit in the capacity of Co-Chair of the G20 Africa Advisory Group.

src: Die G20-Konferensie oor die KmA sal na nuwe maniere kyk hoe die G20, Afrika-lande en ontwikkelingsinstellings met mekaar kan saamwerk om privaat belegging en ekonomiese deelname in Afrika-lande te bevorder.
tgt: The G20 Conference on the CwA will focus on ways in which the G20, African countries and development institutions can cooperate to promote private investment and economic participation in African states.

src: Die vergadering sal ook voorbereidingswerk op hierdie terrein vir die G20-Beraad in Buenos Aires, Argentinië, onderneem.
tgt: The meeting will also undertake preparatory work in this field for the G20 Summit in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

src: Nasionale Imbizo-fokusweekLede van die Uitvoerende Gesag sal aan die GCIS se 9de Nasionale Imbizo-fokusweek van die vyfde demokratiese administrasie deelneem, wat vanaf 12 tot 25 November 2018 gehou word.
tgt: National Imbizo Focus WeekMembers of the Executive will participate in the GCIS’s 9th National Imbizo Focus Week of the fifth democratic administration, which will take place from 12 to 25 November 2018.

src: Dit val saam met die Kabinet se Aksieprogram-verslagdoeningsweek.
tgt: This coincides with the Cabinet Programme of Action Reporting Week.

src: Die Imbizo-fokusweek bied ’n platform aan lede van die Nasionale Uitvoerende Gesag, asook aan provinsiale en plaaslike-regeringsleiers om oor hierdie tydperk gemeenskapsvergaderings en Izimbizo landswyd te onderneem.
tgt: The Imbizo Focus Week will provide a platform for members of the National Executive as well as provincial and local government leaders to undertake community meetings and Izimbizo countrywide, over this period, to demonstrate government’s implementation of the 2014-2019 Medium Term Strategic Framework and to respond to issues being raised by citizens, which impact on the safety, growth and development of our communities.

src: Dit sal ook ’n geleentheid bied om die regering se implementering van die 2014-2019 Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk te demonstreer en om te reageer op kwessies wat deur inwoners geopper word en wat ’n uitwerking sal hê op die veiligheid, groei en ontwikkeling van ons gemeenskappe.
tgt: The two weeks of activism takes place against the backdrop of celebrations of the centenaries of Struggle icons Mama Albertina Sisulu and Tata Nelson Mandela, both of whom epitomised the value of regular consultation and interaction with the communities they served.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Minister van Gesondheid, dr Aaron Motsoaledi, geluk, wat twee gesogte Kochon-pryse gewen het tydens ’n toekenningseremonie in Den Haag, Nederland.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the Minister of Health, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi, who received two prestigious Kochon prizes, at an award ceremony held at The Hague, The Netherlands.

src: Die eerste toekenning is in die minister se individuele hoedanigheid vir sy rol en politieke leierskap in die stryd teen tuberkulose (TB) op internasionale vlak.
tgt: The first prize is in the Minister’s individual capacity for his role and political leadership in the fight against tuberculosis (TB) globally.

src: Die tweede toekenning, wat die minister met die Agbare Nick Hebert, Lid van die Parlement (LP) in die Verenigde Koninkryk deel, is in hul hoedanigheid as medevoorsitters van die Global TB Caucus van LP’s regoor die wêreld.
tgt: The second prize, which the Minister will share with the Right Honourable Nick Hebert, Member of Parliament (MP) in the United Kingdom, will be in their capacity as co-chairs of the Global TB Caucus of MPs from all over the world.

src: Die Kochon-prys word jaarliks toegeken aan individue en/of organisasies wat ’n beduidende bydrae tot die bestryding van TB gelewer het gelewer het, hetsy in hul eie lande of internasionaal.
tgt: The Kochon Prize is awarded annually to individuals and/or organisations that have made a significant contribution to combating TB either in their countries or globally.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die Wêreldreistoekennings 2018 se benoeming van Suid-Afrika as Afrika se Toonaangewende Bestemming.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the World Travel Awards 2018 which voted South Africa as Africa’s Leading Destination.

src: Durban in KwaZulu-Natal is as Afrika se Toonaangewende Stadsbestemming aangewys en het ook die gesogte titel van Afrika se Toonaangewende Toerskiphawe ingepalm.
tgt: Durban in KwaZulu-Natal was also recognised as Africa’s Leading City Destination and scooped the prestigious title of Africa’s Leading Cruise Port.

src: Kaapstad in die Wes-Kaap het die titel Afrika se Toonaangewende Fees- en Geleentheidsbestemming verwerf.
tgt: Cape Town, in the Western Cape landed the title of Africa’s Leading Festival and Event Destination.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die première van ’n plaaslike rolprent getitel Nommer 37 in die Verenigde State op 2 November 2018.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the premiering of a local film titled Nommer 37 by film-maker Joshua Bradley in the United States on 2 November 2018.

src: Die misdaadriller, deur rolprentmaker Joshua Bradley, wat op die Kaapse Vlakte afspeel, is deur die Departement van Handel en Nywerheid befonds deur sy Aansporingskema vir Suid-Afrikaanse Ontluikende Swart Rolprentmakers.
tgt: The crime thriller set in the Cape Flats was funded by the Department of Trade and Industry through its South African Emerging Black Filmmakers Incentive scheme.

src: Dit sal help om regstreekse buitelandse belegging na die Suid-Afrikaanse rolprentbedryf te lok.
tgt: This will contribute in attracting foreign direct investment into the South African film industry.

src: Die Kabinet betuig saam met President Ramaphosa sy medelye met:.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Ramaphosa in expressing sadness and condolences:.

src: die tragiese afsterwe van meer as 27 mense in ’n veelvuldige motorbotsing op die N1 Noord in Limpopo.
tgt: at the tragic passing away of more than 27 people, in a multiple vehicle accident on the N1 North in Limpopo.

src: Padgebruikers word weer eens -dringend gemaan om versigtig te bestuur op ons paaie en om te alle tye die padreëls te gehoorsaam.
tgt: Road users are urged to exercise caution on our roads and must ensure that they obey the rules of the road at all times.

src: die afsterwe van die vryheidstrydikoon, Mama Agnes Msimang.
tgt: at the passing of Struggle icon, Mama Agnes Msimang.

src: Mama Msimang was ’n toegewyde gender-aktivis en voormalige adjunkpresident van die African National Congress (ANC) se Vroueliga.
tgt: Mama Msimang was a committed gender activist and former Deputy President of the African National Congress (ANC) Women’s League.

src: Sy was een van talle vroue wat hul gemeenskappe regoor Suid-Afrika teen die apartheidstelsel gemobiliseer het.
tgt: She was amongst countless women who mobilised their communities across South Africa against the apartheid system.

src: Sy word op Vrydag, 26 Oktober ter ruste gelê.
tgt: She will be laid to rest on Friday, 26 October.

src: Die begrafnisdiens sal om 08:00 begin by Our Lady of Cedars Katolieke Kerk in Woodmead, Johannesburg.
tgt: The funeral service will start at 8:00 at Our Lady of Cedars Catholic Church in Woodmead, Johannesburg.

src: die afsterwe van die vryheidstrydveteraan en ontvanger van die Nasionale Orde van Medi vir Dapperheid in Silwer, mnrEric “Stalin” Mtshali.
tgt: at the passing Struggle stalwart and recipient of the National Order of Mendi for Bravery in Silver Eric “Stalin” Mtshali.

src: die afsterwe van die ANC-veteraan Moss Chikane.
tgt: at the passing of ANC stalwart Moss Chikane.

src: MnrChikane het in 1994, ná die land se eerste demokratiese verkiesing, ’n LP geword.
tgt: Mr Chikane became an MP in 1994 after the country's first democratic elections.

src: In 2005 is hy as Suid-Afrika se ambassadeur in Duitsland aangestel.
tgt: In 2005, he was appointed as South Africa’s Ambassador to Germany.

src: die mense van Swede asook die familie van me Lisbet Palme‚ 87‚ met haar afsterwe.
tgt: to the people of Sweden as well as the family of Lisbet Palme‚ 87‚ who has passed on.

src: MePalme was die weduwee van die voormalige Eerste Minister Olof Palme, wat in 1986 in ’n sluipmoordaanval vermoor is en deur President Ramaphosa beskryf word as ’n “vriend van Suid-Afrika”.
tgt: Lisbet Palme was the widow of the former Swedish Prime Minister Olof Palme who was assassinated in 1986 and whom President Ramaphosa has described as a “Friend of South Africa”.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderworpe aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die toepaslike klaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Direksie van SENTECH SOC LIMITED:a. MeMaureen Makole Manyama (nie-uitvoerende direkteur) enb.
tgt: SENTECH SOC LIMITED Board:a. Ms Maureen Makole Manyama (non-executive director) andb.

src: MePrecious Nompumelelo Sibiya (nie-uitvoerende direkteur).
tgt: Ms Precious Nompumelelo Sibiya (non-executive director).

src: Heraanstelling van me Gugulethu Brightness Nokukhanya (Poppy) Khoza as die Direkteur: Burgerlugvaart op die Direksie van die Suid-Afrikaanse Burgerlugvaartgesag.
tgt: Reappointment of Ms Gugulethu Brightness Nokukhanya (Poppy) Khoza as the Director: Civil Aviation of the South Africa Civil Aviation Authority Board.

src: Dr Molefi Motuku as die Hoof Uitvoerende Beampte van Mintek (Suid-Afrika se Nasionale Mineraalnavorsingsorganisasie).
tgt: Dr Molefi Motuku as the Chief Executive Officer of Mintek (South Africa’s national mineral research organisation).

src: MnrTerries Salani Ndove as Adjunk-direkteurgeneraal: Grondherverdeling en Ontwikkeling in die Departement van Landelike Ontwikkeling en Grondhervorming.
tgt: Mr Terries Salani Ndove as Deputy Director-General: Land Redistribution and Development at the Department of Rural Development and Land Reform.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 7 November 2018 by Tuynhuys in Kaapstad vergaderKwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 7 November 2018 at Tuynhuys in Cape Town.

src: Presidensiële Beraad oor Geslagsgebaseerde Geweld en Vrouemoord.
tgt: Presidential Gender-Based Violence and Femicide Summit Cabinet welcomes the successful deliberations of the Presidential Gender Based Violence and Femicide Summit held on 01 and 02 November.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die suksesvolle samesprekings tydens die Presidensiële Beraad oor Geslagsgebaseerde Geweld en Vrouemoord, wat op 1 en 2 November plaasgevind het.
tgt: The Summit has confirmed the urgency of forging consensus on dealing with the crisis of gender-based violence, discrimination against women and gender disparities.

src: Dit het die noodsaaklikheid beklemtoon dat ooreenstemming bereik moet word oor hoe geslagsgebaseerde geweld, diskriminasie teen vroue en geslagsongelykheid hanteer moet word.
tgt: Government has agreed to conduct a review of national plans to end gender-based violence and the development of a National Action Plan on gender-based violence.

src: Die regering het ooreengekom om die nasionale planne vir die beëindiging van geslagsgebaseerde geweld en die ontwikkeling van ’n nasionale aksieplan oor geslagsgebaseerde geweld te hersien.
tgt: It remains committed to work with all stakeholders to ensure that we dramatically reduce levels of gender-based violence – and ultimately eradicate it.

src: Die regering bly daartoe verbind om met alle belanghebbendes saam te werk om te verseker dat die vlakke van geslagsgebaseerde geweld dramaties verminder word – en uiteindelik heeltemal uitgewis word.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to work together to fundamentally change attitudes, practices and institutions to end violence against women.

src: Belegging.
tgt: Investment.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die suksesvolle beleggingskonferensie wat in Oktober in Sandton, Johannesburg plaasgevind het.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the successful Investment Conference that took place in October in Sandton, Johannesburg.

src: Deur die konferensie het Suid-Afrika toegang verkry tot R290 miljard se beleggingsbeloftes in verskillende sektore van die ekonomie.
tgt: The Investment Conference enabled South Africa to garner in access of R290 billion in investment commitments across different sectors of the economy.

src: Dit dra by tot die beloftes van meer as R400 miljard wat danksy die beleggingsveldtog tydens spesiale gesante se staatsbesoeke aan verskeie lande, ontvang is.
tgt: This adds to the pledges of over R400 billion that were received during the investment drive by the special envoys and from various countries during state visits.

src: Mer as 1 000 afgevaardigdes uit meer as 35 lande het die konferensie bygewoon.
tgt: The Conference was attended by more than 1 000 delegates, drawn from more than 35 countries.

src: Die gees en bui was optimisties en die land het nuwe geleenthede vir belegging en beleidsinisiatiewe bekendgestel, wat help om 'n beleggingsvriendelike omgewing te skep.
tgt: The spirit and mood was upbeat and the country showcased new opportunities for investment and policy-initiatives that are helping to create an investment-friendly environment.

src: Die Kabinet wens die span geluk met hulle harde werk tydens die konferensie en sien daarna uit om gereelde vorderingsverslae oor die implementering van die verbintenisse wat gemaak is te ontvang.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the team that worked on the Conference and looks forward to receiving regular update reports on implementation of the commitments made.

src: Terwyl Suid-Afrika en die res van Afrika steeds meer doen om die vasteland se ekonomie te laat groei, verwelkom die Kabinet ook die eerste Afrika-beleggingsforum wat tans tot 9 November in Johannesburg plaasvind.
tgt: As South Africa and the rest of Africa continues to move on a higher trajectory towards growing the economy of the continent, Cabinet also welcomes the inaugural Africa Investment Forum, currently taking place up until the 9th November, in Johannesburg.

src: Die Afrika-beleggingsforum is deur die Afrika-ontwikkelingsbank belê.
tgt: The Africa Investment Forum was convened by the African Development Bank.

src: Dit is daarop gerig om op huidige suksesse te bou deur openbare en private beleggers bymekaar te bring om 'n nuwe groeipad vir die hele Afrika-vasteland uit te stippel.
tgt: It aims to build on current successes by bringing together public and private sector investors to chart a new growth path for the entire African Continent.

src: Die onlangse G20-Afrikakonferensie gee ons groeivooruitsigte ’n verdere hupstoot deur die verskillende verbintenisse wat private belegging en ekonomiese deelname in Afrika-lande bevorder as deel van die Compact-with-Africa-inisiatief.
tgt: The recently held G20 Africa Conference further boosts our growth prospects through the various commitments that promote private investment and economic participation in African states as part of the Compact with Africa Initiative.

src: Die Compact-with-Africa-inisiatief word deur die Afrika-adviesgroep onder mede-voorsitterskap van Suid-Afrika en Duitsland gedryf.
tgt: The Compact with Africa Initiative is co-chaired by South Africa and Germany through the Africa Advisory Group.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom ook die R50 miljoen Phuthaditjhaba-nywerheidspark in die Vrystaat, wat onlangs bekendgestel is.
tgt: Cabinet also welcomed the recently launched R50 million Phuthaditjhaba Industrial Park in the Free State which will promote industrialization and increase local job creation and growth in that province.

src: Dit sal industrialisering, plaaslike werkskepping en ekonomiese groei in daardie provinsie verhoog.
tgt: Cabinet remains convinced that these interventions will ultimately begin to reduce the unemployment challenges facing the country, by igniting a renewed spirit of hope and optimism.

src: Die regering is besig om sy pogings vir die skep van meer werksgeleenthede vir jongmense en Suid-Afrikaners in die algemeen, te verskerp, met die klem op township- en landelike ekonomieë, asook ondernemings deur vroue en jeugdiges, wat dikwels die ergste deurloop onder die ekonomiese realiteite.
tgt: Government is stepping up efforts to create more jobs for young people and South Africans as a whole, focused on township and rural economies, and enterprises of women and youth who often bear the brunt of challenging economic realities.

src: Die Kabinet is vol vertroue dat die pakket van herstelmaatreëls, wat ’n R50 miljard-hupstoot vir kernsektore soos landbou, openbare infrastruktuur, township- en landelike ekonomieë sal verseker, die nodige dryfkrag vir werkskepping en volgehoue ekonomiese herstel sal bied.
tgt: Cabinet is confident that the package of recovery measures, which will inject R50 billion into key sectors such as agriculture, public infrastructure, township and rural economies, will provide the necessary impetus for job creation and sustained economic recovery.

src: Dit dra by tot die praktiese gevolge van die Werksberaad waartydens die regering, die sakesektor en arbeid, hulle daartoe verbind het om: plaaslike produkte te koop 'n meer aggressiewe benadering tot die verhoging van uitvoere aan te neem tussenkomste in landbouwaardekettings te verseker en steun aan klein- en medium ondernemings te gee om werksgeleenthede te bevorder.
tgt: This adds to the practical outcomes of the Jobs Summit where government, business and labour committed to: buy local products adopt a more aggressive approach to increasing exports interventions in agricultural value chains and support for small and medium enterprises to boost jobs.

src: Die Kabinet glo dat hierdie tussenkomste van deurslaggewende belang is om die bevindings van die kwartaallikse arbeidsmagopname vir die derde kwartaal van 2018 aan te pak.
tgt: Cabinet believes that these interventions are critical in addressing the findings from the Quarterly Labour Force Survey for the third quarter of 2018, which showed both a growth in employment and an increase in the number of unemployed persons.

src: Vir die drie-maande-tydperk is 92 000 bykomende werksgeleenthede geskep.
tgt: For the 3-months period, 92 000 additional jobs were created.

src: Aangesien ongeveer 131 000 voorheen ontmoedigde werksoekers weer die arbeidsmark in die kwartaal betree het, het die werkloosheidsyfer met 0,3 van 'n persentasiepunt tot 27,5 persent gestyg.
tgt: However, because about 131 000 previously ‘discouraged work-seekers’ re-entered the labour market in the quarter, the unemployment rate also rose, by of a percentage point to per cent.

src: Volgens Statistiek Suid-Afrika het indiensneming in sakedienstehandel en-konstruksie gestyg, terwyl daar werksverliese in mynbou, vervaardiging, vervoer en private huishoudings was.
tgt: According to Statistics South Africa employment growth was registered in business services trade and construction, while job losses were occurred in mining, manufacturing, transport and private households.

src: Indiensneming in die formele sektor het gedaal, terwyl werksgeleenthede in die informele sektor gegroei het.
tgt: Employment in the formal sector shrunk, whilst jobs in the informal sector grew.

src: 20ste herdenking van die Wet op Meedinging.
tgt: 20th Anniversary of the Competition Act Cabinet notes that the Competition Act reached its 20th year since it was brought into operation in October 1998.

src: Oor die 20 jaar het die mededingingsowerheid aansienlike suksesse in die stryd teen kartels aangeteken, sowel as teen misbruik van markoorheersing en beskerming van openbare belang tydens samesmeltings.
tgt: Over the twenty-year period, the competition authorities have registered significant successes in the fight against cartels, abuse of market dominance and protection of public interest during mergers.

src: Die owerhede het meer as R8 miljard in boetes aan maatskappye opgelê vir oortredings van die Wet.
tgt: The authorities imposed more than R8 billion in penalties on companies for breaches of the Act.

src: Die Ministerie van Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling het deur middel van maatreëls in die Wet op Meedinging meer as R5 miljard in spesiale fondse gegenereer om klein ondernemings, plaaslike verskaffers en die toetrede van swart boere tot die ekonomiese hoofstroom te bevorder.
tgt: The Ministry of Economic Development, through measures in the Competition Act, generated more than R5 billion in special funds to promote small business, local suppliers and the entry of black farmers into the economic mainstream.

src: Die Kabinet wens die mededingingsowerheid geluk met die werk wat gedoen word om die ekonomie oop te maak vir nuwe spelers en om entrepreneurskap en mededigendheid te bevorder.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the competition authorities for the work done to open the economy to new players and promote entrepreneurship and competition.

src: 18de Vergadering van die Vereniging van Lande om die Indiese Oseaan (IORA) se Raad van Ministers.
tgt: 18th Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) Council of Ministers meeting.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Departement van Internasionale Betrekkinge en Samewerking geluk met die aanbieding van 'n suksesvolle 18de vergadering van die Vereniging van Lande om die Indiese Oseaan (IORA) wat op 2 November 2018 in Durban, KwaZulu-Natal plaasgevind het, onder die tema: Verenig die Volke van Afrika, Asië, Australasië en die Midde-Ooste deur beter Koöperatiewe Samewerking vir Vrede, Stabiliteit en Volhoubare Ontwikkeling.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the Department of International Relations and Cooperation for hosting a successful 18th Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) Meeting of the Council of Ministers (COM) which was held in Durban, KwaZulu Natal on 02 November 2018 under the theme: Uniting the Peoples of Africa, Asia, Australasia and the Middle East through enhanced cooperation for Peace, Stability and Sustainable Development”.

src: Een van die uitkomste van die 18de IORA-vergadering was 'n spesiale verklaring ter ere van oud-President Nelson Mandela wat ook een van die stigters van IORA was.
tgt: One of the outcomes of the 18th IORA meeting was a Special Declaration in honour of President Nelson Mandela who is also one of the founders of IORThis led to the establishment of the “IORA Nelson Mandela ‘Be the Legacy’ internship programme” expected to be officially launched in July 2019.

src: Dit het tot die vestiging van die IORA Nelson Mandela: Be the Legacy-internskapprogram gelei, wat na verwagtinge in Julie 2019 amptelik van stapel gestuur sal word.
tgt: This initiative aims at empowering and capacitating young people of IORA with work experience in their fields of study.

src: Hierdie inisiatief is daarop gerig om jongmense van IORA toe te rus met werkservaring in hul studierigtings.
tgt: Fighting Crime Cabinet welcomes the recently launched Anti-Gang Unit in Hanover Park, Western Cape, by President Cyril Ramaphosa.

src: Hierdie bykomende ingryping deur die regering sal 'n belangrike rol speel om die probleem van bende- en dwelmverwante misdade wat gemeenskappe teister, die hoof te bied.
tgt: This added intervention by government will go a long way in dealing decisively with the problem of gang and drug related crimes that are plaguing communities.

src: Lede van die eenheid is opgelei om hoërisiko-situasies te hanteer, aangesien hulle uit die taktiese reaksiespanne, die spesiale taakmag en die nasionale ingrypsingseenheid gewerf is.
tgt: The unit has members who are trained in handling high-risk situations as they come from the tactical response teams, the special task force as well as the national intervention unit.

src: As deel van pogings om misdaad te pak, sal hierdie besondere regeringsingryping nasionaal van stapel gestuur word.
tgt: In the pursuit of tackling crime, this particularly government-led intervention will be rolled out nationally.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op gemeenskappe om met wetstoepassingsagentskappe saam te werk om veiligheid en sekuriteit te handhaaf, aangesien ’n veilige omgewing noodsaaklik is vir enige gemeenskap se ontwikkeling.
tgt: Cabinet calls on communities to work with law enforcement agencies to maintain safety and security which is critical for any community to develop.

src: Die Kabinet is steeds daartoe verbind om te verseker dat gemeenskappe veilig is en veilig voel in hul onderskeie omgewings.
tgt: It remains committed in ensuring that communities are safe and feel safe in their respective areas.

src: Die Kabinet bedank all belastingbetalers wat hul jaarlikse belastingopgawes vir die 2017/18-belastingseisoen, wat op 31 Oktober ten einde geloop het, stiptelik ingedien het.
tgt: Tax Season Cabinet thanks all taxpayers for promptly submitting their annual tax returns for the 2017/18 tax season, which closed on 31 October 2018.

src: Inkomste wat deur belasting ingevorder word bly die hoofbron van fondse wat verseker dat die regering dienste aan die publiek kan lewer.
tgt: Revenue generated through taxes remains the main source of funds that ensures government can deliver services to the public.

src: Nasionale Finansiële Hulpfonds vir Studente (NSFAS).
tgt: National Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS).

src: Die Kabinet herinner alle leerders wat vir die Nasionale Finansiële Hulpfonds vir Studente (NSFAS) wil aansoek doen om finansiële bystand in 2019, dat aansoeke op 30 November 2018 sluit.
tgt: Cabinet reminds all learners wanting to apply to the National Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS) for financial aid in 2019 that online applications close on 30 November 2018.

src: Aansoeke het op 1 September 2018 geopen vir kwalifiserende studente wat hul studies in goedgekeurde kursusse in 2019 by enige openbare universiteit of tegniese en beroepsonderwys en -opleiding (TVET) -kollege in Suid-Afrika wil voortsit.
tgt: On 01 September 2018, applications opened to eligible students wishing to further their studies in 2019 on an approved course at any public university or Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) college in South Africa.

src: Studente word sterk aangemoedig om aanlyn aansoek te doen of hul naaste tak van die Nasionale Agentskap vir Jeugontwikkeling (NYDA) voor die sluitingsdatum te besoek.
tgt: Students are strongly encouraged to submit online applications or visit their nearest National Youth Development Agency (NYDA) centre before the closing date.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet decisions.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die Strategieraamwerk vir die nastreef van Suid-Afrika se strategiese ekonomiese belange wêreldwyd met betrekking tot handel, belegging en industrialisering.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Strategy Framework for the pursuit of South Africa’s strategic economic interests globally as it relates to trade, investment and industrialisation.

src: Die raamwerk is daarop gerig om te verseker dat internasionale samesprekings die land se binnelandse beleidsprioriteite, soos armoedeverligting, werkloosheid en ongelykheid, dien.
