tgt: The strategy aims to ensure that international engagements serve the country’s domestic policy imperatives such as poverty alleviation, unemployment and inequality.

src: Die strategie beveel aan dat Suid-Afrika ontwikkelingsintegrasie in die res van Afrika, wat deur 'n beleggingsgeleide strategie ondersteun word, nastreef, en strategiese alliansies vestig om sy agenda te bevorder.
tgt: The strategy advocates that South Africa pursue development integration in the rest of Africa supported by an investment led strategy and build strategic alliances to advance its agenda.

src: Dit konsolideer ook sy handels- en beleggingsverhoudinge met ontwikkelde lande en streef na inwaartse beleggings, vaardighede en tegnologie-oordrag, asook toegevoegde waarde-uitvoere.
tgt: It also consolidates its trade and investment relations with developed countries and pursues inward investments, skills and technology transfer and value –added exports.

src: Die Kabinet keur die jaarlikse lewenskoste-salarisaanpassing vir lede van die Suid-Afrikaanse Meseregtekommissie goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the cost-of-living annual salary adjustment for members of the South African Human Rights Commission.

src: Die Wet op die Suid-Afrikaanse Meseregtekommissie, 2013, bepaal dat vergoeding, toelaes en ander bepalings en diensvoorwaardes deur die President in oorleg met die Kabinet en die Minister van Finansies bepaal word.
tgt: The South African Human Rights Commission Act, 2013 provides that remuneration, allowances and other terms and conditions of office be determined by the President in consultation with Cabinet and the Minister of Finance.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Internasionale ArbeidsorganisasieDie Internasionale Arbeidsorganisasie (ILO) se Hoëvlak-wêreldkommissie oor die Toekoms van Werk hou sy finale sessie van 15 tot 17 November 2018.
tgt: International Labour OrganisationThe International Labour Organisation’s (ILO) High-Level Global Commission on the Future of Work will hold its final session from the 15 to 17 November 2018 The Commission is is co-chaired by President Cyril Ramaphosa and his Swedish counterpart Stefan Löfven.

src: Die Hoëvlak-wêreldkommissie wat in 2017 deur die ILO gestig is, is daarop gerig om die vinnige transformasies wat in die werksomgewing plaasvind te assesseer, die kernuitdagings te identifiseer en aan te beveel wat gedoen moet word om die toekoms van werk te verbeter en regverdiger te maak.
tgt: The High-Level Global commission, set up by the ILO in 2017, is tasked with assessing the rapid transformations taking place in the world of work,identifying the key challenges and what must be done to make the future of work better and fairer.

src: Die werk van die kommissie stem ooreen met die regering se fokus op die skep van behoorlike en volhoubare werksgeleenthede en pogings om te verseker dat jong Suid-Afrikaners die nodige vaardighede het om in die veranderende werksomgewing te floreer.
tgt: The work of the Global Commission aligns with government's focus on the creation of decent and sustainable jobs, and efforts to ensure young South Africans have the skills necessary to thrive in the changing workplace.

src: China Internasionale Invoer-ekspo (CIIE)Die Kabinet verwelkom Suid-Afrika se deelname as ’n eregasland aan die China Internasionale Invoer-ekspo (CIIE) in Shanghai.
tgt: China International Import Expo (CIIE)Cabinet welcomes the participation of South Africa as a country guest of honour in the China International Import Expo (CIIE) in Shanghai.

src: Die Minister van Handel en Nywerheid, Rob Davies, lei die afvaardiging wat 27 Suid-Afrikaanse organisasies insluit.
tgt: Trade and Industry Minister Rob Davies, is leading a delegation of 27 South African organisations.

src: Die afvaardiging word befonds deur die Departement van Handel en Nywerheid deur die Uitvoerbemarking- en Beleggingsbystandskema.
tgt: The delegation is being funded by the Department of Trade and Industry through the Export Marketing and Investment Assistance (EMIA) Scheme.

src: Suid-Afrika se deelname stel die land in staat om sy handel- en beleggingsvermoëns meer doeltreffend te bevorder en ons sien uit daarna dat deelnemende uitstallers uit sektore soos agro-prosessering, skoeisel en leer, ingenieurswese, petro-chemikalië, spoorwegkomponente en verdediging, sowel as inligtings- en kommunikasietegnologie, sal terugkeer met vekrygingsbestellings.
tgt: South Africa’s participation better enables the country to promote its trade and investment capabilities and we look forward to participating exhibitors from sectors, including agro-processing, footwear and leather, engineering, petro-chemicals, railway components, defence, as well as information and communication technology, returning home with procurement orders.

src: Suid-Afrika was op die kantlyn van die ekspo, ook gasheer van ’n beleggingseminaar wat op geleenthede in die vervaardigingsektor gefokus het.
tgt: On the margins of the Expo, South Africa also hosted an investment seminar focusing on opportunities in the manufacturing sector.

src: Imbizo-fokusweekDie komende twee weke van die regering se program van aktivisme, is die 9de Nasionale Imbizo-fokusweek wat deur die Regering se Kommunikasie- en Inligtingstelsel (GCIS) gekoördineer word.
tgt: Imbizo Focus WeekThe upcoming two weeks of activism by government will mark the 9th National Imbizo Focus Week, which is being coordinated by the Government Communication and Information System (GCIS).

src: Lede van die Nasionale Uitvoerende Gesag, sowel as leiers van provinsiale en plaaslike regerings sal gemeenskapsvergaderings en Izimbizo landwyd hou.
tgt: Members of the National Executive as well as provincial and local government leaders will undertake community meetings and Izimbizo countrywide.

src: 'n Program vir die tydperk 12 tot 25 November 2018 is op WEBTOKEN beskikbaar.
tgt: A programme will be posted on WEBTOKEN for the period 12 to 25 November 2018.South Africans are encouraged to utilise this platform to engage with principals on service delivery issues to ensure that we work together in developing our communities.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy meegevoel oor aan die gesinne en geliefdes van die mense wat tydens 'n reeks brande op die Tuinroete en omliggende gebiede, sowel as in die Oos-Kaap gesterf het.
tgt: Cabinet expresses its condolences to the families and loved ones of all those who lost their lives during a series of fires on the Garden Route and surrounding areas, as well as in the Eastern Cape.

src: Die vuur het onder andere die lewe van Nico Heyns geëis, wat 'n vlieënier vir "Working on Fire" was.
tgt: The fire claimed the life of Nico Heyns, who was a pilot for “Working on Fire”.

src: Dit het ook gelei tot die dood van nege ander mense en die verplasing van ongeveer 2 000 mense.
tgt: It also resulted in the death of nine other people and the displacement of approximately 2000.

src: Verskeie eiendomme is verwoes en plantegroei is oor groot gebiede vernietig.
tgt: A number of properties and large areas of vegetation were also destroyed.

src: Die Kabinet prys die vinnige reaksie van brandweermanne en rampbestuursamptenare, asook die Suid-Afrikaanse Lugmag en "Working on Fire", wat onvermoeid gewerk het om lewens te red en die brand onder beheer te bring.
tgt: Cabinet commends the swift response of fire fighters and disaster management officials, together with the SA Air Force and “Working on Fire” who worked tirelessly to save lives and bring the fire under control.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy meegevoel oor aan die regering en die mense van Indonesië ná die vliegtuigongeluk waarin 189 mense gesterf het pas nadat die vliegtuig vanaf die Indonesiese hoofstad, Jakarta, opgestyg het.
tgt: Cabinet expresses its condolences to the Government and the people of Indonesia following the plane crash that killed 189 people after takeoff from the Indonesian capital, Jakarta.

src: Gelukwense.
tgt: Congratulations.

src: Die Kabinet wens Suid-Afrika geluk dat die land op 5 November 2018 tydens die Gevolmagtige Konferensie in Duba, gekies is om in die Internasionale Telekommunikasie Unie (ITU) se Raad te dien.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates South Africa for being elected with responding support to serve on the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) Council on Monday, 05 November 2018 during the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference in Dubai.

src: Die Kabinet wens mnr Mandla Mchunu van ICASA ook geluk met sy verkiesing tot die Raad vir Radioregulasies van die ITU, asook me Doreen Bogdan-Martin, met haar verkiesing as die direkteur van die Telekommunikasie-ontwikkelingsburo en as die eerste vrou in die senior bestuur van die ITU tydens sedert dit in 1865 gestig is.
tgt: Cabinet also congratulates Mr Mandla Mchunu of ICASA who has been elected to serve on the Radio Regulations Board of the ITU as well as Ms Doreen Bogdan-Martin on her election as the Director of the Telecommunication Development Bureau, and as the first woman to be part of the senior management of the ITU since it was established in 1865.

src: Suid-Afrika aanvaar met nederigheid die vertroue wat ander nasies in die land plaas om gedurende die volgende vier jaar in hierdie hoë strukture van die ITU te dien.
tgt: South Africa is humbled by the confidence bestowed by other nation states to serve in these high structures of the ITU for the next four years.

src: Ons sal hierdie posisies gebruik om die ontwikkelingsagenda en 'n inklusiewe inligtingsamelewing in die digitale era aan te dryf.
tgt: We will use these positions to push the developmental agenda and for an inclusive information society in the digital age.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Federale Demokratiese Republiek van Ethiopië geluk met die verkiesing van die land se eerste vroulike president, Haar Eksellensie Sahle-Work Zewde, wat tans die enigste vroulike president in Afrika is.
tgt: Cabinet also congratulated the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia for electing its first woman president, Her Excellency Sahle-Work Zewde, who is the only current woman president on the African continent.

src: Suid-Afrika sal voortgaan om bilaterale betrekkinge met Ethiopië op verskeie terreine, wat handel, politieke en ekonomiese bande insluit, te handhaaf.
tgt: South Africa will continue to strengthen its bilateral relations with Ethiopia on a number of areas which include trade, political and economic relations.

src: Die Kabinet wens Kameroen se President Paul Biya geluk met sy inhuldiging tot ’n sewende ampstermyn.
tgt: Cabinet sends congratulations to Cameroon’s President Paul Biya, who was inaugurated for his seventh term in office.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op al die mense van Kameroen om saam te werk vir ’n vreedsame oplossing deur inklusiewe samesprekings.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all people of Cameroon to work together towards a peaceful solution through an inclusive dialogue process.

src: Die Kabinet sien uit na sterker bilaterale politieke, ekonomiese en handelsbetrekkinge tussen Suid-Afrika en Kameroen.
tgt: Cabinet looks forward to the deepening of bilateral political, economic and trade relations between South Africa with Cameroon.

src: Die Kabinet wens die mense van Brasilië ook geluk met hul suksesvolle verkiesing, waartydens die presidensiële kandidaat van die Bondsrepubliek van Brasilië, H. Jair Bolsonaro as die volgende Brasiliaanse president verkies is.
tgt: Cabinet also congratulates the people of Brazil for holding a successful election which sees President-elect of the Federative Republic of Brazil, H. Jair Bolsonaro as the next Brazilian President.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy goeie wense oor aan al die Hindoe-gemeenskappe in Suid-Afrika wat Diwali of Deepavali vier.
tgt: Cabinet extends good wishes to all the Hindu communities in South Africa who are celebrating Diwali or Deepavali.

src: Dit is 'n godsdienstige geleentheid wat die oorwinning van goed oor boosheid, kennis en wysheid oor onkunde, sowel as die oorwinning van lig oor duisternis vier.
tgt: This is a religious occasion that celebrates the victory of good over evil, knowledge and wisdom over ignorance as well as the triumph of light over darkness.

src: Laat die Goddelike Lig Suid-Afrika seën met vrede, voorspoed, geluk, sukses en vervulling, terwyl ons almal ’n bydrae lewer om harmonie en eenheid in ons land se kulturele en godsdienstige diversiteit te verseker.
tgt: Let the divine light bless South Africa with peace, prosperity, happiness, success and fulfilment, as we all do our part to cement harmony and unity in our country’s cultural and religious diversityAppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Heraanstelling van MeNomfundo Maseti om as Voltydse Reguleerderlid, verantwoordelik vir pypgasregulering, op NERSA se direksie te dien.
tgt: Re-appointment of Ms Nomfundo Maseti as Full-time Regulator Member, responsible for Piped-Gas regulation, to serve on the NERSA Board.

src: Die volgende mense is in die Raad vir die Bou-omgewing aangestel:a. Absalom Mosabeni Molobe (Voorsitter)b. MeMaphefo K Mogodi (Adjunkvoorsitter)c. MeZandile Yvonne Mathed.
tgt: The following persons have been appointed to the Council for the Built Environment:a. Absalom Mosabeni Molobe (Chairperson)b. Ms Maphefo K Mogodi (Deputy Chairperson)c. Ms Zandile Yvonne Mathed.

tgt: Dr Jenitha Badule.

tgt: Ngwako Edward Hutamof.

tgt: Noninzi Qinag.

tgt: Gert Hendrik Meyerh.

tgt: Jerry Leigh Magoliusi.

tgt: Hendrik Ndlovuj.

tgt: Dr Keith Ivor Jacobsk.

tgt: Adv Boitumelo Tlhakungl.

tgt: Inge Maree Vieiram.

tgt: Sinenhlanhla Thuleleni Mthembun.

tgt: Dr Prittish Dalao.

tgt: Ulandi Exnerp.
