tgt: Ms Florence Rabadaq.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 21 November 2018 by Tuynhuys in Kaapstad vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 21 November 2018 at Tuynhuys in Cape Town.

src: Kwessies in die omewing.
tgt: Issues in the Environment.

src: Belegging.
tgt: Investment.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die suksesvolle intree-Afrikabeleggingsforum wat van 7 tot 9 November 2018 by die Sandton-konferensiesentrum in Gauteng gehou is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the successful inaugural Africa Investment Forum held from 7 to 9 November 2018 at the Sandton Convention Centre in Gauteng.

src: Verskeie Afrika-regerings en -besighede, internasionale finansiële instansies en ander ontwikkelingsvennote het daarop gefokus om Afrika as die volgende globale pionier in belegging te vestig.
tgt: African governments and businesses, international financial institutions and other development partners focused on making Africa the next global frontier in investment.

src: Teen die einde van die konferensie is 45 ooreenkomste ter waarde van US$32 miljard tot voordeel van die vasteland beklink, waarvan US$6.8 miljard se beleggings tot voordeel van Suid-Afrika sal strek.
tgt: At the close of the conference 45 deals, worth US$32 billion, were concluded to benefit the continent.

src: Afrika Unie (AU) -Beraad.
tgt: African Union (AU) Summit.

src: Die Kabinet is bemoedig deur samesprekings tydens die AU-beraad op 17 en 18 November 2018 in Addis Ababa, Ethiopië, waaraan President Cyril Ramaphosa deelgeneem het.
tgt: Cabinet is encouraged by deliberations at the AU Summit held in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia on 17 and 18 November 2018, where President Cyril Ramaphosa participated.

src: Die Buitengewone Sessie het beraadslag oor voortgesette hervormingsprosesse, wat daarop gerig is om ’n meer doeltreffende versterkte AU te vestig, wat in staat sal wees om die vasteland se prioriteite en doelwitte soos vervat in Agenda 2063, wat ’n strategiese raamwerk vir die sosio-ekonomiese transformasie van Afrika is, oor die volgende 50 jaar aan te dryf.
tgt: The Extraordinary Session deliberated on the ongoing reform processes which are intended to establish an effective, efficient and re-energized AU that is capable of achieving continental priorities and goals set out in Agenda 2063, which is a strategic framework for the socio-economic transformation of Africa over the next 50 years.

src: Die hervorming van die AU is ’n voortgesette proses, waarvan sommige aanbevelings reeds in werking gestel is, veral ten opsigte van die onderneming om AU-lidlande meer eienaarskap vir die finansiering van die organisasie te laat aanvaar.
tgt: The reform of the AU is an ongoing process, with some of its recommendations already implemented, particularly in relation to the commitment to have member states of the AU assume greater ownership of financing the organisation.

src: Al hoe meer lande onderteken nou Afrika se Vryhandelsooreenkomste om te verseker dat dié ooreenkomste oor die vasteland heen ’n werklikheid word.
tgt: More countries continue to sign the African Continental Free Trade Agreement to ensure the Continent realises the continent-wide free-trade agreement.

src: Strategiese Vennootskap met die Europese Unie (EU).
tgt: Strategic Partnership with the European Union (EU).

src: Die Kabinet is in sy skik met die positiewe resultate van die 7de Suid-Afrika-EU-beraad, wat op 15 November in België gehou is.
tgt: Cabinet is pleased with the positive outcome of the 7th South Africa – EU Summit held on 15 November in Belgium.

src: Die uitkomste, sowel as die ondernemings wat tydens die beraad gemaak is, bou voort op ons ongekende poging om ekonomiese groei en werkskepping aan te dryf aan die voorpunt van Suid-Afrika se nasionale agenda.
tgt: The outcomes and commitments made at the summit build on our unprecedented drive to place economic growth and job creation at the centre of South Africa’s national agenda.

src: Suid-Afrika is die enigste land in Afrika en een van 10 lande wêreldwyd wat ‘n strategiese vennootskap met die EU het.
tgt: South Africa is the only African country and one of the 10 countries globally that has a Strategic Partnership with the EThe EU is South Africa’s largest trading partner and largest foreign investor as a bloc, representing 73.7% of total Foreign Direct Investment stocks in the country.

src: President Ramaphosa was hierdie week gasheer vir die President van die Federale Republiek van Duitsland, MnrFrank-Walter Steinmeier, tydens sy staatsbesoek aan Suid-Afrika.
tgt: President Ramaphosa this week hosted the President of the Federal Republic of Germany, Mr Frank-Walter Steinmeier, on a State Visit to South Africa.

src: Duitsland is een van Suid-Afrika se grootste buitelandse beleggers, met meer as 600 Duitse maatskappye wat dogtermaatskappye of produksiefasiliteite in die land het en altesaam ongeveer 100 000 werkgeleenthede ondersteun.
tgt: Germany is one of the largest foreign investors in South Africa, with more than 600 German companies having subsidiaries or production in the country, sustaining about 100 000 jobs.

src: Die staatsbesoek het tot die ondertekening van handels- en beleggingsooreenkomste tussen die twee lande gelei, en het albei leiers die geleentheid gegee om multilaterale kwessies te bespreek en om saam te werk as nie-permanente lede van die Verenigde Nasies (VN) se Veiligheidsraad vir ’n tweejaartermyn vanaf 2019 tot Grondhervorming.
tgt: This State Visit resulted in the signing of trade and investment agreements between the two countries, and afforded both leaders an opportunity to discuss multilateral issues and cooperate closely as non-permanent members of the United Nations (UN) Security Council for a two-year term from 2019 to Land reform.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis dat die Parlement se Gesamentlike Grondwetlike Hersieningskomitee sy verslag wat ten gunste is van die wysiging van Artikel 25 van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996 goedkeur.
tgt: Cabinet noted that Parliament’s Joint Constitutional Review Committee adopted its report that is in favour of amending Section 25 of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.

src: Die wysiging sal die Staat toelaat om grond sonder vergoeding in die openbare belang te onteien.
tgt: The amendment will make it possible for the State to expropriate land without compensation in the public interest.

src: Die komitee se verslag sal na verwagting in die Nasionale Vergadering vir bespreking ter tafel gelê word.
tgt: The committee’s report is expected to be tabled in the National Assembly for debate.

src: ’n Openbare oorlegplegingsproses het gelei tot voorleggings oor die wetsontwerp deur verskeie organisasies, asook openbare verhore in al nege provinsies.
tgt: A public consultation process saw numerous organisations making submissions on the Bill and public hearings were held in all nine provinces.

src: Die Grondwet is tot op hede 17 keer deur ’n oorlegplegende en inklusiewe proses gewysig.
tgt: The Constitution has so far been amended 17 times through a consultative and inclusive process.

src: Die Regering bly verbind tot ’n verantwoordelike benadering tot grondhervormig, wat in almal se beste belang is.
tgt: Government remains committed to a responsible land reform approach that is in the best interests of everyone.

src: Die Kabinet bevestig dat die regering die letter van die Wet respekteer, en te alle tye ooreenkomstig die Grondwet sal optree.
tgt: Cabinet affirms that government respects the rule of law and will, at all times, act in accordance with the Constitution.

src: Konstitusionele Hof-uitspraak.
tgt: Constitutional Court judgement.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die uitspraak van die Konstitusionele Hof, wat beslis dat die Wet op die Ontwikkeling van Minerale en Petroleumhulpbronne, 2002 (Wet 28 van 2002), wat die toestaan van mynregte beheer, in eenstemming met die Wet op die Interimbeskerming van Informele Grondregte, 1996 (Wet 31 van 1996), wat kwesbare grondregte beskerm, vertolk moet word.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the Constitutional Court judgment which ruled that the Minerals and Petroleum Resources Development Act, 2002 (Act 28 of 2002) which governs the awarding of mining rights, must be read concurrently with the Interim Protection of Informal Land Rights Act, 1996 (Act 31 of 1996), which protects vulnerable land rights.

src: Die Lesetlheng-gemeenskap in Noordwes se oorwinning, is die begin van ’n proses wat daarop dui dat grondregte, waarvan Suid-Afrika se histories onderdrukte mense vir geslagte lank ontneem is, nou erken word.
tgt: The victory of the Lesetlheng community in North West signals a start to the recognition of land rights of which South Africa’s historically oppressed people had been deprived for generations.

src: Waar mynbedrywighede ’n invloed op nedersettings, families en gemeenskappe het, moet mense wat direk daardeur geraak word, toestem tot enige veranderinge wat ’n invloed op hulle grondregte sal hê.
tgt: Where mining impacts on settlements, families and communities, people directly affected by mining must consent to any changes affecting their land rights.

src: Oudituitslae.
tgt: Audit outcomes.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom en dra sy gelukwense oor aan die staatsdepartement en -entiteite wat steeds en konsekwent skoon oudituitslae behaal.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes and congratulates the government departments and entities that continues to consistently receive clean- audit outcomes.

src: Dit volg nadat die Ouditeur-Generaal (OG), Kimi Makwetu, die Openbare Finansiële Bestuur se Ouditverslag vir die 2017/18-finansiële jaar vrygestel het.
tgt: This comes after the release by the Auditor General (AG) Kimi Makwetu of the Public Finance Management Audit Report of the 2017/18 financial year.

src: Die Kabinet is egter bekommerd oor aanduidings in die verslag wat algehele agteruitgang in die oudituitslae van sommige nasionale en provinsiale staatsdepartemente en hul entiteite toon.
tgt: Cabinet is however concerned with the report that shows an overall deterioration in the audit results of some national and provincial government departments and their entities.

src: Die bekragtiging van die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Openbare Oudit deur President Ramaphosa, wat daarop gerig is om die werk van die OG se kantoor te versterk, sal toesien dat dié wat aanhou om die regeringsraamwerk te verontagsaam, aanspreeklik gehou sal word.
tgt: The signing into law of the Public Audit Amendment Bill by President Ramaphosa, which will strengthen the work of the Office of the AG, will assist in holding accountable those that continue to have disregard for the governance framework.

src: Die Kabinet moedig alle departemente en entiteite aan om met behulp van remediërende tussenkomste al die kwessies wat deur die OG uitgelig is aan te pak, en om vordering gereeld te kontroleer om hierdie kwessies voor die volgende ouditsiklus die hoof te bied.
tgt: Cabinet encourages all departments and entities to work on remedial interventions on all the issues flagged by the AG and to monitor progress regularly to address issues before the next audit cycle.

src: Veiligheid en sekuriteit.
tgt: Safety and Security.

src: Die Kabinet verbind hom tot die ondersteuning van die Nasionale Veldtog vir ’n Veiliger Feesseisoen, wat deur die Minister van Polisie, Bheki Cele, van stapel gestuur is onder die tema “Operation Quiet Storm”.
tgt: Cabinet pledges support to the National Safer Festive Season Campaign that was launched by Police Minister Bheki Cele under the theme “Operation Quiet Storm”.

src: Me die aanloop tot die jaareindvakansieseisoen, is die veldtog daarop gerig om Suid-Afrika ’n veiliger plek te maak.
tgt: The campaign aims to make South Africa a safer place as we approach the year-end holiday season.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens sal tot die einde van Januarie 2019 landwyd operasies in elke stad, dorp en township onderneem.
tgt: The South African Police Service will conduct nationwide operations in every town, village and township until the end of January 2019.They will focus on visible policing, whilst conducting special crime awareness and prevention operations.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op almal in Suid-Afrika om steeds met die polisie saam te werk om ons gemeenskappe veilig te hou.
tgt: Cabinet appeals to all people in South Africa to continue cooperating with the police in keeping our communities safe.

src: Ouers en voogde word veral aangemoedig om ekstra waaksaam te wees oor hul kinders se veiligheid gedurende die komende feesseisoen.
tgt: Parents and guardians are also advised to be extra vigilant in caring for their children during the upcoming festive season.

src: Die Kabinet verbind hom ook tot die Feesseisoen se Padveiligheidsveldtog, wat die afgelope naweek deur die Minister van Vervoer, Dr Blade Nzimande, in Limpopo van stapel gestuur is.
tgt: Cabinet also pledges support to the 2018 Festive Season Road Safety campaign, launched by the Minister of Transport, Dr Blade Nzimande, in Limpopo at the weekend.

src: Die bekenstelling van die veldtog val saam met die jaarlikse twee-dag-lang Padveligheidsberaad, en die VN se Wêreldgedenkdag vir slagoffers van padongelukke.
tgt: The launch coincided with the annual two-day Road Safety Summit and the UN’s World Day of Remembrance for victims of road crashes.

src: Dit is in almal se beste belang dat elkeen van ons ’n rol speel om ’n veiliger feesseisoen te verseker deur verantwoordelik te bestuur en alle verkeersreëls te gehoorsaam.
tgt: It is in the best interests of our well-being that we all play a part in ensuring a safer festive season by driving responsibly and obeying the rules of the road.

src: Maputo-Catembe-brug.
tgt: Maputo-Catembe Bridge.

src: Die Kabinet wens die Suid-Afrikaanse ingenieurs wat by die historiese ontwikkeling van die langste sweefbrug in Afrika betrokke was, geluk.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the South African engineers involved in the historic development of the longest suspension bridge in Africa.

src: Die Maputo-Catembe-brug, wat Maputo in Mosambiek en KwaZulu-Natal met mekaar verbind, is deur Sjina se Pad- en Brugkorporasie gebou.
tgt: The Maputo-Catembe Bridge was built by the China Road and Bridge Corporation and connects Maputo in Mozambique and KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Mosambiek se President Filipe Nyusi, het die drie-kilometer-lang Maputo-Catembe-brug, wat oor ’n tydperk van vier jaar gebou is teen ’n koste van US$785 miljoen, ingewy.
tgt: President of Mozambique, Mr Filipe Nyusi, inaugurated the three-kilometre-long Maputo-Catembe Bridge, which was built over four years at a cost of US$785 million.

src: Dié ontwikkeling sal handel en toerisme tussen Mosambiek en Suid-Afrika stimuleer met ’n drastiese vermindering in die reistyd tussen Maputo en Kosibaai by KwaZulu-Natal se Ooskus-grenspos, van ses ure tot 90 minute.
tgt: This development will stimulate trade and tourism between Mozambique and South Africa with travel time between Maputo to Kosi Bay in KwaZulu-Natal’s East Coast border post drastically reduced from six hours to 90 minutes.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet decisions.

src: Program van Aksie Inligtingsweek.
tgt: Programme of Action Briefing Week.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die vorderingsverslae van die prioriteitsuitkomste vir die tydperk vanaf 1 April 2018 tot 30 September 2018.
tgt: Cabinet was apprised on the progress reports on the priority outcomes for the period starting 1 April 2018 to 30 September 2018.

src: Departemente wat binne die regeringsgroeperings (clusters) werk om die 14 prioriteitsuitkomste te implementeer, gaan voort met hul onderskeie lewerbare uitkomste.
tgt: Departments working within the clusters to implement the 14 priority outcomes continue to achieve their respective deliverables.

src: Hierdie uitkomste spruit voort uit die 2014-2019 Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk en die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan se Visie 2030.
tgt: These outcomes are derived from the 2014-2019 Medium Term Strategic Framework and from the National Development Plan’s Vision 2030.

src: Die Kabinet keur die optrede goed wat nodig is om die uitdagings wat implementering beïnvloed aan te pak.
tgt: Cabinet has approved the action required to deal with the challenges affecting implementation.

src: Die verslae is op die Departement van Beplanning, Monitering en Evaluering (DPME) se webtuiste by WEBTOKEN beskikbaar.
tgt: The reports are published on the DPME website (WEBTOKEN).

src: Motorvoertuigproduksie- en Ontwikkelingsprogram (MPOP).
tgt: Automotive Production and Development Programme (APDP).

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die MPOP van 2021 tot 2035 uitgebrei word met wysigings, om die Suid-Afrikaanse Motorvoertuigmeesterplan (SAAM) te bevorder.
tgt: Cabinet approved the extension of the APDP from 2021 to 2035 with amendments to support the South African Automotive Masterplan (SAAM).

src: Die SAAM fokus op ses areas: optimalisering van plaaslike markte ontwikkeling van streeksmarkte lokalisering infrastruktuurontwikkeling nywerheidstransformasie, en die ontwikkeling van tegnologie en verwante vaardighede.
tgt: The SAAM focuses on six areas: Local market optimisation Regional market development Localisation Infrastructure development Industry transformation, and Technology and associated skills development.

src: Die wysigings is onder meer gerig op hoër vlakke van plaaslike waardetoevoeging om meer geleenthede vir bykomende indiensneming te skep.
tgt: The amendments seek amongst others to encourage higher levels of local value addition to create more opportunities for additional employment.

src: Monitering en evaluering van die program en verwante nywerheidstendense word verder verbeter om te verseker dat voldoende vordering gemaak word om SAAM se visie en doelwitte te bereik.
tgt: Monitoring and evaluation of the programme and related industry trends are further enhanced to ensure progress towards the SAAM vision and objectives.

src: Die Minister van Handel en Nywerheid, Dr Rob Davies, sal die media op Vrydag 23 November 2018 oor hierdie wysigings inlig.
tgt: .The Minister of Trade and Industry, Dr Rob Davies, will brief the media on these amendments on Friday, 23 November 2018.Bills.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Public Audit Excess Fee Bill van 2018 aan die Parlement voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the Public Audit Excess Fee Bill of 2018 to be introduced in Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp maak voorsiening vir die Ouditeur-generaal (OG) om regstellende aksie te neem om te verseker dat verliese wat deur die staat gely word, waar moontlik, verhaal word en sekere vermoedelik wesenlike onreëlmatighede vir ondersoek verwys kan word.
tgt: The Bill supports changes to the regulation of fees for Auditor General functions in the Public Audit Amendment Act, assented to by the President and promulgated earlier this week.

src: Die Wetsontwerp poog verder om die OG te bemagtig om internasionale ouditwerk te verrig en prestasie-oudits te onderneem, sowel as om die OG se bestuursreëlings in ooreenstemming te bring met huidige beste praktyk.
tgt: The Public Audit Excess Fee Bill proposes that audit fees in excess of 1% of expenditure of municipalities and certain other public institutions payable to the Auditor-General, be treated as a direct charge against the National Revenue Fund.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: 100 #WomenOfFortitude-veldtogNa afloop van ’n nominasietyperk, sal die 100 standvastige vroue wat vir die #WomenOfFortitude-veldtog gekies is, op 22 November 2018 by die Uniegebou in Pretoria bekendgestel word.
tgt: 100 #WomenOfFortitudeFollowing a period of nominations, the 100 #WomenOfFortitude will be unveiled at the Union Buildings in Pretoria on 22 November 2018.

src: Die Interministeriële Komitee vir die Nelson Mandela- en Albertina Sisulu-eeufeesvierings het op 11 Oktober 2018 die #WomenOfFortitude-veldtog aangekondig as een van die Mama Sisulu-eeufeesaktiwiteite.
tgt: The Inter-Ministerial Committee on the Nelson Mandela Centenary and Centenary of AlbertinaSisulu announced on the 11 October 2018 the #WomenOfFortitude campaign as one of the Mama Sisulu Centenary activities.

src: Die #WomenOfFortitude-veldtog is ’n beweging van 100 vroue wat die gesprek sal aandryf oor hoe vroue vandag Mama Sisulu se nalatenskap kan handhaaf.
tgt: The #WomenOfFortitude campaign is a movement of 100 women to drive the conversation of how women today can sustain the legacy of Mama Sisulu.

src: 16 Dae van Aktivisme teen Geslagsgebaseerde Geweld (GBV)Die Departement van Vroue koördineer en konsolideer die regering se lys van byeenkomste vir die veldtog 16 Dae van Aktivisme teen GBV vanaf 25 November tot 10 Desember 2018.
tgt: 16 Days of Activism against Gender-Based Violence (GBV)The Department of Women is coordinating and consolidating government's calendar of events for the 16 Days of Activism against GBV Campaign from 25 November to 10 December 2018.

src: Lede van die Nasionale Uitvoerende Raad, sowel as provinsiale en plaaslike regeringsleiers sal by portefeulje-/sektorspesifieke byeenkomste regoor die land betrokke wees deur gemeenskapsgedrewe inisiatiewe.
tgt: Members of the National Executive as well as provincial and local government leaders will undertake portfolio/sector-specific events throughout the country through community-engagement initiatives.

src: Mer besonderhede oor al die betrokke regeringsprogramme is op die webtuiste WEBTOKEN beskikbaar.
tgt: Detailed government programmes can be accessed from WEBTOKEN Cabinet urges all South Africans to use this platform and participate in a government event nearest to them.

src: Die burgerlike samelewing en vroue-organisasies word ook aangemoedig om hul byeenkomste vir dié tydperk so wyd as moontlik bekend te maak.
tgt: Civil society and other women's organisations are encouraged to populate their calendars of events for the period.

src: Alle Suid-Afrikaners word aangemoedig om saam te werk en ag te slaan op die oproep #HearMeoo, ’n internasionale bewusmakingsveltog vir die uitwissing van geweld teen vroue, deur te luister na die lot van vroue en te help om alle vorme van geweld teen vroue te beëindig.
tgt: All South Africans are urged to work together to heed the call to #HearMeToo, by listening to the plight of women, and taking action to end the scourge of all forms of violence against women.

src: Gelukwense.
tgt: Congratulations.

src: Die Kabinet wens al ons sporthelde, wat die Suid-Afrikaanse vlag hoog laat wapper het, geluk met hul prestasies.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates all local sporting heroes who are flying the South African flag high.

src: Atlete wat uitgeblink het in hul onderskeie sportsoorte, is tydens die onlangse 2018 Sporttoekenningseremonie vereer.
tgt: The achievements of those who excelled in their respective sporting fields, was acknowledged at the recent 2018 Sports Award ceremony.

src: Suid-Afrika se Caster Semenya het dubbele goud behaal deur die gesogte Sportster van die Jaar, sowel as die Sportvrou van die Jaar-toekennings in te palm.
tgt: South Africa’s Caster Semenya bagged double gold by winning the coveted Sports Star of the Year award along with the Sportswoman of the Year Award.

src: Suid-Afrika se swemsensasie, Chad le Clos, het die Sportman van die Jaar-toekenning ingepalm.
tgt: South African swimming sensation Chad le Clos won the Sportsman of the Year Award.

src: Ndodomzi Ntutu het die toekenning vir die Sportman van die Jaar met ’n Gestremdheid gewen.
tgt: Ndodomzi Ntutu won the Sportsman of the Year with Disability Award.

src: Anrune Liebenberg het die Sportvrou van die Jaar met ’n Gestremdheid gewen.
tgt: Anrune Liebenberg won the Sportswoman of the Year with Disability Award.

src: Banyana Banyana is met die gesogte Span van die Jaar-toekenning bekroon.
tgt: Banyana Banyana won the prestigious Team of the Year Award.

src: Banyana Banyana het hul eerste wedstryd in die Vroue Afrika-nasiesbeker (AFCON) teen Nigerië gewen.
tgt: Banyana Banyana won their match against Nigeria at the 2018 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON).

src: Bafana Bafana het met ’n telling van 1-1 gelykop gespeel in die AFCON kwalifiserende wedstryd teen Nigerië.
tgt: Bafana Bafana drew 1-1 in the AFCON qualifier match with Nigeria.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse Rugbyspan word geprys vir hulle spel en ons wens hulle alles van die beste toe vir hul komende wedstryd teen Wallis op 24 November 2018.Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om steeds die land se sportmanne en -vroue daadwerklik te ondersteun.
tgt: The South African Rugby team is commended for their performances and we wish them well for their upcoming match against Wales on 24 November 2018.Cabinet calls on South Africans to continue to rally behind the country’s sports women and men.

src: Die Kabinet dra ook sy gelukwense oor aan:.
tgt: Cabinet also congratulates:.

src: Die Minister van Wetenskap en Tegnologie, Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane met haar nominasie vir die Wêreld Ekonomiese Forum se Raad oor die Vierde Industriële Revolusie, wat uit regerings, lede van die burgerlike samelewing en akademici bestaan.
tgt: Science and Technology Minister Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane, who has been nominated to serve in the World Economic Forum Council on the Fourth Industrial Revolution, which consists of government, civil society and academics.

src: Die forum sal lande help om wêreldwyd te reageer en voordeel te trek uit geleenthede wat deur die Vierde Industriële Revolusie gebied word.
tgt: This will help countries globally to respond and take advantage of opportunities presented by the Fourth Industrial Revolution.

src: Die Minister van Finansies, Tito Mboweni, met sy aanstelling as ’n lid van die AU-Vredesfonds se Raad van Trustees, wat bemiddeling- en voorkomende diplomasie-aktiwiteite, institusionele kapasiteitsvereistes en vredesondersteuningsaktiwiteite in Afrika sal finansier.
tgt: Finance Minister Tito Mboweni on his appointment to the Board of Trustees of the AU Peace Fund, which will finance mediation and preventative diplomacy activities, institutional capacity requirements, and peace support operations in Africa.

src: As 'n lid van die Raad van Trustees sal Minister Mboweni bydra tot strategiese samehorigheid en verbeterde bestuur, asook tot finansiële en administratiewe toesig oor die Vredesfonds.
tgt: As a member of the Board of Trustees, Minister Mboweni will contribute towards the strategic coherence and enhanced governance, financial and administrative oversight of the Peace Fund.

src: Die aanstelling van die trustees van die AU se Vredesfonds is 'n belangrike stap in die implementering van finansiering vir die AU se agenda, wat deel vorm van die deurlopende institusionele hervormingsproses.
tgt: The appointment of the trustees of the AU’s Peace Fund is a key step in the implementation of the financing of the AU’s agenda, which is part of the ongoing institutional reform process.

src: Die Minister van Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding, Naledi Pandor, wat op Vrydag 30 November 2018 die Franse Nasionale Orde van die Legioen van Eer-toekenning ontvang.
tgt: Higher Education and Training Minister Naledi Pandor, who will be conferred with the French National Order of the Legion of Honour Award on Friday, 30 November 2018.

src: Die toekenning is ter erkenning van haar lewenslange merkwaardige prestasies en pogings om samewerking tussen Frankryk en Suid-Afrika op die gebied van wetenskap en tegnologie te koester en te bevorder.
tgt: The award is in recognition of her lifelong remarkable achievements and efforts in nurturing and furthering the cooperation between France and South Africa in the field of Science and Technology.

src: Die seremonie sal by die Franse ambassadeur in Suid-Afrika se ampswoning in Pretoria gehou word.
tgt: The ceremony will be held in at the residence of the French Ambassador to South Africa in Pretoria.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die betrokke klaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Provinsiale hoofde van die Direktoraat vir Prioriteitsmisdaadondersoek (Hawks):.
tgt: Provincial heads of the Directorate for Priority Crime Investigation:.

src: Vrystaat: Brigadier Kubandran Moodley en.
tgt: Free State: Brigadier Kubandran Moodley and.

src: Noordwes: Majoor-General Dumisani Patrick Mbotho.
tgt: North West: Major General Dumisani Patrick Mbotho.

src: Heraanstelling van AdvMakhosini Solomon Mebi as die Hoof Uitvoerende Beampte (HUB) van die Padverkeerbestuurskorporasie (RTMC).
tgt: Reappointment of Adv Makhosini Solomon Msibi as the CEO of the Road Traffic Management Corporation (RTMC).

src: Heraanstelling van MnrThulani Matiki Norman Kgomo as nie-uitvoerende lid van die RTMC-direksie.
tgt: Reappointment of Mr Thulani Matiki Norman Kgomo as non-executive member of the RTMC Board.

src: Heraanstelling van MeDaphline Harridene Charlotte-Ann Ewertse as nie-uitvoerende lid van die RTMC-direksie.
tgt: Reappointment of Ms Daphline Harridene Charlotte-Ann Ewertse as non-executive member of the RTMC Board.

src: Aanstelling van AdvSandile Nogxina as nie-uitvoerende direkteur en voorsitter van die Lughawemaatskappy van Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Appointment of Adv Sandile Nogxina as Non-Executive Director and Chairperson of the Airport Company South Africa Board.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 5 Desember 2018 by Tuynhuys in Kaapstad vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 5 December 2018 at Tuynhuys in Cape TownIssues in the environment.

src: Ekonomiese groeiDie Kabinet verwelkom die 2,2% groei in die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie gedurende die derde kwartaal, wat help om die land uit 'n tegniese resessie te neem.
tgt: Economic growthCabinet welcomes the 2.2% growth in the South African economy during the third quarter, which is helping move the country out of a technical recession.

src: Die groeisyfers is gedryf deur toenames in die landbousektor (6,5%), die finansiële sektor (2,3%) die vervaardigingsektor (7,5%) en groot- en kleinhandelverkope (3,2%).
tgt: The growth figures were driven by increases in the agricultural sector (6.5%), financial sector (2.3%) manufacturing sector (7.5%) and wholesale and retail trade sales (3.2%).

src: Die groeisyfers dui op 'n herstel in die ekonomie en sal saam met inisiatiewe van die Werkskeppingsberaad en die Suid-Afrikaanse Beleggingskonferensie verbeter.
tgt: The growth figures signal a rebound in the economy and together with initiatives from the Jobs Summit and South African Investment Conference, will continue to improve.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom saam met alle Suid-Afrikaners die daling in die brandstofprys, wat ’n verligting vir almal is, veral met die vakansie-tydperk op hande.
tgt: Cabinet also joins South Africans in welcoming this month’s drop in the fuel price which comes as a relief, especially as we move into a holiday period.

src: Alle sektore van die samelewing word aangemoedig om voort te bou op die positiewe momentum gedurende die derde kwartaal om die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie na 'n nuwe groeifase te lei.
tgt: All sectors of society are urged to build on the positive momentum during the third quarter to help place the South African economy on a new growth trajectory.

src: Nasionale Minimum Loon (NML)Die Kabinet verwelkom ook die bekragtiging van die NML-wetsontwerp deur pres.
tgt: National Minimum Wage (NMW)Cabinet also welcomes the signing of the NMW Bill into law by President Cyril Ramaphosa.

src: Die Wetsontwerp vestig 'n historiese presedent om lae-inkomstewerkers te beskerm en ongelykheid in die samelewing te verminder.
tgt: The Bill sets a historic precedent in the protection of low-earning workers and reduction of inequality in society.

src: Die eerste NML sal die verdienste van 'n geskatte ses miljoen Suid-Afrikaanse lae-inkomsewerkers verhoog.
tgt: The first NMW will raise the earnings of an estimated six million South African low-earning workers.

src: Dit sal in fases gedoen word vir plaaswerkers, bosbouwerkers en huishoudelike werkers.
tgt: There will be a phase-in period for farm workers, forestry workers and domestic workers.

src: Hoewel hierdie NML nie ongelykheid in inkomste sal beëindig nie, glo die Kabinet dat dit 'n belangrike bydrae sal maak om die agteruitgang van stygende ongelykheid en volgehoue armoede te stuit.
tgt: Whilst this NMW will not end income inequality, Cabinet believes it will go a long way to breaking the back of rising inequality and persistent poverty.

src: Toyota Wessels Instituut vir Vervaardigingstudies (TWIMS)Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van die nuutgestigte R56 miljoen-TWIMDie instituut sal Suid-Afrika se vervaardigingsektor versterk, wêreldklasvermoëns ontwikkel en Afrika-industrialisasie aandryf.
tgt: Toyota Wessels Institute for Manufacturing Studies (TWIMS)Cabinet welcomes the launch of the newly established R56-million TWIMThe institute will boost South Africa’s manufacturing sector, develop world-class capabilities and drive African industrialisation.

src: Dit sal ook die bou van 'n vervaardigingskultuur versnel, wat nodig is om die land se huishoudelike eise te bestuur en meer werksgeleenthede te skep.
tgt: It will also accelerate the building of a manufacturing culture that the country needs to drive its domestic demands and create more WEBTOKEN is an independent and not-for-profit initiative established through grant funding from the Toyota South Africa Education Trust.

src: Dit is 'n onafhanklike en nie-winsgewende inisiatief wat deur middel van toekennings vir befondsing van die Toyota Suid-Afrikaanse Onderwystrust ingestel is.
tgt: It has been established in partnership with the University of Pretoria’s Gordon Institute of Business Science to deliver a Master of Business Administration degree specialising in manufacturing.

src: Dit is gevestig in vennootskap met die Universiteit van Pretoria se Gordon Instituut vir Bedryfswetenskap, wat daarop gerig is om 'n Mestergraad in Bedryfsadministrasie te lewer wat in vervaardiging spesialiseer.
tgt: Social EconomyCabinet notes the successful Symposium on the Social Economy held by government in partnership with the International Labour Organisation (ILO) and the Government of Flanders on Friday, 30 November 2018.

src: Maatskaplike ekonomieDie Kabinet neem kennis van die suksesvolle Simposium oor die Maatskaplike Ekonomie wat die regering in vennootskap met die Internasionale Arbeidsorganisasie (IAO) en die regering van Vlaandere op 30 November 2018 gehou het.
tgt: The symposium was led by the Economic Development Department and supported by the Department of Small Business Development.

src: Die simposium is gelei deur die Departement Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling en ondersteun deur die Departement van Klein Sake-ontwikkeling.
tgt: The Social Economy comprises enterprises and initiatives directed at achieving social-policy objectives such as creating jobs, mainstreaming excluded groups, and bringing goods and services to rural communities.

src: Dit het die potensiaal om ekonomiese insluiting te ondersteun en duisende bykomende werksgeleenthede te skep.
tgt: It has the potential of supporting economic inclusion and creating thousands of additional jobs.

src: Die simposium het maatskaplike entrepreneurs, beleidmakers, navorsers en nie-regeringsorganisasies bymekaar gebring en sal help met die ontwikkeling van 'n Groenskrif oor die Sosiale Ekonomie gedurende KieserregistrasieTer Voorbereiding vir die 2019 verkiesings, doen die Kabinet 'n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om hul reg as verantwoordelike burgers uit te oefen deur seker te maak dat hulle 'n groen strepieskode ID-boek, slim ID-kaart of tydelike identiteitsertifikaat het en geregistreer is om in hul distrikte te stem.
tgt: The symposium brought together social entrepreneurs, policymakers, researchers and non-governmental organisations, and will help in the development of a Green Paper on the Social Economy during Voter registrationIn preparation for the 2019 elections, Cabinet calls on South Africans to exercise their right as responsible citizens by ensuring they have a green bar-coded ID book, smart ID card or temporary identity certificate and are registered to vote in their districts.

src: Die Onafhanklike Verkiesingskommissie sal op 26 en 27 Januarie 2019 'n kieserregistrasie-naweek hou en Suid-Afrikaners word aangemoedig om die geleentheid te gebruik om te registreer om hul registrasiestatus te stem of te verifieer.
tgt: The Independent Electoral Commission will hold a voter-registration weekend on 26 and 27 January 2019 and South Africans are encouraged to use the opportunity to register to vote or verify their registration status.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op diegene wat aansoek gedoen het vir slim ID’s om hul dokumente by hul onderskeie kantore van die Departemente van Binnelandse Sake te gaan afhaal.
tgt: Cabinet appeals to those who have applied for Smart IDs to collect their documents at their respective Department of Home Affairs (DHA) branches.

src: Nasionale Direkteur van Openbare Vervolgings (NDOV)Die Kabinet verwelkom president Ramaphosa se aanstelling van Advkaat Shamila Batohi as die nuwe Nasionale Direkteur van Openbare Vervolging.
tgt: National Director of Public Prosecutions (NDPP)Cabinet applauds President Ramaphosa’s appointment of Advocate Shamila Batohi as the new NDPThis follows the President’s consideration of five nominees shortlisted by an advisory panel.

src: Die aanstelling bring stabiliteit na die leierskap van die Nasionale Vervolgingsgesag en versterk die land se stryd teen misdaad en korrupsie.
tgt: The appointment brings stability to the leadership of the National Prosecuting Authority and emboldens the country’s fight against crime and corruption.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy waardering oor aan die Minister van Energie, Jeff Radebe en die paneel vir hul bydrae tot hierdie historiese aanstellingsproses.
tgt: Cabinet extends its appreciation to Energy Minister Jeff Radebe and the panel for their contribution to this historic process of appointment.

src: Limpopo se professionele gesondheidswerkersDie Kabinet veroordeel die aanvalle op dokters in hospitale rondom Limpopo ten sterkste.
tgt: Limpopo health professionalsCabinet strongly condemns attacks on doctors in hospitals around Limpopo.

src: Gesondheidswerkers en gesondheidsfasiliteite dien gemeenskappe, veral kwesbare lede, wat op hulle staatmaak om hulp te kry.
tgt: Health professionals and health facilities serve communities, especially vulnerable members who facilities to get assistance.

src: Aanvalle op mense wat help om ander se lewens te red, is 'n kriminele oortreding en sal nie geduld word nie.
tgt: Attacking those who are meant to save lives is a criminal offence and will not be tolerated.

src: Die Minister van Gesondheid, dr. Aaron Motsoaledi, lei 'n multidissiplinêre taakspan - bestaande uit polisie-intelligensieagente, speurders, openbare orde polisiëring, privaat sekuriteitsowerhede en beamptes van die Departement van Binnelandse Sake - om die veiligheidstelsels by openbare gesondheidsorgfasiliteite te hersien.
tgt: The Minister of Health, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi, is leading a multidisciplinary task team – comprising police intelligence agents, detective services, public order policing, private security authorities and DHA officials – to review the security systems at public healthcare facilities.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op die gemeenskap om met wetstoepassingsagentskappe saam te werk om te verseker dat die oortreders van hierdie gruwelike misdade in hegtenis geneem en skuldig bevind word.
tgt: Cabinet calls on the community to work with law-enforcement agencies to ensure that perpetrators of this heinous crimes are arrested and convicted.

src: Veiliger vakansies Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om tydens die Desember-vakansie veilig te bly.
tgt: Safer holidaysCabinet appeals to all South Africans to keep safe during the December holidays.

src: Padgebruikers word aangespoor om alle verkeersreëls na te kom en nie roekeloos of nalatig te bestuur nie, veral onder die invloed an alkohol nie.
tgt: Road users are urged to adhere to the traffic rules, and not to drive recklessly and negligently, especially under the influence.

src: Voetgangers word ook aangemoedig om versigtig te wees wanneer hulle op die paaie is.
tgt: Pedestrians are also urged to remain cautious on the road.

src: Die groepering vir Justisie, Misdaadvoorkoming en Sekuriteit (JCPS) het anti-misdaad- en veiligheidsaktiwiteite landwyd versterk.
tgt: The Justice, Crime Prevention and Security (JCPS) Cluster has intensified anti-crime and safety operations countrywide.

src: Die Department het sy kapasiteit in hawens versterk om te verseker dat dit in staat sal wees om die verwagte toename in reisigers gedurende die feestyd te hanteer.
tgt: The DHA’s has increased its capacity in ports of entry to ensure it is able to respond to the expected increase of travellers over the festive period.

src: Die departement beplan ook om sy bedryfstye by besige hawens, wat die aanloop tot die feestyd, die feestydperk en die heropening van skole insluit.
tgt: It also plans to extend operating hours at busy ports of entry, covering pre-festive season movements, the festive season period and the re-opening of schools.

src: Vyfde herdenking van Madiba se afsterweDie Kabinet sluit by alle Suid-Afrikaners aan om die vyfde herdenking van ons eerste demokraties verkose president Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela, wat op 5 Desember 2013 gesterf het, te gedenk.
tgt: Fifth anniversary of the passing of MadibaCabinet joins South Africans in commemorating the fifth anniversary of the passing of our first democratically elected President Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela, who passed on 5 December 2013.

src: President Ramaphosa het 2018 verklaar as die Jaar van Mandela se eeufeesherdenking.
tgt: President Ramaphosa declared 2018 as the Year marking Mandela’s centenary.

src: Die mees onlangse is die Global Citizens Mandela 100-fees wat die afgelope naweek gehou is.
tgt: His legacy has been celebrated throughout the year by South Africans in their various formations, the most recent being the Global Citizens Mandela 100 Festival held over the past weekend.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op almal om getrou te bly aan Madiba se ideale, insluitende sy onwrikbare toewyding aan geregtigheid, gelykheid en nie-rassigheid.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all to stay true to Madiba’s ideals, including his unwavering commitment to justice, equality and non-racialism.

src: Global Citizen Festival Mandela 100Die Kabinet bedank al die deelnemers aan die Global Citizen Festival Mandela 100 wat op Sondag, 2 Desember 2018 in Johannesburg gehou is.
tgt: Global Citizen Festival Mandela 100Cabinet thanks all participants of the Global Citizen Festival Mandela 100 held in Johannesburg on Sunday, 2 December 2018.

src: Die fees het deel gevorm van die nasionale gedenkgeleenthede om die eeufees van Tata Nelson Mandela te vier en is in meer as 180 lande uitgesaai.
tgt: The festival formed part of the national commemorative events to celebrate the centenary of Tata Nelson Mandela and was transmitted in over 180 countries.

src: Dit het duisende internasionale burgers, aktiviste, wêreldleiers, musikante en invloede bymekaar gebring om die Volhoubare Ontwikkelingsdoelstellings van die Verenigde Nasies (VN) te bevorder ter ere van Mandela se nagedagtenis.
tgt: It brought together thousands of global citizens, activists, world leaders, musicians and influencers to advance the Sustainable Development Goals of the United Nations (UN) in honour of Mandela’s memory.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy simpatie met almal wat slagoffers van kriminele elemente was terwyl hulle die stadion verlaat het.
tgt: Cabinet extends its sympathy to all those who were violated by criminal elements that preyed on them whilst leaving the stadium.

src: Dit veroordeel hierdie kriminele dade ten sterkste en doen 'n beroep op wetstoepassingsagentskappe om oortreders hiervoor te laat boet.
tgt: It strongly condemns these criminal acts and calls on law-enforcement agencies to bring offenders to book.

src: Wêreld Vigs-dag Suid-Afrika het Wêreldvigsdag op 1 Desember herdenk onder die tema: "Cheka Impilo.
tgt: World AIDS DaySouth Africa marked World AIDS Day on 1 December under the theme: “Cheka Impilo.

src: Know Your Status" Die Kabinet waardeer die regering se multidimensionele MIV- en vigs-program wat beslissende stappe geneem het om 'n einde te maak aan die epidemie.
tgt: Know Your Status.” Cabinet appreciates government’s multidimensional HIV and AIDS programme that has taken decisive steps to bring an end to the epidemic.

src: Die program het 'n bykomende inname van twee miljoen mense tot die antiretrovirale behandelingsprogram gevoeg.
tgt: The programme has realised an additional uptake of two million people to the antiretroviral treatment programme.

src: Suid-Afrika voorsien behandeling aan 4,2 miljoen mense, wat dit een van die wêreld se grootste behandelingsprogramme maak.
tgt: South Africa has more than 4,2 million people on treatment, making it one of the world’s biggest treatment programmes.

src: Die MIV- en Vigs-veldtog maak steeds vordering in die verandering van gedrag, mediese behandeling en sosiale de-stigmatisering.
tgt: The HIV and AIDS campaign continues to make inroads towards changing behaviour, medical treatment and social de-stigmatisation.

src: Die Kabinet is onwrikbaar in sy oproep aan Suid-Afrikaners om hulle te laat toets sodat hulle weet wat hul MIV-status is, en ingeligte besluite kan neem oor voorkomende maatreëls, behandeling, versorging en ondersteuning.
tgt: Cabinet is steadfast in its call on South Africans to get tested so they can know their HIV status, which will help them make informed decisions on preventative measures, treatment, care and support.

src: VN se Internasionale Dag vir mense met gestremdhedeSuid-Afrika het saam met die internasionale gemeenskap die VN se jaarlikse Internasionale Dag vir Persone met Gestremdhede op Maandag, 3 Desember gevier.
tgt: UN International Day of Persons with DisabilitiesSouth Africa joined the global community in observing the annual UN International Day of Persons with Disabilities on Monday, 3 December.

src: Die regering bly verbind tot die insluiting en beskerming van mense met gestremdhede deur toegewyde programme en intervensies om toegang tot gelyke geleenthede te verseker, soos vervat in die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996.
tgt: Government remains committed to the inclusion and protection of persons with disabilities through dedicated programmes and interventions to ensure access to equal opportunities, as enshrined in the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.Cabinet decisions.

src: Nkomazi Spesiale Ekonomiese Zone (SEZ) Die Kabinet bekragtig 'n besluit van die Minister van Handel en Nywerheid, dr Rob Davies, om die SEZ aan te wys en 'n SEZ-lisensie aan die Mpumalanga Provinsiale Regering se Departement van Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling en Toerisme uit te reik.
tgt: Nkomazi Special Economic Zone (SEZ)Cabinet ratified a decision of the Minister of Trade and Industry, Dr Rob Davies, to designate the SEZ and to grant a SEZ Licence to the Mpumalanga Provincial Government’s Department of Economic Development and Tourism.

src: Die Nkomazi SEZ sal as 'n ‘Agro-verwerkingspilpunt’ gevestig word deur groen energie te gebruik.
tgt: The Nkomazi SEZ will be positioned as an “Agro-Processing Hub” using green energy.

src: Dit sal ondersteun word deur gemengde dienste soos pakhuise en logistiek.
tgt: It will be supported by mixed services such as warehousing and logistics.

src: Dit vorm deel van die Maputo Ontwikkelingskorridorprojek, wat 'n belangrike handelskorridor is wat Gauteng, Limpopo en Mpumalanga met Maputo in Mosambiek verbind.
tgt: This forms part of is the Maputo Development Corridor project, which is a major trade corridor which connects Gauteng, Limpopo and Mpumalanga with Maputo in Mozambique.

src: Dit bestaan onder meer uit paaie, hawens en spoorweë.Dit sal bydra tot vinnniger groei, buitelandse en binnelandse direkte beleggings aantrek, die vervaardigingsektor uitbrei en werk in die streek skep.
tgt: It comprises, among other things, roads, ports and WEBTOKEN will contribute towards accelerating growth, attract foreign and domestic direct investment, expand the manufacturing sector and create employment in the region.

src: Die Kabinet keur die ondertekening van die verlengde Ekonomiese Vennootskapsooreenkoms (EVO) met die Verenigde Koninkryk (VK) goed tot die laaste uitstaande tegniese probleme opgelos word en die interne administratiewe kwessies gefinaliseer word.
tgt: Cabinet has approved the signing of the rollover Economic Partnership Agreement (EPA) with the United Kingdom (UK) once the last outstanding technical issues are resolved and the internal administrative issues are finalised.

src: Die Kabinet keur ook die voorlegging in die Parlement goed vir die bekragtiging van die ooreenkoms wat die EVO tussen die Suider-Afrikaanse Doeane-unie en Mosambiek en die Verenigde Koninkryk tot stand bring.
tgt: Cabinet also approved the submission in Parliament for ratification, the Agreement establishing the EPA between Southern African Customs Union and Mozambique and the UCabinet approved the publication of the streamlined White Paper on Home Affairs for public comment.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die vaartbelynde Witskrif oor Binnelandse Sake vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer word.
tgt: The White Paper argues that for South Africa to fully realise the potential of the Fourth Industrial Revolution, the DHA must play a critical enabling role in citizen empowerment, inclusive development, efficient government and national security.

src: Die Witskrif voer aan dat vir Suid-Afrika om die potensiaal van die Vierde Nywerheidsrevolusie ten volle uit te leef, moet die Departement van Binnelandse Sake 'n deurslaggewende rol speel in die bemagtiging van burgers, inklusiewe ontwikkeling, doeltreffende regering en nasionale veiligheid.
tgt: It is also based on the DHA having sole mandate for the management of official identity and status, international migration, and asylum seekers and refugees.

src: Die Witskrif stel maatreëls voor om bedrieglike banktransaksies te verminder en besparings te realiseer weens verhoogde ondoeltreffendheid.
tgt: The White Paper proposes measures to reduce the fraudulent bank transactions and realise savings due to increased inefficiencies.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wet op die Organisasie vir Wêreld Intellektuele Eiendom (WIPO) se Kopiéregverdrag (WKO) van 1996 aan die Parlement voorgelê word vir toetreding.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the World Intellectual Property Organisation (WIPO) Copyright Treaty (WCT) of 1996 to Parliament for accession.

src: Dit is 'n multilaterale ooreenkoms asook 'n spesiale ooreenkoms onder die Bernse Konvensie, wat die werk en regte van hul outeurs in die digitale omgewing beskerm.
tgt: This is a multilateral agreement and a special agreement under the Berne Convention that deals with the protection of the work and rights of their authors in the digital environment.

src: Toetrede tot die WKT bevoordeel ook die Suid-Afrikaanse skeppende bedryf, spesifiek skrywers van literêre en artistieke werke.
tgt: Acceding to the WCT also benefits the South African creative industry, specifically authors of literary and artistic works.

src: Die WKT is in Suid-Afrika se beste belang, aangesien dit verseker dat die land se kopieregwet tred hou met tegnologiese verandering.
tgt: The WCT is in the best interest of South Africa as it ensures that the country’s copyright law will keep pace with technological change.

src: Dit sal belangrike beskerming bied vir regtehouers teen kapery (“piracy”) op die gebied van rekenaarprogramme en databasisse.
tgt: This will afford important protection against piracy for rights holders in the areas of computer programmes and databases.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die WIPO-verdrag oor Optredes en Fonogramme van 1996, aan die Parlement voorgelê word vir toetrede.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the WIPO Performances and Phonograms Treaty of 1996, to Parliament for accession.

src: Dit is 'n multilaterale ooreenkoms wat die regte van kunstenaars en vervaardigers van fonogramme, spesifiek in die digitale omgewing reguleer.
tgt: This is a multilateral agreement which deals with the rights of performers and producers of phonograms, specifically in the digital environment.

src: Hierdie verdrag sal mense of organisasies beskerm wat aansienlike kreatiewe, tegniese of organisatoriese vaardighede byvoeg tydens die proses om werk na die publiek te bring en om inkomste te verhoog tot hulle voordeel.
tgt: This treaty will protect people or organisations that add substantial creative, technical or organisational skill in the process of bringing work to the public and enhance revenue to benefit them.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Beijing-verdrag aan die Parlement voorgelê word vir toetrede.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Beijing Treaty to Parliament for accession.

src: Dit is multilaterale ooreenkoms, wat kopiéreg vir oudiovisuele optredes reguleer en oudiovisuele kunstenaars se regte uitbrei.
tgt: This is a multilateral agreement, which regulates copyright for audio-visual performances and expands the audio-visual performers’ rights.

src: Dit erken oudiovisuele kunstenaars se intellektuele eiendomsreg in hul oudiovisuele werk, en skep ekonomiese voordeel vir hulle.
tgt: It recognises audio-visual performers’ intellectual property right in their audio-visual work and creates economic benefit for them.

src: Dit voorsien morele regte aan oudio-visuele kunstenaars ten opsigte van hul werk en erken oudio-visuele kunstenaars se regte in die digitale omgewing.
tgt: It also provides audio-visual performers with moral rights in respect of their work and recognises audio-visual performers’ rights in the digital environment.

src: Die Kabinet keur die totstandkoming van 'n interministeriële komitee (IMK) om die tweede generasie periodieke hersiening van die Afrika-portuuroorsigmeganisme (APRM) te lei.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the establishment of an Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC) to lead the African Peer Review Mechanism (APRM) second generation periodic review.

src: Dit sal ná die 2019 algemene verkiesings gedoen word.
tgt: It will be conducted after the 2019 General Elections.

src: Die IMK sal ondersteun word deur die goedgekeurde instelling van die APRM se Nasionale Bestuursraad.
tgt: The IMC will be supported by the approved establishment of the APRM National Governing Council.

src: Hierdie APRM-hersieningsproses bied lidlande 'n geleentheid vir nasionale dialoog oor bestuurs- en sosio-ekonomiese aanwysers en 'n geleentheid om konsensus vir die toekoms te bereik.
tgt: This APRM review process provides member states a space for national dialogue on governance and socio-economic indicators and an opportunity to build consensus on the way forward.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat Suid-Afrika die Konvensie onderteken om, onder die internasionale reg, 'n interregeringsorganisasie, wat die Square Kilometre Array (SKA) -Observatorium genoem word, te vestig.
tgt: Cabinet approved for South Africa to sign the Convention to establish, under international law, an intergovernmental organisation called the Square Kilometre Array (SKA) Observatory, which will be responsible for the construction and operational phases of the global SKA radio telescope project, to be located in South Africa and Australia.

src: Dit sal verantwoordelik wees vir die oprig- en operasionele fases van die wêreldwye SKA-radioteleskoopprojek in Suid-Afrika en Australië.Die ondertekening van die konvensie sal van kardinale belang wees om die wêreldwye vennootskap van die toepaslike bestuursmeganismes te voorsien, wat die suksesvolle lewering van die projek sal verseker.
tgt: The signing of the convention will be crucial in providing the global partnership with the appropriate governance mechanisms, which will ensure successful delivery of the project.

src: Suid-Afrika sal ook in staat wees om buitelandse beleggings te benut, sowel as vaardighede en voordele ten opsigte van infrastruktuurontwikkeling wat met die SKA-projek verband hou.
tgt: South Africa will also be able to leverage foreign inward investment, as well as skills and infrastructure development benefits associated with the SKA project.

src: Die Kabinet keur die implementering van die Eenstop-grenspos Nasionale Raamwerk goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the One-Stop Border Post (OSBP) National Framework for implementation.

src: Dit bied riglyne vir die vinnige vestiging van eenstop-grensposte tussen Suid-Afrika en sy buurlande.
tgt: This provides guidance towards the speedy establishment of OSBPs between South Africa and its neighboring countries.

src: Die Eeenstop-grenspos Nasionale Raamwerk sal die fasilitering van handel verbeter sonder om nasionale veiligheid of inkomste-insameling in gevaar te stel deur doeltreffende beweging van goedere, mense en dienste tussen Suid-Afrika en die aangrensende lande Botswana, Lesotho, Namibië, Mosambiek en Zimbabwe.
tgt: The OSBP will enhance trade facilitation without compromising national security or revenue collection through the efficient movement of goods, persons and services between South Africa and the adjoining states of Botswana, Lesotho, Namibia, Mozambique and Zimbabwe.

src: Dit sal ook vinniger klarings by grensposte in die streek tot gevolg hê en duplisering van grensagentskap-ingrypings beperk, wat op sy beurt handelsmededingendheid en die beweging van mense sal verebeter deur koste en tyd te verminder.
tgt: It will also result in the region realising a faster border clearance and limited duplication of border agency interventions, which in turn improves trade competitiveness and movement of person by cutting down on cost and time.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Nasionale Tesourie en Finansiële Intelligensiesentrum (FIC) Suid-Afrika se voorbereiding vir die nasionale risikobepaling en toekomstige wedersydse evalueringsproses wat teen die middel van April 2019 begin, sal koördineer.
tgt: Cabinet approved that the National Treasury and Financial Intelligence Centre (FIC) will coordinate South Africa’s preparation for the national risk assessment and upcoming mutual evaluation process which commences in mid-April 2019.

src: Die wedersydse evaluering is 'n eweknie-oorsigproses wat deur internasionale kundiges van ander lidlande van die interregeringsliggaam, die Finansiële Aksie-taakspan, gedoen word om die doeltreffendheid van anti-geldwassery (AGW) en die stelsels vir die bestryding van terrorismefinansiering (BTF) in Suid-Afrika te beordeel.
tgt: The mutual evaluation is a peer-review process conducted by international experts from other member countries of the intergovernmental body, the Financial Action Task Force, to assess the effectiveness of the anti-money laundering (AML) and combating of terrorist financing (CFT) system in South Africa.

src: Die uitkomste van die proses sal help om die integriteit van die Suid-Afrikaanse finansiële stelsel te versterk deur stappe te identifiseer wat aangewend moet word om enige swak punte in ons AGW/BTF-stelsel te hanteeer.
tgt: The outcomes of the process will assist in strengthening the integrity of the South African financial system by identifying steps to be taken to address any weaknesses in our AML/CFT system.

src: Die Kabinet keur die aanbevelings aan die Departement van Basiese Onderwys (DBO), deur die Departement van Beplanning, Monitering en Evaluering (DPME) goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the recommendations presented to the Department of Basic Education by the Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation.

src: Die aanbevelings spruit voort uit die Impakevaluering van die Vroeëgraadleesstudie na twee jaar van tussenkomste.
tgt: The recommendations flow from the Impact evaluation of the Early Grade Reading Study after two years of interventions.

src: Die DBO het die vroeëgraadleesstudie in samewerking met verskeie universiteite begin.
tgt: The DBE initiated the Early Grade Reading Study in collaboration with various universities.

src: Dit is 'n grootskaalse opvoedkundige impakevaluering wat daarop gemik is om bewyse te versamel oor watter stappe geneem kan word om die onderrig en leer van vroeëgraadse leeswerk in Afrikatale in die land te verbeter.
tgt: This is a large-scale educational impact evaluation which aims to build evidence about what works to improve the teaching and learning of early grade reading in African languages in the country.

src: Die verslag sal op die DPME se webwerf geplaas word.
tgt: The Report will be posted on the DPME website.

src: Die Kabinet keur die Beleidsraamwerk vir Nasionale Museums goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Policy Framework on National Museums.

src: Die doel is om die bestuur en bedrywighede van museums te verander bereffende toegang, regstelling, billikheid, nasiebou en sosiale samehorigheid.
tgt: The aim is to transform the management and operations of museums in terms of access, redress, equity, nation-building and social cohesion.

src: Die beleid stel voor dat museums saamgevoeg word in nuwe bestuurstrukture om skaalvoordele te bereik deur die aantal rade te verminder.
tgt: The policy proposes the clustering of museums into new management structures to achieve economies of scale by reducing the number of WEBTOKEN also provides for the grading of all the museums according to qualities, scope and significance to enable equitable funding allocations.

src: Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring aan die Nasionale Gids vir die Aanstelling van Persone tot Direksies en Hoof Uitvoerende Beamptes (HUB's) van instellings in staatsbesit en instellings onder staatsbeheer.
tgt: Cabinet approved the National Guide for the Appointment of Persons to Boards and Chief Executive Officers (CEOs) of State-owned and State-controlled Institutions.

src: Die gids bied nasionale beginsels en riglyne om goeie praktyk en eenvormigheid in die aanstelling van personeel te bevorder.
tgt: The guide provides national principles and good-practice guidelines to promote uniformity in the appointment of persons.

src: Dit is in reaksie op die Presidensiële Oorsigkomitee oor Entiteite in Staatsbesit om deursigtigheid, aanspreeklikheid en goeie bestuurspraktyke in alle staatsinstellings te bevorder.
tgt: It responds to the Presidential Review Committee on State-owned Entities to promote transparency, accountability and good governance practices in all organs of state.

src: Die Kabinet keur die 6de vorderingsverslag deur die Interministeriële Taakspan oor Noordwes goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the 6th progress report by the Inter-Ministerial Task Team on North West.

src: Die Kabinet is tevrede dat daar sigbare vordering gemaak is om die provinsiale departemente in Noordwes te stabiliseer en die voorsiening van basiese dienste te prioritiseer.
tgt: Cabinet is pleased that visible progress has been made in stabilising the provincial departments in North West and the provision of basic services has been prioritised.

src: Die ingryping het meer as 90% van die opgeloopte bedrae aan verskaffers uit die weg geruim, wat die verbeterde verkaffing van medisyne en toerusting moontlik maak.
tgt: The intervention has cleared over 90% of the accruals to suppliers enabling the improved supply of medicine and equipment.

src: Vier van die vyf operasionele teaters by Mafikeng-hospitaal is herstel en funksioneel.
tgt: Four of the five operating theatres at Mafikeng hospital have been returned to functionality.

src: 'n Aantal van die befondsde vakante poste in die onderskeie departemente is gevul.
tgt: A number of the funded vacant posts in the respective departments have been filled.

src: 'n Proses om die agterstallige onderhoud van infrastruktuur aan te pak is in plek gestel en die wetstoepassingsagentskappe maak vordering om diegene wat by korrupsie betrokke was, tot verantwoording te bring.
tgt: A process to address the backlog infrastructure maintenance has been put in place and the law enforcement agencies continue to make progress in bringing those who were involved in corruption to account.

src: In samewerking met die Noordwes-leierskap, vorder die aangestelde administrateurs met die instelling van goeie bestuursprosesse.
tgt: Working with the North West leadership the appointed Administrators continue to make progress in setting in place good governance processes.

src: Die Nasionale Raad van Provinsies het Noordwes in Oktober besoek en het hul verslag ter ondersteuning van die regering se tussenkoms in die provinsie ingedien.
tgt: The NCOP visited the North West in October and have tabled their report endorsing the National government intervention in the Province.

src: Die Kabinet keur die aanbied van die volgende gebeure goed:Die Derde Jaarlikse Vergaderings van die Nuwe Ontwikkelingsbank (NDB) gedurende die eerste kwartaal van 2019.
tgt: Cabinet approved the hosting of the following events:The Fourth Annual Meetings of the New Development Bank (NDB), during the first quarter of 2019.

src: Die NDB is gestig deur die Brasilië-, Rusland-, Indië-, China- en Suid-Afrika- (BRICS) blok om hulpbronne te mobiliseer om infrastruktuur en volhoubare ontwikkelingsprojekte in die BRICS-lande, en ander ontluikende markte en ontwikkelende lande, te ondersteun.
tgt: The NDB was established by the Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa (BRICS) bloc to mobilise resources to support infrastructure and sustainable development projects in BRICS countries, and other emerging markets and developing countries.

src: Die 17de Gewone Sessie van die Afrika-Ministeriële Konferensie oor die Omgewing (AMCEN) in Junie/Julie 2019.
tgt: The 17th Ordinary Session of the African Ministerial Conference on the Environment (AMCEN) in June/July 2019.

src: AMCEN is 'n permanente forum waar Afrika se ministers van omgewingsake doelbewus besluite neem oor omgewingskwessies wat betrekking het op die vasteland.
tgt: AMCEN is a permanent forum where African Ministers of the Environment deliberate and decide on environmental issues of relevance to the Continent.

src: Suid-Afrika sal vanaf 2019 tot 2021 as voorsitter dien.
tgt: South Africa assumes its chairship from 2019 to 2021.Bills.

src: Die Kabinet keur die publikasie van die Hersiene Wet op Onteiening vir openbare kommentaar goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved publication of the Revised Expropriation Bill for public comment.

src: Die hersiene wetsontwerp voeg 'n deel by wat uitdruklike omstandighede bepaal waaronder grond onteiening in die openbare belang sonder vergoeding mag wees.
tgt: The revised bill adds a section that provides explicit circumstances under which land expropriation in the public interest may be without compensation.

src: Die afdeling versterk die vroeëre Wetssontwerp op Onteiening, wat uit die parlementsproses onttrek is.
tgt: The section strengthen the earlier Expropriation Bill that was withdrawn from the parliament process.

src: Die wetsontwerp sal help om die grondhervormingsprogram te versnel, terwyl dit binne die raamwerk van die grondwetlike beginsels plaasvind.
tgt: The Bill will assist in accelerating the land reform programme whilst within the framework of the constitutional principles.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wet op die Bestuur van Finansiële Instellings van 2018 vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer word.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the publication of the Conduct of Financial Institutions Bill of 2018 for public comment.

src: Dit vorm deel van die regering se hervorming van die finansiële sektor se regulering na 'n “Twin Peaks”-model en volg op die verordening van die Wet op die Finansiële Sektor, 2017 (Wet 9 van 2017) wat onder meer daarop gemik is om beter markbeheer en die hantering van kliënte in die finansiële sektor te verseker.
tgt: This forms part of government’s reform of the financial sector regulation towards a Twin Peaks model and follows the enactment of the Financial Sector Regulation Act, 2017 (Act 9 of 2017) which, amongst others, aims to ensure better market conduct and the treatment of customers in the financial sector.

src: Die regulering van markbeheer poog om te voorkom en te bestuur wanneer voorkoming nie suksesvol is nie, asook die swak uitkomste as gevolg van finansiële instellings wat hul besigheid doen op maniere wat onbillik teenoor kliënte is, of die integriteit van finansiële markte en vertroue in die finansiële stelsel ondermyn.
tgt: Market conduct regulation aims to prevent and manage when prevention is not successful, the poor outcomes that arise from financial institutions conducting their business in ways that are unfair to customers or undermines the integrity of financial markets and confidence in the financial system.

src: Die wetsontwerp sal die beskerming van klante versterk deur 'n enkele omvattende markbeheerwet op te stel.
tgt: The Bill will strengthen customer protection by putting in place a single comprehensive market conduct law.

src: Dit sal lei tot die konsekwente toepassing van kliëntebeskermingsbeginsels regoor die finansiële sektor.
tgt: This will result in the consistent application of customer-protection principles across the financial sector.

src: Dit maak voorsiening vir 'n enkele aktiwiteitsgebaseerde benadering om alle finansiële instellings te lisensieer en om volle regulatoriese dekking en toesig te verseker.
tgt: It provides for a single, activity-based approach to licensing all financial institutions, and ensuring full regulatory coverage and supervision.

src: Dit sal die nuutgestigte Finansiële Sektor Beheerowerheid in staat stel om beter aan sy mandaat te voldoen om finansiële kliënte te beskerm deur regverdige behandeling te verseker.
tgt: This will allow the newly established Financial Sector Conduct Authority to better meet its mandate of protecting financial customers by ensuring fair treatment.

src: Die Wetsontwerp, wat op alle finansiële instellings van toepassing sal wees, ondersteun ook die transformasie van die finansiële sektor deur die implementering van die Finansiële Sektor Kode wat uitgereik is ingevolge die Wet op Breedgebaseerde Swart Ekonomiese Bemagtiging, 2003 (Wet 53 van 2003) deur te vereis dat beleid bekendgestel word wat aan die kode voldoen en ook toesig hou oor die implementering van daardie beleid.
tgt: The Bill, which will apply to all financial institutions, also supports transformation of the financial sector through implementation of the Financial Sector Code issued under the Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Act, 2003 (Act 53 of 2003) by requiring that policies be introduced to comply with the code and also supervising implementation of those policies.

src: Die Kabinet keur die bekendstelling van die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Finansiële Aangeleenthede van 2018 in die Parlement goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved for the introduction of the Financial Matters Amendment Bill of 2018 in Parliament.

src: Die wysigings het betrekking op die:a) Insolvensiewet van 1963, om die regulering van die oor-die-toonbank-afgeleide mark te versterk, in ooreenstemming met G20-verpligtingeb) Wet op Militêre Pensioene van 1976 om diskriminerende bepalings te uit die weg te ruimc) Bankwet van 1990, om kwalifiserende maatskappye in staatsbesit toe te laat om aansoek te doen vir banklisensiesd) Die Wet op Regeringspensioene van 1996 om die skoonbreekbeginsel in die geval van egskeiding te verander, om te verseker dat lede se pensioenuitbetalings aan voormalige eggenote na egskeiding nie omgeskakel word na 'n skuldverpligting nie ene) Die Wet op Ouditberoepe van 2005, om uitdagings en beperkings te wysig waarmee die Onafhanklike Regulerende Raad vir Ouditeurs te doen kry in die uitvoering van sy regulatoriese en toesighoudende verantwoordelikhede.
tgt: The amendments relate to the:a) Insolvency Act of 1963, to strengthen the regulation of over-the-counter derivative market, in line with G20 commitmentsb) Military Pensions Act of 1976, to address discriminatory provisionsc) Banks Act of 1990, to allow for qualifying state-owned companies to apply for banking licencesd) Government Employment Pension Law of 1996, to change the clean break principle in the case of divorce, ensuring that members’ pension pay outs to former spouses on divorce are not converted to a debt obligation ande) Auditing Profssion Act of 2005, to address challenges and limitations that the Independent Regulatory Board for Auditors faces in discharging its regulatory and oversight responsibilities.

src: Toekomstige Gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Aankondiging oor Nasionale Minimum Lone (NML)President Ramaphosa sal die NML tydens 'n geleentheid wat op Vrydag, 7 Desember 2018 te Kliptown in Soweto gehou word, bekend maak.
tgt: National Minimum Wage (NMW) announcementPresident Ramaphosa will announce the NMW at an event to be held at Kliptown in Soweto on Friday, 7 December 2018.

src: Die NML sal dadelik tot voordeel van meer as ses miljoen werkers strek en help om die vlak van ongelykheid en armoede in Suid-Afrika die hoof te bied.
tgt: The NMW will immediately benefit more than six million workers and help address the level of inequality and poverty in South Africa.

src: Hierdie mylpaalaankondiging sal ons maatskaplike hulp na die kwesbaarste mense uitbrei.
tgt: This landmark proclamation will extend our social net to the most vulnerable people.

src: Internasionale Anti-korrupsiedagTer herdenking van die VN se Internasionale Anti-korrupsiedag op Sondag,9 Desember 2018, bevestig die Kabinet die land se stryd teen korrupsie in die private, sowel as die openbare sektor.
tgt: International Anti-Corruption DayIn commemoration of the UN’s International Anti-Corruption Day on Sunday, 9 December 2018, Cabinet reaffirms the country’s fight against corruption in both the private and public sectors.

src: Die groepering vir Justisie, Misdaadvoorkoming en Sekuriteit prioritiseer die stryd teen hierdie plaag in lyn met die regering se zero-verdraagsaamheid teenoor korrupsie.
tgt: The JCPS Cluster has prioritised the fight against this scourge in line with government’s zero-tolerance stance towards corruption.

src: Korrupsie is 'n samelewingsprobleem wat deur almal beveg moet word, aangesien dit sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling belemmer en armoede vererger deur hulpbronne weg te neem van waar hulle die nodigste is.
tgt: Corruption is a societal problem that must be fought by everyone as it hinders socio-economic development and increases poverty by diverting resources away from where they are most needed.

src: Internasionale MeseregtedagSuid-Afrika vier Internasionale Meseregtedag saam met die internasionale gemeenskap op Maandag, 10 Desember 2018.
tgt: International Human Rights DaySouth Africa will join the international community in observing International Human Rights Day on Monday, 10 December 2018.

src: Die dag is die herdenking van die VN se Algemene Vergadering se aanvaarding van die Universele Verklaring van Meseregte in 1948.
tgt: The day marks the anniversary of the UN General Assembly's adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights in 1948.

src: Die regering maak steeds seker dat elke Suid-Afrikaner alle menseregte soos die reg op lewe, gelykheid en menswaardigheid, geniet.
tgt: Government continues to ensure that all South Africans enjoy all human rights such as the rights to life, equality and human dignity.

src: Elke burger het 'n verantwoordelikheid om te verseker dat menseregte en waardigheid in ons land beskerm word.
tgt: Every citizen has a responsibility to ensure that human rights and dignity in our nation is protected.

src: Wêreldkommissie oor die Toekoms van WerkDie verslag van die Wêreldkommissie oor die Toekoms van Werk word op 22 Januarie 2019 bekendgestel.
tgt: Global Commission on the Future of WorkThe report from the Global Commission on the Future of Work will be launched on 22 January 2019.

src: Dit is in 2017 deur die International Labour Organization (ILO) ingestel om die spoedige transformasie van die wêreld-ekonomie en die werksomgewing te evalueer en die belangrikste uitdagings en aanbevelings te identifiseer.
tgt: It was established by the ILO in 2017 to assess the rapid transformation taking place in the global economy and world of work, and identify the key challenges and recommendations.

src: President Cyril Ramaphosa is die mede-voorsitter van hierdie hoëvlak globale kommissie, saam met Premier Stefan Löfven van die Koninkryk van Swede.
tgt: This High-Level Global Commission is co-chaired by President Ramaphosa together with Prime Minister Stefan Löfven of the Kingdom of Sweden.

tgt: Messages.

src: MegevoelDie Kabinet betuig saam met President Ramaphosa sy hartseer oor die heengaan van die vryheidsvegter en voormalige hoë kommissaris by die Verenigde Koninkryk, mnrMedi Msimang, op Maandag 3 Desember 2018, na 'n lang siekbed.
tgt: CondolencesCabinet joins President Ramaphosa in expressing sadness at the passing of Struggle stalwart and former High Commissioner to the United Kingdom, Mr Mendi Msimang, on Monday, 3 December 2018, following a long illness.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel met mnr Msimang se familie, vriende, kamerade en medewerkers.
tgt: Cabinet extends condolences to the family, friends, comrades and associates of Mr Msimang.

src: Msimang het 'n spesiale amptelike begrafnis kategorie 1 ontvang wat elemente van militêre seremoniële eer in ooreenstemming met die beleid oor staats- en provinsiale amptelike begrafnisse behels.
tgt: Mr Msimang has been accorded a Special Official Funeral category 1 which entails elements of military ceremonial honour in line with the policy on State and Provincial official funerals.

src: Gelukwense.1 Die Kabinet wens Banyana geluk dat hulle tot die eindstryd van die 2018 Afrika-Vrouebeker deurgedring het.
tgt: Congratulations.1 Cabinet congratulates Banyana on reaching the final of the 2018 Africa Women’s Cup of Nations.

src: Deur dit te doen, het hulle outomaties gekwalifiseer vir volgende jaar se FIFA Vroue-wêreldbeker in Frankryk.2 Die Kabinet prys dr Lindiwe Sidali, wat geskiedenis gemaak het deur die eerste Afrika-vroulike kardiotorakale chirurg in die land te word.
tgt: By doing so they have automatically qualified for next year’s FIFA Women’s World Cup in France.2 Cabinet commends Dr Lindiwe Sidali, who made history by becoming the first African female cardiothoracic surgeon in the country.

src: Die Kabinet het op Woensdag 13 Februarie 2019 by Tuynhuys in Kaapstad vergader.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 13 February 2019 at Tuynhuys in Cape Town.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom President Cyril Ramaphosa se 2019-staatsrede, wat 25 jaar sedert die eerste gesamentlike sittig van die Parlement in die nuwe demokratiese Suid-Afrika plaasgevind het.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes President Cyril Ramaphosa’s 2019 SoNA, which marks 25 years since the first Joint Sitting of Parliament in the new democratic South Africa.

src: Die meerderheid Suid-Afrikaners het die toespraak, wat hoop en vernuwing bied, verwelkom.
tgt: A majority of South Africans also welcomed the address, which continues to provide hope and renewal.

src: President Ramaphosa het besin oor die vordering wat gedurende die afgelope jaar gemaak is.
tgt: President Ramaphosa reflected on the progress made in the past year.

src: Die President het voortgebou op die suksesse deur vanjaar se fokusareas in breë trekke te beskryf.
tgt: Building on these successes, the President outlined this year’s focus areas.
