src: Dit het onder meer ingesluit die voortsetting van ingrypingsmaatreëls om inklusiewe ekonomiese groei en werkskepping te versnel die verbetering van ons onderwysstelsel, vaardigheidsontwikkeling vir die toekoms en die verskerping van die stryd teen korrupsie en staatskaping.
tgt: These included the continuation of intervention measures to accelerate inclusive economic growth and create jobs improve our education system and develop the skills for the future and step up the fight against corruption and state capture.

src: Binne die volgende week sal die Minister van Finansies, Tito Mboweni, die finansiële plan tydens sy Begrotingsrede uiteensit.
tgt: In the next week, Finance Minister Tito Mboweni will unpack the financial plan when he delivers his Budget Speech.

src: Die ministers sal deur hul departementele begrotingsposte, hul operasionele planne uiteensit, wat uitvoering aan die President se Staatsrede sal gee.
tgt: Through the departmental budget votes, Ministers will unpack their operational plans that will give effect to the President’s SoNCabinet remains committed to steering our country towards the realization of Vision 2030 of the National Development Plan (NDP), the blueprint for eliminating poverty and reducing inequality and unemployment in the country by African Mining Indaba.

src: Die Kabinet bly daartoe verbind om die vervulling van Visie 2030 van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingplan (NOP), die bloudruk vir die uitroei van armoede en die vermindering van ongelykheid en werkloosheid in die land, teen 2030 te verwesenlik.
tgt: South Africa successfully hosted the 25th annual Investing in Africa Mining Indaba, which is the world’s largest gathering of mining stakeholders and decision-makers.

src: Die Minster van Openbare Ondernemings, Pravin Gordan, het die Kabinet ingelig oor die onlangse beurtkrag wat landwyd ’n uitwerking op die land se ekonomie gehad het.
tgt: To address the recent situation, President Ramaphosa has appointed a Special Cabinet Committee on Eskom led by the Deputy President and comprising the Ministers of Public Enterprises Energy Finance Transport Intelligence and Police.

src: Total se olie- en gasontdekking As deel van die nasionale poging om die ekonomie te laat groei en werk te skep, het die regering – deur Operasie Phakisa vir die Oseane-ekonomie – geleenthede geskep in die land se olie- en gassektor vir groei en belegging.
tgt: Cabinet has lauded the offshore discovery of gas condensate by oil company Total that could contain one billion barrels of resources, which will significantly boost the country's oil and gas supplies.

src: Suid-Afrika het potensiële hulpmiddels ter waarde van nege miljard vate olie en 60 tkv (triljoen kubieke voet) of 11 miljard vate olie gelykstaande aan aflandige gas.
tgt: The discovery was made by the company after drilling at its Brulpadda prospects in the Outeniqua basin, about 175 kilometres (km) off the coast of South Africa.

src: 32ste Gewone Sitting van die Afrika-unie (AU).
tgt: 32nd Ordinary Session of the African Union (AU).

src: Die Kabinet wens President Ramaphosa geluk met sy verkiesing as Voorsitter van die AU vir 2020.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates the appointment of President Ramaphosa as Chair of the AU for 2020.

src: Hy sal by President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi van Egipte, wat tans sy termyn vir 2019 uitdien, oorneem.
tgt: He will take over from Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi, who is currently serving his term for 2019.

src: President Ramaphosa het ’n Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging na die 32ste Gewone Sitting van die Byeenkoms van AU-staatshoofde en -regerings gelei, wat van 15 Januarie tot 11 Februarie 2019 in Addis Ababa in die Federale Demokratiese Republiek van Ethiopië plaasgevind het onder die tema “Vlugtelinge, Teruggekeerde en Interne Ontwortelde Mese: Op weg na Volhoubare Oplossings vir Gedwonge Ontworteling in Afrika.” Dit het ’n platform geskep om te besin oor en aandag te gee aan die kernoorsake van gedwonge ontworteling in Afrika.
tgt: President Ramaphosa led a South African delegation to the 32nd Ordinary Session of the Assembly of the Heads of State and Government of the AU, held in Addis Ababa, Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia from 15 January to 11 February 2019, under the theme “Refugees, Returnees and Internally Displaced Persons: Towards Durable Solutions to Forced Displacement in Africa”.

src: Suid-Afrika het sy bekragtigingstuk van die Ooreenkoms oor die Afrika Kontinentale Vryhandelsgebied (AfCFTA) tydens die beraad voorgelê.
tgt: This provided a platform to reflect on and address the root causes of forced displacement in Africa.

src: Kwessies waaroor gesprek gevoer is, sluit in die institusionele hervorming en finansiering van die kontinentale liggaam vrede en sekuriteit op die vasteland ontwikkelinge rakende AfCFTA en onderhandelinge vir ’n nuwe samewerkingsooreenkoms tussen Afrika, die ontwikkelende lande van die Karibiese en Stille Oseaan en die Europese Unie post-2020.
tgt: Issues deliberated on included the institutional reform and financing of the continental body Peace and Security on the Continent developments related to the AfCFTA and negotiations for a new cooperation agreement between the African, Caribbean and Pacific developing countries and the European Union Post-2020.

src: Gedurende die loop van vanjaar sal President Ramaphosa ook na verwagting as voorsitter van die vergadering van die Komitee van Afrika-staatshoofde en-regerings oor Klimaatsverandering (CAHOSCC) optree.
tgt: During the course of this year, President Ramaphosa is also expected to take chairship of the meeting of the Committee of African Heads of State and Government on Climate Change (CAHOSCC).

src: CAHOSCC is in 2009 by die AU se vergadering van Staatshoofde en Regerings gestig om Afrika se gesaamentlike posisie oor klimaatsverandering, sowel as globale samesprekings oor klimaatsverandering, te lei Wanneer President Ramaphosa die voorsitterskap aanvaar, sal hy met ander staatshoofde saamwerk om die suksesvolle implementering van die mylpaal Parys-ooreenkoms, wat daarop gerig is om die uitwerking van klimaatsverandering te verlig en daarby aan te pas, te steun.
tgt: CAHOSCC was established in 2009 by the AU Assembly of Heads of State and Government to lead the African Common Position on Climate Change and in global climate change negotiations.

src: Deur CAHOSCC, sal Afrika ’n beduidende bydrae kan lewer tot die globale poging vir lae-koolstof en klimaatsveerkagtige ontwikkeling.
tgt: When President Ramaphosa assumes chairship, he will work with other heads of state to ensure successful implementation of the landmark Paris Agreement to mitigate and adapt to the effects of climate change.

src: Hoër Onderwys Die Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel aan die naastebestaandes en vriende van Mlungisi Madonslea,’n student aan die Durbanse Universiteit van Tegnologie.
tgt: Higher education Cabinet extends condolences to the family and friends of the Durban University of Technology student, Mlungisi Madonsela.

src: Die ontwrigting van studies en die sluit van instansis van hoër onderrig, veral in KwaZulu-Natal, wat tot die tragiese dood van hierdie student gelei het, is ’n ernstige bron van kommer.
tgt: The disruption of learning and closures of institutions of higher learning, especially in KwaZulu-Natal, which tragically led to the death of this student, are a cause for much concern.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle rolspelers om geskille op ’n vreedsame manier op te los.
tgt: .Cabinet calls on all role-players to resolve issues in a peaceful manner.

src: Ons land het opgevoede mense nodig om ’n bydrae tot ons ontwikkeling te lewer.
tgt: Our country needs educated young speople to contribute to our development.

src: Die regering, deur die Departement van Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding, ondersteun instansies van hoër onderwys waar daar uitdagings is.
tgt: Government, through the Department of Higher Education and Training, is assisting institutions of higher learning where there are challenges.

src: Die Minister van Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding, Naledi Pandor, het ook die administrateurs van die Nasionale Finansiële Hulpskema vir Studente opdrag gegee om die hantering van alle studente se navrae te prioritiseer.
tgt: Higher Education and Training Minister Naledi Pandor has also directed National Student Financial Aid Scheme administrators to prioritise providing responses to all student queries.

src: Inperking van bek-en-klouseer Die Kabinet is tevrede met die optrede en tussenkomste wat die verspreiding van bek-en-klouseer in the Vhembe-distrik van Limpopo voorkom ter wille van die volk se gesondheid.
tgt: In safeguarding the health of the nation, Cabinet is pleased with the response and interventions to avoid spillage of the FMD outbreak in the Vhembe District, Limpopo.

src: Die Departement van Landbou, Bosbou en Visserye, in samewerking met die Rooivleisbedryf, sowel as ander belanghebbendes, werk daaraan om die uitdaging op ’n geïntegreerde manier die hoof te bied.
tgt: The Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, along with the Red Meat Association and other stakeholders, are working to address the issue in an integrated manner.

src: Inenting het op 14 Januarie 2019 met beeste in geaffekteerde nedersettings begin, sowel as beeste in ’n radius van 20-kilometer rondom die geaffekteerde nedersettings.
tgt: Vaccination started on 14 January 2019, with cattle in affected villages, as well as cattle in the 20 km radius around affected villages.

src: Tot op hede is meer as 10 000 beeste ingeënt hulle word gemerk om hulle van die ander te onderskei.
tgt: To date, the total number of cattle vaccinated is over 10 000 they are being marked to distinguish them from others.

src: Suid-Afrikaanse Filmberaad.
tgt: South African Film Summit.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse filmbedryf word lank reeds erken as ’n katalisator vir ekonomiese groei en werkskepping in die land.
tgt: The South African film industry has long been recognised as a catalyst for economic growth and job creation in South Africa.

src: Die kreatiewe en kulturele bedryf, veral die filmsektor, speel ook ’n kernrol in die ontwikkeling van die Suid-Afrikaanse storie en lewer ’n bydrae tot pogings vir nasiebou en maatkskaplike samehorigheid.
tgt: The creative and cultural industry, particularly the film sector, also plays a key role in developing the South African story and contributing to the efforts of nation-building and social cohesion.

src: Me die oog op hierdie benadering, verwelkom die Kabinet die eerste Suid-Afrikaanse Filmberaad, wat op 4 en 5 Februarie 2019 in Johannesburg plaasgevind het onder die tema “Transformasie en Innovasie in die Suid-Afrikaanse Film/Oudio-visuele Bedryf en die Vierdie Nywerheidsrewolusie (4IR): Is ons gereed vir verandering?”.
tgt: In line with this approach, Cabinet welcomes the first South African Film Summit, held in Johannesburg from 4 to 5 February 2019 under the theme: “Transformation and innovation in the South African Film/Audio-Visual Industry and the Fourth Industrial Revolution (4IR).

src: Die uitkomste van die beraad sal na verwagting ’n bydrae lewer tot die skep van ’n bemagtigingsomgewing wat die bedryf sal laat floreer.
tgt: The summit’s outcomes are expected to contribute towards creating an enabling environment for the industry to thrive.

src: Die regering bly daartoe verbind op projekte te befonds deur die Nywerheid-Ontwikkelingskorporasie en die dti.
tgt: Government remains committed to funding projects through the Industrial Development Corporation and the dti.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet decisions Social cohesion and nation-building.

src: Hoewel die nasie sedert 1994 beduidende vordering gemaak het, ondermyn die kunsmatige versperrings wat op ras, klas en kulturele verskille gegrond is, steeds ons vooruitgang.
tgt: While our nation has made massive strides since 1994, the artificial barriers based on race, class and cultural differences continue to undermine our advances.

src: In dié verband het die Kabinet die Politieke Perspektief goedgekeur, wat ’n wetgewende en beleidsraamwerk bied om groter maatskaplike samehorigheid en nasiebou vir die toekoms bevorder.
tgt: In this regard, Cabinet approved the Political Perspective, which provides a legislative and policy framework to support greater social cohesion and nation-building going forward.

src: Die raamwerk sal vêrreikende gevolge op die implementering van die doelwitte om 'n verenigde volk en 'n meer samehorige samelewing te bou hê.
tgt: The framework will have a far-reaching effect on implementing the objectives of constructing “a united people and a more cohesive society are not only national objectives they are also the means to eradicating poverty,” as set out in the NDAll sectors of society are encouraged to support the policy framework by celebrating our differences and building a society that reverses the legacy of colonialism and apartheid.

src: Die Departement van Kuns en Kultuur sal die Maatskaplike Kompakkonvensie aan die einde van Maart 2019 in Johannesburg byeenroep, waar verskeie sektore van die samelewing – insluitend burgers, arbeid, die sakesektor, akademia en intelligentsia, die godsdienstige broederskap en die media – hulle sal verbind tot die projek van sosiale samehorigheid en nasiebou.
tgt: The Department of Arts and Culture will be convening the Social Compact Convention at the end of March 2019 in Johannnesburg where various sectors of society – including civil, labour, business, academia and intelligentsia, religious fraternity and media – will commit to the project of social cohesion and nation-building.

src: Samesprekings met die verkillende sektore sal gedurende Februarie tot middel Maart 2019 plaasvind.
tgt: Consultations with sectors will be done during February and mid-March 2019.Bills Children’s Amendment Bill of 2019.

src: Die Kabinet keur die voorlegging van die Kinderwysigingswetsontwerp van 2019 aan die Parlement goed om ons nasie se werk rakende die beskerming van kinderregte te versterk.
tgt: Cabinet has approved the submission of the Children’s Amendment Bill of 2019 to Parliament to strengthen our nation’s work in protecting the rights of children.

src: In 2017 het die Sentrum vir Kinderreg ’n saak teen die Departement van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling aanhangig gemaak oor die versorgingsagterstande.
tgt: In 2017 the Centre for Child Law litigated the Department of Social Development on foster-care backlogs.

src: Die Hooggeregshof het die Minister van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling beveel om onder meer die nodige wysiging aan die Kinderwet, 2005 (Wet 38 van 2005) en/of die Wet op Maatskaplike Bystand, 2004 (Wet 13 van 2004) voor te berei en aan die Parlement voor te lê om omvattende regsoplossing vir pleegsorguitdagings te vind.
tgt: The High Court directed the Minister of Social Development to, amongst others, prepare and introduce before Parliament the necessary amendment to the Children’s Act, 2005 (Act 38 of 2005) and/or the Social Assistance Act, 2004 (Act 13 of 2004) to provide comprehensive legal solution to address foster-care challenges.

src: Alle kinders moet toegang tot dienste hê wat daarop gerig is om hul veiligheid, versorging en beskerming te fasiliteer sowel as 'n doeltreffende maatskaplike welsynstelsel.
tgt: All children should enjoy access to services that are aimed at facilitating their safety, care and protection and an effective social welfare system.

src: Daar is veelvuldige tekortkominge in die huidige kindersorg- en beskermingstelsel.
tgt: There are multiple inadequacies in the current child care and protection system.

src: Die wetsontwerp gee onder meer aandag aan die uitdagings wat verband hou met die voorsiening en administrasie van pleegsorg en ander verwante kindersorg- en beskermingskwessies.
tgt: The Bill addresses, amongst others, the challenges relating to the provision and administration of foster care, and other related child care and protection matters.

src: Digitale Ekonomie-beraad.
tgt: Upcoming events Digital Economy Summit.

src: Die globale skuif na tegnologie wat deur die 4IR geïnspireer word, bring nuwe geleenthede om ons samelewing en ekonomie te bou.
tgt: The global move towards technology inspired by the 4IR brings with it new opportunities to build our society and economy.

src: Om aan die voorpunt van nuwe tegnologiese tendense te bly, bied Suid-Afrika in Maart 2019 die Digitale Ekonomie-beraad aan.
tgt: To remain at the forefront of new technological trends, the country will host the Digital Economy Summit in March 2019.

src: Die beraad word belê onder die vaandel van die 4IR Suid-Afrika (4IRSA), 'n vennootskap tussen die Departement van Telekommunikasie en Posdienste, Telkom, die Universiteit van die Witwatersrand, die Universiteit van Johannesburg en die Universiteit van Fort Hare.
tgt: The summit is convened under the banner of the 4IR South Africa (4IRSA), a partnership between the Department of Telecommunications and Postal Services, Telkom, University of the Witwatersrand, University of Johannesburg and University of Fort Hare.

src: Die #4IRSA poog om aandag te gee aan die uitdagings wat Suid-Afrika in die digitale era ervaar, ten einde 'n samehangende en kollektiewe plan van aksie vir die land te vind.
tgt: The #4IRSA aims to address the challenges facing South Africa in the Digital Age so as to find a coherent and collective response for the country.

src: Die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap (SAOG) se 2019 MeiatoekenningsAs deel van pogings om streeksintegrasie, samewerking en die erkenning van voortreflike joernalistiek te bevorder, word Suid-Afrika se media genooi om hul inskrywings vir die 2019 SAOG-mediatoekennings in te stuur.
tgt: As part of promoting regional integration, cooperation and recognising excellence in journalism, South African media are invited to submit their entries for the 2019 SADC Media Awards competition by 28 February 2019.

src: Die toekennings is gerig op gedrukte media, radio, televisie en fotojoernalistiek.
tgt: The awards are in the fields of print, radio, television and photo journalism.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Messages Condolences.

src: .Die Kabinet betuig saam met President Ramaphosa en alle Suid-Afrikaners hul meegevoel met die naasbestaandes en vriende van leerders wat gesterf het nadat ’n voetgangerbrug by die Hoërskool Driehoek in Vanderbijlpark op Vrydag 1 Februarie 2019 ineengestort het.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Ramaphosa and all South Africans in extending condolences to the families and friends of learners who died after a walkway collapsed at Hoërskool Driehoek in Vanderbijlpark on Friday, 1 February 2019.

src: Die Kabinet wens ook alle leerders wat tydens die voorval beseer is ’n spoedige herstel toe.
tgt: Cabinet also wishes all injured learners a speedy recovery.

src: GelukwenseDie Kabinet dra sy gelukwense oor aan:die Soweto Gospel-koor, wat hulle Suid-Afrika weer eens met trots gevul het toe hulle die Grammy vir die beste musiekalbum gewen het.
tgt: Cabinet has congratulated: the Soweto Gospel Choir for making South Africa proud again after winning the Grammy for the best world music album.

src: Die groep het vir sy eerste album, Freedom – renditions of well-known liberation struggle songs, gewen.
tgt: The group won for its album Freedom – renditions of well-known liberation struggle songs.

src: Dit is die koor se derde Grammy-toekenning.
tgt: This is the choir’s third Grammy Award.

src: Die Ontwikkelingsbank van Suider-Afrika (OBSA) met hul African Renewable Energy Programme Award, wat deur die London-gebaseerde instelling, Project Finance International, toegeken is.
tgt: the Development Bank of Southern Africa (DBSA) for winning the African Renewable Energy Programme Award from London-based institution, Project Finance International.

src: Die OBSA het erkenning gekry vir sy innoverende finansiering van 14 hernubare projekte in die land se Hernubare Energie Onafhanklike Kragopwekkersprogram.
tgt: The DBSA was recognised for its innovative financing of 14 renewable energy projects in the country’s Renewable Energy Independent Power Producers Programme.

src: Twee van ons wetenskaplikes wat die gesogte AU Kwame Nkrumah-toekennings vir Wetenskaplike Voortreflikheid 2018 in Addis Ababa, Ethiopië op 11 Februarie 2019 ontvang het:ProfAletta Schutte het die streeksprys vir vrouewetenskaplikes van US$20 000, in die kategorie vir Lewens- en Aardwetenskappe gewen.
tgt: two of our scientists who won the prestigious AU Kwame Nkrumah Awards for Scientific Excellence 2018 edition in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia on 11 February 2019: ProfAletta Schutte won the regional prize for Women Scientist US$20 000 for the Life and Earth Sciences category.

src: Sy is ’n professor in Fisiologie aan die Noordwes Universiteit.
tgt: She is a Profssor of Physiology at North-West University.

src: ProfSchutte het ’n SARChI in die Vroeë Opsporing en Voorkoming van Kardiovaskulêre Siektes in Afrika.
tgt: ProfSchutte holds a SARChI in the Early Detection and Prevention of Cardiovascular Disease in Africa, the research chair is funded by the Department of Science and Technology (DST).

src: ProfSchutte se navorsingsfokus is op hipertensie en die ontwikkeling daarvan op bevolkings in WEBTOKEN David Mark Richardson het die kontinentale toekenning van US$100 000 gewen in die kategorie vir Aard- en Lewenswetenskappe.
tgt: ProfDavid Mark Richardson won the continental award of US$100 000 for the Earth and Life Science category.

src: Hy is ’n Voortreflike Profssor van Ekologie aan die Universiteit van Stellenbosch, en Direkteur van die DST-Nasionale Navorsingstigting se Sentrum vir Voortreflikheid vir Indringerbiologie.
tgt: He is a Distinguished Profssor of Ecology at Stellenbosch University, and Director of the DST-National Research Foundation Centre of Excellence for Invasion Biology.

src: Sy Navorsing handel oor die begrip van kwessies rakende indringer uitheemse boomspesies.
tgt: His research deals with understanding issues pertaining to invasive alien tree species.

src: Suid-Afrika se onder-20 sokkerspan, Amajita, wat gekwalifiseer het vir die 2019 FIFA onder-20 Wêreldbeker, wat in Me 2019 in Pole plaasvind.
tgt: South Africa’s Under-20 football team, Amajita, for qualifying for the 2019 FIFA Under-20 World Cup, to be held in Poland in May 2019.

src: Amajita het hul plek verseker nadat hulle deurgedring het tot die semi-finale van die Konfederasie van Afrika Sokker Onder-20 Afrika-nasiesbeker wat tans in Niger plaasvind.
tgt: Amajita booked their spot after making it through to the semi-finals of the Confederation of African Football Under-20 Africa Cup of Nations currently underway in Niger.

src: Verklaring oor die Kabinetsvergadering van 27 Februarie 2019 by Tuynhuys in KaapstadA.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 27 February 2019 at Tuynhuys in Cape Town.

src: Kwessies in die Omgewing.
tgt: Issues In The Environment.

src: Begrotingsrede vir 2019.Die Kabinet verwelkom die begrotingsrede vir 2019 deur die Minister van Finansies, Tito Mboweni, in die Parlement in Kaapstad op Woensdag 20 Februarie 2019, as 'n raamwerk wat die weg baan vir Suid-Afrikaners om saam die ekonomie te hernu en te herbou tot 'n inklusiewe en florerende een.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the 2019 Budget Speech delivered by Finance Minister Tito Mboweni in Parliament, Cape Town on Wednesday, 20 February 2019, as a framework that has set South Africa on a path where together we are enabled to renew and rebuild our economy into an inclusive and thriving one.

src: Die Begrotingsrede bring die verpligtinge wat president Cyril Ramaphosa in sy Staatsrede in die Parlement in Kaapstad op 7 Februarie 2019 uiteengesit het, in werking.
tgt: The Budget Speech brings into effect the commitments outlined by President Cyril Ramaphosa in his State of the Nation Address in Parliament, Cape Town on 7 February 2019.

src: Die Kabinet ondersteun verskeie inisiatiewe, insluitend die vermindering van die openbare sektor se loonrekening om bykomende besparing te genereer ter versterking van die regering se finansies.
tgt: Cabinet supports various initiatives, including cutting the public sector wage bill, in order to generate additional savings to strengthen government’s finances.

src: Deur streng voorwaardes vir finansiële ondersteuning aan Eskom te stel om die energieverskaffer tot 'n lewensvatbare organisasie te herstruktureer, word ook verwelkom.
tgt: Imposing strict conditions of financial support to Eskom to help the utility restructure into a viable organisation is also welcomed.

src: Ons het almal 'n rol te speel om die ekonomie te laat groei en werk te skep vir ons mense.
tgt: We all have a part to play in growing the economy and creating jobs for our people.

src: Om die moeilikste uitdagings van die nalatenskap van apartheid te oorkom, moet ons met die regering saamwerk om sy programme in werking te tel, die ekonomie te laat groei en meer buitelandse beleggings te lok.
tgt: Overcoming the toughest challenges stemming from the legacy of apartheid means working together with government to implement its programmes, grow the economy and attract more foreign investment.

src: Eskom.
tgt: Eskom.

src: Die Kabinet het 'n verslag van Adjunkpresident David Mabuza ontvang oor die werk van die gesamentlike Spesiale Kabinetskomitee oor Eskom wat geskep is in reaksie op onlangse onderbrekings in elektrisiteitsvoorsiening en die gevolglike negatiewe uitwerking op die ekonomie.
tgt: Cabinet received a report from Deputy President David Mabuza on the work of the joint Special Cabinet Committee on Eskom that was established in response to recent electricity supply disruptions and the negative impact on the economy.

src: Die regering se gekoördineerde pogings om finansiële, operasionele en strukturele volhoubaarheid vir Eskom te verseker gaan doelgerig voort.
tgt: Government’s coordinated efforts to bring financial, operational and structural sustainability to Eskom are proceeding in earnest.

src: Die Spesiale Kabinetskomitee is deur Adjunkpresident Mabuza belê en sluit die ministers van Openbare Ondernemings, Energie, Vervoer en Finansies, sowel as Polisie en Staatsveiligheid in.
tgt: The Special Cabinet Committee is convened by Deputy President Mabuza and includes the Ministers of Public Enterprises, Energy, Transport, Finance, Police and State Security.

src: In ooreenstemming met President Ramaphosa se verbintenis dat die regering se reaksie op die elektrisiteitskrisis inklusief en oorlegplegend moet wees, het die Minister van Openbare Ondernemings en die Voorsitter van die Eskom-direksie sy eerste voorlopige gesprekke gevoer met die leierskap van die drie vakbonde wat deur Eskom, die steenkoolmynbedryf en die ingenieurswesekorps erken word.
tgt: In line with President Ramaphosa’s commitment that government’s response to the electricity crisis must be inclusive and consultative, the Minister of Public Enterprises and the Eskom board Chairperson had their first preliminary engagements with the leadership of the three labour unions recognized by Eskom, the coal mining industry and the engineering fraternity.

src: Die vergadering met die arbeidsektor het verslag gedoen oor die probleme met Eskom se bedryfs- en voorsieningstelsel, instandhouding en onbeplande kragonderbrekings.
tgt: The meeting with labour reported on the problems with Eskom’s operations and generation system, maintenance and unplanned outages.

src: Die vergadering het gepoog om 'n basis vir formele toekomstige raadpleging te vestig.
tgt: The meeting sought to establish a basis for formal future consultations.

src: Die herstrukturering van Eskom is ook bespreek en alle partye het ooreengekom dat daar meer interaksies moet wees om die pad vorentoe, asook die implikasies van die verdeling van Eskom se bedryfsafdelings in drie afsonderlike bedryfsentiteite, beter te verstaan.
tgt: The restructuring of Eskom was also discussed, and all parties agreed that there would be more interactions to better understand the roadmap and the implications of separating Eskom’s business divisions into three separate operating entities.

src: Die steenkoolmynbedryf is onder beskerming van die Minerale Raad van Suid-Afrika (MINCOSA) byeengeroep en die vergadering het probleme met betrekking tot steenkoolvoorsiening, koste en pryse, asook die gehalte van steenkool wat aan Eskom verskaf word, bespreek.
tgt: The coal mining industry was convened under the auspices of the Minerals Council of South Africa (MINCOSA), and the meeting raised problems related to coal supply, costs and pricing, and the quality of coal provided to Eskom.

src: Vergaderings is ook met die ingenieurswesekorps onder beskerming van die Ingenieursraad van Suid-Afrika (ECSA) belê.
tgt: Further engagements were convened with the engineering fraternity, under the auspices of the Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA).

src: Alle spesialiteitsdissiplines in ingenieurswese is verteenwoordig deur hul onderskeie vrywillige verenigings, insluitend die Nasionale Vereniging van Swart Ingenieurs.
tgt: All engineering specialist disciplines were represented by their respective voluntary associations, including the National Association of Black Engineers.

src: ECSA het Eskom se probleme uiteengesit en aanbevelings gemaak oor hoe om die breër Suid-Afrikaanse akademiese en tegniese professionele korps te betrek by die dringende ingrypings wat nodig is om elektrisiteitsvoorsiening te stabiliseer.
tgt: The ECSA gave its analysis of the problems facing Eskom and provided a set of recommendations about how to involve the broader South African academic and technical professional fraternity in the urgent interventions required to stabilize electricity supply.

src: MINCOSA en ECSA sal die regering help om 'n Eskom-oorsigspan vir tegniese bedrywighede en onderhoud, wat binnekort aangekondig sal word, op die been te bring.
tgt: MINCOSA and the ECSA will assist government to establish a Technical Operations and Maintenance Review Team for Eskom that will be announced shortly.

src: Hernubare energie Die Kabinet ondersteun die aankondigings deur die Minister van Energie, Jeff Radebe, wat die basiese rasionaal oor hoe hernubare energie die negatiewe uitwerking van fossielbrandstof-energiebronne, soos olie en steenkool, kan stuit, herbevestig.
tgt: Cabinet supports the announcements by Energy Minister Jeff Radebe, which reaffirms the basic rationale behind renewable energy in arresting the high negative impact of fossil fuel sources of energy such as oil and coal.

src: Energie is 'n deurslaggewende bemagtiger vir sosio-ekonomiese groei en ontwikkeling in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Energy is a key enabler in South Africa’s trajectory towards socio- economic growth and development.

src: Die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NDP) bepaal dat Suid-Afrika minstens 20 000 megawatt hernubare energie teen 2030 benodig.
tgt: The National Development Plan (NDP) states that South Africa needs at least 20 000 megawatts of renewable energy by 2030.

src: Die Verkrygingsprogram vir Hernubare Energie van Onafhanklike Kragprodusente het 'n beduidende uitwerking op die ekonomie, werkskepping, gemeenskapsopheffing, ekonomiese transformasie en klimaatsverandering.
tgt: The Renewable Energy Independent Power Producer Procurement Programme has made a significant impact on the economy, job creation, community upliftment, economic transformation and climate change.

src: Terwyl Suid-Afrika steeds 'n beduidende bydrae tot die globale poging tot lae-koolstof en klimaatsveerkragtige ontwikkeling lewer, bly die regering daartoe verbind om die oorgang na 'n skoner toekoms verantwoordelik en regverdig deur te voer.
tgt: While South Africa continues to make a significant contribution to the global effort for a low-carbon and climate resilient developments, government remains committed to ensuring a responsible and just transition to a cleaner future.

src: Die Wêreldbankgroep het onlangs die Suid-Afrikaanse Hernubare Energie- en Energiebergingstelsels in Kaapstad van 25 tot 26 Februarie 2019 onder die tema: "Batterye, Energieberging en die Hernubare Toekoms – op weg na 'n 100% Versendbare Hernubare Energiestelsel".
tgt: The World Bank Group recently hosted the South African Renewable Energy and Energy Storage Systems in Cape Town from 25 to 26 February 2019 under the theme: “Batteries, Energy Storage and the Renewable Future – Towards a 100% Dispatchable Renewable Energy System”.

src: Afgevaardigdes uit die nywerheids- en finansiële sektore, nutsdienste, reguleerders, die regering en die akademie het die vordering wat in die hernubare energiesektor gemaak is bespreek, insluitend beleid regulatoriese, finansiële, sake-, en tegnologiese toepassings innovering, kodes en standaarde wat nodig is vir die uitbreiding van hernubare energie.
tgt: Delegates from industry, finance, utilities, regulators, government and academia discussed advancements in the renewable-energy sector including policy, regulatory, financial, business, technological, applications, innovation, codes and standards issues that are required for the expansion of renewable energy.

src: Hernubare energie en energiebergingstegnologieë stel ons in staat om elektriese krag in energie om te skakel en dit te berg vir later gebruik wanneer dit nodig is.
tgt: Renewable energy and energy storage technologies enable us to convert electrical power into an energy form and store it for later use when needed.

src: Energiebergingstelsels verminder die behoefte aan reserwevoorrade van steenkool of gasaangedrewe elektriese kragopwekkingsaanlegte dit verminder sodoende die energiesektor se uitstralings en help ons om klimaatsverandering te temper.
tgt: Energy storage systems reduce the need for back-up capacity from coal or gas-fired electrical generation plants, thereby reducing power sector emissions and help us mitigate against climate change.

src: Program vir Spesiale Ekonomiese Sones (SEZ’e).
tgt: Special Economic Zones (SEZs) Programme.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom plaaslike en internasionale beleggersvertroue wat blyk uit beleggings in die Saldanhabaai-bedryfsontwikkelingsone (SBIDZ), wat in 'n wêreldklas aflandige en martime-spilpunt ontwikkel.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes local and international investor confidence displayed through investments in the Saldanha Bay Industrial Development Zone (SBIDZ), which is developing into a world-class offshore and martime hub.

src: Dit is deel van die Departement van Handel en Nywerheid se SEZ-program.
tgt: This is part of the Department of Trade and Industry’s SEZ Programme.

src: Die vestiging van SEZ'e landwyd is daarop gerig om die konsentrasie van ekonomiese bedrywighede in sekere gebiede van die land as gevolg van apartheid se ruimtelike beplanning, om te keer.
tgt: The establishment of SEZs countrywide is reversing the concentration of economic activity to certain areas of the country as a result of apartheid spatial planning.

src: Sedert hul stigting het SEZ'e tot direkte buitelandse belegging bygedra, soos die onlangse ondertekening van 'n belegging van R3 miljard by die SBIDDie SBIDZ se beleggingspyplyn sluit minstens vyf beleggings in wat ’n bykomende R2,4 miljard se belegging tot die kort- en mediumtermyn-vooruitsig vir die sone sal byvoeg.
tgt: Since their establishment, SEZs have contributed to attracting foreign direct investment such as the recently signed a R3-billion investment at the SBIDThe SBIDZ’s investment pipeline includes at least five more investments that will add another R.4 billion of investment to the short and medium-term outlook of the zone, once completed.

src: Watervoorsiening.
tgt: Water supply.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die gevorderde infrastruktuur van die Mzimvubu-waterprojek by Esiqhungqwini in Tsolo in die Mhlontlo Plaaslike Munisipaliteit in die Oos-Kaap, as 'n voorbeeld van hoe die regering aan gemeenskappe se behoeftes voldoen ondanks die feit dat Suid-Afrika 'n waterskaars land is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the Mzimvubu Water Project’s advanced infrastructure at Esiqhungqwini village in Tsolo, situated in Mhlontlo Local Municipality in the Eastern Cape, as an example of how government continues to meet the needs of communities despite South Africa being a water-stressed country The realisation of such water projects create job opportunities and ensure potable water supply for domestic and industrial use.

src: Die verwesenliking van sulke waterprojekte skep werksgeleenthede en verseker drinkbare watertoevoer vir huishoudelike en industriële gebruik.
tgt: Since the advent of democracy much work has been done to ensure that communities have access to basic services like clean water.

src: Byna 90% van huishoudings het tans toegang tot kraanwater.
tgt: Nearly 90% of households currently have access to piped water.

src: Veiligheid by skole.
tgt: School safety.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel aangemelde voorvalle van afknouery, rooftogte en geweld by sommige van die land se skole.
tgt: Cabinet condemns reported incidents of bullying, robberies and violence in some of the country’s schools.

src: Ons kinders moet in veilige omgewings kan leer en ons doen ’n ernstige beroep op leerders, opvoeders, ouers en voogde om ons kinders sosiaal, fisies en emosioneel te beskerm.
tgt: Our children need safe environments of learning and we call on learners, educators, parents and guardians to work together to protect our children socially, physically and emotionally.

src: Die Kabinet loof die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens vir hul spoedige optrede om verdagtes wat by 'n poging tot kaping by 'n skool in Edenvale, Gauteng betrokke was, in hegtenis te neem.
tgt: Cabinet also commends the South African Police Service for their swift apprehension of suspects involved in an attempted hijacking at an Edenvale school in Gauteng.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n spesiale beroep op skoolbeheerliggame om die bestaande infrastruktuur van hul skole te evalueer om te verseker dat skoolgeboue veilig is, gereeld onderhou word en bevorderlik is vir leer.
tgt: Cabinet makes a special appeal to school governing bodies to assess the existing infrastructure of their schools to ensure that school buildings are safe, regularly maintained and conducive to learning.

src: Onaanvaarbare praktyke deur godsdiensleiers.
tgt: Unacceptable practices by some religious leaders.

src: Die Kabinet neem met kommer kennis van onlangse mediaverslae oor onaanvaarbare praktyke deur sommige godsdiensleiers.
tgt: Cabinet noted with concern recent media reports about certain unacceptable practices by some religious leaders.

src: Die onlangse beweerde opwekking van 'n oorledene is 'n voorbeeld.
tgt: The recent purported resurrection of a deceased person is a case in point.

src: Verskeie soortgelyke insidente, wat wissel van gemeentes wat met giftige insekdoders bespruit word, tot kerkgangers wat aangemoedig word om onder meer motorbrandstof, rotte en gras te eet.
tgt: More of such incidences have happened in the recent past, ranging from spraying of congregants with poisonous insecticides to encouraging them to consume vehicle fuel, rats and grass, among others.

src: Mese besoek godsdiensinstellings om geestelike vervulling en sielkundige steun te verkry, veral in tye wanneer hulle op hul kwesbaarste is.
tgt: People approach religious institutions to gain spiritual fulfilment and psychological strength, especially when they are at their lowest and most vulnerable state.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op almal om saam te werk om hierdie praktyke wat mense se kwesbaarheid misbruik en hul lewens in gevaar stel, stop te sit.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all people to work together to stop these practices which abuse people’s vulnerability and endanger their lives.

src: Wetstoepassingsagentskappe moet ingryp waar strafregtelike dade onder die dekmantel van godsdiens gepleeg word.
tgt: The law-enforcement agencies should intervene where acts of criminality have been committed under the guise of religion.

src: Die Kabinet merk ook op dat die Kommissie vir die Bevordering en Beskerming van die Regte van Kulturele, Godsdiens- en Taalgemeenskappe hierdie praktyke ondersoek, wat 'n meer omvattende ingryping sal bied om dit stop te sit.
tgt: Cabinet has also noted that the Commission for the Promotion and Protection of the Rights of Cultural, Religious and Linguistic Communities is investigating these practices, which will provide a more comprehensive intervention that will stop them.

src: 2019 Nasionale en provinsiale verkiesings.
tgt: 2019 national and provincial elections.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle stemgeregtigde Suid-Afrikaners, veral jong kiesers wat vir die eeste keer stem, waarvan duisende geregistreer het, om hul stemreg in die komende nasionale en provinsiale verkiesings op Woensdag 8 Me 2019 uit te oefen en 'n sê te hê in die toekoms van die land.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all eligible South Africans, especially young first time voters who have registered in their thousands, to exercise their right to vote in the upcoming National and Provincial Elections on Wednesday, 8 May 2019, and have a say in the future of the country.

src: President Ramaphosa het 8 Me 2019 amptelik aangekondig en in die Staatskoerant geplaas as die datum vir die nasionale en provinsiale verkiesings.
tgt: President Ramaphosa has officially proclaimed and gazetted the 8 May 2019 as the date for the national and provincial elections.

src: Dit beteken dat die kiesersrol nou amptelik gesluit is en dat mense nie meer kan registreer om in die komende verkiesings te stem nie.
tgt: This means the voters’ roll is now officially closed and people will no longer be able to register to vote in the May elections.

src: Die President het ook ingevolge artikel 2A van die Wet op Openbare Vakansiedae, 1994 (Wet 36 van 1994), soos gewysig, 8 Me 2019 as 'n nasionale openbare vakansiedag verklaar.
tgt: The President has also in terms of Section 2A of the Public Holidays Act, 1994 (Act 36 of 1994), as amended, declared 8 May 2019 as a public holiday throughout the country.

src: In Suid-Afrika is die reg om te stem 'n hoogtepunt van jare se stryd om ons vryheid te verseker.
tgt: In South Africa, the right to vote is a culmination of years of struggle for our freedom.

src: Dit het baie opoffering gekos met talle van ons landgenote wat hul lewens in die stryd verloor het.
tgt: It came at a huge cost with countless of our country men andwomen sacrificing their lives.

src: Caster Semenya.
tgt: Caster Semenya.

src: Die Kabinet ondersteun saam met die res van Suid-Afrika ons goue meisie, Caster Semenya.
tgt: Cabinet joins the rest of South Africa in standing united behind our golden girl Caster Semenya.

src: Haar saak, wat voor die Arbitrasiehof vir Sport aangehoor word, is meer as net 'n sportkwessie.
tgt: Her case, which is being heard before the Court of Arbitration for Sport, is more than just a sporting matter.

src: Dit gaan oor fundamentele menseregte en die inherente waardigheid van alle mense.
tgt: It is about fundamental human rights and the inherent dignity of all people.

src: Ons doen 'n beroep op mense om hul steun te wys by #HandsOffCaster.
tgt: We call on people to show their support at #HandsOffCaster.

src: Kom ons wys vir die wêreld dat ons 'n nasie is wat billikheid, gelykheid en respek vir menswaardigheid waarborg.
tgt: Let us show the world that we are a nation which values fairness, equality and respect for human dignity.

src: Kreatiwiteitsbedryf.
tgt: Creative industry.

src: Die Kabinet is tevrede met die positiewe uitkomste van die Kreatiwiteitsbedryf-interaksie, onder leiding van die Minister van Kommunikasie, Stella Ndabeni-Abrahams, onder die tema: Hefkrag van Digitale Platforms vir Vierde Industriële Rewolusie (4IR) Kreatiwiteit.
tgt: Cabinet is pleased with the positive outcomes of the Creative Industry interaction led by Communications Minister Stella Ndabeni-Abrahams, held under the Theme: “Leveraging on Digital Platforms for Fourth Industrial Revolution (4IR) Creatives”.

src: Die doel was om die bedryf te betrek om die impak van 4IR op die kreatiewiteitsbedryf binne die uitsaai- en oudiovisuele sektor, te assesseer en om formele platforms vir belanghebbendes te ontwikkel om transformasie te verseker.
tgt: The purpose was to engage the industry to assess the impact of the 4IR on the creative sector, and within the broadcasting and audio-visual sector, and to develop formal stakeholder platforms towards its transformation.

src: Deelnemers het ooreengekom dat die regering belanghebbendes en die Parlement moet betrek by die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Outeursreg en die ontwikkeling van die Handves vir Meiatransformasie, en met uitsaaiers gesprek te voer in ’n poging om die uitbuiting van klein en onafhanklike produsente te beperk, sowel as om te verseker dat die eienaars van inhoud behoorlik vergoed word vir hul inhoud wat aanlyn gebruik word.
tgt: Participants agreed that government should engage stakeholders and Parliament on the Copyright Amendment Bill, development of the Media Transformation Charter, engage broadcasters in an endeavour to curbexploitation of small and independent producers, and ensure that content owners duly benefit from their content being used on online platforms.

src: Vals sosiale mediarekeninge.
tgt: Fake social media accounts.

src: Die Kabinet neem met kommer kennis van vals LinkedIn- en Facebook-rekeninge wat na bewering dié van ministers en adjunkministers is.
tgt: Cabinet notes with concern fake LinkedIn and Facebook accounts which claim to be that of Ministers and Deputy Ministers.

src: Ons wil lede van die publiek waarsku om nie mislei te word deur hierdie vals rekeninge nie, waarvan sommige vals sakegeleenthede belowe en mense vra om te betaal om deel van die sakegeleenthede te wees.
tgt: We wish to warn members of the public not to be misled and drawn in by these fake accounts, some of which promise fake business opportunities, and which requests people to pay money to be part of these businessopportunities.

src: Geen lid van die Uitvoerende Bestuur versoek betalings vir enige amptelike transaksies deur sosiale media nie.
tgt: No member of the Executive solicits payments for any official transactions via social media.

src: In geval van twyfel, kontak die verskillende ministeries of departemente by WEBTOKELede van die publiek word aangespoor om op hul hoede te wees vir nabootsers, en mense wat slagoffers van nabootsers was, moet dit dadelik by die polisie aanmeld.
tgt: In cases of doubt, please contact the various ministries or departments at WEBTOKEMembers of the public are urged to exercise caution and those who fell prey to these impersonators should immediately report it to the police.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel dade wat in die naam van lede van die Uitvoerende Bestuur of enige ander lid van die samelewing deur middel van vals sosiale mediarekeninge gepleeg word.
tgt: Cabinet condemns activities performed in the name of members of the Executive or any other member of society through fake social media accounts.

src: Ons distansieer ons van die kommentaar, sienings en foto's wat met hierdie vals rekeninge verband hou.
tgt: We distance ourselves from the comments, views and photographs purported by these fake accounts.

src: Venezuela.
tgt: Venezuela.

src: Die Kabinet is bekommerd oor die ontwikkelende situasie in Venezuela, veral die humanitêre uitdagings wat dringende aandag vereis.
tgt: Cabinet is concerned about the unfolding situation in Venezuela, especially the humanitarian challenges that require urgent attention.

src: Ons loof pogings deur die Verenigde Nasies (VN) om humanitêre hulp aan die plaaslike bevolking te bied, en doen ’n beroep op die internasionale gemeenskap om die mense van Venezuela gedurende hierdie moeilike tyd te ondersteun.
tgt: We commend efforts by the United Nations (UN) to provide humanitariansupport to locals and call on the the international community to support the people of Venezuela during this difficult time.

src: Die Kabinet ondersteun verder beroepe dat die mense van Venezuela die geleentheid gebied moet word om hul eie toekoms te bepaal.
tgt: Cabinet further supports calls for the people of Venezuela to be afforded the opportunity to decide their own future.

src: Uit ons eie ervaring in Suid-Afrika glo ons dat 'n permanente oplossing slegs bereik kan word uit 'n interne en inklusiewe politieke dialoog met alle geaffekteerde partye in daardie land.
tgt: Drawing from our own experience in South Africa, we believe that a permanent solution can only be achieved from internal and inclusive political dialogue involving all affected parties in that country.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet Decisions.

src: Nasionale Aksieplan (NAP) om Rassisme, Rassediskriminasie, Xenofobie en Verwante Onverdraagsaamheid te beveg.
tgt: National Action Plan (NAP) to Combat Racism, Racial Discrimination, Xenophobia and Related Intolerance.

src: Sedert 1994 het opeenvolgende regerings daaraan gewerk om al ons mense te verenig, nasionale eenheid te bevorder en groter sosiale samehorigheid te verseker.
tgt: Since 1994, successive administrations have worked to unite all our people, foster national unity and ensure greater social cohesion.

src: Om van die verdeeldheid van die verlede te herstel, is 'n deurlopende proses wat hand aan hand moet gaan met groter ekonomiese geleenthede vir meer mense.
tgt: Healing the divisions of the past is a continuous process that must go hand in hand with ensuring greater economic opportunities for more people.

src: Die Kabinet keur dus goed dat die NAP vir die Bekamping van Rassisme, Rassediskriminasie, Xenofobie en Verwante Onverdraagsaamheid by die VN ter tafel gelê word.
tgt: Cabinet has therefore approved the NAP to Combat Racism, Racial Discrimination, Xenophobia and Related Intolerance for tabling at theUThis follows extensive consultations with government departments, Chapter Nine institutions, civil-society organisations and relevant stakeholders in all provinces.

src: Dit volg op uitgebreide oorlegpleging met staatsdepartemente, Hoofstuk 9-instellings, burgerlike samelewingsorganisasies en tersaaklike belanghebbendes in alle provinsies.
tgt: The NAP will contribute to and ensure government’s compliance with its international, regional and national obligations, specifically the International Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Racial Discrimination and the Durban Declaration and Programme of Action adopted by the UN following the 3rd World Conference against Racism (WCAR) held in Durban, KwaZulu-Natal in Optional Protocol to the Convention against Torture and other Cruel, Inhuman or Degrading Treatment or Punishment.

src: Die NAP sal bydra tot en verseker dat die regering sy internasionale, streeks- en nasionale verpligtinge nakom, spesifiek die Internasionale Konvensie vir die Uitskakeling van Alle Vorme van Rassediskriminasie en die Durban-verklaring en -aksieprogram wat ná die Derde Wêreldkonferensie teen Rassisme (WCAR) in 2001 in Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, deur die VN aangeneem is.
tgt: Cabinet approved submission of the Optional Protocol to the Convention against Torture and other Cruel, Inhuman or Degrading Treatment or Punishment to Parliament for ratification in terms ofSection 231(2) of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.

src: Bekragtiging bevorder konstitusionalisme en menseregte en is in ooreenstemming met Suid-Afrika se internasionale verpligtinge.
tgt: Ratification promotes constitutionalism, human rights and is in accordance with South Africa’s international obligations.

src: Die Grondwet maak voorsiening vir die voorkoming van die skending van die regte van mense in plekke van aanhouding deur staatsbepalings of hofbevele.
tgt: The Constitution provides for the prevention of the violation of the rights of person held inplaces of detention through state sanction or court order.

src: Ontwerpe vir die Gedenkmuntereeks.
tgt: Designs of the commemorative collectors coin series.

src: Die Kabinet keur die ontwerpe van die gedenkmuntreeks wat in 2019-2021 uitgereik sal word, goed:a) 2019 'Vier Suid-Afrika'-muntreeks: 25 Jaar van 'n Grondwetlike Demokrasieb) 2019-2021 goue muntstukreeks: Afrika se Groot Vyfc) 2019-2021 platinummuntreeks: Afrika se Groot Vyfd) 2020 Natura-muntreeks: die Superkontinent Gondwanae) 2020 Natura-muntreeks: R25-fynsilwermuntstuk: Wieg van die Mesdom - Hominiedef) 2020 2½-tiekie- en R2-kroonreeks: Suid-Afrikaanse Uitvindings – “Retinal CryoProbe”g) 2020 R10- en R5-kleurmuntreeks: Voëls en Blomme van die Kaapse Wynland-biosfeerreservaat enh) 2021 Natura-muntreeks: R25-fynsilwermuntstuk: die Superkontinent Gondwana.
tgt: Cabinet approved the designs of the commemorative collectors’ coinseries to be issued in 2019-2021:a) 2019 ‘Celebrating South Africa’ coin series: 25 Years of a Constitutional Democracyb) 2019-2021 pure-gold coin series: Africa’s Big Fivec) 2019-2021 platinum coin series: Africa’s Big Fived) 2020 Natura coin series: the Supercontinent Gondwanae) 2020 Natura coin series: R25 fine-silver coin: Cradle of Humankind – Hominidsf) 2020 2½c tickey and R2 crown series: South African Inventions – Retinal Cryoprobeg) 2020 R10 and R5 colour coin series: Birds and Flowers of the Cape Winelands Biosphere Reserve andh) 2021 Natura coin series: R25 fine-silver coin: the Supercontinent Gondwana.

src: Wetsontwerpe.
tgt: Bills.

src: Wysigignswetsontwerp op Toerisme.
tgt: Tourism Amendment Bill.

src: Die toerismesektor hou die belofte van ongelooflike geleenthede in en moet gekoester word sodat dit kan groei en verder ontwikkel.
tgt: Tourism is a sector that holds the promise of incredible opportunities and must be nurtured to grow and further develop.

src: Die NDP erken dat toerisme die potensiaal het om een van die hoofaandrywers van die ekonomie te word.
tgt: The NDP recognises that tourism has the potential to become one of the main drivers in the economy.2 In further pursuing the country’s tourism potential as a significant generator of jobs and revenue, Cabinet approved the publication of the Tourism Amendment Bill for public comment, which amends the Tourism Act, 2014 (Act 3 of 2014).

src: Om die land se toerismepotensiaal verder te bevorder, keur die Kabinet goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Toerisme, wat die Wet op Toerisme, 2014 (Wet 3 van 2014) wysig, vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer word.
tgt: The amendments improve the governance of South African Tourism as an entity under the authority of a board.

src: Dit bemagtig ook die Minister van Toerisme om die drempels rakende die korttermynhuur van wonings te bepaal.
tgt: It also empowers the Minister of Tourism to determine the thresholds regarding short-term home rental.

src: Die wetsontwerp maak ook voorsiening vir die bevoegdheidsvereistes van toeristegidse en vir die regulering van toeritegidse as motorbestuurders.
tgt: The Bill also provides for the competence requirements of tourist guides and for the regulation of tourist guide driving.

src: Wetsontwerp op ’n Sentrale Aansoekdiens van 2019.
tgt: Central Application Service Bill of 2019.

src: Suid-Afrika is verbind tot die oopstel en versekering van wyer toegang tot die naskoolse onderwys- en opleidingstelsel.
tgt: As a nation we are committed to opening up and ensuring wider access to the post-school education and training system.

src: 'n Belangrike deel van hierdie proses is om te verseker dat voornemende studente toegang kry tot 'n enkele, bekostigbare en maklik verstaanbare aansoekstelsel wat verskeie instellings van hoër onderwys dek.
tgt: A crucial part of this process lies in ensuring that prospective students have access to a single, affordable and easy-to-understand application system which covers multiple institutions of higher learning.

src: Die Kabinet keur derhalwe goed dat die Wetsontwerp op ’n Sentrale Aansoekdienswet van 2019 in die Staatskoerant vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer word.
tgt: To this effect, Cabinet approved publication of the Central Application Service Bill of 2019 in the Government Gazette, for public comment.

src: Die wetsontwerp maak voorsiening vir die skep van 'n openbare entiteit wat aansoeke in hoër onderwys- en opleidingsprogramme sal stroomlyn, aansoekkoste sal verminder, aansoekers van inligting oor akademiese programme sal voorsien, en die Departement van Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding en instellings van hoër onderwys in staat sal stel om billikheid en demografie te monitor.
tgt: The Bill provides for the establishment of a public entity that will streamline applications into higher education and training programmes, reduce the cost of application, provide applicants with information on academic programmes and enable the Department of Higher Education and Training and institutions of higher learning to monitor equity and demographics.

src: Wetsontwerp op die Suid-Afrikaanse Openbare Biblioteek- en Inligtingsdiens van 2019.
tgt: African Public Library and Information Services Bill of 2019.

src: In die strewe om ’n kultuur van ’n lesende nasie te sekp, keur die Kabinet goed dat die Wetsontwerp op die Suid-Afrikaanse Openbare Biblioteek- en Inligtingsdiens van 2019 vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer word.
tgt: In pursuit of a culture of a reading nation, Cabinet has approved the publication of South African Public Library and Information Services Bill of 2019 for public comment.

src: Die Wetsontwerp is daarop gerig om uitdagings rakende transformasie in die voorsiening van openbare biblioteke aan gemeenskappe, veral die voorheen benadeeldes, die hoof te bied.
tgt: The Bill seeks to address the transformational issues in providing public libraries with the communities particularly those previously disadvantaged communities.

src: Me inagneming van die feit dat die voorsiening van openbare biblioteke ingevolge die Grondwet 'n bevoegdheid van munisipaliteite is, voorsien hierdie wetsontwerp onder meer die norme en standaarde van die ideale openbare biblioteek.
tgt: Cognisance of the fact that the provision of public libraries in terms of the Constitution is a competence of the municipalities.

src: Dit bevorder ook koöperatiewe bestuur en koördinasie oor die drie sfere van regering rakende openbare biblioteek- en inligtingsdienste.
tgt: This Bill, amongst others, provides the norms and standards of the ideal public library.

src: Sodra die wetsontwerp goedgekeur is, sal dit aandag gee aan die historiese ongelykhede rakende openbare biblioteke en voorsiening maak vir voldoende tegemoetkomende hulpbronne vir mense met gestremdhede, jeugdiges, bejaardes en nie-Engelssprekers in stedelike en landelike gebiede.
tgt: It also promotes cooperative governance and coordination across the three spheres of government regarding public library and information services.

src: Die Minister van Kuns en Kultuur, Nathi Mthethwa, sal 'n mediakonferensie hou om die wetsontwerp uiteen te sit.
tgt: Once the Bill is approved, it will address the historical inequalities in respect of public libraries and provide for sufficient accommodating resources for impaired persons, youth, elderly and non-English speakers in urban and rural areas.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Verklaring oor geslagsgebaseerde geweld (GBG).
tgt: Declaration of gender-based violence (GBV).

src: Die stryd teen die plaag van GBG, sal op 8 Maart 2019 versterk word wanneer president Ramaphosa saam met verskeie nie-regeringsorganisasies 'n verklaring onderteken om GBG te beveg.
tgt: The fight against the scourge of GBV will be strengthened when President Ramaphosa, together with various non-governmental organisations, signs a declaration to combat GBThe details around the signing ceremony will be announced soon.

src: Die ondertekeningseremonie vind in Oos-Londen in die Oos-Kaap plaas en volg op die eerste Presidensiële Spitsberaad oor Geslagsgebaseerde Geweld- en Vrouemoord, wat in November verlede jaar gehou is.
tgt: This follows the inaugural Presidential Gender-Based Violence and Femicide Summit held in November last year.

src: 63ste Sitting van die VN se Kommissie oor die Status van Vroue.
tgt: 63rd Session on the UN Commission on the Status Of Women.

src: Bathabile Dlamini, sal 'n afvaardiging lei om die land se verslag vir die 63ste sitting van die VN-kommissie oor die status van vroue in New York, VSA op 13 Maart 2019 voor te lê.
tgt: The Minister of Women, Ms Bathabile Dlamini, will be leading a delegation to present the country report for the 63rd Session of the UN Commission on the Status of Women in New York, USA on 13 March 2019.

src: Die kommissie sal ‘sosiale beskermingstelsels, toegang tot openbare dienste en volhoubare infrastruktuur vir geslagsgelykheid en die bemagtiging van vroue en meisies’ as 'n prioriteitstema beskou.
tgt: The commission will consider “social protection systems, access to public services and sustainable infrastructure for gender equality and the empowerment of women and girls” as a priority theme.

src: Die verslag sal Suid-Afrika se verbintenis tot die bekamping van geslagsonbillikheid en -ongelykheid in die land beklemtoon en stel steeds programme en aksies in werking om hierdie kwessies te hanteer.
tgt: The report will highlight South Africa’s commitment to addressing gender inequity and inequality in the country, and continue to introduce programmes and actions to address these.

src: Mynbelegging.
tgt: Mining Investment.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die amptelike opening deur President Ramaphosa van Vedanta Zinc International se Gamsberg-myn in die Noord-Kaap op Donderdag 28 Februarie 2019.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the official opening by President Ramaphosa of Vedanta Zinc International’s Gamsberg Mine in the Northern Cape on Thursday, 28 February 2019.

src: Die belegging van meer as R21,8 miljard bou op die beloftes wat tydens die land se eerste beleggingskonferensie verlede jaar, ontvang is, en het reed tot 'n nuwe golf van nywerheids- en ekonomiese ontwikkeling in die land gelei.
tgt: The investment of more than R.8 billion builds on the commitments received during the country’s inaugural Investment Conference held last year, which triggered a new wave of industrial and economic development in the country.

src: Die eerste fase van die myn sal 'n belegging van R5,5 miljard ontvang en het 'n geskatte lewensduur van meer as 30 jaar.
tgt: The first phase of the mine will receive an investment of R.5 billion and has an estimated lifespan of over 30 years.

src: Die myn sal tot 3 000 mense tydens konstruksie en 700 mense permanent in diens neem.
tgt: The mine will employ 3 000 people at the height of construction and 700 people permanently.

src: Aanvangsdialoog oor die Maritieme Vervoersektor.
tgt: Inaugural Maritime Transport Sector Dialogue.

src: Om die potensiaal van Suid-Afrika as 'n maritieme land, wat deur sy handels- en geostrategiese ligging op 'n groot seevaartroete gedefinieer word, sal die Minister van Vervoer, dr. Blade Nzimande, 'n tweedaagse Aanvangsdialoog oor die Maritieme Vervoersektor van 28 Februarie tot 1 Maart 2019 in Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, aanbied.
tgt: In further exploring the potential of South Africa as a maritime country defined by its trade and geostrategic location on a major sea-trading route, the Minister of Transport, Dr Blade Nzimande, will host a two-day Inaugural Maritime Transport Sector Dialogue from 28 February to 1 March 2019 in Durban, KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Die dialoog dui op die verbintenis wat in 2019 deur die Departement van Vervoer gemaak is om die implementering van die Omvattende Martieme Vervoerbeleid (CMTP), wat in 2017 deur die Kabinet goedgekeur is, te versnel.
tgt: The dialogue signifies the commitment made by the Department of Transport in 2019 to accelerate the implementation of the Comprehensive Maritime Transport Policy (CMTP) approve by Cabinet in 2017.

src: Die byeenkoms sal stappe oorweeg wat onderneem moet word om transformasie te verdiep en belegging in strategiese seevaart- infrastruktuurprojekte te lok, wat as deurslaggewend beskou word in die posisionering van Suid-Afrika as 'n Internasionale Seevaartsentrum.
tgt: The event will consider actions that must be undertaken to deepen transformation, attract investment into strategic maritime infrastructure projects considered as critical in the positioning South Africa as an Internation Maritime Centre.

src: Dit is ook 'n aanloop tot die vestiging van die Maritieme Vervoersektor-ontwikkelingsraad soos deur die CMTP voorgestel.
tgt: It is also a buildup to the furture stablishment of the Maritme Transport Sector Development Council as envisaged by the CMTGood Green Deeds.

src: President Ramaphosa sal die nasionale veldtog ‘Goeie Groen Dade’ op 8 Maart 2019 in Buffalo City, Oos-Kaap, lei.
tgt: President Ramaphosa will lead the national campaign “Good Green Deeds” on 8 March 2019 in Buffalo City, Eastern Cape.

src: Dit is die verantwoordelikheid van alle Suid-Afrikaners om 'n skoon en veilige omgewing te verseker.
tgt: The responsibility to ensure a clean and safe environment rests with all South Africans.

src: Stappe om ons leefomgewings skoon te hou, begin by ons, en dit is belangrik dat woonplekke en besighede volhoubare afvalbestuurspraktyke in werking stel.
tgt: Keeping our communities clean starts with us, and it is important that homes and businesses implement sustainable waste management practices.

src: Die President sal ook die Operasie Phakisa: Chemiese en Afvalekonomie bekendstel, wat daarop gemik is om die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie te ondersteun, terwyl die omgewingsvoetspoor verminder word.
tgt: The President will also launch the Operation Phakisa: Chemical and Waste Economy, which aims to support the South African economy while reducing its environmental footprint.

src: Nasional Leeskoalisie.
tgt: National Reading Coalition.

src: President Cyril Ramaphosa sal op 8 Maart 2019 in Mdantsane in die Oos-Kaap verdere stukrag aan die Nasionale Leeskoalisie gee.
tgt: President Cyril Ramaphosa will lend further impetus to the National Reading Coalition at an event of which the details will be announced soon.

src: Die program poog om die leesgewoontes van Suid-Afrikaners te verbeter deur ’n liefde vir lees te vestig.
tgt: The programme aims to improve the reading habits of South Africans by instilling the love of reading.

src: Kleinskaalse visserye.
tgt: Small-scale fisheries.

src: Die Departement van Landbou, Bosbou en Visserye (DAFF), ooreenkomstig die Wet op Mariene Lewende Hulpbronne, 1998 (Wet 18 van 1998), soos gewysig, sal visvangregte aan kleinskaalse visserye in die Matigulu-gemeenskap, KwaZulu-Natal, op 14 Maart 2019 toestaan.
tgt: The Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (DAFF), in line with the Marine Living Resources Act, 1998 (Act 18 of 1998), as amended, will allocate fishing rights to small-scale fisheries in Matigulu community,KwaZulu-Natal on 14 March 2019.

src: Dit volg op 'n bekendstelling in Port Nolloth in die Noord-Kaap.
tgt: This follows a launch in Port Nolloth in the Northern Cape.

src: Die DAFF het ook uitgebreide opleiding voorsien om veral vroue in hierdie gemeenskappe te baat.
tgt: The DAFF has also conducted extensive training to benefit mainly women in these communities.

src: Soortgelyke bekendstellings sal ook in die Oos- en Wes-Kaap gehou word.
tgt: Similar launches will also be held in the Eastern Cape and Western Cape.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die selfoon- aansoekmetode, wat deur die DAFF ontwikkel is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the mobile applicationdeveloped by the DAFF called the Abalobi app, which aims to assist small-scale fisheries to link their sea harvest directly with the market such as fish retailers.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Messages.

src: Gelukwense.
tgt: Congratulations.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense oor aan:Onderwaterfotograaf, Allen Walker van Warner Beach, wat die eerte prys gewen het in die kategorie vir foto’s van haaie in die 2018 World ShootOut-toekennings in Duitsland.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates:underwater photographer Allen Walker of Warner Beach for winning the shark photography category at the World ShootOut 2018 awards held in Germany.

src: Sjef Kobus van der Mewe van Wolfgat-restaurant in Paternoster in die Wes-Kaap, wat met die Restaurant van die Jaar-toekenning bekroon is by die eerste Wêreld Restaurant-toekennings in Parys.
tgt: Chef Kobus van der Merwe of Wolfgat restaurant in Paternoster in the Western Cape, which won the Restaurant of the Year Award at the inaugural World Restaurant Awards in Paris.

src: die mense van Nigerië en Senegal – wat ook aansluit by die Afrika-unie se gelukwense – met hul suksesvolle verkiesings.
tgt: the people of Nigeria and Senegal – and also echoes the sentiment of African Union Commission – for holding successful elections.

src: Verklaring oor die Kabinetsvergadering van Woensdag 13 Maart by Tuynhuys in KaapstadKwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Cabinet met on Wednesday 13 March 2019 at Tuynhuys in Cape TownIssues in the environment.

src: Goeie Groen Dade.
tgt: Good Green Deeds.

src: Die Kabinet bedank alle Suid-Afrikaners wat hulle by President Cyril Ramaphosa aangesluit het met die bekendstelling van die nasionale veldtog vir Goeie Groen Dade.
tgt: Cabinet thanks all South Africans who joined President Cyril Ramaphosa in the launch of the national Good Green Deeds campaign.

src: Die veldtog bied ’n geleentheid aan die onderskeie samelewingsektore om hul deel te doen en meer omgewingsbewus te word.
tgt: The campaign, presents an opportunity for the various sectors of society to play their part and become more environmentally conscious.

src: Suid-Afrika is een van die ondertekenaars van die Parys Ooreenkoms oor klimaatsverandering, wat as riglyn dien vir internasionale pogings om kweekhuisgasvrystellings te beperk.
tgt: South Africa is one of the signatories to the Paris Agreement on climate change which guides the international efforts to limit greenhouse gas emissions.

src: Dit is die plig en verantwoordelikheid van alle mense in Suid-Afrika om ’n skoon en gesonde omgewing te verseker, nou en vir toekomstige geslagte.
tgt: It is the duty and responsibility of all people in South Africa to ensure a clean and healthy environment now and for the future generations.

src: ’n Goed bestuurde omgewing sal help om kweekhuisgasvrystellings te verminder, en tot voedselsekerheid, water, energie en algemene bestaansmiddele bydra.
tgt: A well-managed environment will contribute in reducing the greenhouse gas emissions, contribute towards food security, water, energy and general livelihoods.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op almal om ’n veldtog vir Goeie Groen Dade ’n lewenswyse te maak, sodat ons woonbuurte, gemeenskappe en die land ’n internasionale voorbeeld kan word van hoe om skoon, groen en bewoonbaar te wees.
tgt: Cabinet calls on everyone to make the Good Green Deeds campaign a way of living so that our neighborhoods, communities and the country can become a global example of being clean, green and habitable.

src: Die Kabinet is tevrede met die voortgesette implementering van grondhervormingsprogramme wat daarna streef om die onregte van die verlede reg te stel en ’n meer regverdige samelewing te bou, wat tot alle Suid-Afrikaners se voordeel sal strek.
tgt: Cabinet is pleased with the continued roll out programme of land reforms that seek to correct the wrongs of the past and build a more equitable society that will benefit all South Africans.

src: Ter bevordering van die regverdige verdeling van grond, het President Ramaphosa die leiding geneem met die oorhandiging van die bygelegde en gefinaliseerde 142 hektaar van prima-grondeiese aan die gemeenskap van Moretele, wat aangedui het dat hulle die grond vir ontwikkeling gaan gebruik.
tgt: In advancing the equitable distribution of land, President Ramaphosa led the handover of the settled and finalised 142 hectares of prime land claims to the community of Moretele, who indicated that they will use the land for development.

src: Hierdie gemeenskappe het die reg op hulle grond verloor toe hulle summier van hul eiendomme verwyder is ná die implementering van die bepalings van die Wet op Naturellegrond van 1913.
tgt: These communities lost their rights to land when they were abruptly removed from their properties following the implementation of the provisions of the Natives Land Act of 1913.

src: Die Kommissie vir die Herstel van Grondregte (CRLR) het meer as R203 miljoen aan die bylegging en finalisering van die eise spandeer.
tgt: The Commission on Restitution of Land Rights (CRLR) has spent over R203 million in settling and finalising the claims.

src: Eskom.
tgt: Eskom.

src: Die Kabinet het ’n verslag van Adjunkpresident David Mabuza ontvang oor die werk van die gesamentlike Sosiale Kabinetskomitee oor Eskom, wat ingestel is in reaksie op onlangse onderbrekings in elektrisiteitsvoorsiening en die negatiewe uitwerking daarvan op die ekonomie.
tgt: Cabinet received a report from Deputy President David Mabuza on the work of the joint Special Cabinet Committee on Eskom that was established in response to recent, electricity supply disruptions and its negative impact on the economy.

src: Die regering se gekoördineerde pogings om die finansiële, operasionele en strukturele volhoubaarheid van Eskom te verseker, vorder daadwerklik.
tgt: Government’s coordinated efforts to bring financial, operational and structural sustainability to Eskom are proceeding in earnest.

src: Die Eskom Tegniese Hersieningspan wat deur die Minister van Openbare Ondernemings en die Direksie van Eskom aangestel is, het vandeesweek met sy werk begin.
tgt: The Eskom Technical Review Team appointed by the Minister of Public Enterprises and the Board of Eskom started its work this week.

src: Die span sal na verwagting binne vier (4) weke ’n voorlopige verslag uitreik.
tgt: It is expected to produce a preliminary report within four (4) weeks.

src: Die werkverrigting van die kragaanlegte bly wisselvallig, selfs al is beurtkrag nie sedert 15 Februarie 2019 geïmplementeer nie.
tgt: The performance of the power plants remain volatile even though load-shedding has not been implemented since 15 February 2019.There has been a number of major incidents in the distribution areas that have contributed to the power disruptions.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis dat goeie vordering gemaak is met die herstel van steenkoolvoorraad by al die kragstasies, maar die Steenkoolvoorsieningsketting verg verdere aandag.
tgt: Cabinet noted the good progress that has been made with the recovery of coal stocks across the power stations, but further attention must be given to the Coal Supply Chain.

src: Die Kabinet bly egter bekommerd oor die werkverrigting van die Meupi- en Kusile-kragstasie, en het die Minister van Openbare Ondernemings opdrag gegee om ’n omvattende herstelplan te ontwikkel, gegrond op ’n herevaluering van die sleuteldryfkragte van die koste- en tydoorskrydings vir hierdie nuwe bouprojek.
tgt: Cabinet however, remains concerned about the performance of the Medupi and Kusile power stations and has mandated the Minister of Public Enterprises to provide a comprehensive recovery plan based on a reassessment of the key drivers of the cost and time overruns for this new build project.

src: ILO Kommissie oor die Toekoms van Werk en Edcon-ooreenkoms.
tgt: ILO commission on the future of work and EDCON agreement.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die internasionale kommissie se verslag, wat 10 aanbevelings bevat wat in drie pilare verdeel is: investering in mense se bekwaamhede investering in die instellings in die wêreld van werk en investering in behoorlike volhoubare werk.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the global commission’s report which made 10 recommendations grouped into three pillars: investing in the capabilities of people, investing in the institutions of the world of work and investing in decent, sustainable work.

src: Die aanbeveling is direk gerig op die drieledige uitdagings van ongelykheid, armoede en werkloosheid.
tgt: The recommendation directly speaks to the triple challenges of inequality, poverty and unemployment.

src: Deur die werk van die Minister van Arbeid, Mildred Oliphant, het Suid-Afrika vordering gemaak met die verbetering van toestande in die werkplek deur geslagsgebaseerde maatreëls, meer deursigtigheid in vergoeding, die uitskakeling van geweld en teistering in die werkplek, en spesifieke maatreëls om gelyke geleenthede te verseker.
tgt: Through the work of Minister of Labour Mildred Oliphant, South Africa has made progress in improving workplace conditions through gender balanced measures, more transparency in pay, eliminating violence, harassment in the workplace and specific measures to ensure equal opportunities.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom ook die gesamentlike pogings van die regering, die Werkloosheidsversekeringsfonds (wat vakbonde insluit) en die privaat sektor (banke en eienaars van winkelsentrums) om Suid-Afrika se grootste klerekleinhandelaar, EDCON, te herkapitaliseer.
tgt: Cabinet also, welcomes the joint efforts of government, the Unemployment Insurance Fund (which includes trade unions) and the private sector (banks and shopping mass landlords) to recapitalize South Africa’s largest clothing retailer – EDCOIn order to conclude an agreement to save Edcon, all parties had to make sacrifices and to work closely together.

src: Ten einde die ooreenkoms om Edcon te red te kon sluit, moes alle partye opofferings maak en nou met mekaar saamwerk.
tgt: At the heart of efforts to ensure that Edcon stays afloat is the impact on employment.

src: Mer as 40 000 direkte werksgeleentehde en veel meer duisende direkte en indirekte werksgeleenthede sou verlore gegaan het indien Edcon nie geherkapitaliseer is nie.
tgt: More than 40 000 direct jobs and many more thousands of direct and indirect jobs would have been lost if Edcon had not been recapitalized.

src: Die Kabinet vra Suid-Afrikaners om gehoor te gee aan die beroep op ons landsburgers wat tydens die Werkberaad gemaak is, naamlik om Trots Suid-Afrikaanse produkte te koop en plaaslike nywerhede te ondersteun.
tgt: Cabinet calls on South Africans to support the call made at the Jobs Summit to buy Proudly South African products and support local industry.

src: Vierkante Kilometer Reeks (SKA).
tgt: Square Kilometer Array (SKA).

src: ’n Nuwe era vir internasionale wetenskapbestuur het aangebreek toe die Minister van Wetenskap en Tegnologie, Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane, namens die Suid-Afrikaanse regering die internasionale verdrag (wat as die Rome Konvensie bekendstaan) op 12 Maart 2019 in Italië onderteken het.
tgt: A new era for global science governance was realised when the Minister of Science and Technology, Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane, on behalf of the South African government, signed the international treaty (called the Rome Convention) in Italy, on 12 March 2019.

src: Dit vestig die Vierkante Kilometer Reeks Observatorium (SKAO), as ’n interregeringsorganisasie, met die mandaat om die wêreld se kragtigste radio-astronomieteleskoop wat in Suid-Afrika en Australië geleë sal wees, te bou en bedryf.
tgt: This establishes the Square Kilometer Array Observatory (SKAO), as an intergovernmental organization, tasked with building and operating the world's most powerful radio astronomy telescope, to be located in South Africa and Australia.

src: Die Kabinet wens die lidlande geluk met hierdie mylpaal en herbevestig Suid-Afrika se verbintenis tot die SKA-projek, wat volg op die suksesvolle bekendstelling van ons MerKAT teleskoop en Suid-Afrika se kritiese bydrae tot die SKA-teleskoopontwerp.
