src: Ons bevestig onomwonde ons siening dat diegene wat sulke afskuwelike misdade teen vroue en kinders pleeg, geen plek in ons samelewing moet hê nie en met die volle krag van die wet te doen sal kry.
tgt: We remain firm that those who commit such heinous crimes against women and children should have no space in our society and must face the full might of the law.

src: Suid-Afrika sal saam met die internasionale gemeenskap deelneem aan Veldtog vir 16 Dae van Aktivisme vir Geen Geweld teen Vroue en Kinders (vanaf 25 November tot 10 Desember – Internasionale Meseregtedag), om bewustheid van GGGV in die land te verhoog.
tgt: South Africa will join the global community in the 16 Days of Activism for No Violence against Women and Children campaign (from 25 November to 10 December – International Human Rights Day), to raise awareness of GBVF in the country.

src: Die kabinet bekragtig die uitbreiding van die program van die Veldtog vir 16 Dae van Aktivisme vir Geen Geweld teen Vroue en Kinders, wat aangevul sal word deur 'n bewustheids-, ondersteunings-en-opvoedingsprogram om 'n einde te bring aan geweld teen die mees kwesbare lede van die samelewing, in die besonder vroue en kinders.
tgt: Cabinet has endorsed the expansion of the 16 Days of Activism to the 365 Days programme that will be sustained by an awareness, support and education programme to stop violence against the vulnerable members of society, in particular women and children.

src: Die 16 Dae van Aktivisme, wat op verhoogde mobilisering en bewustheid fokus, sal op 25 November deur Sy Eksellensie die President van die Republiek, mnrCyril Ramaphosa in Ga-Seleka Village in Limpopo bekendgestel word.
tgt: The 16 Days of Activism, which focuses on heightened mobilisation and awareness, will be launched by His Excellency the President of the Republic, Mr Cyril Ramaphosa on the 25th November in Ga-Seleka Village in Limpopo.

src: Die tema, “Genoeg is genoeg: Saam bespoedig ons implementering om geslagsgebaseerde geweld te beëindig”, bou voort op die vordering wat gemaak is met die ontwikkeling van 'n omvattende, multisektorale reaksie op GGGDie kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om op te staan en standpunt in te neem as mense wat aktief is in die stryd teen geslagsgebaseerde geweld ten einde veiliger huise, veiliger gemeenskappe en veiliger openbare ruimtes vir almal te skep.
tgt: The theme, “Enough is enough: Together fast-tracking implementation to end gender-based violence”, builds on the progress made in developing a comprehensive, multi-sectoral response to GBVCabinet calls on all South Africans to stand up and be counted amongst those who are active in the fight against gender based violence to create safer homes, safer communities and safer public spaces for all.

src: Oudituitslae vir 2018/19 vir provinsiale en nasionale departemente.
tgt: Audit outcomes for 2018/19 for provincial and national departments.

src: Die Ouditeur-Generaal (OG), Kimi Makwetu, lig die kabinet in oor die uitslae van 2018/19 se nasionale en provinsiale oudits.
tgt: Auditor-General (AG) Kimi Makwetu briefed Cabinet on the outcomes of the 2018/19 national and provincial audit results.

src: Die kabinet is bekommerd oor die voortgesette toename in wesenlike onreëlmatighede.
tgt: Cabinet is concerned about the continued increase in material irregularities.

src: Twaalf entiteite is gekies vir oudits oor onreëlmatige besteding.
tgt: Twelve entities were selected to be audited on irregular expenditure.

src: Sewe was Provinsiale Departemente van Gesondheid, Meslike Nedersettings, Onderwys die Nasionale Departement van Water en Sanitasie en Nasionale Departement van Basiese Onderwys en die Passierspooragentskap van Suid-Afrika (PRASA), wat 'n entiteit in staatsbesit is.
tgt: Seven were Provincial Departments in Health, Human Settlement, Education National Department of Water and Sanitation and National Department of Basic Education and the State Owned Entity Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa (PRASA).

src: Die Wysingingswet op Openbare Oudit, 2018 (Wet 5 van 2018), wat op 1 April 2019 van krag geword het, sal na verwagting die werk van die Kantoor van die OG versterk en verseker dat die regering begin om beslissend op te tree teen departemente wat aanhou om die raamwerk vir goeie openbare bestuur te verontagsaam.
tgt: The Public Audit Amendment Act, 2018 (Act 5 of 2018), which came into effect on 1 April 2019, is expected to strengthen the work of the Office of the AG and ensure government begins to deal decisively with departments that continue to disregard the governance framework.

src: Me die oog hierop bekragtig die kabinet die afdwinging van hierdie Wet, veral met betrekking tot ernstige onreëlmatighede wat van die OG vereis om sulke oortredings vir verdere ondersoeke te verwys, onder andere ook na wetstoepassingsentiteite.
tgt: To this effect, Cabinet has endorsed the enforcement of this Act, particularly on serious irregularities that require the AG to refer such transgression for further investigations, inclusive of law enforcement entities.

src: Die kabinet bly daartoe verbind om skoon bestuur en beheer om staatsbestuurde instellings te verseker.
tgt: Cabinet remains committed to ensuring clean governance within state-run institutions.

src: Die Nasionale Regeringskool het opdrag ontvang om die nodige opleiding en ondersteuning te voorsien aan instellings wat verdere opleiding van hul amptenare benodig.
tgt: The National School of Government has been instructed to provide the necessary training and support to institutions requiring further training of their officials.

src: Diegene wat die raamwerk vir openbare finansiële bestuur blatant oortree deur staatshulpbronne te misbruik, sal die gevolge van hul optrede moet dra.
tgt: Those who blatantly violate the public finance management framework will have to face the consequences of abusing state resources.

src: Weerstands-en-Bevrydingserfenisroete (RLHR) -projek.
tgt: Resistance and Liberation Heritage Route (RLHR) Project.

src: Die kabinet ontvang 'n vorderingsverslag oor die RLHR-projek van die Minister van Sport, Kuns en Kultuur, mnrNathi Mthethwa.
tgt: Cabinet received a progress report on the RLHR Project from Sports, Arts and Culture Minister Nathi Mthethwa.

src: Die Departement van Kuns en Kultuur – in samewerking met die Nasionale Erfenisraad en Suid-Afrikaanse Erfenishulpbronagentskap – sal die bewaring van ons geskiedenis en die historiese terreine op die vasteland wat 'n skakel met die Suid-Afrikaanse bevrydingserfenis het, identifiseer, versamel en bevorder.
tgt: The Department of Arts and Culture – working together with the National Heritage Council and South African Heritage Resources Agency – will identify, collect, and promote the preservation of our history and those historical sites in the continent which have a link with the South African liberation heritage.

src: Die projek dien as die land se afdeling van die kontinentale Afrika- bevrydingserfenisprogram.
tgt: The project serves as the country’s chapter of the continental African Liberation Heritage Programme.

src: Historiese infrastruktuur en terreine is in al nege provinsies geïdentifiseer en sommige dien as erfenistoerisme-fasiliteite.
tgt: Historical infrastructure and sites have been identified in all the nine provinces and some serve as heritage tourism facilities.

src: Die kabinet bekragtig die driejaarlange implementeringsplan wat voorgelê word.
tgt: Cabinet endorsed the three-year implementation plan that was presented.

src: Wetsontwerpe.
tgt: Bills.

src: Wetsontwerp op Ekonomiese Regulering van Vervoer van 2019.
tgt: Economic Regulation of Transport Bill of 2019.

src: Die kabinet keur die voorlegging van die Wetsontwerp op Ekonomiese Regulering van Vervoer van 2019 aan die parlement goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Economic Regulation of Transport Bill of 2019 to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp konsolideer die ekonomiese regulasies van vervoer in 'n enkele raamwerk.
tgt: The Bill consolidates the economic regulations of transport into a single framework.

src: Dit bevat voorstelle vir die instelling van die Enkele Ekonomiese Vervoerreguleerder en die Ekonomiese Vervoerraad.
tgt: It proposes the establishment of the Transport Economic Regulation and the Transport Economic Council.

src: Die Wetsontwerp sal van toepassing wees op die lugvaart-, seevaart-, spoor- en padvervoersektor.
tgt: The Bill will be applicable to the aviation, marine, rail and road transport sectors.

src: Die Wetsontwerp is gedurende 2018 tweemaal vir openbare oorlegpleging voorgelê.
tgt: The Bill went through public consultation twice in 2018.

src: Insette uit die openbare-oorlegplegingsproses is in hierdie hersiene Wetsontwerp geïnkorporeer.
tgt: Inputs from the public consultation process have been incorporated into this revised Bill.

src: Die uitkoms van die implementering van die Wetsontwerp sal bydra tot die kabinet se pogings om dit makliker te maak om in Suid-Afrika sake te doen.
tgt: The outcome of implementing this Bill will contribute towards Cabinet’s efforts to the ease of doing business in South Africa.

src: Ondernemings sal nou onderwerp word aan 'n beheerde enkeltariefstruktuur in hul transaksies met die land se vervoerbedryf.
tgt: Businesses will now be subjected to a controlled single tariff structure when engaging with the transportation industry in the country.

src: Daar word voorgestel dat 'n neutrale struktuur om toesig oor hierdie werk te hou, onder die Minister van Vervoer sal val.
tgt: A neutral structure to oversee this work is proposed to be under the Minister of Transport.

src: Toekomstige Gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Distriksontwikkelingsmodel.
tgt: District Development Model.

src: Sy Eksellensie die President van die Republiek, mnrCyril Ramaphosa, sal op Dinsdag 26 November 2019 die derde Distriksontwikkelingsmodel in die Waterbergdistrik by die Shongoane Sportterrein in Lephalale, Limpopo, bekendstel.
tgt: His Excellency the President of the Republic, Mr Cyril Ramaphosa will launch the third District Development Model in the Waterberg District on Tuesday, 26 November 2019 at the Shongoane Sports Ground in Lephalale, Limpopo.

src: Die Waterberg-area is die grootste platinumproduksie-area in die provinsie, en die ontginning van steenkool en petroleumontwikkeling het die vraag na die kommoditeit vir elektrisiteitsopwekking verhoog.
tgt: The Waterberg area is the largest platinum production area in the province, and the mining of coal and petroleum development has increased demand for the commodity for electricity generation.

src: Lephalale is ook die tuiste van 'n verskeidenheid landbou-aktiwiteite.
tgt: Lephalale is also home to a variety of agricultural activities.

src: Maand vir Bewustheid van die Regte van Mese met Gestremdhede.
tgt: Disability Rights Awareness Month South Africa commemorates the Disability Rights Awareness Month which started on 3 November to end on 3 December 2019.

src: Die tema vir hierdie jaar is: “Bou saam 'n Suid-Afrika inklusief van Regte van Mese met Gestremdhede”.
tgt: The theme for this year: “Together building South Africa inclusive of Disability Rights”.

src: Die regering het vordering gemaak met die voorsiening van 'n maatskaplike veiligheidsnet vir mense met gestremdhede en gaan voort met sy programme wat die sosio-ekonomiese insluiting van persone met gestremdhede prioritiseer.
tgt: Government has made progress in providing a social safety net for people with disabilities and continues to forge ahead in its programmes which prioritise the socio-economic inclusion of persons with disabilities.

src: Adjunkpresident Mabuza, in sy hoedanigheid as die voorsitter van die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale VIGS-raad, sal aan die hoof staan van die herdenking van Wêreld-VIGS-dag op 1 Desember in Orkney, Noordwes.
tgt: World AIDS Day Deputy President Mabuza, in his capacity as the Chairperson of the South African National AIDS Council, will lead the marking of World AIDS Day on 1 December 2019 in Orkney, North West.

src: Die tema vir Wêreld-VIGS-dag 2019 is: “Gemeenskappe maak die verskil”.
tgt: The World AIDS Day 2019 theme is: “Communities make the difference”.

src: Wêreld-VIGS-dag 2019 bied aan lande wêreldwyd die geleentheid om te besin oor hul onderskeie bydraes om die verspreiding van MIV en VIGS te voorkom.
tgt: World AIDS Day 2019 is an opportunity for countries globally to reflect on their respective contribution in fighting the spread of HIV and AIDThis year’s theme recognises the essential role communities have played and continue to play in the HIV and AIDS response.

src: Vanjaar se tema erken die sleutelrol wat gemeenskappe gespeel het, en steeds speel, in die MIV- en VIGS-respons.
tgt: South Africa has been relentless in its mission to turn around the HIV, AIDS, and TB epidemics, with notable achievements which include scientific advances in HIV treatment and more people receiving antiretroviral treatment.

src: Suid-Afrika werk onvermoeid in sy strewe om die MIV-, VIGS- en TB-epidemies om te keer, met merkwaardige prestasies soos wetenskaplike ontwikkelings in MIV-behandeling en meer mense wat antiretrovirale behandeling ontvang.
tgt: Access to antiretroviral therapy in the public health sector has grown from 45 500 patients in 2004 to over 4,7 million in 2019.

src: Dit word aangevul deur gedragsveranderingsprogramme, met inbegrip van gereelde toetsing en die gebruik van mans- en vrouekondome om infeksiesyfers te verlaag.
tgt: This is complemented by behavioural change programmes which include regular testing, and using female and male condoms to reduce infection rates.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Messages.

src: MeelyeDie kabinet betuig sy medelye met die:AmaXhosa Koninklike Familie en die hele gemeenskap met die afsterwe van Sy Majesteit, Koning Mpendulo Calvin Zwelonke Sigcawu.
tgt: CondolencesCabinet sent condolences to the:• AmaXhosa Royal Family and the community as a whole, on the passing of His Majesty, King Mpendulo Calvin Zwelonke Sigcawu.• family and friends of the seasoned broadcaster and thought leader, Mr Xolani Gwala.

src: familie en vriende van die ervare uitsaaier en meningsleier, mnrXolani Gwala.
tgt: President Ramaphosa declared a Special Provincial Official Funeral Category 2 for Mr Gwala.

src: President Ramaphosa het 'n Spesiale Provinsiale Amptelike Begrafnis Kategorie 2 aan mnrGwala toegeken.
tgt: He was buried at Impendle in KwaZulu-Natal on Saturday, 9 November 2019.• family and friends of former SABC Group Chief Executive Officer, Mr Solly Mokoetle.

src: familie en vriende van die voormalige Groep Uitvoerende Beampte van die SAUK, mnrSolly Mokoetle.
tgt: • family and friends of businessman, Mr Allan Gray, who founded the asset management company of the same name.• family and friends of the well-known South African writer, activist and poet, Mr Sandile Dikeni.

src: familie en vriende van die sakeman, mnrAllan Gray, wat die batebestuursmaatskappy met dieselfde naam gestig het.
tgt: • family and friends of actor, Mr Andile Gumbi, who was well-known for his roles on Isibaya and The Lion King.

src: familie en vriende van die bekende Suid-Afrikaanse skrywer, aktivis en digter, mnrSandile Dikeni.
tgt: • family and friends of former YoTV presenter and member of the music group Jozi, Mr Luther Cohen.

src: familie en vriende van die akteur, mnrAndile Gumbi, wat bekend was vir sy rolle in Isibaya en The Lion King.
tgt: CongratulationsCabinet extended its congratulations to: Agriculture, Land Reform and Rural Development Minister Thoko Didiza, as the elected Chairperson of the African Union Specialised Technical Committee on Agriculture and Rural Development.

src: familie en vriende van die voormalige YoTV-aanbieder en lid van die musiekgroep Jozi, mnrLuther Cohen.
tgt: All South Africans who came out in their numbers to welcome our victorious national rugby team, the Springboks from the 2019 Rugby World Cup in Japan.

src: Brad Binder vir sy oorwinning by die Maleisiese Moto2 Grand Prix.
tgt: Brad Binder for emerging victorious at the Malaysian Moto2 Grand Prix.

src: Ons wens hom alles van die beste vir die volgende seisoen toe, wanneer hy vir die Red Bull KTM Fabriekswedrenspan in die MotoGP-klas gaan meeding.
tgt: We wish him well for the next season when he competes in the MotoGP class with the Red Bull KTM Factory Racing team.

src: Chad le Clos met sy goue medalje in sowel die 100 meter as 200 meter vlinderslag by die FINA Swemwêreldbekertoernooi in Doha, Katar.
tgt: Chad le Clos for winning gold both in the 100 and 200 metres butterfly at the FINA Swimming World Cup in Doha, Qatar.

src: Caitlin Rooskrantz, wat vir die 2020 Olimpiese Spele in Japan gekwalifiseer het nadat sy die eerste Suid-Afrikaner geword het om goud te wen by die 2019 Wêreld- Artistiese Gimnastiekkampioenskappe.
tgt: Caitlin Rooskrantz for qualifying for the 2020 Olympics in Japan after becoming the first South African to win a gold at the 2019 World Artistic Gymnastics Championships.

src: Teddy Nzama, wat as die Starbucks Baristakampioen vir Europa, Midde-Ooste en Afrika aangewys is tydens die internasionale kompetisie wat in Londen gehou is.
tgt: Teddy Nzama, who was crowned the 2019 Starbucks Europe, Middle East and Africa Barista Champion of the international competition held in WEBTOKEN SA athletes who represented the country at the World Para Athletics Championships in Dubai.

src: Hulle het altesaam 11 medaljes ingepalm, waarvan twee goud is.
tgt: A total of 11 medals with two of these being gold.

src: Anrune Weyers: Vroue 400m T47 (Goud), Vroue 200m T47 (Silwer), Vroue 100m T47 (Brons) Ntando Mahlangu: Mans 100m T61 (Goud) Simone Kruger: Vrouediskus F38 (Silwer) Mpumelelo Mhlongo: Mans 100m T64 (Silwer), Mans-verspring T64 (Brons) Charl Du Toit: Mans 400m T37 (Brons) Reinhardt Hamman: Mans-spiesgooi F38 (Brons) Anika Johanna Pretorius: Vroue 100m T13 (Brons) en Sheryl James: Vroue 400m T37 (Brons).Luyolo Yiba, wat as die wenner van Seisoen 15 van Idols Suid-Afrika aangewys is.
tgt: Anrune Weyers: Women's 400m T47 (Gold), Women’s 200m T47 (Silver), Women's 100m T47 (Bronze) Ntando Mahlangu: Men’s 100m T61 (Gold) Simone Kruger: Women's Discus F38 (Silver) Mpumelelo Mhlongo: Men's 100m T64 (Silver), Men's Long Jump T64 (Bronze) Charl Du Toit: Men's 400m T37 (Bronze) Reinhardt Hamman: Men's Javelin Throw F38 (Bronze) Anika Johanna Pretorius: Women's 100m T13 (Bronze) and Sheryl James: Women's 400m T37 (Bronze).Luyolo Yiba, who was crowned the winner of Season 15 of Idols South Africa.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderworpe aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die toepaslike klaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Weermagdienskommissie:a. AdvMotlatjo Josephine Ralefataneb.
tgt: Defence Force Service Commission:a. Adv Motlatjo Josephine Ralefataneb.

src: AdvLinda Mbana enc.
tgt: Adv Linda Mbana andc.

src: Verklaring oor die Gewone Kabinetsvergadering, wat op Vrydag 13 Desember 2019 by die Uniegebou in Pretoria gehou isKwessies in die Omgewing.
tgt: Statement on the Cabinet Ordinary Meeting held at Union Buildings, Pretoria on Friday, 13 December Issues in the environmentEskomCabinet fully supports all efforts meant to ensure electricity supply certainty in our country.

src: Die Kabinet het die Minister van Openbare Ondernemings, Pravin Gordhan, vervolgens opdrag gegee om met die nuwe Hoof Uitvoerende Beampte van Eskom, mnrAndre de Ruyter, te onderhandel om vroeër as die vasgestelde datum met sy pligte te begin.
tgt: In this regard, Cabinet has mandated Public Enterprises Minister Pravin Gordhan to negotiate with the Chief Executive Officer Mr Andre de Ruyter to commence his duties earlier than the set WEBTOKEN de Ruyter together with his management team will immediately deal with the concerning issues of governance, lack of financial management as well as stabilize the operations of Eskom.

src: MnrDe Ruyter, in samewerking met sy bestuurspan, sal onmiddellik aandag gee aan kwessies rakende beheer en 'n gebrek aan finansiële bestuur, sowel as die stabilisering van Eskom se bedrywighede.
tgt: This includes dealing with the huge backlog of maintenance of the aging fleet of their power stations and the structural defects in Medupi and Kusile power stations.

src: Dit sluit in die groot agterstand met instandhouding van hul verouderde kragstasies en die strukturele gebreke in die Meupi- en Kusile-kragstasies.
tgt: Deputy President David Mabuza will convene a resuscitated Energy War Room comprising Finance Minister Tito Mboweni Minerals and Energy Minister Gwede Mantashe and Minister Gordhan.

src: Die span sal uitdagings rakende die land se energievoorraad hanteer.
tgt: The team will deal with any challenges to our energy supply in the country.

src: Hernubare produkte sal 'n sleutelrol seel in ons energievoorsiening ter aanvulling van Eskom se pogings.
tgt: Renewables will play a key role in our energy supply to complement the efforts of Eskom.

src: Suid-Afrikaanse Lugdiens (SAL) sakeredding.
tgt: South African Airways (SAA) Business RescueThe SAA was this past week placed under Business Rescue.

src: Die Kabinet is vol vertroue dat hierdie ingryping sal bydra tot die herposisionering van die nasionale lugdiens as 'n sterker, mededingende entiteit wat mettertyd vertroue by alle Suid-Afrikaners sal inboesem en ekwiteitsvennote sal lok.
tgt: Cabinet is confident that this intervention will assist in repositioning the national airline into a stronger, competitive entity that with time will gain confidence of all South Africans and attract equity partners.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die aanstelling van die sakereddingspraktisyn mnrLes Matuson van Matuson Associates.
tgt: Cabinet has welcomed the appointment of the Business Rescue Practitioner Mr Les Matuson from the Matuson Associates.

src: Hy sal saam met swart vennote werk wat mettertyd aangekondig sal word.
tgt: He will work with the Black Partners that will be announced in due course.

src: SAL sal bykomende finansiële bystand ten bedrae van R2 miljard van die regering ontvang om tot die radikale herstrukturering van die lugdiens by te dra.
tgt: The SAA will receive an additional R2 billion in financial assistance from government to contribute towards the radical restructuring of the airline.

src: Die bestaande SAL-leners sal ook ’n bykomende bedrag van R2 miljard voorsien.
tgt: Also, the existing SAA lenders will provide an additional R2 billion.

src: Die Kabinet is vol vertroue dat hierdie ingryping die lugredery se aansien sal herstel en ineenstorting van die redery, wat 'n negatiewe uitwerking op passasiers, verskaffers en ander vennote in die lugvaartbedryf en veral die arbeidsmag sou gehad het, sal voorkom.
tgt: Cabinet is confident that this intervention will restore the reputation of the airline and prevent the collapse which would have had a negative impact on passengers, suppliers and other partners in the aviation sector and importantly, the workforce.

src: Minister Gordhan sal die Kabinet gereeld op hoogte hou oor vordering rakende hierdie sakereddingsingryping.
tgt: Minister Gordhan will report progress regarding this Business Rescue intervention to Cabinet on a regular basis.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel teenoor almal wat geliefdes aan die dood afgestaan het as gevolg van die onlangse oorstromings, wat op verskeie plekke in die land voorgekom het.
tgt: FloodingCabinet sends condolences to those who lost their loved ones as a result of the recent floods experienced in various parts of the country.

src: Die regering koördineer ’n multidissiplinêre ingryping deur die Nasionale Rampbestuursentrum om te reageer op die vernietiging wat deur die vloede veroorsaak.
tgt: Government is coordinating a multidisciplinary intervention through the National Disaster Management Centre to respond to the devastation caused by these floods.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die ondersteuning van verskillende organisasies wat die vinnige hulpverlening gebied het.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the support of various organisations in providing rapid relief efforts.

src: Hulp met die ontruiming van mense uit geboue en die hervestiging van dié wat na gemeenskapsale en kerke verplaas is, het 'n ware gees van ubuntu (medemenslikheid) getoon.
tgt: The evacuation of people from buildings and relocation of people who were displaced in community halls and churches displayed a true spirit of Ubuntu (Humanity).

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op die publiek om ag te slaan op waarskuwings en wenke oor erge weersomstandighede.
tgt: Cabinet calls on the public to listen to alerts and tips on severe weather conditions.

src: Vinnig bewegende vloedwater is lewensgevaarlik en motoriste en voetgangers word gemaan om uiters versigtig te wees en roetes wat oorstroom is heeltemal te vermy.
tgt: Fast-moving flood water is life threatening and drivers and pedestrians are urged to be extremely careful and to completely avoid using routes which have been flooded.

src: Mese wat onder die vloedlyn van riviere en damme woon, word gewaarsku om op hul hoede te wees en om met die vroegste tekens van oorstromings na veilige plekke te gaan.
tgt: Residents who live below the flood line of rivers and dams are warned to be cautious and move to safer areas at the earliest sign of flooding.

src: Moenie jou lewe in gevaar stel deur in swaar reën in damme en riviere te swem nie.
tgt: Do not put your life at risk by swimming in dams and rivers during heavy rains.

src: Die Kabinet wens alle Suid-Afrikaners 'n veilige en voorspoedige feesgety toe.
tgt: Festive SeasonCabinet wishes all South Africans a safe and prosperous Festive Season.

src: As Suid-Afrikaners moet ons in hierdie tyd van vrolikheid steeds die beginsels van ubuntu aan mede-Suid-Afrikaners sowel as besoekers betoon.
tgt: As South Africans we must continue showing Ubuntu to fellow South Africans and our visitors during this period of merriment.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om alle verkeersreëls na te kom wanneer hulle na hul vakansiebestemmings reis, asook regdeur die feestyd.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to observe the rules of the road as they make their way to their holiday destination and throughout the festive season.

src: Die verantwoordelikheid om ’n bloedbad op ons paaie te voorkom, lê by elkeen van ons.
tgt: The responsibility to reduce the carnage on the roads lies with every one of us.

src: Verantwoordelike optrede op die pad behels dat jy nie drink en bestuur nie, snelheidsperke gehoorsaam, en bedagsaam is teenoor ander padgebruikers, insluitend voetgangers.
tgt: Responsible behaviour on the road includes no drinking and driving, driving within the speed limits, being considerate for other road users, including pedestrians.

src: Laat ons saamwerk om lewens te red #LiveBeyondDezemba # Arrive Alive.
tgt: Let us work together to save lives #LiveBeyondDezemba # Arrive Alive.

src: Die regering se “Veiliger Feestyd-bedrywighede” het reeds begin met die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens (SAPD) wat gedurende die feestyd in groot getalle op hulle poste is.
tgt: Government’s “Safer Festive Season Operations” has already started with the South African Police Service (SAPS) out in force during this period.

src: Burgers word aangemoedig om die MySAPS-mobiele app te gebruik, wat die eerste in sy soort in Afrika is.
tgt: Citizens are encouraged to use the MySAPS mobile App, which is the first of its kind on the African continent.

src: Die nuwe app stel mense in staat om doeltreffender met wetstoepassers te kommunikeer deur anonieme wenke te verskaf, uit te vind waar hul naaste polisiestasies is en om slagoffers van misdaad in staat te stel om tydens noodgevalle dadelik boodskappe te stuur.
tgt: The new App allows citizens to interact with law-enforcement officials more effectively by providing tip-offs anonymously, finding nearest police stations and facilities, and allowing a victim of crime to send messages instantly during an emergency.

src: Die Kabinet doen ook 'n beroep op ouers en voogde om te verseker dat kinders nie gedurende hierdie tyd sonder toesig gelaat word nie.
tgt: Cabinet also appeals to parents and guardians to ensure that children are not left unattended during this time.

src: Die Kabinet moedig Suid-Afrikaners aan om 'n Sho't Left te neem deur plaaslike besienswaardighede te besoek en plaaslike vermaak te ondersteun.
tgt: Cabinet encourages South Africans to take a Sho’t Left by visiting local attractions and support domestic events.

src: Die gebruik van geregistreerde toeroperateurs of toergidse sal veiligheid verseker en reiservarings verbeter.
tgt: The use of registered tour operators or tourist guides will ensure safety and enhance travel experiences.

src: Besonderhede van geregistreerde toergidse is op die verskillende webwerwe van die provinsiale toerismekantore beskikbaar.
tgt: Details of registered tourist guides can be found on the various Provincial Tourism Office websites.

src: 2019 Nasionale Seniorsertifikaat (NSS) -eksamenuitslae.
tgt: 2019 National Senior Certificate (NSC) Examination resultsCabinet thanks teachers, learners and parents for working with government to ensure the successful conclusion of the 2019 NSC Examinations.

src: Die Kabinet bedank onderwysers, leerders en ouers dat hulle met die regering saamgewerk het om te verseker dat die 2019 NSS-eksamens suksesvol afgeloop het.
tgt: Results will be announced on the evening of 7 January 2020 and matriculants are encouraged to visit the website of the Department of Basic Education (WEBTOKEN) or register via SMS by sending their ID number and Exam number to 3565.8 to get their results.

src: Die raamwerk voorsien vyf terreine wat gereguleer moet word, naamlik (1) die voedingsprotokol, wat die risiko van die biobrandstofprogram vir voedselsekerheid verminder.
tgt: The protocol mitigates the risk of the biofuels programme towards food security.

src: (2) Die verpligte vermengingregulasies om die vraag na biobrandstof te verseker.
tgt: (2) The mandatory blending regulations so as to create certainty of biofuels demand.

src: (3) Die kosteverhalingsmeganisme vir die vermenging van biobrandstof.
tgt: (3) The cost recovery mechanism for blending of biofuels.

src: (4) Die subsidiemeganisme vir biobrandstowwe vir die ondersteuning van biobrandstofboere en biobrandstofvervaardigers.
tgt: (4) The Biofuels subsidy mechanism for biofuels farmer support and biofuel manufacturer’s support.

src: (5) die keuringskriteria vir biobrandstofprojekte wat 'n subsidie benodig.
tgt: (5) the selection criteria for biofuel projects requiring a subsidy.

src: Die Kabinet keur die herinstelling van die Nasionale Veiligheidsraad goed om die koördinering van al die veiligheidswerk in die land te stroomlyn.
tgt: The framework document can be accessed through the Department of Energy website: WEBTOKENational Security CouncilCabinet approved the re-establishment of the National Security Council to streamline the coordination of all the security related work of the country.

src: Die raad sal verantwoordelik wees vir die goedkeuring van die nasionale veiligheidstrategie, die land se nasionale intelligensieprioriteite en die nasionale intelligensieramings.
tgt: The council will be responsible for the approval of the National Security Strategy, the National Intelligence priorities of the country and National Intelligence Estimates.

src: Die President sal in sy hoedanigheid as die opperbevelvoerder van die gewapende en veiligheidsmagte as voorsitter van die raad dien.
tgt: The council will be chaired by the President in his capacity as the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed and Security Forces.

src: Die ander lede van die raad sluit in Adjunkpresident Mabuza die Minister van Staatsveiligheid, Ayanda Dlodlo die Minister van Verdediging en Militêre Veterane, Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula die Minister van Binnelandse Sake Aaron Motsoaledi die Minister van Justisie en Korrektiewe Dienste, mnrRonald Lamola die Minister van Polisie, Bheki Cele die Minister van Finansies, Tito Mboweni en, die Minister van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake, Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma.
tgt: The other members of the council will be Deputy President Mabuza State Security Minister Ms Ayanda Dlodlo Defence and Military Veterans Minister Mrs Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula Home Affairs Minister Mr Aaron Motsoaledi Justice and Correctional Service Minister Mr Ronald Lamola Police Minister Mr Bheki Cele Finance Minister Mr Tito Mboweni and Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs Minister Ms Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma.

src: Die Kabinet keur die Witskrif oor Binnelandse Sake goed, sowel as die hoëvlak strategie en padkaart vir die herposisionering van die Departement van Binnelandse Sake as ’n kritieke instaatsteller van ekonomiese ontwikkeling en nasionale veiligheid.
tgt: White Paper on Home AffairsCabinet approved the White Paper on Home Affairs, as well as the high-level strategy and road map for repositioning the Department of Home Affairs as a critical enabler for economic development and national security.

src: Die Witskrif is gegrond op 'n beleidsbasis vir 'n gemoderniseerde en gedigitaliseerde regering, wat ’n stap nader is aan die verwesenliking van die doelstellings van e-regering en e-handel.
tgt: The White Paper is based on a policy foundation for a modernised and digitised government that takes us closer to realizing the objectives of e-Government and e-Commerce.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Madrid-ooreenkoms oor die Internasionale Registrasie van Handelsmerke (1989) aan die Parlement voorgelê word vir bekragtiging.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Madrid Agreement on the International Registration of Marks (1989) to Parliament for ratification.

src: Die Madrid-protokol behels die beskerming van handelsmerke.
tgt: The Madrid Protocol covers the protection of trade marks.

src: Handelsmerke bou handelsmerkherkenning en mededingende voordeel in die bemarking van goedere en dienste, plaaslik en internasionaal.
tgt: Trademarks build brand recognition and competitive advantage in marketing goods and services both locally and internationally.

src: Toetrede tot die Madrid-protokol sal dit moontlik maak om die land se beleid vir intellektuele eiendom (IP) te bevorder.
tgt: Accession to the Madrid Protocol will enable the advancement of the country’s Intellectual Property (IP) Policy.

src: Dit sal Suid-Afrikaanse ondernemings, veral kleinsakeondernemings, 'n geleentheid bied om die IP-stelsel te gebruik om hul goedere en dienste internasionaal te bemark.
tgt: It will offer South African businesses particularly the small businesses an avenue to use the IP system to market their goods and services internationally.

src: Passasierspooragentskap van Suid-Afrika (Prasa).
tgt: Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa (PRASA)Cabinet approved the dissolution of the Interim Board of PRASA and placing of the entity under administration.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat Prasa se Interimdireksie ontbind word en dat die entiteit onder administrasie geplaas word.
tgt: South Africa needs a reliable, economical and smooth flowing rail corridors that acts as the backbone of public transport in linking the various modes of transport.

src: Suid-Afrika het betroubare, ekonomiese en vloeiende spoordeurgange nodig, wat as die ruggraat vir openbare vervoer kan dien om die verskillende maniere van vervoer te verbind.
tgt: The Auditor-General’s recent outcomes for 2018/19 reported serious governance failures at PRASA, lack of effective financial management process resulting in PRASA obtaining a Disclaimer Audit WEBTOKEN this effect, Cabinet approved the appointment of an Administrator, Mr Bongisizwe Mpondo, to administer the affairs of the entity for 12 months.

src: Die Kabinet het derhalwe die aanstelling van 'n administrateur, mnrBongisizwe Mpondo, goedgekeur om die entiteit se bedrywighede vir 12 maande te administreer.
tgt: Cabinet also approved the appointment of Mr Newyear Niniva Ntuli as the Administrator and Accounting Authority of the Universal Service and Access Agency of South Africa for 24 months.

src: Die Kabinet keur ook goed dat mnrNewyear Niniva Ntuli as die administrateur en rekenpligtige owerheid van die Agentskap vir Universele Dienste en Toegang van Suid-Afrika vir 24 maande aangestel word.
tgt: The following Ministers were directed to do further work in this regard: Social Development Minister Ms Lindiwe Zulu Justice and Correctional Services Minister Mr Ronald Lamola Police Minister Mr Bheki Cele Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities Minister Mrs Maite Nkoana-Mashabane.

src: Die Kabinet keur die publikasie van die Wetsontwerp op Slagofferondersteuningsdienste van 2019 vir openbare kommentaar goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the publication of the Municipal Fiscal Powers and Functions Amendment Bill for public comment.

src: Die Kabinet keur ook die Wetsontwerp op Maatskaplike-dienste-praktisyns van 2019 goed vir openbare kommentaar.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission to Parliament the Auditing Profssion Amendment Bill.

src: Die wetsontwerp is daarop gerig om die regulering van maatskaplike-dienste-praktisyns uit te brei deur te erken dat daar professionele sowel as hulpvlakke binne die maatskaplikediensberoepe is.
tgt: The Bill amends the Auditing Profssion Act, 2005 (Act 26 of 2005).

src: Verklaring oor die Kabinetsvergadering wat op Woensdag, 12 Februarie 2020 by die Parlement, Tuynhuys in Kaapstad gehou isKwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Statement on the Cabinet Meeting held on Wednesday, 12 February 2020 at Parliament, Tuynhuys in Cape TownIssues in the environment.

src: 2020 Staatsrede (SoNA).
tgt: 2020 State of the Nation Address (SoNA).

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die 2020-Staatsrede wat op Donderdag, 13 Februarie 2020, deur President Cyril Ramaphosa by die Gesamentlike Sitting van die twee huise in die Parlement, Kaapstad gelewer is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the 2020 SoNA delivered by President Cyril Ramaphosa at a Joint Sitting of the two houses in Parliament, Cape Town on Thursday, 13 February 2020.

src: Die Staatsrede is gelewer ter viering van die 30ste herdenking van die vrylating van die Vader van ons Nasie, Tata Madiba, wat op 11 Februarie 1990 as 'n vry man uit die Victor Verster-gevangenis gestap het.
tgt: The address was delivered following the 30th anniversary of the release of the Father of the Nation, Tata Madiba, who walked free from Victor Verster Prison on 11 February 1990.

src: President Ramaphosa se 2020-Staatsrede het 'n omvattende Program van Aksie (PvA) uiteengesit, wat daarna sal streef om die land se sukkelende ekonomie 'n hupstoot te gee deur die fundamentee ekonomiese grondslae reg te stel.
tgt: President Ramaphosa’s 2020 SoNA provided an elaborate government Programme of Action (PoA) that will seek to ramp up the country’s ailing economy by fixing the economic fundamentals.

src: Die volgende paar maande sal gekenmerk word deur die implementering van maatreëls wat die trajek van energieopwekking en -verkryging in die land fundamenteel sal verander.
tgt: The next few months will see the implementation of measures that will fundamentally change the trajectory of energy generation and procurement in the country.

src: Die President het planne uitgelig om plaaslike produksie 'n hupstoot te gee, wat klein, medium- en mikro-ondernemings (KMMO's) sal bemagtig.
tgt: The President highlighted plans to boost local production that will empower small, medium and micro enterprises (SMMEs).

src: Mer as 1 000 plaaslik vervaardigde produkte sal deur hierdie KMMO's verkry word.
tgt: Over 1 000 locally produced products will be procured through these SMMEs.

src: Hierdie inisiatiewe sal deel vorm van innoverende maniere om jeugentrepreneurskap en selfindiensneming te ondersteun.
tgt: These initiatives will form part of the innovative ways to support youth entrepreneurship and self-employment.

src: Die nuwe Tegniese en Beroepsonderwys en -opleidingskampusse (TBOO-kampusse) wat vanjaar gebou gaan word, sal help om die gaping tussen jeugwerkloosheid en vaardighede te oorbrug.
tgt: The new Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) college campuses to be built this year will assist in bridging the gap between youth unemployment and skills.

src: Die Jeugindiensnemingsdiens, saam met die TBOO-kolleges en die privaat sektor, sal verseker dat meer leerders praktiese werkplekervaring as deel van hul opleiding ontvang.
tgt: The Youth Employment Service, together with the TVET colleges and the private sector, will ensure that more learners receive practical workplace experience as part of their training.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom ook die aankondiging van die SheTradesZA-platform, wat ondernemings in besit van vroue sal help om by internasionale waardekettings en markte in te skakel.
tgt: Cabinet also welcomes the announcement to set up the SheTradesZA platform which will assist women-owned businesses to participate in global value chains and markets.

src: Die Distriksontwikkelingsmodel wat verlede jaar in een metro en twee distriksmunisipaliteite geloods is, sal vanjaar verder in alle distrikte en metro's geïmplementeer word.
tgt: The District Development Model that was piloted last year in one metro and two district municipalities will this year be rolled out in all districts and metros.

src: Dit sal uitvoering gee aan 'n holistiese diensleweringsmodel bestaande uit een plan, wat deur al drie regeringsfere ondersteun word.
tgt: This will give effect to a holistic service delivery model that encompasses one plan supported by all three spheres of government.

src: Die President se toespraak het almal geïnspireer om te verenig en vooruit te streef om ons uitdagings te oorwin en 'n florerende Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie te bou.
tgt: The President’s address has inspired all to unite and forge ahead towards overcoming our challenges and build a thriving South African democracy.

src: Die Kabinet nooi alle sektore van die samelewing uit om in vennootskap met die regering die Plan van Aksie te implementeer.
tgt: Cabinet invites all sectors of society to partner with government in implementing government’s PoDuring the debates in Parliament this week, members of the Executive will further unpack the PoA to be rolled out in the current financial year and beyond.

src: Beraad van die Afrika-unie (AU) Die Kabinet wens President Ramaphosa geluk met sy aanvaarding van die AU-voorsitterskap namens Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates President Ramaphosa on assuming the AU Chairship on behalf of South Africa.

src: Die President sal sy rol gebruik ter bevordering van vrede en stabiliteit, goeie bestuur, geslagsgelykheid en die bemagtiging van vroue ten einde Afrika se ekonomie te laat groei.
tgt: The President will use his role to advance peace and stability, good governance, gender equality and the empowerment of women to grow Africa’s economy.

src: Later vanjaar sal die Afrika Kontinentale Vryhandelgebied-ooreenkoms (AfCFTA) ook in werking tree.
tgt: Later this year the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) Agreement also comes into effect.

src: Hierdie ooreenkoms bring 'n enkele mark oor 64 nasies van ongeveer 1,2 miljard mense byeen, met 'n gekombineerde bruto binnelandse produk van meer as US$3 triljoen.
tgt: This agreement converges into a single market across 54 nations of about 1,2 billion people with a combined gross domestic product of over US$3 trillion.

src: Suid Afrika, as die Voorsitter, sal 'n beraad aanbied om die AfCFTA-implementeringsprotokol te finaliseer.
tgt: As the Chair, South Africa will host a summit to finalise the AfCFTA protocol of implementation.

src: Suid-Afrika sal ook in hierdie hoedanigheid 'n standvastige en vreedsame Afrika nastreef onder die tema: “Silencing the Guns: Creating Conducive Conditions for Africa’s Development”.
tgt: South Africa will also work towards a stable and peaceful Africa under the theme: “Silencing the Guns: Creating Conducive Conditions for Africa’s Development”.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom ook die herlewing van die Afrika Diaspora-agenda.
tgt: Cabinet also welcomes the resuscitation of the African Diaspora Agenda.

src: Die grootte van die Afrika Diaspora, en die vaardighede en hulpbronne wat dit bevat, noodsaak doeltreffende betrokkenheidsmeganismes om hierdie potensiaal te ontsluit ter bevordering van die ontwikkeling van die vasteland.
tgt: The size of the African Diaspora, and the skills and resources it contains, necessitate effective engagement mechanisms to harness this potential to advance the development of this continent.

src: Duitse ampsbesoek.
tgt: German Official Visit.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die uitkomste van die Duitse Kanselier Angela Mekel se ampsbesoek, wat bestaande betrekkinge tussen die twee lande verstewig het.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the outcomes of the Official Visit by German Chancellor Angela Merkel, which strengthened existing relations between the two countries.

src: Kanselier Mekel het Suid-Afrika op uitnodiging van President Ramaphosa vanaf 5 tot 7 Februarie 2020 besoek.
tgt: Chancellor Merkel visited South Africa at the invitation of President Ramaphosa from 5 to 7 February 2020.

src: Suid-Afrika het die geleentheid gebruik om inligting oor die talle beleggingsgeleenthede wat in die land beskikbaar is, te deel.
tgt: South Africa used the opportunity to share the many investment opportunities available in the country.

src: Dit is gedoen tydens 'n sakeforum wat bygewoon is deur sowel Suid-Afrikaanse leiers as die sake-afvaardiging wat Kanselier Mekel vergesel het.
tgt: This was done during a Business Forum comprising both South African leaders and the business delegation accompanying Chancellor Merkel.

src: Duitsland is een van die grootste beleggers in Suid-Afrika, met meer as 600 maatskappye in ons land.
tgt: As one of the biggest investors in South Africa, Germany has over 600 companies in our country.

src: Sosiale-kompakkonvensie oor SosialeSamehorigheid en Nasiebou Die Kabinet sluit hul by President Ramaphosa aan om die uitkomste van die Sosiale-kompakonvensie oor Sosiale Samehorigheid en Nasiebou wat onder die tema: “Die Dekade van Eenheid en Vernuwing: Na 'n Sosiale Kompak vir Samehorigheid en Nasiebou” gehou is.
tgt: Social Compact Convention on Social Cohesion and Nation-Building.

src: Onder die leierskap van die Departement van Sport, Kuns en Kultuur – saam met die Presidensie en ander sleutelbelanghebbers – het die sakesektor, regering, arbeid en burgerlike samelewing hulle verbind tot samewerking om 'n samehorige samelewing te bou en vryheid, vrede en sekuriteit asook respek vir menseregte te bevorder.
tgt: Cabinet joins President Ramaphosa in welcoming the outcomes of the Social Compact Convention on Social Cohesion and Nation-Building held under the theme: “The Decade of Unity and Renewal: Towards a Social Compact for Cohesion and Nation-Building”.

src: Die sosiale kompak is 'n verdere uitbreiding van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan, wat die behoefte aan vennootskappe om Suid-Afrika te laat groei, bepleit, teen die agtergrond van die sosio-historiese verdelings in die samelewing, veral op grond van ras, wat vandag steeds voortduur.
tgt: Under the leadership of the Department of Sports, Arts and Culture – together with The Presidency and other key stakeholders – business, government, labour and civil society agreed to work together to build a cohesive society and advance freedom, peace and security as well as respect for all human rights.

src: Koronavirus.
tgt: Coronavirus.

src: Die Kabinet bevestig dat al die gesondheidsinstellings in die land op ŉ hoë gereedheidsgrondslag is om moontlike gevalle van die koronavirus te hanteer.
tgt: Cabinet reaffirms that all the country’s health facilities are on high alert to deal with any eventuality of the Coronavirus.

src: Geen gevalle of vermoedelike gevalle van die virus is al aangemeld nie, en die Kabinet herbeklemtoon die boodskap van die Minister van Gesondheid, Dr Zweli Mkhize, dat alle moontlike maatreëls getref is om enige infeksies in die land te voorkom.
tgt: There are no reports or suspected cases of the virus and Cabinet reiterates the message of the Minister of Health, Dr Zweli Mkhize, that all measures have been put in place to prevent any infections in the country.

src: Al ons inklaringshawens is op ŉ hoë gereedheidsgrondslag en professionele gesondheidswerkers monitor alle internasionale reisigers se koors.
tgt: All our ports of entry are on high alert and health professionals are conducting temperature screening for all international travellers.

src: Daarbenewens het Suid-Afrika ook kliniese riglyne en gevaldefinisies ontwikkel en aan dokters en verpleegsters in sowel die openbare as privaat sektor versprei.
tgt: In addition, South Africa has developed and distributed clinical guidelines and case definitions to doctors and nurses in both the public and private sectors.

src: Alle provinsies het reaksiespanne geaktiveer, en is op ŉ hoë gereedheidsgrondslag om gevalle wat moontlik wel in die land mag ontstaan, te identifiseer en bestuur.
tgt: All provinces have activated outbreak response teams, and are on high alert to detect and manage inadvertent cases that may arise in the country.

src: 'n Aantal hospitale regoor die land is ook as kwarantynsentrums geïdentifiseer om enigiemand wat dalk met die koronavirus besmet mag wees, te behandel.
tgt: A number of hospitals have also been identified across the country as centres to quarantine and treat anyone who may be infected with the Coronavirus.

src: Ons monitor die situasie noukeurig deur ons ambassade in China en ons is daarvan oortuig dat ons voorbereid is om studente en ander Suid-Afrikaanse burgers wat hul tans in Wuhan, China bevind, te ontruim indien nodig.
tgt: Through our Embassy in China we are closely monitoring the situation and we are confident that we are prepared to evacuate students and other South African citizens currently in Wuhan, China should the need arise.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet decisions.

src: Verdrag oor Vriendskap en Samewerking in Suidoos-Asië (TAC).
tgt: Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC).

src: Die Kabinet keur Suid-Afrika se toetrede tot die TAC goed, wat vir bekragtiging aan die Parlement voorgelê sal word.
tgt: Cabinet approved South Africa’s accession to the TAC which will be submitted to Parliament for ratification.

src: Die Vereniging van Suidoos-Asiatiese Nasies (ASEAN) is een van die mees snelgroeiende en dinamiese streke in die wêreld.
tgt: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) comprises one of the fastest-growing and dynamic regions in the world.

src: Toetrede tot die TAC sal aan Suid-Afrikaanse ondernemings strategiese toegang tot daardie streek verleen, en ook aan die ASEAN-lande toegang tot Suid-Afrikaanse markte en die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap se streeksmarkte gee.
tgt: Accession to the TAC will strategically afford South African business the opportunity to access that region, and the ASEAN countries to access South African and Southern African Development Community regional markets.

src: 6de Verenigde Nasies (VN) Simposium van die Internasionale Vennootskap vir Tegnologie in Vredesbewaring Die Kabinet verleen goedkeuring dat Suid-Afrika vanaf 23 tot 26 Junie 2020 as gasheer optree van die 6de Verenigde Nasies (VN) Simposium van die Internasionale Vennootskap vir Tegnologie in Vredesbewaring.
tgt: 6th United Nations (UN) International Partnership for Technology in Peacekeeping Symposium.

src: Hoewel verskeie lande in die verlede gasheer vir hierdie geleentheid was, sal dit die eerste keer wees dat dit in Afrika aangebied word.
tgt: Although various countries have hosted this event in the past, this will be the first time it is hosted in Africa.

src: Die simposium sal bydra tot konflikoplossing op die vasteland, asook die handhawing van vrede en sekuriteit en heropbouing en ontwikkling ná konflikoplossing.
tgt: The symposium contributes to improving the continent towards conflict prevention, peacekeeping, security and post-conflict reconstruction and development.

src: Die simposium sal vanjaar op oplossings fokus deur die gebruik van moderne tegnologieë en konsepte in veldmissies onder VN-leiding te bevorder.
tgt: The focus this year will be finding solutions by promoting the use of modern technologies and concepts in the UN-led field missions.

src: Tydens die simposium sal Suid-Afrika die geleentheid kry om sy plaaslik ontwikkelde tegnologieprodukte en die land se verdedigingbedryfsvermoëns te bevorder.
tgt: During this symposium, South Africa will be able to promote its locally developed technology products and the country’s defence industrial capabilities.

src: Wetsontwerpe.
tgt: Bills.

src: Wetsontwerp op Openbare Verkryging.
tgt: Public Procurement Bill.

src: Die Kabinet keur die publikasie van die Wetsontwerp op Openbare Verkryging vir openbare kommentaar goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved the publication of the Public Procurement Bill for public comment.

src: Sodra die Wetsontwerp verorden is, sal dit die Wet op die Beleidsraamwerk vir Voorkeurverkryging, 2000 (Wet 5 van 2000) herroep en ander verkrygingsverwante wette wysig.
tgt: Once passed into law, the Bill will repeal the Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, 2000 (Act 5 of 2000) and amend other procurement-related laws.

src: Die Wetsontwerp stel 'n enkele regulerende raamwerk vir openbare verkryging voor.
tgt: The Bill proposes a single regulatory framework of public procurement.

src: Dit stel 'n verkrygingsowerheid in om Artikel 217 van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika regoor die regering heen te reguleer en te bevorder.
tgt: It establishes the procurement authority to regulate and promote Section 217 of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996 across government.

src: Dit maak voorsiening vir meer buigsame wetgewing vir voorkeurverkrygingstrategieë, ter ondersteuning van die regering se sosio-ekonomiese doelwitte.
tgt: It provides for a more flexible legislation for preferential procurement strategies in support of government’s socio-economic objectives.

src: Wysigingswetsontwerp op Gelyke Indiensneming van 2020.
tgt: Employment Equity Amendment Bill of 2020.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Gelyke Indiensneming, 2020 in die Parlement ter tafel gelê word.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the Employment Equity Amendment Bill of 2020 to Parliament.

src: Die wysigings bemagtig die Minister van Indiensneming en Arbeid, in oorleg met sektorale belanghebbers, om instaatstellende bepalings vir die vasstelling van sektor-spesifieke numeriese mikpunte vir gelyke indiensneming in te voer.
tgt: The amendments will empower the Minister of Employment and Labour, in consultation with sector stakeholders, to introduce enabling provisions for the setting of sector-specific Employment Equity numerical targets.

src: Dit verlig ook die reguleringslas op klein werkgewers.
tgt: It also reduces the regulatory burden on small employers.

src: Die wysigingwsetsontwerp bevorder gelyke geleenthede en billike behandeling met indiensneming deur die uitskakeling van onbillike diskriminasie.
tgt: The Bill promotes equal opportunity and fair treatment in employment through the elimination of unfair discrimination.

src: Wysigingswetsontwerp op die Opgradering van Grondbesitregte.
tgt: Upgrading of Land Tenure Rights Amendment Bill.

src: Die Kabinet keur die publikasie van die Wysigingswetsontwerp op die Opgradering van Grondbesitregte vir openbare kommentaar goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved publication of the Upgrading of Land Tenure Rights Amendment Bill for public comment.

src: Die wetsontwerp maak voorsiening vir 'n grondwetlik toelaatbare prosedure vir die bepaling van eiendomsreg en die reg op besetting van grond en regstelling van die grondwetlike ongeldigheid van twee artikels van die Wet op die Opgradering van Grondbesitregte, 1991 (Wet 112 van 1991).
tgt: The Bill provides for a constitutionally permissible procedure for the determination of rights of ownership and occupation of land to remedy the constitutional invalidity of two sections of the Upgrading of Land Tenure Rights Act, 1991 (Act 112 of 1991).

src: Die huidige reëling diskrimineer teen vroue in die omskakeling van die grondbesitregte in eiendomsreg.
tgt: The current arrangement discriminates against women in the conversion of the land tenure rights into ownership.

src: Die Wetsontwerp verseker ook dat die Wet op die hele land van toepassing sal wees, aangesien die Wet voorheen nie op die destydse "onafhanklike state" van Bophuthatswana, Ciskei, Transkei en Venda van toepassing was nie.
tgt: The Bill also ensures application to the entire country, where previously the Act did not apply to the former ‘independent states’ of Bophuthatswana, Ciskei, Transkei and Venda.

src: Wetsontwerp op Handelskeepvaart van 2020.
tgt: Merchant Shipping Bill of 2020.

src: Die Kabinet keur die publikasie van die Wetsontwerp op Handelskeepvaart van 2020 vir openbare kommentaar goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved publication of the Merchant Shipping Bill of 2020 for public comment.

src: Die Wetsontwerp wil gevolg gee aan die regering se visie om die maritieme vervoersektor te laat herleef, en sy bydrae tot groei en die radikale ekonomiese transformasie van die land te verbeter.
tgt: The Bill seeks to give effect to the government vision to revive the maritime transport sector, and enhance its contribution to growth and radical transformation of the economy.

src: Dit is in ooreenstemming met die skeepvaartbepalings van die Omvattende Maritieme Vervoerbeleid wat in 2017 deur die Kabinet goedgekeur is.
tgt: It aligns to the shipping provisions of the Comprehensive Maritime Transport Policy which was approved by Cabinet in 2017.

src: Sodra die wetsontwerp verorden is, sal dit 'n aantal verwante mariene wetgewing herroep.
tgt: Once approved into law, the Bill will repeal a number of related marine legislations.

src: Wetsontwerp op Spoorveiligheid van 2020.
tgt: Railway Safety Bill of 2020.

src: Die Kabinet keur die voorlegging van die Wetsontwerp op Spoorveiligheid, 2020 aan die Parlement goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved submission of the Railway Safety Bill of 2020 to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp het ten doel om spoorveiligheid te verbeter en te verseker dat spoorvervoer 'n aantreklike vervoermetode is, wat 'n positiewe bydrae tot ons ekonomie lewer.
tgt: The Bill seeks to strengthen the safety of our railway and ensure rail becomes an attractive mode of transport that is also able to positively contribute to the economy.

src: Die wetsontwerp is aanvanklik in Februarie 2018 vir openbare oorlegpleging goedgekeur en is in Maart 2018 in alle provinsies vir openbare oorlegpleging uitgereik.
tgt: The Bill was first approved for public consultation in February 2018 and went out for public consultation in all provinces in March 2018.

src: Die goedgekeurde wetsontwerp vir voorlegging aan die Parlement het insette wat tydens die openbare oorlegpleging ontvang is, in aanmerking geneem.
tgt: The approved Bill to be submitted to Parliament has taken into account inputs received during the public consultation.

src: Die parlementêre proses sal ook die wetsontwerp verfyn voordat dit tot Wet verorden word.
tgt: The parliamentary process will also refine the Bill before it is passed into law.

src: Wysigingswetsontwerp op die Vervoerappèltribunaal van 2018.
tgt: Transport Appeal Tribunal Amendment Bill of 2018.

src: Die Kabinet keur die voorlegging van die Wysigignswetsontwerp op die Vervoerappèltribunaal van 2018 aan die Parlement goed.
tgt: Cabinet approved submission of the Transport Appeal Tribunal Amendment Bill of 2018 to Parliament.

src: Die Wysigingswetsontwerp wysig die Wet op die Vervoerappèltribunaal, 1998 (Wet 39 van 1998), wat handel oor appèlle rakende aansoeke vir padvervoerpermitte (nou bedryfslisensies genoem).
tgt: The Bill amends the Transport Appeal Tribunal Act, 1998 (Act 39 of 1998) which deals with appeals relating to applications for road carrier permits (now called operating licences).

src: Die wysiging neem beleidsveranderings, ontwikkelings en nuwe wetgewing sedert 1998 in aanmerking.
tgt: The amendment takes into account policy changes, developments and new legislation since 1998.

src: Die wetsontwerp vereenvoudig en verbeter appèlprosedures, wat tot koste- en tydsbesparings sal lei en operateurs van oorgrens- en binnelandse padvervoer beter sal toerus om passasiers doeltreffend te vervoer en 'n bestaan te maak.
tgt: The Bill streamlines and improves appeal procedures, which will result in savings of costs and time, and better enabling operators of cross-border and domestic road transport to convey passengers efficiently and make a living for themselves.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Messages.

src: Gelukwense.
tgt: Congratulations.

src: Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense oor aan: die span van Suid-Afrikaanse Graad 11-leerders: Sureshka Naidoo Caitlin Schwarer Nondumiso Ntshangase Nosipho Dube Mihlali Precious Stofile Ondele Bede Okhela Sigwela en Lizalise Dlomo, wat die 5de Internasionale Skynhofkompetisie vir Skole in Pole gewen het.
tgt: Cabinet extends its congratulations to:the team of South African Grade 11 learners: Sureshka Naidoo Caitlin Schwarer Nondumiso Ntshangase Nosipho Dube Mihlali Precious Stofile Ondele Bede Okhela Sigwela and Lizalise Dlomo, who won the 5th International School Moot Court Competition in Poland.

src: Suid-Afrikaanse swemmer Natalie du Toit, wat deurgedring het tot die finale vyf kandidate vir die Laureus Sportoombliktoekenning van die afgelope 20 jaar (2000-2020).
tgt: South African swimmer Natalie du Toit for being been voted through to the final five candidates for the Laureus Sporting Moment Award of the last 20 years (2000-2020).

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy medelye met die:familie en vriende van professor Joseph Shabalala, die legendariese musikant en stigter van die groep Ladysmith Black Mambazo, wat met ’n Grammy-toekenning bekroon is.
tgt: Cabinet sent condolences to the:family and friends of Profssor Joseph Shabalala, the legendary musician and founder of the Grammy Award winning group Ladysmith Black Mambazo.

src: Sy musiek het talle mense regoor die wêreld geïnspireer en Suid-Afrikaners verenig.
tgt: His music inspired countless people around the world and united South Africans.

src: President Ramaphosa het 'n spesiale amptelike kategorie 2-begrafnis toegestaan om professor Shabalala te vereer.
tgt: President Ramaphosa has declared a Special Official Funeral Category 2 to honour Profssor Shabalala.

src: die regering en mense van Kenia, met die afsterwe van die voormalige Keniaanse President Sy Eksellensie Daniel Toroitich Arap Moi, wat as Kenia se tweede President ná bevryding gedien het.
tgt: government and people of Kenya at the passing of former Kenyan President His Excellency Daniel Toroitich Arap Moi, who served as Kenya’s second post-liberation WEBTOKEN and friends of Captain Thabiso Collins Tolo (49), First Officer Tebogo Caroline Lekalakala (33) and Flight Inspector Gugu Comfort Mnguni (36), whose plane crashed into mountainous terrain near Mossel Bay in the Western Cape on 23 January 2020.

src: familie en vriende van Kaptein Thabiso Collins Tolo (49), Eerste Offisier Tebogo Caroline Lekalakala (33) en Vluginspekteur Gugu Comfort Mnguni (36), wie se vliegtuig op 23 Januarie 2020 in bergagtige terrein naby Mosselbaai in die Wes-Kaap neergestort het.
tgt: At the time of their death they were based at the South African Civil Aviation WEBTOKEN and friends of Mr Marcelino dos Santos, one of the founders of the Mozambique Liberation Front (FRELIMO), who died at the age of The historic leader was also one of the symbols of African nationalism.

src: familie en vriende van mnrMarcelino dos Santos, een van die stigters van die Mosambiekse Bevrydingsbeweging (FRELIMO), wat in die ouderdom van 90 oorlede is.
tgt: He was a veteran of the armed liberation struggle of Mozambique, and was also a politician and poet who signed his texts with the pseudonyms of Lilinho Micaia and Kalungano.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderworpe aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die toepaslike klaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
