tgt: Applications for special votes opened on 20 September 2021 and will close on 4 October 2021 at 17:00.

src: Geslagsgebaseerde geweld en moord op vrouens (GBVF).
tgt: Gender-based violence and femicide (GBVF).

src: Die kabinet het die dubbele lewenslange gevangenisstraf verwelkom wat deur die Mpumalanga Afdeling van die Hooggeregshof op Maandag 13 September 2021 aan mnr Sbusiso Nkosi (36) opgelê is, vir die verkragting en moord van me.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the double life sentence handed down to Mr Sbusiso Nkosi (36) by the Mpumalanga Division of the High Court on Monday, 13 September 2021, for the rape and murder of Ms Nomcebo Simelane (23) on 5 September 2020.

src: Die hof het die verkragter en moordenaar tot twee keer lewenslange gevangenisstraf gevonnis en ‘n addisionele drie jaar gevangenisstraf vir diefstal, wat samelopend uitgedien sal word.
tgt: The court sentenced the rapist and murderer to two life imprisonment terms and an additional three years’ imprisonment for theft, which will run concurrently.

src: Dit is ‘n ferm waarskuwing aan almal wat geslagsgebaseerde geweld pleeg dat hulle gearresteer sal word en met die volle mag van die wet te doen sal kry.
tgt: This is a firm warning to all perpetrators of GBVF that they will be arrested and face the full might of the law.

src: Deur met die polisie en wetstoepassingsagentskappe saam te werk, kan ons ons strate en gemeenskappe veiliger maak vir almal.
tgt: By working together with the police and law-enforcement agencies, we can make our streets and communities safer for all.

src: Rapporteer alle GBVF-verwante insidente aan die polisie of skakel die Nasionale GBVF Bevelsentrum by: 0800 428 428 of STOP Gender Violence Helpline: 0800 150 150 / *120*7867#10.
tgt: Report all GBVF-related incidents to the police or call the National GBVF Command Centre: 0800 428 428 or STOP Gender Violence Helpline: 0800 150 150 / *120*7867#9.

src: Registrasie van gewoontehuwelike.
tgt: Registration of customary marriages.

src: Die kabinet het kennis geneem van die Hooggeregshof van KwaZulu-Natal se uitspraak in die saak tussen die applikant, me Phumza Ethel Mankayi, en die respondente, die Minister van Binnelandse Sake, me Ntombizakhe Portia Miya en die Mester van die Hooggeregshof van Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Cabinet noted the High Court, KwaZulu-Natal Division judgment in the matter involving the applicant, Ms Phumza Ethel Mankayi and the respondents, the Minister of Home Affairs, Ms Ntombizakhe Portia Miya and the Master of the High Court of South Africa.

src: Die uitspraak bevestig die regte van mense wat getroud is onder die Wet op die Erkenning van Gewoontehuwelike, 1998 (Wet 120 van 1998).
tgt: The judgment affirms the rights of people married under the Recognition of Customary Marriages Act, 1998 (Act 120 of 1998).

src: Die kabinet doen ‘n beroep op paartjies om hulle gewoontehuwelike binne drie maande na die sluiting van die huwelik by Binnelandse Sake te registreer.
tgt: Cabinet calls on couples to register their customary marriages at Home Affairs within three months of their marriage.

src: Die Minister van Binnelandse Sake het die registrasietydperk verleng na 30 June 2024.
tgt: The Minister of Home Affairs has extended the registration period to 30 June 2024.

src: Dit is om voorsiening te maak vir diegene wie se huwelike nie binne drie maande geregistreer is nie.
tgt: This is to cater for those whose marriages that were not registered within three months.

src: Om te registreer, moet mense hulle bewys van die lobola-onderhandelinge bring of ‘n brief en ‘n beëdigde verklaring van die mense wat getroud is sowel as hulle getuies, wat aandui dat ‘n huwelik gesluit is.
tgt: To register, people need to bring proof of lobola negotiations or a letter and an affidavit from people getting married and their witnesses, indicating that a marriage was entered into or celebrated.

src: Tot op datum is slegs 99 491 gewoontehuwelike by Binnelandse Sake geregistreer sedert die wet in November 2000 in werking getree het.
tgt: To date, only 99 491 customary marriages have been registered at Home Affairs since the law came into effect in November 2000.Cabinet decisions.

src: Suid-Afrika Beleggingskonferensie (SABK).
tgt: South Africa Investment Conference (SAIC).

src: Die kabinet het die volgende SABK geskeduleer om in Maart 2022 plaas te vind.
tgt: Cabinet approved the scheduling of the next SAIC to take place in March 2022.

src: Die konferensie vind al die derde keer plaas en poog om R1,2 biljoen se beleggings oor vyf jaar te lok.
tgt: The conference is on its third year and aims to attract R1,2 trillion investments over five years.

src: Die beleggingsveldtog bou voort op die twee vorige suksesvolle SABK’s.
tgt: The investment drive continues to build on the two previous successful SAICs.

src: Die besonderhede en datum van die konferensie sal op ‘n later stadium bekendgemaak word.
tgt: The details of the conference and date will be announced at a later stage.

src: Digitale Uitsaaimigrasieprogram (BDM).
tgt: Broadcasting Digital Migration (BDM) programme Cabinet was apprised on the country’s BDM programme.

src: Die kabinet is op hoogte gebring van die land se Digitale Uitsaaimigrasieprogram.
tgt: Substantial progress has been made in migrating some parts of the country from analogue to digital platforms.

src: Die kabinet het die hersiene geïntegreerde analoog-afskakelimplementeringsplan goedgekeur, wat ‘n skedule is om die oorblywende areas teen Maart 2022 te voltooi.
tgt: Cabinet approved the revised integrated analogue switch-off implementation plan, which is a schedule to complete the remaining areas by March 2022.

src: Suid-Afrika is een van talle lande in die wêreld wat hulle daartoe verbind het om die digitale migrasieprojek te bespoedig, wat sal lei tot ‘n algehele analoogafskakeling in 2022.
tgt: South Africa is one of many countries in the world that have committed to expedite the digital migration project, which will lead to a complete analogue switch-off in 2022.

src: Die kabinet het die samewerkende benadering tot die bespoediging van die finalisering van die migrasie van die hele land na digitale platforms goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet endorsed the collaborative approach adopted towards fast-tracking the finalisation of the migration of the whole country from analogue to digital platforms.

src: Nasionale Beleid vir die Voorkoming en Bestuur van Leerderswangerskappe in Skole.
tgt: National Policy on the Prevention and Management of Learner Pregnancy in Schools Cabinet approved the National Policy on the Prevention and Management of Learner Pregnancy in Schools.

src: Die kabinet het die Nasionale Beleid vir die Voorkoming en Bestuur van Leerderswangerskappe in Skole goedgekeur.
tgt: The policy responds to the 2012 Court Judgement that ruled against the Department of Basic Education on certain clauses that called for learners to take leave of absence from school for up to two years post-delivery.

src: Die beleid maak voorsiening vir ‘n bemagtigende omgewing om leerders te ondersteun en om diskriminasie teen swanger leerlinge te voorkom.
tgt: The policy provides for an enabling environment to support learners and prevent discrimination against pregnant learners.

src: Dit maak ook voorsiening vir toegang tot omvattende swangerskapsvoorkomingsinligting, berading en sorggewingsriglyne, sowel as die opstel van beleidsbestuur- en koördineringstrukture.
tgt: It also provides for access to comprehensive pregnancy prevention information counselling and care guidelines, as well as the setting up of policy management and coordinating structures.

src: Die beleid is aan omvattende konsultasie deur die betrokke belanghebbendes onderwerp en is in pas met die relevante wetgewing.
tgt: The policy has gone through extensive consultation with all relevant stakeholders and is aligned with all relevant laws.

src: Aanvaarding van die Opvoedkundige, Wetenskaplike en Kulturele Organisasie van die Verenigde Nasies (UNESCO) se Konvensie vir die Beveiliging van die Ontasbare Kulturele Erfenis (ICH) van 2003.
tgt: Accession to the 2003 United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) Convention for the Safeguarding of Intangible Cultural Heritage (ICH).

src: Die kabinet het die aanvaarding van UNESCO se Konvensie vir die Beveiliging van ICH van 2003 goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved South Africa’s accession to the 2003 UNESCO Convention for the Safeguarding of ICThe convention provides for the safeguarding, preservation and promotion of ICH by the respective member states.

src: Die ICH sluit onder andere die volgende in: gemeenskaplike kulturele ruimtes, kennis, voorwerpe en artefakte in gemeenskappe.
tgt: The ICH includes amongst others community cultural spaces, knowledge, objects and artefacts in communities.

src: Die konvensie verplig lidstate om toepaslike maatreëls vir hulle bewaring te identifiseer, te definieer en op te stel.
tgt: The convention obliges member states to identify, define and devise appropriate measures for their preservation.

src: Dit moedig ook lande aan om wetlike, tegnies administratiewe en finansiële maatreëls in plek te stel om ICH te beskerm en te bevorder.
tgt: It also encourages countries to adopt legal, technical administrative and financial measures to safeguard and promote ICThe accession will be tabled to Parliament for ratification.

src: VN Konvensie teen Korrupsie (UNCAC).
tgt: UN Convention against Corruption (UNCAC).

src: Die kabinet het die publikasie van Suid-Afrika se beoordelingsverslag oor die implementering van die Konvensie goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the publication of South Africa’s Review Report on the implementation of the Convention.

src: Suid-Afrika het die UNCAC in 2004 aanvaar.
tgt: South Africa ratified the UNCAC in 2004.

src: Lidstate ondergaan portuurevaluering oor die implementering van die konvensie.
tgt: Member states are peer reviewed on the implementation of the convention.

src: Suid-Afrika is die eerste keer in 2012 beoordeel op sy implementering van die kriminalisering- en wetstoepassingsintervensies, en ook op sy handhawing van internasionale samewerking.
tgt: South Africa was first reviewed in 2012 on the implementation of the criminalisation and law-enforcement interventions, and also on its international cooperation adherence.

src: Die huidige 2019/20 inspeksieverslag het gefokus op voorkomende en bateherwinningsmaatreëls.
tgt: The current 2019/20 review report focused on preventative and asset recovery measures.

src: Die beoordelingsmeganisme bevorder konstruktiewe samewerking deur onder andere tegniesebystandsprogramme aan die lidstate te verskaf.
tgt: The review mechanism promotes constructive collaboration by, amongst others, providing technical assistance programmes to the member states.

src: Uitstel aan Suid-Afrika om gasheer te wees vir die Wêreld Maritieme Dag Parallelle Geleentheid (WMDPE).
tgt: Postponement for South Africa to host the World Maritime Day Parallel Event (WMDPE).

src: Die Internasionale Maritieme Organisasie het weer eens aan Suid-Afrika toestemming verleen om die aanbieding van die WMDPE uit te stel weens Covid-19.
tgt: The International Maritime Organisation has once again granted South Africa permission to postpone the hosting of the WMDPE owing to COVID-19.

src: Die uitstel van Oktober 2021 tot Oktober 2022 volg op die eerste een in 2020 weens die pandemie.
tgt: The postponement from October 2021 to October 2022, follows the first one in 2020 as a result of the pandemic.

src: Wetsontwerp op die nasionale raad op geslagsgebaseerde geweld en moord op vroue (GBVF) van 2021 Die kabinet het die publikasie van die wetsontwerp op die nasionale raad op geslagsgebaseerde geweld en moord op vroue in die Staatskoerant goedgekeur vir openbare insette.
tgt: Bills National Council on GBV and Femicide (GBVF) Bill of 2021 Cabinet approved the publication of the National Council on GBVF Bill of 2021 in the Government Gazette for public comment.

src: Die wetsontwerp is in reaksie op die strategiese opdrag van die Nasionale Strategiese Plan (NSP) oor GBVF wat in Maart 2020 deur die kabinet goedgekeur is.
tgt: The Bill responds to the strategic directive from the National Strategic Plan (NSP) on GBVF that was approved by Cabinet in March 2020.

src: Die wetsontwerp beveel die totstandkoming van ‘n verteenwoordigende onafhanklike raad aan wat oorsig sal hê oor die NSP oor GBVWysigingswetsontwerp op Nasionale Veld- en Bosbrande (NVFFA) van 2021.
tgt: The Bill proposes the establishment of a representative independent council to oversee the NSP on GBVNational Veld and Forest Fire Amendment (NVFFA) Bill of 2021 Cabinet approved the submission of the National Veld and Forest Fire Amendment Bill of 2021 to Parliament.

src: Die kabinet het die voorlegging van die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Nasionale Veld- en Bosbrande (NVFFA) van 2021 aan die Parlement goedgekeur.
tgt: This Bill was first submitted to Parliament in 2017 and was sent back for further consultation with the public.

src: Hierdie wetsontwerp is aanvanklik die eerste keer in 2017 aan die Parlement voorgelê en is terugverwys vir verdere konsultasie met die publiek.
tgt: Among other provisions, the Bill establishes structures in the public sector and at community level that will work together to mitigate veldfire risks, and promote effective compliance and law enforcement.

src: Onbeheerde veldbrande is verantwoordelik vir omgewingsdegradasie, werksverlies, verplasing van gemeenskappe en algemene vernietiging van infrastruktuur, lewende hawe, habitat en biodiversiteit.
tgt: Uncontrolled veldfires are responsible for environmental degradation, loss of jobs, displacement of communities, and general destruction of infrastructure, livestock, habitat and biodiversity.

src: Volhoubare Infrastruktuurontwikkelingsimposium van Suid-Afrika(SIDSSA).
tgt: UPCOMING EVENTSustainable Infrastructure Development Symposium South Africa (SIDSSA).

src: Die regering is die gasheer van die SIDSSA 2021 op Woensdag 6 en Donderdag 7 Oktober 2021.
tgt: Government will be hosting the SIDSSA 2021 on Wednesday, 6 and Thursday, 7 October 2021.

src: Die simposium sal met ‘n aantal belanghebbendes in gesprek tree om nuwe lewe te blaas in die infrastruktuurpyplyn.
tgt: The symposium will engage with a range of stakeholders to revitalise the infrastructure pipeline.

src: Die SIDSSA-infrastruktuurpyplyn poog om by te dra tot industrialisasie en werkskepping soos in die vooruitsiggestel deur die ERRP en die herbedinkte nywerheidstrategie (RIS).
tgt: The SIDSSA infrastructure pipeline aims to contribute to industrialisation and job creation as envisaged in the ERRP and the Re-imagined Industrial Strategy.

src: Die intervensies wat geïdentifiseer is, poog om stukrag aan aanvraag te gee en doeltreffende koördinering van alle infrastruktuurrolspelers te verseker.
tgt: The interventions identified aim to boost demand and ensure effective coordination of all infrastructure players.

src: Daar word verwag dat hierdie intervensies ook sal bydra tot die bou van ‘n veerkragtige ekonomie deur die lewering van infrastruktuur te verhaas.
tgt: It is envisaged that these interventions will also contribute to building a resilient economy by accelerating infrastructure delivery.

src: Die SIDSSA 2021 word gehou onder die tema: “Gehalte-infrastruktuur vir ontwikkeling, herstel en inklusiewe groei”.
tgt: The SIDSSA 2021 is held under the theme: “Quality infrastructure for development, recovery and inclusive growth”.

src: Oktober word daaraan toegewy om vervoerkwessies in die land onder die vergrootglas te plaas.
tgt: Transport Month 2021 October is dedicated to bringing a sharp focus to transport issues in the country.

src: Dit is die 16e jaar dat die land Vervoermaand vier.
tgt: This is the 16th year that the country observes Transport Month.

src: Die kabinet het hierdie jaar se tema goedgekeur, nl.
tgt: Cabinet approved this year’s theme: “Together, let’s fix transport”.

src: Die veldtog se slagspreuk is “Brika Bova: Riding the wave to a better transport system for tomorrow”.
tgt: The campaign’s slogan is “Brika Bova: Riding the wave to a better transport system for tomorrow”.

src: Die vervoersektor is ‘n belangrike sosio-ekonomiese element in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: The transport sector is an important socio-economic element in South Africa.

src: Hierdie jaar sal die veldtog fokus om vervoer as ‘n sleutelrolspeler te posisioneer in die land se ekonomiese herstel, om bewustheid te skep en mense op te voed oor veiligheid in alle vervoermodusse, en ook om die verbeterings wat in die vervoerstelsel aangebring is, ten toon te stel.
tgt: This year the campaign will focus on positioning transport as a key enabler in the country’s economic recovery create an awareness and educate on the safety in all transport modes, and also showcase the improvements made in the transport system.

src: Die Departement van Vervoer sal die maand se aktiwiteite met die publiek deel en meer inligting is beskikbaar by www.
tgt: The Department of Transport will share the month’s activities with the public and more information is available on www.

src: GelukwenseDie kabinet het sy gelukwense aan die volgende persone en sportspanne oorgedra:Suid-Afrika se Paralimpiese Span, dat hulle Suid-Afrika se naam hoog gehou het deur sewe medaljes in totaal te wen – vier goud, een silwer en twee brons.
tgt: MESSAGECongratulations Cabinet extended its congratulations and well-wishes to: South Africa’s Paralympic team for flying the South African flag high by winning seven medals in total – four golds, a silver and two bronzes.

src: Span SA se medaljewenners in Tokio is Ntando Mahlangu (twee goud), Pieter du Preez (goud), Anrune Weyers (goud), Louzanne Coetzee (silwer en brons) en Sheryl James (brons).MeVerity Price, ‘n professionele spreker en fasiliteerder, wat die 2021 Toastmasters World Champion of Public Speaking gewen het.
tgt: Team SA’s medallists in Tokyo were Ntando Mahlangu (two golds), Pieter du Preez (gold), Anrune Weyers (gold), Louzanne Coetzee (silver and bronze) and Sheryl James (bronze).

src: Sy is die sesde vrou wat die wêreldkampioenskap in die afgelope 80 jaar van die kompetisie se bestaan wen, en die eerste uit Afrika.
tgt: Ms Verity Price, a professional speaker and facilitator, for winning the 2021 Toastmasters World Champion of Public Speaking.

src: Die Springbok Sewesspan, wat die vierde HSBC World Rugby Sevens Series gewen het toe hulle die Noord-Amerikaanse dubbeltoernooi voltooi het deur die tweede van twee HSBC Canada Sevens-toernooie in Edmond te wen.
tgt: She is the sixth woman to win the World Championship in the last 80 years of the competition and the first winner from Africa.

src: Betuiging van meegevoelDie kabinet het sy meegevoel betuig met die familie en vriende van:Prof Hlengiwe Buhle Mkhize (69), Adjunkminister in die Presidensie vir Vroue, Jongmense en Persone met Gestremdhede.
tgt: The Springbok Sevens team, for winning the fourth HSBC World Rugby Sevens Series when they completed the North American double by winning the second of two HSBC Canada Sevens tournaments in Edmond.

src: Mnr Karabo Gungubele (32), die seun van die Minister in die Presidensie, mnr Mondli WEBTOKEN Zanele kaMagwaza-Msibi (59), leier van die Nasionale Vryheidsparty en voormalige adjunkminister van Wetenskap en Tegnologie, wat haar daaraan toegewy het om talle uitstaande bydraes tot ons demokrasie en die samelewing te maak.
tgt: Condolences Cabinet expressed condolences to the family and friends of: ProfHlengiwe Buhle Mkhize (69), Deputy Minister in The Presidency for Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities.

src: Mnr Jolidee Matongo (46), Uitvoerende Burgemeester van die Stad Johannesburg, wat hom daaraan toegewy het om toestande te verbeter en geleenthede vir al die mense van Johannesburg en belanghebbendes by die metropolitaanse ekonomie te skep.
tgt: Throughout her life she distinguished herself as a tireless and passionate anti-apartheid and human rights activist, and campaigner for an end to gender WEBTOKEN Karabo Gungubele (32), the son of Minister in The Presidency, Mr Mondli Gungubele.

src: AanstellingsDie kabinet het die aanstelling van die kommissaris en adjunkkommissaris van die Grensbestuurowerheid (GBO) bekragtig:1.
tgt: Ms Zanele kaMagwaza-Msibi (59), National Freedom Party leader and former Deputy Minister of Science and Technology, who devoted herself to making numerous extraordinary contributions to our democracy and WEBTOKEN Jolidee Matongo (46), City of Johannesburg Executive Mayor, who was dedicated to improving conditions and creating opportunities for all the people of Johannesburg and stakeholders in the metropolitan economy.

src: Dr. Nakampe Michael Masiapato as Kommissaris van die Grensbestuurowerheid.
tgt: Dr Nakampe Michael Masiapato as Commissioner of the Border Management Authority (BMA).
