src: Die saak sal weereens oor 20 dae in die hof voorkom en die regering sal dan sy argument voorlê.
tgt: The matter will again be before the courts in 20 days’ time and government will present its argument then.2 South Africa’s bonds of friendship with Cuba are deeply rooted in our region’s struggle for liberation.

src: Dit sou baie langer geneem het om dié streek van koloniale onderdrukking te bevry, as dit nie vir die selflose ingryping van die Kubane in Suider-Afrika oor drie dekades was nie.
tgt: Were it not for the selfless intervention of the Cubans in Southern Africa over three decades, it would have taken far longer to liberate this region from colonial oppression.

src: Voormalige President Nelson Mandela het dit begryp en dit is waarom Kuba die eerste land buite die kontinent was wat Madiba besoek het toe hy in 1990 uit die tronk gelaat is.
tgt: Former President Nelson Mandela understood this, which is why Cuba was the first country outside the continent Madiba visited upon his release from prison in 1990.

src: Kuba het monumentale opofferings gemaak om langs Afrika-bevrydingsbewegings te baklei op ŉ stadium toe die klein eilandnasie gebuk gegaan het onder die Verenigde State se ekonomiese verbod vir ŉ dekade en ŉ half.
tgt: Cuba made monumental sacrifices to fight alongside African liberation movements at a time when the small island nation had been struggling under the United States’ economic embargo for a decade and a half.

src: Kuba se ekonomiese krisis het onuithoudbaar geword en die Kubaanse regering benodig hulp.
tgt: Cuba’s economic crisis has become untenable and the Cuban Government is in need of assistance.

src: Mesiko, Bolivia en Rusland is van die lande wat humanitêre hulp verskaf het om die eiland se ergste ekonomiese krisis in dekades te verlig.
tgt: Mexico, Bolivia and Russia are among the countries which have provided humanitarian aid to ease the island’s worst economic crisis in decades.

src: Die Kabinet het dié week by die herdenking van die Slag van Cuito Cuanavale in Angola aangesluit, wat van 1987 tot 1988 plaasgevind het.
tgt: Cabinet this week joins in commemorating the Battle of Cuito Cuanavale in Angola that took place from 1987 to 1988.

src: Kuba het ŉ kritieke rol gespeel deur hulp aan Afrika-bevrydingsbewegings te bied om hulle doelwitte te verwesenlik.
tgt: Cuba played the critical role in assisting African liberation movements to realise their objectives.

src: Daar was geen materiële voordeel vir die Kubane wat ons ondersteun het nie, maar hulle oorheersende aansporing was om te veg om Suider-Afrika van koloniale en reagerende magte te bevry.
tgt: There was no material gain for the Cubans who came to our support, but their overriding incentive was to fight for the liberation of Southern Africa from colonial and reactionary forces.

src: Destydse President Fidel Castro was aangedryf deur revolusionêre geesdrif en hy het aan sy kamerade gesê dat hulle vir “die mooiste beweegrede van die mensdom” veg.
tgt: Then President Fidel Castro was driven by revolutionary zeal and he told his comrades they were fighting “the most beautiful cause of mankind”.

src: Kuba het, van Angola tot Namibië en Algerië tot Guinee-Bissau, ŉ beslissende rol gespeel in die bydrae tot die bevryding van dié Afrikalande vanuit koloniale besetting.
tgt: From Angola to Namibia and Algeria to Guinea Bissau, Cuba played a decisive role in contributing to the liberation of these African countries from colonial occupation.

src: Kuba het steeds aanhoudend mediese en ander hulp aan Suid-Afrika gebied in die tydperk na 1994 en mees onlangs tydens die KOVID-19-pandemie en ons het ŉ morele verpligting om solidariteit te toon met die mense in Kuba op ŉ tyd wanneer hulle sukkel om te oorleef.
tgt: Cuba has continued to consistently provide medical and other assistance to South Africa in the post-1994 period, most recently during the COVID-19 pandemic, and it is our moral obligation to show solidarity with the people of Cuba at a time when they are struggling to survive.

src: Besoek deur Sy Majesteit Koning Letsie III Die Kabinet het kennis geneem van die beleefdheidsbesoek van Sy Majesteit Koning Letsie III van Lesotho aan President Ramaphosa wat op Vrydag, 18 Maart 2022 in Pretoria plaasgevind het en dit verwelkom.
tgt: Visit by His Majesty King Letsie III Cabinet noted and welcomed the courtesy call from His Majesty King Letsie III of the Kingdom of Lesotho to President Ramaphosa that took place on Friday, 18 March 2022 in Pretoria.

src: President Ramaphosa, in sy hoedanigheid as die Suid-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskapsfasiliteerder (SADC-fasiliteerder) vir die Koninkryk van Lesotho, het gedagtes oor bilaterale betrekkinge en vordering aangaande die SADC-fasiliteringsproses in die Koninkryk van Lesotho, met Sy Majesteit Koning Letsie III gewissel.
tgt: President Ramaphosa, in his capacity as the Southern African Development Community (SADC) Facilitator to the Kingdom of Lesotho, exchanged views with His Majesty King Letsie III on bilateral relations and progress regarding the SADC facilitation process in the Kingdom of Lesotho.

src: Daar word beoog dat Basotho, deur die fasilitering van President Ramaphosa, in alle erns sal werk om die hervormingsproses te voltooi voordat die volgende algemene verkiesings wat vir September 2022 geskeduleer is, gehou word.
tgt: It is envisaged that Basotho, through the facilitation of President Ramaphosa, will work in earnest to complete the reforms process before holding the next general elections scheduled for September 2022.Cabinet decisions.

src: Multilaterale konvensie om belastingsverdragverwante maatreëls in werking te stel om basiserosie en winsverskuiwing te voorkom (BEPS MLI in Engels).
tgt: Multilateral Convention to Implement Tax Treaty Related Measures to Prevent Base Erosion and Proft Shifting (BEPS MLI).

src: Die Kabinet het die voorlegging van die BEPS MLI aan die Parlement vir bekragtiging goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the BEPS MLI to Parliament for ratification.

src: Suid-Afrika het, as deel van die 95 lande wat deelneem aan die konvensie wat deur die Organisasie vir Ekonomiese Samewerking en Ontwikkeling (OESO) in werking gestel is om geleenthede vir belastingvermyding en basiserosie deur multinasionale maatskappye te verminder, die belastingverdrag in Junie 2017 onderteken.
tgt: As one of the 95 countries participating in the convention initiated by the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) to reduce opportunities for tax avoidance and base erosion by multinational companies, South Africa signed the tax treaty in June 2017.

src: Suid-Afrika sal die belastingverdrag saam met ander belastingverdrae wat met ander lande onderteken is, toepas sodra dit bekragtig is.
tgt: Once the tax treaty is ratified, South Africa will apply it alongside other tax treaties it has signed with other countries.

src: Suid-Afrika is ŉ lid van die OESO en is daartoe verbind om saam met ander lande te werk om te keer dat maatskappywinste kunsmatig uit die land verskuif word na ŉ lae- of geen-belastingomgewing.
tgt: South Africa is a member of the OECD and is committed to working with other countries to stop company profits being artificially shifted out of the country to low or no tax environment.

src: Wysiging van die belastingverdragprotokol tussen Suid-Afrika en Koeweit.
tgt: Amendment of the Tax Treaty Protocol between South Africa and Kuwait.

src: Die Kabinet het die voorlegging aan die Parlement van die gewysigde belastingverdragprotokol wat tussen Suid-Afrika en Koeweit geteken is, goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the amended Tax Treaty Protocol signed between South Africa and Kuwait to Parliament.

src: Wysigings aan dié verdrag, wat in 2006 in werking gestel is, is in 2021 aangebring en onderteken.
tgt: Amendments to this treaty, which came into force in 2006, were made and signed in 2021.

src: Die belastingprotokol handel oor die vermyding van dubbele belasting en voorkoming van fiskale ontduiking betreffende belasting op inkomste tussen die twee lande.
tgt: The tax protocol deals with the avoidance of double taxation and prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income between the two countries.

src: Sodanige verdrae poog om belastingdeursigtigheid tussen lande aan te moedig, buiten om belastingontduiking te hanteer.
tgt: Apart from dealing with tax evasion, such treaties seek to encourage tax transparency between countries.

src: Geïntegreerde strategie vir die voorkoming van misdaad en geweld (ICVPS in Engels).
tgt: Integrated Crime and Violence Prevention Strategy (ICVPS).

src: Die Kabinet het die ICVPS vir inwerkingstelling goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the ICVPS for implementation.

src: Die strategie sal dien as ŉ implementeringsinstrument van die Witskrif oor veiligheid en sekuriteit wat in 2016 goedgekeur is.
tgt: The strategy will serve as an implementation tool of the White Paper on Safety and Security adopted in 2016.

src: Dit beveel ŉ algehele regerings- en samelewingsbenadering aan vir die bestryding van misdaad en voorkoming van geweld.
tgt: It advocates for a whole of government and society approach in fighting crime and preventing violence.

src: Die ICVPS bestaan uit ses interafhanklike en onderling verwante pilare, naamlik (1) ŉ doeltreffende kriminele justisie (2) vroeë ingrypings vir misdaadvoorkoming (3) slagofferondersteuningsingrypings (4) doeltreffende en geïntegreerde dienslewering, (5) veiligheid deur omgewingsontwerp en (6) aktiewe openbare en gemeenskapsdeelname.
tgt: The ICVPS consists of six interdependent and interrelated pillars namely, (1) an effective criminal justice (2) early interventions in preventing crime (3) victim support interventions (4) effective and integrated service delivery (5) safety through environmental design and (6) active public and community participation.

src: Die strategie erken die behoefte vir aanvullende ingrypings om die aandrywers van misdaad soos armoede, ongelykheid, werkloosheid, volkswelsyn en onderwys, aan te spreek.
tgt: The strategy acknowledges the need for complimentary interventions to address the drivers of crime such as poverty, inequality, unemployment, social welfare health and education.

src: Dit is inklusief betreffende beide stedelike en landelike gebiede, waaronder tradisionele rade as belanghebbendes.
tgt: It is inclusive in terms of both urban and rural areas, including traditional councils, as stakeholders.

src: Daar is ten volle beraadslaag met alle regeringsfere, sakelui, navorsingsinstansies en burgerlike samelewingsorganisasies.
tgt: It has been fully consulted with all the spheres of government, business, research institutions and civil-society organisations.

src: Die goedgekeurde strategie vervang die huidige nasionale misdaadvoorkomingstrategie.
tgt: The approved strategy replaces the current National Crime Prevention Strategy.

src: Suid-Afrika se landbeleggingstrategie (CIS in Engels).
tgt: South Africa’s Country Investment Strategy (CIS).

src: Die Kabinet het die publikasie van die CIS openbare kommentaar goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the publication of the CIS for public comment.

src: Die strategie poog om die land as belangrike verkose Afrikabeleggingsbestemming te posisioneer deur kwaliteit buitelandse en binnelandse direkte belegging te beheer.
tgt: The strategy seeks to position the country as a key African investment destination of choice by leveraging quality foreign and domestic direct investments.

src: Die strategie is geanker in die land se prioriteitsbeleggings- en ekonomiese ontwikkelingsektore soos
tgt: The strategy is anchored on the country’s priority investment and economic development sectors such as

src: finansiering, versekering, eiendom en besigheidsdienste (ii) vervoer en logistiek (iii) vervaardiging (iv) mynbou en steengroefwerk
tgt: finance, insurance, real estate and business services (ii) transport and logistics, (iii) manufacturing (iv) mining and quarrying,

src: elektrisiteit, gas en water en (vi) landbou en agroverwerking.
tgt: electricity, gas and water, and (vi) agriculture and agro-processing.

src: Dit verskaf beleggingsmeganismes om klein, medium en mikro-ondernemings na die ekonomiese groeimoontlikheid te lok.
tgt: It provides investment mechanisms to attract small, medium and micro enterprises into the economic growth drive.

src: Die strategie maak ook gebruik van ŉ aantal multilaterale, streeks- en bilaterale ooreenkomste wat Suid-Afrika onderteken het.
tgt: The strategy also taps into a number of multilateral, regional and bilateral agreements which South Africa has signed.

src: Die strategie is in lyn gebring met die doelwitte van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan, EHHP, hervoorgestelde bedryfstrategie en die Nasionale Infrastruktuurplan 2050 wat onlangs goedgekeur is.
tgt: The strategy is aligned to the goals of the National Development Plan, ERRP, Re-imagined Industrial Strategy and the recently adopted National Infrastructure Plan 2050.

src: Die nege provinsies en hulle agt onderskeie belangrike metropolitaanse ekonomieë is kernbelangrik vir die aandryf van die strategie, wat ŉ lewende dokument sal wees wat deurentyd aanpasbaar tot die veranderende ekonomiese omgewing sal wees.
tgt: The nine provinces and their eight respective metropolitan key economies are central in driving the strategy, which will be a living document that will constantly be adaptable to the changing economic environment.

src: Hersiene nasionale biodiversiteitsraamwerk (NBR) Die Kabinet het die NBR vir inwerkingstelling goedgekeur.
tgt: Revised National Biodiversity Framework (NBF).

src: Die NBR wat die Kabinet in November 2022 vir openbare beraadslaging goedgekeur het, is in ooreenstemming met die Wet op Nasionale Omgewingsbestuur: Biodiversiteit, 2004 (Wetnr 10 van 2004) ontwikkel.
tgt: The NBF, which Cabinet approved for public consultation in November 2020, was developed in line with the National Environmental Management: Biodiversity Act, 2004 (Act 10 of 2004).

src: Dit maak voorsiening vir ŉ geïntegreerde, gekoördineerde en eenvormige benadering tot biodiversiteitsbestuur deur alle staatsorgane, nieregeringsorganisasies (NRO’s), die privaat sektor en gemeenskappe.
tgt: It provides for an integrated, coordinated and uniform approach to biodiversity management by all organs of state, non-governmental organisations (NGOs), the private sector and communities.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Biodiversiteitsinstituut het in 2018 ŉ omvattende wetenskaplike assessering van die stand van biodiversiteit en ekostelsel in Suid-Afrika gedoen.
tgt: In 2018, the South African National Biodiversity Institute conducted a comprehensive scientific assessment of the state of biodiversity and ecosystem in South Africa.

src: Die hersiene NBR se sektorale plan van aksie spreek die bedreigings wat in dié assessering bepaal is, aan.
tgt: The revised NBF sectoral plan of action addresses the threats identified from this assessment.

src: Daar is met alle regeringsfere, staatsbesitte entiteite (SBE’s), omgewingsbewaardersentiteite en plaaslike gemeenskappe beraadslaag.
tgt: The revised framework was consulted with all the spheres of government state-owned entities (SOEs), conservationist entities NGOs and local communities.

src: Die inwerkingstelling van die NBR word gelei deur die goedgekeurde nasionale strategie en aksieplan vir biodiversiteit (2015-2025).
tgt: The implementation of the NBF is guided by the adopted National Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan (2015-2025).

src: Suid-Afrika is ŉ ondertekenaar van die Verenigde Nasie se konvensie oor biologiese diversiteit wat die bewaring van biologiese diversiteit, volhoubare gebruik van sy komponente en die regverdige en gelyke verdeling van voordele wat uit genetiese hulpbronne spruit, bevorder.
tgt: South Africa is a signatory to the United Nations’ Convention on Biological Diversity, which promotes the conservation of biological diversity, sustainable use of its components, and the fair and equitable sharing of benefits arising from genetic resources.

src: Konsep nasionale ruimtelike ontwikkelingsraamwerk (NROR).
tgt: Draft National Spatial Development Framework (NSDF).

src: Die Kabinet het die konsep-NROR vir inwerkingstelling goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the draft NSDF for implementation.

src: Dit is ingevolge die Wet op Ruimtelike Beplanning en Grondgebruikbestuur, 2013 (Wetnr 16 van 2013) voorberei en in 2019 vir openbare beraadslaging, goedgekeur.
tgt: It was prepared in terms of the Spatial Planning and Land Use Management Act, 2013 (Act 16 of 2013) and approved for public consultation in 2019.

src: Insae is verkry vanaf verskeie belanghebbendes, waaronder professionele liggame, alle regeringsfere, SBE's en lede van die publiek.
tgt: Inputs were obtained from various stakeholders, including professional bodies, all spheres of government, SOEs and members of the public.

src: Die raamwerk poog om die uitwissing van die koloniale en apartheid ruimtelike nalatenskap op ordelike en gekoördineerde wyse te hanteer.
tgt: The framework seeks to deal with the eradication of the colonial and apartheid spatial legacies in an orderly and coordinated manner.

src: Dit verskaf ŉ ruimtelik gefokusde ontwikkelingsbenadering oor die langtermyn vir die beplanning en ŉ grondgebruikbestuurstelsel.
tgt: It provides a long-term spatially focused developmental approach towards planning and a land use management system.

src: Die dokument sal deur die Departement van Landbou, Grondhervorming en Landelike Ontwikkeling, se webwerf toeganklik wees (WEBTOKEN).
tgt: The document will be accessible through the website of the Department of Agriculture, Land Reform and Rural Development (WEBTOKEN).

src: Amptelike identiteitsbestuursbeleid Die Kabinet het na ŉ uitgebreide openbare beraadslaging in 2021, die amptelike identiteitsbestuursbeleid goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Official Identity Management Policy, following an extensive public consultation in 2021.

src: Dié beleid sal die huidige Identifikasiewet, 1997 (Wetnr 68 van 1997) vervang, wat die nasionale bevolkingsregister (NB) daarstel en ook sy bestek in die verpligte rekords wat daarop aangeteken word, spesifiseer.
tgt: This policy will replace the current Identification Act, 1997 (Act 68 of 1997), which establishes the National Population Register (NPR) and also specify its scope in the mandatory records that are captured on it.

src: Dié Wet is nie in ooreenstemming met die grondwetlike beginsels van gelykheid, nie-diskriminasie en menswaardigheid nie.
tgt: This Act is not aligned to the constitutional principles of equality, non-discrimination and human dignity.

src: Die goedgekeurde beleid stel ŉ enkele digitale NB vir alle mense voor — ongeag burgerskap en geslagstatus — wat in die land woon en gewoon het.
tgt: The adopted policy proposes a single digital NPR of all people – irrespective of citizenship and sex status – who live and have lived in the country.

src: Dit maak ook voorsiening vir ŉ biometriese nasionale identiteitstelsel (NI) wat ŉ enkele beskouing van ŉ persoon in staat sal stel.
tgt: It also provides for a biometric National Identity System (NIS) that will enable a single view of a person.

src: Die NI sal ook in staat kan wees om met ander regerings- en privaat sektoridentiteitstelsel te koppel.
tgt: The NIS will also be able to interface with other government and private sector identity systems.

src: Die beleid sal ook die beskerming van die regte van lede van die lesbiër-, homoseksuele-, biseksuele-, transgeslagtelike, interseksuele-, queer- en aseksuele gemeenskap verseker.
tgt: The policy will also ensure the protection of the rights of members of the Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Intersex, Queer and Asexual community.

src: Witskrif op huwelike in Suid-Afrika Die Kabinet het die Witskrif op huwelike in Suid-Afrika vir inwerkingstelling goedgekeur.
tgt: White Paper on Marriages in South Africa.

src: Die Witskrif reageer op baie hofuitsprake wat bevind het dat sommige elemente van die huidige huwelikswetgewing ongrondwetlik is.
tgt: The White Paper responds to many court judgements that have found some elements of the current marriage legislation to be unconstitutional.

src: Dit het alle huwelike in ooreenstemming gebring om ingevolge die beginsels van gelykheid, nie-diskriminasie en menswaardigheid, soos vervat in die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996, onderneem te word.
tgt: It has aligned all marriages to be concluded in accordance with the principles of equality, non-discrimination and human dignity as provided for in the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.

src: Die goedgekeurde Witskrif sal Suid-Afrikaners en inwoners van alle seksuele oriëntasies, godsdienstige- en kulturele oortuigings toelaat om wettige huwelike, in ooreenstemming met grondwetlike beginsels, te onderneem.
tgt: The approved White Paper will allow South Africans and residents of all sexual orientations, religious and cultural persuasions to conclude legal unions in line with the constitutional principles.

src: Die Witskrif stipuleer sommige van die huwelike wat uitgesluit word, soos kinderhuwelike en huwelike wat in die afwesigheid van die ander party, onderneem word.
tgt: The White Paper outlines some of the unions that are excluded such as child marriages and those done in the absence of the other party.

src: Eenstop-grensposbeleid (ESG-beleid).
tgt: One-Stop Border Post (OSBP) Policy.

src: Die Kabinet het die ESG en sy implementeringstrategie goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the OSBP and its implementation strategy.

src: Die beleid poog om die beweging van mense en goedere tussen Suid-Afrika se landinklaringshawens en naburige lande, te versoen.
tgt: The policy seeks to harmonise the movement of people and goods between South Africa’s land ports of entry and its neighbouring countries.

src: Dit gee uitvoering aan die eenstop-grensposraamwerk wat in 2018 deur die Kabinet goedgekeur is.
tgt: It gives effect to the One-Stop Border Framework that was adopted by Cabinet in 2018.

src: Die toepassing van die beleid sal die huidige opeenhoping by ons landinklaringshawens vir oorgrensreisigers en -handelaars verlig.
tgt: The application of the policy will alleviate current congestions at our land ports of entry for cross-border travellers and traders.

src: Dié ingrypings is ook belangrik vir die land se pogings om die AKV-ooreenkoms aan te dryf.
tgt: These interventions are also key in the country’s efforts in driving the AfCFTA agreement.

src: Ons voorsien dat die verwerking van goedere, voertuie en mense op ŉ meer naatlose en vinnige wyse gedoen sal word wanneer dit ten volle in werking is met die toepaslike wetgewing en infrastruktuurbywerkings.
tgt: Once fully operationalised with relevant legislation and infrastructure upgrades, we envisage that the processing of goods, vehicles and people will be done in a seamless and faster manner.

src: Tussentydse aanbieding van die presidensiële klimaatskommissie.
tgt: Interim hosting of the Presidential Climate Commission.

src: Die Kabinet het die oorgangsaanbieding van die presidensiële klimaatskommissie deur die Nasionale Ekonomiese, Ontwikkelings- en Arbeidsraad (Nedlac), goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the transitional hosting of the Presidential Climate Commission by the National Economic Development and Labour Council (Nedlac).

src: Nedlac sal vir twee jaar of minder die kommissie saam met sy sekretariaat aanbied om die promulgasie van die Wet op Klimaatsverandering, in staat te stel.
tgt: Nedlac will host the commission with its secretariat for two years or shorter to enable the promulgation of the Climate Change Act.

src: Die tydperk sal ook aan die kommissie die geleentheid bied om— in medewerking met die Departement van Bosbou, Visserye en die Omgewing — die uitvoerbaarheidstudie en besigheidsaak vir die toekomstige stigting van die kommissie, soos deur die Wetsontwerp op Klimaatsverandering, te finaliseer.
tgt: The period will also afford the commission – in collaboration with the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment – to finalise the feasibility study and business case for the future establishment of the commission as determined by the Climate Change Bill.

src: Konsepwitskrif op nasionale spoorwegbeleid.
tgt: Draft White Paper on National Rail Policy.

src: Die Kabinet het die Konsepwitskrif op nasionale spoorwegbeleid goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the draft White Paper on National Rail Policy.

src: Die beleid sal leiding bied om ŉ doeltreffende vervoerstelsel te skep wat in staat sal wees om plaaslik en internasionaal mee te ding.
tgt: The policy will guide in creating an efficient transport system that will be able to compete locally and internationally.

src: Die beleid stel gefokusde ingrypings voor wat beleggings in beide die vrag- en passasiersdienste, sal bevorder.
tgt: The policy proposes focused interventions that will promote investments in both the feight and passenger services.

src: Dit sal ook landelike toegang verbeter en beweeglikheid verhoog om ekonomiese groei te bevorder.
tgt: It will also improve rural access and increase mobility to promote economic growth.

src: Dit sal ook wesenlik bydra tot die vermindering van die land se uitlatings aangesien dit spoorweg-genetiese tegnologieë vir die opgradering van spoorwegvoorraad voorstel.
tgt: It will also contribute substantially towards reducing the country’s emissions as it proposes rail genetic technologies in upgrading the rail stock.

src: Die beleid sal geopenbaar word sodra die Departement van Vervoer dit in die Staatskoerant gepubliseer het.
tgt: The policy will be made public once the Department of Transport has published it in the Government Gazette.

src: Wetsontwerp.
tgt: Bill.

src: Wetsontwerp op die Munisipale Afbakeningsowerheid (IMDA in Engels) van 2022 Die Kabinet het die voorlegging van IMDA-wetsontwerp vir verdere verwerking van 2022 aan die Parlement, goedgekeur.
tgt: Independent Municipal Demarcation Authority (IMDA) Bill of 2022.

src: Die Wetsontwerp is in Junie 2020 vir openbare kommentaar en gevolglike deelname oor die kommentaar wat vanaf die publiek ontvang is, gepubliseer.
tgt: The Bill was published for public comment in June 2020 and subsequent engagements on the comments received from the public.

src: Die Wetsontwerp maak voorsiening vir die bestuursregime van die IMDDie voorstelle behels verduideliking van die terme van die raadslede en dat hulle op tydelike basis moet dien, behalwe vir die voorsitter wat op voltydse basis mag dien.
tgt: The Bill provides the governance regime of the IMDIts proposals include clarifying the terms of the Board members and that they are to serve on a part-time basis, except for the Chairperson who may serve on a full-time basis.

src: Dit lei ook die IMDA oor die proses van die afbakening van grense.
tgt: It also guides the IMDA on the process towards the delimiting of boundaries.

src: Komende Gebeurtenisse.
tgt: Upcoming event.

src: Besoek aan die Midde-Ooste President Ramaphosa sal op Maandag, 28 Maart, 2022 die afvaardiging van ministers na die Wêreld Ekspo Dubai in die Verenigde Arabiese Emirate lei.
tgt: President Ramaphosa will lead a delegation of Ministers to the World Expo Dubai in the United Arab Emirates on Monday, 28 March 2022.

src: Suid-Afrika neem deel aan die ekspo met ŉ pawiljoen wat die land se ryk erfenis en beleggingsgeleenthede ten toon stel.
tgt: South Africa is participating at the expo with a pavilion showcasing the country’s rich heritage and investment opportunities.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Messages.

src: GelukwenseDie Kabinet het sy gelukwense en welmenendheid gerig aan die: Suid-Afrikaanse vroue krieketspan omdat hulle die nasionale vlag hoog gehys het by die Krieketwêreldbeker vir vroue in Nieu Seeland.
tgt: CongratulationsCabinet extended its congratulations and well-wishes to the:the South African women’s cricket team, for flying the national flag high at the Women’s Cricket World Cup in New Zealand.

src: Hulle het die huidige wêreldkampioene, Engeland, in hulle derde wedstryd geklop en het tot dusver vier wedstryde in die toernooi gewen.
tgt: They defeated current World Champions England in their third match and have managed to win four matches in the tournament so far.

src: Meelye Die Kabinet het by President Ramaphosa aangesluit en medelye aan die regering en mense van die Republiek van Zambië betoon na die afsterwe van hulle voormalige President, Rupiah Bwezani Banda (85).Die Kabinet het sy medelye betuig aan die familie en vriende van: Meeer Michael Spicer (68), die voormalige Hoof Uitvoerende Beampte (HUB) van Sakeleierskap Suid-Afrika, wat ŉ beduidende rol gespeel het om sterker verhoudings tussen sakelui en die regering te smee.
tgt: CondolencesCabinet joined President Ramaphosa in extending condolences to the government and people of the Republic of Zambia following the passing of former President Rupiah Bwezani Banda (85).Cabinet expressed condolences to the family and friends of:Mr Michael Spicer (68), the former Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Business Leadership South Africa, who played a significant role in forging a stronger relationship between business and WEBTOKEN Luzuko Koti (47), the former Director of Communication and Marketing at the Nelson Mandela Foundation and Business Manager of Channel Africa.

src: Meeer Luzuko Koti (47), die voormalige direkteur van kommunikasie en bemarking by die Nelson Mandela Stigting en Sakebestuurder van Channel Africa.
tgt: Mr Sheik Abdul Gamiet Gabier (86), Life President of the Muslim Judicial Council South Africa, who was a renowned scholar, community activist and a pioneer of the Al-Azhar Institute of Cape Town.

src: Aanstellings Alle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en toepaslike klaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Mnr Thembinkosi Bonakele Me Seithati Bolimpobo Me Thembisile Chiliza Me Palesa Kadi
tgt: Non-Executive Board members of the National Housing Finance Corporation: Mr Luthando Vutula Mr Thembinkosi Bonakele Ms Seithati Bolimpobo Ms Thembisile Chiliza Ms Palesa Kadi Ms Philisiwe Mthethwa Mr Thulani Mabaso Mr Paul Heeger Mr Velile Cecil Dube Ms Tshepiso Kobile and Ms Ayesha Seedat.

src: Me Philisiwe Mthethwa Mnr Thulani Mabaso Mnr Paul Heeger Mnr Velile Cecil Dube Me Tshepiso Kobile en
tgt: Mr Lwazi Mboyi as CEO of the Cross-Border Road Transport Agency.

src: Kwessies in die Omgewing.
tgt: Issues in the environment.

src: Vierde Suid-Afrikaanse Beleggingskonferensie (SABK).
tgt: Fourth South Africa Investment Conference (SAIC).

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die suksesvolle afloop van die 4e SABK wat op Donderdag, 24 Maart 2022 by die Sandton konferensie-sentrum in Johannesburg aangebied is, waartydens plaaslike en internasionale beleggers nuwe verbintenisse tot belegging in ons land onderneem het.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the successful conclusion of the fourth SAIC held at the Sandton Convention Centre, Johannesburg on Thursday, 24 March 2022, which saw domestic and international investors pledging new investments in our country.

src: Ons land het 80 nuwe verbintenisse tot belegging ter waarde van R332 miljard ontvang.
tgt: Our country received 80 new investment pledges totalling R332 billion.

src: Dit bring die totale beleggings waartoe verbind is tot R.14 triljoen, wat nie net 95 persent van ons beleggingsteiken verteenwoordig nie, maar ons ook stewig op koers hou om ons beleggingsteiken van R.2 triljoen oor vyf jaar te oorskry.
tgt: This takes the total investments pledged to R.14 trillion, which not only represents 95 percent of our investment target but also places us firmly on the path to exceed our R.2 trillion investment target over five years.

src: Hierdie verbintenisse tot belegging bevestig ons land se status as ŉ voorkeurbeleggingsbestemming.
tgt: These investment commitments affirm our country’s status as an investment destination of choice.

src: Tot dusver is R316 miljard van hierdie verbintenisse tot belegging belê in 46 voltooide projekte en ŉ verdere 57 projekte wat steeds onder konstruksie is.
tgt: So far, R316 billion of the commitments have been invested in 46 projects that have been completed and a further 57 projects that are still under construction.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die sukses van vorige verbintenisse tot belegging soos vermeld tydens die konferensie, wat onder meer nuwe produksiekapasiteit in diverse sektore soos voertuie, voedselproduksie, farmaseutiese produksie en digitale sentrums ingesluit het.
tgt: Cabinet notes the successes of past pledges as reported at the Conference, covering among others new production capacityin sectors as diverse as automobiles, food production, pharmaceuticals and digital centres.

src: Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op alle dele van die samelewing om hierdie kritiese ingrypings te ondersteun as deel van ons gesamentlike poging om ons werkloosheidskoers om te swaai.
tgt: Cabinet called on all sectors of society to support these critical interventions as we work together to reverse our unemployment rate, which climbed to percent, according to the Quarterly Labour Force Survey results released recently by Statistics South Africa.

src: Die werkloosheidskoers het gestyg tot persent, volgens die Kwartaallikse Arbeidsmagopname wat onlangs deur Statistieke Suid-Afrika vrygestel is.
tgt: Lifting of the National State of Disaster Cabinet also welcomed the lifting of the National State of Disaster announced by President Cyril Ramaphosa on Monday, 4 April 2022.

src: Hierdie mylpaal is moontlik gemaak deur die deursettingsvermoë van die mense van Suid-Afrika wat alle koronavirussiekte-veiligheidsmaatreëls nagekom het wat deur die regering daargestel is om lewens en lewensbestane te red.
tgt: This milestone was made possible by the resilience of people in South African who complied with all Coronavirus Disease (COVID-19) safety protocols designed by government to save lives and livelihoods.

src: Die pandemie sal voortaan bestuur word ingevolge die Wet op Nasionale Gesondheid, 2003 (Wet 61 van 2003).
tgt: The pandemic will henceforth be managed in terms of the National Health Act, 2003 (Act 61 of 2003).

src: Die konsep gesondheidsregulasies wat die Wet op Nasionale Gesondheid, 2003 sal lei, is bekendgemaak vir publieke kommentaar tot 16 April 2022.
tgt: The draft health regulations that will inform the National Health Act of 2003 are open for public comment until 16 April 2022.

src: Die Kabinet herinner alle mense in die land om steeds voort te gaan om die nodige voorkomingsmaatreëls te volg om onsself en diegene te beskerm teen KOVID-19-infeksies.
tgt: Cabinet reminded all people in the country to continue taking the necessary preventative measures to safeguard ourselves and others against COVID-19 infections.

src: Dit sluit in die gereelde was van hande met seep en water of ŉ 70% alkohol-gebaseerde saniteerder, die dra van maskers wat beide die mond en neus bedek in binnenshuise ruimtes, die handhaaf van ŉ veilige afstand van minstens een meter, die oopmaak van vensters vir ventilasie, en deur ingeënt te word.
tgt: This includes regularly washing our hands with water and soap or using a 70% alcohol-based sanitiser, wearing a mask that covers both the nose and mouth when indoors, keeping a safe social distance of at least one metre, opening windows for ventilation and vaccinating.

src: KOVID-19-inentings is doeltreffend om ernstige ongesteldheid, hospitalisering en sterfte te verhoed.
tgt: COVID-19 vaccinations are effective in preventing serious illness, hospitalisation and even death.

src: Beskerm jouself en jou geliefdes deur jou naaste inentingspunt sonder ŉ afspraak te besoek om verniet ingeënt te word.
tgt: Protect yourself and your loved ones by visiting your nearest vaccination site to get vaccinated for free, even without an appointment.

src: Migrasie na digitale uitsending.
tgt: Migration to digital broadcasting.

src: Die uitstel van die analoog-afskakeldatum van 31 Maart 2022 tot 30 Junie 2022 verskaf genoegsame tyd aan die regering vir die voltooïng van die installering van staatsgesubsidieerde dekodeerders vir huishoudings wat betyds geregistreer het en kwalifiseer om hierdie dekodeerders voor die analoog-afskakeling te ontvang.
tgt: The deferment on the Analogue Switch-off Date from 31 March to 30 June 2022 provides sufficient time to government to complete the installation of set-top boxes (STBs) for households that have registered timeously and are entitled to receive them before the analogue switch-off.

src: Die departement van kommunikasie en digitale tegnologie sal verseker dat al 507 251 huishoudings wat teen 31 Oktober 2021 geregistreer het, nie later nie as 30 Junie 2022 gekonnekteer is.
tgt: The Department of Communications and Digital Technologies will ensure that all the 507 251 households that registered by 31 October 2021 are connected no later than 30 June 2022.

src: Die 260 868 huishoudings wat tussen 31 Oktober 2021 and 10 Maart 2022 geregistreer het, sal teen 30 September 2022 gekonnekteer wees.
tgt: The 260 868 households that registered between 31 October 2021 and 10 March 2022 will be connected to their STBs by 30 September 2022.

src: Die Kabinet is vol vertroue dat die voltooïng van die proses as ondersteuning sal dien vir die digitale migrasie-proses en die gevolglike vrystelling van die hoë-frekwensie spektrum.
tgt: Cabinet is confident that the completion of this process will support the process of digital migration and the subsequent release of the high frequency spectrum.

src: Stryd teen misdaad en korrupsie Die Kabinet wens die land se nuwe kommissaris van polisie, genl.
tgt: Fighting crime and corruption Cabinet congratulated the country’s new National Commissioner of Police, General Sehlahle Fannie Masemola, following his recent appointment by President Ramaphosa.

src: Sehlahle Fannie Masemola, geluk na aanleiding van sy aanstelling deur President Ramaphosa.
tgt: General Masemola has an outstanding record of achievements in policing across South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die preserveringsbevele wat deur die Gautengse hooggeregshof aan die bateverbeuringseenheid van die Nasionale Vervolgingsowerheid (NVO) toegestaan is teen diegene wat betrokke was in die “finansiering” van die aankoop van die Optimum-steenkoolmyn vir R.1 miljard deur die Gupta-besitte Tegeta Exploration and Resources-maatskappy in 2016.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the preservation orders granted to the Asset Forfeiture Unit of the National Prosecuting Authority (NPA) by the Gauteng High Court against those involved in ‘financing’ the purchase of Optimum Coal Mine for R.1-billion in 2016 by the Gupta-owned Tegeta Exploration and Resources company.

src: Die uitsprake, wat die doeltreffende gekoördineerde benadering van die NVO en die prioriteitsmisdaaddirektoraat van die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens demonstreer, stuur ŉ sterk boodskap oor die groeiende kapasiteit van die regering om korte mette te maak van staatskaping en te verseker dat diegene wat daarin betrokke is, tot verantwoording te bring – en gesteelde geld terug te kry en terug te gee.
tgt: The rulings, which demonstrate the effective coordinated approach of the NPA and the Directorate for Priority Crime Investigation of the South African Police Service, send a strong message about the growing capacity of government to deal with State Capture and ensure accountability for those involved – and to seize, recover and return stolen money.

src: As deel daarvan om diegene betrokke met korrupsie verantwoordbaar te hou, verwelkom die Kabinet ook die uitspraak van die Palm Ridge-gespesialiseerde kommersiële misdaadhof in Gauteng teen ŉ voormalige finansiële kontrolleerder van Eskom vir die bedrog van R35 miljoen teen die energieverskaffer deur vals fakture vir die vervoer van steenkool te verwerk.
tgt: In holding those involved in corruption accountable, Cabinet also welcomed the judgement by the Palm Ridge Specialised Commercial Crimes Court in Gauteng against a former Eskom financial controller for defrauding the power utility of R35 million by loading fake invoices for coal transport and the initiatives to recover the stolen monies.

src: As ŉ belangrike mylpaal in ons nasie se stryd teen korrupsie, verwelkom die Kabinet die oorhandiging van die vierde deel van die Regterlike Kommissie van Ondersoek na Staatskaping se verslag.
tgt: As an important milestone in our nation’s fight against corruption, Cabinet welcomed the handover of the fourth part of the Judicial Commission of Inquiry into State Capture Report.

src: President Ramaphosa sal ingrypings om die kommissie se aanbevelings te implementeer aan die Parlement voorlê wanneer hy die volle verslag teen 30 Junie 2022 oorhandig.
tgt: President Ramaphosa will present to Parliament interventions to implement the commission’s recommendations when he submits the full report by 30 June 2022.

src: Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap (SAOG) Spesiale Troika-Spitskonferensie Die Kabinet verwelkom die uitkomste van die SAOG se Spesiale Troika-Spitsberaad wat op Maandag 4 April 2022 en Dinsdag, 5 April in Pretoria plaasgevind het.
tgt: Southern African Development Community (SADC) Extraordinary Organ Troika Summit.

src: Suid-Afrika was die gasheer as deel van sy rol as voorsitter van die SAOG-ligaam vir politiek, verdediging en sekuriteits-samewerking.
tgt: South Africa hosted the summit as Chair of the SADC Organ on Politics, Defence and Security Cooperation.

src: Die land se dienstydperk duur van Augustus 2021 to Augustus 2022.
tgt: The country’s tenure runs from August 2021 to August 2022.

src: Die spitsberaad het onder meer die SAOG-missie in Mosambiek se vorderingsverslag ontvang.
tgt: The summit received, among others, the SADC Mission in Mozambique (SAMIM) progress report.

src: Die SAOG-missie in Mosambiek is ontplooi ter ondersteuning van Mosambiek se stryd teen terrorisme en dade van geweldadige ekstremisme.
tgt: The SAMIM was deployed to support Mozambique to combat terrorism and acts of violent extremism.

src: Ekonomie Die Kabinet verwelkom die kredietgradeerder, Moody’s se opgradering van hul beskouing van Suid-Afrika vanaf negatief tot stabiel, en die besluit om Suid-Afrika se langtermyn-skuldgradering in buitelandse en plaaslike geldeenhede as ‘Ba2’ te bevestig.
tgt: Economy Cabinet welcomed credit rating agency Moody’s upgrade of its outlook on South Africa to stable from negative and the decision to affirm South Africa’s long-term foreign and local currency debt ratings at ‘Ba2’.

src: Die opgradering bevestig die regering se werk om die volhoubaarheid van die land se publieke finansies te herstel, wat gesteun word deur beter-as-verwagte inkomste-invordering.
tgt: The upgrade affirms the work of government to restore sustainability to the country’s public finances, which is supported by better-than-expected revenue collection.

src: Inkomste-opbrengs vir die tydperk April 2021 tot Maart 2022 toon dat die Suid-Afrikaanse Inkomstediens meer as R.5 triljoen ingevorder het.
tgt: Revenue results for the period April 2021 to March 2022, showed that the South African Revenue Service collected more than R.5 trillion.

src: Dit verteenwoordig ŉ verbetering van 25 persent teenoor die vorige jaar en ŉ styging van 15 persent teenoor die laaste jaar voor die KOVID-19-pandemie.
tgt: It represents a 25 percent improvement over the previous year and a 15 percent increase over the last year prior to the COVID-19 pandemic.

src: Die regering gebruik die ekstra inkomste om skuldstabilisering te versnel en dringende maatskaplike nood aan te spreek, werkskepping te bevorder by wyse van die Presidensiële jeugindiensnemingsinisiatief, en steun te verskaf aan die openbare sektor.
tgt: Government is using the additional revenue to accelerate debt stabilisation and address urgent social needs, promote job creation through the Presidential Youth Employment Initiative, and support the public health sector.

src: Vryheidsmaand.
tgt: Freedom Month.

src: Suid-Afrika vier vanjaar Vryheidsmaand in April, met hernude hoop vir ŉ beter toekoms, nadat ons twee somber jare onder die wêreldwye KOVID-19-pandemie verduur het.
tgt: South Africa this year celebrates Freedom Month in April with renewed hope for a better tomorrow, having endured two sombre years under the global COVID-19 pandemic.

src: Die jaarlikse Vryheidsdag sal op Woensdag, 27 April 2022 herdenk word.
tgt: The annual Freedom Day will be commemorated on Wednesday, 27 April 2022.

src: Vryheidsmaand herdenk en eer almal wat opofferings gemaak het om dit moontlik te maak dat ons die menseregte en vryhede wat in ons wêreldbekroonde Grondwet vervat is, kan waardeer.
tgt: Freedom Month commemorates and salutes all those whose sacrifices made it possible for us to enjoy the human rights and freedoms contained in our world-acclaimed Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.

src: Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om saam te werk in ons stryd om die impak van KOVID-19 te oorkom.
tgt: Cabinet called on all South Africans to work together as we continue our struggle to overcome the impact of COVID-19.

src: Ons moet almal ons deel bring om ons ekonomie te herstel as deel van die ekonomiese herstel- en heropbouplan en meer besighede op die been te bring en sodoende meer werke te skep.
tgt: We all need to do our part to restore our economy, through the Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan, and grow more businesses to be able to create more jobs.

src: Heilige Maand van Ramadan Die Kabinet wens Suid-Afrika se Moslem-gemeenskap ŉ geseënde Heilige Maand van Ramadan toe.
tgt: Holy Month of Ramadan Cabinet wished South Africa’s Muslim community a blessed Holy Month of Ramadan.

src: Ramadan word jaarliks regoor die wêreld gedenk deur gebed, vaste en liefdadigheid.
tgt: Ramadan is annually marked around the world with prayer, fasting and acts of charity.

src: Die Moslem-gemeenskap is ŉ integrale deel van ons nasionale diversiteit en ons nasionale karakter.
tgt: The Muslim community is an integral part of our national diversity and of our national character.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet decisions.

src: Konsep Nasionale Geïntegreerde Kleinsake-ontwikkeling (NISED) Mesterplan Die Kabinet keur die publikasie van die konsep NISED goed vir publike kommentaar.
tgt: Draft National Integrated Small Enterprise Development (NISED) Masterplan.

src: Die aanvanklike Geïntegreerde Strategie vir Entrepreneurskap en Kleinsake-ondernemings is in 2005 aanvaar.
tgt: The initial Integrated Strategy for Entrepreneurship and Small Enterprises was adopted in 2005.

src: Dié strategie en die latere NISED bekragtig die 1995 Witskrif oor Nasionale Strategie op die Ontwikkeling en Bevordering van Kleinsakeondernemings in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: The strategy and the subsequent NISED give effect to the 1995 White Paper on National Strategy for the Development and Promotion of Small Business in South Africa.

src: Sodra dit aanvaar is, sal die NISED die huidige Geïntegreerde Strategie vir Entrepreneurskap en Kleinsake-ondernemings vervang.
tgt: Once adopted the NISED will replace the current Integrated Strategy for Entrepreneurship and Small Enterprises.

src: Dit sal ŉ koördineringsraamwerk aan alle sleutelrolspelers in die ekosisteem van kleinsake-ontwikkeling bied.
tgt: It will provide a coordination framework for all key ecosystem role players in small enterprise development.

src: Dit lei ook die koördineringsmeganisme wat leiding sal gee aan alle programme wat steun verleen aan kleinsake-ondernemings.
tgt: It guides the coordinating mechanism that will guide all programmes that support small enterprises.

src: Hierdie strategie streef daarna om die deelname van kleinsake-ondernemings in die formele ekonomie aan te moedig, burokratiese rompslomp uit te skakel en dit makliker maak om handelk te dryf, veral vir klein entrepreneurs.
tgt: This strategy seeks to increase the participation of small enterprises in the formal economy, eliminate red tape and promote the ease of doing business, particularly for small entrepreneurs.

src: Die NISED is die eindproduk van breedvoerige konsultasie met die betrokke departemente van die nasionale, provinsiale en plaaslike sfere van die regering, handel, arbeid, akademikuste en verskeie relevante instellings.
tgt: The NISED is the product of a wide consultation with the relevant departments in the national, provincial and local spheres of government, business, labour, academics and various relevant institutions.

src: Inlywing van die Agentskap vir die Finansiering van Kleinsake (Sefa) en die Ontwikkelingsagentskap vir Koöperatiewe Banke (CBDA) in die Kleinsake-ontwikkelingsagentskap (Seda) Die Kabinet het die 20-maand verlengingstydperk vir die samesmelting van die twee entiteite, die Sefa en die CBDA, na die Seda goedgekeur.
tgt: Incorporation of the Small Enterprise Finance Agency (SEFA) and Cooperative Banks Development Agency (CBDA) into the Small Enterprise Development Agency (SEDA).

src: Die samesmelting was aanvanklik verwag om van krag te wees vanaf 1 April 2022.
tgt: Cabinet approved the 20 months extension period for the merging of the two entities, the SEFA and CBDA, into the SEDThe merger was initially set to be effective from 1 April 2022.

src: Dít na die Kabinet die samesmeltings goedgekeur het om te verseker dat die regering ŉ enkele entiteit verskaf wat die regerings se werksaamhede in die steun van klein- tot mediumsake-indernemings en koöperasies sal ondersteun.
tgt: This was after Cabinet approved the mergers to ensure government provides a single entity that will support its work in supporting small to medium enterprises and cooperatives.

src: Die goedkeuring van die verlengingstydperk sal die departement van kleinsake-ontwikkeling die geleentheid gee om die regterlike hersiening te finaliseer om sodoende ŉ gepaste wetgewings- en beleidsomgewing te verskaf wat die vorming van die enkele entiteit – Seda – moontlik sal maak.
tgt: The approved extension will enable the Department of Small Business Development to finalise the legislative review to provide a proper legislated and policy environment that allows the formation of the single entity – SEDA single and well-resourced entity will provide a more streamlined support to small to medium enterprises and cooperatives.

src: ŉ Enkele entiteit met ŉ wye verskeidenheid hulpbronne tot sy beskikking sal meer vaartbelynde steun aan klein- tot mediumsake-indernemings en koöperasies kan lewer.
tgt: Cabinet also approved the appointment of the interim Boards of Directors for the SEFA and SEDRegulations relating to the Protection, Promotion, Development and Management of Indigenous Knowledge (IK regulations) Cabinet approved the publication of IK regulations for public comment.

src: Die IK-regulasies sal die implementering van die Wet op die Beskerming, Bevordering, Ontwikkeling en Bestuur van Inheemse Kennis, 2019 (Wet 6 van 2019) bekragtig.
tgt: The IK regulations will give effect to the implementation of the IK Act, 2019 (Act 6 of 2019).

src: Die Wet het die beskerming, bevordering, ontwikkeling en bestuur van inheemse kennis ten doel.
tgt: The Act provides for the protection, promotion, development and management of indigenous knowledge.

src: Dit voorsien vir die vestiging van nasionale IK-stelsels en die bestuur van die regte van die inheemse kennis van gemeenskappe.
tgt: It provides for the establishment of national IK systems management of rights of IK of communities.

src: Dit voorsien ook vir die totstandkoming van ŉ adviespaneel, erkenning vir voorgaande kunde en kennis, en die fasilitering en koördinering van IDie voorgestelde regulasies sal onder meer aan die volgende aandag gee: die opstel van die adviespaneel, akkreditasieprosesse, registrasie van vaardighede van IK-praktisyns, hoe om IK te gebruik en toegang daartoe te verkry, en die bewaring van IK-registers.
tgt: It also provides for the establishment of an advisory panel recognition of prior learnings facilitation and coordination of IThe proposed regulations deal with, amongst others, the setting up of the Advisory Panel accreditation processes registration of competencies of IK practitioners how to access or use IK and the safekeeping of registers of IThe regulations also provide for dispute-resolution mechanisms.

src: Die regulasies sal in die Staatskoerant gepubliseer word en sal ook beskikbaar wees op die departement van wetenskap en innovering se webwerf: WEBTOKEDit sal beskikbaar wees in alle amptelike landstale.
tgt: The regulations will be gazetted and can also be accessed through the Department of Science and Innovation website: WEBTOKEThey will also be available in all official languages.

src: Verenigde Nasies se Volhoubare Ontwikkelings en Samewerkingsraamwerk (UNSDCF) 2020-2025 Die Kabinet het Suid-Afrika se UNSDCF 2020-2025 vir implementering goedgekeur.
tgt: United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) 2020-2025 Cabinet approved South Africa’s UNSDCF 2020-2025 for implementation.

src: Die raamwerk dien as ŉ verantwoordbaarsvennootskap tussen die regering, die breër samelewing en die VN se kantoor in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: The framework provides an accountability partnership between government, the broader society and the UN’s country office in South Africa.

src: Die UNSDCF onderskryf vier breë strategiese pilare om die volgende te dek: (1) inklusiewe, geregtige en volhoubare groei (2) menslike kapitaal en maatskaplike transformasie (3) doeltreffende, bekwame en transformerende bestuur en (4) klimaatveerkragtigheid en natuurlike hulpbronne wat volhoubaar bestuur word.
tgt: The UNSDCF outlines four broad strategic priority pillars to cover (1) inclusive , justice and sustainable growth (2) human capital and social transformation (3) effective, efficient and transformative governance and (4) climate resilience and sustainably managed natural resources.

src: Hierdie strategiese pilare skakel ineen met die land se Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan: Visie 2030 en die Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk, asook met die VN se volhoubare ontwikkelingsdoelwitte wat deur die VN-kantoor in Suid-Afrika aangedryf word.
tgt: These strategic pillars are interlinked with the country’s National Development Plan: Vision 2030 and the Medium Term Strategic Framework, and also with the UN Sustainable Development Goals driven through the UN country’s office in South Africa.

src: Die implementering sal plaasvind via ŉ gesamentlike mobiliseringstrategie.
tgt: The implementation will be done through a joint resource mobilisation strategy.

src: Nasionhale Ingryping in die Mangaung metropolitaanse and Enoch Mgijima plaaslike munisipaliteite.
tgt: National intervention in the Mangaung Metropolitan and Enoch Mgijima Local municipalities.

src: Die Kabinet het die ingryping goedgekeur ingevolge artikel 139(7) van die Grondwet, saamgelees met artikel 150 van die Wet op Munisipale Finansiële Bestuur, 2003 (Wet 56 van 2003), in die Mangaung metropolitaanse and Enoch Mgijima plaaslike munisipaliteite.
tgt: Cabinet approved the intervention in terms of Section 139(7) of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996, read together with Section 150 of the Municipal Finance Management Act, 2003 (Act 56 of 2003), in the Mangaung Metropolitan and Enoch Mgijima Local municipalities.

src: Beide munisipaliteite het noemenswaardige finansiële en diensleweringsmislukkings vir ŉ geruimde tyd ervaar.
tgt: Both municipalities have been experiencing significant financial and service delivery failures for a prolonged period.

src: Die Vrystaatse provinsiële uitvoerende gesag het die Mangaung metropolitaanse munisipaliteit in Desember 2019 onder ŉ verpligte ingryping geplaas ingevolge artikel 139(5)
tgt: The Free State Provincial Executive placed the Mangaung Metropolitan Municipality under a mandatory intervention in terms of Section 139(5)

src: en
tgt: and

src: van die Grondwet.
tgt: of the Constitution in December 2019.

src: ŉ Verpligte finansiële herstelplan is gevolglik in 2020 op die munisipaliteit geïmponeer.
tgt: A mandatory financial recovery plan was subsequently imposed on the municipality in 2020.

src: Nadat die metro vir twee jaar lank daarin misluk het om die herstelplan te implementeer, is die metro nou onder ŉ nasionale ingryping geplaas ingevolge artikel 139(7) van die Grondwet.
tgt: After failing for more than two years to implement the financial recovery plan during the provincial intervention, the Metro has now been placed under a national intervention in terms of Section 139(7) of the Constitution.

src: Die Enoch Mgijima plaaslike munisipaliteit is ook onder ŉ verpligte ingryping geplaas in 2018 deur die Oos-Kaapse provinsiale uitvoerende gesag, ingevolge artikel 139(5)
tgt: The Enoch Mgijima Local Municipality was also placed under mandatory intervention by the Eastern Cape Provincial Executive in terms of Section 139(5)

src: Nadat die munisipaliteit daarin misluk het om vordering te maak in die verbetering van finansiële en diensleweringsverrigting, het die Kabinet egter besluit om hierdie munisipaliteit ook onder ŉ nasionale ingryping te plaas.
tgt: However, after the municipality failed to make progress in improving its financial and service delivery performance, Cabinet decided to place it under a national intervention.

src: Die aanroeping van ŉ nasionale ingryping ingevolge artikel 139(7) van die Grondwet impliseer dat die nasionale regering nou in beide munisipaliteite sal intree, in plaas van die provinsiale uitvoerende gesag.
tgt: The invocation of a national intervention in terms of Section 139(7) of the Constitution implies that in both municipalities, national government will now act in the stead of the Provincial Executive.

src: Hierdie soort ingryping in verpligtend en volg dieselfde prosedures as artikel 139(5) van die Grondwet, behalwe dat die nasionale regering nou direkte verantwoordelikheid neem vir hierdie ingrypings.
tgt: This type of intervention is mandatory and follows the same procedure as Section 139(5) of the Constitution, except that national government will now directly assume responsibility for these interventions.

src: Om gevolg te gee aan die aanvaarding van verantwoordelikheid, sal nasionale kabinetsverteenwoordigers binnekort na beide munisipaliteite ontplooi word.
tgt: To give effect to the assumption of responsibility, National Cabinet Representatives (NCR) will shortly be deployed to both municipalities.

src: Die minister van finansies sal gesag delegeer aan hierdie kabinetsverteenwoordigers en hulle sal verder deur ŉ multidissiplinêre span deskundiges ondersteun word.
tgt: The Minister of Finance will delegate powers to the NCR and will also be supported by a multidisciplinary team of experts.

src: Geen besluit is tot dusver geneem om die munisipale raad te ontbind ingevolge artikel 139(5) van die Grondwet nie.
tgt: No decision has yet been taken to dissolve the municipal council in terms of Section 139(5) of the Constitution.

src: Die nasionale ingryping sal van krag wees nadat dit amptelik in die Staatskoerant gepubliseer is die huidige ingryping luidens artikel 139(5) sal tot dan van krag wees.
tgt: The national intervention will take effect upon formal gazetting in the Government Gazette, however, the current Section 139(5) intervention will remain in effect until this date.

src: Die ingryping luidens artikel 139(1) betreffende die Enoch Mgijima plaaslike munisipaliteit sal ook vervang word deur ingrypings luidens artikel 139 (5)
tgt: The Section 139(1) intervention into the Enoch Mgijima Local Municipality will also be replaced by a Section 139 (5)

src: en , wat ook die mislukking van die munisipaliteit om sy uitvoerende pligte en verantwoordelikhede te vervul, sal aanspreek.
tgt: intervention, which will also cover the failure of the municipality to fulfil its executive obligations.

src: Die minister in die Presidensie, mnr Mondli Gungubele, sal – in samewerking met die minister van finansies, mnr Enoch Godongwana en die minister van samewerkende regering en tradisionele sake, dr. Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma – ŉ persverklaring uitreik om die nasionale ingryping te omskryf.
tgt: The Minister in The Presidency, Mr Mondli Gungubele will – together with the Minister of Finance, Mr Enoch Godongwana and the Minister of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, Dr Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma – hold a media briefieng next week to outline the national intervention.

src: Toekomstige Gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming event.

src: Distriksontwikkelingsmodel (DDM) Presidensiële Imbizo.
tgt: District Development Model (DDM) Presidential Imbizo.

src: President Ramaphosa sal op Vrydag, 8 April 2022 en Saterdag, 9 April 2022 ŉ DDM Presidensiële Imbizo hou by die Petrus Molemela-sportkompleks in Mangaung in die Vrystaat.
tgt: President Ramaphosa will hold a DDM Presidential Imbizo at the Petrus Molemela Sports Complex in Mangaung, Free State on Friday, 8 and Saturday, 9 April 2022.

src: Die Imbizo, wat plaasvind onder die tema: “Laat niemand agter nie”, sal die vlak van dienslewering in die provinsie in oënskou neem, die vordering van die DDM volg, en toesig hou oor ingrypings en planne van kernbelang.
tgt: The Imbizo, convened under the theme: “Leave no one behind”, will assess the level of service delivery in the province, track progress on the DDM, and oversee key interventions and plans.

src: Die DDM Presidensiële Imbizo is ŉ belangrike platform vir publieke deelname omdat dit aan burgers ŉ stem verleen en die President die geleentheid gee om na die mense te luister en ag te slaan op die dinge wat hulle kwel.
tgt: The DDM Presidential Imbizo is an important public participation platform as its gives citizens a voice and the President the opportunity to listen to the people and respond to their concerns.

src: Suid-Afrikaners kan op sosiale media hierdie gesprekvoering volg en daaraan deelneem onder die hutsmerk #PresidentialImbizo.
tgt: South Africans can follow and participate in discussions on social media under the hashtag #PresidentialImbizo.

src: GelukwensingsDie Kabinet het sy gelukwense en welmenendheid gerig aan die: Mnr Nkosinathi Maphumulo, beter bekend as DJ Black Coffee, wat onlangs sy eerste Grammy-toekenning gewen het in die kategorie “Beste Dans-/Elektroniese Album” vir sy album Subconsciously by die 64e-toekenningseremonie wat plaasgevind het in Las Vegas in die Verenigde State.
tgt: CongradulationsCabinet extended its congratulations and well-wishes to: Mr Nkosinathi Maphumulo, better known as DJ Black Coffee, who recently won his first Grammy in the category of “Best Dance/Electronic Album” for his album Subconsciously, at the 64th Grammy Awards ceremony held in Las Vegas, United States.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifiëring van kwalifikasies en toepaslike klaring.
tgt: Appointment All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant WEBTOKEN Mpumelelo Tyikwe as Chief Executive Officer and Executive Director of the South African Special Risk Insurance Association.

src: Kwessies in die Omgewing.
tgt: Issues in the environment.

src: Rampbestuur na aanleiding van die vloede.
tgt: Disaster management after the floods.

src: Die Kabinet het hul medelye uitgespreek met almal wat geliefdes verloor het tydens die onlangse verwoestende vloede wat verskeie dele van die land geraak het, in besonder KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Cabinet expressed condolences to all people who have lost their loved ones in the recent devastating floods that hit several parts of our country, particularly KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Die verklaring van ŉ nasionale ramptoestand en sosio-ekonomiese hulpingrypings wat onlangs deur President Cyril Ramaphosa aangekondig is, het ten doel om doeltreffende en gekoördineerde teenmaatreëls regoor alle regeringsfere te verseker, by wyse van die nasionale rampbestuursentrum.
tgt: The declaration of a National State of Disaster and socio-economic relief interventions recently announced by President Cyril Ramaphosa, sought to ensure an effective and coordinated response across all spheres of government, through the National Disaster Management Centre.

src: Die R1 miljard wat beskikbaar gestel is deur die regering word aangewend om verligtings- en herstelpogings te steun, basiese dienste weer beskikbaar te stel en humanitêre steun te lewer by wyse van voedsel, water, skuiling, sanitasie en klere.
tgt: The R1 billion made available by the government is being used to support relief and recovery efforts, restore basic services and provide humanitarian assistance in the form of food, water, shelter, sanitation and clothing.

src: Die proses om areas wat deur die vloede geraak is, te herbou, het reeds begin, met ons land se mense wat verenig is in hul vasberadenheid om hulp te verleen aan diegene wat hul huise en besittings verloor het.
tgt: The process to rebuild affected areas has already started as the people of our country unite in their determination to assist those who have lost their homes and possessions.

src: Nuutste oor die koronavirussiekte (KOVID-19) Die Kabinet is besorg oor die onlangse skerp styging in KOVID-19-infeksies in sommige dele van die land en spoor alle burgers aan om voorkomingsmaatreëls te tref om hulself teen die virus te beskerm, veral tydens die winterseisoen.
tgt: Update on the Coronavirus Disease (COVID-19) Cabinet noted with concern the recent spike in COVID-19 infections in some parts of the country and urged all people to take precautionary measures to protect themselves against the deadly virus, especially during winter.

src: Die virus is steeds ŉ bedreiging en inenting bied die mees doeltreffende beskerming daarteen.
tgt: The virus is still a constant threat and vaccination remains the most effective weapon to protect ourselves.

src: Die Kabinet is daarmee genoë dat al meer en meer mense kies om ingeënt te word vir beskerming teen die virus, na aanleiding van onlangse statistieke wat getoon het dat ons die mylpaal van meer as 50% van volwasse inentings in vyf provinsies bereik het.
tgt: The cabinet is pleased that more people continue to choose vaccination as their first line of defence against COVID-19 after recent statistics showed that we have reached the milestone of over 50 per cent of adult vaccinations in five provinces.

src: Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op almal wat nog nie ingeënt is nie, om ingeënt te word om hulself en hul geliefdes te beskerm.
tgt: Cabinet calls on those who have not yet been vaccinated to do so to protect themselves and their loved ones.

src: Ons moet ook alle KOVID-19-voorkomingsmaatreëls volg, insluitend die dra van gesigmaskers wat beide neus en mond bedek, gereelde handewas met seep en water of ŉ 70%-alkoholgebaseerde handsaniteerder, en om ŉ veilige sosiale afstand van minstens een meter van ander mense te handhaaf.
tgt: We should also all continue to adhere to all COVID-19 prevention protocols, including the wearing of a mask that covers both the nose and mouth, washing hands with water and soap, or using a 70% alcohol-based hand sanitiser, and keeping a safe social distance of at least one metre.

src: Die Kabinet moedig burgers wat die R350 maatskaplike verligting van nood-toelae ontvang om weer daarvoor aansoek te doen, na aanleiding van die nuwe regulasies wat aansoeke en kwalifisering vir die toelae reguleer.
tgt: Social Relief of Distress (SRD) Grant Cabinet encouraged citizens receiving the R350 SRD Grant to reapply, following the introduction of new regulations governing applications and eligibility for the grant.

src: Aansoeke kan ingedien word op die Suid-Afrikaanse Agentskap vir Maatskaplike Sekerheid (SASSA) se WEBTOKEN Die stelsel vir aansoeke het op 23 April 2022 in werking getree en die proses is ten volle digitaal om vinnige omkeertye te verseker.
tgt: Applications can be lodged on the South African Social Security Agency (SASSA) website: WEBTOKEN The application system opened on 23 April 2022 and is a fully digital process to enable quick turnaround times.

src: Die toelae is ŉ belangrike veiligheidsnet vir behoeftige gesinne wat andersins nie die mas sou opkom onder die juk van armoede en werkloosheid nie.
tgt: The relief grant is an important safety net for needy families who would otherwise be devastated by the scourge of poverty and unemployment.

src: Die regering is daartoe verbind om maatskaplike steun te lewer aan die mees weerlose mense in ons samelewing sodat daar aan hule basiese behoeftes voldoen word.
tgt: Government is committed to providing social assistance to the most vulnerable so that they can meet their basic needs.

src: Die Kabinet verdoem steeds die sinnelose moor van vroue en het die spoedige aksie van wetstoepassingsagentskappe in die inhegtenisname van verdagtes in die moord op me.
tgt: Safety and security Cabinet continues to condemn the senseless killing of women and has welcomed the swift response by law-enforcement officers in arresting suspects in connection with the death of Ms Hillary Gardee (28), of Kamagugu in Mpumalanga.

src: Hillary Gardee (28) van Kamagugu in Mpumalanga verwelkom.
tgt: Cabinet further condemned the killing of six people in Khayelitsha, Cape Town.

src: Hierdie sinnelose moorde dien as herinnering daaraan dat ons as ŉ samelewing meer moet doen om geweld en geslagsgebaseerde geweld en vrouemoord (GGGV) te verhoed.
tgt: These senseless murders are a reminder that we must do more as a society to end violence and gender-based violence and femicide (GBVF).

src: Die Kabinet spoor alle landsinwoners aan om hul samewerking aan die regering te gee in die stryd teen misdaad en GGGSaam kan ons verseker dat ons gemeenskappe en strate veilig is vir alle mense, insluitend bejaardes, vroue en kinders.
tgt: Cabinet urged all people in the country to work with the government in the fight against crime and GBVTogether we can ensure that our communities and streets are safer for all people, including the elderly, women and children.

src: Ekonomie.
tgt: Economy.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die amptelike opening van Corobrik se Kwastina-baksteenvervaardigingsfabriek in Driefontein in Gauteng, behartig deur President Ramaphosa op Woensdag, 4 Me 2022.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the official opening of Corobrik’s Kwastina brick manufacturing factory at Driefontein in Gauteng by President Ramaphosa on Wednesday, 4 May 2022.

src: Die ultra-moderne fabriek vorm deel van ŉ belegging van R800 miljoen, tesame met ŉ verdere R200 miljoen wat daarvoor geoormerk is om Corobrik se betonhandel in KwaZulu-Natal uit te brei.
tgt: The state-of-the-art factory forms part of an R800 million investment, which goes hand in hand with a further R200 million earmarked to expand Corobrik’s concrete operations in KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Corobrik is een van verskeie plaaslike ondernemings wat gereageer het op President Ramaphosa se beroep op Suid-Afrika en buitelandse ondernemings om in ons ekonomie te belê.
tgt: Corobrik is one of several local businesses that have responded to President Ramaphosa’s call on South African and international enterprises to invest in this economy.

src: Die Kabinet neem daarvan kennis dat die ontluikende waterstofekonomie ŉ hupstoot ontvang het danksy die loods van ŉ trok wat waterstof as brandstof gebruik, deur Anglo American.
tgt: Cabinet noted that the fledgling hydrogen economy has been given a boost with the launch of a hydrogen-powered truck by Anglo American.

src: Die trok – wat vanaf diesel na waterstof aangepas is en deels krag trek vanaf litium-ioon batterye – is een van die eerste van sy soort in die wêreld.
tgt: The truck – which was converted from diesel to hydrogen, and is powered in part by lithium-ion batteries – is a world first.

src: Die waterstofekonomie is identifiseer as ŉ strategiese prioriteit vir ons land se groen ekonomie en as noodsaaklik om ekonomiese groei en werkskepping aan te dryf.
tgt: The hydrogen economy has been identified as a strategic priority for our country’s green economy, and to drive economic growth and employment.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom ook ŉ verdere belegging in ons ekonomie deur die Ierse voedselmaatskappy The Kerry Group, wat ŉ nuwe uitleg ter waarde van R650 miljoen in Hammarsdale, KwaZulu-Natal geopen het met die doel om volhoubare voedsel vir die kontinent te produseer.
tgt: Cabinet also welcomed a further investment into our economy by an Irish food company, The Kerry Group, which has opened a new R650-million plant in Hammarsdale, KwaZulu-Natal aimed at producing sustainable food for the continent.

src: Die uitleg is uniek synde dit spog met verskeie volhoubare eietrekke insluitend lae-energieverbruiktoerusting, sonkragopwekking op verbruik op die plaaslike netwerk te verminder, die herwinning van verspilde hitte, asook die herwinning, herbruik en verminderde gebruik van water.
tgt: The plant is unique as it boasts numerous sustainability features including low energy usage equipment, solar power generation to reduce consumption from the local grid, waste heat capture, and efficient water capture, reuse and reduction.

src: Die Kerry Group is sedert 2011 werksaam in Suid-Afrika en hul verdere belegging is ŉ teken dat Suid-Afrika ŉ voorkeur-beleggingsbestemmig is.
tgt: The Kerry Group has had a presence in South Africa since 2011, and their further investment is a sign that South Africa remains an investment destination of choice.

src: Hierdie beleggings volg in die voetspore van die loods van die plaaslikvervaardigde Isuzu D-Max-bakkie laasmaand in Gqeberha in die Oos-Kaap.
tgt: These investments follow in the footsteps of the launch of the locally manufactured Isuzu D-Max bakkie in Gqeberha in the Eastern Cape last month.

src: Die nuwe-generasie D-MAX bekroon Isuzu se verbintenis tot Suid-Afrika en is een van die suksesse wat behaal is onder die vaandel van die voertuigvervaardigingsontwikkelingsprogram (oftewel Automotive Production Development Programme [APDP]).
tgt: The new generation D-MAX crowns Isuzu’s commitment to South Africa and is one of the successes achieved under the Automotive Production Development Programme (APDP).

src: Die APDP is ŉ vervaardigingsaanporingskema vir die voertuigbedryf wat gemik is op die bevordering van vervaardigingsvolumes in die aangewese motorvoertuigbedryf, wat voorts ook toegevoegde waarde bevorder en op dié manier werkskepping regoor die voertuigwaardeketting aanspoor.
tgt: The APDP is a production incentive scheme for the motor industry aimed at promoting production volumes in the specified motor vehicle industry, promoting added value in the automotive component industry thus creating employment across the automotive value chain.

src: Plaaslike vervvardiging van inhoud van nagenoeg R.8 miljard sal tydens die lewensiklus van die APDP plaasvind.
tgt: Approximately R2,8 billion will be generated in local content production value through the lifecycle of the APDThe investment will secure more than 1 000 direct jobs at the plant and indirectly employ 24 000 people, contributing significantly to community upliftment in the region.

src: Mynwese-indaba.
tgt: Mining Indaba.

src: Die “Investing in African Mining” Indaba 2022 het vanaf 9 tot 12 Me by die Kaapstad internasionale konferensiesentrum plaasgevind.
tgt: The Investing in African Mining Indaba 2022 held at the Cape Town International Convention Centre from 9 to 12 May 2022, is one of the biggest platforms for engagement and collaboration between all stakeholders in the mining industry.

src: Die tema vir die indaba was “Evolusie van die Mynwese in Afrika: Belegging in die Oordrag van Energie, ESG en die Ekonomieë”.
tgt: The theme of the event was: “Evolution of African Mining: Investing in the Energy Transition, ESG, and the Economies”.

src: Die Kabinet is vol vertroue dat die mynwese-indaba by sal dra tot die tentoonstelling en bevording van Suid-Afrika as ŉ voorkeur-beleggingsbestemming.
tgt: Cabinet is confident that the Mining Indaba will assist in showcasing and promoting South Africa as an investment destination of choice.

src: Suid-Afrika verwelkom beleggings in ons land en is daartoe verbind om gunstige toestande te skep vir inklusiewe groei en transformasie in die ekonomie.
tgt: South Africa welcomes investments into our country and is committed to creating favourable conditions for inclusive growth and transformation of the economy.

src: Internasionale en streeksbande.
tgt: International and regional relations.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom ook President Ramaphosa se onlangse interaksies met onderskeidelik President Joe Biden van die Verenigde State, President Emmanuel Macron van Frankryk en President Hakainde Hichilema van Zambië, wat op verskillende platforms plaasgevind het.
tgt: Cabinet also welcomed President Ramaphosa’s recent interactions with President Joe Biden of the United States, President Emmanuel Macron of France and President Hakainde Hichilema of Zambia on different platforms.

src: Hierdie geleenthede het aan die president die geleentheid gebied om bilaterale verhoudinge en samewerking tussen Suid-Afrika en ons vennootslande te versterk ten opsigte van streeks- en internasionale sake van sleutelbelang, insluitend ŉ vreedsame oplossing tot die konflik in die Oekraïene.
tgt: These engagements allowed the President to strengthen bilateral relations and cooperation between South Africa and partner states on key regional and international issues, including finding a peaceful solution to the conflict in Ukraine.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet Decisions.

src: Begrotingstem.
tgt: Budget Votes.

src: Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op alle burgers om die onderskeie begrotingstemme deur die nasionale staatsdepartemente en die Presidensie te volg sodat hulle die regering tot verantwoording kan roep.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all citizens to follow the various Budget Votes by national government departments and The Presidency so that they can hold the government to account.

src: Tydens die begrotingstem lewer alle departemente ŉ gedetailleerde verslag van hul beplanning en prioriteite vir die jaar.
tgt: During Budget Votes, all departments give a detailed account of their plans and priorities for the year.

src: Die begrotingstem het ten doel om te verseker dat openbare fondse doeltreffend bestee word om die behoeftes van die publiek te vervul.
tgt: Budget Votes seek to ensure that public funds are spent efficiently in meeting the needs of the public.

src: Die begrotingstem verskaf ook die ideale platform vir ministers om uit te wy oor die werkverrigting van die regering, insluitend suksesse en uitdagings.
tgt: They also provide the ideal platform for Ministers to further unpack the work of government, including successes and challenges.

src: Vloeibare petroleumgas (VPG) uitrolstrategie Die Kabinet keur die VPG-uitrolstrategie goed vir implementering.
tgt: Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) Rollout Strategy Cabinet approved the LPG Rollout Strategy for implementation, which was published for public consultation in March 2022.

src: Die strategie het ten doel om die VPG-bedryf in die land uit te brei.
tgt: The strategy seeks to expand the LPG industry in the country.

src: VPG sal ŉ betekenisvolle bydrae lewer tot die diversifikasie van energiebronne.
tgt: LPG will contribute meaningfully to the diversification of sources of energy.

src: Die strategie sal ingrypings soos die regulering van pryse in die waardeketting en die steun van die vervaardiging van VPG-silinders in die land implementeer.
