tgt: Board of Directors of the Council for Geoscience

src: Mnr Kelepile Dintwe (Voorsitter) Mnr Xolisa Mvinjelwa (Adjunkvoorsitter) Adv Ntika Maake Dr. Mayshree Singh Dr. Siyanda Mngadi Dr. Ntombifuthi Nxumalo Me Thobeka Njozela Mnr Andries Moatshe Dr. Moloko Matlala Mnr Mandla Malindisa
tgt: Mr Kelepile Dintwe (Chairperson) Mr Xolisa Mvinjelwa (Deputy Chairperson) Adv Ntika Maake Dr Mayshree Singh Dr Siyanda Mngadi Dr Ntombifuthi Nxumalo Ms Thobeka Njozela Mr Andries Moatshe Dr Moloko Matlala Mr Mandla Malindisa

src: Dr. Mmboneni Muofhe en Mnr Mosa Mabuza (HUB).
tgt: Dr Mmboneni Muofhe and Mr Mosa Mabuza (CEO).

src: Konsepwysigingswetsontwerp op die Onafhanklike Polisie-ondersoekdirektoraat (OPOD) van 2023 Die Kabinet het die OPOD-konsepwysigingswetsontwerp van 2023 vir voorlegging aan die Parlement, goedgekeur.
tgt: Draft Independent Police Investigative Directorate (IPID) Amendment Bill of 2023.

src: Die Wysigingswetsontwerp wysig die OPOD-wet, 2011 (Wetnr 1 van 2011) en maak voorstelle wat ten doel het om die institusionele en bedryfsonafhanklikheid van die OPOD te verskans, wat uiting aan die “McBride-uitspraak” gee.
tgt: The Bill amends the IPID Act, 2011 (Act 1 of 2011), and makes proposals aimed at entrenching the institutional and operational independence of the IPID, giving effect to the “McBride judgement”.

src: Die wysigings spreek ook die kwessies aan wat deur die Grondwetlike Hof geopper is en wat sekere voorskrifte van die OPOD-wet van 2011 as ongeldig verklaar het, wat die Minister toegelaat het om die Uitvoerende Direkteur te skors, om na skorsing dissiplinêre stappe teen die Uitvoerende Direkteur te neem, en om die Uitvoerende Direkteur uit die amp te verwyder.
tgt: The amendments also address the issues raised by the Constitutional Court which declared as invalid certain provisions of the IPID Act of 2011, which authorised the Minister of Police to suspend the Executive Director, to take disciplinary steps against the Executive Director following suspension, and to remove the Executive Director from office.

src: Die Wetsontwerp stel ŉ meer deursigtige en oop proses vir die aanstelling van die Uitvoerende Direkteur, asook ŉ gedetailleerde en deeglike proses vir integriteitstoetsing van OPOD-beamptes, voor.
tgt: The Bill proposes a more transparent and open process for the appointment of the Executive Director and also a detailed and thorough process for integrity testing of IPID officials.

src: Die Wetsontwerp maak ook voorsiening vir die wysiging van ander voorskrifte van die Hoofwet, om sodoende te verseker dat die OPOD sy mandaat doeltreffend en doelmatig uitvoer.
tgt: The Bill further provides for the amendment of other provisions of the Principal Act, so as to ensure that IPID executes its mandate effectively and efficiently.

src: Algemene Konsepwysigingswetsontwerp op Intelligensiewette (GILAB) van 2023 Die Kabinet het die konsep-GILAB van 2023 vir voorlegging aan die Parlement, goedgekeur.
tgt: The draft Bill can be found at WEBTOKEDraft General Intelligence Laws Amendment Bill (GILAB) of 2023 Cabinet approved the draft GILAB of 2023 for submission to Parliament.

src: Die GILAB stel wysigings voor aan die Wet op Nasionale Strategiese Intelligensie, 1994 (Wetnr 39 van 1994).
tgt: The GILAB proposes amendments to the National Strategic Intelligence Act, 1994 (Act 39 of 1994).

src: Die Wetsontwerp gee uitvoering aan die aanbevelings van die Presidensiële Hoëvlak-oorsigpaneel oor die Staatsveiligheidsagentskap (SVA) asook die implementeringsplan van die Regterlike Kommissie van Ondersoek oor die bewerings van ŉ staatsgreep, korrupsie en bedrog in die staatsektor, waaronder staatsliggame.
tgt: The Bill gives effect to the recommendations of the Presidential High-Level Review Panel on the State Security Agency (SSA) as well as the implementation plan of the recommendations of the Judicial Commission of Inquiry into Allegations of State Capture, Corruption and Fraud in the Public Sector including Organs of State.

src: Die Wetsontwerp beoog, onder andere, om:
tgt: Amongst others the Bill seeks to:

src: die intelligensiedienste te herstruktureer om voorsiening te maak vir ŉ institusionele argitektuur wat doeltreffendheid en doelmatigheid in werking stel deur die binnelandse intelligensie-agentskap en die buitelandse intelligensie-agentskap te vestig
tgt: restructure the intelligence services to provide an institutional architecture that enables effectiveness and efficiency by establishing the domestic intelligence agency and the foreign intelligence service

src: die gebreke oor die funksionering van die seinintelligensiekapasiteit, soos deur die Grondwetlike Hof bevestig, te herstel
tgt: remedy the defects on the functioning of the Signals Intelligence Capacity as confirmed by the Constitutional Court

src: die swakpunte wat deur die Finansiële Aksietaakspan-proses bepaal is, waaronder maatreëls om geldwassery en terrorisfinansiering te bestry deur die nasionale sekuriteitstrukture te bemagtig om ondersoek in te stel en ŉ sekuriteitsassessering uit te voer as ŉ persoon of instansie van nasionale belang is
tgt: address the weaknesses identified through Financial Action Task Force process, including measures to combat money laundering and terrorist financing by empowering the national security structures to investigate and conduct security assessment if a person or institution is of national security interest

src: maatreëls te versterk om die private sekruiteitsbedryf te reguleer en te koördineer, as deel van ŉ breër nasionale benadering en
tgt: Strengthen measures to regulate and coordinate the private security industry as part of a broader national security approach and

src: maatreëls in te stel wat die gedrag van voormalige lede van die diens en ander met toegang tot intelligensie-inligting, reguleer.
tgt: put in place measures to regulate the conduct of former members of the service and others with access to intelligence information.

src: Die Wetsontwerp sal ook verseker dat die SVA se dienste nie vir die belange of agenda van sekere individue, misbruik word nie.
tgt: The Bill will further ensure that the services of the SSA are not abused to serve the interests or agenda of certain individuals.

src: Die wysigings sal die toesig oor die intelligensie-agentskappe deur liggame soos die inspekteur-generaal van Intelligensie, die Gesamentlike staande komitee vir Intelligensie en die Ouditeur-Generaal van Suid-Afrika, versterk.
tgt: The amendments will strengthen the oversight of the intelligence agencies by bodies such as the Inspector-General of Intelligence, the Joint Standing Committee on Intelligence and the Auditor-General of South Africa.

src: Konsepwetsontwerp op die Openbare Dienstekommissie (ODK) van 2023 Die Kabinet het die publikasie van die Konsepwetsontwerp op ODK vir openbare kommentaar goedgekeur.
tgt: The Bill is available on WEBTOKEDraft Public Service Commission (PSC) Bill of 2023 Cabinet approved the publication of the draft PSC Bill of 2023 for public comments.

src: Die Wetsontwerp herroep die ODK Wet (Wetnr 46 van 1997) van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996.
tgt: The Bill repeals the PSC Act, 1997 (Act 46 of 1997) of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.

src: Die Wetsontwerp maak voorsiening vir die stigting van ŉ onafhanklike sekretariaat vir die ODK om die organisasie se onafhanklikheid en onpartydigheid te versterk.
tgt: The Bill provides for the establishment of an independent secretariat for the PSC to strengthen the independence and impartiality of the organisation.

src: Die mandaat van die ODK sal, wanneer die Wetsontwerp as wet uitgevaardig word, uitgebrei word na munisipaliteite en staatsentiteite.
tgt: Once the Bill is enacted into law, the mandate of the PSC will be extended to municipalities and public entities.

src: Die wysiging sal aan die ODK ŉ meer gefokusde benadering verskaf om ŉ sinvolle bydrae tot die ontwikkeling van ŉ reagerende, etiese en waarde-aangedrewe staatsdiens, te gee.
tgt: The amendment will give the PSC a more focused approach to making a meaningful contribution towards building a responsive, ethical and values-driven public service.

src: Konsepwysigingswetsontwerp op die Nasionale Kernreguleerder van 2023.
tgt: The Bill is available on WEBTOKEN Draft National Nuclear Regulator Amendment Bill of 2023.

src: Die Kabinet het die Konsepwysigingswetsontwerp op die Nasionale Kernreguleerder vir voorlegging aan die Parlement, goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the draft Nuclear Regulator Amendment Bill for submission of to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp wysig die Wet op die Nasionale Kernreguleerder (NK), 1999 (Wetnr 47 van 1999).
tgt: The Bill amends the National Nuclear Regulator (NNR) Act, 1999 (Act 47 of 1999).

src: Die Wetsontwerp poog om die bestaande gapings in die huidige NK-wet van 1999 aan te spreek.
tgt: The Bill seeks to address the existing gaps in the current NNR Act of 1999.

src: Die Wet is tans nie in ooreenstemming met internasionale beste praktyk in die veld van kernveiligheidsregulasies nie, want hy spreek nie beroepsblootstelling van lugbemanning aan kosmiese bestraling aan nie.
tgt: The Act in its current form is not in line with international best practices in the field of nuclear safety regulations because it does not address occupational exposure of aircrew to cosmic radiation.

src: Die Wetsontwerp is ook ontwerp om die NK-wet van 1999 in ooreenstemming met die Internasionale Atoomenergie-agentskap (IAEA) se voorskrifte en beste praktyke, te bring.
tgt: The Bill is also designed to align the NNR Act of 1999 with the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) prescripts and its best practice.

src: Suid-Afrika is ŉ lid van die IAEA.
tgt: South Africa is a member of the IAEA.

src: Inhuldiging van die President van die Federale Republiek van Nigerië.
tgt: Upcoming events Inauguration of the President of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

src: President Ramaphosa sal op Maandag, 29 Me 2023 ŉ uitnodiging nakom om die inhuldiging van gekose president van die Federale Republiek van Nigerië, Mnr Bola Ahmed Tinubu, by te woon.
tgt: On Monday, 29 May 2023, President Ramaphosa will honour an invitation to attend the Inauguration of President-Elect Mr Bola Ahmed Tinubu of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

src: Die President se deelname sal deurlopendheid van die strategiese verhouding tussen Suid-Afrika en Nigerië, demonstreer.
tgt: The President’s participation will demonstrate continuity in the strategic relationship between South Africa and Nigeria.

src: Nigerië is Suid-Afrika se grootste handelsvennoot in Wes-Afrika.
tgt: Nigeria is South Africa’s biggest trade partner in West Africa.

src: ŉ Breë reeks Suid-Afrikaanse firmas het in Nigerië belê en Nigeriese maatskappye druk ook hulle stempel op Suid-Afrika af.
tgt: A broad range of South African firms have invested in Nigeria, while Nigerian companies are also developing a footprint in South Africa.

src: Kinderbeskermingsweek Suid-Afrika sal van 28 Me tot 4 Junie 2023 kinderbeskermingsweek herdenk, met die tema: “kom ons beskerm kinders tydens KOVID-19 en verder”.
tgt: Child Protection Week South Africa will mark Child Protection Week from 28 May to 4 June 2023 under the theme: “Let us Protect Children during COVID-19 and Beyond”.

src: Die veldtog mobiliseer alle sektore en gemeenskappe vir die ontwikkeling, sorg en beskerming van kinders.2 Die veldtog sal dié jaar op RISIHA, ŉ gemeenskapsgebaseerde voorkomings- en ingrypingsprogram wat poog om kinders vanuit kwesbaarheid na lewenskragtigheid te beweeg, fokus.
tgt: The campaign mobilises all sectors and communities towards development, care, and protection of children.2 This year the campaign will focus on RISIHA, a community-based prevention and early intervention programme, aimed at moving children from vulnerability to resilience.

src: Oos-Kaap DOM-toesigbesoek.1 Adjunkpresident, Mnr Paul Mashatile, sal op 26 en 27 Me 2023 ŉ DOM-toesigbesoek aan OP Tambodistrik en Buffalo City Mero in die Oos-Kaap, aflê.2 Die besoek is deel van die regering se inisiatief om te verseker dat die ontwikkeling van gemeenskappe op geïntegreerde wyse, soos deur die DOM-benadering onderstut, plaasvind.
tgt: Eastern Cape DDM Oversight Visit.1 Deputy President, Mr Paul Mashatile will on 26 and 27 May 2023 conduct a DDM Oversight Visit to OR Tambo District and Buffalo City Metro, Eastern Cape.2 The visit is part of government’s initiative to ensure development of communities happens in an integrated way underpinned by the DDM approach.

src: Sesde Parlement van die Pan-Afrika-parlement (PAP)4.1 Leiers van regoor die kontinent het op Maandag, 15 Me 2023, in Midrand, Suid-Afrika vir die Sesde Parlement van die PAP byeengekom.
tgt: Sixth Parliament of the Pan-African Parliament (PAP)4.1 Leaders from across the continent gathered from Monday, 15 May 2023 in Midrand, South Africa for the Sixth Parliament of the PAThe sitting will end on 02 June 20.2 The PAP seeks to address common challenges across the continent and is represented by African leaders from across the continent.

src: Die sitting sal op 2 Junie 2023 eindig.2 Die PAP poog om algemene uitdagings regoor die kontinent aan te spreek en word deur Afrika-leiers van regoor die kontinent, verteenwoordig.
tgt: Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission (IOC)5.1 South Africa will participate at the 56th session of the executive council to be held in Paris, France from 16 to 30 June 20.2 The IOC of UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (IOC-UNESCO) is the UN body responsible for supporting global ocean science and services.3 South Africa recognises the importance of research and management of its oceans and coastal environments for sustainable development.

src: Oseaannavorsing help ook om vroeë waarskuwings oor oseaangebaseerde rampe te verskaf en help regerings om ingeligte besluite te neem.
tgt: Ocean research also helps to provide early warnings against ocean-based disasters and assist governments to make informed decisions.

src: Suid-Afrika bied vername sportkampioenskap aan.1 Sportliefhebbers vanaf regoor die wêreld kan ŉ geesdriftige Ubuntu-verwelkoming en wêreldklas gasvryheid verwag wanneer hulle die Netbalwêreldbeker en Kimura Shukokai Internasionale (KSI) Karatewêreldkampioenskap in Suid-Afrika bywoon.
tgt: South Africa hosting major sporting championships.1 Sporting fans from across the world can expect a warm Ubuntu welcome and world-class hospitality when they attend the Netball World Cup and Kimura Shukokai International (KSI) Karate World Championship in South Africa.

src: Suid-Afrika het bewese prestasies van die verlede aangaande die aanbied van groot geleenthede.2 Almal is opgewonde met net meer 60 dae oor voor die begin van die Netbalwêreldbeker op 28 Julie tot 6 Augustus 2023 in Kaapstad.
tgt: South Africa has a proven track record in successfully staging mega events.2 Excitement continues to mount with just over sixty (60) days to go to the start of the Netball World Cup in Cape Town from 28 July to 6 August 2023.

src: Dit is die eerste keer dat dié toonaangewende toernooi in Afrika aangebied word.3 Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op almal om die Netbal Vrydag se veldtog te ondersteun deur ondersteunersuitrustings of nasionale kleure te dra om die Suid-Afrikaanse nasionale netbalspan te ondersteun.4 KSI Suid-Afrika bied ook van 10 tot 15 Julie 2023 die 20ste KSI Karate wêreldkampioenskap in Kaapstad aan en ons wens Span SA sterkte toe terwyl hulle vir dié toonaangewende wêreldwye geleentheid voorberei.5 Suid-Afrika is trots daarop om die 2023 tafeltenniskampioenskap se eindronde by die Durban internasionale konvensiesentrum aan te bied.
tgt: This is the first time that this prestigious tournament is being hosted on African soil.3 Cabinet calls on everyone to support the Netball Friday’s campaign, by wearing supporter’s outfits or adorning national colours to rally behind the South African National Netball team.4 KSI South Africa is also hosting the 20th KSI Karate World Championship in Cape Town from 10 to 15 July 2023, and our well-wishes are extended to Team SA as they prepare for this prestigious global event.5 South Africa is proudly hosting the 2023 Table Tennis Championship Finals Championships at the Durban International Convention Centre.

src: Ongeveer 600 spelers uit verskillende land rondom die wêreld speel tans en dié toernooi bied ons spelers die geleentheid om hul talent ten toon te stel.
tgt: Around 600 players from different countries around the world are currently in action and this tournament presents our players with an opportunity to display their talent.

src: Die toernooi het op 20 Me 2023 begin en sal tot 28 Me 2023 duur.
tgt: The tournament started on 20 May 2023 and will continue until 28 May 2023.Messages.

src: GelukwenseDie Kabinet het sy gelukwense en welmenendheid gerig aan: die Minister van Finansies, Mnr Enoch Godongwana, wat op 24 Me 2023 in El Sheikh, Egipte, die invloedryke African Banker 2023 finansiesminister van die jaar-toekenning ontvang het vir sy pogings oor die afgelope jaar om die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie deur ŉ gekompliseerde globale en binnelandse omgewing te lei.
tgt: CongratulationsCabinet extended its congratulations and well wishes to: the Minister of Finance, Mr Enoch Godongwana, who was awarded the prestigious African Banker 2023 Finance Minister of the Year Award in Sharm El Sheikh, Egypt on Wednesday, 24 May 2023 for his efforts over the past year to manage the South African economy through a complicated global and domestic environment.

src: Die toekenning het die Minister se gebruik van fiskale beleid om beleggings in die hernubare energiesektor te bespoedig, erken.
tgt: The award recognised the Minister’s use of fiscal policy to accelerate investments in the renewable energy sector.

src: Hana Gammon, ŉ 20-jarige Suid-Afrikaanse skrywer wat die 2023 Statebond-kortverhaalprys, Afrikastreek gewen het en die jongste in die toekenning se geskiedenis geword het.
tgt: Hana Gammon, a 20-year-old South African writer for winning the 2023 Commonwealth Short Story Prize, Africa region and becoming the youngest in the history of the award.

src: die Stormers rugbyspan wat die eindstryd van die verenigde rugbykampioenskap bereik het.
tgt: the Stormers Rugby Team for reaching the final of the United Rugby Championship.

src: Die Stormers sal op Saterdag, 27 Me 2023 op Kaapstad se stadion teen die Ierse Munsters kragte meet.
tgt: The Stormers will be up against the Irish Musters at Cape Town Stadium on Saturday, 27 May 2023.

src: Mnr Zakes Mda, die Suid-Afrikaanse romanskrywer en Prof Tshilidzi Marwala, die voormalige adjunkvisekanselier en hoof van die Universiteit van Johannesburg, wat beide vir die 2023 African Genius-toekennings genomineer is.
tgt: Mr Zakes Mda, the South African novelist and ProfTshilidzi Marwala, the former University of Johannesburg Deputy Vice-Chancellor and Principal, who have both been nominated for the 2023 African Genius Awards.

src: Meeer Mda en Prof Marwala is onder 19 ander Afrika-presteerders wat in ŉ verskeidenheid velde presteer het.
tgt: Mr Mda and ProfMarwala are nominated among 19 other African achievers who have excelled in a variety of fields.

src: Meelye Die Kabinet het sy medelye betuig aan die familie en vriende van: Ambassadeur vir die Republiek van Algerië, Mnr Billy Masetlha, wat Suid-Afrika in verskeie hoedanighede, waaronder direkteur-generaal van die intelligensiedienste, bedien het.
tgt: Condolences Cabinet expressed condolences to the family and friends of: Ambassador to the Republic of Algeria, Mr Billy Masetlha, who served South Africa in various capacities in government, including as Director-General of the intelligence services.

src: Hy was nou betrokke by die stryd vir Suid-Afrika se bevryding, onder meer as lid van Umkhonto we Sizwe.
tgt: He was deeply involved in the Struggle for South Africa’s liberation, including as a member of Umkhonto we Sizwe.

src: Murthi Naidoo, wat sy lewe gewy het aan die land se bevrydingstryd.
tgt: Murthi Naidoo, who dedicated his life to the country’s liberation struggle.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Issues in the Environment.

src: Krag.
tgt: Energy.

src: Die Kabinet het kennis geneem van die vordering aangaande die implementering van die Energie-aksieplan, terwyl die beduidende beperkings wat steeds in die nasionale netwerk bestaan, erken word.
tgt: Cabinet noted the progress made in the implementation of the Energy Action Plan, while it acknowledges significant constraints that still remain against the national grid.

src: Die Kabinet het die finalisering van die kontrak vir 400 megawatt (MW) se bykomende kapasiteit deur die Standaardaanbodprogram wat voor die einde van Me 2023 aanlyn sal wees verwelkom, namate die land winter betree.
tgt: As the country enters the Winter period, Cabinet welcomed the finalisation of the Contract for 400 megawatts (MW) of additional capacity through the Standard Offer Programme which will be online before the end of May 2023.

src: Die Departement van Gesondheid het ook 213 hospitale vir beurtkraguitsluiting vasgestel, met 76 van dié wat reeds uitgesluit is en daar word daaraan gewerk om nog 46 hospitale op ŉ gevorderde stadium by te voeg.
tgt: Furthermore, the Department of Health has identified 213 hospitals for exclusion from load-shedding, with 76 of these already excluded and work to add another 46 hospitals at an advanced stage.

src: Die Kabinet het ook die naderende bekendstelling van die eenstopwinkel vir energie op 31 Me 2023 deur Invest SA verwelkom wat die reguleringsproses sal bespoedig om nuwe kragopwekkende maatskappye sal help om betrokke te raak.
tgt: Cabinet further welcomed the imminent launch of the Energy One-Stop Shop on 31 May 2023 by Invest SA to speed up the regulatory processes that will assist new power-generating companies to come on board.

src: Daar word van die vordering by die Kulisile-kragstasie kennis geneem om teen die einde van 2023 3 200 MW deur eenheid 1, 2, 3 en 5, in die nasionale netwerk terug te stoot.
tgt: It has noted progress made at the Kusile Power Station to restore 3 200 MW, through units 1, 2, 3 and 5, to the national grid by the end of 2023.

src: Die Kabinet is besorg oor die voortdurende sirkulasie van valse nuus, op sosiale media wat beweer dat daar ŉ naderende nasionale netwerkineenstorting sal wees wat tot ŉ totale verduistering sal lei.
tgt: Cabinet is concerned about the continued circulation of fake news, through social media alleging an imminent national grid collapse that will result in a total blackout.

src: Eskom het die regering verseker van planne wat gereed is vir stelselvoorsorg om ŉ nasionale verduistering te voorkom.
tgt: Eskom has assured government of plans in place for the system safeguards to prevent a national blackout.

src: Die Kabinet herhaal beroepe op alle mense in Suid-Afrika om steeds elektrisiteit te bespaar.
tgt: Cabinet reiterates calls to all people in South Africa to continue to save electricity.

src: Die doelwit is om daagliks minstens 1 000 MW te bespaar, wat gelykstaande is aan een vlak van beurtkrag per dag.
tgt: The target is to save at least 1 000 MW everyday, which equals saving one stage of load-shedding each day.

src: Die Minister van Elektrisiteit, Dr. Kgosientsho Ramokgopa, sal op Vrydag, 26 Me 2023, deur ŉ media-inligtingsessie die land op hoogte hou oor die implementasie van die Energie-aksieplan.
tgt: The Minister of Electricity, Dr Kgosientsho Ramokgopa, will update the country on the implementation of the Energy Action Plan on Friday, 26 May 2023, through a media briefing.

src: Gesondheid.
tgt: Health.

src: Die regering het ŉ tegniese werkkomitee, gelei deur die Nasionale Departement van Gesondheid, van stapel gestuur aangaande die cholera-uitbraak in Hammanskraal in die Stad van Tshwane, wat reeds soos op 24 Me 2023, 15 lewens geëis het.
tgt: Government has established a technical working committee, led by the National Department of Health, in response of the outbreak of cholera in Hammanskraal in the City of Tshwane, which has already claimed 15 lives as of 24 May 2023.

src: Breedvoerige werk is onderweg om alle moontlike bronne van die kontaminasie te toets, hetsy waterbronne, tenkwaens wat water aflewer, krane en die Rooiwal-rioolwerke (RR).
tgt: Extensive work is underway to test all possible sources of the contamination, be they water sources, tankers delivering water, taps and the Rooiwal Wastewater Treatment Works (WWTW).

src: Daar is tot op hede geen bewyse van cholerabakterieë in dié bronne opgespoor nie, wat dit baie waarskynlik maak dat die cholera-uitbraak vanuit ŉ eenmalige kontaminasie kon gewees het, met die huidige gevalle wat die gevolg van sekondêre en tersiêre kontaminasie is.
tgt: To date, no evidence of cholera bacteria has been found in these sources, giving confidence to the likelihood that the cholera outbreak could be from a once-off contamination event, with the current cases being a result of secondary and tertiary contamination.

src: Inwoners van Hammanskraal word, namate dié ingrypings plaasvind, aangemoedig om kraanwater te kook en ŉ knippie sout by te voeg voordat dit gedrink word.
tgt: As these interventions unfold, residents of Hammanskraal are encouraged to boil tap water and add a pinch of salt before drinking it.

src: Enigiemand met ŉ loopmaag, naarheid of gastro-intestinale simptome moet ook onmiddellik ŉ dokter of plaaslike kliniek besoek.
tgt: In addition, anyone with a runny tummy, nausea or gastrointestinal symptoms must immediately visit their doctor or local clinic.

src: Die Minister van Water en Sanitasie, Mnr Senzo Mchunu, sal op Vrydag, 26 Me 2023 ŉ vergadering met die Stad van Tshwane se burgemeester, Raadslid Cilliers Brink, belê om ŉ gesamentlike plan vir die opknapping van die Rooiwal-rioolwerke, wat lankal moes plaasgevind het, te ontwikkel.
tgt: The Minister of Water and Sanitation, Mr Senzo Mchunu, will meet with the City of Tshwane Mayor, Cllr Cilliers Brink, on Friday 26 May 2023 in an effort to develop a joint plan for the long overdue refurbishment of the Rooiwal WWTFor more information you can call the 24-hour hotline of the National Institute for Communicable Diseases (NICD) on 082 883 9920.

src: President Ramaphosa het op Dinsdag, 16 Me 2023 eerste minister Lee Hsien Loong van die Republiek van Singapoer ontvang.
tgt: President Ramaphosa undertook the sixth DDM Presidential Imbizo to the Western Cape, Drakenstein Local Municipality, Cape Winelands District, on Friday, 19 May 2023.

src: Wes-Kaapse Presidensiële Imbizo vir die Distriksontwikkelingsmodel (DOM) President Ramaphosa het op Vrydag, 19 Me 2023 die sesde DOM Presidensiële Imbizo in die Wes-Kaap, Drakenstein plaaslike munisipaliteit, Kaapse Wynlanddistrik, onderneem.
tgt: The Imbizo was preceded by the President’s visit to the nearby Vlakkeland Catalytic Human Settlement Development, which is the largest public housing development to date in the Drakenstein Local Municipality.

src: Die ontwikkeling wat in 2017 van stapel gestuur is sal, wanneer dit voltooi is, 2 556 huise aan kwalifiserende begunstigdes verskaf.
tgt: The development that commenced in 2017 will upon completion provide 2 556 houses to qualifying beneficiaries.

src: Die bou van 942 huise in die eerste fase is onderweg, met 454 wat voltooi is en 301 wat steeds gebou word.
tgt: The construction of 942 houses in the First Phase is underway, with 454 completed and 301 under construction.

src: Die belangrikheid van dié projek is dat dit aan die behoeftes van ŉ verskeidenheid behuisingsopsies voorsien, van diegene met ŉ inkomste van R0 tot R3 500 (onder Breek Nuwe Grond), tot finansieringsgekoppelde subsidieprogram vir diegene wat tussen R3 501 en R22 000 per jaar verdien.
tgt: The importance of this project is that it caters for a variety of housing options from those with an income of R0 to R3 500 (under Breaking New Ground), to Finance Linked Individual Subsidy Programme, for those earning between R3,501 and R22 000 per annum.

src: Beide maatskaplike behuisingsgeleenthede en geleenthede vir militêre veterane is in dié projek beskikbaar.
tgt: Both Social Housing opportunities as well as opportunities for Military Veterans are available in this project.

src: Toesigbesoek aan eThekwini metropolitaanse munisipaliteit en uMgungundlovu distriksmunisipaliteit op 18 en 19 Me 2023.
tgt: Oversight Visit to eThekwini Metropolitan Municipality and uMgungundlovu District Municipality on 18 and 19 May 2023.

src: Adjunkpresident Paul Mashitile het belanghebbendes in onderrig en opleiding, landbou, handel en nywerheid tydens ŉ toesigbesoek aan die eThekwini metropolitaanse munisipaliteit en uMgungundlovu distriksmunisipaliteit, as deel van die DOM-toesigbesoeke, betrek.
tgt: Deputy President Paul Mashatile engaged stakeholders in education and training, agriculture, commerce and industry during an oversight visit to the eThekwini Metropolitan Municipality and uMgungundlovu District Municipality as part of the DDM oversight visits.

src: Een van die sleutelprojekte was die Ntshongweni katalitiese projekterrein waar ŉ slimstad tussen Durban en Pietermaritzburg gebou word.
tgt: One of the key projects visited was the Ntshongweni Catalytic Project site, where a Smart City is being constructed between Durban and Pietermaritzburg.

src: Die projek sal nuwe lewe in ekonomiese aktiwiteit in die gebied blaas en oor die volgende 10 tot 15 jaar, ongeveer R15 miljard in belegging bydra.
tgt: The project will revitalise economic activity in the area, contributing about R15 billion worth of investments in the next 10 to 15 years.

src: Waterinfrastruktuur.
tgt: Water infrastructure.

src: President Ramaphosa het op Dinsdag, 23 Me 2023, die Lesotho-Hoogland-waterprojek besoek waartydens hy aan die sooispitseremonie van fase 2 van die projek deelgeneem het.
tgt: President Ramaphosa visited the Lesotho Highlands Water Project on Tuesday, 23 May 2023 during which he participated in the sod-turning ceremony of Phase 2 of the project.

src: Dié seremonie, wat ŉ paar jaar gelede onderteken is en vertragings in die gesig gestaar het, het die versnelling van dié kritieke binasionale inisiatief aangedui.
tgt: Signed a number of years back and having faced delays, this ceremony signified the pacing up of this critical binational initiative.

src: Die Lesotho-Hoogland-waterprojek is van kardinale belang om die watertoevoersekerheid in Gauteng, die Vrystaat, Mpumalanga en die Noord-Kaap, te verseker.
tgt: The Lesotho Highlands Water Project is critical in ensuring security of water supply in Gauteng, the Free State, Mpumalanga, North West and Northern Cape.

src: Die belegging in waterinfrastruktuur om die lewens van Suid-Afrikaners te verbeter, duur voort met die toewysing van meer as R14 miljard aan munisipaliteite om waterinfrastruktuuragterstand, deur die infrastruktuurtoelaag vir streeksinfrastruktuur op grootmaat (RBIG in Engels) en die infrastruktuurtoelaag vir waterdienste (WSIG in Engels), aan te spreek.
tgt: The investment in water infrastructure to uplift the lives of South Africans continues with the allocation of over R14 billion to municipalities to address water infrastructure backlogs, through the Regional Bulk Infrastructure Grant (RBIG) and the Water Services Infrastructure Grant (WSIG).

src: Die RBIG sal op 130 projekte bestee word en die WSIG sal toegewys word aan meer as 400 projekte landwyd.
tgt: The RBIG will be spent on 130 projects and the WSIG will be allocated to over 400 projects across the country.

src: Die Kabinet is ook verheug dat die Departement van Water en Sanitasie (DWS) vordering toon in die stryd teen korrupsie, met nagenoeg R600 miljoen wat deur maatskappye wat voordeel getrek het uit tenders wat onreëlmatig toegeken is, terugbetaal is.
tgt: Cabinet is also pleased that the Department of Water and Sanitation (DWS) is making strides in the fight against corruption with nearly R600 million repaid by companies who benefited from receiving irregular tenders.

src: Die Kabinet het ook kennis geneem van die voorkomende beheermaatreëls wat deur die departement ingestel is om onreëlmatige, nuttelose en verkwistende besteding uit die weg te ruim.
tgt: Cabinet also noted the preventative control measures put in place by the department to eliminate irregular, fruitless and wasteful expenditure.

src: Maatskaplike beveiligingstoekening.
tgt: Social Security Award.

src: Suid-Afrika het die toonaangewende Internasionale Maatskaplike Beveiligingsvereniging (ISSA in Engels) se toekenning vir goeie praktyk in maatskaplike veiligheid vir Afrika 2023 ontvang, wat die regering se belegging in die lewens van ons kinders, veral diegene vanaf arm en kwesbare huishoudings, erken.
tgt: South Africa has received the prestigious International Social Security Association (ISSA) Good Practice Award in Social Security for Africa 2023, which recognises government’s investment in the lives of our children, especially those from poor and vulnerable households.

src: Suid-Afrika se inskrywing vir dié toonaangewende toekenning is getiteld: “geleidelike uitbreiding van maatskaplike veiligheidsdekking aan kwesbare kinders: die geval van die kinderondersteuningstoelaag, Suid-Afrika”.
tgt: South Africa’s entry to this prestigious award was titled: “Gradual extension of social security coverage to vulnerable children: The case of the Child Support Grant, South Africa”.

src: ŉ Totaal van 138 inskrywings is vanuit 48 lede-instansies in meer as 30 lande in Afrika, ontvang.
tgt: A total of 138 entries were received from 48 member institutions in over 30 countries in Africa.

src: Ons maatskaplike bystand is die kern van die regering se armoedeverligtingsprogram en kernbelangrik om die waardigheid van ons mense te herstel.
tgt: Our social assistance is at the heart of government’s poverty alleviation programme and central to restoring the dignity of our people.

src: Suid-Afrika se maatskaplike beskermingstelsel is onder die grootste ter wêreld, met meer as 18 miljoen begunstigdes.
tgt: South Africa’s social protection system is amongst the largest in the world, with more than 18 million beneficiaries.

src: Begrotingsposte.
tgt: Budget Votes.

src: Die Kabinet is verheug dat begrotingsposte deur regeringsdepartemente goed vorder.
tgt: Cabinet is pleased that Budget Votes by government departments are progressing well.

src: Die skedule van die komende begrotingsposte en ondersteunende media-inligtingsessies: Die Minister van Samewerkende Regeerkunde en Tradisionele Sake (CoGTA), Me Thembi Nkadimeng, sal op Vrydag, 26 Me 2023 om 13:00 ŉ media-inligtingsessie oor CoGTA se begrotingspos, wat die maatreëls wat poog om die prestasie van munisipaliteite te versterk, uiteen sal sit, belê.
tgt: The schedule of upcoming Budget Votes and supporting media briefings: Friday 26 May 2023 at 13:00, the Minister of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs (CoGTA), Ms Thembi Nkadimeng, will conduct a media briefing on the CoGTA Budget Vote which will outline measures aimed at strengthening the performance of municipalities.

src: Die Minister van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling, Me Lindiwe Zulu, en die Minister van Justisie en Korrektiewe Dienste, Mnr Ronald Lamola, sal op Dinsdag, 30 Me 2023 hul begrotingsposte hou en die besonderhede van hulle media-inligtingsessies sal ter gelegener tyd gedeel word.
tgt: On Tuesday, 30 May 2023, the Minister of Social Development, Ms Lindiwe Zulu, and the Minister of Justice and Correctional Services, Mr Ronald Lamola, will hold their Budget Votes and details of their media briefings will be shared in due course.

src: Die Presidensie se begrotingspos sal op Woensdag, 31 Me 2023 ter tafel gelê word en die media-inligtingsessie oor vordering met strukturele hervormings en die indiensname-inisiatiewe wat deur Operasie Vulindlela gekoördineer is, sal op Dinsdag, 30 Me 2023, gehou word.
tgt: The Presidency’s Budget Vote will be tabled on Wednesday, 31 May 2023 and the media briefing on Progress with Structural Reforms and the Employment Initiatives coordinated through Operation Vulindlela will be held on Tuesday, 30 May Africa Day and the African Peer Review Mechanism (APRM) 20 year anniversary.

src: Afrika-dag en die Afrika-portuuroorsigmeganisme (APRM in Engels) 20-jaar herdenking.
tgt: Cabinet and all South Africans join the African continent and the globe in celebrating Africa Day on Thursday, 25 May.

src: Die Kabinet en alle Suid-Afrikaners sluit by die kontinent van Afrika en die wêreld aan om op Donderdag, 25 Me 2023 Afrika-dag te vier.
tgt: This year is particularly important as it marks the 60th anniversary of the signing of the founding charter of the Organisation of African Unity, the forerunner to the African Union.

src: Dié jaar is veral belangrik omdat dit die 60ste herdenking van die stigtingsmanifes van die Organisasie vir Afrika-eenheid, die voorganger van die Afrika-unie, se ondertekening vier.
tgt: The theme for the 2023 celebrations – “Acceleration of the African Continental Free Trade Area implementation” – acknowledges the strides being made in bringing into operation of the world’s largest free trade area.

src: Die tema vir die 2023-vierings — “Bespoediging van die Afrika kontinentale vryhandelsgebied-implementering” — erken die vooruitgang aangaande die inwerkingtreding van een van die wêreld se grootste vryhandelsgebiede.
tgt: This year’s Africa Month commemoration coincides with the 20th anniversary of the APRM, which is aimed at fostering good governance in the continent through systematic peer learning and self-assessment.

src: Kabinetsbesluite Namakwa spesiale ekonomiese sone (SES).
tgt: Cabinet decisions Namakwa Special Economic Zone (SEZ).

src: Die Kabinet het die aanwysing van die Namakwa SES in Aggeneys in die Noord-Kaap, goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the designation of the Namakwa SEZ in Aggeneys in the Northern Cape.

src: Die voorgestelde aanwysing is ingevolge die Wet op Spesiale Ekonomiese Sones, 2014 (Wetnr 16 van 2014) gedoen en die voorgestelde SES is deel van die presidensiële beleggingsaksie.
tgt: The proposed designation is done in terms of the Special Economic Zones Act, 2014 (Act 16 of 2014) and the proposed SEZ is part of the Presidential Investment Drive.

src: Die Namakwa SES sal mynbouveredeling, die vervaardiging van groen waterstof, infrastruktuurontwikkeling, hernubare energie en agroverwerking, beskikbaar maak.
tgt: The Namakwa SEZ will unlock mining beneficiation, production of green hydrogen, infrastructure development, renewable energy and agro-procession.

src: Dié sektore is kernbelangrik vir werkskepping en ekonomiese ontwikkeling van die Noord-Kaap en die land.
tgt: These sectors are critical to job creation and economic development of the Northern Cape and the country.

src: Mer as R29 miljard se beleggings is reeds vir fase 1 van die SES belowe.
tgt: More than R29 billion in investments has already been committed for phase one of the SEThese include commitments from Vedanta Zinc (R16 billion), Frontier Rare Earth (R13 billion), Hive Energy (R200 million) and RRS Trade and Investment (R100 million).

src: Dit sluit in beloftes van Vedanta Zinc (R16 miljard), Frontier Rare Earth (R13 miljard), Hive Energy (R200 miljoen) en RRS Trade and Investment (R100 miljoen).
tgt: National Water Resource Strategy Third Edition (NWRS-3) 2023.

src: Nasionale waterhulpbronstrategie, derde uitgawe (NWHS-3) 2023.
tgt: Cabinet approved the NWRS-3 2023 for implementation and the strategy is binding on all authorities and institutions implementing the National Water Act, 1998 (Act 36 of 1998).

src: Die Kabinet het die NWHS-3 2023 vir implementering goedgekeur en die strategie is bindend op alle owerhede en instansies wat die Nasionale Waterwet, 1998 (Wetnr 36 van 1998) implementeer.
tgt: This strategy is informed by a three-year review of the NWRS-2, which identified areas of success and areas that remain a challenge.

src: Daar word aan dié strategie gestalte gegee deur ŉ drie-jaar-hersiening van die NWHS-2, wat gebiede van welslae en gebiede wat steeds ŉ uitdaging bly, bepaal het.
tgt: The NWRS-3 comprises three thematic goals, that water and sanitation must support development, the elimination of poverty and inequality, contribute to the economy and job creation, and water must be protected, used, developed, managed and controlled sustainably and equitably.

src: Die NWHS-3 bestaan uit drie tematiese doelwitte, dat water en sanitasie ontwikkeling, die wegwerking van armoede en ongelykheid moet ondersteun, dat water moet bydra tot die ekonomie en werkskepping en dat water volhoubaar en regverdig beskerm, gebruik, ontwikkel, bestuur en beheer moet word.
tgt: This strategy makes tangible proposals for increasing water supply, reducing water demand, effective water and sanitation management, regulating the water and sanitation sector, redistributing water for transformation, promoting international cooperation, and managing water and sanitation under a changing climate.

src: Dié strategie maak vatbare voorstelle vir die verhoging van watertoevoer, die vermindering van wateraanvraag, doeltreffende water- en sanitasiebestuur, die regulering van die water- en sanitasiesektor, die herverspreiding van water vir transformasie, die bevordering van internasionale samewerking en die bestuur van water en sanitasie in ŉ veranderende klimaat.
tgt: The NWRS-3 is published on the DWS website on WEBTOKEReport on measures implemented by the Department of Defence (DoD) to address the conduct and behaviour of South African National Defence Force (SANDF) members deployed in peace missions.

src: Verslag oor maatreëls wat deur die Departement van Verdediging geïmplementeer is om die optrede en gedrag van lede van die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Weermag (SANW) wat in vredesendings ontplooi is, aan te spreek.
tgt: Cabinet received a report on progress South Africa is making to address the conduct of some of the members of the SANDF deployed in peace-keeping missions across the continent.

src: Die Kabinet het ŉ verslag ontvang oor die vordering wat Suid-Afrika maak om die gedrag van sommige van die SANW-lede wat in vredehandhawingsendings regoor die kontinent ontplooi is, aan te spreek.
tgt: The SANDF has been a source of national pride as it participates in peacekeeping missions on the continent to secure stability and peace in war torn African nations under the auspices of the United Nations (UN).

src: Die SANW is ŉ bron van nasionale trots omdat hy aan vredehandhawingsendings op die kontinent deelneem om stabiliteit en vrede in oorloggeteisterde Afrika-nasies onder die beskerming van die Verenigde Nasies (VN) te bewerkstellig.
tgt: With allegations of sexual offences involving military peacekeepers surfacing in 2015, a Ministerial Task Team was established in 2019 to investigate cases of sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) within the DoCabinet is pleased by the set of measures that have been put in place to address the incidents of SEA in the SANDF peace keeping missions.

src: ŉ Ministeriële taakspan is in 2019 gestig om gevalle van seksuele uitbuiting en mishandeling (SUM) in die DoV te ondersoek, nadat bewerings van seksuele oortredings deur militêre vredebewaarders in 2015 aan die lig gekom het.
tgt: The UN recognises South Africa as best practices and had commended the country for the progress it has made to stamping out SEA in the SANDCabinet emphasised that the practice of SEA will not be allowed to tarnish the good record of the SANDF on the continent.

src: Die Kabinet is bly oor die stel maatreëls wat in plek gestel is om die gevalle van SUM in die SANW se vredehandhawingsendings aan te spreek.
tgt: 2023 Youth Month Cabinet approved the 2023 Youth Month Programme under the theme: “Accelerating youth economic emancipation for a sustainable future”.

src: Daar sal tydens die twee dae ŉ geleentheid vir die jeug wees om aan gesprekke met ministers, adjunkministers en ander belanghebbendes deel te neem oor verskeie opleidings-, entrepreneurs- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede wat by die regering en maatskaplike vennote beskikbaar is.
tgt: Government, as the largest employer, has responded to the need for skills development and youth employment by enabling unemployed graduates to gain experience through the Public Service Graduate Internship and Learnership Programme.

src: Jeugmaand sal op Donderdag, 1 Junie by die Hector Pieterson-gedenkteken en museum in Soweto deur die Minister in die Presidensie vir vroue, die jeug en mense met gestremdhede, Dr. Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma, geloods word.
tgt: Government is also implementing the Social Employment Fund (SEF) and revitalised National Youth Service (NYS) job-creation initiatives that draw thousands of young people into the economy.

src: Die Kabinet het ŉ oproep op die samelewing gedoen om pogings om te verseker dat jongmense toegang tot geleenthede het wat hulle toelaat om aktief aan die ekonomie deel te neem, te verskerp.
tgt: The Presidential Youth Employment Intervention has already successfully supported access to 934 563 temporary earning opportunities for young people across the country.

src: Die regering, as die grootste werkgewer, het op die behoefte vir vaardigheidsontwikkeling en jeugindiensname gereageer deur werklose graduandi toe te laat om ervaring deur die internskap- en leerderskapprogram vir gegradueerdes in die staatsdiens, te verkry.
tgt: As we enter Youth Month, government reminds young people to join over million of their compatriots and register on the WEBTOKEN platform to access a wide range of learning and earning opportunities.

src: Die regering implementeer ook die maatskaplike indiensnamefonds (MIF) en hernude nasionale jeugdiens (NJD) se werkskeppingsinisiatiewe wat duisende jeugdiges by die ekonomie betrek.
tgt: Co-hosting of the Forum for Agricultural Research in Africa’s (FARA) 8th African Agri-Business and Science Week Conference and its 9th General Assembly.

src: Mee-aanbieding van die forum vir landbounavorsing in Afrika (FARA) se agtste landbou-ondernemings- en wetenskapweekkonferensie en sy negende algemene byeenkoms.
tgt: The FARA is the apex continental organisation responsible for facilitating and coordinating agricultural research and innovation advancement on the continent.

src: Die Kabinet het die mede-aanbieding van FARA se agtste Afrika-landbou-ondernemings- en wetenskapweekkonferensie en sy negende algemene byeenkoms van 5 tot 9 Junie 2023 in Durban, goedgekeur.
tgt: By hosting the event, South Africa will benefit from collaboration and partnerships with continental agriculture and research institutions through sharing of best practices in agricultural science and research.

src: Die FARA is die top kontinentale organisasie wat verantwoordelik is vir die fasilitering en koördinasie van landbounavorsing en -innovasiebevordering op die kontinent.
tgt: South Africa values agricultural research for development, especially in light of climate change and other factors that affect the country’s ability to achieve food security, economic development and employment.

src: Suid-Afrika sal, deur die geleentheid aan te bied voordeel trek uit medewerking en vennootskappe met kontinentale landbou- en navorsingsinstansies deur beste praktyke in landbouwetenskap en -navorsing te deel.
tgt: The conference is expected to attract 800 delegates to KwaZulu-Natal and Gauteng, and this will contribute to economic activity.

src: Handelsake.
tgt: Trade matters.

src: Die Kabinet het ŉ verslag ontvang wat op verbeterings in die land se handels- en uitvoerprogram dui.
tgt: Cabinet received a report that point to improvements in the country’s trade and export programme.

src: Die verslag het aangedui dat Suid-Afrika tydens 2022 goedere ter waarde van R300 miljard aan 12 lande uitgevoer het en hierdeur ŉ beraamde 57 300 direkte werke gehandhaaf het.
tgt: The report indicated that South Africa exported goods to the value of R300 billion of during 2022 to 12 countries, sustaining an estimated 57 300 direct jobs.

src: Aanstellings Alle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en toepaslike klaring.
tgt: Appointments All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.

src: Meeer Bernard Scelo Duma as adjunkdirekteur-generaal: plaaslike regeringswerksaamhede en ondersteuning by die Departement van Samewerkende Regering.
tgt: Mr Bernard Scelo Duma as Deputy Director-General: Local Government Operations and Support in the Department of Cooperative Governance.

src: Direkteursraad van die Raad vir Minerale Tegnologie Me Ntombifuthi Zikalala-Mvelase (Adjunkvoorsitter en heraanstelling)
tgt: Board of Directors of Council for Mineral Technology Ms Ntombifuthi Zikalala-Mvelase (Deputy Chairperson and reappointment)

tgt: Ms Pontsho Maruping (reappointment) Mr Rudolf Heydenrich (reappointment) Dr Siyabonga Simayi Dr Takalani Madzivhandila Ms Azwinndini Mavis Thomani Mr Livhu Nengovhela and Ms Faith Ntokozo Ngcwabe (Department of Mineral Resources and Energy representative).

tgt: Board of Directors of the Council for Geoscience
