tgt: Mr Kelepile Dintwe (Chairperson) Mr Xolisa Mvinjelwa (Deputy Chairperson) Adv Ntika Maake Dr Mayshree Singh Dr Siyanda Mngadi Dr Ntombifuthi Nxumalo Ms Thobeka Njozela Mr Andries Moatshe Dr Moloko Matlala Mr Mandla Malindisa

src: Dr. Mmboneni Muofhe en Mnr Mosa Mabuza (HUB).
tgt: Dr Mmboneni Muofhe and Mr Mosa Mabuza (CEO).

src: Konsepwysigingswetsontwerp op die Onafhanklike Polisie-ondersoekdirektoraat (OPOD) van 2023 Die Kabinet het die OPOD-konsepwysigingswetsontwerp van 2023 vir voorlegging aan die Parlement, goedgekeur.
tgt: Draft Independent Police Investigative Directorate (IPID) Amendment Bill of 2023.

src: Die Wysigingswetsontwerp wysig die OPOD-wet, 2011 (Wetnr 1 van 2011) en maak voorstelle wat ten doel het om die institusionele en bedryfsonafhanklikheid van die OPOD te verskans, wat uiting aan die “McBride-uitspraak” gee.
tgt: The Bill amends the IPID Act, 2011 (Act 1 of 2011), and makes proposals aimed at entrenching the institutional and operational independence of the IPID, giving effect to the “McBride judgement”.

src: Die wysigings spreek ook die kwessies aan wat deur die Grondwetlike Hof geopper is en wat sekere voorskrifte van die OPOD-wet van 2011 as ongeldig verklaar het, wat die Minister toegelaat het om die Uitvoerende Direkteur te skors, om na skorsing dissiplinêre stappe teen die Uitvoerende Direkteur te neem, en om die Uitvoerende Direkteur uit die amp te verwyder.
tgt: The amendments also address the issues raised by the Constitutional Court which declared as invalid certain provisions of the IPID Act of 2011, which authorised the Minister of Police to suspend the Executive Director, to take disciplinary steps against the Executive Director following suspension, and to remove the Executive Director from office.

src: Die Wetsontwerp stel ŉ meer deursigtige en oop proses vir die aanstelling van die Uitvoerende Direkteur, asook ŉ gedetailleerde en deeglike proses vir integriteitstoetsing van OPOD-beamptes, voor.
tgt: The Bill proposes a more transparent and open process for the appointment of the Executive Director and also a detailed and thorough process for integrity testing of IPID officials.

src: Die Wetsontwerp maak ook voorsiening vir die wysiging van ander voorskrifte van die Hoofwet, om sodoende te verseker dat die OPOD sy mandaat doeltreffend en doelmatig uitvoer.
tgt: The Bill further provides for the amendment of other provisions of the Principal Act, so as to ensure that IPID executes its mandate effectively and efficiently.

src: Algemene Konsepwysigingswetsontwerp op Intelligensiewette (GILAB) van 2023 Die Kabinet het die konsep-GILAB van 2023 vir voorlegging aan die Parlement, goedgekeur.
tgt: The draft Bill can be found at WEBTOKEDraft General Intelligence Laws Amendment Bill (GILAB) of 2023 Cabinet approved the draft GILAB of 2023 for submission to Parliament.

src: Die GILAB stel wysigings voor aan die Wet op Nasionale Strategiese Intelligensie, 1994 (Wetnr 39 van 1994).
tgt: The GILAB proposes amendments to the National Strategic Intelligence Act, 1994 (Act 39 of 1994).

src: Die Wetsontwerp gee uitvoering aan die aanbevelings van die Presidensiële Hoëvlak-oorsigpaneel oor die Staatsveiligheidsagentskap (SVA) asook die implementeringsplan van die Regterlike Kommissie van Ondersoek oor die bewerings van ŉ staatsgreep, korrupsie en bedrog in die staatsektor, waaronder staatsliggame.
tgt: The Bill gives effect to the recommendations of the Presidential High-Level Review Panel on the State Security Agency (SSA) as well as the implementation plan of the recommendations of the Judicial Commission of Inquiry into Allegations of State Capture, Corruption and Fraud in the Public Sector including Organs of State.

src: Die Wetsontwerp beoog, onder andere, om:
tgt: Amongst others the Bill seeks to:

src: die intelligensiedienste te herstruktureer om voorsiening te maak vir ŉ institusionele argitektuur wat doeltreffendheid en doelmatigheid in werking stel deur die binnelandse intelligensie-agentskap en die buitelandse intelligensie-agentskap te vestig
tgt: restructure the intelligence services to provide an institutional architecture that enables effectiveness and efficiency by establishing the domestic intelligence agency and the foreign intelligence service

src: die gebreke oor die funksionering van die seinintelligensiekapasiteit, soos deur die Grondwetlike Hof bevestig, te herstel
tgt: remedy the defects on the functioning of the Signals Intelligence Capacity as confirmed by the Constitutional Court

src: die swakpunte wat deur die Finansiële Aksietaakspan-proses bepaal is, waaronder maatreëls om geldwassery en terrorisfinansiering te bestry deur die nasionale sekuriteitstrukture te bemagtig om ondersoek in te stel en ŉ sekuriteitsassessering uit te voer as ŉ persoon of instansie van nasionale belang is
tgt: address the weaknesses identified through Financial Action Task Force process, including measures to combat money laundering and terrorist financing by empowering the national security structures to investigate and conduct security assessment if a person or institution is of national security interest

src: maatreëls te versterk om die private sekruiteitsbedryf te reguleer en te koördineer, as deel van ŉ breër nasionale benadering en
tgt: Strengthen measures to regulate and coordinate the private security industry as part of a broader national security approach and

src: maatreëls in te stel wat die gedrag van voormalige lede van die diens en ander met toegang tot intelligensie-inligting, reguleer.
tgt: put in place measures to regulate the conduct of former members of the service and others with access to intelligence information.

src: Die Wetsontwerp sal ook verseker dat die SVA se dienste nie vir die belange of agenda van sekere individue, misbruik word nie.
tgt: The Bill will further ensure that the services of the SSA are not abused to serve the interests or agenda of certain individuals.

src: Die wysigings sal die toesig oor die intelligensie-agentskappe deur liggame soos die inspekteur-generaal van Intelligensie, die Gesamentlike staande komitee vir Intelligensie en die Ouditeur-Generaal van Suid-Afrika, versterk.
tgt: The amendments will strengthen the oversight of the intelligence agencies by bodies such as the Inspector-General of Intelligence, the Joint Standing Committee on Intelligence and the Auditor-General of South Africa.

src: Konsepwetsontwerp op die Openbare Dienstekommissie (ODK) van 2023 Die Kabinet het die publikasie van die Konsepwetsontwerp op ODK vir openbare kommentaar goedgekeur.
tgt: The Bill is available on WEBTOKEDraft Public Service Commission (PSC) Bill of 2023 Cabinet approved the publication of the draft PSC Bill of 2023 for public comments.

src: Die Wetsontwerp herroep die ODK Wet (Wetnr 46 van 1997) van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996.
tgt: The Bill repeals the PSC Act, 1997 (Act 46 of 1997) of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.

src: Die Wetsontwerp maak voorsiening vir die stigting van ŉ onafhanklike sekretariaat vir die ODK om die organisasie se onafhanklikheid en onpartydigheid te versterk.
tgt: The Bill provides for the establishment of an independent secretariat for the PSC to strengthen the independence and impartiality of the organisation.

src: Die mandaat van die ODK sal, wanneer die Wetsontwerp as wet uitgevaardig word, uitgebrei word na munisipaliteite en staatsentiteite.
tgt: Once the Bill is enacted into law, the mandate of the PSC will be extended to municipalities and public entities.

src: Die wysiging sal aan die ODK ŉ meer gefokusde benadering verskaf om ŉ sinvolle bydrae tot die ontwikkeling van ŉ reagerende, etiese en waarde-aangedrewe staatsdiens, te gee.
tgt: The amendment will give the PSC a more focused approach to making a meaningful contribution towards building a responsive, ethical and values-driven public service.

src: Konsepwysigingswetsontwerp op die Nasionale Kernreguleerder van 2023.
tgt: The Bill is available on WEBTOKEN Draft National Nuclear Regulator Amendment Bill of 2023.

src: Die Kabinet het die Konsepwysigingswetsontwerp op die Nasionale Kernreguleerder vir voorlegging aan die Parlement, goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the draft Nuclear Regulator Amendment Bill for submission of to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp wysig die Wet op die Nasionale Kernreguleerder (NK), 1999 (Wetnr 47 van 1999).
tgt: The Bill amends the National Nuclear Regulator (NNR) Act, 1999 (Act 47 of 1999).

src: Die Wetsontwerp poog om die bestaande gapings in die huidige NK-wet van 1999 aan te spreek.
tgt: The Bill seeks to address the existing gaps in the current NNR Act of 1999.

src: Die Wet is tans nie in ooreenstemming met internasionale beste praktyk in die veld van kernveiligheidsregulasies nie, want hy spreek nie beroepsblootstelling van lugbemanning aan kosmiese bestraling aan nie.
tgt: The Act in its current form is not in line with international best practices in the field of nuclear safety regulations because it does not address occupational exposure of aircrew to cosmic radiation.

src: Die Wetsontwerp is ook ontwerp om die NK-wet van 1999 in ooreenstemming met die Internasionale Atoomenergie-agentskap (IAEA) se voorskrifte en beste praktyke, te bring.
tgt: The Bill is also designed to align the NNR Act of 1999 with the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) prescripts and its best practice.

src: Suid-Afrika is ŉ lid van die IAEA.
tgt: South Africa is a member of the IAEA.

src: Inhuldiging van die President van die Federale Republiek van Nigerië.
tgt: Upcoming events Inauguration of the President of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

src: President Ramaphosa sal op Maandag, 29 Me 2023 ŉ uitnodiging nakom om die inhuldiging van gekose president van die Federale Republiek van Nigerië, Mnr Bola Ahmed Tinubu, by te woon.
tgt: On Monday, 29 May 2023, President Ramaphosa will honour an invitation to attend the Inauguration of President-Elect Mr Bola Ahmed Tinubu of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

src: Die President se deelname sal deurlopendheid van die strategiese verhouding tussen Suid-Afrika en Nigerië, demonstreer.
tgt: The President’s participation will demonstrate continuity in the strategic relationship between South Africa and Nigeria.

src: Nigerië is Suid-Afrika se grootste handelsvennoot in Wes-Afrika.
tgt: Nigeria is South Africa’s biggest trade partner in West Africa.

src: ŉ Breë reeks Suid-Afrikaanse firmas het in Nigerië belê en Nigeriese maatskappye druk ook hulle stempel op Suid-Afrika af.
tgt: A broad range of South African firms have invested in Nigeria, while Nigerian companies are also developing a footprint in South Africa.

src: Kinderbeskermingsweek Suid-Afrika sal van 28 Me tot 4 Junie 2023 kinderbeskermingsweek herdenk, met die tema: “kom ons beskerm kinders tydens KOVID-19 en verder”.
tgt: Child Protection Week South Africa will mark Child Protection Week from 28 May to 4 June 2023 under the theme: “Let us Protect Children during COVID-19 and Beyond”.

src: Die veldtog mobiliseer alle sektore en gemeenskappe vir die ontwikkeling, sorg en beskerming van kinders.2 Die veldtog sal dié jaar op RISIHA, ŉ gemeenskapsgebaseerde voorkomings- en ingrypingsprogram wat poog om kinders vanuit kwesbaarheid na lewenskragtigheid te beweeg, fokus.
tgt: The campaign mobilises all sectors and communities towards development, care, and protection of children.2 This year the campaign will focus on RISIHA, a community-based prevention and early intervention programme, aimed at moving children from vulnerability to resilience.

src: Oos-Kaap DOM-toesigbesoek.1 Adjunkpresident, Mnr Paul Mashatile, sal op 26 en 27 Me 2023 ŉ DOM-toesigbesoek aan OP Tambodistrik en Buffalo City Mero in die Oos-Kaap, aflê.2 Die besoek is deel van die regering se inisiatief om te verseker dat die ontwikkeling van gemeenskappe op geïntegreerde wyse, soos deur die DOM-benadering onderstut, plaasvind.
tgt: Eastern Cape DDM Oversight Visit.1 Deputy President, Mr Paul Mashatile will on 26 and 27 May 2023 conduct a DDM Oversight Visit to OR Tambo District and Buffalo City Metro, Eastern Cape.2 The visit is part of government’s initiative to ensure development of communities happens in an integrated way underpinned by the DDM approach.

src: Sesde Parlement van die Pan-Afrika-parlement (PAP)4.1 Leiers van regoor die kontinent het op Maandag, 15 Me 2023, in Midrand, Suid-Afrika vir die Sesde Parlement van die PAP byeengekom.
tgt: Sixth Parliament of the Pan-African Parliament (PAP)4.1 Leaders from across the continent gathered from Monday, 15 May 2023 in Midrand, South Africa for the Sixth Parliament of the PAThe sitting will end on 02 June 20.2 The PAP seeks to address common challenges across the continent and is represented by African leaders from across the continent.

src: Die sitting sal op 2 Junie 2023 eindig.2 Die PAP poog om algemene uitdagings regoor die kontinent aan te spreek en word deur Afrika-leiers van regoor die kontinent, verteenwoordig.
tgt: Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission (IOC)5.1 South Africa will participate at the 56th session of the executive council to be held in Paris, France from 16 to 30 June 20.2 The IOC of UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (IOC-UNESCO) is the UN body responsible for supporting global ocean science and services.3 South Africa recognises the importance of research and management of its oceans and coastal environments for sustainable development.

src: Oseaannavorsing help ook om vroeë waarskuwings oor oseaangebaseerde rampe te verskaf en help regerings om ingeligte besluite te neem.
tgt: Ocean research also helps to provide early warnings against ocean-based disasters and assist governments to make informed decisions.

src: Suid-Afrika bied vername sportkampioenskap aan.1 Sportliefhebbers vanaf regoor die wêreld kan ŉ geesdriftige Ubuntu-verwelkoming en wêreldklas gasvryheid verwag wanneer hulle die Netbalwêreldbeker en Kimura Shukokai Internasionale (KSI) Karatewêreldkampioenskap in Suid-Afrika bywoon.
tgt: South Africa hosting major sporting championships.1 Sporting fans from across the world can expect a warm Ubuntu welcome and world-class hospitality when they attend the Netball World Cup and Kimura Shukokai International (KSI) Karate World Championship in South Africa.

src: Suid-Afrika het bewese prestasies van die verlede aangaande die aanbied van groot geleenthede.2 Almal is opgewonde met net meer 60 dae oor voor die begin van die Netbalwêreldbeker op 28 Julie tot 6 Augustus 2023 in Kaapstad.
tgt: South Africa has a proven track record in successfully staging mega events.2 Excitement continues to mount with just over sixty (60) days to go to the start of the Netball World Cup in Cape Town from 28 July to 6 August 2023.

src: Dit is die eerste keer dat dié toonaangewende toernooi in Afrika aangebied word.3 Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op almal om die Netbal Vrydag se veldtog te ondersteun deur ondersteunersuitrustings of nasionale kleure te dra om die Suid-Afrikaanse nasionale netbalspan te ondersteun.4 KSI Suid-Afrika bied ook van 10 tot 15 Julie 2023 die 20ste KSI Karate wêreldkampioenskap in Kaapstad aan en ons wens Span SA sterkte toe terwyl hulle vir dié toonaangewende wêreldwye geleentheid voorberei.5 Suid-Afrika is trots daarop om die 2023 tafeltenniskampioenskap se eindronde by die Durban internasionale konvensiesentrum aan te bied.
tgt: This is the first time that this prestigious tournament is being hosted on African soil.3 Cabinet calls on everyone to support the Netball Friday’s campaign, by wearing supporter’s outfits or adorning national colours to rally behind the South African National Netball team.4 KSI South Africa is also hosting the 20th KSI Karate World Championship in Cape Town from 10 to 15 July 2023, and our well-wishes are extended to Team SA as they prepare for this prestigious global event.5 South Africa is proudly hosting the 2023 Table Tennis Championship Finals Championships at the Durban International Convention Centre.

src: Ongeveer 600 spelers uit verskillende land rondom die wêreld speel tans en dié toernooi bied ons spelers die geleentheid om hul talent ten toon te stel.
tgt: Around 600 players from different countries around the world are currently in action and this tournament presents our players with an opportunity to display their talent.

src: Die toernooi het op 20 Me 2023 begin en sal tot 28 Me 2023 duur.
tgt: The tournament started on 20 May 2023 and will continue until 28 May 2023.Messages.

src: GelukwenseDie Kabinet het sy gelukwense en welmenendheid gerig aan: die Minister van Finansies, Mnr Enoch Godongwana, wat op 24 Me 2023 in El Sheikh, Egipte, die invloedryke African Banker 2023 finansiesminister van die jaar-toekenning ontvang het vir sy pogings oor die afgelope jaar om die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie deur ŉ gekompliseerde globale en binnelandse omgewing te lei.
tgt: CongratulationsCabinet extended its congratulations and well wishes to: the Minister of Finance, Mr Enoch Godongwana, who was awarded the prestigious African Banker 2023 Finance Minister of the Year Award in Sharm El Sheikh, Egypt on Wednesday, 24 May 2023 for his efforts over the past year to manage the South African economy through a complicated global and domestic environment.

src: Die toekenning het die Minister se gebruik van fiskale beleid om beleggings in die hernubare energiesektor te bespoedig, erken.
tgt: The award recognised the Minister’s use of fiscal policy to accelerate investments in the renewable energy sector.

src: Hana Gammon, ŉ 20-jarige Suid-Afrikaanse skrywer wat die 2023 Statebond-kortverhaalprys, Afrikastreek gewen het en die jongste in die toekenning se geskiedenis geword het.
tgt: Hana Gammon, a 20-year-old South African writer for winning the 2023 Commonwealth Short Story Prize, Africa region and becoming the youngest in the history of the award.

src: die Stormers rugbyspan wat die eindstryd van die verenigde rugbykampioenskap bereik het.
tgt: the Stormers Rugby Team for reaching the final of the United Rugby Championship.

src: Die Stormers sal op Saterdag, 27 Me 2023 op Kaapstad se stadion teen die Ierse Munsters kragte meet.
tgt: The Stormers will be up against the Irish Musters at Cape Town Stadium on Saturday, 27 May 2023.

src: Mnr Zakes Mda, die Suid-Afrikaanse romanskrywer en Prof Tshilidzi Marwala, die voormalige adjunkvisekanselier en hoof van die Universiteit van Johannesburg, wat beide vir die 2023 African Genius-toekennings genomineer is.
tgt: Mr Zakes Mda, the South African novelist and ProfTshilidzi Marwala, the former University of Johannesburg Deputy Vice-Chancellor and Principal, who have both been nominated for the 2023 African Genius Awards.

src: Meeer Mda en Prof Marwala is onder 19 ander Afrika-presteerders wat in ŉ verskeidenheid velde presteer het.
tgt: Mr Mda and ProfMarwala are nominated among 19 other African achievers who have excelled in a variety of fields.

src: Meelye Die Kabinet het sy medelye betuig aan die familie en vriende van: Ambassadeur vir die Republiek van Algerië, Mnr Billy Masetlha, wat Suid-Afrika in verskeie hoedanighede, waaronder direkteur-generaal van die intelligensiedienste, bedien het.
tgt: Condolences Cabinet expressed condolences to the family and friends of: Ambassador to the Republic of Algeria, Mr Billy Masetlha, who served South Africa in various capacities in government, including as Director-General of the intelligence services.

src: Hy was nou betrokke by die stryd vir Suid-Afrika se bevryding, onder meer as lid van Umkhonto we Sizwe.
tgt: He was deeply involved in the Struggle for South Africa’s liberation, including as a member of Umkhonto we Sizwe.

src: Murthi Naidoo, wat sy lewe gewy het aan die land se bevrydingstryd.
tgt: Murthi Naidoo, who dedicated his life to the country’s liberation struggle.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Issues in the environment.

src: Aanbevelings van die Geregtelike Kommissie van Ondersoek na Bewerings van Staatskaping, Korrupsie en Bedrog in die Openbare Sektor, waaronder Staatsorgane.
tgt: Recommendations of the Judicial Commission of Inquiry into Allegations of State Capture, Corruption and Fraud in the Public Sector, including Organs of State.

src: Vandag, 22 Junie 2023, is dit presies 'n jaar sedert Die Presidensie die finale verslag van die Regterlike Kommissie van Ondersoek na Bewerings van Staatskaping, Korrupsie en Bedrog in die Openbare Sektor, waaronder Staatsorgane, ontvang het.
tgt: Today, 22 June 2023, is exactly a year since The Presidency received the final report of the Judicial Commission of Inquiry into Allegations of State Capture, Corruption and Fraud in the Public Sector, including Organs of State.

src: President Cyril Ramaphosa het in Oktober 2022 die regering se plan vir die implementering van die Kommissie se aanbevelings aan die Parlement voorgelê.
tgt: In October 2022, President Cyril Ramaphosa submitted to Parliament government’s plan for the implementation of the Commission’s recommendations.

src: Die Kabinet sal binnekort 'n vorderingsverslag oor die implementering van die Kommissie se aanbevelings ontvang.
tgt: Cabinet is due to receive a progress report on the implementation of the Commission’s recommendations.

src: Protokolooreenkoms met Frankryk om die kapasiteit van die Spesiale Ondersoekeenheid (SOE) te vergroot.
tgt: Protocol Agreement with France to increase Special Investigating Unit (SIU) capacity.

src: Suid-Afrika, verteenwoordig deur die Minister van Justisie en Korrektiewe Dienste, mnrRonald Lamola, en Frankryk, verteenwoordig deur die land se Minister vir Europa en Buitelandse Sake, me Catherine Colonna, het 'n protokolooreenkoms vir samewerking onderteken wat die kapasiteit van die SOE sal vergroot.
tgt: South Africa, represented by the Minister of Justice and Correctional Services, Mr Ronald Lamola and France, represented by the Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs, Ms Catherine Colonna, have signed a cooperation protocol agreement that will increase the capacity of the SIThis cooperation further capacitates the SIU on cyber forensics, financial crimes and analytical skills.

src: Hierdie samewerking bemagtig die SOE verder rakende kuberforensiese ondersoeke, finansiële misdade en analitiese vaardighede.
tgt: The partnership will result in the establishment of an Anti-Corruption Academy in Pretoria.

src: Die vennootskap sal tot die stigting van 'n teenkorrupsie-akademie in Pretoria lei.
tgt: This academy will serve members of the SIU, other law-enforcement and anti-corruption agencies within Southern African Development Community member states, the Commonwealth and non-Commonwealth countries.

src: Die akademie sal lede van die SOE, ander wetstoepassings- en teenkorrupsie-agentskappe binne lidlande van die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap, die Statebond en nie-Statebondlande bedien.
tgt: This new capacity will also deepen the country’s ability to respond to matters arising from the State of Capture Commission.

src: Gesamentlike werksbesoek deur die eerste ministers van Nederland en Denemarke.
tgt: Joint Working Visit by Prime Ministers of the Netherlands and Denmark.

src: Die Kabinet het die verbintenisse tussen President Ramaphosa, Eerste Minister Mark Rutte van Nederland en Eerste Minister Mete Frederiksen van Denemarke tydens hul gesamentlike werksbesoek in Pretoria hierdie week verwelkom.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the engagements between President Ramaphosa, Prime Minister Mark Rutte of the Netherlands and Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen of Denmark, during the joint working visit in Pretoria this week.

src: Die gesamentlike werksbesoek was 'n eerste in sy soort in ons land.
tgt: The joint working visit was a first of its kind in our country.

src: Die ekonomiese betrekkinge tussen die drie lande is 'n hedendaagse manifestasie van langdurige verhoudings tussen Suid-Afrika en twee Europese Unie-lande wat aansienlike steun aan Suid-Afrika se bevrydingsbewegings en die stryd teen apartheid gebied het.
tgt: The economic relations between the three countries are a present-day manifestation of longstanding relations between South Africa and two European Union countries that offered significant support to South Africa’s liberation movements and the fight against apartheid.

src: Tydens hierdie werksbesoek het Suid-Afrika Meorandums van Verstandhouding oor samewerking op die gebied van groen waterstof- en energie-vennootskappe met die twee lande onderteken.
tgt: During this working visit, South Africa signed Memoranda of Understanding on cooperation in the field of green hydrogen and energy partnerships with the two countries.

src: Maatskappye en instellings van die drie lande het aankondigings oor beleggings en vennootskappe gemaak, waaronder 'n verbintenis van een miljard Amerikaanse dollar vir die stigting van die SA-H2-fonds om groen waterstof-beleggings te mobiliseer.
tgt: Companies and institutions from the three countries made investment and partnership announcements, including a one billion United States Dollar commitment for the establishment of the SA-H2 Fund to mobilise green hydrogen investments.

src: Die Openbare Infrastruktuurfonds vir Water en Energie: Bele Internasionaal beoog om 'n pakketfonds vir konsessiefinansiering van 300 miljoen euro en toekennings van 100 miljoen euro te stig, wat Suid-Afrika sal bystaan met die lewering van water- en energie-infrastruktuur.
tgt: The Public Infrastructure Fund for Water and Energy: Invest International intends to establish a concessional financing package fund for 300 million Euros and grants of 100 million Euros that will assist South Africa in the delivery of water and energy infrastructure.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom 'n inligtingsessie deur president Ramaphosa oor die onlangse Afrika-vredesending na die Oekraïne en die Russiese Federasie waaraan die president saam met leiers en verteenwoordigers van die regerings van Senegal, die Comore, Zambië, Egipte, Kongo-Brazzaville en Uganda, deelgeneem het.
tgt: African Peace Mission Cabinet welcomed a briefing by President Ramaphosa on the recent African Peace Mission to Ukraine and the Russian Federation in which the President participated alongside leaders and representatives of the governments of Senegal, Comoros, Zambia, Egypt, Congo-Brazzaville, and Uganda.

src: Die Sending het Suid-Afrika se beginselposisie van onverbondenheid en die land se verbintenis tot die vreedsame oplossing van die konflik beklemtoon.
tgt: The Mission underscored South Africa’s principled position of non-alignment and the country’s commitment to the peaceful resolution of the conflict.

src: Die Kabinet het kennis geneem dat President Volodymyr Zelensky van die Oekraïne en President Vladimir Poetin van die Russiese Federasie die Afrika-vredesinisiatief verwelkom het en hulle verbind het tot verdere betrekkinge met Afrika-leiers oor sake wat vir 'n vreedsame oplossing vir die konflik geopper is.
tgt: Cabinet noted that President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine and President Vladimir Putin of the Russian Federation had welcomed the African peace initiative and committed to further engagements with African leaders on matters raised towards a peaceful resolution of the conflict.

src: Die Sending het beklemtoon dat 'n de-eskalasie van die konflik noodsaaklik is om toe te laat dat onderhandelinge met dringendheid begin kan word, sowel as die terugkeer van kinders wat uit die Oekraïne geneem is, die vrylating van krygsgevangenes en die skep van toegangsweë om groter humanitêre bystand te fasiliteer.
tgt: The Mission emphasised the need for a de-escalation of the conflict to allow negotiations to commence with urgency, the return of children taken from Ukraine, the release of prisoners of war and creation of corridors to facilitate for greater humanitarian assistance.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die waardering van wêreldleiers vir die waarde van die Afrika-leiers se vredesinisiatief om 'n vreedsame oplossing vir die konflik te vind, soos onder meer deur die eerste ministers van Denemarke en Nederland uitgespreek, sowel as deur Frankryk se Minister van Buitelandse Sake.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the appreciation expressed by global leaders of the value of this African Leaders’ Peace Initiative towards finding a peaceful resolution of the conflict as expressed by the Prime Ministers of Denmark and the Netherlands, as well as the Foreign Minister of France, amongst others.

src: Na afloop van die vredessending sal Suid-Afrika in Julie op die kantlyn aan die Afrika-Unie-Rusland-beraad in Moskou deelneem, vanwaar ons regering ook die geleentheid sal benut om Rusland verder te betrek oor sake wat die twee presidente onderneem het om te oorweeg.
tgt: Following the peace mission, South Africa will participate in the African Union-Russia Summit in Moscow in July, on the sidelines of which, our government will also take the opportunity to further engage Russia on matters the two Presidents undertook to give their consideration.

src: President Ramaphosa se nasionale veiligheidsraadgewer, prof Fholisani Sydney Mufamadi, sal in Augustus 'n vredesberaad, wat deur President Zelenksy byeengeroep is, in Kopenhagen, Denemarke bywoon.
tgt: President Ramaphosa’s National Security Advisor, ProfFholisani Sydney Mufamadi, will attend a Peace Summit, convened by President Zelenksy, that will take place in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August.

src: Me betrekking tot Suid-Afrikaanse presidensiële veiligheidspersoneel en mediaverteenwoordigers se vlug na Pole op pad na die Oekraïne en Rusland het die Kabinet kennis geneem van die onaangename gebeure wat afgespeel het toe hierdie vlug in Warskou, Pole, geland het.
tgt: With regard to the flight that transported South African presidential security personnel and media representatives to Poland en route to Ukraine and Russia, Cabinet noted the unfortunate events that unfolded when this flight landed in Warsaw, Poland.

src: Die Kabinet het kennis geneem dat die Departement van Internasionale Betrekkinge en Samewerking ’n bespreking oor hierdie aangeleentheid deur die toepaslike diplomatieke meganismes en kanale sal voer.
tgt: Cabinet noted that the Department of International Relations and Cooperation will pursue discussion on this matter through the appropriate diplomatic mechanisms and channels.

src: Handelsake.
tgt: Trade matters.

src: Die Kabinet het kennis geneem van die jongste handelsyfers soos voorgelê deur die Departement van Handel, Nywerheid en Meedinging, wat aandui dat Suid-Afrika se uitvoere na China in 2022 VSA$33 miljard bereik het, meer as twee keer die vlak van ons naasgrootste handelsvennoot, Duitsland.
tgt: Cabinet noted the latest trade figures as presented by the Department of Trade, Industry and Competition showed that South Africa’s exports to China reached US$33 billion in 2022, more than twice the level of our next largest trading partner, Germany.

src: Oor die algemeen het handel tussen Suid-Afrika en China met 30% toegeneem van VSA$44 miljard in 2018 tot VSA$57 miljard teen die einde van 2022.
tgt: Overall, South Africa-China trade increased by 30% from US$44 billion in 2018 to US$57 billion by the end of 2022.

src: Van 2018 tot 2022 is gemiddelde jaarlikse groeikoerse van 10% (uitvoer) en 4,5% (invoere) aangeteken.
tgt: From 2018 to 2022, average annual growth rates of 10% (exports) and 4.5% (imports) were recorded.

src: Suid-Afrika het oor daardie vyf jaar 'n groot handelsoorskot gehandhaaf.
tgt: South Africa maintained a large trade surplus over those five years.

src: Energie.
tgt: Energy.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die ooreenkoms dat Mosambiek binne die volgende drie maande met die ondertekening van die ooreenkoms om krag te koop 100 megawatt (MW) elektrisiteit aan Suid-Afrika sal voorsien.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the agreement that will see Mozambique supply South Africa with 100 megawatts (MW) of electricity within the next three (3) months upon the signing of the Power Purchase Agreement.

src: Gedurende die volgende drie tot 12 maande sal Suid-Afrika tot 1 000 MW elektrisiteit van Mosambiek af invoer.
tgt: The next three to 12 months will see South Africa importing up to 1 000 MW of electricity from Mozambique.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom voorts voortdurende verbetering in Eskom se opwekkingskapasiteit wat verseker dat Eskom ’n Energiebeskikbaarheidsfaktor van meer as 60% registreer.
tgt: Cabinet further welcomed continuous improvement in the Eskom’s generation capacity that has ensured the utility registers over 60% Energy Availability Factor.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy waardering aan Suid-Afrikaners vir hul bydrae om die vraag na elektrisiteit te verlaag, wat daartoe bydra dat Eskom laer stadiums van beurtkrag kan handhaaf.
tgt: Cabinet extends its appreciation to South Africans for your contribution in lowering the demand for electricity, which has contributed to Eskom being able to maintain lower stages of load-shedding.

src: Om elektrisiteit te bespaar is 'n gedeelde verantwoordelikheid en 'n aksie waarby ons almal baat vind.
tgt: Saving electricity is a shared responsibility and an action from which all of us benefits.

src: Die Kabinet het sy waardering uitgespreek teenoor die Volksrepubliek van China vir ’n skenking aan Suid-Afrika van nood- en kleinskaalse opwekkingstoerusting ter waarde van R167 miljoen.
tgt: Cabinet expressed appreciation for a donation to South Africa by the People’s Republic of China of emergency and small-scale generation equipment valued at R167 million.

src: ’n Ontplooiingsplan word ontwikkel om te verseker dat dié toerusting geïnstalleer word in openbare fasiliteite, wat sodoende van beurtkrag geïsoleer sal wees.
tgt: A deployment plan is being developed to ensure the donated equipment is installed in public facilities which will, as a result, be isolated from load-shedding.

src: ’n Formele oorhandigingseremonie sal plaasvind sodra die goedere deur Suid-Afrikaanse doeaneowerhede uitgeklaar is.
tgt: A formal handover ceremony will take place as soon as the goods are cleared by South African customs authorities.

src: Water Die Kabinet het 'n oorsig oor die Departement van Water en Sanitasie se reaksies oor die land se water- en sanitasie-uitdagings ontvang.
tgt: Water Cabinet received an overview of responses by the Department of Water and Sanitation to water and sanitation challenges in the country.

src: Die oorsig beklemtoon die versnelling van projekte rakende oppervlakwaterhulpbronne, waaronder:7.
tgt: The overview highlighted the acceleration of surface water resource projects that had previously experienced such as:7.

src: Konstruksie van die Lesotho-Hoogland-waterprojek se R40-miljard-Fase 2, wat Gauteng en omliggende provinsies sal bedien.
tgt: Construction of the R40 billion Phase 2 of the Lesotho Highlands Water Project which will serve Gauteng and surrounding provinces.

src: Die Mokolo-Krokodil-wateruitbreidingsprojek se R4-miljard-Fase 2A in Noordwes en Limpopo.
tgt: Work will be completed in The R4 billion Phase 2A of the Mokolo Crocodile Water Augmentation Project in North West and Limpopo.

src: Fondse word ingesamel vir nog 'n fase waaraan bouwerk in Me 2024 sal begin, en na verwagting in 2030 voltooi sal word.
tgt: Funding is being raised for another phase on which construction will start in May 2024, with completion planned for In a partnership between government and the mining sector, construction is underway on the R24 billion Olifants River Water Resource Development project in Limpopo, with completion expected in In a similar partnership with mines in the Northern Cape, construction will start later this year on the R10 billion Vaal Gamagara project where completion is also expected around Construction started this month, June 2023, on the R500 million Groot Letaba Water Augmentation Project in Limpopo, which entails the raising of the Tzaneen Dam.

src: In 'n vennootskap tussen die regering en die mynbousektor is konstruksiewerk van die R24-miljard-waterhulpbronontwikkelingsprojek by die Olifantsrivier in Limpopo aan die gang.
tgt: Work on this project will be completed in In the Western Cape, construction will begin in 2024 on the R1,2 billion Voëlvlei Augmentation Scheme, where completion is expected in 2026.

src: Die projekte sal ook duisende mense in diens neem, besighede rondom die konstruksieterreine sal voordeel trek uit die werkers en kontrakteurs se verbruik en die verbeterde infrastruktuur sal verder ook tot voordeel van plaaslike ekonomieë wees.
tgt: Currently about 5 000 South African patients a year benefit from the supply, and it is expected that these numbers could increase by a factor of five to seven, with the increase in production capacity through the SAIF and the availability of a new cohort of isotopes.

src: Die Kabinet het die aanvaarding van die Wysigingswetsontwerp op die Suid-Afrikaanse Posbank deur die Parlement (beide die Nasionale Vergadering en Nasionale Raad van Provinsies) verwelkom, wat die weg baan vir die lisensiëring van die staatsbank.
tgt: Cabinet further welcomed the initiatives by the Department of Agriculture, Land Reform and Rural Development to support youth to participate in the agricultural sector in their revitalisation of communal areas such as the Marapyane-Bakgatla primary cooperative.

src: Die Wetsontwerp is gerig op die risiko's wat tans met die Posbank se huidige struktuur geassosieer word, deur die eienaarskap- en verslagdoeningstruktuur te wysig om 'n nuwe beheermaatskappy vir die bank te stig.
tgt: This cooperative has created more than 100 jobs in their villages and these youth are primarily grain and sunflower farmers.

src: Die Kabinet verwag dat die President die Wet sal onderteken, wat die registrasie van die bank as 'n bankbeheermaatskappy sal toelaat.
tgt: Working on Fire Programme Cabinet salutes the 400 South African firefighters deployed to Canada to assist in saving lives, homes, businesses and vegetation in the Canadian Province of Alberta.

src: Die Kabinet het die publikasie van die Konsepwetsontwerp op Huwelike van 2022 vir openbare kommentaar goedgekeur.
tgt: Divorce Amendment Bill of 2023 Cabinet approved the submission of the draft Divorce Amendment Bill of 2023 to Parliament.

src: Die Wetsontwerp gee uitvoering aan die Witskrif oor Huwelike in Suid-Afrika, wat in Maart 2022 deur die Kabinet goedgekeur is.
tgt: The Bill amends the Divorce Act, 1979 (Act 70 of 1979) so as to provide for mechanisms to safeguard the welfare of minor or dependent children born of Muslim marriages.

src: Die Wetsontwerp bemagtig die Departement van Binnelandse Sake om 'n enkele Huwelikswet vir die land te ontwikkel.
tgt: The amendments also aim to provide for the redistribution of assets on the dissolution of a Muslim marriage to provide for the forfeiture of patrimonial benefits of a Muslim marriage.

src: Die Konsepwetsontwerp poog om te verseker dat alle huwelike in ooreenstemming met die beginsels van gelykheid, niediskriminasie en menswaardigheid gesluit word, soos voorsien in die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996.
tgt: In June 2022, the Constitutional Court had found that the Divorce Act in its current form to be inconsistent with the Constitution as it excludes Muslim marriages.

src: Die Konsepwetsontwerp laat Suid-Afrikaners en inwoners van die land van alle seksuele oriëntasies, sowel as godsdienstige en kulturele oortuigings, toe om wettige verbintenisse in ooreenstemming met die grondwetlike beginsels te sluit.
tgt: The court found that a section of the Divorce Act is unconstitutional in that it unfairly discriminates against children of married parents and those of unmarried parents.

src: Die ARF is ook belangrik vir Suid-Afrika aangesien dit samewerking tussen ons land en ander lande, veral Afrikalande, ondersteun deur die bevordering van demokrasie, goeie bestuur, die voorkoming en oplossing van konflik, sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling en integrasie, humanitêre bystand en mensehulpbronontwikkeling.
tgt: Ms P Khoza who was elected the President of the 42st ICAO Assembly that took place from 27 September to 7 October 2022 in Montreal, Canada Condolences Cabinet expressed condolences to the family and friends of: Member of Parliament, Ms Tina Joemat-Pettersson, who was the Chairperson of the National Assembly Portfolio Committee on Police, and previously served as Minister of Agriculture, Forestry, and Fisheries and Minister of Energy.

src: Suid-Afrika se herverkiesing om as lid van die Raad van die Internasionale Burgerlugvaartorganisasie te dien.
tgt: She also served as an MEC for Education in the Northern Cape.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die herverkiesing van Suid-Afrika om as lid van die Raad van die Internasionale Burgerlugvaartorganisasie te dien.
tgt: She was also a member of the National Executive Committee of the African National Congress (ANC) and ANC Women’s League.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing.
tgt: Issues in the environment.

src: Energie.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die verbetering in Eskom se energiebeskikbaarheidsfaktor, wat nou nader aan 70% is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the improvement in Eskom’s Energy Availability Factor, which is now closer to 70%.

src: Sowat 400 megawatt (MW) is by die netwerk gevoeg en beplande instandhouding het binne ’n kort tydjie verbeter.2 Die Kabinet het ook kennis geneem van die besluit deur die Department van Bosbou, Visserye en die Omgewing se Nasionale Luggehaltebeampte om Eskom uitstel te gee om aan die minimum emissiestandaarde by die Kusile-kragstasie in Mpumalanga te voldoen, onderhewig aan sekere streng voorwaardes.3 Die uitstel sal Eskom in staat stel om herstelwerk te doen aan die skoorsteenpyp wat op 23 Oktober 2022 beskadig is.
tgt: About 400 megawatts (MW) have been added to the grid and planned maintenance has improved in a short space of time.

src: Die kragvoorsiener sal ook drie tydelike skoorsteenpype bou, wat na verwagting 2100 MW krag na die nasionale netwerk sal terugbesorg en beurtkrag met twee vlakke sal verminder.4 Die Kabinet het beklemtoon dat die regering tot die Just Energy Transition (JET) -oorgangstydperk verbind is en vasbeslote is om die uitwerking van klimaatsverandering te verlig.
tgt: Cabinet also noted the decision by the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment’s National Air Quality Officer to grant Eskom a postponement to meet the Minimum Emission Standards at the Kusile Power Station in Mpumalanga, subject to certain strict conditions.

src: Tot dusver is sowat 800 000 korttermynwerksgeleenthede, meestal vir jongmense, in die kritieke gebiede van onderwys, vroeë kinderontwikkeling en gemeenskapsveiligheid geskep.3 Die program het verseker dat baie kwesbare Suid-Afrikaners by betekenisvolle werk betrokke raak en ’n stabiele inkomste verdien.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the successful Joint Working Visit between the Prime Minister of the Netherlands, Mr Mark Rutte and Prime Minister of Denmark, Ms Mette Frederiksen that solidified South Africa’s relationship with the two countries in the areas of green hydrogen, renewable energy and the JEThe visit also brought a group of investors to South Africa to reinforce the high levels of cooperation and good relations between the country and the two important European partners.

src: Konsep-landbeleggingstrategie (LBS)1.1 Die Kabinet het Suid-Afrika se konsep LBS vir implementering goedgekeur.2 Die LBS, wat in 2022 vir openbare kommentaar gepubliseer is, poog om die land te posisioneer as ’n belangrike Afrika-beleggingsbestemming van keuse deur gehalte buitelandse en binnelandse direkte beleggings te benut.3 Die strategie is gevestig in die land se prioriteitbeleggings- en ekonomiese ontwikkelingsdoelwitte soos om indiensneming te verhoog, armoede te verminder, en ’n regverdige oorgang na ’n laekoolstofekonomie en energiesekuriteit te steun.4 Dit skep beleggingsmeganismes om klein, medium en mikro-ondernemings te lok in die strewe na ekonomiese groei, veral die groen ekonomie.
tgt: Cabinet further welcomed a joint declaration of intent to establish the South African-German Hydrogen Task Force, which was signed by the Minister in The Presidency responsible for Electricity, Dr Kgosientsho Ramokgopa and German Vice Chancellor Robert Habeck.

src: Die strategie maak ook gebruik van verskeie multilaterale, streeks- en bilaterale ooreenkomste wat deur Suid-Afrika onderteken is.5 Die strategie is belyn met die doelwitte van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan vir Ekonomiese Transformasie en die Nasionale Infrastruktuurplan 2050, wat onlangs aanvaar is.6 Die land se provinsies en hul metropolitaanse munisipaliteite sal ’n deurslaggewende rol speel om die strategie, wat voortdurend by veranderende ekonomiese omstandighede aangepas sal word, aan te dryf.
tgt: The task force will look at how the green hydrogen market will be created and developed, as well as create business-to-business opportunities between the two countries.

src: Issues in the Environment.
tgt: Issues in the Environment.

src: South African National Taxi Council (SANTACO) Western Cape taxi strike Cabinet was briefed about the ongoing impasse between SANTACO Western Cape and the City of Cape Town, which has escalated into a violent strike as a result of the impounding of taxi vehicles by the City of Cape Town.
tgt: South African National Taxi Council (SANTACO) Western Cape taxi strike Cabinet was briefed about the ongoing impasse between SANTACO Western Cape and the City of Cape Town, which has escalated into a violent strike as a result of the impounding of taxi vehicles by the City of Cape Town.

src: Cabinet condemns the violence and anarchy in Cape Town and has called on SANTACO to ensure that its protest action is peaceful and does not interfere with the rights of others.
tgt: Cabinet condemns the violence and anarchy in Cape Town and has called on SANTACO to ensure that its protest action is peaceful and does not interfere with the rights of others.

src: In this regard, we have noted that there were no violent incidents in the last 48-hours.
tgt: In this regard, we have noted that there were no violent incidents in the last 48-hours.

src: However, members of the South African Police Service and other law-enforcement agencies have been directed to ensue violent situation is under control to allow residents safe movement to school, work and their normal daily activities.
tgt: However, members of the South African Police Service and other law-enforcement agencies have been directed to ensue violent situation is under control to allow residents safe movement to school, work and their normal daily activities.

src: Cabinet was also briefed about the City of Cape Town’s imposing of taxi operating conditions which are at variance with both the National Road Traffic, 1996 (Act 93 of 1996) and the National Land Transport Act, 2009 (Act 5 of 2009), which regulate the traffic offences and applicable penalties, including the impounding of vehicles.
tgt: Cabinet was also briefed about the City of Cape Town’s imposing of taxi operating conditions which are at variance with both the National Road Traffic, 1996 (Act 93 of 1996) and the National Land Transport Act, 2009 (Act 5 of 2009), which regulate the traffic offences and applicable penalties, including the impounding of vehicles.

src: Cabinet has directed the Minister of Transport, Ms Sindisiwe Chikunga, to ensure that any taxi operating conditions that contradicts the laws of the Republic are removed.
tgt: Cabinet has directed the Minister of Transport, Ms Sindisiwe Chikunga, to ensure that any taxi operating conditions that contradicts the laws of the Republic are removed.

src: Fight against illegal mining.
tgt: Fight against illegal mining.

src: Cabinet welcomed the deployment of a special police unit, which is supported by the military, in Riverlea, Johannesburg, to deal with illegal mining in the area.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the deployment of a special police unit, which is supported by the military, in Riverlea, Johannesburg, to deal with illegal mining in the area.

src: In addition, Cabinet commended the arrest of over 194 suspects over illegal mining activities and directed law-enforcement agencies to urgently clamp down on this and other serious crimes in the country.
tgt: In addition, Cabinet commended the arrest of over 194 suspects over illegal mining activities and directed law-enforcement agencies to urgently clamp down on this and other serious crimes in the country.

src: The Department of Mineral Resources and Energy (DMRE) has committed to close all derelict open shafts and mine holes in Riverlea by the end of September 2023, whilst finalising plans to close other derelict open shafts and mining holes across the country.
tgt: The Department of Mineral Resources and Energy (DMRE) has committed to close all derelict open shafts and mine holes in Riverlea by the end of September 2023, whilst finalising plans to close other derelict open shafts and mining holes across the country.

src: The security situation in Niger.
tgt: The security situation in Niger.

src: Cabinet has noted the impact the security situation in Niger is having on air-travel between South Africa/Southern Africa and Western Europe, with negative implications for business and individuals alike and the airline industry that is just starting to recover from the devastating ravages of the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.

src: Western Cape Provincial Powers Bill.1 Cabinet was briefed about the unconstitutional draft Western Cape Provincial Powers Bill.2 The Draft Bill violates the provisions of Schedules 4 and 5 of the Constitution that set out powers and functions including concurrent powers of both the provincial and National executives.

src: Cabinet has noted that this draft Bill is an attempt to revert back to the Democratic Party’s (forerunner to the Democratic Alliance) preferred federal approach that seeks to undermine a United and inclusive South Africa.4 It is noteworthy that WC draft Bill ignores the exclusion from access to services of the large black communities of Khayelitsha, Gugulethu, Nyanga, Langa, the Cape Flats, Delft, Central Line, amongst others Cabinet has mandated the Ministers of Justice and COGTA to enter into discussions with the Western Cape provincial government in line with the relevant dispute resolution mechanisms as provided for in section 146 of the Constitution and the applicable intergovernmental framework.

src: Algemene Vergadering van die Verenigde Nasies (UNGA) Die Kabinet het die toespraak deur President Cyril Ramaphosa by die 78ste UNGA wat van 18 tot 26 September 2023 in New York, Verenigde State van Amerika, gehou is, verwelkom.
tgt: United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) Cabinet welcomed the address by President Cyril Ramaphosa at the 78th UNGA held in New York, United States of America from 18 to 26 September 2023.

src: Die President se welkome toespraak het Suid-Afrika se voorvegtersposisie in die belange en gelyke en sinvolle deelname van die Afrika-kontinent en die globale Suide in die algemeen by die VN en ander multilaterale forums, herbevestig.
tgt: The President’s widely welcomed address reaffirmed South Africa’s position in championing the interests, and equal and meaningful participation, of the African continent and the Global South in general at the UN and other multilateral forums.

src: Die toespraak het ook Suid-Afrika se vasberadenheid vir die steunmobilisering vir die volgende, herbevestig:
tgt: The address also reaffirmed South Africa’s resoluteness in the mobilisation of support for:

src: hernude toewyding aan multilateralisme, gebaseer op duidelike reëls en deur doeltreffende instansies ondersteun.
tgt: renewed commitment to multilateralism, based on clear rules and supported by effective institutions.

src: die hervorming van die VN se Veiligheidsraad (VNVR) om sin te gee aan die beginsel van die soewereine gelykheid van nasies en om die VNVR in staat te stel om meer doeltreffend op huidige geopolitieke werklikhede, te reageer.
tgt: the reform of the UN Security Council (UNSC), to give meaning to the principle of the sovereign equality of nations and to enable the UNSC to respond more effectively to current geopolitical realities.

src: welaf lande moet finansiële steun vermeerder om die 2023 Agenda vir volhoubare Ontwikkeling te implementeer en hul klimaatsveranderingsdoelwitte op omvattende en geïntegreerde wyse te bereik, waaronder die behoefte om dringend die werksaamhede van die Verlies- en Skadefonds vir kwesbare lande wat hard deur klimaatsrampe getref is, soos in November 2022 deur die 27ste sessie van die Konferensie van die Partye in Egipte ooreengekom is.
tgt: wealthy nations to increase financial support to both implement the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and achieve their climate-change goals in a comprehensive and integrated manner, including the need to urgently operationalise the Loss and Damage Fund for vulnerable countries hit hard by climate disasters, as agreed at the 27th Session of the Conference of the Parties held in Egypt in November 2022.

src: President Ramaphosa het Suid-Afrika se toewyding om steeds klimaatsverandering aan te spreek en die land as ŉ leier in hernubare energie, groen waterstof en volhoubare industrialisasie te posisioneer, herbevestig.
tgt: President Ramaphosa reaffirmed South Africa’s commitment to continue addressing climate change and positioning the country as a leader in renewable energy, green hydrogen and sustainable industrialisation.

src: President Ramaphosa het ook die Spitsberaad vir die bevordering van pandemievoorkoming, -gereedheid en -reaksie, in sy hoedanigheid as die Afrika-unie se kampioen vir die reaksie op die Koronavirussiekte (KOVID-19), toegespreek.
tgt: President Ramaphosa also addressed the Advancing Pandemic Prevention, Preparedness and Response Summit, in his capacity as the African Union Champion for the Coronavirus Disease (COVID-19) Response.

src: Suid-Afrika se bilaterale program op die kantlyn van die 78ste UNGA President Ramaphosa het op die kantlyn van die 78ste UNGA ŉ regeringsafvaardiging gelei wat verskeie bilaterale vergaderings belê het wat gepoog het om strategiese, politieke, diplomatieke en handelsverhoudinge te versterk.
tgt: South Africa’s bilateral programme on the sidelines of the 78th UNGA On the sidelines of the 78th UNGA, President Ramaphosa led a government delegation which held several bilateral meetings aimed at strengthening strategic, political, diplomatic and trade relations.

src: Die President het met sy Oekraïniese eweknie, Volodymyr Zelensky, vergader om vordering aangaande die vertroue-opbouingsmaatreëls en ander ontwikkelings deur die Afrika-vrede-inisiatief te bespreek.
tgt: The President met with his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelensky to discuss progress being made on the African Peace Initiative-led confidence-building measures and other developments.

src: President Ramaphosa het ook vergader met:2.
tgt: President Ramaphosa also met with:2.

src: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan van Turkye aangaande die versterking van verhoudings tussen Suid-Afrika en Turkye, en hulle het mekaar ingelig oor die vredesinisiatiewe oor die konflik tussen Rusland en Oekraïne.
tgt: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan of Türkiye, on strengthening relations between South Africa and Turkey, and briefing each other on the peace initiatives on the conflict between Russia and Ukraine.

src: President Bola Tinubu van die Federale Republiek van Nigerië oor die versterking van verhoudings tussen Suid-Afrika en Nigerië.
tgt: President Bola Tinubu of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, on strengthening relations between South Africa and Nigeria.

src: Hy het ook die jongste nuus ontvang oor die inisiatief deur die Ekonomiese Gemeenskap van Wes-Afrikastate oor die staatsgreep in Niger en algemene pogings om demokratiese bevel in die Sahel te herstel.
tgt: He also received an update on the Economic Community of West African States-led initiative on the coup in Niger and general efforts to restore democratic rule in the Sahel.

src: President Emmerson Mnangagwa van die Republiek van Zimbabwe, oor inisiatiewe deur Zimbabwe se regering om die herbou van daardie land na die onlangse geharmoniseerde verkiesings, te konsolideer.
tgt: President Emmerson Mnangagwa of the Republic of Zimbabwe, on initiatives by the government of Zimbabwe to consolidate the rebuilding of that country after the recent harmonised elections.

src: President Ramaphosa het ook deelgeneem aan die ronde tafelbespreking oor besigheid van die Verenigde State-Suid-Afrikaanse handel en beleggings, wat Suid-Afrikaanse en Amerikaanse sakeleiers ingesluit het.
tgt: President Ramaphosa also participated in the United States (US)-South Africa Trade and Investment Business Roundtable, which included South African and American business leaders.

src: Dié vergadering was kernbelangrik vir die voortdurende versterking van verhoudings tussen Suid-Afrika en die VSA, met meer as 600 VSA-maatskappye wat in Suid-Afrika bedrywig is.
tgt: With more than 600 US companies operating from South Africa, this engagement was critical in the ongoing strengthening of relations between South Africa and the UDuring the period, a formal announcement was made that the 20th US-Sub-Saharan Africa Trade and Economic Cooperation Forum, (AGOA Forum) will take place in Johannesburg from 2 to 4 November 2023.

src: Daar sal ook ŉ ‘Gemaak in Afrika-uitstalling’ by die forum wees, wat streekswaardekettings op die kontinent ten toon sal stel.
tgt: The forum will also feature the ‘Made in Africa Exhibition’ that will showcase regional value chains on the continent.

src: President Ramaphosa het ook die aankondiging van die medewerking tussen Novo Nordisk en Aspen, betrag.
tgt: President Ramaphosa also witnessed the announcement of the collaboration between Novo Nordisk and Aspen.

src: Die medewerking sal tot die vervaardiging van insulien by Aspen se fasiliteite in Gqebera, in die Oos-Kaap, lei.
tgt: The collaboration will see the production of insulin at the Aspen’s facilities in Gqeberha, Eastern Cape.

src: Die medewerking poog om in 2024 meer as 16 miljoen dosisse insulien te verskaf, wat in 2026 vermeerder sal word.
tgt: The collaboration aims to supply over 16 million doses of insulin in 2024, which will be up scaled by 2026.

src: Dit sal toegang tot insulienbehandeling in Suid-Afrika en regoor die kontinent, verhoog.
tgt: This will significantly enhance access to insulin treatment not just in South Africa, but also across the continent.

src: Die Kabinet het die Nasionale Energiereguleerder van Suid-Afrika se goedkeuring van handels- en invoer-/uitvoerlisensie-aansoeke aan die Nasionale Transmissiemaatskappy van Suid-Afrika, verwelkom, wat die weg vir die verkryging van krag regoor die streek, baan.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the National Energy Regulator of South Africa’s granting of trading and import/export license applications to the National Transmission Company of South Africa, paving the way for procurement of power from across the region.

src: Die Kusile-kragstasie se eenheid 4 wat na beplande onderhoud weer operasioneel is, het 800 megawatt in ons kragnetwerk ingestoot.
tgt: The return to service of the Kusile Power Station’s Unit 4 from planned maintenance has brought back 800 megawatts to our power grid.

src: Dié mylpaal is kernbelangrik vir die verbetering van opwekkingskapasiteit vir die nasionale netwerk en die aanspreek van die frekwensie van beurtkrag.
tgt: This milestone is central to improving generation capacity for the national grid and addressing the frequency of load-shedding.

src: Die Kabinet is verder ingelig oor die vordering om die Kusile-kragstasie se eenheid 1, 2 en 3 vroeg operasioneel te maak.
tgt: Cabinet was further briefed about progress to return Units 1, 2 and 3 of the Kusile Power Station ahead of schedule.

src: Die Kabinet het Eskom se stabiele beoordeling deur Moody se Beleggersdiens verwelkom, wat die kragnutsdiens se kredietwaardigheid sal verbeter en hom in staat sal stel om vooruit te beplan oor die implementering van beplande onderhoud van sy opwekkingsvloot.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed Eskom’s stable rating by Moody’s Investors Service, which will improve the power utility’s credit worthiness and enable it to plan ahead in implementing planned maintenance on its generation fleet.

src: Watersekerheid.
tgt: Water security.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor pogings om wateruitdagings wat ŉ aantal gebiede regoor die land raak, aan te spreek.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed about efforts to address water challenges affecting a number of areas across the country.

src: Die Minister van Water en Sanitasie, Mnr Senzo Mchunu, en uitvoerende burgemeesters van sommige van die stede in Gauteng sal die jongste nuus oor voortdurende ingrypings om watertoevoer in die provinsie te stabiliseer, bekend maak.
tgt: The Minister of Water and Sanitation, Mr Senzo Mchunu and executive mayors of some of the cities in Gauteng will provide an update on ongoing interventions to stabilise water supply in the province.

src: Die Kabinet wil graag almal daaraan herinner dat Suid-Afrika ŉ waterskaarsland is.
tgt: Cabinet wishes to remind everyone that South Africa is a water-scarce country.

src: Alle Suid-Afrikaners en almal in dié land moet water spaar en spaarsamig gebruik.
tgt: All South Africans and everyone in this country must save and use water sparingly.

src: Handelsake.
tgt: Trade matters.

src: Die vergadering van die Suid-Afrika-Lesotho binasionale kommissie (BNK) en die ministeriële kluster Die vergadering van die Suid-Afrika-Lesotho binasionale kommissie (BNK) en die ministeriële kluster wat van 25 tot 28 September 2023 gehou sal word, fokus op ekonomiese samewerking, oorkruis-grenskwessies en die beweging van mense, goedere en dienste tussen die twee lande.
tgt: The South Africa-Lesotho Binational Commission (BNC) and Ministerial Cluster Meeting.

src: President Ramaphosa en die Eerste Minister, Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane, sal op Donderdag, 28 September 2023 medevoorsitters van die openingsessie van die BNK tussen Suid-Afrika en Lesotho, wees.
tgt: The South Africa-Lesotho BNC and Ministerial Cluster Meeting held from 25 to 28 September 2023 is focussing on economic cooperation, cross-border issues, and the free movement of people, goods and services between the two countries.

src: Die BNK sal diplomatieke verhoudings, verdediging en sekuriteit, water, vervoer, elektrisiteit en handel, bespreek.
tgt: President Ramaphosa and Prime Minister Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane will co-chair the Inaugural Session of the BNC between South Africa and Lesotho on Thursday, 28 September 2023.

src: Die Kabinet het die werk van die kommissie verwelkom aangaande die aanspreek van monopoliekommerpunte in digitale bemiddelingsplatforms, waaronder e-handel, aanlynreisagentskappe, voedselaflewering, toepassingswinkels, snuffelgidsverskaffers en soekenjins.
tgt: The BNC will cover diplomatic relations, defence and security, water, transport, electricity and trade.

src: Die Kabinet het aan die ministers van toepaslike regeringsdepartemente opdrag gegee om verder by die aanbevelings vir verbetering betrokke te raak, die beleidsimplikasies te oorweeg en die nodige beleidsverbeterings te onderneem wat sinvolle deelname van Suid-Afrikaners en klein-, medium- en mikro-ondernemings oor die ontwikkelende aanlynbesighede, sal vergemaklik.
tgt: Cabinet commended the work of the commission in addressing monopoly concerns in digital intermediation platforms, including ecommerce, online travel agencies, food delivery, app stores, classifieds providers and search engines.

src: Voëlgriep.
tgt: Bird flu.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die huidige uitbraak van die uiters patogeniese influensa (HPAI) H5 en H7 in die pluimvee-industrie in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Cabinet noted the current outbreaks of highly pathogenic influenza (HPAI) H5 and H7 in the poultry industry in South Africa.

src: Die Wes-Kaap en KwaZulu-Natal het uitbrekings van HPAI H5 ervaar, en HPAI H7 is in Gauteng-, Limpopo-, Mpumalanga- en die Noordwesprovinsie, gerapporteer.
tgt: The Western Cape and KwaZulu-Natal experienced outbreaks of HPAI H5 while HPAI H7 has been reported in the provinces of Gauteng, Limpopo, Mpumalanga and North West.

src: Beheermaatreëls om die verspreiding van die uitbraak te beheer is in plek en boere word aangemoedig om voorgeskrewe bioveiligheidsmaatreëls, na te kom.
tgt: Control measures to manage the spread of the outbreaks are in place and farmers are encouraged to observe prescribed biosecurity measures.

src: Die uitbrekings stel voedselsekerheidsrisiko’s, en handelsmaatreëls in die vorm van invoere om vir die beskikbaarheid van vrugbare eiers, tafeleiers en pluimveevleis te sorg, kan geïmplementeer word.
tgt: The outbreaks pose food security risks and trade measures in the form of imports to manage availability of fertile eggs, table eggs and poultry meat may be implemented.

src: Die Departement van Landbou, Grondhervorming en Landelike Ontwikkeling, die Suid-Afrikaanse Reguleringsowerheid vir Gesondheidsprodukte en die industrie ondersoek aansoeke vir die registrasie van moontlike entstowwe, met nakomingsmaatreëls verwant aan veiligheid, doeltreffendheid en kwaliteit wat van die grootste belang vir die registrasie van sodanige entstowwe is.
tgt: The Department of Agriculture, Land Reform and Rural Development, South African Health Products Regulatory Authority and the industry are exploring applications for the registration of possible vaccines, with compliance measures relating to safety, efficacy and quality being paramount for registration of such vaccines.

src: Geïntegreerde stryd teen misdaad Die Kabinet het die jongste nuus oor die stryd teen geweld verwelkom, wat ook deur die Minister van Polisie, Generaal Bheki Cele, en die Nasionale Gesamentlike Operasionele en Intelligensiestruktuur, aan die nasie verskaf is.
tgt: Integrated fight against crime Cabinet welcomed the update on the fight against crime, which was also provided to the nation by the Minister of Police, General Bheki Cele, and the National Joint Operational and Intelligence Structure.

src: Die multidissiplinêre werksaamheid oor onwettige mynbou en immigrasie in die Noord-Kaap het die arrestasie van 867 mense, baie vanaf Lesotho, Zimbabwe, Mosambiek en sommige Suid-Afrikaners, tot gevolg gehad.
tgt: The multidisciplinary operation on illegal mining and immigration in the Northern Cape led to the arrest of 867 people, many from Lesotho, Zimbabwe, Mozambique and some South Africans.

src: Die Kabinet het die sentimente van wetstoepassingsagentskappe herhaal dat Suid-Afrikaners wat skuilplekke aan kriminele betrokke in onwettige mynaktiwiteite verleen, die volle mag van die gereg in die gesig sal staar.
tgt: Cabinet echoed the sentiments of law-enforcement agencies that South Africans who harbour criminals involved in illegal mining activities will face the full might of the law.

src: Uiterste weer.
tgt: Extreme weather.

src: Die land se uiterste weerpatrone beklemtoon die impak wat klimaatsverandering op ons lewens het en die behoefte aan volgehoue optrede om ons ekonomie te ontkool terwyl volhoubare ontwikkeling nagestreef word.
tgt: The country’s extreme weather patterns underscore the impact climate change is having in our lives and the need for sustained action to decarbonise our economy while pursuing sustainable development.

src: Die Kabinet bly ingelig oor die verwoesting wat deur erge storms en vloede in die Oos-Kaap, Wes-Kaap en Gauteng veroorsaak is, met aanduidings dat dit waarskynlik na ander provinsies sal versprei.
tgt: Cabinet is being kept abreast on the devastation caused by severe storms and flooding in the Eastern Cape, Western Cape and Gauteng, with indications that this will likely spread to other provinces.

src: Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op gemeenskappe om baie waaksaam vir verdere uiterste weerwaarskuwings, wat verdere verwoesting regoor die land kan veroorsaak, te wees.
tgt: Cabinet calls on communities to remain on high alert for further extreme weather warnings, which could bring further devastation across the country.

src: Die regering ondersteun steeds nooddienste en rampbestuursentrums vir reddingsbedrywighede en om humanitêre steun te bied.
tgt: Government continues to support emergency services and disaster management centres for rescue operations and to provide humanitarian support.

src: Winnie Mandelalaan Die Kabinet neem kennis van die herbenoeming van William Nicollaan in Sandton na Winnie Mandelalaan as ŉ belangrike stap in die herskryf van die geskiedenis van Suid-Afrika om die bydrae van diegene wat vir ons vryheid geveg het, te weerspieël.
tgt: Winnie Mandela Avenue Cabinet noted the renaming of William Nicol Drive in Sandton to Winnie Mandela Avenue as an important step in rewriting the history of South Africa to reflect the contribution of those who fought for our freedom.

src: Die geleentheid het op 26 September oorvleuel met wat Winnie Madikizela-Mandela se 87ste verjaardag sou gewees het.
tgt: The event coincided with what would have been Winnie Madikizela-Mandela’s 87th birthday on 26 September 2023.

src: Kabinetsbesluite Bygewerkte wildsvleisstrategie vir Suid-Afrika Die Kabinet het die bygewerkte wildsvleisstrategie vir Suid-Afrika, wat poog om die wildsvleisindustrie te formaliseer en transformeer, goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet decisions Revised Game Meat Strategy for South Africa Cabinet approved for implementation of the Revised Game Meat Strategy for South Africa, which seeks to formalise and transform the game meat industry.

src: Die strategie poog om die wildsvleissektor as beide verskaffer van voedselsekerheid en ŉ ekonomiese groeisektor wat kan help om werk te skep, te versterk.
tgt: The strategy aims to strengthen the game meat sector as both a provider of food security and an economic growth sector that can help create jobs.

src: Suid-Afrika is eerste op die Afrikakontinent vir wildsvleisproduksie, gelys.
tgt: South Africa is ranked number one on the African continent for game-meat production.

src: Die strategie poog om teen 2030 die skep van 202 666 volhoubare werke in die wildsvleisindustrie te verseker.
tgt: The strategy seeks to ensure the creation of 202 666 sustainable jobs in the game meat industry by 2030.

src: Die strategie sal op die Departement van omgewing, bosbou en visserye se webwerf, WEBTOKEN, gepubliseer word.
tgt: The strategy will be published on the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment’s website: WEBTOKETourism Sector Master Plan Cabinet has approved the alignment of the Tourism Sector Recovery Plan to a new Tourism Master Plan.

src: Toerismesektormeesterplan Die Kabinet het die in ooreenstemming bring van die toerismesektorherstelplan met ŉ nuwe toerismemeesterplan, goedgekeur.
tgt: An important component of the Master Plan is to mitigate the impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic on the tourism sector.

src: ŉ Belangrike komponent van die meesterplan is om die impak van die KOVID-19-pandemie op die toerismesektor, te versag.
tgt: It further provides a road map for full recovery of tourism in the country.

src: Die plan verskaf ook ŉ padkaart vir die volle herstel van toerisme in die land.
tgt: Whereas the Tourism Sector Recovery Plan was developed to facilitate the recovery of the sector, preserve jobs and protect livelihoods, the Master Plan will take this work to another level and facilitate new opportunities in the sector.

src: Die toerismesektorherstelplan is ontwikkel om die herstel van die sektor te vergemaklik, werke te behou en lewensbestaan te beskerm en die meesterplan wil dié werk na ŉ ander vlak neem en nuwe geleenthede in die sektor bevorder.
tgt: The plan proposes seven intervention strategies to ensure the tourism sector returns to its glory days, and that it becomes the centre of job creation and entrepreneurship.

src: Die toerisme-industrie is ŉ noodsaaklike ekonomie en het voor die KOVID-19-pandemie 725 000 werke ondersteun.
tgt: The tourism industry is a vital contributor to the economy and had supported 725 000 jobs before the COVID-19 pandemic.

src: Wetsontwerpe.
tgt: Bills.

src: Wetsontwerp op Suid-Afrikaanse Uitsaaikorporasie (SABC) van 2023.
tgt: South African Broadcasting Corporation (SABC) Bill of 2023.

src: Die Kabinet het die voorlegging van SABC-wetsontwerp van 2023 aan die Parlement, goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the submission of the SABC Bill of 2023 to Parliament.

src: Die wetsontwerp sal, sodra dit aangeneem word, die herroeping van die huidige Uitsaaiwet, 1999 (Wetnr 4 van 1999) tot gevolg hê.
tgt: Once passed into law, the Bill will result in the repeal of the current Broadcasting Act, 1999 (Act 4 of 1999).

src: Die wysigings sal die doeltreffendheid van die openbare uitsaaier se bedrywighede, versterk.
tgt: The amendments will strengthen the efficiency of the operations of the public broadcaster.

src: Die wetsontwerp stel ook verbeterings van die SABC se befondsingsmodel en die TV-lisensiëringstelsel, voor.
tgt: The Bill further proposes reforms in the SABC’s funding model and the TV-licensing system.

src: Konsepwysigingswetsontwerp op waterdienste Die Kabinet het die publikasie van die Konsepwysigingswetsontwerp op waterdienste vir openbare kommentaar goedgekeur.
tgt: Draft Water Services Amendment Bill Cabinet approved the publication of the Water Services Amendment Bill for public comments.

src: Die sleuteloogmerke van die wetsontwerp is om aanspreeklikheid vir waterdiensverskaffers te versterk en deursigtigheid in te bring.
tgt: The key aims of the Bill are to strengthen accountability for water services providers and to introduce transparency.

src: Die wysigings tot die Waterdienswet, 1997 (Wetnr 108 van 1997) sal verseker dat waterdiensverskaffers hoë kwaliteit water as deel van hulle lisensievoorwaardes, sal lewer.
tgt: The amendments to the Water Services Act, 1997 (Act 108 of 1997) will ensure that water-service providers deliver high-quality water as part of their licensing conditions.

src: Die wysigings sal ook swak punte aanspreek wat in die waterdienssektor uitgewys is.
tgt: The amendments will also address weaknesses that have been identified in the water services sector.

src: Die wetsontwerp stel minimumstandaarde vir die funksionering van waterdiensverskaffers, wat deur waterdiensowerhede toegepas moet word.
tgt: The Bill sets minimum standards for the functioning of water services providers, which must be enforced by Water Services authorities.

src: Nasionale waterkonsepwysigingswetsontwerp Die Kabinet het die publikasie van die Nasionale waterkonsepwysigingswetsontwerp vir openbare kommentaar goedgekeur.
tgt: Draft National Water Amendment Bill.

src: Die wetsontwerp wysig die Nasionale Waterwet, 1998 (Wetnr 36 van 1998).
tgt: Cabinet approved the publication of the draft National Water Amendment Bill for public comments.

src: Dié wysigings sal regulasies verbeter en sal verseker dat die land se waterhulpbronne goed bestuur, beskerm en bewaar word.
tgt: These amendments will improve regulations and will ensure that the country’s water resources are well managed, protected and conserved.

src: Die wetsontwerp maak ook voorstelle om die wanbalanse van die verlede verwant aan watertoewysing te elimineer en maak voorsiening vir doeltreffende en vinniger interne geskilbeslegtingsmeganismes.
tgt: The Bill also makes proposals to eliminate the imbalances of the past relating to water allocation, and provides for effective and quicker internal dispute resolution mechanisms.

src: Aanstellings Alle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en toepaslike klaring.
tgt: Appointments All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant clearance.

src: Mnr Kuberndran Moodley as Hoofbestuurder: Vervaardiging en Ingenieurswese by Government Printing Works.
tgt: Mr Kuberndran Moodley as General Manager: Manufacturing and Engineering at the Government Printing Works.

src: Mnr Sihle Ngubane as Hoofbestuurder: Bedryfsbestuur by die Government Printing Works.
tgt: Mr Sihle Ngubane as General Manager: Operations Management at the Government Printing Works.

src: Me Mmolaeng Mooki as Hoofbestuurder: Korporatiewe dienste by die Government Printing Works.
tgt: Ms Mmolaeng Mooki as General Manager: Corporate Services at the Government Printing Works.

tgt: Appointment of non-executive directors to the Board of the South African Special Risk Insurance Association.

src: Komende gebeurtenisse.
tgt: Upcoming Events.

src: Vervoermaand Dié jaar se vervoermaand sal gevier word met die tema: “Siyakha - Bou beter infrastruktuur om Suid-Afrika te ontwikkel”.
tgt: Transport Month This year’s Transport Month will be commemorated under the theme: “Siyakha - Building better infrastructure to grow South Africa”.

src: Vervoermaand 2023 sal op groot beleggings in vervoerinfrastuktuur, en ŉ oproep tot optrede om vervoerinfrastruktuur teen diefstal en vandalisme te beskerm, fokus.
tgt: Transport Month 2023 will focus on major investments in transport infrastructure, and a call to action to protect transport infrastructure from theft and vandalism.

src: Wêreldonderwysersdag Suid-Afrika sal by die res van die wêreld aansluit en Wêreldonderwysersdag op Donderdag, 5 Oktober 2023 gedenk, met die tema: “Die onderwysers wat ons benodig vir die opvoeding wat ons wil hê: Die wêreldwye opdrag om die onderwyserstekort om te keer”.
tgt: World Teachers’ Day South Africa will join the rest of the world in commemorating World Teachers’ Day on Thursday, 5 October 2023, under the theme: “The teachers we need for the education we want: The global imperative to reverse the teacher shortage”.

src: Die dag poog om bewustheid, begrip en waardering vir die noodsaaklike bydrae van onderwysers wêreldwyd in onderwys en ontwikkeling, te verhoog.
tgt: The day aims to raise awareness, understanding and appreciation for the vital contribution that teachers make to education and development across the globe.

src: Dié dag is ook gesamentlik deur die Internasionale Arbeidsorganisasie en die Verenigde Nasies se Onderwys-, Wetenskaplike en Kulturele Organisasie verklaar om die belangrike werk wat ons onderwysers doen, te vier.
tgt: This day has been declared jointly by the International Labour Organization and the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization to celebrate the critical work that our teachers do.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Messages.

src: Gelukwense Die Kabinet het sy gelukwense en welmenendheid gerig aan: Generaal Bheki Cele, Minister van Polisie, wat die Groot muur gedenkmedalje van die Volksrepubliek van China ontvang het vir die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens se bydrae tot die breër wetstoepassingsamewerking tussen die twee lande.
tgt: CongratulationsCabinet extended its congratulations and well-wishes to: General Bheki Cele, the Minister of Police, who received the Great Wall Commemorative Medal from the People’s Republic of China for the South African Police Service’s contribution to the broader law-enforcement cooperation between the two countries.

src: Me Angie Motshekga, die Minister van basiese onderwys omdat sy deur die Sekretaris-Generaal van die VN, Mnr Antonio Guterres, verkies is om op die globale hoëvlakpaneel te dien en hom in te lig oor hoe lande hul onderwysstelsels kan transformeer.
tgt: Ms Angie Motshekga, the Minister of Basic Education, on being selected by the Secretary-General of the UN, Mr Antonio Guterres, to serve on a Global High-Level Panel to advise him on how countries can transform their education systems.

src: Die verkiesing van Minister Motshekga vir die hoëvlakpaneel weerspieël haar deskundigheidsvlak in die onderwysveld en is ŉ uitdrukking van vertroue op Suid-Afrika se onderwysbaan.
