tgt: The selection of Minister Motshekga into the high-level panel reflects her level of expertise in the field of education and is an expression of confidence on South Africa’s education trajectory.

src: Die paneel sluit verteenwoordigers van die Internasionale Arbeidsorganisasie, die VN se Opvoedkundige, Wetenskaplike en Kulturele Organisasie se Onderwyserstaakspan, wêreldwye onderwysersunies en drie onderwysministers, in.
tgt: The panel includes representatives from the International Labour Organization, the UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization’s Teacher Task Force, Global Teacher Unions and three education Ministers.

src: Twee voormalige Presidente was medevoorsitters van die paneel.
tgt: The panel was co-chaired by two former Presidents.

src: Kaapstadse Filmstudio’s, plaaslike akteurs en waaghalse, vir hulle werk op die Netflix-reeks, One Piece, wat wêreldwyd na nommer een op die aanlynstroomplatform, geskiet het.
tgt: Cape Town Film Studios, local actors and stunt performers, for their work on the Netflix series, One Piece, that rocketed to number one worldwide on the online streaming platform.

src: Van Ryn Distilleerdery omdat hulle die trofeë vir die wêreld se beste brandewyn vir sy 12-jaar-oue potketelbrandewyn by die Internasionale sterk drankuitdaging in Londen, verower het.
tgt: Van Ryn's Distillery, for being awarded the World's Best Brandy trophy for its 12-year-old potstill brandy at the 2023 International Spirits Challenge in London.

src: Meelye Die Kabinet het sy medelye betuig aan die familie en vriende van: Mnr Aziz Goolam Hoosein Pahad (82), voormalige anti-apartheidsaktivis wat die eerste Suid-Afrikaanse demokratiese regering se Adjunkminister van buitelandse aangeleenthede was.
tgt: Condolences Cabinet expressed condolences to the family and friends of: Mr Aziz Goolam Hoosein Pahad (82), the former anti-apartheid activist who was the first South African democratic government Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs from 1994 to 2008.Lieutenant Commander Gillian Elizabeth Hector, Master Warrant Officer William Masela Mathipa, and Warrant Officer Class One Mmokwapa Lucas Mojela, who died in the line of duty while aboard the submarine, SAS Manthatisi, off Kommetjie in the Western Cape.

src: Omstandigheidskwessies 2023 Rugby Wêreldbeker-kampioene Die Kabinet wens die Springbokke geluk met hul 2023 Rugby Wêreldbeker-oorwinning, wat gemaak het dat Suid-Afrika die enigste land is wat die Rugby Wêreldbeker vier (4) keer gewen het en die tweede land wat daarin kon slaag om die titel agtereenvolgens te wen.
tgt: Issues in the environment 2023 Rugby World Cup Champions Cabinet congratulated the Springboks on their 2023 Rugby World Cup victory that made South Africa the only country to win the Rugby World Cup four (4) times and second to win the title back-to-back.

src: In die geskiedenis van rugby in Suid-Afrika is hierdie die mees diverse Springbokspan wat Suid-Afrika se demografiese verteenwoordiging betref.
tgt: In the history of rugby in South Africa, this Springboks team is the most diverse in terms of the demographics representation of South Africa.

src: Die samestelling van so ŉ diverse span was nie toevallig nie, maar ŉ doelbewuste poging deur die Springbokke se bestuur en afrigters om ŉ inklusiewe span te kies.
tgt: The composition of such a diverse team was not an act of coincidence, but a deliberate effort by the management and coaching staff of the Springboks to select an inclusive team.

src: Daardie waagmoedige besluit deur die destydse afrigter, Rassie Erasmus, en sy span demonstreer aan Suid-Afrikaners sowel as die res van die wêreld dat enigeen met vaardigheid, gegewe ŉ kans en die nodige ondersteuning, sukses kan behaal – ŉ bevestiging dat ons Sterker Tesame is.
tgt: That bold decision by then coach Rassie Erasmus and his team continues to demonstrate to South Africans and the rest of the world, that everyone with skill, if given a chance and support, can become great – an affirmation that we are Stronger Together.

src: Allerbelangrik is hoedat die Springbokke se veerkragtigheid en vasberadenheid op die veld ŉ vergestalting is van dit wat aan die kern van Suid-Afrikanerskap lê, dit wat hierdie grootse nasie bo sy uitdagings laat uitstyg om telkens as oorwinnaar uit die stryd te tree.
tgt: Most importantly, the resilience and determination of the Springboks in the field of play is an embodiment of a true essence of being South African, that which makes this great nation rise against all odds and adversities to emerge victorious.

src: ŉ Paar van die uitblinkers in hierdie Springbokspan moes persoonlike struikelblokke oorkom onderweg na sukses.
tgt: Some of the best players of this Springboks team have had to overcome personal adversities on their path to greatness.

src: Die Kabinet se gelukwensings gaan aan Siyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, die Springbokke se dubbele Wêreldbeker-wennerkaptein, met sy aanvoering van die span tot die Grootste van Alle Tye — en die vieringe duur steeds voort.
tgt: Cabinet expressed its congratulations to Siyamtanda “Siya” Kolisi, the Springboks double World Cup-winning captain for leading the team to the Greatest of All Time (GOAT) status and the celebrations must go-on.

src: AGOA Forum Die Kabinet verwelkom die bevestiging deur beide die Amerikaanse administrasie sowel as die kongres dat hulle voornemens is om AGOA te verleng, wat sekerheid bring aan die beleggingsgemeenskap in die lande wat vir AGOA kwalifiseer.
tgt: AGOA Forum Cabinet had welcomed the confirmation by both the United States administration and congress on the intention to extend AGOA, which brings certainty to the investment community in the AGOA-eligible countries.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom ook die aanbieding van die 2023 AGOA Forum in Johannesburg vanaf 2–4 November 2023, wat bygewoon is deur deelnemers uit 32 Afrika-lande vanuit die geledere van regeringslui, die besigheidswêreld, die burgerlike samelewing en — die eerste keer ooit — georganiseerde arbeid, asook verteenwoordigers van die regering van die Verenigde State.
tgt: Cabinet had also welcomed the hosting of the 2023 AGOA Forum in Johannesburg from the 2nd – 4th November 2023 with participants from 32 Africa countries from government, Business, civil society and organised labour for the first time and representatives of the United States government.

src: Die Kabinet meen steeds dat AGOA ŉ geleentheid bied vir die Verenigde State van Amerika om sy ekonomiese verhouding met Afrika te versterk en dus vir ŉ betekenisvolle tydperk verleng en aangevul moet word sodat dit ŉ groter impak kan hê en aantrekliker vir deelnemers kan wees.
tgt: Cabinet has always asserted that AGOA provides an opportunity for the United States of America to strengthen its economic relationship with Africa and thus it must be extended for a meaningful period, enhanced to make it impactful and attractive.

src: Vergadering van BRICS se Ministers van Toerisme Die Kabinet verwelkom die suksesvolle afsluiting van 2023 se Vergadering van BRICS se Ministers van Toerisme wat in Kaapstad gehou is, waar lidlande hulself daartoe verbind het om nouer saam te werk en intra-BRICS-toerisme te bevorder asook roetes vir groter toerismemobiliteit en konnektiwiteit tussen die lidlande te ontwikkel.
tgt: BRICS Tourism Ministers’ Meeting Cabinet welcomed the successful conclusion of the 2023 BRICS Tourism Ministers’ Meeting held in Cape Town, which committed member nations to deeper cooperation and to promote intra-BRICS tourism, develop routes for better tourism mobility and connectivity among the member countries.

src: Dit sal ŉ verdere hupstoot gee aan Suid-Afrika se toerismesektor, wat reeds tekens van herstel toon.
tgt: This will further strengthen South Africa’s tourism sector which is already showing signs of recovery.

src: Die land het 5,5 miljoen aankomste in die eerste agt maande van 2023 gehad, wat ŉ toename van 63,4% is, gemeet aan dieselfde tydperk in 2022.
tgt: For the first 8 months of 2023, the country saw million arrivals which represented a 63.4% increase from the same period in 2022.

src: Kieserregistrasie Die OVK het 18 en 19 November 2023 as die eerste kieserregistrasienaweek vir 2024 se algemene verkiesing aangekondig.
tgt: Voter Registration The IEC has announced the 18th and 19th of November 2023 as a first voter registration weekend for the 2024 General Elections.

src: Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op alle stemgeregtigde kiesers om te registreer om in 2024 se algemene verkiesing by hul naaste stemlokaal te stem.
tgt: Cabinet is calling on all eligible voters to register to vote for the 2024 General Elections at your nearest voting stations.

src: Aanlyn kieserregistrasie is sedert Februarie 2023 beskikbaar, en burgers word versoek om die fasiliteit te gebruik om te registreer of hul besonderhede by te werk.
tgt: Online voter registration has been opened since February 2023 and citizens are urged to use the facility to register or update their details.

src: Suid-Afrikaners wat vir hul ID's aansoek gedoen het, word aangemoedig om hul plaaslike kantoor van Binnelandse Sake te besoek om dit af te haal.
tgt: South Africans who have applied for their IDs are encouraged to visit their local Home Affairs office to collect them.

src: Daar is nog meer as 500 000 slim ID-kaarte wat by kantore van Binnelandse Sake regoor die land afgehaal moet word.
tgt: There are more than 500 000 smart ID cards still to be collected atHome Affairs offices across the country.

src: Elektrisiteit Die Minister in die Presidensie getaak met elektrisiteit het omvattende inligting oor die land se elektrisiteitsituasie verskaf.
tgt: Electricity The Minister in the Presidency responsible for Electricity has provided a comprehensive briefing on electricity situation in the country.

src: Die Kabinet loof pogings deur die Gautengse provinsiale regering in samewerking met Eskom om elektrisiteittoevoer te herstel na gebiede in Gauteng wat deur stroomonderbrekings weens diefstal of skade aan transformators getref is.
tgt: Cabinet applauded efforts by the Gauteng Provincial Government working with Eskom to restore electricity to areas in Gauteng that have been hit by black-outs due to the theft or damage to transformers.

src: Gisteraand is ses nuwe elektriese transformators in Kagiso aan die Wes-Rand aangeskakel nadat gemeenskappe meer as drie jaar lank sonder krag was.
tgt: Last night, six new electrical transformers were switched in Kagiso, in the West Rand area after communities were left without power for more than 3 years.

src: Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op hierdie gemeenskappe om hierdie kritieke infrastruktuur teen diefstal, vandalisme en skade as gevolg van onwettige verbindings te beskerm.
tgt: Cabinet calls on these communities to protect the critical infrastructure from theft, vandalism and damage that is caused by illegal connections.

src: Voedselvergiftiging Die Kabinet neem met kommer kennis van die vlaag voedselvergiftiging onder kinders as gevolg van die inname van verouderde en besmette voedsel afkomstig van spazawinkels en straatsmouse.
tgt: Food Poisoning Cabinet is concerned by the spate of food poisoning of children from eating expired and contaminated foodstuff from spaza shops and street vendors.

src: Dit is gerusstellend om te verneem van wetstoepassingspogings om voldoening aan voedselveiligheid af te dwing.
tgt: Cabinet is encouraged by the law enforcement efforts to enforce food safety compliance.

src: Werkwinkel met burgemeesters en tradisionele leiers oor internasionale migrasie Die Kabinet is ingelig oor ŉ internasionale migrasiewerkwinkel, aangebied deur die Departement van Binnelandse Sake met die deelname van die DSBD, COGTA, Meslike Nedersettings en tradisionele leiers en burgemeesters van metro- en distriksmunisipaliteite, wat toegespits was op die bekamping van die gevolge van onwettige immigrasie, insluitend die bedrywighede van spazawinkels.
tgt: International Migration Workshop with Mayors and Traditional leaders Cabinet was briefed about the international migration workshop hosted by the Department of Home Affairs with the participation of the DSBD, COGTA, Human Settlements and traditional leaders and mayors from metro and district municipalities that focused on curbing effects of illegal immigration, including the operations of spaza shops.

src: Sleuteluitkomste sluit in die instelling van omnibusverordeninge om uitdagings aan te spreek wat verband hou met die afdwinging van besigheidsverordeninge deur munisipaliteite en tradisionele owerhede.
tgt: Key outcomes include the introduction of omnibus by-laws to address challenges relating to the enforcement of business by-laws by municipalities and traditional authorities.

src: Besighede, veral spazawinkels, sal onmiddellik gesamentlik deur die departemente van arbeid, gesondheid en kleinsake-ontwikkeling asook Binnelandse Sake se immigrasie-inspektoraatspanne geïnspekteer word om die nakoming van toepaslike wette af te dwing.
tgt: There will be immediate joint inspections of businesses, in particular spaza shops by the departments of labour, health, small business development and the Home Affairs immigration inspectorate teams, to enforce compliance with applicable laws An audit of spaza shops in villages and townships, and mechanisms to register them by both traditional leaders and municipalities will be undertaken.

src: ŉ Oudit van spazawinkels in dorpies en townships sal onderneem word, en meganismes sal ingestel word om hulle deur beide tradisionele leiers en munisipaliteite te registreer.
tgt: There are also efforts to support traditional authorities to keep a record of foreign nationals in their communities.

src: Daar word ook gepoog om tradisionele owerhede te ondersteun om rekord te hou van buitelandse burgers in hul gemeenskappe.
tgt: Business licencing legislation is being amended to support all those who wish to trade in the informal sector.

src: Besigheidslisensiewetgewing word tans gewysig om al diegene te ondersteun wat in die informele sektor wil handel dryf.
tgt: Integrated Crime Fighting Cabinet commends the SAPS for dealing a massive blow to international drug syndicates following the discovery of cocaine valued at R80 million which were seized on 20 October 2023 at a warehouse at the Dube Trade Port within the King Shaka International Airport.

src: Twee dae voor die beslaglegging is daar ook op ŉ verdere R70 miljoen se kokaïen in ŉ houer by die Durbanse hawe beslag gelê.
tgt: Two days prior the seizure, another R70 million worth of cocaine was also seized from a container at the Durban Harbour.

src: Die Kabinet loof die SAPD vir hul ontwrigting en aftakeling van oorgrens georganiseerde misdaad, wat ŉ wesenlike bedreiging vir ons gemeenskappe en nasie inhou.
tgt: Cabinet applauds the SAPS for their work in disrupting and dismantling transnational organised crime that poses a significant threat to our communities and the nation.

src: Operasie Veiliger Feesseisoen lewer reeds resultate op nadat die polisie meer as 140 verdagtes in hegtenis geneem het, insluitend ŉ beweerde sleutelfiguur in onwettige mynbou, en op talle ongelisensieerde vuurwapens beslag gelê het.
tgt: Operation Safer Festive Season is already yielding results with police arresting over 140 suspects, including an alleged illegal mining kingpin, and seizing unlicensed firearms.

src: Presidensiële oorsigbesoek Die Kabinet verwelkom die presidensiële oorsigbesoek aan die Emfuleni Munisipaliteit, wat voorafgegaan is deur samesprekings met die gemeenskap tydens die Distriksontwikkelingmodelbesoek van 2022.
tgt: Presidential Oversight Visit Cabinet welcomed the Presidential Oversight Visit to the Emfuleni Municipality, which followed-up on engagements with the community during the District Development Model visit of 2022.

src: Tydens die besoek aan Emfuleni in 2022 is swak infrastruktuuronderhoud deur die munisipaliteit as ŉ probleem geïdentifiseer.
tgt: The 2022 visit to Emfuleni identified issues of poor infrastructure maintenance by the municipality Through the intervention of the Department of Water and Sanitation, there has been notable progress in addressing water and sanitation infrastructure challenges that had resulted in the collapse of the Vaal Waste Water system.

src: Nadat die Departement van Water en Sanitasie ingegryp het, is noemenswaardige vordering gemaak met die oplos van water- en sanitasie-infrastruktuuruitdagings wat voorheen tot die ineenstorting van die Vaal-afvalwaterstelsel gelei het.
tgt: Work has been undertaken to improve water supply, the proper functioning of the waste water infrastructure and thus eliminating the problem of the sewer effluent that run running on the streets and people’s yards.

src: Werk is onderneem om watervoorsiening en die funksionering van die afvalwaterinfrastruktuur te verbeter en sodoende die probleem uit te skakel van riooluitvloeisel wat in die strate en oor mense se erwe loop.
tgt: Noted progress during the visit include improvements in critical bulk pipelines and water pump stations, resurfacing and resealing of roads, and a massive rollout of streetlights to improve lighting and safety.

src: Vordering wat tydens die besoek waargeneem is, sluit verbeterings aan kritieke grootmaat pypleidings en waterpompstasies in asook die hervlakking en herseël van paaie en die grootskaalse uitrol van straatligte om beligting en veiligheid op te skerp.
tgt: Roadmap for the Freight Logistics System in South Africa The Department of Transport has commenced consultations on the Roadmap for the Freight Logistics System in South Africa, as part of measures to address the challenges facing the freight and logistics sector and the strengthening of South Africa’s economic recovery efforts.

src: Padkaart vir Suid-Afrika se vraglogistiekstelsel Die Departement van Vervoer het begin konsulteer oor die padkaart vir Suid-Afrika se vraglogistiekstelsel as deel van maatreëls om die probleme op te los wat die vrag- en logistieke sektor in die gesig staar en Suid-Afrika se ekonomiese herstelpogings te onderskraag.
tgt: Infrastructure Development and Maintenance Cabinet welcomed the progress being made with infrastructure development and maintenance with the completion of 36 rural bridges under the Welisizwe Rural Bridges, and the construction underway on 20 projects in human settlements, roads, and water.

src: Infrastruktuurontwikkeling en -instandhouding Die Kabinet verwelkom die vordering in infrastruktuurontwikkeling en instandhouding met die voltooiing van 36 landelike brûe ingevolge die Welisizwe Landelike Brûe-projek, en konstruksiewerk aan 20 menslikenedersetting-, pad- en waterprojekte.
tgt: Relaunch of South African Airways (SAA) international routes Cabinet welcomed the relaunch of SAA international routes with the re-introduction of its intercontinental flight to São Paulo, Brazil, which also marked the return of the long-haul service out of Cape Town and Johannesburg.

src: Herbekendstelling van Suid-Afrikaanse Lugdiens (SAL) se internasionale roetes Die Kabinet verwelkom die herbekendstelling van SAL se internasionale roetes met die herinstelling van sy interkontinentale vlug na São Paulo, Brasilië, wat ook die herlewing van langafstandvlugte vanuit Kaapstad en Johannesburg inlui.
tgt: The return of SAA in the international routes will contribute directly in driving growth in international travel to the country, and growth of the tourism sector after the ravages of the Covid-19 pandemic.

src: Die SAL se herinstelling van internasionale roetes sal direk daartoe bydra om internasionale reise na die land te laat toeneem en die toerismesektor te help herstel na die verwoesting van die Covid-19-pandemie.
tgt: South Africa launches the largest drone in Africa Cabinet congratulated the Defence and aerospace company Milkor on their successful launch of the Milkor 380 unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), which places South Africa among the countries that continue to make strides in drone technology.

src: Suid-Afrika stel die grootste hommeltuig in Afrika bekend Die Kabinet se gelukwensings gaan aan die verdedigings- en lugruimmaatskappy Milkor met hul suksesvolle bekendstelling van die Milkor 380 onbemande lugvoertuig (OLV), wat Suid-Afrika onder die lande plaas wat die toon aangee in hommeltuigtegnologie.
tgt: The Milkor 380 is the largest drone built in Africa and it will be used by the defence industry for combat, border control, conservation efforts including to combat poaching.

src: Die Milkor 380 is die grootste hommeltuig wat nog in Afrika gebou is en sal deur die verdedigingsbedryf gebruik word vir gevegsituasies, grensbeheer en bewaringswerk, insluitend om stropery te bekamp.
tgt: Matric and Year-end schools examinations Cabinet welcomed the smooth start to the 2023 National Senior Certificate (matric) exams, which commenced on 30 October 2023.

src: Die Kabinet moedig ouers en voogde aan om leerders gedurende hierdie kritieke tydperk te ondersteun.
tgt: Parents and guardians are encouraged to continue to support learners during this critical period.

src: Die Kabinet wens ook al die ander leerders alles van die beste toe met hul jaareindeksamen.
tgt: Cabinet also sends its well wishes to all the learners who will be sitting for their year-end exams.

src: Kabinetbesluite Die situasie in Palestina Die Kabinet is teleurgesteld oor die weiering van die Israeliese regering om internasionale reg te respekteer en sy voortgesette ondermyning van die Verenigde Nasies se resolusies aangaande die implementering van ŉ wapenstilstand.
tgt: Cabinet decisions The Situation in Palestine Cabinet is disappointed by the refusal of the Israeli government to respect international law and its continued undermining of the United Nations resolutions for the implementation of a ceasefire with impunity.

src: Die humanitêre weë vir die mense van Palestina bly gesluit, met ernstige gevolge vir kinders, vroue en onskuldige burgerlikes.
tgt: The humanitarian corridors for the people of Palestine remain closed with dire consequences for children, women and innocent civilians.

src: Die moordende lugaanvalle deur Israel se regering op die mense van Palestina duur steeds voort, met ŉ stygende dodetal wat vroue en kinders insluit.
tgt: The genocidal airstrikes by the government of Israel on the people of Palestine, continue with rising death toll that include women and children.

src: Die afgelope twee dae het die wêreld hulpeloos gesit en toekyk hoe toenemende lugaanvalle op Gaza en die Wesoewer skole, gesondheidsfasiliteite, ambulanse en burgerlike infrastruktuur en paaie na die suide van Gasa wat veronderstel is om ŉ veilige roete te wees, vernietig.
tgt: In the last two days, the world have sat helplessly and watched as intensifying airstrikes on Gaza and the West Bank have destroyed schools, health facilities, ambulances and civilian infrastructure and supposedly safe roads travelling to the South of Gaza.

src: Die Kabinet het gevolglik besluit om alle Suid-Afrikaanse diplomate uit Tel Aviv te herroep vir konsultasie.
tgt: For these, the Cabinet has decided to recall all South African diplomats from Tel Aviv for consultation.

src: Die Kabinet neem ook met ontsteltenis kennis van die voortdurende neerhalende opmerkings van die Israeliese ambassadeur in Suid-Afrika, mnr Eliav Belotsercovsky, oor Suid-Afrikaners en Suid-Afrika se leierskap binne sowel as buite regeringskringe, insluitend die burgerlike samelewing, wat hulle uitspreek teen die Israeliese regering se slagting van die Palestyne.
tgt: Cabinet has also noted with disquiet the continuing disparaging remarks of the Israeli’s ambassador to South Africa, Mr. Eliav Belotsercovsky, against South Africans, the leadership of South Africa both in and outside government including civil society who are speaking against the holocaust being committed by the Israeli government against the Palestinians.

src: Ambassadeur Belotsercovsky se aanmerkings druis in teen die verklarings van twee voormalige Israeliese ambassadeurs in Suid-Afrika (Illan Baruch en dr. Alon Liel) wat konsekwent is in hul beskrywing van hul regering se optrede teen die Palestyne as ‘Apartheid’.
tgt: The disparaging remarks of Ambassador Belotsercovsky are contrasted by the statements of two former Israeli ambassadors to South Africa (Illan Baruch and Dr. Alon Liel) who have been consistent in describing the actions of their government against Palestinians as Apartheid.

src: Hierdie neerhalende opmerkings oor diegene wat die gruweldade veroordeel en oor die land se leiers maak ambassadeur Belotsercovsky se posisie al hoe meer verwerplik.
tgt: The disparaging remarks against those speaking up against the atrocities and the country’s leaders make ambassador Belotsercovsky position more and more untenable.

src: Die Kabinet het gevolglik die Departement van Internasionale Betrekkinge en Samewerking gelas om die Suid-Afrikaanse regering se misnoeë met die ambassadeur formeel deur diplomatieke kanale oor te dra.
tgt: As such Cabinet has directed the Department of International Relations and Cooperation to convey the South African government displeasure with the ambassador formally through diplomatic channels.

src: Meiumtermyn-begrotingsbeleidverklaring Die Kabinet het die mediumtermyn-begrotingsbeleidverklaring (MTBBV) vir 2023 verwelkom, wat ŉ eerlike beoordeling van die huidige ekonomiese klimaat verskaf en die regering se stewige houvas op ons land se finansies te midde van moeilike inkomstebeperkings demonstreer.
tgt: Medium Term Budget Policy Statement Cabinet welcomed the 2023 Medium Term Budget Policy Statement (MTBPS), which provided a frank assessment of the current economic climate and demonstrated government’s firm hold on our nation’s finances amid tough revenue constraints.

src: Die besluite in die MTBBV verbeter ons fiskale raamwerk en stimuleer ekonomiese groei terwyl dit ŉ ewewig bied vir die maatskaplike ondernemings waardeur ons ons nasie se kwesbares ondersteun.
tgt: The decisions in the MTBPS improve our fiscal framework stimulate economic growth while balancing our social commitments that support the vulnerable in our nation.

src: Die Ekonomiese Heropbou- en Herstelplan het tot talle groen lote in ons ekonomie bygedra.
tgt: The Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan has contributed to many green shoots in our economy.

src: Hoëspoedspoorontwikkeling Die Kabinet het die hoëspoedspoorontwikkelingsraamwerk goedgekeur, en die finansiële implikasies van die implementering daarvan sal deur die Ministers van Vervoer en Finansies bespreek word.
tgt: High Speed Rail Development Cabinet approved the High Speed Rail Development Framework and the financial implications for implementation will be discussed between the Ministers of Transport and Finance Cabinet approved the prioritisation of the Johannesburg to Durban corridor for a detailed feasibility study, and the Johannesburg-Polokwane to Musina, and the Johannesburg to Mbombela will be put to the market.

src: Konsep-witskrif oor burgerskap, immigrasie en vlugtelingbeskerming Die Kabinet het die publikasie van die Witskrif oor Burgerskap, Immigrasie en Vlugtelingbeskerming vir openbare kommentaar goedgekeur.
tgt: Draft White Paper on Citizenship, Immigration and Refugee Protection Cabinet approved the publication of the White Paper on Citizenship, Immigration and Refugee Protection for public comments.

src: Die konsepbeleid het ten doel om ŉ raamwerk te verskaf vir leiding oor die toekenning van verblyf en burgerskap aan buitelandse burgers sowel as die beskerming van vlugtelinge en asielsoekers in Suid-Afrika, met inagneming van die Republiek se nasionale veiligheidsbelange en in ooreenstemming met internasionale ooreenkomste en protokolle oor migrasie waarby Suid-Afrika ŉ party is.
tgt: The draft Policy aims to provide a framework to guide the granting of residency and citizenship to foreign nationals, as well as the protection of refugees and asylum seekers in South Africa, cognisant of the Republic’s national security interests and in compliance with international agreements and protocols on migration that South Africa is party to.

src: Die 6de jaarlikse vorderingsverslag oor die implementering van die Witskrif oor die Regte van Mese met Gestremdhede Die Kabinet het sy goedkeuring verleen vir publikasie in die staatskoerant van die 6de jaarlikse vorderingsverslag oor die implementering van die Witskrif oor die Regte van Mese met Gestremdhede.
tgt: The 6th Annual Progress Report on the implementation of the White Paper on the Rights of People with Disabilities Cabinet has approved for publication in the government gazette the 6th Annual Progress Report on the implementation of the White Paper on the Rights of People with Disabilities.

src: Die publikasie van die vorderingsverslag sal saamval met die internasionale viering van Gestremdheidsregte-bewusmakingsmaand van 3 November tot 3 Desember.
tgt: The publication of the progress report will coincide with the international commemoration of the Disability Rights Awareness Month from 3 November to 3 December.

src: Die vorderingsverslag dui ook op ŉ verhoging van die minimum diensbillikheidsteiken van 2% tot 3% vir persone met gestremdhede vanaf die 2024/2025 finansiële jaar, tot ŉ minimum 7% diensbillikheidsteiken vir persone met gestremdhede teen 2030.
tgt: The progress report also signals an increase of the minimum employment equity target from 2% to 3% for persons with disabilities as from the 2024/2025 financial year, towards a minimum 7% employment equity target for persons with disabilities by 2030.

src: Wetsontwerpe Konsepwetsontwerp op die Afrika Renaissance en Internasionale Samewerkingsfonds (ARF) Die Kabinet het die voorlegging van die ARF-wysigingswetsontwerp aan die Parlement goedgekeur.
tgt: Bills Draft African Renaissance and International Cooperation Fund (ARF) Bill Cabinet approved the submission of the ARF Amendment Bill to Parliament.

src: Die wetsontwerp het ten doel om die ARF-wet (Wet 51 van 2000) te wysig en die Suid-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsvennootskapagentskap tot stand te bring, wat sal dien as ŉ meganisme om Suid-Afrika se ontwikkeling en samewerking met susterlande deur die bevordering van demokrasie, goeie regering, die voorkoming en oplossing van konflik, sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling en integrasie te ondersteun.
tgt: The Bill seeks to amend the ARF Act (Act 51 of 2000) and establish the South African Development Partnership Agency that will serve as a mechanism to support South Africa’s development and cooperation with sister countries through the promotion of democracy, good governance, the prevention and resolution of conflict, socio-economic development and integration.

src: Aanstellings Alle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en relevante klaring.
tgt: All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant clearance.

src: Aanstelling van mnr Ebrahim Rasool as Voorsitter van die Ontwikkelingsbank van Suider-Afrika Aanstelling van Me Margaret Mosibudi Phiri as lid van die Nasionale Kernreguleerderraad
tgt: Appointment of Mr Ebrahim Rasool as Chairperson of the Development Bank of Southern Africa.

src: Komende gebeure Teenkorrupsie-dialoog Die Teenkorrupsie-dialoog word op 8 en 9 November 2023 by die Birchwood Hotel in Ekurhuleni gehou om die samelewing in die stryd teen korrupsie in ooreenstemming met die land se Nasionale Teenkorrupsiestrategie te mobiliseer.
tgt: Upcoming Events Anti-Corruption Dialogue The Anti-Corruption Dialogue will be held on 8 and 9 November 2023 at Birchwood Hotel in Ekurhuleni to mobilise society in the fight against corruption in line with the country’s National Anti-Corruption Strategy Cabinet, in November 2020, approved the National Anti-Corruption Strategy (NACS 2020-2030).

src: Dit is ŉ landswye strategie wat daarop gemik is om ŉ korrupsievrye samelewing te skep, terwyl dit ook burgers aanmoedig om geen korrupsie te verdra nie en die oppergesag van die reg te gehoorsaam.
tgt: This is a country strategy that is aimed at creating a corruption-free society while also encouraging citizens to have zero-tolerance for corruption and abide by the rule of law.

src: 16 Dae van Aktivisme-veldtog vir Geen Geweld Teen Vroue en Kinders nie 2023 Vanjaar is die 25ste herdenking van Suid-Afrika se deelname aan die 16 Dae van Aktivisme-veldtog vir Geen Geweld Teen Vroue en Kinders nie wat sal plaasvind aan die hand van die tema: “Versnelling van aksies om gendergebaseerde geweld en vrouemoord (GBVF) te beëindig: Niemand word agtergelaat nie”.
tgt: 16 Days of Activism Campaign for No Violence Against Women and Children 2023 This year marks the 25th anniversary of South Africa’s participation in the 16 Days of Activism for No Violence against Women and Children Campaign which will be observed under the theme: “Accelerating actions to end Gender-Based Violence and Femicide (GBVF): Leaving no one behind”.

src: Hierdie wêreldwye veldtog strek vanaf 25 November, die Internasionale Dag vir die Uitwissing van Geweld teen Vroue, tot 10 Desember, Internasionale Meseregtedag.
tgt: This global campaign runs from 25 November, the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women to 10 December, International Human Rights Day.

src: Dit het ten doel om geweld teen vroue te bekamp terwyl menseregte gehandhaaf word.
tgt: It aims to combat violence against women whilst upholding human rights.

src: 14de Beleidsdialoogforum Suid-Afrika gaan in Januarie 2024 mede-gasheer van die 14de Beleidsdialoogforum wees in samewerking met UNESCO se Internasionale Onderwyserstaakmag (OTM) vir Onderwys, aan die hand van die tema "Hoe om onderwysertekorte aan te spreek en die beroep aantrekliker te maak”.
tgt: 3 14th Policy Dialogue Forum South Africa will co-host the 14th Policy Dialogue Forum in collaboration with the UNESCO International Teacher Task Force for Education (TTF) in January 2024 under the theme “Addressing teacher shortages and making the profession more attractive”.

src: Die forum sal regeringsamptenare, NRO's, onderwysers en onderwyskundiges bymekaarbring om kritieke kwessies te bespreek rakende die diensvoorwaardes vir onderwysers, onderwysersoutonomie en aanspreeklikheid, en hoe om ŉ aantreklike beroep van onderwys te maak.
tgt: The forum will bring together government officials, NGOs, teachers and education experts to discuss critical issues pertaining to the conditions of service for teachers, issues of teacher autonomy and accountability as well as how to make teaching an attractive profession.

src: Boodskappe Gelukwense
tgt: Messages Congratulations

src: Die Kabinet dra wense van geluk en voorspoed oor aan: Die Proteas vir hul vordering tot die halfeindronde van die IKR Wêreldbeker 2023 in Indië.
tgt: Cabinet extended its congratulations and well wishes to: The Proteas for securing a place in the semi-finals of the the ICC World Cup 2023 in India.

src: Ondanks die terugslag in die span se wedstryd teen Indië gister staan die land bankvas agter hulle en is ons vol vertroue dat hulle sal aanhou bou aan hul prestasie en ons trots sal maak.
tgt: Despite the setback in their match against India yesterday, the country remains firmly behind the team and is confident they will continue to build and make us proud.

src: Die Moto GP-renster Brad Binder, wat nou die premierklas podiumrekordhouer vir Suid-Afrika is nadat hy onder die top drie geëindig het by die Thailandse Grand Prix.
tgt: Moto GP racing star Brad Binder who is now the outright premier class podium record holder for South Africa after his top three finish at the Thailand Grand Prix.

src: Suid-Afrika se eerste professionele rolstoelliggaambouer, Macethandile Kulati, vir die verdediging van sy titel by die 2023 Wêreldkampioenskap van die Internasionale Federasie van Liggaamsbouers en Fiksheid in Slowenië.
tgt: South Africa’s first pro-wheelchair bodybuilder Macethandile Kulati for defending his title at the 2023 International Federation of Body Builders and Fitness World Championship in Slovenia.

src: Suid-Afrikaanse geoktrooieerde rekenmeesters, nadat hulle die topposisie in Edelman se wêreldwye opname oor professionele vertroue behaal het.
tgt: South African Chartered Accountants for earning the top position in the Edelman global professional trust survey.

src: Dr. Claude Mashego, nadat sy die eerste Me.
tgt: Dr Claude Mashego for winning the inaugural Miss World South Africa and she will now represent South Africa at the Miss World in New Delhi, India in December this year.

src: Wêreld Suid-Afrika-titel gewen het sy sal Suid-Afrika in Desember vanjaar by die Me.
tgt: Advocate Kholeka Gcaleka following her appointment as the new Public Protector for a term of seven years with effect from 1 November 2023.

src: Wêreldkompetisie in Nieu-Delhi, Indië verteenwoordig.
tgt: Condolences Cabinet expressed condolences to the family and friends of: Paralympic gold medallist Zanele Situ who was the first black South African female athlete to win a gold medal at the Paralympic Games in Sydney in 2000.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing
tgt: Issues in the Environment

src: Ekonomiese herstel en groei Kwartaallikse Arbeidsmagopname Die Kabinet verwelkom die 2023 derde kwartaal-arbeidsmagresultate, wat deur Statistieke Suid-Afrika vrygestel is en aandui dat die indiensnemingsyfers hoër is as die indiensnemingsvlakke voor COVID-19.
tgt: Economic Recovery and Growth Quarterly Labour Force Survey (QLFS) Cabinet welcomes the 2023, 3rd quarter, QLFS results as released by Statistics South Africa that indicated employment figures have surpassed the pre-COVID-19 employment levels.

src: Die Kabinet is verheug dat al die provinsies behalwe een, daartoe bygedra dat die aantal werkende mense met 399 000 toegeneem het tot altesaam 16,7 miljoen mense wat in die derde kwartaal werk gehad het, vergeleke met 16,3 miljoen in die tweede kwartaal van 2023.
tgt: Cabinet is pleased that all provinces but one have contributed to the 399 000 increase to the number of employed people to a total of 16,7 million people in employment in the 3rd quarter, compared to 16,3 million in the 2nd quarter of 2023.

src: Beduidende bydraes tot bykomende werksgeleenthede in KwaZulu-Natal (met 152 000), Limpopo (met 70 000), Noordwes (met 61 000) en Mpumalanga, dui op die geleidelike, maar bestendige verwesenliking van die Ekonomiese Heropbou- en Herstelplan se doelwit om beter, sterker en meer inklusief te herbou.
tgt: The strong contributions to additional jobs of KwaZulu-Natal (up by 152 000), Limpopo (up by 70 000), North West (up by 61 000) and Mpumalanga, indicate the gradual but steady realisation of the goal of the Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan of rebuilding better, stronger and inclusively.

src: Die Kabinet waardeer die volgehoue en konsekwente bydrae van die volgende sektore en nywerhede: Die formele sektor se indiensnemingsyfer het met 287 000 toegeneem, terwyl die informele sektor met 29 000 werksgeleenthede toegeneem het Finansies (dit sluit besigheidsdienste in) het met 237 000 poste gestyg Gemeenskaps- en maatskaplike dienste het met 119 000 poste gestyg en landbou met 61 000 poste.
tgt: Cabinet appreciates the continued and consistent contribution of the following sectors and industries: The formal sector employment increased by 287 000 whereas informal sector increased by 29 000 jobs Finance (this includes business services) up by 237 000 jobs Community and social services up by 119 000 jobs and agriculture by 61 000 jobs.

src: Die Kabinet het ook kennis geneem van die negatiewe uitwerking wat die elektrisiteits- en logistieke beperkings steeds op die vervaardigings-, mynbou-, vervoer- en nutsdienste-sektore het.
tgt: Cabinet also noted the negative impact the electricity and logistics constraints continued to have on the manufacturing, mining, transport and utilities.

src: Die Kabinet vertrou dat merkbare voortuitgang met die uitwis van beide beurtkrag en beperkings in die vragvervoer en logistieke nywerhede binnekort merkbaar sal wees.
tgt: Cabinet is confident that noticeable progress will soon be visible in eradicating both load-shedding, and constraints within the freight and logistics industry.

src: Die Kabinet is ook tevrede dat jeugwerkloosheid, ondanks blywende uitdagings, geleidelik afneem (’n afname van 1.9% sedert die vorige kwartaal), en dat daar ’n toename van 237 000 jeugdiges is wat werk het, wat die totaal op ses miljoen te staan bring.
tgt: Cabinet is also pleased that despite remaining challenges, youth unemployment is gradually declining (a decrease of 1.9% from the previous quarter), and a 237 000 increase in the number of employed youth, rising to a total of six (6) million youth in employment.

src: Beleggings In dieselfde trajek van ’n herstellende en groeiende ekonomie, het die Kabinet die bykomende R5-miljardbelegging deur die Ford Motormaatskappy verwelkom vir ’n nuwe inprop hibride elektriese Ford Ranger, wat geoormerk is vir uitvoere na Europa, Nieu Seeland en Australië.
tgt: Investments In the same trajectory of a recovering and growing economy, Cabinet welcomed the additional R5-billion investment by the Ford Motor Company for its new plug-in hybrid electric Ford Ranger that is earmarked for export to Europe, New Zealand and Australia.

src: Die maatskappy neem tans 5 200 mense in Suid-Afrika in diens.
tgt: The company currently employs 5 200 people in South Africa.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom ook die belegging deur Procter & Gamble (P&G) in sy nuwe moderne produksielyn van Pampers Premium Care in Ekurhuleni, Gauteng.
tgt: Cabinet further welcomed the investment by Procter & Gamble (P&G) in its new state-of-the-art production line of the Pampers Premium Care in Ekurhuleni, Gauteng.

src: P&G se kumulatiewe belegging behels sedertdien ongeveer R900 miljoen sedert 2018 en bied tans 4 000 direkte en indirekte werksgeleenthede regdeur sy waardeketting.
tgt: The P&G cumulative investment since totals approximately R900 million since 2018 and currently employed over 4000 direct and indirect jobs throughout its value chain.

src: Die bekendstelling van beide die Ford Motormaatskappy en P&G se projekte, dui op die waardevolle bydrae van President Cyril Ramaphosa se beleggingsinisiatiewe deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Beleggingskonferensie en herbevestig Suid-Afrika as ’n voorkeur-beleggingsbestemming.
tgt: Both The Ford Motor Company and P&G project launches are testament of the valuable contribution of President Cyril Ramaphosa’s investment drive through the South Africa Investment Conference, and a reaffirmation of South Africa as an investment destination of choice.

src: 3 Toegang vir Suid-Afrika se rooivleis tot die Koningkryk van Saoedi-Arabië Die Kabinet het die ondertekening van die rooivleisooreenkoms met die Koningkryk van Saoedi-Arabië tydens die Saoedi-Afrika-belegginsberaad verwelkom.
tgt: South Africa’s red meat access to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Cabinet welcomed the signing of the red meat agreement with the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, during the Saudi-African Investment Summit.

src: Hierdie ooreenkoms is 'n kritieke stap wat verseker dat Suid-Afrikaanse rooivleisprodukte toegang tot 'n belangrike mark kry, en versterk die bydrae van die landbousektor verder in beide ekonomiese groei en werkskepping.
tgt: This agreement marks a critical step in ensuring that South African red meat products gain access to an important market, and further strengthens the contribution of the agricultural sector in both economic growth and job creation.

src: Die Kabinet het ministers Thoko Didiza en Ebrahim Patel geluk gewens met die werk wat gedoen is om die opening van hierdie mark vir Suid-Afrikaanse rooivleisprodukte te verseker.
tgt: Cabinet congratulated Ministers Thoko Didiza and Ebrahim Patel for the work done to ensure the opening of this market for South African red meat products.

src: Opsetlike verdraaiing van die vereistes vir landbou-uitvoere rakende Agri Swart Ekonomiese Bemagtiging (Agri-SEB) Die Kabinet veroordeel doelbewuste verdraaiings van die vereistes vir Agri-SEB landbou-uitvoere deur sommige afdelings van die media met die doel om rassespanning aan te wakker, en het die media daaraan herinner dat hul vryheid met verantwoordelikhede gepaard gaan.
tgt: Deliberate distortions of the Agri-Black Economic Empowerment (BEE) requirements for agricultural exports Cabinet condemned deliberate distortions by some sections of the media of the Agri-BEE requirements for agricultural exports to stoke racial tensions, and reminded the media that its freedom equally comes with responsibility.

src: Die Kabinet het sy waardering uitgespreek teenoor die landboubedryf, veral die SA Wyn- en Landbousakekamer, algemeen bekend as Agbiz, vir die verwerping van pogings om die land en die sektor in rassespanning te dompel deur die verdraaiings in die openbaar uit te klaar sodra dit gepubliseer is.
tgt: Cabinet expressed its appreciation to the agricultural industry, in particular the SA Wine and Agricultural Chamber of Business, commonly known as Agbiz, for rejecting attempts to plunge the country and the sector into racial tensions by publicly clarifying the distortions as soon as they were published.

src: Die bedryf se houding teenoor hierdie saak het getoon dat dit inderdaad die gees van “Stronger Together” wat deur die Springbokke uitgera is, gekoester het.
tgt: Your posture on this matter, demonstrated that indeed you have embraced the spirit canvassed by the Springboks of Stronger Together.

src: Toerisme Die Kabinet het kennis geneem van die vennootskap wat tussen die Departement van Toerisme en Google gesluit is as 'n spelwisselaar wat sal bydra tot die bevordering van Suid-Afrika as 'n uitstekende toerismebestemming.
tgt: Tourism Cabinet noted the partnership established between the Department of Tourism and Google as a game changer that will assist in promoting South Africa as a prime tourist destination.

src: Die vennootskap het onder meer ten doel om die gebruik van digitale hulpmiddels te fasiliteer om toerisme-ervarings en -volhoubaarheid te verbeter, insluitend die verbintenis dat Google Maps tegnologie sal gebruik om misdaadbrandpunte te vermy.
tgt: The partnership aims, amongst others, to facilitate the use of digital tools to enhance tourism experiences and sustainability, including the commitment that Google Maps will use technology to avoid crime hotspots.

src: Stryd teen teen misdaad en korrupsie Geïntegreerde stryd teen misdaaad Die Kabinet verwelkom die ontplooiing van 3 300 lede van die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Weermag (SANW), vanaf 28 Oktober 2023 tot 28 April 2024, om die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens (SAPD) en ander wetstoepassingsagentskappe te ondersteun in die hantering van onwettige mynbou in die land.
tgt: Fight against crime and corruption Integrated Crime Fighting Cabinet welcomed the deployment of 3 300 members of the South African National Defence Force (SANDF), from 28 October 2023 until 28 April 2024, to support the South African Police Service (SAPS) and other law-enforcement agencies to deal with illegal mining in the country.

src: Hierdie ontplooiing bevestig die regering se verbintenis om onwettige mynbou die hoof te bied en om toestande te skep vir inklusiewe groei en transformasie van die ekonomie.
tgt: This deployment affirms government’s commitment to put an end to illegal mining and create conditions for inclusive growth and transformation of the economy.

src: Die ministers van die groepering vir justisie, misdaadvoorkoming en sekuriteit het vordering gemaak met werk wat gedoen word om misdaad te bekamp, en die Minister van Polisie het verlede week die jongste kwartaallikse misdaadstatistieke bekend gemaak.
tgt: The Ministers of the Justice, Crime Prevention and Security Cluster have provided progress with work underway to fight against crime, and the Minister of Police last week provided an update on the quarterly crime statistics.

src: 7 Nasionale Teenkorrupsie Advesraad (NACAC) se nasionale dialoog Die Kabinet verwelkom die suksesvolle aanbieding van NACAC se nasionale dialoog, wat beraadslaag het oor vordering met die implementering van die Nasionale Teenkorrupsiestrategie en aanbevelings van die Geregtelike Kommissie van Ondersoek na Bewerings van Staatskaping.
tgt: National Anti-Corruption Advisory Council’s (NACAC) National Dialogue Cabinet welcomed the successful hosting of the NACAC’s National Dialogue, which deliberated on progress in implementing the National Anti-Corruption Strategy and recommendations of the Judicial Commission of Inquiry into Allegations of State Capture.

src: Die vordering sluit agt (8) uit 16 aanbevole stukke wetgewende hervormings in om spesifieke aanbevelings van die Staatskapingskommissie te bespreek wat nou voor die Parlement is.
tgt: The progress includes eight (8) out of 16 recommended pieces of legislative reforms to address specific recommendations of the State Capture Commission that are now before Parliament.

src: Hierdie wetsontwerpe is gerig op kwessies soos openbare verkryging, administratiewe hervorming, gedrag van staatsamptenare, hervorming van intelligensiedienste, geldwassery en verkiesingshervorming.
tgt: These Bills cover areas such as public procurement, administrative reform, conduct of public servants, reform of intelligence services, money laundering and electoral reform.

src: Bevriesingsbevele ter waarde van R14-miljard is aan die Batebeslagleggingseenheid toegestaan vir sake wat verband hou met staatskaping en R5,4-miljard van die winste wat onwettig verkry is, is verhaal.
tgt: The Asset Forfeiture Unit has been granted freezing orders worth R14 billion for state capture related cases and has recouped R.4 billion of the ill-gotten gains.

src: Daarbenewens het die Ondersoekdirektoraat 34 staatskaping- en korrupsiesake waarby 205 beskuldigdes betrokke is, hof toe geneem.
tgt: In addition, the Investigating Directorate has taken 34 state capture and corruption cases to court, involving 205 accused persons.

src: 8 Stryd teen geslagsgebaseerde geweld en vrouemoord Die Kabinet veroordeel ten sterkste die messteekaanval van 'n vroulike student van die Kaapse Skiereiland Universiteit van Tegnologie deur haar man.
tgt: Fight against gender-based violence and femicide Cabinet condemned in the strongest terms the stabbing of a female Cape Peninsula University of Technology student, by her husband.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op die samelewing om saam met die regering te werk om geslagsgebaseerde geweld uit te wis, terwyl wetstoepassingsagentskappe voortgaan om ootreders wat sulke laakbare misdade pleeg voor die gereg te bring.
tgt: Cabinet calls on society to work together with government to eliminate gender-based violence whilst law-enforcement agencies continue to bring perpetrators of such callous acts to justice.

src: 9 Sterfte van kinders weens wanvoeding Die Kabinet het met groot kommer kennis geneem van kinders wat weens wanvoeding gesterf het soos aangemeld deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Meseregtekommissie.
tgt: Death of children due to malnutrition Cabinet noted with concern the reported deaths of children due to malnutrition as reported by the South African Human Rights Commission.

src: Die Kabinet wil gemeenskappe graag herinner aan die regering se ondersteuningsprogramme soos kinderonderhoudstoelae, wat daarop gemik is om gesinne te help om in kinders se basiese behoeftes te voorsien.
tgt: Cabinet wishes to remind members of the community about government support programmes such as the Child Support Grant which is aimed at assisting families to meet the basic needs of children.

src: Dit is bykomend tot die omvattende Maatskaplike Bystandsprogram waardeur die regering gesonde maaltye aan kwesbare huishoudings verskaf deur die Nasionale Skoolvoedingsprogram en Gemeenskapsvoeding- en -ontwikkelingsentrums.
tgt: This is in addition to the comprehensive Social Assistance Programme through which government provides healthy meals to vulnerable households through the National School Nutrition Programme and Community Nutrition and development centres.

src: 10 Kieserregistrasie Die Kabinet het sy oproep aan alle stemgeregtigde burgers herhaal om tydens die kiesersregistrasienaweek van 18 tot 19 November 2023 by hul naaste stemlokaal te registreer om te kan stem dit sluit ook kiesers in wat hul besonderhede wil bywerk.
tgt: Voter Registration Cabinet reiterated its call to all eligible voters to register to vote at their nearest voting station, including to update their details during the Voter Registration Weekend of 18 to 19 November 2023.

src: Om kiesers te help om ID's waarvoor hulle aansoek gedoen het af te haal, of om vir tydelike identitetisdokumente aansoek te doen, het die Departement van Binnelandse Sake sy werksure met dié van die OVK tydens die kiesersregistrasienaweek in lyn gebring.
tgt: To assist voters who need to collect IDs they have applied for or to apply for Temporary Identification certificates, the Department of Home Affairs had aligned its operating hours with those of the IEC during the voter registration weekend.

src: Die Kabinet het burgers ook daaraan herinner dat hulle van die aanlynkiesersregistrasiefasiliteit gebruik kan maak by WEBTOKEN wat sedert Februarie 2023 beskikbaar is, om hul besonderhede te registreer of by te werk.
tgt: Cabinet has reminded Citizens can also use the online voter registration facility (WEBTOKEN) which has been operating since February 2023, to register or update their details.

src: 11 Energie Die Minister in die Presidensie wat vir Elektrisiteit verantwoordelik is, het 'n omvattende openbare inligtingsessie gehou oor die status en vordering met die versekering van elektrisiteitsekuriteit.
tgt: Infrastructure development Energy The Minister in The Presidency responsible for Electricity has provided a comprehensive public briefing on the status and progress with ensuring electricity security.

src: 12 Watersekerheid Die Kabinet is tevrede met berigte dat die dispute wat tot vertragings met die implementering van die Mzimvubu-damprojek gelei het, opgelos is en dat werk om die terrein voor te berei, vroeg in November begin het.
tgt: Water Security Cabinet is pleased with reports that the disputes that resulted in delays towards implementation of the Mzimvubu Dam project have been resolved and site establishment commenced in early November, whilst consultations with traditional leaders on social issues is underway.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig dat werk aan die opbou van die Clanwilliam-dam se muur om bergingskapasiteit tot 344 miljoen kubieke meter te verhoog, hervat is.
tgt: Cabinet was updated that the raising of the Clanwilliam Dam wall to increase storage capacity to 344 million cubic metres for the benefit of the people of the West Coast District Municipality, Cederberg Local Municipality and Matzikama Local Municipality is underway.

src: Dit is tot voordeel van die inwoners van die Weskus Distriksmunisipaliteit, die Cederberg Plaaslike Munisipaliteit en die Matzikama Plaaslike Munisipaliteit.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed that the construction of the Tzaneen Dam re- commenced in June 2023, with the estimated completion date of April 2025.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig dat die bou van die Tzaneen-dam in Junie 2023 hervat is, en dat dit na verwagting in April 2025 voltooi sal wees.
tgt: Cabinet was apprised that a joint team of the three metropolitan municipalities (Ekurhuleni, Joburg and Tshwane) and Rand Water continue to meet daily to address root causes of water challenges.

src: Die Kabinet is in kennis gestel dat 'n gesamentlike span van drie metropolitaanse munisipaliteite, naamlik Ekurhuleni, Joburg en Tshwane, asook Rand Water, steeds daagliks vergader om die hoofoorsake van die wateruitdagings die hoof te bied.
tgt: At the centre of Gauteng’s water challenges is water losses caused by old municipal infrastructure and deficiencies in water leakage monitoring and efficient repairs.

src: Die kern van Gauteng se wateruitdagings is waterverliese wat veroorsaak word deur verouderde munisipale infrastruktuur en tekortkominge in waterlekkasiemonitering, asook ondoeltreffende herstelwerk.
tgt: SA Connect Phase Two Cabinet received and considered an update report on the implementation of the SA Connect Phase 2 Project.

src: SA Connect is 'n vlagskipprogram van die regering wat poog om die digitale kloof te oorbrug deur huishoudings en regeringsinstellings te verbind en Wi-Fi-toegang aan gemeenskappe regoor die land te voorsien.
tgt: SA Connect is a flagship programme of government that seeks to bridge the digital divide by connecting households and government institutions and provide Wi-Fi access to communities across the country.

src: Oor vordering met Fase 2 van die projek, was die Kabinet verheug dat 1000 huishoudings met breëband gekoppel is en dat daar beplan word om 1000 gemeenskaps-Wi-Fi-brandpunte teen Desember 2023 te installeer.
tgt: On progress with Phase 2 of the project, Cabinet was pleased that 1 000 households were connected with broadband and that 1 000 community Wi-Fi hotspots are planned to be installed by December 2023.

src: Hierbenewens, het die projek ook infrastruktuur vir internetverbinding ontplooi wat huishoudings toelaat om toegang tot die internet te kry teen goedkoper tariewe.
tgt: In addition, the project has rolled out infrastructure for Internet connectivity that allows households to access the Internet at cheaper rates.

src: Vir R249 per maand het 'n huishouding wat inteken onbeperkte toegang tot robuuste internet, met laer datakoste so min as R5 vir een ‘gig’ per dag.
tgt: For R249 per month, a subscribing household has unlimited access to robust internet, with cheaper data costs as low as R5 for one gig per day.

src: Daar word voorsien dat die projek ook sal bydra tot ekonomiese deelname deur die verskaffing van 4 505 halfgeskoolde en 169 geskoolde werksgeleenthede, en sal meer as 75 klein- tot mediumgrootte maatskappye ondersteun.
tgt: It is estimated that the project will also contribute to economic participation through the provision of 4 505 semi-skilled and 169 skilled employment opportunities, and will support over 75 small to medium-sized companies.

src: Boonop sal hoë aanvraagspektrum oor die volgende maande aan meer as 18 000 skole, 943 biblioteke, 5 731 gesondheidsfasiliteite en 8 241 stamowerhede verskaf word deur die sosiale verpligtinge aan telekommunikasiemaatskappye.
tgt: In addition, high demand spectrum will be provided to more than 18 000 schools, 943 libraries, 5 731 health facilities and 8 241 tribal authorities over the next months through the social obligations to telecommunications companies.

src: Na verwagting sal die projek oor die volgende 36 maande konnektiwiteit aan meer as vyf miljoen huishoudings en 32 000 gemeenskaps-Wi-Fi-brandpunte regoor die land kan lewer.
tgt: It is anticipated that the project will deliver connectivity to more than five million households and 32 000 community Wi-Fi hotspots across the country over the next 36 months.

src: 14 Uitsaai digitale migrasie Die Kabinet het kennis geneem van die vordering wat gemaak word met die migrasie van analoog- na digitale uitsaaiwese.
tgt: Broadcasting Digital Migration Cabinet noted the progress the country is making with the migration from analogue to digital broadcasting.

src: Vanaf 23 Julie 2023 is al 123 analoogsenders bo 694 Meahertz in die oorblywende vier provinsies afgeskakel, naamlik die Oos-Kaap, KwaZulu-Natal, die Wes-Kaap en Gauteng.
tgt: As of 23 July 2023, all 123 analogue transmitters above 694 Megahertz were switched off in the remaining four provinces namely the Eastern Cape, KwaZulu-Natal, Western Cape and Gauteng.

src: Dit sal die spektrum wat nodig is vir mobiele breëband en ander behoeftes vir inligting- en kommunikasietegnologie, beskikbaar stel.
tgt: This will free up the spectrum needed for mobile broadband, and other information and communications technology-related needs.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig dat die Minister van Kommunikasie en Digitale Tegnologie Desember 2024 as die finale datum vir die afskakel van alle analoog-uitsaaidienste bepaal het, en dat vordering gemaak word om die vasgestelde teikendatum te haal.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed that the Minister of Communications and Digital Technologies had determined December 2024 as the final date for the switch-off of all analogue broadcasting services, and that progress is on to meet the set target date.

src: 15 Munisipale skoonmaak- en vergroeningsprogram Die Kabinet moedig Suid-Afrikaners aan om by die program aan te sluit om ons land skoon en vry van rommel te hou deur deel te neem aan die munisipale skoonmaak- en vergroeningsinisiatiewe wat regoor die land plaasvind.
tgt: Municipal Cleaning and Greening Programme Cabinet encourages South Africans to join the programme to keep our country clean and free from litter by participating in the municipal cleaning and greening initiatives taking place across the country.

src: Die program wat reeds meer as 37 000 werksgeleenthede geskep het, is daarop gemik om die 7 251 onwettige stortingspunte in gemeenskappe regoor die land op te ruim.
tgt: The programme which has already created more than 37 000 work opportunities is aimed at clearing the 7 251 illegal dumping hotspots in communities across the country.

src: Dit behels die daaglikse skoonmaak van strate, opruim van onwettige stortingsterreine, skoonmaak van kusgebiede en om parke te laat herleef.
tgt: This involves the daily cleaning of streets, clearing illegal dumping sites, cleaning coastal areas and the revitalisation of parks.

src: 16 Verbeterde nasionale en provinsiale oudituitkomste (2022/23 finansiële jaar) Die Kabinet is deur die Ouditeur-Generaal van Suid-Afrika (OGSA) ingelig oor die uitkomste van die nasionale en provinsiale oudits vir die 2022/23 finansiële jaar.
tgt: Capacity of the State Improved National and Provincial Audit Outcomes (2022/23 financial year) Cabinet was briefed by the Auditor-General of South Africa (AGSA) non the outcomes of the 2022/23 financial year national and provincial audits.

src: Die OGSA het die aanmoedigende tendens van voortgesette verbeterde prestasie uitgewys, wat dui op algehele verbetering in aanspreeklikheid, deursigtigheid, toereikendheid en doeltreffendheid van beheermaatreëls.
tgt: The AGSA pointed out to encouraging trend of continuous improved performance which indicates overall improvement in accountability, transparency, adequacy and effectiveness of controls.

src: Die departemente en instellings wat ongekwalifiseerde oudits met geen bevindings behaal het nie (skoon oudits) het van 94 in die 2018/2019 finansiële jaar tot 147 gedurende die 2022/2023 finansiële jaar toegeneem, wat 'n jaar-tot-jaar verbetering aandui.
tgt: The departments and institutions that have achieved unqualified audits with no findings (clean audits) have increased from 94 during the 2018/2019 to 147 during the 2022/2023, reporting a year-on-year improvement.

src: Altesaam 162 departemente en instansies het ongekwalifiseerde oudits met bevindings behaal.
tgt: The departments and institutions that have achieved unqualified audits with findings are 162, and this represents 39% of the audited institutions.

src: Die instellings en departemente met bevindings wat geweier is, het van 25 gedurende die 2018/2019-verslagtydperk tot vyf tydens die 2022/2023-verslagtydperk afgeneem en verteenwoordig slegs 1% van geouditeerde instellings.
tgt: The institutions and departments with Disclaimed findings have decreased from 25 during 2018/2019 reporting period to 5 during 2022/2023 reporting period and represent only 1% of audited institutions.

src: Hoewel die Ouditeur-Generaal ’n geraamde R14 miljard se finansiële verliese aangedui het, toon maatreëls wat wesenlike onreëlmatighede die hoof bied ook ’n verbetering.
tgt: Although the Auditor-General reports an estimated R14 billion in financial losses, measures to address material irregularities also show an improvement.

src: Hoewel daar steeds uitdagings is, word bewerings dat staatskapasiteit heeltemal ineenstort verwerp deur die uitkomste van die 2022/23 nasionale en provinsiale oudits, met onafhanklike en objektiewe assessering deur instellings soos die OGSA, wat 'n baie sterk en voortdurende verbeteringstrajek toon.
tgt: Although challenges still remain, the outcomes of the 2022/23 national and provincial governments audits dispel claims that State capacity is in total collapse, with independent and objective assessment by institutions such as the AGSA indicating a very strong and continuous improvement trajectory.

src: 17 Internasionale betrekkinge – Staatsbesoek aan Katar President Cyril Ramaphosa het verlede week 'n staatsbesoek aan Katar op uitnodiging van Sy Hoogheid Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, Amir van die Staat Katar, afgesluit.
tgt: International Relations – State Visit to Qatar Last week, President Cyril Ramaphosa concluded a State Visit to Qatar at the invitation of His Highness Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, Amir of the State of Qatar.

src: Die besoek het drie dekades van diplomatieke betrekkinge beklemtoon.
tgt: The visit underscored three decades of diplomatic relations.

src: Die President het by 'n hoëvlak sakeafvaardiging aangesluit en het met verskeie sektore van Katar se sakegemeenskap gesprek gevoer met die doel om handelsbetrekkinge te verbeter.
tgt: The President was joined by a high-level business delegation and engaged the Qatari business community in various sectors with the aim of improving trade relations.

src: President Ramaphosa en die Amir het ooreengekom om werkspanne saam te stel wat ondersoek sal instel na die verhoging van Katar se belegging in Suid-Afrika om by die vlak van die diplomatieke betrekkinge te pas.
tgt: President Ramaphosa and the Amir agreed to set up working teams that will look into increasing Qatar’s investment into South Africa to match the depth of the diplomatic relations.

src: 18 Geopolitieke aangeleenthede Die Kabinet herhaal die oproep wat deur Afrika-leiers gemaak is vir 'n einde aan die oorlog in Gaza, tydens die Afrika-Saoedi-beraad in Riyadh, wat deur kroonprins Mohammed Bin Salman aangebied is.
tgt: Geopolitical matters Cabinet reiterates the call made by African leaders for an end to the war in Gaza, during the African-Saudi Summit in Riyadh hosted by Crown Prince Mohammed Bin Salman.

src: Die beraad het die teiken van burgerlikes en die oortredings van internasionale reg deur Israeliese regering veroordeel.
tgt: The summit condemned the targeting of civilians and the violations of international law by the Israeli Government.

src: Die Kabinet is steeds bekommerd oor die gruweldade van die Israeliese regering teen die mense van Palestina, insluitend die doelbewuste aanvalle op die Verenigde Nasies (VN) Skool in Gaza en die slagting van honderde kinders wat by die skool skuiling gesoek het, benewens die voortgesette aanvalle op hospitaalpersoneel, pasiënte en hospitaalinfrastruktuur.
tgt: Cabinet continues to be concerned by the atrocities of the Israeli Government against the people of Palestine, including the deliberate attacks on the United Nations (UN) School in Gaza and the massacre of hundreds of children who had sought refuge at the school, in addition to the continued attacks on hospital staff, patients and hospital infrastructure.

src: Dit is as gevolg van hierdie voortgesette gruweldade wat straffeloos deur die Israeliese regering met die ondersteuning en beskerming van magtige lande gepleeg word, dat Suid-Afrika op 17 November 2023 – saam met die Comore, Djiboeti, Bolivië en Bangladesj – die situasie in Palestina en Israel gesamentlik na die Internasionale Strafhof (ICC) verwys het.
tgt: It is because of these continued atrocities that are being committed with impunity by the Israeli Government with the support and protection of powerful countries, that on 17 November 2023, South Africa – together with the Comoros, Djibouti, Bolivia and Bangladesh – jointly referred the situation in Palestine and Israel to the International Criminal Court (ICC).

src: Hoewel die Palestynse Owerheid wel die IKR gevra het om die misdade onder die hof se jurisdiksie in 2018 te ondersoek, glo Suid-Afrika die huidige gruweldade, veral in Gaza, verg hernude aandag met die volle steun van staatsowerhede.
tgt: While the Palestinian Authority did ask the ICC to investigate crimes under the court’s jurisdiction in 2018, South Africa believes the current atrocities, particularly in Gaza, need renewed attention with the full backing of state parties.

src: Ons ambassadeur in Den Haag het die verwysing persoonlik gelewer dit het die IKR versoek om die pleeg van oorlogsmisdade, misdade teen die mensdom en volksmoord te ondersoek met die doel om diegene wat daarvoor verantwoordelik is aanspreeklik te hou.
tgt: Our ambassador in the Hague delivered the referral in person, which asked the ICC to investigate the commission of war crimes, crimes against humanity and genocide with a view to holding those most responsible accountable.

src: Gegewe dat ‘n groot deel van die wêreldgemeenskap die pleeg van hierdie misdade intyds aanskou, insluitend verklarings van volksmoordvoorneme deur verskeie Israeliese leiers, verwag ons dat lasbriewe vir die inhegtenisneming vir hierdie leiers, insluitend Eerste Minister Netanyahu, binnekort uitgereik sal word.
tgt: Given that much of the global community is witnessing the commission of these crimes in real time, including statements of genocidal intent by many Israeli leaders, we expect that warrants of arrests for these leaders, including Prime Minister Netanyahu, will be issued shortly.

src: Die ICC kon die situasie in Palestina sedert 2021 ondersoek toe die kwessie van territoriale jurisdiksie afgehandel is.
tgt: The ICC has been able to investigate the situation in Palestine since 2021 when the issue of territorial jurisdiction was settled.

src: Ons het egter opgemerk dat die Kantoor van die Aanklaer aangehou het om sy voete te sleep ondanks die erns van die situasie.
tgt: However, we have noted that the Office of the Prosecutor has continued to drag its feet despite the gravity of the situation.

src: Die huidige gruweldade sou dalk nie gepleeg gewees het as hierdie ondersoeke plaasgevind het sodra die Palestynse owerhede die eerste keer sy verwysing gemaak het nie.
tgt: The current atrocities may not have occurred if these investigations took place as soon as the Palestinian authorities first made its referral.

src: Ons verwag nou dat ander state ook 'n einde aan Israel se straffeloosheid versoek het en daar is beduidende bewyse dat internasionale lasbriewe vir inhegtenisneming uitgereik sal word wanneer die Konferensie van Partye in die middel van Desember in New York vergader.
tgt: We expect now that other state parties have also added their voices for an end to the impunity by Israel, and the significant levels of evidence available, that international warrants of arrest will be issued by the time the Conference of Parties meet in mid-December in New York.

src: Versuim om dit te doen, sal 'n aanduiding wees dat die IKR nie die wil het om op te tree nie, dat dit 'n duidelik teken is dat die globale stelsel van goeie regering ’n totale mislukking is en daar ‘n behoefte is om 'n nuwe stelsel te vestig.
tgt: Failure to do so will be indicative of a lack of will to act by the ICC and a strong signal to the total failure of the global system of good governance and the need to establish a new system.

src: Mer kinders is die afgelope maand vermoor as dié wat per jaar in alle konflikte saam vir die afgelope drie jaar vermoor is.
tgt: More children have been killed over the last month than those killed per annum in all conflicts combined for the last three years.

src: Mer VN-personeellede is sedert die stigting van die Verenigde Nasies in Gaza vermoor.
tgt: More UN staff members have been killed in Gaza since the founding of the United Nations.

src: Die aantal joernaliste wat vermoor is, is verbysterend.
tgt: The numbers of journalists killed have been staggering.

src: Dit is almal mense wat gesterf het deur die optrede van die Israeliese regering, nie die land te verdedig nie, maar, blyk uit die verklarings van sy leiers om die grootste deel van Gaza van Palestyne skoon te maak en dit te beset.
tgt: These are all people killed by the actions of the Israeli Government, not to defend itself, but, evinced by the statements of its leaders to clear most of Gaza of Palestinians and to occupy it.

src: Die wêreld kan nie net terugstaan en toekyk nie, die globale gemeenskap moet opstaan om hierdie volksmoord nou te stuit.
tgt: The world cannot simply stand by and watch, the global community need to rise to stop this genocide now.

src: Kabinetsbesluite – insluitend dié van die Spesiale Kabinet op 9 November 2023 African Peer Review Mehanism (APRM) 20ste bestaansjaarviering Die Kabinet het die versoek dat Suid-Afrika die 20ste bestaansjaarvieringe van die APRM van 23 tot 30 November 2023 aanbied oorweeg en ondersteun.
tgt: CABINET DECISIONS – including those of Special Cabinet, 9 November African Peer Review Mechanism (APRM) 20th Anniversary celebrations Cabinet considered and supported the request for South Africa to host the 20th Anniversary celebrations of the APRM from 23 to 30 November 2023.

src: Suid-Afrika ondersteun die APRM se missie om die Afrika-unie (AU) se gedeelde waardes van demokratiese regering en inklusiewe ontwikkeling op die vasteland te bevorder.
tgt: South Africa supports the APRM mission to promote the African Union’s (AU) shared values of democratic governance and inclusive development on the continent.

src: Die 20ste bestaansjaarviering sal die deelname van huidige en voormalige staats- en regeringshoofde en die AU-kommissie insluit.
tgt: The 20th Anniversary celebrations will include the participation of current and former heads of state and government and the AU Commission.

src: Aanwending van fondse uit die Kriminele Bates Herwinningsrekening (CARA) Die Kabinet het goedgekeur dat fondse in die CARA-rekening gebruik word om onwettige mynbou en ander misdade te beveg.
tgt: Utilisation of funds from the Criminal Assets Recovery Account (CARA) Cabinet approved the use of monies in the CARA to fight against illegal mining and other crimes.

src: Die R2 172 359 word bewillig om onwettige mynbou te beveg, wat steeds 'n bedreiging vir die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie is.
tgt: The R2 172 359 000 is allocated to fight illicit mining, which continues to be a threat to the South African economy.

src: Die geld word aan die SAPD, SANW, die Departement van Binnelandse Sake en die Grensbestuursagentskap toegeken.
tgt: The money is allocated to the SAPS, SANDF, Department of Home Affairs and Border Management Agency.

src: Die SAPD sal die befondsing gebruik om voertuie, helikopters en Njalas te koop en om vir 18 maande meer as 4 000 beamptes te ontplooi.
tgt: The SAPS will use the funding to buy vehicles, helicopters, Nyalas and will deploy more 4 000 officers for 18 months.

src: Onwettige mynbou en ander georganiseerde misdade kos Suid-Afrika elke jaar miljarde rande en dit beïnvloed ons posisie as 'n beleggingsbestemming.
tgt: Illegal mining and other organised crimes cost South Africa billions of rands each year and it affects our position as an investment destination.

src: Die Just Energy Transition Implementation Plan (JET-IP) Die Kabinet het die JET-IP goedgekeur, wat Suid-Afrika se oorgang na laekoolstofekonomie sal lei deur hernubare energiebronne op te skaal.
tgt: The Just Energy Transition Implementation Plan (JET-IP) Cabinet approved the JET-IP, which will guide South Africa’s transition to low carbon economy through the scaling up of renewable energy sources.

src: Die JET-IP bied ‘n uiteensetting van verskeie ingrypings wat Suid-Afrika benodig, asook beleggings wat nodig is vir die oorskakeling na 'n laekoolstof- en klimaatbestande ekonomie in ooreenstemming met die Nasionale Bepaalde Bydraes wat aan die VN voorgelê is.
tgt: The JET-IP sets out a number of interventions South Africa needs and investments required for the country to transition to a low carbon and climate resilient economy in line with the National Determined Contributions presented to the UCabinet is of the view that the JET-IP demonstrates South Africa’s commitment to a just transition in line with the country’s energy needs.

src: Die Kabinet is van mening dat die JET-IP Suid-Afrika se verbintenis tot ’n regverdige oorgang in lyn met die land se energiebehoeftes bevestig.
tgt: The JET-IP will be driven by a combination of reforms in the energy sector, including the Mpumalanga Just Transition, New Energy Vehicles and Green Hydrogen, among others.

src: Die plan is verder ‘n reaksie op Suid-Afrika se verpligtinge ingevolge die Parys-ooreenkoms en die VN-raamwerkkonvensie oor Klimaatsverandering, sowel as die verpligtinge van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan (NOP).
tgt: The plan further responds to South Africa’s commitments under the Paris Agreement and UN Framework Convention on Climate Change as well as the National Development Plan (NDP) commitments.

src: Die JET-IP sal Suid-Afrika in staat stel om geleidelik sy verpligtinge om koolstofvrystellings te verminder na te kom, terwyl dit terselfdertyd inklusiewe ekonomiese groei, energiesekerheid en indiensneming sal verseker.
tgt: The JET-IP will enable South Africa to gradually meet its carbon emissions reduction commitments while at the same time, it will ensure inclusive economic growth, energy security and employment.

src: Konsep Nasionale Openbare Vervoersubisidiebeleid Die Kabinet het die publikasie van die konsep Nasionale Openbare Vervoersubsidiebeleid vir openbare kommentaar goedgekeur.
tgt: Draft National Public Transport Subsidy Policy Cabinet approved the gazetting of the draft National Public Transport Subsidy Policy for public comments.

src: Die beleid stel voor dat Suid-Afrika se openbare vervoerfinansiering verskuif moet word van die subsidiëring van 'n bepaalde vervoermiddel na 'n gebruikersubsidiemodel.
tgt: The policy proposes that South Africa’s public transport funding should move from subsidising a particular mode of transport to a user-subsidy model.

src: Die regering erken dat die vervoersektor in die kern van die land se ontwikkeling is, met die meerderheid huishoudings wat heeltemal afhanklik is van openbare vervoer vir mobiliteit.
tgt: Government recognises that the transport sector is at the heart of the country’s development, with most households completely reliant on public transport for mobility.

src: Tweejaarlikse Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk (MTSR) 2019-2024 prestasievorderingsverslae Die Kabinet ontvang en oorweeg die MTSR se tweejaarlikse vorderingsverslae vir die tydperk 1 April 2023 tot 30 September 2023.
tgt: Biannual Medium Term Strategic Framework (MTSF) 2019-2024 performance progress reports Cabinet received and considered the MTSF biannual progress reports for the period 1 April 2023 to 30 September 2023.

src: Die verslae vorm deel van die gekonsolideerde regeringsprioriteite vir die bereiking van die NOP-doelwitte.
tgt: The reports form part of the consolidated government priorities towards the achievement of the NDP goals.

src: Die verslae het op die regering se sewe prioriteite, wat deur die sesde administrasie geïdentifiseer is, gefokus, naamlik: Prioriteit een: Die bou van 'n bekwame, etiese ontwikkelingstaat
tgt: The reports focused on the seven priorities of government that were identified by the sixth administration namely: Priority One: Building a capable, ethical and developmental state

src: Prioriteit twee: Onderwysvaardighede en gesondheid
tgt: Priority Two: Education skills and health Priority Three: Consolidating the social wage through reliable and quality basic service
