src: Prioriteit drie: Konsolidering van die maatskaplike loon deur betroubare en gehalte basiese diens
tgt: Priority Four: Spatial integration, human settlements and local government

src: Prioriteit vyf: Sosiale samehorigheid
tgt: Priority Five: Social Cohesion

src: Prioriteit ses: Ekonomiese transformasie en werkskepping
tgt: Priority Six: Economic transformation and job creation Priority Seven: A better Africa and a better world.

src: Die Minister in die Presidensie verantwoordelik vir Beplanning, Monitering en Evaluering sal gedetailleerde inligtingsessies met die groeperings oor die Program van Aksie lei.
tgt: The Minister in The Presidency responsible for Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation will lead detailed briefings with the clusters on the Programme of Action.

src: Wetsontwerpe Wetsontwerp op die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Petroleummaatskappy (SANPC) Die Kabinet het die publikasie van die SANPC-wetsontwerp vir openbare kommentaar goedgekeur.
tgt: BILLS South African National Petroleum Company (SANPC) Bill Cabinet approved the publication of the SANPC Bill for public comments.

src: Die wetsontwerp gee uitvoering aan die Kabinet se besluit om PetroSA, die Suid-Afrikaanse Gasontwikkelingsmaatskappy (iGas) en die Strategiese Brandstoffonds saam te smelt.
tgt: The Bill gives effect to the Cabinet decision to merge PetroSA, South African Gas Development Company (iGas) and the Strategic Fuel Fund.

src: Die wetsontwerp maak voorsiening vir die stigting van 'n maatskappy in staatsbesit wat sal verseker dat Suid-Afrika sinvol aan olie- en gasontwikkeling deelneem.
tgt: The Bill makes provisions for the establishment of a state-owned company that will ensure South Africa participates meaningfully in oil and gas development.

src: Dit sal ook die land se sekuriteit van energievoorsiening waarborg om ekonomiese ontwikkeling en groei te ondersteun.
tgt: It will also guarantee the country’s security of energy supply to support economic development and growth.

src: Die SANPC sal toesig hou oor strategiese beplanning, koördinering en bestuur van die land se petroleumbronne, en dit sal bydra tot ontwikkeling en werkskepping.
tgt: The SANPC will oversee strategic planning, coordination and governance of the country’s petroleum resources, and this will contribute to development and job creation.

src: Alle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verfikasie van kwalifikasies en die toepaslike uitklaring.
tgt: Appointments All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant clearance.

src: Heraanstelling van Dr Molefi Motukuas Hoof Uitvoerende Beampte (HUB) van die Raad vir Mineraaltegnologie (MINTEK) Aanstelling van MnrSiyabulela Koyo as HUB van Amatola Water Heraanstelling van MePoppy Khoza as Besturende Direkteur van die Suid-Afrikaanse Burgerlugvaartowerheid (hernuwing van dienskontrak) Lede van die Phongolo–Umzimkhulu-opvanggebied se Bestuursagentskapsraad.

src: Komende gebeure 16 Dae van Aktivisme vir Geen Geweld teen Vroue en Kinders (25 November tot 10 Desember) Dit is vanjaar die 25ste herdenking van Suid-Afrika se veldtog vir 16 Dae van Aktivisme vir Geen Geweld teen Vroue en Kinders.
tgt: Upcoming events 16 Days of Activism for No Violence against Women and Children (25 November to 10 December) This year marks the 25th Anniversary since South Africa initiated the 16 Days of Activism for No Violence against Women and Children campaign.

src: Die bekendstelling sal in Mpumalanga by die Nsikazi-stadion in Mbombela gehou word onder die tema: “Versnelling van aksies om geslagsgebaseerde geweld en vrouemoord te beëindig: laat niemand agter nie”.
tgt: The launch will be held in Mpumalanga at the Nsikazi Stadium, City of Mbombela under the theme: “Accelerating actions to end gender-based violence & femicide: leaving no one behind”.

src: Die sub-tema: “Veilige toegang vir vroue tot skoon water: ’n basiese mensereg”, dui op struikelblokke wat vroue ervaar met veilige toegang tot water en sanitasie.
tgt: The sub-theme: “Safe access for women to clean water: a basic human right, addresses barriers women face in safely accessing water and sanitation.

src: Suid-Afrika en die Unie van die Comore is op 27 en 28 November 2023 mede-gashere vir die 3de AU-Konferensie oor Positiewe Manlikheid in Leierskap om Geweld teen Vroue en Mesies te beëindig, onder die tema: “Konsolideer ondernemings teenoor die Afrika-Unie se Konvensie om Geweld teen vroue en meisies te beëindig.”
tgt: South Africa and the Union of Comoros will co-host the 3rd AU Men’s Conference on Positive Masculinity in Leadership to End Violence against Women and Girls on 27 and 28 November 2023 in Pretoria under the theme: “Consolidating Commitments Towards the African Union Convention on Ending Violence Against Women and Girls.”

src: Boodskappe Gelukwense
tgt: Messages Congratulations

src: Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense en goeie wense oor aan: ProfDire Tladi, voorheen van die Universiteit van Pretoria, met sy verkiesing deur die VN as regter van die Internasionale Hof van Justisie.
tgt: Cabinet extended its congratulations and well-wishes to: ProfDire Tladi, formerly of the University of Pretoria, on his election by the UN as a judge of the International Court of Justice.

src: ProfTladi is 'n hoogs gerespekteerde akademikus, 'n bekwame diplomaat en die eerste Suid-Afrikaner ooit wat in sy 78-jaargeskiedenis tot die Hof verkies is, die tweede regter van die Suider-Afrikastreek en die tweede jongste regter ooit wat tot die hof gekies is.
tgt: ProfTladi is a highly respected scholar, a skilled diplomat and is the first South African ever to be elected to the Court in its 78 year history, the second judge from the Southern African region and the second youngest judge ever to be selected to the court.

src: Die Ouditeur-Generaal van Suid-Afrika (OGSA) vir sy aanstelling as eksterne ouditeur van die VN se Opvoedkundige, Wetenskaplike en Kulturele Organisasie.
tgt: The AGSA for being appointed the external auditor of the UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization .

src: Dit is 'n herbevestiging van die bogemiddelde internasionale aansien van Suid-Afrika se instellings.
tgt: This is a reaffirmation of the above-average international standing of South Africa’s institutions.

src: Die OGSA was voorheen, meer as 10 jaar gelede, 'n eksterne ouditeur van die VMamelodi Sundowns dat hulle die vlag hoog laat wapper en geskiedenis gemaak het deur die eerste Afrika-voetballiga te wen.
tgt: Previously, the AGSA was an external auditor of the UN, more than 10 years ago.

src: Mamelodi Sundowns Vroue dat hulle die kampioene van die CAF-kampioenskapsliga vir vroue geword het deur Sporting Club Casablanca te klop.
tgt: Mamelodi Sundowns for flying the flag high and making history by winning the Inaugural African Football League.

src: Die Proteas vir hul veerkragtigheid en veggees ondanks hul nederlaag teen Australië in die Krieket Wêreldbeker-halfeindronde, en wens Australië geluk met hulle oorwinning in die IKR 2023 Wêreldbeker.
tgt: The Proteas for demonstrating resilience and fighting spirit in their defeat against Australia in the Cricket World Cup semi-finals and congratulate Australia for winning the ICC 2023 World Cup.

src: Legendariese akteur en dramaturg Dr John Kani, wat as 'n ere-offisier van die Uitnemendste Orde van die Britse Ryk (OBE) bekroon is ter erkenning vir sy dienste aan drama.
tgt: Legendary actor and playwright Dr John Kani, who has been awarded an honorary Officer of the Most Excellent Order of the British Empire (OBE) in recognition for his services to drama.

src: 'n OBE is 'n Britse riddersorde wat erkenning gee aan mense wat 'n groot impak in hul werksveld gemaak het.
tgt: An OBE is a British chivalric order which recognises one for making great impact in their line of work.

src: Die Minister van Hoër Onderwys, Wetenskap en Innovasie, dr Blade Nzimande, aan wie 'n ereprofessoraat deur die Beijing Jiaotong Universiteit in China toegeken is.
tgt: Minister of Higher Education, Science and Innovation, Dr Blade Nzimande, who has been awarded an honorary professorship by the Beijing Jiaotong University in China.

src: Dit is ter erkenning van sy bydraes tot onderwys, en simboliseer die versterking van bande tussen Suid-Afrika en China.
tgt: This is in recognition of his contributions to education, and is a symbol of strengthening ties between South Africa and China.

src: Dr Kogie Naidoo, wat met die gesogte prys vir Uitstaande Vroulike Wetenskaplikes bekroon is deur die Europese en Ontwikkelende Lande Kliniese Proewe Vennootskap – 'n navorsingsprogram van die Europese Unie.
tgt: Dr Kogie Naidoo, who was awarded the prestigious Outstanding Female Scientist Prize presented by the European and Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership - a research programme of the European Union.

src: Suid-Afrika se InvestSA, 'n tak van die Departement van Handel, Nywerheid en Meedinging (die dtic) wat 'n VN-toekenning vir beleggingsbevordering by die 8ste Wêreldbeleggingsforum ontvang het het vir die bevordering en fasilitering van 'n groot energieprojek.
tgt: South Africa’s InvestSA, a branch of the Department of Trade, Industry and Competition (the dtic) that won a UN Investment Promotion Award at the 8th World Investment Forum, for promoting and facilitating a large energy project that includes foreign investment for the construction of the country's largest renewable energy project, expected to provide clean energy to 200 000 households.

src: Die projek sluit buitelandse beleggings in vir die bou van die land se grootste hernubare energieprojek, wat na verwagting skoon energie aan 200 000 huishoudings sal verskaf.
tgt: South Africa was ranked in first place in the GBS World Competitiveness Index, for its support for call centres in the category of ‘Global Customer Lifecycle Management’ and ranked second in the Global Customer Service and Support Services category.

src: Suid-Afrika wat die eerste plek behaal het op die rangorde van die GBS Wêreld Kompeterendheidsindeks, vir sy ondersteuning van oproepsentrums in die kategorie Global Customer Lifecycle Management en tweede plek in die kategorie Global Customer Service and Support Services.
tgt: Condolences Cabinet expressed condolences to the family and friends of: South African music icon Marc Rantseli, who was part of the musical duo Marc Alex which he co-founded with his brother Alex Rantseli.

src: Meelye Die Kabinet dra sy medelye oor aan die naasbestaandes en vriende van: Suid-Afrikaanse musiek-ikoon Marc Rantseli, wat deel was van die musikale duo Marc Alex, wat hy saam met sy broer Alex Rantseli gestig het.
tgt: Legendary former sports journalist and news editor Sello Rabothata.

src: Kwessies uit die omgewing Ekonomie Nasional Begrotingstoespraak Die Kabinet het die 2024 Nasionale Begroting verwelkom, wat die regering se vasberade verbintenis om die land se ekonomie konsekwent te bestuur en moeilike besluite te neem wat nodig is om die tekort te balanseer terwyl ekonomiese groei bevorder word, weerpieël.
tgt: .1 Cabinet welcomed the 2024 National Budget, which demonstrated the resolute commitment by government to consistently manage the country’s economy and take tough decisions necessary to balance the deficit while promoting economic growth.

src: Die Nasionale Begroting bevorder steeds kritieke prioriteite en ondersteuning vir ons nasie se kwesbaarste mense.
tgt: .2 The National Budget continues to drive critical priorities and support for the most vulnerable of our nation.

src: Dit verskaf maatskaplike bystand om die lewensomstandighede van arm, kwesbare en minderbevoorregte Suid-Afrikaners te verbeter.
tgt: It provides social assistance to improve the living conditions of poor, vulnerable and underprivileged South Africans.

src: Dit sluit werklose Suid-Afrikaners in, asook wees- en kwesbare kinders wat in omstandige woon waar kinders aan die hoof van die huishouding is.
tgt: These include unemployed South Africans, and orphaned and vulnerable children living in child- headed households.

src: Die konsolidasie en tertafellegging van die 2024 Nasionale Begroting is 'n belangrike deel van Suid-Afrika se oop en verantwoordbare stelsel van demokrasie.
tgt: .3 The consolidation and tabling of the 2024 National Budget is an important part of South Africa’s open and accountable system of democracy.

src: Die Kabinet is vol vertroue dat die Nasionale Begrotingstoekennings na ekonomiese winste sal lei, wat ons ekonomiese status sal herbou.
tgt: Cabinet is confident that the National Budget allocations will translate into economic gains that rebuild our economic standing.

src: Openbare-Private Vennootskap Die Kabinet verwelkom die eerste in sy soort openbare-private vernootskapooreenkoms tussen Sasol en Transnet Freight Rail, wat daarop gemik is om die betroubaarheid van spoorvervoer te verbeter.
tgt: .1 Cabinet welcomed the first-of-its-kind public-private partnership agreement between Sasol and Transnet Freight Rail to improve the reliability of rail transport.

src: Kragtens 'n vyfjaar-ooreenkoms sal Transnet Freight Rail sy vloot van 128 ammoniaktenkwaens gebruik om ammoniak van Sasol-fasiliteite aan kliënte te lewer en in ruil daarvoor sal Sasol die instandhouding- en herstelprogram van die vloot finansier.
tgt: .2 Under a five-year agreement, Transnet Freight Rail will use its fleet of 128 ammonia tankers to deliver ammonia from Sasol facilities to customer and in return Sasol will fund the maintenance and repair programme of the fleet.

src: Die vennootskap bevorder werk aan die land se Vraglogistieke Padkaart om die sektor volkome te hernu.
tgt: .3 The partnership advances work on the country’s Freight Logistics Roadmap to turn around the sector.

src: Hierdie vennootskap is ’n aanduiding dat ons saam ons dringendste uitdagings kan oorkom.
tgt: This partnership demonstrates how together we can overcome our pressing challenges.

src: Kwarttaalikse Arbeidsmagopname (QLFS) Statistiek Suid-Afrika se onlangse QLFS, wat 'n effense styging in die land se werkloosheidsyfer in die vierde kwartaal van 2023 getoon het van 31,9% in die derde kwartaal tot 32,1%, motiveer die regering om sy pogings om meer mense na werksgeleenthede te lok, te verdubbel.
tgt: .1 Statistics South Africa’s recent QLFS that showed a slight rise in the country’s unemployment rate in the fourth quarter of 2023 to 32.1% from 31.9% in the third quarter, motivates us as government to redouble our efforts to draw more people into work opportunities.

src: Hoewel ons ekonomie steeds werk skep, is dit nie op die vlak waarna die regering mik om die uitdaging van werkloosheid die hoof te bied nie.
tgt: .2 While our economy continues to create jobs, it is not at the level that government aims to achieve in order to address the challenge of unemployment.

src: Die QLFS het getoon dat indiensneming in die informele sektor met 124 000 toegeneem het, in finansies met 128 000 poste, vervoer met 57 000, mynbou met 37 000 poste en private huishoudings met 18 000 poste.
tgt: The QLFS showed that the informal sector employment increased by 124 000, finance by 128 000 jobs,

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle sektore om die Ekonomiese Heropbou- en Herstelplan te ondersteun, wat help om werk- en bestaansgeleenthede aan miljoene Suid-Afrikaners te voorsien.
tgt: .3 Cabinet called on all sectors to support the Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan, which is helping to provide work and livelihood opportunities to millions of South Africans.

src: 20ste Herdenking van die Uitgebreide Openbare Werke Program (EPWP) Die jaar 2024 is die herdenking van die EPWP se 20ste bestaansjaar.
tgt: 20th Anniversary of Expanded Public Works Programme (EPWP)

src: Die program verteenwoordig een van Suid-Afrika se suksesverhale van massa openbare indiensnemingprogramme en is verreweg een van die grootste armoedeverligtingsinisiatiewe.
tgt: .1 The year 2024 marks 20 years of the existence of the EPWP, which represents one of South Africa’s success stories of mass public employment programmes and is by far one of the largest poverty alleviation initiatives.

src: Die Kabinet is inligelig oor die implementering en prestasies van die EPWP, 'n vlagskip-regeringsprogram wat sedert sy ontstaan miljoene werksgeleenthede aan werklose Suid-Afrikaners gebied het.
tgt: .2 Cabinet received a briefing on the implementation and achievements of the EPWP, a flagship government programme that has provided millions of work opportunities to unemployed South Africans since its inception.

src: Die EPWP het oor die afgelope 20 jaar meer as 14 miljoen werksgeleenthede geskep, wat dit die grootste deurlopende openbare indiensnemingsprogram ter wêreld maak.
tgt: .3 The EPWP has over the past 20 years created over 14 million work opportunities, making it the largest continuous public employment programme in the world.

src: Hierdie mylpaal is bereik deur voortdurende vennootskappe met die private sektor en die burgerlike samelewing.
tgt: This milestone was achieved through continuous partnerships with the private sector and civil society.

src: Dié werksgeleenthede het bygedra tot vaardigheidsontwikkeling vir die deelnemers aangesien dit geskep is vir 'n reeks EPWP-projekte in toerisme-, landbou-, infrastruktuur-, en maatskaplike projekte, asook projekte wat deur vroue gelei is.
tgt: These work opportunities have contributed to skills development for the participants as they were created under a range of EPWP projects in the tourism, agriculture, infrastructure, social projects and projects led by women.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig dat 4 609 000 werksgeleenthede geskep is gedurende Fase 4-mediumtermyn van die EPWP, wat die tydperk 2019/2020 tot 2022/23 dek.
tgt: .4 Cabinet was informed that 4 609 000 work opportunities were created during Phase 4 medium term of the EPWP, which covers the period 2019/2020 – 2022/23.

src: Hierdie geal verteenwoordig 'n 92%-prestasie teenoor die teiken wat deur die Sesde Administrasie gestel is om vyf miljoen werksgeleenthede te skep.
tgt: This figure represents a 92% achievement against the target set by the Sixth Administration to create five million work opportunities.

src: Planne is in plek om die oorblywende 390 973 werksgeleenthede teen Maart 2024 te skep.
tgt: Plans are in place to achieve the remaining 390 973 work opportunities by March 2024.

src: Die drie provinsies wat die meeste werksgeleenthede uit die total van 4 609 000 geskep het, is KwaZulu-Natal, wat verantwoordelik is vir 1 064 000 werksgeleenthede (23%), gevolg deur die Oos-Kaap met 903 789 (20%) en die Wes-Kaap met 508 954 (11%).
tgt: .5 Of the 4 609 000 work opportunities, the top three provinces where most work opportunities have been created are KwaZulu-Natal, which accounts for 1 064 000 opportunities (23%), followed by the

src: Hoewel die meeste van hierdie geleenthede oor die korttermyn tot mediumtermyn stek, het sommige tot permanente indiensneming gelei.
tgt: .6 Although most of these opportunities are short term to medium term, some have resulted in permanent employment.

src: Syfers dui ook daarop dat meer as 20% van die deelnemers werk gekry het buite die UOWTalle vorige EPWP-deelnemers het diplomas in loopbaanrigtings soos professionele kookkuns suksesvol voltooi en sommige is permanent in die gasvryheidsbedryf aangestel.
tgt: Figures also indicate that more than 20% of participants obtained employment outside the EPW.7 Many past EPWP participants have successfully completed diplomas in fields such as professional cookery and some are permanently employed in the hospitality industry.

src: Benewens werksgeleenthede, dra die EPWP ook baie meer by in terme van dienslewering en verbetering van geriewe in gemeenskappe en 'n beter lewenskwaliteit.
tgt: In addition to work opportunities, the EPWP also contributes much more in terms of service delivery, and improvements of amenities in communities and a better quality of life.

src: Mer as R52 miljard is aan EPWP-deelnemers oorgedra as lone vir werk wat in Fase IV gedoen is.
tgt: .8 Over R52 billion has been transferred to the EPWP participants as wages for work done in Phase I.9 In addition, over 600 businesses were established through the programme.

src: Regeringsake Algemene verkiesing 2024 Die Kabinet het president Cyril Ramaphosa se aankondiging dat Woensdag 29 Me 2024 die datum vir die Algemene Verkiesing is, verwelkom.
tgt: .1 Cabinet welcomed President Cyril Ramaphosa’s proclamation of Wednesday, 29 May 2024 as the date for the General Elections, following his consultations with the Electoral Commission of South Africa and all nine provincial Premiers on the state of readiness for the national and provincial elections.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op almal, veral die jeug, om hul stemreg uit te oefen.
tgt: .2 The Cabinet called on everyone, especially the youth, to exercise their right to vote.

src: Jare se ongekende opoffering en stryd vir ons vryheid het in 1994 stemreg vir die meerderheid Suid-Afrikaners verseker.
tgt: Years of untold sacrifice and struggle for our freedom culminated in the right to vote for the majority of South Africans in 1994.

src: Ons stryd om vryheid het die reg vir elke Suid-Afrikaner om aktiewe deelnemers aan ons demokratiese stelsel te wees verwesenlik.
tgt: Our struggle for freedom secured the right for every South African to be active participants in our democratic system.

src: Vanjaar se verkiesings val saam met die viering van 30 jaar van vryheid, wat 'n belangrike mylpaal vir Suid-Afrika is, aangesien dit ons die geleentheid bied om oor ons suksesse te besin en na oplossings te soek om ons oorkombare uitdagings die hoof te bied.
tgt: .3 This year’s elections coincide with the celebration of 30 Years of Freedom, which is a significant milestone for South Africa as it provides us with the opportunity to reflect on our successes and also look for solutions to address our surmountable challenges.

src: Presidensiële eThekwini Werkgroep Die Kabinet het kennis geneem van President Ramaphosa se vergadering met die Durbanse Kamer van Koophandel en Nywerheid op Vrydag 23 Februarie 2024.
tgt: .1 Cabinet noted President Ramaphosa’s meeting on Friday, 23 February 2024 with the Durban Chamber of Commerce and Industry to discuss various initiatives led by national government to assist the eThekwini Metropolitan Municipality to address the current water, electricity and infrastructure challenges.

src: Verskeie inisiatiewe is bespreek wat deur die nasionale regering gelei is om die eThekwini Meropolitaanse Munisipaliteit te help om die huidige water-, elektrisiteit- en infrastruktuuruitdagings die hoof te bied.
tgt: .2 The President also established the Presidential eThekwini Working Group to accelerate the speedy resolution of issues affecting the eThekwini Metropolitan Municipality.

src: Die President het ook die Presidensiële eThekwini-werkgroep gestig om spoedige oplossing van kwessies wat die eThekwini Meropolitaanse Munisipaliteit raak, te versnel.
tgt: The group – comprising Ministers, and eThekwini Metropolitan Municipality and business officials – will regularly present progress reports to the President 14th Policy Dialogue Forum of the International Task Force on Teachers for Education

src: Die groep – bestaande uit ministers, die eThekwini Meropolitaanse Munisipaliteit en sakeleiers – sal gereeld vorderingsverslae aan die President voorlê.
tgt: .1 Cabinet noted the country’s successful hosting of the 14th PDF of the International Task Force on Teachers for Education in Sandton, Johannesburg on Monday, 26 February 2024.

src: 14de Beleidsdialoogforum (PDF) van die Internasionale Taakspan oor Onderwysers vir Onderwys Die Kabinet het kennis geneem van die land se suksesvolle aanbieding van die 14de PDF van die Internasionale Taakspan oor Onderwysers vir Onderwys in Sandton, Johannesburg, op Maandag 26 Februarie 2024.
tgt: It brought together education stakeholders from across the globe to foster advocacy, knowledge exchange and the monitoring of progress towards Sustainable Development Goal 4 on quality education.

src: Die PDF het 'n hoëvlakpaneelverslag oor die onderwysprofessie vrygestel en ook die globale verslag oor onderwystekorte bekendgestel.
tgt: .2 The Policy Dialogue Forum released a High-Level Panel Report on the Teaching Profssion and also launched the Global Report on teacher shortages.3 Crime Combating Cabinet commends the South African Police Service for their tireless work, which has led to the arrest of seven persons in connection with the murder of Kiernan 'AKA' Forbes and his friend Tebello 'Tibs' Motsoane.

src: Twee van die verdagtes is in Eswatini in hegtetenis geneem en moet nog aan die land uitgelewer word.
tgt: Two of the suspects were arrested in Eswatini and are still to be extradited to the country.

src: Die inhegtenisneming kon plaasvind danksy maande se moeisame polisiewerk.
tgt: The arrests are as result of months of painstaking police work.

src: Die verdagtes wat in hegtenis geneem is, sluit in ’n koördineerder, skerpskutters, uitkykers en ’n persoon wat die voertuig en vuurwapens gehuur het.
tgt: The suspects arrested included a coordinator, shooters, spotter and person who hired the vehicle and firearms.

src: Internasionale Betrekkinge 37ste Afrika Unie (AU) Beraad Die Kabinet waardeer die vordering wat gemaak is by die 37ste AU-beraad wat op 17 en 18 Februarie 2024 in Addis Abeba, Ethiopië gehou is en Afrika se prioriteite vir 2024 en daarna uiteengesit het.
tgt: .1 Cabinet appreciated the progress made at the 37th AU Summit held in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia on 17 and 18 February 2024, which outlined Africa's priorities for 2024 and beyond.

src: President Ramaphosa het by ander Afrika-leiers aangesluit om die belangrikste kontinentale prioriteite te bespreek, insluitend vrede en veiligheid, klimaatsverandering, ekonomiese ontwikkeling en Afrika se rol in die breër globale multilaterale konteks.
tgt: President Ramaphosa joined other African leaders in discussing key continental priorities including peace and security, climate change, economic development and Africa’s role in the wider global multilateral context.

src: Die beraad het die tweede 10-jaar-implementeringsplan van Agenda 2063 aanvaar, wat die versnelling van vlagskipprojekte soos die Afrika-kontinentale vryhandelsgebied insluit, waarin Suid-Afrika 'n leidende rol speel.
tgt: .2 The summit adopted the Second 10-Year Implementation Plan of Agenda 2063, which will see the acceleration of flagship projects such as the African Continental Free Trade Area, in which South Africa is playing a leading role.

src: President Ramaphosa het ook in sy hoedanigheid as die leier van die AU se Covid-19-reaksie, 'n verslag oor die vasteland se reaksie op die Coronavirus (Covid-19) -pandemie en die stand van gereedheid teen toekomstige gesondheidsbedreigings, voorgelê.
tgt: .3 President Ramaphosa also presented a report on the continent’s response to the Coronavirus Disease (COVID-19) pandemic and the state of readiness against future health threats, in his capacity as the Champion of the AU’s COVID-19 response.

src: Die beraad het verder die erns van sosio-ekonomiese herstel ná Covid-19 beklemtoon, asook lesse uit die pandemie se paraatheid, reaksie, en die veiligheid van die Afrika-vasteland.
tgt: The summit also emphasised the importance of socio-economic recovery post COVID-19, and lessons from the pandemic preparedness and response and continental security.

src: Die president het 'n beroep op Afrika-leiers gedoen om hul lande se vlakke van waaksaamheid teen toekomstige pandemies steeds te verbeter en het 'n beroep gedoen op die aanvaarding van 'n sterk gemeenskaplike Afrika-standpunt oor pandemiese paraatheid en die reaksie daarop.
tgt: .4 The President called on African leaders to continue improving the levels of alertness of their countries against future pandemics and urged for the adoption of a strong Common Africa Position on Pandemic Preparedness and Response.

src: Suid-Afrika se aanbieding van die Groep van Twintig (G20) en Presidensie in 2025 Die Kabinet het 'n verslag ontvang en oorweeg oor die voorbereidings vir Suid-Afrika se aanbieding van die G20-beraad in 2025, asook die oorname van die beraad se presidentskap.
tgt: South Africa’s hosting of the Group of Twenty (G20) and Presidency in 2025

src: Dit is 'n belangrike mylpaal vir Suid-Afrika aangesien dit die eerste land in Afrika sal wees wat so 'n byeenkoms aanbied dit is nie net uniek weens die verwagte getalle nie, maar ook weens die blywende impak wat dit na verwagting sal maak.
tgt: .1 Cabinet received and considered a report on the preparations for South Africa’s hosting of the G20 Summit in 2025 as well as taking over the Presidency.

src: .2 Die Kabinet is vol vertroue dat Suid-Afrika 'n suksesvolle G20-beraad sal aanbied, soos reeds met vorige groot geleenthede soos die Brasilië, Rusland, Indië, China en Suid-Afrika (BRICS)-beraad, asook die African Growth and Opportunity Act-Forum.
tgt: This is a momentous event for South Africa as it will be the first country in Africa to host such a gathering not only unique because of the anticipated numbers but also of the enduring impact it is envisaged to make.

src: Die G20-presidentskap bied aan Suid-Afrika 'n geleentheid om die vooruitsigte van ontluikende markte te verdedig.
tgt: .2 Cabinet is confident that South Africa will deliver a successful G20 Summit, as it has done with previous major events such as the Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa Summit and the African Growth and Opportunity Act Forum.

src: Terwyl Suid-Afrika die G20 aanbied, sal die land se deelname aan die forum steeds gelei word deur die verbintenis om nasionale belange sowel as dié van die Afrika-kontinent te bevorder.
tgt: The G20 Presidency presents South Africa with an opportunity to champion the aspirations of emerging markets.

src: Kabinetsbesluite Aanbied van die negende jaarvergadering van die Nuwe Ontwikkelingsbank (NDB) Die Kabinet het dit oorweeg en goedgekeur dat die jaarvergadering van die NDB in Junie 2024 in Suid-Afrika aangebied word.
tgt: .3 As it hosts the G20, South Africa’s participation in the forum will continue to be guided by the country’s commitment to advance national interests as well as those of the African continent.

src: Dit is 10 jaar sedert die BRICS-lande die Aktes van Ooreenkoms van die NDB op 15 en 16 Julie 2014 by die 6de BRICS-beraad in Fortaleza, Brasilië onderteken het.
tgt: Cabinet decisions Hosting of the Ninth annual meeting of the New Development Bank (NDB) Cabinet considered and approved the hosting of the annual meeting of the NDB in South African in South African in June 2024.

src: Dit het die eerste multilaterale ontwikkelingsinstelling deur ontluikende en ontwikkelende lande tot stand gebring.
tgt: It has been 10 years since BRICS countries signed the Articles the NDB at the 6th BRICS Summit in Fortaleza, and this established the first multilateral development institution by emerging and developing countries.

src: Suid-Afrika het tot dusver R25 miljard bygedra tot die bank se inbetaalde kapitaal.
tgt: So far, South Africa has contributed R25 billion towards the bank’s paid in Capital.

src: Suid-Afrika sien daarna uit om die NDB-vergadering aan te bied en is daartoe verbind om hand-aan-hand met die bank en sy lidlande te werk om volhoubare ontwikkeling te bewerkstellig en 'n beter Afrika-kontinent te skep.
tgt: South Africa is looking forward to host the meeting on NDB and commits to working hand in hand with the bank and its member countries to achieve sustainable development and create a better the African continent.

src: Strategie vir die aanstelling van professionele maatskaplike dienstewerkers (SSPs) Die Kabinet het die Strategie vir die Indiensneming van SSP's goedgekeur as deel van die behoefte om die regering, nie-regeringsorganisasies en die private sektor se menslike hulpbronkapasiteit uit te brei as ’n proaktiewe reaksie op die maatskaplike euwels wat die land in die gesig staar.
tgt: Strategy for the Employment of Social Service Profssionals (SSPs) Cabinet approved the Strategy for the Employment of SSPs as part of increasing the human resource capacity of government, non- governmental organisations and the private sector to proactively respond to social ills that are facing the country.

src: Die strategie is 'n kollektiewe verbintenis tot die bou van 'n maatskaplike dienstesektor wat reageer op die behoeftes van ons gemeenskappe om maatskaplike euwels soos misdaad, geslagsgebaseerde geweld en vrouemoord, tienerswangerskappe, afknouery, huishoudings met 'n kind aan die hoof, geestesgesondheid en dwelmmisbruik die hoof te bied.
tgt: The strategy is a collective commitment to building a social service sector that is responsive to the needs of our communities and overcome social ills such as crime, gender-based violence and femicide, teenage pregnancies, bullying, child-headed households, mental health and substance abuse.

src: Die strategie is ook daarop gemik om die grondslag te lê vir 'n sosiaal-inklusiewe en veerkragtige toekoms en 'n samelewing wat omgee.
tgt: The strategy is also aimed at laying the foundation for a socially inclusive and resilient future and a caring society.

src: Groenskrif oor Omvattende Maatskaplike Sekuriteit Die Kabinet het oorweeg en goedgekeur dat die hersiene Groenskrif oor Omvattende Maatskaplike Sekuriteit gepubliseer word, en versoek openbare kommentaar daaroor.
tgt: Green Paper on Comprehensive Social Security Cabinet considered and approved the publication and call for public comments on the revised Green Paper on Comprehensive Social Security for the country.

src: Die groenskrif het ten doel om 'n verpligte pensioenstelsel vir sosiale sekerheid in te stel wat aftree-, ongeskiktheids- en sterftevoordele aan alle werkers bied.
tgt: The paper aims to introduce a mandatory social security pension system that provides retirement, disability and death benefits to all workers.

src: Lae-inkomsteverdieners se bydraes sal gesubsidieer word in ooreenstemming met bestaande bepalings.
tgt: Low- income earners would have their contributions subsidised in line with existing provisions.

src: Die referaat stel verder die gelykmaking van die manier waarop ouer persone in die belasting- en maatskaplike toelaestelsel behandel word voor, om die ongelyke behandeling van ouer persone in die twee regimes reg te stel.
tgt: The paper further proposes the harmonisation of the tax treatment of older persons in the tax and social grant system to address the unequal treatment of older persons in the two regimes.

src: Die groenskrif is verder ook daarop gerig om institusionele hervormings voor te stel wat samehang in maatskaplike sekerheidsbeleid bevorder met die doel om administratiewe doeltreffendheid, verbeterde dienslewering en doeltreffende regulering, bestuur en toesig oor alle maatskaplike sekerheidsreëlings te verseker.
tgt: In addition, the paper also seeks to propose institutional reforms to promote coherence in social security policy making for administrative efficiency, improved service delivery and ensure effective regulation, governance and oversight across all social security arrangements.

src: Aaanstellings
tgt: Appointments

src: Alle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en toepaslike sekuriteitsklarings.
tgt: All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant security clearances.

src: Aanstelling van mnrSnike Thulani Sibuyi as Sekretaris vir Polisiediens by die Departement Burgerlike Sekretariaat vir Polisiediens.
tgt: Appointment of Mr Snike Thulani Sibuyi as Secretary for Police Service at the Department of Civil Secretariat for Police Service.

src: Aanstelling van mnrXolile Sizani as die Hoof Uitvoerende Beampte (HUB) van PetroSAanstelling van me Nombulelo Guliwe as HUB van Suid-Afrikaanse Toerisme.
tgt: Appointment of Mr Xolile Sizani as the Chief Executive Officer of Petro SAppointment of Ms Nombulelo Guliwe as CEO of South African Tourism Extension of contract for Ms Totsie Memela-Khambula as the Chief Executive Officer of the South African Social Security Agency.

src: Aanstelling van me Mapatane Elizabeth Kgomoas as die HUB van die Munisipale Infrastruktuur Ondersteuningsagentskap.
tgt: Ms Mapatane Elizabeth Kgomo.

src: Heraanstelling in die Raad van die Sentrale Energiefonds (SEF) en aanstelling van me Ayanda Noah as Voorsitter.
tgt: Re-appointment to the Board of Central Energy Fund (CEF) and appointment as chairperson Ms Ayanda Noah.

src: Aanstelling van lede van die Suid-Afrikaanse Toerismeraad: MeMakhosazana Khanyile (Voorsitter) AdvLizelle Dominique Jordaan (Ondervoorsitter) Dr Gregory J Davids MnrIkaneng Ephraim Pilane prof Motlhago Stella Bvuma MeNqabomzi Haya MnrRajesh Mahabeer MnrAyanda V Mazibuko MeMaija de Rijk-Uys Dr Mzolisi Michael Toni en MeUveshnee Pillay as verteenwoordiger van die Departement van Toeriesme.
tgt: Appointment of members of the South Africa Tourism Board: Ms Makhosazana Khanyile (Chairperson) Adv.

src: Aanstelling van die Voorsitter en Ondervoorsitter van die Raad van Trustees van die Onafhanklike Ontwikkelingstrust: AdvKwazikwenkosi Mshengu (Voorsitter) en Ms Karabo Siyila (Adjunkvoorsitter).
tgt: Lizelle Dominique Jordaan (Deputy Chairperson) Dr Gregory Davids Mr Ikaneng Ephraim Pilane ProfMotlhago Stella Bavuma Ns Nqabomzi Haya Mr Rajesh Mahabeer Mr Ayanda Mazibuko Ms Maija de Rijk-Uys Dr Mzolisi Michael Toni and Ms Uveshnee Pillay as the Department representative Appointment of the Chairperson and Deputy Chairperson of the Board of Trustees of the Independent Development Trust: Adv Kwazikwenkosi Mshengu (Chairperson) and Ms Karabo Siyila (Deputy Chairperson).

src: Toekomstige gebeure Meseregtemaand Vanjaar se herdenking van Meseregtemaand en Meseregtedag vind op 21 Maart, die vooraand van die land se viering van 30 Jaar van Vryheid in April, plaas.
tgt: This year’s commemoration of Human Rights Month and Human Rights Day on 21 March takes place on the eve of the nation’s celebration of 30 Years of Freedom in April.

src: Onder die tema: “Drie dekades van respek vir en bevordering van menseregte”, doen die Kabinet 'n beroep op almal om ’n bydrae te lewer tot die versterking van ons menseregte, en om ons vryheid en demokrasie wat ten duurste bereik is, te koester.
tgt: Under the theme: “Three Decades of Respect for and Promotion of Human Rights”, Cabinet calls on everyone to play their part towards strengthening our human rights, and to cherish our freedom and democracy, which was attained at great cost.

src: Distriksontwikkelingsmodel (DDM) Presidensiële Imbizo Die President het die 12de DDM Presidensiële Imbizo op Donderdag 7 Maart 2024 by die Nkangala-distriksmunisipaliteit in Mpumalanga aangebied.
tgt: District Development Model (DDM) Presidential Imbizo

src: Die Imbizo bring leiers van al drie regeringsfere byeen om met inwoners te kommunikeer oor diensleweringsuitdagings en sit planne uiteen vir die verbetering van dienslewering en gemeenskapsontwikkeling in die gebied.
tgt: c. The Imbizo brings together leaders from all three spheres of government to interact with residents on service delivery challenges and sets out plans for service delivery improvements and community development in the area.

src: Die DDM Presidensiële Imbizo en toesigbesoeke het in al nege provinsies plaasgevind as deel van pogings om voortgesette werk vir die verbetring van hul inwoners se lewens, te versterk.
tgt: The DDM Presidential Imbizo and oversight visits have occurred in all nine provinces as part of efforts to reinforce on-going work of improving the lives of citizens.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op inwoners van die Nkangala-distriksmunisipaliteit en omliggende gebiede om die Imbizo by te woon en hul openbare verteenwoordigers te betrek oor kwessies wat hulle raak.
tgt: d. Cabinet calls on residents of the Nkangala District Municipality and surrounding areas to attend the Imbizo and engage their public representatives on issues affecting them.

src: Simposium vir Volhoubare Infrastruktuurontwikkeling Suid-Afrika (SIDSSA) 4202.4 Alles is gereed vir SIDSSA 2024, wat van 17 tot 19 Maart 2024 in Kaapstad plaasvind.
tgt: Sustainable Infrastructure Development Symposium South Africa (SIDSSA) 2024 a.

src: Dié simposium bring kritieke rolspelers in die infrastruktuursektor bymekaar, wat deurslaggewende bydraes kan lewer om die pas van infrastruktuurbeleggings in die land te versnel.
tgt: It is all systems go for the SIDSSA 2024, which will take place in Cape Town from 17 to 19 March 2024.

src: Infrastruktuurontwikkeling is die sleutelprioriteit van die regering en die Sesde Administrasie, aangesien dit bydra tot ekonomiese groei en werkskepping.
tgt: The SIDSSA brings together critical role-players in the infrastructure sector who are key to accelerating the pace of infrastructure investments in the country.

src: Die SIDSSA sal sommige van die vordering wat met die implementering van die Infrastruktuurbeleggingsplan wat in Me 2020 deur die Kabinet goedgekeur is, ten toon stel.
tgt: The SIDSSA will showcase some of the progress in the implementation of the Infrastructure Investment Plan that was approved by Cabinet in May 2020.

src: Tweede Swart Nyweraars- en Uitvoerderskonferensie Die tweede Swart Nyweraars- en Uitvoerderskonferensie sal op Woensdag 20 Maart 2024 by die Sandton-konvensiesentrum in Johannesburg plaasvind.
tgt: Second Black Industrialists and Exporters Conference

src: Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense en goeie wense oor aan: Ms Michelle Phillips met haar aanstelling as die Groep HUB van Transnet en me Nosipho Maphumulo as Groep Hoof Finansiële Beampte van Transnet.
tgt: Messages Congratulations Cabinet extended its congratulations and well-wishes to: Ms Michelle Phillips on her appointment as the Group CEO of Transnet and Ms Nosipho Maphumulo as Group Chief Financial Officer of Transnet.

src: Hierdie aanstellings is van kritieke belang vir die voortgesette werk om die kapasiteit binne Transnet te herbou as deel van die werk om die land se vrag-, spoor- en logistieke kapasiteit te herstel.
tgt: These appointments are critical to the on-going work to rebuild the capacity within Transnet as part of the work to restore the country’s freight, rail and logistics capacity.

src: MnrWamkele Mee met sy herverkiesing as die Sekretaris-generaal van die Afrika Kontinentale Vryhandelsgebied.
tgt: Mr. Wamkele Mene for his re-election as the Secretary General of the African Continental Free Trade Area Mr Sibusiso Ngalwa who is the current Chairperson of the South African National Editors Forum (SANEF) on his appointment to the Executive Committee of the Africa Editors Forum.

src: MnrSibusiso Ngalwa, wat tans voorsitter van die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Redakteursforum (SANEF) is, vir sy aanstelling op die Uitvoerende Komitee van die Afrika-redakteursforum.
tgt: Banyana-Banyana, the national women’s soccer team, for its victory in the second leg of the CAF Women’s Olympic Qualifiers.

src: BanyanaBanyana, die nasionale vrouesokkerspan, vir hul oorwinning in die tweede been van die CAF Vroue se Olimpiese kwalifikaserende rondte.
tgt: The team won the two-legged outing on a 4-0 on aggregate, and they will face Nigeria in the final round in April 2024.

src: Die Kabinet spreek sy meegevoel uit teenoor die naasbestaandes, vriende en kollegas van: Kaptein Simon Mkhulu Bobe en Onderkorporaal Irven Thabang Semono van die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Weermag, wat op 14 Februarie 2024 in die Demokratiese Republiek van die Kongo (DRK) gesterf het.
tgt: Cabinet expressed condolences to the family, friends and colleagues of: Captain Simon Mkhulu Bobe and Lance Corporal Irven Thabang Semono of the South African National Defence Force, who were killed in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) on 14 February 2024.

src: Hulle was deel van die Suider-Afrikaanse Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap se sending in die DRK, algemeen bekend as SAMIDRC, wat ontplooi is om veiligheid, vrede en stabiliteit te herstel in ooreenstemming met die AU-agenda van "Silencing the Guns by 2030".
tgt: They were part of the Southern African Development Community Mission in the DRC, commonly known as SAMIDRC deployed to restore security, peace, and stability in line with the AU Agenda of “Silencing the Guns by 2030”.

src: Die Kabinet wens verder die drie ander soldate wat in die aanval beseer is 'n spoedige herstel toe.
tgt: Cabinet also wished the three other soldiers injured in the attack a speedy recovery.

src: Die nege mense van Mpumalanga wat hul lewens in 'n tragiese busongeluk in Paulpietersburg, KwaZulu-Natal verloor het terwyl hulle teruggekeer het van die African National Congress-saamtrek in eThekwini.
tgt: The Nine people from Mpumalanga who lost their lives in a tragic bus accident in Paul Pietersburg, KwaZulu-Natal from the African National Congress rally in eThekwini.

src: Die Kabinet prys die miljoene belastingbetalers wat hul belastingopgawes ingedien het om die Suid-Afrikaanse Inkomstediens te help om belastinginkomste van R.155 triljoen vir die 2023/24 finansiële jaar in te vorder.
tgt: Issues from the Environment Economy Revenue collection Cabinet commends the millions of taxpayers who have filed their tax returns to help the South African Revenue Service collect tax revenue of R.155 trillion for the 2023/24 financial year.

src: Dit is R52 miljard meer as die vorige jaar en toon die kragtigheid van die plaaslike ekonomie, ondanks uitdagende plaaslike en internasionale toestande.
tgt: This is R52 billion more than the previous year and demonstrates the robustness of the local economy, despite challenging local and international conditions.

src: Die verhoogde inkomste help die regering om die land se diensleweringsprojekte en ander sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkelingsprogramme te finansier.
tgt: The increased revenue helps government to fund the country’s service-delivery projects and other socio-economic development programmes.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die opening van 'n Newlyn Park Bayhead Spoorwegterminaalprojek van R3,4 miljard by die Durbanhawe dit beslaan ‘n oppervlak van 640 000 vierkante meter met pakhuise, wisselspoorlyne en oop bergingsruimte.
tgt: Infrastructure investment Cabinet welcomed the opening of a R3,4 billion Newlyn Park Bayhead Rail Terminal project at the Port of Durban, which consists of 640 000 square metres of warehousing, rail sidings and open storage.

src: 1.Die nuwe terminaal sal die doeltreffende beweging van see-, spoor- en padvrag deur die Durbanhawe fasiliteer, en help om die onlangse uitdagings wat deur die logistieke, infrastruktuur- en netwerkbedryf ervaar word, die hoof te bied.
tgt: The new terminal will facilitate the efficient movement of sea, rail and road cargo through the Port of Durban, and help address the recent challenges experienced in the logistics, infrastructure and network industries.

src: Die belegging het gelei tot 4 013 direkte werksgeleeenthede vir konstruksiewerkers en die voltydse indiensneming van meer as 1 000 mense hierdie getal sal na verwagting groei namate die fasiliteit meer vrag hanteer.
tgt: The investment resulted in 4 013 direct construction jobs and the full-time employment of more than 1 000 people, with this number expected to grow as the facility handles more cargo.

src: In die herlewing van ons land se spoornetwerk, verwelkom die Kabinet ook die Passasierspooragentskap van Suid-Afrika (PRASA) se suksesvolle herstel van vyf belangrike Merorail-dienste regoor Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal en die Wes-Kaap.
tgt: In revitalising our country’s rail network, Cabinet also welcomed the Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa’s (PRASA) successful restoration of five crucial Metrorail services across Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal and the Western Cape.

src: PRASA het effektief 31 van sy 40 lyne herstel tot gedeeltelike werking en werk daaraan om volle operasionele status te bereik.
tgt: PRASA effectively brought 31 of its 40 lines back into partial operation and is working on achieving full operational status.

src: Die mylpaal toon die regering se verbintenis tot die herlewing van passasierspoordienste en die voorsiening van 'n doeltreffende openbare vervoeropsie vir Suid-Afrikaners.
tgt: The milestone demonstrates government’s commitment to revitalising passenger rail services and providing an efficient public transport option for South Africans.

src: In 'n verwante ontwikkeling, het die Kabinet die aankondiging deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Padagentskap dat hy meer as R50 miljard in padinfrastruktuurontwikkeling in die Oos-Kaap gaan inspuit, verwelkom.
tgt: In a related development, Cabinet welcomed the announcement by the South African National Roads Agency that it would inject over R50 billion into road infrastructure development in the Eastern Cape.

src: Hierdie infrastruktuurbelegging is gerig op die bou van nuwe fasiliteite, padverbeterings en -versterking, en spesiale instandhouding van die nasionale padnetwerk in die provinsie.
tgt: This infrastructure investment is geared towards the construction of new facilities, road improvements and strengthening, and special maintenance of the national road network in the province.

src: Belegging Die Kabinet het die opening van die nuwe Tetra Pak-fasiliteit in KwaZulu-Natal deur President Cyril Ramaphosa verwelkom, wat 'n belegging van R500 miljoen gelok het.
tgt: Investment Cabinet welcomed the opening of the new Tetra Pak facility in KwaZulu-Natal by President Cyril Ramaphosa, which attracted an investment of R500 million.

src: Die belegging vorm deel van die Presidensiële Beleggingsmobiliseringsveldtog waarvoor die regering in 2018 die ambisieuse teiken gestel het om R1,2 triljoen beleggings oor vyf jaar te lok.
tgt: The investment forms part of the Presidential Investment Mobilisation Drive where government set the ambitious target in 2018 to attract R1,2 trillion investments over five years.

src: Verlede jaar by die vyfde Suid-Afrikaanse Beleggingskonferensie, wat die einde van die eerste fases van ons beleggingsmobiliseringsiklus gemerk het, is meer as R1,5 triljoen in beleggingsverpligtinge ingesamel.
tgt: Last year at the fifth South Africa Investment Conference, which marked end of the first phases of our investment mobilisation cycle, more the R1,5 trillion in investment commitments were raised.

src: Hierdie beleggings herlei na nuwe fabrieke, werksgeleenthede in gemeenskappe en groter ekonomiese aktiwiteit regoor ons land.
tgt: These investments translate into new factories, jobs in communities and greater economic activity around our country.

src: Die Kabinet is vol vertroue dat ons beleggingsveldtog ekonomiese groei weer sal laat opvlam en ons ekonomie sal ophef.
tgt: Cabinet is confident that our investment drive will reignite economic growth and uplift our economy.

src: Werkloosheidsversekeringsfonds (WVF) se Arbeidsaktiverings-program (LAP)1.
tgt: Unemployment Insurance Fund (UIF) Labour Activation Programme (LAP) Cabinet welcomed the launch of the UIF-LAP, which is a skills training and entrepreneurship programme aimed at benefitting the youth and the unemployed in the country.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van die WVF-LAP, wat 'n vaardigheidsopleiding- en entrepreneurskapprogram is wat gerig is om die jeug en werkloses in die land te bevoordeel.
tgt: The programme ensures that youth and work seekers are equipped with the necessary skills to be employable and to establish their own businesses.

src: Die WVF-LAP, wat regoor die land in werking gestel sal word, sal na verwagting werksgeleenthede vir meer as 704 000 werklose mense skep.
tgt: The UIF-LAP, which will be rolled out across the country, is expected to create employment opportunities for over 704 000 unemployed people.

src: Dit sal gedoen word deur opleiding en klein-ondernemingsondersteuning aan 333 projekte regoor die land te bied.
tgt: It will do so by providing training and small enterprise support to 333 projects across the country.

src: Sowat R23,8 miljard is opsygesit om die plan in werking te stel en werksgeleenthede sal tussen 12 en 36 maande duur.
tgt: About R.8 billion has been set aside to implement the plan and employment opportunities will run between 12 and 36 months.

src: 30 Jaar van Vryheid en Demokrasie.
tgt: 30 Years of Freedom and Democracy Cabinet welcomed the launch of the commemoration of 30 Years of Freedom and Democracy, which is being held under the theme: “30 years of Democracy, Partnership and Growth”.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van die herdenking van 30 Jaar van Vryheid en Demokrasie, wat gehou word onder die tema: ‘30 jaar van Demokrasie, Vennootskap en Groei’.
tgt: The launch also saw the unveiling of the official 30 Years of Freedom logo, which is a symbol that will unify us as we celebrate this significant milestone in the history of our country.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op almal om die amptelike logo wat vir gebruiksgemak in verskillende formate beskikbaar is op die GCIS-webwerf, te gebruik by: WEBTOKEN Die bekendstelling het die amptelike aanvang gemerk van die jaarlange aktiwiteite om die merkwaardige vordering wat ons sedert 1994 gemaak het deur 'n demokratiese samelewing te vestig wat gegrond is op die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996 en die Handves van Meseregtegte, te vier.
tgt: Cabinet called on everyone to use the official logo which is available in various formats for ease of use on the GCIS website at: WEBTOKEN The launch marked the official commencement of the year-long activities to celebrate the remarkable progress we have made since 1994 in establishing a democratic society based on the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996 and the Bill of Rights.

src: Hierdie belangrike gebeurtenis bied ook 'n geleentheid om na te dink oor die uitdagings waarvoor ons steeds te staan kom en om maniere te vind om dit te oorkom en ons land vorentoe te beweeg.
tgt: This momentous occasion is also an opportunity to reflect on the challenges that remain and find ways to overcome them and move our country forward.

src: Ons werk sedert 1994 daaraan om 'n samelewing te bou wat gegrond is op eenheid en samesyn, en hoewel daar nog baie uitdagings is, het toestande met elke dag wat verbygegaan het fundamenteel verbeter.
tgt: We have worked since 1994 to build a society based on unity and togetherness, and while many challenges still remain, conditions have fundamentally improved with each passing day.

src: Die aansienlike vordering wat ons sedert 1994 gemaak het, word weerspieël in Sensus 2022 en die 30-Jaaroorsig.
tgt: The great strides we have made since 1994 are reflected in Census 2022 and the 30 Year Review.

src: Albei skets 'n prentjie van 'n samelewing wat aan die beweeg is en wat verbeterings in die meeste aanwysers weerspieël.
tgt: Both paint a picture of a society on the move and which reflects improvements across most indicators.

src: Die bevindinge van die sensus en die 30-Jaaroorsig dui onweerlegbaar daarop dat ons ontwikkeling nie per toeval is nie, maar eerder met opset deur regeringsprogramme sedert 1994.
tgt: The findings of the Census and the 30 Year Review conclusively demonstrate that our development is not by chance, but rather by design from government programmes since 1994.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners en sektore van die samelewing om deel te neem aan die viering van 30 Jaar van Vryheid en Demokrasie.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans and sectors of society to participate in celebrating 30 Years of Freedom and Democracy.

src: Suid-Afrikaners kan deelneem deur hul stories te vertel oor hoe dit was om in apartheid-Suid-Afrika te leef en ons te help om voort te bou op die prestasies wat ons tot dusver behaal het.
tgt: South Africans can participate by telling their stories on what it was like to have lived in apartheid South Africa and help us to build on the achievements we have made so far.

src: Verenigde Nasies (VN) se Resolusie van die Meseregteraad Die Kabinet verwelkom die resolusie van die VN se Meseregteraad waarin gevra word dat Israel aanspreeklik gehou moet word vir moontlike oorlogsmisdade en misdade teen die mensdom wat in Gasa gepleeg is.
tgt: United Nations (UN) Human Rights Council Resolution Cabinet welcomes the UN Human Rights Council resolution calling for Israel to be held accountable for possible war crimes and crimes against humanity committed in Gaza.

src: Die resolusie het verder 'n beroep gedoen op alle State “om die verkoop, oordrag en afwending van wapens, ammunisie en ander militêre toerusting aan Israel te staak” Die aanvaarding van hierdie resolusie is geskiedkundig aangesien dit die heel eerste keer is dat die Meseregteraad tot aksie oorgegaan het oor die ongekende menslike tragedie wat in Gasa plaasvind, waar minstens 32 975 Palestyne gedood is, wat onder meer 14 500 kinders insluit, sedert Israel sy aanslag meer as 180 dae gelede geloods het.
tgt: The resolution further “called upon all States to cease the sale, transfer and diversion of arms, munitions and other military equipment to Israel”.

src: Alles is in gereedheid vir die 2024 Nasionale en Provinsiale verkiesings, na die ondertekening van die Verkiesingskommissie se Gedragskode deur politieke partye en onafhanklike kandidate.
tgt: 2024 General Elections It is all systems go for the 2024 National and Provincial Elections, following the signing of the Electoral Commission’s Code of Conduct by political parties and independent candidates.

src: Die algemene verkiesing sal op 29 Me 2024 gehou word en altesaam 325 politieke partye sal aan vanjaar se verkiesing deelneem.
tgt: The General Elections will be held on 29 May 2024 and in total 325 political parties will be taking part in this year’s elections.

src: Die Verkiesingsgedragskode verbind almal wat die verkiesing betwis om by die stel reëls te hou, wat daarop gerig is om vrye en regverdige verkiesings te verseker.
tgt: The Electoral Code of Conduct commits all those contesting the elections to abide by the set of rules that are meant to ensure free and fair elections.

src: Die Kabinet is vol vertroue dat ons nasie weereens sal voortbou op die diensrekord waarvolgens gereelde, geloofwaardige, vrye en regverdige nasionale en plaaslike verkiesings sedert 1994 gehou is.
tgt: Cabinet is confident that our nation will once again build on our track record of holding regular, credible and free and fair national and local elections since 1994.

src: Terwyl die land 30 Jaar van Vryheid vier, word burgers aangemoedig om hul demokratiese reg om te kan stem uit te oefen.
tgt: As the country celebrates 30 Years of Freedom, citizens are encouraged to exercise their democratic right and vote.

src: Nasionale Regeringsberaad oor Kunsmatige Intelligensie (KI) Spoedige vooruitgang in KI is 'n werklikheid en KI is spoedig besig om die wêreld te vorm wat dit dus noodsaak dat lande vir die impak daarvan op hul burgers en bestuurstelsels moet voorberei.
tgt: National Artificial Intelligence (AI) Government Summit Rapid advances in AI are a reality and AI is rapidly shaping the world, which necessitates that countries prepare for its impact on citizens and governance systems.

src: Die Nasionale KI-regeringsberaad is op 5 April 2024 in Johannesburg belê sodat die regering en die sektor 'n beleids- en regulatoriese raamwerk tot stand kan bring om vooruitgang in KI tot voordeel van die mense te rig en te benut.
tgt: The National AI Government Summit was convened in Johannesburg on 5 April 2024 for government and the sector to initiate a policy and regulatory framework to guide and leverage advances in AI for human good.

src: KI-beleid is die sleutel tot die bou van 'n sterk digitale ekosisteem waaruit regerings, besighede en individue voordeel kan trek.
tgt: AI policies are key to building a strong digital ecosystem in which governments, businesses and individuals can reap the benefits.

src: Die beraad is die eerste stap om 'n duidelike pad vorentoe te karteer om die mag van KI te benut om sommige van Suid-Afrika se ekonomiese en maatskaplike uitdagings die hoof te bied.
tgt: The summit is the first step in charting a clear way forward towards leveraging the power of AI to address some of South Africa’s economic and social challenges.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die ondertekening van die Wysigingswet op Geregtelike Aangeleenthede, 2023 (Wet 15 van 2023).
tgt: Crime and corruption Cabinet welcomed the signing into law of the Judicial Matters Amendment Act, 2023 (Act 15 of 2023).

src: Die Wet gee uitvoering aan die aanbeveling van die Staatskapingskommissie en skep 'n bykomende oortreding wat ingesluit moet word in die Wet op die Voorkoming en Bestryding van Korrupte Aktiwiteite, 2004 (Wet 12 van 2004) deur individue strafregtelik aanspreeklik te hou vir versuim om korrupsie te voorkom.
tgt: The Act gives effect to the recommendation of the State Capture Commission and creates an additional offence to be included in the Prevention and Combating of Corrupt Activities Act, 2004 (Act 12 of 2004) by holding individuals criminally liable for failure to prevent corruption.

src: Die Wet het verder ten doel om 'n aantal wette te wysig wat deur die Departement van Justisie en Grondwetlike Ontwikkeling geadministreer word, insluitend bevoegdhede, pligte en funksies van die Hoofmeester van die Hooggeregshof.
tgt: The Act further aims to amend a number of Acts which are administered by the Department of Justice and Constitutional Development including powers, duties and functions of the Chief Master.

src: Hierdie veranderinge sal die Hoofmeester van die Hooggeregshof in staat stel om 'n groter toesighoudende rol oor die Mesters van die hof te speel en sal lei tot verbeterde dienslewering aan die publiek en aan regspraktisyns.
tgt: These changes will allow the Chief Master to play a greater supervisory role over the Masters of the High Court and will lead to improved service delivery to the public and to legal practitioners.

src: Die Kabinet het opdrag ontvang oor die implementering van die omkeerstrategie vir die POF, wat daarop gemik is om die fondsestelsel te vereenvoudig, asook om die administrasie van voordele en uitbetalings aan ongelukslagoffers te verbeter.
tgt: Updates to cabinet The status of the Road Accident Fund (RAF) Cabinet received a briefing on the implementation of the turnaround strategy for the RAF, aimed at simplifying the funds system while also improving the administration of benefits and payouts to accident victims.

src: 'n Belangrike ingryping was die bekendstelling van die POF-kontaksentrum, wat 'n platform bied vir POF-eisers om toegang tot hul eise-inligting te kry sonder om noodwendig uitsluitlik op hul regsverteenwoordigers staat te maak.
tgt: A key intervention has been the launch of the RAF contact centre, which provides a platform for RAF claimants to have access to their claims information without having to solely rely on their legal representatives.

src: Die platform bied ook aan eisers die geleentheid om die betalings wat deur die POF aan hulle regsverteenwoordigers gemaak is te verfieer.
tgt: The platform also allows claimants the opportunity to verify the payments made by RAF to their legal representatives.

src: Die omkeerstrategie het gelei tot groot verbeterings in die skikking van eise binne 120 dae, dit het regskoste met 75 persent verlaag en mediese koste van R3,6 miljard in die 2019/20-boekjaar tot R2,1 miljard in die 2023/24-boekjaar getoon.
tgt: The turnaround strategy has resulted in major improvements in the settlements of claims within 120 days, reduced legal costs by 75 percent and has seen a reduction of medical costs from R.6 billion in the 2019/20 financial year to R.1 billion in the 2023/24 financial year.

src: Die ingrypings het ook gelei tot 'n kumulatiewe regskostebesparing van meer as R23 miljard in die drie jaar van die implementering van die strategie.
tgt: The interventions also led to a cumulative legal costs savings of over R23 billion in the three years of implementing the strategy.

src: Daarbenewens het die strategie-ingrypings gelei tot die vermindering van eise wat betaal is aan eisers/korttermynaanspreeklikheid tot R9,3 miljard vir die tydperk geëindig 31 Maart 2023.
tgt: Moreover, the strategy interventions resulted in the in the reduction of claims paid to claimants/ short term liability to R.3 billion for the period ending 31 March 2023.

src: Die Kabinet is ook op die hoogte gebring van wysigings aan die huidige POF-wet, wat in 'n gevorderde stadium is.
tgt: Cabinet was also updated on legislative amendments to the current RAF Act, which are at an advanced stage.

src: Die POF-wysigingswetsontwerp sal deur die 7de administrasie van die regering oorweeg word.
tgt: The RAF Amendment Bill will be considered by the 7th administration of government.

src: Die wetsontwerp is daarop gemik om die voordele en die betaling van sekere produkte in annuïteite te verfyn en dit meer billik te maak.
tgt: The bill is aimed at refining the benefits and the payment of certain products in annuities and making it equitable.

src: Witskrif oor Burgerskap, Immigrasie en Vlugtelingbeskerming Die Kabinet het die Witskrif oor Burgerskap, Immigrasie en Vlugtelingbeskerming vir implementering goedgekeur, nadat 'n wye raadplegingsproses deur die Departement van Binnelandse Sake in al nege provinsies onderneem is.
tgt: Cabinet decisions White Paper on Citizenship, Immigration and Refugee Protection Cabinet approved the White Paper on Citizenship, Immigration and Refugee Protection for implementation, following a wide consultation process undertaken by the Department of Home Affairs in all nine provinces.

src: Die beleid het ten doel om 'n raamwerk te verskaf om burgerskap, immigrasie en vlugtelingbeskerming te rig, met inagneming van die land se nasionale veiligheidsbelange en in ooreenstemming met internasionale ooreenkomste en protokolle oor migrasie waaraan Suid-Afrika deelneem.
tgt: The policy aims to provide a framework to guide citizenship, immigration and refugee protection, considering the country’s national security interests and in compliance with international agreements and protocols on migration that South Africa is party to.

src: Dit sal ook Suid-Afrika se ekonomiese belange, transformasie en werkskeppingpogings bevorder.
tgt: It will also promote South Africa’s economic interests, transformation and job creation efforts.

src: Op pad na ’n 30-Jaaroorsig van Suid-Afrika se Demokrasie (1994-2024).
tgt: Towards a 30-Year Review of South Africa’s Democracy (1994-2024).

src: Die Kabinet het die publikasie van die verslag "Towards a 30-Year Review of South Africa's Democracy (1994-2024)" goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the publication of the report “Towards a 30-Year Review of South Africa’s Democracy (1994-2024)”.

src: Die oorsigverslag lui die verhaal in van Suid-Afrika se oorgang na demokrasie sedert die geskiedkundige verkiesing van 27 April 1994.
tgt: The review report heralds the story of South Africa’s transition into democracy since the historical elections of 27 April 1994.

src: Suid-Afrika se verhaal van oorgang na demokrasie inspireer steeds hoop vir baie mense regoor die wêreld en die oorsigverslag beklemtoon belangrike lesse in die evolusie van ons demokrasie.
tgt: South Africa’s story of transition to democracy continues to inspire hope for many people around the world, and the review report highlights important lessons in the evolution of our democracy.

src: Oor die afgelope 30 jaar het die land 'n stabiele demokrasie verwerf met sterk instellings en 'n aansienlike wêreldwye invloed.
tgt: Over the last 30 years, the country has attained a stable democracy, with strong institutions and a considerable global influence.

src: Die 30-jaar-oorsigverslag is gestruktureer op 13 tematiese gebiede wat deur vier belangrike verwysings beïnvloed is, nl (1) die 1994-Heropbou- en Ontwikkelingsprogram en sy vyf doelwitte (2) die aanvaarding van die Grondwet van 1996 (3) die 2012 Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan en (4) die Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk 2019-2024 om sewe prioriteite van die sesde administrasie te weerspieël.
tgt: The 30-Year Review Report is structured on 13 thematic areas informed by four important references (1) the 1994 Reconstruction and Development Programme and its five objectives (2) the 1996 adoption of the Constitution (3) the 2012 National Development Plan and (4) the Medium-Term Strategic Framework 2019-2024 to reflect seven priorities of the sixth administration.

src: Die oorsigverslag sal deur die Departement van Beplanning, Monitering en Evaluering gepubliseer word en lede van die gemeenskap sal 'n geleentheid kry om hulself by die verslag te betrek.
tgt: The review report will be published by the Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation and members of society will have an opportunity to engage the report.

src: Toekomstige Gebeure 6de Statebond Konferensie van die die Rooikruis en die Rooi Sekelmaan oor Internasionale Humanitêre Reg.1 Suid-Afrika en die Internasionale Komitee van die Rooikruis sal van 15 tot 19 April 2024 die 6de Rooikruis en Rooi Sekelmaan Statebondskonferensie oor Internasionale Humanitêre Reg in Suid-Afrika by die Irene Country Lodge in Pretoria aanbied.
tgt: Upcoming Events 6th Commonwealth Red Cross and Red Crescent Conference on International Humanitarian Law South Africa and the International Committee of the Red Cross will co-host the 6th Red Cross and Red Crescent Commonwealth Conference on International Humanitarian Law in South Africa from 15 to 19 April 2024 at the Irene Country Lodge in Pretoria.

src: Die konferensie sal verteenwoordigers van die Statebondlidlande, lede van die Rooi Kruis- en Rooi Sekelmaan-beweging en ander belangrike belanghebbendes byeen bring om oor Internasionale Mesereg te beraadslaag.2 Die konferensie poog om bestaande menseregte-instrumente te herkalibreer en te versterk en ons kennis oor die belangrikheid van Internasionale Mesereg te verdiep in 'n era van verhoogde gewapende konflikte, sowel as klimaatsverandering, voedselonsekerheid en toenemende gedwonge verplasing.
tgt: The conference will bring together representatives of Commonwealth Member States, members of the Red Cross and Red Crescent movement, and other key stakeholders to deliberate on International Human Law.

src: Boodskappe GelukwenseDie Kabinet dra sy gelukwense en goeie wense oor aan: • Die Minister van Gesondheid Dr Joe Phaahla vir sy aanstelling in die Raad van die Global Fund met ingang van 1 Me 2024.
tgt: The conference seeks to recalibrate and strengthen existing human rights instruments and deepen our knowledge on the importance of International Human Law in an era of increased armed conflicts as well as climate change, food insecurity and growing displacement.

src: Dr Phaahla sal as 'n verteenwoordiger van die Oos- en Suider-Afrikastreek dien.
tgt: Dr Phaahla will serve as a representative of the East and Southern Africa region.

src: • Suid-Afrikaanse Moslems, sowel as wêreldwyd, veral in Palestina, by geleentheid van Eid al-Fitr.
tgt: South Africans Muslims as well as those across the globe, especially in Palestine, on the occasion of Eid al-Fitr.

src: Ramadan is ook 'n tyd van innerlike refleksie, liefdadigheid en geestelike toewyding wanneer Moslems streef na geestelike groei en selfbeheersing.
tgt: Ramadan is also a time of inner reflection, charity and spiritual devotion when Muslims strive towards spiritual growth and self-control.

src: Die fees van Eid al-Fitr merk die hoogtepunt van die heilige maand van Ramadan, waartydens Moslems daagliks en onder uiterste omstandighede in Palestina gevas het.
tgt: The festival of Eid al-Fitr marks the culmination of the holy month of Ramadan, during which Muslims have fasted daily, and under extreme conditions in Palestine.

src: • Die Kompetisiekomissie van Suid-Afrika, wat twee pryse ingepalm het by die 2024 Antitrust Writing Awards in Washington DC en vir erkenning van sy toonaangewende aanlyn Intermediasie-platforms-markondersoek.
tgt: The Competition Commission of South Africa for winning two awards at the 2024 Antitrust Writing Awards held in Washington DC and for being recognised for its leading Online Intermediation Platforms Market Inquiry.

src: Die kommissie het dié prys gewen vir sy finale verslag en besluit, terwyl die ander prys vir 'n akademiese artikel oor mededingingsdinamika in Suid-Afrika se digitale markte vir reis en toerisme toegeken is.
tgt: It won an award for its final report and decision while the other award was for an academic article on competition dynamics in South Africa’s digital markets for travel and tourism.

src: Die Kabinet prys die miljoene belastingbetalers wat hul belastingopgawes ingedien het om die Suid-Afrikaanse Inkomstediens te help om belastinginkomste van R.155 triljoen vir die 2023/24 finansiële jaar in te vorder.
tgt: Issues from the Environment Economy Revenue collection Cabinet commends the millions of taxpayers who have filed their tax returns to help the South African Revenue Service collect tax revenue of R.155 trillion for the 2023/24 financial year.

src: Dit is R52 miljard meer as die vorige jaar en toon die kragtigheid van die plaaslike ekonomie, ondanks uitdagende plaaslike en internasionale toestande.
tgt: This is R52 billion more than the previous year and demonstrates the robustness of the local economy, despite challenging local and international conditions.

src: Die verhoogde inkomste help die regering om die land se diensleweringsprojekte en ander sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkelingsprogramme te finansier.
tgt: The increased revenue helps government to fund the country’s service-delivery projects and other socio-economic development programmes.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die opening van 'n Newlyn Park Bayhead Spoorwegterminaalprojek van R3,4 miljard by die Durbanhawe dit beslaan ‘n oppervlak van 640 000 vierkante meter met pakhuise, wisselspoorlyne en oop bergingsruimte.
tgt: Infrastructure investment Cabinet welcomed the opening of a R3,4 billion Newlyn Park Bayhead Rail Terminal project at the Port of Durban, which consists of 640 000 square metres of warehousing, rail sidings and open storage.

src: 1.Die nuwe terminaal sal die doeltreffende beweging van see-, spoor- en padvrag deur die Durbanhawe fasiliteer, en help om die onlangse uitdagings wat deur die logistieke, infrastruktuur- en netwerkbedryf ervaar word, die hoof te bied.
tgt: The new terminal will facilitate the efficient movement of sea, rail and road cargo through the Port of Durban, and help address the recent challenges experienced in the logistics, infrastructure and network industries.

src: Die belegging het gelei tot 4 013 direkte werksgeleeenthede vir konstruksiewerkers en die voltydse indiensneming van meer as 1 000 mense hierdie getal sal na verwagting groei namate die fasiliteit meer vrag hanteer.
tgt: The investment resulted in 4 013 direct construction jobs and the full-time employment of more than 1 000 people, with this number expected to grow as the facility handles more cargo.

src: In die herlewing van ons land se spoornetwerk, verwelkom die Kabinet ook die Passasierspooragentskap van Suid-Afrika (PRASA) se suksesvolle herstel van vyf belangrike Merorail-dienste regoor Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal en die Wes-Kaap.
tgt: In revitalising our country’s rail network, Cabinet also welcomed the Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa’s (PRASA) successful restoration of five crucial Metrorail services across Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal and the Western Cape.

src: PRASA het effektief 31 van sy 40 lyne herstel tot gedeeltelike werking en werk daaraan om volle operasionele status te bereik.
tgt: PRASA effectively brought 31 of its 40 lines back into partial operation and is working on achieving full operational status.

src: Die mylpaal toon die regering se verbintenis tot die herlewing van passasierspoordienste en die voorsiening van 'n doeltreffende openbare vervoeropsie vir Suid-Afrikaners.
tgt: The milestone demonstrates government’s commitment to revitalising passenger rail services and providing an efficient public transport option for South Africans.

src: In 'n verwante ontwikkeling, het die Kabinet die aankondiging deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Padagentskap dat hy meer as R50 miljard in padinfrastruktuurontwikkeling in die Oos-Kaap gaan inspuit, verwelkom.
tgt: In a related development, Cabinet welcomed the announcement by the South African National Roads Agency that it would inject over R50 billion into road infrastructure development in the Eastern Cape.

src: Hierdie infrastruktuurbelegging is gerig op die bou van nuwe fasiliteite, padverbeterings en -versterking, en spesiale instandhouding van die nasionale padnetwerk in die provinsie.
tgt: This infrastructure investment is geared towards the construction of new facilities, road improvements and strengthening, and special maintenance of the national road network in the province.

src: Belegging Die Kabinet het die opening van die nuwe Tetra Pak-fasiliteit in KwaZulu-Natal deur President Cyril Ramaphosa verwelkom, wat 'n belegging van R500 miljoen gelok het.
tgt: Investment Cabinet welcomed the opening of the new Tetra Pak facility in KwaZulu-Natal by President Cyril Ramaphosa, which attracted an investment of R500 million.

src: Die belegging vorm deel van die Presidensiële Beleggingsmobiliseringsveldtog waarvoor die regering in 2018 die ambisieuse teiken gestel het om R1,2 triljoen beleggings oor vyf jaar te lok.
tgt: The investment forms part of the Presidential Investment Mobilisation Drive where government set the ambitious target in 2018 to attract R1,2 trillion investments over five years.

src: Verlede jaar by die vyfde Suid-Afrikaanse Beleggingskonferensie, wat die einde van die eerste fases van ons beleggingsmobiliseringsiklus gemerk het, is meer as R1,5 triljoen in beleggingsverpligtinge ingesamel.
tgt: Last year at the fifth South Africa Investment Conference, which marked end of the first phases of our investment mobilisation cycle, more the R1,5 trillion in investment commitments were raised.

src: Hierdie beleggings herlei na nuwe fabrieke, werksgeleenthede in gemeenskappe en groter ekonomiese aktiwiteit regoor ons land.
tgt: These investments translate into new factories, jobs in communities and greater economic activity around our country.

src: Die Kabinet is vol vertroue dat ons beleggingsveldtog ekonomiese groei weer sal laat opvlam en ons ekonomie sal ophef.
tgt: Cabinet is confident that our investment drive will reignite economic growth and uplift our economy.

src: Werkloosheidsversekeringsfonds (WVF) se Arbeidsaktiverings-program (LAP)1.
tgt: Unemployment Insurance Fund (UIF) Labour Activation Programme (LAP) Cabinet welcomed the launch of the UIF-LAP, which is a skills training and entrepreneurship programme aimed at benefitting the youth and the unemployed in the country.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van die WVF-LAP, wat 'n vaardigheidsopleiding- en entrepreneurskapprogram is wat gerig is om die jeug en werkloses in die land te bevoordeel.
tgt: The programme ensures that youth and work seekers are equipped with the necessary skills to be employable and to establish their own businesses.

src: Die WVF-LAP, wat regoor die land in werking gestel sal word, sal na verwagting werksgeleenthede vir meer as 704 000 werklose mense skep.
tgt: The UIF-LAP, which will be rolled out across the country, is expected to create employment opportunities for over 704 000 unemployed people.

src: Dit sal gedoen word deur opleiding en klein-ondernemingsondersteuning aan 333 projekte regoor die land te bied.
