tgt: It will do so by providing training and small enterprise support to 333 projects across the country.

src: Sowat R23,8 miljard is opsygesit om die plan in werking te stel en werksgeleenthede sal tussen 12 en 36 maande duur.
tgt: About R.8 billion has been set aside to implement the plan and employment opportunities will run between 12 and 36 months.

src: 30 Jaar van Vryheid en Demokrasie.
tgt: 30 Years of Freedom and Democracy Cabinet welcomed the launch of the commemoration of 30 Years of Freedom and Democracy, which is being held under the theme: “30 years of Democracy, Partnership and Growth”.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van die herdenking van 30 Jaar van Vryheid en Demokrasie, wat gehou word onder die tema: ‘30 jaar van Demokrasie, Vennootskap en Groei’.
tgt: The launch also saw the unveiling of the official 30 Years of Freedom logo, which is a symbol that will unify us as we celebrate this significant milestone in the history of our country.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op almal om die amptelike logo wat vir gebruiksgemak in verskillende formate beskikbaar is op die GCIS-webwerf, te gebruik by: WEBTOKEN Die bekendstelling het die amptelike aanvang gemerk van die jaarlange aktiwiteite om die merkwaardige vordering wat ons sedert 1994 gemaak het deur 'n demokratiese samelewing te vestig wat gegrond is op die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996 en die Handves van Meseregtegte, te vier.
tgt: Cabinet called on everyone to use the official logo which is available in various formats for ease of use on the GCIS website at: WEBTOKEN The launch marked the official commencement of the year-long activities to celebrate the remarkable progress we have made since 1994 in establishing a democratic society based on the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996 and the Bill of Rights.

src: Hierdie belangrike gebeurtenis bied ook 'n geleentheid om na te dink oor die uitdagings waarvoor ons steeds te staan kom en om maniere te vind om dit te oorkom en ons land vorentoe te beweeg.
tgt: This momentous occasion is also an opportunity to reflect on the challenges that remain and find ways to overcome them and move our country forward.

src: Ons werk sedert 1994 daaraan om 'n samelewing te bou wat gegrond is op eenheid en samesyn, en hoewel daar nog baie uitdagings is, het toestande met elke dag wat verbygegaan het fundamenteel verbeter.
tgt: We have worked since 1994 to build a society based on unity and togetherness, and while many challenges still remain, conditions have fundamentally improved with each passing day.

src: Die aansienlike vordering wat ons sedert 1994 gemaak het, word weerspieël in Sensus 2022 en die 30-Jaaroorsig.
tgt: The great strides we have made since 1994 are reflected in Census 2022 and the 30 Year Review.

src: Albei skets 'n prentjie van 'n samelewing wat aan die beweeg is en wat verbeterings in die meeste aanwysers weerspieël.
tgt: Both paint a picture of a society on the move and which reflects improvements across most indicators.

src: Die bevindinge van die sensus en die 30-Jaaroorsig dui onweerlegbaar daarop dat ons ontwikkeling nie per toeval is nie, maar eerder met opset deur regeringsprogramme sedert 1994.
tgt: The findings of the Census and the 30 Year Review conclusively demonstrate that our development is not by chance, but rather by design from government programmes since 1994.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners en sektore van die samelewing om deel te neem aan die viering van 30 Jaar van Vryheid en Demokrasie.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans and sectors of society to participate in celebrating 30 Years of Freedom and Democracy.

src: Suid-Afrikaners kan deelneem deur hul stories te vertel oor hoe dit was om in apartheid-Suid-Afrika te leef en ons te help om voort te bou op die prestasies wat ons tot dusver behaal het.
tgt: South Africans can participate by telling their stories on what it was like to have lived in apartheid South Africa and help us to build on the achievements we have made so far.

src: Verenigde Nasies (VN) se Resolusie van die Meseregteraad Die Kabinet verwelkom die resolusie van die VN se Meseregteraad waarin gevra word dat Israel aanspreeklik gehou moet word vir moontlike oorlogsmisdade en misdade teen die mensdom wat in Gasa gepleeg is.
tgt: United Nations (UN) Human Rights Council Resolution Cabinet welcomes the UN Human Rights Council resolution calling for Israel to be held accountable for possible war crimes and crimes against humanity committed in Gaza.

src: Die resolusie het verder 'n beroep gedoen op alle State “om die verkoop, oordrag en afwending van wapens, ammunisie en ander militêre toerusting aan Israel te staak” Die aanvaarding van hierdie resolusie is geskiedkundig aangesien dit die heel eerste keer is dat die Meseregteraad tot aksie oorgegaan het oor die ongekende menslike tragedie wat in Gasa plaasvind, waar minstens 32 975 Palestyne gedood is, wat onder meer 14 500 kinders insluit, sedert Israel sy aanslag meer as 180 dae gelede geloods het.
tgt: The resolution further “called upon all States to cease the sale, transfer and diversion of arms, munitions and other military equipment to Israel”.

src: Alles is in gereedheid vir die 2024 Nasionale en Provinsiale verkiesings, na die ondertekening van die Verkiesingskommissie se Gedragskode deur politieke partye en onafhanklike kandidate.
tgt: 2024 General Elections It is all systems go for the 2024 National and Provincial Elections, following the signing of the Electoral Commission’s Code of Conduct by political parties and independent candidates.

src: Die algemene verkiesing sal op 29 Me 2024 gehou word en altesaam 325 politieke partye sal aan vanjaar se verkiesing deelneem.
tgt: The General Elections will be held on 29 May 2024 and in total 325 political parties will be taking part in this year’s elections.

src: Die Verkiesingsgedragskode verbind almal wat die verkiesing betwis om by die stel reëls te hou, wat daarop gerig is om vrye en regverdige verkiesings te verseker.
tgt: The Electoral Code of Conduct commits all those contesting the elections to abide by the set of rules that are meant to ensure free and fair elections.

src: Die Kabinet is vol vertroue dat ons nasie weereens sal voortbou op die diensrekord waarvolgens gereelde, geloofwaardige, vrye en regverdige nasionale en plaaslike verkiesings sedert 1994 gehou is.
tgt: Cabinet is confident that our nation will once again build on our track record of holding regular, credible and free and fair national and local elections since 1994.

src: Terwyl die land 30 Jaar van Vryheid vier, word burgers aangemoedig om hul demokratiese reg om te kan stem uit te oefen.
tgt: As the country celebrates 30 Years of Freedom, citizens are encouraged to exercise their democratic right and vote.

src: Nasionale Regeringsberaad oor Kunsmatige Intelligensie (KI) Spoedige vooruitgang in KI is 'n werklikheid en KI is spoedig besig om die wêreld te vorm wat dit dus noodsaak dat lande vir die impak daarvan op hul burgers en bestuurstelsels moet voorberei.
tgt: National Artificial Intelligence (AI) Government Summit Rapid advances in AI are a reality and AI is rapidly shaping the world, which necessitates that countries prepare for its impact on citizens and governance systems.

src: Die Nasionale KI-regeringsberaad is op 5 April 2024 in Johannesburg belê sodat die regering en die sektor 'n beleids- en regulatoriese raamwerk tot stand kan bring om vooruitgang in KI tot voordeel van die mense te rig en te benut.
tgt: The National AI Government Summit was convened in Johannesburg on 5 April 2024 for government and the sector to initiate a policy and regulatory framework to guide and leverage advances in AI for human good.

src: KI-beleid is die sleutel tot die bou van 'n sterk digitale ekosisteem waaruit regerings, besighede en individue voordeel kan trek.
tgt: AI policies are key to building a strong digital ecosystem in which governments, businesses and individuals can reap the benefits.

src: Die beraad is die eerste stap om 'n duidelike pad vorentoe te karteer om die mag van KI te benut om sommige van Suid-Afrika se ekonomiese en maatskaplike uitdagings die hoof te bied.
tgt: The summit is the first step in charting a clear way forward towards leveraging the power of AI to address some of South Africa’s economic and social challenges.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die ondertekening van die Wysigingswet op Geregtelike Aangeleenthede, 2023 (Wet 15 van 2023).
tgt: Crime and corruption Cabinet welcomed the signing into law of the Judicial Matters Amendment Act, 2023 (Act 15 of 2023).

src: Die Wet gee uitvoering aan die aanbeveling van die Staatskapingskommissie en skep 'n bykomende oortreding wat ingesluit moet word in die Wet op die Voorkoming en Bestryding van Korrupte Aktiwiteite, 2004 (Wet 12 van 2004) deur individue strafregtelik aanspreeklik te hou vir versuim om korrupsie te voorkom.
tgt: The Act gives effect to the recommendation of the State Capture Commission and creates an additional offence to be included in the Prevention and Combating of Corrupt Activities Act, 2004 (Act 12 of 2004) by holding individuals criminally liable for failure to prevent corruption.

src: Die Wet het verder ten doel om 'n aantal wette te wysig wat deur die Departement van Justisie en Grondwetlike Ontwikkeling geadministreer word, insluitend bevoegdhede, pligte en funksies van die Hoofmeester van die Hooggeregshof.
tgt: The Act further aims to amend a number of Acts which are administered by the Department of Justice and Constitutional Development including powers, duties and functions of the Chief Master.

src: Hierdie veranderinge sal die Hoofmeester van die Hooggeregshof in staat stel om 'n groter toesighoudende rol oor die Mesters van die hof te speel en sal lei tot verbeterde dienslewering aan die publiek en aan regspraktisyns.
tgt: These changes will allow the Chief Master to play a greater supervisory role over the Masters of the High Court and will lead to improved service delivery to the public and to legal practitioners.

src: Die Kabinet het opdrag ontvang oor die implementering van die omkeerstrategie vir die POF, wat daarop gemik is om die fondsestelsel te vereenvoudig, asook om die administrasie van voordele en uitbetalings aan ongelukslagoffers te verbeter.
tgt: Updates to cabinet The status of the Road Accident Fund (RAF) Cabinet received a briefing on the implementation of the turnaround strategy for the RAF, aimed at simplifying the funds system while also improving the administration of benefits and payouts to accident victims.

src: 'n Belangrike ingryping was die bekendstelling van die POF-kontaksentrum, wat 'n platform bied vir POF-eisers om toegang tot hul eise-inligting te kry sonder om noodwendig uitsluitlik op hul regsverteenwoordigers staat te maak.
tgt: A key intervention has been the launch of the RAF contact centre, which provides a platform for RAF claimants to have access to their claims information without having to solely rely on their legal representatives.

src: Die platform bied ook aan eisers die geleentheid om die betalings wat deur die POF aan hulle regsverteenwoordigers gemaak is te verfieer.
tgt: The platform also allows claimants the opportunity to verify the payments made by RAF to their legal representatives.

src: Die omkeerstrategie het gelei tot groot verbeterings in die skikking van eise binne 120 dae, dit het regskoste met 75 persent verlaag en mediese koste van R3,6 miljard in die 2019/20-boekjaar tot R2,1 miljard in die 2023/24-boekjaar getoon.
tgt: The turnaround strategy has resulted in major improvements in the settlements of claims within 120 days, reduced legal costs by 75 percent and has seen a reduction of medical costs from R.6 billion in the 2019/20 financial year to R.1 billion in the 2023/24 financial year.

src: Die ingrypings het ook gelei tot 'n kumulatiewe regskostebesparing van meer as R23 miljard in die drie jaar van die implementering van die strategie.
tgt: The interventions also led to a cumulative legal costs savings of over R23 billion in the three years of implementing the strategy.

src: Daarbenewens het die strategie-ingrypings gelei tot die vermindering van eise wat betaal is aan eisers/korttermynaanspreeklikheid tot R9,3 miljard vir die tydperk geëindig 31 Maart 2023.
tgt: Moreover, the strategy interventions resulted in the in the reduction of claims paid to claimants/ short term liability to R.3 billion for the period ending 31 March 2023.

src: Die Kabinet is ook op die hoogte gebring van wysigings aan die huidige POF-wet, wat in 'n gevorderde stadium is.
tgt: Cabinet was also updated on legislative amendments to the current RAF Act, which are at an advanced stage.

src: Die POF-wysigingswetsontwerp sal deur die 7de administrasie van die regering oorweeg word.
tgt: The RAF Amendment Bill will be considered by the 7th administration of government.

src: Die wetsontwerp is daarop gemik om die voordele en die betaling van sekere produkte in annuïteite te verfyn en dit meer billik te maak.
tgt: The bill is aimed at refining the benefits and the payment of certain products in annuities and making it equitable.

src: Witskrif oor Burgerskap, Immigrasie en Vlugtelingbeskerming Die Kabinet het die Witskrif oor Burgerskap, Immigrasie en Vlugtelingbeskerming vir implementering goedgekeur, nadat 'n wye raadplegingsproses deur die Departement van Binnelandse Sake in al nege provinsies onderneem is.
tgt: Cabinet decisions White Paper on Citizenship, Immigration and Refugee Protection Cabinet approved the White Paper on Citizenship, Immigration and Refugee Protection for implementation, following a wide consultation process undertaken by the Department of Home Affairs in all nine provinces.

src: Die beleid het ten doel om 'n raamwerk te verskaf om burgerskap, immigrasie en vlugtelingbeskerming te rig, met inagneming van die land se nasionale veiligheidsbelange en in ooreenstemming met internasionale ooreenkomste en protokolle oor migrasie waaraan Suid-Afrika deelneem.
tgt: The policy aims to provide a framework to guide citizenship, immigration and refugee protection, considering the country’s national security interests and in compliance with international agreements and protocols on migration that South Africa is party to.

src: Dit sal ook Suid-Afrika se ekonomiese belange, transformasie en werkskeppingpogings bevorder.
tgt: It will also promote South Africa’s economic interests, transformation and job creation efforts.

src: Op pad na ’n 30-Jaaroorsig van Suid-Afrika se Demokrasie (1994-2024).
tgt: Towards a 30-Year Review of South Africa’s Democracy (1994-2024).

src: Die Kabinet het die publikasie van die verslag "Towards a 30-Year Review of South Africa's Democracy (1994-2024)" goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the publication of the report “Towards a 30-Year Review of South Africa’s Democracy (1994-2024)”.

src: Die oorsigverslag lui die verhaal in van Suid-Afrika se oorgang na demokrasie sedert die geskiedkundige verkiesing van 27 April 1994.
tgt: The review report heralds the story of South Africa’s transition into democracy since the historical elections of 27 April 1994.

src: Suid-Afrika se verhaal van oorgang na demokrasie inspireer steeds hoop vir baie mense regoor die wêreld en die oorsigverslag beklemtoon belangrike lesse in die evolusie van ons demokrasie.
tgt: South Africa’s story of transition to democracy continues to inspire hope for many people around the world, and the review report highlights important lessons in the evolution of our democracy.

src: Oor die afgelope 30 jaar het die land 'n stabiele demokrasie verwerf met sterk instellings en 'n aansienlike wêreldwye invloed.
tgt: Over the last 30 years, the country has attained a stable democracy, with strong institutions and a considerable global influence.

src: Die 30-jaar-oorsigverslag is gestruktureer op 13 tematiese gebiede wat deur vier belangrike verwysings beïnvloed is, nl (1) die 1994-Heropbou- en Ontwikkelingsprogram en sy vyf doelwitte (2) die aanvaarding van die Grondwet van 1996 (3) die 2012 Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan en (4) die Meiumtermyn Strategiese Raamwerk 2019-2024 om sewe prioriteite van die sesde administrasie te weerspieël.
tgt: The 30-Year Review Report is structured on 13 thematic areas informed by four important references (1) the 1994 Reconstruction and Development Programme and its five objectives (2) the 1996 adoption of the Constitution (3) the 2012 National Development Plan and (4) the Medium-Term Strategic Framework 2019-2024 to reflect seven priorities of the sixth administration.

src: Die oorsigverslag sal deur die Departement van Beplanning, Monitering en Evaluering gepubliseer word en lede van die gemeenskap sal 'n geleentheid kry om hulself by die verslag te betrek.
tgt: The review report will be published by the Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation and members of society will have an opportunity to engage the report.

src: Toekomstige Gebeure 6de Statebond Konferensie van die die Rooikruis en die Rooi Sekelmaan oor Internasionale Humanitêre Reg.1 Suid-Afrika en die Internasionale Komitee van die Rooikruis sal van 15 tot 19 April 2024 die 6de Rooikruis en Rooi Sekelmaan Statebondskonferensie oor Internasionale Humanitêre Reg in Suid-Afrika by die Irene Country Lodge in Pretoria aanbied.
tgt: Upcoming Events 6th Commonwealth Red Cross and Red Crescent Conference on International Humanitarian Law South Africa and the International Committee of the Red Cross will co-host the 6th Red Cross and Red Crescent Commonwealth Conference on International Humanitarian Law in South Africa from 15 to 19 April 2024 at the Irene Country Lodge in Pretoria.

src: Die konferensie sal verteenwoordigers van die Statebondlidlande, lede van die Rooi Kruis- en Rooi Sekelmaan-beweging en ander belangrike belanghebbendes byeen bring om oor Internasionale Mesereg te beraadslaag.2 Die konferensie poog om bestaande menseregte-instrumente te herkalibreer en te versterk en ons kennis oor die belangrikheid van Internasionale Mesereg te verdiep in 'n era van verhoogde gewapende konflikte, sowel as klimaatsverandering, voedselonsekerheid en toenemende gedwonge verplasing.
tgt: The conference will bring together representatives of Commonwealth Member States, members of the Red Cross and Red Crescent movement, and other key stakeholders to deliberate on International Human Law.

src: Boodskappe GelukwenseDie Kabinet dra sy gelukwense en goeie wense oor aan: • Die Minister van Gesondheid Dr Joe Phaahla vir sy aanstelling in die Raad van die Global Fund met ingang van 1 Me 2024.
tgt: The conference seeks to recalibrate and strengthen existing human rights instruments and deepen our knowledge on the importance of International Human Law in an era of increased armed conflicts as well as climate change, food insecurity and growing displacement.

src: Dr Phaahla sal as 'n verteenwoordiger van die Oos- en Suider-Afrikastreek dien.
tgt: Dr Phaahla will serve as a representative of the East and Southern Africa region.

src: • Suid-Afrikaanse Moslems, sowel as wêreldwyd, veral in Palestina, by geleentheid van Eid al-Fitr.
tgt: South Africans Muslims as well as those across the globe, especially in Palestine, on the occasion of Eid al-Fitr.

src: Ramadan is ook 'n tyd van innerlike refleksie, liefdadigheid en geestelike toewyding wanneer Moslems streef na geestelike groei en selfbeheersing.
tgt: Ramadan is also a time of inner reflection, charity and spiritual devotion when Muslims strive towards spiritual growth and self-control.

src: Die fees van Eid al-Fitr merk die hoogtepunt van die heilige maand van Ramadan, waartydens Moslems daagliks en onder uiterste omstandighede in Palestina gevas het.
tgt: The festival of Eid al-Fitr marks the culmination of the holy month of Ramadan, during which Muslims have fasted daily, and under extreme conditions in Palestine.

src: • Die Kompetisiekomissie van Suid-Afrika, wat twee pryse ingepalm het by die 2024 Antitrust Writing Awards in Washington DC en vir erkenning van sy toonaangewende aanlyn Intermediasie-platforms-markondersoek.
tgt: The Competition Commission of South Africa for winning two awards at the 2024 Antitrust Writing Awards held in Washington DC and for being recognised for its leading Online Intermediation Platforms Market Inquiry.

src: Die kommissie het dié prys gewen vir sy finale verslag en besluit, terwyl die ander prys vir 'n akademiese artikel oor mededingingsdinamika in Suid-Afrika se digitale markte vir reis en toerisme toegeken is.
tgt: It won an award for its final report and decision while the other award was for an academic article on competition dynamics in South Africa’s digital markets for travel and tourism.

src: Die eerste formele Kabinetsvergadering van die 7de administrasie het twee dae voor die viering van Nasionale Vroudag, by die Uniegebou in Pretoria plaasgevind.
tgt: The first normal Cabinet meeting of the 7th administration took place at the Union Buildings, Pretoria, two days before the country commemorates of the National Women’s Day.

src: Ons vier die 68ste herdenking van die Vroue-optog en 70 jaar sedert die aanvaarding van die Vrouehandves, 'n verklaring van voorneme deur die Federasie van Suid-Afrikaanse Vroue, wat die regte en voorregte vir vroue deur vroue van Suid-Afrika duidelik omskryf.
tgt: As we mark the 68th anniversary of the Women’s March and 70 years since the adoption of the Women’s Charter, a declaration of intent by the Federation of South African Women, which clearly defined the rights and privileges for women by women of South Africa.

src: Vanjaar vier ons nie net Vrouemaand nie, maar ook die toonaangewende aanstelling van regter Mandisa Maya, die eerste vroulike hoofregter van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika.
tgt: This year, we celebrate Women’s Month as we also celebrate the appointment of Justice Mandisa Maya on her trail blazing appointment as South Africa’s first female Chief Justice of the Republic of South Africa.

src: Sy het ook sedert 2017 met onderskeiding as die president van die Hoër Hof van Appèl gedien en was die eerste vrou wat dié pos beklee het.
tgt: She also previously served with distinction as the President of the Supreme Court of Appeal since 2017 and was the first woman to hold that position.

src: Haar aanstelling is veral betekenisvol in die konteks van die volgende gegewens deur die International Association of Women Judges: "In 1994 was daar ongeveer 165 regters, waarvan 160 wit mans was, drie was swart mans en twee was wit vroue geen swart vroue was destyds regters nie.
tgt: According to the International Association of Women Judges: “In 1994, there were approximately 165 judges, 160 of whom were white men, three were black men, and two were white women no black women were judges at that time.

src: Vanaf Februarie 2023 is daar 253 regters, waarvan 113 vroue is omgeskakel na persentasies is 32% swart vroue en 13% wit vroue wat altesaam op 45% vroueverteenwoordiging dui.
tgt: As of February 2023, there are 253 judges, comprised of which 113 are women, broken down to 32% black women plus 13% white women making up a total of 45% women representation.

src: Boonop bestaan die oorblywende 140 manlike regters uit 39% swart mans en 17% wit mans.
tgt: Additionally, the remaining 140 male judges are comprised of 39% black men and 17% white men.”

src: "Kwessies in die omgewing 2024 Olympiese Spele in Parys: Suid-Afrika se span.
tgt: Issues in the environment 2024 Paris Olympics: Team South Africa Cabinet congratulated Team South Africa for proudly representing the country at the Paris Olympics and flying the national flag high with the country in the top 30 nations for total medals received.

src: Die Kabinet wens weereens die volgende spanlede geluk:1.
tgt: Cabinet once more congratulates:1.

src: Die swemsensasie Tatjana Smith vir haar goue medalje in die 100m-borsslag vir vroue en silwermedalje in die 200m-borsslag.
tgt: Swimming sensation, Tatjana Smith for winning gold in the Women’s 100m Breaststroke and silver in the 200m Breaststroke.

src: Die Blitsbokke vir hul brondsmedalje in die sewesrugby vir mans.
tgt: The Blitzboks for winning bronze in the Men’s Rugby Sevens.

src: Bergfietsryer Alan Hatherly vir sy bronsmedalje in die bergfietsry-item vir mans.
tgt: Mountain-biker Alan Hatherly for winning bronze during the Men’s Cross-country Cycling Mountain Bike.

src: Akani Simbine, wat ’n nuwe nasionale rekord opgestel het toe hy die 4de plek in die mans 100m senutergende finaal verower het.
tgt: Akani Simbine who set a new national record when he secured a 4th place finish in the men’s 100m nail-biting final.

src: Suid-Afrika tel onder een van die lande met die vinnigste mans.
tgt: South Africa is counted within countries with fastest men.

src: Ons doen ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om ook die Suid-Afrikaanse span wat in die Paralimpiese Spele van 28 Augustus tot 8 September 2024 meeding, te ondersteun.
tgt: South Africans are called upon to continue to support Team South Africa which will also be competing in the Paralympic Games that will take place from the 28th August until 8th September 2024.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die Passasierspoorwegagentskap van Suid-Afrika (PRASA), ’n agent van die Departement van Vervoer (DoT), se bekendstelling van die nuwe hoë-tegnologie treine op die Sentrale Spoor in Kaapstad.
tgt: Economy Rail Infrastructure Cabinet welcomed the introduction of new high-tech trains on the Central Line in the City of Cape Town by the Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa (PRASA), an agency of the Department of Transport (DoT).

src: Die roete is verleng van Nyanga- tot Mandalay-stasie.
tgt: The service has been extended from Nyanga to Mandalay station.

src: Moderne seinstelsels word vanaf Langa tot by die Mutual-spoor gebruik om die veiligheid en betroubaarheid van die spoordiens te verbeter.
tgt: The trains utilises modern signaling system from Langa to Mutual Line, to enhance the safety and reliability of the rail service.

src: Die moderne hoëtegnologiefunksies sluit outomatiese deure en kringtelevisie vir elke wa in om passasiersveiligheid te verbeter.
tgt: The modern hi-tech features in these trains include automated doors, and CCTVs for each coach are for improved passenger safety.

src: Die Kabinet loof ook die herstel van meer spoorlyne as deel van die regering se prioriteit om veilige, betroubare en bekostigbare openbare vervoer te verskaf.
tgt: Cabinet further commended the recovery of more rail lines part of government’s priority of providing safe, reliable and affordable public transport.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die jongste toevoeging van die Suid-Afrikaanse menseregte- en bevrydingstrydterreine tot die gesogte lys van UNESCO se wêrelderfenisgebiede.
tgt: UNESCO’s World Heritage Sites Cabinet welcomed the latest addition of the South African human rights and liberation struggle sites in the prestigious list of UNESCO’S World Heritage Sites.

src: Die terreine, wat Meseregte, Bevryding en Versoening: Nelson Mandela-erfenisterreine genoem word, dra nie net daartoe by om ons unieke erfenis te bewaar nie, maar verhoog ook ons land se posisie as ’n vooraanstaande toeriste-aantreklikheid vir wêrelderfenisgebiede, wat nie net toerisme nie, maar ook die ekonomie 'n hupstoot gee.
tgt: The sites termed as The Human Rights, Liberation and Reconciliation: Nelson Mandela Legacy Sites, not only help preserve our unique heritage but catapults our country to prominence as a major tourist attraction for World Heritage Sites, thereby boosting tourism and the economy.

src: Dit sluit die Uniegebou, Constitution Hill, Liliesleaf-plaas, die Sharpeville-gedenkteken, Walter Sisulu-plein, 16 Junie 1976: Die strate van Orlando-Wes, die Universiteit van Fort Hare en die ZK Mathews-huis, Mqhekezweni, Waaihoek en Ohlange in.
tgt: It includes the Union Buildings, Constitution Hill, Liliesleaf farm, Sharpeville memorial, Walter Sisulu Square, 16 June 1976: The Streets of Orlando West, University of Fort Hare and ZK Mathews House, Mqhekezweni, Waaihoek and Ohlange.

src: Die UNESCO-wêrelderfeniskomitee het verder drie terreine in die Middelsteentydperk toegevoeg ter erkenning aan Suid-Afrika se belangrike bydrae tot kennis oor die oorsprong van moderne menslike gedrag.
tgt: The UNESCO World Heritage Committee further inscribed three Middle Stone Age sites in recognition of South Africa’s significant contribution to the understanding of the origins of modern human behaviour.

src: Dit sluit in die Diepkloof-rotsskuiling naby Elandsbaai in die Wes-Kaap Pinnacle Point-terreinkompleks in Mosselbaai, ook in die Wes-Kaap en Sibhudu-grot in KwaDukuza, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: These are Diepkloof Rock Shelter close to Elands Bay in the Western Cape, Pinnacle Point Site Complex in Mossel Bay also in the Western Cape and Sibhudu Cave in KwaDukuza, KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Halfjaarbevolkingsberamings Die Kabinet verwelkom die halfjaarbevolkingsberamings (MYPE) vir 2024, wat daarop dui dat Suid-Afrikaners langer leef.
tgt: Mid-Year Population Estimates Cabinet welcomed the Mid-Year Population Estimates (MYPE) for 2024 which showed that South Africans are living longer.

src: Die lewensverwagting het van 53,6 jaar in 2005, tot 66,5 jaar in 2024 toegeneem.
tgt: Life expectancy has increased to 66,5 years from 53,6 years in 2005 as a result of multiple government interventions that included the expanded rollout of antiretroviral therapy - which is one of the largest antiretroviral therapy programme in the world, the provision of vaccinations and the decrease in the infant mortality rate from an estimated 57 infant deaths per 1,000 live births in 2002 to 22,9 per 1,000 live births in 2024.

src: Suid-Afrika se bevolking oorskry nou 63 miljoen en het van Julie 2023 tot Julie 2024 met 1,33% gegroei.
tgt: South Africa’s population now exceeded 63 million, growing 1,33 percent from July 2023 to July 2024.

src: Die bygewerkte bevolkingsgroeisyfers sal die regering help met beplanning en toewysing van hulpbronne terwyl die regering voordurend daarna streef om alle Suid-Afrikaners se lewens te verbeter.
tgt: The updated population growth figures will assist government in its planning and resource allocation as we continue to better the life of all South Africans.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die voortgesette sukses van wetstoepassingsagentskappe in die stryd teen misdaad dit sluit onder meer die inhegtenisneming van lede van georganiseerde misdaadsindikate en bendes in as deel van misdaadbestryding.
tgt: Safety and Security Fight against Crime Cabinet welcomed the continued successes of law enforcement agencies in the arrest of members of organised crime syndicates and gangs as part of the ongoing fight against crime.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens se Operasie Shanela het tot die inhegtenisneming van 766 237 verdagtes vir verskeie misdade, gelei, waarvan 161 752 verdagtes van prioriteitsmisdade was dit sluit onder meer moord, transitorooftogte, gewapende rooftogte, verkragting en motorkaping in.
tgt: Operation Shanela of the South African Police Service has also ensured the arrest of 766 237 suspects for various crimes, and 161 752 of these were suspects wanted for priority crimes, including murder, cash-in-transit heists, armed robberies, rape, car hijacking amongst others.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die sluiting van 'n onwettige militêre opleidingskamp in Witrivier, Mpumalanga ná 'n intelligensiegedrewe multidissiplinêre wetstoepassingsoperasie wat ook tot die inhegtenisneming van 95 Libiese burgers gelei het.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the shutting down of an illegal military training camp in White River, Mpumalanga following an intelligence-driven multidisciplinary law enforcement operation which has also resulted in the arrest of 95 Libyan nationals.

src: Die Kabinet herhaal 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om met wetstoepassingsagentskappe saam te werk in die stryd teen misdaad sonder om onoordeelkundig op te tree.
tgt: Cabinet has reiterated a call to all South Africans to partner with law enforcement agencies in the fight against crime without resorting to vigilantism.

src: Die Kabinet het die optrede van sommige gemeenskapsleiers wat neerkom op die bedreiging van leerders en onderwysers by hul skole veroordeel.
tgt: Cabinet has taken a dim view of actions by some community leaders that amounted to threatening of learners and teachers at their school.

src: Die Departement van Basiese Onderwys sal voortgaan om met die SAPD saam te werk om te verseker dat skole veilige ruimtes vir leer en onderrig bly.
tgt: The Department of Basic Education will continue to work with the SAPS to ensure schools remain safe spaces for learning and teaching.

src: Die Kabinet is tevrede met die skuldigbevinding en vonnisoplegging deur die Durbanse gespesialiseerde handelsmisdaadhof van voormalige amptenare van die Departement van Binnelandse Sake en buitelandse burgers wat skuldig bevind is aan die pleeg van bedrog en korrupsie teen die immigrasiestelsel.
tgt: Fraud and Corruption Cabinet is pleased with the conviction and sentencing, by the Durban Specialised Commercial Crimes Court, of former officials of the Department of Home Affairs and foreign nationals who were found guilty of committing fraud and corruption against the immigration system.

src: Die suksesvolle skuldigbevinding versterk die regering se pogings om 'n etiese, professionele en bekwame ontwikkelingstaat te bou.
tgt: The successful convictions bolster government’s efforts of building an ethical, professional, and capable developmental state.

src: Inligting oor nuwe verwikkelings aan die Kabinet Watersekerheid.
tgt: Updates to Cabinet Water Security Cabinet was briefed about the initiatives underway to ensure water security in the country given the increasing demand for water due to population and economic growth, and the fact that 75% of available surface water resources in South Africa have already been captured.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor inisiatiewe wat in werking gestel word om watersekerheid in die land te verseker gegewe die toenemende vraag na water weens bevolkings- en ekonomiese groei, asook die feit dat 75% van die beskikbare oppervlakwaterbronne in Suid-Afrika reeds opgevang is.
tgt: Currently, there are 14 major national surface water resources infrastructure projects to the value of more than R100 billion in different stages of development.

src: Daar is tans 14 groot nasionale hulpbroninfrastruktuurprojekte vir oppervlakwater ter waarde van meer as R100 miljard in verskillende ontwikkelingsfases.
tgt: The Department of Water and Sanitation has established a Water Partnerships Office together with SALGA and the DBSA aimed at assisting municipalities to drive initiatives to diversify and develop alternative water resources to ensure water security into the future.

src: Die Departement van Water en Sanitasie het 'n Kantoor vir Watervennootskappe saam met SALGA en die DBSA gestig dit is daarop gerig om munisipaliteite te help om inisiatiewe te dryf wat alternatiewe waterbronne sal diversifiseer en ontwikkel om watersekerheid in die toekoms te verseker.
tgt: Cabinet was also updated about the progress to ensure water supply to the residents of Givani and Hammanskraal and addressing the sewerage spills in the Emfuleni Municipality.

src: Die Kabinet is ook op die hoogte gebring van die vordering om watervoorsiening aan die inwoners van Giyani en Hammanskraal te verseker en om aandag te gee aan die rioolstortings in die Emfuleni-munisipaliteit.
tgt: Cabinet was informed that water has started to flow to nine (9) villages under the Greater Giyani Municipality and a further 15 villages will receive water by end of August 2024.

src: Die Kabinet is voorts ingelig dat water na nege (9) dorpe onder die Groter Giyani Munisipaliteit begin vloei het 'n verdere 15 dorpe sal teen einde Augustus 2024 water kry.
tgt: The Mopani District Municipality has received grant funding to refurbish and increase the capacity of the Giyani Water Treatment Works.

src: Die Mopani-distriksmunisipaliteit het befondsing ontvang om die Giyani-watersuiweringswerke op te knap en die kapasiteit te verhoog.
tgt: The Department in collaboration with the City of Tshwane and Magalies Water are completing a Magalies Water project to provide an alternative source of drinking water to Hammanskraal in the City of Tshwane by October 2024, whilst the City of Tshwane continue to repair and upgrade the Rooiwal Wastewater Treatment Works.

src: Die Departement in samewerking met die Stad Tshwane en Magalies Water is besig met 'n Magalies Water-projek wat teen Oktober 2024 'n alternatiewe bron van drinkwater aan Hammanskraal in die Stad Tshwane sal voorsien.
tgt: Given the increasing challenges of water supply in the country, the DWS will provide fortnightly briefings on progress with addressing water insecurity and measures the communities must undertake to ensure water security in our water scarce country.

src: Die EAP se voortgesette fokus op beplande instandhouding en werk om energiesekerheid te bewerkstellig deur nuwe opwekkingskapasiteit aan boord te bring, het grootliks bygedra tot volhoubare kragvoorsiening en geen beurtkrag oor etlike maande nie.
tgt: Trade 21st AGOA FORUM Cabinet was appraised of the successful participation of South Africa’s delegation in the 21st Africa Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) Forum in the United States as a positive confirmation of good bilateral relations between our country and the USSouth Africa continues to advance a case for the renewal of the Africa Growth and Opportunity Act, which expires in 14 months, and supports calls by African Trade Ministers for the US government to do away with the annual reviews of AGOSA – EU citrus disputes in the WTO Cabinet was also briefed about a formal dispute the country initiated with the World Trade Organisation against the European Union’s (EU) stringent and unnecessary plant health requirements regarding Citrus Black Spot (CBS) and False Codling Moth (FMC) regulations on the export of South Africa’s citrus products to the EU South Africa is the world’s second largest exporter of citrus and 33% of SA’s citrus exports are destined for the EU market.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging se suksesvolle deelname aan die 21ste Forum van die Africa Growth and Opportunity Act (Agoa) in die Verenigde State, as 'n positiewe bevestiging van goeie bilaterale betrekkinge tussen ons land en die VSSuid-Afrika bevorder steeds sy saak vir die hernuwing van die Wet op Groei en Geleenthede in Afrika, wat oor 14 maande verstryk, en ondersteun oproepe deur Afrika se ministers van handel dat die Amerikaanse regering moet wegdoen met die jaarlikse oorsigte van Agoa.
tgt: International Relations Cabinet welcomed the ICJ’s Advisory Opinion on the Legal Consequences arising from the Policies and Practices of Israel in the Occupied Palestinian Territories which unanimously affirmed that Israel’s continued presence in the Occupied Palestinian Territories is unlawful under international law.

src: SA – EU sitrusdispuut in die WHDie Kabinet is ingelig oor 'n formele dispuut wat die land met die Wêreldhandelsorganisasie teen die Europese Unie (EU) se streng en onnodige plantgesondheidsvereistes rakende Sitrus-Black Spot (CBS) en False Codling Moth (FMC) se regulasies oor die uitvoer van Suid-Afrikaanse sitrusprodukte na die EU ingestel het.
tgt: The judgement creates an additional legal obligation for all states to end complicity in Israel’s illegal actions and to act to ensure respect for international law.

src: Suid-Afrika is die wêreld se tweede grootste uitvoerder van sitrus met 33% van die land se sitrusuitvoere wat vir die EU-mark bestem is.
tgt: South Africa was amongst 49 UN member states that delivered a statement on the matter to the ICJ in February 2024.

src: Suid-Afrika se bedryf verskaf direkte werk aan meer as 140 000 mense in landelike Suid-Afrika en ondersteun sodoende meer as 1,5 miljoen mense.
tgt: Unrests in Kenya and Nigeria Cabinet raised concerns with the continuing unrests in Kenya and Nigeria and urged all parties to find urgent solutions to the plight of citizens with the high cost of living, which South Africa is not spared from.

src: Internasionale betrekkinge.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die Internasionale Geregshof se raadgewende mening oor die regsgevolge wat voortspruit uit die beleid en praktyke van Israel in die besette Palestynse gebiede, wat eenparig bevestig het dat Israel se voortgesette teenwoordigheid in die besette Palestynse gebiede onwettig is onder internasionale reg.2 Die uitspraak skep 'n bykomende wetlike verpligting vir alle state om medepligtigheid aan Israel se onwettige optrede te beëindig en om deur hul optrede respek vir die internasionale reg te toon.3 Suid-Afrika was een van 49 VN-lidlande wat in Februarie 2024 'n verklaring oor die aangeleentheid aan die Internasionale Geregshof gerig het.
tgt: South Africa’s Candidature to multilateral bodies Cabinet has endorsed the South Africa’s candidature to multilateral bodies: The candidacy of Ms Swazi Bajabulile Tshabalala for the Presidency of the African Development Bank (AfDB) for the term 2025-2030, at the elections taking place in August 2024.

src: Onrus in Kenia en Nigerië4.1 Die Kabinet het sy kommer uitgespreek oor die voortslepende onrus in Kenia en Nigerië en het alle partye aangemoedig om dringende oplossings te vind vir die lot van burgers weens die hoë lewenskoste, waarvan Suid-Afrika ook nie gespaar word nie.
tgt: The candidacy of Ms Yvette van der Merwe for the President of the Organisation of Vine and Wine (OIV) at elections to be held in France in October 2024.

src: Suid-Afrika se kandidatuur aan multilaterale liggame.1 Die Kabinet onderskryf Suid-Afrika se kandidatuur aan multilaterale liggame:.1 Die kandidatuur van me Swazi Bajabulile Tshabalala vir president van die Afrika Ontwikkelingsbank (AfDB) vir die termyn 2025-2027, tydens ’n verkiesing wat in Augustus 2024 plaasvind.
tgt: South Africa seeks the re-election of its candidates, Profssor Frans Jacobus Viljoen to the UN Human Rights Advisory Committee for the period 2025-2027, at elections scheduled for October 2024 in New York, USSouth Africa is also seeking terms on the UN’s Commission on the Status of Women (CSW) in 2025 and the Commission for Social Development in 2025.

src: Verkiesings vir albei liggame sal in April 2025 plaasvind.
tgt: Elections for both bodies will take place in April 2025.

src: Suid-Afrika sal verkiesing tot die VN se Veiligheidsraad vir ’n tweejaartermyn aanvra vir die tydperk 2031-2032, wanneer dit Suider Afrika se beurt sal wees.
tgt: South Africa will seek elections to the UN Security Council for a two-year term for the period 2031-2032, when it will be the turn of Southern Africa.

src: Voorbereiding vir Suid-Afrika se presidentskap van die G207.1 Suid-Afrika sal die presidentskap van die G20 vanaf 1 Desember 2024 oorneem.
tgt: Preparations for South Africa’s Presidency of the G20 South Africa will take over the Presidency of the G20 from the 1st of December 2024 Cabinet received an update on the preparations for South Africa’s G20 Presidency and the hosting of the G20 Summit in 2025.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die voorbereidings vir Suid-Afrika se G20-presidentskap en die aanbieding van die G20-beraad in ’n Interministeriële komitee sal namens die regering en Suid-Afrikaners verantoordelik wees om hierdie geleentheid te reël.4 Suid-Afrika sal voortgaan om geleenthede aan te gryp om internasionale forums soos die G20 te lei en aan te bied aangesien dit wêreldwyd aandag vestig op die ontwikkelingsuitdagings wat Afrika en die lande van die globale Suide in die gesig staar.
tgt: An Inter- Ministerial Committee has been assigned the responsibility to organise this event on behalf of government and South Africans.

src: Toekomstige gebeure1 Vrouemaand Nasionale Vrouedag word vanjaar op 9 Augustus 2024 gevier by die Dennis Nel Stadion op Pofadder in die Noord-Kaap met die tema: “Vier 300 jaar van demokrasie vir die ontwikkeling van vroue”.
tgt: South Africa will continue to use opportunities to lead and host international forums such as the G20 to focus global attention to the development challenges confronting Africa and the countries of the global South.

src: Ons nasie bring hulde aan die meer as 20 000 vroue wat op 9 Augustus 1956 na die Uniegebou opgeruk het uit protes teen die uitbreiding van paswette rakende vroue.
tgt: 1 Women’s Month The country will commemorate the 2024 National Women’s Day on 9 August 2024 at the Dennis Nel Stadium, Poffader in the Northern Cape under the theme: “Celebrating 30 years of democracy towards Women’s Development”.

src: Die Kabinet nooi burgers om deel te wees van die geleenthede wat tydens Vrouemaand aangebied word.
tgt: This year’s celebration of Women’s Month will take stock of progress made on socio-economic empowerment of women since the advent of democracy and the achievements of the objectives of the Women’s Charter.

src: Dit sluit onder meer ook 'n handelsuitstalling, interaktiewe dialoë en geleenthede in wat vir vroue in uiteenlopende sektore beskikbaar is en instrumenteel is om geslagsongelykheid te beperk.
tgt: Cabinet invites citizens to be part of the events of the month which will also include a trade expo, interactive dialogues and showcase opportunities available for women in diverse sectors that are instrumental in narrowing gender disparities.

src: 2 32ste Algemene Vergadering van die Internasionale Sterrekunde-unie (IAU) Suid-Afrika bied vanjaar die wêreld se grootste sterrekundevergadering, naamlik die 32ste Algemene Vergadering van die Internasionale Sterrekunde-unie (IAU), in Kaapstad aan.
tgt: 32nd General Assembly of the International Astronomy Union (IAU) South Africa is hosting the world’s largest astronomy meeting, the 32nd General Assembly of the International Astronomy Union (IAU), in Cape Town.

src: Die vergadering strek oor ’n tydperk van twee weke vanaf 6 Augustus 2024 en is die eerste konferensie vir die internasionale sterrekundegemeenskap wat op die vasteland van Afrika gehou word.3 Dié vergadering speel 'n belangrike rol om Suid-Afrika te help om van 'n hulpbrongebaseerde ekonomie na 'n kennisgebaseerde ekonomie oor te skakel.
tgt: The meeting is convened over two weeks from 6 August 2024 and marks the first time a conference for the international astronomy community is taking place on the African continent.

src: Suid-Afrika het oor die jare vordering gemaak met sterrekunde-ontwikkeling en sterrekundeverwante aktiwiteite, wat groot wetenskaplike projekte soos die SKA en die MerKAT ingelui het.
tgt: These engagements play an important role in assisting South Africa move from a resource-based economy to a knowledge-based economy.

src: 3 Money Smart-week Suid-Afrika.1 Die 2024 Money Smart-week Suid-Afrika (MSWSA) word van 26 Augustus 2024 tot 1 September 2024 aangebied met verskeie verbruikersgerigte finansiële opvoedingsprogramme en inisiatiewe.2 MSWSA is 'n inisiatief van die Nasionale Verbruiker Finansiële Onderwyskomitee (NCFEC) wat daarop gerig is om Suid-Afrikaners te motiveer, te bemagtig en op te voed, en om by te dra tot meer finansieel geletterde burgers.3 Aktiwiteite wat tydens die veldtog aangebied word sluit in gratis werksessies, inligtingsessies, winkelsentrum-aktiverings, uitstallings en webinaars.
tgt: South Africa has over the years made inroads in astronomy development and astronomy-related activities, heralding large science projects like the SKA and the MeerKAMoney Smart Week South Africa The 2024 Money Smart Week South Africa (MSWSA) will run from 26 August 2024 to 1 September 2024 featuring various consumer-focused financial education programmes and initiatives.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing Die bou van ŉ veiliger Suid-Afrika Stryd teen misdaad.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die nuus van die inhegtenisname van ŉ 40-jarige verdagte wat vermoedelik een van die leiers is van ŉ ontvoering-vir-losprys-sindikaat wat sakepersone in Suid-Afrika teiken.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the arrest of a 40-year-old suspect believed to be one of the ringleaders behind a kidnapping-for-ransom syndicate that is targeting businesspeople in South Africa.

src: Hy is ook vermoedelik ŉ sleutelfiguur agter die smokkel van kristalmet oftewel “tik” ter waarde van R300-miljoen waarop onlangs in die Johannesburgse voorstede Fourways en Bruma beslag gelê is.
tgt: He is also suspected to be a key figure in the R300 million crystal meth drugs seized recently at the Johannesburg suburbs of Fourways and in Bruma.

src: Die inhegtenisname beklemtoon die regering se toewyding daartoe om beslissend teen georganiseerde misdaad op te tree.
tgt: This arrest underscores government’s commitment to decisively deal with organised crime.

src: .2 Die Kabinet ondersteun die ontplooïng van multidissiplinêre wetstoepassingspanne om die hoë misdaadsyfer-situasie wat tans in die Oos-Kaap heers, aan te spreek.
tgt: Cabinet supports the deployment of multidisciplinary law enforcement teams to deal with the high crime rate situation that is prevailing in the Eastern Cape.

src: Die multidissiplinêre spanne sluit in personeel wat spesialiseer in anti-georganiseerde misdaad, gespesialiseerde operasies en intelligensiepersoneel.
tgt: The multidisciplinary teams include anti organised crime, specialised operations and intelligence operatives.

src: Die Kabinet herhinner wetstoepassingsowerhede weereens dat gemeenskappe nie deur misdadigers gyselaar gehou mag word nie.3 Die Kabinet verwelkom ook die inhegtenisname van ŉ verdagte wat met 34 paspoorte in sy besit deur die grensbestuursowerheid by die Lebombo-grenspos na Mosambiek gestop is.
tgt: Cabinet also welcomed the arrest of the suspect found in possession of 34 passports by the Border Management Agency’s (BMA) at the Lebombo Port of Entry to Mozambique.

src: Dit vorm deel van voortgesette pogings om kriminele sindikate wat handel in onwettige immigrasie en wat ons grenskontrole en immigrasiewetgewing probeer omseil, uit te dryf.4 Die stryd teen misdaad bly ŉ gedeelde verantwoordelikheid tussen die polisie, gemeenskappe en alle sektore van die samelewing, en die Kabinet spoor landsburgers weereens aan om saam met wetstoepassingsagentskappe te werk om misdaad in ons gemeenskappe te beveg.
tgt: This is part of continued efforts to stem out illegal immigration criminal syndicates that seek to undermine our border controls and immigration laws.

src: Stryd teen geslagsgebaseerde geweld en vrouemoord (GGGV)1.
tgt: Fight against gender-based violence and femicide (GBVF)1.

src: Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op die mans van ons nasie om president Cyril Ramaphosa se inisiatief te ondersteun en ŉ standpunt in te neem teen GGGV deur die virtuele belofte te onderteken by WEBTOKEN Deur hierdie belofte te onderteken, verbind mans hulle daartoe om deel te wees van die oplossing deur positiewe gedrag en houdings teenoor vroue te handhaaf en verantwoordelikheid te neem vir hul aksies.
tgt: Cabinet calls on the men of our nation to join the initiative by President Cyril Ramaphosa to take a stand against GBVF by signing the virtual pledge at WEBTOKEN By signing the pledge, men commit to be part of the solution by maintaining positive behaviour and attitudes, and to take responsibility for their actions.

src: Dit verbind mans ook daartoe om nooit ŉ hand teen ŉ vrou te lig nie, om vroue as gelykes te behandel, hul regte te respekteer en hulle met waardigheid te behandel.
tgt: It also commits the men to never raise a hand against a woman, to treat women as equals, respect their rights, and to treat them with dignity.

src: As ons GGGV saam aanspreek sal dit lei tot gesonder, veiliger en meer vreedsame gemeenskappe waarin vroue en kinders kan floreer.
tgt: Managing GBVF as a collective will result in healthier, safer and more peaceful communities in which women and children can thrive.

src: Daarbenewens verwelkom die Kabinet ook die opening van die 65e Thuthuzela-sorgsentrum om slagoffers van GGGV te ondersteun vroeër die week by die Mitchellsplein-hospitaal in Kaapstad.
tgt: Furthermore, Cabinet welcomed the opening of the 65th Centre at the Mitchells Plain Hospital in Cape Town earlier this week to support victims of GBVGovernment’s establishment of the Thuthuzela Care Centres across the country is a response to the urgent need for prevention, response and support for victims of violence, especially women and children.

src: Die Kabinet het hul sorg uitgespreek oor die kommerwekkende statistieke van tienerswangerskappe, waar kinders so jonk as 10 jaar voortydig ouers word.
tgt: Cabinet expressed concern over the alarming statistics of adolescent pregnancies where children as young as 10 years of age are prematurely becoming parents.

src: Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op die samelewing en ouers om te help om hierdie uitdaging aan te spreek deur enige iemand wat seks het met ŉ minderjarige (ŉ kind onder die ouderdom van 16 jaar) aan te meld, aangesien dit ŉ kriminele oortreding is.
tgt: Cabinet urges society and parents to help solve this challenge by reporting anyone who engages in sex with a minor (a child under the age of 16) as it is a criminal offence.

src: As die land nie saamwerk om hierdie uitdaging van tienerswangerskappe aan te spreek nie, sal vroue en jong meisies vasgevang bly in ŉ boosaardige kringloop van armoede en ŉ gebrek aan onderrig en ekonomiese vooruitsigte.
tgt: If the country does not work together to address this challenge of teenage pregnancies, women and young girls will continue to be trapped in a vicious cycle of poverty, lack of educational and economic prospects.

src: Voorvrystellingskalender vir die publikasie van die kwartaallikse misdaadstatistieke Die Kabinet neem kennis van die voorvrystellingskalender vir die publikasie van die kwartaallikse misdaadstatistieke vir die 2024/25 finansiële jaar.
tgt: Pre-release calendar for the publication of the quarterly crime statistics Cabinet noted the pre-release calendar for the publication of the quarterly crime statistics for the 2024-25 year.

src: Die misdaadstatistieke sal vrygestel word in Augustus en November 2024, en in Februarie en Me 2025.
tgt: The crime statistics will be released in August and November 2024, and in February and May 2025.

src: Die gereelde vrystelling van misdaadstatistieke is belangrik om misdaadtendense te monitor en vir beter besluitneming in die stryd teen misdaad.
tgt: The frequent release of crime statistics is important for monitoring crime trends and better decision-making in the fight against crime.

src: .1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die dringende ingryping deur die departement van menslike nedersettings om steun te verleen aan verplaasde gesinne wie se huise oorstroom het nadat die wal van ŉ dam op 8 Augustus 2024 in die Swartland-munisipaliteit in die Wes-Kaap ingestort het.2 Steun word steeds verskaf aan gesinne wat geraak is na aanleiding van die breek van drie damme se walle in die Riverlands-omgewing, wat erge skade aan eiendom en infrastruktuur veroorsaak het.
tgt: Disaster Management.1 Cabinet welcomed the urgent intervention by the Department of Human Settlements to assist displaced families whose homes were flooded when the walls of a dam collapsed on 8 August 2024 in the Swartland Municipality in the Western Cape.2 Support continues to be provided to affected families following the failure of three farm dams, located in Riverlands that caused severe damage to property and infrastructure.

src: Watervlakke het nou genoeg gesak dat inwoners – wie vroeër ontruim is – na hul huise kon terugkeer.
tgt: Water levels have now receded for residents – who were earlier evacuated – to return to their homes.

src: Die volle omvang van die skade word egter steeds bepaal en die twee beskikbare gemeenskapsentrums bly oop vir inwoners wat verkies om nie dadelik na hul huise terug te keer nie.
tgt: However, the full extent of the damage is still being assessed, and the two available community centres remain open for residents who prefer not to return home immediately.3 As the country’s rainy season approaches in the northern part of the country, Cabinet calls on municipalities to ensure storm-water drains are cleaned and free from blockages to ensure the smooth flow of water when it rains.

src: .3 Me die land se naderende reënseisoen vir die noordelike gedeeltes van die land, doen die Kabinet ŉ beroep op munisipaliteite om te verseker dat stormwaterdreineringstelsels skoon en vry is van blokkasies om die gladde vloei van water te verseker wanneer dit reën.
tgt: The Economy Quarterly labour statistics .1 The official unemployment rate was 33,5% in the second quarter of 2024, it went up by 0,6 of a percentage from the first quarter (first quarter was 32,9%).

src: Die ekonomie.1 Kwartaallikse arbeidstatistieke .1 Die amptelike werkloosheidsyfer was 33.5% in die tweede kwartaal van 2024 dit het met van ŉ persentasie gestyg vanaf die eerste kwartaal (toe was dit 32.9%).
tgt: Employment decreased by 92 000 to 16,7 million in the second quarter of 2024.

src: Die aantal werklose mense het met 158 000 gestyg na miljoen tydens dieselfde kwartaal.
tgt: The number of unemployed persons increased by 158 000 to 8,4 million during the same quarter.

src: .2 ŉ Nywerjeidsanalise van indiensneming toon ŉ afname in die aantal individue met werk in vyf van die 10 nywerhede tussen K1: 2024 en K2: 2024.
tgt: .2 An analysis of employment by industry reveals a decrease in the number of employed individuals within five of the ten industries between Q1: 2024 and Q2: 2024.

src: Afname in indiensneming was meestal in die handelsektor (110 000), landbousektor (45 000) en privaathuishoudingsektor (18 000).
tgt: Employment decreases were mainly in the Trade (110 000), Agriculture (45 000), and Private households (18 000) industries.

src: .3 Die grootste toenames in indiensneming was egter in die vervaardigingsektor (49 000) en gemeenskaps- en maatskaplike dienste (36 000).
tgt: .3 However, the largest increases in employment were recorded in Manufacturing (49 000) and Community and Social Services (36 000).

src: Die bestendige groei in die vervaardigingsektor is ŉ hupstoot vir vertroue in die werk wat tans gedoen word om ŉ produksie-ekonomie te bou.
tgt: The steady growth in the manufacturing is a confidence booster on work to build a production economy.

src: Die staat se fokus bly gerig op die hoogste prioriteit naamlik die bou van ŉ inklusiewe ekonomie wat werk skep.
tgt: Government remains focused on its apex priority of building an inclusive economy that creates jobs.

src: Inflasie.
tgt: Inflation.

src: Die jaarlikse verbruikersprysinflasie was 4.6% in Julie 2024, af van 5.1% in Junie 2024.
tgt: Annual consumer price inflation was 4,6% in July 2024, down from 5,1% in June 2024.

src: Die verbruikersprysindeks het gegroei tot 0.4% maand-op-maand in Julie Die grootste bydraers tot die jaarlikse inflasiekoers van 4.6% was die volgende:• Behuising en hereregte (toegeneem met 5.3% jaar-op-jaar en met ŉ bydrae van persentasiepunte)• Diverse goedere en dienste (toegeneem met 7.0% jaar-op-jaar en met ŉ bydrae van persentasiepunt),• Voedsel en nie-alkoholiese drankies (toegeneem met 4.5% jaar-op-jaar en met ŉ bydrae van 0.8% van ŉ persentasiepunt), en• Vervoer (toegeneem met 4.2% jaar-op-jaar en met ŉ bydrae van van ŉ persentasiepunt).
tgt: The CPI increased by 0,4% month-on-month in July The main contributors to the 4.6% annual inflation rate were:• Housing and duties (increased by 5.3% year-on-year and contributed percentage points)• Miscellaneous goods and services (increased by 7.0% year-on- year and contributed percentage point),• Food and non-alcoholic beverages (increased by 4.5% year-on-year and contributed 0.8% of a percentage point), and• Transport (increased by 4.2% year-on-year and contributed of a percentage point).

src: In Julie 2024 was die jaarlikse inflasiekoers van:• Goedere 4.6%, af van 5.5% in Junie 2024, en • Dienste 4.7% op van 4,6 in Junie 2024.
tgt: In July 2024, the annual inflation rate of:• Goods was 4.6%, down from 5.5% in June 2024, and • Services was 4.7% up from in June 2024 Energy.

src: Die wetsaantekening van die Gewysigde Wet op Elektrisiteitsregulering, 2006 (Wet 4 van 2006) deur president Ramaphosa lui ŉ nuwe era in vir ŉ mededingende en volhoubare elektrisiteitsektor wat Suid-Afrika se energiebehoeftes kan vervul.
tgt: The signing into law of the Electricity Regulation Amendment Act by President Cyril Ramaphosa creates a new era of a competitive and sustainable electricity sector that meets South Africa’s energy needs.

src: Die wysigings verbeter energiesekuriteit deur meer deelnemers in energieproduksie te betrek.
tgt: The amendments enhance energy security by drawing in more participants into energy production.

src: Die land se energiesekuriteit is verder versterk deur ŉ bykomende 2 500 megawatt elektrisiteit wat in die nasionale elektrisiteitsrooster gevoer sal word teen die einde van September 2024.
tgt: The country’s energy security has also been further strengthened with an additional 2 500 megawatts of electricity that will be fed into the national grid at the end of September 2024.

src: Die bykomende kapasiteit sal afkomstig wees vanaf Meupi-eenheid 4, Kusile-eenheid 6 en Koeberg-eenheid 2, en sal die land stewing op koers plaas om die mylpaal van 150 dae sonder beurtkrag te behaal.
tgt: The additional capacity which will come from Medupi Unit 4, Kusile Unit 6 and Koeberg Unit 2 will place the country firmly on track to reach the milestone of 150 days without load-shedding.

src: Die huidige mylpaal van 148 dae sonder beurtkrag is behaal deur ŉ verminderde gebruik van opelug-gasturbines wat gelei het tot ŉ besparing van R.21 miljard in die koste van diesel, vergeleke met dieselfde tydperk laasjaar.
tgt: This milestone of 148 days without load shedding has been achieved with the reduction in the use of OCGT, resulting in R.21 billion savings in the cost of diesel compared to the same period last year.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die onttrekking van die vasstelling vir die verkryging van nuwe kernenergie-opwekkingskapasiteit deur die minister van energie, dr. Kgosientsho Ramokgopa, om verder konsultasie met die publiek te bemoontlik.
tgt: Cabinet has noted the withdrawal of the determination for the procurement of new nuclear energy generation capacity by the Minister of Electricity and Energy, Dr Kgosientsho Ramokgopa, to allow for further public consultation.

src: Die Kabinet bevestig dat kernenergie deel bly van ons land se energieverskaffing aangesien dit ŉ lae-koolstof, betroubare bron van elektrisiteit is wat noemnswaardig kan bydra tot die land se energiesekuriteit en klimaatsteikens.
tgt: Cabinet affirmed that nuclear energy remains part of our country’s energy mix as it offers a low-carbon, reliable source of electricity that can contribute significantly to the country’s energy security and climate goals.

src: Hawe-infrastruktuur.
tgt: Ports infrastructure.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van vyf van die sewe sleepbote wat deel vorm van Transnet se nasionale hawe-owerheid se vlootvernuwingsprogram om die uitdaging van verkeersopeenhoping in die land se hawens aan te spreek, belyn met die spoorvrag logistieke padkaart (Freight Logistics Roadmap), om die doeltreffendheid en mededingendheid van ons hawens en spoorweë te herstel.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the launch of five (5) out of seven (7) tugboats which is part of Transnet National Ports Authority’s fleet renewal programme to tackle the challenges of congestion at the country’s ports in line with the Freight Logistics Roadmap to restore the efficiency and competitiveness in our ports and rail.

src: Die sleepbote, wat toegerus is met die nuutste tegnologie asook sterker sleepkrag, sal help om vaartuigomkeertye te verminder deur te help met vinniger vervoer van vrag en vragskepe deur ons grootste hawens.
tgt: The tugboats which are equipped with the latest technology and improved bollard pull capacity will help reduce vessel turnaround times by assisting in the faster movement of cargo and container ships through our major ports.

src: Dus sal die sleepbote ook bydra tot veiligheid en help om ongelukke te voorkom deur skepe deur verkeersopeenhopings in die hawens te lei.
tgt: The tugboats will also contribute to safety and assist in preventing accidents by guiding ships through congested areas.

src: Gesondheidsverwante sake.1 Mpox.1 Die Kabinet stel Suid-Afrikaners gerus dat die uitbreek van die Mpox-siekte onder beheer is in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Cabinet reassures South Africans that the outbreak of Mpox disease, which has now been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by the World Health Organisation (WHO) and the public health emergency of continental security (PHECS) by the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) is under control in South Africa.

src: Die siekte is nou as ŉ openbare gesondheidsnoodgeval van internasionale belang deur die wêreldgesondheidsorganisasie (WHO) verklaar, asook as openbare gesondheidsnoodgeval van kontinentale sekuriteit deur die Afrika-sentrums vir siektebeheer en -voorkoming (Afrika-CDC).2 Tot hede staan die aantal positiewe gevalle wat aangemeld is op 24 wat insluit drie sterftes, 19 gevalle van herstel en twee aktiewe gevalle in tuis-isolasie.
tgt: To date, the total number of positive cases recorded stands at 24 and these include three deaths, 19 recoveries and two active cases undergoing home isolation.

src: Twaalf gevalle is in Gauteng aangemeld, 11 in KwaZulu-Natal en een in die Wes-Kaap.3 Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op lede van die publiek om hul deel te bring en steun te verleen aan die staat se pogings om die verspreiding van Mpox te verhoed deur waaksaam te bly en nie-farmaseutiese ingrypings soos strenger persoonlike higiëne ter harte te neem en sodoende verdere verspreiding te bekamp.
tgt: Of these, twelve cases were reported in Gauteng, 11 in KwaZulu-Natal and one in the Western Cape.

src: .4 Die Kabinet steun die beroep deur president Ramaphosa – in sy kapasiteit as die Afrika-unie se kampioen vir pandemie-voorkoming, paraatheid en reaksie – op alle rolspelers om nou saam te werk met die Afrika-CDC om te verseker dat daar voldoende steun is vanaf die internasionale gemeenskap, wat sal verseker dat daar billike toegang is tot alle mediese teenmaatreëls, insluitend diagnostieke, terapeutika en entstowwe.
tgt: Cabinet calls on members of the public to play their part by supporting the government’s efforts to prevent the spread of Mpox by remaining vigilant and exercising non-pharmaceutical interventions such as heightened personal hygiene to prevent further transmission.

src: Bek-en-klouseer .1 Groot vordering is gemaak in die bestryding van bek-en-klouseer in die Kouga en Kou-Kamma plaaslike munisipaliteite in die Oos-Kaap, met die laaste kliniese geval wat in middel-Julie aangemeld is.
tgt: Cabinet supports the call by President Ramaphosa in his capacity as the African Union (AU) Champion on Pandemic Prevention, Preparedness, and Response for all partners to collaborate closely with the Africa CDC to ensure that there is appropriate support from the international community, guaranteeing equitable access to medical countermeasures, including diagnostics, therapeutics and vaccines.

src: .2 Die beweging van diere in en uit die areas wat geraak is, word voortdurend gemonitor om die verspreiding van die siekte na ongeraakte areas (soos bepaal deur die amptelike siektebestuursarea) te verhoed en die vervoer van vee van een plek na ŉ ander vereis ŉ vervoerpermit van die plaaslike staatsveearts om die verspreiding van die siekte te bekamp.
tgt: Animal movements in and out of the affected regions continue to be monitored to prevent the spread of the disease to unaffected areas in terms of the Disease Management Area, and the transportation of livestock from one place to another requires a Transport Permit from a local state veterinary office to prevent the spread of the disease.

src: .3 Die 30 beesplase wat positief getoets het vir die siekte is onder kwarantyn geplaas en inentings word gebruik om die verspreiding van die infeksie te beheer en die erns van die kliniese simptome te verminder.
tgt: The 30 cattle farms that have tested positive for the disease have been placed under quarantine, and vaccination efforts continue to control the spread of infection and reduce the severity of clinical symptoms.

src: Daarbenewens is voorkomende inentings gedoen op ŉ verdere 37 plase wat identifiseer is hoë-risiko weens hul nabyheid aan die plase waar diere die siekte het.
tgt: Additionally, pre-emptive vaccination has been carried out on a further 37 farms identified as high risk due to their proximity to infected areas.

src: In totaal is meer as 92 000 beeste en nagenoeg 600 skape op 67 plase ingeënt.
tgt: In total, over 92 000 cattle and nearly 600 sheep across 67 farms have been vaccinated.

src: Skoolvoedingsprogram.1 Die Kabinet het kennis geneem van die voorgestelde moderniseringstrategie van die nasionale skoolvoedingsprogram en steun die werk wat reeds onderweg is om deurdagte omsigtigheid te verseker in terme van die voorgestelde benadering en sodoende die belange van die miljoen leerders wat daagliks deel is van die program te beskerm.
tgt: The school nutrition programme.1 Cabinet has noted the proposed modernisation strategy of the National School Nutrition programme and supports the work underway to ensure proper due diligence on the proposed approach to safeguard the interests of the million learners who are daily beneficiaries of scheme.

src: 4 Vrouemaandvieringe.1 Nasionale lugvaartspitsberaad oor geslag (NAGS).1 Die Suid-Afrikaanse burgerlugvaartowerheid (SACAA), ŉ entiteit onder die departement van vervoer, het op Woensdag, 21 Augustus 2024 ŉ suksesvolle spitsberaad oor geslag (NAGS) aangebied in KwaZulu-Natal om die deelname van vroue aan die globale lugvaartsektor, asook vroueregte in die sektor, te bevorder.
tgt: The South African Civil Aviation Authority (SACAA) an entity of the Department of Transport hosted successful National Aviation Gender Summit (NAGS) in KwaZulu-Natal on Wednesday, 21 August 2024 to promote the participation of women in the global aviation sector, as well as advancing women’s rights in the sector.

src: Suider-Afrikaanse streekswebinaar oor die ekonomiese bemagtiging van vroue .1 Die departement van vroue, die jeug en persone met gestremdhede bied op 21 en 22 Augustus ŉ tweedag-webinaar aan oor die ekonomiese bemagtiging van vroue in suider-Afrika.2 Die webinaar sal kritiese kwessies rakende die ekonomiese bemagtiging van vroue aanspreek, met ŉ fokus op handels- en ekonomiese inisiatiewe, raamwerke en ooreenkomste op nasionale en streeksvlak en die impak daarvan op die ekonomiese bemagtiging van vroue, die jeug en persone met gestremdhede.
tgt: Southern African Regional Webinar on the Economic Empowerment of Women.

src: 5 Internasionale sake.1 44e spitsberaad van die Suider-Afrikaanse ontwikkelingsgemeenskap (SAOG) .1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die uitkomste van die 44e SAOG-spitsberaad vir staats- en regeringshoofde wat op 17 Augustus 2024 in Harare, Zimbabwe plaasgevind het.2 Die spitsberaad het ledestate aangespoor om die SAOG se humanitêre maatreëls te implementeer met betrekking tot die droogtes en vloede veroorsaak deur El Niño-effek en om aan te hou om weerstoestande en klimaatsrisiko’s te monitor, insluitend die voorspelde La Niña-effek, en voorsorgmaatreëls te ontwikkel om die impak van rampe te versag.
tgt: The Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities is hosting a two-day webinar on the economic empowerment of women in the Southern African Region which started on 21 and 22 August 2024.

src: .3 Die spitsberaad het kennis geneem van die totstandkoming van die ooreenkoms wat die drieparty-vryhandelsgebied onder die gemeenskaplike mark vir oostelike en suider-Afrika, die oos-Afrikaanse gemeenskap en die SAOG bekragtig, wat geleenthede sal bied aan SAOG-lede om voordeel te trek uit ŉ uitgebreide mark van 26 lande met ŉ totale bevolking van naastenby 700 miljoen en ŉ gesamentlike bruto binnelandse produk van US$1 triljoen.
tgt: The webinar is exploring critical issues on the economic empowerment of women with a focus on trade and economic initiatives, frameworks and agreements at national and regional levels and their impact on economic empowerment of women, youth and persons with disabilities.

src: .4 Rakende Israel se oorlog teen Palestina, het die spitsberaad met kommer kennis geneem van die voortdurende en meedoënlose aanvalle op gewone Palestynse burgers, wat tot lewensverlies, die vernietiging van eiendom en verswakkende humanitëre toestande gelei het.
tgt: International Affairs.1 44th Ordinary SADC Summit.1 Cabinet welcomed the outcomes of the 44th Ordinary SADC Summit of Heads of State and Government held in Harare, Zimbabwe on 17 August 2024.2 The Summit urged member states to implement the SADC Regional Humanitarian Appeal to the El Niño-induced drought and floods, and to continue monitoring weather and climate risks, including the forecasted La Niña event and develop contingency measures to mitigate the impact of disasters.3 The Summit took note of the coming into effect of the Agreement establishing the Tripartite Free Trade Area among the COMESA, the East African Community and SADC which will provide opportunities for SADC members to tap into an expanded market of 26 countries with a population of about 700 million and a gross domestic product of US$1 trillion.

src: Die spitsberaad het ŉ beroep gedoen tot ŉ onmiddelike wapenstilstand, die vrylating van alle gyselaars en die aanvang van samesprekings om ŉ blywende oplossing tot die konflik te vind.2 Konferensie van die spoorwegvereniging van suidelike Afrika (SARA).1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die beraadslaging tydens die 13e SARA-konferensie om die spoorwegsektor in die SAOG te verhef met die doel om meer handel in die streek te bevorder en voordeel te trek uit die handelsgeleenthede wat spruit uit die Afrika kontinentale vryhandelsgebied.2 ŉ Florerende SAOG spoorwegbedryf vereis groter belegging in spoorweë asook samewerking in die SAOG-streek om die vele uitdagings aan te spreek.
tgt: Southern African Railways Association (SARA) Conference.1 Cabinet welcomed the deliberations during the 13th SARA Conference to uplift the rail sector within Southern African Development Community (SADC) with an aim of facilitating greater trade within the region and take advantage of trade opportunities presented by the African Continental Free Trade Area.2 A thriving SADC rail industry requires greater rail investment and collaboration within the SADC region to address its many challenges.

src: Die streek se spoorwegbedryf het oor die jare heen uitdagings soos misdaad, diefstal en vandalisme ervaar.
tgt: The region’s rail industry has over the years been faced with challenges such as crime, theft and vandalism.3 South Africa is committed to doing its part to create an efficient, connected and modern rail sector, and is implementing policy and interventions, such as the Freight Logistics Roadmap, to revive, support and modernise the capacity and competence of our railways.

src: .3 Suid-Afrika is daartoe verbind om sy deel te doen om ŉ doeltreffende, gekonekteerde en moderne spoorwegsektor te skep en is besig om beid en ingrypings soos die spoorvrag logistieke padkaart (Freight Logistics Roadmap) te implementeer om sodoende die kapasiteit en bevoegdheid van ons spoorweë tot herlewing te bring, te steun en moderniseer.
tgt: Cabinet decisions Advisory Body within the Department of Small Business Development (DSBD) Cabinet approved the establishment of an advisory body within the DSBD as prescribed by the National Small Enterprise Act, 1996 (Act 102 of 1996), as amended.

src: Kabinetsbesluite Advserende liggaam in die departement van kleinsakeontwikkeling (DSBD) Die Kabinet het die vestiging van ŉ adviserende liggaam in die departement van kleinsakeontwikkeling goedgekeur, soos voorgeskryf deur die gewysigde nasionale Wet op Kleinsake-ontwikkeling, 1996 (Wet 102 van 1996), gewysig.
tgt: The establishment of an advisory body is to ensure representation and promotion of the interest of small enterprises as contemplated in the National Strategy for the Development and Promotion of Small Enterprises in South Africa.

src: Die vestiging van ŉ adviserende liggaam het ten doel om verteenwoordiging en bevordering van die belange van kleinsake-ondernemings te verseker, soos uiteengesit in die nasionale strategie vir die ontwikkeling en bevordering van kleinsake-ondernemings in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: The primary function of the advisory body will be to advise the Minister on broad areas that affect small enterprise growth, including national standards pertaining to small enterprise development and regulation.

src: Die primêre funksie van die adviserende liggaam sal wees om die minister te adviseer oor breedvoerige areas wat kleinsake-ondernemings se groei beïnvloed, insluitend nasionale standaarde rakende kleinsake-ontwikkeling en -regulering.
tgt: The advisory body will provide government with evidence-based expert advice on the functioning of various aspects of the small enterprise support ecosystem to enable more effective policy reforms, legislative amendments, and design of interventions to support micro, small and medium enterprises and cooperatives.

src: Opdatering aan die Kabinet
tgt: Updates to cabinet

src: Uitkomste van die 35e vergadering van die partye oor die Montreal-protokol (MOP) oor middele wat die osoonlaag verdun Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die uitkomste van die 35e vergadering van die partye oor die MOP oor die middele van die osoonlaag verdun, wat in Oktober 2023 in Nairobi, Kenia plaasgevind het.
tgt: Outcomes of the 35th Meeting of the Parties to the Montreal Protocol (MOP) on the Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer

src: Tydens die vergadering het afgevaardigdes hulself sterk daartoe verbind om bedreigings tot beide die osoonlaag en die globale klimaat aan te spreek.
tgt: Cabinet received a briefing on the outcomes of the 35th Meeting of the Parties to the MOP on the Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer that was held in Nairobi, Kenya in October 2023.

src: Suid-Afrika het die Montreal-ooreenkoms onderteken en die land se deelname aan die 35e MOP was daarop gemik om te verseker dat die regte van Suid-Afrikaners tot ŉ veilige omgewing, soos vasgelê in die Grondwet, beskerm is, gegewe dat sommige van die chemikalieë wat bespreek is as nadelig vir mense, in Suid-Afrika gebruik word, naamlik die verkoelingsbedryf, landbou, brandbestryding en lugversorging, en dat sommige van hierdie gebruike ŉ bydrae lewer tot ekonomiese groei in die land.
tgt: At that meeting, delegates committed firmly to address threats to both the ozone layer and the threats to global climate.

src: (ii) Uitkomste van die 5e konferensie van die partye (COP5) oor die Minamata-konvensie
tgt: (ii) Outcomes of the fifth Conference of Parties to the Minamata Convention (COP5)

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die uitkomste van COP5 wat in November 2023 in Genève, Switserland plaasgevind het.
tgt: Cabinet noted the outcomes of COP5 that was held in Geneva, Switzerland in November 2023.

src: Die Minamata-konvensie is krities om menslike gesondheid en die omgewing teen die skadelike nagevolge en newe-effekte van kwik te beskerm.
tgt: The Minamata Convention is critical to keep protecting human health and the environment from harmful effects of mercury.
