src: Die besluite wat by die spitsberaad geneem is, sluit die volgende in:
tgt: Amongst the decisions taken at the summit include

src: gedefinieërde nuwe datums om kwikdraende produkte uit te faseer, insluitend grimering- en skoonheidsprodukte, (ii) versterkte bande met inheemse volke, (iii) ŉ ooreenkoms op 15mg/kg totale konsentrasie van kwik as die skeidsdrumpel vir afval wat deur kwik of kwikverbindings besmet is.
tgt: the defined new dates to phase out mercury-added products including cosmetics, (ii) Strengthen ties with Indigenous Peoples, (iii) an agreement on 15mg/kg total concentration of mercury as the threshold for wastes contaminated with mercury or mercury compounds Other technical decisions covered adoption of guidance for controlling mercury releases to land and water and to control the emissions of mercury to the atmosphere.

src: (iii) Uitkomste van die 28e konferensie van die partye (COP28) tot die VN raamwerkkonvensie oor klimaatsverandering (UNFCCC) Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die uitkomste van COP28, wat in Desember 2023 in Doebai in die Verenigde Arabiese Emirate plaasgevind het.
tgt: (iii) Outcomes of the 28th Conference of Parties (COP28) to the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) The Cabinet received a briefing on the outcomes of COP28 which took place in Dubai in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) in December 2023.

src: Die COP28-besluite is daarop gemik om die hoeveelheid kweekhuisgasse te verminder na 2°C, soos ten doel gestel tydens die Parys-ooreenkoms, en om ontwikkelende lande te help om aan te pas by die nadelige uitwerking van klimaatsverandering.
tgt: The COP28 decisions are aimed at reducing the amount of greenhouse gas emissions in keeping with the 20C goal of the Paris Agreement and help the developing country Parties to adapt to the adverse impacts of climate change.

src: Die Kabinet neem verder kennis van die belangrikste aflewerbares van COP28 ten opsigte van kwessies soos
tgt: Cabinet further noted the key deliverables of COP28 on key issues such as

src: die beëindiging van die twee-jarige Glasgow-Sharm el-Sheikh-werksprogram, (ii) aanvaarding van die UAE Just Transition-werksprogram om verskillende regverdige oorgangswyses te bespreek – besluite rakende die belangrike rol wat finansies, tegnologiese ontwikkeling en oordrag, en die bou van kapasiteitsteun speel om regverdige en billike oorgange te bemagtig, en (iii) die operasionalisering van die verlies- en skadefonds.
tgt: conclusion of the two- year Glasgow-Sharm el-Sheikh work programme, (ii) adoption of the UAE Just Transition Work Programme to discuss different just transition pathways – decision which underscores the importance of finance, technology development and transfer and capacity building support to achieve just and equitable transitions (iii) the operationalisation of the Loss and Damage Fund.

src: Die partye het met spyt kennis geneem dat die teiken van U$100 miljard nie teen 2021 bereik is nie en dat, tensy genoegsame befondsing verskaf word, ontwikkelende lande dus nie hul teikens sal kan implementeer nie.
tgt: Parties noted with regret that the U$100 billion was not met by 2021, and unless sufficient finance is provided, developing countries will not be able to implement.

src: Suid-Afrika bly daartoe verbind om die land se ondernemings onder die UNFCCC en die Parys-ooreenkoms na te kom.
tgt: South Africa remains committed to meeting its undertakings under the UNFCCC and its Paris Agreement.

src: Wetsontwerp Wetsontwerp op Maritieme en Lugvaart-soek-en-redding (AMSAR) van 2024
tgt: Aeronautical and Marine Search and Rescue (AMSAR) Bill of 2024

src: Die Kabinet het die publikasie van die AMSAR Wetsontwerp vir openbare kommentaar goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the publication of the AMSAR Bill for public comments.

src: Die Wetsontwerp beoog om die verouderde Suid-Afrikaanse Wet op Maritieme en Lugvaart-soek-en-redding, 2002 (Wet 44 van 2002) te wysig.
tgt: The Bill seeks to amend the South African Maritime and Aeronautic Act, 2002 (Act 44 of 2002) which has become outdated.

src: Die Wetsontwerp is daarop gerig om die veiligheid van mense tydens lugvaart- en see-reddingsoektogte te verseker.
tgt: The Bill aims to ensure the safety of people in the event of aeronautical and maritime search and rescue incidents.

src: Die Wetsontwerp is ook daarop gerig om die nasionale AMSAR-stelsel te belyn met internasionale standaarde en tendense.
tgt: The Bill further seeks to align the national AMSAR system with international standards and trends.

src: Die Wetsontwerp sal die AMSAR-stelsel versterk en ŉ hupstoot verleen aan die groei en ontwikkeling van lugvaart- en maritieme-verwante sektore en bydra tot ekonomiese groei.
tgt: The Bill will strengthen AMSAR system to boost the growth of aviation and maritime related industries and will contribute to economic growth.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en toepaslike klaring.
tgt: Appointments All appointments are subject to verification of qualification and relevant security clearance.

src: Stigtingslede van die raad van die kleinsake-ontwikkelingsagentskap:
tgt: Founding members to the board of the Small Enterprise Development Finance Agency:

src: Me Nonzuzo Makhanda (Voorsitter)(ii) Me Dorah Mosili(iii) Me Xolisa Daku(iv) Me Nontobeko Lubisi Mnr Luyanda Ntuane(vi) Me Cingashe Motale(vii) Mnr Pat Makape(viii) Me Hilda Tsoadi(ix) Mnr Avuyile Xabadiya Mnr Sinovuyo Mpakama(xi) Mnr Waseem Carrim(xii) Mnr Thembinkosi Bonakele en (xiii) Me Keabetwe Mogorosi
tgt: Ms Nonzuzo Makhanda (Chairperson).

src: Toerismemaand.1 Die 2024-toerismemaandprogram, wat vanaf 1 tot 30 September 2024 sal plaasvind, is in die Noord-Kaap geloods ter erkenning van die behoefte om die waarde van toerisme regoor die land te versprei.
tgt: President Ramaphosa will undertake a DDM Presidential Imbizo in the Ekurhuleni Metro on Friday, 23 August 2024 at the Tsakane Stadium, to assess progress on service delivery commitments.

src: Terwyl die land plaaslike en internasionale besoekers uitnooi om Suid-Afrika se majestieuse toeriste-bestemmings, lewendige kultuur en tradisies te verken, is die regering hard aan’t werk om die sektor verder uit te brei deur die ongetapde potensiaal vir toerisme in ons informele nedersettings, gehuggies en dorpe te ontsluit.
tgt: The DDM Presidential Imbizo will be attended by leaders from all three spheres of government who will engage on service delivery challenges confronting communities, and development plans for the metropolitan municipal in line with the principle of One Government, One Plan, One Budget.

src: ŉ Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging sal ook deelneem aan die forum vir Sjina-Afrika samewerking (FOCAC) wat sal plaasvind van 4 tot 6 September 2024.
tgt: Hosting of the Aviation Africa Summit and Exhibition Cabinet considered and approved for South Africa to host the Aviation Africa Summit and Exhibition in Johannesburg from 16 to 17 September 2024.

src: FOCAC is ŉ multilaterale koordineringsmeganisme tussen Sjina en Afrika-lande en word beskou as ŉ samewerkingsplatform in die Sjinese “Belt and Road”-inisiatief, wat Sjina se globale infrastruktuursontwikkelingstrategie vorm.
tgt: The summit and the exhibition are a major trade event for the aviation industry.

src: Boodskappe ŉ Wennasie.. Ons nasie se sportmanne en -vroue hou ons naam hoog in verskeie sportkodes regoor die wêreld en verening ons net nog meer as nasie.
tgt: In addition, the event will expose South African as a tourist destination and present an opportunity to market other South African products to Summit and Exhibition participants.

src: 1.. Ons rugbywêreldkampioene, die Springbokke, het Australië oorwin en bly onoorwonne in die rugby-kampioenskap.
tgt: Conference on Migration.1 The National Planning Commission, the International Organisation for Migration and the UN Development Programme are convening a Conference on Migration in Johannesburg from 20 to 23 August 2024.

src: 1.. Ook in Australië het Dricus du Plessis ŉ manjefieke oorwinning behaal in sy UFC-middelgewigtitel teen Nigerië se Israel Adesanya in Perth..
tgt: The conference is exploring and discussing migration as a driver of development, with a particular focus on leveraging diaspora capital and international collaboration.

src: Suid-Afrika gekroon te word, verpersoonlik Mia die Suid-Afrikaanse gees van oorwinning teen teëspoed.
tgt: Australia was also the scene of a magnificent victory for Dricus du Plessis who retained his UFC middleweight title by defeating Nigeria’s Israel Adesanya in Perth.

src: • Die uitgaande hoofregter Justice Raymond Zondo, wat aftree aan die einde van Augustus 2024 na ŉ bekroonde regsloopbaan van 27 jaar.• Me Fikile Marakalla, wat die tweede plek behaal het in die foto-afdeling van die SADC Meia-toekennings 2024.
tgt: Team SA won 1 x gold, 3 x silver and 2 bronze medals at the 2024 Paris Olympics, doubling their medal tally from the previous 2021 Tokyo Olympic Games.

src: Sy het haar loopbaan begin by die Regering se Kommunikasie- en Inligtingstelsel (GCIS) as ŉ intern en is tans werksaam in die adjunkpresident se fotografiese span.• Mnr Benjamin Moshatama van Channel Africa Radio, wat tweede plek behaal het in die radio-afdeling van die SADC Meia-toekennings 2024.• Die Durbanse dansgroep Wu Tang Cru, wat goud en silwer gewen het by die UDO-wêreldstraatdanskampioenskappe.
tgt: As a nation we celebrate the South African relay team of Bayanda Walaza Bradley Nkoana Shaun Maswanganyi and Akani Simbine for winning a silver medal in the men's 4x100m relay final.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing Ekonomiese imperatiewe Die Regering bly standvastig in sy strewe om: die ekonomie te laat groei
tgt: Issues in the environment Economic imperatives Government remains steadfast in its quest to:o grow the economyo reduce unemployment ando create a more resilient investment climate.

src: Noemenswaardige ontwikkelings ten opsigte van ekonomies-verwante imperatiewe:
tgt: Notable developments on economic-related imperatives:

src: .1 Groei in die bruto binnelandse produk (BBP) Die Kabinet neem kennis van die effense toename in die land se ekonomiese groei met 0,4% in die tweede kwartaal van 2024, wat 'n positiewe vooruitsig vir ons algehele ekonomiese prestasie vir die jaar is.
tgt: .1 Gross domestic product (GDP) growth Cabinet noted the slight increase in the growth of the South African economy by 0,4% in the second quarter of 2024, which sets a positive tone for our overall economic performance for the year.

src: Die groei word grootliks toegeskryf aan die finansierings-, eiendoms- en sakedienstebedryf, wat elke bedryf met 1,3% toegeneem het elke bedryf het onderskeidelik tot 0,3 van 'n persentasiepunt tot die BBP-groei bygedra.
tgt: The growth is largely attributed to the finance, real estate and business services industry, which increased by 1.3%, each industry contributing to of a percentage point to the GDP growth respectively.

src: Die handel-, spysenierings- en akkommodasiebedryf, asook die vervaardigingsbedryf en die elektrisiteits-, gas- en waterbedryf het tot 0,1 van 'n persentasiepunt tot die BBP-groei bygedra.
tgt: The trade, catering and accommodation industry, manufacturing industry and electricity, gas and water industry contributed to of a percentage point to the GDP growth, whilst household final consumption expenditure contributed to of a percentage point and final consumption contributed to of a percentage point to GDP growth.

src: 'n Toename in die ekonomiese aktiwiteit van hierdie bedrywe is die afgelope kwartaal opgemerk.
tgt: These industries have noted increase in economic activity in the last quarter.

src: Suid-Afrika se ekonomie bly sterk en die Kabinet moedig alle sektore van die samelewing aan om steeds op hierdie momentum voort te bou.
tgt: South Africa’s economy remains robust and Cabinet encourages all sectors of society to build on this momentum going forward.

src: As alle sektore as ’n nasie saamstaan en op hierdie momentum voortbou, sal ons meer werkgeleenthede kan skep en die lewenstandaard van alle Suid-Afrikaners verbeter.
tgt: When all sectors build on this momentum as a nation, we will realise the creation of more jobs and improve the living standards of all South Africans.

src: Die Kabinet het inklusiewe ekonomiese groei en werkskepping vir die Sewende Administrasie geprioritiseer.
tgt: Cabinet has prioritised inclusive economic growth and job creation for the Seventh Administration and therefore existing interventions will be intensified to achieve this objective.

src: .2 Massiewe belegging in die motorsektor Suid-Afrika se beleggingsaantrekkingskrag trek steeds katalitiese beleggings wat die regering se voorneme bevestig om ekonomiese groei aan te dryf en werk te skep.
tgt: .2 Massive automotive sector investment South Africa’s investment appeal continues to draw catalytic investments that affirm the government’s intent to drive economic growth and create jobs.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van 'n vervaardigingsfasiliteit vir motorkomponente van R1,1 miljard by die Dube TradePort Spesiale Ekonomiese Sone in KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the launch of a R.1-billion automotive components manufacturing facility at the Dube Trade Port Special Economic Zone in KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Die massiewe belegging deur Toyota Tsusho Africa (Edms.)
tgt: The massive investment by Toyota Tsusho Africa (Pty) Ltd and Ogihara Thailand Corporation Ltd is a vote of confidence on South Africa’s position as a formidable destination for foreign direct investment.

src: .3 Hupstoot vir Suid-Afrikaanse uitvoere Die eerste versending Suid-Afrikaanse avokado's het einde Augustus 2024 in Japan aangekom dit is 'n beduidende hupstoot vir die plaaslike avokadosektor en bevestig die positiewe impak van die Landbou- en Landbouverwerkingsmeesterplan, wat daarop gemik is om toegang tot belangrike nuwe markte vir Suid-Afrikaanse produsente uit te brei.
tgt: .4 Energy Security Cabinet commends Eskom, its board, management and all its employees who have worked tirelessly to ensure that South Africa will have no load-shedding this summer as the power utility continues to add more electrons to the grid through its generation recovery plan.

src: Suid-Afrikaanse avokadokwekers kan nou aansienlik baat namate die pogings om toegang tot markte vir ons landbouprodukte te verhoog, voortduur.
tgt: Eskom aims to keep unplanned losses at power stations below 13 000 megawatts as it works on improving the reliability of its power-generation fleet.

src: Eskom beoog om onbeplande verliese by kragstasies onder 13 000 megawatt te hou, terwyl werk voortgaan om die betroubaarheid van die kragopwekkingsvloot te verbeter.
tgt: Government continues to execute the Energy Action Plan, which has been instrumental in reducing the frequency of load-shedding through planned maintenance of Eskom’s power-generation fleet.

src: 'n Betroubare energievoorsiening is noodsaaklik om ons ekonomie te laat groei, vertroue te bevorder en die lewensgehalte van ons burgers te verbeter.
tgt: The reform of our energy sector is a critical component of our efforts to create a secure energy future for our people.

src: Die Regering gaan voort om die Energie-aksieplan uit te voer, wat tot dusver instrumenteel was om herhaalde beurtkrag deur beplande instandhouding van Eskom se kragopwekkingsvloot te verminder.
tgt: State-owned entities’ (SOEs) reform In line with an undertaking that President Ramaphosa made previously before Parliament to recalibrate our SOEs, the responsibility for all our strategic SOEs has been transferred to the various line ministries, after the President had signed the relevant proclamation to this effect.

src: Die hervorming van ons energiesektor is 'n kritieke komponent van ons pogings om 'n veilige energietoekoms vir ons mense te skep.
tgt: This step coincides with plans to create a centralised shareholder model through which the State seeks to better leverage the capabilities of our SOEs to grow the economy, improve service delivery, and infuse the SOEs with the requisite commercial and strategic agility.

src: Hervorming van ondernemings in staatsbesit (OSB) In ooreenstemming met 'n onderneming wat President Ramaphosa voorheen in die Parlement gemaak het om ons OSB te herkalibreer, is die verantwoordelikheid vir al ons strategiese OSB na die verskillende lynministeries oorgedra, nadat die President die betrokke proklamasie hieroor onderteken het.
tgt: The responsibility for power utility Eskom has been transferred to the Ministry of Energy and Electricity and Transnet, South African Airways and South African Express to the Ministry of Transport.

src: Hierdie stap val saam met planne om 'n gesentraliseerde aandeelhouersmodel te skep waardeur die staat poog om die vermoëns van ons OSB beter te benut om die ekonomie te laat groei, dienslewering te verbeter en die OSB met die nodige kommersiële en strategiese vaardigheid te vul.
tgt: The state-owned diamond mining company Alexkor will be managed by the Ministry of Mineral and Petroleum Resources, aerospace and military technology conglomerate Denel will fall under the Ministry of Defence and Military Veterans while South African Forestry Company SOC Limited, which is responsible for state forestry, will report to the Ministry of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.

src: Die verantwoordelikheid vir die kragvoorsiener Eskom is na die Ministerie van Energie en Elektrisiteit oorgeplaas, terwyl Transnet die Suid-Afrikaanse Lugdiens en South African Express na die Ministerie van Vervoer oorgeplaas is.
tgt: .6 Funding for development The recently approved R17,8-billion funding from the BRICS New Development Bank (NDB) for infrastructure projects in water and sanitation will reduce infrastructure backlogs and ensure the provision of basic services to poor households.

src: Die staatsbeheerde diamantmynmaatskappy Alexkor sal deur die Ministerie van Minerale en Petroleumhulpbronne bestuur word lugvaart- en militêre tegnologiekonglomeraat Denel sal onder die Ministerie van Verdediging en Militêre Veterane val, en die Suid-Afrikaanse Bosboumaatskappy SOC Beperk, wat vir staatsbosbou verantwoordelik is, aan die Ministerie van Bosbou, Visserye en die Omgewing verslag sal doen.
tgt: The NDB has also entered into an agreement with Transnet for a government-guaranteed R5-billion loan to improve the freight rail sector.

src: .6 Befondsing vir ontwikkeling Die befondsing van R17,8 miljard van BRICS se Nuwe Ontwikkelingsbank (NOB) vir infrastruktuurprojekte in water en sanitasie, wat onlangs goedgekeur is, sal infrastruktuuragterstande verminder en die voorsiening van basiese dienste aan arm huishoudings verseker.
tgt: Cabinet expressed appreciation for the funding, which will greatly accelerate infrastructure development in our nation and contribute to improving the lives of people.

src: Die (NOB) het ook 'n ooreenkoms met Transnet aangegaan vir 'n lening van R5 miljard, wat deur die regering gewaarborg is om die vragspoorsektor te verbeter.
tgt: Social well-being imperatives Government strives to:o build a better South Africa for all ando ensure equity, access and inclusion to services.

src: Die gesondheidsooreenkoms is 'n raamwerk vir samewerking tussen kritieke sektore en belanghebbendes soos die regering, die sakesektor, arbeid, die burgerlike samelewing, gesondheidswerkers, vakbonde, diensgebruikers, statutêre rade, die akademie en navorsers.
tgt: The health compact seeks to bolster the development of human resources while improving access to medicine, vaccines and health products, along with upgrading infrastructure and ensuring private sector engagement.

src: Dit is daarop gerig om die gesondheidstelsel te versterk en dit monitor en evalueer voorbereidings vir die implementering van die Nasionale Gesondheidsversekering.
tgt: Fight against crime and corruption Government has zero-tolerance for crime, fraud and corruption and will hold those who violate the laws of our country accountable.

src: Die gesondheidsooreenkoms onderneem om die ontwikkeling van menslike hulpbronne te versterk, terwyl toegang tot medisyne, entstowwe en gesondheidsprodukte verbeter word saam met die opgradering van infrastruktuur en die versekering van betrokkenheid by die private sektor.
tgt: .1 Unrelenting fight against crime Cabinet remains determined to ensure that South Africa is a society where all people feel safe and the recent arrests and conviction of suspects involved in various serious crimes demonstrates the commitment to push back against crime.

src: Stryd teen misdaad en korrupsie Die Regering het zero toleransie vir misdaad, bedrog en korrupsie en sal diegene wat die wette van ons land oortree, aanspreeklik hou.
tgt: The increase in contact crimes in the latest quarterly crime statistics for the first quarter from April to June 2024 indicates that more still needs to be done to ensure every citizen feels safe.

src: .1 Onverbiddelike stryd teen misdaad Die Kabinet bly vasbeslote om te verseker dat Suid-Afrika 'n samelewing is waar alle mense veilig voel.
tgt: The South African Police Service (SAPS), led by the Ministry of Police, is actively fighting these crimes.

src: operasies in die Oos-Kaap, met die fokus op Mthatha en Nelson Mandelabaai.
tgt: arrests made in Gauteng, Mpumalanga and the Free State related to extortion activities.

src: inhegtenisnemings in Gauteng, Mpumalanga en die Vrystaat wat verband hou met afpersingsaktiwiteite Die Regering stel tans ’n volledige regeringsbenadering in werking, insluitend: ondertekening van koöperatiewe ooreenkomste met provinsiale en plaaslike regerings
tgt: Government is implementing a whole government approach, including: signing cooperative agreements with provincial and local governments.

src: inwerkingstelling van operasionele planne in Kaapstad en Nelson Mandelabaai, met planne om dit in alle metro's te herhaal
tgt: rolling out operational plans in Cape Town and Nelson Mandela Bay, with plans to replicate in all metros.

src: skakeling met susterdepartemente om samewerking teen misdaad te verbeter.
tgt: engaging with sister departments to improve collaboration against crime.

src: Die Nasionale Polisiëringsbeleid sal teen die einde van Oktober 2024 voltooi en aanvaar word om aandag te gee aan kwessies soos polisiestasies en infrastruktuur wat op norme en standaarde gegrond is.
tgt: The National Policing Policy is set to be completed and adopted by the end of October 2024 to address issues such as police stations and infrastructure based on norms and standards.

src: Dit sal samewerking en koördinering tussen alle belanghebbendes bevorder om veiligheids- en sekuriteitskwessies te hanteer.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the signing of the Cooperation Agreement to Combat Crime in the Western Cape, which enhances collaboration and coordination among all stakeholders to address safety and security concerns.

src: Deur gemeenskapsgedrewe inisiatiewe, die integrasie van hulpbronne en die ontwikkeling van innoverende strategieë, maak die ooreenkoms voorsiening vir 'n verenigde front tussen die SAPD, die provinsie en gemeenskappe om misdaad te bekamp en openbare veiligheid te bevorder.
tgt: Through community-driven initiatives, the integration of resources and the development of innovative strategies, the agreement allows for a united front between SAPS, the province and communities to combat crime and promote public safety.

src: In ooreenstemming met die verbintenisse wat President Ramaphosa tydens sy Parlementsopeningstoespraak op 18 Julie 2024 gemaak het om 'n veiliger land te bou, het ons wetstoepassingsagentskappe die stryd teen misdaad verskerp.
tgt: Consistent with the commitments made by President Ramaphosa during his Opening of Parliament Address on 18 July 2024 to build a safer country, our law-enforcement agencies have stepped up the fight against crime.

src: Die Direktoraat vir Prioriteitsmisdaadondersoek (DPCI), ook bekend as die Valke, het in die eerste kwartaal van 2024/25 673 verdagtes in hegtenis geneem, waarvan 506 skuldig bevind is en 77 hofbevele toegestaan is vir die beslaglegging op bates wat met kriminele aktiwiteite verband hou.
tgt: The Directorate for Priority Crime Investigation (DPCI), also called the Hawks, arrested 673 suspects during the first quarter of 2024/25, of which 506 were convicted and 77 court orders granted for the seizure of assets connected to criminal activities.

src: Die polisie het van 19 tot 25 Augustus 2024 ook 14 422 verdagtes in hegtenis geneem vir verskeie misdade deur Operasie Shanela.
tgt: The police also arrested 14 422 suspects for various crimes through Operation Shanela from 19 to 25 August 2024.

src: ’n Multidissiplinêre klopjagoperasie deur die polisie, metropolisie, korrektiewe dienste, binnelandse sake en ander wetstoepassingsagentskappe in ses gekaapte geboue in Durban, het tot die ontdekking van R4 miljoen se vervalste Amerikaanse dollars, beslaglegging op dwelms en drank asook 117 rondes ammunisie gelei.
tgt: A multidisciplinary raid operation by the police, metro police, correctional services, Home Affairs and other law-enforcement agencies in six hijacked buildings in Durban led to the discovery of R4 million in counterfeit United States dollars, seizure of drugs, 117 rounds of ammunition and liquor, and arrest of more than 150 allegedly undocumented foreign nationals.

src: Hierdie suksesse volg op beduidende vordering met die aftakeling van 'n transnasionale misdaadsindikaat in die land sedert die begin van die jaar.
tgt: These successes follow significant inroads made in dismantling a transnational crime syndicate in the country since the beginning of the year.

src: Die DPCI het 10 klandestiene dwelmlaboratoriums ontbloot en 34 mense gearresteer vir die vervaardiging, handel en besit van onwettige dwelms.
tgt: The DPCI has uncovered 10 clandestine drug laboratories and arrested 34 persons for manufacturing, dealing and possession of illicit drugs.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om steeds met wetstoepassingsagentskappe saam te werk deur onwettige dade by die polisie aan te meld by 1011.1 om misdadigers van ons strate af te hou.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to continue to work with law-enforcement agencies by reporting illegal acts to the police on 1011.1 to help keep criminals off our streets.

src: Die stryd teen misdaad is 'n gedeelde verantwoordelikheid en die regering sal voortgaan om enige inisiatiewe te bevorder wat alle mense in die samelewing sal mobiliseer om saam te werk vir 'n beter en veiliger Suid-Afrika.
tgt: The fight against crime is a shared responsibility and government will continue to champion all initiatives that will mobilise all people in society to work together towards a better and safer South Africa.

src: .2 Hou die korruptes aanspreeklik Die Kabinet verwelkom die bewaringsbevel van R6,5 miljoen teen diegene wat betrokke is by die plundering van fondse by die Nasionale Loteryekommissie.
tgt: .2 Holding the corrupt accountable Cabinet welcomes the preservation order of R.5 million against those involved in looting funds at the National Lotteries Commission.

src: Hierdie optrede ondersteun die implementering van die Teenkorrupsiestrategie, wat wetstoepassers byeenbring in die stryd teen korrupsie.
tgt: These actions support the implementation of the Anti-Corruption Strategy, which brings together law-enforcement agencies in the fight against corruption.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom verder die uitspraak deur 'n Londense hof om die uitlewering van die Britse burger en voormalige Eskom-kontrakteur, mnrMichael Lomas, aan Suid-Afrika toe te laat waar hy korrupsieklagtes in die gesig staar.
tgt: Cabinet further welcomes the ruling by a London Court to allow the extradition of British national and former Eskom contractor, Mr Michael Lomas, to South Africa to face corruption charges.

src: MnrLomas sal uitgelewer word om tereg te staan op 41 ernstige korrupsieklagte wat verband hou met die bou van die Kusile-kragstasie.
tgt: Mr Lomas will be extradited to face 41 serious corruption charges related to the construction of the Kusile Power Station.

src: Hierdie uitspraak is ook 'n mosie van vertroue in ons strafregstelsel en bevestig ons verbintenis om internasionale menseregteverpligtinge na te kom.
tgt: This ruling is also a vote of confidence in our criminal justice system and affirms our commitment to comply with international human rights obligations.

src: In sy uitspraak het regter Charles Bourne gesê dat die Suid-Afrikaanse gevangenisstelsel toepaslike maatreëls het en in die saak teen mnrLomas se behoeftes kan voorsien.
tgt: In his ruling, Judge Charles Bourne stated that the South African prison system has appropriate measures and can meet the needs of Mr Lomas.

src: Die ondertekening van 'n proklamasie deur President Ramaphosa, wat die Spesiale Ondersoekeenheid (SOE) magtig om bewerings van korrupsie en wanadministrasie by Eskom te ondersoek, versterk pogings om diegene wat by korrupsie-aktiwiteite by dié staatsentiteit betrokke is, aanspreeklik te hou.
tgt: The signing of a proclamation by President Ramaphosa authorising the Special Investigating Unit (SIU) to investigate allegations of corruption and maladministration at Eskom strengthens efforts to hold those involved in corruption activities at the State entity accountable.

src: Die proklamasie sluit in bewerings van onwettige en onbehoorlike gedrag wat tussen 1 Maart 2006 en 30 Augustus 2024 plaasgevind het nege kontrakte sal ondersoek word.
tgt: The proclamation covers allegations of unlawful and improper conduct that occurred between 1 March 2006 and 30 August 2024, and nine contracts will be investigated.

src: Die president het ook 'n proklamasie gewysig wat die SOE magtig om verdere klagte van beweerde korrupsie by die Departement van Landelike Ontwikkeling en Grondhervorming te ondersoek.
tgt: The President also amended a proclamation authorising the SIU to investigate further areas of allegations of corruption at the Department of Rural Development and Land Reform.

src: Die Kabinet het die 15-jaar-vonnis van die voormalige Hoof van Ingenieurswese by die Passasierspooragentskap van Suid-Afrika, mnrDaniel Mthimkhulu, deur die Palm Ridge-handelsmisdaadhof geloof.
tgt: Cabinet applauded the 15-year sentence of the former Head of Engineering at the Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa, Mr Daniel Mthimkhulu, by the Palm Ridge Commercial Crimes Court.

src: Hierdie vonnis is 'n beduidende oorwinning in die stryd teen korrupsie en bedrog binne die land se instellings.
tgt: This sentence marks a significant victory in the fight against corruption and fraud within the country’s institutions.

src: Dit dui verder op die regering se verbintenis om oneerlike praktyke uit te roei en aanspreeklikheid op alle vlakke te verseker.
tgt: It further demonstrates government’s commitment to rooting out dishonest practices and ensuring accountability at all levels.

src: Die Kabinet volg 'n zero-toleransiebenadering teen afpersing Suid-Afrika leer uit internasionale beste praktyke om strategieë te ontwikkel om voorvalle van afpersing beslissend te hanteer.
tgt: .3 Fight against extortionCabinet takes a zero-tolerance approach against extortion South Africa is learning from international best practices to develop strategies to deal decisively with incidents of extortion.

src: 'n Volledige samelewingsbenadering en 'n verenigde poging van die regering, wetstoepassingsagentskappe, besighede en gemeenskappe is nodig om 'n verenigde front te skep om hierdie misdaad te bekamp.
tgt: A whole-of-society approach and a unified effort from government, law-enforcement agencies, businesses and communities are needed to create a united front to combat this crime.

src: Afpersing benadeel nie net individue nie dit ondermyn ons hele ekonomie.
tgt: Extortion does not just harm individuals it undermines our entire economy.

src: Deur hierdie misdaad te beveg, beskerm ons werksgeleenthede, moedig ons beleggings aan en ons bevorder ekonomiese groei.
tgt: By fighting this crime, we are protecting jobs, encouraging investment and promoting economic growth.

src: Ons bemagtig gemeenskappe om op te staan teen afpersing.
tgt: We are empowering communities to stand up against extortion.

src: Deur opvoeding, ondersteuningsnetwerke, en vertroulike aanmeldstelsels, maak ons dit veiliger vir mense om nee te sê vir misdadigers.
tgt: Through education, support networks, and confidential reporting systems, we're making it safer for people to say no to criminals.

src: Die SAPD word toegerus met die jongste instrumente en tegnieke om afpersing te bekamp, insluitend gevorderde tegnieke vir die insamel van intelligensie, asook gespesialiseerde taakmagte, om voor te bly teen kriminele taktiek en aktiwiteite.
tgt: The SAPS is being equipped with the latest tools and techniques to combat extortion, including advanced intelligence gathering and specialised task forces, to staying ahead of criminal tactics.

src: Afpersing floreer dikwels waar daar 'n gebrek aan ekonomiese geleenthede is.
tgt: Extortion often thrives where there is a lack of economic opportunity.

src: Die regering gee aandag aan die basiese oorsake deur saam met ons wetstoepassingspogings in onderwys, werkskepping en gemeenskapsontwikkeling te belê.
tgt: Government is addressing root causes by investing in education, job creation, and community development alongside our law enforcement efforts.

src: Die Regering werk nou saam met internasionale vennote om intelligensie te deel, kriminele netwerke op te spoor en oortreders voor die gereg te bring.
tgt: Government is working closely with international partners to share intelligence, track criminal networks and bring offenders to justice.

src: Ons pogings is veral gefokus op die beskerming van kwesbare individue en besighede wat dikwels die primêre teikens van afpersing is.
tgt: Our efforts are particularly focused on protecting vulnerable individuals and businesses who are often the primary targets of extortion.

src: Niemand behoort in vrees in hul eie gemeenskap te leef nie.
tgt: No one should have to live in fear in their own community.

src: Die Regering is verbind tot 'n volgehoue, langtermynpoging om hierdie misdaad uit te roei en blywende veiligheid en sekuriteit vir alle Suid-Afrikaners te skep.
tgt: Government is committed to a sustained, long-term effort to root out this crime and create lasting safety and security for all South Africans.

src: .4 Bedrieglike mediese regseise Die Kabinet is geskok dat sommige gewetenlose en gierige prokureurs en advokate probeer het om miljarde rande uit die staat op bedrieglik wyse te bekom deur vals en onreëlmatige mediese regseise.
tgt: .4 Fraudulent medico-legal claims Cabinet is appalled that some unscrupulous and greedy lawyers and advocates have attempted to swindle billions of rands from the State through fraudulent and irregular medico-legal claims.

src: Hierdie oortredings is ontbloot in 'n verreikende ondersoek deur die SOE na beweerde bedrieglike mediese regseise teen die Staat sedert 2017.
tgt: These wrongdoings were uncovered in a far-reaching investigation by the SIU into alleged fraudulent medico-legal claims against the State since 2017.

src: Die voortgesette ondersoek het aan die lig gebring dat sommige regspraktisyns soms met behulp van gesondheidspraktisyns wat vir die staat werk, provinsiale departemente van gesondheid teiken, en sake wat deur die SOE afgehandel is, tot minstens R3 miljard se besparings vir verskeie Departemente van Gesondheid gelei het.
tgt: The ongoing investigation revealed that some legal practitioners at times with the help of health practitioners working for the State, have been targeting provincial Departments of Health, and matters completed by the SIU have resulted in at least R3 billion in savings for various Departments of Health.

src: Bestuursimperatiewe Die Regering van Nasionale Eenheid (RNE) fokus op die verbetering van staatskapasiteit om belangrike regeringsdoelwitte te bereik.
tgt: Governance imperatives The Government of National Unity (GNU) is focused on enhancing state capacity to deliver on key government objectives.

src: RNE-vennote is daartoe verbind om hul kollektiewe wil in te span om die lewens van alle Suid-Afrikaners te verbeter.
tgt: GNU partners are committed to harnessing their collective will to improve the lives of all South Africans.

src: Ons het 'n duidelike voorneme om 'n meer responsiewe benadering oor alle regeringsfere heen te bevorder – op nasionale, provinsiale en plaaslike vlak Noemenswaardige ontwikkelings oor bestuursimperatiewe
tgt: We have a clear resolve to foster a more responsive approach across all spheres of government – at national, provincial and local level.

src: .1 Verbetering van waterhulpbronbestuur Pogings om die bestuur van bestaande waterbates te verbeter en watersekerheid oor die volgende dekade te verseker, is versterk toe President Ramaphosa ingestem het tot die wet op die Suid-Afrikaanse Agentskap vir Nasionale Waterhulpbroninfrastruktuur SOC Bpk.
tgt: Notable developments on governance imperatives.1 Improving the management of water resources Efforts to improve the management of existing water assets and ensure water security over the next decade has been boosted with the assent by President Ramaphosa of the South African National Water Resources Infrastructure Agency SOC Ltd Bill, which establishes a new agency that will be responsible for developing and managing national water infrastructure.

src: Dit lei tot die stigting van ’n nuwe agentskap wat verantwoordelik sal wees vir die ontwikkeling en bestuur van nasionale waterinfrastruktuur.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the new legislation as signifying a critical step in the reform process to increase investment in the maintenance and construction of water infrastructure and improvement of water quality.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die nuwe wetgewing as 'n kritieke stap in die hervormingsproses om belegging in die instandhouding en konstruksie van waterinfrastruktuur en die verbetering van watergehalte te verhoog.
tgt: .2 Local government audit outcomes Cabinet notes the Municipal Audit Outcomes by the Auditor-General of South Africa (AGSA) for the 2022/23 that show gradual improvement in financial management within some municipalities.

src: Daar is egter voortdurend meer werk wat gedoen moet word om nakoming in baie munisipaliteite wat steeds negatiewe oudituitkomste bereik, te verbeter.
tgt: Nevertheless, there remains more work to be done to improve compliance across many municipalities that continue to receive negative audit outcomes.

src: Die OGSA-verslag dui aan dat net 34 van 257 metropolitaanse, distriks- en plaaslike munisipaliteite skoon oudituitkomste bereik het.
tgt: The AGSA report shows only 34 of 257 metropolitan, district and local municipalities received clean audit outcomes.

src: Op 'n positiewe noot het die aantal gediskrediteerde oudits afgeneem terwyl 45 munisipaliteite hul oudituitkomste sedert 2020/21 verbeter het en dié wat hul finansiële state betyds ingedien het, van sowat 81% in 2020/21 tot 94% in 2022/23 verbeter het.
tgt: On a positive note, the number of disclaimed audits decreased while 45 municipalities improved their audit outcomes since 2020/21 and those that submitted their financial statements on time improved from some 81% in 2020/21 to 94% in 2022/23.

src: Die Kabinet is bemoedig dat die Departement van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele Sake, tesame met die OGSA, voortgaan om inisiatiewe te ondersteun en te implementeer wat daarop gemik is om die verbeterings wat in sommige munisipaliteite aangeteken is, te konsolideer.
tgt: Cabinet is encouraged that the Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, together with the AGSA, continue to support and implement initiatives aimed at consolidating the improvements recorded in some municipalities.

src: Die departement het ook voorkeur daaraan gegee om die munisipaliteite wat die swakste presteer te help deur die bevoegdheid van personeel met opleiding en vaardigheidsoordrag te verbeter, asook om regulasies oor minimum standaarde vir munisipale bestuurders en senior amptenare af te dwing.
tgt: The department has also prioritised assisting the worst-performing municipalities in the country by improving the competency of personnel though training and skills transfer, as well as enforcing regulations on minimum standards for municipal managers and senior officials.

src: Nasionale Polisieherdenkingsdag Die Kabinet het inligting ontvang oor die Nasionale Polisieherdenkingsdag, wat op Sondag 1 September 2024 gehou is.
tgt: Updates to Cabinet National Police Commemoration Day

src: Die Herdenkingsdag is daarop gemik om die vroue en mans in blou wat hul lewens in die uitvoering van hul pligte verloor het, te vereer en ook die nodige stappe te doen om hul gesinne en veral hul skoolgaande kinders te onderhou.
tgt: The Commemoration Day is aimed to honour the women and men in blue who lost their lives in the line of duty, and also take the necessary steps to support their families and especially their school going age children.

src: Die regering is ontstoke oor die 39 polisiebeamptes wat in die uitvoering van hul plig gesterf het en sal beslissend optree teenoor enigiemand wat betrokke is by moord op polisiebeamptes in die uitvoering van hul plig.
tgt: Government takes an exception on the 39 police officers that have died in the line of duty and will deal decisively with anyone who is involved in the killing of police officers in the line of duty.

src: Die Regering prioritiseer die stryd teen alle misdadigheid en sal die wette versterk wat die regering in staat stel om misdaadbekamping nog kragtiger te beveg.
tgt: Government is prioritising the fight against all acts of criminality and will strengthen the laws that will enable government to enhance its crime-fighting efforts.

src: (ii) Suid-Afrika se vordering om gryslys-tekortkominge teen geldwassery aan te pak soos beoordeel deur die Finansiële Aksie-taakspan (FATS)
tgt: (ii) South Africa’s progress in addressing grey-listing anti-money laundering deficiencies as assessed by the Financial Action Task Force (FATF)

src: Sedert Suid-Afrika in Februarie 2023 op die gryslys geplaas is, het die Kabinet die vierde vorderingsverslag van die Interdepartementele Komitee oor Geldwassery en die Bekamping van die Finansiering van Terrorisme (IDC-AML/CFT) ontvang.
tgt: Cabinet received the fourth progress report by the Interdepartmental Committee on Anti-Money Laundering and Combatting the Financing of Terrorism (IDC-AML/CFT) since South Africa was grey-listed in February 2023.

src: Dit gee uitvoering aan die kabinetsbesluit van 27 September 2023 dat die IDC-AML/CFT, wat oor die vordering verslag doen, drie keer per jaar ter tafel gelê sal word.
tgt: It gives effect to the Cabinet decision of 27 September 2023 that the IDC-AML/CFT that reports on progress be tabled three times a year.

src: Suid-Afrika het beduidende vordering gemaak om tegniese voldoeningstekorte die hoof te bied.
tgt: There has been significant progress for South Africa to address technical compliance deficiencies and of the 20 technical compliance requirements, 15 have been fully addressed.

src: Uit van die 20 tegniese voldoeningsvereistes is 15 volledig reggestel.
tgt: For South Africa to completely exit the grey-listing had 22 actions identified as deficiencies on effectiveness, of which 8 of these items have been fully addressed, leaving 14 items to be addressed by February 2025.

src: Vir Suid-Afrika om heeltemal van die gryslys verwyder te word, is 22 aksies geïdentifiseer as tekortkominge ten opsigte van doeltreffendheid agt van hierdie items is volledig reggestel, wat beteken nog 14 items moet teen Februarie 2025 reggestel word.
tgt: Cabinet takes notes of complexities of the nature of issues to be addressed, but remains committed to ensuring that efforts are heightened to address the remaining actions, and also takes note that South Africa’s efforts are yielding better outcomes compared to the well-developed countries like United States of America, which is still heading behind South Africa.

src: (iii) Cannabis-meesterplan
tgt: (iii) Cannabis Master Plan

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor vordering met die ontwikkeling van die Cannabis-meesterplan, wat daarop gemik is om 'n raamwerk te voorsien vir die vestiging, kweek en ontwikkeling van die dagga- en hennepbedryf in Suid-Afrika en om by te dra tot ekonomiese groei, armoedeverligting en werkskepping.
tgt: Cabinet received a briefing on the progress on the development of the Cannabis Master Plan, which aims to provide a framework for the establishment, growth and development of the cannabis and hemp industry in South Africa to contribute to economic growth, poverty alleviation and job creation.

src: Die Mesterplan is op nege pilare gevestig, naamlik Doeltreffende Reguleringsdienste Volhoubare Saadvoorsieningstelsels Navorsing en Tegnologie-ontwikkeling Produsente-Ondersteuningstelsels Markontwikkeling Ondernemings- en Verskaffersontwikkeling Vervaardiging en Produkontwikkeling Onderwys en Opleiding en Kommunikasie en Bewustheid Hier volg ’n kort opsomming van vordering tot op datum:i. Ná die verklaring van hennep as landbougewas is altesaam een duisend eenhonderd en tien (1 110) permitte uitgereik vir hennepverbouing.
tgt: The Master Plan is anchored on nine pillars, namely Effective Regulatory Services Sustainable Seed Supply Systems Research and Technology Development Producer Support Systems Market Development Enterprise and Supplier Development Manufacturing and Product Development Education and Training and Communication and Awareness.

src: ii.
tgt: i.

src: iii.
tgt: ii.

src: Die Departement van Justisie en Grondwetlike Ontwikkeling het die proses om die regulasies op te stel begin ter ondersteuning van die kweek van cannabis vir private doeleindes.
tgt: President Ramaphosa approved the Cannabis for Private Purposes Bill in May 2024.iii.

src: iv.
tgt: iv.

src: Die Departement van Gesondheid, deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Reguleringsowerheid vir Gesondheidsprodukte, het raadpleging oor veranderinge aan die skedules van die Wet op Meisyne en Verwante Middels, 1965 (Wet 101 van 1965) afgehandel.
tgt: The Department of Health, through the South African Health Products Regulatory Authority, has concluded consultations on changes to the Schedules of the Medicines and Related Substances Act, 1965 (Act 101 of 1965).v.

src: v. Die Departement van Handel, Nywerheid en Meedinging (die DHNM) het situasie- en waardekettingontleding oor die Hennep- en Daggasektor in Suid-Afrika afgehandel die DHNM sal binnekort met raadpleging oor die Beleid vir die Kommersialisering van Cannabis WEBTOKEDie Landbounavorsingsraad (LNR) het twee hennepvariëteite ontwikkel en met die ondersteuning van die Departement van Landbou, Grondhervorming en Landelike Ontwikkeling (DLGLO) ervaar die raad tans 'n tweede seisoen van saadvermenigvuldiging om dit vir die 2025-plantseisoen beskikbaar te stel.
tgt: The Department of Trade, Industry and Competition (the dtic) concluded situational and value chain analysis on the Hemp and Cannabis sector in South Africa, the dtic will soon commence consultations on the Cannabis Commercialisation WEBTOKEThe Agricultural Research Council (ARC) developed two hemp varieties and with the support of the Department of Agriculture, Land Reform and Rural Development (DALRRD), is currently undergoing a second season of seed multiplication to make it available for the 2025 planting season.

src: vii.
tgt: vii.

src: In Me 2024, het die Minister van Landbou, Grondhervorming en Landelike Ontwikkeling die Hennep Sertifiseringskema goedgekeur om die variëteitsintegriteit en gehalte van hennepvoortplantingsmateriaal te reguleer om die volhoubare saadstelsel van hennep te ondersteun.
tgt: In May 2024, the Minister of Agriculture, Land Reform and Rural Development approved the Hemp Certification Scheme to regulate the varietal integrity and quality of hemp propagation material towards supporting sustainable seed system of hemp.

src: viii.
tgt: viii.

src: Die DLGLO het navorsing ter waarde van R124 miljoen by die LNR laat doen, wat fokus op cannabisverbouing vir medisinale, vesel- en ander gebruike, toesig oor daggaplantsiektes, inheemse kiemplasmaversameling, en cannabis-saadstelselontwikkelingix.
tgt: The DALRRD has commissioned research to the value of R124 million with the ARC which focusses on cannabis breeding for medicinal, fibre and other uses, cannabis plant disease surveillance, indigenous germplasm collection, Cannabis seed system developmentix.

src: In Gauteng, in samewerking met die Wetenskaplike en Nywerheidsnavorsingsraad, is 10 klein-, medium- en mikro-ondernemings vir produkontwikkeling ondersteun.
tgt: In Gauteng, in collaboration with the Council for Scientific and Industrial Research, 10 small, medium and micro enterprises were supported for product development.

src: Die DLGLO gaan voort om provinsies te raadpleeg oor verpligtinge tot dusver.
tgt: The DALRRD continues to consult provinces on commitments thus far.

src: x. Om die kapasiteit van die departement te verbeter om die verbouing van hennep deur permithouers te monitor, het die LNR 'n gedetailleerde opleidingsprogram vir inspeksiedienste ontwikkel.
tgt: To improve the capacity of the department to monitor cultivation of hemp by permit holders, the ARC developed a detailed training programme for inspection services.

src: (iv) Geïntegreerde Staatsdiensmaand
tgt: (iv) Integrated Public Service Month

src: Die Kabinet het 'n inligtingsessie ontvang oor planne om vanjaar se Geïntegreerde Staatsdiensmaand waar te neem.
tgt: Cabinet received a briefing on plans to observe this year’s Integrated Public Service Month.

src: Vanjaar se Geïntegreerde Staatsdiensmaand word gevier onder die tema: "Regering wat werk".
tgt: This year’s Integrated Public Service Month is celebrated under the theme: “Government that works”.

src: Staatsdiensmaand dien as 'n herinnering aan wat dit beteken om gemeenskappe te dien en ook te kyk na die impak wat die regering het, veral rondom kwessies van dienslewering.
tgt: Public Service Month serves as a reminder of what it means to serve communities and to also look at the impact government has, especially around issues of service delivery.

src: Suid-Afrika vier vanjaar 30 Jaar van Demokrasie en die 27ste herdenking van die Batho Pele-Witskrif as raamwerk vir die transformasie van openbare dienslewering in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: This year, South Africa celebrates 30 Years of Democracy and the 27th anniversary of the Batho Pele White Paper as a framework for the transformation of public service delivery in South Africa.

src: Die Geïntegreerde staatswye program sluit Staatsdiensmaand, Erfenismaand, Toerismemaand en Boomplantmaand in.
tgt: The Integrated government-wide programme includes Public Service Month Heritage Month Tourism Month and Arbor Month.

src: Alle aanstellings is onderhewig aan verifikasie van kwalifikasie en toepaslike sekuriteitsklaring.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to verification of qualification and relevant security clearance.

src: Me Yolanda Batandwa Damoyi as Uitvoerende Direkteur in die Raad van die Openbare Beleggingskorporasie.
tgt: Ms. Yolanda Batandwa Damoyi as Executive Director on the Board of the Public Investment Corporation.

src: Me Thulisile Glory Manzini as Direkteur-Generaal in die Departement van Kleinsakeontwikkeling.
tgt: Ms. Thulisile Glory Manzini as the Director-General in the Department of Small Business Development.

tgt: Mpati Lebakeng – Non-Executive Member Dr Olga Masekoa – Departmental representative (vi) Ms. Hellen Diatile NUM main member representative(vii) Mr Thapelo Malekutu NUM alternate member(viii) Ms. Adele Rossouw Solidarity main member representative(ix) Mr Johan Du Toit Böning – Solidarity alternative member representative Mr Jacques Hugo – UASA representative(xi) Ms. Danile Nyakale – IDC main member representative(xii) Mr Lefu Dlamini – IDC alternate representative(xiii) Ms. Nosiphiwo Mzamo – Non-executive member (Ex-Officio) and(xiv) Mr Cecil Khosa – Non-executive member (Ex-Officio).Upcoming eventsa) Heritage Month In September, South Africa marks Heritage Month under theme: “Celebrating the lives of our heroes and heroines who laid down their lives for our freedom”.

src: Tydens hierdie maand sal die regering die Ballingskap-repatriasieprojek van stapel stuur dit is daarop gemik om die menslike oorskot van die vryheidsvegters wat in ballingskap gesterf het, huistoe te bring en gesinne sodoende met aanvaarding te help, asook om die genesing en herstel van ons land te bewerkstelling.
tgt: During this month, government will launch the Exile Repatriation Project aimed at bringing home the remains of the freedom fighters who died in exile to help bring closure to families, and the healing and restoration of our nation.

src: Die inisiatief vorm deel van die Nasionale Beleid vir die Repatriasie en Restitusie van Meslike Oorskot en Erfenisvoorwerpe.
tgt: The initiative forms part of National Policy for the Repatriation and Restitution of Human Remains and Heritage Objects.

src: Diegene wat hul lewens vir ons vryheid opgeoffer het, het die weg gebaan vir ons grondwetlike demokrasie wat gegrond is op die beginsels van menswaardigheid en gelyke regte vir almal.
tgt: Those who sacrificed their lives for our freedom have laid the path for our constitutional democracy founded on the principles of human dignity and equal rights for everyone.

src: Die Regering doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om tydens Erfenismaand groter maatskaplike samehorigheid, nasiebou en 'n gedeelde nasionale identiteit te bevorder, asook om diegene te eer wat hul lewens vir ons opgeoffer het om vryheid te verkry.
tgt: Government calls on all South Africans to use Heritage Month to foster greater social cohesion, nation building and a shared national identity as well as honour those who sacrificed their lives for us to gain freedom.

src: b) Verenigde Nasies se 79e Algemene Vergadering (UNGA) President Ramaphosa sal die Suid-Afrikaanse afvaardiging na die Algemene Debat van UNGA se 79ste sessie, wat van 24 tot 30 September 2024 in New York plaasvind, lei.
tgt: b) 79th United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) President Ramaphosa will lead the South African delegation to the General Debate of the 79th Session of UNGA in New York from 24 to 30 September 2024.

src: Die vergadering vind vanjaar plaas onder die tema: "Eenheid in diversiteit, vir die bevordering van vrede, volhoubare ontwikkeling en menswaardigheid vir almal oral."
tgt: This year the assembly is convened under the theme: “Unity in diversity, for the advancement of peace, sustainable development and human dignity for everyone everywhere.”

src: President Ramaphosa sal die Algemene Vergadering op 24 September 2024 toespreek en die huidige globale en kontinentale vredes-, veiligheids- en ontwikkelingsuitdagings bespreek.
tgt: President Ramaphosa will address the General Assembly on 24 September 2024, providing an assessment of the current global and continental peace, security and development challenges.

src: Voor UNGA 79 sal die sekretaris-generaal van die VN die Toekomsberaad op 20 en 21 September 2024 by die VN se hoofkwartier aanbied.
tgt: Preceding UNGA 79, the Secretary-General of the UN will convene the Summit of the Future on 20 and 21 September 2024 at UN Headquarters.

src: Die beraad bring wêreldleiers byeen om 'n nuwe internasionale konsensus te bewerkstellig oor hoe om 'n beter hede te lewer, terwyl dit ook die toekoms beskerm.
tgt: The summit brings together world leaders to forge a new international consensus on how to deliver a better present while also safeguarding the future.

src: c) Uitstalling en lugskou deur Afrika Lugvaart en Verdediging (AAD) 2024 President Ramaphosa sal die AAD-ekspo, wat van 18 tot 22 September 2024 by die lugmagbasis Waterkloof in Pretoria plaasvind, open.
tgt: c) Africa Aerospace and Defence (AAD) exhibition and Airshow 2024 President Ramaphosa will open the AAD expo, which will take place from 18 to 22 September 2024 at the Air Force Base Waterkloof in Gauteng under the theme: “Exploring New Paths, Sharing Solutions, Showcasing Innovation and Capability”.

src: Die AAD is die enigste verdedigingsuitstalling wat deur Suid-Afrika op die vasteland van Afrika aangebied word en tel onder die top ses op die wêreldwye verdedigings kalender.
tgt: The AAD is the only Defence exhibition hosted on the African Continent by South Africa and ranked with the top six in the global Defence calendar with objectives to: showcase Defence and aerospace cutting-edge technology developed and manufactured in South Africa and around the world.

src: Die doelwitte van die uitstalling is om: die nuutste tegnologie vir verdediging en lugvaart wat in Suid-Afrika en regoor die wêreld ontwikkel en vervaardig is te vertoon
tgt: promote and drive exports which sustain the Defence and aviation industries.

src: uitvoere wat die verdedigings- en lugvaartbedryf onderhou te bevorder en te dryf
tgt: promote and reinforce South Africa’s position as a key driver of innovation and manufacturing.

src: internasionale vennootskappe besigheid-tot-besigheid- en regering-tot-regering-netwerke te fasiliteer Suid-Afrika as 'n voorkeurbestemming vir toerisme en besigheid te bevorder.
tgt: promote South Africa as a destination of choice for tourism and business.

src: by te dra tot werkskepping.
tgt: contribute to job creation.

src: 'n opvoedkundige platform te skep om loopbane en innovasie vir verdediging en lugvaart vir die jeug te bevorder.
tgt: create an educational platform to promote defense and aviation careers and innovation for the youth.

src: d) Internasionale Basketbalfederasie (FIBA) o.18 AfroBasket-toernooi Suid-Afrika bied van 1 tot 14 September 2024 ’n 12-nasie o.18 basketbal Afrika-kampioenskap in Pretoria aan.
tgt: d) FIBA Under-18 AfroBasket Tournament South Africa is currently hosting a 12 nation U18 Basketball African Championship in Pretoria from 1 to 14 September 2024.

src: Die toernooi sluit 12 manlike en 12 vroulike nasionale basketbalspanne in, wat in drie groepe verdeel is waarvan elk uit vier spanne bestaan.
tgt: The tournament features 12 male and 12 female national basketball teams divided into three groups, with each consisting of four teams.

src: e) Ondertekening van die Implementeringsprotokol tussen die departemente van Basiese Onderwys en Sport, Kuns en Kultuur Op 4 September 2024 het die Minister van Basiese Onderwys en die Minister van Sport, Kuns en Kultuur ’n protokol onderteken en van stapel gestuur om die wese van skoolsport te bevorder, en ook om die belangrikheid van komplimentêre kurrikulêre aktiwiteite in ons skole te ondersteun.
tgt: e) Signing of the Implementation Protocol between the departments Basic Education and Sport, Arts and Culture On 4 September 2024, the Ministers of Basic Education and Sport, Arts and Culture signed and Implementation Protocol to promote the essence of school sport, and also to support the importance of co-curricular activities in our schools to help develop learners holistically and assist them in developing critical skills and abilities to be successful and active citizens of this country.

src: Dit is daarop gerig om leerders holisties te help ontwikkel en om kritieke vaardighede en vermoëns aan te leer wat hulle sal voorberei om suksesvolle en aktiewe burgers van die land te wees.
tgt: The protocol incorporates a range of collaborative programmes such as Sport ambassadors National Youth Camp Indigenous Games Reading clubs Heritage Education Programme Spelling Bee The Young Patriots Programme Physical Education National Library Programme The South African Schools Choral Eisteddfod National Archives Awareness Week, among others.

src: Boodskappe Gelukwense
tgt: Congratulations

src: Die Kabinet dra sy gelukwense en goeie wense oor aan: Suid-Afrikaanse navorsers betrokke by die baanbrekerstudie BEAT-Tuberculosis (TB), wat die wêreld se eerste program geword het in die stryd teen middelweerstandige tuberkulose vir alle bevolkingsgroepe en wat die internasionale TB-behandelingsbeleid van die Wêreldgesondheidsorganisasie beïnvloed.
tgt: Cabinet extended its congratulations and well wishes to: South African researchers involved in the groundbreaking study, BEAT-Tuberculosis (TB), which has become the world’s first programme in the battle against drug-resistant tuberculosis for all population groups, influencing the international TB treatment policy of the World Health Organisation.

src: Warona Tsiane en Onalerona Tsiane, bekend as die Tee Sisters, vir die derde plek by die gesogte Wêreldbekerkompetisie van entrepreneurskap wat in Japan gehou is.
tgt: Warona Tsiane and Onalerona Tsiane, known as the Tee Sisters, for securing third place at the prestigious World Cup Competition of Entrepreneurship held in Japan.

src: Die Tee Sisters het ook twee toekennings vir Volhoubare Ontwikkelingsdoelwitte van die VN gewen, spesifiek vir doelwitte 1 (Geen Armoede) en 16 (Vrede, Geregtigheid en Sterk Instellings).
tgt: The Tee Sisters also won two Sustainable Development Goals awards from the UN, specifically for Goals 1 (No Poverty) and 16 (Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions).

src: Ons land se atlete by die o.20 Wêreldkampioenskappe en Paralimpiese Spele, veral vir : die vinnigste tiener ter wêreld, naelloper Bayanda Walaza met ‘n goue medalje in die 100 m- en 200 m-eindstryd by die o.20-wêreldkampioenskappe.
tgt: Our nation’s athletes at the Under-20 World Championships and Paralympic Games, notably: the fastest teenager in the world, sprinter Bayanda Walaza on his gold medal in the 100m and 200m final at the U20 World Championships.

src: Walaza is tans besig met sy matriek by Curro Hazeldean in Pretoria.
tgt: Walaza is currently doing his matric at Curro Hazeldean in Pretoria.

src: Bradley Nkoana vir 'n bronsmedalje vir die 100 m-finaal by die o.20 wêreldkampioenskappe.
tgt: Bradley Nkoana for a Bronze medal for the 100m final at the Under 20 (U20) World Championships.

src: Udeme Okon vir 'n goue medalje vir die 400 m-finaal by die o.20 wêreldkampioenskappe.
tgt: Udeme Okon for a Gold medal for the 400m final at the U20 World Championships.

src: ’n silwer medalje vir 4x400m mans aflosspan (Bryan Katoo, Sihle Mahlangu, Njabulo Mbatha, Udeme Okon) by die o.20 wêreldkampioenskappe.
tgt: Silver medal for 4x400m men’s relay team (Bryan Katoo, Sihle Mahlangu, Njabulo Mbatha, Udeme Okon) at the U20 World Championships.

src: JL van Rensburg vir 'n silwer medalje vir die mans gewigstoot by die o.20 wêreldkampioenskap-finaal.
tgt: JL van Rensburg for a Silver medal for the Men’s shot-put at the U20 World Championships final.

src: Hannah van Niekerk vir 'n bronsmedalje vir die 400m hekkies by die o.20 wêreldkampioenskappe.
tgt: Hannah van Niekerk for a Bronze medal for the 400m hurdles at the U20 World Championships.

src: Mpumelelo Mhlongo vir 'n goue medalje en nuwe wêreldrekord vir die T44 100m vir mans by die Paralimpiese Spele in Parys.
tgt: Mpumelelo Mhlongo for a Gold medal and new world record for the Men’s T44 100m at the Paralympic Games in Paris.

src: Louzanne Coetzee vir 'n bronsmedalje vir die vroue T11 1500m by die Paralimpiese Spele in Parys.
tgt: Louzanne Coetzee for a Bronze medal for the Women’s T11 1500m at the Paralympic Games in Paris.

src: Ronwen Williams, Bafana-Bafana en Mamelodi Sundowns se doelwagter, met sy benoeming as een van die 10 beste doelwagters ter wêreld by die Ballon d'Or-toekennings.
tgt: Ronwen Williams, Bafana-Bafana and Mamelodi Sundowns goalkeeper, on his nomination as one of the ten (10) best goalkeepers in the world at the Ballon d’Or awards

src: Die Springbokke, vir hulle oorwinning oor die All Blacks tydens die Castle Lager-rugbykampioenskap op Saterdag 31 Augustus 2024.
tgt: Springboks, for defeating the All Blacks during the Castle Lager Rugby Championship on Saturday, 31 August 2024.

src: Passasierspooragentskap van Suid-Afrika (PRASA) en die Gautrein vir die geïntegreerde vervoerdienste wat Suid-Afrikaners in staat gestel het om na die Springbokke vs. All Blacks rugbywedstryd op Ellispark in Johannesburg te gaan kyk.
tgt: Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa (PRASA) and Gautrain for providing integrated transport services that enabled South Africans to physically watch the Springboks and All Blacks rugby match.

src: Die Kabinet moedig die publiek verder aan om die PRASA-trein wat die handelsmerk: 30 jaar van vryheid en demokrasie vertoon, raak te sien en daarop te ry.
tgt: Cabinet further encourages the public to spot and ride the 30 years of freedom and democracy PRASA branded train.

src: Die Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel met die naasbestaandes en vriende van: ProfBrian O'Connell, voormalige Rektor en Vise-Kanselier van die Universiteit van die Wes-Kaap, wat van 2002 tot 2014 as Rektor gedien het.
tgt: Cabinet expressed condolences to the friends and family of: ProfBrian O'Connell, the former Rector and Vice-Chancellor at the University of the Western Cape.

src: Kwessies in die omgewing Ekonomie Positiewe ekonomiese aanwysers.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die positiewe ekonomiese aanwysers soos aangedui deur Statistieke Suid-Afrika (StatsSA).
tgt: Issues in the environment Economy.1 Positive Economic Indicators.1 Cabinet welcomed positive economic indicators as per the data released by Statistics South Africa (StatsSA).

src: .2 Op 23 September 2024 het StatsSA ŉ 0.4% verhoging in die bruto binnelandse produk (BBP) in die tweede kwartaal van 2024 bekendgemaak.
tgt: .2 On the 3rd September 2024, StatsSA announced a percent increase in Gross Domestic Product (GDP) in the second quarter of 2024.

src: Hierdie verhoging is deur die verbetering van 1.7% groei jaar-na-jaar in die vervaardigingsektor beïnvloed.
tgt: This increase was influenced by improvement in the manufacturing sector of percent growth year-on-year.

src: .3 Die verbeterings in die vervaardigingsektor is deur vyf (5) van die tien (10) afdelings van die vervaardigingbedryf aangedryf, naamlik voedsel en drank, basiese staal en yster, nie-ysterhoudende metaalprodukte, metaalprodukte en masjinerie.
tgt: .3 The improvements in the manufacturing sector were driven by five (5) of the ten (10) manufacturing divisions, namely food and beverages, basic iron and steel, nonferrous metal products, metal products and machinery sectors the recorded a rise in production.

src: .4 Die herlewing van die vervaardigingsektor is ŉ noodsaaklike suksesfaktor in die herindustrialisering van Suid-Afrika se nywerheidsektor.
tgt: .4 The revival of the manufacturing sector is a critical success factor in the re-industrialisation of South Africa.5 In addition, the Headline Consumer Price Index for all urban areas has indicated that annual inflation for August 2024 was 4.4%, which is down from 4.6% in July 2024.

src: .5 Hierbenewens het die verbruikersprysindeks – die algehele koers van prysstyging in ŉ ekonomie – vir alle stedelike areas aangedui dat die jaarlikse inflasie vir Augustus 2024 4% was, ŉ afname van 4.6% in Julie 2024.
tgt: The annual inflation rate of goods was 4.4%, down from 4.6% in July 2024, and similarly annual inflation rate for services was 4.5%, down from 4.7% in July 2024.

src: Die jaarlikse inflasiekoers van goedere was 4.4%, ŉ afname van 4.6% in Julie 2024.
tgt: There has been a consistent improvement in the CPI since March 2024.

src: Soortgelyke jaarlikse inflasiekoerse vir dienste was 4.5%, ŉ afname van 4.7% in Julie 2024.
tgt: The Revitalisation of State-Owned Companies (SOCs).1 Cabinet has welcomed the steady progress being made in revitalisation of the SOCs and improvements in SOC performance will positively contribute to SouthAfrica’s industrialisation drive.2 In this regard, it is worth noting that Denel posted a profit of R390 million before interest and tax for the 2023/24 financial year, with irregular expenditure declining by 98 percent.

src: Sedert Maart 2024 was daar ŉ konsekwente verbetering in die verbruikersprysindeks.
tgt: PRASA is making strong headway in getting passenger trains back on track with 31 of the 40 rail corridors now operational, and Eskom’s Recovery Plan continues to deliver positive outcomes, with load shedding remaining suspended for more than 175 days as of 18 September 2024.

src: Die herlewing van maatskappye in staatsbesit.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die bestendige vordering wat gemaak word met die herlewing van die ondernemings in staatsbesit (SOK's) verbeterings in SOK-prestasie sal positief bydra tot Suid-Afrika se industrialiseringsveldtog.
tgt: Fight against crime and corruption Operation Shanela.1 Cabinet welcomed progress being made in the fight against crime through Operation Shanela.

src: Eskom se herstelplan lewer steeds positiewe uitslae, met beurtkrag wat vir meer as 175 dae opgeskort is, tot en met 18 September 2024.
tgt: Since its launch in May 2023, Operation Shanelahas resulted in the arrest of 850 375 suspects, and seizure of 824 illegal firearms and over 17 282 rounds of ammunition.

src: Stryd teen misdaad en korrupsie Operasie Shanela.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die vordering wat Operasie Shanela in die stryd teen misdaad gemaak het.
tgt: In addition, drugs worth over R13 million were seized at the OR Tambo International Airport over the past two months, and copper worth over R20 million was recovered from a scrapyard near Durban with a suspect arrested.2 Through a coordinated multidisciplinary and intelligence-led operations, law enforcement agencies are focused on dismantling extortion syndicates across the country.

src: Tussen 2 en 8 September 2024 het wetstoepassingsagentskappe 13 691 verdagtes vir ernstige misdaad soos moord, verkragting, die besit van onwettige vuurwapens en sakeroof in hegtenis geneem.
tgt: Through a multidisciplinary collaboration, law enforcement agencies have arrested 14 suspects in Mpumalanga on charges of fraud and corruption for issuing illegal learners’ and driver’s licences, and 11 traffic officers were also arrested for soliciting bribes from motorists along the N1 freeway in Limpopo.2 Three off-duty police officers and a civilian were arrested in Durban, KZN for soliciting a R100 000 bribe from a businessman in exchange for the release of confiscated goods, and 4 more police officers handed themselves over to the SAPS on the same case.

src: Sedert Operasie Shanela in Me 2023 van stapel gestuur is, het die inisiatief tot die inhegtenisname van 850 375 verdagtes en beslaglegging op 824 onwettige vuurwapens asook meer as 17 282 rondtes ammunisie gelei.
tgt: .3 Furthermore, eight suspects were arrested for alleged involvement on tender fraud and corruption amounting to R850 million in the City of Cape Town, Western Cape.

src: Hierbenewens is daar in die afgelope twee maande op dwelms ter waarde van meer as R13 miljoen by OR Tambo Internasionale Lughawe beslag gelê, koper ter waarde van meer as R20 miljoen is in ŉ skrootwerf naby Durban opgespoor en een verdagte is in hegtenis geneem.
tgt: Education Cabinet has called on all qualifying students entering and already in tertiary education to apply for the National Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS) bursaries and loan when they open.

src: Herstel van wetstoepassingsbeamptes se integriteit.1 Danksy multidissiplinêre samewerking het wetstoepassingsagentskappe 14 verdagtes in Mpumalanga op aanklagte van bedrog en korrupsie in die uitreiking van onwettige leerlingrybewyse en rybewyse in hegtenis geneem.
tgt: za.2 Basic Education Laws Amendment (BELA) Act.1 Cabinet welcomed the signing of the BELA Bill into law by President Ramaphosa, marking a significant step towards transforming and enhancing our basic education system.

src: Elf verkeersbeamptes is ook in hegtenis geneem omdat hulle omkoopgelde van motoriste op die N1-hoofweg in Limpopo geëis het.
tgt: This landmark legislation requires school governing bodies to consider the linguistic needs of the broader community to ensure inclusivity in education.2 In a move to strengthen early childhood education, the BELA Act makes Grade R the new compulsory starting age for school.

src: Onderwys Nasionale finansiële hulpskema vir studente (NSFAS).1 Die Kabinet het ŉ beroep op alle kwalifiserende studente wat tersiêre onderwys betree of reeds deel daarvan is gedoen om aansoek te doen vir beurse en lenings by die Nasionale Finansiële Hulpskema vir Studente (NSFAS) wanneer aanlynaansoeke vir die 2025 akademiese jaar op Vrydag, 20 September 2024 open.
tgt: These include regular washing of hands with soap and water or using an alcohol-based hand sanitiser.2 Although the risk of widespread Mpox transmission in the country remains low, an additional case of Mpox was confirmed and thus the number of confirmed cases to 25 in South Africa since the outbreak began in May 2024.

src: Om aansoek te doen, besoek WEBTOKEGewysigde Wetsontwerp op Basiese Onderwys (BELA-wet) .1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die ondertekening van die BELA-wetgewing.
tgt: Bilharzia Outbreak – Mopani District of Limpopo.1 Cabinet was updated on the Bilharzia outbreak in Greater Tzaneen in Mopani (Limpopo) where 150 pupils have tested positive for Bilharzia.2 Provincial Task Team was established by the Limpopo Provincial government and efforts are underway to contain this waterborne disease, dealing with the outbreak and assessing water quality in the affected areas.3 Bilharzia is transmitted through contact with contaminated water.

src: Hierdie mylpaalwetgewing vereis dat skoolbeheerliggame die taalbehoeftes van die groter gemeenskap in ag neem om inklusiwiteit in onderwys te verseker.
tgt: Foot and Mouth Diseases outbreak in Sarah Baartman, Eastern Cape.1 Cabinet called on all livestock farmers to limit the movement of animals following the outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease in the Kouga and Koukamma municipalities of Sarah Baartman District of the Eastern Cape.2 Animal movements in and out of the affected region continue to be monitored to prevent the spread of the disease to unaffected areas in terms of the Disease Management Area.

src: .2 As ŉ maatreël om vroeë kinderonderwys te verbeter, stel die BELA-wet graad R in as die nuwe verpligte intree-ouderdom tot formele onderwys.
tgt: .3 Cabinet reminded South Africans that the transportation of livestock from one place to another requires a Transport Permit from a local state veterinary office.

src: Dit hou ouers ook verantwoordbaar deur die versuim om te verseker dat hul kinders skool toe gaan te kriminaliseer.3 Die Kabinet verwelkom verder die besluit van President Ramaphosa om 'n tydperk van 3 maande van betrokkenheid by 2 klousules rakende skooltoelating en taal toe te laat, as deel daarvan om nasionale samehorigheid te verseker.
tgt: GNU management.1 Cabinet welcomed the decision by President Ramaphosa to set-up a clearing house mechanism at a government level on matters that parties within the GNU may be deemed to hold fundamental differences.

src: Die beleid sal entrepreneurskap in die toerisme-sektor bevorder en ŉ groter bydrae tot werkskepping deur die sektor bewerkstellig.
tgt: Government has prioritised support for MSMEs and cooperatives because these businesses create the most jobs and provide the most opportunities for people to earn a living.

src: Beleidsvoorstelle fokus ook op die belyning van die toerismebeleid met die huidige regeringsbeleidsraamwerke en die verbetering van die sektor se veerkragtigheid en vermoë om op krisissituasies te reageer.
tgt: The implementation of the policy will eliminate credit gap in the MSMEs ecosystem and enable economic growth, which is the priority of government.

src: Befondsingsbeleid vir klein, medium en mikro-ondernemings (KMMO’s) en koöperasies.1 Die Kabinet het die finale befondsingsbeleid vir KMMO’s en koöperasies vir implementering goedgekeur.
tgt: (iv) National Astro-Tourism Strategy and Implementation Plan 2023-2033 Cabinet approved the publication of the National Astro-Tourism Strategy and Implementation Plan for public comments.

src: Die beleid is daarop gemik om struikelblokke wat KMMO’s en koöperasies verhoed om finanssiële steun te verkry, uit die weg te ruim.
tgt: The strategy aims to position South Africa as a world-class astro-tourism destination, and this will boost economic development and employment in the tourism sector.

src: Hierdie ingrypings sal ook die soomlose oorgang van informele na formele ondernemings en van klein na medium ondernemings bewerkstellig.2 Die beleid tref voorsorg vir die skep van ŉ befondsingsomgewing vir teikengroepe soos die jeug, vroue en mense met gestremdhede.
tgt: South Africa is the first African nation to develop a National Astro-Tourism Strategy, and this will boost the country’s tourism diversification.

src: Die beleid vorm ook deel van ander ingrypings om kleinsakeondernemings te ondersteun, insluitend die nasionale geïntegreerde kleinsake-ontwikkelingsraamwerk wat in 2022 deur die Kabinet goedgekeur is.3 Die regering het steun vir KMMO’s en koöperasies geprioritiseer omdat hierdie besighede die meeste werkskepping verskaf en die meeste geleenthede bied vir mense om geld te verdien en ŉ bestaan te voer.
tgt: The strategy focuses on various pillars, namely infrastructure development, optimising astronomy-tourism streams, public private partnerships, inclusive tourism and transformation.

src: Nasionale astro-toerisme: Strategie en implementeringsplan 2023-20.1 Die Kabinet het die publikasie van die nasionale astro-toerisme strategie en implementeringsplan vir openbare oorlegpleging goedgekeur.2 Die strategie is daarop gemik om Suid-Afrika as ŉ wêreldklas astro-toerismebestemming te vestig, wat ekonomiese ontwikkeling en werkskepping in die toerisme-sektor ŉ hupstoot sal gee.
tgt: The Department of Tourism, in collaboration with the Department of Science and Innovation, will launch the National Astro-Tourism Strategy at the National Tourism Day celebrations in the Northern Cape on 27 September 2024, where the Square Kilometer Array project is located.

src: Suid-Afrika is die eerste Afrika-land wat ŉ nasionale astro-toerisme strategie ontwikkel hierdie stap bevorder die diversifikasie van die land se toerisme-aantreklikheid.
tgt: Municipal Performance Turnaround Plan Cabinet received and approved the Chairperson, members and expanded terms of reference of the Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC) on implementation of the initiatives to address local government underperformance.

src: Die strategie fokus op verskeie pilare, naamlik infrastruktuurontwikkeling, die optimalisering van astronomie-toerismestrome, openbare-privaat-vennootskappe, inklusiewe toerisme en transformasie.4 Suid-Afrika spog met verskeie unieke voordele wat die land die ideale bestemming vir astro-toerisme maak.
tgt: The overall objective of the IMC is to oversee implementation of various activities to address local government underperformance through various interventions on the following specific areas:i. Profssionalisation of local governmentii.

src: Verantwoordbaarheid, oorsig en bestuur van gevolgeiii.
tgt: Governance, political stability and administrationiv.

src: Finansiële bestuur en verbeterede oudituitkomsteiv.
tgt: Financial management and improved audit outcomesv.

src: Dienslewering en onderhoud van infrastruktuurv.
tgt: Service delivery and infrastructure maintenancevi.

src: Plaaslike ekonomiese ontwikkeling en ruimtelike beplanning, envii.
tgt: Local economic development and spatial planning andvii.
