src: Inter- en intra-regeringsverhoudings.3 Die IMK sal ingrypings in die munisipaliteite met die grootste nood prioritiseer.4 Die Kabinet het voorts ook aangedui dat staatsdepartemente en openbare entiteite dringend hul skuld aan munisipaliteite moet delg.
tgt: Cabinet further directed that government departments and public entities must urgently settle their debts owed to municipalities and National Treasury was assigned the responsibility to ensure this is done.

src: Uitstaande munisipale skuld aan waterrade Die Kabinet het ŉ inligtingsessie gehou oor die toenemende en onvolhoubare munisipale skuld aan waterrade, wat nou die volhoubaarheid van die Vaal Sentrale Waterraad en Magalies Water bedreig.
tgt: (vi) Outstanding municipal debt to water boards Cabinet was briefed on growing and unsustainable municipal debts to water boards, which are now threatening the sustainability of the Vaal Central Water Board owed R.9 billion and Magalies Water R930 million by end of July 2024 with possibility of bankruptcy of these two boards.

src: Teen einde Julie 2024 was daar R.9 miljard aan die Vaal Sentrale Waterraad en R930 miljoen aan Magalies Water verskuldig, wat moontlik tot bankrotskap vir die twee rade kan lei.
tgt: Debts owed to water boards have a potential to threaten provision of water even to municipalities that are paying their water debts.

src: Gelde verskuldig aan waterrade het die potensiaal om die watervoorsiening aan selfs die munisapliteite wat wel hul waterrekeninge betaal, te bedreig.3 Die Kabinet het goedgekeur dat ŉ IMK saamgestel word om aandag te gee aan munisipale omkeer.
tgt: Cabinet approved that an IMC be established to address municipal turnaround.

src: Die IMK sal ook ingrypings prioritiseer om terugbetaling van munisipale skuld aan waterrade, veral dié wat bankrotskap in die gesig staar, te hanteer.
tgt: The IMC will also prioritise interventions to address municipal debt payments to water boards, particularly to those facing imminent bankruptcy.

src: Wetsontwerp Wetsontwerp op Tradisionele en Khoi-San-leierskap van 20.1 Die Kabinet het die voorlegging van die Wetsontwerp op Tradisionele en Khoi-Sanleierskap van 2024 aan die Parlement goedgekeur.
tgt: BILTraditional Khoi-San Leadership Bill of 2024.

src: Die wetsontwerp is ‘n reaksie op die Grondwethof se uitspraak wat die Wet op Tradisionele en Khoi-San-leierskap, 2019 (Wet 3 van 2019) ongeldig verklaar het weens onvoldoende openbare deelname deur die Parlement.
tgt: The Bill is a response to the Constitutional Court ruling that declared the Traditional and Khoi-San Leadership Act, 2019 (Act 3 of 2019) to be invalid based on insufficient public participation by Parliament.

src: Die wetsontwerp bied ’n geleentheid aan die Parlement om die Grondwethof se bevel te gehoorsaam.
tgt: The Bill will give Parliament an opportunity to comply with the order of the Constitutional Court.

src: Die Wet op Tradisionele en Khoi-Sanleierskap, 2019 het die Wet of Tradisionele Leierskap en Regeringsraamwerk, 2003 (Wet 41 van 2003) vervang.
tgt: The Traditional and Khoi-San Leadership Act of 2019 replaced the Traditional Leadership and Governance Framework Act, 2003 (Act 41 of 2003)

src: Die Kabinet word op die hoogte van sake gebringUitkomste van die staatsbesoek aan die Volksrepubliek Sjina en deelname aan die forum vir Sjina-Afrika samewerking (FOCAC)1.1 Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die uitkomste van die onlangse suksesvolle staatsbesoek aan die Volksrepubliek Sjina en die FOCAC-vergadering te Beijing in Sjina van 2 tot 6 September 2024.
tgt: Cabinet received a briefing about the outcomes of the recent successful State Visit to the People’s Republic of China and FOCAC meeting held in Beijing, China from 2 to 6 September 2024.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die volgende sleuteluitkomste vir Suid-Afrika:.1 ŉ Ooreenkoms om die handelstruktuur te verander na meer togevoegde-waarde vervaardigingsgoedere, in besonder ŉ ooreenkoms om ŉ lys uit te ruil van 100 toegevoegde-waarde produkte vanuit Suid-Afrika wat deur Sjina vir invoere oorweeg sal word.2 Hierbenewens het Suid-Afrika Sjina se samewerking in drie waardekettings verseker.
tgt: Cabinet noted the following key outcomes for South Africa:1.

src: Hierdie samewerking sal die weg baan vir die bevordering van beleggings in elektriese voertuie, die vervaardiging van batterye en die berging van hernubare energie, asook beleggings in spesiale ekonomiese sones en nywerheidsontwikkelingsones.
tgt: An agreement to change the structure of trade into more value-added manufactured products, in particular, an agreement to exchange a list of 100 value-added products from South Africa that China will consider importing.

src: .3 Sleutelbeleggers van Sjina in beide Shenzhen en Beijing het belangstelling getoon om óf hul huidige beleggings uit te brei óf in nuwe konstruksieprojekte in Suid-Afrika te belê.4 Meoranda van verstandhouding (MoU’s) is tydens die staatsbesoek onderteken.
tgt: In addition, South Africa secured cooperation from China on three value chains relating to decarbonisation, digitalisation, transport and logistics.

src: Hierdie MoU’s is gemik op die bevordering van samewerking tussen Sjina en Suid-Afrika.5 Die MoU’s sluit die baanbreker MoU vir bek-en-klouseer in wat die beperkings op die uitvoer van beesvleis beperk tot spesifieke streke wat deur bek-en-klouseer geraak is en nie die hele land nie.
tgt: This cooperation will pave the way to promote investments in electric vehicles, battery manufacturing, renewable energy storage, as well as in identified Special Economic Zones and Industrial Development Zones.

src: Vorderingsverslag oor die repatriasie van die oorskot van vryheidsvegters vanaf Zambië en Zimbabwe.1 Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die jongste reëlings om die sterflike oorskot van Suid-Afrika se vryheidsvegters wat in Zimbabwe en Zambië begrawe is, te repatrieer.
tgt: Memoranda of Understanding were signed during the state visit aimed at promoting cooperation between China and South Africa.5 The MoUs include the groundbreaking MoU on Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD) that limits the restrictions on the exporting of beef to the specific district affected by FMD instead of the whole country.

src: Sowat 2 895 935 hektaar grond is teen ŉ koste van R.4 miljard WEBTOKEFinansiële vergoeding van R26 miljard is aan begunstigdes toegeken.
tgt: Through the Transformation of Certain Rural Areas Act, 1998 (Act 94 of 1998), a total of 630 000 hectares was transferredii.

src: Die Kabinet het verder ook kennis geneem dat hoë bevolkingsgroei, gebrek aan instandhouding van infrastruktuur, gebrek aan afdwinging van verordeninge, asook vertragings in die implementering van fase 2 van die Lesotho Hoogland-waterprojek geweldig bygedra het tot die huidige waterontwrigtings in Gauteng.
tgt: The planned maintenance work is crucial to protect the infrastructure for another 20-30 years and failure to undertake this work will risk the transfer of water to the Integrated Vaal River System (IVRS), which provides the water supplied by Rand Water to its customers and all municipalities in Gauteng.

src: Die voltooiing van die Lesotho Hoogland-waterprojek sal egter verligting bring indien dit aangevul word met watervraagbestuuringrypings, die gebruik van nuwe waterbesparingstegnologieë en behoorlike instandhouding van die infrastruktuur.
tgt: A thorough analysis to assess the risk to the performance of the IVRS, which consists of 14 interconnected dams, was undertaken by the DWThe analysis confirmed that the impact of the tunnel closure on the overall IVRS will be minimal as most dams in the IVRS are currently full.

src: Die Kabinet het kennis geneem dat die DWS sedert Februarie 2022 gereedheidsvergaderings met die Vrystaatse munisipaliteite het, wat water vanuit die Liebenbergsvleirivier ontvang om enige risiko’s van diensonderbrekings tydens die tonnelinstandhouding te verminder.
tgt: Cabinet noted existing water supply disruptions in Gauteng and in some Free State municipalities that are not related to the tunnel closure, and further noted that the DWS has supported municipalities to engage stakeholders in relation to the closure of the Lesotho Highlands Tunnel.

src: Vertragings deur die munisiplaiteite om hul infrastruktuur op te gradeer of op te knap bly egter steeds ŉ uitdaging.
tgt: Cabinet further noted that in Gauteng, rapid population growth, lack of infrastructure maintenance, lack of enforcement of by-laws and delays in implementation of the phase two of the Lesotho Highlands project have contributed immensely to the current water disruptions.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis dat die DWS die situasie sal monitor en, waar nodig, sal ingryp om hierdie munisipaliteite te steun.
tgt: However, the completion of Phase 2 of the Lesotho Highlands project will bring relief if supplemented by water demand management interventions, use of new water-saving technologies and proper maintenance of infrastructure.

src: Die DWS, Rand Water en Gautengse munisipaliteite is in vennootskap met die Wêreldbank se 2020 waterhulpbronnegroep om ’n massabewustheid- en kommunikasieveldtog oor die spaarsamige gebruik van water van stapel te stuur, in samewerking met die burgerlike samelewing en sakeleiers.
tgt: This is a result of Rand Water reaching its maximum water output on the IVRWater demand in Gauteng continues to grow because of population growth, increase in non-revenue water in municipal systems, including illegal and unbilled connections, and lack of maintenance resulting in huge water leaks, which are at 33% average across Gauteng municipalities.

src: • Mnr Gift Zowa as die HUB van Broadband Infraco vir vyf jaar.
tgt: Mr Captain Rufus Lekala as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the South African Maritime Safety Authority for five years.

src: Toekomstige gebeure.
tgt: Upcoming Events.

src: Erfenisdag.1 Adjunkpresident Mashatile sal op Dinsdag, 24 September 2024 die hoofrede lewer by die land se amptelike Erfenisdagvieringe by die Meheleng-stadion in Ficksburg in die Vrystaat.
tgt: Deputy President Paul Mashatile will deliver the keynote address at the country’s official Heritage Day celebration on Tuesday, 24 September 2024 at the Meqheleng Stadium in Ficksburg in the Free State, which is being marked under the theme: “Celebrating the lives of our heroes and heroines who laid down their lives for our freedom.”.

src: Dit word herdenk onder die tema: ‘Vier die lewens van ons helde en heldinne wat vir ons vryheid gesterf het’ (“Celebrating the lives of our heroes and heroines who laid down their lives for our freedom.”)1.2 Me die herdenking van Erfenisdag bring ons hulde aan die helde en heldinne wat hul lewens opgeoffer het in die stryd om ons nasie te bevry, veral die vryheidsvegters wat deur die apartheidsregering tot ballingskap gedwing is en in die buiteland gesterf het.3 ŉ Tuiskoms-seremonie sal op 27 September 2024 gehou word wanneer die sterflike oorskot van verskeie struggle-helde vanuit Zambië en Zimbabwe aan Suid-Afrika terugbesorg word as deel van ons ballingskaprepatriasieprojek.
tgt: In marking Heritage Day, we pay tribute to heroes and heroines who gave up their lives fighting for our liberation, particularly those freedom fighters who were forced into exile by the apartheid state and died in foreign lands.

src: As deel van die vieringe tydens Erfenismaand sal die regering ŉ fees van inheemse spele tussen 24 en 29 September 2024 in die Vrystaat aanbied om inheemse spele, musiek, dans, kookkuns en handwerk ten toon te stel.
tgt: A Homecoming Ceremony will take place on 27 September 2024 when the mortal remains of several Struggle stalwarts return from Zambia and Zimbabwe to South Africa as part of our Exile Repatriation Project.4 As part of Heritage Month celebrations, government will host an Indigenous Games Festival between 24 and 29 September 2024 in the Free State to showcase indigenous games, music, dance, cuisine and crafts.

src: Staatsdiensmaand (PSM)2.1 Me die herdenking van Staatsdiensmaand sal die regering vandeesweek op die werkers fokus wat ons land met trots en onderskeiding in die frontlinie dien.
tgt: As we continue to commemorate PSM, government’s focus this week recognises frontline workers who serve our nation with pride and distinction.

src: Tydens hierdie week sal ons ook ons land se Thusong-dienssentrums vereer, wat toegang tot inligting en dienste aan die samelewing bewerkstellig.
tgt: In the week, we also profile our country’s Thusong Service Centres, which facilitate access to information and services to the people.

src: Doofheid-bewustheidweek.1 Suid-Afrika sal Internasionale Doofheid-bewustheidsweek van 23 tot 29 September 2024 saam met die internasionale gemeenskap vier.
tgt: South Africa will join the international community in marking the international week of Deaf people from 23 to 29 September 2024 under the theme: “Sign up for Sign Language Rights”.

src: Brasilië, Rusland, Indië, Sjina and Suid-Afrika (BRICS) spitsberaad.1 Ter voorbereiding van die komende 2024 BRICS-spitsberaad in Rusland, wat van 22 tot 24 Oktober 2024 plaasvind, woon Suid-Afrika tans verskeie voorbereidingsvergaderings by om ons insette in die bespreking van sleutelkwessies te versker en om die gedeelde belange van die groep te bevorder.
tgt: In preparation for the upcoming BRICS 2024 Summit from 22 to 24 October 2024 to be held in Russia, South Africa is participating in numerous preparatory meetings to add its voice to key issues and promote common interests in the grouping.

src: Internasionale konferensie oor die teorie en praktyk van elektroniese bestuur.1 Die Departement van Openbare Diens en Administrasie, in samewerking met die Universiteit van die Witwatersrand se Bestuurskool, sal die 17e internasionale konferensie oor die teorie en praktyk van elektroniese bestuur aanbied van 1 tot 4 Oktober 2024 met die tema: Vertroue en Etiese Regeringsbestuur vir die Wêreld wat ons wil hê (“Trust and Ethical Governance for the World We Want.”)
tgt: International Conference on Theory and Practice of Electronic Governance The Department of Public Service and Administration, in partnership with the University of the Witwatersrand School of Governance, will host the 17th International Conference on Theory and Practice Electronic Governance (ICEGOV) between 1 and 4 October 2024 under the theme: “Trust and Ethical Governance for the World We Want”.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Messages.

src: GelukwenseDie Kabinet wens die volgende spanne geluk: • Die Suid-Afrikaanse paralimpiese span met hul uitstekende prestasie by die 2024 Paralimpiese Spele in Parys, Frankryk waar hulle ses medaljes verower het.• Simoné Kruger, wat ’n goue medalje in die F38-diskusgooi by die Paralimpiese Spele verower het.
tgt: CongratulationsCabinet extended its congratulations and well wishes to: Team South Africa for their outstanding performance at the 2024 Paralympics in Paris and winning six medals.

src: • Fietsryer Nicolas Pieter du Preez, wat ’n bronsmedalje in die H1-individuele tydren vir mans by die Paralimpiese Spele verower het.• Donald Ramphadi en Lucas Sithole, wat bronsmedaljes in die kwadrupleeg-rolstoeltennis dubbelspel by die Paralimpiese Spele verower het.
tgt: Simoné Kruger for winning gold in the discus throw F38 at the Paralympic Games.

src: • Wêreldkampioene, ons Springbokspan, vir hul epiese dubbele seges oor Nieu-Seeland in die rugbykampioenskapsreeks.
tgt: Cyclist Nicolas Pieter du Preez for winning bronze in the Men’s H1 Individual Time Trial at the Paralympic Games in Paris.

src: Die Springbokke bly onoorwonne in die rugby-kampioenskapsreeks en sal in hul volgende wedstryd teen Argentinië te staan kom.
tgt: Donald Ramphadi and Lucas Sithole for winning bronze in wheelchair tennis Quad doubles at the Paralympic Games in Paris.

src: • Die Suid-Afrikaanse musikant Tyla, wat geskiedenis gemaak het as die eerste Suid-Afrikaner wat ŉ MTV Video Musiek-toekenning wen.• Die Suid-Afrikaanse span wat by die World Skills-konferensie 2024 in Frankryk die room van ons nasie se talente en vaardighede ten toon gestel het.
tgt: The world champion Springboks for their epic double over New Zealand in the Rugby Championship.

src: • Die Kabinet wens die Douglas-keerwal in die Noord-Kaap geluk met sy benoeming as ŉ Wêrelderfenis-besproeiingstruktuur deur die Internasionale Kommissie vir Besproeiing en Dreinering.
tgt: The Springboks remain unbeaten in the Rugby Championship and will play Argentina in their next game.

src: Dit is die eerste keer dat ŉ Suid-Afrikaanse besproeiingstruktuur hierdie toekenning ontvang.
tgt: South African musician Tyla who made history by becoming the first South African to win an MTV Video Music Award.

src: Suid-Afrika: ŉ Beleggingsbestemming van keuse.
tgt: South Africa: An Investment Destination of Choice.

src: Die Kabinet het besin oor die positiewe beleggersgemoedstemming voortspruitend uit President Cyril Ramaphosa and Adjunkpresident Paul Mashatile se werksbesoek aan onderskeidelik New York in die VSA en London in die Verenigde Koninkryk (VK).
tgt: Cabinet reflected on the positive investor sentiments emanating from President Cyril Ramaphosa and Deputy President Paul Mashatile’s working visits to New York in the USA and London in the United Kingdom (UK), respectively.

src: Die President se program, aangrensend tot die Verenigde Nasies se Algemene Vergadering (UNGA), het verskeie geleenthede – onder meer sy toespraak aan die New Yorkse aandelebeurs, wat volgens markkapitalisasie die grootste aandelebeurs ter wêreld is – ingesluit om Suid-Afrika as ŉ beleggingsbestemming van keuse te bevorder.
tgt: The President’s programme, on the margins of the 79th United Nations General Assembly (UNGA), included opportunities to promote South Africa as an investment destination of choice such as in his address to the New York Stock Exchange – the largest stock exchange in the world by market capitalisation.

src: Die Adjunkpresident se beleggingsveldtog na die VK en Ierland het ook ŉ toespraak aan die Londense aandelebeurs (LSE) ingesluit oor die behoefte om hul beleggingsvoetspoor in Suid-Afrika uit te brei.
tgt: The Deputy President’s investment drive to the UK and Ireland also included an address to the London Stock Exchange (LSE) about the need to expand their investment footprint to South Africa.

src: Die LSE was vanaf 2023 die Europese aandelebeurs met die hoogste waarde.
tgt: The LSE was the most valued stock exchange in Europe from Both President Ramaphosa and Deputy President Mashatile, and the delegation that accompanied them, articulated the priorities of the Government of National Unity, with the apex priority being achieving inclusive economic growth and job creation, and the concomitant initiatives underway to achieve the set priorities.

src: Daarbenewens het hulle die werk bespreek wat deur die program van strukturele hervormings gedoen word word om gunstige toestande vir belegging te skep.
tgt: They further set out work that is underway through the programme of structural reforms to create favourable conditions for investment.

src: Hierdie program word deur Operasie Vulindlela gekoördineer, wat deur die Presidensie en die Nasionale Tesourie gedryf word.
tgt: The programme of structural reforms is coordinated through Operation Vulindlela by The Presidency and National Treasury.

src: Regerings-besigheidvennootskap: fase Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van fase 2 van die samewerking tussen die regering en die sakesektor wat daarop gemik is om prioriteitsingrypings in uitgesoekte fokusareas te implementeer.
tgt: Government-Business Partnership Phase Cabinet welcomed the launch of Phase 2 of the Government- Business Partnership aimed at implementing priority interventions across selected focal areas to accelerate the country’s path towards inclusive economic growth and job creation, through increased investment and rapid implementation of reforms, to improve national sentiment.

src: Dit is daarop gemik om inklusiewe ekonomiese groei en werkskepping in die land te versnel deur middel van meer beleggings en vinniger implementering van hervorming, om sodoende ook nasionale gemoedstemming te verbeter.
tgt: Working in support of government interventions, more than 130 Chief Executive Officers (CEOs) of major South African businesses mobilised resources, including expertise to address the electricity load-shedding crisis that is now a thing of the past, support the implementation of the Logistics and Freight Roadmap, the Visa Reform, and the fight against crime and corruption during Phase Visa Reforms Gazetted Cabinet welcomed the gazetting of South Africa’s new visa regime as a key step towards attracting international skills and investment, growing tourism and creating jobs.

src: Mer as 130 hoof-uitvoerende beamptes (HUB’s) van groot Suid-Afrikaanse besighede het hulpbronne gemobiliseer, insluitend kundigheid om die elektrisiteitsbeurtkragkrisis, wat tans iets van die verlede is, aan te pak en die implementering van die logistieke en vragpadkaart, visum-hervorming en die stryd teen misdaad en korrupsie tydens fase 1 te ondersteun.
tgt: The Minister of Home Affairs, Dr Leon Schreiber, has gazetted the reforms, which constitute another success under Operation Vulindlela.

src: Afdwing van arbeidswette.
tgt: Enforcement of Labour Laws.

src: Die Kabinet het hul waardering uitgespreek vir die verskerpte gesamentlike inspeksiepogings onder leiding van die departement van indiensneming en arbeid (DEL), wat daarop gerig is om te verseker dat werkgewers aan werwingsvereistes voldoen.
tgt: Cabinet commended intensified joint inspection efforts led by the Department of Employment and Labour (DEL) to ensure that employers comply with recruitment requirements.

src: Sedert die aanvang van die sewende administrasie is DEL-boetes ter waarde van meer as R10 miljoen uitgereik aan werkgewers in die gasvryheidsbedryf wat nie arbeidswetgewing nakom nie deur voort te gaan om ongedokumenteerde immigrante in diens te neem.
tgt: Since the beginning of the Seventh Administration, the DEL has issued fines worth more than R10 million to errant employers within the hospitality industry who continue to employ undocumented immigrants.

src: Hierdie inspeksies is soortgelyk aan dié wat in die vragmotorbedryf gedoen word om te verseker dat werkgewers die bepalings van die Wet op Basiese Diensvoorwaardes, 1997 (Wet 75 van 1997) nakom.
tgt: These inspections are similar to those being conducted in the trucking industry to ensure that employers uphold the provisions of the Basic Conditions of Employment Act, 1997 (Act 75 of 1997).

src: Die inspeksies het ook gevalle van nie-nakoming van arbeidswette aan die lig gebring, insluitend onderbetaling van lone, onwettige aftrekkings en onvoldoende gesondheids- en veiligheidsmaatreëls by die werkplek.
tgt: The inspections also revealed instances of non-compliance to Labour Laws that include underpayment of wages, unlawful deductions, and inadequate health and safety measures at the workplace.

src: Tydelike werkgewer-werknemer-verligtingskema (TERS)1.
tgt: Temporary Employer-Employee Relief Scheme (TERS)1.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die verhoging in die begroting vir die TERS in die huidige finansiële jaar van R400 miljoen tot R2,4 miljard.
tgt: Cabinet welcomes the increase in the budget for the TERS from R400 million to R.4 billion in the current financial year.

src: Die verhoging is deel van die regering se proaktiewe reaksieplan om werksgeleenthede te help beskerm deur maatskappye by te staan wat hul weens moeilike ekonomiese toestande in finansiële nood bevind en sodoende afleggings tot die minimum te beperk.
tgt: The increase is part of the government’s proactive response to help preserve jobs by assisting companies that find themselves in financial distress due to difficult economic conditions and thereby minimise retrenchments.

src: Stryd teen misdaad en korrupsie Misdaad.
tgt: Fight against crime and corruption Crime.

src: Die Kabinet het die moorde op 18 mense in Lusikisiki en ses gemeenskapspatrolleerders in Qumbu in die Oos-Kaap in massaskietvoorvalle ten sterkste veroordeel.
tgt: Cabinet condemned the murders of eighteen (18) people in Lusikisiki and six (6) community patrollers in Qumbu in the Eastern Cape in mass shooting incidents.

src: Hul werk het reeds vrugte afgewerp, met die hofverskyning van een verdagte wat direk verbind is met die moord op 18 mense in Lusikisiki.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the swift deployment of a team of specialist law-enforcement officers to investigate these shooting incidents, whose work is already bearing fruits, with one suspect directly linked to the murder of 18 people in Lusikisiki having already appeared in court.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die suksesse van intelligensie-geleide operasies wat in die Verulam- en High-Flats-areas in KwaZulu-Natal uitgevoer is.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the successes of intelligence-led operations conducted in the Verulam and High-Flats areas in KwaZulu-Natal.

src: In die Verulam-operasie het die polisie ŉ meesterbrein en een van die mees gesogte verdagtes in die meerderheid van transitorooftogte in KwaZulu-Natal gekonfronteer.
tgt: In the Verulam operation, police confronted a mastermind and one of the most wanted suspects in most of the Cash-In-Transit robberies in KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Die verdagte is in ŉ skietgeveg dood nadat hy op die polisie losgebrand het.
tgt: The suspect was killed in a shootout after he opened fire on the police.

src: Voorts is ŉ verdere twee verdagtes in die moord op sewe mense in die High-Flats-voorval in ŉ skietgeveg met die polisie doodgeskiet.
tgt: Similarly, two (2) suspects in the murder of seven (7) people in the High-Flats case were killed in a shootout with the police.

src: Die Kabinet is bemoedig deur die voortgesette sukses van Operasie Shanela.
tgt: Cabinet is encouraged by the continued success of Operation Shanela.

src: Die afgelope week is meer as 10 000 verdagtes in hegtenis geneem vir verskeie oortredings soos moord, verkragting, die besit van onwettige vuurwapens, rooftogte by besighede en dwelmmuile in besit van kokaïen by die land se hawens van binnekoms.
tgt: In the past week, over 10 000 suspects were arrested for various offences such as murder, rape, possession of illegal firearms, business robberies and drug mules for possession of cocaine at our ports of entry.

src: Die Kabinet het verder ŉ gesamentlike operasie in Limpopo geprys wat gelei het tot die ontdekking van ŉ dwelmlaboratorium in Lebowakgomo, waar daar op dwelms ter waarde van ongeveer R4 miljoen beslag gelê is en drie verdagtes in hegtenis geneem is.
tgt: Cabinet further commended a joint operation in Limpopo that led to the discovery of a drug laboratory in Lebowakgomo, where drugs to the value of approximately R4 million were seized and three (3) suspects arrested.

src: Stryd teen korrupsie.
tgt: Fight Against Corruption.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die inhegtenisneming van ses direkteure van ingenieursfirmas wat beskuldig word van tenderbedrog ten bedrae van R400 miljoen rakende swart ekonomiese bemagtiging by Eskom en Sasol.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the arrest of six engineering firm directors accused of Black Economic Empowerment fronting and tender fraud of R400 million at Eskom and Sasol.

src: Geslagsgebaseerde geweld en vrouemoord (GGGV)2.
tgt: Gender-Based Violence and Femicide (GBVF)2.

src: Die mylpaalvonnis van die veroordeelde reeksverkragter Nkosinathi Phakathi tot 42 lewenslange tronkstraftermyne deur die Gautengse hooggeregshof, stuur ŉ sterk waarskuwing uit aan oortreders van GGGV dat ons nasie nie afgedreig sal word deur hul gruwelike dade nie.
tgt: The landmark sentencing of convicted serial rapist Nkosinathi Phakathi to 42 life terms by the Gauteng High Court sends a strong warning to perpetrators of GBVF that our nation will not be held to ransom by their heinous acts.

src: Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om enige oortreders van GGGV-misdade of enige vorm van geweld teen kwesbare persone – kinders, ouer persone of persone met ŉ gestremdheid – by ŉ plaaslike polisiestasie aan te meld of die tolvrye Stop Misdaad-nommer: 086 00 1011.1 te skakel.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to report all perpetrators of GBVF crimes or any form of violence against vulnerable persons – a child, older person or person with a disability – to a local police station or call the toll-free Crime Stop number: 086 00 3.

src: Provinsiale bestuur Om die verbintenis na te kom wat tydens die President se begrotingstoespraak gemaak is om nou saam met provinsiale en plaaslike regerings te werk om diensleweringsuitdagings aan te pak, sal President Ramaphosa ŉ afvaardiging van kabinetslede lei om met premiers en lede van die provinsiale uitvoerende komitees in gesprek te tree.
tgt: Governance In fulfilling the commitment made during The Presidency’s Budget Vote Speech to work closely with provincial and local governments to address service delivery challenges, President Ramaphosa will lead a delegation of Cabinet members to engage with Premiers and Members of the Provincial Executive Committees.

src: Die eerste besoek sal op Vrydag, 1 November 2024 in Limpopo plaasvind, gevolg deur ŉ besoek aan KwaZulu-Natal op Donderdag, 7 November 2024.
tgt: The first visit will be to Limpopo on Friday, 1 November 2024 and will be followed by a visit to KwaZulu-Natal on Thursday, 7 November 2024.

src: Maatskaplike beskerming Nadelige weersomstandighede Die Kabinet het Suid-Afrikaners aangemoedig om waaksaam te bly en om gehoor te gee aan die Suid-Afrikaanse Weerdiens se weerwaarskuwings.
tgt: Social protection Adverse Weather Conditions Cabinet has encouraged South Africans to remain alert and adhere to weather warnings from the South African Weather Service.

src: Die land ervaar steeds gure weerstoestande wat wissel van ongewone sneeuval, oorstromings, reënstorms, skadelike rukwinde en hittegolwe weens die gevolge van klimaatsverandering.
tgt: The country continues to experience inclement weather conditions ranging from unusual snowfalls, flooding, rainstorms, damaging winds and heat waves due to the effects of climate change.

src: Die weerwaarskuwings word oor alle mediaplatforms gekommunikeer, insluitend gemeenskapsradiostasies.
tgt: The weather alerts are communicated across all media platforms, including community radio stations.

src: Die Kabinet sal binnekort ŉ hersiene geïntegreerde rampbestuur- en reaksiestrategie ontvang wat rampverligting en -reaksie sal dek, insluitend befondsing vir rampherstel.
tgt: Cabinet will soon receive a revised Integrated Disaster Management and Response Strategy that will cover disaster mitigation and response, including funding for disaster recovery.

src: Eerste Suid-Afrikaanse nasionale stedelike forum oor die globale habitat en stedelike agenda.
tgt: Inaugural South African National Urban Forum on the Global Habitat and Urban Agenda.

src: Die departemente van menslike nedersettings asook samewerkende regering en tradisionele sake, die Suid-Afrikaanse netwerk van stede en die VN se menslike nedersettingsprogram (VN-Habitat) het die eerste Suid-Afrikaanse nasionale stedelike forum oor globale habitat en stedelike agenda, sowel as die Suid-Afrikaanse stedelike beleid, aangebied.
tgt: The departments of Human Settlements, and Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, South African Cities Network and the UN Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) hosted the three-day Inaugural South African National Urban Forum on Global Habitat and Urban Agenda, and the South African Urban Policy.

src: Die forum, wat drie dae geduur het, het belangrike maatskaplike vennote byeengebring om uitdagings en geleenthede wat vinnige verstedeliking in Suid-Afrika meebring, te bespreek.
tgt: The forum gathered key social partners to address the challenges and leverage opportunities of rapid urbanisation in South Africa.

src: Die forum het beklemtoon dat dit strategies noodsaaklik is om die vinnige pas van verstedeliking te bestuur in die konteks van reaksies op ander megatendense soos klimaatsverandering, gevorderde mobiliteit en tegnologie.
tgt: The forum highlighted the strategic importance of managing rapid urbanisation in the context of responding to other mega trends such as climate change, smart mobility and technology.

src: Repatriasie van die oorskot van Suid-Afrika se vryheidsvegters Die Kabinet verwelkom die terugkoms van die oorskot van ons vryheidsvegters wat in Zimbabwe en Zambië begrawe is terwyl hulle in ballingskap was.
tgt: Repatriation of the Remains of South Africa’s Freedom Fighters Cabinet welcomed the return of the remains of our freedom fighters who were buried while in exile in Zimbabwe and Zambia.

src: Die terugkeer van hul oorskot na ŉ vrye en demokratiese Suid-Afrika is ŉ verwesenliking van die aanhef van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996, wat ons aansê om die verdeeldheid van die verlede te genees en ŉ samelewing te vestig wat gegrond is op demokratiese waardes, maatskaplike geregtigheid en fundamentele menseregte.
tgt: The return of their remains to a free and democratic South Africa is a realisation of the Preamble of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996, which enjoins us ‘to heal the divisions of the past and establish a society based on democratic values, social justice and fundamental human rights.’4.

src: Hierdie inisiatief is deel van die Exile Repatriation-projek, wat daarop gemik is om die land en gesinne in staat te stel om die herinneringe aan diegene wat vir vryheid en geregtigheid geveg het, te eer.
tgt: This initiative is part of the Exile Repatriation Project, which aims to allow the country and families to honour the memories of those who fought for freedom and justice, and for government to honour and restore the legacy of those who sacrificed their lives for the country’s freedom.

src: Dit is ook ŉ geleentheid vir die regering om die nalatenskap van diegene wat hul lewens vir die land se vryheid opgeoffer het, in ere te herstel.
tgt: South Africa remains indebted to the international solidarity of all countries that provided freedom fighters shelter, support and final resting places.

src: Sport.
tgt: Sport.

src: Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om hul steun te wys vir Mamelodi Sundowns en Bafana Bafana-doelwagter, Ronwen Williams, wat as een van die 10 beste doelwagters ter wêreld by die Ballon d’Or-toekennings vir die Yachine-trofee genomineer is, deur hul stemme uit te bring by WEBTOKEN Williams is die eerste Suid-Afrikaanse speler wat genomineer is vir die Yachine-trofee by die Ballon d’Or-toekennings.
tgt: Cabinet calls on South Africans to show their support for Mamelodi Sundowns and Bafana Bafana goalkeeper Ronwen Williams, who has been nominated as one of the 10 best goalkeepers in the world at the Ballon d’Or awards for the Yachine Trophy, by casting their votes on WEBTOKEN Williams is the first South African player to be nominated for the Yachine Trophy at the Ballon d’Or awards.

src: Die 68ste toekenningseremonie vind op 28 Oktober 2024 plaas.
tgt: The 68th edition of the awards ceremony will take place on 28 October 2024.

src: Tot dan kan ons vir Williams in beide Engels en Frans stem.
tgt: Until then, we can vote for Williams in both English and French.

src: Internasionale sake.
tgt: International Affairs.

src: UNGA-resolusie oor Israel/Palestina.
tgt: UNGA Resolution on Israel/Palestine.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die VN se historiese resolusie wat Israel se besetting van Oos-Jerusalem, die Wesoewer en Gasa onwettig verklaar het en opdrag gegee het vir die volledige onttrekking van Israeliese setlaars en soldate.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the UNGA’s historic resolution that declared Israel’s occupation of East Jerusalem, the West Bank and Gaza unlawful, and mandated the complete withdrawal of Israeli settlers and soldiers.

src: Hierdie resolusie is nie net betekenisvol vir Suid-Afrika se regsaak by die internasionale geregshof nie, maar ontwikkelde lande soos Spanje, België en Japan het ook by die meerderheid lande van die globale Suide aangesluit om die resolusie te ondersteun.
tgt: This resolution is not only significant for South Africa’s case at the International Court of Justice (ICJ) but developed countries such as Spain, Belgium and Japan joined most of the countries of the global South to support the resolution.

src: Werksbesoek aan die Koninkryk van Lesotho Die Kabinet het kennis geneem van President Ramaphosa se werksbesoek aan die Koninkryk van Lesotho op Vrydag, 4 Oktober 2024, op uitnodiging van Sy Majesteit Koning Letsie IIPresident Ramaphosa het Lesotho se 58ste Onafhanklikheidsdag en die tweehonderdjaarherdenking van die stigting van die Basoeto-nasie bygewoon hy het die Basoeto-nasie se ryk erfenis tydens die vieringe geprys.
tgt: Working Visit to the Kingdom of Lesotho Cabinet noted President Ramaphosa’s Working Visit to the Kingdom of Lesotho on Friday, 4 October 2024, at the invitation of His Majesty King Letsie IIDuring the visit, the President attended the 58th Lesotho Independence Day and Bicentennial Celebration, and also delivered remarks during the celebrations to commemorate the Basotho Nation’s rich heritage.

src: Voortslepende konflik in Soedan.
tgt: Ongoing Conflict in Sudan.

src: Die Kabinet het kennis geneem van die toenemende konflik in Soedan en ŉ beroep op alle Soedanese gedoen om die riglyne van die AU en die interregeringsowerheid vir ontwikkeling na te kom om die konflik te beëindig.
tgt: Cabinet noted the escalation of conflict in Sudan and called upon all Sudanese to adhere to the guidelines of the AU and Intergovernmental Authority on Development to end the conflict.

src: Suid-Afrika is gereed om sy kundigheid en samewerking aan te bied om partye, rolspelers en ander toepaslike belanghebbendes by te staan om blywende vrede in Soedan te bewerkstellig.
tgt: South Africa stands ready to offer its expertise to assist parties, role players and other relevant stakeholders to collectively work towards finding lasting peace in Sudan.

src: Opdaterings aan die Kabinet Verslag oor die voltooiing van leefstyloudits deur lede van die senior bestuursdiens (SBD) Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die vordering met die voltooiing van e-openbaarmakings deur lede van die SBD en het die vordering wat volle nakoming deur 147 uit ŉ somtotaal van 160 nasionale en provinsiale departemente ingesluit het, geprys.
tgt: Updates to Cabinet Report on completion of Lifestyle Audits by members of the Senior Management Service (SMS).

src: Die Kabinet het ook kennis geneem van ondersoeke wat gedoen word met betrekking tot lede wat nie aan die vereistes voldoen nie.
tgt: Cabinet was briefed on the progress with the completion of e-Disclosures by members of the SMS and commended the progress that included full compliance by 147 out of a total 160 national and provincial departments, and noted investigations that are underway for non-compliant members.

src: Die Kabinet het die departement van staatsdiens en administrasie versoek om te oorweeg om die e-openbaarmakingstelsel na munisipaliteite uit te brei.
tgt: Cabinet urged the Department of Public Service and Administration to consider piloting the extension of the eDisclosure system to municipalities.

src: Verslag oor die vestiging van ŉ sentrale register vir dissipline regoor die drie regeringsfere Die Kabinet het die jongste inligting oor vordering met die vestiging van ŉ sentrale register vir dissipline regoor die drie regeringsfere heen ontvang.
tgt: Report on the establishment of a Central Register for Discipline across the three spheres of government Cabinet received an update on progress with the establishment of a Central Register for Discipline across the three spheres of government and supported a proposal to interface the Central Register for Discipline with government’s PERSAL system and the local government’s payroll systems, to have a line of sight on the recruitment of implicated, resigned or dismissed officials.

src: Kabinetsbesluite
tgt: Cabinet Decisions

src: Wetsontwerpe Konsepwetsontwerp op die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Petroleummaatskappy (SANPM) Die Kabinet het die voorlegging van die SANPM-wetsontwerp van 2024 aan die Parlement goedgekeur.
tgt: Bills Draft South African National Petroleum Company (SANPC) Bill Cabinet approved the submission of the SANPC Bill of 2024 to Parliament.

src: Die wetsontwerp maak voorsiening vir die stigting van ŉ staatsbeheerde maatskappy, wat uitvoering gee aan die Kabinet se besluit van 10 Junie 2020 om PetroSA, die Suid-Afrikaanse gasontwikkelingsmaatskappy (iGas) en die strategiese brandstoffondsvereniging saam te smelt.
tgt: The Bill provides for the establishment of a state-owned company, giving effect to the Cabinet decision of 10 June 2020 to merge PetroSA, South African Gas Development Company (iGas) and the Strategic Fuel Fund Association.

src: Plaaslike raffineringskapasiteit in Suid-Afrika is meerendeels in die besit van internasionale oliemaatskappye (IOK’s).
tgt: Local refining capacity in South Africa is largely held by International Oil Companies (IOCs), which poses a risk to security of liquid fuels as IOCs are shutting down refineries.

src: Dit hou ŉ risiko in vir die sekuriteit van vloeibare brandstowwe deurdat die IOK’s besig is om hul raffinaderye te sluit.
tgt: The proposed Bill positions the SANPC as the national champion that will hold oil and gas exploration rights on its own and hold shares through State carry method in privately held rights.

src: Konsepwetsontwerp op petroleumprodukte van 2024 Die Kabinet het die publikasie van die konsepwetsontwerp op petroleumprodukte vir openbare kommentaar goedgekeur.
tgt: Draft Petroleum Products Bill of 2024 Cabinet approved the publication of the draft Petroleum Products Bill for public comments.

src: Die doel van die wetsontwerp is om die veiligheid van petroleumprodukte en die ordelike ontwikkeling van die petroleumproduktesektor te verseker.
tgt: The purpose of the Bill is to ensure security of petroleum products and orderly development of the petroleum products sector, including the introduction of modern, cleaner products and renewable components which will improve the energy mix.

src: Dit sluit die bekendstelling van moderne, skoner produkte en hernubare komponente in, wat die energiemengsel sal verbeter.
tgt: The Bill will contribute towards the government priorities on economic transformation and job creation in the South African petroleum products sector governance and will also address several concerns that were raised in relation to the administration of the Petroleum Products Act, 1977 (Act 120 of 1977).

src: Die wetsontwerp sal bydra tot die regering se prioriteite oor ekonomiese transformasie en werkskepping in die bestuur van die Suid-Afrikaanse petroleumproduktesektor en aandag te gee aan verskeie bekommernisse wat geopper is met betrekking tot die administrasie van die Wet op Petroleumprodukte, 1977 (Wet 120 van 1977).
tgt: Mine Health and Safety Amendment Bill Cabinet approved the submission of the draft Mine Health and Safety Amendment Bill to Parliament.

src: Konsepwysigingswetsontwerp op myngesondheid en -veiligheid Die Kabinet het die voorlegging van die konsepwysigingswetsontwerp op myngesondheid en -veiligheid aan die Parlement goedgekeur.
tgt: The draft Bill seeks to amend the Mine Health and Safety Act, 1996 (Act 29 of 1996) by streamlining administrative processes, strengthening enforcement provisions, reinforcing offences and penalties, and amending certain definitions.

src: Die konsepwetsontwerp het ten doel om die Wet op Myngesondheid en -Veiligheid, 1996 (Wet 29 van 1996) te wysig deur administratiewe prosesse te stroomlyn, afdwingingsbepalings te versterk, oortredings en strawwe strenger te behandel en om sekere definisies te wysig.
tgt: The draft Bill will, among others, guarantee that health and safety standards are effectively implemented, enforced and improved in mines, thereby reducing fatalities, injuries and occupational diseases.

src: Aanstellings
tgt: Appointments

src: Alle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en toepaslike sekuriteitsklaring.
tgt: All appointments are subject to verification of qualification and relevant security clearance.

src: Mnr Nkululeko Lwazi Mahlangu as adjunkdirekteur-generaal: bestuur, risiko en nakoming in die departement van openbare werke en infrastruktuur.
tgt: Mr Nkululeko Lwazi Mahlangu as Deputy Director-General: Governance, Risk and Compliance in the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure.

src: Aanstelling van lede tot die raad van die Limpopo-Olifants-opvangsagentskap:
tgt: Appointment of members to the board for the Limpopo-Olifants Catchment Agency:

src: Adv Thato Goodness Moeeng (voorsitter) Mnr Nandha Govender (adjunk-voorsitter) Mnr Francois Joubert Me Phathutshedzo Mudzanani Dr. Vhahangwele Bologo Akwinekomi Mnr Nkhangweni Lawrence Rambau Mnr Dikgole Timothy Seroka Adv Reinette Mary Rosey en
tgt: Adv Thato Goodness Moeeng (Chairperson) Mr Nandha Govender (Deputy Chairperson) Mr Francois Joubert Ms Phathutshedzo Mudzanani Dr Vhahangwele Bologo Akwinekomi Mr Nkhangweni Lawrence Rambau Mr Dikgole Timothy Seroka Adv Reinette Mary Rosey and

src: Adv Elanie Broekman.
tgt: Adv Elanie Broekman.

src: Toekomstige gebeure Vervoermaand.
tgt: Upcoming Events Transport Month.

src: Die 19e herdenking van Vervoermaand in Oktober word vanjaar onder die tema “Doen meer saam” gevier.
tgt: This year marks the 19th anniversary of the October Transport Month under the theme: “Doing more together”.

src: Die aktiwiteite is daarop gerig om openbare infrastruktuur en voortgesette verbeterings in openbare dienste deur samewerking met alle belanghebbendes ten toon te stel.
tgt: The events will focus on showcasing public infrastructure and ongoing improvements in public services through collaboration with all stakeholders.

src: Sedert die stigting van die Transnet “War Room ” is beduidende vordering ten opsigte van vragvervoer gemaak, insluitend die verbetering van vragspoor- en hawebedrywighede.
tgt: Significant progress is being made in the freight environment since the establishment of the Transnet War Room, with an improved performance in its freight rail and ports operations.

src: Belangrike padbouprojekte sal ook beklemtoon word, insluitend die N2/N3-opgraderings in KwaZulu-Natal en die opgraderings aan doe Moloto-pad, wat Gauteng, Mpumalanga en Limpopo verbind.
tgt: Government will also showcase significant road construction projects, including the N2/N3 upgrades in KwaZulu-Natal and the Moloto Road, which links Gauteng, Mpumalanga and Limpopo provinces.

src: Die passasierspooragentskap van Suid-Afrika (Prasa) het ook aansienlike vordering gemaak met die heropening van prioriteitslyne, insluitend die Germiston-Katlehong-Kwesine-lyn, wat tans in die toetsfase is, en Kaapstad se sentrale lyn, wat na verwagting teen die einde van die finansiële jaar voltooi sal word.
tgt: The Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa has also made significant progress with the reopening of priority lines including the Germiston-Katlehong-Kwesine Line, which is in the test phase, and the Cape Town Central Line, which is planned for completion by end of the financial year.

src: Maatskaplike Ontwikkelingsmaand Oktober is ook Maatskaplike Ontwikkelingsmaand en die regering poog om bewustheid van die departement van maatskaplike ontwikkeling se portefeulje van dienste te skep.
tgt: Social Development Month October is also Social Development Month and government aims to create awareness of the Department of Social Development’s Portfolio of Services.

src: Deur die loop van die maand sal gemeenskapsbesoeke aan verskeie wyke regoor die land onderneem word om gemeenskappe aan maatskaplike dienste en opheffingsprogramme te koppel en gemeenskapsdialoog-, mobiliserings- en voorspraakprogramme te vestig om die lewensgehalte van gemeenskappe wat geraak word, te verbeter.
tgt: Over the month, there will be community visits to various areas around the country to link communities to social services, upliftment programmes and undertake community dialogues, mobilisation and advocacy programmes to improve the quality of life of affected communities.

src: Jaarlikse nasionale mondelinge geskiedeniskonferensie Suid-Afrika bied die 2024 jaarlikse nasionale mondelinge geskiedeniskonferensie van 7 tot 11 Oktober 2024 in Ulundi, KwaZulu-Natal aan.
tgt: Annual National Oral History Conference South Africa is hosting the 2024 Annual National Oral History Conference from 7 to 11 October 2024 in Ulundi, KwaZulu-Natal.

src: By vanjaar se konferensie sal spesiale aandag gegee word aan dié aspekte van die nasie se geheue wat nie in die nasionale en provinsiale argief aangeteken en bewaar word nie.
tgt: At this year’s conference, special attention will be given to those aspects of the nation’s memory that are not recorded, preserved and conserved in the national and provincial archives.

src: Geestesgesondheid-bewustheidsmaand Oktober is Geestesgesondheid-bewustheidsmaand, wat daarop gemik is om die publiek op te voed oor geestesgesondheid en hulle aan te moedig om na hul geestesgesondheid om te sien.
tgt: Mental Health Awareness Month.

src: Ons moedig Suid-Afrikaners dus aan om hulp en ondersteuning te kry, indien nodig, en om diegene wat aan geestesongesteldhede ly, te respekteer.
tgt: October is Mental Health Awareness Month, which aims to educate the public about mental health and encourage them to take care of their mental health.

src: Brasilië, Rusland, Indië, Sjina en Suid-Afrika (BRICS) –spitsberaad President Ramaphosa sal van 22 tot 24 Oktober die 2024 BRICS-spitsberaad in Kazan, Rusland bywoon.
tgt: Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa (BRICS) Summit President Ramaphosa will attend the 2024 BRICS Summit in Kazan, Russia from 22 to 24 October 2024.

src: Tydens die 16de spitsberaad, onder die tema: “Versterk Multilaterisme vir Regverdige Globale Ontwikkeling en Sekuriteit”, sal kwessies oor handel, globale politieke aangeleenthede en die bevordering van samewerking tussen lidlande bespreek word.
tgt: The 16th Summit under theme: “Strengthening Multilateralism for Just Global Development and Security”, will discuss issues about trade, global political matters and advancing cooperation between member countries.

src: Meiavryheidsdag.
tgt: Media Freedom Day.

src: Op Saterdag, 19 Oktober 2024 vier Suid-Afrika Meiavryheidsdag wat die gebeure van 19 Oktober 1977 (Swart Woensdag) herdenk, waartydens 19 organisasies van die swart bewustheidsbeweging en twee koerante verban is.
tgt: On Saturday, 19 October 2024, South Africa will observe Media Freedom Day to mark the events of 19 October 1977 (Black Wednesday) that banned 19 Black Consciousness Movement organisations and two (2) newspapers.

src: ŉ Demokratiese Suid-Afrika het beduidende vordering gemaak om mediavryheid en vryheid van uitdrukking te bevorder.
tgt: A democratic South Africa has made significant progress to advance media freedom and freedom of expression.

src: Die reg op vryheid van spraak is verskans in Suid-Afrika se Grondwet.
tgt: The right to freedom of expression is entrenched entrenched in South Africa’s Constitution.

src: Distriksontwikkelingsmodel (DDM) presidensiële imbizo.
tgt: District Development Model (DDM) Presidential Imbizo.

src: President Ramaphosa sal op Vrydag, 8 November 2024 ŉ DDM presidensiële imbizo in Umgababa in die eThekwini metropolitaanse munisipaliteit in KwaZulu-Natal lei.
tgt: President Ramaphosa will lead a DDM Presidential Imbizo to Umgababa in the eThekwini Metropolitan in KwaZulu-Natal on Friday, 8 November 2024.

src: Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op inwoners van Umgababa en omliggende gebiede om by die imbizo aan te sluit en hul openbare verteenwoordigers te betrek by oplossings vir uitdagings in hul gemeenskappe, en om maniere te vind om dienslewering te verbeter Nasionale seniorsertifikaat (NSS) -eksamens Die Kabinet wens die klas van 2024 sterkte toe met die aanvang van hul matriekeksamen op 21 Oktober 2024 en doen ŉ beroep op ouers en voogde om leerders gedurende hierdie kritieke tydperk in hul akademiese reis te ondersteun.
tgt: Cabinet calls on residents of Umgababa and surrounding areas to join the imbizo and engage their public representatives on solutions to challenges in their community, and find ways to improve service delivery.

src: Die NSS bly van onskatbare waarde en bied talle opwindende opsies vir ons jongmense.
tgt: National Senior Certificate (NSC) examinations Cabinet wishes the Class of 2024 well with the start of their matric exams on 21 October 2024, and calls on parents and guardians to support learners during this critical period in their academic journey.

src: Boodskappe GelukwenseDie Kabinet dra hul gelukwense oor aan:• Die Suid-Afrikaanse regspan by die internasionale geregshof met die toekenning van die 4e Steve Biko/Frantz Fanon-prys vir Sielkundige Bevryding.
tgt: MESSAGES CongratulationsCabinet extended its congratulations and well wishes to: the South African Legal Team at the ICJ for being awarded the 4th Steve Biko/Frantz Fanon Award for Psychological Liberation.

src: Die toekenning is vir hul werk om die konvensie oor die voorkoming en straf van die misdaad van volksmoord in Gasa te handhaaf.
tgt: The award is for their work to uphold the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide in Gaza.

src: Die lede van die span is: John Dugard SC Adila Hassim SC Tembeka Ngcukaitobi SC Blinne Ní Ghrálaigh KC, Max du Plessis SC, Vaughan Lowe KC, Tshidiso Ramogale, Sarah Pudifin-Jones en Lerato Zikalala.• Profssors Salim Abdool Karim en Quarraisha Abdool, vir die gesogte Lasker-toekenning vir staatsdiens ter erkenning van hul baanbrekende lewensreddende MIV-navorsing.• Relebogile Maloma, ŉ dapper graad 3-leerder wat chemoterapie ondergaan en haar onderwyseres, me.
tgt: The members of the team are: John Dugard SC Adila Hassim SC Tembeka Ngcukaitobi SC Blinne Ní Ghrálaigh KC, Max du Plessis SC, Vaughan Lowe KC, Tshidiso Ramogale, Sarah Pudifin-Jones and Lerato Zikalala.

src: Nqobile Mbatha, wat gesamentlik die minister se spesiale #MyTeacher-toekenning ontvang het vir hul inspirerende storie.
tgt: professors Salim Abdool Karim and Quarraisha Abdool, for winning the prestigious Lasker Award for public service in recognition of their groundbreaking life-saving HIV research

src: Mbatha se onwrikbare ondersteuning daarin geslaag om tred te hou met haar skoolwerk terwyl sy in die hospitaal was.
tgt: Despite her battle with cancer, Relebogile, with Ms Mbatha’s unwavering support, managed to keep up with her schoolwork while in the hospital.

src: Me Mbatha het verseker dat Relebogile nie agter raak nie, wat haar gehelp het om met haar lesse en klasmaats in verbinding te bly.
tgt: Ms Mbatha ensured that Relebogile did not fall behind, helping her to stay connected to her lessons and classmates.

src: Deur hierdie buitengewone poging het Relebogile nie net tred gehou nie, maar ook uitgeblink en in die top 10 van haar klas geëindig – alles vanuit haar hospitaalbed.
tgt: Through this extraordinary effort, Relebogile not only kept pace but excelled, finishing in the top 10 of her class – all from her hospital bed.

src: Hul verhaal is ŉ kragtige bewys van die transformerende impak van deernisvolle en toegewyde onderrig, en die veerkragtigheid van die menslike gees.• Me Meisa Carol du Plessis (uitnemendheid in graad R-onderrig) • Me Bonisiwe Happiness Maphumulo (uitnemendheid in laerskoolonderrig) • Me Nthabiseng Mavis Mateba (uitnemendheid in die onderrig van Lewensvaardighede, grade 1-6)• Me Koliwe Doris Mbatha (uitnemendheid in laerskoolleierskap)• Mnr Thapelo Jacob Mthimkhulu (uitnemendheid in sekondêre skool onderrig)• Me Rose Martha De Jonker (uitnemendheid in sekondêre skool leierskap) • Mnr Tiisetso Daniel Chaka (uitnemendheid in met spesiale behoeftesonderrrig) • Mnr Mbongiseni Cyril Dlamini (uitnemendheid in spesiale behoeftesleierskap) • Mnr Itumeleng Esau Jr Komane (uitnemendheid in Tegnologie-verbeterde-onderrig en leer) • Mnr Maserole Mojela (uitnemendheid in die onderrig van Natuurwetenskappe) • Me Motlatso Lucia Maake (uitnemendheid in die onderrig van Fisiese Wetenskappe) • Mnr Ethon Alexander (uitnemendheid in Wiskunde-onderrig, (AOO) • Mnr Sithembiso Eugene Mahlalela (uitnemendheid in Wiskunde-onderrig – VOO) • Mnr Derek Swart (Kader Asmal Lifetime Achievement-toekenning) en• Me Ntombozuko Mkizwana (nasionale beste onderwyser-toekenning).
tgt: Ms Melisa Carol Du Plessis (Excellence in Teaching Grade R) Ms Bonisiwe Happiness Maphumulo (Excellence in Primary School Teaching) Ms Nthabiseng Mavis Mateba (Excellence in Life Skills Teaching, Grade 1-6)

src: • Suid-Afrika se onder-20 mans nasionale sokkerspan, algemeen bekend as Amajita, vir hul prestasie as die ‘Total Energies’ CAF O-20 Afrikabeker-kampioene, en omdat hulle vir die 2025 O-20 Afrikabeker-kompetisie gekwalifiseer het.
tgt: Ms Rose Martha De Jonker (Excellence in Secondary School Leadership) Mr Tiisetso Daniel Chaka (Excellence in Special Needs Teaching) Mr Mbongiseni Cyril Dlamini (Excellence in Special Needs Leadership), Mr Itumeleng Esau Jr Komane (Excellence in Technology-Enhanced Teaching and Learning) Ms Maserole Mojela (Excellence in Teaching Natural Sciences) Ms Motlatso Lucia Maake (Excellence in Teaching Physical Science) Mr Ethon Alexander (Excellence in Teaching Mathematics, GET) Mr Sithembiso Eugene Mahlalelo (Excellence in Teaching Mathematics, FET) Mr Derek Swart (Kader Asmal Lifetime Achievement) and Ms Ntombozuko Mkizwana (National Best Teacher Award).

src: • Motorsport Suid-Afrika, vir die versekering van ŉ nuwe Wêreld Rally-Raid-kampioenskap (W2RC)-byeenkoms, wat nou ook in 2025 in Suid-Afrika sal plaasvind.• Zoalize Jansen van Rensburg, met haar bekroning as Me.
tgt: The Springboks, our national rugby team, on their resounding win against Argentina and for being crowned the 2024 Rugby Champions.

src: Wêreld Suid-Afrika 2024.
tgt: South Africa’s Under 20 Men’s National Soccer Team, commonly known as Amajita, for being crowned TotalEnergies CAF Under-20 Africa Cup of Nations champions, and qualifying for the 2025 U-20 Africa Cup of Nations competition.

src: Wêreld-kompetisie in Februarie 2025 verteenwoordig.• Die wenners in die verskillende kategorieë van die eerste SAIGR Suid-Afrikaner in Australië-toekennings.
tgt: Motorsport South Africa, for securing a new World Rally-Raid Championship (W2RC) event, which will now also take place in South Africa in 2025.

src: Manana Johnson het die HUB-toekennning ontvang vir haar verpersoonliking van uiteenlopende eienskappe op die gebiede van gemeenskapsbou, Ubuntu, sosiale impak en jeugbetrokkenheid.
tgt: Zoalize Jansen van Rensburg, for being crowned Miss World South Africa 2024.

src: MeelyeDie Kabinet het hul meegevoel betuig met die regering en mense van die Demokratiese Republiek van die Kongo ná ŉ boottragedie op Saterdag, 5 Oktober 2024, wat verskeie lewens geëis het.
tgt: Zoalize is 18 years old and will represent the country at the 72nd Miss World Pageant in February 2025.

src: Die Kabinet het hul meegevoel oorgedra aan die naasbestaandes en vriende van : • Pastoor Ray McCauley, stigter van die Rhema Bybelkerk en voormalige medevoorsitter van die nasionale intergeloofsraad van Suid-Afrika.• Voormalige regter Willem Heath, wat van 1997 tot 2001 voorsitter van die Heath-kommissie van ondersoek na korrupsie, bedrog en wanadministrasie in die Oos-Kaap gedien het, en ook van 1997 tot 2001 aan die hoof van die spesiale ondersoekeenheid was.• Gospel-ikoon Solomon Molokoane, algemeen bekend onder die verhoognaam ‘Solly Moholo’, wat ons inspireer, genees en vermaak het deur sy musiek.
tgt: the winners of the various categories of the inaugural SAICA South African in Australia Awards.

src: • Siphiwe ‘General GTZ’ Sibisi, wat die laaste oorlewende lid van die Kwaito-groep Chiskop was ŉ groep wat ŉ fundamentele rol gespeel het in die ontwikkeling van Kwaito-musiek in die land.
tgt: The CEO Award went to Manana Johnson for her embodiment of diverse qualities in the areas of community building, Ubuntu, social impact and youth engagement.

src: KWESSIES IN DIE OMGEWING Veiligheid en sekuriteit.
tgt: Issues for the environment Safety and Security.

src: Voedselgedraagde siektes en sterftes Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die voedselgedraagde siektes en sterftes wat in verskeie dele van die land vermeld is, wat gelei het tot die tragiese sterftes van kinders en verskeie hospitaalopnames in Gauteng, Mpumalanga, die Oos-Kaap, KwaZulu-Natal en die Vrystaat.
tgt: Food borne illness and fatalities Cabinet was briefed on the food borne illnesses and fatalities recorded in various parts of the country, which have led to the tragic deaths of children and resulted in several hospitalisations in Gauteng, Mpumalanga, Eastern Cape, KwaZulu-Natal and Free State.

src: Die President sal die nasie toespreek oor die ingrypingsmaatreëls wat die staat tans in plek stel om die situasie te hanteer.
tgt: The President will address the Nation on the interventions government is undertaking to deal with this situation.

src: Intussen het die departement van gesondheid die nasionale instituut vir oordraagbare siektes (NICD) opdrag gegee om die bron van die vergiftiging van voedsel na te spoor en te ondersoek, en aanbevelings te maak.
tgt: In the meantime, the Department of Health has activated the National Institute of Communicable Diseases to (NICD) to trace and examine the source of the poisoning of foodstuffs and make recommendations.

src: Die Departement van Samewerkende Regering en Tradisionele sake, gesteun deur die Department van Kleinsakeontwikkeling en die Interministeriële Komitee vir Rampbestuur, het die Standaard konsep-verordeninge vir township-ekonomieë in die Staatskoerant gepubliseer.
tgt: The Department of Co-operative Governance and Traditional Affairs supported by the Department of Small Business Development and the Inter-Ministerial Committee on Disaster Management have gazetted the Standard Draft By-laws for Township Economies aimed at mobilising municipalities around a common agenda and collective responses towards inclusive local economies and curbing illegal business operations in townships.

src: Die Kabinet spreek hul medelye uit teenoor die familie, vriende en skoolmaats van die kinders wat hul lewens weens voedselgedraagde siektes verloor het en spreek ook hul goeie wense uit vir die genesing van die kinders wat steeds besig is om te herstel.
tgt: Cabinet extended its condolences to the families, friends and schoolmates of all the children who lost their lives due to food-borne illnesses and well-wishes to those still in recovery.

src: Stryd teen misdaad Die Kabinet veroordeel die sinnelose moord van Nkosikazi Thenjiwe Eunice “Nogcinile” Mtirara by die Mqhekezweni Great Place in die Oos-Kaap en spreek hul medelye uit teenoor die AmaDlomo-koninlike stam en die hele AbaThembu-koninkryk.
tgt: Fight Against Crime Cabinet condemned the senseless killing of Nkosikazi Thenjiwe Eunice “Nogcinile” Mtirara at the Mqhekezweni Great Place in the Eastern Cape and conveyed its condolences to the AmaDlomo royal clan and the entire AbaThembu Kingdom.

src: Wetstoepassingsagentskappe sal met die oortreders afreken.
tgt: Law enforcement agencies will bring the perpetrators of this crime to book.

src: Die Kabinet veroordeel ook die verkragting van vyf leerders, wie ook onder bedreiging van ŉ vuurwapen beroof is, in die Mqhekezweni-area.
tgt: Cabinet also condemned the rape of five learners who were also robbed at gunpoint in the Mqhekezweni administrative area.

src: Die NATJOINTS is spesifiek opdrag gegee op spoedig die stygende misdaadvlakke aan te spreek, insluitend die moorde in die Oos-Kaap, en te verseker dat alle oortreders en meesterbreine mee afgereken word.
tgt: The NATJOINTS have been directed to speedily curb the escalation of levels of criminality including murders in the Eastern Cape and to ensure that all perpetrators and masterminds are brought to book.

src: Die Kabinet spreek hul prys uit teenoor die intelligensie-gedrewe operasie, gelei deur NATJOINTS (die stryd teen onwettige mynaktiwiteite en Operasie Vala-mgodi), wat gelei het tot die inhegtenisname van meer as 1 000 onwettige myners by verlate mynskagte in Orkney in die Noordwes sedert die naweek van 2 November Die Kabinet verwelkom die volgehoue pogings om die kapasiteit van die polisie te versterk met die ontplooïng van 2 800 nuutopgeleide polisiebeamptes in verskeie polisiestasies regoor die land.
tgt: Cabinet commended the intelligence driven operation led by NATJOINTS (the fight against illegal mining and operation vala-mgodi) that have led to the arrest of more than 1000 illegal miners at abandoned mine shafts in Orkney in North West since the weekend of 2 November Cabinet welcomed continued efforts to strengthen the capacity of the police with the deployment of 2 800 newly trained police officers across various police stations.

src: ŉ Bykomende 2 000 polisiebeamptes, wat tans in opleiding is, sal in Desember gradueer en gereed wees vir ontplooïng tydens die Feestyd.
tgt: An additional 2000 police trainees will graduate in December 2024 and they will be ready for the festive season deployment.

src: Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om die polisie by te staan in die stryd teen misdaad deur misdaadgevalle aan te meld by 0800 1011.1 en die toegewyde nasionale afpersingshulplyn by 080 091 1011 vir misdade verwant aan afpersing.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to partner with the police in the fight against crime by reporting incidents of crime on 0800 1011.1 and the dedicated National Extortion Hotline: 080 091 1011 on extortion-related crimes.

src: Internasionale sake.
tgt: International Matters.

src: Aftelling: Suid-Afrika se presidensie van die Groep van 20 (G20)2.
tgt: Countdown: South Africa’s Group of Twenty (G20) Presidency The countdown to South Africa assuming the Presidency of the G20 from 1 December 2024 to 30 November 2025 under the theme: “Solidarity, Equality and Sustainability”, has begun.

src: Die leiersberaad van die G20-leiers sal in Johannesburg, Gauteng plaasvind en die IMK werk saam met ander provinsies om gasheer te speel vir die ministeriële en werkgroepsvergaderings.
tgt: The Leaders Summit will be held in Johannesburg, Gauteng and the IMC is working with other Provinces to host Ministerial and Working Groups meetings.

src: Ons sal die Suid-Afrika G20-program op 1 Desember 2024 van stapel stuur.
tgt: We will launch the South Africa G20 programme on the 1st December 2024.

src: Suid-Afrika sal deelneem aan die opkomende G20- beraad op 18 en 19 November 2024 te Rio de Janeiro, Brasilië.
tgt: South Africa will participate in the upcoming G20 Summit on 18 and 19 November 2024, in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil .

src: Internasionale Strafhof (ISH)2.
tgt: International Court of Justice (ICJ)2.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die indiening van die versoekskrif aan die ISH, wat toon dat die regering van Israel die volksmoord-konvensie oortree het met doelbewuste oortredings en die moord van Palestyne wat in Gaza woon.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the filing of the Memorial to the ICJ, which shows how the Government of Israel violated the Genocide Convention through deliberate violations and murder of Palestinians living in Gaza.

src: Die versoekskrif - ŉ dokument van meer as 1 300 bladsye wat gesteun word deur bewysstukke en aanhangsels - bevat bewyse van Israel se dade van volksmoord en die land se versuim om aanhitsing tot volksmoord te verhoed en diegene skuldig aan die aanhitsing en pleeg van dade van volksmoord, te straf.
tgt: The memorial document of more 1300 pages – supported by exhibits and annexures – contains evidence of Israel’s genocidal acts, and its failure to prevent incitement to genocide and punish those inciting and committing acts of genocide.

src: Die indiening van die versoekskrif neem plaas tydens ŉ tydperk met verskerpte dodelike aanvalle op burgers in Gaza en ŉ vaste voorneme om soortgelyke verwoesting in Lebanon te saai.
tgt: The filing of the memorial takes place at a time when Israel is intensifying the killing of civilians in Gaza and is intent on following a similar path of destruction in Lebanon.

src: Die versoekskrif herinner die wêreldgemeenskap van die gruweldade wat teen die mense van Palestina gepleeg is en die behoefte aan solidariteit om die katastrofe te beëindig.
tgt: The memorial is a reminder to the global community of the atrocities perpetuated against the people of Palestine and the need for solidarity to stop the catastrophe.

src: Die indiening volg ook in die voetspore van die Verenigde Nasies se resolusie, wat die dade van die Israeliese regering teenoor die mense van Palestina, veroordeel.
tgt: The filing also comes in the footsteps of the United Nations resolution condemning the actions of the Israeli government against the people of Palestine.

src: Bevordering van globale demokrasie Die Kabinet het hul gelukwense gerig aan die regerings en die mense van die Republiek van Botswana, Mosambiek en die Verenigde State (VSA) na aanleiding van suksesvolle afsluiting van hul onlangse verkiesings.
tgt: Advancing Global Democracy Cabinet extends its congratulations to the governments and people of the Republic of Botswana, Mozambique and the United States (US) on the successful conclusion of their recent elections.

src: Die Kabinet spreek hul prys uit teenoor die “Umbrella for Democratic Change”- koalisies in Botswana vir hul suksesvolle werk onder leiding van die aangewese president, Duma Boko, en verwelkom die vestiging van oorgangsbeplanning tussen die uitgaande administrasie en die inkomende administrasie van die aangewese president.
tgt: Cabinet commends the Umbrella for Democratic Change coalitions in Botswana on its success under the leadership of President-Elect Duma Boko and welcomed the establishment of transitional plans between the outgoing administration and the incoming administration of President-Elect Boko.

src: Die Kabinet wens die aangewese president Daniel Chapo en sy party, Frelimo, geluk met hul oorwinning in die land se historiese verkiesing wat plaasgevind het 32 jaar na die ondertekening van die algemene vredesooreenkoms, wat burgeroorlog tot ŉ einde gebring het en multi-party demokrasie in Mosambiek ingestel het.
tgt: Cabinet congratulates President-Elect Daniel Chapo and his party, FRELIMO, on their victory following the country’s historic election having been held 32 years following the signing of the General Peace Agreement, which brought an end to the civil war and introduced multi-party democracy in Mozambique.

src: Die voortdurende geweld, na aanleiding van die verkiesing, is rede tot kommer en alle ontevrede partye moet eerder van bestaande regsmiddele gebruik maak om hul griewe oor die verkiesing op te los en voort te bou op die grondslag vir demokrasie wat neergelê is in die Maputo-ooreenkoms vir vrede en nasionale versoening.
tgt: The ongoing post-election violence is a concern, and all the disaffected parties should exhaust established legal remedies to resolve their election grievances and continue to build on the foundations of peace laid in the Maputo Accord for Peace and National Reconciliation.

src: Die Kabinet het ook aangewese president Donald Trump gelukgewens na aanleiding van die VSA se verkiesings wat op 5 November 2024 plaasgevind het.
tgt: Cabinet also congratulates President-Elect Donald Trump following the US elections held on 5 November 2024.

src: Suid-Afrika sien daarna uit om nou saam met die aangewese president te werk oor die verloop van die volgende 12 maande, met president Cyril Ramaphosa se presidensie van die G20 wat op 1 Desember 2024 in werking tree.
tgt: South Africa looks forward to working very closely with President-Elect Trump over the next 12 months when President Cyril Ramaphosa assumes the Presidency of the G20 on 1 December 2024.

src: 3 Handelsaangeleenthede Uitkomste van die staatsbesoek en deelname aan die forum vir Sjina-Afrika-samewerking (FOCAC).1 Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die uitkomste van die onlangse suksesvolle staatsbesoek aan die Volksrepubliek Sjina en die FOCAC- vergadering vanaf 2 tot 6 September 2024 te Beijing, Sjina.
tgt: Trade Matters Outcomes of the State Visit and participation in the Forum for China-Africa Cooperation (FOCAC).1 Cabinet received a briefing about the outcomes of the recent successful State Visit to the People’s Republic of China and FOCAC meeting held in Beijing, China from 2 to 6 September 2024.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die volgende sleuteluitkomste vir Suid-Afrika:.2 ŉ Ooreenkoms om handelstrukture te verander na meer waarde-toegevoegde produkte, veral ŉ ooreenkoms om ŉ lys van 100 toegevoegde-waarde produkte vanuit Suid-Afrika wat Sjina sal oorweeg om in te voer, uit te ruil.
tgt: Cabinet noted the following key outcomes for South Africa:.2 An agreement to change the structure of trade into more value-added manufactured products, particularly an agreement to exchange a list of 100 value-added products from South Africa that China will consider importing.

src: .3 Daarbenewens het Suid-Afrika die samewerking van Sjina rakende drie waardekettings verwant aan dekarbonisering, digitalisering, vervoer en logistieke verseker.
tgt: .3 In addition, South Africa secured cooperation from China on three value chains relating to decarbonisation, digitalisation, transport and logistics.

src: Hierdie samewerking sal die weg uitlê om belegging in elektriese voertuie, batteryvervaardiging, hernubare energie-storing asook in geïdentifiseerde spesiale ekonomiese sones en nywerheidsontwikkelingsones te bevorder.
tgt: This cooperation will pave the way to promote investments in electric vehicles, battery manufacturing, renewable energy storage, as well as in identified Special Economic Zones and Industrial Development Zones.

src: .4 Sjinese beleggers van sleutelbelang, vanuit beide Shenzhen en Beijing, het hul belangstelling uitgespreek om óf hul beleggings uit te brei, óf in sogenaamde “groenveld”-beleggings in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: .4 Key Chinese investors in both Shenzhen and Beijing expressed interest to either expand their investments or for greenfield investment into South Africa.

src: .5 Tydens die sakeforum is ses memorandums van verstandhouding onderteken, gemik op groter samewerking tussen Sjinese entiteite en finansiële ontwikkelingsinstansies met betrekking tot die bevordering van nywerheidsontwikkeling in Suid-Afrika, tegnologiese samewerking om die dekarbonisering van sleutelsektore in Suid-Afrika te bespoedig, en beleggings in die hernubare energiesektor.
tgt: .5 During the Business Forum, six Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) were signed aimed at promoting cooperations between Chines entities and South African companies and Development Finance Institutions to strengthen cooperation to promote industrial development in South Africa, promote technology cooperation to advance decarbonization of key South African sectors and value -chains and to promote investments in the renewable energy sector.6 The agreements signed both at a government and private sector level will contribute to accelerating investments that promote green and low-carbon transformation and promote innovation in industrial activities and also attract investment in Special Economic Zones and Industrial Parks.

src: .6 Die ooreenkomste is op beide staatsektor- en private sektorvlak onderteken en sal bydra tot die versnelling van beleggings ter bevordering van groen- en laekoolstoftransformasie en innovering in nywerheidsaktiwiteite, asook die beleggings in spesiale ekonomiese sones en nywerheidsparke te lok.
tgt: Economy.1 Medium Term Budget Policy Statement (MTBPS).1 Cabinet welcomes the 2024 MTBPS, which gives effect to the commitments of the Government of Nation Unity to pursue rapid, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, and create a more just and equitable society by tackling poverty, inequality and unemployment.2 The stability in public finances through the prudent management of government spending and debt ensures that our country can stimulate economic growth while ensuring the most vulnerable in our midst continue to be supported through our social assistance programmes.3 Cabinet supports the four pillars to uplift the economy through macroeconomic stability, implementing structural reforms, building state capability and increasing public infrastructure investment.

src: 4 Ekonomie.1 Meiumtermyn-begrotingsbeleidsverklaring (MTBBV).1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die 2024 MTBBV, wat uitvoering gee aan die regering van nasionale eenheid se verbintenisse om spoedige, inklusiewe en volhoubare ekonomiese groei na te streef en ŉ meer geregtige en billike samelewing te skep deur armoede, ongelykheid en werkloosheid aan te spreek.2 Die stabiliteit in openbare finansies, danksy die verstandige bestuur van staatsbesteding en -skuld, beteken dat ons land terselfdetyd ekonomiese groei kan stimuleer en steeds verseker dat die mees weerloses in die samelewing gesteun word deur maatskaplike hulpprogramme.3 Die Kabinet ondersteun die vier pilare om die ekonomie op te bou deur middel van makro-ekonomiese stabiliteit, die implementering van strukturele hervorming, die bou van staatskapasiteit en ŉ toename in openbare infrastruktuurbelegging.
tgt: The country is also on track to be removed from the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) grey list, having already addressed 16 of the 22 action items identified ahead of FATF reassessment in 2025.

src: Die land is ook op dreef om verwyder te word van die Financial Action Task Force (FATF) se gryslys, siende dat 16 van die 22 aksie-items reeds aangespreek is ter afwagting van die FATF se evaluering en heroorweging in 2025.
tgt: .4 The MTBPS is part of our nation’s open and accountable budget cycle that allows for medium to long-term financial planning of our nation’s finance.

src: .4 Die MTBBV is deel van ons nasie se oop en verantwoordbare begrotingsiklus wat voorsiening maak vir die medium- tot langtermyn finansiële beplanning van ons land se finansies.
tgt: It also allows South Africans to hold government departments and entities to account on spending and gives investors surety over the country’s economic direction.

src: Dit stel ook Suid-Afrikaners in staat om staatsdepartemente en -entiteite verantwoordbaar te hou vir hul besteding en, met betrekking tot oorsese beleggers, staan die MTBBV borg vir ons land se ekonomiese rigting.
tgt: Tourism.1 The launch of the country’s Summer Tourism Campaign encourages South Africans and visitors from across the globe to explore the country’s hidden tourist gems found across all our nine provinces.2 The Gimme Summer – Sho’t Left Campaign will profile local tourist offerings to allow more South Africans to enjoy, explore and experience our nation’s hidden tourist attractions.3 In strengthening the tourism sector, Cabinet welcomed the gazetting of the Trusted Tour Operator Scheme (TTOS), which streamlines the visa application process for large tour groups from China and India.

src: Toerisme.1 Die afskop van die land se somertoerisme-veldtog moedig Suid-Afrikaners en besoekers van regoor die wêreld aan om die land se versteekte toerisme-juwele regoor ons nege provinsies te verken.2 Die “Gimme Summer – Sho’t Left”-veldtog sal die lig skyn op plaaslike toerisme-aanbiedinge om meer Suid-Afrikaners in staat te stel om ons land se versteekte toerisme-besienswaardighede te verken, ervaar en geniet.
