tgt: .4 The initiative addresses capacity constraints at foreign missions and aims to attract more tourists from China and India, which respectively account for 1.8% and 3.9% of all international visitors to South Africa.5 Interested travel companies can access the system by visiting WEBTOKEN or accessing the portal through the TTOS banner on www.

src: Hierdie lande is veranwoordelik vir onderskeidelik 1.8% en 3.9% van alle internasionale besoekers aan Suid-Afrika.5 Toeragentskappe wat belang stel kan toegang tot die stelsel verkry by WEBTOKEN of toegang tot die portaal verkry by wyse van die TTOS-banier op die webwerf www.
tgt: za.6 Furthermore, the country’s eVisa System has been rolled out to 34 countries to allow tourists from those countries to apply online for a visa to South Africa without having to visit an embassy or consulate.

src: 5 Wateraangeleenthede.1 Tydelike maatreëls om drinkwater aan Hammanskraal te verskaf.1 Die Kabinet is ingelig en beskou vordering wat gemaak is deur die Departement van Water en Sanitasie om drinkwater aan die Tshwane-metro te verskaf om die stad in staat te stel om drinkwater aan die mense van Hammanskraal te verskaf, hetsy op ŉ tydelike basis.
tgt: .2 The ongoing water supply problems that have hit Hammanskraal and surrounding areas continue to negatively affect the lives of the people, including the provision of healthcare services at local facilities such as the Jubilee Hospital.3 The City of Tshwane is currently implementing a R278-million project to repair the previously dysfunctional Rooiwal Wastewater Treatment Works (WWTW).

src: .2 Die voortdurende verskaffingsprobleme in Hammanskraal en omliggende omgewings het ŉ negatiewe invloed op die inwoners se lewens, insluitend belemmerings in die verskaf van gesondheidsdienste by plaaslike fasiliteite soos die Jubilee-hospitaal.3 Die Tshwane-metro is tans besig om ŉ projek van R278 miljoen te implementeer om die voorheen-wanfunksionele Rooiwal-afvalwaterbehandelingswerke (AWBW) te herstel.
tgt: .4 It is expected that increasing the capacity of the Rooiwal WWTW will cost about R2 billion.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig dat die Tshwane-metro die projek sal moet befonds deur hul eie inkomste, deur geld te leen of om geld te gebruik afkomstig vanuit die stad se toelae vir die ontwikkeling van stedelike nedersettings vanaf die Departement van Meslike Nedersettings.
tgt: Cabinet was informed that the City of Tshwane will have to fund this project through revenue, borrowing or its Urban Settlements Development Grant allocations from the Department of Human Settlements.

src: .5 In 2023 het die ministerie van water en sanitasie Magalies Water aangesê om dringend in te gryp in terme van die Wet op Waterdienste, 1997 (Wet 108 van 1997) en om ŉ nuwe waterbehandelingsaanleg te ontwerp en installeer by die waterraad se Klipdrift-waterbehandelingswerke naby Hammanskraal.
tgt: .5 In 2023, the Ministry of Water and Sanitation directed Magalies Water to urgently intervene in terms of the Water Services Act, 1997 (Act 108 of 1997), and to design and install a new water-treatment plant at its Klipdrift Water Treatment Works near Hammanskraal.

src: Dit sal help om die uitdagings rondom waterverskaffing aan te spreek en langtermynoplossings te verskaf.
tgt: This will help to ease the water challenges and provide long-term solutions.

src: Die bykomende waterbehandelingsaanleg sal water aan sekere reservoirs in die stad se waterverspreidingstelsel verskaf om die toevoer van skoon drinkwater aan Hammanskraal te verhoog.6 Die staat doen ŉ beroep op die inwoners van Hammanskraal en omliggende omgewings om geduldig te bly terwyl hierdie maatreëls onderweg is.
tgt: This additional water treatment plant will supply water to certain reservoirs in the City’s water distribution system to increase the supply of clean drinking water to Hammanskraal.

src: Die eerste fase sal na verwagting teen 15 November voltooi wees.
tgt: The first phase is expected to be completed by 15 November 2024.

src: Dit sal die Tshwane-metro in staat stel om drinkbare water aan sommige dele van Hammanskraal te lewer.
tgt: This will allow the City of Tshwane to deliver potable water to some areas of Hammanskraal.

src: Munisipale skuld aan waterrade.1 Die Kabinet is op hoogte gebring oor die voordurende uitstaande munisipale skuld aan waterrade, wat aanhou styg en nie volhoubaar is nie, met ŉ totaal van R23 miljard wat teen 31 Augustus 2024 verskuldig was.
tgt: Municipal debts to water boards.1 Cabinet received an update on the ongoing outstanding municipal debts to water boards, which is rising and unsustainable, with a total of R23 billion owed by 31 August 2024.

src: Hierdie skuld is ŉ bedreiging vir die finansiële lewensvatbaarheid van die waterrade en die algehele watersektor.
tgt: The debt threatens the financial viability of the water boards and the entire water sector.

src: Water en sanitasie minister, Pemmy Majodina, het onlangs met verskeie van die munisipaliteite wat geraak word, ontmoet en verbintenisse van meeste van hierdie nie-betalende munispaliteite verkry om hul skuld te delg.
tgt: Water and Sanitation Minister Pemmy Majodina recently met with several of the affected municipalities and received commitments to pay from most non-paying municipalities.

src: .2 Die Kabinet het voorheen die stigting van ŉ interministeriële komitee (IMK) om munisipale omkeer aan te spreek, goedgekeur.
tgt: .2 Cabinet had previously approved the establishment of an Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC) to address municipal turnaround.

src: Die IMK sal ook maatreëls om munisipale verheffing van hul skuld aan waterrade aan te spreek, prioritiseer – veral dié wat dreigende bankrotskap in die oë staar.
tgt: The IMC will also prioritise measures to address municipal debt payments to water boards, particularly those facing imminent bankruptcy.

src: Waterbeperkings in Gauteng.1 Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die vlak 1-waterbeperkings wat ingestel is in Gauteng weens die voortdurende wateraanvraag danksy hoë verbruik wat deur bevolkingsgroei, onwettige verbindings, waterlekkasie en misbruik van water veroorsaak word.
tgt: Water Restrictions in Gauteng.1 Cabinet was appraised of the level 1 water restrictions that are in place in Gauteng due to continued water demand as a result of high consumption caused by population growth, illegal connections, leaks and misuse of water.

src: .2 Die gemiddelde waterverbruik in Gauteng is 279 liter per kapita per dag, vergeleke met die internasionale gemiddeld van 173 liter per kapita per dag.
tgt: .2 The average consumption in Gauteng is 279 litres per capita per day compared to the international average of 173 litres per capita per day.

src: Alhoewel die metropolitaanse munisipaliteite in Gauteng tans onderhewig is aan vlak 1-waterbeperkings, word bittermin deur die munisipaliteite gedoen om dit af te dwing.3 Die minister van water en sanitasie en die Gautengse premier het die munisipaliteite versoek om vlak 2-waterbeperkings in te stel, met gepaardgaande boetes indien verbruikers nie die waterbeperkings gehoorsaam nie.
tgt: Whilst the metropolitan municipalities in Gauteng have level 1 water restrictions in place, very little enforcement is undertaken by the municipalities.

src: Vestiging van die nasionale waterkrisiskomitee.1 Die Kabinet het die besluit gesteun deur die President om die werk wat tans deur die Adjunkpresident gelei word, te ondersteun deur die kwessies rondom water te verhef met die stigting van ŉ nasionale waterkrisiskomitee.
tgt: Establishment of National Water Crises Committee.1 Cabinet supported the decision by the President to augment the work that is currently spearheaded by the Deputy President by elevating the water matters as a crisis and establish a National water crises committee that will develop an water action plan and bring in water experts in order to intervene to the nation-wide water challenges in the Local Government space Social.1 Signing of the Divorce Amendment Bill Into Law.1 Cabinet welcomed the historic issuing of the first batch of 33 Muslim marriage certificates by the Department of Home Affairs following the signing of the Divorce Amendment Bill into law in May this year by President Ramaphosa.

src: Hierdie komitee sal ŉ wateraksieplan ontwikkel en deskundiges byeenbring om in te gryp in die landswye uitdagings rakende water in die plaaslike regeringsmilieu.
tgt: The Bill amended the Divorce Act, 1979 (Act 70 of 1979) to recognise Muslim marriages and safeguard the interests of Muslim women and children if those marriages are dissolved.2 These long-overdue changes signal our country’s commitment to ensure that Muslim women and children’s rights to equality, dignity, access to justice as well as the best interests of the minor child, as enshrined in the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996, are upheld.

src: 6 Maatskaplike aangeleenthede.1 Ondertekening van Wysigingswetsontwerp op Egskeiding.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die historiese toekenning van 33 Moeslimhuweliksertifikate deur die departement van binnelandse sake na aanleiding van die ondertekening van die Wysigingswetsontwerp deur President Cyril Ramaphosa in Me- maand vanjaar.
tgt: .3 They also give effect on fostering greater social cohesion, nation-building and a shared national identity as well as honouring various cultural and religious traditions.

src: Hierdie wetsontwerp wysig die Wet op Egskeiding, 1979 (Wet 70 van 1979) om Moeslimhuwelike te erken en die belange van die Moeslimvroue en -kinders te beskerm indien sulke huwelike ontbind word.
tgt: Cabinet decisions Decisions of the Cabinet Meeting of Wednesday, 23 October 2024 2026 Local Government Elections Cabinet approved the establishment of an Inter-Ministerial Committee that will oversee preparations for the 2026/27 Local Government Elections.

src: KABINETSBESLUITE Besluite van die Kabinetvergadering op Woensdag, 23 Oktober 2024 2026 plaaslike regeringsverkiesings Die Kabinet het die skep van ŉ interministeriële komitee (IMK), wat sal toesig hou oor die voorbereidings vir die 2026/27 plaaslike regeringsverkiesings, goedgekeur.
tgt: With the previous local government having been held on 1 November 2021, the next municipal elections will be held between 2 November 2026 and 1 February 2027.

src: Die IMK sal byeengeroep word deur die minister van samewerkende regering en tradisionele sake en sal bestaan uit verskeie staatsdepartemente wat ŉ sleutelrol speel om ŉ suksesvolle verkiesing te verseker.
tgt: The IMC will be convened by the Minister of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs and consists of several government departments that are key to ensuring the delivery of successful elections.

src: Die Kabinet het ook die formules vir die bepaling van die aantal raadslede in terme van artikel 20(1) van die Wet op Plaaslike Regering: Munisipale Strukture, 1998 (Wet 117 van 1998), bepaal en goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet also considered and approved the formulae for the determination of the number of councilors in terms of Section 20 (1)

src: Die 2026 munisipale verkiesings sal die sesde sulke verkiesings wees sedert die koms van demokrasie in 1994.
tgt: The 2026 Municipal Elections will be the sixth such elections since the advent of democracy in 1994.

src: Die IMK sal saam met die OVK werk om te verseker dat die aanloop tot die verkiesings glad en vreedsaam verloop.
tgt: The IMC will work with the IEC and other relevant bodies towards ensuring that the process leading to the local government is smooth and peaceful.

src: Wetsontwerpe Wetsontwerp op die Raamwerk vir Interregeringsverhoudinge, Die Kabinet het die publikasie van die Wetsontwerp op die Raamwerk vir Interregeringsverhoudinge, 2024 vir openbare kommentaar goedgekeur.
tgt: Intergovernmental Framework Amendment Bill, Cabinet approved publication of the Intergovernmental Relations Framework Bill, 2024 for public comments.

src: Die wetsontwerp is gemik op wysigings aan die Wet op die Raamwerk vir Interregeringsverhoudinge, 2005 (Wet 13 van 2005), om te verseker dat werk in die verskillende regeringsfere op ŉ gekoördineerde wyse plaasvind.
tgt: The Bill seeks to make amendments to the Intergovernmental Relations Framework Act (Act 13 of 2005), to ensure that the different spheres of government work in a coordinated manner.

src: Die wysigings sal sommige artikels van die wet wat verouderd is, regstel en verseker dat die drie regeringsfere saamwerk om dienslewering te verbeter.
tgt: The amendments will correct some sections of the Act that have become outdated and will ensure that the three spheres of government work together to improve service delivery in meeting the needs of the people.

src: Hoofstuk 3 van die Grondwet vereis dat al drie regeringsfere saamwerk in wedersydse vertroue en goeie trou deur onder meer vriendskaplike verhoudings te vestig en mekaar te help en ondersteun.
tgt: Chapter 3 of the Constitution requires all spheres of government to cooperate with one another in mutual trust and good faith by, among others, fostering friendly relations and assisting and supporting one another.

src: In hierdie verband sal die Wetsontwerp op die Raamwerk vir Interregeringsverhoudinge, 2024 die koördinering van die implementering van staatsbeleide en wetgewing fasiliteer, insluitend die versekering van samehangende regering, die doeltreffende verskaffing van dienste en die monitor en implementering van beleide.
tgt: In this regard, the Intergovernmental Relations Framework Bill, will facilitate the coordination of the implementation of government policies and legislation, including ensuring coherent government, the effective provision of services, the monitoring and implementation of policies.

src: Hierdie veranderinge aan die wetgewing sal ook die streeksontwikkelingsmodel steun, wat gemik is op die verbetering en verskerping van interregerings-verhoudingstelsels.
tgt: These changes to legislation will also support the District Development Model which is geared towards improving and strengthening the intergovernmental relations system.

src: Besluite van die Kabinetvergadering op Woensdag, 6 November 2024 16 Dae van Aktivisme teen Geslagsgebaseerde Geweld-veldtog.
tgt: Cabinet decisions of the meeting held on the 6th of November 2024 16 Days of Activism Campaign against Gender-based Violence (GBV)3.

src: Die Kabinet het die konsep-benadering tot die 2024 16 Dae van Aktivisme teen Geslagsgebaseerde Geweld goedgekeur, met die tema: “30 Jaar van die Bevordering van Gesamentlike Aksie om Geweld teen Vroue en Kinders te Beëindig”, wat die belangrikheid van ŉ samelewing-as-geheel benadering tot die stryd teen geslagsgebaseerde geweld en vrouemoord (GGGV) asook die belangrikheid van multisektorale verantwoordbaarheid beklemtoon.
tgt: Cabinet approved the conceptual approach to the 2024 16 Days of Activism Campaign against GBV, under the theme: “30 Years of Advancing Collective Action to End Violence Against Women and Children”, which emphasises the importance of a whole-of-society approach to combating GBVF and the importance of a multisectoral accountability.

src: Vanjaar vier ons die 26ste herdenking van Suid-Afrika se deelname aan die 16 Dae van Aktivisme vir Geen Geweld teen Vroue en Kinders-veldtog, wat op 25 November 2024 by die Royal Bafokeng-stadion in Noordwes geloods sal word.
tgt: This year marks the 26th anniversary of South Africa’s participation in the 16 Days of Activism for No Violence against Women and Children Campaign, which will be launched on 25 November 2024 at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in North West.

src: Dit steun die globale veldtog wat van 25 November (die Internasionale Dag vir die Uitwissing van Geweld teen Vroue) tot 10 Desember (Internasionale Meseregtedag) duur.
tgt: This supports the global campaign which runs from 25 November (International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women) to 10 December (International Human Rights Day).

src: Vanjaar se veldtog spreek weereens die grondoorsake van GGGV aan terwyl dit ook positiewe manlikheid en geslagsgelykheid bevorder, tesame met die skep van ekonomiese geleenthede vir vroue en kinders.
tgt: This year’s campaign continues to address the root causes of GBVF while promoting positive masculinity and gender equity, along with creating economic opportunities for women and children.

src: Alhoewel meer as 1 000 GGGV- oortreders tussen 1 April en 21 September 2024 vervolg en skuldig bevind is, het ons as nasie steeds baie om te verrig om hierdie plaag in die samelewing uit te wis. Nasionale Gestremdheidsregte-bewustheidsmaand Die Kabinet het die konsep en tema vir die Nasionale Gestremdheidsregte-bewustheidsmaand 2024 en die Nasionale Dag vir Persone met Gestremdhede, wat plaasvind van 3 November tot 3 Desember, goedgekeur.
tgt: While more than 1 000 GBVF perpetrators were convicted between 1 April and 31 September 2024, we still have more to do as a nation to eradicate this scourge from society.

src: Vanjaar se tema vier 30 jaar van demokrasie en die skep van ŉ inklusiewe samelewing vir persone met gestremdhede – oftewel “Celebrating 30 Years of Democracy Creating a Disability Inclusive Society”.
tgt: Disability Rights Awareness Month (DRAM) Cabinet approved the concept and the theme for the 2024 DRAM and National Day of Persons with Disabilities, which run from 3 November to 3 December.

src: Die tema beklemtoon die belangrikheid daarvan om bewustheid te skep oor die uitdagings waarvoor mense met gestremdhede te staan kom, die bevordering en beskerming van hul waardigheid en die behoud van hul regte, soos vasgelê in die Grondwet.
tgt: The theme for this year is: “Celebrating 30 Years of Democracy creating a disability inclusive society”.

src: Die uitwissing van die bestaande hindernisse wat mense met gestremdhede beïnvloed sluit in om vindingryke, volhoubare en veilige omgewings te verseker en ook te besef dat nie alle gestremdhede sigbaar is nie.
tgt: The theme emphasises the importance of raising awareness about the challenges facing persons with disabilities, promoting and protecting their dignity and realising their rights as enshrined in the Constitution.

src: Die maandlange aktiwiteite sal bewustheid skep en die vordering wat die land sover gemaak het om die regte van mense met gestremdhede te beskerm, ten toon te stel.
tgt: The month-long activities will raise awareness and showcase the progress the country has made in ensuring the protection of the rights of persons with disabilities.

src: Die regering doen ŉ beroep op almal in die samelewing om saam te werk om ŉ volhoubare en gestremdheids-inklusiewe toekoms te bou.
tgt: Government calls on all of society to work together as partners in building a sustainable and disability-inclusive future.

src: Beleid vir die voorkoming van en behandeling vir middelgebruikversteurings.
tgt: Policy on the Prevention of and Treatment for Substance Use Disorders Cabinet approved the Policy on the Prevention of and Treatment for Substance Use Disorders, which aims to provide a comprehensive response framework to address challenges related to alcohol and substance abuse faced by communities.

src: Die Kabinet het die beleid vir die voorkoming van en behandeling vir middelgebruikversteurings goedgekeur.
tgt: The policy supplements existing interventions such as the National Drug Master Plan that was implemented between 2013 and 2017, and responds directly to gaps identified in the Prevention of and Treatment for Substance Abuse Act, 2008 (Act 70 of 2008).

src: Die beleid is daarop gemik om ŉ breedvoerige reaksieraamwerk te verskaf om die uitdagings verbonde aan alkohol- en middelmisbruik wat ons gemeenskappe in die oë staar, aan te spreek.
tgt: The policy proposes community-based prevention programmes that effectively address major challenges from substance abuse.

src: Dit steun op drie pilare: Vermindering van aanvraag – daarop gemik om die aanvang van middelmisbruik of middelafhanklikheid te voorkom Vermindering van verskaffing – daarop gemik om toeganklikheid van middele te beperk en Vermindering van skade – wat insluit die behandeling van middelgebruikversteurings en verwante aktiwiteite en gedrag.
tgt: It is underpinned by three pillars: the Demand reduction pillar – aimed at preventing the onset of substance abuse or dependence the Supply reduction pillar – aimed at reducing accessibility and the Harm reduction pillar – which includes treatment of substance use disorders and related activities.

src: Die fokus is op beide die beperking van die skade aan individue en aan gemeenskappe weens middelmisbruik.
tgt: The focus is both on reducing damage caused by substance abuse to individuals and communities.

src: Dit kan bereik word deur voorkoming, vroeë ingryping, behandeling en ander verwante maatreëls, nasorg en herintegrasiedienste.
tgt: This can be achieved through prevention, early intervention, treatment and other related measures, aftercare and reintegration services.

src: Die beleid is beskikbaar op die webwerf van die departement van maatskaplike ontwikkeling by WEBTOKEOPDATERING AAN DIE KABINET Die stand van mynwese in Suid-Afrika Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die verslag oor die stand van mynwese, wat gebaseer is op ŉ studie deur Mintek.
tgt: The policy is published on the Department of Social Development website: WEBTOKEUpdates to Cabinet The State of Mining in South Africa Cabinet was apprised on the State of Mining Industry report, based on a study conducted by Mintek.

src: Die verslag verskaf volledige en op-datum inligting oor die nuutste ontwikkelinge in globale kommoditeitsmarkte, mineraalproduksieneigings in Suid-Afrika, asook die mynbedryf se bydraes tot die bruto binnelandse produk, beleggings en werkskepping.
tgt: The report provides comprehensive and up-to-date information on the latest developments in global commodity markets, mineral production trends in South Africa, the mining industry’s contribution to gross domestic product, investments and employment creation.

src: Die verslag dien as ŉ kritiese hulpbron om belemmerings tot die ontwikkeling van die mynsektor te identifiseer en is ŉ sleutelbydraer tot die groei van die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie.
tgt: The report serves as a critical resource in identifying impediments to the development of the mining sector, which is a key contributor to the growth of the South African economy.

src: Die verslag oor die stand van mynwese sal die land se mynsektor in staat stel om hulself te posisioneer en voordeel te trek uit die oplewing in kommoditeitsaanvraag deur inligting oor verskeie kommoditeite te verskaf.
tgt: The State of the Mining Industry report will enable the country’s mining sector to position itself and take advantage of the boom in commodity demand by providing information on various commodities.

src: Verslag oor Fase IV van die presidensiële jeugindiensnemingsinisiatief in die basiese onderwyssektor genaamd die basiese onderwysindiensnemingsinisiatief (BEEI) Die Kabinet is ingelig oor die prestasies van die BEEI, die grootskaalse openbare indiensnemingsingrypingaksie gemik op werklose jeugdiges tussen die ouderdomme van 18 en 35 jaar.
tgt: Report on the Phase IV of the Presidential Youth Employment Initiative in the basic education sector under the name of Basic Education Employment Initiative (BEEI) Cabinet received a briefing on the achievements of the BEEI, the large-scale public employment intervention targeting unemployed youth aged between 18 and 35 years.

src: Die ingryping spreek ook hoë vlakke van jeugwerkloosheid in Suid-Afrika aan.2 Sedert hul onstaan in Desember 2020 het die BEEI ongeveer miljoen werksgeleenthede vir jeugdiges tussen 18 en 35 geskep.
tgt: The intervention also seeks to address the high levels of youth unemployment in South Africa.

src: Die program het ook die land gehelp om die vernietigende ekonomiese uitdagings wat deur die COVID-19-pandemie veroorsaak is, te konfronteer as deel van die regering se breë ekonomiese herstelagenda.3 Die BEEI het 240 342 jeugdiges in skole geplaas as onderwysassistente en algemene skoolassistente.
tgt: The programme has also helped the country to confront the devastating economic challenges caused by the COVID-19 pandemic, as part of government’s broader economic recovery agenda.

src: Die assistente verdien ŉ maandelikse toelae van meer as R4 000.
tgt: The assistants received a monthly stipend of more than R4 000 per month.

src: Die Kabinet het ingestem tot ŉ voorstel deur die Departement van Basiese Onderwys om die basiese onderwysjeugindiensnemingsprogram te verleng tot die 2024/25 finansiële jaar.
tgt: Cabinet agreed to a proposal by the Department of Basic Education to continue the Basic Education Youth Employment Programme for the 2024/25 financial year.

tgt: All appointments are subject to verification of qualification and relevant security clearance.

src: KOMENDE GEBEURTENISSE 16 Dae van Aktivisme-veldtog Die 16 Dae van Aktivisme vir Geen Geweld teen Vroue en Kinders-veldtog sal op 25 November 2024 geloods word by die Royal Bafokeng-stadion in Noordwes met die tema: “30 Jaar van die Bevordering van Gesamentlike Aksie om Geweld teen Vroue en Kinders te Beëindig.” Pan-Afrika-parlement (PAP)2.1 Die vierde gewone sessie van die sesde parlementsitting van die PAP, die kontinentale wetgewer vir verteenwoordigers van alle Akrika-state, neem plaas van 4 tot 15 November 2024.
tgt: Mr Lucky Charles Mohalaba Upcoming events 16 Days of Activism Campaign The 16 Days of Activism for No Violence against Women and Children campaign will be launched on 25 November 2024 at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in North West under the theme: “30 Years of Advancing Collective Action to End Violence Against Women and Children”.

src: Tydens hierdie sessies sal volledige verslae van verskeie komitees ter tafel gelê word en aanbevelings vir geharmoniseerde beleide en wetgewing vir die kontinent sal gemaak word aan die spitsberaad vir Afrika-staats- en regeringshoofde.3 Die Regering se Kommunikasie- en Inligtingstelsel (GCIS) sal die implementering van kommunikasie- en klusterplanne monitor en monitorverslae sal maandeliks aan die Kabinet beskikbaar gemaak word as deel van die verslag oor huidige sake.
tgt: During these sessions, the plenary reports from various committees will be tabled and recommendations made for the Summit of African Heads of State and Government on harmonised policies and laws for the continent.

src: • Ghana se minister van buitelandse sake, Shirley Ayorkor Botchwey met haar onlangse aanstelling as die volgende sekretaris-generaal van die Statebond.
tgt: • Ghana’s Foreign Minister Shirley Ayorkor Botchwey on her recent appointment as the next Commonwealth Secretary-General.

src: Me Botchwey sal haar vierjaar-termyn as leier van die 56-nasie vereniging op 1 April 2025 begin.• Die groep van vyf Suid-Afrikaanse studente wat hul meestersgrade voltooi het aan die World Maritime universiteit in Swede.
tgt: Ms Botchwey will assume her four-year leadership of the 56-nation association on 1 April 2025.• the group of five South African students who graduated with their Masters in Maritime Affairs degrees from the World Maritime University in Sweden.

src: Sake in die omgewing Internasionale betrekkinge Suid-Afrika se presidentskap van die Groep van Twintig (G20) Suid-Afrika se presidentskap van die G20 met die tema ‘Solidariteit, Gelykheid en Volhoubaarheid’ het in alle erns begin met die suksesvolle afsluiting van die eerste G20-vergadering vir buitelandse ministers in Johannesburg van 20 tot 21 Februrie 2025, en die eerste G20-vergadering van ministers van finansies en goewerneurs van sentrale banke, in Kaapstad van 26 tot 27 Februarie.
tgt: Issues in the environment International Relations South Africa’s Presidency of the Group of Twenty (G20) South Africa’s Presidency of the G20 under the theme: “Solidarity, Equality and Sustainability”, has commenced in earnest with the successful conclusion of the First G20 Foreign Ministers’ meeting in Johannesburg from 20 to 21 February 2025, and the First G20 Finance Ministers and Central Banks Governors meeting currently underway in Cape Town from 26 to 27 February.

src: Die eerste vergadering van G20 ministers van buitelandse sake was ’n geleentheid vir die ministers van buitelandse sake om oor wêreldwye geopolitieke uitdagings te besin en maniere voor te stel hoe die G20 kan bydra om oplossings hiervoor te vind.
tgt: The First G20 Foreign Ministers’ meeting was an opportunity for the G20 Foreign Ministers to reflect on the global geopolitical challenges and discuss ways in which the G20 could contribute to finding solutions to these.

src: Die vergadering steun Suid-Afrika se benadering tot die bestuur van geopolitieke kwessies, sowel as die prioriteite vir sy G20-presidensie en hoëvlak-eindprodukte en het die rol van die G20 as die voorste forum vir internasionale ekonomiese samewerking herbevestig.
tgt: The meeting supported South Africa’s approach of managing geopolitical issues, its G20 Presidency priorities and high-level deliverables, and reaffirmed the role of the G20 as the premier forum for international economic cooperation.

src: Suid-Afrika het hierbenewens die volgende werkgroepe suksesvol aangebied: Eerste Onderwyswerkgroep (12-13 Februarie 2025, virtueel).
tgt: First Education Working (12-13 February 2025, virtually).

src: Die doel van die vergadering was om konsesus te bereik oor drie van die werkgroep se prioriteite, naamlik:
tgt: The purpose of the meeting was to share and seek consensus in the three priorities of the Working Group, namely:

src: Prioriteit 1: Gehalte grondslagfaseonderrig: die rol van vroeë kindersorg en onderwys om die gehalte van grondslagleer te verbeter

tgt: Information on South Africa’s hosting of various G20 meetings and their outcomes can be accessed on WEBTOKEN OR WEBTOKEN.

src: za Suid-Afrika-Europese Unie (EU) Politieke Dialoog Die Kabinet verwelkom die EU se steun vir Suid-Afrika se standpunte, die wêreldwye geopolitiek en ons G20-presidensie se prioriteite ná afloop van die suksesvolle 16de ministeriële politieke dialoog tussen Suid-Afrika en die EU, wat op 19 Februarie 2025 in Kaapstad gehou is.
tgt: za South Africa-European Union (EU) Political Dialogue Cabinet welcomed the support of the EU for South Africa’s positions the global geopolitics and our G20 Presidency priorities following the successful 16th Ministerial Political Dialogue between South Africa and the EU held on 19 February 2025 in Cape Town.

src: Die dialoog het ’n geleentheid vir die EU en Suid-Afrika gebied om hul gemeenskaplike verbintenis tot multilateralisme asook die sentraliteit van die reëlgebaseerde internasionale orde en die sentraliteitv van die Verenigde Nasies (VN) se Handves te bevestig.
tgt: The dialogue presented an opportunity for the EU and South Africa to reiterate their common commitment to multilateralism, Rules-based international order, and the centrality of the United Nations (UN) Charter.

src: Die partye het verder ooreengekom dat dit noodsaaklik is om die VN se Veiligheidsraad (UNSC) te hervorm en aanvaar die dringende behoefte dat dit meer verteenwoordigend, inklusief, deursigtig, doeltreffend, demokraties en verantwoordbaar gemaak moet word.
tgt: The parties further agreed on the need to reform the UN Security Council (UNSC), recognising the urgent need to make it more representative, inclusive, transparent, efficient, democratic and accountable.

src: Die EU en Suid-Afrika het ook hul samewerking ten opsigte van multilaterale en streeksforums bespreek, met die klem op hul gesamentlike pogings om mensergte en volhoubae ontwikkeling te bevorder en om klimaatsverandering te bespreek.
tgt: The EU and South Africa also discussed their cooperation in multilateral and regional fora, focusing, in particular, on their joint efforts to promote human rights and sustainable development and to address climate change.

src: Hulle het ook herbesin oor geleenthede om samewerking en volhoubare waardekettings te versterk, insluitend kritieke roumteriale met die doel om hul onderskeie mededingendheid, ekonomiese sekerheid en anti-koolstofpogings te bevorder.
tgt: They also reviewed opportunities to step up cooperation on sustainable value chains, including critical raw materials with a view to further their respective competitiveness, economic security and decarbonisation efforts.

src: Die vergadering het ook gedien as ’n voorbereidingsplatfrom vir die opkomende EU-Suid-Afrika Beraad, wat op 13 Maart 2025 in Suid-Afrika gehou word.
tgt: The meeting also served as a preparatory platform for the upcoming EU-South Africa Summit to be held on 13 March 2025 in South Africa.

src: Besprekingspunte sluit in die verbetering van ekonomiese verhoudinge, regverdige energie-oorskakeling, sekuriteit en verdediging, volhoubare waardekettings en multilaterale samewerking.
tgt: The summit will discuss improving economic relations, just energy transition, security and defence, sustainable value chains and multilateral cooperation.

src: Die EU is Suid-Afrika se belangrikste bron van regstreekse buitelandse belegging en Suid-Afrika is die EU se grootste handelsvennoot in sub-Sahara Afrika.
tgt: The EU is South Africa’s top source of foreign direct investment and South Africa is the EU’s largest trading partner in Sub-Saharan Africa.

src: Die vergadering het ook die noodsaaklikheid van die EU-Afrika Unie (AU) se Ministeriële Vergadering en Beraad in 2025 beklemtoon.
tgt: The meeting also underscored the importance of holding the EU-African Union (AU) Ministerial Meeting and Summit in 2025.

src: AU se Vredes- en veiligheidsraad (PSC) en UNSC-resolusies oor die situasie in die oostelike Demokratiese Republiek van die Kongo (DRK) Die Kabinet verwelkom en ondersteun beide die AU PSC en die UNSC se besluite oor die situasie in die oostelike DRDie AU onderskryf die besluite van die Gesamentlike Oos-Afrika Gemeenskap (GOAG) en die Suider-Afrika Ontwikkelingsgemeenskap (SAOG) se vergadering, wat 'n onmiddellike skietstilstand vereis, asook die fasilitering van veilige en ongehinderde humanitêre roetes, die onttrekking van alle ongenooide magte uit die oostelike DRK, respek vir die DRK se territoriale integriteit en die deelname van alle staats- en nie-staatsdeelnemers aan politieke dialoog onder die gesamentlike Luanda-Nairobi-proses.
tgt: AU Peace and Security Council (PSC) and UNSC Resolutions on the situation in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) Cabinet welcomed and supports both the AU PSC and the UNSC Resolutions on the situation in the eastern DRThe AU PSC endorsed the decisions of the Joint East African Community (EAC) and Southern African Development Community (SADC) meeting that demanded an immediate ceasefire, the facilitation of safe and unhindered humanitarian routes, the withdrawal of all uninvited forces from the eastern DRC, the respect of the DRC’s territorial integrity and the participation of all state and non-state actors in political dialogue under the Joint Luanda-Nairobi process.

src: The UNSC-resolusie het alle partye (staats- en nie-staatsdeelnemers) in die oostelike DRK aangemoedig om 'n onmiddellike en onvoorwaardelike skietstilstand te sluit soos versoek deur leiers van die EAC enSAODie resolusie vereis verder dat M23-rebellegroepe hulle uit die gebiede wat hulle in die oostelike DRK ingeneem het onttrek, en doen 'n beroep op Rwanda se weermag om hul steun aan die gewapende groep te staak en onmiddellik “sonder voorwaardes” uit Kongolese grondgebied te onttrek.
tgt: The UNSC resolution urged all parties (state and non-state actors) in the eastern DRC to conclude an immediate and unconditional ceasefire, as called for by leaders of the EAC and SADThe Resolution further demands that M23 rebel groups withdraw from the territories they have seized in the eastern DRC and called on the Rwanda Defence Force to stop supporting the armed group and immediately withdraw from Congolese territory “without preconditions”.

src: Die Kabinet wens alle (10) beseerde soldate wat nou medies behandeling op hul tuisbodem, Suid-Afrika, ontvang, spoedige beterskap toe.
tgt: Cabinet expressed its well-wishes for a speedy recovery for all (10) returned injured soldiers who are now receiving medical treatment in South Africa, the home soil.

src: AU-Konvensie oor die beëindiging van geweld teen vroue en meisies (AU-CEVAWG) Die Kabinet het die AU se aanvaarding van die AU-CEVAWG verwelkom dit is ’n wetlike instrument wat ten doel het om geweld teen vroue en meisies in Afrika te stuit en uit te wis.
tgt: AU Convention on Ending Violence Against Women and Girls (AU-CEVAWG) Cabinet welcomed the AU Adoption of the AU-CEVAWG, which is a legal instrument to prevent and eliminate violence against women and girls in Africa.

src: Die AU-CEVAWG het na aanleiding van die historiese besluit deur AU-staatshoofdedie in Februarie 2023 ontstaan tydens die AU-Beraad.
tgt: The development of the AU-CEVAWG is informed by the historic decision by the AU Heads of State in February 2023 during the AU Summit.

src: Die konvensie het ten doel om 'n omvattende en wetlik bindende raamwerk vir die voorkoming en uitwissing van alle vorme van geweld teen vroue en meisies regoor Afrika te voorsien.
tgt: The convention aims to provide a comprehensive and legally binding framework for the prevention and elimination of all types of violence against women and girls throughout Africa.

src: Dit sal bereik word deur die grondoorsake en aandrywers van sulke geweld die hoof te bied, wetlike en institusionele meganismes te versterk en 'n kultuur van respek vir menseregte, geslagsgelykheid en die waardigheid van vroue en meisies te bevorder.
tgt: This will be accomplished by addressing the root causes and drivers of such violence, strengthening legal and institutional mechanisms, and promoting a culture of respect for human rights, gender equality and the dignity of women and girls.

src: Dit sal ook verseker dat al die betrokke partye ’n gemeenskaplike benadering tot die uitwissing van geweld teen vroue en meisies verskerp.
tgt: It would also ensure that State Parties reinforce a common approach to eliminating violence against women and girls.

src: Ekonomie Uitstel van voorlegging van die Nasionale Begroting Die Kabinet beklemtoon dat die voorlegging van die Nasionale Begroting van 19 Februarie tot 12 Maart 2025 uitgestel is weens pogings deur die Kabinet om gesamentlik oor ons land se befondsingsuitdagings binne ’n beperkte fiskale omgewing te beraadslaag.
tgt: Economy Postponement of the tabling of the National Budget Cabinet wishes to reiterate that the postponement of the tabling of the National Budget from the 19th February 2025 to 12 March 2025 is a result of efforts by Cabinet to collectively address our nation’s funding challenges within a constrained fiscal environment.

src: Die Kabinet verseker Suid-Afrikaners dat beraadslaging binne die Kabinet oor die 2025 Nasionale Begroting voortgaan om die beste maniere te bepaal om ons nasionale prioriteite te finansier en te seker te maak dat die begroting die aspirasies van alle Suid-Afriknaers weerspieël.
tgt: Cabinet assures South Africans that deliberations within Cabinet on the 2025 National Budget are continuing to determine the best ways to fund our national priorities and ensure the budget reflects the aspirations of all South Africans.

src: Hoewel die uitstel die eerste in Suid-Afrika se geskiedenis is, is dit nie buite die norm in ander jurisdiksies nie en is dit steeds binne die bepalings van die Wet op Openbare Finansiële Bestuur, 1999 (Wet 1 van 1999).
tgt: The postponement while it is the first in the history of South Africa, but not out of the norm in other jurisdictions, it is still within the provisions of the Public Finance Management Act, 1999 (Act 1 of 1999).

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die opwaartse trajek in werkskepping ná die tweede agtereenvolgende daling in die werkloosheidsyfer.
tgt: Quarterly Labour Force Survey Cabinet welcomed the upward trajectory in employment creation following the second consecutive drop in the unemployment rate, which marks the lowest rate since the third quarter of The country’s unemployment rate decreased to 31.9% in the fourth quarter of 2024 from 32.1% in the previous quarter.

src: Dit is die laagste koers sedert die derde kwartaal van Die land se werkloosheidsyfer het in die vierdie kwartaal van 2024 tot 31.9% gedaal van 32.1% in die vorige kwartaal.
tgt: The number of employed people increased by 132 000 to million while the number of unemployed persons decreased by 20 000 to eight (8) million during the same quarter.

src: Die aantal werkende mense het met 132 000 tot miljoen toegeneem, terwyl die aantal werkloses met 20 000 tot agt (8) miljoen gedurende dieselfde kwartaal afgeneem het.
tgt: Employment over the quarter increased in four of the ten industries surveyed by Statistics South Africa, including finance (232 000), followed by manufacturing (41 000), private households (18 000) and transport (17 000).

src: Die Kabinet bevestig die regering se verbintenis om werk te skep met die klem op indiensnemingsprogramme vir die jeug.
tgt: Cabinet affirmed government’s commitment to create jobs with a special focus on youth employment programmes.

src: Deur die Presidensiële Stimulusprogram vir Indiensneming is byna miljoen werkgeleenthede reeds vir jongmense geskep.
tgt: Through the Presidential Employment Stimulus Programme, almost million work opportunities have been created for young people.

src: Handel en belegging tussen Suid-Afrika en China Die Kabinet verwelkom die suksesvolle samewerking tussen die voorsitter van die Chinese Raad vir die Bevordering van Internasionale Handel (CCPIT), Ren Hongbin, en Adjunkpresident Paul Mashatile oor die bvordering van beter handel- en beleggingsamewerking tussen Suid-Afrika en China.
tgt: South Africa-China Trade and Investment Cabinet welcomes the successful engagement between the China Council for the Promotion of International Trade (CCPIT) Chairman Ren Hongbin and Deputy President Paul Mashatile on fostering better trade and investment cooperation between South Africa and China.

src: Die besoek volg op President Cyril Ramaphosa se suksesvolle tweede staatsbesoek aan China in September 2024.
tgt: The visit follows the successful second State Visit to China by President Cyril Ramaphosa in September 2024.

src: Dit bou veral voort op die uitkomste van die president se sakeverbintenisse, insluitend die invloedryke Suid-Afrika-China Presidensiële Sakeforum, die geslote rondetafelbespreking tussen die president en die leieskap van 20 hoëvlak Chinese beleggers en die Presidensiële Sakeprogram in Shenzhen wat op sleutebeleggers in China se voorste tegnologie- en innovasiesentrum gefokus het.
tgt: In particular, it builds on the outcomes of the President’s business engagements, including the seminal South Africa-China Presidential Business Forum, the closed roundtable discussion between the President and the Leadership of 20 high-level Chinese investors, and the Presidential Business Programme in Shenzhen that focused on key investors in China’s leading technology and innovation hub.

src: Suid-Afrika het Chinese ondernemings gemobiliseer om vanjaar die verskillende sakevergaderings van die G20 wat hier gehou is, by te woon, terwyl CCPIT Suid-Afrika genooi het om die 3de China International Supply Chain Expo in Julie 2025 in Beijing by te woon.
tgt: South Africa mobilised Chinese businesses to attend the various business meetings of the G20 in the country this year while CCPIT invited South Africa to attend the 3rd China International Supply Chain Expo in Beijing in July Relations between South Africa and China were further enhanced with the arrival of the first group of tourists from China through the country’s new Trusted Tour Operator Scheme (TTOS).

src: Betrekkinge tussen Suid-Afrika en China is verder versterk met die aankoms van die eerste groep toeriste uit China deur die land se nuwe Trusted Tour Operator Scheme (TTOS).
tgt: The TTOS allows vetted tour operators to submit group applications for tour groups from China and India through a secure digital platform and receive their outcomes digitally within a matter of hours.

src: Gesondheid Hand-, bek- en klouseersiekte (HBKS) Die Kabinet verwelkom die owerhede se vinnige ingryping ná die onlangse uitbreek van HBKS in KwaZulu-Natal en die Oos-Kaap.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the quick intervention by authorities following the recent outbreak of HFMD in KwaZulu-Natal and the Eastern Cape, which causes flu-like symptoms such as painful blisters and swollen hands.

src: Die siekte veroorsaak griepagtige simptome soos ’n pynlike blaas en geswelde hande.
tgt: This is not the same as the animal-based foot and mouth disease and it is not fatal.

src: ’n Aantal gevalle van die uiters aansteeklike virusinfeksie is in verskeie laerskole en dagsorgsentrums in die twee provinsies opgespoor.
tgt: A number of cases of the extremely contagious viral infection were detected in several primary schools and daycare centres in the two provinces.

src: Skoolhoofde word aangemoedig om daaglikse assesserings in hul skole te onderneem om HBKS-gevalle op te spoor en aan te meld.
tgt: School principals are urged to conduct daily assessments in their schools to detect and report HFMD cases.

src: Voedseloordraagbare siektes Die sperdatum vir alle spaza-winkels en ander plekke waar voedsel in munisipaliteite hanteer en verkoop word, is Vrydag 28 Februarie 2025.
tgt: Food-Borne Illnesses The registration deadline for all spaza shops and other food-handling outlets with their local municipality is Friday, 28 February 2025.

src: Spaza-winkels wat nie geregistreer is nie en nie aan alle gesondheidstandaarde en -vereistes voldoen nie, sal gesluit word.
tgt: Spaza shops that are not registered and do not meet all health standards and requirements will be closed.

src: Die regering het hierdie maatreëls in November 2024 ingestel om spaza-winkels te reguleer in ’n poging om kindersterftes weens voedseloordraagbare siektes deur besmette voedsel wat by sulke winkels gekoop word, te voorkom.
tgt: Government introduced these measures in November 2024 as part of efforts to regulate spaza shops and prevent unnecessary deaths of children as a result of food-borne illnesses caused by contaminated food purchased from such shops.

src: Geïntegreerde multidisiplinêre inspeksiespanne onderneem inspeksies regoor die land om te verseker dat alle voedselkleinhandelaars wettig handel dryf en aan gesondheid- en veiligheistandaarde voldoen.
tgt: Integrated multidisciplinary inspection teams continue to conduct compliance inspections across the country to ensure that all food retailers operate legally and comply with health and safety standards.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op verbruikers, ouers en versorgers om slegs kos te koop by plekke wat gelisensieer is om voedsel te verkoop en die nodige veiligheidsmaatreëls toepas.
tgt: Cabinet calls on consumers, parents and caregivers to only buy food from places that are licensed to sell foodstuffs and observe food safety regulations.

src: Die publiek word ook aangemoedig om basiese maatreëls ten opsigte van voedselveiligheid na te kom, soos om hul hande deeglik met seep en water te was voordat hulle kos hanteer of eet.
tgt: Members of the public are also encouraged to practice basic food safety measures such as washing their hands thoroughly with soap and water before handling or consuming food.

src: Maatskaplike welsyn Suid-Afrikaanse Agentskap vir Maatskaplike Sekerheid (SASSA) Die sperdatum vir SASSA-begunstigdes om hul goue SASSA-kaarte vir die Posbank se swart kaarte te ruil, is tot 20 Maart 2025 verleng.
tgt: Social welfare South African Social Security Agency (SASSA) The deadline for SASSA beneficiaries to swap their SASSA Gold Card for the Postbank Black Card has been extended to 20 March 2025.

src: Mer as 716 900 begunstigdes het reeds na die Posbank se swart kaarte oorgeskakel.
tgt: More than 716 900 beneficiaries have transitioned to the Postbank black cards and card distribution sites have been increased around the country to mitigate the queues so that every beneficiary receives the new card near where they live.

src: Om lang toue te verhoed, is daar nou meer plekke waar die kaarte beskikbaar is sodat begunstigdes die nuwe kaart naby hul woonplekke kan kry.
tgt: Postbank has also increased the number of tellers in the card replacement sites from 2 tellers to up to 5 tellers depending on the business of the site.

src: Daar is ook nou meer tellers by sekere verspreidingsplekke, naamlik van net twee to soveel as vyf afhangend van hoe besig dit is.
tgt: Beneficiaries are encouraged to visit their nearest Checkers, Shoprite, Pick n Pay, Usave, or Boxer store to collect their new Postbank Black Card.

src: ’n Geldige Suid-Afrikaanse indentiteitsdokument (ID) of tydelike ID moet gewys word.
tgt: A valid South African identity document (ID) or temporary ID is required.

src: Om begunstigdes in afgeleë gebiede by te staan sal mobiele kantore ook in landelike gebiede beskiksbaar wees.
tgt: Mobile offices will also be available in rural areas to assist beneficiaries.

src: Posbank het hierbenewens vennootskappe aangegaan met die Spar-groep, wat 200 van hul winkels landwyd beskikbaar stel.
tgt: Additionally, Postbank has partnered with the Spar Group, which will designate 200 of its stores as service sites across the country.

src: Die Kabinet herinner begunstigdes daaraan dat die ou goue SASSA-kaart ná 20 Maart nie meer sal werk nie en dat begunstigdes wat nie hul nuwe kaarte teen daardie datum gekry het nie, na hul naaste tak van die Poskantoor sal moet gaan om toegang tot hul geld te kry.
tgt: Cabinet reminds beneficiaries that the old SASSA Gold Card will stop working on 20 March 2025 and beneficiaries who have not exchanged their cards by then will need to visit their nearest Post Office branch to access their funds.

src: Die stryd teen misdaad Die Kabinet verwelkom die verslag oor misdaadstatistiek, wat aandui dat misdaad oor verskeie misdaadkategorieë gedaal het.
tgt: Fight Against Crime Cabinet welcomed the Crime Stats report which showed a decline across multiple crime categories in the country’s latest crime statistics.

src: In die derde kwartaal van die 2024/2025 finansiële jaar, was daar ’n 9.8% daling in moorde, ’n 3.3% daling in verkragting en ’n 3.2% daling in pogings tot seksuele misdade.
tgt: The third quarter of the 2024/25 financial year, showed a 9.8% decrease in murder, a 3.3% reduction in rape, and a 3.2% drop in attempted sexual offences.

src: Daar is ook ’n merkbare daling in motorkapings en rooftogte.
tgt: There was also a notable decline in carjackings and robberies.

src: Hoewel die oorhoofse vlakke van misdaad steeds onaanvaarbaar hoog is, bewys die daling dat tussenkomste deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens om Suid-Afrika ’n veiliger plek te maak, reeds ’n verskil maak.
tgt: While overall levels of crime continue to remain unacceptably high, the decline shows that interventions by the South African Police Service to make South Africa safer are making a difference.

src: Die stryd teen misdaad is ’n gedeelde verantwoordelikheid tussen die polisie, die gemeenskap en die sakesektor.
tgt: Fighting crime is a shared responsibility between the police, the community and the business sector.

src: Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op Suid-Afrikaners om hul deel by te dra om misdaad te beveg deur enige kriminele aktiwiteite by hul naaste polisiestasie aan te meld of die Crime Stop-nommer: 0860.0 1011.1 te skakel.
tgt: Cabinet calls on South Africans to play their part in the fight against crime by reporting any criminal activity to their nearest police station or calling the Crime Stop number: 0860.0 6.

src: SAOG-mediatoekennings Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op Suid-Afrikaanse joernaliste om hul inskrywings vir die SAOG se 2025-mediatoekennings in te handig.
tgt: SADC Media Awards Cabinet calls on South African journalists to submit their entries for the 2025 SADC Media Awards.

src: Inskrywings vir die kompetisie sluit op Vrydag 28 Februarie 2025.
tgt: Entries for the competition close on Friday, 28 February 2025.

src: Joernaliste wat wil inskryf kan meer inligting kry by WEBTOKEDie wenner van die eerste prys in elke kategorie ontvang US$2500 en die wenner van die tweede prys ontvang US$1000.
tgt: Journalists who wish to enter can access more information about the competition from WEBTOKEThe first prize winner in each category receives US$2500 and the runner-up receives US$1000.

src: Eerstepryswenners sal hul pryse en sertifikate op die kantlyn van die SAOG-beraad van Staatshoofde, wat in Augustus 2025 plaasvind, ontvang.
tgt: First prize winners will receive their prizes and certificates on the margins of the SADC Summit of Heads of State and Government that will take place in August 2025.

src: Opdaterings aan die Kabinet Beurtkragherstelmaatreëls Die Kabinet verwelkom die opdatering oor Eskom se herstelpogings om die land se kragtoevoer te stabiliseer ná 'n reeks onvoorsiene voorvalle by verskeie kragstasies, wat gelei het tot die implementering van beurtkrag om die nasionale netwerk te beskerm.
tgt: Updates to Cabinet Electricity Load-shedding Recovery Measures Cabinet received and welcomed an update on the recovery efforts by Eskom to stabilise the nation’s power supply following a series of unforeseen incidents at multiple power stations that led to the implementation of load-shedding to protect the national grid.

src: Hierdie hoogs ongewone en onverwante voorvalle op 22 Februarie 2025 het daartoe gelei dat reserwemarges vinnig uitgeput is.
tgt: These highly unusual and unrelated incidents on 22 February 2025 resulted in a rapid depletion of reserve margins.

src: Dit sluit 'n elektriese fout in by Majuba-kragstasie, die verlies van verkoelingswaterpompe by Camden-kragstasie en eenheidsverliese by Meupi-kragstasie.
tgt: They included an electrical fault at Majuba Power Station, the loss of cooling water pumps at Camden Power Station and unit loss at Medupi Power Station.

src: Die Kabinet loof die vinnige reaksie van Eskom se tegniese span wat 4 800 megawatt (MW) herwin het.
tgt: Cabinet acknowledged the swift response by Eskom’s technical team to recover 4 800 megawatts (MW) with four of the five tripped units at Majuba returned and two of four tripped units returned at Camden by 8pm on 23 February 2025.

src: Me die implementering van sy herstelplan verwag die kragvoorsiener 'n afname in beurtkrag.
tgt: In implementing its recovery plan, the power utility anticipates a step down in the stages of load-shedding.

src: Pogings is daarop gefokus om noodreserwes, veral dieselvoorrade, aan te vul om bedrywighede in die komende dae te stabiliseer.
tgt: Efforts are focused on replenishing emergency reserves, particularly diesel stocks, to stabilise operations for the coming days.

src: Ondanks die huidige terugslag is bestendige vordering gemaak met die verbetering van opwekkingskapasiteit en die handhawing van betroubare elektrisiteitsvoorsiening.
tgt: Despite the current setback, steady progress has been made in improving generation capacity and maintaining a reliable electricity supply.

src: Van 1 April 2024 tot 20 Februarie 2025 is beurtkrag vir 323 dae opgeskort, vergeleke met 32 dae in dieselfde tydperk verlede jaar.
tgt: From 1 April 2024 to 20 February 2025, load-shedding was suspended for 323 days, compared to 32 days in the same period last year.

src: Elektrisiteitsvoorsiening was 99% van die tyd beskikbaar, vergeleke met net 9.8% verlede jaar.
tgt: Electricity supply was available 99% of the time compared to just 9.8% last year.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis dat die komende toevoeging van 1 600 MW met die sinchronisasie van Kusile-eenheid 6 wat vir 9 Maart 2025 geskeduleer is, en Meupi-eenheid 4 aan die einde van Maart 2025, ons land se energievoorsiening verder sal versterk.
tgt: Cabinet noted that the upcoming addition of 1 600 MW with the synchronisation of Kusile Unit 6 scheduled for 9 March 2025 and Medupi Unit 4 at the end of March 2025 will further bolster our nation’s energy supply.

src: Kabinetsbesluite Meiumtermyn Ontwikkelingsplan (MTOP) 2024-2029 Die Kabinet het die MTOP vir die tydperk 2024-2029, wat sleutelprioriteite vir die Sewende Administrasie uiteensit, goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet decisions Medium Term Development Plan (MTDP) 2024-2029 Cabinet approved the MTDP for the period 2024-2029, which outlines key priorities for the Seventh Administration.

src: Die MTOP bou voort op die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan, die Verklaring van Voorneme vir die Regering van Nasionale Eenheid (GNU), en die konsensus wat bereik is tydens die Kabinet-lekgotla wat van 29 tot 30 Januarie 2025 gehou is.
tgt: The MTDP builds on the National Development Plan, the Statement of Intent of the Government of National Unity (GNU), and the consensus reached during the Cabinet Lekgotla held from 29 to 30 January 2025.

src: Hierbenewens inkorporeer die MTOP die drie strategiese prioriteite wat President Ramaphosa in sy openingsrede op 18 Julie 2024 uiteengesit het.
tgt: Additionally, the MTDP incorporates the three strategic priorities outlined by President Ramaphosa in his Opening of Parliament Adress on 18 July 2024.

src: Die plan rig die regering se inisiatiewe om 'n meer inklusiewe land te skep waar die verpligtinge van die GNU nagekom word.
tgt: The plan guides government’s initiatives to create a more inclusive country that lives up to the commitments of the GNIt aims, among others, to ensure inclusive economic growth, reduce unemployment, poverty, and the rising cost of living as well as to ensure a capable, developmental and ethical state.

src: Nasionale Kommunikasie Strategieraamwerk (NCSF) 2024-2029.
tgt: National Communication Strategy Framework (NCSF) 2024-2029 Cabinet approved the NCSF for implementation across all spheres of government.

src: Die Kabinet keur goed dat die NCSF oor alle regeringsfere geïmplementeer word.
tgt: The NCSF forms part of the ongoing work to consolidate and enhance government-wide communication system, in support of the implementation of the MTDP 2024-2029 as envisaged in the Government Communication Policy, approved by Cabinet in 2018. which is currently under review.

src: Die NCSF vorm deel van die voortgesette werk om regeringswye kommunikasiestelsels te konsolideer en te verbeter.
tgt: The NCSF responds to the expectation that government communication must be coherent, improves public trust and investor confidence, foster unity and social cohesion and mobilise citizens’ participation as ongoing efforts to encourage South Africans to use information to improve their lives and take advantage of socio-economic opportunities to contribute to the development of our country.

src: Dit ondersteun die implementering van die MTOP 2024-2029 soos beoog in die regering se kommunikasiebeleid, wat in 2018 deur die Kabinet goedgekeur is en tans hersien word.
tgt: Ratification of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) Protocol on Women and Youth in Trade Cabinet approved the submission of the AfCFTA Protocol on Women and Youth in Trade to Parliament for ratification.

src: Die NCSF reageer op die verwagting dat regeringskommunikasie samehangend moet wees, openbare vertroue en beleggersvertroue moet verbeter, eenheid en sosiale samehorigheid moet bevorder en burgers se deelname moet mobiliseer dit is ’n voortdurende poging om Suid-Afrikaners aan te moedig om inligting te gebruik om hul lewens te verbeter en sosio-ekonomiese geleenthede te benut om by te dra tot die ontwikkeling van ons land.
tgt: The protocol aims to enhance the participation of women and youth in trade under the AfCFTA, and it outlines specific objectives such as helping women and youth traders to effectively participate in the market.

src: Die protokol het ten doel om vroue en jongmense se deelname aan handel onder die AfCFTA te verbeter dit skets spesifieke doelwitte soos om vroue en jongmense wat handel dryf te help om effektief aan die mark deel te neem.
tgt: It also strives to foster value addition and innovation for increased imports and exports by women and youth, as well as their inclusion in regional and continental value chains.

src: Dit is ook daarop gemik om waardetoevoeging en innovasie te bevorder vir verhoogde invoer en uitvoer deur vroue en jomgmense, en om hulle by streeks- en kontinentale waardekettings in te sluit.
tgt: The protocol also advocates for measures to eliminate discrimination, promote equality and inclusivity to ensure that women and youth benefit from trade opportunities.

src: Die protokol bepleit ook maatreëls om diskriminasie uit te skakel, gelykheid en inklusiwiteit te bevorder om te verseker dat vroue en jeug voordeel trek uit handelsgeleenthede.
tgt: Other significant provisions of the protocol include eliminating non-tariff barriers affecting women and youth in trade, promoting their participation in policy formulation, and improving their access to finance.

src: Ander belangrike bepalings van die protokol sluit in die uitskakeling van nie-tariefhindernisse wat vroue en jeug in die handel raak, die bevordering van hul deelname aan beleidsformulering en die verbetering van hul toegang tot finansiering.
tgt: The protocol is expected to support women and youth in trade to take advantage of the opportunities presented by the AfCFTA and enhance their inclusive participation in intra-Africa trade.

src: Die protokol sal na verwagting vroue en jongmense in die handel help om voordeel te trek uit die geleenthede wat die AfCFTA bied en om hul inklusiewe deelname aan intra-Afrika-handel te verbeter.
tgt: Ratification of the Protocol on Competition Policy under the AfCFTA Cabinet approved the submission of the Protocol on Competition Policy under the AfCFTA to Parliament for ratification.

src: Die protokol is ’n ooreenkoms deur AU-lidlande om te verseker dat mededinging op die vasteland bydra tot handel, inklusiewe groei, industrialisasie en volhoubare ekonomiese ontwikkeling.
tgt: The protocol is an agreement by AU member states to ensure that competition on the continent contributes to trade, inclusive growth, industrialisation and sustainable economic development.

src: Die protokol fokus op die voorkoming van anti-mededingende praktyke deur ’n raamwerk vir die hantering van markkonsentrasie, magsmisbruik en ander mededingingsverwante kwessies.
tgt: The protocol focuses on preventing anti-competitive practices by providing a framework for addressing market concentration, abuse of power and other competition-related issues.

src: Die AU erken dat die afwesigheid van kontinentale mededingingsbeleid tot anti-mededingende praktyke lei soos kartelle en monpolieë wat hul markposisies misbruik.
tgt: The AU acknowledges that the absence of continental competition policies results in anti-competitive practices such as cartels and monopolies that abuse their market position.

src: Die protokol sal van toepassing wees op alle ekonomiese aktiwiteite binne die AfCFTA-mark en sal anti-mededingende praktyke teiken, insluitend internasionale en oorgrens-kartelle wat nie doeltreffend gereguleer word nie, sowel as mededingende praktyke wat deur groter ondernemings buite die vasteland geïnisieer word.
tgt: The protocol will apply to all economic activity within the AfCFTA market and will target anti-competitive practices including international and cross-border cartels that are not effectively regulated, as well as competitive practices initiated by larger enterprises operating outside the continent.

src: Uitkomste van Suid-Afrika se deelname aan die Algemene Debat van die 79ste Sitting van die VN se Algemene Vergadering (UNGA 79) Die Kabinet het die uitkomste van die UNGA 79 onder die tema "Laat niemand agter nie: tree saam op vir die bevordering van vrede, volhoubare ontwikkeling en menswaardigheid vir huidige en toekomstige geslagte" oorweeg en goedgekeur.
tgt: Outcomes from South Africa’s participation at the General Debate of the 79th Session of the UN General Assembly (UNGA 79) Cabinet considered and approved the report on the outcomes of the UNGA 79 under the theme: “Leaving no one behind: acting together for the advancement of peace, sustainable development and human dignity for present and future generations”.

tgt: Appointments

src: Alle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die betrokke sekerheidsklarings.
tgt: All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant security clearances.

tgt: ProfJohn Lamola has been appointed Chief Executive Officer of the South African Airways for two years.

tgt: Mr Tebogo Seokolo as the Deputy DG (DDG): Africa at the Department of International Relations and Cooperation.

tgt: Ms Sedzani Mudau (Chairperson)(ii) Mr Willie Vukela (Department of Public Service and Administration representative)(iii) Mr Willie Mathebula (National Treasury representative)(iv) Adv Johannes Collen Weapond and
