tgt: Mr Omega Shelembe (Department of Communications and Digital Technologies).

src: Toekomstige gebeure Meseregtemaand Suid-Afrika herdenk in Maart Meseregtemaand onder die tema: "Versnelde pogings tot maatskaplike geregtigheid geanker in menseregte".
tgt: Upcoming events Human Rights Month South Africa will in March commemorate Human Rights Month under the theme: “Accelerating efforts towards social justice anchored on human rights”.

src: Die geskiedenis van Meseregtemaand is gegrond op die Sharpeville-slagting van 21 Maart 1960, toe die apartheidspolisie 69 mense tydens 'n vreedsame betoging doodgeskiet het.
tgt: The history of Human Rights Month is grounded in the Sharpeville Massacre on 21 March 1960, where the apartheid police shot and killed 69 people during a peaceful protest.

src: Die pynlike nalatenskap van apartheid se verwronge beleid beïnvloed steeds ons huidige werklikheid en het daartoe gelei dat baie mense in 'n siklus van armoede en werkloosheid vasgevang is.
tgt: The painful legacy from apartheid’s skewed policies continue to shape our present reality and has led to many people being trapped in a cycle of poverty and unemployment.

src: Die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996, wat die grondslag lê vir 'n vrye en demokratiese samelewing, steun pogings om maatskaplike geregtigheid te bevorder deur die regstelling van vorige ongeregtighede.
tgt: The Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996, which lays the foundation for a free and democratic society, supports efforts to advance social justice through the redress of past injustices.

src: Die onlangs goedgekeurde Onteieningswet, 2024 (Wet 13 van 2024) stel 'n grondwetlike regsproses uiteen wat die regering in staat stel om die bitter nalatenskap van grondonteiening en armoede reg te stel deur te help om die speelveld gelyk te maak sodat meer burgers toegang tot ekonomiese geleenthede, basiese dienste en grond kry.
tgt: The recently assented Expropriation Act, 2024 (Act 13 of 2024) sets forth a constitutionally mandated legal process that allows government to rectify the bitter legacy of land dispossession and poverty by helping level the playing field so that more citizens can have access to economic opportunities, basic services and land.

src: Nasionale Meseregtedag sal op 21 Maart 2025 by Constitution Hill in Johannesburg gevier word die distrik waar die setel van die Konstitusionele Hof van Suid-Afrika gevestig is.
tgt: Our national Human Rights Day celebration on 21 March 2025 will take place in Kariega in Nelson Mandela Bay, Eastern Cape.

src: Afrika Energie-indaba 2025 Suid-Afrika bied van 4 tot 6 Maart 2025 die Afrika Energie-indaba 2025 by die Kaapstadse Internasionale Konferensiesentrum aan.
tgt: Africa Energy Indaba 2025 South Africa will host the Africa Energy Indaba 2025 from 4 to 6 March 2025 at the Cape Town International Convention Centre.

src: Die indaba is 'n vlagskipgeleentheid op die vasteland, aangesien dit bedryfsleiers verbind en innoverende oplossings vir die sektor ten toon stel.
tgt: The Indaba is a flagship event on the continent as it connects industry leaders and showcases new cutting-edge solutions for the sector.

src: Die konferensie val saam met 'n tyd waarin Suid-Afrika se energiesektor met rasse skrede groei en daadwerklike pogings aangewend word om die land se toekomstige energievoorsiening te verseker.
tgt: The conference comes at a time when South Africa’s energy sector is growing in leaps and bounds as the country works to secure its future energy supply.

src: Verlede jaar het die regering die Wysigingswet op Elektrisiteitsregulering, 2024 (Wet 38 van 2024) aangekondig om 'n mededingende en volhoubare energiesektor te skep, wat aan die land se toenemende energiebehoeftes kan voldoen.
tgt: Last year government promulgated the Electricity Regulation Amendment Act, 2024 (Act 38 of 2024) towards creating a competitive and sustainable energy sector that can meet our nation’s growing energy demands.

src: Om ons energievoorsiening vir die toekoms te verseker, is 11 gigawatt se energieprojekte oor die volgende drie jaar vir konstruksie geskeduleer.
tgt: In securing our future energy supply, 11 gigawatts of energy projects are scheduled for construction over the next three years.

src: In Desember 2024 is agt voorkeurbieërs vir Bodvenster 7 van die Verkrygingsprogram vir Hernubare Energie Onafhanklike Kragprodusente met 'n gesamentlike gekontrakteerde kapasiteit van 1 760 megawatt aangekondig.
tgt: In December 2024, eight preferred bidders for Bid Window 7 of the Renewable Energy Independent Power Producer Procurement Programme with a combined contracted capacity of 1 760 megawatts were announced.

src: Boodskappe Gelukwense
tgt: Messages Congratulations

src: Die Kabinet wens die volgende mense geluk en dra sy beste wense oor: Minister Nomakhosazana met met haar verkiesing tot Voorsitter van die Afrika Streek se Arbeid Administrasiesentrum
tgt: Cabinet extended its congratulations and well wishes to: Minister Nomakhosazana Meth on her election as Chairperson of the African Regional Labour Administration Centre.

src: MeLerato Mataboge met haar geskiedkundige verkiesing tot Kommissaris vir Infrastruktuur en Energie van die AMeTyla Laura Seethal, algemeen bekend as Tyla.
tgt: Ms Lerato Mataboge on her historic election to the position of Commissioner for Infrastructure and Energy of the AMs Tyla Laura Seethal, popularly known as Tyla, the South African singer who is the first African solo artist whose single “Water” has surpassed one billion streams on Spotify.

src: Kabinetsbesluite Begroting 2025-2026 ’n Spesiale vergadering van die Kabinet is op Maandag 3 Maart 2025 belê om insette deur lede van die Kabinet te oorweeg oor die beste moontlike opsies, onder die omstandighede, om die Begroting vir die 2025/26 finansiële jaar en die medium termyn te befonds.
tgt: Cabinet decisions Budget 2025-2026 A Special Meeting of the Cabinet was convened on Monday, 03 March 2025 to consider inputs by members of the Cabinet into best possible options, under the circumstances, to fund the Budget of 2025/26 financial year and the medium term.

src: Dit volg op ’n vorige spesiale kabinetsvergadering op Maandag 24 Februarie 2025, wat breë besprekings moontlik gemaak het oor die land se fiskale beperkings en die behoefte aan vinnige implementering van die drie sleutelprioriteite van die 7de Administrasie onder die Regering van Nasionale Eenheid.
tgt: This follows another special Cabinet meeting on Monday, 24 February 2025, that allowed broad discussions on the country’s fiscal constraints and the need for rapid implementation of the three key priorities of the 7th administration under the Government of National Unity.

src: By die vergadering van 24 Februarie 2025 het President Cyril Ramaphosa 'n span ministers, onder leiding van Adjunkpresident Paul Mashatile, saamgestel om saam met die Minister van Finansies en sy Nasionale Tesourie-span te werk om kabinetsinsette vir verdere oorweging te konsolideer.
tgt: At the meeting of 24 February 2025, President Cyril Ramaphosa set-up a team of Ministers led by the Deputy President Paul Mashatile to work with the Minister of Finance and his National Treasury team to consolidate cabinet inputs for further consideration.

src: Die span onder leiding van Adjunkpresident Mashatile, ondersteun deur die Nasionale Tesourie, het verskeie opsies ter tafel gelê wat deur die Kabinet oorweeg is.
tgt: The team led by Deputy President Mashatile and supported by National Treasury tabled a variety of options that were considered by Cabinet.

src: In ooreenstemming met die bepalings van artikel 27 van die Wet op Openbare Finansiële Bestuur (1 van 1999), het die Kabinet die Minister van Finansies opdrag gegee om uit die opsies wat bespreek is te kies en die begroting te finansier op 'n wyse wat die volgende in ag neem:
tgt: In compliance with the provisions of section 27 of the Public Finance Management Act (1 of 1999), Cabinet mandated the Minister of Finance to select from the discussed options and fund the Budget in a manner that takes into consideration:

src: Kwessies in die omgewing Ekonomie.
tgt: Issues in the environment Economy.

src: Nasionale Begroting 2025 Die Kabinet verwelkom die 2025 Nasionale Begroting, wat poog om ŉ balans te handhaaf tussen Suid-Afrika se fiskale raamwerk en die befondsing van die prioriteite van die sewende administrasie soos verwoord deur Sy Eksellensie, President Cyril Ramaphosa, tydens die staatsrede, terwyl die impak van befondsingsvereistes op behoeftige en middelinkomstehuishoudings versag word.
tgt: National Budget 2025 Cabinet welcomed the 2025 National Budget which seeks to maintain a balance between South Africa’s fiscal framework, funding the priorities of the Seventh Administration, as articulated by His Excellency, President Cyril Ramaphosa during the State of the Nation Address while mitigating the funding requirements impact on the poor and the middle-income household.

src: Die toekenning van meer as R1 triljoen aan infrastruktuurontwikkeling oor die mediumtermyn-bestedingsraamwerk (MTBR), die vestiging van alternatiewe infrastruktuurfinansiering deur ŉ kredietwaarborgwerktuig en die bekendstelling van veelvuldige bodvensters op die begrotingsfasiliteit vir infrastruktuur dien as demonstrasie van die verbintenis om die ekonomie te laat groei by wyse van ŉ sterk infrastruktuurgeboude program en terselfdertyd dienslewering te verbeter.
tgt: The allocation of over R1 trillion to infrastructure development over the MTEF, the establishment of alternative infrastructure financing through a credit guarantee vehicle and the introduction of multiple bid windows on the Budget Facility for infrastructure is a demonstration of the commitment to grow the economy through a strong infrastructure-built programme whilst simultaneously improving service delivery.

src: Meanismes vir deelname aan die private sektor, soos aangekondig met die begroting – wat deel uitmaak van Operasie Vulindlela-gedrewe hervormings in die energie-, vervoer- en vraglogistieke sektore – dui op die regering se verbintenis tot die bespoediging van belegging in die private sektor en inklusiewe ekonomiese groei.
tgt: Mechanisms for private sector participation, as announced with the Budget – which are part of Operation Vulindlela driven reforms in the energy, transport and freight logistics sectors – indicate government’s commitment to fast-tracking private sector investment and inclusive economic growth.

src: Me inagneming van die impak van die belastingverhogings maak die begroting voorsiening vir versagtingsmaatreëls teen die verhogings, insluitend:.
tgt: Acknowledging the impact of the tax increases, the Budget provides for mitigation measures against the increases such as:.

src: Geen verhoging in die brandstofheffing nie.. Bo-inflasie stygings in maatskaplike toelaes, met ouderdoms- en ongeskiktheidstoelaes wat in 2025 met R130 tot R2 315 styg.. Beduidende befondsing aan die Passasierspooragentskap van Suid-Afrika om passasierspoorvervoer te verbeter, wat huishoudelike inkomstebesteding aan vervoerkoste sal verminder.
tgt: Above inflation increases to social grants, with old age and disability grants increasing by R130 to R2 315 in Significant funding allocation to the Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa to improve passenger rail transport, which will reduce household income spend on transport costs.

src: Die belangrikste hiervan is dat die belastingverhogings volhoubaarheid van die land gaan finansier deur 11 000 onderwysers in hul klaskamers en 9 300 gesondheidswerkers in hul poste te hou, die indiensneming van 800 post-gemeenskapsdiensdokters en om ŉ bykomende 700 000 kinders (vier jaar oud) toegang tot vroeë kinderontwikkeling (VKO) te gee.
tgt: Most significantly, the tax increases are going to finance sustainability of this country, by maintaining 11 000 teachers in the classrooms, 9 300 health worker in their jobs, the employment of 800 post-community service doctors and allow an additional 700 000 children (four-years of age) access to early childhood development (ECD), which is the necessary foundational education they need for a successful education journey.

src: Ekonomiese groei.
tgt: Economic Growth.

src: Die styging van 0,6% in die vierde kwartaal (BBP) vir 2024 dui op ŉ herstel regoor die ekonomie, synde die landbou-, finansies-, handels- en huishoudelike sektore in die laaste kwartaal van die jaar gegroei het.
tgt: The 0.6% increase in the fourth quarter (GDP) for 2024 signals a recovery across the economy, as the agriculture, finance, trade and household sectors grew in the last quarter of the year.

src: Die landboubedryf het met 17,2% herstel, wat BBP-groei met ŉ persentasiepunt van 0,4 verhoog het.
tgt: The agricultural industry rebounded by 17,2%, lifting GDP growth by 0,4 of a percentage point.

src: Die finansies-, eiendoms- en besigheidsdienstebedryf het vir ŉ agtste agtereenvolgende kwartaal gegroei, met finansiële tussengangers, eiendomsaktiwiteite en ander sakedienste wat die grootste positiewe bydraers tot groei was.
tgt: The finance, real estate and businesses services industry grew for an eighth consecutive quarter, with financial intermediary, real estate activities and other business services being the largest positive contributors to growth.

src: Die Kabinet is vol vertroue dat die groter fokus en tempo van lewering op ekonomiese strukturele hervormings, verbeterde dienslewering en staatskapasiteit, en verhoogde deelname van die private sektor verdere groei van die ekonomie in 2025 en daarna sal aanspoor.
tgt: Cabinet is confident that the increased focus and pace of delivery on economic structural reforms, improved service delivery and state capacity, and increased participation of the private sector, will spur further growth of the economy in 2025 and beyond.

src: Belegging Die Kabinet verwelkom Microsoft South Africa se aankondiging om R5,4 miljard in kunsmatige intelligensie-infrastruktuur in die land te belê.
tgt: Investment Cabinet welcomed the announcement by Microsoft South Africa to invest R.4 billion in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure in the country.

src: Hierdie belegging sal Suid-Afrika se posisie as ŉ toonaangewende KI-spilpunt op die vasteland van Afrika versterk en bou voort op Microsoft South Africa se belegging van R20,4 miljard oor die afgelope drie jaar.
tgt: This investment will strengthen South Africa’s position as a leading AI hub on the African continent and builds on Microsoft South Africa’s R.4 billion investment over the past three years.

src: Microsoft South Africa het ook hul bydrae tot die ontwikkeling van Suid-Afrika se digitale geletterdheid aangekondig deur te betaal vir die tegniese sertifisering van 50 000 individue in digitale vaardighede met ŉ hoë aanvraag.
tgt: Microsoft South Africa also announced their contribution to developing South Africa’s digital literacy by paying for technical certification for 50 000 individuals in high-demand digital skills.

src: Om ons beleggingsprofiel verder op te hef, het die Indiese motorvervaardiger Mahindra ŉ memorandum van verstandhouding met Suid-Afrika se Nywerheidsontwikkelingskorporasie (NOK) onderteken om die moontlikheid te ondersoek om ŉ volskaalse voertuigmonteeraanleg in die land op te rig.
tgt: In further uplifting our investment profile, Indian car manufacturer Mahindra signed a memorandum of understanding with South Africa’s Industrial Development Corporation (IDC) to explore the possibility of setting up a full-scale vehicle assembly plant in the country.

src: Mahindra het reeds ŉ monteeraanleg van Pik Up-reeks voertuie in Durban wat deur AIH Logistics bedryf word, waar ons onlangs die produksie van hul 25 000e plaaslik-saamgestelde Pik Up-voertuie gevier het.
tgt: Mahindra already has an assembly plant of Pik Up range of vehicles in Durban operated by AIH Logistics, where we recently celebrated the production of their 25 000th locally assembled Pik Up vehicles.

src: Die Kabinet herinner elke Suid-Afrikaner as direkte aandeelhouer in South Africa Incorporated (SA Inc.) aan hul gevestigde belang om ons land as ŉ beleggingsbestemming in ŉ wêreldwye mededingende omgewing te bevorder.
tgt: Cabinet reminded every South African as direct shareholder in South Africa Incorporated (SA Inc.) of their vested interest in promoting our country as an investment destination in a globally competitive environment.

src: Ons moet voortgaan om met een stem te praat ter verdediging van ons nasionale belang, ons soewereiniteit en ons grondwetlike demokrasie.
tgt: We must continue to speak with one voice in defence of our national interest, our sovereignty and our constitutional democracy.

src: Internasionale betrekkinge Suid-Afrika se presidentskap van die Groep van Twintig (G20)2.
tgt: International Relations South Africa’s Presidency of the Group of Twenty (G20)2.

src: As deel van sy G20-presidentskap, het Suid-Afrika einde Februarie en tydens Maart die volgende G20-werkgroepe en taakspanvergaderings suksesvol aangebied: Die G20-navorsings- en innovasiewerkgroep (RIWG)-vergadering, wat van 23 tot 25 Februarie 2025 by die Universiteit van die Vrystaat in Mangaung gehou is, het bespreek hoe hulle navorsing en innovasie beter kan gebruik om globale uitdagings aan te spreek en wetenskap en tegnologie te bevorder.
tgt: As part of its G20 Presidency, South Africa successfully hosted the following G20 working groups and task force meetings end of February and during this month: The G20 Research and Innovation Working Group (RIWG) meeting, which was held at the University of the Free State in Mangaung from 23 to 25 February 2025, discussed how they can better use research and innovation to address global challenges, and promote science and technology.

src: Prioriteit 2: Biodiversiteit vir volhoubare ontwikkeling en Prioriteit 3: Diversiteit, billikheid, insluiting en toeganklikheid in wetenskap, tegnologie en innovasie..

tgt: This meeting was an opportunity for participants to establish the agenda and lay the groundwork for future discussions, encouraging dialogue and collaboration to strengthen anti-corruption strategies.

tgt: The First Agriculture Working Group Meeting, held virtually on 3 and 4 March 2025, discussed critical issues that affect agricultural stakeholders worldwide and agreed on priorities for the year ahead.

src: Prioriteit 1: Bevordering van inklusiewe markdeelname en voedselsekerheid

src: Die eerste toerismewerkgroepvergadering wat op 5 Maart 2025 virtueel gehou is, het beraadslaag oor hoe toerisme gebruik kan word om mense se lewens, gemeenskappe en die wêreld te verander.
tgt: The First Tourism Working Group Meeting held virtually on 5 March 2025 deliberated on how tourism can be used to change people’s lives, communities and the world.

First Disaster Risk Reduction Working Group Meeting held virtually on 5 March 2025 discussed the acceleration of early warnings for all initiatives, which is a key global target set by the United Nations and reinforced the implementation of the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015-2030.

tgt: South Africa sees this meeting as a key international forum to drive the agenda of a shared responsibility to build resilience, strengthen our cooperation, and drive meaningful action that is needed to prevent an escalation or exacerbation of risk.

src: Die eerste voedselsekerheidtaakspanvergadering, wat virtueel op 5 Maart 2025 gehou is, het beleide en programme bespreek om voedselsekerheid te verbeter.
tgt: First Task Force Meeting: Food Security which was held virtually on 5 March 2025 discussed policies and programmes to improve food security.

src: Deelnemers het ingestem om ŉ sterker, regverdiger en meer volhoubare voedselstelsel te bou.
tgt: Participants agreed to build a stronger, fairer and more sustainable food system.

src: Hulle het hul ook daartoe verbind om sleuteluitdagings soos handelshindernisse, befondsing vir voedselproduksie en die impak van klimaatsverandering op voedselvoorsieningskettings aan te spreek.
tgt: They also committed to address key challenges like trade barriers, funding for food production and the impact of climate change on food supply chains.

tgt: Some of the priorities outcomes discussed are the following:

src: Prioriteit 1: Sterker voedselsekerheidsbeleid
tgt: Priority 1: Stronger food security policies

src: Prioriteit 2: Stabiele voedselpryse
tgt: Priority 2: Stable food prices

src: Prioriteit 3: Duidelike regulasies en standaarde Prioriteit 4: G20-aksieplan vir voedselsekerheid en

tgt: Priority 5: Ministerial approval and implementation..

src: Die G20-uitreikprogram wat op 7 Maart 2025 by die Universiteit van Venda in Thohoyandou gehou is, het ten doel gehad om breër openbare dialoog en deelname aan Suid-Afrika se G20-presidentskap te bevorder.
tgt: The G20 Outreach Programme held at the University of Venda in Thohoyandou on 7 March 2025 aimed at fostering wider public dialogue and participation in South Africa’s G20 Presidency.

src: Die byeenkoms is gebruik om die landsburgers aan te moedig om betrokke te raak by die verwelkoming van gaste in die land terwyl ons voortgaan om byeenkomste in verskeie dele van die land aan te bied, en om hul kultuur en erfenis te bevorder.
tgt: The gathering was used to encourage the people of this country to get involved in welcoming our guests to the country as we continue to host meetings in various parts of the country, and to promote their culture and heritage.

src: Suid-Afrikaners is ook aangemoedig om ŉ goeie storie oor hul land te vertel.
tgt: South Africans were also encouraged to tell a good story about their country.

src: Die volgende G20-werkgroepe en taakgroepvergaderings sal tot einde Maart 2025 plaasvind: Eerste vergadering van die taakspan vir inklusiewe ekonomiese groei, industrialisasie, indiensneming en vermindering van ongelykheid: 17 Maart 2025 – virtueel.2 Eerste handels- en beleggingswerkgroepvergadering: 18 tot 20 Maart 2025 – virtueel.3 Tweede gesondheidswerkgroep: 26 tot 28 Maart 2025 – Durban.4 Eerste werkgroepvergadering vir klimaat- en omgewingsvolhoubaarheid: 25 tot 28 Maart 2025 – virtueel.
tgt: The following G20 working groups and task forces meetings will take place until the end of March 2025: First Task Force Meeting: Inclusive Economic Growth, Industrialisation, Employment, and Reduce Inequality: 17 March 2025 – virtually.2 First Trade and Investment Working Group Meeting: 18-20 March 2025 – virtually.

src: Inligting oor hierdie verskillende G20-vergaderings en hul uitkomste kan verkry word op WEBTOKEN OR WEBTOKEN.
tgt: Second Health Working Group: 26-28 March 2025 – Durban.4 First Climate and Environment Sustainability Working Group Meeting: 25-28 March 2025 – virtually.3 Information on these various G20 meetings and their outcomes can be accessed on WEBTOKEN OR WEBTOKEN.

src: za Humanitêre hulp aan Palestina.2 Die Kabinet veroordeel Israel se weiering om humanitêre hulp in die Gasa-strook toe te laat en die land se sluiting van grensoorgange in ŉ tyd waarin die mense van Gasa onmeetbare lyding ervaar en dringend voedsel, skuiling en mediese voorraad benodig.3 Hierdie optrede is ŉ voortsetting van Israel se gebruik van hongersnood as ŉ oorlogswapen as deel van die voortdurende veldtog wat die Internasionale Hof van Justisie as aanneemlike volksmoord teen die Palestynse volk beslis het.4 Die Kabinet herhaal ons land se beroep op die internasionale gemeenskap om Israel aanspreeklik te hou en die veilige, deurlopende en ongehinderde lewering van humanitêre hulp aan alle gebiede van die Gaza-strook te verseker.
tgt: za Humanitarian Aid to Palestine.2 Cabinet condemns the refusal of Israel to allow humanitarian aid into the Gaza Strip and its closure of border crossings at a time when the people of Gaza are experiencing immeasurable suffering and urgently need food, shelter and medical supplies.3 This action is a continuation of Israel’s use of starvation as a weapon of war as part of the ongoing campaign of what the International Court of Justice ruled to be plausible genocide against the Palestinian people.

src: Misdaad.
tgt: Crime.

src: Verwelkoming van die Malawi-hof se uitspraak oor die uitlewering van Shepherd en Mary Bushiri.
tgt: Welcoming the Malawi Court Ruling on the Extradition of Shepherd and Mary Bushiri.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom die beslissing van die Republiek van Malawi se hoofinwonende landdroshof dat Shepherd en Mary Bushiri aan Suid-Afrika uitgelewer word vir misdaadverhoor rakende verskeie kriminele aanklagte, insluitend verkragting, oortreding van die Wet op Finansiële Adves- en Tussengangerdienste, 2002 (Wet 37 van 2002), die Bankwet, 1990 (Wet 94 van 1990), die Immigrasiewet, 2002 (Wet 13 van 2002) en die oortreding van hul borgtogvoorwaardes.
tgt: Cabinet welcomed the ruling by the Republic of Malawi’s Chief Resident Magistrate Court that Shepherd and Mary Bushiri be extradited to South Africa to stand trial on multiple criminal charges including rape, contravening the Financial Advisory and Intermediary Services Act, 2002 (Act 37 of 2002), the Bank Act, 1990 (Act 94 of 1990), Immigration Act, 2002 (Act 13 of 2002) and violating their bail conditions.

src: Hierdie uitspraak toon dat niemand van die oppergesag kan vlug nie en bevestig ook die geregtelike onafhanklikheid, internasionale samewerking en wedersydse vertroue tussen die Suid-Afrikaanse en Malawiese regsinstellings.
tgt: This ruling shows that no-one can run away from the rule law and also reaffirms the judicial independence, international cooperation and mutual trust between the South African and Malawian legal institutions.

src: Ons is bewus daarvan dat die Bushiri’s hul voorneme aangedui het om te appelleer.
tgt: We are aware that that the Bushiris have indicated their intention to appeal.

src: Ons is egter vol vertroue dat ons ŉ sterk saak teen hulle het.
tgt: However, we are confident that we have a strong case against them.

src: Suid-Afrika is gereed om met Interpol saam te werk om die oordragreëlings en logistiek te koördineer om te verseker dat die Bushiri’s na Suid-Afrika gebring word om verhoor te word.
tgt: South Africa stands ready to collaborate with INTERPOL to coordinate the transfer arrangements and logistics to ensure that they are brought to South Africa to stand trial.

src: Onlangse swaar reën het verskeie lewens geëis en honderde mense ontwortel gelaat, met huise en infrastruktuur wat ernstig beskadig is in KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Recent heavy rains have claimed several lives, left hundreds displaced, with homes and infrastructure severely damaged in KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Die impak van erge weerstoestande in KwaZulu-Natal is as ŉ nasionale ramptoestand verklaar om die provinsiale departement van korporatiewe bestuur en tradisionele sake in staat te stel om alle staatsorgane te mobiliseer om ondersteuningsmaatreëls aan te vul en die impak van die ramp op gemeenskappe te beperk.
tgt: The impact of severe weather conditions in KwaZulu-Natal has been declared a national state of disaster to allow the provincial department of Corporate Governance and Traditional Affairs to mobilise all organs of state to augment support measures, limiting the impact of the disaster on communities.

src: Die regering gaan voort om vloedslagoffers van hulp te voorsien en die departement van menslike nedersettings het R100 miljoen aan KwaZulu-Natal toegeken om te help met die bestuur van die nasleep van die vloede.
tgt: Government continues to provide flood victims with assistance and the Department of Human Settlements has allocated R100 million to KwaZulu-Natal to assist in managing the flood aftermath.

src: Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om uiters versigtig te wees wanneer daar gure weer is.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to exercise extreme caution whenever there is inclement weather.

src: Swaar reën hou ŉ risiko van plaaslike oorstromings in, veral in laagliggende gebiede, brûe en paaie.
tgt: Heavy rain poses a risk of localised flooding, particularly in low-lying areas, bridges and roads.

src: In gevalle van swaar reën word gemeenskappe aangemoedig om oorstroomde paaie te vermy en om nuusuitsendings, radiobulletins en die amptelike sosiale mediaplatforms van die regering dop te hour vir intydse opdaterings en waarskuwings.
tgt: In cases of heavy rains, communities are urged to avoid flooded roads and to monitor news broadcasts, radio bulletins and government official social media pages for real-time updates and alerts.

src: Opdatering van die kabinet Beskerming en verbetering van die nasionale minimum loon (NML).
tgt: Protection and improvement of the National Minimum Wage (NMW).

src: Die Kabinet het ŉ verslag van die departement van indiensneming en arbeid ontvang en in oorweging geplaas oor die vordering wat gemaak is om die NML te beskerm en te verbeter.
tgt: Cabinet received and considered a report by the Department of Employment and Labour on the progress made to protect and enhance the NMThe NMW Act, 2018 (Act 9 of 2018), which was enacted in November 2018, laid the foundation for reducing income inequality and wage gaps, and continues to safeguard low-income workers in the country.

src: Die NML-wet, 2018 (Wet 9 van 2018), wat in November 2018 gepromulgeer is, het die grondslag gelê vir die vermindering van inkomste-ongelykheid en loongapings, en gaan voort om lae-inkomstewerkers in die land te beskerm.
tgt: From 1 March 2025, the NMW increased by 4% from R27,58 to R28,79 per hour.

src: Hierdie verhoging het ten doel om noodsaaklike ekonomiese ondersteuning en broodnodige verligting te bied aan die ses miljoen werkers wat binne die NML-groep val.
tgt: This increase aims to provide essential economic support and much-needed relief to the six million workers earning within the NMW bracket.

src: Bevordering van grondslagleer.
tgt: Promoting Foundation Learning.

src: Die Kabinet het sy steun uitgespreek vir die strategiese heroriëntering van die basiese onderwyssektor na grondslagleer.
tgt: Cabinet expressed its support for the strategic reorientation of the Basic Education sector towards foundation learning.

src: In Januarie 2025 het die departement van basiese onderwys ŉ rekordhoë matriekslaagsyfer van 87,4% aangekondig en gevier.
tgt: In January 2025, the Department of Basic Education announced and celebrated a record high matric pass rate of 87.4%.

src: Net ŉ maand tevore het die departement egter stelselmatige evalueringsresultate van drie verskillende studies bekendgemaak, wat toon dat byna 80% van Suid-Afrikaanse kinders teen die ouderdom van tien nie in enige taal vir begripsleer kan lees nie.
tgt: However, just a month earlier, the department had released systematic evaluation results from three different studies showing that nearly 80% of South African children cannot read for meaning, in any language by the age of ten (10).

src: Om hierdie uitdaging op te los, het die minister van basiese onderwys ŉ strategiese heroriëntering begin wat die volgende inisiatiewe sal hê: Universele toegang tot gehalte-VKO (vroeë kinderonderwys) deur die massaregistrasie van VKO-sentrums, wat sal verseker dat elke kind in VKO-sentrums ŉ subsidie ontvang VKO-sentrums met leer- en onderrigmateriaal sal ondersteun en ondersteuning aan praktisyns sal verskaf om onderrigkwalifikasies te verwerf.
tgt: To resolve this challenge the Minister of Basic Education has initiated a strategic reorientation that will have the following initiatives: Universal access to quality ECD through the mass registration of ECD centres, ensure each child in ECD receives a subsidy, support ECD centres with Learning and Teaching materials, and offer support to practitioners to obtain teaching qualifications.

src: Befondsing hiervoor is in die 2025 Nasionale Begroting toegeken.
tgt: Funding for this has been allocated in the 2025 National Budget.

src: Hersien die norme en standaarde om onderwyserposte in grondslagfase-onderrig te verhoog.
tgt: Review the norms and standards to increase teacher posts in foundation phase teaching.

src: Die Funza Lushaka-beurs sal heroriënteer word om beurse te prioritiseer aan studente wat in die grondslagfase wil onderrig.
tgt: The Funza Lushaka Bursary will be reoriented to prioritise bursaries to students who wish to teach in the foundation phase.

src: Hierdie strategiese heroriëntering sal grondliggende geletterdheids- en syfervaardighede van leerders versterk en verseker dat hulle later in meer komplekse vakke soos Wiskunde, Wetenskap, Rekeningkunde en Ekonomie bekwaamheid kan verwerf.
tgt: This strategic reorientation will strengthen foundational literacy and numeracy skills of learners, and ensure that they later be able to table on more complex subjects such as Maths, Science, Accounting and Economics, amongst others.

src: Elektrisiteitsopwekking-prestasie Die Kabinet het ŉ verslag ontvang oor die werk wat Eskom onderneem het om elektrisiteitsopwekking en stabilisering van die nasionale netwerk te verbeter om meer voorvalle van beurtkrag te voorkom.
tgt: Electricity generation performance Cabinet received a report on the work undertaken by Eskom to improve electricity generation and stabilisation of the national grid to avert more incidents of load-shedding.

src: Na die herstel van meer as 300 megawatt se opwekkingskapasiteit en die aanvulling van voldoende reserwes, is beurtkrag op Sondag, 9 Maart 2025 om 10:00 opgeskort.
tgt: After the recovery of more than 300 megawatts of generation capacity and replenishment of sufficient reserves, load-shedding was suspended at 10:00 on Sunday, 9 March 2025.

src: Steenkoolbedrywighede by die Kusile-kragstasie funksioneer op optimale vlakke nadat dit vanaf Vrydag, 7 Maart vanlyn was, is suksesvol weer in diens en die Koeberg-eenheid 2 is ook suksesvol weer terug in diens.
tgt: Coal operations at Kusile Power Station are at optimal levels with all units which were offline as of Friday 7 March now successfully returned to service and the Koeberg Unit 2 was successfully brought back to service.

src: Die algehele opwekkingsprestasie sedert die somer van 2024 het aansienlike verbeterings en stabiliteit getoon, wat gelei het tot 98% van beurtkragvrye dae.
tgt: The overall generation performance since the summer of 2024 has shown significant improvements and stability, resulting in 98% of load-shedding-free days.

src: Eskom bly optimisties vir ŉ positiewe vooruitsig vir die res van die somertydperk.
tgt: Eskom remains optimistic for a positive outlook for the remainder of the summer period.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet decisions.

src: Aanbieding van die water- en sanitasie-indaba Die Kabinet het die aanbieding van die water- en sanitasie-indaba op 27 en 28 Maart 2025 te Gauteng goedgekeur.
tgt: Hosting of the Water and Sanitation Indaba Cabinet approved the hosting of the Water and Sanitation Indaba on 27 and 28 March 2025 in Gauteng.

src: Hierdie geleentheid dien as ŉ opvolg van die waterberaad wat in Januarie 2024 gehou is, waar alle waterdienste-owerhede byeengekom het om sleutelsektoruitdagings aan te spreek, na aanleiding van die vrystelling van die groen- en blouwaterdruppelverslae.
tgt: This event serves as a follow-up to the Water Summit held in January 2024, which brought together all water services authorities to address key sector challenges, following the release of the Drops Reports.

src: Die beraad het ŉ aksieplan opgestel om hierdie kwessies aan te pak en die indaba sal ŉ geleentheid bied om vordering wat gemaak is, te evalueer en verdere stappe te identifiseer waar nodig.
tgt: The summit established an Action Plan to tackle these issues, and the Indaba will provide an opportunity to assess progress made and identify further steps needed.

src: Die verwagte uitkomste van die indaba is konsensus oor die stand van watersekerheid in Suid-Afrika, vordering met onvolledige aksies van die 2024-waterberaad en sleutelaksies wat nodig is om watersekerheid te verbeter, asook ŉ bygewerkte (nuwe) aksieplan.
tgt: The expected outcomes of the Indaba are to have consensus on the state of water security in South Africa, progress on incomplete actions from the 2024 Water Summit and key actions required to improve water security and an updated (new) action plan.

src: Die Kabinet erken die watersekerheidsuitdagings wat die land in die gesig staar en bevestig sy verbintenis om te verseker dat elke Suid-Afrikaner toegang tot skoon, veilige en volhoubare water- en sanitasiedienste het.
tgt: Cabinet acknowledged the water security challenges facing the country and reaffirms its commitment to ensure that every South African has access to clean, safe and sustainable water and sanitation services.

src: Die 2e, 3e en 4e tydperk landverslag oor die VN-konvensie oor die regte van persone met gestremdhede (UNCRPD) Die Kabinet het dit goedgekeur dat die departement van vroue, jeug en persone met gestremdhede die 2e, 3e en 4e UNCRPD-periodieke verslag aan die VN voorlê.
tgt: 2nd, 3rd and 4th Period Country Report on the UN Convention on the rights of persons with disabilities (UNCRPD).

src: Die verslag verskaf ŉ opdatering oor die vordering wat Suid-Afrika gemaak het om die regte van persone met gestremdhede te bevorder en te beskerm.
tgt: Cabinet approved that the Department Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities submits the 2nd, 3rd and 4th UNCRPD periodic report to the UThe report provides an update on the progress South Africa has made to promote and protect the rights of persons with disabilities.

src: Die Kabinet het die basislynlandverslag oor die implementering van die UNCRPD in 2013 goedgekeur en die verslag is daarna in 2014 gedeponeer.
tgt: Cabinet approved the Baseline Country Report on the Implementation of the UNCRPD in 2013 and the report was subsequently deposited in 2014.

src: Hierdie gekombineerde vorderingsverslag gee ŉ oorsig van die regering se prestasie in die implementering van die Witskrif oor die Regte van Persone met Gestremdhede.
tgt: This combined progress report gives an overview of government’s performance in the implementation of the White Paper on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities.

src: Dit beklemtoon beleids- en wetgewende hervormings asook maatreëls wat getref is om die regte van persone met gestremdhede te beskerm en te bevorder.
tgt: It highlights policy and legislative reforms, and measures taken to protect and promote the rights of persons with disabilities.

src: Die verslag bevat pogings in onderwys, bewusmaking, gesondheid, maatskaplike dienste, toegang tot geregtigheid en indiensneming vir persone met gestremdhede.
tgt: The report unpacks efforts in education, awareness raising, health, social services, access to justice and employment for persons with disabilities.

src: Die verslag sal op die webwerf gepubliseer word: WEBTOKEN
tgt: The report will be published on the website: WEBTOKEN

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en relevante sekuriteitsklarings.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant security clearances.

tgt: Mr Neil Jansen as Deputy Director-General: Human Resource Management and Development in the Department of Home Affairs.

tgt: Appointment of the Alexkor board members

src: Komende gebeurtenisse.
tgt: Upcoming events.

src: Inhuldigingsberaad vir die nasionale stelsel van innovasietransformasie.1 Die eerste nasionale stelsel van innovasie-transformasieberaad vind van 13 tot 14 Maart 2025 plaas om Suid-Afrika se wetenskap-, tegnologie- en innovasievermoëns te benut op ŉ wyse wat insluiting fasiliteer.
tgt: Inaugural National System of Innovation Transformation Summit.1 The inaugural National System of Innovation Transformation Summit will take place from 13 to 14 March 2025 to harness South Africa’s science, technology and innovation capabilities in a manner that facilitates inclusion.

src: Die beraad bring wetenskaprade, hoëronderwysinstellings, staatsdepartemente, die sakesektor en georganiseerde arbeid byeen om te beraadslaag oor die huidige en toekomstige rol van die land se nasionale stelsel van innovasie.
tgt: The summit brings together science councils, higher education institutions, government departments, the business sector and organised labour to reflect and engage on the current and future role of the country’s National System of Innovation.

src: Dit sal aksies aanbeveel om die verwesenliking van inklusiewe en volhoubare sosio-ekonomiese ontwikkeling tot voordeel van alle Suid-Afrikaners te versnel.
tgt: It will recommend actions to accelerate the realisation of inclusive and sustainable socio-economic development for the benefit of all South Africans.

src: 8e beraad tussen Suid-Afrika en die Europese Unie (EU) Die 8e beraad tussen Suid-Afrika en die EU vind op 13 Maart 2025 in Kaapstad plaas en dit sal tesame gelei word deur president Cyril Ramaphosa, die president van die Europese Raad, mnrAntónio Luís Santos da Costa, en die president van die Europese Komissie, dr Ursula von der Leyen om die sterk betrekkinge tussen Suid-Afrika en die EU verder te versterk.2 Die beraad sal kwessies van handel en belegging bespreek, tesame met groter wedersydse samewerking en versterkte bilaterale betrekkinge tussen Suid-Afrika en die EDie beraad sal na verwagting samewerkende benaderings ondersoek om streeks- en globale uitdagings aan te spreek, insluitend klimaatsverandering, menslike onsekerheid, vrede, veiligheid en stabiliteit, die groen oorgang en hervorming van globale bestuursinstellings.4 Die beraad sal ook steun vir Suid-Afrika se G20-presidentskap en sy prioriteite herbevestig, insluitend die tema van “Solidariteit, Gelykheid en Volhoubaarheid”.
tgt: 8th South Africa – European Union (EU) Summit.1VThe 8th South Africa – EU Summit is taking place in Cape Town (today) on 13 March 2025, and it will be co-chaired by President Cyril Ramaphosa, President of the European Council, Mr. António Luís Santos da Costa, and the President of the European Commission, Dr. Ursula von der Leyen to further strengthen the strong relations between South Africa and the EU.2 The summit will discuss issues of trade and investment, along with greater mutual cooperation and reinforced bilateral relations between South Africa and the EThe summit is expected to explore collaborative approaches to addressing regional and global challenges, including climate change, human insecurity, peace, security and stability, the green transition, and reform of global governance institutions.4 The summit will also reaffirm support for South Africa’s G20 Presidency and its priorities, including the theme of Solidarity, Equality and Sustainability.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Messages.

src: • Dylan Naidoo, die eerste swart Suid-Afrikaner wenner van die gesogte SA Ope gewen het, een van die oudste wêreldgholfkampioenskappe.
tgt: CongratulationsCabinet extended its congratulations and well-wishes to: Dylan Naidoo for becoming the first black South African to win the prestigious SA Open, which is also one of the oldest golf championships.

src: Sy oorwinning het hom ŉ plek in Julie se Ope-kampioenskap by Royal Portrush verseker.
tgt: His victory has secured him a place in July's Open Championship at Royal Portrush.

src: • Ncazelo Mlilo, vir haar nominasie in twee kategorieë vir die gesogte Women Changing the World-toekennings.
tgt: Ncazelo Mlilo on her nomination for two categories for the prestigious Women Changing the World Awards.

src: Die toekennings gee erkenning aan vroue regoor die wêreld wat uitsonderlike werk doen om lewens te verander.• Die Moslem-gemeenskap, wat tans hul heilige maand van Ramadan vier.
tgt: The awards recognise women across the world who are doing incredible work in changing lives.

src: • MnrPatrice Motsepe, met sy herverkiesing as CAF-president.
tgt: Mr Patrice Motsepe on his re-election as CAF President.

src: Sy bydrae tot die ontwikkeling van Suid-Afrikaanse en Afrika-sokker maak ons steeds trots.
tgt: His contribution to the development of South African and African football continues to make us proud.

src: MeelyeDie Kabinet spreek hul medelye uit met die vriende en familie van:
tgt: CondolencesCabinet expressed condolences to the friends and family of: the 31 passengers who lost their lives in three separate bus accidents between Reddersburg and Smithfield in the Free State on the N2 North, near Mandeni, in KwaZulu-Natal and on the R21 in Ekurhuleni, Gauteng respectively.

src: • Die 31 passasiers wat hul lewens verloor het in drie afsonderlike busongelukke tussen Reddersburg en Smithfield in die Vrystaat op die N2-Noord naby Mandeni, KwaZulu-Natal en op die R21 in Ekurhuleni, Gauteng.• Vier laerskoolleerders wat hul lewens verloor het in ŉ padongeluk op die N12 in Daveyton in Ekurhuleni, Gauteng.• Fluitjieblaser en geslagsaktivis Pamela Mabini wat opgestaan het vir vroue wat GGG ervaar het en verseker het dat oortreders van GGGV tot verantwoording geroep word.• Crystal-Donna Roberts, die Suid-Afrikaanse aktrise en aanbieder wat in rolprente soos The Endless River en Krotoa gespeel het en in Arendsvlei, Swartwater en 7de Laan verskyn het.• Dr Gomolemo Mokae, anti-apartheids- en swart bewussynsaktivis, mediese dokter en skrywer wat ŉ aktiewe voorstander van Afrikatale was.
tgt: four primary school pupils who lost their lives in a road accident on the N12 in Daveyton, Ekurhuleni, Gauteng.

src: Hy het die multilinguistiese toekenning van die Pan-Suid-Afrikaanse Taalraad ontvang vir die bevordering van die gebruik van inheemse tale in Suid-Afrikaanse literatuur.• MnrAthol Fugard, die wêreldbekende akteur, romanskrywer en dramaturg wat plaaslik en internasionaal erkenning ontvang het vir sy uitstaande bydraes tot die teaterwese.
tgt: whistleblower and gender activist Pamela Mabini who stood up for women who experienced GBV and ensured that perpetrators of GBVF are brought to book.

src: Kwessies in die omgeing Ekonomie.1 Belegging.1 Die Kabinet het sy vertroue in die veerkragtigheid van die ekonomie uitgespreek terwyl die land steeds voortgaan om vennootskappe te versterk, sleutelsektore op te bou en nuwe beleggings te lok.
tgt: .1 Cabinet expressed confidence in the resilience of the economy, as the country continues to forge partnerships to build key sectors and attract new investments.

src: .2 Die Kabinet het die bekendstelling van Suid-Afrika se R.5-miljard Google Cloud-streek in Johannesburg, wat Suid-Afrika in Google Cloud se globale netwerk integreer, verwelkom.
tgt: .2 Cabinet also welcomed the launch of Google South Africa’s R.5-billion cloud region in Johannesburg, which integrates South Africa into Google Cloud’s global network.

src: Dit is Google se eerste in Afrika en is 'n beduidende belegging in Suid-Afrika se tegnologie-infrastruktuur is.3 Die Kabinet doen ’n beroep op alle sektore om ons land se pad na volhoubare, inklusiewe ekonomiese groei en werkskepping te versnel deur meer belegging te bevorder en die talle positiewe aspekte van ons land te beklemtoon.2 Privaatsektordeelname aan spoor- en hawevrag logistieke projekte.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van die Versoek vir Inligting oor Privaatsektordeelname aan Spoor- en Hawevrag Logistieke Projekte.
tgt: This project is Google’s first in Africa and marks a significant investment in South Africa’s technology infrastructure.3 Cabinet calls on all sectors to accelerate our country's path towards sustainable inclusive economic growth and job creation through increased investment and by reinforcing the many positives about our country.

src: Dit is deel van kritieke hervormings om Suid-Afrika se logistieke sektor op te gradeer en by te dra tot ekonomiese groei deur verbeterde invoere.2 Die ‘Padkaart vir die Vrag Logistieke Stelsel’ in Suid-Afrika dra by tot groter mededinging in spoor- en hawebedrywighede.
tgt: .1 Cabinet welcomed the launch of the Request for Information on Private Sector Participation in Rail and Port Freight Logistics Projects, as this is part of the critical reforms to improve South Africa’s logistics sector and thus improving economic growth through improved exports.2 The Roadmap for Freight Logistics System in South Africa promotes the greater competition in rail and port terminal operations, which will attract private investment but strategic infrastructure such as rail lines and ports remain in public ownership.

src: Energie.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die toevoeging van 800 megawatt nuwe opwekkingskapasiteit tot die nasionale netwerk nadat Eskom die Kusile-kragstasie se finale opwekkingseenheid suksesvol aanlyn gebring het.
tgt: .1 Cabinet welcomed the addition of 800 megawatts of new generation capacity to the national grid after Eskom successfully brought Kusile Power Station’s final generation unit online.

src: Dit sal bydra tot die stabilisering van die netwerk en om die land se toekomstige energiesekerheid te versterk.
tgt: This will help stabilise the grid and strengthen our nation’s future energy security.

src: Kwarttaalikse indiensnemingstatistieke.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die toename in indiensneming met 12 000 poste 10.64 miljoen in die formele nie-landbousektor gedurende die vierde kwartaal van 2024.
tgt: .1 Cabinet welcomed the increase in employment by 12 000 jobs to 10.64 million in the formal non-agricultural sector during the fourth quarter of 2024.

src: Statistieke SA se kwartaalikse indiensnemingstatistiek weerspieël indiensnemingswinste in die handel, sakedienste,vervoer en die elektrisiteitsektor.
tgt: The Stats SA’s Quarterly Employment Statistics reflected employment gains in the trade, business services, transport and the electricity sector.2 Despite the modest improvement, full-time employment remains lower than it was a year ago.

src: Die Kabinet is daartoe verbind om strukturele hervormings te versnel en programme wat op ekonomiese groei gerig is van stapel te stuur om ’n gunstige omgewing vir werkskepping te verseker.
tgt: Cabinet has committed to drive structural reforms, and implement economic growth focused programmes in order to create conducive environment for job creation.

src: Proklamasie van die Wet op Klimaatsverandering, Wet 22 van 20.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die proklamasie van die Wet op Klimaatsverandering, 2024 (Wet 22 van 2024) deur President Ramaphosa op Maandag 17 Maart 2025.
tgt: Proclamation of the Climate Change Act, 22 of 2024 Cabinet welcomed the proclamation of the Climate Change Act, 2024 (Act 22 of 2024) by President Ramaphosa on Monday, 17 March 2025, which enables the development of effective climate change policies and the long-term plan for a transition to a low-carbon economy and society.2 Cabinet also welcomed the International Partners Group (IPG), a coalition of countries comprising the United Kingdom, Germany, France and the EU, to fill the funding gap left by the US after its withdrawal from the Just Energy Transition Partnership.3 The total international pledges to South Africa now amount to US$12.8 billion, which include more than US$9 billion from the IPG along with contributions from Spain, Switzerland and Canada.

src: Die wet maak die ontwikkeling van doeltreffende beleide oor klimaatsverandering moontlik, asook die langtermynplan vir die oorgang na ’n laekoolstof-ekonomie en -samelewing moontlik.2 Die Kabinet verwelkom ook die International Partners Group (IPG), ’n koalisie van lande, insluitend die Verenigde Koninkryk Duitsland Frankryk en die EU, wat die finansieringsgaping wat die VSA ná sy onttrekking aan die Just Energy Transition Partnership gelaat het, sal vul.3 Die totale bedrag van internasionale beloftes aan Suid-Afrika beloop nou US$12,8 miljard, wat meer as US$9 miljard van die IP insluit, tesame met bydraes van Spanje, Switserland en Kanada.
tgt: .1 Cabinet welcomed the firmer ties between South Africa and Japan following Deputy President Paul Mashatile’s working visit to Japan from 17 to 19 March 2025 aimed at strengthening the existing cooperation between South Africa and Japan in areas of mutual interest.2 Engagements were also held with the Japan International Cooperation Agency to explore areas of economic collaboration, the Association for African Economic Development in Japan to discuss trade and investment opportunities and the Japan Organisation for Metals and Energy Security to highlight investment opportunities in the mining sector.

src: Internasionale betrekkinge Samewerking tussen Suid-Afrika en Japan.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die stewige bande tussen Suid-Afrika en Japan ná Adjunkpresident Paul Mashatile se werksbesoek aan Japan van 17 tot 19 Maart 2025.
tgt: Health Hemp and Cannabis Food Product Regulations withdrawal .1 Cabinet welcomed the withdrawal by the Department of Health of Regulations banning the sale of hemp and cannabis food product.2 Whilst acknowledging the negative impact of the unregulated sale of hemp and cannabis food products on possible consumption by children, such Regulations must be fully consulted, must not be in contempt of the Constitutional Court Judgement and must not contravene the Cannabis for Private Purposes Act.3 The Department of Justice and Constitutional Development is coordinating an interdepartmental Draft Regulations for the implementation of the Cannabis for Private Purposes Act Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD)

src: Die besoek was daarop gemik om die bestaande samewerking tussen Suid-Afrika en Japan op gebiede van wedersydse belang te versterk.2 Gesprekke is ook met die Japanse Internasionale Samewerkingsagentskap gehou om gebiede van ekonomiese samewerking te ondersoek, asook om handels- en beleggingsgeleenthede met die Vereniging vir Afrika Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling in Japan te bespreek en samewerking met die Japanse Organisasie vir Meale en Energiesekerheid om geleenthede vir belegging in die mynbousektor uit te lig.
tgt: .1 Cabinet was updated on the extension of the KwaZulu-Natal’s Disease Management Area (DMA) boundaries to curb further outbreaks of Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD).

src: Gesondheid.1 Ontrekking van regulasies oor hennep- en cannabis-voedselproduksie .1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die Departement van Gesondheid se onttrekking van regulasies wat die verkoop van hennep en cannabis-voedselprodukte verbied.2 Daar is begrip vir die moontlike negatiewe impak van die ongereguleerde verkoop van hennep- en cannabisprodukte op kinders en daarom moet daar volle raadpleging oor sodanige regulasies wees.
tgt: .2 The DMA has been expanded to include the following municipalities: Big Five Hlabisa Mtubatuba Nongoma Ulundi Umhlabuyalingana Jozini Pongola Abaqulusi Mfolozi uMhlathuze Mthonjaneni Nqutu Nkandla uMlalazi and Mandeni.3 No cloven-hoofed animals (cattle, sheep and goats), their products or genetic material may be moved from or within the DMA unless authorised by a state veterinary permit.

src: Dit mag nie die Konstitusionele Hof se uitspraak minag nie en dit mag nie die Wet op Cannabis vir Privaat Doeleindes oortree nie.3 Die Departement van Justisie en Grondwetlike Ontwikkeling koördineer interdepartementele konsepregulasies vir die implementering van die Wet op Cannabis vir privaat doeleindes.
tgt: Justice, Crime Prevention and Security Crime Prevention .1 Cabinet welcomed the arrest of 12 892 suspects between 17 March and 23 March 2025 by the South African Police Service (SAPS) as part of Operation Shanela.

src: Geregtigheid, misdaadvoorkoming en sekuriteit Misdaadvoorkoming .1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die inhegtenisneming van 12 892 verdagtes tussen 17 Maart en 23 Maart 2025 deur die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens (SAPD) as deel van Operasie Shanela.2 Dit sluit in 1 753 gesoekte verdagtes vir ernstige en gewelddadige misdade soos moord, poging tot moord, verkragting, besigheids- en huisrooftogte.
tgt: .2 These include 1 753 wanted suspects for serious and violent crimes such as murder, attempted murder, rape, business and house robberies.

src: Hierbenewens is 1 794 verdagtes in hegtenis geneem vir aanranding met ernstige liggaamlike besering en 203 dwelmhandelaars is in hegtenis geneem.
tgt: Additionally, 1 794 suspects were arrested for assault with Grievous Bodily Harm and 203 drug dealers were arrested.

src: 'n Verdere 1 507 verdagtes is in hegtenis geneem vir die besit van dwelms en 115 verdagtes vir die besit van onwettige vuurwapens.
tgt: A further 1 507 suspects were arrested for possession of drugs and 115 suspects for the possession of illegal firearms.

src: Voortgesette veldtogte oor verkeerde inligting en vals inligting .1 Die Kabinet neem met kommer kennis van voortgesette waninligtingsveldtogte deur Solidariet en AfriForum en hul bondgenote.
tgt: Continuing Misinformation and Disinformation Campaigns .1 Cabinet noted with concern continuing misinformation campaigns by Solidaritiet and AfriForum and their allies, and law enforcement agencies are investigating the violations of South African laws.2 To prevent further misinformation, the South African Police Service met with AfriForum to clarify the allegations of white genocide with reference to farm murders.

src: Wetstoepassingsagentskappe ondersoek die oortredings van Suid-Afrikaanse wette.2 Om verdere onakkurate inligting te voorkom, het die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens met AfriForum vergader om die bewerings van wit volksmoord met verwysing na plaasmoorde uit te klaar.3 AfriForum het tydens die vergadering erken dat die misdaadstatistiek soos deur die Minister van Polisie bekend gemaak, akkuraat is, insluitend ten opsigte van plaasmoorde.4 Dit is algemeen bekend dat sommige van die plaasmoorde gepleeg word deur mense wat aan die boere bekend is, insluitend familielede.5 Die Kabinet is ook bewus van die vals bewering dat daar ongeveer 72 000 wit boere is wat aangemeld het om na die VSA te verhuis in reaksie op die uitnodiging van die Amerikaanse president.6 Volgens data van beide AgriSA en die Departement van Landbou, asook StatsSA, is daar slegs 41 000 kommersiële boere in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: .3 At the meeting AfriForum conceded that the crime statistics as released by the Minister of Police are accurate, including on farm murders.4 It is common knowledge that some of the farm murders are committed by people known to the farmers including family members.5 Cabinet is also aware of the false claim that there are approximately 72,000 white farmers who have signed up to relocate to the USA in response to the invitation by the US President.

src: Stryd teen korrupsie.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die forum vir korrupsie teen grensbestuur en immigrasie, wat op 25 Maart 2025 bekendgestel is, as deel van pogings om korrupsie in grensbestuur en immigrasie te bekamp.
tgt: .1 Cabinet welcomed the launched Border Management and Immigration Anti-Corruption Forum on 25 March 2025, as part of efforts to clamp down on corruption in border management and immigration.

src: Die Groep van Twintig- (G20) Beraad se voorbereidingsvergaderings.1 Suid-Afrika gaan voort om 'n reeks hoëvlak-G20-vergaderings aan te bied in die aanloop tot die G20-beraad in November 2025.
tgt: Updates to Cabinet Group of Twenty (G20) SUMMIT PREPARATORY MEETINGS South Africa continues to host a series of high-level G20 meetings in the build-up to the G20 Summit in November 2025.

src: Onlangse vergaderings is soos volg gehou:.2 Die eerste vergadering van die G20-handels- en beleggingswerkgroep het van 18 tot 20 Maart 2025 (virtueel) plaasgevind.
tgt: Recent meetings were held as follows: The First G20 Trade and Investment Working Group meeting took place virtually from 18 to 20 March 2025 and it discussed building inclusive economies, the successes and failures of the multilateral trade system over the last 30 years.

src: Die bou van inklusiewe ekonomieë en die suksesse sowel as die mislukkings van die multilaterale handelstelsel oor die afgelope 30 jaar is bespreek.
tgt: It also discussed trade and inclusive growth, a responsive trade agenda, green industrialisation and the reform of the World Trade Organisation.

src: Dit het ook handel en inklusiewe groei, 'n responsiewe handelsagenda, groen industrialisasie en die hervorming van die Wêreldhandelsorganisasie bespreek.3 Tydens 'n nasionale dialoog oor die betrokkenheid van die landbouwerkgroep en die G20 se vergadering van landbou se hoofwetenskaplikes, wat op 18 Maart 2025 (virtueel) gehou is, is volhoubaar in landbouvolhoubaarheid, -innovasie en -veerkragtigheid bespreek.4 Die G20 Internasionale Finansiële Argitektuurwerkgroep het op 18 Maart in Pretoria vergader om oor Afrika se skuldkrisis te beraadslaag.5 Suid-Afrika het op 20 Maart 2025 die voorbereidende vergadering vir die Afrika-Unie en Afrika-waterbeleggingsprogram se Waterbeleggingsberaad 2025 aangebied.
tgt: A National Dialogue towards the Agricultural Working Group engagement and the G20’s Meeting of Agricultural Chief Scientists held on 18 March 2025 (virtually) and discussed agricultural sustainability, innovation and resilience.

src: Die G20-werkgroep vir omgewing- en klimaatvolhoubaarheid, wat op 25 Maart 2025 byeengekom het, het op die belangrikste prioriteite vir die omgewing en klimaatsverandering gefokus.
tgt: The G20 International Financial Architecture Working Group met in Pretoria on 18 March to deliberate on Africa’s debt crisis.

src: Die tweede vergadering van die G20-gesondheidswerkgroep is tans aan die gang tot 28 Maart 2025.
tgt: South Africa hosted the preparatory meeting on 20 March 2025 for the African Union-Africa Water Investment Programme Water Investment Summit 2025 scheduled for August 2025.

src: Die G20 Werkgroep vir Digitale Ekonomie se taakspan oor kunsmatige intelligensie sal van van 7 tot 11 April 2025 in Gqeberha byeenkom om op digitale transformasie en inklusiewe maatskaplike en ekonomiese groei te fokus.
tgt: The G20 Environment and Climate Sustainability Working Group convened on 25th March 2025, and focused key environmental and climate change priorities.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis dat sewe uit twaalf (12) van Suid-Afrika se wêrelderfenisgebiede gereed is om G20-gaste te huisves, maar 'n mate van opknapping is nodig om besoekers se ervarings te verbeter.
tgt: Cabinet also received an assessment report on the status and preservation of South Africa’s World Heritage sites in line with the G20 Minimum Standards for preparation and hosting of Cabinet noted that seven out of twelve (12) South Africa’s World Heritage sites are ready to host G20 guests, but some refurbishment is required for an enhanced visitor experience 8th South Africa – European Union (EU) Summit Cabinet welcomed the strengthening of the Strategic Partnership between South Africa and the EU at the 8th South Africa – EU Summit held on 13 March 2025 in South Africa.

src: 8ste Beraad van Suid-Afrika en die Europese Unie (EU) Die Kabinet het die versterking van die strategiese vennootskap tussen Suid-Afrika en die EU by die 8ste Suid-Afrika-EU-beraad, wat op 13 Maart 2025 in Suid-Afrika plaasgevind het, verwelkom.
tgt: The EU reiterated its support for South Africa’s G20 Presidency and the importance of the G20 as a global forum for international economic cooperation.

src: Die EU het sy steun vir Suid-Afria se G20-presidensie en die belangrikheid van die G20 as ’n globale forum vir internasionale ekonomiese samewerking beklemtoon.
tgt: The EU also announced a R93,5-billion Global Gateway Investment Package to support strategic investment projects in clean and just energy transition, digital and physical connectivity infrastructure, and the local pharmaceutical industry.

src: Die EU het ook ’n R93,5-miljard “Global Gateway”-beleggingspakket aangekondig om strategiese beleggingsprojekte in skoon en regverdige energie-oordrag, digitale en fisiese verbindingsinfrastruktuur, en die plaaslike farmaseutiese industrie te ondersteun.
tgt: Progress report on the registration of spaza shops and other food handling outlets and interventions to curb foodborne illnesses Cabinet received a progress report on the registration of spaza shops and other food-handling outlets as well as an update on the work that is being done to curb foodborne illnesses.

src: Die registrasieproses is voltooi, behalwe vir persone wat nuwe spaza-winkels wil oopmaak.
tgt: The registration process is completed unless for a person wishing to open a new spaza shop.

src: Migrasie van die begunstigdes van die Suid-Afrikaanse Agentskap vir Maatskaplike Sekerheid (SASSA) se toelaes na die nuwe Posbankkaart Die Kabinet is op die hoogte gebring oor die migrasie van SASSA- begunstigdes na die nuwe en veilige swart Posbankkaart.
tgt: Migration of South African Social Security Agency (SASSA) grant beneficiaries to new Postbank card Cabinet received an update on the migration of SASSA grant beneficiaries to the new and secure Postbank black card.

src: Die sperdatum vir SASSA-begunstigdes om hul goue SASSA-kaarte vir die swart Posbankkaart te ruil, is tot 30 April 2025 verleng om SASSA en die Departement van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling in staat te stel om die migrasie van uitstaande begunstigdes te voltooi.
tgt: The deadline for SASSA beneficiaries to swop their SASSA Gold Card for the Postbank Black Card has been extended to 30th April 2025 to allow SASSA and the Department of Social Development to complete the migration of the outstanding beneficiaries.

src: Fase 2 van Operasie Vulindlela Die Kabinet het die fokuspunte van Operasie Vulindlela (OV), ’n gesamentlike inisiatief van die Presidensie en Nasionale Tesourie om strukturele hervormings te bestuur, goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet decisions Phase 2 of Operation Vulindlela Cabinet approved the focus areas of Operation Vulindlela, a joint initiative of the Presidency and National Treasury to drive structural reforms.

src: Die fokuspunte sluit in die voltooiing van uitstaande werk op Fase 1 op die gebiede van energie, water, visums en logistieke hervormings, asook die nuwe fokuspunte, naamlik plaaslike regering, ruimtelike ongelykheid en digitale transformasie.
tgt: The focus areas include the completion of outstanding work on Phase 1 in the areas of Energy, Water, Visa, and Logistics Reforms and new focus areas of Local Government, spatial inequality and digital transformation.

src: Die Kabinet het die OV in konsultasie met die betrokke lyndepartemente opdrag gegee om bykomende fokuspunte vir hervormings in herindustrialisering te oorweeg en om infrastruktuurbou te ontsluit, asook die olie- en gassektor en eksplorasie.
tgt: Cabinet directed OV in consultation with relevant line Departments to consider additional reforms focus areas in Re-industrialisation and localisation, to unlock infrastructure build, and the oil and gas sector and exploration.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis dat Suid-Afrika steeds die land met die 8ste grootste reserwes van gas is en dat die belemmerende gas-afgrond (Mosambiek se verwagte skerp afname in gasvoorsiening aan Suid-Afrika) vereis dat die land selfvoorsieningskapasiteit in gas moet bou.
tgt: Cabinet noted that South Africa remains the 8th country with the largest reserves of gas and the impeding gas cliff requires the country to build self provisioning capacity in gas.

src: Die Kabinet sal spesiale vergaderings hou om binne die volgende vier (4) weke op 'n ekonomiese groeiplan te fokus.
tgt: Cabinet will also hold special meeting to focus on an Economic Growth Plan within the next four (4) weeks.

src: Nasionale Bestuursbeleid vir Geïntegreerde Watergehalte.
tgt: Integrated National Water Quality Management Policy Cabinet approved the implementation of the Integrated Water Quality Management Policy.

src: Die beleid is daarop gemik om watergehalte-uitdagings aan te pak soos uiteengesit in die 1997 Witskrif oor 'n Nasionale Waterbeleid vir Suid-Afrika en die Nasionale Waterwet.
tgt: The policy seeks to address water quality challenges as outlined in the 1997 White Paper on a National Water Policy for South Africa and the National Water Act, The policy outlines a set of principles that form the basis for water quality management.

src: Die beleid gee 'n uiteensetting van 'n stel beginsels wat die basis vir watergehaltebestuur vorm.
tgt: It provides an alignment to all the relevant water-related legislation, and the country’s global commitments to the provision and conservation of water as a scarce resource.

src: Dit bied 'n belyning met al die toepaslike waterverwante wetgewing, en die land se wêreldwye verbintenisse tot die voorsiening en bewaring van water as 'n skaars hulpbron.
tgt: The South African Renewable Energy Masterplan (SAREM) Cabinet approved the South African Renewable Energy Masterplan (SAREM) for implementation.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse Mesterplan vir Hernubare Energie (SAREM).
tgt: The SAREM seeks to leverage the rising demand for renewable energy and storage technologies to promote industrialisation and localisation.

src: Die Kabinet het die implementering van die Suid-Afrikaanse Mesterplan vir Hernubare Eneregie (SAREM) goedgekeur.
tgt: The masterplan focuses on solar and wind energy, lithium-ion, battery and vanadium-based battery storage technologies and is designed to be a living document.

src: Die Kabinet het opdrag gegee dat daar bykomende werk aan die Mesterplan gedoen moet word om:3.
tgt: Cabinet directed that additional work be done on the Masterplan to:3.

src: Beleggers aan te spoor om die ontwikkeling van verskaffers van hernubare energie te finansier3.
tgt: Incentivise investors to fund renewable energy supplier development, Include the development of green hydrogen fuel in order to meet the international obligation of 5% blended fuel in aviation and maritime sectors by 2030.

src: Die ontwikkeling van groen waterstofbrandstof om die internasionale verpligting van 5% gemengde brandstof in die lugvaart- en maritieme sektore teen 2030 na te kom.
tgt: Digital Transformation of Government Roadmap Cabinet approved the Digital Transformation of Government Roadmap that aims to leverage technology to enhance public service delivery and government efficiency.

src: Kwessies wat aandag kry, sluit in: interdepartementele koördinasie, verouderde stelsels, oorvleuelende mandate en beperkte vaardighede of kapasiteit.
tgt: Issues which are being addressed include: interdepartmental coordination, outdated systems, overlapping mandates and limited skills or capacity.

src: Dit is ontwerp om ’n mens-gesentreerde digitale regering te bied, wat die behoeftes van die mense beter verstaan, veral kwesbare groepe, deur doeltreffende en effektiewe dienslewering te verseker.
tgt: It is designed to deliver a people-centered digital government that better understands the needs of the people, particularly vulnerable groups, by ensuring efficient and effective service delivery.

src: Konsep Wysigingswetsontwerp op die Agentskap vir die Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Waterhulpbroninfrastruktuur (NWRIA) Die Kabinet het die die voorlegging van die konsep NWRIA-wysigingswetsontwerp aan die Parlement goedgekeur.
tgt: Bills Draft South African National Water Resources Infrastructure Agency (NWRIA) Amendment Bill Cabinet approved the submission of the draft NWRIA Amendment Bill to Parliament.

src: Die wysigings hou verband met die notering van die NWRIA as 'n Bylae 2-maatskappy in staatsbesit.
tgt: The amendments relate to the listing of the NWRIA as a Schedule 2 state-owned company.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die toepaslike sekerheidsklarings.
tgt: Appointments All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant security clearances.

tgt: Mr Fhululani Peter Netshipale as Director-General in the Department of Socia Development.
