src: Wêreld Tuberkulose (TB) -dag Suid-Afrika het Wêreld TB-dag op 24 Maart 2025 gevier onder die tema: Ja!
tgt: Upcoming events World Tuberculosis (TB) Day South Africa commemorated World TB Day on 24 March 2025 under the theme “Yes!

src: Ek en jy kan TB beëindig: verbind, belê, lewer.
tgt: You and I Can End TB: Commit, Invest, Deliver”.

src: Die Kabinet is verheug dat die voorkoms van TB in Suid-Afrika in 2023 met 57% gedaal het en sodoende die Wêreldgesondheidsorganisasie se teiken om die voorkoms van TB van 2015 tot 2025 met 50% te verminder bereik het.
tgt: Cabinet is pleased that South Africa has reduced its TB incidence rate by 57% in 2023 to meet the World Health Organisation target of reducing TB incidence by 50% from 2015 to 2025.

src: Ons uitgebreide antiretrovirale program het bygedra tot beter TB-uitkomste, insluitend suksesvolle behandeling en minder sterftes.
tgt: Our large antiretroviral programme has contributed to better TB outcomes, including successful treatment and reduced mortality.

src: Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners om hul naaste kliniek of hospitaal te besoek vir gratis TB-sifting.
tgt: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to visit their nearest clinic or hospital for free TB screening.

src: Water- en Sanitasie-Indaba (27–28 Maart 2025).
tgt: Water and Sanitation Indaba (27 -28 March 2025) The Water and Sanitation Indaba 2025 will be held on 27 and 28 March 2025 at the Gallagher Estate under the theme: “Water Security and Provision.” The Indaba will advance commitments made in the 2025-2029 Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP) and Operation Vulindlela 2.0, as part of the Seventh Administration’s turnaround strategy for the water sector.

src: Die Water- en Sanitasie-Indaba 2025 word op 27 en 28 Maart 2025 by die Gallagher-landgoed gehou met die tema: Watersekerheid en -voorsiening.
tgt: The Indaba will also measure progress made in the Action Plan of the Water Summit 2024 and reflect on the Blue, Green and No Drop reports in December 2023.

src: Die Indaba sal verpligtinge wat in die 2025–2029 Meiumtermyn-ontwikkelingsplan (MTOP) en Operasie Vulindlela onderneem is, bevorder as deel van die Sewende Administrasie se omkeerstrategie vir die watersektor.
tgt: Women Economic Assembly (WECONA) The WECONA, which advocates for equal economic participation of women in the mainstream economy to curb the scourge of gender-based violence and femicide (GBVF), will take place on 28 March 2025.

src: Die nasionale inisiatief bring maatskappye, staatsdepartemente, organisasies en individue bymekaar om geleenthede te skep vir sakeondernemings in vrouebesit om aan die ekonomie deel te neem.
tgt: The national initiative brings together companies, government departments, organisations and individuals to create pathways for women-owned businesses to participate in the economy.

src: Suid-Afrika vier Vryheidsmaand in April om aan te sluit by Vryheidsdag wat op 27 April 2025 gevier word.
tgt: Freedom Month South Africa will celebrate Freedom Month in April and our Freedom Day on the 27th April 2025.

src: Vryheidsdag en Vryheidsmaand is betekenisvolle vierings vir ons nasie, omdat ons die stigting van 'n verenigde, nie-rassige, nie-seksistiese en demokratiese Suid-Afrika vier, asook ons verbintenis tot die waardes van menswaardigheid, nie-rassigheid en nie-seksisme, en die respek vir die oppergesag van die reg soos voorgestaan in ons Grondwet.
tgt: Freedom Day and Freedom Month are a momentous occasion to celebrate as one nation, as our country marks the founding of a united, non-racial, non-sexist and democratic South Africa that is committed to the the values of human dignity, non-racialism and non-sexism, and the respect of the rule of law as espoused in our Constitution .

src: Vanjaar se nasionale Vryheidsdagvierings vind in Mpumalanga plaas en sluit ook die land se jaarlange viering van 30 Jaar van Vryheid en Demokrasie af.
tgt: This year’s Freedom Day celebrations National event will take place in Mpumalanga and it will also mark the conclusion of the year-long celebration of 30 Years of Freedom and Democracy.

src: Die Afrika-beraad vir Kinders (3 – 7 April 2025).
tgt: The African Children’s Summit (3 – 7 April 2025) South Africa will host The African Children’s Summit (ACS) in Johannesburg from 3 to 7 April 2025.

src: Suid-Afrika is gasheer vir die Afrika-beraad vir Kinders wat van 3 tot 7 April 2025 in Johannesburg gehou word.
tgt: South Africa was selected as the location for the next Summit, with the Nelson Mandela Children’s Fund as the lead Civil Society Organisation.

src: 17de Internasionale Assosiasie van Vroueregters (IAWJ) se Tweejaarlikse KonferensieSuid-Afrika sal van 9 tot 12 April 2025 die 17de IAWJ-tweejaarlikse konferensie in Kaapstad aanbied onder die tema: "Veerkragtigheid: Vroue in Leierskap om GGGV te beëindig".
tgt: Presidential Oversight Visit to Nelson Mandela Bay Metro President Ramaphosa will undertake a Presidential Oversight Visit to Gqeberha on 15 and 16 April 2025 to assess progress on service delivery, challenges and opportunities for inclusive economic growth.

src: Die konferensie, wat deur die Suid-Afrikaanse afdeling van die IAWJ aangebied word, bring regters en ander regslui van regoor die wêreld bymekaar.
tgt: The Presidential Oversight Visit will be attended by leaders from all three spheres of government and provides an opportunity for government to interact with residents.

src: Presidensiële toesigbesoek aan die Nelson Mandelabaai-metroPresident Ramaphosa sal op 15 en 16 April 2025 'n presidensiële toesigbesoek aan Gqeberha onderneem om vordering met dienslewering, asook uitdagings en geleenthede vir inklusiewe ekonomiese groei te evalueer.
tgt: Africa Green Hydrogen Summit (12 - 13 June 2025) South Africa will host the inaugural Africa Green Hydrogen Summit from 12 to 13 June 2025.

src: Die presidensiële toesigbesoek sal deur leiers van al drie regeringsfere bygewoon word en bied 'n geleentheid vir die regering om met inwoners te kommunikeer.
tgt: The Africa Green Hydrogen Summit aims to promote regional collaboration, facilitate technology sharing, capacity-building and to enable market access in the green hydrogen sector.

src: Suid-Afrika se span vir hul uitnemende prestasie by die 2025 Spesiale Olimpiese Winterspele in Italië en die Wêreld Binnenshuise Atletiekkampioenskap in China.
tgt: Team SA at the World Athletics Indoor Championship in China, won as follows: a) Prudence Sekgodiso delivered a historic win by being the first South African woman to win a gold medal at the World Athletics Indoor Championships in the 800m.

src: Tydens die Spesiale Olimpiese Wêreldwinterspele, het Suid-Afrika een goue, drie silwer en twee brons medaljes ingepalm:a) Naledi Hlalele het ’n goue medalje vir figuurskaats verowerb) Bianca Basson en Kenneth Mokabo het silwer medaljes vir figuurskaats verowerc) Shane Bentley het silwer ingepalm vir kortbaan-snelskaats d) Tyrell Sykes het brons gewen vir figuurskaats en e) Shirnel Swarts het brons gewen vir kortbaan-snelskaats.
tgt: b) Akani Simbine for winning the bronze medal in the 60m final at the World Athletics Indoor Championships.

src: Die Suid-Afrikaanse span by die Wêreld Binnenshuise Atletiekkampioenskap in China, het as volg presteer: a) Prudence Sekgodiso het 'n geskiedkundige oorwinning behaal as die eerste Suid-Afrikaanse vrou om 'n goue medalje by die Binnenshuise Wêreldatletiekkampioenskap in die 800m te wen.
tgt: c) Magnificent efforts were also achieved by Cheswill Johnson in the men’s long jump and Chris van Niekerk in the shot put.

src: b) Akani Simbine het die die bronsmedalje in die 60m-eindstryd by die Wêreldatletiek Binnenshuise Kampioenskappe gewen.
tgt: Youth sprinting sensation Bayanda Walaza, who broke through the sub-10 barrier, clocking the fifth worlds-fastest junior 100 meter and South Africa’s Under-20 record at 9.99 seconds to win Gold at the Athletics Gauteng North Championships.

src: c) Cheswill Johnson het ook uitmuntend presteer in verspring vir mans en Chris van Niekerk in gewigstoot.
tgt: Rassie Erasmus for being named Coach of the Year for 2024 at the SA Rugby Awards.

src: Die jeugdige naelloopsensasie, Bayanda Walaza, wat deur die sub-10-grens gebreek het en die wêreld se vyfde vinnigste junior 100-meter en Suid-Afrika se o.20-rekord deur 9.99 sekondes aan te teken om goud by die Gauteng-`Noord Atletiekkampioenskappe te wen.
tgt: Springbok Cheslin Kolbe for becoming the first backline player since 2013 to win the 2024 SA Rugby Men’s Player of the Year.

src: Rassie Erasmus wat aangewys is as Afrigter van die Jaar vir 2024 by die SA Rugbytoekennings.
tgt: Nadine Roos for being honoured as SA Rugby Women’s Player of the Year for 2024, the second time in three years.

src: Springbok Cheslin Kolbe, wat as die SA Mans-rugbyspeler van die Jaar 2024 aangewys is.
tgt: Bafana Bafana for topping Group C in the 2026 FIFA World Cup Qualifiers with a 2-0 triumph over Lesotho at the full-to-capacity Peter Mokaba Stadium.

src: Bafana Bafana met hul top-posisie in Groep C in die kwalifiserende wedstryde vir die 2026 FIFA Wêreldbeker met 'n 2-0-triomf oor Lesotho in die stampvol Peter Mokaba-stadion in Polokwane.
tgt: South African singer Tyla Laura Seethal, popularly known as Tyla, named World Artist of the Year at the iHeartRadio Music Awards.

src: Suid-Afrikaanse sangeres Tyla Laura Seethal, algemeen bekend as Tyla, wat as Wêreld Uitvoerende Kunstenaar van die Jaar aangewys is by die iHeartRadio Music Awards.
tgt: Cabinet expressed condolences to the friends and family of: Ms Yolanda Nyembezi, popularly known as Yallunder, was a multifaceted musician who captivated audiences with her rich voice and passionate artistry.

src: MegevoelDie Kabinet dra sy meegevoel oor aan die vriende en naasbestaandes van: MeYolanda Nyembezi, algemeen bekend as Yallunder, ’n veelsydige musikant wat gehore bekoor het met haar ryk stem en passievolle optredes.
tgt: Mr Ashwin Trikamjee, President of the South African Hindu Maha Sabha and Chairperson of the National Religious Leaders Forum.

src: Hy was ’n menseregteprokureur en was ook instrumenteel in die ontwikkeling van sokker in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: He was also instrumental in the development of football (soccer) in South Africa.

src: As 'n anti-apartheidsaktivis het hy die Durban Sentraal-komponent van die Natalse Indiese Kongres gelei.
tgt: As an Anti-Apartheid activist, he led the Durban Central component of the Natal Indian Congress.

src: Die ses gemeenskapspatroleerders wat in ’n aanval by die Marry Meinformele nedersetting in Soshanguve gesterf het.
tgt: The six (6) community patrollers who were killed and sends well wishes for speedy recovery to the other six (6) who are injured at the Marry Me informal settlement in Soshanguve.

src: .1 Op 7 Me 2025 het President Cyril Ramaphosa die tweede fase van Operasie Vulindlela (OV Fase II) van stapel gestuur.
tgt: Issues In The Environment Economy.1 Operation Vulindlela Phase II.1 On 7 May 2025, President Cyril Ramaphosa launched Phase II of Operation Vulindlela (OV Phase II), the government reforms programme aimed at driving inclusive economic growth that creates jobs.

src: Dit is die regering se hervormingsprogram wat daarop gemik is om inklusiewe ekonomiese groei aan te dryf en werksgeleenthehede te skep.
tgt: .2 The OV Phase II will oversee the conclusion of reforms which started in the 6th administration in the areas of energy, water, logistics, and telecommunications, and introduces new focus areas in the local government system to improve the delivery of basic services, and in spatial planning.

src: .2 Die OV Fase II sal toesien dat die hervormings wat in die 6de Administrasie ten opsigte van energie, water, logistiek, en telekommunikasie begin is, voltooi word.
tgt: Government Business Partnership.1 Cabinet welcomed the outcomes of the progress review meeting of the Government Business Partnership initiatives.

src: Nuwe fokus-areas in die plaaslike regeringstelsel sal ook bekendgestel word om die lewering van basiese dienste en ruimtelike beplanning te verbeter.
tgt: The partnership focuses on supporting the implementation of key reforms and priority initiatives aimed at driving economic growth and job creation.2 Some of the progress made include in development of the national wheeling framework, Transnet performance improvement, electronic travel authorisation visa.

src: Die vennootskappe fokus daarop om die implementering van sleutel hervormings en prioriteitsinisiatiewe wat daarop gemik is om ekonomiese groei en werkskepping aan te dryf, te ondersteun.2 Die vordering wat gemaak is behels ontwikkeling van die nasionale wieleraamwerk, die verbetering van Transnet se prestasie en die elektroniese reismagtiging-visum.
tgt: .2 The implementation of the Transformation Fund will advance our constitutional commitment to economic redress and transformation as part of reversing the skewed policies of the apartheid era.3 Comments may be sent to the DTIC and contacts details will be found on their website WEBTOKEQuarterly Labour Force Survey.1 Cabinet noted Statistics South Africa (Stats SA) Labour Force Survey, which shows a rise in unemployment to 32.9% in the first quarter of 2025 from 31.9% in the final quarter of last year.

src: .1 Die Kabinet het kennis geneem van Statistieke Suid-Afrika (Stats SA) se ondersoek na die arbeidsmag, wat aandui dat werkloosheid van 31.9% in die laaste kwartaaal van verlede jaar tot 32.9% in die eerste kwartaal van 2025 gestyg het.
tgt: International Working visit to Côte d’Ivoire.1 Cabinet welcomed the President’s Working Visit to Côte d’Ivoire which coincided with 12th edition of the Africa CEO Forum on 12 and 13 May 2025, to consolidate existing bilateral relations between the two countries.

src: .2 In vyf van 10 nywerhede wat deur Stats SA gevolg is, het werksgeleenthede toegeem, veral in vervoer en finansies, terwyl die grootste verlies aan werksgeleenthede in die handel en konstruksiesektore aangedui is.3 Die Kabinet bly daartoe verbind om ekonomiese groei te bevorder wat werksgeleenthede skep.
tgt: President Ramaphosa held a bilateral meeting with His Excellency Mr Alassane Ouattara, President of the Republic of Côte d’Ivoire to discuss matters of mutual interest and both of them committed to strengthening bilateral ties and to increase trade between the two countries G-2.1 South Africa continues to host a series of high-level G20 group meetings in preparation for the G20 Summit in November 2025 under the theme: “Solidarity, Equality, and Sustainability.” The following meetings have been held during the month of May: .1 The G20 Financial Inclusion and Women Empowerment Conference on 6 to 9 May 2025 in the North West, sought to influence future G20 policy through the introduction of a Guidelines Framework for Mainstreaming Women’s Priorities, ensuring women’s financial empowerment remains central to global institutional and economic reforms.

src: .2 Hierbenewens is Suid-Afrika ook in Remitly se Big 5 Persoonlikheidstoets as die wêreld se vriendelikste nasie aangewys, wat die warmte en gasvryheid van Suid-Afrikaners beklemtoon, terwyl die Stad Kaapstad as die 5de gewildste stad op die wêreldwye ranglys aangewys is.
tgt: .4 The Second Tourism Working Group Meeting held from 11 to 13 May 2025 in KwaZulu-Natal deliberated on the G20 tourism priorities to drive sustainable tourism growth and the development of a G20 Tourism Action Plan..5 The Second Task Force 1 Meeting: Inclusive Economic Growth, Industrialisation, Employment, and Reduced Inequality was held virtually from 14 to 15 May 2025.

src: Die volgende vergaderings is gedurende Me gehou: Die G20 se Konferensie oor Finansiële Insluiting en Vrouebemagtiging van 6 tot 9 Me 2025 in Noord-Wes was daarop gemik om toekomstige G20-beleid te beïnvloed deur 'n riglynraamwerk vir die hoofstroom van vroue se prioriteite te vestig, en om te verseker dat die finansiële bemagtiging van vroue sentraal bly in globale institusionele en ekonomiese hervormings.
tgt: Governance Digital Transformation Roadmap of the South African Government.1 Cabinet welcomed the launch of the Digital Transformation Roadmap of the South African Government which is part of government’s plans to improve service delivery and drive economic growth through investments in digital innovations.2 The Roadmap, which is part of OV Phase II, sets out a focused path to modernise delivery of Government services through investment in digital public infrastructure.

src: Dit het daarop gefokus om die prioriteite van Agenda 2063, die VN se Volhoubare Ontwikkelingsteikens en die beskerming van erfenis as ’n mensereg te belyn.3 Die derde vergadering van die Gesondheidswerksgroep, wat virtueel op 8 en 9 Me 2025 gehou is, het gefokus op gesondheidsorgwerkers, wat die fondament vir gesondheidstelsels en van universele gesondheidsdekking, gesondheidsveiligheid, gelykheid en inklusiewe groei is.
tgt: Amongst those arrested on allegations of rape from 05 May - 11 May 2025, are a SAPS trainer, an Inkosi from KwaZulu Natal and a 15-year old boy in Mpumalanga.2 Additionally, 148 suspects were arrested for attempted murder, 256 suspects were arrested for dealing in drugs, 2841 suspects were arrested for being in possession of drugs and 86 hijacked and stolen vehicles were recovered.

src: Die tweede vergadering van die Toerismewerkgroep, wat van 11 tot 13 Me 2025 in KwaZulu-Natal gehou is, het besin oor die G20-toerismeprioriteite om volhoubare toerismegroei en die ontwikkeling van 'n G20-toerisme-aksieplan te bevorder.5 Die Tweede Taakspan 1 se vergadering oor inklusiewe ekonomiese groei, industrialisasie, indiensneming, en verminderde ongelykheid is virtueel van 14 tot 15 Me 2025 gehou.
tgt: Furthermore, 74 explosives mostly used in illegal mining and cash in transit robberies were seized by North-West police.

src: .3 Boonop ondersteun die Suid-Afrikaanse Polisiediens se statistieke oor plaasverwante misdade nie bewerings van geweldsmisdaad of volksmoord wat op boere in die algemeen of enige rassegroep gemik is nie.4 Die Kabinet weerlê die narratief deur die regering van die Verenigde State van Amerika en bly oop vir konstruktiewe betrokkenheid om 'n beter en gemeenskaplike begrip oor hierdie sake te deel.
tgt: Fight Against GBVF.1 Cabinet noted the decision of the National Prosecuting Authority (NPA) to appeal the acquittal of Timothy Omotoso and his two co-accused in the Eastern Cape Division of the High Court in Gqeberha.

src: Die plan identifiseer 19 fokusareas en spesifieke tasbare, lewerbare doelwitte wat in die 90 dae uitgevoer moet word met die doel om die opwaartse neiging van GGGV in die land te stuit en om te keer.3 Die Nasionale Gesamentlike Operasionele en Intelligensiestruktuur (NatJoint) het 'n prioriteitskomitee gestig wat uit agt spesifieke werkstrome bestaan.
tgt: Substantial progress has been made to date, including unblocking of blocked sewer lines, replacement of collapsed sewer pipelines, refurbishment of pumpstations and assisting the munipality with vehicles, trucks, TLBs and security for its water and sanitation infrastructure.

src: Die prioriteitskomitee het ses dringende en treffende tussenkomste geïdentifiseer wat binne die 90 dae geïmplementeer moet word.
tgt: This work has resulted in major reduction in sewer spillage in communities of Emfuleni as well as an improvement in the levels of effluent from the wastewater treatment works.

src: Kommunikasie, vennootskappe en gemeenskapsmobilisering om seker te maak dat die regering in sy geheel, sowel as die burgerlike samelewing en burgers saamwerk vir beter uitkomste teen die GGGV-plaag en Die benutting van hulpbronne, finansieel sowel as menslik, om te verseker dat ons as 'n samelewing beter georganiseerd is om die GGGV-plaag te beveg.
tgt: Key policy proposals include creating professional and quality policing, providing efficient and effective policing service delivery, improving legitimacy and trust between communities and the police, and building a strong and ethical leadership, management and governance architecture within the SAPComprehensive Civil Aviation Policy Cabinet approved the draft Comprehensive Civil Aviation Policy for public comments.

src: Beduidende vordering is tot op hede gemaak, insluitend die oopmaak van geblokkeerde rioolpype, die vervanging van ingestorte rioolpype, die opknapping van pompstasies en bystand aan munisipaliteite met voertuie, vragmotors, rioolpompe en sekuriteit vir sy water- en sanitasie-infrastruktuur.
tgt: Key pillars of the strategy focus on exploration and beneficiation investment localisation streamlining regulations, fostering innovation in mining technologies building workforce skills improving transport and logistics infrastructure, and incentivising investment.

src: Hierdie werk het gelei tot 'n groot vermindering in rioolstorting in Emfuleni se gemeenskappe, asook 'n verbetering in die vlakke van afvalwater van die afvalwaterbehandelingswerke.
tgt: The strategy further recognises the importance of collaboration with other countries to develop the potential of South Africa’s critical minerals sector.

src: Wetsontwerpe Wysigingswetsontwerp op Algemene (Familie) Wette van 2025 Die Kabinet het die indiening van die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Algemene (Familie) Wette van 2025 aan die Parlement goedgekeur.
tgt: International Cooperation in Criminal Matters Amendment Bill, 2025 Cabinet approved the submission of the International Co-operation in Criminal Matters Amendment Bill to Parliament.

src: Die wysigings is daarop gemik om die grondwetlikheid van familiewette te versterk en stel wysigings voor aan die Egskeidingswet, 1979 (Wet 70 van 1979), die Wet op Huweliksgoedere, 1984 (Wet 84 van 1984) en die Wet op Bemiddeling in Sekere Egskeidingsaangeleenthede, 1987 (Wet 24 van 1987).
tgt: The purpose of the Bill is to amend the International Co-operation in Criminal Matters Act (Act 75 of 1996) to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of international legal cooperation in criminal matters.

src: Die Wetsontwerp poog om die grondwetlike regte van partye by huwelike buite gemeenskap van goedere te beskerm, en veral vroueregte, gelykheid, toegang tot howe en die regte van kinders.
tgt: This Bill will strengthen the processes and mechanisms for international cooperation in criminal matters, such as evidence gathering and sentence execution, between South Africa and other countries.

src: Die Wetsontwerp op Uitlewering Die Kabinet het die voorlegging van die Wetsontwerp op Uitlewering aan die Parlement vir verdere verwerking goedgekeur.
tgt: The Bill will also address legal issues related to extradition and the confiscation and transfer of proceeds of crime.

src: Die Wetsontwerp beoog om die huidige verouderde Wet op Uitlewering, 1962 (Wet 67 van 1962), te wysig.
tgt: Mineral Resources Development Bill of 2025 Cabinet approved the publication of the Mineral Resources Development Bill of 2025 for public comments.

src: Die Wetsontwerp beoog om die wetlike raamwerk te versterk om uitvoering te kan gee aan die uitlewering van mense wat beskuldig is of skuldig bevind word aan misdaad na en van Suid-Afrika, en buitelandse state en internasionale entiteite.
tgt: The Bill aims to enhance investor confidence by removing red tape and providing regulatory certainty to attract and retain investment.

src: Dit verduidelik die rol van landdroste in uitleweringsprosedures en maak voorsiening vir 'n voorlopige inhegtenisneming en die oorgawe van 'n persoon wat deur 'n internasionale entiteit gesoek word oor internasionale misdade soos volksmoord, oorlogsmisdade en misdaad teen die mensdom.
tgt: The Bill aims to address key regulatory gaps, streamline licensing processes, ensure equitable distribution of mining benefits, promote local processing and manufacturing industries by ensuring that more raw minerals are transformed into higher-value products within South Africa.

src: Wysigingswetsontwerp op Internasionale Samewerking in Kriminele Sake, 2025 Die Kabinet het die voorlegging van die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Internasionale Samewerking in Strafregtelike Sake aan die Parlement goedgekeur.
tgt: The Bill introduces a licensing regime for artisanal and small-scale mining operations, thereby enhancing economic growth.

src: Die doel van die Wetsontwerp is om die Wet op Internasionale Samewerking in Strafregtelike Sake (Wet 75 van 1996) te wysig om die doeltreffendheid van internasionale regsamewerking in strafregtelike sake te verbeter.
tgt: Furthermore, the amendments seek to strengthen regulatory measures to combat unlawful activities while ensuring clear prohibitions and enforcement mechanisms in relation to illegal mining.

src: Hierdie Wetsontwerp sal die prosesse en meganismes vir internasionale samewerking in strafregtelike sake, soos die insameling van bewysstukke en die uitvoering van vonnisse tussen Suid-Afrika en ander lande versterk.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant security clearances.

src: Dr Sabelo Siyabonga Sandile Buthelezi as DG by die Department Gesondheid (verlenging van kontrak).
tgt: Mr Malemolla David Makhura and Ms Lynette Milne.

src: MnrTakalani Lucky Ramaru as Adjunk Direkteur-Generaal: Burgerlike Toesig en Strategiese Vennootskappe by die Departement van Burgerlike Sekretariaat vir Polisiediens.
tgt: EVENTUPCOMING CONFERENCES.1 Hosting of the 27th International Criminal Police Organisation (INTERPOL) African Reginal Conference a) Cabinet approved for the SAPS to host the 27th INTERPOL African Regional Conference from 27 to 29 August 2025. b) INTERPOL currently has 196 member states and hosting the African Regional Conference will assist South Africa to build closer working relationships with other law-enforcement agencies on the continent.

src: Gebeure Komende Konferensies Aanbied van die 27ste Internasionale Kriminele Polisie Organisasie (INTERPOL) Afrika Streekskonferensie a) Die Kabinet het goedgekeur dat die SAPD die 27ste INTERPOL Afrika-streekskonferensie van 27 tot 29 Augustus 2025 aanbied.
tgt: Hosting of the 96th INTERPOL Annual General Assembly (AGA) in South Africaa) Cabinet approved the hosting of the INTERPOL AGA in South Africa in 2028 and onwards.

src: b) INTERPOL het tans 196 lidlande en die aanbied van die Afrika-streekskonferensie sal Suid-Afrika help om nouer werksverhoudinge met ander wetstoepassingsagentskappe op die vasteland te smee.
tgt: b) Hosting this INTERPOL AGA presents South Africa with an opportunity to assert its leadership both regionally and internationally.

src: c) Die aanbied van hierdie konferensie gee Suid-Afrika die geleentheid om met lande op die vasteland van Afrika te skakel oor kritieke kwessies rakende misdaad.
tgt: Furthermore, hosting the AGA will be a significant step towards reinforcing South Africa’s commitment to regional and international cooperation in the fight against crime.

src: Hierdie samewerking het die potensiaal om 'n ooreenkoms te bewerkstellig oor 'n streeksreaksie op toenemende bedreigings van transnasionale georganiseerde misdaad en terrorisme.
tgt: c) The hosting of the AGA is testimony to the country’s commitment to being a responsible global nation committed to fighting all forms of crime.

src: Na verwagting sal ongeveer 550 senior wetstoepassingsbeamptes van 54 lande die geleentheid by woon, wat tot ekonomiese aktiwiteit sal bydra.
tgt: State of readiness for the Sustainable Infrastructure Development Symposium South Africa (SIDSSA) 2025 a) Cabinet was appraised about the state of readiness for the convening of the SIDSSA, an infrastructure investment summit that brings together a broad spectrum of stakeholders, including investors financial institutions, policymakers and other critical partners to drive South Africa’s infrastructure investment.

src: a) Die Kabinet het goedgekeur dat Suid-Afrika die INTERPOL JAV in 2028 en daarna aanbied.
tgt: The conference brought together heads of anti-corruption agencies from across African Commonwealth countries.2 South Africa was elected to chair the Association of Heads of Anti-Corruption Agencies in Commonwealth Africa for the 2025-2026 term.

src: Internasionaal.1 SA-VSA-betrekkinge.1 Die Kabinet het die herstel van strategiese verhoudings tussen Suid-Afrika (SA) en die Verenigde State (VSA) tydens President Cyril Ramaphosa se werksbesoek aan die Verenigde State van Amerika verwelkom.2 Die SA- en VSA-spanne sal die besonderhede van die handelsooreenkoms tussen SA en die VSA finaliseer.
tgt: Issues In The Environment International.1 SA-US Relations.1 Cabinet welcomed the reset of strategic relationships between South Africa (SA) and the United States (US) during President Cyril Ramaphosa’s working visit to the United States of America.2 The SA and US teams will finalise the details of the trade deal between the SA and USafe to emphasise that the objectives that SA had set for the trip have been met.3 Cabinet looks forward to the continued participation of the US administration in the G20, including the possible attendance of President Trump to the G20 Leaders Summit.

src: Dit kan met veiligheid beklemtoon word dat die doelwitte wat SA vir die reis gestel het, bereik is.3 Die Kabinet sien uit na die VSA-administrasie se voortgesette deelname aan die G20, insluitend die moontlikheid dat President Trump die G20-leiersberaad sal bywoon.
tgt: South Africa – France Relations.1 Cabinet welcomed the working visit by Deputy President Shipokosa Paulus Mashatile’s that strengthened relations between South Africa and France.

src: Suid-Afrika-Frankryk-betrekkinginge.1 Die Kabinet het Adjunkpresident Shipokosa Paulus Mashatile se werksbesoek, wat die betrekkinge tussen Suid-Afrika en Frankryk versterk het, verwelkom.
tgt: The Deputy President and the SA delegation also attended the SA-France Investment Conference with a view to improving investments by French Companies into South Africa and vice versa, and also establishing partnerships between South African and French companies in joint investments through the African Continental Free Trade Area.

src: Die Adjunkpresident en die SA-afvaardiging het ook die SA-Frankryk Beleggingskonferensie bygewoon met die doel om beleggings deur Franse maatskappye in Suid-Afrika en andersom te verbeter, sowel as om vennootskappe tussen Suid-Afrikaanse en Franse maatskappye in gesamentlike beleggings deur die Afrika-kontinentale vryhandelsgebied te vestig.
tgt: Economy.1 National Budget.1 Cabinet affirmed its support for the 2025 National Budget tabled by the Minister of Finance on Wednesday, 21 May 2025, which details key spending priorities over the next three years within the country’s fiscal envelope.2 The National Budget has demonstrated our commitment to fiscal discipline.

src: Ekonomie.1 Nasionale Begroting.1 Die Kabinet het sy steun bevestig vir die 2025 Nasionale Begroting wat op Woensdag 21 Me 2025 deur die Minister van Finansies ter tafel gelê is.
tgt: We have shown that we are steering the economy in a way that looks after the most vulnerable in our society, while investing in economic activity through investment of R1-trillion towards infrastructure over the coming three years.3 This pro poor budget, means on every Rand, 61 cents of consolidated, non-interest expenditure funds will be spent on free basic services like electricity, water, education, healthcare, affordable housing, as well as social grants for those in need.

src: Ons het gewys dat ons die ekonomie op 'n manier stuur wat na die kwesbaarstes in ons samelewing omsien, terwyl ons in ekonomiese aktiwiteit belê deur 'n belegging van R1 triljoen in infrastruktuur oor die volgende drie jaar.3 Hierdie begroting waarin die armes se behoeftes in ag geneem word, beteken dat op elke Rand, 61 sent van gekonsolideerde, nie-rentedraende uitgawefondse aan gratis basiese dienste bestee sal word, soos elektrisiteit, water, onderwys, gesondheidsorg, bekostigbare behuising en aan maatskaplike toelaes vir mense in nood.
tgt: Sustainable Infrastructure Development Symposium South Africa (SIDSSA) 2025.1 Cabinet welcomed the successful conclusion of the Sustainable Infrastructure Development Symposium South Africa (SIDSSA) 2025 held in Cape Town from 25 to 27 May 2025, which saw the unveiling of the country’s second edition of the construction book: “A Repository Of Funded Infrastructure Projects” for procurement in 2025/2026.

src: Simposium oor Volhoubare Infrastruktuurontwikkeling Suid-Afrika (SIDSSA) 2025.1 Die Kabinet het die suksesvolle verloop van die Simposium oor Volhoubare Infrastruktuurontwikkeling Suid-Afrika (SIDSSA) 2025, wat van 25 tot 27 Me 2025 in Kaapstad gehou is, verwelkom.
tgt: .2 During the symposium, the new top seven (7) infrastructure project priorities, stemming from Bid Window 1 for project preparation, were announced, uplifting our nation’s drive to use infrastructure to grow the economy, create jobs and build sustainable communities.3 The total value of projects currently in construction in the country is over R313.5 billion, while our energy sector infrastructure project pipeline includes R180 billion of embedded generation investment.

src: Die land se tweede uitgawe van die konstruksieboek “A Repository of Funded Infrastructure Projects” is bekendgestel vir 2025/2026.2 Tydens die simposium is die jongste top sewe (7) prioriteite vir infrastruktuurprojekte, wat uit Bodvenster 1 voortgespruit het vir projekvoorbereiding, aangekondig.
tgt: Justice, Crime Prevention and Security Crime Statistics.1 The release of the fourth-quarter crime statistics for the 2024/2025 financial year confirms that crime remains a societal issue in South Africa which affects everyone.

src: Hoewel die statistieke 'n afname in sommige kategorieë aangedui, insluitend moord, het kommersiële misdade, seksuele oortredings, insluitend verkragting en ander kontak seksuele oortredings, egter toegeneem.2 Ons prys die SAPD vir die vinnige ondersoek en inhegtenisnemings in gevalle van geslagsgebaseerde geweld en vrouemoord (GGGV).
tgt: However, commercial crimes, sexual offences, including rape and other contact sexual offences have increased.

src: Die SAPD het reeds verdagtes in hegtenis geneem vir die moord op Olorato Mongale, 'n student van Wits Universiteit wie se liggaam gevind is nadat sy met haar vermeende moordenaar uitgegaan het.
tgt: .2 We commend the SAPS for the speedy work in investigating and making arrests in cases of GBVThe SAPS have already made arrests of suspects in the murder of Olorato Mongale, a Wits University student whose body was found after going on a date with her alleged killer.

src: Ons betuig die regering se diepste meegevoel aan haar familie en vriende.3 Die regering verwelkom Regter Nathan Erasmus se uitspraak in die Wes-Kaapse Hooggeregshof, wat Kelly Smith, Jacquen Appollis en Steveno van Rhyn tot lewenslange tronkstraf gevonnis het vir mensehandel, met 'n bykomende 10 jaar vir ontvoering wat verband hou met die verdwyning van die sesjarige Joshlin Smith.
tgt: We extend governments deepest condolences to her family and friends.3 Government welcomes the judgement handed down by Judge Nathan Erasmus in the Western Cape High Court, sentencing Kelly Smith, Jacquen Appollis, and Steveno van Rhyn to life imprisonment for human trafficking, with an additional 10 years for kidnapping related to the disappearance of six-year-old Joshlin Smith.

src: Hoewel hierdie vonnisoplegging 'n mate van geregtigheid bring, is dit 'n bittersoet oomblik.
tgt: While this sentencing brings a measure of justice, it is a bittersweet moment.

src: Ons bly vasberade in ons verbintenis om die waarheid te ontbloot en om te verseker dat wetstoepassers steeds elke moontlike leidraad opvolg om Joshlin te vind.
tgt: We remain steadfast in our commitment to uncovering the truth and ensuring that law enforcement continues to pursue every possible lead to find Joshlin.

src: Om kinders te beskerm is 'n nasionale prioriteit.
tgt: The protection of children is a national priority.

src: Ons sal voortgaan om ons wette, vennootskappe en gemeenskapspogings te versterk om te verseker dat elke kind in Suid-Afrika veilig is, gewaardeer word en teen mishandeling beskerm word.4 Die regering sal voortgaan om ons stryd teen misdaad te verskerp deur nuwe beamptes te werf en op te lei en om weer gespesialiseerde misdaadbestrydingseenhede in plek te stel.
tgt: We will continue to strengthen our laws, partnerships, and community efforts to ensure that every child in South Africa is safe, valued, and shielded from harm.4 As government we will continue to intensify our fight against crime by recruiting and training new officers and reintroducing specialised crime-fighting units.

src: Dit sluit in dat ons wetstoepassers met moderne gereedskap en opleiding sal toerus, wat noodsaaklik is om vandag se komplekse misdaaduitdagings die hoof te bied.
tgt: This includes equipping our law enforcement agencies with modern tools and training which are required to tackle today’s complex crime challenges.

src: Die stryd teen onwettige immigrasie.1 Die bekendstelling van Operasie Nuwe Besem is die jongste tegnologiegedrewe inisiatief deur die Departement van Binnelandse Sake.
tgt: Combating illegal immigration.1 The launch of Operation New Broom is the latest technology-driven initiative by the Department of Home Affairs which serves to combat illegal immigration demonstrates government’s commitment to fight crime and maintain the rule of law.

src: Dit is daarop gerig om onwettige immigrasie te bestry, wat die regering se verbintenis demonstreer om misdaad aan te pak en die oppergesag van die reg te handhaaf.
tgt: This initiative uses technology to arrest, convict and deport illegal immigrants from the country.2 The operation, has in its first phase, led to the arrest of 25 suspects who occupied land illegally in District 6, Cape Town.

src: Hierdie inisiatief gebruik tegnologie om onwettige immigrante in hegtenis te neem, skuldig te bevind en uit die land te deporteer.2 In sy eerste fase het die operasie gelei tot die inhegtenisneming van 25 verdagtes wat onwettig grond in Distrik 6, Kaapstad, beset het.
tgt: The initiative uses biometric technology to verify the immigration status of suspects, eliminating the risk of fraudulent documents and making it easier for the courts to conclude cases.

src: Bestuur.1 Regering van Nasionale Eenheid (RNE).1 Vandag is presies 'n jaar sedert die nasionale en provinsiale verkiesings plaasgevind het.
tgt: Governance.1 Government of National Unity (GNU).1 Today marks exactly a year after the National and Provincial elections whose outcome meant that there was no political party that won outright majority.

src: Die uitslae het aangedui dat geen politieke party 'n volstrekte meerderheid behaal het nie, wat heelwat onsekerheid vir Suid-Afrika en haar mense geskep het.
tgt: The period created much uncertainty for South Africa and her people.

src: Vandag is ons as Regering van Nasionale Eenheid (RNE) trots dat ons binne 14 dae 'n regering kon vorm dit is 'n uitstekende prestasie gegewe die tyd wat sommige eerstewêreldlande geneem het om 'n regering in soortgelyke omstandighede te vorm.2 Hierdie mylpaal simboliseer 'n hernieude verbintenis tot stabiliteit, samewerking en inklusiewe regering.
tgt: Today as Government of National Unity (GNU), we are proud that we were able to form a government within 14 days, an outstanding achievement given the period taken by some first world countries to form a government in similar situations.2 This milestone symbolises a renewed commitment to stability, collaboration and inclusive governance.

src: Die geskiedkundige vennootskap, wat 10 politieke partye insluit, het gedemonstreer dat hulle die nasie eerste gestel het deur die behoeftes van Suid-Afrika en sy mense te prioritiseer.
tgt: This historic partnership, comprising 10 political parties, has demonstrated the power of putting the nation first by prioritising the needs of South Africa and its people.

src: Deur opbouende dialoog en kompromie het die partye saamgewerk om dringende kwessies die hoof te bied, wat 'n gevoel van eenheid en gedeelde doelwitte bevorder het ondanks ons verskillende ideologiese oortuigings
tgt: Through constructive dialogue and compromise, the parties have worked together to address pressing issues, fostering a sense of unity and shared purpose despite our different ideological outlook.

src: Opdaterings aan die Kabinet.
tgt: Updates to cabinet.

src: Voorbereidings vir die G20-beraad Plek waar die G20-leiersberaad plaasvindDie G20-leiersberaad sal in November 2025 by die NASREC-eksposentrum in Johannesburg plaasvind.
tgt: G20 Summit Preparations G20 Leaders Summit VenueThe G20 Leaders Summit will take place in NASREC Expo Centre in Johannesburg in November 2025.

src: NASREC (die Nasionale Landbou-, Sport- en Ontspanningsentrum) is in 1984 gebou tydens die hoogtepunt van apartheid.
tgt: NASREC (the National Agricultural, Sports and Recreation Events Centre) was built in 1984 at the height of Apartheid segregation.

src: Die ligging tussen Johannesburg en die Suidwestelike Dorpsgebiede, nou eenvoudig bekend as SOWETO, het die grens van die stad verteenwoordig, met sy bewegingsbeperkings dit was die begin van Soweto, wat as 'n reservoir van goedkoop swart arbeid gedien het.
tgt: Its location between Johannesburg and the South-Western-Townships, now simply known as SOWETO, represented the boundary of the city, with its movement restrictions and the beginning of Soweto, which served as a reservoir of black cheap labour.

src: Die demokratiese regering gaan voort om die NASREC-distrik te ontwikkel om as 'n brug te dien teen die apartheidsruimtelike beplanningskloof wat die ontwikkelde en onontwikkelde Suid-Afrika geskei het, Dit bly 'n ware Suid-Afrikaanse karakterisering van twee lande in een.
tgt: The democratic government continues to develop the NASREC precinct to serve as a bridge against the Apartheid spatial planning divide that separated the developed and undeveloped South Africa, which remains a true South African characterisation of two countries in one.

src: Vandag word ontwikkelings rondom die NASREC-distrik as 'n slimstad aangebied, wat ook Soccer City (FNB-stadion) huisves, Suid-Afrika se nasionale stadion wat baie simbolies is.
tgt: Today, developments around the NASREC precinct as a smart city, which also hosts Soccer City (FNB stadium), South Africa’s national stadium which is very symbolic.

src: Soccer City, wat die eerste sokkerwêreldbekerwedstryd op Afrika-bodem aangebied het, is onder die top 20 grootste stadions ter wêreld.
tgt: Soccer City which hosted the first soccer World Cup match on African soil is amongst the top 20 largest stadiums in the world.

src: Daarom dra die aanbieding van die G20-leiersberaad, soos baie ander geleenthede in die NASREC-distrik, steeds by tot NASREC as 'n simbool van ruimtelike integrasie na 'n gelyke Suid-Afrika.
tgt: Therefore, the hosting of the G20 Leaders Summit, like many other events, in the NASREC precinct continues to contribute to making NASREC a symbol of spatial integration towards an equal South Africa.

src: G20 Sosiale BeraadSuid-Afrika sal binnekort die plan en program vir sy G20 Sosiale Beraad onthul.
tgt: G20 Social SummitSouth Africa will soon unveil its G20 Social Summit plan and programme.

src: Die G20 Sosiale Beraad-inisiatief is deel van die program wat uit die Brasiliaanse G20-inisiatiewe aanvaar is.
tgt: The G20 Social Summit initiative is part of the programme adopted from the Brazil G20 Initiatives, which created a platform for social movements and civil society organisations who are impacted by geopolitical and macroeconomic decisions made by leaders of the powerful Group of 20 countries.

src: G20-beraad – voorbereidingsvergaderingsAs deel van die voortgesette inhoudvoorbereidings vir die G20-beraad en terwyl ons besluite oorweeg wat in ag geneem moet word tydens die G20-leiersberaad, is die volgene G20-vergaderings gehou: a) Die tweede vergadering van die Globale Vennootskap vir Finansiële Insluiting wat in Mpumalanga gehou is, het beraadslaag oor die belangrikheid om finansiële insluiting te bevorder deur finansiële ondersteuning aan mikro-, klein en mediumgrootte ondernemings te bied, asook hoe om tegnologie ten beste te gebruik om onderbediende bevolkings in te sluit.
tgt: G20 Summit Preparatory MeetingsAs part of the on-going G20 content preparations as we work towards decisions that must be considered at the G20 Leaders Summit, the following G20 meetings were held: a) The Second Global Partnership for Financial Inclusion Meeting held in Mpumalanga - deliberated on the importance of advancing financial inclusion by providing financial support to micro, small, and medium enterprises as well as how best to use technology to include underserved populations.

src: b) Die W20-aanvangsvergadering, wat deur die Raad vir Geesteswetenskaplike Navorsing (RGN) en sy vennote in Kaapstad aangebied is, het 'n geleentheid vir verskeie taakspanne gebied om kwessies te bespreek wat vroue raak, insluitend die rol van vroue in die ekonomie, GGGV, toegang tot onderwys en gesondheidsgelykheid.
tgt: b) The W20 Inception Meeting hosted by the Human Sciences Research Council (HSRC) and its partners in Cape Town - provided an opportunity for various task teams to discuss issues that affect women, including the role of women in the economy, GBVF, access to education and health equity.

src: c) Die derde vergadering van die infrastruktuurwerkgroep, wat in Mpumalanga gehou is, het gefokus op produktiewe oorgrens-infrastruktuur, die opgradering van volhoubare belegging deur gemengde finansiering en die bou van belêbare projekpyplyne.
tgt: c) The Third Infrastructure Working Group Meeting held in Mpumalanga - focused on Productive cross-border infrastructure, scaling sustainable investment via blended finance and building investable project pipelines.

src: d) Die tweede vergadering van die G20-inisiatief oor bio-ekonomie wat in Mpumalanga gehou is, het die benutting van die bio-ekonomie om ekonomiese groei, volhoubare ontwikkeling, omgewingsbeskerming en sosiale gelykheid aan te pak, bespreek.
tgt: d) The Second meeting of the G20 Initiative on Bio-Economy held in Mpumalanga - deliberated on leveraging the bioeconomy to address economic growth, sustainable development, environmental protection and social equity.

src: e) Die vergaderings van die G20-navorsing- en innovasiegroep en die samewerkingsgroep, wat in Mpumalanga gehou is, het die vordering wat met die tien lewerbare doelwitte in die eerste vergadering gemaak is, hersien.
tgt: e) The G20 Research and Innovation Working Group & Engagement Group Meetings held in Mpumalanga - reviewed the progress made on the ten deliverables that were agreed upon during the first meeting and discussed the G20 Research and Innovation Ministerial Declaration.

src: f) Die derde vergadering van die ontwikkelingswerkgroep wat in KwaZulu-Natal gehou is, het op dié werkgroep se prioriteite gefokus met die doel om konsensus te bereik oor die hantering van die dringende ontwikkelingsuitdagings van ons tyd.
tgt: f) The Third Development Working Group Meeting held in KwaZulu-Natal - focused on priority areas of the Development Working Group with the aim of reaching consensus on addressing pressing development challenges of our time and accelerating the attainment of the SDGs.

src: g) Die vergadering van hoof landbouwetenskaplikes (MACS) wat in Limpopo gehou is, het bruikbare strategieë bespreek oor hoe lande regoor die wêreld voedselsekerheid, volhoubare boerdery en klimaatsverandering deur innovasie en wetenskaplike samewerking kan versterk.
tgt: g) The Agricultural Chief Scientists (MACS) Meeting held in Limpopo - discussed actionable strategies on how countries around the world can strengthen food security, sustainable farming, and climate change through innovation and scientific collaboration.

src: h) Die G20-seminaar oor vroeë kindersorg en onderwys, het gefokus op hoe om vroeë kindersorg en onderwys in die middelpunt van die globale onderwysagenda te plaas.
tgt: h) The G20 Seminar on Early Childhood Care and Education - discussed placing Early Childhood Care and Education at the heart of the global education agenda.

src: i) Die G20-seminaar: Wedersydse Erkenning van Kwalifikasies in 'n Globale Konteks, het kwessies bespreek wat deurslaggewend is om inklusiewe en wêreldwye mededingende onderwysstelsels te vorm, soos internasionale arbeidsmigrasie, vaardigheidsmobiliteit en die ontwikkelende rol van mikro-krediete in lewenslange leer en indiensneembaarheid.
tgt: i) The G20 Seminar: Mutual Recognition of Qualifications in a Global Context - discussed issues that are critical to shaping inclusive and globally competitive educational systems such as international labour migration, skills mobility and the evolving role of micro-credentials in lifelong learning and employability.

src: j) Die tweede vergadering van die onderwyswerkgroep wat in Noordwes gehou is, het gehndel oor die voorsiening van gehalte- en inklusiewe onderwys vir alle leerders.
tgt: j) The Second Education Working Group Meeting held in the North West discussed the provision of quality and inclusive education for all learners.

src: Kabinetsbesluite.
tgt: Cabinet decisions.

src: Beleid oor Nasionale Arbeidsmagmigrasie (NLMP) 2025 Witskrif.
tgt: National Labour Migration Policy (NLMP) 2025 White Paper.

src: Die Kabinet het die Witskrif vir die Beleid oor Nasionale Arbeidsmigrasie (NLMP) 2025 vir implementering goedgekeur.
tgt: Cabinet approved the National Labour Migration Policy (NLMP) White Paper 2025 for implementation.

src: Die beleid is daarop gerig om ’n raamwerk te bied wat behoorlike en ordelike beweging en indiensneming van buitelandse burgers in die land afdwing.
tgt: The policy seeks to provide a framework to enforce proper and orderly movement and employment of foreign nationals in the country.

src: Dit poog om 'n balans te bereik oor verskeie gebiede, insluitend die hantering van Suid-Afrikaners se verwagtinge oor werksvooruitsigte in die lig van stygende werkloosheid en die persepsie dat buitelandse burgers toegang tot die arbeidsmark beperk.
tgt: It aims to achieve a balance across several areas, including addressing South Africans’ expectations for job prospects, in light of rising unemployment and the perception that foreign nationals restrict labour market access.

src: Die NLMP stel kwotas in op die totale aantal gedokumenteerde buitelandse burgers met werkvisums wat in belangrike ekonomiese sektore soos onder meer landbou, gasvryheid en toerisme, sowel as konstruksie, in diens geneem kan word.
tgt: The NLMP introduces quotas on the total number of documented foreign nationals with work visas that can be employed in major economic sectors such as agriculture, hospitality and tourism, as well as construction, among others.

src: Die beleid komplementeer ander tussenkomste soos die afdwing van 'n lys van sektore waar buitelandse burgers nie sakevisums kan kry nie, en wysigings aan die Nasionale Wet op Klein Ondernemings, 1996 (Wet 102 van 1996), soos gewysig, om buitelandse burgers wat klein, medium en mikro-ondernemings stig, en handel dryf in sommige sektore van die ekonomie, te beperk.
tgt: The policy complements other interventions such as enforcement of a list of sectors where foreign nationals cannot be allocated business visas and amendments to the National Small Enterprise Act, 1996 (Act 102 of 1996), as amended, to limit foreign nationals establishing small, medium and micro enterprises, and trading in some sectors of the economy.

src: Goedkeuring van die Nasionale Beleid op Besigheidslisensiëring.
tgt: Approval of the National Business Licensing Policy.

src: Die Beleid op Besigheidslisensiëring verteenwoordig 'n belangrike stap om lisensiëringsprosesse oor nasionale, provinsiale en munisipale vlakke, wat regulatoriese konsekwentheid en verbeterde nakoming verseker, te stroomlyn.
tgt: The Business Licensing Policy represents a major step in streamlining licensing processes across national, provincial, and municipal levels, ensuring regulatory consistency and improved compliance.

src: Deur duidelike riglyne en 'n voorkeur-lisensiëringsregime in te stel, bevorder die beleid ekonomiese insluiting vir medium, klein en mikro-ondernemings (MSME), sowel as histories benadeelde groepe in geteikende sektore, terwyl sekere sake-aktiwiteite uitsluitlik vir Suid-Afrikaanse ondernemings gereserveer word.
tgt: By introducing clear guidelines and a preferential licensing regime, the policy promotes economic inclusion for MSMEs and historically disadvantaged groups in targeted sectors, while reserving certain business activities exclusively for South African-owned enterprises.

src: Om die stelsel te moderniseer, vestig die beleid 'n elektroniese lisensiëringsportaal, wat verouderde handmatige prosesse vervang met 'n meer doeltreffende en deursigtige digitale platform.
tgt: To modernize the system, the policy establishes an electronic licensing portal, replacing outdated manual processes with a more efficient and transparent digital platform.

src: Hierdie hervorming verminder nie net administratiewe fragmentasie nie, maar ondersteun ook 'n meer sakevriendelike omgewing, wat billike groei en breër deelname aan die ekonomie dryf.
tgt: This reform not only reduces administrative fragmentation but also supports a more business-friendly environment, driving equitable growth and broader participation in the economy.

src: Wetsontwerpe.
tgt: Bill.

src: Wysigingswetsontwerp op Indiensnemingsdienste.
tgt: Employment Services Amendment Bill Cabinet approved the Employment Services Amendment Bill for submission to Parliament.

src: Die Kabinet het die Wysigingswetsontwerp op Indiensnemingsdienste goedgekeur vir voorlegging aan die Parlement.
tgt: The Bill provides a policy framework and the legal basis to regulate the employment of foreign nationals in businesses while promoting national security and national interests.

src: Die Wetsontwerp bied 'n beleidsraamwerk en die regsgrondslag om die indiensneming van buitelandse burgers in besighede te reguleer terwyl nasionale veiligheid en nasionale belange bevorder word.
tgt: The purpose of the Bill is to propose the regulation of labour brokers to prevent worker exploitation, such as the provision of cheap labour through undocumented foreign nationals.

src: Dit skep ook konsekwentheid tussen die bepalings van die Immigrasiewet (Wet 13 van 2002) en die Vlugtelingewet (Wet 130 van 1998).
tgt: It further creates consistency between the provisions of the Immigration Act, (Act 13 of 2002) and the Refugees Act (Act 130 of 1998).

src: Die wetsontwerp stel 'n raamwerk voor wat die Minister van Indiensneming en Arbeid in staat sal stel om kwotas vir die indiensneming van buitelandse burgers vas te stel.
tgt: The Bill proposes a framework that will enable the Minister of Employment and Labour to set quotas for the employment of foreign nationals.

src: 'n Kwota kan van toepassing wees op 'n sektor van die ekonomie, 'n beroepskategorie of 'n geografiese gebied.
tgt: A quota may apply in respect of a sector of the economy, an occupational category or a geographical area.

src: Die minister sal 'n kwota in 'n sektor vasstel na oorlegpleging met die Raad vir Indiensneming en oorweging van openbare kommentaar.
tgt: The Minister will establish a quota in a sector after consulting the Employment Services Board and considering public comments.

src: Die Kabinet het die Minister van Indiensneming en Arbeid opdrag gegee om die kartering (deur konsultasies) van dit wat skaars en kritieke vaardighede uitmaak, spoedig te finaliseer om 'n binnelandse vaardigheidsbasis te ontwikkel sodat die absorpsie van meer werklose Suid-Afrikaners verbeter kan word.
tgt: Cabinet directed the Minister of Employment and Labour to speedily finalise the mapping (through consultations) of what constitutes scarce and critical skills in order to develop a domestic skills base to improve absorption of more unemployed South Africans.

src: Die Kabinet het weer eens beklemtoon dat dit noodsaaklik is om die finalisering van die Witskrif oor Immigrasie te versnel sodat die administrasie van arbeidsmigrasie doetreffend bestuur kan word.
tgt: Cabinet reiterated the need to fast-track the finalisation of the White Paper on Immigration for the effective administration and management of labour migration.

src: AanstellingsAlle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en die toepaslike sekuriteitsklarings.
tgt: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant security clearances.
