tgt: Events.

src: Herdenking van belangrike maande en nasionale gebeure in 2025 Die Kabinet het die temas en konsepdokumente vir die die herdenking van belangrike gebeure wat deur die loop van die volgende paar maande sal plaasvind, as volg goedgekeur:
tgt: Commemoration of key months and national events in 2025 Cabinet approved the themes and concept documents for the commeration of key national events that will be taking place over the next few months as follows:

src: JeugmaandDie 2025 Jeugmaandprogram sal by die Hector Pieterson-gedenkteken en -Museum in Orlando-wes, Soweto in Gauteng plaasvind met die tema: “Vaardighede vir die veranderende wêreld – Bemagtig die jeug vir betekenisvolle ekonomiese deelname.” Die Jeumaandprogram sal fokus op ’n oproep om tot aksie oor te gaan om jeugwerkloosheid die hoof te bied en ’n ekonomie te bou wat die land se jeug prioritiseer.
tgt: Youth MonthThe 2025 Youth Month programme will be launched at the Hector Pieterson Memorial and Museum in Orlando West, Soweto in Gauteng under the theme: “Skills for the changing world – Empowering youth for meaningful economic participation.” The focus of the 2025 Youth Month programme will be a call to action to address youth unemployment and build an economy that prioritises the country’s youth.

src: Die maand sal ook gerig wees op die beskikbare leer- en werksgeleenthede in industrieë met ’n hoë-opnamekapasitiet wat in aanvraag is vir jong mense.
tgt: The month will be used to highlight the available learning and job opportunities in industries with high absorption capacity and that are in demand for young people.

src: VrouemaandDie Kabinet het die tema en aktiwiteite vir die herdenking van die 2025 Vrouemaand goedgekeur.
tgt: Women’s MonthCabinet approved the theme and activities for the commemoration of the 2025 Women’s Month programme, this year marks the 30th anniversary of the 1995 Beijing Declaration and Platform for Action, an important reflection on women’s rights, empowerment and pursuit of gender equality.

src: Die 2025-program sal fokus op die implementering van proaktiewe maatreëls om GGGV te voorkom, gesonde, respekvolle gedrag en gesindhede onder mans en seuns te bevorder, en werkplekke en omgewings te skep waar vroue en meisies veilig voel.
tgt: The 2025 programme will focus on implementing proactive measures to prevent GBVF, promote healthy, respectful behaviour and attitude among men and boys, and create workplaces and environments where women and girls feel safe.

src: Die Kabinet het die oproep aan alle Suid-Afrikaners herhaal om om die plaag van GGGV daadwerklik te konfronteer.
tgt: Cabinet reiterated the call to all South Africans to stand up and confront the scourge of GBV 16 Days of Activism against GBVFThe 16 Days of Activism against Gender Based Violence and Femicide (GBVF) will take place from 25 November until 10 December 2025 under the theme: “Empowering Change: Scaling, prevention, promoting positive masculinities, and ensuring safe and inclusive spaces to end GBVF”.

src: 16 Dae van Aktivisme teen GGGVDie 16 Dae van Aktivisme teen GGGV sal van 25 November tot 10 Desember 2025 plaasvind met die tema: "Bemagtig verandering: oorkom, voorkom, bevorder positiewe manlikheid, en verseker veilige en inklusiewe ruimtes om GGGV te beëindig".
tgt: This year’s campaign continues to address the root causes of GBVF while promoting positive masculinity and gender equity, along with creating economic opportunities for women and children.

src: Maand vir die Bewusmaking van Getremdes se RegteDie Kabinet het die konsep en tema vir die 2025 Maand van Bewustheid van Gestremdheidsregte, wat van 3 November tot 3 Desember gedenk word, goedgekeur.
tgt: Disability Rights Awareness Month Cabinet approved the concept and the theme for the 2025 Disability Rights Awareness Month (DRAM) which runs from 3 November to 3 December.

src: Die tema is: "Skep strategiese multisektorale vennootskappe vir 'n gestremdheidsinklusiewe samelewing".
tgt: The theme is: “Creating strategic multisectoral partnerships for disability-inclusive society”.

src: Hierdie tema beklemtoon die belangrikheid van vennootskappe om die regte en deelname van mense met gestremdhede in die samelewing te bevorder.
tgt: The theme emphasises the importance of partnerships towards promoting the rights and participation, of people with disability in society.

src: Die maandlange aktiwiteite sal bewustheid verhoog en die vordering wat die land gemaak het beklemtoon om te verseker dat die regte van persone met gestremdhede beskerm word.
tgt: The month-long activities will raise awareness and also showcase progress the country has made in ensuring that the rights of persons with disability are protected, this will include promoting the voice of children with disability, unlocking digital opportunities for persons with disability and investing in strategies to promote disability-inclusive jobs.

src: Boodskappe.
tgt: Messages.

src: MegevoelDie Kabinet het sy medelye aan die vriende en naasbestaandes van die volgende mense oorgedra:a) Mama Gertrude Ntiti Shope, wat liefdevol bekend was as MaShope.
tgt: CondolencesCabinet expressed condolences to the friends and family of:a) Mama Gertrude Ntiti Shope, who was affectionately known as MaShope, a stalwart from our liberation struggle who was part of the first cohort of democratically elected members of Parliament in 1994.

src: Sy was 'n staatmaker van ons bevrydingstryd en deel van die eerste groep demokraties verkose parlementslede van die 1994-Parlement.
tgt: She was also a member of the Order for Meritorious Service (Silver), awarded in 2003 in recognition of her exceptional public service.

src: Sy was ook 'n lid van die Orde vir Verdienstelike Diens (Silwer), wat in 2003 aan haar toegeken is ter erkenning van haar uitsonderlike openbare diens.
tgt: Further, MaShope was a founding member of the Federation of South African Women (FEDSAW) which mobilised women to fight against the unjust, brutal and racist apartheid regime.

src: Sy is in 1991 as die eerste president van die ANC Vroueliga (ANCWL) verkies.
tgt: She was elected the first President of the ANCWL in 1991.

src: President Ramaphosa het verklaar dat MaShope vereer word met 'n spesiale amptelike begrafnis kategorie 1 en dat Suid-Afrikaanse vlae regoor die land en in al ons stasies halfstok moet hang tot haar begrafnisdiens op Saterdag 31 Me 2025.b) MeLungi Annette Mnganga-Gcabashe wat sedert 2004 op verskeie tye 'n parlementslid was en as voorsitter van die portefeuljekomitee oor toerisme in die 7de Parlement gedien het.
tgt: President Ramaphosa has declared that MaShope be honoured with a Special Official Funeral Category 1 and that South African flags across the country and in all our stations must fly at half mast until her funeral service on Saturday, 31 May 2025. b) Ms Lungi Annette Mnganga-Gcabashe who a Member of Parliament at various periods since 2004 and served as the Chairperson of the Portfolio Committee on Tourism in the 7th Parliament.

src: Sy was ook die huidige adjunkpresident van die ANCWSy het teen die ongeregtighede van apartheid geveg en 'n aktiewe rol gespeel in die mobilisering van gemeenskappe vir vrede tydens die hoogtepunt van politieke geweld in KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: She was also the current Deputy President of the ANCWShe fought against the injustices of Apartheid and played an active role in mobilising communities for peace at the height of political violence in KwaZulu-Natal.

src: c) Bekroonde akteur, Presley Chweneyagae, wat bekend geword het vir sy uitsonderlike toneelspel in die rolprent Tsotsi, wat in 2005 die Oscar-toekenning vir beste buitelandsse rolprent gewen het.
tgt: c) Award-winning actor, Presley Chweneyagae who became known for his extraordinary acting abilities in the film Tsotsi, which won the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film in 2005.

src: Hy het in talle rolprente en televisiedramas verskyn, en ten tyde van sy afsterwe was hy gewild in sy rol as Cobrizi in die gewilde televisiedrama The River.
tgt: He featured in many films and television drama, at the time of his passing he was popular in his role as Cobrizi in the popular television drama The River.

src: d) Veteraan-uitsaaier Darren Scott wie se stem die Suid-Afrikaanse radiobedryf vir meer as vier dekades gevorm het en in 2024 in die Radio Awards Hall of Fame opgeneem is.
tgt: d) Veteran broadcaster Darren Scott whose voice shaped the South African radio industry for over four decades and was in 2024 inducted into the Radio Awards Hall of Fame.

src: e) Gevierde voormalige Sprinkbok-vleuel Cornal Hendricks, wat tussen 2014 en 2015 12 toetse vir die Springbokke gespeel het en vyf drieë gedruk het.
tgt: e) Celebrated former Springbok winger Cornal Hendricks who played 12 Tests matched for the Springboks between 2014 and 2015 and scored five tries.

src: f) Charles B Rangel, voormalige en langdienende Amerikaanse kongreslid van Harlem, New York, wat in 1987 die borg was van wat bekend geword as die Rangel-wysiging dit het die Amerikaanse belastingkode verander om buitelandse belastingkrediete te weier aan Amerikaanse maatskappye wat in apartheid Suid-Afrika belê.
tgt: f) Charles B Rangel, former and long serving US congressman from Harlem, New York, who in 1987 sponsored what became known as the “Rangel Amendment” that changed the US tax code to deny foreign tax credits to US companies investing in Apartheid South Africa.

src: Hy het ook sy invloed gebruik om te help om handelsgeleenthede tussen ontwikkelende lande en die VSA te help skep deur die Caribbean Basin Initiative en die African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA).
tgt: He also used his influence to help open trading opportunities between the US and developing nations through the Caribbean Basin Initiative and the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA).g) Ngũgĩ wa Thiong'o, Kenyan author who died aged 87, was a giant of modern African literature – his writings documenting the transformation of Kenya from a colonial subject to a democracy, and his work continues to inspire Africa and the World in the development of the African Continent.

src: g) Ngũgĩ wa Thiong'o, die Keniaanse skrywer wat op die ouderdom van 87 oorlede is, was 'n reus van moderne Afrika-letterkunde.
tgt: He will be remembered as one of the greatest literary giant from the African continent.

src: h) Dr Dean Tshenuwani Simon Farisani, 'n voormalige lid van die Parlement, 'n voormalige LUR van Vervoer in Limpopo, 'n teoloog en pastoor van die Evangeliese Lutherse Kerk van Suider-Afrika (ELCSA).
tgt: h) Dr, Dean Tshenuwani Simon Farisani, a former member of Parliament, a former MEC of Transport in Limpopo, a theologian and pastor of the Evangelical Lutheran Church of Southern Africa (ELCSA).

src: Gedurende die apartheidsera was hy een van die land se prominentste swart geestelikes wat anti-apartheidsbevrydingsteologie vanuit sy Bisdom en Devhula-Lebowakring in die destydse Transvaal verkondig het.
tgt: During the Apartheid era, he was one of the country’s most prominent black clergymen who preached anti-Apartheid liberation theology from his Diocese and Devhula-Lebowa Circuit in the then Transvaal.

src: Hy het die Swart Evangeliese Jeugorganisasie saam met Cyril Ramaphosa (Suid-Afrika se huidige president) in die vroeë 1970's gestig en was ook aktief in die swart bewussynsbeweging, veral as die president van die Konvensie van Swartmense van 1973 tot 1975.
tgt: He founded the Black Evangelic Youth Organisation with Cyril Ramaphosa (the current President of South Africa) in the early 1970s and was also active in the Black Consciousness movement, especially as its President of the Black People’s Convention from 1973 to 1975.

src: Hy is volgens Amnesty International by verskeie geleenthede as 'n gewetensgevangene in hegtenis geneem en het in die buiteland getuig oor die marteling waaraan hy deur die apartheidspolisie onderwerp is.
tgt: He was arrested on several occasions, according to Amnesty International as a prisoner of conscience, and he testified abroad about the torture he was subjected to by the apartheid police.

src: Hy is in die vroeë 1980's verban en in ballingskap geplaas.
tgt: He was banished and exiled in the early 1980s.

src: Me sy terugkeer nadat die ANC ontban is, het hy bygedra tot die heropbou van ANC-strukture en het die Kerk gemobiliseer om die versoening van die land en gemeenskapsontwikkeling aktief te ondersteun.
tgt: Upon his return after the unbanning of the ANC, he contributed to the rebuilding of the ANC structures, mobilising the Church to actively support the reconciliation of the country and community development.

src: GelukwenseDie Kabinet het sy gelukwense en goeie wense oorgedra aan:a) Die naelloopsensasie Akani Simbine, tans die vinnigste atleet ter wêreld, wat die 100m by die Atlanta City Games in 9.86 sekondes en die 100m by die Rabat Diamond League in 'n tyd van 9.95 sekondes gewen het.
tgt: CongratulationsCabinet extended its congratulations and well-wishes to:a) Sprinting sensation Akani Simbine, currently the fastest athlete in the world, who won the 100m at the Atlanta City Games in 9.86 seconds and the 100m at the Rabat Diamond League in a time of 9.95s.

src: b) Junior naelloop-sensasie Bayanda Walaza, die vinnigste in sy ouderdomskategorie ter wêreld, wat 'n nuwe Suid-Afrikaanse rekord in die mans 100 m opgestel het met 'n tyd van 9.94 sekondes by die Boris Hanzekovic-gedenkwedloop.
tgt: b) Junior sprint sensation Bayanda Walaza, the fastest in his age category in the world who set a new South African record in the Men’s 100m, clocking 9.94 seconds at the Boris Hanzekovic Memorial.

src: c) Suid-Afrikaanse atleet, Zakithi Nene, wat tweede geëindig het in die mans 400 m met 'n stewige tyd van 44.46 sekondes by die Rabat Diamantliga.
tgt: c) South African athlete, Zakithi Nene who finished 2nd in the Men’s 400m, clocking a solid 44.46 seconds at the Rabat Diamond League.

src: d) Amajita, die o.20 nasionale sokkerspan, wat geskiedenis gemaak het deur die o.20 Afrikabeker-titel vir die eerste keer te wen.
tgt: d) Amajita, the under 20 national soccer team, who made history by winning the U20 Africa Cup of Nations title for the first time.

src: Ekonomiese groei.1 Die Kabinet neem kennis van die bruto binnelandse produk (BBP) se syfers soos deur StatsSA bekend gemaak, wat daarop dui dat die ekonomie in die eerste kwartaal van 2025 met 0.1% gegroei het.
tgt: Issues in the environment Economy Economic growth.1 Cabinet noted the gross domestic product (GDP) figures as released by StatsSA that indicated that the economy grew by 0.1% in the first (quarter (Q1) of 2025, and this follows an increase of 0.4% in the 4th Quarter of 2024.

src: Dit volg op 'n toename van 0.4% in die 4de kwartaal van 2024.
tgt: .2 Amongst others, the agriculture, forestry, and fishing industry increased by 15.8%, whereas the transport, storage and communication industry increased by 2.4%.

src: .2 Die landbou-, bosbou- en visbedryf het onder meer met 15,8% gestyg, terwyl die vervoer-, bergings- en kommunikasiebedryf met 2,4% gestyg het.
tgt: Furthermore, the trade, catering and accommodation industry increased by 0.5%.3 Cabinet remains concerned about the decline in the manufacturing industry, more so when government has prioritised boosting local manufacturing and thus awaits the finalisation of the revised Industrial Policy.

src: Hierbenewens het die handel-, spysenierings- en akkommodasiebedryf met 0,5% gestyg.3 Die Kabinet bly bekommerd oor die agteruitgang in die vervaardigingsbedryf, veral omdat die regering die bevordering van plaaslike vervaardiging geprioritiseer het en op die finalisering van die hersiene nywerheidsbeleid wag.
tgt: .4 Government understands the impact of the challenges within freight and logistics that continues to impact the growth of the mining industry, and we are maintaining a razor-sharp focus on the work of Operation Vulindlela Phase 2 and the Government Business Partnership in urgently resolving the logistics challenges of the country.5 As such Cabinet welcomes the approval by the National Assembly of the 2025 Fiscal Framework that will increase government spending on infrastructure investment (one trillion Rands over the 3-year period).

src: .4 Die regering het begrip vir die impak van die uitdagings binne die vrag- en logistiekbedryf, wat steeds die groei van die mynbedryf beïnvloed.
tgt: Quarterly Labour Force Survey .1 Cabinet has noted media reports that raised concerns about the employment figures from the informal sector in the Quarterly Labour Force Survey (QLFS).2 QLFS collects data on the labour market activities of individuals aged 15 years and older on a quarterly basis.

src: Verder lewer StatsSA elke vier jaar 'n omvattende verslag, wat 'n toegewyde module vir die Opname van Werkgewers en Selfstandiges (mense in eie diens) insluit.
tgt: Furthermore, StatsSA produces a comprehensive report every four years, which includes a dedicated module for the Survey of of Employers and the Self-Employed (SESE).

src: Hierdie werkersopname het ten doel om diepgaande insig in die kenmerke en bedrywighede van ondernemings in Suid-Afrika se informele sektor te verskaf.3 Die Kabinet het die opsie van 'n kwartaallikse of jaarlikse werkersopname bespreek, maar StatsSA benodig toegang tot 'n register van informele besighede waaruit ’n verteenwoordigende steekproef getrek kan word.4 Ons het voorheen aangekondig dat die Kabinet die Nasionale Besigheidslisensiëringsbeleid (NBLB) goedgekeur het, wat onder meer 'n gestandaardiseerde lisensiëring van informele besighede moontlik sal maak.
tgt: This survey aims to provide in-depths insights into the characteristics and operations of the informal sector businesses within South Africa.3 Cabinet has been discussing the option of either a quarterly or annual SESE, however the StatsSA would require access to a business register of informal businesses which is currently absence from wherein StatsSA will be able to draw representative sample.4 We previously announced that Cabinet has approved the National Business Licensing Policy (NBLP) which will enable a standardised licensing of informal businesses amongst others and over a period of the implementation of this Policy, the Department of Small business Development should be able to create a reliable register of informal businesses that will improve the QLFS and the possibility of an annual SESJustice and Crime Prevention.1 Safety and security.1 Cabinet has noted the continuous debate about crime in South Africa and allegations that there is a lack of a concrete government plan to deal with crime in South Africa, this is despite that on the 23rd May 2025, the Minister of Police released the 2024/5 Quarter 4 (1 January – 31 March 2025) crime statistics.2 During this crime statistics release the Minister of Police outlined the 7th Administration Policing Priorities as follows:

src: Dit is ondanks die feit dat die Minister van Polisie op 23 Me 2025 die 2024/25 Kwartaal 4 (1 Januarie – 31 Maart 2025) misdaadstatistieke vrygestel het.2 Me die vrystelling van misdaadstatistieke het die Minister van Polisie die 7de Administrasie se polisiëringsprioriteite as volg uiteengesit:
tgt: dismantling organised crime, including drug trafficking syndicates, cash-in-transit heist, extortion, and kidnappings, tackling gang violence, and combating corruption – both within the SAPS and across the country.3 The 2024/25, 4th Quarter statics showed progress (general decline) compared to same period in the previous financial year.

src: aftakeling van georganiseerde misdaad, insluitend dwelmhandelsindikate, transitorooftogte, afpersing en ontvoerings, die aanpak van bendegeweld en die bekamping van korrupsie – binne die SAPD sowel as regoor die land.3 Die 2024/25 4de kwartaalstatistieke het vordering (’n algemene afname) getoon in vergelyking met dieselfde tydperk in die vorige boekjaar.
tgt: .6 The Directorate for Priority Crime Investigation is also continuing with its work, which resulted in 656 suspects appearing in court, including 364 linked to serious organised crimes, 220 from serious commercial crime and 72 from serious corruption.7 On GBVF, a roundtable led by the IMC on GBVF will be held this Friday, 13 June 2025 at the Atteridgeville Community Hall in Pretoria and will focus on the National Strategic Plan implementation and progress.

src: Repatriasie van Suid-Afrikaners in ballingskap se oorskot.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die bekendstelling van fase 2 van die Ballingskap-repatriasieprojek, wat die herbegrafnis van Khoi- en San-voorvaders se menslike oorskot insluit.
tgt: The process of the reburial of the 58 ancestral remains that originate from the Northern Cape, is at an advanced stage and consultations with affected communities are underway.2 The initiative builds on the success of the repatriation of 49 former freedom fighters in 2024 and is a testament to government’s commitment to addressing historical injustices and fostering a sense of unity and healing within the nation.

src: Klem sal egter gelê word op die opsporing, opgrawing en teruggee van die oorskot van vryheidsvegters wat in ballingskap gesterf het.
tgt: A joint delegation will soon embark on a technical mission to Angola, Lesotho, Zambia and Zimbabwe to conduct research, cemetery record inspections and grave mapping.

src: Die inisiatief om die oorskot van Khoi en San van buite die land huis toe te bring en te herbegrawe, is ’n belangrike stap om Suid-Afrika se voorvader-erfenis akkuraat aan te teken.
tgt: Celebration of the establishment of the Constitutional Court.1 2025 marks 25 years since the first session of the Constitutional Court, an important instrument in the protection of our constitutional democracy.2 It is in this spirit that Cabinet welcomed the engagements between government and the Judiciary led by Chief Justice Mandisa Maya and heads of courts which was hosted by President Cyril Ramaphosa.

src: Die herbegrafnis van die 58 voorvaders se oorskot uit die Noord-Kaap, is in 'n gevorderde stadium en konsultasies met gemeenskappe wat hierdeur geraak word, is op dreef.2 Hierdie inisiatief bou voort op die sukses van die repatriasie van 49 voormalige vryheidsvegters in 2024 en is 'n bewys van die regering se verbintenis om historiese ongeregtighede die hoof te bied en 'n gevoel van eenheid en genesing binne die land te bevorder.
tgt: The engagements focused on discussing the implementation of the outstanding administrative measures to give effect to the constitutional provisions of ensuring the judiciary, like parliament, operates as an independent arm of the state.

src: 'n Gesamentlike afvaardiging sal binnekort 'n tegniese sending na Angola, Lesotho, Zambië en Zimbabwe onderneem om navorsing, inspeksie van begraafplaasrekords en grafkartering te doen.
tgt: Both the Executive and the Judiciary reaffirmed the shared commitment to building a stronger, more effective justice system firmly anchored in the values of our Constitution.

src: Maatskaplike beskerming en menslike ontwikkeling.1 Uiterste weer.1 Die Kabinet betuig sy meegevoel met die naasbestaandes van diegene wat tydens oorstromings in verskeie gebiede in die Oos-Kaap gesterf het.
tgt: Emergency teams have also been deployed from Gqeberha, East London and the Chris Hani District to the affected areas to support local responders.3 Cabinet cautions everyone to be vigilant over the next few days due to the expected extreme weather conditions in most parts of the country.

src: Noodspanne is ook van Gqeberha, Oos-Londen en die Chris Hani-distrik na die rampgebiede ontplooi om plaaslike regerings te ondersteun.3 Die Kabinet waarsku almal om oor die volgende paar dae waaksaam te wees vir die verwagte uiterste weerstoestande in die meeste dele van die land.
tgt: Health.1 New COVID-19 variant in certain regions in Asia.1 Cabinet assures South Africans that the country is, through the Department of Health (DoH), closely monitoring the emergence of a new COVID-19 variant, known as Nimbus or NB.1, associated with a rise in cases in certain regions of Asia.2 Cabinet calls on all citizens to ensure good hygiene practices including avoiding unnecessary handshaking, washing hands with soap, covering the mouth when coughing, using a mask when one has flu, and staying home when feeling unwell.

src: Die variant word geassosieer met 'n toename in gevalle in sekere streke van Asië.2 Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle burgers om goeie higiënepraktyke toe te pas, soos om nie onnodige mekaar se hande aan te raak nie, hul hande met seep te was, hul monde te bedek tydens hoes of nies, 'n masker te gebruik indien hulle griep het, en tuis te bly as hulle siek voel.
tgt: The department has ordered over 900 000 doses of vaccines, with the first batch expected to arrive soon.2 In areas where there are active outbreaks, all infected properties are placed under quarantine no movement is allowed into, out of, or through these areas or farms.

src: Ons het tydens die Covid-19-pandemie gewys dat ons deur hierdie eenvoudige maatreëls die verspreiding van respiratoriese siektes kan verminder.
tgt: Large areas, where individuals cannot be served with quarantine notices, are declared Disease Management Areas and the same restrictions apply.3 In addition, plans are underway to establish a Biosecurity Council that will bring together the South African Police Service, veterinarians, scientists, the Border Management Authority and captains of industry to better respond to future outbreaks and manage the related risks.

src: Bek-en-klouseer.1 Die Kabinet verwelkom die Departement van Landbou se vinnige reaksie nadat bek-en-klouseer uitgebreek het.
tgt: Initiation season.1 The 2025 winter initiation season is upon us, government remains committed to ensuring the safety of initiates, while preserving the cultural sanctity of the practice.2 Several measures are being implemented for the 2025 initiation season, including mandatory registration and verification of initiation schools, along with thorough medical screening of all initiates.

src: .2 President Ramaphosa het 'n interministeriële komitee aangestel wat deur adjunkpresident, Paulos Mashatile, gelei sal word om die Nasionale Konvensie sowel as die Nasionale Dialoog voor te berei, te koördineer en te fasiliteer.
tgt: .5 Through the implementation of Local Government Reforms introduced under Operation Vulindlela Phase 2, government will work to support this important commitment by the Auditor-General and working with entities to follow prescribed process to regularise the irregular expenditure.

src: .3 President Ramaphosa het verder 'n groep vooraanstaande burgers aangestel wat leiding aan die regering sal gee ten opsigte van beide die Nasionale Konvensie en die Nasionale Dialoog.
tgt: This work with also be complemented by the review of the Local Government White Paper to eliminate those areas of irregular expenditure which are caused by legislative gaps.

src: Plaaslike regering-oudituitkomste.1 Die Kabinet neem kennis van die 2023/24 Algemene Verslag oor Plaaslike Regering-oudituitkomste, wat 'n paar verbeterings op die gebied van finansiële state en prestasieverslae toon.
tgt: Clean Cities and Towns campaign.1 Cabinet welcomed the launch by Deputy President Paulos Mashatile of the Clean Cities and Towns campaign to encourage communities to keep our cities and towns clean.

src: Sodra dit deur die ouditeur-generaal geïdentifiseer is, beteken dit dat die entiteit versuim het om die toepaslike wette in ooreenstemming met relevante bepalings van die ouditeur-generaal na te kom.4 Die Kabinet is bemoedig deur die ouditeur-generaal se verbintenis om nuttelose en verkwistende uitgawes voor die einde van haar ampstermyn uit te roei.
tgt: .2 The G7 Summit aims to address pressing global challenges including fostering inclusive economic growth, combating climate change and navigating the complexities of rapidly evolving technologies.3 Discussions are expected to focus on international security concerns, particularly the ongoing conflict in Ukraine and strengthening global economic stability.

src: .2 Die G7-beraad het ten doel om dringende wêreldwye uitdagings die hoof te bied dit sluit in die bevordering van inklusiewe ekonomiese groei, die bekamping van klimaatsverandering en die navigasie van die kompleksiteite van vinnig ontwikkelende tegnologieë.3 Besprekings sal na verwagting ook op internasionale veiligheidskwessies fokus, veral op die voortslepende konflik in die Oekraïne en die versterking van wêreldwye ekonomiese stabiliteit.
tgt: All Water Services Authorities (WSA) to pay their current invoices in full to the Water Boards timeously, immediately, all Water Boards to pay their current invoices in full to Department of Water and Sanitation (DWS), starting immediately, DWS and water boards to implement the approved debt write-off mechanism with qualifying municipalities, starting immediately and DWS to implement the revised Raw Water Pricing Strategy by 1 April National Treasury to finalise the review of the funding model for local government and DWS to establish an independent economic water regulator to regulate water prices across the water value chain, within three years.

src: Suid-Afrika-Ruslandbetrekkinge.1 Adjunkpresident, Paulos Mashatile, sal tussen 16 en 21 Junie 2025 'n werksbesoek aan die Russiese Federasie onderneem om die jarelange diplomatieke en ekonomiese bande tussen Suid-Afrika en die Russiese Federasie te versterk.2 Die besoek bied 'n geleentheid om ekonomiese vennootskappe verder te versterk, nuwe weë vir samewerking te ondersoek en vrede in die streek te bevorder.
tgt: All WSAs/Water Service Providers (WSPs) which do not yet have non-revenue water programmes, to have these in place by May 2025, all WSAs which have not yet ringfenced revenues from the sale of water for the water function to take resolutions to their Councils in this regard within 6 months and all WSAs to review their indigent registers and ensure the provision of free basic water to the indigent within two years.

src: Die uitkomste bevestig die regering se verbintenis om sektorale uitdagings te oorkom en 'n volhoubare water- en sanitasiesektor te bou, wat tot die handhawing van alle Suid-Afrikaners se waardigheid en welstand bydra.
tgt: These include the tourism legacy project under the leadership of the Department of Tourism, and events such as Tourism Investment Summit, Tourism Hackathon, and Tourism Sustainability Village.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom belanghebbendes se verbintenis om dienslewering in die sektor te verbeter deur middel van ingrypings oor die kort-, medium- en langtermyn met sleutelbesluite wat op die volgende fokus:1.
tgt: These are intended to use the G20 platform to elevate and reposition South Africa as a destination of choice for both tourism and tourism investment.

src: Alle staatsdepartemente moet binne drie maande korrekte fakture van munisipaliteite betaal en munisipaliteite moet streng kredietbeheermaatreëls op staatsdepartemente wat nie betaal nie toepas.
tgt: The following G20 meetings were held in South Africa in preparation for the G20 Summit The third Digital Economy Working Group (DEWG) meeting held on 9 to 11 June 2025 in Limpopo, focused on advancing a set of shared priorities designed to make the digital economy more inclusive, more accountable and more enabling of sustainable development.

src: Alle waterdienste-owerhede om hul huidige fakture betyds, onmiddellik en ten volle aan die waterrade te betaal alle waterrade om hul huidige fakture onmiddellik ten volle aan die Departement van Water en Sanitasie (DWS) te betaal, die DWS en waterrade om onmiddellik die goedgekeurde skuldafskrywingsmeganisme met kwalifiserende munisipaliteite te implementeer, en die DWS om die hersiene rouwaterprysstrategie teen 1 April 2026 te implementeer.
tgt: The third International Financial Architecture Working Group meeting held from 9 to 10 June 2025 in Limpopo, discussed the monitoring and reporting framework of the G20 Roadmap towards better, bigger and more effective Multilateral Development Banks (MDBs).

src: Nasionale tesourie om die hersiening van die befondsingsmodel vir plaaslike regering en DWS te finaliseer om binne drie jaar 'n onafhanklike ekonomiese waterreguleerder te vestig om waterpryse regoor die waterwaardeketting te reguleer.
tgt: The G20 Provincial Education Indaba held in KZN on 10 June 2025 explored opportunities that will enable member countries to deliver quality early childhood care and education as well as produce capable learners for the future.

src: Die G20-interministeriële komitee het verslag gedoen oor sommige van die beplande G20-nalatenskapprojekte en kantlyngeleenthede onder die vaandel van Suid-Afrika se G20-presidentskap.
tgt: The third Task Force meeting on Artificial Intelligence (AI), Data Governance and Innovation for Sustainable Development took place in Limpopo from the 12 to 13 June 2025, provides an opportunity for the G20 member countries to shape the future of AI development and use for global public interest.

src: Dit sluit die toerisme-nalatenskapprojek onder leiding van die Departement van Toerisme in, sowel as geleenthede soos die Tourism Investment Summit, Tourism Hackathon en Tourism Sustainability Village.
tgt: CABINET DECISIONS Report of the Inter-Ministerial Committee on Foodborne Illnesses Cabinet received a report of the IMC on Food-borne Illnesses with a special focus on organophosphate pesticides.

src: Hierdie projekte is daarop gemik om die G20-platform te gebruik om Suid-Afrika te bevorder en te her-posisioneer as 'n voorkeurbestemming vir toerisme sowel as toerismebelegging.
tgt: The IMC was advised by the Ministerial Advisory Council (MAC) on food born illnesses as appointed by the Minister of Health, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi.

src: Die volgende G20-vergaderings is in Suid-Afrika gehou ter voorbereiding van die G20-beraad Die derde vergadering van die Digitale Ekonomiewerkgroep wat van 9 tot 11 Junie 2025 in Limpopo gehou is, het op die bevordering van 'n stel gedeelde prioriteite gefokus, wat daarop gerig is om die digitale ekonomie meer inklusief, meer aanspreeklik en meer uitvoerbaar vir volhoubare ontwikkeling te maak.
tgt: The MAC comprises of experts from various health disciplines and they will provide guidance on the prevention of future outbreaks.

src: Die derde vergadering van die Internasionale Finansiële Argitektuurwerkgroep wat van 9 tot 10 Junie 2025 in Limpopo gehou is, het die G20-padkaart se moniterings- en verslagdoeningsraamwerk na beter, groter en doeltreffender multilaterale ontwikkelingsbanke bespreek.
tgt: The MAC conducted work on the availability and use of Terbufos, (commonly known as Galiphirimi), a highly hazardous product that caused the death of six children in Naledi, Soweto.

src: Daar is beraadslaag oor geleenthede vir tegnologie-oordrag, volhoubare finansiering en regulatoriese belyning om tydige en billike toegang tot tegnologie, wat lewens kan red tydens gesondheidsnoodgevalle, te verseker.
tgt: Cabinet has approved the ban and the importation of Terbufos in South Africa, a chemical compound classified as an organophosphate, commonly used as an insecticide and pesticide.

src: Die derde taakspanvergadering oor kunsmatige intelligensie (KI), databestuur en innovasie vir volhoubare ontwikkeling, wat van 12 tot 13 Junie 2025 in Limpopo gehou is, het 'n geleentheid vir die G20-lidlande gebied om die toekoms van KI-ontwikkeling en -gebruik vir wêreldwye openbare belang te vorm.
tgt: The Department of Agriculture will lead the consultation process on the ban in line with its 2010 Plan to eradicate poisonous insecticides and pesticides over a period of time and also work on identifying safer alternatives to Terbufos.

src: Die beraad bring Afrika se ministers van energie, beleidmakers en beleggers bymekaar om geleenthede in groenwaterstofproduksie, -infrastruktuurontwikkeling en -uitvoerpotensiaal te ondersoek.2 Die land se waterstofsektor word al hoe meer prominent as 'n hoeksteen van die land se strategie vir die oorgang na 'n laekoolstofekonomie, die skep van volhoubare werksgeleenthede en die posisionering van die land as 'n wêreldleier in groen energie.
tgt: CondolencesCabinet expressed condolences to the friends and family of:a) Cabinet expressed its condolences to the Government of the Republic of Zambia and the nation, following the passing away of former President, His Excellency Edgar Chagwa Lungu of Zambiab) Renowned photographer, cultural activist and jazz organizer, Rashid Lombard.

src: Jeugmaand (2025 Nasionale Jeugdag)2.1 Die Kabinet doen 'n beroep op alle Suid-Afrikaners, veral jongmense, om Nasionale Jeugdag op 16 Junie te herdenk onder die tema ‘Vaardighede vir die veranderende wêreld, bemagtiging van die jeug vir betekenisvolle ekonomiese deelname’.
tgt: Lombard was an esteemed member of the National Order of Ikhamanga (Silver), which he received in 2014 for his contribution to arts and culture and his dedication to promoting jazz music in the country andc) Former Judge President of the Eastern Cape Division of the High Court, Justice Clement Temba Sangoni, a jurist of towering intellect and a firm upholder of unwavering principle of justice, who was also a senior traditional leader of the Qokolweni-Zimbane Traditional Council in Mthatha.

tgt: CongratulationsCabinet extends its congratulations and well wishes to:a) Tete Dijana for winning the 2025 Comrades Marathon for the third time, having previously won in 2022 and 2023b) Gerda Steyn for defending her Comrades Marathon title by winning the Women’s 2025 Comrades Marathon and becoming the first South African runner to win the ultimate human race four times.

src: Dit sal fokus op die bevordering van onderwys en vaardigheidsontwikkeling vir die jeug, wat aan ekonomiese geleenthede gekoppel is.
